verses.original: וַ/יֵּ֖דַע יוֹאָ֣ב בֶּן צְרֻיָ֑ה כִּֽי לֵ֥ב הַ/מֶּ֖לֶךְ עַל אַבְשָׁלֽוֹם
verses.translit: vyd' yv'b bn tsryh khy lb hmlkh 'l 'bshlvm
verses.translation: Now Joab the son of Zeruiah perceived that the king’s heart was toward Absalom.

verses.original: וַ/יִּשְׁלַ֤ח יוֹאָב֙ תְּק֔וֹעָ/ה וַ/יִּקַּ֥ח מִ/שָּׁ֖ם אִשָּׁ֣ה חֲכָמָ֑ה וַ/יֹּ֣אמֶר אֵ֠לֶי/הָ הִֽתְאַבְּלִי נָ֞א וְ/לִבְשִׁי נָ֣א בִגְדֵי אֵ֗בֶל וְ/אַל תָּס֨וּכִי֙ שֶׁ֔מֶן וְ/הָיִ֕ית כְּ/אִשָּׁ֗ה זֶ֚ה יָמִ֣ים רַבִּ֔ים מִתְאַבֶּ֖לֶת עַל מֵֽת
verses.translit: vyshlch yv'b tqv'h vyqch mshm 'shh chkhmh vy'mr 'lyh ht'bly n' vlbshy n' bgdy 'bl v'l tsvkhy shmn vhyyt kh'shh zh ymym rbym mt'blt 'l mt
verses.translation: And Joab sent to Tekoah, and fetched thence a wise woman, and said unto her, I pray thee, feign thyself to be a mourner, and put on now mourning apparel, and anoint not thyself with oil, but be as a woman that had a long time mourned for the dead:

verses.original: וּ/בָאת֙ אֶל הַ/מֶּ֔לֶךְ וְ/דִבַּ֥רְתְּ אֵלָ֖י/ו כַּ/דָּבָ֣ר הַ/זֶּ֑ה וַ/יָּ֧שֶׂם יוֹאָ֛ב אֶת הַ/דְּבָרִ֖ים בְּ/פִֽי/הָ
verses.translit: vb't 'l hmlkh vdbrt 'lyv khdbr hzh vyshm yv'b 't hdbrym bpyh
verses.translation: And come to the king, and speak on this manner unto him. So Joab put the words in her mouth.

verses.original: וַ֠/תֹּאמֶר הָ/אִשָּׁ֤ה הַ/תְּקֹעִית֙ אֶל הַ/מֶּ֔לֶךְ וַ/תִּפֹּ֧ל עַל אַפֶּ֛י/הָ אַ֖רְצָ/ה וַ/תִּשְׁתָּ֑חוּ וַ/תֹּ֖אמֶר הוֹשִׁ֥עָ/ה הַ/מֶּֽלֶךְ
verses.translit: vt'mr h'shh htq'yt 'l hmlkh vtpl 'l 'pyh 'rtsh vtshtchv vt'mr hvsh'h hmlkh
verses.translation: And when the woman of Tekoah spake to the king, she fell on her face to the ground, and did obeisance, and said, Help, O king.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּֽאמֶר לָ֥/הּ הַ/מֶּ֖לֶךְ מַה לָּ֑/ךְ וַ/תֹּ֗אמֶר אֲבָ֛ל אִשָּֽׁה אַלְמָנָ֥ה אָ֖נִי וַ/יָּ֥מָת אִישִֽׁ/י
verses.translit: vy'mr lh hmlkh mh lkh vt'mr 'bl 'shh 'lmnh 'ny vymt 'yshy
verses.translation: And the king said unto her, What aileth thee? And she answered, I am indeed a widow woman, and mine husband is dead.

verses.original: וּ/לְ/שִׁפְחָֽתְ/ךָ֙ שְׁנֵ֣י בָנִ֔ים וַ/יִּנָּצ֤וּ שְׁנֵי/הֶם֙ בַּ/שָּׂדֶ֔ה וְ/אֵ֥ין מַצִּ֖יל בֵּֽינֵי/הֶ֑ם וַ/יַּכּ֧/וֹ הָ/אֶחָ֛ד אֶת הָ/אֶחָ֖ד וַ/יָּ֥מֶת אֹתֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: vlshpchtkh shny bnym vyntsv shnyhm bshdh v'yn mtsyl bynyhm vykhv h'chd 't h'chd vymt 'tv
verses.translation: And thy handmaid had two sons, and they two strove together in the field, and there was none to part them, but the one smote the other, and slew him.

verses.original: וְ/הִנֵּה֩ קָ֨מָה כָֽל הַ/מִּשְׁפָּחָ֜ה עַל שִׁפְחָתֶ֗/ךָ וַ/יֹּֽאמְרוּ֙ תְּנִ֣י אֶת מַכֵּ֣ה אָחִ֗י/ו וּ/נְמִתֵ֨/הוּ֙ בְּ/נֶ֤פֶשׁ אָחִי/ו֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר הָרָ֔ג וְ/נַשְׁמִ֖ידָה גַּ֣ם אֶת הַ/יּוֹרֵ֑שׁ וְ/כִבּ֗וּ אֶת גַּֽחַלְתִּ/י֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר נִשְׁאָ֔רָה לְ/בִלְתִּ֧י שום שִׂים לְ/אִישִׁ֛/י שֵׁ֥ם וּ/שְׁאֵרִ֖ית עַל פְּנֵ֥י הָ/אֲדָמָֽה
verses.translit: vhnh qmh khl hmshpchh 'l shpchtkh vy'mrv tny 't mkhh 'chyv vnmthv bnpsh 'chyv 'shr hrg vnshmydh gm 't hyvrsh vkhbv 't gchlty 'shr nsh'rh lblty shvm shym l'yshy shm vsh'ryt 'l pny h'dmh
verses.translation: And, behold, the whole family is risen against thine handmaid, and they said, Deliver him that smote his brother, that we may kill him, for the life of his brother whom he slew; and we will destroy the heir also: and so they shall quench my coal which is left, and shall not leave to my husband neither name nor remainder upon the earth.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֧אמֶר הַ/מֶּ֛לֶךְ אֶל הָ/אִשָּׁ֖ה לְכִ֣י לְ/בֵיתֵ֑/ךְ וַ/אֲנִ֖י אֲצַוֶּ֥ה עָלָֽיִ/ךְ
verses.translit: vy'mr hmlkh 'l h'shh lkhy lbytkh v'ny 'tsvh 'lykh
verses.translation: And the king said unto the woman, Go to thine house, and I will give charge concerning thee.

verses.original: וַ/תֹּ֜אמֶר הָ/אִשָּׁ֤ה הַ/תְּקוֹעִית֙ אֶל הַ/מֶּ֔לֶךְ עָלַ֞/י אֲדֹנִ֥/י הַ/מֶּ֛לֶךְ הֶ/עָוֺ֖ן וְ/עַל בֵּ֣ית אָבִ֑/י וְ/הַ/מֶּ֥לֶךְ וְ/כִסְא֖/וֹ נָקִֽי
verses.translit: vt'mr h'shh htqv'yt 'l hmlkh 'ly 'dny hmlkh h'vn v'l byt 'by vhmlkh vkhs'v nqy
verses.translation: And the woman of Tekoah said unto the king, My lord, O king, the iniquity be on me, and on my father’s house: and the king and his throne be guiltless.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֖אמֶר הַ/מֶּ֑לֶךְ הַֽ/מְדַבֵּ֤ר אֵלַ֨יִ/ךְ֙ וַֽ/הֲבֵאת֣/וֹ אֵלַ֔/י וְ/לֹֽא יֹסִ֥יף ע֖וֹד לָ/גַ֥עַת בָּֽ/ךְ
verses.translit: vy'mr hmlkh hmdbr 'lykh vhb'tv 'ly vl' ysyf 'vd lg't bkh
verses.translation: And the king said, Whosoever saith ought unto thee, bring him to me, and he shall not touch thee any more.

verses.original: וַ/תֹּאמֶר֩ יִזְכָּר נָ֨א הַ/מֶּ֜לֶךְ אֶת יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶ֗י/ךָ מ/הרבית מֵ/הַרְבַּ֞ת גֹּאֵ֤ל הַ/דָּם֙ לְ/שַׁחֵ֔ת וְ/לֹ֥א יַשְׁמִ֖ידוּ אֶת בְּנִ֑/י וַ/יֹּ֨אמֶר֙ חַי יְהוָ֔ה אִם יִפֹּ֛ל מִ/שַּׂעֲרַ֥ת בְּנֵ֖/ךְ אָֽרְצָ/ה
verses.translit: vt'mr yzkhr n' hmlkh 't yhvh 'lhykh mhrbyt mhrbt g'l hdm lshcht vl' yshmydv 't bny vy'mr chy yhvh 'm ypl msh'rt bnkh 'rtsh
verses.translation: Then said she, I pray thee, let the king remember the LORD thy God, that thou wouldest not suffer the revengers of blood to destroy any more, lest they destroy my son. And he said, As the LORD liveth, there shall not one hair of thy son fall to the earth.

verses.original: וַ/תֹּ֨אמֶר֙ הָֽ/אִשָּׁ֔ה תְּדַבֶּר נָ֧א שִׁפְחָתְ/ךָ֛ אֶל אֲדֹנִ֥/י הַ/מֶּ֖לֶךְ דָּבָ֑ר וַ/יֹּ֖אמֶר דַּבֵּֽרִי
verses.translit: vt'mr h'shh tdbr n' shpchtkh 'l 'dny hmlkh dbr vy'mr dbry
verses.translation: Then the woman said, Let thine handmaid, I pray thee, speak one word unto my lord the king. And he said, Say on.

verses.original: וַ/תֹּ֨אמֶר֙ הָֽ/אִשָּׁ֔ה וְ/לָ֧/מָּה חָשַׁ֛בְתָּה כָּ/זֹ֖את עַל עַ֣ם אֱלֹהִ֑ים וּ/מִ/דַּבֵּ֨ר הַ/מֶּ֜לֶךְ הַ/דָּבָ֤ר הַ/זֶּה֙ כְּ/אָשֵׁ֔ם לְ/בִלְתִּ֛י הָשִׁ֥יב הַ/מֶּ֖לֶךְ אֶֽת נִדְּחֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: vt'mr h'shh vlmh chshbth khz't 'l 'm 'lhym vmdbr hmlkh hdbr hzh kh'shm lblty hshyb hmlkh 't ndchv
verses.translation: And the woman said, Wherefore then hast thou thought such a thing against the people of God? for the king doth speak this thing as one which is faulty, in that the king doth not fetch home again his banished.

verses.original: כִּי מ֣וֹת נָמ֔וּת וְ/כַ/מַּ֨יִם֙ הַ/נִּגָּרִ֣ים אַ֔רְצָ/ה אֲשֶׁ֖ר לֹ֣א יֵאָסֵ֑פוּ וְ/לֹֽא יִשָּׂ֤א אֱלֹהִים֙ נֶ֔פֶשׁ וְ/חָשַׁב֙ מַֽחֲשָׁב֔וֹת לְ/בִלְתִּ֛י יִדַּ֥ח מִמֶּ֖/נּוּ נִדָּֽח
verses.translit: khy mvt nmvt vkhmym hngrym 'rtsh 'shr l' y'spv vl' ysh' 'lhym npsh vchshb mchshbvt lblty ydch mmnv ndch
verses.translation: For we must needs die, and are as water spilt on the ground, which cannot be gathered up again; neither doth God respect any person: yet doth he devise means, that his banished be not expelled from him.

verses.original: וְ֠/עַתָּה אֲשֶׁר בָּ֜אתִי לְ/דַבֵּ֨ר אֶל הַ/מֶּ֤לֶךְ אֲדֹנִ/י֙ אֶת הַ/דָּבָ֣ר הַ/זֶּ֔ה כִּ֥י יֵֽרְאֻ֖/נִי הָ/עָ֑ם וַ/תֹּ֤אמֶר שִׁפְחָֽתְ/ךָ֙ אֲדַבְּרָה נָּ֣א אֶל הַ/מֶּ֔לֶךְ אוּלַ֛י יַעֲשֶׂ֥ה הַ/מֶּ֖לֶךְ אֶת דְּבַ֥ר אֲמָתֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: v'th 'shr b'ty ldbr 'l hmlkh 'dny 't hdbr hzh khy yr'ny h'm vt'mr shpchtkh 'dbrh n' 'l hmlkh 'vly y'shh hmlkh 't dbr 'mtv
verses.translation: Now therefore that I am come to speak of this thing unto my lord the king, it is because the people have made me afraid: and thy handmaid said, I will now speak unto the king; it may be that the king will perform the request of his handmaid.

verses.original: כִּ֚י יִשְׁמַ֣ע הַ/מֶּ֔לֶךְ לְ/הַצִּ֥יל אֶת אֲמָת֖/וֹ מִ/כַּ֣ף הָ/אִ֑ישׁ לְ/הַשְׁמִ֨יד אֹתִ֤/י וְ/אֶת בְּנִ/י֙ יַ֔חַד מִֽ/נַּחֲלַ֖ת אֱלֹהִֽים
verses.translit: khy yshm' hmlkh lhtsyl 't 'mtv mkhf h'ysh lhshmyd 'ty v't bny ychd mnchlt 'lhym
verses.translation: For the king will hear, to deliver his handmaid out of the hand of the man that would destroy me and my son together out of the inheritance of God.

verses.original: וַ/תֹּ֨אמֶר֙ שִׁפְחָ֣תְ/ךָ֔ יִֽהְיֶה נָּ֛א דְּבַר אֲדֹנִ֥/י הַ/מֶּ֖לֶךְ לִ/מְנוּחָ֑ה כִּ֣י כְּ/מַלְאַ֣ךְ הָ/אֱלֹהִ֗ים כֵּ֣ן אֲדֹנִ֤/י הַ/מֶּ֨לֶךְ֙ לִ/שְׁמֹ֨עַ֙ הַ/טּ֣וֹב וְ/הָ/רָ֔ע וַֽ/יהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֶ֖י/ךָ יְהִ֥י עִמָּֽ/ךְ
verses.translit: vt'mr shpchtkh yhyh n' dbr 'dny hmlkh lmnvchh khy khml'kh h'lhym khn 'dny hmlkh lshm' htvb vhr' vyhvh 'lhykh yhy 'mkh
verses.translation: Then thine handmaid said, The word of my lord the king shall now be comfortable: for as an angel of God, so is my lord the king to discern good and bad: therefore the LORD thy God will be with thee.

verses.original: וַ/יַּ֣עַן הַ/מֶּ֗לֶךְ וַ/יֹּ֨אמֶר֙ אֶל הָ֣/אִשָּׁ֔ה אַל נָ֨א תְכַחֲדִ֤י מִמֶּ֨/נִּי֙ דָּבָ֔ר אֲשֶׁ֥ר אָנֹכִ֖י שֹׁאֵ֣ל אֹתָ֑/ךְ וַ/תֹּ֨אמֶר֙ הָֽ/אִשָּׁ֔ה יְדַבֶּר נָ֖א אֲדֹנִ֥/י הַ/מֶּֽלֶךְ
verses.translit: vy'n hmlkh vy'mr 'l h'shh 'l n' tkhchdy mmny dbr 'shr 'nkhy sh'l 'tkh vt'mr h'shh ydbr n' 'dny hmlkh
verses.translation: Then the king answered and said unto the woman, Hide not from me, I pray thee, the thing that I shall ask thee. And the woman said, Let my lord the king now speak.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֣אמֶר הַ/מֶּ֔לֶךְ הֲ/יַ֥ד יוֹאָ֛ב אִתָּ֖/ךְ בְּ/כָל זֹ֑את וַ/תַּ֣עַן הָ/אִשָּׁ֣ה וַ/תֹּ֡אמֶר חֵֽי נַפְשְׁ/ךָ֩ אֲדֹנִ֨/י הַ/מֶּ֜לֶךְ אִם אִ֣שׁ לְ/הֵמִ֣ין וּ/לְ/הַשְׂמִ֗יל מִ/כֹּ֤ל אֲשֶׁר דִּבֶּר֙ אֲדֹנִ֣/י הַ/מֶּ֔לֶךְ כִּֽי עַבְדְּ/ךָ֤ יוֹאָב֙ ה֣וּא צִוָּ֔/נִי וְ/ה֗וּא שָׂ֚ם בְּ/פִ֣י שִׁפְחָֽתְ/ךָ֔ אֵ֥ת כָּל הַ/דְּבָרִ֖ים הָ/אֵֽלֶּה
verses.translit: vy'mr hmlkh hyd yv'b 'tkh bkhl z't vt'n h'shh vt'mr chy npshkh 'dny hmlkh 'm 'sh lhmyn vlhshmyl mkhl 'shr dbr 'dny hmlkh khy 'bdkh yv'b hv' tsvny vhv' shm bpy shpchtkh 't khl hdbrym h'lh
verses.translation: And the king said, Is not the hand of Joab with thee in all this? And the woman answered and said, As thy soul liveth, my lord the king, none can turn to the right hand or to the left from ought that my lord the king hath spoken: for thy servant Joab, he bade me, and he put all these words in the mouth of thine handmaid:

verses.original: לְ/בַ/עֲב֤וּר סַבֵּב֙ אֶת פְּנֵ֣י הַ/דָּבָ֔ר עָשָׂ֛ה עַבְדְּ/ךָ֥ יוֹאָ֖ב אֶת הַ/דָּבָ֣ר הַ/זֶּ֑ה וַ/אדֹנִ֣/י חָכָ֗ם כְּ/חָכְמַת֙ מַלְאַ֣ךְ הָ/אֱלֹהִ֔ים לָ/דַ֖עַת אֶֽת כָּל אֲשֶׁ֥ר בָּ/אָֽרֶץ
verses.translit: lb'bvr sbb 't pny hdbr 'shh 'bdkh yv'b 't hdbr hzh v'dny chkhm khchkhmt ml'kh h'lhym ld't 't khl 'shr b'rts
verses.translation: To fetch about this form of speech hath thy servant Joab done this thing: and my lord is wise, according to the wisdom of an angel of God, to know all things that are in the earth.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֤אמֶר הַ/מֶּ֨לֶךְ֙ אֶל יוֹאָ֔ב הִנֵּה נָ֥א עָשִׂ֖יתִי אֶת הַ/דָּבָ֣ר הַ/זֶּ֑ה וְ/לֵ֛ךְ הָשֵׁ֥ב אֶת הַ/נַּ֖עַר אֶת אַבְשָׁלֽוֹם
verses.translit: vy'mr hmlkh 'l yv'b hnh n' 'shyty 't hdbr hzh vlkh hshb 't hn'r 't 'bshlvm
verses.translation: And the king said unto Joab, Behold now, I have done this thing: go therefore, bring the young man Absalom again.

verses.original: וַ/יִּפֹּל֩ יוֹאָ֨ב אֶל פָּנָ֥י/ו אַ֛רְצָ/ה וַ/יִּשְׁתַּ֖חוּ וַ/יְבָ֣רֶךְ אֶת הַ/מֶּ֑לֶךְ וַ/יֹּ֣אמֶר יוֹאָ֡ב הַ/יּוֹם֩ יָדַ֨ע עַבְדְּ/ךָ֜ כִּי מָצָ֨אתִי חֵ֤ן בְּ/עֵינֶ֨י/ךָ֙ אֲדֹנִ֣/י הַ/מֶּ֔לֶךְ אֲשֶׁר עָשָׂ֥ה הַ/מֶּ֖לֶךְ אֶת דְּבַ֥ר עבד/ו עַבְדֶּֽ/ךָ
verses.translit: vypl yv'b 'l pnyv 'rtsh vyshtchv vybrkh 't hmlkh vy'mr yv'b hyvm yd' 'bdkh khy mts'ty chn b'ynykh 'dny hmlkh 'shr 'shh hmlkh 't dbr 'bdv 'bdkh
verses.translation: And Joab fell to the ground on his face, and bowed himself, and thanked the king: and Joab said, To day thy servant knoweth that I have found grace in thy sight, my lord, O king, in that the king hath fulfilled the request of his servant.

verses.original: וַ/יָּ֥קָם יוֹאָ֖ב וַ/יֵּ֣לֶךְ גְּשׁ֑וּרָ/ה וַ/יָּבֵ֥א אֶת אַבְשָׁל֖וֹם יְרוּשָׁלִָֽם
verses.translit: vyqm yv'b vylkh gshvrh vyb' 't 'bshlvm yrvshlm
verses.translation: So Joab arose and went to Geshur, and brought Absalom to Jerusalem.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֤אמֶר הַ/מֶּ֨לֶךְ֙ יִסֹּ֣ב אֶל בֵּית֔/וֹ וּ/פָנַ֖/י לֹ֣א יִרְאֶ֑ה וַ/יִּסֹּ֤ב אַבְשָׁלוֹם֙ אֶל בֵּית֔/וֹ וּ/פְנֵ֥י הַ/מֶּ֖לֶךְ לֹ֥א רָאָֽה
verses.translit: vy'mr hmlkh ysb 'l bytv vpny l' yr'h vysb 'bshlvm 'l bytv vpny hmlkh l' r'h
verses.translation: And the king said, Let him turn to his own house, and let him not see my face. So Absalom returned to his own house, and saw not the king’s face.

verses.original: וּ/כְ/אַבְשָׁל֗וֹם לֹא הָיָ֧ה אִישׁ יָפֶ֛ה בְּ/כָל יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל לְ/הַלֵּ֣ל מְאֹ֑ד מִ/כַּ֤ף רַגְל/וֹ֙ וְ/עַ֣ד קָדְקֳד֔/וֹ לֹא הָ֥יָה ב֖/וֹ מֽוּם
verses.translit: vkh'bshlvm l' hyh 'ysh yph bkhl yshr'l lhll m'd mkhf rglv v'd qdqdv l' hyh bv mvm
verses.translation: But in all Israel there was none to be so much praised as Absalom for his beauty: from the sole of his foot even to the crown of his head there was no blemish in him.

verses.original: וּֽ/בְ/גַלְּח/וֹ֮ אֶת רֹאשׁ/וֹ֒ וְֽ֠/הָיָה מִ/קֵּ֨ץ יָמִ֤ים לַ/יָּמִים֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר יְגַלֵּ֔חַ כִּֽי כָבֵ֥ד עָלָ֖י/ו וְ/גִלְּח֑/וֹ וְ/שָׁקַל֙ אֶת שְׂעַ֣ר רֹאשׁ֔/וֹ מָאתַ֥יִם שְׁקָלִ֖ים בְּ/אֶ֥בֶן הַ/מֶּֽלֶךְ
verses.translit: vbglchv 't r'shv vhyh mqts ymym lymym 'shr yglch khy khbd 'lyv vglchv vshql 't sh'r r'shv m'tym shqlym b'bn hmlkh
verses.translation: And when he polled his head, (for it was at every year’s end that he polled it: because the hair was heavy on him, therefore he polled it:) he weighed the hair of his head at two hundred shekels after the king’s weight.

verses.original: וַ/יִּֽוָּלְד֤וּ לְ/אַבְשָׁלוֹם֙ שְׁלוֹשָׁ֣ה בָנִ֔ים וּ/בַ֥ת אַחַ֖ת וּ/שְׁמָ֣/הּ תָּמָ֑ר הִ֣יא הָיְתָ֔ה אִשָּׁ֖ה יְפַ֥ת מַרְאֶֽה
verses.translit: vyvldv l'bshlvm shlvshh bnym vbt 'cht vshmh tmr hy' hyth 'shh ypt mr'h
verses.translation: And unto Absalom there were born three sons, and one daughter, whose name was Tamar: she was a woman of a fair countenance.

verses.original: וַ/יֵּ֧שֶׁב אַבְשָׁל֛וֹם בִּ/ירוּשָׁלִַ֖ם שְׁנָתַ֣יִם יָמִ֑ים וּ/פְנֵ֥י הַ/מֶּ֖לֶךְ לֹ֥א רָאָֽה
verses.translit: vyshb 'bshlvm byrvshlm shntym ymym vpny hmlkh l' r'h
verses.translation: So Absalom dwelt two full years in Jerusalem, and saw not the king’s face.

verses.original: וַ/יִּשְׁלַ֨ח אַבְשָׁל֜וֹם אֶל יוֹאָ֗ב לִ/שְׁלֹ֤חַ אֹת/וֹ֙ אֶל הַ/מֶּ֔לֶךְ וְ/לֹ֥א אָבָ֖ה לָ/ב֣וֹא אֵלָ֑י/ו וַ/יִּשְׁלַ֥ח עוֹד֙ שֵׁנִ֔ית וְ/לֹ֥א אָבָ֖ה לָ/בֽוֹא
verses.translit: vyshlch 'bshlvm 'l yv'b lshlch 'tv 'l hmlkh vl' 'bh lbv' 'lyv vyshlch 'vd shnyt vl' 'bh lbv'
verses.translation: Therefore Absalom sent for Joab, to have sent him to the king; but he would not come to him: and when he sent again the second time, he would not come.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֨אמֶר אֶל עֲבָדָ֜י/ו רְאוּ֩ חֶלְקַ֨ת יוֹאָ֤ב אֶל יָדִ/י֙ וְ/ל/וֹ שָׁ֣ם שְׂעֹרִ֔ים לְכ֖וּ ו/הוצתי/ה וְ/הַצִּית֣וּ/הָ בָ/אֵ֑שׁ וַ/יַּצִּ֜תוּ עַבְדֵ֧י אַבְשָׁל֛וֹם אֶת הַ/חֶלְקָ֖ה בָּ/אֵֽשׁ
verses.translit: vy'mr 'l 'bdyv r'v chlqt yv'b 'l ydy vlv shm sh'rym lkhv vhvtstyh vhtsytvh b'sh vytstv 'bdy 'bshlvm 't hchlqh b'sh
verses.translation: Therefore he said unto his servants, See, Joab’s field is near mine, and he hath barley there; go and set it on fire. And Absalom’s servants set the field on fire.

verses.original: וַ/יָּ֣קָם יוֹאָ֔ב וַ/יָּבֹ֥א אֶל אַבְשָׁל֖וֹם הַ/בָּ֑יְתָ/ה וַ/יֹּ֣אמֶר אֵלָ֔י/ו לָ֣/מָּה הִצִּ֧יתוּ עֲבָדֶ֛/ךָ אֶת הַ/חֶלְקָ֥ה אֲשֶׁר לִ֖/י בָּ/אֵֽשׁ
verses.translit: vyqm yv'b vyb' 'l 'bshlvm hbyth vy'mr 'lyv lmh htsytv 'bdkh 't hchlqh 'shr ly b'sh
verses.translation: Then Joab arose, and came to Absalom unto his house, and said unto him, Wherefore have thy servants set my field on fire?

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֣אמֶר אַבְשָׁל֣וֹם אֶל יוֹאָ֡ב הִנֵּ֣ה שָׁלַ֣חְתִּי אֵלֶ֣י/ךָ לֵ/אמֹ֡ר בֹּ֣א הֵ֠נָּה וְ/אֶשְׁלְחָה֩ אֹתְ/ךָ֨ אֶל הַ/מֶּ֜לֶךְ לֵ/אמֹ֗ר לָ֤/מָּה בָּ֨אתִי֙ מִ/גְּשׁ֔וּר ט֥וֹב לִ֖/י עֹ֣ד אֲנִי שָׁ֑ם וְ/עַתָּ֗ה אֶרְאֶה֙ פְּנֵ֣י הַ/מֶּ֔לֶךְ וְ/אִם יֶשׁ בִּ֥/י עָוֺ֖ן וֶ/הֱמִתָֽ/נִי
verses.translit: vy'mr 'bshlvm 'l yv'b hnh shlchty 'lykh l'mr b' hnh v'shlchh 'tkh 'l hmlkh l'mr lmh b'ty mgshvr tvb ly 'd 'ny shm v'th 'r'h pny hmlkh v'm ysh by 'vn vhmtny
verses.translation: And Absalom answered Joab, Behold, I sent unto thee, saying, Come hither, that I may send thee to the king, to say, Wherefore am I come from Geshur? it had been good for me to have been there still: now therefore let me see the king’s face; and if there be any iniquity in me, let him kill me.

verses.original: וַ/יָּבֹ֨א יוֹאָ֣ב אֶל הַ/מֶּלֶךְ֮ וַ/יַּגֶּד ל/וֹ֒ וַ/יִּקְרָ֤א אֶל אַבְשָׁלוֹם֙ וַ/יָּבֹ֣א אֶל הַ/מֶּ֔לֶךְ וַ/יִּשְׁתַּ֨חוּ ל֧/וֹ עַל אַפָּ֛י/ו אַ֖רְצָ/ה לִ/פְנֵ֣י הַ/מֶּ֑לֶךְ וַ/יִּשַּׁ֥ק הַ/מֶּ֖לֶךְ לְ/אַבְשָׁלֽוֹם
verses.translit: vyb' yv'b 'l hmlkh vygd lv vyqr' 'l 'bshlvm vyb' 'l hmlkh vyshtchv lv 'l 'pyv 'rtsh lpny hmlkh vyshq hmlkh l'bshlvm
verses.translation: So Joab came to the king, and told him: and when he had called for Absalom, he came to the king, and bowed himself on his face to the ground before the king: and the king kissed Absalom.

verses.original: וַֽ/יְהִי֙ מֵ/אַ֣חֲרֵי כֵ֔ן וַ/יַּ֤עַשׂ ל/וֹ֙ אַבְשָׁל֔וֹם מֶרְכָּבָ֖ה וְ/סֻסִ֑ים וַ/חֲמִשִּׁ֥ים אִ֖ישׁ רָצִ֥ים לְ/פָנָֽי/ו
verses.translit: vyhy m'chry khn vy'sh lv 'bshlvm mrkhbh vssym vchmshym 'ysh rtsym lpnyv
verses.translation: And it came to pass after this, that Absalom prepared him chariots and horses, and fifty men to run before him.

verses.original: וְ/הִשְׁכִּים֙ אַבְשָׁל֔וֹם וְ/עָמַ֕ד עַל יַ֖ד דֶּ֣רֶךְ הַ/שָּׁ֑עַר וַ/יְהִ֡י כָּל הָ/אִ֣ישׁ אֲשֶֽׁר יִהְיֶה לּ/וֹ רִיב֩ לָ/ב֨וֹא אֶל הַ/מֶּ֜לֶךְ לַ/מִּשְׁפָּ֗ט וַ/יִּקְרָ֨א אַבְשָׁל֤וֹם אֵלָי/ו֙ וַ/יֹּ֗אמֶר אֵֽי מִ/זֶּ֥ה עִיר֙ אַ֔תָּה וַ/יֹּ֕אמֶר מֵ/אַחַ֥ד שִׁבְטֵֽי יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל עַבְדֶּֽ/ךָ
verses.translit: vhshkhym 'bshlvm v'md 'l yd drkh hsh'r vyhy khl h'ysh 'shr yhyh lv ryb lbv' 'l hmlkh lmshpt vyqr' 'bshlvm 'lyv vy'mr 'y mzh 'yr 'th vy'mr m'chd shbty yshr'l 'bdkh
verses.translation: And Absalom rose up early, and stood beside the way of the gate: and it was so , that when any man that had a controversy came to the king for judgment, then Absalom called unto him, and said, Of what city art thou? And he said, Thy servant is of one of the tribes of Israel.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֤אמֶר אֵלָי/ו֙ אַבְשָׁל֔וֹם רְאֵ֥ה דְבָרֶ֖/ךָ טוֹבִ֣ים וּ/נְכֹחִ֑ים וְ/שֹׁמֵ֥עַ אֵין לְ/ךָ֖ מֵ/אֵ֥ת הַ/מֶּֽלֶךְ
verses.translit: vy'mr 'lyv 'bshlvm r'h dbrkh tvbym vnkhchym vshm' 'yn lkh m't hmlkh
verses.translation: And Absalom said unto him, See, thy matters are good and right; but there is no man deputed of the king to hear thee.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֨אמֶר֙ אַבְשָׁל֔וֹם מִי יְשִׂמֵ֥/נִי שֹׁפֵ֖ט בָּ/אָ֑רֶץ וְ/עָלַ֗/י יָב֥וֹא כָּל אִ֛ישׁ אֲשֶֽׁר יִהְיֶה לּ/וֹ רִ֥יב וּ/מִשְׁפָּ֖ט וְ/הִצְדַּקְתִּֽי/ו
verses.translit: vy'mr 'bshlvm my yshmny shpt b'rts v'ly ybv' khl 'ysh 'shr yhyh lv ryb vmshpt vhtsdqtyv
verses.translation: Absalom said moreover, Oh that I were made judge in the land, that every man which hath any suit or cause might come unto me, and I would do him justice!

verses.original: וְ/הָיָה֙ בִּ/קְרָב אִ֔ישׁ לְ/הִשְׁתַּחֲוֺ֖ת ל֑/וֹ וְ/שָׁלַ֧ח אֶת יָד֛/וֹ וְ/הֶחֱזִ֥יק ל֖/וֹ וְ/נָ֥שַׁק לֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: vhyh bqrb 'ysh lhshtchvt lv vshlch 't ydv vhchzyq lv vnshq lv
verses.translation: And it was so , that when any man came nigh to him to do him obeisance, he put forth his hand, and took him, and kissed him.

verses.original: וַ/יַּ֨עַשׂ אַבְשָׁל֜וֹם כַּ/דָּבָ֤ר הַ/זֶּה֙ לְ/כָל יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל אֲשֶׁר יָבֹ֥אוּ לַ/מִּשְׁפָּ֖ט אֶל הַ/מֶּ֑לֶךְ וַ/יְגַנֵּב֙ אַבְשָׁל֔וֹם אֶת לֵ֖ב אַנְשֵׁ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל
verses.translit: vy'sh 'bshlvm khdbr hzh lkhl yshr'l 'shr yb'v lmshpt 'l hmlkh vygnb 'bshlvm 't lb 'nshy yshr'l
verses.translation: And on this manner did Absalom to all Israel that came to the king for judgment: so Absalom stole the hearts of the men of Israel.

verses.original: וַ/יְהִ֕י מִ/קֵּ֖ץ אַרְבָּעִ֣ים שָׁנָ֑ה וַ/יֹּ֤אמֶר אַבְשָׁלוֹם֙ אֶל הַ/מֶּ֔לֶךְ אֵ֣לֲכָה נָּ֗א וַ/אֲשַׁלֵּ֛ם אֶת נִדְרִ֛/י אֲשֶׁר נָדַ֥רְתִּי לַֽ/יהוָ֖ה בְּ/חֶבְרֽוֹן
verses.translit: vyhy mqts 'rb'ym shnh vy'mr 'bshlvm 'l hmlkh 'lkhh n' v'shlm 't ndry 'shr ndrty lyhvh bchbrvn
verses.translation: And it came to pass after forty years, that Absalom said unto the king, I pray thee, let me go and pay my vow, which I have vowed unto the LORD , in Hebron.

verses.original: כִּי נֵ֨דֶר֙ נָדַ֣ר עַבְדְּ/ךָ֔ בְּ/שִׁבְתִּ֥/י בִ/גְשׁ֛וּר בַּ/אֲרָ֖ם לֵ/אמֹ֑ר אִם ישיב יָשׁ֨וֹב יְשִׁיבֵ֤/נִי יְהוָה֙ יְר֣וּשָׁלִַ֔ם וְ/עָבַדְתִּ֖י אֶת יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: khy ndr ndr 'bdkh bshbty bgshvr b'rm l'mr 'm yshyb yshvb yshybny yhvh yrvshlm v'bdty 't yhvh
verses.translation: For thy servant vowed a vow while I abode at Geshur in Syria, saying, If the LORD shall bring me again indeed to Jerusalem, then I will serve the LORD .

verses.original: וַ/יֹּֽאמֶר ל֥/וֹ הַ/מֶּ֖לֶךְ לֵ֣ךְ בְּ/שָׁל֑וֹם וַ/יָּ֖קָם וַ/יֵּ֥לֶךְ חֶבְרֽוֹנָ/ה
verses.translit: vy'mr lv hmlkh lkh bshlvm vyqm vylkh chbrvnh
verses.translation: And the king said unto him, Go in peace. So he arose, and went to Hebron.

verses.original: וַ/יִּשְׁלַ֤ח אַבְשָׁלוֹם֙ מְרַגְּלִ֔ים בְּ/כָל שִׁבְטֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל לֵ/אמֹ֑ר כְּ/שָׁמְעֲ/כֶם֙ אֶת ק֣וֹל הַ/שֹּׁפָ֔ר וַ/אֲמַרְתֶּ֕ם מָלַ֥ךְ אַבְשָׁל֖וֹם בְּ/חֶבְרֽוֹן
verses.translit: vyshlch 'bshlvm mrglym bkhl shbty yshr'l l'mr khshm'khm 't qvl hshpr v'mrtm mlkh 'bshlvm bchbrvn
verses.translation: But Absalom sent spies throughout all the tribes of Israel, saying, As soon as ye hear the sound of the trumpet, then ye shall say, Absalom reigneth in Hebron.

verses.original: וְ/אֶת אַבְשָׁל֗וֹם הָלְכ֞וּ מָאתַ֤יִם אִישׁ֙ מִ/יר֣וּשָׁלִַ֔ם קְרֻאִ֖ים וְ/הֹלְכִ֣ים לְ/תֻמָּ֑/ם וְ/לֹ֥א יָדְע֖וּ כָּל דָּבָֽר
verses.translit: v't 'bshlvm hlkhv m'tym 'ysh myrvshlm qr'ym vhlkhym ltmm vl' yd'v khl dbr
verses.translation: And with Absalom went two hundred men out of Jerusalem, that were called; and they went in their simplicity, and they knew not any thing.

verses.original: וַ/יִּשְׁלַ֣ח אַ֠בְשָׁלוֹם אֶת אֲחִיתֹ֨פֶל הַ/גִּֽילֹנִ֜י יוֹעֵ֣ץ דָּוִ֗ד מֵֽ/עִיר/וֹ֙ מִ/גִּלֹ֔ה בְּ/זָבְח֖/וֹ אֶת הַ/זְּבָחִ֑ים וַ/יְהִ֤י הַ/קֶּ֨שֶׁר֙ אַמִּ֔ץ וְ/הָ/עָ֛ם הוֹלֵ֥ךְ וָ/רָ֖ב אֶת אַבְשָׁלֽוֹם
verses.translit: vyshlch 'bshlvm 't 'chytpl hgylny yv'ts dvd m'yrv mglh bzbchv 't hzbchym vyhy hqshr 'mts vh'm hvlkh vrb 't 'bshlvm
verses.translation: And Absalom sent for Ahithophel the Gilonite, David’s counsellor, from his city, even from Giloh, while he offered sacrifices. And the conspiracy was strong; for the people increased continually with Absalom.

verses.original: וַ/יָּבֹא֙ הַ/מַּגִּ֔יד אֶל דָּוִ֖ד לֵ/אמֹ֑ר הָיָ֛ה לֶב אִ֥ישׁ יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל אַחֲרֵ֥י אַבְשָׁלֽוֹם
verses.translit: vyb' hmgyd 'l dvd l'mr hyh lb 'ysh yshr'l 'chry 'bshlvm
verses.translation: And there came a messenger to David, saying, The hearts of the men of Israel are after Absalom.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֣אמֶר דָּ֠וִד לְ/כָל עֲבָדָ֨י/ו אֲשֶׁר אִתּ֤/וֹ בִ/ירוּשָׁלִַ֨ם֙ ק֣וּמוּ וְ/נִבְרָ֔חָה כִּ֛י לֹא תִֽהְיֶה לָּ֥/נוּ פְלֵיטָ֖ה מִ/פְּנֵ֣י אַבְשָׁל֑וֹם מַהֲר֣וּ לָ/לֶ֗כֶת פֶּן יְמַהֵ֤ר וְ/הִשִּׂגָ֨/נוּ֙ וְ/הִדִּ֤יחַ עָלֵ֨י/נוּ֙ אֶת הָ֣/רָעָ֔ה וְ/הִכָּ֥ה הָ/עִ֖יר לְ/פִי חָֽרֶב
verses.translit: vy'mr dvd lkhl 'bdyv 'shr 'tv byrvshlm qvmv vnbrchh khy l' thyh lnv plyth mpny 'bshlvm mhrv llkht pn ymhr vhshgnv vhdych 'lynv 't hr'h vhkhh h'yr lpy chrb
verses.translation: And David said unto all his servants that were with him at Jerusalem, Arise, and let us flee; for we shall not else escape from Absalom: make speed to depart, lest he overtake us suddenly, and bring evil upon us, and smite the city with the edge of the sword.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּאמְר֥וּ עַבְדֵֽי הַ/מֶּ֖לֶךְ אֶל הַ/מֶּ֑לֶךְ כְּ/כֹ֧ל אֲשֶׁר יִבְחַ֛ר אֲדֹנִ֥/י הַ/מֶּ֖לֶךְ הִנֵּ֥ה עֲבָדֶֽי/ךָ
verses.translit: vy'mrv 'bdy hmlkh 'l hmlkh khkhl 'shr ybchr 'dny hmlkh hnh 'bdykh
verses.translation: And the king’s servants said unto the king, Behold, thy servants are ready to do whatsoever my lord the king shall appoint.

verses.original: וַ/יֵּצֵ֥א הַ/מֶּ֛לֶךְ וְ/כָל בֵּית֖/וֹ בְּ/רַגְלָ֑י/ו וַ/יַּעֲזֹ֣ב הַ/מֶּ֗לֶךְ אֵ֣ת עֶ֧שֶׂר נָשִׁ֛ים פִּֽלַגְשִׁ֖ים לִ/שְׁמֹ֥ר הַ/בָּֽיִת
verses.translit: vyts' hmlkh vkhl bytv brglyv vy'zb hmlkh 't 'shr nshym plgshym lshmr hbyt
verses.translation: And the king went forth, and all his household after him. And the king left ten women, which were concubines, to keep the house.

verses.original: וַ/יֵּצֵ֥א הַ/מֶּ֛לֶךְ וְ/כָל הָ/עָ֖ם בְּ/רַגְלָ֑י/ו וַ/יַּעַמְד֖וּ בֵּ֥ית הַ/מֶּרְחָֽק
verses.translit: vyts' hmlkh vkhl h'm brglyv vy'mdv byt hmrchq
verses.translation: And the king went forth, and all the people after him, and tarried in a place that was far off.

verses.original: וְ/כָל עֲבָדָי/ו֙ עֹבְרִ֣ים עַל יָד֔/וֹ וְ/כָל הַ/כְּרֵתִ֖י וְ/כָל הַ/פְּלֵתִ֑י וְ/כָֽל הַ/גִּתִּ֞ים שֵׁשׁ מֵא֣וֹת אִ֗ישׁ אֲשֶׁר בָּ֤אוּ בְ/רַגְל/וֹ֙ מִ/גַּ֔ת עֹבְרִ֖ים עַל פְּנֵ֥י הַ/מֶּֽלֶךְ
verses.translit: vkhl 'bdyv 'brym 'l ydv vkhl hkhrty vkhl hplty vkhl hgtym shsh m'vt 'ysh 'shr b'v brglv mgt 'brym 'l pny hmlkh
verses.translation: And all his servants passed on beside him; and all the Cherethites, and all the Pelethites, and all the Gittites, six hundred men which came after him from Gath, passed on before the king.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֤אמֶר הַ/מֶּ֨לֶךְ֙ אֶל אִתַּ֣י הַ/גִּתִּ֔י לָ֧/מָּה תֵלֵ֛ךְ גַּם אַתָּ֖ה אִתָּ֑/נוּ שׁ֣וּב וְ/שֵׁ֤ב עִם הַ/מֶּ֨לֶךְ֙ כִּֽי נָכְרִ֣י אַ֔תָּה וְ/גַם גֹּלֶ֥ה אַתָּ֖ה לִ/מְקוֹמֶֽ/ךָ
verses.translit: vy'mr hmlkh 'l 'ty hgty lmh tlkh gm 'th 'tnv shvb vshb 'm hmlkh khy nkhry 'th vgm glh 'th lmqvmkh
verses.translation: Then said the king to Ittai the Gittite, Wherefore goest thou also with us? return to thy place, and abide with the king: for thou art a stranger, and also an exile.

verses.original: תְּמ֣וֹל בּוֹאֶ֗/ךָ וְ/הַ/יּ֞וֹם אנוע/ך אֲנִֽיעֲ/ךָ֤ עִמָּ֨/נוּ֙ לָ/לֶ֔כֶת וַ/אֲנִ֣י הוֹלֵ֔ךְ עַ֥ל אֲשֶׁר אֲנִ֖י הוֹלֵ֑ךְ שׁ֣וּב וְ/הָשֵׁ֧ב אֶת אַחֶ֛י/ךָ עִמָּ֖/ךְ חֶ֥סֶד וֶ/אֱמֶֽת
verses.translit: tmvl bv'kh vhyvm 'nv'kh 'ny'kh 'mnv llkht v'ny hvlkh 'l 'shr 'ny hvlkh shvb vhshb 't 'chykh 'mkh chsd v'mt
verses.translation: Whereas thou camest but yesterday, should I this day make thee go up and down with us? seeing I go whither I may, return thou, and take back thy brethren: mercy and truth be with thee.

verses.original: וַ/יַּ֧עַן אִתַּ֛י אֶת הַ/מֶּ֖לֶךְ וַ/יֹּאמַ֑ר חַי יְהוָ֗ה וְ/חֵי֙ אֲדֹנִ֣/י הַ/מֶּ֔לֶךְ כִּ֠י אִם בִּ/מְק֞וֹם אֲשֶׁ֥ר יִֽהְיֶה שָּׁ֣ם אֲדֹנִ֣/י הַ/מֶּ֗לֶךְ אִם לְ/מָ֨וֶת֙ אִם לְ/חַיִּ֔ים כִּי שָׁ֖ם יִהְיֶ֥ה עַבְדֶּֽ/ךָ
verses.translit: vy'n 'ty 't hmlkh vy'mr chy yhvh vchy 'dny hmlkh khy 'm bmqvm 'shr yhyh shm 'dny hmlkh 'm lmvt 'm lchyym khy shm yhyh 'bdkh
verses.translation: And Ittai answered the king, and said, As the LORD liveth, and as my lord the king liveth, surely in what place my lord the king shall be, whether in death or life, even there also will thy servant be.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֧אמֶר דָּוִ֛ד אֶל אִתַּ֖י לֵ֣ךְ וַ/עֲבֹ֑ר וַֽ/יַּעֲבֹ֞ר אִתַּ֤י הַ/גִּתִּי֙ וְ/כָל אֲנָשָׁ֔י/ו וְ/כָל הַ/טַּ֖ף אֲשֶׁ֥ר אִתּֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: vy'mr dvd 'l 'ty lkh v'br vy'br 'ty hgty vkhl 'nshyv vkhl htf 'shr 'tv
verses.translation: And David said to Ittai, Go and pass over. And Ittai the Gittite passed over, and all his men, and all the little ones that were with him.

verses.original: וְ/כָל הָ/אָ֗רֶץ בּוֹכִים֙ ק֣וֹל גָּד֔וֹל וְ/כָל הָ/עָ֖ם עֹֽבְרִ֑ים וְ/הַ/מֶּ֗לֶךְ עֹבֵר֙ בְּ/נַ֣חַל קִדְר֔וֹן וְ/כָל הָ/עָם֙ עֹבְרִ֔ים עַל פְּנֵי דֶ֖רֶךְ אֶת הַ/מִּדְבָּֽר
verses.translit: vkhl h'rts bvkhym qvl gdvl vkhl h'm 'brym vhmlkh 'br bnchl qdrvn vkhl h'm 'brym 'l pny drkh 't hmdbr
verses.translation: And all the country wept with a loud voice, and all the people passed over: the king also himself passed over the brook Kidron, and all the people passed over, toward the way of the wilderness.

verses.original: וְ/הִנֵּ֨ה גַם צָד֜וֹק וְ/כָֽל הַ/לְוִיִּ֣ם אִתּ֗/וֹ נֹֽשְׂאִים֙ אֶת אֲרוֹן֙ בְּרִ֣ית הָ/אֱלֹהִ֔ים וַ/יַּצִּ֨קוּ֙ אֶת אֲר֣וֹן הָ/אֱלֹהִ֔ים וַ/יַּ֖עַל אֶבְיָתָ֑ר עַד תֹּ֥ם כָּל הָ/עָ֖ם לַ/עֲב֥וֹר מִן הָ/עִֽיר
verses.translit: vhnh gm tsdvq vkhl hlvym 'tv nsh'ym 't 'rvn bryt h'lhym vytsqv 't 'rvn h'lhym vy'l 'bytr 'd tm khl h'm l'bvr mn h'yr
verses.translation: And lo Zadok also, and all the Levites were with him, bearing the ark of the covenant of God: and they set down the ark of God; and Abiathar went up, until all the people had done passing out of the city.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֤אמֶר הַ/מֶּ֨לֶךְ֙ לְ/צָד֔וֹק הָשֵׁ֛ב אֶת אֲר֥וֹן הָ/אֱלֹהִ֖ים הָ/עִ֑יר אִם אֶמְצָ֥א חֵן֙ בְּ/עֵינֵ֣י יְהוָ֔ה וֶ/הֱשִׁבַ֕/נִי וְ/הִרְאַ֥/נִי אֹת֖/וֹ וְ/אֶת נָוֵֽ/הוּ
verses.translit: vy'mr hmlkh ltsdvq hshb 't 'rvn h'lhym h'yr 'm 'mts' chn b'yny yhvh vhshbny vhr'ny 'tv v't nvhv
verses.translation: And the king said unto Zadok, Carry back the ark of God into the city: if I shall find favour in the eyes of the LORD , he will bring me again, and shew me both it, and his habitation:

verses.original: וְ/אִם֙ כֹּ֣ה יֹאמַ֔ר לֹ֥א חָפַ֖צְתִּי בָּ֑/ךְ הִנְ/נִ֕י יַֽעֲשֶׂה לִּ֕/י כַּ/אֲשֶׁ֥ר ט֖וֹב בְּ/עֵינָֽי/ו
verses.translit: v'm khh y'mr l' chptsty bkh hnny y'shh ly kh'shr tvb b'ynyv
verses.translation: But if he thus say, I have no delight in thee; behold, here am I, let him do to me as seemeth good unto him.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֤אמֶר הַ/מֶּ֨לֶךְ֙ אֶל צָד֣וֹק הַ/כֹּהֵ֔ן הֲ/רוֹאֶ֣ה אַתָּ֔ה שֻׁ֥בָ/ה הָ/עִ֖יר בְּ/שָׁל֑וֹם וַ/אֲחִימַ֨עַץ בִּנְ/ךָ֜ וִ/יהוֹנָתָ֧ן בֶּן אֶבְיָתָ֛ר שְׁנֵ֥י בְנֵי/כֶ֖ם אִתְּ/כֶֽם
verses.translit: vy'mr hmlkh 'l tsdvq hkhhn hrv'h 'th shbh h'yr bshlvm v'chym'ts bnkh vyhvntn bn 'bytr shny bnykhm 'tkhm
verses.translation: The king said also unto Zadok the priest, Art not thou a seer? return into the city in peace, and your two sons with you, Ahimaaz thy son, and Jonathan the son of Abiathar.

verses.original: רְאוּ֙ אָנֹכִ֣י מִתְמַהְמֵ֔הַּ ב/עברות בְּ/עַֽרְב֖וֹת הַ/מִּדְבָּ֑ר עַ֣ד בּ֥וֹא דָבָ֛ר מֵ/עִמָּ/כֶ֖ם לְ/הַגִּ֥יד לִֽ/י
verses.translit: r'v 'nkhy mtmhmh b'brvt b'rbvt hmdbr 'd bv' dbr m'mkhm lhgyd ly
verses.translation: See, I will tarry in the plain of the wilderness, until there come word from you to certify me.

verses.original: וַ/יָּ֨שֶׁב צָד֧וֹק וְ/אֶבְיָתָ֛ר אֶת אֲר֥וֹן הָ/אֱלֹהִ֖ים יְרוּשָׁלִָ֑ם וַ/יֵּשְׁב֖וּ שָֽׁם
verses.translit: vyshb tsdvq v'bytr 't 'rvn h'lhym yrvshlm vyshbv shm
verses.translation: Zadok therefore and Abiathar carried the ark of God again to Jerusalem: and they tarried there.

verses.original: וְ/דָוִ֡ד עֹלֶה֩ בְ/מַעֲלֵ֨ה הַ/זֵּיתִ֜ים עֹלֶ֣ה וּ/בוֹכֶ֗ה וְ/רֹ֥אשׁ ל/וֹ֙ חָפ֔וּי וְ/ה֖וּא הֹלֵ֣ךְ יָחֵ֑ף וְ/כָל הָ/עָ֣ם אֲשֶׁר אִתּ֗/וֹ חָפוּ֙ אִ֣ישׁ רֹאשׁ֔/וֹ וְ/עָל֥וּ עָלֹ֖ה וּ/בָכֹֽה
verses.translit: vdvd 'lh bm'lh hzytym 'lh vbvkhh vr'sh lv chpvy vhv' hlkh ychf vkhl h'm 'shr 'tv chpv 'ysh r'shv v'lv 'lh vbkhh
verses.translation: And David went up by the ascent of mount Olivet, and wept as he went up, and had his head covered, and he went barefoot: and all the people that was with him covered every man his head, and they went up, weeping as they went up.

verses.original: וְ/דָוִד֙ הִגִּ֣יד לֵ/אמֹ֔ר אֲחִיתֹ֥פֶל בַּ/קֹּשְׁרִ֖ים עִם אַבְשָׁל֑וֹם וַ/יֹּ֣אמֶר דָּוִ֔ד סַכֶּל נָ֛א אֶת עֲצַ֥ת אֲחִיתֹ֖פֶל יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: vdvd hgyd l'mr 'chytpl bqshrym 'm 'bshlvm vy'mr dvd skhl n' 't 'tst 'chytpl yhvh
verses.translation: And one told David, saying, Ahithophel is among the conspirators with Absalom. And David said, O LORD , I pray thee, turn the counsel of Ahithophel into foolishness.

verses.original: וַ/יְהִ֤י דָוִד֙ בָּ֣א עַד הָ/רֹ֔אשׁ אֲשֶֽׁר יִשְׁתַּחֲוֶ֥ה שָׁ֖ם לֵ/אלֹהִ֑ים וְ/הִנֵּ֤ה לִ/קְרָאת/וֹ֙ חוּשַׁ֣י הָ/אַרְכִּ֔י קָר֨וּעַ֙ כֻּתָּנְתּ֔/וֹ וַ/אֲדָמָ֖ה עַל רֹאשֽׁ/וֹ
verses.translit: vyhy dvd b' 'd hr'sh 'shr yshtchvh shm l'lhym vhnh lqr'tv chvshy h'rkhy qrv' khtntv v'dmh 'l r'shv
verses.translation: And it came to pass, that when David was come to the top of the mount , where he worshipped God, behold, Hushai the Archite came to meet him with his coat rent, and earth upon his head:

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֥אמֶר ל֖/וֹ דָּוִ֑ד אִ֚ם עָבַ֣רְתָּ אִתִּ֔/י וְ/הָיִ֥תָ עָלַ֖/י לְ/מַשָּֽׂא
verses.translit: vy'mr lv dvd 'm 'brt 'ty vhyt 'ly lmsh'
verses.translation: Unto whom David said, If thou passest on with me, then thou shalt be a burden unto me:

verses.original: וְ/אִם הָ/עִ֣יר תָּשׁ֗וּב וְ/אָמַרְתָּ֤ לְ/אַבְשָׁלוֹם֙ עַבְדְּ/ךָ֨ אֲנִ֤י הַ/מֶּ֨לֶךְ֙ אֶֽהְיֶ֔ה עֶ֣בֶד אָבִ֤י/ךָ וַֽ/אֲנִי֙ מֵ/אָ֔ז וְ/עַתָּ֖ה וַ/אֲנִ֣י עַבְדֶּ֑/ךָ וְ/הֵפַרְתָּ֣ה לִ֔/י אֵ֖ת עֲצַ֥ת אֲחִיתֹֽפֶל
verses.translit: v'm h'yr tshvb v'mrt l'bshlvm 'bdkh 'ny hmlkh 'hyh 'bd 'bykh v'ny m'z v'th v'ny 'bdkh vhprth ly 't 'tst 'chytpl
verses.translation: But if thou return to the city, and say unto Absalom, I will be thy servant, O king; as I have been thy father’s servant hitherto, so will I now also be thy servant: then mayest thou for me defeat the counsel of Ahithophel.

verses.original: וַ/הֲ/ל֤וֹא עִמְּ/ךָ֙ שָׁ֔ם צָד֥וֹק וְ/אֶבְיָתָ֖ר הַ/כֹּהֲנִ֑ים וְ/הָיָ֗ה כָּל הַ/דָּבָר֙ אֲשֶׁ֤ר תִּשְׁמַע֙ מִ/בֵּ֣ית הַ/מֶּ֔לֶךְ תַּגִּ֕יד לְ/צָד֥וֹק וּ/לְ/אֶבְיָתָ֖ר הַ/כֹּהֲנִֽים
verses.translit: vhlv' 'mkh shm tsdvq v'bytr hkhhnym vhyh khl hdbr 'shr tshm' mbyt hmlkh tgyd ltsdvq vl'bytr hkhhnym
verses.translation: And hast thou not there with thee Zadok and Abiathar the priests? therefore it shall be, that what thing soever thou shalt hear out of the king’s house, thou shalt tell it to Zadok and Abiathar the priests.

verses.original: הִנֵּה שָׁ֤ם עִמָּ/ם֙ שְׁנֵ֣י בְנֵי/הֶ֔ם אֲחִימַ֣עַץ לְ/צָד֔וֹק וִ/יהוֹנָתָ֖ן לְ/אֶבְיָתָ֑ר וּ/שְׁלַחְתֶּ֤ם בְּ/יָדָ/ם֙ אֵלַ֔/י כָּל דָּבָ֖ר אֲשֶׁ֥ר תִּשְׁמָֽעוּ
verses.translit: hnh shm 'mm shny bnyhm 'chym'ts ltsdvq vyhvntn l'bytr vshlchtm bydm 'ly khl dbr 'shr tshm'v
verses.translation: Behold, they have there with them their two sons, Ahimaaz Zadok’s son , and Jonathan Abiathar’s son; and by them ye shall send unto me every thing that ye can hear.

verses.original: וַ/יָּבֹ֥א חוּשַׁ֛י רֵעֶ֥ה דָוִ֖ד הָ/עִ֑יר וְ/אַבְשָׁלֹ֔ם יָבֹ֖א יְרוּשָׁלִָֽם
verses.translit: vyb' chvshy r'h dvd h'yr v'bshlm yb' yrvshlm
verses.translation: So Hushai David’s friend came into the city, and Absalom came into Jerusalem.

verses.original: וְ/דָוִ֗ד עָבַ֤ר מְעַט֙ מֵֽ/הָ/רֹ֔אשׁ וְ/הִנֵּ֥ה צִיבָ֛א נַ֥עַר מְפִי בֹ֖שֶׁת לִ/קְרָאת֑/וֹ וְ/צֶ֨מֶד חֲמֹרִ֜ים חֲבֻשִׁ֗ים וַ/עֲלֵי/הֶם֩ מָאתַ֨יִם לֶ֜חֶם וּ/מֵאָ֧ה צִמּוּקִ֛ים וּ/מֵ֥אָה קַ֖יִץ וְ/נֵ֥בֶל יָֽיִן
verses.translit: vdvd 'br m't mhr'sh vhnh tsyb' n'r mpy bsht lqr'tv vtsmd chmrym chbshym v'lyhm m'tym lchm vm'h tsmvqym vm'h qyts vnbl yyn
verses.translation: And when David was a little past the top of the hill , behold, Ziba the servant of Mephibosheth met him, with a couple of asses saddled, and upon them two hundred loaves of bread, and an hundred bunches of raisins, and an hundred of summer fruits, and a bottle of wine.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֧אמֶר הַ/מֶּ֛לֶךְ אֶל צִיבָ֖א מָה אֵ֣לֶּה לָּ֑/ךְ וַ/יֹּ֣אמֶר צִ֠יבָא הַ/חֲמוֹרִ֨ים לְ/בֵית הַ/מֶּ֜לֶךְ לִ/רְכֹּ֗ב ו/ל/ה/לחם וְ/הַ/לֶּ֤חֶם וְ/הַ/קַּ֨יִץ֙ לֶ/אֱכ֣וֹל הַ/נְּעָרִ֔ים וְ/הַ/יַּ֕יִן לִ/שְׁתּ֥וֹת הַ/יָּעֵ֖ף בַּ/מִּדְבָּֽר
verses.translit: vy'mr hmlkh 'l tsyb' mh 'lh lkh vy'mr tsyb' hchmvrym lbyt hmlkh lrkhb vlhlchm vhlchm vhqyts l'khvl hn'rym vhyyn lshtvt hy'f bmdbr
verses.translation: And the king said unto Ziba, What meanest thou by these? And Ziba said, The asses be for the king’s household to ride on; and the bread and summer fruit for the young men to eat; and the wine, that such as be faint in the wilderness may drink.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֣אמֶר הַ/מֶּ֔לֶךְ וְ/אַיֵּ֖ה בֶּן אֲדֹנֶ֑י/ךָ וַ/יֹּ֨אמֶר צִיבָ֜א אֶל הַ/מֶּ֗לֶךְ הִנֵּה֙ יוֹשֵׁ֣ב בִּ/ירוּשָׁלִַ֔ם כִּ֣י אָמַ֔ר הַ/יּ֗וֹם יָשִׁ֤יבוּ לִ/י֙ בֵּ֣ית יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל אֵ֖ת מַמְלְכ֥וּת אָבִֽ/י
verses.translit: vy'mr hmlkh v'yh bn 'dnykh vy'mr tsyb' 'l hmlkh hnh yvshb byrvshlm khy 'mr hyvm yshybv ly byt yshr'l 't mmlkhvt 'by
verses.translation: And the king said, And where is thy master’s son? And Ziba said unto the king, Behold, he abideth at Jerusalem: for he said, To day shall the house of Israel restore me the kingdom of my father.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֤אמֶר הַ/מֶּ֨לֶךְ֙ לְ/צִבָ֔א הִנֵּ֣ה לְ/ךָ֔ כֹּ֖ל אֲשֶׁ֣ר לִ/מְפִי בֹ֑שֶׁת וַ/יֹּ֤אמֶר צִיבָא֙ הִֽשְׁתַּחֲוֵ֔יתִי אֶמְצָא חֵ֥ן בְּ/עֵינֶ֖י/ךָ אֲדֹנִ֥/י הַ/מֶּֽלֶךְ
verses.translit: vy'mr hmlkh ltsb' hnh lkh khl 'shr lmpy bsht vy'mr tsyb' hshtchvyty 'mts' chn b'ynykh 'dny hmlkh
verses.translation: Then said the king to Ziba, Behold, thine are all that pertained unto Mephibosheth. And Ziba said, I humbly beseech thee that I may find grace in thy sight, my lord, O king.

verses.original: וּ/בָ֛א הַ/מֶּ֥לֶךְ דָּוִ֖ד עַד בַּֽחוּרִ֑ים וְ/הִנֵּ֣ה מִ/שָּׁם֩ אִ֨ישׁ יוֹצֵ֜א מִ/מִּשְׁפַּ֣חַת בֵּית שָׁא֗וּל וּ/שְׁמ/וֹ֙ שִׁמְעִ֣י בֶן גֵּרָ֔א יֹצֵ֥א יָצ֖וֹא וּ/מְקַלֵּֽל
verses.translit: vb' hmlkh dvd 'd bchvrym vhnh mshm 'ysh yvts' mmshpcht byt sh'vl vshmv shm'y bn gr' yts' ytsv' vmqll
verses.translation: And when king David came to Bahurim, behold, thence came out a man of the family of the house of Saul, whose name was Shimei, the son of Gera: he came forth, and cursed still as he came.

verses.original: וַ/יְסַקֵּ֤ל בָּֽ/אֲבָנִים֙ אֶת דָּוִ֔ד וְ/אֶת כָּל עַבְדֵ֖י הַ/מֶּ֣לֶךְ דָּוִ֑ד וְ/כָל הָ/עָם֙ וְ/כָל הַ/גִּבֹּרִ֔ים מִ/ימִינ֖/וֹ וּ/מִ/שְּׂמֹאלֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: vysql b'bnym 't dvd v't khl 'bdy hmlkh dvd vkhl h'm vkhl hgbrym mymynv vmshm'lv
verses.translation: And he cast stones at David, and at all the servants of king David: and all the people and all the mighty men were on his right hand and on his left.

verses.original: וְ/כֹֽה אָמַ֥ר שִׁמְעִ֖י בְּ/קַֽלְל֑/וֹ צֵ֥א צֵ֛א אִ֥ישׁ הַ/דָּמִ֖ים וְ/אִ֥ישׁ הַ/בְּלִיָּֽעַל
verses.translit: vkhh 'mr shm'y bqllv ts' ts' 'ysh hdmym v'ysh hbly'l
verses.translation: And thus said Shimei when he cursed, Come out, come out, thou bloody man, and thou man of Belial:

verses.original: הֵשִׁיב֩ עָלֶ֨י/ךָ יְהוָ֜ה כֹּ֣ל דְּמֵ֣י בֵית שָׁא֗וּל אֲשֶׁ֤ר מָלַ֨כְתָּ֙ תחת/ו תַּחְתָּ֔י/ו וַ/יִּתֵּ֤ן יְהוָה֙ אֶת הַ/מְּלוּכָ֔ה בְּ/יַ֖ד אַבְשָׁל֣וֹם בְּנֶ֑/ךָ וְ/הִנְּ/ךָ֙ בְּ/רָ֣עָתֶ֔/ךָ כִּ֛י אִ֥ישׁ דָּמִ֖ים אָֽתָּה
verses.translit: hshyb 'lykh yhvh khl dmy byt sh'vl 'shr mlkht tchtv tchtyv vytn yhvh 't hmlvkhh byd 'bshlvm bnkh vhnkh br'tkh khy 'ysh dmym 'th
verses.translation: The LORD hath returned upon thee all the blood of the house of Saul, in whose stead thou hast reigned; and the LORD hath delivered the kingdom into the hand of Absalom thy son: and, behold, thou art taken in thy mischief, because thou art a bloody man.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֨אמֶר אֲבִישַׁ֤י בֶּן צְרוּיָה֙ אֶל הַ/מֶּ֔לֶךְ לָ֣/מָּה יְקַלֵּ֞ל הַ/כֶּ֤לֶב הַ/מֵּת֙ הַ/זֶּ֔ה אֶת אֲדֹנִ֖/י הַ/מֶּ֑לֶךְ אֶעְבְּרָה נָּ֖א וְ/אָסִ֥ירָה אֶת רֹאשֽׁ/וֹ
verses.translit: vy'mr 'byshy bn tsrvyh 'l hmlkh lmh yqll hkhlb hmt hzh 't 'dny hmlkh ''brh n' v'syrh 't r'shv
verses.translation: Then said Abishai the son of Zeruiah unto the king, Why should this dead dog curse my lord the king? let me go over, I pray thee, and take off his head.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֣אמֶר הַ/מֶּ֔לֶךְ מַה לִּ֥/י וְ/לָ/כֶ֖ם בְּנֵ֣י צְרֻיָ֑ה כי כֹּ֣ה יְקַלֵּ֗ל ו/כי כִּ֤י יְהוָה֙ אָ֤מַר ל/וֹ֙ קַלֵּ֣ל אֶת דָּוִ֔ד וּ/מִ֣י יֹאמַ֔ר מַדּ֖וּעַ עָשִׂ֥יתָה כֵּֽן
verses.translit: vy'mr hmlkh mh ly vlkhm bny tsryh khy khh yqll vkhy khy yhvh 'mr lv qll 't dvd vmy y'mr mdv' 'shyth khn
verses.translation: And the king said, What have I to do with you, ye sons of Zeruiah? so let him curse, because the LORD hath said unto him, Curse David. Who shall then say, Wherefore hast thou done so?

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֨אמֶר דָּוִ֤ד אֶל אֲבִישַׁי֙ וְ/אֶל כָּל עֲבָדָ֔י/ו הִנֵּ֥ה בְנִ֛/י אֲשֶׁר יָצָ֥א מִ/מֵּעַ֖/י מְבַקֵּ֣שׁ אֶת נַפְשִׁ֑/י וְ/אַ֨ף כִּֽי עַתָּ֜ה בֶּן הַ/יְמִינִ֗י הַנִּ֤חוּ ל/וֹ֙ וִֽ/יקַלֵּ֔ל כִּ֥י אָֽמַר ל֖/וֹ יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: vy'mr dvd 'l 'byshy v'l khl 'bdyv hnh bny 'shr yts' mm'y mbqsh 't npshy v'f khy 'th bn hymyny hnchv lv vyqll khy 'mr lv yhvh
verses.translation: And David said to Abishai, and to all his servants, Behold, my son, which came forth of my bowels, seeketh my life: how much more now may this Benjamite do it ? let him alone, and let him curse; for the LORD hath bidden him.

verses.original: אוּלַ֛י יִרְאֶ֥ה יְהוָ֖ה ב/עונ/י בְּ/עֵינִ֑/י וְ/הֵשִׁ֨יב יְהוָ֥ה לִ/י֙ טוֹבָ֔ה תַּ֥חַת קִלְלָת֖/וֹ הַ/יּ֥וֹם הַ/זֶּֽה
verses.translit: 'vly yr'h yhvh b'vny b'yny vhshyb yhvh ly tvbh tcht qlltv hyvm hzh
verses.translation: It may be that the LORD will look on mine affliction, and that the LORD will requite me good for his cursing this day.

verses.original: וַ/יֵּ֧לֶךְ דָּוִ֛ד וַ/אֲנָשָׁ֖י/ו בַּ/דָּ֑רֶךְ וְ/שִׁמְעִ֡י הֹלֵךְ֩ בְּ/צֵ֨לַע הָ/הָ֜ר לְ/עֻמָּת֗/וֹ הָלוֹךְ֙ וַ/יְקַלֵּ֔ל וַ/יְסַקֵּ֤ל בָּֽ/אֲבָנִים֙ לְ/עֻמָּת֔/וֹ וְ/עִפַּ֖ר בֶּ/עָפָֽר
verses.translit: vylkh dvd v'nshyv bdrkh vshm'y hlkh btsl' hhr l'mtv hlvkh vyqll vysql b'bnym l'mtv v'pr b'pr
verses.translation: And as David and his men went by the way, Shimei went along on the hill’s side over against him, and cursed as he went, and threw stones at him, and cast dust.

verses.original: וַ/יָּבֹ֥א הַ/מֶּ֛לֶךְ וְ/כָל הָ/עָ֥ם אֲשֶׁר אִתּ֖/וֹ עֲיֵפִ֑ים וַ/יִּנָּפֵ֖שׁ שָֽׁם
verses.translit: vyb' hmlkh vkhl h'm 'shr 'tv 'ypym vynpsh shm
verses.translation: And the king, and all the people that were with him, came weary, and refreshed themselves there.

verses.original: וְ/אַבְשָׁל֗וֹם וְ/כָל הָ/עָם֙ אִ֣ישׁ יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל בָּ֖אוּ יְרוּשָׁלִָ֑ם וַ/אֲחִיתֹ֖פֶל אִתּֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: v'bshlvm vkhl h'm 'ysh yshr'l b'v yrvshlm v'chytpl 'tv
verses.translation: And Absalom, and all the people the men of Israel, came to Jerusalem, and Ahithophel with him.

verses.original: וַ/יְהִ֗י כַּֽ/אֲשֶׁר בָּ֞א חוּשַׁ֧י הָ/אַרְכִּ֛י רֵעֶ֥ה דָוִ֖ד אֶל אַבְשָׁל֑וֹם וַ/יֹּ֤אמֶר חוּשַׁי֙ אֶל אַבְשָׁלֹ֔ם יְחִ֥י הַ/מֶּ֖לֶךְ יְחִ֥י הַ/מֶּֽלֶךְ
verses.translit: vyhy kh'shr b' chvshy h'rkhy r'h dvd 'l 'bshlvm vy'mr chvshy 'l 'bshlm ychy hmlkh ychy hmlkh
verses.translation: And it came to pass, when Hushai the Archite, David’s friend, was come unto Absalom, that Hushai said unto Absalom, God save the king, God save the king.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֤אמֶר אַבְשָׁלוֹם֙ אֶל חוּשַׁ֔י זֶ֥ה חַסְדְּ/ךָ֖ אֶת רֵעֶ֑/ךָ לָ֥/מָּה לֹֽא הָלַ֖כְתָּ אֶת רֵעֶֽ/ךָ
verses.translit: vy'mr 'bshlvm 'l chvshy zh chsdkh 't r'kh lmh l' hlkht 't r'kh
verses.translation: And Absalom said to Hushai, Is this thy kindness to thy friend? why wentest thou not with thy friend?

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֣אמֶר חוּשַׁי֮ אֶל אַבְשָׁלֹם֒ לֹ֕א כִּי֩ אֲשֶׁ֨ר בָּחַ֧ר יְהוָ֛ה וְ/הָ/עָ֥ם הַ/זֶּ֖ה וְ/כָל אִ֣ישׁ יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל לא ל֥/וֹ אֶהְיֶ֖ה וְ/אִתּ֥/וֹ אֵשֵֽׁב
verses.translit: vy'mr chvshy 'l 'bshlm l' khy 'shr bchr yhvh vh'm hzh vkhl 'ysh yshr'l l' lv 'hyh v'tv 'shb
verses.translation: And Hushai said unto Absalom, Nay; but whom the LORD , and this people, and all the men of Israel, choose, his will I be, and with him will I abide.

verses.original: וְ/הַ/שֵּׁנִ֗ית לְ/מִי֙ אֲנִ֣י אֶֽעֱבֹ֔ד הֲ/ל֖וֹא לִ/פְנֵ֣י בְנ֑/וֹ כַּ/אֲשֶׁ֤ר עָבַ֨דְתִּי֙ לִ/פְנֵ֣י אָבִ֔י/ךָ כֵּ֖ן אֶהְיֶ֥ה לְ/פָנֶֽי/ךָ
verses.translit: vhshnyt lmy 'ny ''bd hlv' lpny bnv kh'shr 'bdty lpny 'bykh khn 'hyh lpnykh
verses.translation: And again, whom should I serve? should I not serve in the presence of his son? as I have served in thy father’s presence, so will I be in thy presence.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֥אמֶר אַבְשָׁל֖וֹם אֶל אֲחִיתֹ֑פֶל הָב֥וּ לָ/כֶ֛ם עֵצָ֖ה מַֽה נַּעֲשֶֽׂה
verses.translit: vy'mr 'bshlvm 'l 'chytpl hbv lkhm 'tsh mh n'shh
verses.translation: Then said Absalom to Ahithophel, Give counsel among you what we shall do.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֤אמֶר אֲחִיתֹ֨פֶל֙ אֶל אַבְשָׁלֹ֔ם בּ֚וֹא אֶל פִּלַגְשֵׁ֣י אָבִ֔י/ךָ אֲשֶׁ֥ר הִנִּ֖יחַ לִ/שְׁמ֣וֹר הַ/בָּ֑יִת וְ/שָׁמַ֤ע כָּל יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ כִּֽי נִבְאַ֣שְׁתָּ אֶת אָבִ֔י/ךָ וְ/חָ֣זְק֔וּ יְדֵ֖י כָּל אֲשֶׁ֥ר אִתָּֽ/ךְ
verses.translit: vy'mr 'chytpl 'l 'bshlm bv' 'l plgshy 'bykh 'shr hnych lshmvr hbyt vshm' khl yshr'l khy nb'sht 't 'bykh vchzqv ydy khl 'shr 'tkh
verses.translation: And Ahithophel said unto Absalom, Go in unto thy father’s concubines, which he hath left to keep the house; and all Israel shall hear that thou art abhorred of thy father: then shall the hands of all that are with thee be strong.

verses.original: וַ/יַּטּ֧וּ לְ/אַבְשָׁל֛וֹם הָ/אֹ֖הֶל עַל הַ/גָּ֑ג וַ/יָּבֹ֤א אַבְשָׁלוֹם֙ אֶל פִּֽלַגְשֵׁ֣י אָבִ֔י/ו לְ/עֵינֵ֖י כָּל יִשְׂרָאֵֽל
verses.translit: vytv l'bshlvm h'hl 'l hgg vyb' 'bshlvm 'l plgshy 'byv l'yny khl yshr'l
verses.translation: So they spread Absalom a tent upon the top of the house; and Absalom went in unto his father’s concubines in the sight of all Israel.

verses.original: וַ/עֲצַ֣ת אֲחִיתֹ֗פֶל אֲשֶׁ֤ר יָעַץ֙ בַּ/יָּמִ֣ים הָ/הֵ֔ם כַּ/אֲשֶׁ֥ר יִשְׁאַל אִ֖ישׁ בִּ/דְבַ֣ר הָ/אֱלֹהִ֑ים כֵּ֚ן כָּל עֲצַ֣ת אֲחִיתֹ֔פֶל גַּם לְ/דָוִ֖ד גַּ֥ם לְ/אַבְשָׁלֹֽם
verses.translit: v'tst 'chytpl 'shr y'ts bymym hhm kh'shr ysh'l 'ysh bdbr h'lhym khn khl 'tst 'chytpl gm ldvd gm l'bshlm
verses.translation: And the counsel of Ahithophel, which he counselled in those days, was as if a man had enquired at the oracle of God: so was all the counsel of Ahithophel both with David and with Absalom.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֥אמֶר אֲחִיתֹ֖פֶל אֶל אַבְשָׁלֹ֑ם אֶבְחֲרָ֣ה נָּ֗א שְׁנֵים עָשָׂ֥ר אֶ֨לֶף֙ אִ֔ישׁ וְ/אָק֛וּמָה וְ/אֶרְדְּפָ֥ה אַחֲרֵי דָוִ֖ד הַ/לָּֽיְלָה
verses.translit: vy'mr 'chytpl 'l 'bshlm 'bchrh n' shnym 'shr 'lf 'ysh v'qvmh v'rdph 'chry dvd hlylh
verses.translation: Moreover Ahithophel said unto Absalom, Let me now choose out twelve thousand men, and I will arise and pursue after David this night:

verses.original: וְ/אָב֣וֹא עָלָ֗י/ו וְ/ה֤וּא יָגֵ֨עַ֙ וּ/רְפֵ֣ה יָדַ֔יִם וְ/הַֽחֲרַדְתִּ֣י אֹת֔/וֹ וְ/נָ֖ס כָּל הָ/עָ֣ם אֲשֶׁר אִתּ֑/וֹ וְ/הִכֵּיתִ֥י אֶת הַ/מֶּ֖לֶךְ לְ/בַדּֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: v'bv' 'lyv vhv' yg' vrph ydym vhchrdty 'tv vns khl h'm 'shr 'tv vhkhyty 't hmlkh lbdv
verses.translation: And I will come upon him while he is weary and weak handed, and will make him afraid: and all the people that are with him shall flee; and I will smite the king only:

verses.original: וְ/אָשִׁ֥יבָה כָל הָ/עָ֖ם אֵלֶ֑י/ךָ כְּ/שׁ֣וּב הַ/כֹּ֔ל הָ/אִישׁ֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר אַתָּ֣ה מְבַקֵּ֔שׁ כָּל הָ/עָ֖ם יִהְיֶ֥ה שָׁלֽוֹם
verses.translit: v'shybh khl h'm 'lykh khshvb hkhl h'ysh 'shr 'th mbqsh khl h'm yhyh shlvm
verses.translation: And I will bring back all the people unto thee: the man whom thou seekest is as if all returned: so all the people shall be in peace.

verses.original: וַ/יִּישַׁ֥ר הַ/דָּבָ֖ר בְּ/עֵינֵ֣י אַבְשָׁלֹ֑ם וּ/בְ/עֵינֵ֖י כָּל זִקְנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל
verses.translit: vyyshr hdbr b'yny 'bshlm vb'yny khl zqny yshr'l
verses.translation: And the saying pleased Absalom well, and all the elders of Israel.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֨אמֶר֙ אַבְשָׁל֔וֹם קְרָ֣א נָ֔א גַּ֖ם לְ/חוּשַׁ֣י הָ/אַרְכִּ֑י וְ/נִשְׁמְעָ֥ה מַה בְּ/פִ֖י/ו גַּם הֽוּא
verses.translit: vy'mr 'bshlvm qr' n' gm lchvshy h'rkhy vnshm'h mh bpyv gm hv'
verses.translation: Then said Absalom, Call now Hushai the Archite also, and let us hear likewise what he saith.

verses.original: וַ/יָּבֹ֣א חוּשַׁי֮ אֶל אַבְשָׁלוֹם֒ וַ/יֹּאמֶר֩ אַבְשָׁל֨וֹם אֵלָ֜י/ו לֵ/אמֹ֗ר כַּ/דָּבָ֤ר הַ/זֶּה֙ דִּבֶּ֣ר אֲחִיתֹ֔פֶל הֲ/נַעֲשֶׂ֖ה אֶת דְּבָר֑/וֹ אִם אַ֖יִן אַתָּ֥ה דַבֵּֽר
verses.translit: vyb' chvshy 'l 'bshlvm vy'mr 'bshlvm 'lyv l'mr khdbr hzh dbr 'chytpl hn'shh 't dbrv 'm 'yn 'th dbr
verses.translation: And when Hushai was come to Absalom, Absalom spake unto him, saying, Ahithophel hath spoken after this manner: shall we do after his saying? if not; speak thou.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֥אמֶר חוּשַׁ֖י אֶל אַבְשָׁל֑וֹם לֹֽא טוֹבָ֧ה הָ/עֵצָ֛ה אֲשֶׁר יָעַ֥ץ אֲחִיתֹ֖פֶל בַּ/פַּ֥עַם הַ/זֹּֽאת
verses.translit: vy'mr chvshy 'l 'bshlvm l' tvbh h'tsh 'shr y'ts 'chytpl bp'm hz't
verses.translation: And Hushai said unto Absalom, The counsel that Ahithophel hath given is not good at this time.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֣אמֶר חוּשַׁ֗י אַתָּ֣ה יָ֠דַעְתָּ אֶת אָבִ֨י/ךָ וְ/אֶת אֲנָשָׁ֜י/ו כִּ֧י גִבֹּרִ֣ים הֵ֗מָּה וּ/מָרֵ֥י נֶ֨פֶשׁ֙ הֵ֔מָּה כְּ/דֹ֥ב שַׁכּ֖וּל בַּ/שָּׂדֶ֑ה וְ/אָבִ֨י/ךָ֙ אִ֣ישׁ מִלְחָמָ֔ה וְ/לֹ֥א יָלִ֖ין אֶת הָ/עָֽם
verses.translit: vy'mr chvshy 'th yd't 't 'bykh v't 'nshyv khy gbrym hmh vmry npsh hmh khdb shkhvl bshdh v'bykh 'ysh mlchmh vl' ylyn 't h'm
verses.translation: For, said Hushai, thou knowest thy father and his men, that they be mighty men, and they be chafed in their minds, as a bear robbed of her whelps in the field: and thy father is a man of war, and will not lodge with the people.

verses.original: הִנֵּ֨ה עַתָּ֤ה הֽוּא נֶחְבָּא֙ בְּ/אַחַ֣ת הַ/פְּחָתִ֔ים א֖וֹ בְּ/אַחַ֣ד הַ/מְּקוֹמֹ֑ת וְ/הָיָ֗ה כִּ/נְפֹ֤ל בָּ/הֶם֙ בַּ/תְּחִלָּ֔ה וְ/שָׁמַ֤ע הַ/שֹּׁמֵ֨עַ֙ וְ/אָמַ֔ר הָֽיְתָה֙ מַגֵּפָ֔ה בָּ/עָ֕ם אֲשֶׁ֖ר אַחֲרֵ֥י אַבְשָׁלֹֽם
verses.translit: hnh 'th hv' nchb' b'cht hpchtym 'v b'chd hmqvmt vhyh khnpl bhm btchlh vshm' hshm' v'mr hyth mgph b'm 'shr 'chry 'bshlm
verses.translation: Behold, he is hid now in some pit, or in some other place: and it will come to pass, when some of them be overthrown at the first, that whosoever heareth it will say, There is a slaughter among the people that follow Absalom.

verses.original: וְ/ה֣וּא גַם בֶּן חַ֗יִל אֲשֶׁ֥ר לִבּ֛/וֹ כְּ/לֵ֥ב הָ/אַרְיֵ֖ה הִמֵּ֣ס יִמָּ֑ס כִּֽי יֹדֵ֤עַ כָּל יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ כִּי גִבּ֣וֹר אָבִ֔י/ךָ וּ/בְנֵי חַ֖יִל אֲשֶׁ֥ר אִתּֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: vhv' gm bn chyl 'shr lbv khlb h'ryh hms yms khy yd' khl yshr'l khy gbvr 'bykh vbny chyl 'shr 'tv
verses.translation: And he also that is valiant, whose heart is as the heart of a lion, shall utterly melt: for all Israel knoweth that thy father is a mighty man, and they which be with him are valiant men.

verses.original: כִּ֣י יָעַ֗צְתִּי הֵ֠אָסֹף יֵאָסֵ֨ף עָלֶ֤י/ךָ כָל יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ מִ/דָּן֙ וְ/עַד בְּאֵ֣ר שֶׁ֔בַע כַּ/ח֥וֹל אֲשֶׁר עַל הַ/יָּ֖ם לָ/רֹ֑ב וּ/פָנֶ֥י/ךָ הֹלְכִ֖ים בַּ/קְרָֽב
verses.translit: khy y'tsty h'sf y'sf 'lykh khl yshr'l mdn v'd b'r shb' khchvl 'shr 'l hym lrb vpnykh hlkhym bqrb
verses.translation: Therefore I counsel that all Israel be generally gathered unto thee, from Dan even to Beer-sheba, as the sand that is by the sea for multitude; and that thou go to battle in thine own person.

verses.original: וּ/בָ֣אנוּ אֵלָ֗י/ו ב/אחת בְּ/אַחַ֤ד הַ/מְּקוֹמֹת֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר נִמְצָ֣א שָׁ֔ם וְ/נַ֣חְנוּ עָלָ֔י/ו כַּ/אֲשֶׁ֛ר יִפֹּ֥ל הַ/טַּ֖ל עַל הָ/אֲדָמָ֑ה וְ/לֹֽא נ֥וֹתַר בּ֛/וֹ וּ/בְ/כָל הָ/אֲנָשִׁ֥ים אֲשֶׁר אִתּ֖/וֹ גַּם אֶחָֽד
verses.translit: vb'nv 'lyv b'cht b'chd hmqvmt 'shr nmts' shm vnchnv 'lyv kh'shr ypl htl 'l h'dmh vl' nvtr bv vbkhl h'nshym 'shr 'tv gm 'chd
verses.translation: So shall we come upon him in some place where he shall be found, and we will light upon him as the dew falleth on the ground: and of him and of all the men that are with him there shall not be left so much as one.

verses.original: וְ/אִם אֶל עִיר֙ יֵֽאָסֵ֔ף וְ/הִשִּׂ֧יאוּ כָֽל יִשְׂרָאֵ֛ל אֶל הָ/עִ֥יר הַ/הִ֖יא חֲבָלִ֑ים וְ/סָחַ֤בְנוּ אֹת/וֹ֙ עַד הַ/נַּ֔חַל עַ֛ד אֲשֶֽׁר לֹא נִמְצָ֥א שָׁ֖ם גַּם צְרֽוֹר
verses.translit: v'm 'l 'yr y'sf vhshy'v khl yshr'l 'l h'yr hhy' chblym vschbnv 'tv 'd hnchl 'd 'shr l' nmts' shm gm tsrvr
verses.translation: Moreover, if he be gotten into a city, then shall all Israel bring ropes to that city, and we will draw it into the river, until there be not one small stone found there.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֤אמֶר אַבְשָׁלוֹם֙ וְ/כָל אִ֣ישׁ יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל טוֹבָ֗ה עֲצַת֙ חוּשַׁ֣י הָ/אַרְכִּ֔י מֵ/עֲצַ֖ת אֲחִיתֹ֑פֶל וַ/יהוָ֣ה צִוָּ֗ה לְ/הָפֵ֞ר אֶת עֲצַ֤ת אֲחִיתֹ֨פֶל֙ הַ/טּוֹבָ֔ה לְ/בַ/עֲב֗וּר הָבִ֧יא יְהוָ֛ה אֶל אַבְשָׁל֖וֹם אֶת הָ/רָעָֽה
verses.translit: vy'mr 'bshlvm vkhl 'ysh yshr'l tvbh 'tst chvshy h'rkhy m'tst 'chytpl vyhvh tsvh lhpr 't 'tst 'chytpl htvbh lb'bvr hby' yhvh 'l 'bshlvm 't hr'h
verses.translation: And Absalom and all the men of Israel said, The counsel of Hushai the Archite is better than the counsel of Ahithophel. For the LORD had appointed to defeat the good counsel of Ahithophel, to the intent that the LORD might bring evil upon Absalom.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֣אמֶר חוּשַׁ֗י אֶל צָד֤וֹק וְ/אֶל אֶבְיָתָר֙ הַ/כֹּ֣הֲנִ֔ים כָּ/זֹ֣את וְ/כָ/זֹ֗את יָעַ֤ץ אֲחִיתֹ֨פֶל֙ אֶת אַבְשָׁלֹ֔ם וְ/אֵ֖ת זִקְנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וְ/כָ/זֹ֥את וְ/כָ/זֹ֖את יָעַ֥צְתִּי אָֽנִי
verses.translit: vy'mr chvshy 'l tsdvq v'l 'bytr hkhhnym khz't vkhz't y'ts 'chytpl 't 'bshlm v't zqny yshr'l vkhz't vkhz't y'tsty 'ny
verses.translation: Then said Hushai unto Zadok and to Abiathar the priests, Thus and thus did Ahithophel counsel Absalom and the elders of Israel; and thus and thus have I counselled.

verses.original: וְ/עַתָּ֡ה שִׁלְח֣וּ מְהֵרָה֩ וְ/הַגִּ֨ידוּ לְ/דָוִ֜ד לֵ/אמֹ֗ר אַל תָּ֤לֶן הַ/לַּ֨יְלָה֙ בְּ/עַֽרְב֣וֹת הַ/מִּדְבָּ֔ר וְ/גַ֖ם עָב֣וֹר תַּעֲב֑וֹר פֶּ֚ן יְבֻלַּ֣ע לַ/מֶּ֔לֶךְ וּ/לְ/כָל הָ/עָ֖ם אֲשֶׁ֥ר אִתּֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: v'th shlchv mhrh vhgydv ldvd l'mr 'l tln hlylh b'rbvt hmdbr vgm 'bvr t'bvr pn ybl' lmlkh vlkhl h'm 'shr 'tv
verses.translation: Now therefore send quickly, and tell David, saying, Lodge not this night in the plains of the wilderness, but speedily pass over; lest the king be swallowed up, and all the people that are with him.

verses.original: וִ/יהוֹנָתָ֨ן וַ/אֲחִימַ֜עַץ עֹמְדִ֣ים בְּ/עֵין רֹגֵ֗ל וְ/הָלְכָ֤ה הַ/שִּׁפְחָה֙ וְ/הִגִּ֣ידָה לָ/הֶ֔ם וְ/הֵם֙ יֵֽלְכ֔וּ וְ/הִגִּ֖ידוּ לַ/מֶּ֣לֶךְ דָּוִ֑ד כִּ֣י לֹ֥א יוּכְל֛וּ לְ/הֵרָא֖וֹת לָ/ב֥וֹא הָ/עִֽירָ/ה
verses.translit: vyhvntn v'chym'ts 'mdym b'yn rgl vhlkhh hshpchh vhgydh lhm vhm ylkhv vhgydv lmlkh dvd khy l' yvkhlv lhr'vt lbv' h'yrh
verses.translation: Now Jonathan and Ahimaaz stayed by En-rogel; for they might not be seen to come into the city: and a wench went and told them; and they went and told king David.

verses.original: וַ/יַּ֤רְא אֹתָ/ם֙ נַ֔עַר וַ/יַּגֵּ֖ד לְ/אַבְשָׁלֹ֑ם וַ/יֵּלְכוּ֩ שְׁנֵי/הֶ֨ם מְהֵרָ֜ה וַ/יָּבֹ֣אוּ אֶל בֵּֽית אִ֣ישׁ בְּ/בַחוּרִ֗ים וְ/ל֥/וֹ בְאֵ֛ר בַּ/חֲצֵר֖/וֹ וַ/יֵּ֥רְדוּ שָֽׁם
verses.translit: vyr' 'tm n'r vygd l'bshlm vylkhv shnyhm mhrh vyb'v 'l byt 'ysh bbchvrym vlv b'r bchtsrv vyrdv shm
verses.translation: Nevertheless a lad saw them, and told Absalom: but they went both of them away quickly, and came to a man’s house in Bahurim, which had a well in his court; whither they went down.

verses.original: וַ/תִּקַּ֣ח הָ/אִשָּׁ֗ה וַ/תִּפְרֹ֤שׂ אֶת הַ/מָּסָךְ֙ עַל פְּנֵ֣י הַ/בְּאֵ֔ר וַ/תִּשְׁטַ֥ח עָלָ֖י/ו הָֽ/רִפ֑וֹת וְ/לֹ֥א נוֹדַ֖ע דָּבָֽר
verses.translit: vtqch h'shh vtprsh 't hmskh 'l pny hb'r vtshtch 'lyv hrpvt vl' nvd' dbr
verses.translation: And the woman took and spread a covering over the well’s mouth, and spread ground corn thereon; and the thing was not known.

verses.original: וַ/יָּבֹ֣אוּ עַבְדֵי֩ אַבְשָׁל֨וֹם אֶֽל הָ/אִשָּׁ֜ה הַ/בַּ֗יְתָ/ה וַ/יֹּֽאמְרוּ֙ אַיֵּ֗ה אֲחִימַ֨עַץ֙ וִ/יה֣וֹנָתָ֔ן וַ/תֹּ֤אמֶר לָ/הֶם֙ הָֽ/אִשָּׁ֔ה עָבְר֖וּ מִיכַ֣ל הַ/מָּ֑יִם וַ/יְבַקְשׁוּ֙ וְ/לֹ֣א מָצָ֔אוּ וַ/יָּשֻׁ֖בוּ יְרוּשָׁלִָֽם
verses.translit: vyb'v 'bdy 'bshlvm 'l h'shh hbyth vy'mrv 'yh 'chym'ts vyhvntn vt'mr lhm h'shh 'brv mykhl hmym vybqshv vl' mts'v vyshbv yrvshlm
verses.translation: And when Absalom’s servants came to the woman to the house, they said, Where is Ahimaaz and Jonathan? And the woman said unto them, They be gone over the brook of water. And when they had sought and could not find them , they returned to Jerusalem.

verses.original: וַ/יְהִ֣י אַחֲרֵ֣י לֶכְתָּ֗/ם וַֽ/יַּעֲלוּ֙ מֵֽ/הַ/בְּאֵ֔ר וַ/יֵּ֣לְכ֔וּ וַ/יַּגִּ֖דוּ לַ/מֶּ֣לֶךְ דָּוִ֑ד וַ/יֹּאמְר֣וּ אֶל דָּוִ֗ד ק֣וּמוּ וְ/עִבְר֤וּ מְהֵרָה֙ אֶת הַ/מַּ֔יִם כִּי כָ֛כָה יָעַ֥ץ עֲלֵי/כֶ֖ם אֲחִיתֹֽפֶל
verses.translit: vyhy 'chry lkhtm vy'lv mhb'r vylkhv vygdv lmlkh dvd vy'mrv 'l dvd qvmv v'brv mhrh 't hmym khy khkhh y'ts 'lykhm 'chytpl
verses.translation: And it came to pass, after they were departed, that they came up out of the well, and went and told king David, and said unto David, Arise, and pass quickly over the water: for thus hath Ahithophel counselled against you.

verses.original: וַ/יָּ֣קָם דָּוִ֗ד וְ/כָל הָ/עָם֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר אִתּ֔/וֹ וַ/יַּעַבְר֖וּ אֶת הַ/יַּרְדֵּ֑ן עַד א֣וֹר הַ/בֹּ֗קֶר עַד אַחַד֙ לֹ֣א נֶעְדָּ֔ר אֲשֶׁ֥ר לֹא עָבַ֖ר אֶת הַ/יַּרְדֵּֽן
verses.translit: vyqm dvd vkhl h'm 'shr 'tv vy'brv 't hyrdn 'd 'vr hbqr 'd 'chd l' n'dr 'shr l' 'br 't hyrdn
verses.translation: Then David arose, and all the people that were with him, and they passed over Jordan: by the morning light there lacked not one of them that was not gone over Jordan.

verses.original: וַ/אֲחִיתֹ֣פֶל רָאָ֗ה כִּ֣י לֹ֣א נֶעֶשְׂתָה֮ עֲצָת/וֹ֒ וַ/יַּחֲבֹ֣שׁ אֶֽת הַ/חֲמ֗וֹר וַ/יָּ֜קָם וַ/יֵּ֤לֶךְ אֶל בֵּית/וֹ֙ אֶל עִיר֔/וֹ וַ/יְצַ֥ו אֶל בֵּית֖/וֹ וַ/יֵּחָנַ֑ק וַ/יָּ֕מָת וַ/יִּקָּבֵ֖ר בְּ/קֶ֥בֶר אָבִֽי/ו
verses.translit: v'chytpl r'h khy l' n'shth 'tstv vychbsh 't hchmvr vyqm vylkh 'l bytv 'l 'yrv vytsv 'l bytv vychnq vymt vyqbr bqbr 'byv
verses.translation: And when Ahithophel saw that his counsel was not followed, he saddled his ass, and arose, and gat him home to his house, to his city, and put his household in order, and hanged himself, and died, and was buried in the sepulchre of his father.

verses.original: וְ/דָוִ֖ד בָּ֣א מַחֲנָ֑יְמָ/ה וְ/אַבְשָׁלֹ֗ם עָבַר֙ אֶת הַ/יַּרְדֵּ֔ן ה֕וּא וְ/כָל אִ֥ישׁ יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל עִמּֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: vdvd b' mchnymh v'bshlm 'br 't hyrdn hv' vkhl 'ysh yshr'l 'mv
verses.translation: Then David came to Mahanaim. And Absalom passed over Jordan, he and all the men of Israel with him.

verses.original: וְ/אֶת עֲמָשָׂ֗א שָׂ֧ם אַבְשָׁלֹ֛ם תַּ֥חַת יוֹאָ֖ב עַל הַ/צָּבָ֑א וַ/עֲמָשָׂ֣א בֶן אִ֗ישׁ וּ/שְׁמ/וֹ֙ יִתְרָ֣א הַ/יִּשְׂרְאֵלִ֔י אֲשֶׁר בָּא֙ אֶל אֲבִיגַ֣ל בַּת נָחָ֔שׁ אֲח֥וֹת צְרוּיָ֖ה אֵ֥ם יוֹאָֽב
verses.translit: v't 'msh' shm 'bshlm tcht yv'b 'l htsb' v'msh' bn 'ysh vshmv ytr' hyshr'ly 'shr b' 'l 'bygl bt nchsh 'chvt tsrvyh 'm yv'b
verses.translation: And Absalom made Amasa captain of the host instead of Joab: which Amasa was a man’s son, whose name was Ithra an Israelite, that went in to Abigail the daughter of Nahash, sister to Zeruiah Joab’s mother.

verses.original: וַ/יִּ֤חַן יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ וְ/אַבְשָׁלֹ֔ם אֶ֖רֶץ הַ/גִּלְעָֽד
verses.translit: vychn yshr'l v'bshlm 'rts hgl'd
verses.translation: So Israel and Absalom pitched in the land of Gilead.

verses.original: וַ/יְהִ֕י כְּ/ב֥וֹא דָוִ֖ד מַחֲנָ֑יְמָ/ה וְ/שֹׁבִ֨י בֶן נָחָ֜שׁ מֵ/רַבַּ֣ת בְּנֵֽי עַמּ֗וֹן וּ/מָכִ֤יר בֶּן עַמִּיאֵל֙ מִ/לֹּ֣א דְבָ֔ר וּ/בַרְזִלַּ֥י הַ/גִּלְעָדִ֖י מֵ/רֹגְלִֽים
verses.translit: vyhy khbv' dvd mchnymh vshby bn nchsh mrbt bny 'mvn vmkhyr bn 'my'l ml' dbr vbrzly hgl'dy mrglym
verses.translation: And it came to pass, when David was come to Mahanaim, that Shobi the son of Nahash of Rabbah of the children of Ammon, and Machir the son of Ammiel of Lo-debar, and Barzillai the Gileadite of Rogelim,

verses.original: מִשְׁכָּ֤ב וְ/סַפּוֹת֙ וּ/כְלִ֣י יוֹצֵ֔ר וְ/חִטִּ֥ים וּ/שְׂעֹרִ֖ים וְ/קֶ֣מַח וְ/קָלִ֑י וּ/פ֥וֹל וַ/עֲדָשִׁ֖ים וְ/קָלִֽי
verses.translit: mshkhb vspvt vkhly yvtsr vchtym vsh'rym vqmch vqly vpvl v'dshym vqly
verses.translation: Brought beds, and basons, and earthen vessels, and wheat, and barley, and flour, and parched corn , and beans, and lentiles, and parched pulse ,

verses.original: וּ/דְבַ֣שׁ וְ/חֶמְאָ֗ה וְ/צֹאן֙ וּ/שְׁפ֣וֹת בָּקָ֔ר הִגִּ֧ישׁוּ לְ/דָוִ֛ד וְ/לָ/עָ֥ם אֲשֶׁר אִתּ֖/וֹ לֶ/אֱכ֑וֹל כִּ֣י אָמְר֔וּ הָ/עָ֗ם רָעֵ֛ב וְ/עָיֵ֥ף וְ/צָמֵ֖א בַּ/מִּדְבָּֽר
verses.translit: vdbsh vchm'h vts'n vshpvt bqr hgyshv ldvd vl'm 'shr 'tv l'khvl khy 'mrv h'm r'b v'yf vtsm' bmdbr
verses.translation: And honey, and butter, and sheep, and cheese of kine, for David, and for the people that were with him, to eat: for they said, The people is hungry, and weary, and thirsty, in the wilderness.

verses.original: וַ/יִּפְקֹ֣ד דָּוִ֔ד אֶת הָ/עָ֖ם אֲשֶׁ֣ר אִתּ֑/וֹ וַ/יָּ֣שֶׂם עֲלֵי/הֶ֔ם שָׂרֵ֥י אֲלָפִ֖ים וְ/שָׂרֵ֥י מֵאֽוֹת
verses.translit: vypqd dvd 't h'm 'shr 'tv vyshm 'lyhm shry 'lpym vshry m'vt
verses.translation: And David numbered the people that were with him, and set captains of thousands and captains of hundreds over them.

verses.original: וַ/יְשַׁלַּ֨ח דָּוִ֜ד אֶת הָ/עָ֗ם הַ/שְּׁלִשִׁ֤ית בְּ/יַד יוֹאָב֙ וְ֠/הַ/שְּׁלִשִׁית בְּ/יַ֨ד אֲבִישַׁ֤י בֶּן צְרוּיָה֙ אֲחִ֣י יוֹאָ֔ב וְ/הַ֨/שְּׁלִשִׁ֔ת בְּ/יַ֖ד אִתַּ֣י הַ/גִּתִּ֑י וַ/יֹּ֤אמֶר הַ/מֶּ֨לֶךְ֙ אֶל הָ/עָ֔ם יָצֹ֥א אֵצֵ֛א גַּם אֲנִ֖י עִמָּ/כֶֽם
verses.translit: vyshlch dvd 't h'm hshlshyt byd yv'b vhshlshyt byd 'byshy bn tsrvyh 'chy yv'b vhshlsht byd 'ty hgty vy'mr hmlkh 'l h'm yts' 'ts' gm 'ny 'mkhm
verses.translation: And David sent forth a third part of the people under the hand of Joab, and a third part under the hand of Abishai the son of Zeruiah, Joab’s brother, and a third part under the hand of Ittai the Gittite. And the king said unto the people, I will surely go forth with you myself also.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֨אמֶר הָ/עָ֜ם לֹ֣א תֵצֵ֗א כִּי֩ אִם נֹ֨ס נָנ֜וּס לֹא יָשִׂ֧ימוּ אֵלֵ֣י/נוּ לֵ֗ב וְ/אִם יָמֻ֤תוּ חֶצְיֵ֨/נוּ֙ לֹֽא יָשִׂ֤ימוּ אֵלֵ֨י/נוּ֙ לֵ֔ב כִּֽי עַתָּ֥ה כָמֹ֖/נוּ עֲשָׂרָ֣ה אֲלָפִ֑ים וְ/עַתָּ֣ה ט֔וֹב כִּי תִֽהְיֶה לָּ֥/נוּ מֵ/עִ֖יר ל/עזיר לַ/עְזֽוֹר
verses.translit: vy'mr h'm l' tts' khy 'm ns nnvs l' yshymv 'lynv lb v'm ymtv chtsynv l' yshymv 'lynv lb khy 'th khmnv 'shrh 'lpym v'th tvb khy thyh lnv m'yr l'zyr l'zvr
verses.translation: But the people answered, Thou shalt not go forth: for if we flee away, they will not care for us; neither if half of us die, will they care for us: but now thou art worth ten thousand of us: therefore now it is better that thou succour us out of the city.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֤אמֶר אֲלֵי/הֶם֙ הַ/מֶּ֔לֶךְ אֲשֶׁר יִיטַ֥ב בְּ/עֵינֵי/כֶ֖ם אֶעֱשֶׂ֑ה וַ/יַּעֲמֹ֤ד הַ/מֶּ֨לֶךְ֙ אֶל יַ֣ד הַ/שַּׁ֔עַר וְ/כָל הָ/עָם֙ יָֽצְא֔וּ לְ/מֵא֖וֹת וְ/לַ/אֲלָפִֽים
verses.translit: vy'mr 'lyhm hmlkh 'shr yytb b'ynykhm ''shh vy'md hmlkh 'l yd hsh'r vkhl h'm yts'v lm'vt vl'lpym
verses.translation: And the king said unto them, What seemeth you best I will do. And the king stood by the gate side, and all the people came out by hundreds and by thousands.

verses.original: וַ/יְצַ֣ו הַ/מֶּ֡לֶךְ אֶת י֠וֹאָב וְ/אֶת אֲבִישַׁ֤י וְ/אֶת אִתַּי֙ לֵ/אמֹ֔ר לְ/אַט לִ֖/י לַ/נַּ֣עַר לְ/אַבְשָׁל֑וֹם וְ/כָל הָ/עָ֣ם שָׁמְע֗וּ בְּ/צַוֺּ֥ת הַ/מֶּ֛לֶךְ אֶת כָּל הַ/שָּׂרִ֖ים עַל דְּבַ֥ר אַבְשָׁלֽוֹם
verses.translit: vytsv hmlkh 't yv'b v't 'byshy v't 'ty l'mr l't ly ln'r l'bshlvm vkhl h'm shm'v btsvt hmlkh 't khl hshrym 'l dbr 'bshlvm
verses.translation: And the king commanded Joab and Abishai and Ittai, saying, Deal gently for my sake with the young man, even with Absalom. And all the people heard when the king gave all the captains charge concerning Absalom.

verses.original: וַ/יֵּצֵ֥א הָ/עָ֛ם הַ/שָּׂדֶ֖ה לִ/קְרַ֣את יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וַ/תְּהִ֥י הַ/מִּלְחָמָ֖ה בְּ/יַ֥עַר אֶפְרָֽיִם
verses.translit: vyts' h'm hshdh lqr't yshr'l vthy hmlchmh by'r 'prym
verses.translation: So the people went out into the field against Israel: and the battle was in the wood of Ephraim;

verses.original: וַ/יִּנָּ֤גְפוּ שָׁם֙ עַ֣ם יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל לִ/פְנֵ֖י עַבְדֵ֣י דָוִ֑ד וַ/תְּהִי שָׁ֞ם הַ/מַּגֵּפָ֧ה גְדוֹלָ֛ה בַּ/יּ֥וֹם הַ/ה֖וּא עֶשְׂרִ֥ים אָֽלֶף
verses.translit: vyngpv shm 'm yshr'l lpny 'bdy dvd vthy shm hmgph gdvlh byvm hhv' 'shrym 'lf
verses.translation: Where the people of Israel were slain before the servants of David, and there was there a great slaughter that day of twenty thousand men .

verses.original: וַ/תְּהִי שָׁ֧ם הַ/מִּלְחָמָ֛ה נפצית נָפֹ֖צֶת עַל פְּנֵ֣י כָל הָ/אָ֑רֶץ וַ/יֶּ֤רֶב הַ/יַּ֨עַר֙ לֶ/אֱכֹ֣ל בָּ/עָ֔ם מֵ/אֲשֶׁ֥ר אָכְלָ֛ה הַ/חֶ֖רֶב בַּ/יּ֥וֹם הַ/הֽוּא
verses.translit: vthy shm hmlchmh nptsyt nptst 'l pny khl h'rts vyrb hy'r l'khl b'm m'shr 'khlh hchrb byvm hhv'
verses.translation: For the battle was there scattered over the face of all the country: and the wood devoured more people that day than the sword devoured.

verses.original: וַ/יִּקָּרֵא֙ אַבְשָׁל֔וֹם לִ/פְנֵ֖י עַבְדֵ֣י דָוִ֑ד וְ/אַבְשָׁל֞וֹם רֹכֵ֣ב עַל הַ/פֶּ֗רֶד וַ/יָּבֹ֣א הַ/פֶּ֡רֶד תַּ֣חַת שׂוֹבֶךְ֩ הָ/אֵלָ֨ה הַ/גְּדוֹלָ֜ה וַ/יֶּחֱזַ֧ק רֹאשׁ֣/וֹ בָ/אֵלָ֗ה וַ/יֻּתַּן֙ בֵּ֤ין הַ/שָּׁמַ֨יִם֙ וּ/בֵ֣ין הָ/אָ֔רֶץ וְ/הַ/פֶּ֥רֶד אֲשֶׁר תַּחְתָּ֖י/ו עָבָֽר
verses.translit: vyqr' 'bshlvm lpny 'bdy dvd v'bshlvm rkhb 'l hprd vyb' hprd tcht shvbkh h'lh hgdvlh vychzq r'shv b'lh vytn byn hshmym vbyn h'rts vhprd 'shr tchtyv 'br
verses.translation: And Absalom met the servants of David. And Absalom rode upon a mule, and the mule went under the thick boughs of a great oak, and his head caught hold of the oak, and he was taken up between the heaven and the earth; and the mule that was under him went away.

verses.original: וַ/יַּרְא֙ אִ֣ישׁ אֶחָ֔ד וַ/יַּגֵּ֖ד לְ/יוֹאָ֑ב וַ/יֹּ֗אמֶר הִנֵּה֙ רָאִ֣יתִי אֶת אַבְשָׁלֹ֔ם תָּל֖וּי בָּ/אֵלָֽה
verses.translit: vyr' 'ysh 'chd vygd lyv'b vy'mr hnh r'yty 't 'bshlm tlvy b'lh
verses.translation: And a certain man saw it , and told Joab, and said, Behold, I saw Absalom hanged in an oak.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֣אמֶר יוֹאָ֗ב לָ/אִישׁ֙ הַ/מַּגִּ֣יד ל֔/וֹ וְ/הִנֵּ֣ה רָאִ֔יתָ וּ/מַדּ֛וּעַ לֹֽא הִכִּית֥/וֹ שָׁ֖ם אָ֑רְצָ/ה וְ/עָלַ֗/י לָ֤/תֶת לְ/ךָ֙ עֲשָׂ֣רָה כֶ֔סֶף וַ/חֲגֹרָ֖ה אֶחָֽת
verses.translit: vy'mr yv'b l'ysh hmgyd lv vhnh r'yt vmdv' l' hkhytv shm 'rtsh v'ly ltt lkh 'shrh khsf vchgrh 'cht
verses.translation: And Joab said unto the man that told him, And, behold, thou sawest him , and why didst thou not smite him there to the ground? and I would have given thee ten shekels of silver, and a girdle.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֤אמֶר הָ/אִישׁ֙ אֶל יוֹאָ֔ב ו/לא וְ/ל֨וּא אָנֹכִ֜י שֹׁקֵ֤ל עַל כַּפַּ/י֙ אֶ֣לֶף כֶּ֔סֶף לֹֽא אֶשְׁלַ֥ח יָדִ֖/י אֶל בֶּן הַ/מֶּ֑לֶךְ כִּ֣י בְ/אָזְנֵ֜י/נוּ צִוָּ֣ה הַ/מֶּ֗לֶךְ אֹ֠תְ/ךָ וְ/אֶת אֲבִישַׁ֤י וְ/אֶת אִתַּי֙ לֵ/אמֹ֔ר שִׁמְרוּ מִ֕י בַּ/נַּ֖עַר בְּ/אַבְשָׁלֽוֹם
verses.translit: vy'mr h'ysh 'l yv'b vl' vlv' 'nkhy shql 'l khpy 'lf khsf l' 'shlch ydy 'l bn hmlkh khy b'znynv tsvh hmlkh 'tkh v't 'byshy v't 'ty l'mr shmrv my bn'r b'bshlvm
verses.translation: And the man said unto Joab, Though I should receive a thousand shekels of silver in mine hand, yet would I not put forth mine hand against the king’s son: for in our hearing the king charged thee and Abishai and Ittai, saying, Beware that none touch the young man Absalom.

verses.original: אֽוֹ עָשִׂ֤יתִי ב/נפש/ו בְ/נַפְשִׁ/י֙ שֶׁ֔קֶר וְ/כָל דָּבָ֖ר לֹא יִכָּחֵ֣ד מִן הַ/מֶּ֑לֶךְ וְ/אַתָּ֖ה תִּתְיַצֵּ֥ב מִ/נֶּֽגֶד
verses.translit: 'v 'shyty bnpshv bnpshy shqr vkhl dbr l' ykhchd mn hmlkh v'th ttytsb mngd
verses.translation: Otherwise I should have wrought falsehood against mine own life: for there is no matter hid from the king, and thou thyself wouldest have set thyself against me .

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֣אמֶר יוֹאָ֔ב לֹא כֵ֖ן אֹחִ֣ילָה לְ/פָנֶ֑י/ךָ וַ/יִּקַּח֩ שְׁלֹשָׁ֨ה שְׁבָטִ֜ים בְּ/כַפּ֗/וֹ וַ/יִּתְקָעֵ/ם֙ בְּ/לֵ֣ב אַבְשָׁל֔וֹם עוֹדֶ֥/נּוּ חַ֖י בְּ/לֵ֥ב הָ/אֵלָֽה
verses.translit: vy'mr yv'b l' khn 'chylh lpnykh vyqch shlshh shbtym bkhpv vytq'm blb 'bshlvm 'vdnv chy blb h'lh
verses.translation: Then said Joab, I may not tarry thus with thee. And he took three darts in his hand, and thrust them through the heart of Absalom, while he was yet alive in the midst of the oak.

verses.original: וַ/יָּסֹ֨בּוּ֙ עֲשָׂרָ֣ה נְעָרִ֔ים נֹשְׂאֵ֖י כְּלֵ֣י יוֹאָ֑ב וַ/יַּכּ֥וּ אֶת אַבְשָׁל֖וֹם וַ/יְמִיתֻֽ/הוּ
verses.translit: vysbv 'shrh n'rym nsh'y khly yv'b vykhv 't 'bshlvm vymythv
verses.translation: And ten young men that bare Joab’s armour compassed about and smote Absalom, and slew him.

verses.original: וַ/יִּתְקַ֤ע יוֹאָב֙ בַּ/שֹּׁפָ֔ר וַ/יָּ֣שָׁב הָ/עָ֔ם מִ/רְדֹ֖ף אַחֲרֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל כִּֽי חָשַׂ֥ךְ יוֹאָ֖ב אֶת הָ/עָֽם
verses.translit: vytq' yv'b bshpr vyshb h'm mrdf 'chry yshr'l khy chshkh yv'b 't h'm
verses.translation: And Joab blew the trumpet, and the people returned from pursuing after Israel: for Joab held back the people.

verses.original: וַ/יִּקְח֣וּ אֶת אַבְשָׁל֗וֹם וַ/יַּשְׁלִ֨יכוּ אֹת֤/וֹ בַ/יַּ֨עַר֙ אֶל הַ/פַּ֣חַת הַ/גָּד֔וֹל וַ/יַּצִּ֧בוּ עָלָ֛י/ו גַּל אֲבָנִ֖ים גָּד֣וֹל מְאֹ֑ד וְ/כָל יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל נָ֖סוּ אִ֥ישׁ ל/אהל/ו לְ/אֹהָלָֽי/ו
verses.translit: vyqchv 't 'bshlvm vyshlykhv 'tv by'r 'l hpcht hgdvl vytsbv 'lyv gl 'bnym gdvl m'd vkhl yshr'l nsv 'ysh l'hlv l'hlyv
verses.translation: And they took Absalom, and cast him into a great pit in the wood, and laid a very great heap of stones upon him: and all Israel fled every one to his tent.

verses.original: וְ/אַבְשָׁלֹ֣ם לָקַ֗ח וַ/יַּצֶּב ל֤/וֹ ב/חי/ו בְ/חַיָּי/ו֙ אֶת מַצֶּ֨בֶת֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר בְּ/עֵֽמֶק הַ/מֶּ֔לֶךְ כִּ֤י אָמַר֙ אֵֽין לִ֣/י בֵ֔ן בַּ/עֲב֖וּר הַזְכִּ֣יר שְׁמִ֑/י וַ/יִּקְרָ֤א לַ/מַּצֶּ֨בֶת֙ עַל שְׁמ֔/וֹ וַ/יִּקָּ֤רֵא לָ/הּ֙ יַ֣ד אַבְשָׁלֹ֔ם עַ֖ד הַ/יּ֥וֹם הַ/זֶּֽה
verses.translit: v'bshlm lqch vytsb lv bchyv bchyyv 't mtsbt 'shr b'mq hmlkh khy 'mr 'yn ly bn b'bvr hzkhyr shmy vyqr' lmtsbt 'l shmv vyqr' lh yd 'bshlm 'd hyvm hzh
verses.translation: Now Absalom in his lifetime had taken and reared up for himself a pillar, which is in the king’s dale: for he said, I have no son to keep my name in remembrance: and he called the pillar after his own name: and it is called unto this day, Absalom’s place.

verses.original: וַ/אֲחִימַ֤עַץ בֶּן צָדוֹק֙ אָמַ֔ר אָר֣וּצָה נָּ֔א וַ/אֲבַשְּׂרָ֖ה אֶת הַ/מֶּ֑לֶךְ כִּי שְׁפָט֥/וֹ יְהוָ֖ה מִ/יַּ֥ד אֹיְבָֽי/ו
verses.translit: v'chym'ts bn tsdvq 'mr 'rvtsh n' v'bshrh 't hmlkh khy shptv yhvh myd 'ybyv
verses.translation: Then said Ahimaaz the son of Zadok, Let me now run, and bear the king tidings, how that the LORD hath avenged him of his enemies.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֧אמֶר ל֣/וֹ יוֹאָ֗ב לֹא֩ אִ֨ישׁ בְּשֹׂרָ֤ה אַתָּה֙ הַ/יּ֣וֹם הַ/זֶּ֔ה וּ/בִשַּׂרְתָּ֖ בְּ/י֣וֹם אַחֵ֑ר וְ/הַ/יּ֤וֹם הַ/זֶּה֙ לֹ֣א תְבַשֵּׂ֔ר כִּֽי על עַל כֵּ֥ן בֶּן הַ/מֶּ֖לֶךְ מֵֽת
verses.translit: vy'mr lv yv'b l' 'ysh bshrh 'th hyvm hzh vbshrt byvm 'chr vhyvm hzh l' tbshr khy 'l 'l khn bn hmlkh mt
verses.translation: And Joab said unto him, Thou shalt not bear tidings this day, but thou shalt bear tidings another day: but this day thou shalt bear no tidings, because the king’s son is dead.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֤אמֶר יוֹאָב֙ לַ/כּוּשִׁ֔י לֵ֛ךְ הַגֵּ֥ד לַ/מֶּ֖לֶךְ אֲשֶׁ֣ר רָאִ֑יתָה וַ/יִּשְׁתַּ֧חוּ כוּשִׁ֛י לְ/יוֹאָ֖ב וַ/יָּרֹֽץ
verses.translit: vy'mr yv'b lkhvshy lkh hgd lmlkh 'shr r'yth vyshtchv khvshy lyv'b vyrts
verses.translation: Then said Joab to Cushi, Go tell the king what thou hast seen. And Cushi bowed himself unto Joab, and ran.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֨סֶף ע֜וֹד אֲחִימַ֤עַץ בֶּן צָדוֹק֙ וַ/יֹּ֣אמֶר אֶל יוֹאָ֔ב וִ֣/יהִי מָ֔ה אָרֻֽצָה נָּ֥א גַם אָ֖נִי אַחֲרֵ֣י הַ/כּוּשִׁ֑י וַ/יֹּ֣אמֶר יוֹאָ֗ב לָֽ/מָּה זֶּ֞ה אַתָּ֥ה רָץ֙ בְּנִ֔/י וּ/לְ/כָ֖ה אֵין בְּשׂוֹרָ֥ה מֹצֵֽאת
verses.translit: vysf 'vd 'chym'ts bn tsdvq vy'mr 'l yv'b vyhy mh 'rtsh n' gm 'ny 'chry hkhvshy vy'mr yv'b lmh zh 'th rts bny vlkhh 'yn bshvrh mts't
verses.translation: Then said Ahimaaz the son of Zadok yet again to Joab, But howsoever, let me, I pray thee, also run after Cushi. And Joab said, Wherefore wilt thou run, my son, seeing that thou hast no tidings ready?

verses.original: וִ/יהִי מָ֣ה אָר֔וּץ וַ/יֹּ֥אמֶר ל֖/וֹ ר֑וּץ וַ/יָּ֤רָץ אֲחִימַ֨עַץ֙ דֶּ֣רֶךְ הַ/כִּכָּ֔ר וַֽ/יַּעֲבֹ֖ר אֶת הַ/כּוּשִֽׁי
verses.translit: vyhy mh 'rvts vy'mr lv rvts vyrts 'chym'ts drkh hkhkhr vy'br 't hkhvshy
verses.translation: But howsoever, said he , let me run. And he said unto him, Run. Then Ahimaaz ran by the way of the plain, and overran Cushi.

verses.original: וְ/דָוִ֥ד יוֹשֵׁ֖ב בֵּין שְׁנֵ֣י הַ/שְּׁעָרִ֑ים וַ/יֵּ֨לֶךְ הַ/צֹּפֶ֜ה אֶל גַּ֤ג הַ/שַּׁ֨עַר֙ אֶל הַ֣/חוֹמָ֔ה וַ/יִּשָּׂ֤א אֶת עֵינָי/ו֙ וַ/יַּ֔רְא וְ/הִנֵּה אִ֖ישׁ רָ֥ץ לְ/בַדּֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: vdvd yvshb byn shny hsh'rym vylkh htsph 'l gg hsh'r 'l hchvmh vysh' 't 'ynyv vyr' vhnh 'ysh rts lbdv
verses.translation: And David sat between the two gates: and the watchman went up to the roof over the gate unto the wall, and lifted up his eyes, and looked, and behold a man running alone.

verses.original: וַ/יִּקְרָ֤א הַ/צֹּפֶה֙ וַ/יַּגֵּ֣ד לַ/מֶּ֔לֶךְ וַ/יֹּ֣אמֶר הַ/מֶּ֔לֶךְ אִם לְ/בַדּ֖/וֹ בְּשׂוֹרָ֣ה בְּ/פִ֑י/ו וַ/יֵּ֥לֶךְ הָל֖וֹךְ וְ/קָרֵֽב
verses.translit: vyqr' htsph vygd lmlkh vy'mr hmlkh 'm lbdv bshvrh bpyv vylkh hlvkh vqrb
verses.translation: And the watchman cried, and told the king. And the king said, If he be alone, there is tidings in his mouth. And he came apace, and drew near.

verses.original: וַ/יַּ֣רְא הַ/צֹּפֶה֮ אִישׁ אַחֵ֣ר רָץ֒ וַ/יִּקְרָ֤א הַ/צֹּפֶה֙ אֶל הַ/שֹּׁעֵ֔ר וַ/יֹּ֕אמֶר הִנֵּה אִ֖ישׁ רָ֣ץ לְ/בַדּ֑/וֹ וַ/יֹּ֥אמֶר הַ/מֶּ֖לֶךְ גַּם זֶ֥ה מְבַשֵּֽׂר
verses.translit: vyr' htsph 'ysh 'chr rts vyqr' htsph 'l hsh'r vy'mr hnh 'ysh rts lbdv vy'mr hmlkh gm zh mbshr
verses.translation: And the watchman saw another man running: and the watchman called unto the porter, and said, Behold another man running alone. And the king said, He also bringeth tidings.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֨אמֶר֙ הַ/צֹּפֶ֔ה אֲנִ֤י רֹאֶה֙ אֶת מְרוּצַ֣ת הָ/רִאשׁ֔וֹן כִּ/מְרֻצַ֖ת אֲחִימַ֣עַץ בֶּן צָד֑וֹק וַ/יֹּ֤אמֶר הַ/מֶּ֨לֶךְ֙ אִֽישׁ ט֣וֹב זֶ֔ה וְ/אֶל בְּשׂוֹרָ֥ה טוֹבָ֖ה יָבֽוֹא
verses.translit: vy'mr htsph 'ny r'h 't mrvtst hr'shvn khmrtst 'chym'ts bn tsdvq vy'mr hmlkh 'ysh tvb zh v'l bshvrh tvbh ybv'
verses.translation: And the watchman said, Me thinketh the running of the foremost is like the running of Ahimaaz the son of Zadok. And the king said, He is a good man, and cometh with good tidings.

verses.original: וַ/יִּקְרָ֣א אֲחִימַ֗עַץ וַ/יֹּ֤אמֶר אֶל הַ/מֶּ֨לֶךְ֙ שָׁל֔וֹם וַ/יִּשְׁתַּ֧חוּ לַ/מֶּ֛לֶךְ לְ/אַפָּ֖י/ו אָ֑רְצָ/ה וַ/יֹּ֗אמֶר בָּרוּךְ֙ יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶ֔י/ךָ אֲשֶׁ֤ר סִגַּר֙ אֶת הָ֣/אֲנָשִׁ֔ים אֲשֶׁר נָשְׂא֥וּ אֶת יָדָ֖/ם בַּֽ/אדֹנִ֥/י הַ/מֶּֽלֶךְ
verses.translit: vyqr' 'chym'ts vy'mr 'l hmlkh shlvm vyshtchv lmlkh l'pyv 'rtsh vy'mr brvkh yhvh 'lhykh 'shr sgr 't h'nshym 'shr nsh'v 't ydm b'dny hmlkh
verses.translation: And Ahimaaz called, and said unto the king, All is well. And he fell down to the earth upon his face before the king, and said, Blessed be the LORD thy God, which hath delivered up the men that lifted up their hand against my lord the king.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֣אמֶר הַ/מֶּ֔לֶךְ שָׁל֥וֹם לַ/נַּ֖עַר לְ/אַבְשָׁל֑וֹם וַ/יֹּ֣אמֶר אֲחִימַ֡עַץ רָאִיתִי֩ הֶ/הָמ֨וֹן הַ/גָּד֜וֹל לִ֠/שְׁלֹחַ אֶת עֶ֨בֶד הַ/מֶּ֤לֶךְ יוֹאָב֙ וְ/אֶת עַבְדֶּ֔/ךָ וְ/לֹ֥א יָדַ֖עְתִּי מָֽה
verses.translit: vy'mr hmlkh shlvm ln'r l'bshlvm vy'mr 'chym'ts r'yty hhmvn hgdvl lshlch 't 'bd hmlkh yv'b v't 'bdkh vl' yd'ty mh
verses.translation: And the king said, Is the young man Absalom safe? And Ahimaaz answered, When Joab sent the king’s servant, and me thy servant, I saw a great tumult, but I knew not what it was .

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֣אמֶר הַ/מֶּ֔לֶךְ סֹ֖ב הִתְיַצֵּ֣ב כֹּ֑ה וַ/יִּסֹּ֖ב וַֽ/יַּעֲמֹֽד
verses.translit: vy'mr hmlkh sb htytsb khh vysb vy'md
verses.translation: And the king said unto him , Turn aside, and stand here. And he turned aside, and stood still.

verses.original: וְ/הִנֵּ֥ה הַ/כּוּשִׁ֖י בָּ֑א וַ/יֹּ֣אמֶר הַ/כּוּשִׁ֗י יִתְבַּשֵּׂר֙ אֲדֹנִ֣/י הַ/מֶּ֔לֶךְ כִּֽי שְׁפָטְ/ךָ֤ יְהוָה֙ הַ/יּ֔וֹם מִ/יַּ֖ד כָּל הַ/קָּמִ֥ים עָלֶֽי/ךָ
verses.translit: vhnh hkhvshy b' vy'mr hkhvshy ytbshr 'dny hmlkh khy shptkh yhvh hyvm myd khl hqmym 'lykh
verses.translation: And, behold, Cushi came; and Cushi said, Tidings, my lord the king: for the LORD hath avenged thee this day of all them that rose up against thee.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֤אמֶר הַ/מֶּ֨לֶךְ֙ אֶל הַ/כּוּשִׁ֔י הֲ/שָׁל֥וֹם לַ/נַּ֖עַר לְ/אַבְשָׁל֑וֹם וַ/יֹּ֣אמֶר הַ/כּוּשִׁ֗י יִהְי֤וּ כַ/נַּ֨עַר֙ אֹֽיְבֵי֙ אֲדֹנִ֣/י הַ/מֶּ֔לֶךְ וְ/כֹ֛ל אֲשֶׁר קָ֥מוּ עָלֶ֖י/ךָ לְ/רָעָֽה
verses.translit: vy'mr hmlkh 'l hkhvshy hshlvm ln'r l'bshlvm vy'mr hkhvshy yhyv khn'r 'yby 'dny hmlkh vkhl 'shr qmv 'lykh lr'h
verses.translation: And the king said unto Cushi, Is the young man Absalom safe? And Cushi answered, The enemies of my lord the king, and all that rise against thee to do thee hurt, be as that young man is .

And the king was much moved, and went up to the chamber over the gate, and wept: and as he went, thus he said, O my son Absalom, my son, my son Absalom! would God I had died for thee, O Absalom, my son, my son!

verses.original: וַ/יִּרְגַּ֣ז הַ/מֶּ֗לֶךְ וַ/יַּ֛עַל עַל עֲלִיַּ֥ת הַ/שַּׁ֖עַר וַ/יֵּ֑בְךְּ וְ/כֹ֣ה אָמַ֣ר בְּ/לֶכְתּ֗/וֹ בְּנִ֤/י אַבְשָׁלוֹם֙ בְּנִ֣/י בְנִ֣/י אַבְשָׁל֔וֹם מִֽי יִתֵּ֤ן מוּתִ/י֙ אֲנִ֣י תַחְתֶּ֔י/ךָ אַבְשָׁל֖וֹם בְּנִ֥/י בְנִֽ/י
verses.translit: vyrgz hmlkh vy'l 'l 'lyt hsh'r vybkh vkhh 'mr blkhtv bny 'bshlvm bny bny 'bshlvm my ytn mvty 'ny tchtykh 'bshlvm bny bny
verses.translation: And it was told Joab, Behold, the king weepeth and mourneth for Absalom.

verses.original: וַ/יֻּגַּ֖ד לְ/יוֹאָ֑ב הִנֵּ֨ה הַ/מֶּ֧לֶךְ בֹּכֶ֛ה וַ/יִּתְאַבֵּ֖ל עַל אַבְשָׁלֹֽם
verses.translit: vygd lyv'b hnh hmlkh bkhh vyt'bl 'l 'bshlm
verses.translation: And the victory that day was turned into mourning unto all the people: for the people heard say that day how the king was grieved for his son.

verses.original: וַ/תְּהִ֨י הַ/תְּשֻׁעָ֜ה בַּ/יּ֥וֹם הַ/ה֛וּא לְ/אֵ֖בֶל לְ/כָל הָ/עָ֑ם כִּֽי שָׁמַ֣ע הָ/עָ֗ם בַּ/יּ֤וֹם הַ/הוּא֙ לֵ/אמֹ֔ר נֶעֱצַ֥ב הַ/מֶּ֖לֶךְ עַל בְּנֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: vthy htsh'h byvm hhv' l'bl lkhl h'm khy shm' h'm byvm hhv' l'mr n'tsb hmlkh 'l bnv
verses.translation: And the people gat them by stealth that day into the city, as people being ashamed steal away when they flee in battle.

verses.original: וַ/יִּתְגַּנֵּ֥ב הָ/עָ֛ם בַּ/יּ֥וֹם הַ/ה֖וּא לָ/ב֣וֹא הָ/עִ֑יר כַּ/אֲשֶׁ֣ר יִתְגַּנֵּ֗ב הָ/עָם֙ הַ/נִּכְלָמִ֔ים בְּ/נוּסָ֖/ם בַּ/מִּלְחָמָֽה
verses.translit: vytgnb h'm byvm hhv' lbv' h'yr kh'shr ytgnb h'm hnkhlmym bnvsm bmlchmh
verses.translation: But the king covered his face, and the king cried with a loud voice, O my son Absalom, O Absalom, my son, my son!

verses.original: וְ/הַ/מֶּ֨לֶךְ֙ לָאַ֣ט אֶת פָּנָ֔י/ו וַ/יִּזְעַ֥ק הַ/מֶּ֖לֶךְ ק֣וֹל גָּד֑וֹל בְּנִ/י֙ אַבְשָׁל֔וֹם אַבְשָׁל֖וֹם בְּנִ֥/י בְנִֽ/י
verses.translit: vhmlkh l't 't pnyv vyz'q hmlkh qvl gdvl bny 'bshlvm 'bshlvm bny bny
verses.translation: And Joab came into the house to the king, and said, Thou hast shamed this day the faces of all thy servants, which this day have saved thy life, and the lives of thy sons and of thy daughters, and the lives of thy wives, and the lives of thy concubines;

verses.original: וַ/יָּבֹ֥א יוֹאָ֛ב אֶל הַ/מֶּ֖לֶךְ הַ/בָּ֑יִת וַ/יֹּאמֶר֩ הֹבַ֨שְׁתָּ הַ/יּ֜וֹם אֶת פְּנֵ֣י כָל עֲבָדֶ֗י/ךָ הַֽ/מְמַלְּטִ֤ים אֶֽת נַפְשְׁ/ךָ֙ הַ/יּ֔וֹם וְ/אֵ֨ת נֶ֤פֶשׁ בָּנֶ֨י/ךָ֙ וּ/בְנֹתֶ֔י/ךָ וְ/נֶ֣פֶשׁ נָשֶׁ֔י/ךָ וְ/נֶ֖פֶשׁ פִּלַגְשֶֽׁי/ךָ
verses.translit: vyb' yv'b 'l hmlkh hbyt vy'mr hbsht hyvm 't pny khl 'bdykh hmmltym 't npshkh hyvm v't npsh bnykh vbntykh vnpsh nshykh vnpsh plgshykh
verses.translation: In that thou lovest thine enemies, and hatest thy friends. For thou hast declared this day, that thou regardest neither princes nor servants: for this day I perceive, that if Absalom had lived, and all we had died this day, then it had pleased thee well.

verses.original: לְ/אַֽהֲבָה֙ אֶת שֹׂ֣נְאֶ֔י/ךָ וְ/לִ/שְׂנֹ֖א אֶת אֹהֲבֶ֑י/ךָ כִּ֣י הִגַּ֣דְתָּ הַ/יּ֗וֹם כִּ֣י אֵ֤ין לְ/ךָ֙ שָׂרִ֣ים וַ/עֲבָדִ֔ים כִּ֣י יָדַ֣עְתִּי הַ/יּ֗וֹם כִּ֠י לא ל֣וּ אַבְשָׁל֥וֹם חַי֙ וְ/כֻלָּ֤/נוּ הַ/יּוֹם֙ מֵתִ֔ים כִּי אָ֖ז יָשָׁ֥ר בְּ/עֵינֶֽי/ךָ
verses.translit: l'hbh 't shn'ykh vlshn' 't 'hbykh khy hgdt hyvm khy 'yn lkh shrym v'bdym khy yd'ty hyvm khy l' lv 'bshlvm chy vkhlnv hyvm mtym khy 'z yshr b'ynykh
verses.translation: Now therefore arise, go forth, and speak comfortably unto thy servants: for I swear by the LORD , if thou go not forth, there will not tarry one with thee this night: and that will be worse unto thee than all the evil that befell thee from thy youth until now.

verses.original: וְ/עַתָּה֙ ק֣וּם צֵ֔א וְ/דַבֵּ֖ר עַל לֵ֣ב עֲבָדֶ֑י/ךָ כִּי֩ בַ/יהוָ֨ה נִשְׁבַּ֜עְתִּי כִּי אֵינְ/ךָ֣ יוֹצֵ֗א אִם יָלִ֨ין אִ֤ישׁ אִתְּ/ךָ֙ הַ/לַּ֔יְלָה וְ/רָעָ֧ה לְ/ךָ֣ זֹ֗את מִ/כָּל הָ/רָעָה֙ אֲשֶׁר בָּ֣אָה עָלֶ֔י/ךָ מִ/נְּעֻרֶ֖י/ךָ עַד עָֽתָּה
verses.translit: v'th qvm ts' vdbr 'l lb 'bdykh khy byhvh nshb'ty khy 'ynkh yvts' 'm ylyn 'ysh 'tkh hlylh vr'h lkh z't mkhl hr'h 'shr b'h 'lykh mn'rykh 'd 'th
verses.translation: Then the king arose, and sat in the gate. And they told unto all the people, saying, Behold, the king doth sit in the gate. And all the people came before the king: for Israel had fled every man to his tent.

verses.original: וַ/יָּ֥קָם הַ/מֶּ֖לֶךְ וַ/יֵּ֣שֶׁב בַּ/שָּׁ֑עַר וּֽ/לְ/כָל הָ/עָ֞ם הִגִּ֣ידוּ לֵ/אמֹ֗ר הִנֵּ֤ה הַ/מֶּ֨לֶךְ֙ יוֹשֵׁ֣ב בַּ/שַּׁ֔עַר וַ/יָּבֹ֤א כָל הָ/עָם֙ לִ/פְנֵ֣י הַ/מֶּ֔לֶךְ וְ/יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל נָ֖ס אִ֥ישׁ לְ/אֹהָלָֽי/ו
verses.translit: vyqm hmlkh vyshb bsh'r vlkhl h'm hgydv l'mr hnh hmlkh yvshb bsh'r vyb' khl h'm lpny hmlkh vyshr'l ns 'ysh l'hlyv
verses.translation: And all the people were at strife throughout all the tribes of Israel, saying, The king saved us out of the hand of our enemies, and he delivered us out of the hand of the Philistines; and now he is fled out of the land for Absalom.

verses.original: וַ/יְהִ֤י כָל הָ/עָם֙ נָד֔וֹן בְּ/כָל שִׁבְטֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל לֵ/אמֹ֑ר הַ/מֶּ֜לֶךְ הִצִּילָ֣/נוּ מִ/כַּ֣ף אֹיְבֵ֗י/נוּ וְ/ה֤וּא מִלְּטָ֨/נוּ֙ מִ/כַּ֣ף פְּלִשְׁתִּ֔ים וְ/עַתָּ֛ה בָּרַ֥ח מִן הָ/אָ֖רֶץ מֵ/עַ֥ל אַבְשָׁלֽוֹם
verses.translit: vyhy khl h'm ndvn bkhl shbty yshr'l l'mr hmlkh htsylnv mkhf 'ybynv vhv' mltnv mkhf plshtym v'th brch mn h'rts m'l 'bshlvm
verses.translation: And Absalom, whom we anointed over us, is dead in battle. Now therefore why speak ye not a word of bringing the king back?

verses.original: וְ/אַבְשָׁלוֹם֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר מָשַׁ֣חְנוּ עָלֵ֔י/נוּ מֵ֖ת בַּ/מִּלְחָמָ֑ה וְ/עַתָּ֗ה לָ/מָ֥ה אַתֶּ֛ם מַחֲרִשִׁ֖ים לְ/הָשִׁ֥יב אֶת הַ/מֶּֽלֶךְ
verses.translit: v'bshlvm 'shr mshchnv 'lynv mt bmlchmh v'th lmh 'tm mchrshym lhshyb 't hmlkh
