verses.translation: And king David sent to Zadok and to Abiathar the priests, saying, Speak unto the elders of Judah, saying, Why are ye the last to bring the king back to his house? seeing the speech of all Israel is come to the king, even to his house.

verses.original: וְ/הַ/מֶּ֣לֶךְ דָּוִ֗ד שָׁ֠לַח אֶל צָד֨וֹק וְ/אֶל אֶבְיָתָ֥ר הַ/כֹּהֲנִים֮ לֵ/אמֹר֒ דַּבְּר֞וּ אֶל זִקְנֵ֤י יְהוּדָה֙ לֵ/אמֹ֔ר לָ֤/מָּה תִֽהְיוּ֙ אַֽחֲרֹנִ֔ים לְ/הָשִׁ֥יב אֶת הַ/מֶּ֖לֶךְ אֶל בֵּית֑/וֹ וּ/דְבַר֙ כָּל יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל בָּ֥א אֶל הַ/מֶּ֖לֶךְ אֶל בֵּיתֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: vhmlkh dvd shlch 'l tsdvq v'l 'bytr hkhhnym l'mr dbrv 'l zqny yhvdh l'mr lmh thyv 'chrnym lhshyb 't hmlkh 'l bytv vdbr khl yshr'l b' 'l hmlkh 'l bytv
verses.translation: Ye are my brethren, ye are my bones and my flesh: wherefore then are ye the last to bring back the king?

verses.original: אַחַ֣/י אַתֶּ֔ם עַצְמִ֥/י וּ/בְשָׂרִ֖/י אַתֶּ֑ם וְ/לָ֧/מָּה תִהְי֛וּ אַחֲרֹנִ֖ים לְ/הָשִׁ֥יב אֶת הַ/מֶּֽלֶךְ
verses.translit: 'chy 'tm 'tsmy vbshry 'tm vlmh thyv 'chrnym lhshyb 't hmlkh
verses.translation: And say ye to Amasa, Art thou not of my bone, and of my flesh? God do so to me, and more also, if thou be not captain of the host before me continually in the room of Joab.

verses.original: וְ/לַֽ/עֲמָשָׂא֙ תֹּֽמְר֔וּ הֲ/ל֛וֹא עַצְמִ֥/י וּ/בְשָׂרִ֖/י אָ֑תָּה כֹּ֣ה יַֽעֲשֶׂה לִּ֤/י אֱלֹהִים֙ וְ/כֹ֣ה יוֹסִ֔יף אִם לֹ֠א שַׂר צָבָ֞א תִּהְיֶ֧ה לְ/פָנַ֛/י כָּל הַ/יָּמִ֖ים תַּ֥חַת יוֹאָֽב
verses.translit: vl'msh' tmrv hlv' 'tsmy vbshry 'th khh y'shh ly 'lhym vkhh yvsyf 'm l' shr tsb' thyh lpny khl hymym tcht yv'b
verses.translation: And he bowed the heart of all the men of Judah, even as the heart of one man; so that they sent this word unto the king, Return thou, and all thy servants.

verses.original: וַ/יַּ֛ט אֶת לְבַ֥ב כָּל אִישׁ יְהוּדָ֖ה כְּ/אִ֣ישׁ אֶחָ֑ד וַֽ/יִּשְׁלְחוּ֙ אֶל הַ/מֶּ֔לֶךְ שׁ֥וּב אַתָּ֖ה וְ/כָל עֲבָדֶֽי/ךָ
verses.translit: vyt 't lbb khl 'ysh yhvdh kh'ysh 'chd vyshlchv 'l hmlkh shvb 'th vkhl 'bdykh
verses.translation: So the king returned, and came to Jordan. And Judah came to Gilgal, to go to meet the king, to conduct the king over Jordan.

verses.original: וַ/יָּ֣שָׁב הַ/מֶּ֔לֶךְ וַ/יָּבֹ֖א עַד הַ/יַּרְדֵּ֑ן וִ/יהוּדָ֞ה בָּ֣א הַ/גִּלְגָּ֗לָ/ה לָ/לֶ֨כֶת֙ לִ/קְרַ֣את הַ/מֶּ֔לֶךְ לְ/הַעֲבִ֥יר אֶת הַ/מֶּ֖לֶךְ אֶת הַ/יַּרְדֵּֽן
verses.translit: vyshb hmlkh vyb' 'd hyrdn vyhvdh b' hglglh llkht lqr't hmlkh lh'byr 't hmlkh 't hyrdn
verses.translation: And Shimei the son of Gera, a Benjamite, which was of Bahurim, hasted and came down with the men of Judah to meet king David.

verses.original: וַ/יְמַהֵ֗ר שִׁמְעִ֤י בֶן גֵּרָא֙ בֶּן הַ/יְמִינִ֔י אֲשֶׁ֖ר מִ/בַּֽחוּרִ֑ים וַ/יֵּ֨רֶד֙ עִם אִ֣ישׁ יְהוּדָ֔ה לִ/קְרַ֖את הַ/מֶּ֥לֶךְ דָּוִֽד
verses.translit: vymhr shm'y bn gr' bn hymyny 'shr mbchvrym vyrd 'm 'ysh yhvdh lqr't hmlkh dvd
verses.translation: And there were a thousand men of Benjamin with him, and Ziba the servant of the house of Saul, and his fifteen sons and his twenty servants with him; and they went over Jordan before the king.

verses.original: וְ/אֶ֨לֶף אִ֣ישׁ עִמּ/וֹ֮ מִ/בִּנְיָמִן֒ וְ/צִיבָ֗א נַ֚עַר בֵּ֣ית שָׁא֔וּל וַ/חֲמֵ֨שֶׁת עָשָׂ֥ר בָּנָ֛י/ו וְ/עֶשְׂרִ֥ים עֲבָדָ֖י/ו אִתּ֑/וֹ וְ/צָלְח֥וּ הַ/יַּרְדֵּ֖ן לִ/פְנֵ֥י הַ/מֶּֽלֶךְ
verses.translit: v'lf 'ysh 'mv mbnymn vtsyb' n'r byt sh'vl vchmsht 'shr bnyv v'shrym 'bdyv 'tv vtslchv hyrdn lpny hmlkh
verses.translation: And there went over a ferry boat to carry over the king’s household, and to do what he thought good. And Shimei the son of Gera fell down before the king, as he was come over Jordan;

verses.original: וְ/עָבְרָ֣ה הָ/עֲבָרָ֗ה לַֽ/עֲבִיר֙ אֶת בֵּ֣ית הַ/מֶּ֔לֶךְ וְ/לַ/עֲשׂ֥וֹת הַ/טּ֖וֹב ב/עינ/ו בְּ/עֵינָ֑י/ו וְ/שִׁמְעִ֣י בֶן גֵּרָ֗א נָפַל֙ לִ/פְנֵ֣י הַ/מֶּ֔לֶךְ בְּ/עָבְר֖/וֹ בַּ/יַּרְדֵּֽן
verses.translit: v'brh h'brh l'byr 't byt hmlkh vl'shvt htvb b'ynv b'ynyv vshm'y bn gr' npl lpny hmlkh b'brv byrdn
verses.translation: And said unto the king, Let not my lord impute iniquity unto me, neither do thou remember that which thy servant did perversely the day that my lord the king went out of Jerusalem, that the king should take it to his heart.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֣אמֶר אֶל הַ/מֶּ֗לֶךְ אַל יַחֲשָׁב לִ֣/י אֲדֹנִ/י֮ עָוֺן֒ וְ/אַל תִּזְכֹּ֗ר אֵ֚ת אֲשֶׁ֣ר הֶעֱוָ֣ה עַבְדְּ/ךָ֔ בַּ/יּ֕וֹם אֲשֶׁר יָׄצָ֥ׄאׄ אֲדֹנִֽ/י הַ/מֶּ֖לֶךְ מִ/ירֽוּשָׁלִָ֑ם לָ/שׂ֥וּם הַ/מֶּ֖לֶךְ אֶל לִבּֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: vy'mr 'l hmlkh 'l ychshb ly 'dny 'vn v'l tzkhr 't 'shr h'vh 'bdkh byvm 'shr yts' 'dny hmlkh myrvshlm lshvm hmlkh 'l lbv
verses.translation: For thy servant doth know that I have sinned: therefore, behold, I am come the first this day of all the house of Joseph to go down to meet my lord the king.

verses.original: כִּ֚י יָדַ֣ע עַבְדְּ/ךָ֔ כִּ֖י אֲנִ֣י חָטָ֑אתִי וְ/הִנֵּֽה בָ֣אתִי הַ/יּ֗וֹם רִאשׁוֹן֙ לְ/כָל בֵּ֣ית יוֹסֵ֔ף לָ/רֶ֕דֶת לִ/קְרַ֖את אֲדֹנִ֥/י הַ/מֶּֽלֶךְ
verses.translit: khy yd' 'bdkh khy 'ny cht'ty vhnh b'ty hyvm r'shvn lkhl byt yvsf lrdt lqr't 'dny hmlkh
verses.translation: But Abishai the son of Zeruiah answered and said, Shall not Shimei be put to death for this, because he cursed the LORD’s anointed?

verses.original: וַ/יַּ֨עַן אֲבִישַׁ֤י בֶּן צְרוּיָה֙ וַ/יֹּ֔אמֶר הֲ/תַ֣חַת זֹ֔את לֹ֥א יוּמַ֖ת שִׁמְעִ֑י כִּ֥י קִלֵּ֖ל אֶת מְשִׁ֥יחַ יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: vy'n 'byshy bn tsrvyh vy'mr htcht z't l' yvmt shm'y khy qll 't mshych yhvh
verses.translation: And David said, What have I to do with you, ye sons of Zeruiah, that ye should this day be adversaries unto me? shall there any man be put to death this day in Israel? for do not I know that I am this day king over Israel?

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֣אמֶר דָּוִ֗ד מַה לִּ֤/י וְ/לָ/כֶם֙ בְּנֵ֣י צְרוּיָ֔ה כִּי תִֽהְיוּ לִ֥/י הַ/יּ֖וֹם לְ/שָׂטָ֑ן הַ/יּ֗וֹם י֤וּמַת אִישׁ֙ בְּ/יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל כִּ֚י הֲ/ל֣וֹא יָדַ֔עְתִּי כִּ֥י הַ/יּ֖וֹם אֲנִי מֶ֥לֶךְ עַל יִשְׂרָאֵֽל
verses.translit: vy'mr dvd mh ly vlkhm bny tsrvyh khy thyv ly hyvm lshtn hyvm yvmt 'ysh byshr'l khy hlv' yd'ty khy hyvm 'ny mlkh 'l yshr'l
verses.translation: Therefore the king said unto Shimei, Thou shalt not die. And the king sware unto him.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֧אמֶר הַ/מֶּ֛לֶךְ אֶל שִׁמְעִ֖י לֹ֣א תָמ֑וּת וַ/יִּשָּׁ֥בַֽע ל֖/וֹ הַ/מֶּֽלֶךְ
verses.translit: vy'mr hmlkh 'l shm'y l' tmvt vyshb' lv hmlkh
verses.translation: And Mephibosheth the son of Saul came down to meet the king, and had neither dressed his feet, nor trimmed his beard, nor washed his clothes, from the day the king departed until the day he came again in peace.

verses.original: וּ/מְפִבֹ֨שֶׁת֙ בֶּן שָׁא֔וּל יָרַ֖ד לִ/קְרַ֣את הַ/מֶּ֑לֶךְ וְ/לֹא עָשָׂ֨ה רַגְלָ֜י/ו וְ/לֹא עָשָׂ֣ה שְׂפָמ֗/וֹ וְ/אֶת בְּגָדָי/ו֙ לֹ֣א כִבֵּ֔ס לְ/מִן הַ/יּוֹם֙ לֶ֣כֶת הַ/מֶּ֔לֶךְ עַד הַ/יּ֖וֹם אֲשֶׁר בָּ֥א בְ/שָׁלֽוֹם
verses.translit: vmpbsht bn sh'vl yrd lqr't hmlkh vl' 'shh rglyv vl' 'shh shpmv v't bgdyv l' khbs lmn hyvm lkht hmlkh 'd hyvm 'shr b' bshlvm
verses.translation: And it came to pass, when he was come to Jerusalem to meet the king, that the king said unto him, Wherefore wentest not thou with me, Mephibosheth?

verses.original: וַ/יְהִ֛י כִּי בָ֥א יְרוּשָׁלִַ֖ם לִ/קְרַ֣את הַ/מֶּ֑לֶךְ וַ/יֹּ֤אמֶר ל/וֹ֙ הַ/מֶּ֔לֶךְ לָ֛/מָּה לֹא הָלַ֥כְתָּ עִמִּ֖/י מְפִיבֹֽשֶׁת
verses.translit: vyhy khy b' yrvshlm lqr't hmlkh vy'mr lv hmlkh lmh l' hlkht 'my mpybsht
verses.translation: And he answered, My lord, O king, my servant deceived me: for thy servant said, I will saddle me an ass, that I may ride thereon, and go to the king; because thy servant is lame.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּאמַ֕ר אֲדֹנִ֥/י הַ/מֶּ֖לֶךְ עַבְדִּ֣/י רִמָּ֑/נִי כִּֽי אָמַ֨ר עַבְדְּ/ךָ֜ אֶחְבְּשָׁה לִּ/י֩ הַ/חֲמ֨וֹר וְ/אֶרְכַּ֤ב עָלֶ֨י/הָ֙ וְ/אֵלֵ֣ךְ אֶת הַ/מֶּ֔לֶךְ כִּ֥י פִסֵּ֖חַ עַבְדֶּֽ/ךָ
verses.translit: vy'mr 'dny hmlkh 'bdy rmny khy 'mr 'bdkh 'chbshh ly hchmvr v'rkhb 'lyh v'lkh 't hmlkh khy psch 'bdkh
verses.translation: And he hath slandered thy servant unto my lord the king; but my lord the king is as an angel of God: do therefore what is good in thine eyes.

verses.original: וַ/יְרַגֵּ֣ל בְּ/עַבְדְּ/ךָ֔ אֶל אֲדֹנִ֖/י הַ/מֶּ֑לֶךְ וַ/אדֹנִ֤/י הַ/מֶּ֨לֶךְ֙ כְּ/מַלְאַ֣ךְ הָ/אֱלֹהִ֔ים וַ/עֲשֵׂ֥ה הַ/טּ֖וֹב בְּ/עֵינֶֽי/ךָ
verses.translit: vyrgl b'bdkh 'l 'dny hmlkh v'dny hmlkh khml'kh h'lhym v'shh htvb b'ynykh
verses.translation: For all of my father’s house were but dead men before my lord the king: yet didst thou set thy servant among them that did eat at thine own table. What right therefore have I yet to cry any more unto the king?

verses.original: כִּי֩ לֹ֨א הָיָ֜ה כָּל בֵּ֣ית אָבִ֗/י כִּ֤י אִם אַנְשֵׁי מָ֨וֶת֙ לַ/אדֹנִ֣/י הַ/מֶּ֔לֶךְ וַ/תָּ֨שֶׁת֙ אֶֽת עַבְדְּ/ךָ֔ בְּ/אֹכְלֵ֖י שֻׁלְחָנֶ֑/ךָ וּ/מַה יֶּשׁ לִ֥/י עוֹד֙ צְדָקָ֔ה וְ/לִ/זְעֹ֥ק ע֖וֹד אֶל הַ/מֶּֽלֶךְ
verses.translit: khy l' hyh khl byt 'by khy 'm 'nshy mvt l'dny hmlkh vtsht 't 'bdkh b'khly shlchnkh vmh ysh ly 'vd tsdqh vlz'q 'vd 'l hmlkh
verses.translation: And the king said unto him, Why speakest thou any more of thy matters? I have said, Thou and Ziba divide the land.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֤אמֶר ל/וֹ֙ הַ/מֶּ֔לֶךְ לָ֛/מָּה תְּדַבֵּ֥ר ע֖וֹד דְּבָרֶ֑י/ךָ אָמַ֕רְתִּי אַתָּ֣ה וְ/צִיבָ֔א תַּחְלְק֖וּ אֶת הַ/שָּׂדֶֽה
verses.translit: vy'mr lv hmlkh lmh tdbr 'vd dbrykh 'mrty 'th vtsyb' tchlqv 't hshdh
verses.translation: And Mephibosheth said unto the king, Yea, let him take all, forasmuch as my lord the king is come again in peace unto his own house.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֤אמֶר מְפִיבֹ֨שֶׁת֙ אֶל הַ/מֶּ֔לֶךְ גַּ֥ם אֶת הַ/כֹּ֖ל יִקָּ֑ח אַ֠חֲרֵי אֲשֶׁר בָּ֞א אֲדֹנִ֥/י הַ/מֶּ֛לֶך בְּ/שָׁל֖וֹם אֶל בֵּיתֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: vy'mr mpybsht 'l hmlkh gm 't hkhl yqch 'chry 'shr b' 'dny hmlkh bshlvm 'l bytv
verses.translation: And Barzillai the Gileadite came down from Rogelim, and went over Jordan with the king, to conduct him over Jordan.

verses.original: וּ/בַרְזִלַּי֙ הַ/גִּלְעָדִ֔י יָרַ֖ד מֵ/רֹגְלִ֑ים וַ/יַּעֲבֹ֤ר אֶת הַ/מֶּ֨לֶךְ֙ הַ/יַּרְדֵּ֔ן לְ/שַׁלְּח֖/וֹ אֶת ב/ירדן הַ/יַּרְדֵּֽן
verses.translit: vbrzly hgl'dy yrd mrglym vy'br 't hmlkh hyrdn lshlchv 't byrdn hyrdn
verses.translation: Now Barzillai was a very aged man, even fourscore years old: and he had provided the king of sustenance while he lay at Mahanaim; for he was a very great man.

verses.original: וּ/בַרְזִלַּי֙ זָקֵ֣ן מְאֹ֔ד בֶּן שְׁמֹנִ֖ים שָׁנָ֑ה וְ/הֽוּא כִלְכַּ֤ל אֶת הַ/מֶּ֨לֶךְ֙ בְּ/שִׁיבָת֣/וֹ בְ/מַחֲנַ֔יִם כִּֽי אִ֛ישׁ גָּד֥וֹל ה֖וּא מְאֹֽד
verses.translit: vbrzly zqn m'd bn shmnym shnh vhv' khlkhl 't hmlkh bshybtv bmchnym khy 'ysh gdvl hv' m'd
verses.translation: And the king said unto Barzillai, Come thou over with me, and I will feed thee with me in Jerusalem.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֥אמֶר הַ/מֶּ֖לֶךְ אֶל בַּרְזִלָּ֑י אַתָּה֙ עֲבֹ֣ר אִתִּ֔/י וְ/כִלְכַּלְתִּ֥י אֹתְ/ךָ֛ עִמָּדִ֖/י בִּ/ירוּשָׁלִָֽם
verses.translit: vy'mr hmlkh 'l brzly 'th 'br 'ty vkhlkhlty 'tkh 'mdy byrvshlm
verses.translation: And Barzillai said unto the king, How long have I to live, that I should go up with the king unto Jerusalem?

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֥אמֶר בַּרְזִלַּ֖י אֶל הַ/מֶּ֑לֶךְ כַּ/מָּ֗ה יְמֵי֙ שְׁנֵ֣י חַיַּ֔/י כִּי אֶעֱלֶ֥ה אֶת הַ/מֶּ֖לֶךְ יְרוּשָׁלִָֽם
verses.translit: vy'mr brzly 'l hmlkh khmh ymy shny chyy khy ''lh 't hmlkh yrvshlm
verses.translation: I am this day fourscore years old: and can I discern between good and evil? can thy servant taste what I eat or what I drink? can I hear any more the voice of singing men and singing women? wherefore then should thy servant be yet a burden unto my lord the king?

verses.original: בֶּן שְׁמֹנִ֣ים שָׁנָה֩ אָנֹכִ֨י הַ/יּ֜וֹם הַ/אֵדַ֣ע בֵּין ט֣וֹב לְ/רָ֗ע אִם יִטְעַ֤ם עַבְדְּ/ךָ֙ אֶת אֲשֶׁ֤ר אֹכַל֙ וְ/אֶת אֲשֶׁ֣ר אֶשְׁתֶּ֔ה אִם אֶשְׁמַ֣ע ע֔וֹד בְּ/ק֖וֹל שָׁרִ֣ים וְ/שָׁר֑וֹת וְ/לָ/מָּה֩ יִֽהְיֶ֨ה עַבְדְּ/ךָ֥ עוֹד֙ לְ/מַשָּׂ֔א אֶל אֲדֹנִ֖/י הַ/מֶּֽלֶךְ
verses.translit: bn shmnym shnh 'nkhy hyvm h'd' byn tvb lr' 'm yt'm 'bdkh 't 'shr 'khl v't 'shr 'shth 'm 'shm' 'vd bqvl shrym vshrvt vlmh yhyh 'bdkh 'vd lmsh' 'l 'dny hmlkh
verses.translation: Thy servant will go a little way over Jordan with the king: and why should the king recompense it me with such a reward?

verses.original: כִּ/מְעַ֞ט יַעֲבֹ֧ר עַבְדְּ/ךָ֛ אֶת הַ/יַּרְדֵּ֖ן אֶת הַ/מֶּ֑לֶךְ וְ/לָ֨/מָּה֙ יִגְמְלֵ֣/נִי הַ/מֶּ֔לֶךְ הַ/גְּמוּלָ֖ה הַ/זֹּֽאת
verses.translit: khm't y'br 'bdkh 't hyrdn 't hmlkh vlmh ygmlny hmlkh hgmvlh hz't
verses.translation: Let thy servant, I pray thee, turn back again, that I may die in mine own city, and be buried by the grave of my father and of my mother. But behold thy servant Chimham; let him go over with my lord the king; and do to him what shall seem good unto thee.

verses.original: יָֽשָׁב נָ֤א עַבְדְּ/ךָ֙ וְ/אָמֻ֣ת בְּ/עִירִ֔/י עִ֛ם קֶ֥בֶר אָבִ֖/י וְ/אִמִּ֑/י וְ/הִנֵּ֣ה עַבְדְּ/ךָ֣ כִמְהָ֗ם יַֽעֲבֹר֙ עִם אֲדֹנִ֣/י הַ/מֶּ֔לֶךְ וַ/עֲשֵׂה ל֕/וֹ אֵ֥ת אֲשֶׁר ט֖וֹב בְּ/עֵינֶֽי/ךָ
verses.translit: yshb n' 'bdkh v'mt b'yry 'm qbr 'by v'my vhnh 'bdkh khmhm y'br 'm 'dny hmlkh v'shh lv 't 'shr tvb b'ynykh
verses.translation: And the king answered, Chimham shall go over with me, and I will do to him that which shall seem good unto thee: and whatsoever thou shalt require of me, that will I do for thee.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֣אמֶר הַ/מֶּ֗לֶךְ אִתִּ/י֙ יַעֲבֹ֣ר כִּמְהָ֔ם וַ/אֲנִי֙ אֶעֱשֶׂה לּ֔/וֹ אֶת הַ/טּ֖וֹב בְּ/עֵינֶ֑י/ךָ וְ/כֹ֛ל אֲשֶׁר תִּבְחַ֥ר עָלַ֖/י אֶֽעֱשֶׂה לָּֽ/ךְ
verses.translit: vy'mr hmlkh 'ty y'br khmhm v'ny ''shh lv 't htvb b'ynykh vkhl 'shr tbchr 'ly ''shh lkh
verses.translation: And all the people went over Jordan. And when the king was come over, the king kissed Barzillai, and blessed him; and he returned unto his own place.

verses.original: וַ/יַּעֲבֹ֧ר כָּל הָ/עָ֛ם אֶת הַ/יַּרְדֵּ֖ן וְ/הַ/מֶּ֣לֶךְ עָבָ֑ר וַ/יִּשַּׁ֨ק הַ/מֶּ֤לֶךְ לְ/בַרְזִלַּי֙ וַ/יְבָ֣רֲכֵ֔/הוּ וַ/יָּ֖שָׁב לִ/מְקֹמֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: vy'br khl h'm 't hyrdn vhmlkh 'br vyshq hmlkh lbrzly vybrkhhv vyshb lmqmv
verses.translation: Then the king went on to Gilgal, and Chimham went on with him: and all the people of Judah conducted the king, and also half the people of Israel.

verses.original: וַ/יַּעֲבֹ֤ר הַ/מֶּ֨לֶךְ֙ הַ/גִּלְגָּ֔לָ/ה וְ/כִמְהָ֖ן עָבַ֣ר עִמּ֑/וֹ וְ/כָל עַ֤ם יְהוּדָה֙ ו/יעברו הֶעֱבִ֣ירוּ אֶת הַ/מֶּ֔לֶךְ וְ/גַ֕ם חֲצִ֖י עַ֥ם יִשְׂרָאֵֽל
verses.translit: vy'br hmlkh hglglh vkhmhn 'br 'mv vkhl 'm yhvdh vy'brv h'byrv 't hmlkh vgm chtsy 'm yshr'l
verses.translation: And, behold, all the men of Israel came to the king, and said unto the king, Why have our brethren the men of Judah stolen thee away, and have brought the king, and his household, and all David’s men with him, over Jordan?

verses.original: וְ/הִנֵּ֛ה כָּל אִ֥ישׁ יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל בָּאִ֣ים אֶל הַ/מֶּ֑לֶךְ וַ/יֹּאמְר֣וּ אֶל הַ/מֶּ֡לֶךְ מַדּוּעַ֩ גְּנָב֨וּ/ךָ אַחֵ֜י/נוּ אִ֣ישׁ יְהוּדָ֗ה וַ/יַּעֲבִ֨רוּ אֶת הַ/מֶּ֤לֶךְ וְ/אֶת בֵּית/וֹ֙ אֶת הַ/יַּרְדֵּ֔ן וְ/כָל אַנְשֵׁ֥י דָוִ֖ד עִמּֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: vhnh khl 'ysh yshr'l b'ym 'l hmlkh vy'mrv 'l hmlkh mdv' gnbvkh 'chynv 'ysh yhvdh vy'brv 't hmlkh v't bytv 't hyrdn vkhl 'nshy dvd 'mv
verses.translation: And all the men of Judah answered the men of Israel, Because the king is near of kin to us: wherefore then be ye angry for this matter? have we eaten at all of the king’s cost ? or hath he given us any gift?

verses.original: וַ/יַּעַן֩ כָּל אִ֨ישׁ יְהוּדָ֜ה עַל אִ֣ישׁ יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל כִּֽי קָר֤וֹב הַ/מֶּ֨לֶךְ֙ אֵלַ֔/י וְ/לָ֤/מָּה זֶּה֙ חָרָ֣ה לְ/ךָ֔ עַל הַ/דָּבָ֖ר הַ/זֶּ֑ה הֶ/אָכ֤וֹל אָכַ֨לְנוּ֙ מִן הַ/מֶּ֔לֶךְ אִם נִשֵּׂ֥את נִשָּׂ֖א לָֽ/נוּ
verses.translit: vy'n khl 'ysh yhvdh 'l 'ysh yshr'l khy qrvb hmlkh 'ly vlmh zh chrh lkh 'l hdbr hzh h'khvl 'khlnv mn hmlkh 'm nsh't nsh' lnv
verses.translation: And the men of Israel answered the men of Judah, and said, We have ten parts in the king, and we have also more right in David than ye: why then did ye despise us, that our advice should not be first had in bringing back our king? And the words of the men of Judah were fiercer than the words of the men of Israel.

verses.original: וְ/שָׁ֨ם נִקְרָ֜א אִ֣ישׁ בְּלִיַּ֗עַל וּ/שְׁמ֛/וֹ שֶׁ֥בַע בֶּן בִּכְרִ֖י אִ֣ישׁ יְמִינִ֑י וַ/יִּתְקַ֣ע בַּ/שֹּׁפָ֗ר וַ֠/יֹּאמֶר אֵֽין לָ֨/נוּ חֵ֜לֶק בְּ/דָוִ֗ד וְ/לֹ֤א נַֽחֲלָה לָ֨/נוּ֙ בְּ/בֶן יִשַׁ֔י אִ֥ישׁ לְ/אֹהָלָ֖י/ו יִשְׂרָאֵֽל
verses.translit: vshm nqr' 'ysh bly'l vshmv shb' bn bkhry 'ysh ymyny vytq' bshpr vy'mr 'yn lnv chlq bdvd vl' nchlh lnv bbn yshy 'ysh l'hlyv yshr'l
verses.translation: And there happened to be there a man of Belial, whose name was Sheba, the son of Bichri, a Benjamite: and he blew a trumpet, and said, We have no part in David, neither have we inheritance in the son of Jesse: every man to his tents, O Israel.

verses.original: וַ/יַּ֜עַל כָּל אִ֤ישׁ יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ מֵ/אַחֲרֵ֣י דָוִ֔ד אַחֲרֵ֖י שֶׁ֣בַע בֶּן בִּכְרִ֑י וְ/אִ֤ישׁ יְהוּדָה֙ דָּבְק֣וּ בְ/מַלְכָּ֔/ם מִן הַ/יַּרְדֵּ֖ן וְ/עַד יְרוּשָׁלִָֽם
verses.translit: vy'l khl 'ysh yshr'l m'chry dvd 'chry shb' bn bkhry v'ysh yhvdh dbqv bmlkhm mn hyrdn v'd yrvshlm
verses.translation: So every man of Israel went up from after David, and followed Sheba the son of Bichri: but the men of Judah clave unto their king, from Jordan even to Jerusalem.

verses.original: וַ/יָּבֹ֨א דָוִ֣ד אֶל בֵּית/וֹ֮ יְרֽוּשָׁלִַם֒ וַ/יִּקַּ֣ח הַ/מֶּ֡לֶךְ אֵ֣ת עֶֽשֶׂר נָשִׁ֣ים פִּלַגְשִׁ֡ים אֲשֶׁ֣ר הִנִּיחַ֩ לִ/שְׁמֹ֨ר הַ/בַּ֜יִת וַֽ/יִּתְּנֵ֤/ם בֵּית מִשְׁמֶ֨רֶת֙ וַֽ/יְכַלְכְּלֵ֔/ם וַ/אֲלֵי/הֶ֖ם לֹא בָ֑א וַ/תִּהְיֶ֧ינָה צְרֻר֛וֹת עַד י֥וֹם מֻתָ֖/ן אַלְמְנ֥וּת חַיּֽוּת
verses.translit: vyb' dvd 'l bytv yrvshlm vyqch hmlkh 't 'shr nshym plgshym 'shr hnych lshmr hbyt vytnm byt mshmrt vykhlkhlm v'lyhm l' b' vthyynh tsrrvt 'd yvm mtn 'lmnvt chyvt
verses.translation: And David came to his house at Jerusalem; and the king took the ten women his concubines, whom he had left to keep the house, and put them in ward, and fed them, but went not in unto them. So they were shut up unto the day of their death, living in widowhood.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֤אמֶר הַ/מֶּ֨לֶךְ֙ אֶל עֲמָשָׂ֔א הַזְעֶק לִ֥/י אֶת אִישׁ יְהוּדָ֖ה שְׁלֹ֣שֶׁת יָמִ֑ים וְ/אַתָּ֖ה פֹּ֥ה עֲמֹֽד
verses.translit: vy'mr hmlkh 'l 'msh' hz'q ly 't 'ysh yhvdh shlsht ymym v'th ph 'md
verses.translation: Then said the king to Amasa, Assemble me the men of Judah within three days, and be thou here present.

verses.original: וַ/יֵּ֥לֶךְ עֲמָשָׂ֖א לְ/הַזְעִ֣יק אֶת יְהוּדָ֑ה ו/ייחר וַ/יּ֕וֹחֶר מִן הַ/מּוֹעֵ֖ד אֲשֶׁ֥ר יְעָדֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: vylkh 'msh' lhz'yq 't yhvdh vyychr vyvchr mn hmv'd 'shr y'dv
verses.translation: So Amasa went to assemble the men of Judah: but he tarried longer than the set time which he had appointed him.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֤אמֶר דָּוִד֙ אֶל אֲבִישַׁ֔י עַתָּ֗ה יֵ֧רַֽע לָ֛/נוּ שֶׁ֥בַע בֶּן בִּכְרִ֖י מִן אַבְשָׁל֑וֹם אַ֠תָּה קַ֞ח אֶת עַבְדֵ֤י אֲדֹנֶ֨י/ךָ֙ וּ/רְדֹ֣ף אַחֲרָ֔י/ו פֶּן מָ֥צָא ל֛/וֹ עָרִ֥ים בְּצֻר֖וֹת וְ/הִצִּ֥יל עֵינֵֽ/נוּ
verses.translit: vy'mr dvd 'l 'byshy 'th yr' lnv shb' bn bkhry mn 'bshlvm 'th qch 't 'bdy 'dnykh vrdf 'chryv pn mts' lv 'rym btsrvt vhtsyl 'ynnv
verses.translation: And David said to Abishai, Now shall Sheba the son of Bichri do us more harm than did Absalom: take thou thy lord’s servants, and pursue after him, lest he get him fenced cities, and escape us.

verses.original: וַ/יֵּצְא֤וּ אַֽחֲרָי/ו֙ אַנְשֵׁ֣י יוֹאָ֔ב וְ/הַ/כְּרֵתִ֥י וְ/הַ/פְּלֵתִ֖י וְ/כָל הַ/גִּבֹּרִ֑ים וַ/יֵּֽצְאוּ֙ מִ/יר֣וּשָׁלִַ֔ם לִ/רְדֹּ֕ף אַחֲרֵ֖י שֶׁ֥בַע בֶּן בִּכְרִֽי
verses.translit: vyts'v 'chryv 'nshy yv'b vhkhrty vhplty vkhl hgbrym vyts'v myrvshlm lrdf 'chry shb' bn bkhry
verses.translation: And there went out after him Joab’s men, and the Cherethites, and the Pelethites, and all the mighty men: and they went out of Jerusalem, to pursue after Sheba the son of Bichri.

verses.original: הֵ֗ם עִם הָ/אֶ֤בֶן הַ/גְּדוֹלָה֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר בְּ/גִבְע֔וֹן וַ/עֲמָשָׂ֖א בָּ֣א לִ/פְנֵי/הֶ֑ם וְ/יוֹאָ֞ב חָג֣וּר מִדּ֣/וֹ לְבֻשׁ֗/וּ ו/על/ו וְ/עָלָ֞י/ו חֲג֥וֹר חֶ֨רֶב֙ מְצֻמֶּ֤דֶת עַל מָתְנָי/ו֙ בְּ/תַעְרָ֔/הּ וְ/ה֥וּא יָצָ֖א וַ/תִּפֹּֽל
verses.translit: hm 'm h'bn hgdvlh 'shr bgb'vn v'msh' b' lpnyhm vyv'b chgvr mdv lbshv v'lv v'lyv chgvr chrb mtsmdt 'l mtnyv bt'rh vhv' yts' vtpl
verses.translation: When they were at the great stone which is in Gibeon, Amasa went before them. And Joab’s garment that he had put on was girded unto him, and upon it a girdle with a sword fastened upon his loins in the sheath thereof; and as he went forth it fell out.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֤אמֶר יוֹאָב֙ לַ/עֲמָשָׂ֔א הֲ/שָׁל֥וֹם אַתָּ֖ה אָחִ֑/י וַ/תֹּ֜חֶז יַד יְמִ֥ין יוֹאָ֛ב בִּ/זְקַ֥ן עֲמָשָׂ֖א לִ/נְשָׁק לֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: vy'mr yv'b l'msh' hshlvm 'th 'chy vtchz yd ymyn yv'b bzqn 'msh' lnshq lv
verses.translation: And Joab said to Amasa, Art thou in health, my brother? And Joab took Amasa by the beard with the right hand to kiss him.

verses.original: וַ/עֲמָשָׂ֨א לֹֽא נִשְׁמַ֜ר בַּ/חֶ֣רֶב אֲשֶׁ֣ר בְּ/יַד יוֹאָ֗ב וַ/יַּכֵּ/הוּ֩ בָ֨/הּ אֶל הַ/חֹ֜מֶשׁ וַ/יִּשְׁפֹּ֨ךְ מֵעָ֥י/ו אַ֛רְצָ/ה וְ/לֹא שָׁ֥נָה ל֖/וֹ וַ/יָּמֹ֑ת וְ/יוֹאָב֙ וַ/אֲבִישַׁ֣י אָחִ֔י/ו רָדַ֕ף אַחֲרֵ֖י שֶׁ֥בַע בֶּן בִּכְרִֽי
verses.translit: v'msh' l' nshmr bchrb 'shr byd yv'b vykhhv bh 'l hchmsh vyshpkh m'yv 'rtsh vl' shnh lv vymt vyv'b v'byshy 'chyv rdf 'chry shb' bn bkhry
verses.translation: But Amasa took no heed to the sword that was in Joab’s hand: so he smote him therewith in the fifth rib , and shed out his bowels to the ground, and struck him not again; and he died. So Joab and Abishai his brother pursued after Sheba the son of Bichri.

verses.original: וְ/אִישׁ֙ עָמַ֣ד עָלָ֔י/ו מִֽ/נַּעֲרֵ֖י יוֹאָ֑ב וַ/יֹּ֗אמֶר מִי֩ אֲשֶׁ֨ר חָפֵ֧ץ בְּ/יוֹאָ֛ב וּ/מִ֥י אֲשֶׁר לְ/דָוִ֖ד אַחֲרֵ֥י יוֹאָֽב
verses.translit: v'ysh 'md 'lyv mn'ry yv'b vy'mr my 'shr chpts byv'b vmy 'shr ldvd 'chry yv'b
verses.translation: And one of Joab’s men stood by him, and said, He that favoureth Joab, and he that is for David, let him go after Joab.

verses.original: וַ/עֲמָשָׂ֛א מִתְגֹּלֵ֥ל בַּ/דָּ֖ם בְּ/ת֣וֹךְ הַֽ/מְסִּלָּ֑ה וַ/יַּ֨רְא הָ/אִ֜ישׁ כִּֽי עָמַ֣ד כָּל הָ/עָ֗ם וַ/יַּסֵּב֩ אֶת עֲמָשָׂ֨א מִן הַֽ/מְסִלָּ֤ה הַ/שָּׂדֶה֙ וַ/יַּשְׁלֵ֤ךְ עָלָי/ו֙ בֶּ֔גֶד כַּ/אֲשֶׁ֣ר רָאָ֔ה כָּל הַ/בָּ֥א עָלָ֖י/ו וְ/עָמָֽד
verses.translit: v'msh' mtgll bdm btvkh hmslh vyr' h'ysh khy 'md khl h'm vysb 't 'msh' mn hmslh hshdh vyshlkh 'lyv bgd kh'shr r'h khl hb' 'lyv v'md
verses.translation: And Amasa wallowed in blood in the midst of the highway. And when the man saw that all the people stood still, he removed Amasa out of the highway into the field, and cast a cloth upon him, when he saw that every one that came by him stood still.

verses.original: כַּ/אֲשֶׁ֥ר הֹגָ֖ה מִן הַֽ/מְסִלָּ֑ה עָבַ֤ר כָּל אִישׁ֙ אַחֲרֵ֣י יוֹאָ֔ב לִ/רְדֹּ֕ף אַחֲרֵ֖י שֶׁ֥בַע בֶּן בִּכְרִֽי
verses.translit: kh'shr hgh mn hmslh 'br khl 'ysh 'chry yv'b lrdf 'chry shb' bn bkhry
verses.translation: When he was removed out of the highway, all the people went on after Joab, to pursue after Sheba the son of Bichri.

verses.original: וַֽ/יַּעֲבֹ֞ר בְּ/כָל שִׁבְטֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל אָבֵ֛לָ/ה וּ/בֵ֥ית מַעֲכָ֖ה וְ/כָל הַ/בֵּרִ֑ים ו/יקלהו וַ/יִּקָּ֣הֲל֔וּ וַ/יָּבֹ֖אוּ אַף אַחֲרָֽי/ו
verses.translit: vy'br bkhl shbty yshr'l 'blh vbyt m'khh vkhl hbrym vyqlhv vyqhlv vyb'v 'f 'chryv
verses.translation: And he went through all the tribes of Israel unto Abel, and to Beth-maachah, and all the Berites: and they were gathered together, and went also after him.

verses.original: וַ/יָּבֹ֜אוּ וַ/יָּצֻ֣רוּ עָלָ֗י/ו בְּ/אָבֵ֨לָ/ה֙ בֵּ֣ית הַֽמַּעֲכָ֔ה וַ/יִּשְׁפְּכ֤וּ סֹֽלְלָה֙ אֶל הָ/עִ֔יר וַֽ/תַּעֲמֹ֖ד בַּ/חֵ֑ל וְ/כָל הָ/עָם֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר אֶת יוֹאָ֔ב מַשְׁחִיתִ֖ם לְ/הַפִּ֥יל הַ/חוֹמָֽה
verses.translit: vyb'v vytsrv 'lyv b'blh byt hm'khh vyshpkhv sllh 'l h'yr vt'md bchl vkhl h'm 'shr 't yv'b mshchytm lhpyl hchvmh
verses.translation: And they came and besieged him in Abel of Beth-maachah, and they cast up a bank against the city, and it stood in the trench: and all the people that were with Joab battered the wall, to throw it down.

verses.original: וַ/תִּקְרָ֛א אִשָּׁ֥ה חֲכָמָ֖ה מִן הָ/עִ֑יר שִׁמְע֤וּ שִׁמְעוּ֙ אִמְרוּ נָ֣א אֶל יוֹאָ֔ב קְרַ֣ב עַד הֵ֔נָּה וַ/אֲדַבְּרָ֖ה אֵלֶֽי/ךָ
verses.translit: vtqr' 'shh chkhmh mn h'yr shm'v shm'v 'mrv n' 'l yv'b qrb 'd hnh v'dbrh 'lykh
verses.translation: Then cried a wise woman out of the city, Hear, hear; say, I pray you, unto Joab, Come near hither, that I may speak with thee.

verses.original: וַ/יִּקְרַ֣ב אֵלֶ֔י/הָ וַ/תֹּ֧אמֶר הָ/אִשָּׁ֛ה הַ/אַתָּ֥ה יוֹאָ֖ב וַ/יֹּ֣אמֶר אָ֑נִי וַ/תֹּ֣אמֶר ל֗/וֹ שְׁמַע֙ דִּבְרֵ֣י אֲמָתֶ֔/ךָ וַ/יֹּ֖אמֶר שֹׁמֵ֥עַ אָנֹֽכִי
verses.translit: vyqrb 'lyh vt'mr h'shh h'th yv'b vy'mr 'ny vt'mr lv shm' dbry 'mtkh vy'mr shm' 'nkhy
verses.translation: And when he was come near unto her, the woman said, Art thou Joab? And he answered, I am he . Then she said unto him, Hear the words of thine handmaid. And he answered, I do hear.

verses.original: וַ/תֹּ֖אמֶר לֵ/אמֹ֑ר דַּבֵּ֨ר יְדַבְּר֤וּ בָ/רִֽאשֹׁנָה֙ לֵ/אמֹ֔ר שָׁאֹ֧ל יְשָׁאֲל֛וּ בְּ/אָבֵ֖ל וְ/כֵ֥ן הֵתַֽמּוּ
verses.translit: vt'mr l'mr dbr ydbrv br'shnh l'mr sh'l ysh'lv b'bl vkhn htmv
verses.translation: Then she spake, saying, They were wont to speak in old time, saying, They shall surely ask counsel at Abel: and so they ended the matter .

verses.original: אָנֹכִ֕י שְׁלֻמֵ֖י אֱמוּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל אַתָּ֣ה מְבַקֵּ֗שׁ לְ/הָמִ֨ית עִ֤יר וְ/אֵם֙ בְּ/יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל לָ֥/מָּה תְבַלַּ֖ע נַחֲלַ֥ת יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: 'nkhy shlmy 'mvny yshr'l 'th mbqsh lhmyt 'yr v'm byshr'l lmh tbl' nchlt yhvh
verses.translation: I am one of them that are peaceable and faithful in Israel: thou seekest to destroy a city and a mother in Israel: why wilt thou swallow up the inheritance of the LORD ?

verses.original: וַ/יַּ֥עַן יוֹאָ֖ב וַ/יֹּאמַ֑ר חָלִ֤ילָ/ה חָלִ֨ילָ/ה֙ לִ֔/י אִם אֲבַלַּ֖ע וְ/אִם אַשְׁחִֽית
verses.translit: vy'n yv'b vy'mr chlylh chlylh ly 'm 'bl' v'm 'shchyt
verses.translation: And Joab answered and said, Far be it, far be it from me, that I should swallow up or destroy.

verses.original: לֹא כֵ֣ן הַ/דָּבָ֗ר כִּ֡י אִישׁ֩ מֵ/הַ֨ר אֶפְרַ֜יִם שֶׁ֧בַע בֶּן בִּכְרִ֣י שְׁמ֗/וֹ נָשָׂ֤א יָד/וֹ֙ בַּ/מֶּ֣לֶךְ בְּ/דָוִ֔ד תְּנֽוּ אֹת֣/וֹ לְ/בַדּ֔/וֹ וְ/אֵלְכָ֖ה מֵ/עַ֣ל הָ/עִ֑יר וַ/תֹּ֤אמֶר הָֽ/אִשָּׁה֙ אֶל יוֹאָ֔ב הִנֵּ֥ה רֹאשׁ֛/וֹ מֻשְׁלָ֥ךְ אֵלֶ֖י/ךָ בְּעַ֥ד הַ/חוֹמָֽה
verses.translit: l' khn hdbr khy 'ysh mhr 'prym shb' bn bkhry shmv nsh' ydv bmlkh bdvd tnv 'tv lbdv v'lkhh m'l h'yr vt'mr h'shh 'l yv'b hnh r'shv mshlkh 'lykh b'd hchvmh
verses.translation: The matter is not so: but a man of mount Ephraim, Sheba the son of Bichri by name, hath lifted up his hand against the king, even against David: deliver him only, and I will depart from the city. And the woman said unto Joab, Behold, his head shall be thrown to thee over the wall.

verses.original: וַ/תָּבוֹא֩ הָ/אִשָּׁ֨ה אֶל כָּל הָ/עָ֜ם בְּ/חָכְמָתָ֗/הּ וַֽ/יִּכְרְת֞וּ אֶת רֹ֨אשׁ שֶׁ֤בַע בֶּן בִּכְרִי֙ וַ/יַּשְׁלִ֣כוּ אֶל יוֹאָ֔ב וַ/יִּתְקַע֙ בַּ/שּׁוֹפָ֔ר וַ/יָּפֻ֥צוּ מֵֽ/עַל הָ/עִ֖יר אִ֣ישׁ לְ/אֹהָלָ֑י/ו וְ/יוֹאָ֛ב שָׁ֥ב יְרוּשָׁלִַ֖ם אֶל הַ/מֶּֽלֶךְ
verses.translit: vtbv' h'shh 'l khl h'm bchkhmth vykhrtv 't r'sh shb' bn bkhry vyshlkhv 'l yv'b vytq' bshvpr vyptsv m'l h'yr 'ysh l'hlyv vyv'b shb yrvshlm 'l hmlkh
verses.translation: Then the woman went unto all the people in her wisdom. And they cut off the head of Sheba the son of Bichri, and cast it out to Joab. And he blew a trumpet, and they retired from the city, every man to his tent. And Joab returned to Jerusalem unto the king.

verses.original: וְ/יוֹאָ֕ב אֶ֥ל כָּל הַ/צָּבָ֖א יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וּ/בְנָיָה֙ בֶּן יְה֣וֹיָדָ֔ע עַל ה/כרי הַ/כְּרֵתִ֖י וְ/עַל הַ/פְּלֵתִֽי
verses.translit: vyv'b 'l khl htsb' yshr'l vbnyh bn yhvyd' 'l hkhry hkhrty v'l hplty
verses.translation: Now Joab was over all the host of Israel: and Benaiah the son of Jehoiada was over the Cherethites and over the Pelethites:

verses.original: וַ/אֲדֹרָ֖ם עַל הַ/מַּ֑ס וִ/יהוֹשָׁפָ֥ט בֶּן אֲחִיל֖וּד הַ/מַּזְכִּֽיר
verses.translit: v'drm 'l hms vyhvshpt bn 'chylvd hmzkhyr
verses.translation: And Adoram was over the tribute: and Jehoshaphat the son of Ahilud was recorder:

verses.original: ו/שיא וּ/שְׁוָ֖א סֹפֵ֑ר וְ/צָד֥וֹק וְ/אֶבְיָתָ֖ר כֹּהֲנִֽים
verses.translit: vshy' vshv' spr vtsdvq v'bytr khhnym
verses.translation: And Sheva was scribe: and Zadok and Abiathar were the priests:

verses.original: וְ/גַ֗ם עִירָא֙ הַ/יָּ֣אִרִ֔י הָיָ֥ה כֹהֵ֖ן לְ/דָוִֽד
verses.translit: vgm 'yr' hy'ry hyh khhn ldvd
verses.translation: And Ira also the Jairite was a chief ruler about David.

verses.original: וַ/יְהִ֣י רָעָב֩ בִּ/ימֵ֨י דָוִ֜ד שָׁלֹ֣שׁ שָׁנִ֗ים שָׁנָה֙ אַחֲרֵ֣י שָׁנָ֔ה וַ/יְבַקֵּ֥שׁ דָּוִ֖ד אֶת פְּנֵ֣י יְהוָ֑ה וַ/יֹּ֣אמֶר יְהוָ֗ה אֶל שָׁאוּל֙ וְ/אֶל בֵּ֣ית הַ/דָּמִ֔ים עַל אֲשֶׁר הֵמִ֖ית אֶת הַ/גִּבְעֹנִֽים
verses.translit: vyhy r'b bymy dvd shlsh shnym shnh 'chry shnh vybqsh dvd 't pny yhvh vy'mr yhvh 'l sh'vl v'l byt hdmym 'l 'shr hmyt 't hgb'nym
verses.translation: Then there was a famine in the days of David three years, year after year; and David enquired of the LORD . And the LORD answered, It is for Saul, and for his bloody house, because he slew the Gibeonites.

verses.original: וַ/יִּקְרָ֥א הַ/מֶּ֛לֶךְ לַ/גִּבְעֹנִ֖ים וַ/יֹּ֣אמֶר אֲלֵי/הֶ֑ם וְ/הַ/גִּבְעֹנִ֞ים לֹ֣א מִ/בְּנֵ֧י יִשְׂרָאֵ֣ל הֵ֗מָּה כִּ֚י אִם מִ/יֶּ֣תֶר הָ/אֱמֹרִ֔י וּ/בְנֵ֤י יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ נִשְׁבְּע֣וּ לָ/הֶ֔ם וַ/יְבַקֵּ֤שׁ שָׁאוּל֙ לְ/הַכֹּתָ֔/ם בְּ/קַנֹּאת֥/וֹ לִ/בְנֵֽי יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל וִ/יהוּדָֽה
verses.translit: vyqr' hmlkh lgb'nym vy'mr 'lyhm vhgb'nym l' mbny yshr'l hmh khy 'm mytr h'mry vbny yshr'l nshb'v lhm vybqsh sh'vl lhkhtm bqn'tv lbny yshr'l vyhvdh
verses.translation: And the king called the Gibeonites, and said unto them; (now the Gibeonites were not of the children of Israel, but of the remnant of the Amorites; and the children of Israel had sworn unto them: and Saul sought to slay them in his zeal to the children of Israel and Judah.)

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֤אמֶר דָּוִד֙ אֶל הַ/גִּבְעֹנִ֔ים מָ֥ה אֶעֱשֶׂ֖ה לָ/כֶ֑ם וּ/בַ/מָּ֣ה אֲכַפֵּ֔ר וּ/בָרְכ֖וּ אֶת נַחֲלַ֥ת יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: vy'mr dvd 'l hgb'nym mh ''shh lkhm vbmh 'khpr vbrkhv 't nchlt yhvh
verses.translation: Wherefore David said unto the Gibeonites, What shall I do for you? and wherewith shall I make the atonement, that ye may bless the inheritance of the LORD ?

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֧אמְרוּ ל֣/וֹ הַ/גִּבְעֹנִ֗ים אֵֽין ל/י לָ֜/נוּ כֶּ֤סֶף וְ/זָהָב֙ עִם שָׁא֣וּל וְ/עִם בֵּית֔/וֹ וְ/אֵֽין לָ֥/נוּ אִ֖ישׁ לְ/הָמִ֣ית בְּ/יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וַ/יֹּ֛אמֶר מָֽה אַתֶּ֥ם אֹמְרִ֖ים אֶעֱשֶׂ֥ה לָ/כֶֽם
verses.translit: vy'mrv lv hgb'nym 'yn ly lnv khsf vzhb 'm sh'vl v'm bytv v'yn lnv 'ysh lhmyt byshr'l vy'mr mh 'tm 'mrym ''shh lkhm
verses.translation: And the Gibeonites said unto him, We will have no silver nor gold of Saul, nor of his house; neither for us shalt thou kill any man in Israel. And he said, What ye shall say, that will I do for you.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּֽאמְרוּ֙ אֶל הַ/מֶּ֔לֶךְ הָ/אִישׁ֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר כִּלָּ֔/נוּ וַ/אֲשֶׁ֖ר דִּמָּה לָ֑/נוּ נִשְׁמַ֕דְנוּ מֵֽ/הִתְיַצֵּ֖ב בְּ/כָל גְּבֻ֥ל יִשְׂרָאֵֽל
verses.translit: vy'mrv 'l hmlkh h'ysh 'shr khlnv v'shr dmh lnv nshmdnv mhtytsb bkhl gbl yshr'l
verses.translation: And they answered the king, The man that consumed us, and that devised against us that we should be destroyed from remaining in any of the coasts of Israel,

verses.original: ינתן יֻתַּן לָ֜/נוּ שִׁבְעָ֤ה אֲנָשִׁים֙ מִ/בָּנָ֔י/ו וְ/הוֹקַֽעֲנוּ/ם֙ לַֽ/יהוָ֔ה בְּ/גִבְעַ֥ת שָׁא֖וּל בְּחִ֣יר יְהוָ֑ה וַ/יֹּ֥אמֶר הַ/מֶּ֖לֶךְ אֲנִ֥י אֶתֵּֽן
verses.translit: yntn ytn lnv shb'h 'nshym mbnyv vhvq'nvm lyhvh bgb't sh'vl bchyr yhvh vy'mr hmlkh 'ny 'tn
verses.translation: Let seven men of his sons be delivered unto us, and we will hang them up unto the LORD in Gibeah of Saul, whom the LORD did choose. And the king said, I will give them .

verses.original: וַ/יַּחְמֹ֣ל הַ/מֶּ֔לֶךְ עַל מְפִי בֹ֖שֶׁת בֶּן יְהוֹנָתָ֣ן בֶּן שָׁא֑וּל עַל שְׁבֻעַ֤ת יְהוָה֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר בֵּֽינֹתָ֔/ם בֵּ֣ין דָּוִ֔ד וּ/בֵ֖ין יְהוֹנָתָ֥ן בֶּן שָׁאֽוּל
verses.translit: vychml hmlkh 'l mpy bsht bn yhvntn bn sh'vl 'l shb't yhvh 'shr byntm byn dvd vbyn yhvntn bn sh'vl
verses.translation: But the king spared Mephibosheth, the son of Jonathan the son of Saul, because of the LORD’s oath that was between them, between David and Jonathan the son of Saul.

verses.original: וַ/יִּקַּ֣ח הַ/מֶּ֡לֶךְ אֶת שְׁ֠נֵי בְּנֵ֨י רִצְפָּ֤ה בַת אַיָּה֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר יָלְדָ֣ה לְ/שָׁא֔וּל אֶת אַרְמֹנִ֖י וְ/אֶת מְפִבֹ֑שֶׁת וְ/אֶת חֲמֵ֗שֶׁת בְּנֵי֙ מִיכַ֣ל בַּת שָׁא֔וּל אֲשֶׁ֥ר יָלְדָ֛ה לְ/עַדְרִיאֵ֥ל בֶּן בַּרְזִלַּ֖י הַ/מְּחֹלָתִֽי
verses.translit: vyqch hmlkh 't shny bny rtsph bt 'yh 'shr yldh lsh'vl 't 'rmny v't mpbsht v't chmsht bny mykhl bt sh'vl 'shr yldh l'dry'l bn brzly hmchlty
verses.translation: But the king took the two sons of Rizpah the daughter of Aiah, whom she bare unto Saul, Armoni and Mephibosheth; and the five sons of Michal the daughter of Saul, whom she brought up for Adriel the son of Barzillai the Meholathite:

verses.original: וַֽ/יִּתְּנֵ֞/ם בְּ/יַ֣ד הַ/גִּבְעֹנִ֗ים וַ/יֹּקִיעֻ֤/ם בָּ/הָר֙ לִ/פְנֵ֣י יְהוָ֔ה וַ/יִּפְּל֥וּ שבעתים שְׁבַעְתָּ֖/ם יָ֑חַד ו/הם וְ/הֵ֨מָּה הֻמְת֜וּ בִּ/ימֵ֤י קָצִיר֙ בָּ/רִ֣אשֹׁנִ֔ים תחלת בִּ/תְחִלַּ֖ת קְצִ֥יר שְׂעֹרִֽים
verses.translit: vytnm byd hgb'nym vyqy'm bhr lpny yhvh vyplv shb'tym shb'tm ychd vhm vhmh hmtv bymy qtsyr br'shnym tchlt btchlt qtsyr sh'rym
verses.translation: And he delivered them into the hands of the Gibeonites, and they hanged them in the hill before the LORD : and they fell all seven together, and were put to death in the days of harvest, in the first days , in the beginning of barley harvest.

verses.original: וַ/תִּקַּ֣ח רִצְפָּה֩ בַת אַיָּ֨ה אֶת הַ/שַּׂ֜ק וַ/תַּטֵּ֨/הוּ לָ֤/הּ אֶל הַ/צּוּר֙ מִ/תְּחִלַּ֣ת קָצִ֔יר עַ֛ד נִתַּךְ מַ֥יִם עֲלֵי/הֶ֖ם מִן הַ/שָּׁמָ֑יִם וְ/לֹֽא נָתְנָה֩ ע֨וֹף הַ/שָּׁמַ֜יִם לָ/נ֤וּחַ עֲלֵי/הֶם֙ יוֹמָ֔ם וְ/אֶת חַיַּ֥ת הַ/שָּׂדֶ֖ה לָֽיְלָה
verses.translit: vtqch rtsph bt 'yh 't hshq vtthv lh 'l htsvr mtchlt qtsyr 'd ntkh mym 'lyhm mn hshmym vl' ntnh 'vf hshmym lnvch 'lyhm yvmm v't chyt hshdh lylh
verses.translation: And Rizpah the daughter of Aiah took sackcloth, and spread it for her upon the rock, from the beginning of harvest until water dropped upon them out of heaven, and suffered neither the birds of the air to rest on them by day, nor the beasts of the field by night.

verses.original: וַ/יֻּגַּ֖ד לְ/דָוִ֑ד אֵ֧ת אֲשֶׁר עָשְׂתָ֛ה רִצְפָּ֥ה בַת אַיָּ֖ה פִּלֶ֥גֶשׁ שָׁאֽוּל
verses.translit: vygd ldvd 't 'shr 'shth rtsph bt 'yh plgsh sh'vl
verses.translation: And it was told David what Rizpah the daughter of Aiah, the concubine of Saul, had done.

verses.original: וַ/יֵּ֣לֶךְ דָּוִ֗ד וַ/יִּקַּ֞ח אֶת עַצְמ֤וֹת שָׁאוּל֙ וְ/אֶת עַצְמוֹת֙ יְהוֹנָתָ֣ן בְּנ֔/וֹ מֵ/אֵ֕ת בַּעֲלֵ֖י יָבֵ֣ישׁ גִּלְעָ֑ד אֲשֶׁר֩ גָּנְב֨וּ אֹתָ֜/ם מֵ/רְחֹ֣ב בֵּֽית שַׁ֗ן אֲשֶׁ֨ר תלו/ם תְּלָא֥וּ/ם שם ה/פלשתים שָׁ֨מָּ/ה֙ פְּלִשְׁתִּ֔ים בְּ/י֨וֹם הַכּ֧וֹת פְּלִשְׁתִּ֛ים אֶת שָׁא֖וּל בַּ/גִּלְבֹּֽעַ
verses.translit: vylkh dvd vyqch 't 'tsmvt sh'vl v't 'tsmvt yhvntn bnv m't b'ly ybysh gl'd 'shr gnbv 'tm mrchb byt shn 'shr tlvm tl'vm shm hplshtym shmh plshtym byvm hkhvt plshtym 't sh'vl bglb'
verses.translation: And David went and took the bones of Saul and the bones of Jonathan his son from the men of Jabesh-gilead, which had stolen them from the street of Beth-shan, where the Philistines had hanged them, when the Philistines had slain Saul in Gilboa:

verses.original: וַ/יַּ֤עַל מִ/שָּׁם֙ אֶת עַצְמ֣וֹת שָׁא֔וּל וְ/אֶת עַצְמ֖וֹת יְהוֹנָתָ֣ן בְּנ֑/וֹ וַ/יַּ֣אַסְפ֔וּ אֶת עַצְמ֖וֹת הַ/מּוּקָעִֽים
verses.translit: vy'l mshm 't 'tsmvt sh'vl v't 'tsmvt yhvntn bnv vy'spv 't 'tsmvt hmvq'ym
verses.translation: And he brought up from thence the bones of Saul and the bones of Jonathan his son; and they gathered the bones of them that were hanged.

verses.original: וַ/יִּקְבְּר֣וּ אֶת עַצְמוֹת שָׁא֣וּל וִ/יהוֹנָֽתָן בְּ֠נ/וֹ בְּ/אֶ֨רֶץ בִּנְיָמִ֜ן בְּ/צֵלָ֗ע בְּ/קֶ֨בֶר֙ קִ֣ישׁ אָבִ֔י/ו וַֽ/יַּעֲשׂ֔וּ כֹּ֥ל אֲשֶׁר צִוָּ֖ה הַ/מֶּ֑לֶךְ וַ/יֵּעָתֵ֧ר אֱלֹהִ֛ים לָ/אָ֖רֶץ אַֽחֲרֵי כֵֽן
verses.translit: vyqbrv 't 'tsmvt sh'vl vyhvntn bnv b'rts bnymn btsl' bqbr qysh 'byv vy'shv khl 'shr tsvh hmlkh vy'tr 'lhym l'rts 'chry khn
verses.translation: And the bones of Saul and Jonathan his son buried they in the country of Benjamin in Zelah, in the sepulchre of Kish his father: and they performed all that the king commanded. And after that God was intreated for the land.

verses.original: וַ/תְּהִי ע֧וֹד מִלְחָמָ֛ה לַ/פְּלִשְׁתִּ֖ים אֶת יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וַ/יֵּ֨רֶד דָּוִ֜ד וַ/עֲבָדָ֥י/ו עִמּ֛/וֹ וַ/יִּלָּחֲמ֥וּ אֶת פְּלִשְׁתִּ֖ים וַ/יָּ֥עַף דָּוִֽד
verses.translit: vthy 'vd mlchmh lplshtym 't yshr'l vyrd dvd v'bdyv 'mv vylchmv 't plshtym vy'f dvd
verses.translation: Moreover the Philistines had yet war again with Israel; and David went down, and his servants with him, and fought against the Philistines: and David waxed faint.

verses.original: ו/ישבו וְ/יִשְׁבִּ֨י בְּנֹ֜ב אֲשֶׁ֣ר בִּ/ילִידֵ֣י הָ/רָפָ֗ה וּ/מִשְׁקַ֤ל קֵינ/וֹ֙ שְׁלֹ֤שׁ מֵאוֹת֙ מִשְׁקַ֣ל נְחֹ֔שֶׁת וְ/ה֖וּא חָג֣וּר חֲדָשָׁ֑ה וַ/יֹּ֖אמֶר לְ/הַכּ֥וֹת אֶת דָּוִֽד
verses.translit: vyshbv vyshby bnb 'shr bylydy hrph vmshql qynv shlsh m'vt mshql nchsht vhv' chgvr chdshh vy'mr lhkhvt 't dvd
verses.translation: And Ishbi-benob, which was of the sons of the giant, the weight of whose spear weighed three hundred shekels of brass in weight, he being girded with a new sword , thought to have slain David.

verses.original: וַ/יַּֽעֲזָר ל/וֹ֙ אֲבִישַׁ֣י בֶּן צְרוּיָ֔ה וַ/יַּ֥ךְ אֶת הַ/פְּלִשְׁתִּ֖י וַ/יְמִיתֵ֑/הוּ אָ֣ז נִשְׁבְּעוּ֩ אַנְשֵׁי דָוִ֨ד ל֜/וֹ לֵ/אמֹ֗ר לֹא תֵצֵ֨א ע֤וֹד אִתָּ֨/נוּ֙ לַ/מִּלְחָמָ֔ה וְ/לֹ֥א תְכַבֶּ֖ה אֶת נֵ֥ר יִשְׂרָאֵֽל
verses.translit: vy'zr lv 'byshy bn tsrvyh vykh 't hplshty vymythv 'z nshb'v 'nshy dvd lv l'mr l' tts' 'vd 'tnv lmlchmh vl' tkhbh 't nr yshr'l
verses.translation: But Abishai the son of Zeruiah succoured him, and smote the Philistine, and killed him. Then the men of David sware unto him, saying, Thou shalt go no more out with us to battle, that thou quench not the light of Israel.

verses.original: וַֽ/יְהִי֙ אַֽחֲרֵי כֵ֔ן וַ/תְּהִי ע֧וֹד הַ/מִּלְחָמָ֛ה בְּ/ג֖וֹב עִם פְּלִשְׁתִּ֑ים אָ֣ז הִכָּ֗ה סִבְּכַי֙ הַ/חֻ֣שָׁתִ֔י אֶת סַ֕ף אֲשֶׁ֖ר בִּ/ילִדֵ֥י הָ/רָפָֽה
verses.translit: vyhy 'chry khn vthy 'vd hmlchmh bgvb 'm plshtym 'z hkhh sbkhy hchshty 't sf 'shr byldy hrph
verses.translation: And it came to pass after this, that there was again a battle with the Philistines at Gob: then Sibbechai the Hushathite slew Saph, which was of the sons of the giant.

verses.original: וַ/תְּהִי ע֧וֹד הַ/מִּלְחָמָ֛ה בְּ/ג֖וֹב עִם פְּלִשְׁתִּ֑ים וַ/יַּ֡ךְ אֶלְחָנָן֩ בֶּן יַעְרֵ֨י אֹרְגִ֜ים בֵּ֣ית הַלַּחְמִ֗י אֵ֚ת גָּלְיָ֣ת הַ/גִּתִּ֔י וְ/עֵ֣ץ חֲנִית֔/וֹ כִּ/מְנ֖וֹר אֹרְגִֽים
verses.translit: vthy 'vd hmlchmh bgvb 'm plshtym vykh 'lchnn bn y'ry 'rgym byt hlchmy 't glyt hgty v'ts chnytv khmnvr 'rgym
verses.translation: And there was again a battle in Gob with the Philistines, where Elhanan the son of Jaare-oregim, a Beth-lehemite, slew the brother of Goliath the Gittite, the staff of whose spear was like a weaver’s beam.

verses.original: וַ/תְּהִי ע֥וֹד מִלְחָמָ֖ה בְּ/גַ֑ת וַ/יְהִ֣י אִ֣ישׁ מדין מָד֗וֹן וְ/אֶצְבְּעֹ֣ת יָדָי/ו֩ וְ/אֶצְבְּעֹ֨ת רַגְלָ֜י/ו שֵׁ֣שׁ וָ/שֵׁ֗שׁ עֶשְׂרִ֤ים וְ/אַרְבַּע֙ מִסְפָּ֔ר וְ/גַם ה֖וּא יֻלַּ֥ד לְ/הָ/רָפָֽה
verses.translit: vthy 'vd mlchmh bgt vyhy 'ysh mdyn mdvn v'tsb't ydyv v'tsb't rglyv shsh vshsh 'shrym v'rb' mspr vgm hv' yld lhrph
verses.translation: And there was yet a battle in Gath, where was a man of great stature, that had on every hand six fingers, and on every foot six toes, four and twenty in number; and he also was born to the giant.

verses.original: וַ/יְחָרֵ֖ף אֶת יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וַ/יַּכֵּ֨/הוּ֙ יְה֣וֹנָתָ֔ן בֶּן שמעי שִׁמְעָ֖ה אֲחִ֥י דָוִֽד
verses.translit: vychrf 't yshr'l vykhhv yhvntn bn shm'y shm'h 'chy dvd
verses.translation: And when he defied Israel, Jonathan the son of Shimea the brother of David slew him.

verses.original: אֶת אַרְבַּ֥עַת אֵ֛לֶּה יֻלְּד֥וּ לְ/הָ/רָפָ֖ה בְּ/גַ֑ת וַ/יִּפְּל֥וּ בְ/יַד דָּוִ֖ד וּ/בְ/יַ֥ד עֲבָדָֽי/ו
verses.translit: 't 'rb't 'lh yldv lhrph bgt vyplv byd dvd vbyd 'bdyv
verses.translation: These four were born to the giant in Gath, and fell by the hand of David, and by the hand of his servants.

verses.original: וַ/יְדַבֵּ֤ר דָּוִד֙ לַֽ/יהוָ֔ה אֶת דִּבְרֵ֖י הַ/שִּׁירָ֣ה הַ/זֹּ֑את בְּ/יוֹם֩ הִצִּ֨יל יְהוָ֥ה אֹת֛/וֹ מִ/כַּ֥ף כָּל אֹיְבָ֖י/ו וּ/מִ/כַּ֥ף שָׁאֽוּל
verses.translit: vydbr dvd lyhvh 't dbry hshyrh hz't byvm htsyl yhvh 'tv mkhf khl 'ybyv vmkhf sh'vl
verses.translation: And David spake unto the LORD the words of this song in the day that the LORD had delivered him out of the hand of all his enemies, and out of the hand of Saul:

verses.original: וַ/יֹּאמַ֑ר יְהוָ֛ה סַֽלְעִ֥/י וּ/מְצֻדָתִ֖/י וּ/מְפַלְטִ/י לִֽ/י
verses.translit: vy'mr yhvh sl'y vmtsdty vmplty ly
verses.translation: And he said, The LORD is my rock, and my fortress, and my deliverer;

verses.original: אֱלֹהֵ֥י צוּרִ֖/י אֶחֱסֶה בּ֑/וֹ מָגִנִּ֞/י וְ/קֶ֣רֶן יִשְׁעִ֗/י מִשְׂגַּבִּ/י֙ וּ/מְנוּסִ֔/י מֹשִׁעִ֕/י מֵ/חָמָ֖ס תֹּשִׁעֵֽ/נִי
verses.translit: 'lhy tsvry 'chsh bv mgny vqrn ysh'y mshgby vmnvsy msh'y mchms tsh'ny
verses.translation: The God of my rock; in him will I trust: he is my shield, and the horn of my salvation, my high tower, and my refuge, my saviour; thou savest me from violence.

verses.original: מְהֻלָּ֖ל אֶקְרָ֣א יְהוָ֑ה וּ/מֵ/אֹיְבַ֖/י אִוָּשֵֽׁעַ
verses.translit: mhll 'qr' yhvh vm'yby 'vsh'
verses.translation: I will call on the LORD , who is worthy to be praised: so shall I be saved from mine enemies.

verses.original: כִּ֥י אֲפָפֻ֖/נִי מִשְׁבְּרֵי מָ֑וֶת נַחֲלֵ֥י בְלִיַּ֖עַל יְבַעֲתֻֽ/נִי
verses.translit: khy 'ppny mshbry mvt nchly bly'l yb'tny
verses.translation: When the waves of death compassed me, the floods of ungodly men made me afraid;

verses.original: חֶבְלֵ֥י שְׁא֖וֹל סַבֻּ֑/נִי קִדְּמֻ֖/נִי מֹֽקְשֵׁי מָֽוֶת
verses.translit: chbly sh'vl sbny qdmny mqshy mvt
verses.translation: The sorrows of hell compassed me about; the snares of death prevented me;

verses.original: בַּ/צַּר לִ/י֙ אֶקְרָ֣א יְהוָ֔ה וְ/אֶל אֱלֹהַ֖/י אֶקְרָ֑א וַ/יִּשְׁמַ֤ע מֵ/הֵֽיכָל/וֹ֙ קוֹלִ֔/י וְ/שַׁוְעָתִ֖/י בְּ/אָזְנָֽי/ו
verses.translit: btsr ly 'qr' yhvh v'l 'lhy 'qr' vyshm' mhykhlv qvly vshv'ty b'znyv
verses.translation: In my distress I called upon the LORD , and cried to my God: and he did hear my voice out of his temple, and my cry did enter into his ears.

verses.original: ו/תגעש וַ/יִּתְגָּעַ֤שׁ וַ/תִּרְעַשׁ֙ הָ/אָ֔רֶץ מוֹסְד֥וֹת הַ/שָּׁמַ֖יִם יִרְגָּ֑זוּ וַ/יִּֽתְגָּעֲשׁ֖וּ כִּֽי חָ֥רָה לֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: vtg'sh vytg'sh vtr'sh h'rts mvsdvt hshmym yrgzv vytg'shv khy chrh lv
verses.translation: Then the earth shook and trembled; the foundations of heaven moved and shook, because he was wroth.

verses.original: עָלָ֤ה עָשָׁן֙ בְּ/אַפּ֔/וֹ וְ/אֵ֥שׁ מִ/פִּ֖י/ו תֹּאכֵ֑ל גֶּחָלִ֖ים בָּעֲר֥וּ מִמֶּֽ/נּוּ
verses.translit: 'lh 'shn b'pv v'sh mpyv t'khl gchlym b'rv mmnv
verses.translation: There went up a smoke out of his nostrils, and fire out of his mouth devoured: coals were kindled by it.

verses.original: וַ/יֵּ֥ט שָׁמַ֖יִם וַ/יֵּרַ֑ד וַ/עֲרָפֶ֖ל תַּ֥חַת רַגְלָֽי/ו
verses.translit: vyt shmym vyrd v'rpl tcht rglyv
verses.translation: He bowed the heavens also, and came down; and darkness was under his feet.

verses.original: וַ/יִּרְכַּ֥ב עַל כְּר֖וּב וַ/יָּעֹ֑ף וַ/יֵּרָ֖א עַל כַּנְפֵי רֽוּחַ
verses.translit: vyrkhb 'l khrvb vy'f vyr' 'l khnpy rvch
verses.translation: And he rode upon a cherub, and did fly: and he was seen upon the wings of the wind.

verses.original: וַ/יָּ֥שֶׁת חֹ֛שֶׁךְ סְבִיבֹתָ֖י/ו סֻכּ֑וֹת חַֽשְׁרַת מַ֖יִם עָבֵ֥י שְׁחָקִֽים
verses.translit: vysht chshkh sbybtyv skhvt chshrt mym 'by shchqym
verses.translation: And he made darkness pavilions round about him, dark waters, and thick clouds of the skies.

verses.original: מִ/נֹּ֖גַהּ נֶגְדּ֑/וֹ בָּעֲר֖וּ גַּחֲלֵי אֵֽשׁ
verses.translit: mngh ngdv b'rv gchly 'sh
verses.translation: Through the brightness before him were coals of fire kindled.

verses.original: יַרְעֵ֥ם מִן שָׁמַ֖יִם יְהוָ֑ה וְ/עֶלְי֖וֹן יִתֵּ֥ן קוֹלֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: yr'm mn shmym yhvh v'lyvn ytn qvlv
verses.translation: The LORD thundered from heaven, and the most High uttered his voice.

verses.original: וַ/יִּשְׁלַ֥ח חִצִּ֖ים וַ/יְפִיצֵ֑/ם בָּרָ֖ק ו/יהמ/ם וַ/יָּהֹֽם
verses.translit: vyshlch chtsym vypytsm brq vyhmm vyhm
verses.translation: And he sent out arrows, and scattered them; lightning, and discomfited them.

verses.original: וַ/יֵּֽרָאוּ֙ אֲפִ֣קֵי יָ֔ם יִגָּל֖וּ מֹסְד֣וֹת תֵּבֵ֑ל בְּ/גַעֲרַ֣ת יְהוָ֔ה מִ/נִּשְׁמַ֖ת ר֥וּחַ אַפּֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: vyr'v 'pqy ym yglv msdvt tbl bg'rt yhvh mnshmt rvch 'pv
verses.translation: And the channels of the sea appeared, the foundations of the world were discovered, at the rebuking of the LORD , at the blast of the breath of his nostrils.

verses.original: יִשְׁלַ֥ח מִ/מָּר֖וֹם יִקָּחֵ֑/נִי יַֽמְשֵׁ֖/נִי מִ/מַּ֥יִם רַבִּֽים
verses.translit: yshlch mmrvm yqchny ymshny mmym rbym
verses.translation: He sent from above, he took me; he drew me out of many waters;

verses.original: יַצִּילֵ֕/נִי מֵ/אֹיְבִ֖/י עָ֑ז מִ/שֹּׂ֣נְאַ֔/י כִּ֥י אָמְצ֖וּ מִמֶּֽ/נִּי
verses.translit: ytsylny m'yby 'z mshn'y khy 'mtsv mmny
verses.translation: He delivered me from my strong enemy, and from them that hated me: for they were too strong for me.

verses.original: יְקַדְּמֻ֖/נִי בְּ/י֣וֹם אֵידִ֑/י וַ/יְהִ֧י יְהוָ֛ה מִשְׁעָ֖ן לִֽ/י
verses.translit: yqdmny byvm 'ydy vyhy yhvh msh'n ly
verses.translation: They prevented me in the day of my calamity: but the LORD was my stay.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּצֵ֥א לַ/מֶּרְחָ֖ב אֹתִ֑/י יְחַלְּצֵ֖/נִי כִּי חָ֥פֵֽץ בִּֽ/י
verses.translit: vyts' lmrchb 'ty ychltsny khy chpts by
verses.translation: He brought me forth also into a large place: he delivered me, because he delighted in me.

verses.original: יִגְמְלֵ֥/נִי יְהוָ֖ה כְּ/צִדְקָתִ֑/י כְּ/בֹ֥ר יָדַ֖/י יָשִׁ֥יב לִֽ/י
verses.translit: ygmlny yhvh khtsdqty khbr ydy yshyb ly
verses.translation: The LORD rewarded me according to my righteousness: according to the cleanness of my hands hath he recompensed me.

verses.original: כִּ֥י שָׁמַ֖רְתִּי דַּרְכֵ֣י יְהוָ֑ה וְ/לֹ֥א רָשַׁ֖עְתִּי מֵ/אֱלֹהָֽ/י
verses.translit: khy shmrty drkhy yhvh vl' rsh'ty m'lhy
verses.translation: For I have kept the ways of the LORD , and have not wickedly departed from my God.

verses.original: כִּ֥י כָל משפט/ו מִשְׁפָּטָ֖י/ו לְ/נֶגְדִּ֑/י וְ/חֻקֹּתָ֖י/ו לֹא אָס֥וּר מִמֶּֽ/נָּה
verses.translit: khy khl mshptv mshptyv lngdy vchqtyv l' 'svr mmnh
verses.translation: For all his judgments were before me: and as for his statutes, I did not depart from them.

verses.original: וָ/אֶהְיֶ֥ה תָמִ֖ים ל֑/וֹ וָ/אֶשְׁתַּמְּרָ֖/ה מֵ/עֲוֺנִֽ/י
verses.translit: v'hyh tmym lv v'shtmrh m'vny
verses.translation: I was also upright before him, and have kept myself from mine iniquity.

verses.original: וַ/יָּ֧שֶׁב יְהוָ֛ה לִ֖/י כְּ/צִדְקָתִ֑/י כְּ/בֹרִ֖/י לְ/נֶ֥גֶד עֵינָֽי/ו
verses.translit: vyshb yhvh ly khtsdqty khbry lngd 'ynyv
verses.translation: Therefore the LORD hath recompensed me according to my righteousness; according to my cleanness in his eye sight.

verses.original: עִם חָסִ֖יד תִּתְחַסָּ֑ד עִם גִּבּ֥וֹר תָּמִ֖ים תִּתַּמָּֽם
verses.translit: 'm chsyd ttchsd 'm gbvr tmym ttmm
verses.translation: With the merciful thou wilt shew thyself merciful, and with the upright man thou wilt shew thyself upright.

verses.original: עִם נָבָ֖ר תִּתָּבָ֑ר וְ/עִם עִקֵּ֖שׁ תִּתַּפָּֽל
verses.translit: 'm nbr ttbr v'm 'qsh ttpl
verses.translation: With the pure thou wilt shew thyself pure; and with the froward thou wilt shew thyself unsavoury.

verses.original: וְ/אֶת עַ֥ם עָנִ֖י תּוֹשִׁ֑יעַ וְ/עֵינֶ֖י/ךָ עַל רָמִ֥ים תַּשְׁפִּֽיל
verses.translit: v't 'm 'ny tvshy' v'ynykh 'l rmym tshpyl
verses.translation: And the afflicted people thou wilt save: but thine eyes are upon the haughty, that thou mayest bring them down.

verses.original: כִּֽי אַתָּ֥ה נֵירִ֖/י יְהוָ֑ה וַ/יהוָ֖ה יַגִּ֥יהַּ חָשְׁכִּֽ/י
verses.translit: khy 'th nyry yhvh vyhvh ygyh chshkhy
verses.translation: For thou art my lamp, O LORD : and the LORD will lighten my darkness.

verses.original: כִּ֥י בְ/כָ֖ה אָר֣וּץ גְּד֑וּד בֵּ/אלֹהַ֖/י אֲדַלֶּג שֽׁוּר
verses.translit: khy bkhh 'rvts gdvd b'lhy 'dlg shvr
verses.translation: For by thee I have run through a troop: by my God have I leaped over a wall.

verses.original: הָ/אֵ֖ל תָּמִ֣ים דַּרְכּ֑/וֹ אִמְרַ֤ת יְהוָה֙ צְרוּפָ֔ה מָגֵ֣ן ה֔וּא לְ/כֹ֖ל הַ/חֹסִ֥ים בּֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: h'l tmym drkhv 'mrt yhvh tsrvph mgn hv' lkhl hchsym bv
verses.translation: As for God, his way is perfect; the word of the LORD is tried: he is a buckler to all them that trust in him.

verses.original: כִּ֥י מִי אֵ֖ל מִ/בַּלְעֲדֵ֣י יְהוָ֑ה וּ/מִ֥י צ֖וּר מִֽ/בַּלְעֲדֵ֥י אֱלֹהֵֽי/נוּ
verses.translit: khy my 'l mbl'dy yhvh vmy tsvr mbl'dy 'lhynv
verses.translation: For who is God, save the LORD ? and who is a rock, save our God?

verses.original: הָ/אֵ֥ל מָעוּזִּ֖/י חָ֑יִל וַ/יַּתֵּ֥ר תָּמִ֖ים דרכ/ו דַּרְכִּֽ/י
verses.translit: h'l m'vzy chyl vytr tmym drkhv drkhy
verses.translation: God is my strength and power: and he maketh my way perfect.

verses.original: מְשַׁוֶּ֥ה רגלי/ו רַגְלַ֖/י כָּ/אַיָּל֑וֹת וְ/עַ֥ל בָּמוֹתַ֖/י יַעֲמִדֵֽ/נִי
verses.translit: mshvh rglyv rgly kh'ylvt v'l bmvty y'mdny
verses.translation: He maketh my feet like hinds’ feet: and setteth me upon my high places.

verses.original: מְלַמֵּ֥ד יָדַ֖/י לַ/מִּלְחָמָ֑ה וְ/נִחַ֥ת קֶֽשֶׁת נְחוּשָׁ֖ה זְרֹעֹתָֽ/י
verses.translit: mlmd ydy lmlchmh vncht qsht nchvshh zr'ty
verses.translation: He teacheth my hands to war; so that a bow of steel is broken by mine arms.

verses.translit: vttn ly mgn ysh'kh v'ntkh trbny
verses.translation: Thou hast also given me the shield of thy salvation: and thy gentleness hath made me great.

verses.original: תַּרְחִ֥יב צַעֲדִ֖/י תַּחְתֵּ֑/נִי וְ/לֹ֥א מָעֲד֖וּ קַרְסֻלָּֽ/י
verses.translit: trchyb ts'dy tchtny vl' m'dv qrsly
verses.translation: Thou hast enlarged my steps under me; so that my feet did not slip.

verses.original: אֶרְדְּפָ֥ה אֹיְבַ֖/י וָ/אַשְׁמִידֵ֑/ם וְ/לֹ֥א אָשׁ֖וּב עַד כַּלּוֹתָֽ/ם
verses.translit: 'rdph 'yby v'shmydm vl' 'shvb 'd khlvtm
verses.translation: I have pursued mine enemies, and destroyed them; and turned not again until I had consumed them.

verses.original: וָ/אֲכַלֵּ֥/ם וָ/אֶמְחָצֵ֖/ם וְ/לֹ֣א יְקוּמ֑וּ/ן וַֽ/יִּפְּל֖וּ תַּ֥חַת רַגְלָֽ/י
verses.translit: v'khlm v'mchtsm vl' yqvmvn vyplv tcht rgly
verses.translation: And I have consumed them, and wounded them, that they could not arise: yea, they are fallen under my feet.

verses.original: וַ/תַּזְרֵ֥/נִי חַ֖יִל לַ/מִּלְחָמָ֑ה תַּכְרִ֥יעַ קָמַ֖/י תַּחְתֵּֽ/נִי
verses.translit: vtzrny chyl lmlchmh tkhry' qmy tchtny
verses.translation: For thou hast girded me with strength to battle: them that rose up against me hast thou subdued under me.

verses.original: וְ/אֹ֣יְבַ֔/י תַּ֥תָּה לִּ֖/י עֹ֑רֶף מְשַׂנְאַ֖/י וָ/אַצְמִיתֵֽ/ם
verses.translit: v'yby tth ly 'rf mshn'y v'tsmytm
verses.translation: Thou hast also given me the necks of mine enemies, that I might destroy them that hate me.

verses.original: יִשְׁע֖וּ וְ/אֵ֣ין מֹשִׁ֑יעַ אֶל יְהוָ֖ה וְ/לֹ֥א עָנָֽ/ם
verses.translit: ysh'v v'yn mshy' 'l yhvh vl' 'nm
verses.translation: They looked, but there was none to save; even unto the LORD , but he answered them not.

verses.original: וְ/אֶשְׁחָקֵ֖/ם כַּ/עֲפַר אָ֑רֶץ כְּ/טִיט חוּצ֥וֹת אֲדִקֵּ֖/ם אֶרְקָעֵֽ/ם
verses.translit: v'shchqm kh'pr 'rts khtyt chvtsvt 'dqm 'rq'm
verses.translation: Then did I beat them as small as the dust of the earth, I did stamp them as the mire of the street, and did spread them abroad.

verses.original: וַֽ/תְּפַלְּטֵ֔/נִי מֵ/רִיבֵ֖י עַמִּ֑/י תִּשְׁמְרֵ֨/נִי֙ לְ/רֹ֣אשׁ גּוֹיִ֔ם עַ֥ם לֹא יָדַ֖עְתִּי יַעַבְדֻֽ/נִי
verses.translit: vtpltny mryby 'my tshmrny lr'sh gvym 'm l' yd'ty y'bdny
verses.translation: Thou also hast delivered me from the strivings of my people, thou hast kept me to be head of the heathen: a people which I knew not shall serve me.

verses.original: בְּנֵ֥י נֵכָ֖ר יִתְכַּֽחֲשׁוּ לִ֑/י לִ/שְׁמ֥וֹעַ אֹ֖זֶן יִשָּׁ֥מְעוּ לִֽ/י
verses.translit: bny nkhr ytkhchshv ly lshmv' 'zn yshm'v ly
verses.translation: Strangers shall submit themselves unto me: as soon as they hear, they shall be obedient unto me.

verses.original: בְּנֵ֥י נֵכָ֖ר יִבֹּ֑לוּ וְ/יַחְגְּר֖וּ מִ/מִּסְגְּרוֹתָֽ/ם
verses.translit: bny nkhr yblv vychgrv mmsgrvtm
verses.translation: Strangers shall fade away, and they shall be afraid out of their close places.

verses.original: חַי יְהוָ֖ה וּ/בָר֣וּךְ צוּרִ֑/י וְ/יָרֻ֕ם אֱלֹהֵ֖י צ֥וּר יִשְׁעִֽ/י
verses.translit: chy yhvh vbrvkh tsvry vyrm 'lhy tsvr ysh'y
verses.translation: The LORD liveth; and blessed be my rock; and exalted be the God of the rock of my salvation.

verses.original: הָ/אֵ֕ל הַ/נֹּתֵ֥ן נְקָמֹ֖ת לִ֑/י וּ/מוֹרִ֥יד עַמִּ֖ים תַּחְתֵּֽ/נִי
verses.translit: h'l hntn nqmt ly vmvryd 'mym tchtny
verses.translation: It is God that avengeth me, and that bringeth down the people under me,

verses.original: וּ/מוֹצִיאִ֖/י מֵ/אֹֽיְבָ֑/י וּ/מִ/קָּמַ/י֙ תְּר֣וֹמְמֵ֔/נִי מֵ/אִ֥ישׁ חֲמָסִ֖ים תַּצִּילֵֽ/נִי
verses.translit: vmvtsy'y m'yby vmqmy trvmmny m'ysh chmsym ttsylny
verses.translation: And that bringeth me forth from mine enemies: thou also hast lifted me up on high above them that rose up against me: thou hast delivered me from the violent man.

verses.original: עַל כֵּ֛ן אוֹדְ/ךָ֥ יְהוָ֖ה בַּ/גּוֹיִ֑ם וּ/לְ/שִׁמְ/ךָ֖ אֲזַמֵּֽר
verses.translit: 'l khn 'vdkh yhvh bgvym vlshmkh 'zmr
verses.translation: Therefore I will give thanks unto thee, O LORD , among the heathen, and I will sing praises unto thy name.

verses.original: מגדיל מִגְדּ֖וֹל יְשׁוּע֣וֹת מַלְכּ֑/וֹ וְ/עֹֽשֶׂה חֶ֧סֶד לִ/מְשִׁיח֛/וֹ לְ/דָוִ֥ד וּ/לְ/זַרְע֖/וֹ עַד עוֹלָֽם
verses.translit: mgdyl mgdvl yshv'vt mlkhv v'shh chsd lmshychv ldvd vlzr'v 'd 'vlm
verses.translation: He is the tower of salvation for his king: and sheweth mercy to his anointed, unto David, and to his seed for evermore.

verses.original: וְ/אֵ֛לֶּה דִּבְרֵ֥י דָוִ֖ד הָ/אַֽחֲרֹנִ֑ים נְאֻ֧ם דָּוִ֣ד בֶּן יִשַׁ֗י וּ/נְאֻ֤ם הַ/גֶּ֨בֶר֙ הֻ֣קַם עָ֔ל מְשִׁ֨יחַ֙ אֱלֹהֵ֣י יַֽעֲקֹ֔ב וּ/נְעִ֖ים זְמִר֥וֹת יִשְׂרָאֵֽל
verses.translit: v'lh dbry dvd h'chrnym n'm dvd bn yshy vn'm hgbr hqm 'l mshych 'lhy y'qb vn'ym zmrvt yshr'l
verses.translation: Now these be the last words of David. David the son of Jesse said, and the man who was raised up on high, the anointed of the God of Jacob, and the sweet psalmist of Israel, said,

verses.original: ר֥וּחַ יְהוָ֖ה דִּבֶּר בִּ֑/י וּ/מִלָּת֖/וֹ עַל לְשׁוֹנִֽ/י
verses.translit: rvch yhvh dbr by vmltv 'l lshvny
verses.translation: The Spirit of the LORD spake by me, and his word was in my tongue.

verses.original: אָמַר֙ אֱלֹהֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל לִ֥/י דִבֶּ֖ר צ֣וּר יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל מוֹשֵׁל֙ בָּ/אָדָ֔ם צַדִּ֕יק מוֹשֵׁ֖ל יִרְאַ֥ת אֱלֹהִֽים
verses.translit: 'mr 'lhy yshr'l ly dbr tsvr yshr'l mvshl b'dm tsdyq mvshl yr't 'lhym
verses.translation: The God of Israel said, the Rock of Israel spake to me, He that ruleth over men must be just, ruling in the fear of God.

verses.original: וּ/כְ/א֥וֹר בֹּ֖קֶר יִזְרַח שָׁ֑מֶשׁ בֹּ֚קֶר לֹ֣א עָב֔וֹת מִ/נֹּ֥גַהּ מִ/מָּטָ֖ר דֶּ֥שֶׁא מֵ/אָֽרֶץ
verses.translit: vkh'vr bqr yzrch shmsh bqr l' 'bvt mngh mmtr dsh' m'rts
verses.translation: And he shall be as the light of the morning, when the sun riseth, even a morning without clouds; as the tender grass springing out of the earth by clear shining after rain.

verses.original: כִּֽי לֹא כֵ֥ן בֵּיתִ֖/י עִם אֵ֑ל כִּי֩ בְרִ֨ית עוֹלָ֜ם שָׂ֣ם לִ֗/י עֲרוּכָ֤ה בַ/כֹּל֙ וּ/שְׁמֻרָ֔ה כִּֽי כָל יִשְׁעִ֥/י וְ/כָל חֵ֖פֶץ כִּֽי לֹ֥א יַצְמִֽיחַ
verses.translit: khy l' khn byty 'm 'l khy bryt 'vlm shm ly 'rvkhh bkhl vshmrh khy khl ysh'y vkhl chpts khy l' ytsmych
verses.translation: Although my house be not so with God; yet he hath made with me an everlasting covenant, ordered in all things , and sure: for this is all my salvation, and all my desire, although he make it not to grow.

verses.original: וּ/בְלִיַּ֕עַל כְּ/ק֥וֹץ מֻנָ֖ד כֻּלָּ֑/הַם כִּֽי לֹ֥א בְ/יָ֖ד יִקָּֽחוּ
verses.translit: vbly'l khqvts mnd khlhm khy l' byd yqchv
verses.translation: But the sons of Belial shall be all of them as thorns thrust away, because they cannot be taken with hands:

verses.original: וְ/אִישׁ֙ יִגַּ֣ע בָּ/הֶ֔ם יִמָּלֵ֥א בַרְזֶ֖ל וְ/עֵ֣ץ חֲנִ֑ית וּ/בָ/אֵ֕שׁ שָׂר֥וֹף יִשָּׂרְפ֖וּ בַּ/שָּֽׁבֶת
verses.translit: v'ysh yg' bhm yml' brzl v'ts chnyt vb'sh shrvf yshrpv bshbt
verses.translation: But the man that shall touch them must be fenced with iron and the staff of a spear; and they shall be utterly burned with fire in the same place.

verses.original: אֵ֛לֶּה שְׁמ֥וֹת הַ/גִּבֹּרִ֖ים אֲשֶׁ֣ר לְ/דָוִ֑ד יֹשֵׁ֨ב בַּשֶּׁ֜בֶת תַּחְכְּמֹנִ֣י רֹ֣אשׁ הַ/שָּׁלִשִׁ֗י ה֚וּא עֲדִינ֣/וֹ ה/עצנ/ו הָֽ/עֶצְנִ֔י עַל שְׁמֹנֶ֥ה מֵא֛וֹת חָלָ֖ל בְּ/פַ֥עַם אחד אֶחָֽת
verses.translit: 'lh shmvt hgbrym 'shr ldvd yshb bshbt tchkhmny r'sh hshlshy hv' 'dynv h'tsnv h'tsny 'l shmnh m'vt chll bp'm 'chd 'cht
verses.translation: These be the names of the mighty men whom David had: The Tachmonite that sat in the seat, chief among the captains; the same was Adino the Eznite: he lift up his spear against eight hundred, whom he slew at one time.

verses.original: ו/אחר/ו וְ/אַחֲרָ֛י/ו אֶלְעָזָ֥ר בֶּן דדי דֹּד֖וֹ בֶּן אֲחֹחִ֑י בִּ/שְׁלֹשָׁ֨ה גברים הַ/גִּבֹּרִ֜ים עִם דָּוִ֗ד בְּ/חָֽרְפָ֤/ם בַּ/פְּלִשְׁתִּים נֶאֶסְפוּ שָׁ֣ם לַ/מִּלְחָמָ֔ה וַֽ/יַּעֲל֖וּ אִ֥ישׁ יִשְׂרָאֵֽל
verses.translit: v'chrv v'chryv 'l'zr bn ddy ddv bn 'chchy bshlshh gbrym hgbrym 'm dvd bchrpm bplshtym n'spv shm lmlchmh vy'lv 'ysh yshr'l
verses.translation: And after him was Eleazar the son of Dodo the Ahohite, one of the three mighty men with David, when they defied the Philistines that were there gathered together to battle, and the men of Israel were gone away:

verses.original: ה֣וּא קָם֩ וַ/יַּ֨ךְ בַּ/פְּלִשְׁתִּ֜ים עַ֣ד כִּֽי יָגְעָ֣ה יָד֗/וֹ וַ/תִּדְבַּ֤ק יָד/וֹ֙ אֶל הַ/חֶ֔רֶב וַ/יַּ֧עַשׂ יְהוָ֛ה תְּשׁוּעָ֥ה גְדוֹלָ֖ה בַּ/יּ֣וֹם הַ/ה֑וּא וְ/הָ/עָ֛ם יָשֻׁ֥בוּ אַחֲרָ֖י/ו אַךְ לְ/פַשֵּֽׁט
verses.translit: hv' qm vykh bplshtym 'd khy yg'h ydv vtdbq ydv 'l hchrb vy'sh yhvh tshv'h gdvlh byvm hhv' vh'm yshbv 'chryv 'kh lpsht
verses.translation: He arose, and smote the Philistines until his hand was weary, and his hand clave unto the sword: and the LORD wrought a great victory that day; and the people returned after him only to spoil.

verses.original: וְ/אַחֲרָ֛י/ו שַׁמָּ֥א בֶן אָגֵ֖א הָרָרִ֑י וַ/יֵּאָסְפ֨וּ פְלִשְׁתִּ֜ים לַ/חַיָּ֗ה וַ/תְּהִי שָׁ֞ם חֶלְקַ֤ת הַ/שָּׂדֶה֙ מְלֵאָ֣ה עֲדָשִׁ֔ים וְ/הָ/עָ֥ם נָ֖ס מִ/פְּנֵ֥י פְלִשְׁתִּֽים
verses.translit: v'chryv shm' bn 'g' hrry vy'spv plshtym lchyh vthy shm chlqt hshdh ml'h 'dshym vh'm ns mpny plshtym
verses.translation: And after him was Shammah the son of Agee the Hararite. And the Philistines were gathered together into a troop, where was a piece of ground full of lentiles: and the people fled from the Philistines.

verses.original: וַ/יִּתְיַצֵּ֤ב בְּ/תוֹךְ הַֽ/חֶלְקָה֙ וַ/יַּצִּילֶ֔/הָ וַ/יַּ֖ךְ אֶת פְּלִשְׁתִּ֑ים וַ/יַּ֥עַשׂ יְהוָ֖ה תְּשׁוּעָ֥ה גְדוֹלָֽה
verses.translit: vytytsb btvkh hchlqh vytsylh vykh 't plshtym vy'sh yhvh tshv'h gdvlh
verses.translation: But he stood in the midst of the ground, and defended it, and slew the Philistines: and the LORD wrought a great victory.

verses.original: וַ/יֵּרְד֨וּ שלשים שְׁלֹשָׁ֜ה מֵ/הַ/שְּׁלֹשִׁ֣ים רֹ֗אשׁ וַ/יָּבֹ֤אוּ אֶל קָצִיר֙ אֶל דָּוִ֔ד אֶל מְעָרַ֖ת עֲדֻלָּ֑ם וְ/חַיַּ֣ת פְּלִשְׁתִּ֔ים חֹנָ֖ה בְּ/עֵ֥מֶק רְפָאִֽים
verses.translit: vyrdv shlshym shlshh mhshlshym r'sh vyb'v 'l qtsyr 'l dvd 'l m'rt 'dlm vchyt plshtym chnh b'mq rp'ym
verses.translation: And three of the thirty chief went down, and came to David in the harvest time unto the cave of Adullam: and the troop of the Philistines pitched in the valley of Rephaim.

verses.original: וְ/דָוִ֖ד אָ֣ז בַּ/מְּצוּדָ֑ה וּ/מַצַּ֣ב פְּלִשְׁתִּ֔ים אָ֖ז בֵּ֥ית לָֽחֶם
verses.translit: vdvd 'z bmtsvdh vmtsb plshtym 'z byt lchm
verses.translation: And David was then in an hold, and the garrison of the Philistines was then in Beth-lehem.

verses.original: וַ/יִּתְאַוֶּ֥ה דָוִ֖ד וַ/יֹּאמַ֑ר מִ֚י יַשְׁקֵ֣/נִי מַ֔יִם מִ/בֹּ֥אר בֵּֽית לֶ֖חֶם אֲשֶׁ֥ר בַּ/שָּֽׁעַר
verses.translit: vyt'vh dvd vy'mr my yshqny mym mb'r byt lchm 'shr bsh'r
verses.translation: And David longed, and said, Oh that one would give me drink of the water of the well of Beth-lehem, which is by the gate!

verses.original: וַ/יִּבְקְעוּ֩ שְׁלֹ֨שֶׁת הַ/גִּבֹּרִ֜ים בְּ/מַחֲנֵ֣ה פְלִשְׁתִּ֗ים וַ/יִּֽשְׁאֲבוּ מַ֨יִם֙ מִ/בֹּ֤אר בֵּֽית לֶ֨חֶם֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר בַּ/שַּׁ֔עַר וַ/יִּשְׂא֖וּ וַ/יָּבִ֣אוּ אֶל דָּוִ֑ד וְ/לֹ֤א אָבָה֙ לִ/שְׁתּוֹתָ֔/ם וַ/יַּסֵּ֥ךְ אֹתָ֖/ם לַֽ/יהוָֽה
verses.translit: vybq'v shlsht hgbrym bmchnh plshtym vysh'bv mym mb'r byt lchm 'shr bsh'r vysh'v vyb'v 'l dvd vl' 'bh lshtvtm vyskh 'tm lyhvh
verses.translation: And the three mighty men brake through the host of the Philistines, and drew water out of the well of Beth-lehem, that was by the gate, and took it , and brought it to David: nevertheless he would not drink thereof, but poured it out unto the LORD .

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֡אמֶר חָלִילָ/ה֩ לִּ֨/י יְהוָ֜ה מֵ/עֲשֹׂ֣תִ/י זֹ֗את הֲ/דַ֤ם הָֽ/אֲנָשִׁים֙ הַ/הֹלְכִ֣ים בְּ/נַפְשׁוֹתָ֔/ם וְ/לֹ֥א אָבָ֖ה לִ/שְׁתּוֹתָ֑/ם אֵ֣לֶּה עָשׂ֔וּ שְׁלֹ֖שֶׁת הַ/גִּבֹּרִֽים
verses.translit: vy'mr chlylh ly yhvh m'shty z't hdm h'nshym hhlkhym bnpshvtm vl' 'bh lshtvtm 'lh 'shv shlsht hgbrym
verses.translation: And he said, Be it far from me, O LORD , that I should do this: is not this the blood of the men that went in jeopardy of their lives? therefore he would not drink it. These things did these three mighty men.

verses.original: וַ/אֲבִישַׁ֞י אֲחִ֣י יוֹאָ֣ב בֶּן צְרוּיָ֗ה ה֚וּא רֹ֣אשׁ ה/שלשי הַ/שְּׁלֹשָׁ֔ה וְ/הוּא֙ עוֹרֵ֣ר אֶת חֲנִית֔/וֹ עַל שְׁלֹ֥שׁ מֵא֖וֹת חָלָ֑ל וְ/ל/וֹ שֵׁ֖ם בַּ/שְּׁלֹשָֽׁה
verses.translit: v'byshy 'chy yv'b bn tsrvyh hv' r'sh hshlshy hshlshh vhv' 'vrr 't chnytv 'l shlsh m'vt chll vlv shm bshlshh
verses.translation: And Abishai, the brother of Joab, the son of Zeruiah, was chief among three. And he lifted up his spear against three hundred, and slew them , and had the name among three.

verses.original: מִן הַ/שְּׁלֹשָׁה֙ הֲ/כִ֣י נִכְבָּ֔ד וַ/יְהִ֥י לָ/הֶ֖ם לְ/שָׂ֑ר וְ/עַד הַ/שְּׁלֹשָׁ֖ה לֹא בָֽא
verses.translit: mn hshlshh hkhy nkhbd vyhy lhm lshr v'd hshlshh l' b'
verses.translation: Was he not most honourable of three? therefore he was their captain: howbeit he attained not unto the first three.

verses.original: וּ/בְנָיָ֨הוּ בֶן יְהוֹיָדָ֧ע בֶּן אִֽישׁ חי חַ֛יִל רַב פְּעָלִ֖ים מִֽ/קַּבְצְאֵ֑ל ה֣וּא הִכָּ֗ה אֵ֣ת שְׁנֵ֤י אֲרִאֵל֙ מוֹאָ֔ב וְ֠/הוּא יָרַ֞ד וְ/הִכָּ֧ה אֶֽת ה/אריה הָ/אֲרִ֛י בְּ/ת֥וֹךְ הַ/בֹּ֖אר בְּ/י֥וֹם הַ/שָּֽׁלֶג
verses.translit: vbnyhv bn yhvyd' bn 'ysh chy chyl rb p'lym mqbts'l hv' hkhh 't shny 'r'l mv'b vhv' yrd vhkhh 't h'ryh h'ry btvkh hb'r byvm hshlg
verses.translation: And Benaiah the son of Jehoiada, the son of a valiant man, of Kabzeel, who had done many acts, he slew two lionlike men of Moab: he went down also and slew a lion in the midst of a pit in time of snow:

verses.original: וְ/הוּא הִכָּה֩ אֶת אִ֨ישׁ מִצְרִ֜י אשר אִ֣ישׁ מַרְאֶ֗ה וּ/בְ/יַ֤ד הַ/מִּצְרִי֙ חֲנִ֔ית וַ/יֵּ֥רֶד אֵלָ֖י/ו בַּ/שָּׁ֑בֶט וַ/יִּגְזֹ֤ל אֶֽת הַ/חֲנִית֙ מִ/יַּ֣ד הַ/מִּצְרִ֔י וַ/יַּהַרְגֵ֖/הוּ בַּ/חֲנִיתֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: vhv' hkhh 't 'ysh mtsry 'shr 'ysh mr'h vbyd hmtsry chnyt vyrd 'lyv bshbt vygzl 't hchnyt myd hmtsry vyhrghv bchnytv
verses.translation: And he slew an Egyptian, a goodly man: and the Egyptian had a spear in his hand; but he went down to him with a staff, and plucked the spear out of the Egyptian’s hand, and slew him with his own spear.

verses.original: אֵ֣לֶּה עָשָׂ֔ה בְּנָיָ֖הוּ בֶּן יְהוֹיָדָ֑ע וְ/ל/וֹ שֵׁ֖ם בִּ/שְׁלֹשָׁ֥ה הַ/גִּבֹּרִֽים
verses.translit: 'lh 'shh bnyhv bn yhvyd' vlv shm bshlshh hgbrym
verses.translation: These things did Benaiah the son of Jehoiada, and had the name among three mighty men.

verses.original: מִן הַ/שְּׁלֹשִׁ֣ים נִכְבָּ֔ד וְ/אֶל הַ/שְּׁלֹשָׁ֖ה לֹא בָ֑א וַ/יְשִׂמֵ֥/הוּ דָוִ֖ד אֶל מִשְׁמַעְתּֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: mn hshlshym nkhbd v'l hshlshh l' b' vyshmhv dvd 'l mshm'tv
verses.translation: He was more honourable than the thirty, but he attained not to the first three. And David set him over his guard.

verses.original: עֲשָׂה אֵ֥ל אֲחִֽי יוֹאָ֖ב בַּ/שְּׁלֹשִׁ֑ים אֶלְחָנָ֥ן בֶּן דֹּד֖וֹ בֵּ֥ית לָֽחֶם
verses.translit: 'shh 'l 'chy yv'b bshlshym 'lchnn bn ddv byt lchm
verses.translation: Asahel the brother of Joab was one of the thirty; Elhanan the son of Dodo of Beth-lehem,

verses.original: שַׁמָּה֙ הַֽ/חֲרֹדִ֔י אֱלִיקָ֖א הַ/חֲרֹדִֽי
verses.translit: shmh hchrdy 'lyq' hchrdy
verses.translation: Shammah the Harodite, Elika the Harodite,

verses.original: חֶ֚לֶץ הַ/פַּלְטִ֔י עִירָ֥א בֶן עִקֵּ֖שׁ הַ/תְּקוֹעִֽי
verses.translit: chlts hplty 'yr' bn 'qsh htqv'y
verses.translation: Helez the Paltite, Ira the son of Ikkesh the Tekoite,

verses.original: אֲבִיעֶ֨זֶר֙ הָֽ/עַנְּתֹתִ֔י מְבֻנַּ֖י הַ/חֻשָׁתִֽי
verses.translit: 'by'zr h'ntty mbny hchshty
verses.translation: Abiezer the Anethothite, Mebunnai the Hushathite,

verses.original: צַלְמוֹן֙ הָֽ/אֲחֹחִ֔י מַהְרַ֖י הַ/נְּטֹפָתִֽי
verses.translit: tslmvn h'chchy mhry hntpty
verses.translation: Zalmon the Ahohite, Maharai the Netophathite,

verses.original: חֵ֥לֶב בֶּֽן בַּעֲנָ֖ה הַ/נְּטֹפָתִ֑י אִתַּי֙ בֶּן רִיבַ֔י מִ/גִּבְעַ֖ת בְּנֵ֥י בִנְיָמִֽן
verses.translit: chlb bn b'nh hntpty 'ty bn ryby mgb't bny bnymn
verses.translation: Heleb the son of Baanah, a Netophathite, Ittai the son of Ribai out of Gibeah of the children of Benjamin,

verses.original: בְּנָיָ֨הוּ֙ פִּרְעָ֣תֹנִ֔י הִדַּ֖י מִ/נַּ֥חֲלֵי גָֽעַשׁ
verses.translit: bnyhv pr'tny hdy mnchly g'sh
verses.translation: Benaiah the Pirathonite, Hiddai of the brooks of Gaash,

verses.original: אֲבִֽי עַלְבוֹן֙ הָֽ/עַרְבָתִ֔י עַזְמָ֖וֶת הַ/בַּרְחֻמִֽי
verses.translit: 'by 'lbvn h'rbty 'zmvt hbrchmy
verses.translation: Abi-albon the Arbathite, Azmaveth the Barhumite,

verses.original: אֶלְיַחְבָּא֙ הַ/שַּׁ֣עַלְבֹנִ֔י בְּנֵ֥י יָשֵׁ֖ן יְהוֹנָתָֽן
verses.translit: 'lychb' hsh'lbny bny yshn yhvntn
verses.translation: Eliahba the Shaalbonite, of the sons of Jashen, Jonathan,

verses.original: שַׁמָּה֙ הַֽ/הֲרָרִ֔י אֲחִיאָ֥ם בֶּן שָׁרָ֖ר הָארָרִֽי
verses.translit: shmh hhrry 'chy'm bn shrr h'rry
verses.translation: Shammah the Hararite, Ahiam the son of Sharar the Hararite,

verses.original: אֱלִיפֶ֥לֶט בֶּן אֲחַסְבַּ֖י בֶּן הַ/מַּֽעֲכָתִ֑י אֱלִיעָ֥ם בֶּן אֲחִיתֹ֖פֶל הַ/גִּלֹנִֽי
verses.translit: 'lyplt bn 'chsby bn hm'khty 'ly'm bn 'chytpl hglny
verses.translation: Eliphelet the son of Ahasbai, the son of the Maachathite, Eliam the son of Ahithophel the Gilonite,

verses.original: חצרו חֶצְרַי֙ הַֽ/כַּרְמְלִ֔י פַּעֲרַ֖י הָ/אַרְבִּֽי
verses.translit: chtsrv chtsry hkhrmly p'ry h'rby
verses.translation: Hezrai the Carmelite, Paarai the Arbite,

verses.original: יִגְאָ֤ל בֶּן נָתָן֙ מִ/צֹּבָ֔ה בָּנִ֖י הַ/גָּדִֽי
verses.translit: yg'l bn ntn mtsbh bny hgdy
verses.translation: Igal the son of Nathan of Zobah, Bani the Gadite,

verses.original: צֶ֖לֶק הָ/עַמֹּנִ֑י נַחְרַי֙ הַ/בְּאֵ֣רֹתִ֔י נשאי נֹשֵׂ֕א כְּלֵ֖י יוֹאָ֥ב בֶּן צְרֻיָֽה
verses.translit: tslq h'mny nchry hb'rty nsh'y nsh' khly yv'b bn tsryh
verses.translation: Zelek the Ammonite, Naharai the Beerothite, armourbearer to Joab the son of Zeruiah,

verses.original: עִירָא֙ הַ/יִּתְרִ֔י גָּרֵ֖ב הַ/יִּתְרִֽי
verses.translit: 'yr' hytry grb hytry
verses.translation: Ira an Ithrite, Gareb an Ithrite,

verses.original: אֽוּרִיָּה֙ הַֽ/חִתִּ֔י כֹּ֖ל שְׁלֹשִׁ֥ים וְ/שִׁבְעָֽה
verses.translit: 'vryh hchty khl shlshym vshb'h
verses.translation: Uriah the Hittite: thirty and seven in all.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֨סֶף֙ אַף יְהוָ֔ה לַ/חֲר֖וֹת בְּ/יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וַ/יָּ֨סֶת אֶת דָּוִ֤ד בָּ/הֶם֙ לֵ/אמֹ֔ר לֵ֛ךְ מְנֵ֥ה אֶת יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל וְ/אֶת יְהוּדָֽה
verses.translit: vysf 'f yhvh lchrvt byshr'l vyst 't dvd bhm l'mr lkh mnh 't yshr'l v't yhvdh
verses.translation: And again the anger of the LORD was kindled against Israel, and he moved David against them to say, Go, number Israel and Judah.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֨אמֶר הַ/מֶּ֜לֶךְ אֶל יוֹאָ֣ב שַׂר הַ/חַ֣יִל אֲשֶׁר אִתּ֗/וֹ שֽׁוּט נָ֞א בְּ/כָל שִׁבְטֵ֤י יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ מִ/דָּן֙ וְ/עַד בְּאֵ֣ר שֶׁ֔בַע וּ/פִקְד֖וּ אֶת הָ/עָ֑ם וְ/יָ֣דַעְתִּ֔י אֵ֖ת מִסְפַּ֥ר הָ/עָֽם
verses.translit: vy'mr hmlkh 'l yv'b shr hchyl 'shr 'tv shvt n' bkhl shbty yshr'l mdn v'd b'r shb' vpqdv 't h'm vyd'ty 't mspr h'm
verses.translation: For the king said to Joab the captain of the host, which was with him, Go now through all the tribes of Israel, from Dan even to Beer-sheba, and number ye the people, that I may know the number of the people.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֨אמֶר יוֹאָ֜ב אֶל הַ/מֶּ֗לֶךְ וְ/יוֹסֵ֣ף יְהוָה֩ אֱלֹהֶ֨י/ךָ אֶל הָ/עָ֜ם כָּ/הֵ֤ם וְ/כָ/הֵם֙ מֵאָ֣ה פְעָמִ֔ים וְ/עֵינֵ֥י אֲדֹנִֽ/י הַ/מֶּ֖לֶךְ רֹא֑וֹת וַ/אדֹנִ֣/י הַ/מֶּ֔לֶךְ לָ֥/מָּה חָפֵ֖ץ בַּ/דָּבָ֥ר הַ/זֶּֽה
verses.translit: vy'mr yv'b 'l hmlkh vyvsf yhvh 'lhykh 'l h'm khhm vkhhm m'h p'mym v'yny 'dny hmlkh r'vt v'dny hmlkh lmh chpts bdbr hzh
verses.translation: And Joab said unto the king, Now the LORD thy God add unto the people, how many soever they be, an hundredfold, and that the eyes of my lord the king may see it: but why doth my lord the king delight in this thing?

verses.original: וַ/יֶּחֱזַ֤ק דְּבַר הַ/מֶּ֨לֶךְ֙ אֶל יוֹאָ֔ב וְ/עַ֖ל שָׂרֵ֣י הֶ/חָ֑יִל וַ/יֵּצֵ֨א יוֹאָ֜ב וְ/שָׂרֵ֤י הַ/חַ֨יִל֙ לִ/פְנֵ֣י הַ/מֶּ֔לֶךְ לִ/פְקֹ֥ד אֶת הָ/עָ֖ם אֶת יִשְׂרָאֵֽל
verses.translit: vychzq dbr hmlkh 'l yv'b v'l shry hchyl vyts' yv'b vshry hchyl lpny hmlkh lpqd 't h'm 't yshr'l
verses.translation: Notwithstanding the king’s word prevailed against Joab, and against the captains of the host. And Joab and the captains of the host went out from the presence of the king, to number the people of Israel.

verses.original: וַ/יַּעַבְר֖וּ אֶת הַ/יַּרְדֵּ֑ן וַ/יַּחֲנ֣וּ בַ/עֲרוֹעֵ֗ר יְמִ֥ין הָ/עִ֛יר אֲשֶׁ֛ר בְּ/תוֹךְ הַ/נַּ֥חַל הַ/גָּ֖ד וְ/אֶל יַעְזֵֽר
verses.translit: vy'brv 't hyrdn vychnv b'rv'r ymyn h'yr 'shr btvkh hnchl hgd v'l y'zr
verses.translation: And they passed over Jordan, and pitched in Aroer, on the right side of the city that lieth in the midst of the river of Gad, and toward Jazer:

verses.original: וַ/יָּבֹ֨אוּ֙ הַ/גִּלְעָ֔דָ/ה וְ/אֶל אֶ֥רֶץ תַּחְתִּ֖ים חָדְשִׁ֑י וַ/יָּבֹ֨אוּ֙ דָּ֣נָ/ה יַּ֔עַן וְ/סָבִ֖יב אֶל צִידֽוֹן
verses.translit: vyb'v hgl'dh v'l 'rts tchtym chdshy vyb'v dnh y'n vsbyb 'l tsydvn
verses.translation: Then they came to Gilead, and to the land of Tahtim-hodshi; and they came to Dan-jaan, and about to Zidon,

verses.original: וַ/יָּבֹ֨אוּ֙ מִבְצַר צֹ֔ר וְ/כָל עָרֵ֥י הַ/חִוִּ֖י וְ/הַֽ/כְּנַעֲנִ֑י וַ/יֵּֽצְא֛וּ אֶל נֶ֥גֶב יְהוּדָ֖ה בְּאֵ֥ר שָֽׁבַע
verses.translit: vyb'v mbtsr tsr vkhl 'ry hchvy vhkhn'ny vyts'v 'l ngb yhvdh b'r shb'
verses.translation: And came to the strong hold of Tyre, and to all the cities of the Hivites, and of the Canaanites: and they went out to the south of Judah, even to Beer-sheba.

verses.original: וַ/יָּשֻׁ֖טוּ בְּ/כָל הָ/אָ֑רֶץ וַ/יָּבֹ֜אוּ מִ/קְצֵ֨ה תִשְׁעָ֧ה חֳדָשִׁ֛ים וְ/עֶשְׂרִ֥ים י֖וֹם יְרוּשָׁלִָֽם
verses.translit: vyshtv bkhl h'rts vyb'v mqtsh tsh'h chdshym v'shrym yvm yrvshlm
verses.translation: So when they had gone through all the land, they came to Jerusalem at the end of nine months and twenty days.

verses.original: וַ/יִּתֵּ֥ן יוֹאָ֛ב אֶת מִסְפַּ֥ר מִפְקַד הָ/עָ֖ם אֶל הַ/מֶּ֑לֶךְ וַ/תְּהִ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֡ל שְׁמֹנֶה֩ מֵא֨וֹת אֶ֤לֶף אִֽישׁ חַ֨יִל֙ שֹׁ֣לֵֽף חֶ֔רֶב וְ/אִ֣ישׁ יְהוּדָ֔ה חֲמֵשׁ מֵא֥וֹת אֶ֖לֶף אִֽישׁ
verses.translit: vytn yv'b 't mspr mpqd h'm 'l hmlkh vthy yshr'l shmnh m'vt 'lf 'ysh chyl shlf chrb v'ysh yhvdh chmsh m'vt 'lf 'ysh
verses.translation: And Joab gave up the sum of the number of the people unto the king: and there were in Israel eight hundred thousand valiant men that drew the sword; and the men of Judah were five hundred thousand men.

verses.original: וַ/יַּ֤ךְ לֵב דָּוִד֙ אֹת֔/וֹ אַחֲרֵי כֵ֖ן סָפַ֣ר אֶת הָ/עָ֑ם וַ/יֹּ֨אמֶר דָּוִ֜ד אֶל יְהוָ֗ה חָטָ֤אתִי מְאֹד֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר עָשִׂ֔יתִי וְ/עַתָּ֣ה יְהוָ֔ה הַֽעֲבֶר נָא֙ אֶת עֲוֺ֣ן עַבְדְּ/ךָ֔ כִּ֥י נִסְכַּ֖לְתִּי מְאֹֽד
verses.translit: vykh lb dvd 'tv 'chry khn spr 't h'm vy'mr dvd 'l yhvh cht'ty m'd 'shr 'shyty v'th yhvh h'br n' 't 'vn 'bdkh khy nskhlty m'd
verses.translation: And David’s heart smote him after that he had numbered the people. And David said unto the LORD , I have sinned greatly in that I have done: and now, I beseech thee, O LORD , take away the iniquity of thy servant; for I have done very foolishly.

verses.original: וַ/יָּ֥קָם דָּוִ֖ד בַּ/בֹּ֑קֶר וּ/דְבַר יְהוָ֗ה הָיָה֙ אֶל גָּ֣ד הַ/נָּבִ֔יא חֹזֵ֥ה דָוִ֖ד לֵ/אמֹֽר
verses.translit: vyqm dvd bbqr vdbr yhvh hyh 'l gd hnby' chzh dvd l'mr
verses.translation: For when David was up in the morning, the word of the LORD came unto the prophet Gad, David’s seer, saying,

verses.original: הָל֞וֹךְ וְ/דִבַּרְתָּ֣ אֶל דָּוִ֗ד כֹּ֚ה אָמַ֣ר יְהוָ֔ה שָׁלֹ֕שׁ אָנֹכִ֖י נוֹטֵ֣ל עָלֶ֑י/ךָ בְּחַר לְ/ךָ֥ אַֽחַת מֵ/הֶ֖ם וְ/אֶֽעֱשֶׂה לָּֽ/ךְ
verses.translit: hlvkh vdbrt 'l dvd khh 'mr yhvh shlsh 'nkhy nvtl 'lykh bchr lkh 'cht mhm v''shh lkh
verses.translation: Go and say unto David, Thus saith the LORD , I offer thee three things; choose thee one of them, that I may do it unto thee.

verses.original: וַ/יָּבֹא גָ֥ד אֶל דָּוִ֖ד וַ/יַּגֶּד ל֑/וֹ וַ/יֹּ֣אמֶר ל֡/וֹ הֲ/תָב֣וֹא לְ/ךָ֣ שֶֽׁבַע שָׁנִ֣ים רָעָ֣ב בְּ/אַרְצֶ֡/ךָ אִם שְׁלֹשָׁ֣ה חֳ֠דָשִׁים נֻסְ/ךָ֨ לִ/פְנֵֽי צָרֶ֜י/ךָ וְ/ה֣וּא רֹדְפֶ֗/ךָ וְ/אִם הֱ֠יוֹת שְׁלֹ֨שֶׁת יָמִ֥ים דֶּ֨בֶר֙ בְּ/אַרְצֶ֔/ךָ עַתָּה֙ דַּ֣ע וּ/רְאֵ֔ה מָה אָשִׁ֥יב שֹׁלְחִ֖/י דָּבָֽר
verses.translit: vyb' gd 'l dvd vygd lv vy'mr lv htbv' lkh shb' shnym r'b b'rtskh 'm shlshh chdshym nskh lpny tsrykh vhv' rdpkh v'm hyvt shlsht ymym dbr b'rtskh 'th d' vr'h mh 'shyb shlchy dbr
verses.translation: So Gad came to David, and told him, and said unto him, Shall seven years of famine come unto thee in thy land? or wilt thou flee three months before thine enemies, while they pursue thee? or that there be three days’ pestilence in thy land? now advise, and see what answer I shall return to him that sent me.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֧אמֶר דָּוִ֛ד אֶל גָּ֖ד צַר לִ֣/י מְאֹ֑ד נִפְּלָה נָּ֤א בְ/יַד יְהוָה֙ כִּֽי רַבִּ֣ים רחמ/ו רַֽחֲמָ֔י/ו וּ/בְ/יַד אָדָ֖ם אַל אֶפֹּֽלָה
verses.translit: vy'mr dvd 'l gd tsr ly m'd nplh n' byd yhvh khy rbym rchmv rchmyv vbyd 'dm 'l 'plh
verses.translation: And David said unto Gad, I am in a great strait: let us fall now into the hand of the LORD ; for his mercies are great: and let me not fall into the hand of man.

verses.original: וַ/יִּתֵּ֨ן יְהוָ֥ה דֶּ֨בֶר֙ בְּ/יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל מֵ/הַ/בֹּ֖קֶר וְ/עַד עֵ֣ת מוֹעֵ֑ד וַ/יָּ֣מָת מִן הָ/עָ֗ם מִ/דָּן֙ וְ/עַד בְּאֵ֣ר שֶׁ֔בַע שִׁבְעִ֥ים אֶ֖לֶף אִֽישׁ
verses.translit: vytn yhvh dbr byshr'l mhbqr v'd 't mv'd vymt mn h'm mdn v'd b'r shb' shb'ym 'lf 'ysh
verses.translation: So the LORD sent a pestilence upon Israel from the morning even to the time appointed: and there died of the people from Dan even to Beer-sheba seventy thousand men.

verses.original: וַ/יִּשְׁלַח֩ יָד֨/וֹ הַ/מַּלְאָ֥ךְ יְרֽוּשָׁלִַם֮ לְ/שַׁחֲתָ/הּ֒ וַ/יִּנָּ֤חֶם יְהוָה֙ אֶל הָ֣/רָעָ֔ה וַ֠/יֹּאמֶר לַ/מַּלְאָ֞ךְ הַ/מַּשְׁחִ֤ית בָּ/עָם֙ רַ֔ב עַתָּ֖ה הֶ֣רֶף יָדֶ֑/ךָ וּ/מַלְאַ֤ךְ יְהוָה֙ הָיָ֔ה עִם גֹּ֖רֶן ה/אורנה הָ/אֲרַ֥וְנָה הַ/יְבֻסִֽי
verses.translit: vyshlch ydv hml'kh yrvshlm lshchth vynchm yhvh 'l hr'h vy'mr lml'kh hmshchyt b'm rb 'th hrf ydkh vml'kh yhvh hyh 'm grn h'vrnh h'rvnh hybsy
verses.translation: And when the angel stretched out his hand upon Jerusalem to destroy it, the LORD repented him of the evil, and said to the angel that destroyed the people, It is enough: stay now thine hand. And the angel of the LORD was by the threshingplace of Araunah the Jebusite.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּאמֶר֩ דָּוִ֨ד אֶל יְהוָ֜ה בִּ/רְאֹת֣/וֹ אֶֽת הַ/מַּלְאָ֣ךְ הַ/מַּכֶּ֣ה בָ/עָ֗ם וַ/יֹּ֨אמֶר֙ הִנֵּ֨ה אָנֹכִ֤י חָטָ֨אתִי֙ וְ/אָנֹכִ֣י הֶעֱוֵ֔יתִי וְ/אֵ֥לֶּה הַ/צֹּ֖אן מֶ֣ה עָשׂ֑וּ תְּהִ֨י נָ֥א יָדְ/ךָ֛ בִּ֖/י וּ/בְ/בֵ֥ית אָבִֽ/י
verses.translit: vy'mr dvd 'l yhvh br'tv 't hml'kh hmkhh b'm vy'mr hnh 'nkhy cht'ty v'nkhy h'vyty v'lh hts'n mh 'shv thy n' ydkh by vbbyt 'by
verses.translation: And David spake unto the LORD when he saw the angel that smote the people, and said, Lo, I have sinned, and I have done wickedly: but these sheep, what have they done? let thine hand, I pray thee, be against me, and against my father’s house.

verses.original: וַ/יָּבֹא גָ֥ד אֶל דָּוִ֖ד בַּ/יּ֣וֹם הַ/ה֑וּא וַ/יֹּ֣אמֶר ל֗/וֹ עֲלֵה֙ הָקֵ֤ם לַֽ/יהוָה֙ מִזְבֵּ֔חַ בְּ/גֹ֖רֶן ארניה אֲרַ֥וְנָה הַ/יְבֻסִֽי
verses.translit: vyb' gd 'l dvd byvm hhv' vy'mr lv 'lh hqm lyhvh mzbch bgrn 'rnyh 'rvnh hybsy
verses.translation: And Gad came that day to David, and said unto him, Go up, rear an altar unto the LORD in the threshingfloor of Araunah the Jebusite.

verses.original: וַ/יַּ֤עַל דָּוִד֙ כִּ/דְבַר גָּ֔ד כַּ/אֲשֶׁ֖ר צִוָּ֥ה יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: vy'l dvd khdbr gd kh'shr tsvh yhvh
verses.translation: And David, according to the saying of Gad, went up as the LORD commanded.

verses.original: וַ/יַּשְׁקֵ֣ף אֲרַ֗וְנָה וַ/יַּ֤רְא אֶת הַ/מֶּ֨לֶךְ֙ וְ/אֶת עֲבָדָ֔י/ו עֹבְרִ֖ים עָלָ֑י/ו וַ/יֵּצֵ֣א אֲרַ֔וְנָה וַ/יִּשְׁתַּ֧חוּ לַ/מֶּ֛לֶךְ אַפָּ֖י/ו אָֽרְצָ/ה
verses.translit: vyshqf 'rvnh vyr' 't hmlkh v't 'bdyv 'brym 'lyv vyts' 'rvnh vyshtchv lmlkh 'pyv 'rtsh
verses.translation: And Araunah looked, and saw the king and his servants coming on toward him: and Araunah went out, and bowed himself before the king on his face upon the ground.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֣אמֶר אֲרַ֔וְנָה מַדּ֛וּעַ בָּ֥א אֲדֹנִֽ/י הַ/מֶּ֖לֶךְ אֶל עַבְדּ֑/וֹ וַ/יֹּ֨אמֶר דָּוִ֜ד לִ/קְנ֧וֹת מֵ/עִמְּ/ךָ֣ אֶת הַ/גֹּ֗רֶן לִ/בְנ֤וֹת מִזְבֵּ֨חַ֙ לַֽ/יהוָ֔ה וְ/תֵעָצַ֥ר הַ/מַּגֵּפָ֖ה מֵ/עַ֥ל הָ/עָֽם
verses.translit: vy'mr 'rvnh mdv' b' 'dny hmlkh 'l 'bdv vy'mr dvd lqnvt m'mkh 't hgrn lbnvt mzbch lyhvh vt'tsr hmgph m'l h'm
verses.translation: And Araunah said, Wherefore is my lord the king come to his servant? And David said, To buy the threshingfloor of thee, to build an altar unto the LORD , that the plague may be stayed from the people.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֤אמֶר אֲרַ֨וְנָה֙ אֶל דָּוִ֔ד יִקַּ֥ח וְ/יַ֛עַל אֲדֹנִ֥/י הַ/מֶּ֖לֶךְ הַ/טּ֣וֹב ב/עינ/ו בְּ/עֵינָ֑י/ו רְאֵה֙ הַ/בָּקָ֣ר לָ/עֹלָ֔ה וְ/הַ/מֹּרִגִּ֛ים וּ/כְלֵ֥י הַ/בָּקָ֖ר לָ/עֵצִֽים
verses.translit: vy'mr 'rvnh 'l dvd yqch vy'l 'dny hmlkh htvb b'ynv b'ynyv r'h hbqr l'lh vhmrgym vkhly hbqr l'tsym
verses.translation: And Araunah said unto David, Let my lord the king take and offer up what seemeth good unto him: behold, here be oxen for burnt sacrifice, and threshing instruments and other instruments of the oxen for wood.

verses.original: הַ/כֹּ֗ל נָתַ֛ן אֲרַ֥וְנָה הַ/מֶּ֖לֶךְ לַ/מֶּ֑לֶךְ וַ/יֹּ֤אמֶר אֲרַ֨וְנָה֙ אֶל הַ/מֶּ֔לֶךְ יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֶ֖י/ךָ יִרְצֶֽ/ךָ
verses.translit: hkhl ntn 'rvnh hmlkh lmlkh vy'mr 'rvnh 'l hmlkh yhvh 'lhykh yrtskh
verses.translation: All these things did Araunah, as a king, give unto the king. And Araunah said unto the king, The LORD thy God accept thee.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֨אמֶר הַ/מֶּ֜לֶךְ אֶל אֲרַ֗וְנָה לֹ֚א כִּֽי קָנ֨וֹ אֶקְנֶ֤ה מֵ/אֽוֹתְ/ךָ֙ בִּ/מְחִ֔יר וְ/לֹ֧א אַעֲלֶ֛ה לַ/יהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהַ֖/י עֹל֣וֹת חִנָּ֑ם וַ/יִּ֨קֶן דָּוִ֤ד אֶת הַ/גֹּ֨רֶן֙ וְ/אֶת הַ/בָּקָ֔ר בְּ/כֶ֖סֶף שְׁקָלִ֥ים חֲמִשִּֽׁים
verses.translit: vy'mr hmlkh 'l 'rvnh l' khy qnv 'qnh m'vtkh bmchyr vl' ''lh lyhvh 'lhy 'lvt chnm vyqn dvd 't hgrn v't hbqr bkhsf shqlym chmshym
verses.translation: And the king said unto Araunah, Nay; but I will surely buy it of thee at a price: neither will I offer burnt offerings unto the LORD my God of that which doth cost me nothing. So David bought the threshingfloor and the oxen for fifty shekels of silver.

verses.original: וַ/יִּבֶן֩ שָׁ֨ם דָּוִ֤ד מִזְבֵּ֨חַ֙ לַֽ/יהוָ֔ה וַ/יַּ֥עַל עֹל֖וֹת וּ/שְׁלָמִ֑ים וַ/יֵּעָתֵ֤ר יְהוָה֙ לָ/אָ֔רֶץ וַ/תֵּעָצַ֥ר הַ/מַּגֵּפָ֖ה מֵ/עַ֥ל יִשְׂרָאֵֽל
verses.translit: vybn shm dvd mzbch lyhvh vy'l 'lvt vshlmym vy'tr yhvh l'rts vt'tsr hmgph m'l yshr'l
verses.translation: And David built there an altar unto the LORD , and offered burnt offerings and peace offerings. So the LORD was intreated for the land, and the plague was stayed from Israel.

verses.original: וְ/הַ/מֶּ֤לֶךְ דָּוִד֙ זָקֵ֔ן בָּ֖א בַּ/יָּמִ֑ים וַ/יְכַסֻּ֨/הוּ֙ בַּ/בְּגָדִ֔ים וְ/לֹ֥א יִחַ֖ם לֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: vhmlkh dvd zqn b' bymym vykhshv bbgdym vl' ychm lv
verses.translation: Now king David was old and stricken in years; and they covered him with clothes, but he gat no heat.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֧אמְרוּ ל֣/וֹ עֲבָדָ֗י/ו יְבַקְשׁ֞וּ לַ/אדֹנִ֤/י הַ/מֶּ֨לֶךְ֙ נַעֲרָ֣ה בְתוּלָ֔ה וְ/עָֽמְדָה֙ לִ/פְנֵ֣י הַ/מֶּ֔לֶךְ וּ/תְהִי ל֖/וֹ סֹכֶ֑נֶת וְ/שָׁכְבָ֣ה בְ/חֵיקֶ֔/ךָ וְ/חַ֖ם לַ/אדֹנִ֥/י הַ/מֶּֽלֶךְ
