verses.translit: vy'mrv lv 'bdyv ybqshv l'dny hmlkh n'rh btvlh v'mdh lpny hmlkh vthy lv skhnt vshkhbh bchyqkh vchm l'dny hmlkh
verses.translation: Wherefore his servants said unto him, Let there be sought for my lord the king a young virgin: and let her stand before the king, and let her cherish him, and let her lie in thy bosom, that my lord the king may get heat.

verses.original: וַ/יְבַקְשׁוּ֙ נַעֲרָ֣ה יָפָ֔ה בְּ/כֹ֖ל גְּב֣וּל יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וַֽ/יִּמְצְא֗וּ אֶת אֲבִישַׁג֙ הַ/שּׁ֣וּנַמִּ֔ית וַ/יָּבִ֥אוּ אֹתָ֖/הּ לַ/מֶּֽלֶךְ
verses.translit: vybqshv n'rh yph bkhl gbvl yshr'l vymts'v 't 'byshg hshvnmyt vyb'v 'th lmlkh
verses.translation: So they sought for a fair damsel throughout all the coasts of Israel, and found Abishag a Shunammite, and brought her to the king.

verses.original: וְ/הַֽ/נַּעֲרָ֖ה יָפָ֣ה עַד מְאֹ֑ד וַ/תְּהִ֨י לַ/מֶּ֤לֶךְ סֹכֶ֨נֶת֙ וַ/תְּשָׁ֣רְתֵ֔/הוּ וְ/הַ/מֶּ֖לֶךְ לֹ֥א יְדָעָֽ/הּ
verses.translit: vhn'rh yph 'd m'd vthy lmlkh skhnt vtshrthv vhmlkh l' yd'h
verses.translation: And the damsel was very fair, and cherished the king, and ministered to him: but the king knew her not.

verses.original: וַ/אֲדֹנִיָּ֧ה בֶן חַגִּ֛ית מִתְנַשֵּׂ֥א לֵ/אמֹ֖ר אֲנִ֣י אֶמְלֹ֑ךְ וַ/יַּ֣עַשׂ ל֗/וֹ רֶ֚כֶב וּ/פָ֣רָשִׁ֔ים וַ/חֲמִשִּׁ֥ים אִ֖ישׁ רָצִ֥ים לְ/פָנָֽי/ו
verses.translit: v'dnyh bn chgyt mtnsh' l'mr 'ny 'mlkh vy'sh lv rkhb vprshym vchmshym 'ysh rtsym lpnyv
verses.translation: Then Adonijah the son of Haggith exalted himself, saying, I will be king: and he prepared him chariots and horsemen, and fifty men to run before him.

verses.original: וְ/לֹֽא עֲצָב֨/וֹ אָבִ֤י/ו מִ/יָּמָי/ו֙ לֵ/אמֹ֔ר מַדּ֖וּעַ כָּ֣כָה עָשִׂ֑יתָ וְ/גַם ה֤וּא טֽוֹב תֹּ֨אַר֙ מְאֹ֔ד וְ/אֹת֥/וֹ יָלְדָ֖ה אַחֲרֵ֥י אַבְשָׁלֽוֹם
verses.translit: vl' 'tsbv 'byv mymyv l'mr mdv' khkhh 'shyt vgm hv' tvb t'r m'd v'tv yldh 'chry 'bshlvm
verses.translation: And his father had not displeased him at any time in saying, Why hast thou done so? and he also was a very goodly man; and his mother bare him after Absalom.

verses.original: וַ/יִּהְי֣וּ דְבָרָ֔י/ו עִ֚ם יוֹאָ֣ב בֶּן צְרוּיָ֔ה וְ/עִ֖ם אֶבְיָתָ֣ר הַ/כֹּהֵ֑ן וַֽ/יַּעְזְר֔וּ אַחֲרֵ֖י אֲדֹנִיָּֽה
verses.translit: vyhyv dbryv 'm yv'b bn tsrvyh v'm 'bytr hkhhn vy'zrv 'chry 'dnyh
verses.translation: And he conferred with Joab the son of Zeruiah, and with Abiathar the priest: and they following Adonijah helped him .

verses.original: וְ/צָד֣וֹק הַ֠/כֹּהֵן וּ/בְנָיָ֨הוּ בֶן יְהוֹיָדָ֜ע וְ/נָתָ֤ן הַ/נָּבִיא֙ וְ/שִׁמְעִ֣י וְ/רֵעִ֔י וְ/הַ/גִּבּוֹרִ֖ים אֲשֶׁ֣ר לְ/דָוִ֑ד לֹ֥א הָי֖וּ עִם אֲדֹנִיָּֽהוּ
verses.translit: vtsdvq hkhhn vbnyhv bn yhvyd' vntn hnby' vshm'y vr'y vhgbvrym 'shr ldvd l' hyv 'm 'dnyhv
verses.translation: But Zadok the priest, and Benaiah the son of Jehoiada, and Nathan the prophet, and Shimei, and Rei, and the mighty men which belonged to David, were not with Adonijah.

verses.original: וַ/יִּזְבַּ֣ח אֲדֹנִיָּ֗הוּ צֹ֤אן וּ/בָקָר֙ וּ/מְרִ֔יא עִ֚ם אֶ֣בֶן הַזֹּחֶ֔לֶת אֲשֶׁר אֵ֖צֶל עֵ֣ין רֹגֵ֑ל וַ/יִּקְרָ֗א אֶת כָּל אֶחָי/ו֙ בְּנֵ֣י הַ/מֶּ֔לֶךְ וּ/לְ/כָל אַנְשֵׁ֥י יְהוּדָ֖ה עַבְדֵ֥י הַ/מֶּֽלֶךְ
verses.translit: vyzbch 'dnyhv ts'n vbqr vmry' 'm 'bn hzchlt 'shr 'tsl 'yn rgl vyqr' 't khl 'chyv bny hmlkh vlkhl 'nshy yhvdh 'bdy hmlkh
verses.translation: And Adonijah slew sheep and oxen and fat cattle by the stone of Zoheleth, which is by En-rogel, and called all his brethren the king’s sons, and all the men of Judah the king’s servants:

verses.original: וְֽ/אֶת נָתָן֩ הַ/נָּבִ֨יא וּ/בְנָיָ֜הוּ וְ/אֶת הַ/גִּבּוֹרִ֛ים וְ/אֶת שְׁלֹמֹ֥ה אָחִ֖י/ו לֹ֥א קָרָֽא
verses.translit: v't ntn hnby' vbnyhv v't hgbvrym v't shlmh 'chyv l' qr'
verses.translation: But Nathan the prophet, and Benaiah, and the mighty men, and Solomon his brother, he called not.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֣אמֶר נָתָ֗ן אֶל בַּת שֶׁ֤בַע אֵם שְׁלֹמֹה֙ לֵ/אמֹ֔ר הֲ/ל֣וֹא שָׁמַ֔עַתְּ כִּ֥י מָלַ֖ךְ אֲדֹנִיָּ֣הוּ בֶן חַגִּ֑ית וַ/אֲדֹנֵ֥י/נוּ דָוִ֖ד לֹ֥א יָדָֽע
verses.translit: vy'mr ntn 'l bt shb' 'm shlmh l'mr hlv' shm't khy mlkh 'dnyhv bn chgyt v'dnynv dvd l' yd'
verses.translation: Wherefore Nathan spake unto Bath-sheba the mother of Solomon, saying, Hast thou not heard that Adonijah the son of Haggith doth reign, and David our lord knoweth it not?

verses.original: וְ/עַתָּ֕ה לְכִ֛י אִיעָצֵ֥/ךְ נָ֖א עֵצָ֑ה וּ/מַלְּטִי֙ אֶת נַפְשֵׁ֔/ךְ וְ/אֶת נֶ֥פֶשׁ בְּנֵ֖/ךְ שְׁלֹמֹֽה
verses.translit: v'th lkhy 'y'tskh n' 'tsh vmlty 't npshkh v't npsh bnkh shlmh
verses.translation: Now therefore come, let me, I pray thee, give thee counsel, that thou mayest save thine own life, and the life of thy son Solomon.

verses.original: לְכִ֞י וּ/בֹ֣אִי אֶל הַ/מֶּ֣לֶךְ דָּוִ֗ד וְ/אָמַ֤רְתְּ אֵלָי/ו֙ הֲ/לֹֽא אַתָּ֞ה אֲדֹנִ֣/י הַ/מֶּ֗לֶךְ נִשְׁבַּ֤עְתָּ לַ/אֲמָֽתְ/ךָ֙ לֵ/אמֹ֔ר כִּֽי שְׁלֹמֹ֤ה בְנֵ/ךְ֙ יִמְלֹ֣ךְ אַחֲרַ֔/י וְ/ה֖וּא יֵשֵׁ֣ב עַל כִּסְאִ֑/י וּ/מַדּ֖וּעַ מָלַ֥ךְ אֲדֹנִיָֽהוּ
verses.translit: lkhy vb'y 'l hmlkh dvd v'mrt 'lyv hl' 'th 'dny hmlkh nshb't l'mtkh l'mr khy shlmh bnkh ymlkh 'chry vhv' yshb 'l khs'y vmdv' mlkh 'dnyhv
verses.translation: Go and get thee in unto king David, and say unto him, Didst not thou, my lord, O king, swear unto thine handmaid, saying, Assuredly Solomon thy son shall reign after me, and he shall sit upon my throne? why then doth Adonijah reign?

verses.original: הִנֵּ֗ה עוֹדָ֛/ךְ מְדַבֶּ֥רֶת שָׁ֖ם עִם הַ/מֶּ֑לֶךְ וַ/אֲנִי֙ אָב֣וֹא אַחֲרַ֔יִ/ךְ וּ/מִלֵּאתִ֖י אֶת דְּבָרָֽיִ/ךְ
verses.translit: hnh 'vdkh mdbrt shm 'm hmlkh v'ny 'bv' 'chrykh vml'ty 't dbrykh
verses.translation: Behold, while thou yet talkest there with the king, I also will come in after thee, and confirm thy words.

verses.original: וַ/תָּבֹ֨א בַת שֶׁ֤בֶע אֶל הַ/מֶּ֨לֶךְ֙ הַ/חַ֔דְרָ/ה וְ/הַ/מֶּ֖לֶךְ זָקֵ֣ן מְאֹ֑ד וַֽ/אֲבִישַׁג֙ הַ/שּׁ֣וּנַמִּ֔ית מְשָׁרַ֖ת אֶת הַ/מֶּֽלֶךְ
verses.translit: vtb' bt shb' 'l hmlkh hchdrh vhmlkh zqn m'd v'byshg hshvnmyt mshrt 't hmlkh
verses.translation: And Bath-sheba went in unto the king into the chamber: and the king was very old; and Abishag the Shunammite ministered unto the king.

verses.translit: vtqd bt shb' vtshtchv lmlkh vy'mr hmlkh mh lkh
verses.translation: And Bath-sheba bowed, and did obeisance unto the king. And the king said, What wouldest thou?

verses.original: וַ/תֹּ֣אמֶר ל֗/וֹ אֲדֹנִ/י֙ אַתָּ֨ה נִשְׁבַּ֜עְתָּ בַּֽ/יהוָ֤ה אֱלֹהֶ֨י/ךָ֙ לַֽ/אֲמָתֶ֔/ךָ כִּֽי שְׁלֹמֹ֥ה בְנֵ֖/ךְ יִמְלֹ֣ךְ אַחֲרָ֑/י וְ/ה֖וּא יֵשֵׁ֥ב עַל כִּסְאִֽ/י
verses.translit: vt'mr lv 'dny 'th nshb't byhvh 'lhykh l'mtkh khy shlmh bnkh ymlkh 'chry vhv' yshb 'l khs'y
verses.translation: And she said unto him, My lord, thou swarest by the LORD thy God unto thine handmaid, saying , Assuredly Solomon thy son shall reign after me, and he shall sit upon my throne.

verses.original: וְ/עַתָּ֕ה הִנֵּ֥ה אֲדֹנִיָּ֖ה מָלָ֑ךְ וְ/עַתָּ֛ה אֲדֹנִ֥/י הַ/מֶּ֖לֶךְ לֹ֥א יָדָֽעְתָּ
verses.translit: v'th hnh 'dnyh mlkh v'th 'dny hmlkh l' yd't
verses.translation: And now, behold, Adonijah reigneth; and now, my lord the king, thou knowest it not:

verses.original: וַ֠/יִּזְבַּח שׁ֥וֹר וּֽ/מְרִיא וְ/צֹאן֮ לָ/רֹב֒ וַ/יִּקְרָא֙ לְ/כָל בְּנֵ֣י הַ/מֶּ֔לֶךְ וּ/לְ/אֶבְיָתָר֙ הַ/כֹּהֵ֔ן וּ/לְ/יֹאָ֖ב שַׂ֣ר הַ/צָּבָ֑א וְ/לִ/שְׁלֹמֹ֥ה עַבְדְּ/ךָ֖ לֹ֥א קָרָֽא
verses.translit: vyzbch shvr vmry' vts'n lrb vyqr' lkhl bny hmlkh vl'bytr hkhhn vly'b shr htsb' vlshlmh 'bdkh l' qr'
verses.translation: And he hath slain oxen and fat cattle and sheep in abundance, and hath called all the sons of the king, and Abiathar the priest, and Joab the captain of the host: but Solomon thy servant hath he not called.

verses.original: וְ/אַתָּה֙ אֲדֹנִ֣/י הַ/מֶּ֔לֶךְ עֵינֵ֥י כָל יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל עָלֶ֑י/ךָ לְ/הַגִּ֣יד לָ/הֶ֔ם מִ֗י יֵשֵׁ֛ב עַל כִּסֵּ֥א אֲדֹנִֽ/י הַ/מֶּ֖לֶךְ אַחֲרָֽי/ו
verses.translit: v'th 'dny hmlkh 'yny khl yshr'l 'lykh lhgyd lhm my yshb 'l khs' 'dny hmlkh 'chryv
verses.translation: And thou, my lord, O king, the eyes of all Israel are upon thee, that thou shouldest tell them who shall sit on the throne of my lord the king after him.

verses.original: וְ/הָיָ֕ה כִּ/שְׁכַ֥ב אֲדֹנִֽ/י הַ/מֶּ֖לֶךְ עִם אֲבֹתָ֑י/ו וְ/הָיִ֗יתִי אֲנִ֛י וּ/בְנִ֥/י שְׁלֹמֹ֖ה חַטָּאִֽים
verses.translit: vhyh khshkhb 'dny hmlkh 'm 'btyv vhyyty 'ny vbny shlmh cht'ym
verses.translation: Otherwise it shall come to pass, when my lord the king shall sleep with his fathers, that I and my son Solomon shall be counted offenders.

verses.original: וְ/הִנֵּ֛ה עוֹדֶ֥/נָּה מְדַבֶּ֖רֶת עִם הַ/מֶּ֑לֶךְ וְ/נָתָ֥ן הַ/נָּבִ֖יא בָּֽא
verses.translit: vhnh 'vdnh mdbrt 'm hmlkh vntn hnby' b'
verses.translation: And, lo, while she yet talked with the king, Nathan the prophet also came in.

verses.original: וַ/יַּגִּ֤ידוּ לַ/מֶּ֨לֶךְ֙ לֵ/אמֹ֔ר הִנֵּ֖ה נָתָ֣ן הַ/נָּבִ֑יא וַ/יָּבֹא֙ לִ/פְנֵ֣י הַ/מֶּ֔לֶךְ וַ/יִּשְׁתַּ֧חוּ לַ/מֶּ֛לֶךְ עַל אַפָּ֖י/ו אָֽרְצָ/ה
verses.translit: vygydv lmlkh l'mr hnh ntn hnby' vyb' lpny hmlkh vyshtchv lmlkh 'l 'pyv 'rtsh
verses.translation: And they told the king, saying, Behold Nathan the prophet. And when he was come in before the king, he bowed himself before the king with his face to the ground.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּאמֶר֮ נָתָן֒ אֲדֹנִ֣/י הַ/מֶּ֔לֶךְ אַתָּ֣ה אָמַ֔רְתָּ אֲדֹנִיָּ֖הוּ יִמְלֹ֣ךְ אַחֲרָ֑/י וְ/ה֖וּא יֵשֵׁ֥ב עַל כִּסְאִֽ/י
verses.translit: vy'mr ntn 'dny hmlkh 'th 'mrt 'dnyhv ymlkh 'chry vhv' yshb 'l khs'y
verses.translation: And Nathan said, My lord, O king, hast thou said, Adonijah shall reign after me, and he shall sit upon my throne?

verses.original: כִּ֣י יָרַ֣ד הַ/יּ֗וֹם וַ֠/יִּזְבַּח שׁ֥וֹר וּֽ/מְרִיא וְ/צֹאן֮ לָ/רֹב֒ וַ/יִּקְרָא֩ לְ/כָל בְּנֵ֨י הַ/מֶּ֜לֶךְ וּ/לְ/שָׂרֵ֤י הַ/צָּבָא֙ וּ/לְ/אֶבְיָתָ֣ר הַ/כֹּהֵ֔ן וְ/הִנָּ֛/ם אֹכְלִ֥ים וְ/שֹׁתִ֖ים לְ/פָנָ֑י/ו וַ/יֹּ֣אמְר֔וּ יְחִ֖י הַ/מֶּ֥לֶךְ אֲדֹנִיָּֽהוּ
verses.translit: khy yrd hyvm vyzbch shvr vmry' vts'n lrb vyqr' lkhl bny hmlkh vlshry htsb' vl'bytr hkhhn vhnm 'khlym vshtym lpnyv vy'mrv ychy hmlkh 'dnyhv
verses.translation: For he is gone down this day, and hath slain oxen and fat cattle and sheep in abundance, and hath called all the king’s sons, and the captains of the host, and Abiathar the priest; and, behold, they eat and drink before him, and say, God save king Adonijah.

verses.original: וְ/לִ֣/י אֲנִֽי עַ֠בְדֶּ/ךָ וּ/לְ/צָדֹ֨ק הַ/כֹּהֵ֜ן וְ/לִ/בְנָיָ֧הוּ בֶן יְהוֹיָדָ֛ע וְ/לִ/שְׁלֹמֹ֥ה עַבְדְּ/ךָ֖ לֹ֥א קָרָֽא
verses.translit: vly 'ny 'bdkh vltsdq hkhhn vlbnyhv bn yhvyd' vlshlmh 'bdkh l' qr'
verses.translation: But me, even me thy servant, and Zadok the priest, and Benaiah the son of Jehoiada, and thy servant Solomon, hath he not called.

verses.original: אִ֗ם מֵ/אֵת֙ אֲדֹנִ֣/י הַ/מֶּ֔לֶךְ נִהְיָ֖ה הַ/דָּבָ֣ר הַ/זֶּ֑ה וְ/לֹ֤א הוֹדַ֨עְתָּ֙ אֶֽת עבדי/ך עַבְדְּ/ךָ֔ מִ֗י יֵשֵׁ֛ב עַל כִּסֵּ֥א אֲדֹנִֽ/י הַ/מֶּ֖לֶךְ אַחֲרָֽי/ו
verses.translit: 'm m't 'dny hmlkh nhyh hdbr hzh vl' hvd't 't 'bdykh 'bdkh my yshb 'l khs' 'dny hmlkh 'chryv
verses.translation: Is this thing done by my lord the king, and thou hast not shewed it unto thy servant, who should sit on the throne of my lord the king after him?

verses.original: וַ/יַּ֨עַן הַ/מֶּ֤לֶךְ דָּוִד֙ וַ/יֹּ֔אמֶר קִרְאוּ לִ֖/י לְ/בַת שָׁ֑בַע וַ/תָּבֹא֙ לִ/פְנֵ֣י הַ/מֶּ֔לֶךְ וַֽ/תַּעֲמֹ֖ד לִ/פְנֵ֥י הַ/מֶּֽלֶךְ
verses.translit: vy'n hmlkh dvd vy'mr qr'v ly lbt shb' vtb' lpny hmlkh vt'md lpny hmlkh
verses.translation: Then king David answered and said, Call me Bath-sheba. And she came into the king’s presence, and stood before the king.

verses.original: וַ/יִּשָּׁבַ֥ע הַ/מֶּ֖לֶךְ וַ/יֹּאמַ֑ר חַי יְהוָ֕ה אֲשֶׁר פָּדָ֥ה אֶת נַפְשִׁ֖/י מִ/כָּל צָרָֽה
verses.translit: vyshb' hmlkh vy'mr chy yhvh 'shr pdh 't npshy mkhl tsrh
verses.translation: And the king sware, and said, As the LORD liveth, that hath redeemed my soul out of all distress,

verses.original: כִּ֡י כַּ/אֲשֶׁר֩ נִשְׁבַּ֨עְתִּי לָ֜/ךְ בַּ/יהוָ֨ה אֱלֹהֵ֤י יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ לֵ/אמֹ֔ר כִּֽי שְׁלֹמֹ֤ה בְנֵ/ךְ֙ יִמְלֹ֣ךְ אַחֲרַ֔/י וְ/ה֛וּא יֵשֵׁ֥ב עַל כִּסְאִ֖/י תַּחְתָּ֑/י כִּ֛י כֵּ֥ן אֶעֱשֶׂ֖ה הַ/יּ֥וֹם הַ/זֶּֽה
verses.translit: khy kh'shr nshb'ty lkh byhvh 'lhy yshr'l l'mr khy shlmh bnkh ymlkh 'chry vhv' yshb 'l khs'y tchty khy khn ''shh hyvm hzh
verses.translation: Even as I sware unto thee by the LORD God of Israel, saying, Assuredly Solomon thy son shall reign after me, and he shall sit upon my throne in my stead; even so will I certainly do this day.

verses.original: וַ/תִּקֹּ֨ד בַּת שֶׁ֤בַע אַפַּ֨יִם֙ אֶ֔רֶץ וַ/תִּשְׁתַּ֖חוּ לַ/מֶּ֑לֶךְ וַ/תֹּ֕אמֶר יְחִ֗י אֲדֹנִ֛/י הַ/מֶּ֥לֶךְ דָּוִ֖ד לְ/עֹלָֽם
verses.translit: vtqd bt shb' 'pym 'rts vtshtchv lmlkh vt'mr ychy 'dny hmlkh dvd l'lm
verses.translation: Then Bath-sheba bowed with her face to the earth, and did reverence to the king, and said, Let my lord king David live for ever.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֣אמֶר הַ/מֶּ֣לֶךְ דָּוִ֗ד קִרְאוּ לִ֞/י לְ/צָד֤וֹק הַ/כֹּהֵן֙ וּ/לְ/נָתָ֣ן הַ/נָּבִ֔יא וְ/לִ/בְנָיָ֖הוּ בֶּן יְהוֹיָדָ֑ע וַ/יָּבֹ֖אוּ לִ/פְנֵ֥י הַ/מֶּֽלֶךְ
verses.translit: vy'mr hmlkh dvd qr'v ly ltsdvq hkhhn vlntn hnby' vlbnyhv bn yhvyd' vyb'v lpny hmlkh
verses.translation: And king David said, Call me Zadok the priest, and Nathan the prophet, and Benaiah the son of Jehoiada. And they came before the king.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֨אמֶר הַ/מֶּ֜לֶךְ לָ/הֶ֗ם קְח֤וּ עִמָּ/כֶם֙ אֶת עַבְדֵ֣י אֲדֹנֵי/כֶ֔ם וְ/הִרְכַּבְתֶּם֙ אֶת שְׁלֹמֹ֣ה בְנִ֔/י עַל הַ/פִּרְדָּ֖ה אֲשֶׁר לִ֑/י וְ/הוֹרַדְתֶּ֥ם אֹת֖/וֹ אֶל גִּחֽוֹן
verses.translit: vy'mr hmlkh lhm qchv 'mkhm 't 'bdy 'dnykhm vhrkhbtm 't shlmh bny 'l hprdh 'shr ly vhvrdtm 'tv 'l gchvn
verses.translation: The king also said unto them, Take with you the servants of your lord, and cause Solomon my son to ride upon mine own mule, and bring him down to Gihon:

verses.original: וּ/מָשַׁ֣ח אֹת֣/וֹ שָׁ֠ם צָד֨וֹק הַ/כֹּהֵ֜ן וְ/נָתָ֧ן הַ/נָּבִ֛יא לְ/מֶ֖לֶךְ עַל יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וּ/תְקַעְתֶּם֙ בַּ/שּׁוֹפָ֔ר וַ/אֲמַרְתֶּ֕ם יְחִ֖י הַ/מֶּ֥לֶךְ שְׁלֹמֹֽה
verses.translit: vmshch 'tv shm tsdvq hkhhn vntn hnby' lmlkh 'l yshr'l vtq'tm bshvpr v'mrtm ychy hmlkh shlmh
verses.translation: And let Zadok the priest and Nathan the prophet anoint him there king over Israel: and blow ye with the trumpet, and say, God save king Solomon.

verses.original: וַ/עֲלִיתֶ֣ם אַחֲרָ֗י/ו וּ/בָא֙ וְ/יָשַׁ֣ב עַל כִּסְאִ֔/י וְ/ה֥וּא יִמְלֹ֖ךְ תַּחְתָּ֑/י וְ/אֹת֤/וֹ צִוִּ֨יתִי֙ לִֽ/הְי֣וֹת נָגִ֔יד עַל יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל וְ/עַל יְהוּדָֽה
verses.translit: v'lytm 'chryv vb' vyshb 'l khs'y vhv' ymlkh tchty v'tv tsvyty lhyvt ngyd 'l yshr'l v'l yhvdh
verses.translation: Then ye shall come up after him, that he may come and sit upon my throne; for he shall be king in my stead: and I have appointed him to be ruler over Israel and over Judah.

verses.original: וַ/יַּ֨עַן בְּנָיָ֧הוּ בֶן יְהֽוֹיָדָ֛ע אֶת הַ/מֶּ֖לֶךְ וַ/יֹּ֣אמֶר אָמֵ֑ן כֵּ֚ן יֹאמַ֣ר יְהוָ֔ה אֱלֹהֵ֖י אֲדֹנִ֥/י הַ/מֶּֽלֶךְ
verses.translit: vy'n bnyhv bn yhvyd' 't hmlkh vy'mr 'mn khn y'mr yhvh 'lhy 'dny hmlkh
verses.translation: And Benaiah the son of Jehoiada answered the king, and said, Amen: the LORD God of my lord the king say so too .

verses.original: כַּ/אֲשֶׁ֨ר הָיָ֤ה יְהוָה֙ עִם אֲדֹנִ֣/י הַ/מֶּ֔לֶךְ כֵּ֖ן יהי יִֽהְיֶ֣ה עִם שְׁלֹמֹ֑ה וִֽ/יגַדֵּל֙ אֶת כִּסְא֔/וֹ מִ֨/כִּסֵּ֔א אֲדֹנִ֖/י הַ/מֶּ֥לֶךְ דָּוִֽד
verses.translit: kh'shr hyh yhvh 'm 'dny hmlkh khn yhy yhyh 'm shlmh vygdl 't khs'v mkhs' 'dny hmlkh dvd
verses.translation: As the LORD hath been with my lord the king, even so be he with Solomon, and make his throne greater than the throne of my lord king David.

verses.original: וַ/יֵּ֣רֶד צָד֣וֹק הַ֠/כֹּהֵן וְ/נָתָ֨ן הַ/נָּבִ֜יא וּ/בְנָיָ֣הוּ בֶן יְהוֹיָדָ֗ע וְ/הַ/כְּרֵתִי֙ וְ/הַ/פְּלֵתִ֔י וַ/יַּרְכִּ֨בוּ֙ אֶת שְׁלֹמֹ֔ה עַל פִּרְדַּ֖ת הַ/מֶּ֣לֶךְ דָּוִ֑ד וַ/יֹּלִ֥כוּ אֹת֖/וֹ עַל גִּחֽוֹן
verses.translit: vyrd tsdvq hkhhn vntn hnby' vbnyhv bn yhvyd' vhkhrty vhplty vyrkhbv 't shlmh 'l prdt hmlkh dvd vylkhv 'tv 'l gchvn
verses.translation: So Zadok the priest, and Nathan the prophet, and Benaiah the son of Jehoiada, and the Cherethites, and the Pelethites, went down, and caused Solomon to ride upon king David’s mule, and brought him to Gihon.

verses.original: וַ/יִּקַּח֩ צָד֨וֹק הַ/כֹּהֵ֜ן אֶת קֶ֤רֶן הַ/שֶּׁ֨מֶן֙ מִן הָ/אֹ֔הֶל וַ/יִּמְשַׁ֖ח אֶת שְׁלֹמֹ֑ה וַֽ/יִּתְקְעוּ֙ בַּ/שּׁוֹפָ֔ר וַ/יֹּֽאמְרוּ֙ כָּל הָ/עָ֔ם יְחִ֖י הַ/מֶּ֥לֶךְ שְׁלֹמֹֽה
verses.translit: vyqch tsdvq hkhhn 't qrn hshmn mn h'hl vymshch 't shlmh vytq'v bshvpr vy'mrv khl h'm ychy hmlkh shlmh
verses.translation: And Zadok the priest took an horn of oil out of the tabernacle, and anointed Solomon. And they blew the trumpet; and all the people said, God save king Solomon.

verses.original: וַ/יַּעֲל֤וּ כָל הָ/עָם֙ אַֽחֲרָ֔י/ו וְ/הָ/עָם֙ מְחַלְּלִ֣ים בַּ/חֲלִלִ֔ים וּ/שְׂמֵחִ֖ים שִׂמְחָ֣ה גְדוֹלָ֑ה וַ/תִּבָּקַ֥ע הָ/אָ֖רֶץ בְּ/קוֹלָֽ/ם
verses.translit: vy'lv khl h'm 'chryv vh'm mchllym bchllym vshmchym shmchh gdvlh vtbq' h'rts bqvlm
verses.translation: And all the people came up after him, and the people piped with pipes, and rejoiced with great joy, so that the earth rent with the sound of them.

verses.original: וַ/יִּשְׁמַ֣ע אֲדֹנִיָּ֗הוּ וְ/כָל הַ/קְּרֻאִים֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר אִתּ֔/וֹ וְ/הֵ֖ם כִּלּ֣וּ לֶ/אֱכֹ֑ל וַ/יִּשְׁמַ֤ע יוֹאָב֙ אֶת ק֣וֹל הַ/שּׁוֹפָ֔ר וַ/יֹּ֕אמֶר מַדּ֥וּעַ קֽוֹל הַ/קִּרְיָ֖ה הוֹמָֽה
verses.translit: vyshm' 'dnyhv vkhl hqr'ym 'shr 'tv vhm khlv l'khl vyshm' yv'b 't qvl hshvpr vy'mr mdv' qvl hqryh hvmh
verses.translation: And Adonijah and all the guests that were with him heard it as they had made an end of eating. And when Joab heard the sound of the trumpet, he said, Wherefore is this noise of the city being in an uproar?

verses.original: עוֹדֶ֣/נּוּ מְדַבֵּ֔ר וְ/הִנֵּ֧ה יוֹנָתָ֛ן בֶּן אֶבְיָתָ֥ר הַ/כֹּהֵ֖ן בָּ֑א וַ/יֹּ֤אמֶר אֲדֹנִיָּ֨הוּ֙ בֹּ֔א כִּ֣י אִ֥ישׁ חַ֛יִל אַ֖תָּה וְ/ט֥וֹב תְּבַשֵּֽׂר
verses.translit: 'vdnv mdbr vhnh yvntn bn 'bytr hkhhn b' vy'mr 'dnyhv b' khy 'ysh chyl 'th vtvb tbshr
verses.translation: And while he yet spake, behold, Jonathan the son of Abiathar the priest came: and Adonijah said unto him, Come in; for thou art a valiant man, and bringest good tidings.

verses.original: וַ/יַּ֨עַן֙ יוֹנָתָ֔ן וַ/יֹּ֖אמֶר לַ/אֲדֹנִיָּ֑הוּ אֲבָ֕ל אֲדֹנֵ֥י/נוּ הַ/מֶּֽלֶךְ דָּוִ֖ד הִמְלִ֥יךְ אֶת שְׁלֹמֹֽה
verses.translit: vy'n yvntn vy'mr l'dnyhv 'bl 'dnynv hmlkh dvd hmlykh 't shlmh
verses.translation: And Jonathan answered and said to Adonijah, Verily our lord king David hath made Solomon king.

verses.original: וַ/יִּשְׁלַ֣ח אִתּֽ/וֹ הַ֠/מֶּלֶךְ אֶת צָד֨וֹק הַ/כֹּהֵ֜ן וְ/אֶת נָתָ֣ן הַ/נָּבִ֗יא וּ/בְנָיָ֨הוּ֙ בֶּן יְה֣וֹיָדָ֔ע וְ/הַ/כְּרֵתִ֖י וְ/הַ/פְּלֵתִ֑י וַ/יַּרְכִּ֣בוּ אֹת֔/וֹ עַ֖ל פִּרְדַּ֥ת הַ/מֶּֽלֶךְ
verses.translit: vyshlch 'tv hmlkh 't tsdvq hkhhn v't ntn hnby' vbnyhv bn yhvyd' vhkhrty vhplty vyrkhbv 'tv 'l prdt hmlkh
verses.translation: And the king hath sent with him Zadok the priest, and Nathan the prophet, and Benaiah the son of Jehoiada, and the Cherethites, and the Pelethites, and they have caused him to ride upon the king’s mule:

verses.original: וַ/יִּמְשְׁח֣וּ אֹת֡/וֹ צָד֣וֹק הַ/כֹּהֵ֣ן וְ/נָתָן֩ הַ/נָּבִ֨יא לְ/מֶ֜לֶךְ בְּ/גִח֗וֹן וַ/יַּעֲל֤וּ מִ/שָּׁם֙ שְׂמֵחִ֔ים וַ/תֵּהֹ֖ם הַ/קִּרְיָ֑ה ה֥וּא הַ/קּ֖וֹל אֲשֶׁ֥ר שְׁמַעְתֶּֽם
verses.translit: vymshchv 'tv tsdvq hkhhn vntn hnby' lmlkh bgchvn vy'lv mshm shmchym vthm hqryh hv' hqvl 'shr shm'tm
verses.translation: And Zadok the priest and Nathan the prophet have anointed him king in Gihon: and they are come up from thence rejoicing, so that the city rang again. This is the noise that ye have heard.

verses.original: וְ/גַם֙ יָשַׁ֣ב שְׁלֹמֹ֔ה עַ֖ל כִּסֵּ֥א הַ/מְּלוּכָֽה
verses.translit: vgm yshb shlmh 'l khs' hmlvkhh
verses.translation: And also Solomon sitteth on the throne of the kingdom.

verses.original: וְ/גַם בָּ֜אוּ עַבְדֵ֣י הַ/מֶּ֗לֶךְ לְ֠/בָרֵךְ אֶת אֲדֹנֵ֜י/נוּ הַ/מֶּ֣לֶךְ דָּוִד֮ לֵ/אמֹר֒ יֵיטֵ֨ב אלהי/ך אֱלֹהִ֜ים אֶת שֵׁ֤ם שְׁלֹמֹה֙ מִ/שְּׁמֶ֔/ךָ וִֽ/יגַדֵּ֥ל אֶת כִּסְא֖/וֹ מִ/כִּסְאֶ֑/ךָ וַ/יִּשְׁתַּ֥חוּ הַ/מֶּ֖לֶךְ עַל הַ/מִּשְׁכָּֽב
verses.translit: vgm b'v 'bdy hmlkh lbrkh 't 'dnynv hmlkh dvd l'mr yytb 'lhykh 'lhym 't shm shlmh mshmkh vygdl 't khs'v mkhs'kh vyshtchv hmlkh 'l hmshkhb
verses.translation: And moreover the king’s servants came to bless our lord king David, saying, God make the name of Solomon better than thy name, and make his throne greater than thy throne. And the king bowed himself upon the bed.

verses.original: וְ/גַם כָּ֖כָה אָמַ֣ר הַ/מֶּ֑לֶךְ בָּר֨וּךְ יְהוָ֜ה אֱלֹהֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל אֲשֶׁ֨ר נָתַ֥ן הַ/יּ֛וֹם יֹשֵׁ֥ב עַל כִּסְאִ֖/י וְ/עֵינַ֥/י רֹאֽוֹת
verses.translit: vgm khkhh 'mr hmlkh brvkh yhvh 'lhy yshr'l 'shr ntn hyvm yshb 'l khs'y v'yny r'vt
verses.translation: And also thus said the king, Blessed be the LORD God of Israel, which hath given one to sit on my throne this day, mine eyes even seeing it .

verses.original: וַ/יֶּֽחֶרְדוּ֙ וַ/יָּקֻ֔מוּ כָּל הַ֨/קְּרֻאִ֔ים אֲשֶׁ֖ר לַ/אֲדֹנִיָּ֑הוּ וַ/יֵּלְכ֖וּ אִ֥ישׁ לְ/דַרְכּֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: vychrdv vyqmv khl hqr'ym 'shr l'dnyhv vylkhv 'ysh ldrkhv
verses.translation: And all the guests that were with Adonijah were afraid, and rose up, and went every man his way.

verses.original: וַ/אֲדֹ֣נִיָּ֔הוּ יָרֵ֖א מִ/פְּנֵ֣י שְׁלֹמֹ֑ה וַ/יָּ֣קָם וַ/יֵּ֔לֶךְ וַֽ/יַּחֲזֵ֖ק בְּ/קַרְנ֥וֹת הַ/מִּזְבֵּֽחַ
verses.translit: v'dnyhv yr' mpny shlmh vyqm vylkh vychzq bqrnvt hmzbch
verses.translation: And Adonijah feared because of Solomon, and arose, and went, and caught hold on the horns of the altar.

verses.original: וַ/יֻּגַּ֤ד לִ/שְׁלֹמֹה֙ לֵ/אמֹ֔ר הִנֵּה֙ אֲדֹ֣נִיָּ֔הוּ יָרֵ֖א אֶת הַ/מֶּ֣לֶךְ שְׁלֹמֹ֑ה וְ֠/הִנֵּה אָחַ֞ז בְּ/קַרְנ֤וֹת הַ/מִּזְבֵּ֨חַ֙ לֵ/אמֹ֔ר יִשָּֽׁבַֽע לִ֤/י כַ/יּוֹם֙ הַ/מֶּ֣לֶךְ שְׁלֹמֹ֔ה אִם יָמִ֥ית אֶת עַבְדּ֖/וֹ בֶּ/חָֽרֶב
verses.translit: vygd lshlmh l'mr hnh 'dnyhv yr' 't hmlkh shlmh vhnh 'chz bqrnvt hmzbch l'mr yshb' ly khyvm hmlkh shlmh 'm ymyt 't 'bdv bchrb
verses.translation: And it was told Solomon, saying, Behold, Adonijah feareth king Solomon: for, lo, he hath caught hold on the horns of the altar, saying, Let king Solomon swear unto me to day that he will not slay his servant with the sword.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֣אמֶר שְׁלֹמֹ֔ה אִ֚ם יִהְיֶ֣ה לְ/בֶן חַ֔יִל לֹֽא יִפֹּ֥ל מִ/שַּׂעֲרָת֖/וֹ אָ֑רְצָ/ה וְ/אִם רָעָ֥ה תִמָּצֵא ב֖/וֹ וָ/מֵֽת
verses.translit: vy'mr shlmh 'm yhyh lbn chyl l' ypl msh'rtv 'rtsh v'm r'h tmts' bv vmt
verses.translation: And Solomon said, If he will shew himself a worthy man, there shall not an hair of him fall to the earth: but if wickedness shall be found in him, he shall die.

verses.translit: vyshlch hmlkh shlmh vyrdhv m'l hmzbch vyb' vyshtchv lmlkh shlmh vy'mr lv shlmh lkh lbytkh
verses.translation: So king Solomon sent, and they brought him down from the altar. And he came and bowed himself to king Solomon: and Solomon said unto him, Go to thine house.

verses.original: וַ/יִּקְרְב֥וּ יְמֵֽי דָוִ֖ד לָ/מ֑וּת וַ/יְצַ֛ו אֶת שְׁלֹמֹ֥ה בְנ֖/וֹ לֵ/אמֹֽר
verses.translit: vyqrbv ymy dvd lmvt vytsv 't shlmh bnv l'mr
verses.translation: Now the days of David drew nigh that he should die; and he charged Solomon his son, saying,

verses.original: אָנֹכִ֣י הֹלֵ֔ךְ בְּ/דֶ֖רֶךְ כָּל הָ/אָ֑רֶץ וְ/חָזַקְתָּ֖ וְ/הָיִ֥יתָֽ לְ/אִֽישׁ
verses.translit: 'nkhy hlkh bdrkh khl h'rts vchzqt vhyyt l'ysh
verses.translation: I go the way of all the earth: be thou strong therefore, and shew thyself a man;

verses.original: וְ/שָׁמַרְתָּ֞ אֶת מִשְׁמֶ֣רֶת יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶ֗י/ךָ לָ/לֶ֤כֶת בִּ/דְרָכָי/ו֙ לִ/שְׁמֹ֨ר חֻקֹּתָ֤י/ו מִצְוֺתָי/ו֙ וּ/מִשְׁפָּטָ֣י/ו וְ/עֵדְוֺתָ֔י/ו כַּ/כָּת֖וּב בְּ/תוֹרַ֣ת מֹשֶׁ֑ה לְמַ֣עַן תַּשְׂכִּ֗יל אֵ֚ת כָּל אֲשֶׁ֣ר תַּֽעֲשֶׂ֔ה וְ/אֵ֛ת כָּל אֲשֶׁ֥ר תִּפְנֶ֖ה שָֽׁם
verses.translit: vshmrt 't mshmrt yhvh 'lhykh llkht bdrkhyv lshmr chqtyv mtsvtyv vmshptyv v'dvtyv khkhtvb btvrt mshh lm'n tshkhyl 't khl 'shr t'shh v't khl 'shr tpnh shm
verses.translation: And keep the charge of the LORD thy God, to walk in his ways, to keep his statutes, and his commandments, and his judgments, and his testimonies, as it is written in the law of Moses, that thou mayest prosper in all that thou doest, and whithersoever thou turnest thyself:

verses.original: לְמַעַן֩ יָקִ֨ים יְהוָ֜ה אֶת דְּבָר֗/וֹ אֲשֶׁ֨ר דִּבֶּ֣ר עָלַ/י֮ לֵ/אמֹר֒ אִם יִשְׁמְר֨וּ בָנֶ֜י/ךָ אֶת דַּרְכָּ֗/ם לָ/לֶ֤כֶת לְ/פָנַ/י֙ בֶּ/אֱמֶ֔ת בְּ/כָל לְבָבָ֖/ם וּ/בְ/כָל נַפְשָׁ֑/ם לֵ/אמֹ֕ר לֹֽא יִכָּרֵ֤ת לְ/ךָ֙ אִ֔ישׁ מֵ/עַ֖ל כִּסֵּ֥א יִשְׂרָאֵֽל
verses.translit: lm'n yqym yhvh 't dbrv 'shr dbr 'ly l'mr 'm yshmrv bnykh 't drkhm llkht lpny b'mt bkhl lbbm vbkhl npshm l'mr l' ykhrt lkh 'ysh m'l khs' yshr'l
verses.translation: That the LORD may continue his word which he spake concerning me, saying, If thy children take heed to their way, to walk before me in truth with all their heart and with all their soul, there shall not fail thee (said he) a man on the throne of Israel.

verses.original: וְ/גַ֣ם אַתָּ֣ה יָדַ֡עְתָּ אֵת֩ אֲשֶׁר עָ֨שָׂה לִ֜/י יוֹאָ֣ב בֶּן צְרוּיָ֗ה אֲשֶׁ֣ר עָשָׂ֣ה לִ/שְׁנֵֽי שָׂרֵ֣י צִבְא֣וֹת יִ֠שְׂרָאֵל לְ/אַבְנֵ֨ר בֶּן נֵ֜ר וְ/לַ/עֲמָשָׂ֤א בֶן יֶ֨תֶר֙ וַ/יַּ֣הַרְגֵ֔/ם וַ/יָּ֥שֶׂם דְּמֵֽי מִלְחָמָ֖ה בְּ/שָׁלֹ֑ם וַ/יִּתֵּ֞ן דְּמֵ֣י מִלְחָמָ֗ה בַּ/חֲגֹֽרָת/וֹ֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר בְּ/מָתְנָ֔י/ו וּֽ/בְ/נַעֲל֖/וֹ אֲשֶׁ֥ר בְּ/רַגְלָֽי/ו
verses.translit: vgm 'th yd't 't 'shr 'shh ly yv'b bn tsrvyh 'shr 'shh lshny shry tsb'vt yshr'l l'bnr bn nr vl'msh' bn ytr vyhrgm vyshm dmy mlchmh bshlm vytn dmy mlchmh bchgrtv 'shr bmtnyv vbn'lv 'shr brglyv
verses.translation: Moreover thou knowest also what Joab the son of Zeruiah did to me, and what he did to the two captains of the hosts of Israel, unto Abner the son of Ner, and unto Amasa the son of Jether, whom he slew, and shed the blood of war in peace, and put the blood of war upon his girdle that was about his loins, and in his shoes that were on his feet.

verses.original: וְ/עָשִׂ֖יתָ כְּ/חָכְמָתֶ֑/ךָ וְ/לֹֽא תוֹרֵ֧ד שֵׂיבָת֛/וֹ בְּ/שָׁלֹ֖ם שְׁאֹֽל
verses.translit: v'shyt khchkhmtkh vl' tvrd shybtv bshlm sh'l
verses.translation: Do therefore according to thy wisdom, and let not his hoar head go down to the grave in peace.

verses.original: וְ/לִ/בְנֵ֨י בַרְזִלַּ֤י הַ/גִּלְעָדִי֙ תַּֽעֲשֶׂה חֶ֔סֶד וְ/הָי֖וּ בְּ/אֹכְלֵ֣י שֻׁלְחָנֶ֑/ךָ כִּי כֵן֙ קָרְב֣וּ אֵלַ֔/י בְּ/בָרְחִ֕/י מִ/פְּנֵ֖י אַבְשָׁל֥וֹם אָחִֽי/ךָ
verses.translit: vlbny brzly hgl'dy t'shh chsd vhyv b'khly shlchnkh khy khn qrbv 'ly bbrchy mpny 'bshlvm 'chykh
verses.translation: But shew kindness unto the sons of Barzillai the Gileadite, and let them be of those that eat at thy table: for so they came to me when I fled because of Absalom thy brother.

verses.original: וְ/הִנֵּ֣ה עִ֠מְּ/ךָ שִֽׁמְעִ֨י בֶן גֵּרָ֥א בֶן הַ/יְמִינִי֮ מִ/בַּחֻרִים֒ וְ/ה֤וּא קִֽלְלַ֨/נִי֙ קְלָלָ֣ה נִמְרֶ֔צֶת בְּ/י֖וֹם לֶכְתִּ֣/י מַחֲנָ֑יִם וְ/הֽוּא יָרַ֤ד לִ/קְרָאתִ/י֙ הַ/יַּרְדֵּ֔ן וָ/אֶשָּׁ֨בַֽע ל֤/וֹ בַֽ/יהוָה֙ לֵ/אמֹ֔ר אִם אֲמִֽיתְ/ךָ֖ בֶּ/חָֽרֶב
verses.translit: vhnh 'mkh shm'y bn gr' bn hymyny mbchrym vhv' qllny qllh nmrtst byvm lkhty mchnym vhv' yrd lqr'ty hyrdn v'shb' lv byhvh l'mr 'm 'mytkh bchrb
verses.translation: And, behold, thou hast with thee Shimei the son of Gera, a Benjamite of Bahurim, which cursed me with a grievous curse in the day when I went to Mahanaim: but he came down to meet me at Jordan, and I sware to him by the LORD , saying, I will not put thee to death with the sword.

verses.original: וְ/עַתָּה֙ אַל תְּנַקֵּ֔/הוּ כִּ֛י אִ֥ישׁ חָכָ֖ם אָ֑תָּה וְ/יָֽדַעְתָּ֙ אֵ֣ת אֲשֶׁ֣ר תַּֽעֲשֶׂה לּ֔/וֹ וְ/הוֹרַדְתָּ֧ אֶת שֵׂיבָת֛/וֹ בְּ/דָ֖ם שְׁאֽוֹל
verses.translit: v'th 'l tnqhv khy 'ysh chkhm 'th vyd't 't 'shr t'shh lv vhvrdt 't shybtv bdm sh'vl
verses.translation: Now therefore hold him not guiltless: for thou art a wise man, and knowest what thou oughtest to do unto him; but his hoar head bring thou down to the grave with blood.

verses.original: וַ/יִּשְׁכַּ֥ב דָּוִ֖ד עִם אֲבֹתָ֑י/ו וַ/יִּקָּבֵ֖ר בְּ/עִ֥יר דָּוִֽד
verses.translit: vyshkhb dvd 'm 'btyv vyqbr b'yr dvd
verses.translation: So David slept with his fathers, and was buried in the city of David.

verses.original: וְ/הַ/יָּמִ֗ים אֲשֶׁ֨ר מָלַ֤ךְ דָּוִד֙ עַל יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל אַרְבָּעִ֖ים שָׁנָ֑ה בְּ/חֶבְר֤וֹן מָלַךְ֙ שֶׁ֣בַע שָׁנִ֔ים וּ/בִ/ירוּשָׁלִַ֣ם מָלַ֔ךְ שְׁלֹשִׁ֥ים וְ/שָׁלֹ֖שׁ שָׁנִֽים
verses.translit: vhymym 'shr mlkh dvd 'l yshr'l 'rb'ym shnh bchbrvn mlkh shb' shnym vbyrvshlm mlkh shlshym vshlsh shnym
verses.translation: And the days that David reigned over Israel were forty years: seven years reigned he in Hebron, and thirty and three years reigned he in Jerusalem.

verses.original: וּ/שְׁלֹמֹ֕ה יָשַׁ֕ב עַל כִּסֵּ֖א דָּוִ֣ד אָבִ֑י/ו וַ/תִּכֹּ֥ן מַלְכֻת֖/וֹ מְאֹֽד
verses.translit: vshlmh yshb 'l khs' dvd 'byv vtkhn mlkhtv m'd
verses.translation: Then sat Solomon upon the throne of David his father; and his kingdom was established greatly.

verses.original: וַ/יָּבֹ֞א אֲדֹנִיָּ֣הוּ בֶן חַגֵּ֗ית אֶל בַּת שֶׁ֨בַע֙ אֵם שְׁלֹמֹ֔ה וַ/תֹּ֖אמֶר הֲ/שָׁל֣וֹם בֹּאֶ֑/ךָ וַ/יֹּ֖אמֶר שָׁלֽוֹם
verses.translit: vyb' 'dnyhv bn chgyt 'l bt shb' 'm shlmh vt'mr hshlvm b'kh vy'mr shlvm
verses.translation: And Adonijah the son of Haggith came to Bath-sheba the mother of Solomon. And she said, Comest thou peaceably? And he said, Peaceably.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֕אמֶר דָּבָ֥ר לִ֖/י אֵלָ֑יִ/ךְ וַ/תֹּ֖אמֶר דַּבֵּֽר
verses.translit: vy'mr dbr ly 'lykh vt'mr dbr
verses.translation: He said moreover, I have somewhat to say unto thee. And she said, Say on.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֗אמֶר אַ֤תְּ יָדַ֨עַתְּ֙ כִּי לִ/י֙ הָיְתָ֣ה הַ/מְּלוּכָ֔ה וְ/עָלַ֞/י שָׂ֧מוּ כָֽל יִשְׂרָאֵ֛ל פְּנֵי/הֶ֖ם לִ/מְלֹ֑ךְ וַ/תִּסֹּ֤ב הַ/מְּלוּכָה֙ וַ/תְּהִ֣י לְ/אָחִ֔/י כִּ֥י מֵ/יְהוָ֖ה הָ֥יְתָה לּֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: vy'mr 't yd't khy ly hyth hmlvkhh v'ly shmv khl yshr'l pnyhm lmlkh vtsb hmlvkhh vthy l'chy khy myhvh hyth lv
verses.translation: And he said, Thou knowest that the kingdom was mine, and that all Israel set their faces on me, that I should reign: howbeit the kingdom is turned about, and is become my brother’s: for it was his from the LORD .

verses.original: וְ/עַתָּ֗ה שְׁאֵלָ֤ה אַחַת֙ אָֽנֹכִי֙ שֹׁאֵ֣ל מֵֽ/אִתָּ֔/ךְ אַל תָּשִׁ֖בִי אֶת פָּנָ֑/י וַ/תֹּ֥אמֶר אֵלָ֖י/ו דַּבֵּֽר
verses.translit: v'th sh'lh 'cht 'nkhy sh'l m'tkh 'l tshby 't pny vt'mr 'lyv dbr
verses.translation: And now I ask one petition of thee, deny me not. And she said unto him, Say on.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֗אמֶר אִמְרִי נָא֙ לִ/שְׁלֹמֹ֣ה הַ/מֶּ֔לֶךְ כִּ֥י לֹֽא יָשִׁ֖יב אֶת פָּנָ֑יִ/ךְ וְ/יִתֶּן לִ֛/י אֶת אֲבִישַׁ֥ג הַ/שּׁוּנַמִּ֖ית לְ/אִשָּֽׁה
verses.translit: vy'mr 'mry n' lshlmh hmlkh khy l' yshyb 't pnykh vytn ly 't 'byshg hshvnmyt l'shh
verses.translation: And he said, Speak, I pray thee, unto Solomon the king, (for he will not say thee nay,) that he give me Abishag the Shunammite to wife.

verses.original: וַ/תֹּ֥אמֶר בַּת שֶׁ֖בַע ט֑וֹב אָנֹכִ֕י אֲדַבֵּ֥ר עָלֶ֖י/ךָ אֶל הַ/מֶּֽלֶךְ
verses.translit: vt'mr bt shb' tvb 'nkhy 'dbr 'lykh 'l hmlkh
verses.translation: And Bath-sheba said, Well; I will speak for thee unto the king.

verses.original: וַ/תָּבֹ֤א בַת שֶׁ֨בַע֙ אֶל הַ/מֶּ֣לֶךְ שְׁלֹמֹ֔ה לְ/דַבֶּר ל֖/וֹ עַל אֲדֹנִיָּ֑הוּ וַ/יָּקָם֩ הַ/מֶּ֨לֶךְ לִ/קְרָאתָ֜/הּ וַ/יִּשְׁתַּ֣חוּ לָ֗/הּ וַ/יֵּ֨שֶׁב֙ עַל כִּסְא֔/וֹ וַ/יָּ֤שֶׂם כִּסֵּא֙ לְ/אֵ֣ם הַ/מֶּ֔לֶךְ וַ/תֵּ֖שֶׁב לִֽ/ימִינֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: vtb' bt shb' 'l hmlkh shlmh ldbr lv 'l 'dnyhv vyqm hmlkh lqr'th vyshtchv lh vyshb 'l khs'v vyshm khs' l'm hmlkh vtshb lymynv
verses.translation: Bath-sheba therefore went unto king Solomon, to speak unto him for Adonijah. And the king rose up to meet her, and bowed himself unto her, and sat down on his throne, and caused a seat to be set for the king’s mother; and she sat on his right hand.

verses.original: וַ/תֹּ֗אמֶר שְׁאֵלָ֨ה אַחַ֤ת קְטַנָּה֙ אָֽנֹכִי֙ שֹׁאֶ֣לֶת מֵֽ/אִתָּ֔/ךְ אַל תָּ֖שֶׁב אֶת פָּנָ֑/י וַ/יֹּֽאמֶר לָ֤/הּ הַ/מֶּ֨לֶךְ֙ שַׁאֲלִ֣י אִמִּ֔/י כִּ֥י לֹֽא אָשִׁ֖יב אֶת פָּנָֽיִ/ךְ
verses.translit: vt'mr sh'lh 'cht qtnh 'nkhy sh'lt m'tkh 'l tshb 't pny vy'mr lh hmlkh sh'ly 'my khy l' 'shyb 't pnykh
verses.translation: Then she said, I desire one small petition of thee; I pray thee , say me not nay. And the king said unto her, Ask on, my mother: for I will not say thee nay.

verses.original: וַ/תֹּ֕אמֶר יֻתַּ֖ן אֶת אֲבִישַׁ֣ג הַ/שֻּׁנַמִּ֑ית לַ/אֲדֹנִיָּ֥הוּ אָחִ֖י/ךָ לְ/אִשָּֽׁה
verses.translit: vt'mr ytn 't 'byshg hshnmyt l'dnyhv 'chykh l'shh
verses.translation: And she said, Let Abishag the Shunammite be given to Adonijah thy brother to wife.

verses.original: וַ/יַּעַן֩ הַ/מֶּ֨לֶךְ שְׁלֹמֹ֜ה וַ/יֹּ֣אמֶר לְ/אִמּ֗/וֹ וְ/לָ/מָה֩ אַ֨תְּ שֹׁאֶ֜לֶת אֶת אֲבִישַׁ֤ג הַ/שֻּׁנַמִּית֙ לַ/אֲדֹ֣נִיָּ֔הוּ וְ/שַֽׁאֲלִי ל/וֹ֙ אֶת הַ/מְּלוּכָ֔ה כִּ֛י ה֥וּא אָחִ֖/י הַ/גָּד֣וֹל מִמֶּ֑/נִּי וְ/ל/וֹ֙ וּ/לְ/אֶבְיָתָ֣ר הַ/כֹּהֵ֔ן וּ/לְ/יוֹאָ֖ב בֶּן צְרוּיָֽה
verses.translit: vy'n hmlkh shlmh vy'mr l'mv vlmh 't sh'lt 't 'byshg hshnmyt l'dnyhv vsh'ly lv 't hmlvkhh khy hv' 'chy hgdvl mmny vlv vl'bytr hkhhn vlyv'b bn tsrvyh
verses.translation: And king Solomon answered and said unto his mother, And why dost thou ask Abishag the Shunammite for Adonijah? ask for him the kingdom also; for he is mine elder brother; even for him, and for Abiathar the priest, and for Joab the son of Zeruiah.

verses.original: וַ/יִּשָּׁבַע֙ הַ/מֶּ֣לֶךְ שְׁלֹמֹ֔ה בַּֽ/יהוָ֖ה לֵ/אמֹ֑ר כֹּ֣ה יַֽעֲשֶׂה לִּ֤/י אֱלֹהִים֙ וְ/כֹ֣ה יוֹסִ֔יף כִּ֣י בְ/נַפְשׁ֔/וֹ דִּבֶּר֙ אֲדֹ֣נִיָּ֔הוּ אֶת הַ/דָּבָ֖ר הַ/זֶּֽה
verses.translit: vyshb' hmlkh shlmh byhvh l'mr khh y'shh ly 'lhym vkhh yvsyf khy bnpshv dbr 'dnyhv 't hdbr hzh
verses.translation: Then king Solomon sware by the LORD , saying, God do so to me, and more also, if Adonijah have not spoken this word against his own life.

verses.original: וְ/עַתָּ֗ה חַי יְהוָה֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר הֱכִינַ֗/נִי ו/יושיבי/ני וַ/יּֽוֹשִׁיבַ֨/נִי֙ עַל כִּסֵּא֙ דָּוִ֣ד אָבִ֔/י וַ/אֲשֶׁ֧ר עָֽשָׂה לִ֛/י בַּ֖יִת כַּ/אֲשֶׁ֣ר דִּבֵּ֑ר כִּ֣י הַ/יּ֔וֹם יוּמַ֖ת אֲדֹנִיָּֽהוּ
verses.translit: v'th chy yhvh 'shr hkhynny vyvshybyny vyvshybny 'l khs' dvd 'by v'shr 'shh ly byt kh'shr dbr khy hyvm yvmt 'dnyhv
verses.translation: Now therefore, as the LORD liveth, which hath established me, and set me on the throne of David my father, and who hath made me an house, as he promised, Adonijah shall be put to death this day.

verses.original: וַ/יִּשְׁלַח֙ הַ/מֶּ֣לֶךְ שְׁלֹמֹ֔ה בְּ/יַ֖ד בְּנָיָ֣הוּ בֶן יְהוֹיָדָ֑ע וַ/יִּפְגַּע בּ֖/וֹ וַ/יָּמֹֽת
verses.translit: vyshlch hmlkh shlmh byd bnyhv bn yhvyd' vypg' bv vymt
verses.translation: And king Solomon sent by the hand of Benaiah the son of Jehoiada; and he fell upon him that he died.

verses.original: וּ/לְ/אֶבְיָתָ֨ר הַ/כֹּהֵ֜ן אָמַ֣ר הַ/מֶּ֗לֶךְ עֲנָתֹת֙ לֵ֣ךְ עַל שָׂדֶ֔י/ךָ כִּ֛י אִ֥ישׁ מָ֖וֶת אָ֑תָּה וּ/בַ/יּ֨וֹם הַ/זֶּ֜ה לֹ֣א אֲמִיתֶ֗/ךָ כִּֽי נָשָׂ֜אתָ אֶת אֲר֨וֹן אֲדֹנָ֤/י יְהֹוִה֙ לִ/פְנֵי֙ דָּוִ֣ד אָבִ֔/י וְ/כִ֣י הִתְעַנִּ֔יתָ בְּ/כֹ֥ל אֲשֶֽׁר הִתְעַנָּ֖ה אָבִֽ/י
verses.translit: vl'bytr hkhhn 'mr hmlkh 'ntt lkh 'l shdykh khy 'ysh mvt 'th vbyvm hzh l' 'mytkh khy nsh't 't 'rvn 'dny yhvh lpny dvd 'by vkhy ht'nyt bkhl 'shr ht'nh 'by
verses.translation: And unto Abiathar the priest said the king, Get thee to Anathoth, unto thine own fields; for thou art worthy of death: but I will not at this time put thee to death, because thou barest the ark of the Lord GOD before David my father, and because thou hast been afflicted in all wherein my father was afflicted.

verses.original: וַ/יְגָ֤רֶשׁ שְׁלֹמֹה֙ אֶת אֶבְיָתָ֔ר מִ/הְי֥וֹת כֹּהֵ֖ן לַֽ/יהוָ֑ה לְ/מַלֵּא֙ אֶת דְּבַ֣ר יְהוָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר דִּבֶּ֛ר עַל בֵּ֥ית עֵלִ֖י בְּ/שִׁלֹֽה
verses.translit: vygrsh shlmh 't 'bytr mhyvt khhn lyhvh lml' 't dbr yhvh 'shr dbr 'l byt 'ly bshlh
verses.translation: So Solomon thrust out Abiathar from being priest unto the LORD ; that he might fulfil the word of the LORD , which he spake concerning the house of Eli in Shiloh.

verses.original: וְ/הַ/שְּׁמֻעָה֙ בָּ֣אָה עַד יוֹאָ֔ב כִּ֣י יוֹאָ֗ב נָטָה֙ אַחֲרֵ֣י אֲדֹנִיָּ֔ה וְ/אַחֲרֵ֥י אַבְשָׁל֖וֹם לֹ֣א נָטָ֑ה וַ/יָּ֤נָס יוֹאָב֙ אֶל אֹ֣הֶל יְהוָ֔ה וַֽ/יַּחֲזֵ֖ק בְּ/קַרְנ֥וֹת הַ/מִּזְבֵּֽחַ
verses.translit: vhshm'h b'h 'd yv'b khy yv'b nth 'chry 'dnyh v'chry 'bshlvm l' nth vyns yv'b 'l 'hl yhvh vychzq bqrnvt hmzbch
verses.translation: Then tidings came to Joab: for Joab had turned after Adonijah, though he turned not after Absalom. And Joab fled unto the tabernacle of the LORD , and caught hold on the horns of the altar.

verses.original: וַ/יֻּגַּ֞ד לַ/מֶּ֣לֶךְ שְׁלֹמֹ֗ה כִּ֣י נָ֤ס יוֹאָב֙ אֶל אֹ֣הֶל יְהוָ֔ה וְ/הִנֵּ֖ה אֵ֣צֶל הַ/מִּזְבֵּ֑חַ וַ/יִּשְׁלַ֨ח שְׁלֹמֹ֜ה אֶת בְּנָיָ֧הוּ בֶן יְהוֹיָדָ֛ע לֵ/אמֹ֖ר לֵ֥ךְ פְּגַע בּֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: vygd lmlkh shlmh khy ns yv'b 'l 'hl yhvh vhnh 'tsl hmzbch vyshlch shlmh 't bnyhv bn yhvyd' l'mr lkh pg' bv
verses.translation: And it was told king Solomon that Joab was fled unto the tabernacle of the LORD ; and, behold, he is by the altar. Then Solomon sent Benaiah the son of Jehoiada, saying, Go, fall upon him.

verses.original: וַ/יָּבֹ֨א בְנָיָ֜הוּ אֶל אֹ֣הֶל יְהוָ֗ה וַ/יֹּ֨אמֶר אֵלָ֜י/ו כֹּֽה אָמַ֤ר הַ/מֶּ֨לֶךְ֙ צֵ֔א וַ/יֹּ֥אמֶר לֹ֖א כִּ֣י פֹ֣ה אָמ֑וּת וַ/יָּ֨שֶׁב בְּנָיָ֤הוּ אֶת הַ/מֶּ֨לֶךְ֙ דָּבָ֣ר לֵ/אמֹ֔ר כֹּֽה דִבֶּ֥ר יוֹאָ֖ב וְ/כֹ֥ה עָנָֽ/נִי
verses.translit: vyb' bnyhv 'l 'hl yhvh vy'mr 'lyv khh 'mr hmlkh ts' vy'mr l' khy ph 'mvt vyshb bnyhv 't hmlkh dbr l'mr khh dbr yv'b vkhh 'nny
verses.translation: And Benaiah came to the tabernacle of the LORD , and said unto him, Thus saith the king, Come forth. And he said, Nay; but I will die here. And Benaiah brought the king word again, saying, Thus said Joab, and thus he answered me.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֧אמֶר ל֣/וֹ הַ/מֶּ֗לֶךְ עֲשֵׂה֙ כַּ/אֲשֶׁ֣ר דִּבֶּ֔ר וּ/פְגַע בּ֖/וֹ וּ/קְבַרְתּ֑/וֹ וַ/הֲסִירֹ֣תָ דְּמֵ֣י חִנָּ֗ם אֲשֶׁר֙ שָׁפַ֣ךְ יוֹאָ֔ב מֵ/עָלַ֕/י וּ/מֵ/עַ֖ל בֵּ֥ית אָבִֽ/י
verses.translit: vy'mr lv hmlkh 'shh kh'shr dbr vpg' bv vqbrtv vhsyrt dmy chnm 'shr shpkh yv'b m'ly vm'l byt 'by
verses.translation: And the king said unto him, Do as he hath said, and fall upon him, and bury him; that thou mayest take away the innocent blood, which Joab shed, from me, and from the house of my father.

verses.original: וְ/הֵשִׁיב֩ יְהוָ֨ה אֶת דָּמ֜/וֹ עַל רֹאשׁ֗/וֹ אֲשֶׁ֣ר פָּגַ֣ע בִּ/שְׁנֵֽי אֲ֠נָשִׁים צַדִּקִ֨ים וְ/טֹבִ֤ים מִמֶּ֨/נּוּ֙ וַ/יַּהַרְגֵ֣/ם בַּ/חֶ֔רֶב וְ/אָבִ֥/י דָוִ֖ד לֹ֣א יָדָ֑ע אֶת אַבְנֵ֤ר בֶּן נֵר֙ שַׂר צְבָ֣א יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל וְ/אֶת עֲמָשָׂ֥א בֶן יֶ֖תֶר שַׂר צְבָ֥א יְהוּדָֽה
verses.translit: vhshyb yhvh 't dmv 'l r'shv 'shr pg' bshny 'nshym tsdqym vtbym mmnv vyhrgm bchrb v'by dvd l' yd' 't 'bnr bn nr shr tsb' yshr'l v't 'msh' bn ytr shr tsb' yhvdh
verses.translation: And the LORD shall return his blood upon his own head, who fell upon two men more righteous and better than he, and slew them with the sword, my father David not knowing thereof, to wit , Abner the son of Ner, captain of the host of Israel, and Amasa the son of Jether, captain of the host of Judah.

verses.original: וְ/שָׁ֤בוּ דְמֵי/הֶם֙ בְּ/רֹ֣אשׁ יוֹאָ֔ב וּ/בְ/רֹ֥אשׁ זַרְע֖/וֹ לְ/עֹלָ֑ם וּ/לְ/דָוִ֡ד וּ֠/לְ/זַרְע/וֹ וּ/לְ/בֵית֨/וֹ וּ/לְ/כִסְא֜/וֹ יִהְיֶ֥ה שָׁל֛וֹם עַד עוֹלָ֖ם מֵ/עִ֥ם יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: vshbv dmyhm br'sh yv'b vbr'sh zr'v l'lm vldvd vlzr'v vlbytv vlkhs'v yhyh shlvm 'd 'vlm m'm yhvh
verses.translation: Their blood shall therefore return upon the head of Joab, and upon the head of his seed for ever: but upon David, and upon his seed, and upon his house, and upon his throne, shall there be peace for ever from the LORD .

verses.original: וַ/יַּ֗עַל בְּנָיָ֨הוּ֙ בֶּן יְה֣וֹיָדָ֔ע וַ/יִּפְגַּע בּ֖/וֹ וַ/יְמִתֵ֑/הוּ וַ/יִּקָּבֵ֥ר בְּ/בֵית֖/וֹ בַּ/מִּדְבָּֽר
verses.translit: vy'l bnyhv bn yhvyd' vypg' bv vymthv vyqbr bbytv bmdbr
verses.translation: So Benaiah the son of Jehoiada went up, and fell upon him, and slew him: and he was buried in his own house in the wilderness.

verses.original: וַ/יִּתֵּ֨ן הַ/מֶּ֜לֶךְ אֶת בְּנָיָ֧הוּ בֶן יְהוֹיָדָ֛ע תַּחְתָּ֖י/ו עַל הַ/צָּבָ֑א וְ/אֶת צָד֤וֹק הַ/כֹּהֵן֙ נָתַ֣ן הַ/מֶּ֔לֶךְ תַּ֖חַת אֶבְיָתָֽר
verses.translit: vytn hmlkh 't bnyhv bn yhvyd' tchtyv 'l htsb' v't tsdvq hkhhn ntn hmlkh tcht 'bytr
verses.translation: And the king put Benaiah the son of Jehoiada in his room over the host: and Zadok the priest did the king put in the room of Abiathar.

verses.original: וַ/יִּשְׁלַ֤ח הַ/מֶּ֨לֶךְ֙ וַ/יִּקְרָ֣א לְ/שִׁמְעִ֔י וַ/יֹּ֣אמֶר ל֗/וֹ בְּֽנֵה לְ/ךָ֥ בַ֨יִת֙ בִּ/יר֣וּשָׁלִַ֔ם וְ/יָשַׁבְתָּ֖ שָׁ֑ם וְ/לֹֽא תֵצֵ֥א מִ/שָּׁ֖ם אָ֥נֶה וָ/אָֽנָה
verses.translit: vyshlch hmlkh vyqr' lshm'y vy'mr lv bnh lkh byt byrvshlm vyshbt shm vl' tts' mshm 'nh v'nh
verses.translation: And the king sent and called for Shimei, and said unto him, Build thee an house in Jerusalem, and dwell there, and go not forth thence any whither.

verses.original: וְ/הָיָ֣ה בְּ/י֣וֹם צֵאתְ/ךָ֗ וְ/עָֽבַרְתָּ֙ אֶת נַ֣חַל קִדְר֔וֹן יָדֹ֥עַ תֵּדַ֖ע כִּ֣י מ֣וֹת תָּמ֑וּת דָּמְ/ךָ֖ יִהְיֶ֥ה בְ/רֹאשֶֽׁ/ךָ
verses.translit: vhyh byvm ts'tkh v'brt 't nchl qdrvn yd' td' khy mvt tmvt dmkh yhyh br'shkh
verses.translation: For it shall be, that on the day thou goest out, and passest over the brook Kidron, thou shalt know for certain that thou shalt surely die: thy blood shall be upon thine own head.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֨אמֶר שִׁמְעִ֤י לַ/מֶּ֨לֶךְ֙ ט֣וֹב הַ/דָּבָ֔ר כַּ/אֲשֶׁ֤ר דִּבֶּר֙ אֲדֹנִ֣/י הַ/מֶּ֔לֶךְ כֵּ֖ן יַעֲשֶׂ֣ה עַבְדֶּ֑/ךָ וַ/יֵּ֧שֶׁב שִׁמְעִ֛י בִּ/ירוּשָׁלִַ֖ם יָמִ֥ים רַבִּֽים
verses.translit: vy'mr shm'y lmlkh tvb hdbr kh'shr dbr 'dny hmlkh khn y'shh 'bdkh vyshb shm'y byrvshlm ymym rbym
verses.translation: And Shimei said unto the king, The saying is good: as my lord the king hath said, so will thy servant do. And Shimei dwelt in Jerusalem many days.

verses.original: וַ/יְהִ֗י מִ/קֵּץ֙ שָׁלֹ֣שׁ שָׁנִ֔ים וַ/יִּבְרְח֤וּ שְׁנֵֽי עֲבָדִים֙ לְ/שִׁמְעִ֔י אֶל אָכִ֥ישׁ בֶּֽן מַעֲכָ֖ה מֶ֣לֶךְ גַּ֑ת וַ/יַּגִּ֤ידוּ לְ/שִׁמְעִי֙ לֵ/אמֹ֔ר הִנֵּ֥ה עֲבָדֶ֖י/ךָ בְּ/גַֽת
verses.translit: vyhy mqts shlsh shnym vybrchv shny 'bdym lshm'y 'l 'khysh bn m'khh mlkh gt vygydv lshm'y l'mr hnh 'bdykh bgt
verses.translation: And it came to pass at the end of three years, that two of the servants of Shimei ran away unto Achish son of Maachah king of Gath. And they told Shimei, saying, Behold, thy servants be in Gath.

verses.original: וַ/יָּ֣קָם שִׁמְעִ֗י וַֽ/יַּחֲבֹשׁ֙ אֶת חֲמֹר֔/וֹ וַ/יֵּ֤לֶךְ גַּ֨תָ/ה֙ אֶל אָכִ֔ישׁ לְ/בַקֵּ֖שׁ אֶת עֲבָדָ֑י/ו וַ/יֵּ֣לֶךְ שִׁמְעִ֔י וַ/יָּבֵ֥א אֶת עֲבָדָ֖י/ו מִ/גַּֽת
verses.translit: vyqm shm'y vychbsh 't chmrv vylkh gth 'l 'khysh lbqsh 't 'bdyv vylkh shm'y vyb' 't 'bdyv mgt
verses.translation: And Shimei arose, and saddled his ass, and went to Gath to Achish to seek his servants: and Shimei went, and brought his servants from Gath.

verses.original: וַ/יֻּגַּ֖ד לִ/שְׁלֹמֹ֑ה כִּי הָלַ֨ךְ שִׁמְעִ֧י מִ/ירוּשָׁלִַ֛ם גַּ֖ת וַ/יָּשֹֽׁב
verses.translit: vygd lshlmh khy hlkh shm'y myrvshlm gt vyshb
verses.translation: And it was told Solomon that Shimei had gone from Jerusalem to Gath, and was come again.

verses.original: וַ/יִּשְׁלַ֨ח הַ/מֶּ֜לֶךְ וַ/יִּקְרָ֣א לְ/שִׁמְעִ֗י וַ/יֹּ֨אמֶר אֵלָ֜י/ו הֲ/ל֧וֹא הִשְׁבַּעְתִּ֣י/ךָ בַֽ/יהוָ֗ה וָ/אָעִ֤ד בְּ/ךָ֙ לֵ/אמֹ֔ר בְּ/י֣וֹם צֵאתְ/ךָ֗ וְ/הָֽלַכְתָּ֙ אָ֣נֶה וָ/אָ֔נָה יָדֹ֥עַ תֵּדַ֖ע כִּ֣י מ֣וֹת תָּמ֑וּת וַ/תֹּ֧אמֶר אֵלַ֛/י ט֥וֹב הַ/דָּבָ֖ר שָׁמָֽעְתִּי
verses.translit: vyshlch hmlkh vyqr' lshm'y vy'mr 'lyv hlv' hshb'tykh byhvh v''d bkh l'mr byvm ts'tkh vhlkht 'nh v'nh yd' td' khy mvt tmvt vt'mr 'ly tvb hdbr shm'ty
verses.translation: And the king sent and called for Shimei, and said unto him, Did I not make thee to swear by the LORD , and protested unto thee, saying, Know for a certain, on the day thou goest out, and walkest abroad any whither, that thou shalt surely die? and thou saidst unto me, The word that I have heard is good.

verses.original: וּ/מַדּ֕וּעַ לֹ֣א שָׁמַ֔רְתָּ אֵ֖ת שְׁבֻעַ֣ת יְהוָ֑ה וְ/אֶת הַ/מִּצְוָ֖ה אֲשֶׁר צִוִּ֥יתִי עָלֶֽי/ךָ
verses.translit: vmdv' l' shmrt 't shb't yhvh v't hmtsvh 'shr tsvyty 'lykh
verses.translation: Why then hast thou not kept the oath of the LORD , and the commandment that I have charged thee with?

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֨אמֶר הַ/מֶּ֜לֶךְ אֶל שִׁמְעִ֗י אַתָּ֤ה יָדַ֨עְתָּ֙ אֵ֣ת כָּל הָ/רָעָ֗ה אֲשֶׁ֤ר יָדַע֙ לְבָ֣בְ/ךָ֔ אֲשֶׁ֥ר עָשִׂ֖יתָ לְ/דָוִ֣ד אָבִ֑/י וְ/הֵשִׁ֧יב יְהוָ֛ה אֶת רָעָתְ/ךָ֖ בְּ/רֹאשֶֽׁ/ךָ
verses.translit: vy'mr hmlkh 'l shm'y 'th yd't 't khl hr'h 'shr yd' lbbkh 'shr 'shyt ldvd 'by vhshyb yhvh 't r'tkh br'shkh
verses.translation: The king said moreover to Shimei, Thou knowest all the wickedness which thine heart is privy to, that thou didst to David my father: therefore the LORD shall return thy wickedness upon thine own head;

verses.original: וְ/הַ/מֶּ֥לֶךְ שְׁלֹמֹ֖ה בָּר֑וּךְ וְ/כִסֵּ֣א דָוִ֗ד יִהְיֶ֥ה נָכ֛וֹן לִ/פְנֵ֥י יְהוָ֖ה עַד עוֹלָֽם
verses.translit: vhmlkh shlmh brvkh vkhs' dvd yhyh nkhvn lpny yhvh 'd 'vlm
verses.translation: And king Solomon shall be blessed, and the throne of David shall be established before the LORD for ever.

verses.original: וַ/יְצַ֣ו הַ/מֶּ֗לֶךְ אֶת בְּנָיָ֨הוּ֙ בֶּן יְה֣וֹיָדָ֔ע וַ/יֵּצֵ֕א וַ/יִּפְגַּע בּ֖/וֹ וַ/יָּמֹ֑ת וְ/הַ/מַּמְלָכָ֥ה נָכ֖וֹנָה בְּ/יַד שְׁלֹמֹֽה
verses.translit: vytsv hmlkh 't bnyhv bn yhvyd' vyts' vypg' bv vymt vhmmlkhh nkhvnh byd shlmh
verses.translation: So the king commanded Benaiah the son of Jehoiada; which went out, and fell upon him, that he died. And the kingdom was established in the hand of Solomon.

verses.original: וַ/יִּתְחַתֵּ֣ן שְׁלֹמֹ֔ה אֶת פַּרְעֹ֖ה מֶ֣לֶךְ מִצְרָ֑יִם וַ/יִּקַּ֣ח אֶת בַּת פַּרְעֹ֗ה וַ/יְבִיאֶ֨/הָ֙ אֶל עִ֣יר דָּוִ֔ד עַ֣ד כַּלֹּת֗/וֹ לִ/בְנ֤וֹת אֶת בֵּית/וֹ֙ וְ/אֶת בֵּ֣ית יְהוָ֔ה וְ/אֶת חוֹמַ֥ת יְרוּשָׁלִַ֖ם סָבִֽיב
verses.translit: vytchtn shlmh 't pr'h mlkh mtsrym vyqch 't bt pr'h vyby'h 'l 'yr dvd 'd khltv lbnvt 't bytv v't byt yhvh v't chvmt yrvshlm sbyb
verses.translation: And Solomon made affinity with Pharaoh king of Egypt, and took Pharaoh’s daughter, and brought her into the city of David, until he had made an end of building his own house, and the house of the LORD , and the wall of Jerusalem round about.

verses.original: רַ֣ק הָ/עָ֔ם מְזַבְּחִ֖ים בַּ/בָּמ֑וֹת כִּ֠י לֹא נִבְנָ֥ה בַ֨יִת֙ לְ/שֵׁ֣ם יְהוָ֔ה עַ֖ד הַ/יָּמִ֥ים הָ/הֵֽם
verses.translit: rq h'm mzbchym bbmvt khy l' nbnh byt lshm yhvh 'd hymym hhm
verses.translation: Only the people sacrificed in high places, because there was no house built unto the name of the LORD , until those days.

verses.original: וַ/יֶּאֱהַ֤ב שְׁלֹמֹה֙ אֶת יְהוָ֔ה לָ/לֶ֕כֶת בְּ/חֻקּ֖וֹת דָּוִ֣ד אָבִ֑י/ו רַ֚ק בַּ/בָּמ֔וֹת ה֥וּא מְזַבֵּ֖חַ וּ/מַקְטִֽיר
verses.translit: vy'hb shlmh 't yhvh llkht bchqvt dvd 'byv rq bbmvt hv' mzbch vmqtyr
verses.translation: And Solomon loved the LORD , walking in the statutes of David his father: only he sacrificed and burnt incense in high places.

verses.original: וַ/יֵּ֨לֶךְ הַ/מֶּ֤לֶךְ גִּבְעֹ֨נָ/ה֙ לִ/זְבֹּ֣חַ שָׁ֔ם כִּ֥י הִ֖יא הַ/בָּמָ֣ה הַ/גְּדוֹלָ֑ה אֶ֤לֶף עֹלוֹת֙ יַעֲלֶ֣ה שְׁלֹמֹ֔ה עַ֖ל הַ/מִּזְבֵּ֥חַ הַ/הֽוּא
verses.translit: vylkh hmlkh gb'nh lzbch shm khy hy' hbmh hgdvlh 'lf 'lvt y'lh shlmh 'l hmzbch hhv'
verses.translation: And the king went to Gibeon to sacrifice there; for that was the great high place: a thousand burnt offerings did Solomon offer upon that altar.

verses.original: בְּ/גִבְע֗וֹן נִרְאָ֧ה יְהֹוָ֛ה אֶל שְׁלֹמֹ֖ה בַּ/חֲל֣וֹם הַ/לָּ֑יְלָה וַ/יֹּ֣אמֶר אֱלֹהִ֔ים שְׁאַ֖ל מָ֥ה אֶתֶּן לָֽ/ךְ
verses.translit: bgb'vn nr'h yhvh 'l shlmh bchlvm hlylh vy'mr 'lhym sh'l mh 'tn lkh
verses.translation: In Gibeon the LORD appeared to Solomon in a dream by night: and God said, Ask what I shall give thee.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֣אמֶר שְׁלֹמֹ֗ה אַתָּ֨ה עָשִׂ֜יתָ עִם עַבְדְּ/ךָ֙ דָוִ֣ד אָבִ/י֮ חֶ֣סֶד גָּדוֹל֒ כַּ/אֲשֶׁר֩ הָלַ֨ךְ לְ/פָנֶ֜י/ךָ בֶּ/אֱמֶ֧ת וּ/בִ/צְדָקָ֛ה וּ/בְ/יִשְׁרַ֥ת לֵבָ֖ב עִמָּ֑/ךְ וַ/תִּשְׁמָר ל֗/וֹ אֶת הַ/חֶ֤סֶד הַ/גָּדוֹל֙ הַ/זֶּ֔ה וַ/תִּתֶּן ל֥/וֹ בֵ֛ן יֹשֵׁ֥ב עַל כִּסְא֖/וֹ כַּ/יּ֥וֹם הַ/זֶּֽה
verses.translit: vy'mr shlmh 'th 'shyt 'm 'bdkh dvd 'by chsd gdvl kh'shr hlkh lpnykh b'mt vbtsdqh vbyshrt lbb 'mkh vtshmr lv 't hchsd hgdvl hzh vttn lv bn yshb 'l khs'v khyvm hzh
verses.translation: And Solomon said, Thou hast shewed unto thy servant David my father great mercy, according as he walked before thee in truth, and in righteousness, and in uprightness of heart with thee; and thou hast kept for him this great kindness, that thou hast given him a son to sit on his throne, as it is this day.

verses.original: וְ/עַתָּה֙ יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהָ֔/י אַתָּה֙ הִמְלַ֣כְתָּ אֶֽת עַבְדְּ/ךָ֔ תַּ֖חַת דָּוִ֣ד אָבִ֑/י וְ/אָֽנֹכִי֙ נַ֣עַר קָטֹ֔ן לֹ֥א אֵדַ֖ע צֵ֥את וָ/בֹֽא
verses.translit: v'th yhvh 'lhy 'th hmlkht 't 'bdkh tcht dvd 'by v'nkhy n'r qtn l' 'd' ts't vb'
verses.translation: And now, O LORD my God, thou hast made thy servant king instead of David my father: and I am but a little child: I know not how to go out or come in.

verses.original: וְ/עַ֨בְדְּ/ךָ֔ בְּ/ת֥וֹךְ עַמְּ/ךָ֖ אֲשֶׁ֣ר בָּחָ֑רְתָּ עַם רָ֕ב אֲשֶׁ֧ר לֹֽא יִמָּנֶ֛ה וְ/לֹ֥א יִסָּפֵ֖ר מֵ/רֹֽב
verses.translit: v'bdkh btvkh 'mkh 'shr bchrt 'm rb 'shr l' ymnh vl' yspr mrb
verses.translation: And thy servant is in the midst of thy people which thou hast chosen, a great people, that cannot be numbered nor counted for multitude.

verses.original: וְ/נָתַתָּ֨ לְ/עַבְדְּ/ךָ֜ לֵ֤ב שֹׁמֵ֨עַ֙ לִ/שְׁפֹּ֣ט אֶֽת עַמְּ/ךָ֔ לְ/הָבִ֖ין בֵּֽין ט֣וֹב לְ/רָ֑ע כִּ֣י מִ֤י יוּכַל֙ לִ/שְׁפֹּ֔ט אֶת עַמְּ/ךָ֥ הַ/כָּבֵ֖ד הַ/זֶּֽה
verses.translit: vntt l'bdkh lb shm' lshpt 't 'mkh lhbyn byn tvb lr' khy my yvkhl lshpt 't 'mkh hkhbd hzh
verses.translation: Give therefore thy servant an understanding heart to judge thy people, that I may discern between good and bad: for who is able to judge this thy so great a people?

verses.original: וַ/יִּיטַ֥ב הַ/דָּבָ֖ר בְּ/עֵינֵ֣י אֲדֹנָ֑/י כִּ֚י שָׁאַ֣ל שְׁלֹמֹ֔ה אֶת הַ/דָּבָ֖ר הַ/זֶּֽה
verses.translit: vyytb hdbr b'yny 'dny khy sh'l shlmh 't hdbr hzh
verses.translation: And the speech pleased the Lord, that Solomon had asked this thing.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֨אמֶר אֱלֹהִ֜ים אֵלָ֗י/ו יַעַן֩ אֲשֶׁ֨ר שָׁאַ֜לְתָּ אֶת הַ/דָּבָ֣ר הַ/זֶּ֗ה וְ/לֹֽא שָׁאַ֨לְתָּ לְּ/ךָ֜ יָמִ֣ים רַבִּ֗ים וְ/לֹֽא שָׁאַ֤לְתָּ לְּ/ךָ֙ עֹ֔שֶׁר וְ/לֹ֥א שָׁאַ֖לְתָּ נֶ֣פֶשׁ אֹיְבֶ֑י/ךָ וְ/שָׁאַ֧לְתָּ לְּ/ךָ֛ הָבִ֖ין לִ/שְׁמֹ֥עַ מִשְׁפָּֽט
verses.translit: vy'mr 'lhym 'lyv y'n 'shr sh'lt 't hdbr hzh vl' sh'lt lkh ymym rbym vl' sh'lt lkh 'shr vl' sh'lt npsh 'ybykh vsh'lt lkh hbyn lshm' mshpt
verses.translation: And God said unto him, Because thou hast asked this thing, and hast not asked for thyself long life; neither hast asked riches for thyself, nor hast asked the life of thine enemies; but hast asked for thyself understanding to discern judgment;

verses.original: הִנֵּ֥ה עָשִׂ֖יתִי כִּ/דְבָרֶ֑י/ךָ הִנֵּ֣ה נָתַ֣תִּי לְ/ךָ֗ לֵ֚ב חָכָ֣ם וְ/נָב֔וֹן אֲשֶׁ֤ר כָּמ֨וֹ/ךָ֙ לֹא הָיָ֣ה לְ/פָנֶ֔י/ךָ וְ/אַחֲרֶ֖י/ךָ לֹא יָק֥וּם כָּמֽוֹ/ךָ
verses.translit: hnh 'shyty khdbrykh hnh ntty lkh lb chkhm vnbvn 'shr khmvkh l' hyh lpnykh v'chrykh l' yqvm khmvkh
verses.translation: Behold, I have done according to thy words: lo, I have given thee a wise and an understanding heart; so that there was none like thee before thee, neither after thee shall any arise like unto thee.

verses.original: וְ/גַ֨ם אֲשֶׁ֤ר לֹֽא שָׁאַ֨לְתָּ֙ נָתַ֣תִּי לָ֔/ךְ גַּם עֹ֖שֶׁר גַּם כָּב֑וֹד אֲ֠שֶׁר לֹא הָיָ֨ה כָמ֥וֹ/ךָ אִ֛ישׁ בַּ/מְּלָכִ֖ים כָּל יָמֶֽי/ךָ
verses.translit: vgm 'shr l' sh'lt ntty lkh gm 'shr gm khbvd 'shr l' hyh khmvkh 'ysh bmlkhym khl ymykh
verses.translation: And I have also given thee that which thou hast not asked, both riches, and honour: so that there shall not be any among the kings like unto thee all thy days.

verses.original: וְ/אִ֣ם תֵּלֵ֣ךְ בִּ/דְרָכַ֗/י לִ/שְׁמֹ֤ר חֻקַּ/י֙ וּ/מִצְוֺתַ֔/י כַּ/אֲשֶׁ֥ר הָלַ֖ךְ דָּוִ֣יד אָבִ֑י/ךָ וְ/הַאַרַכְתִּ֖י אֶת יָמֶֽי/ךָ
verses.translit: v'm tlkh bdrkhy lshmr chqy vmtsvty kh'shr hlkh dvyd 'bykh vh'rkhty 't ymykh
verses.translation: And if thou wilt walk in my ways, to keep my statutes and my commandments, as thy father David did walk, then I will lengthen thy days.

verses.original: וַ/יִּקַ֥ץ שְׁלֹמֹ֖ה וְ/הִנֵּ֣ה חֲל֑וֹם וַ/יָּב֨וֹא יְרוּשָׁלִַ֜ם וַֽ/יַּעֲמֹ֣ד לִ/פְנֵ֣י אֲר֣וֹן בְּרִית אֲדֹנָ֗/י וַ/יַּ֤עַל עֹלוֹת֙ וַ/יַּ֣עַשׂ שְׁלָמִ֔ים וַ/יַּ֥עַשׂ מִשְׁתֶּ֖ה לְ/כָל עֲבָדָֽי/ו
verses.translit: vyqts shlmh vhnh chlvm vybv' yrvshlm vy'md lpny 'rvn bryt 'dny vy'l 'lvt vy'sh shlmym vy'sh mshth lkhl 'bdyv
verses.translation: And Solomon awoke; and, behold, it was a dream. And he came to Jerusalem, and stood before the ark of the covenant of the LORD , and offered up burnt offerings, and offered peace offerings, and made a feast to all his servants.

verses.original: אָ֣ז תָּבֹ֗אנָה שְׁתַּ֛יִם נָשִׁ֥ים זֹנ֖וֹת אֶל הַ/מֶּ֑לֶךְ וַֽ/תַּעֲמֹ֖דְנָה לְ/פָנָֽי/ו
verses.translit: 'z tb'nh shtym nshym znvt 'l hmlkh vt'mdnh lpnyv
verses.translation: Then came there two women, that were harlots, unto the king, and stood before him.

verses.original: וַ/תֹּ֜אמֶר הָ/אִשָּׁ֤ה הָֽ/אַחַת֙ בִּ֣י אֲדֹנִ֔/י אֲנִי֙ וְ/הָ/אִשָּׁ֣ה הַ/זֹּ֔את יֹשְׁבֹ֖ת בְּ/בַ֣יִת אֶחָ֑ד וָ/אֵלֵ֥ד עִמָּ֖/הּ בַּ/בָּֽיִת
verses.translit: vt'mr h'shh h'cht by 'dny 'ny vh'shh hz't yshbt bbyt 'chd v'ld 'mh bbyt
verses.translation: And the one woman said, O my lord, I and this woman dwell in one house; and I was delivered of a child with her in the house.

verses.original: וַ/יְהִ֞י בַּ/יּ֤וֹם הַ/שְּׁלִישִׁי֙ לְ/לִדְתִּ֔/י וַ/תֵּ֖לֶד גַּם הָ/אִשָּׁ֣ה הַ/זֹּ֑את וַ/אֲנַ֣חְנוּ יַחְדָּ֗ו אֵֽין זָ֤ר אִתָּ֨/נוּ֙ בַּ/בַּ֔יִת זוּלָתִ֥י שְׁתַּֽיִם אֲנַ֖חְנוּ בַּ/בָּֽיִת
verses.translit: vyhy byvm hshlyshy lldty vtld gm h'shh hz't v'nchnv ychdv 'yn zr 'tnv bbyt zvlty shtym 'nchnv bbyt
verses.translation: And it came to pass the third day after that I was delivered, that this woman was delivered also: and we were together; there was no stranger with us in the house, save we two in the house.

verses.original: וַ/יָּ֛מָת בֶּן הָ/אִשָּׁ֥ה הַ/זֹּ֖את לָ֑יְלָה אֲשֶׁ֥ר שָׁכְבָ֖ה עָלָֽי/ו
verses.translit: vymt bn h'shh hz't lylh 'shr shkhbh 'lyv
verses.translation: And this woman’s child died in the night; because she overlaid it.

verses.original: וַ/תָּקָם֩ בְּ/ת֨וֹךְ הַ/לַּ֜יְלָה וַ/תִּקַּ֧ח אֶת בְּנִ֣/י מֵֽ/אֶצְלִ֗/י וַ/אֲמָֽתְ/ךָ֙ יְשֵׁנָ֔ה וַ/תַּשְׁכִּיבֵ֖/הוּ בְּ/חֵיקָ֑/הּ וְ/אֶת בְּנָ֥/הּ הַ/מֵּ֖ת הִשְׁכִּ֥יבָה בְ/חֵיקִֽ/י
verses.translit: vtqm btvkh hlylh vtqch 't bny m'tsly v'mtkh yshnh vtshkhybhv bchyqh v't bnh hmt hshkhybh bchyqy
verses.translation: And she arose at midnight, and took my son from beside me, while thine handmaid slept, and laid it in her bosom, and laid her dead child in my bosom.

verses.original: וָ/אָקֻ֥ם בַּ/בֹּ֛קֶר לְ/הֵינִ֥יק אֶת בְּנִ֖/י וְ/הִנֵּה מֵ֑ת וָ/אֶתְבּוֹנֵ֤ן אֵלָי/ו֙ בַּ/בֹּ֔קֶר וְ/הִנֵּ֛ה לֹֽא הָיָ֥ה בְנִ֖/י אֲשֶׁ֥ר יָלָֽדְתִּי
verses.translit: v'qm bbqr lhynyq 't bny vhnh mt v'tbvnn 'lyv bbqr vhnh l' hyh bny 'shr yldty
verses.translation: And when I rose in the morning to give my child suck, behold, it was dead: but when I had considered it in the morning, behold, it was not my son, which I did bear.

verses.original: וַ/תֹּאמֶר֩ הָ/אִשָּׁ֨ה הָ/אַחֶ֜רֶת לֹ֣א כִ֗י בְּנִ֤/י הַ/חַי֙ וּ/בְנֵ֣/ךְ הַ/מֵּ֔ת וְ/זֹ֤את אֹמֶ֨רֶת֙ לֹ֣א כִ֔י בְּנֵ֥/ךְ הַ/מֵּ֖ת וּ/בְנִ֣/י הֶ/חָ֑י וַ/תְּדַבֵּ֖רְנָה לִ/פְנֵ֥י הַ/מֶּֽלֶךְ
verses.translit: vt'mr h'shh h'chrt l' khy bny hchy vbnkh hmt vz't 'mrt l' khy bnkh hmt vbny hchy vtdbrnh lpny hmlkh
verses.translation: And the other woman said, Nay; but the living is my son, and the dead is thy son. And this said, No; but the dead is thy son, and the living is my son. Thus they spake before the king.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֣אמֶר הַ/מֶּ֔לֶךְ זֹ֣את אֹמֶ֔רֶת זֶה בְּנִ֥/י הַ/חַ֖י וּ/בְנֵ֣/ךְ הַ/מֵּ֑ת וְ/זֹ֤את אֹמֶ֨רֶת֙ לֹ֣א כִ֔י בְּנֵ֥/ךְ הַ/מֵּ֖ת וּ/בְנִ֥/י הֶ/חָֽי
verses.translit: vy'mr hmlkh z't 'mrt zh bny hchy vbnkh hmt vz't 'mrt l' khy bnkh hmt vbny hchy
verses.translation: Then said the king, The one saith, This is my son that liveth, and thy son is the dead: and the other saith, Nay; but thy son is the dead, and my son is the living.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֥אמֶר הַ/מֶּ֖לֶךְ קְח֣וּ לִ/י חָ֑רֶב וַ/יָּבִ֥אוּ הַ/חֶ֖רֶב לִ/פְנֵ֥י הַ/מֶּֽלֶךְ
verses.translit: vy'mr hmlkh qchv ly chrb vyb'v hchrb lpny hmlkh
verses.translation: And the king said, Bring me a sword. And they brought a sword before the king.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֣אמֶר הַ/מֶּ֔לֶךְ גִּזְר֛וּ אֶת הַ/יֶּ֥לֶד הַ/חַ֖י לִ/שְׁנָ֑יִם וּ/תְנ֤וּ אֶֽת הַ/חֲצִי֙ לְ/אַחַ֔ת וְ/אֶֽת הַ/חֲצִ֖י לְ/אֶחָֽת
verses.translit: vy'mr hmlkh gzrv 't hyld hchy lshnym vtnv 't hchtsy l'cht v't hchtsy l'cht
verses.translation: And the king said, Divide the living child in two, and give half to the one, and half to the other.

verses.original: וַ/תֹּ֣אמֶר הָ/אִשָּׁה֩ אֲשֶׁר בְּנָ֨/הּ הַ/חַ֜י אֶל הַ/מֶּ֗לֶךְ כִּֽי נִכְמְר֣וּ רַחֲמֶי/הָ֮ עַל בְּנָ/הּ֒ וַ/תֹּ֣אמֶר בִּ֣י אֲדֹנִ֗/י תְּנוּ לָ/הּ֙ אֶת הַ/יָּל֣וּד הַ/חַ֔י וְ/הָמֵ֖ת אַל תְּמִיתֻ֑/הוּ וְ/זֹ֣את אֹמֶ֗רֶת גַּם לִ֥/י גַם לָ֛/ךְ לֹ֥א יִהְיֶ֖ה גְּזֹֽרוּ
verses.translit: vt'mr h'shh 'shr bnh hchy 'l hmlkh khy nkhmrv rchmyh 'l bnh vt'mr by 'dny tnv lh 't hylvd hchy vhmt 'l tmythv vz't 'mrt gm ly gm lkh l' yhyh gzrv
verses.translation: Then spake the woman whose the living child was unto the king, for her bowels yearned upon her son, and she said, O my lord, give her the living child, and in no wise slay it. But the other said, Let it be neither mine nor thine, but divide it .

verses.original: וַ/יַּ֨עַן הַ/מֶּ֜לֶךְ וַ/יֹּ֗אמֶר תְּנוּ לָ/הּ֙ אֶת הַ/יָּל֣וּד הַ/חַ֔י וְ/הָמֵ֖ת לֹ֣א תְמִיתֻ֑/הוּ הִ֖יא אִמּֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: vy'n hmlkh vy'mr tnv lh 't hylvd hchy vhmt l' tmythv hy' 'mv
verses.translation: Then the king answered and said, Give her the living child, and in no wise slay it: she is the mother thereof.

verses.original: וַ/יִּשְׁמְע֣וּ כָל יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל אֶת הַ/מִּשְׁפָּט֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר שָׁפַ֣ט הַ/מֶּ֔לֶךְ וַ/יִּֽרְא֖וּ מִ/פְּנֵ֣י הַ/מֶּ֑לֶךְ כִּ֣י רָא֔וּ כִּֽי חָכְמַ֧ת אֱלֹהִ֛ים בְּ/קִרְבּ֖/וֹ לַ/עֲשׂ֥וֹת מִשְׁפָּֽט
verses.translit: vyshm'v khl yshr'l 't hmshpt 'shr shpt hmlkh vyr'v mpny hmlkh khy r'v khy chkhmt 'lhym bqrbv l'shvt mshpt
verses.translation: And all Israel heard of the judgment which the king had judged; and they feared the king: for they saw that the wisdom of God was in him, to do judgment.

verses.original: וַֽ/יְהִי֙ הַ/מֶּ֣לֶךְ שְׁלֹמֹ֔ה מֶ֖לֶךְ עַל כָּל יִשְׂרָאֵֽל
verses.translit: vyhy hmlkh shlmh mlkh 'l khl yshr'l
verses.translation: So king Solomon was king over all Israel.

verses.original: וְ/אֵ֥לֶּה הַ/שָּׂרִ֖ים אֲשֶׁר ל֑/וֹ עֲזַרְיָ֥הוּ בֶן צָד֖וֹק הַ/כֹּהֵֽן
verses.translit: v'lh hshrym 'shr lv 'zryhv bn tsdvq hkhhn
verses.translation: And these were the princes which he had; Azariah the son of Zadok the priest,

verses.original: אֱלִיחֹ֧רֶף וַ/אֲחִיָּ֛ה בְּנֵ֥י שִׁישָׁ֖א סֹפְרִ֑ים יְהוֹשָׁפָ֥ט בֶּן אֲחִיל֖וּד הַ/מַּזְכִּֽיר
verses.translit: 'lychrf v'chyh bny shysh' sprym yhvshpt bn 'chylvd hmzkhyr
verses.translation: Elihoreph and Ahiah, the sons of Shisha, scribes; Jehoshaphat the son of Ahilud, the recorder.

verses.original: וּ/בְנָיָ֥הוּ בֶן יְהוֹיָדָ֖ע עַל הַ/צָּבָ֑א וְ/צָד֥וֹק וְ/אֶבְיָתָ֖ר כֹּהֲנִֽים
verses.translit: vbnyhv bn yhvyd' 'l htsb' vtsdvq v'bytr khhnym
verses.translation: And Benaiah the son of Jehoiada was over the host: and Zadok and Abiathar were the priests:

verses.original: וַ/עֲזַרְיָ֥הוּ בֶן נָתָ֖ן עַל הַ/נִּצָּבִ֑ים וְ/זָב֧וּד בֶּן נָתָ֛ן כֹּהֵ֖ן רֵעֶ֥ה הַ/מֶּֽלֶךְ
verses.translit: v'zryhv bn ntn 'l hntsbym vzbvd bn ntn khhn r'h hmlkh
verses.translation: And Azariah the son of Nathan was over the officers: and Zabud the son of Nathan was principal officer, and the king’s friend:

verses.original: וַ/אֲחִישָׁ֖ר עַל הַ/בָּ֑יִת וַ/אֲדֹנִירָ֥ם בֶּן עַבְדָּ֖א עַל הַ/מַּֽס
verses.translit: v'chyshr 'l hbyt v'dnyrm bn 'bd' 'l hms
verses.translation: And Ahishar was over the household: and Adoniram the son of Abda was over the tribute.

verses.original: וְ/לִ/שְׁלֹמֹ֞ה שְׁנֵים עָשָׂ֤ר נִצָּבִים֙ עַל כָּל יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל וְ/כִלְכְּל֥וּ אֶת הַ/מֶּ֖לֶךְ וְ/אֶת בֵּית֑/וֹ חֹ֧דֶשׁ בַּ/שָּׁנָ֛ה יִהְיֶ֥ה עַל אחד הָ/אֶחָ֖ד לְ/כַלְכֵּֽל
verses.translit: vlshlmh shnym 'shr ntsbym 'l khl yshr'l vkhlkhlv 't hmlkh v't bytv chdsh bshnh yhyh 'l 'chd h'chd lkhlkhl
verses.translation: And Solomon had twelve officers over all Israel, which provided victuals for the king and his household: each man his month in a year made provision.

verses.original: וְ/אֵ֣לֶּה שְׁמוֹתָ֔/ם בֶּן ח֖וּר בְּ/הַ֥ר אֶפְרָֽיִם
verses.translit: v'lh shmvtm bn chvr bhr 'prym
verses.translation: And these are their names: The son of Hur, in mount Ephraim:

verses.original: בֶּן דֶּ֛קֶר בְּ/מָקַ֥ץ וּ/בְ/שַֽׁעַלְבִ֖ים וּ/בֵ֣ית שָׁ֑מֶשׁ וְ/אֵיל֖וֹן בֵּ֥ית חָנָֽן
verses.translit: bn dqr bmqts vbsh'lbym vbyt shmsh v'ylvn byt chnn
verses.translation: The son of Dekar, in Makaz, and in Shaalbim, and Beth-shemesh, and Elon-beth-hanan:

verses.original: בֶּן חֶ֖סֶד בָּֽ/אֲרֻבּ֑וֹת ל֥/וֹ שֹׂכֹ֖ה וְ/כָל אֶ֥רֶץ חֵֽפֶר
verses.translit: bn chsd b'rbvt lv shkhh vkhl 'rts chpr
verses.translation: The son of Hesed, in Aruboth; to him pertained Sochoh, and all the land of Hepher:

verses.original: בֶּן אֲבִֽינָדָ֖ב כָּל נָ֣פַת דֹּ֑אר טָפַת֙ בַּת שְׁלֹמֹ֔ה הָ֥יְתָה לּ֖/וֹ לְ/אִשָּֽׁה
verses.translit: bn 'byndb khl npt d'r tpt bt shlmh hyth lv l'shh
verses.translation: The son of Abinadab, in all the region of Dor; which had Taphath the daughter of Solomon to wife:

verses.original: בַּֽעֲנָא֙ בֶּן אֲחִיל֔וּד תַּעְנַ֖ךְ וּ/מְגִדּ֑וֹ וְ/כָל בֵּ֣ית שְׁאָ֡ן אֲשֶׁר֩ אֵ֨צֶל צָרְתַ֜נָ/ה מִ/תַּ֣חַת לְ/יִזְרְעֶ֗אל מִ/בֵּ֤ית שְׁאָן֙ עַ֚ד אָבֵ֣ל מְחוֹלָ֔ה עַ֖ד מֵ/עֵ֥בֶר לְ/יָקְמֳעָֽם
verses.translit: b'n' bn 'chylvd t'nkh vmgdv vkhl byt sh'n 'shr 'tsl tsrtnh mtcht lyzr''l mbyt sh'n 'd 'bl mchvlh 'd m'br lyqm'm
verses.translation: Baana the son of Ahilud; to him pertained Taanach and Megiddo, and all Beth-shean, which is by Zartanah beneath Jezreel, from Beth-shean to Abel-meholah, even unto the place that is beyond Jokneam:

verses.original: בֶּן גֶּ֖בֶר בְּ/רָמֹ֣ת גִּלְעָ֑ד ל֡/וֹ חַוֺּת֩ יָאִ֨יר בֶּן מְנַשֶּׁ֜ה אֲשֶׁ֣ר בַּ/גִּלְעָ֗ד ל֚/וֹ חֶ֤בֶל אַרְגֹּב֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר בַּ/בָּשָׁ֔ן שִׁשִּׁים֙ עָרִ֣ים גְּדֹל֔וֹת חוֹמָ֖ה וּ/בְרִ֥יחַ נְחֹֽשֶׁת
verses.translit: bn gbr brmt gl'd lv chvt y'yr bn mnshh 'shr bgl'd lv chbl 'rgb 'shr bbshn shshym 'rym gdlvt chvmh vbrych nchsht
verses.translation: The son of Geber, in Ramoth-gilead; to him pertained the towns of Jair the son of Manasseh, which are in Gilead; to him also pertained the region of Argob, which is in Bashan, threescore great cities with walls and brasen bars:

verses.original: אֲחִֽינָדָ֥ב בֶּן עִדֹּ֖א מַחֲנָֽיְמָ/ה
verses.translit: 'chyndb bn 'd' mchnymh
verses.translation: Ahinadab the son of Iddo had Mahanaim:

verses.original: אֲחִימַ֖עַץ בְּ/נַפְתָּלִ֑י גַּם ה֗וּא לָקַ֛ח אֶת בָּשְׂמַ֥ת בַּת שְׁלֹמֹ֖ה לְ/אִשָּֽׁה
verses.translit: 'chym'ts bnptly gm hv' lqch 't bshmt bt shlmh l'shh
verses.translation: Ahimaaz was in Naphtali; he also took Basmath the daughter of Solomon to wife:

verses.original: בַּֽעֲנָא֙ בֶּן חוּשָׁ֔י בְּ/אָשֵׁ֖ר וּ/בְעָלֽוֹת
verses.translit: b'n' bn chvshy b'shr vb'lvt
verses.translation: Baanah the son of Hushai was in Asher and in Aloth:

verses.original: יְהוֹשָׁפָ֥ט בֶּן פָּר֖וּחַ בְּ/יִשָׂשכָֽר
verses.translit: yhvshpt bn prvch byshshkhr
verses.translation: Jehoshaphat the son of Paruah, in Issachar:

verses.original: שִׁמְעִ֥י בֶן אֵלָ֖א בְּ/בִנְיָמִֽן
verses.translit: shm'y bn 'l' bbnymn
verses.translation: Shimei the son of Elah, in Benjamin:

verses.original: גֶּ֥בֶר בֶּן אֻרִ֖י בְּ/אֶ֣רֶץ גִּלְעָ֑ד אֶ֜רֶץ סִיח֣וֹן מֶ֣לֶךְ הָ/אֱמֹרִ֗י וְ/עֹג֙ מֶ֣לֶךְ הַ/בָּשָׁ֔ן וּ/נְצִ֥יב אֶחָ֖ד אֲשֶׁ֥ר בָּ/אָֽרֶץ
verses.translit: gbr bn 'ry b'rts gl'd 'rts sychvn mlkh h'mry v'g mlkh hbshn vntsyb 'chd 'shr b'rts
verses.translation: Geber the son of Uri was in the country of Gilead, in the country of Sihon king of the Amorites, and of Og king of Bashan; and he was the only officer which was in the land.

verses.original: יְהוּדָ֤ה וְ/יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ רַבִּ֔ים כַּ/ח֥וֹל אֲשֶׁר עַל הַ/יָּ֖ם לָ/רֹ֑ב אֹכְלִ֥ים וְ/שֹׁתִ֖ים וּ/שְׂמֵחִֽים
verses.translit: yhvdh vyshr'l rbym khchvl 'shr 'l hym lrb 'khlym vshtym vshmchym
verses.translation: Judah and Israel were many, as the sand which is by the sea in multitude, eating and drinking, and making merry.
And Solomon reigned over all kingdoms from the river unto the land of the Philistines, and unto the border of Egypt: they brought presents, and served Solomon all the days of his life.
And Solomon’s provision for one day was thirty measures of fine flour, and threescore measures of meal,
Ten fat oxen, and twenty oxen out of the pastures, and an hundred sheep, beside harts, and roebucks, and fallowdeer, and fatted fowl.
For he had dominion over all the region on this side the river, from Tiphsah even to Azzah, over all the kings on this side the river: and he had peace on all sides round about him.
And Judah and Israel dwelt safely, every man under his vine and under his fig tree, from Dan even to Beer-sheba, all the days of Solomon.
And Solomon had forty thousand stalls of horses for his chariots, and twelve thousand horsemen.
And those officers provided victual for king Solomon, and for all that came unto king Solomon’s table, every man in his month: they lacked nothing.
Barley also and straw for the horses and dromedaries brought they unto the place where the officers were, every man according to his charge.
And God gave Solomon wisdom and understanding exceeding much, and largeness of heart, even as the sand that is on the sea shore.
And Solomon’s wisdom excelled the wisdom of all the children of the east country, and all the wisdom of Egypt.
For he was wiser than all men; than Ethan the Ezrahite, and Heman, and Chalcol, and Darda, the sons of Mahol: and his fame was in all nations round about.
And he spake three thousand proverbs: and his songs were a thousand and five.
And he spake of trees, from the cedar tree that is in Lebanon even unto the hyssop that springeth out of the wall: he spake also of beasts, and of fowl, and of creeping things, and of fishes.
And there came of all people to hear the wisdom of Solomon, from all kings of the earth, which had heard of his wisdom.

verses.original: וּ/שְׁלֹמֹ֗ה הָיָ֤ה מוֹשֵׁל֙ בְּ/כָל הַ/מַּמְלָכ֔וֹת מִן הַ/נָּהָר֙ אֶ֣רֶץ פְּלִשְׁתִּ֔ים וְ/עַ֖ד גְּב֣וּל מִצְרָ֑יִם מַגִּשִׁ֥ים מִנְחָ֛ה וְ/עֹבְדִ֥ים אֶת שְׁלֹמֹ֖ה כָּל יְמֵ֥י חַיָּֽי/ו
verses.translit: vshlmh hyh mvshl bkhl hmmlkhvt mn hnhr 'rts plshtym v'd gbvl mtsrym mgshym mnchh v'bdym 't shlmh khl ymy chyyv
verses.translation: And Hiram king of Tyre sent his servants unto Solomon; for he had heard that they had anointed him king in the room of his father: for Hiram was ever a lover of David.

verses.original: וַ/יְהִ֥י לֶֽחֶם שְׁלֹמֹ֖ה לְ/י֣וֹם אֶחָ֑ד שְׁלֹשִׁ֥ים כֹּר֙ סֹ֔לֶת וְ/שִׁשִּׁ֥ים כֹּ֖ר קָֽמַח
verses.translit: vyhy lchm shlmh lyvm 'chd shlshym khr slt vshshym khr qmch
verses.translation: And Solomon sent to Hiram, saying,

verses.original: עֲשָׂרָ֨ה בָקָ֜ר בְּרִאִ֗ים וְ/עֶשְׂרִ֥ים בָּקָ֛ר רְעִ֖י וּ/מֵ֣אָה צֹ֑אן לְ֠/בַד מֵֽ/אַיָּ֤ל וּ/צְבִי֙ וְ/יַחְמ֔וּר וּ/בַרְבֻּרִ֖ים אֲבוּסִֽים
verses.translit: 'shrh bqr br'ym v'shrym bqr r'y vm'h ts'n lbd m'yl vtsby vychmvr vbrbrym 'bvsym
verses.translation: Thou knowest how that David my father could not build an house unto the name of the LORD his God for the wars which were about him on every side, until the LORD put them under the soles of his feet.

verses.original: כִּי ה֞וּא רֹדֶ֣ה בְּ/כָל עֵ֣בֶר הַ/נָּהָ֗ר מִ/תִּפְסַח֙ וְ/עַד עַזָּ֔ה בְּ/כָל מַלְכֵ֖י עֵ֣בֶר הַ/נָּהָ֑ר וְ/שָׁל֗וֹם הָ֥יָה ל֛/וֹ מִ/כָּל עֲבָרָ֖י/ו מִ/סָּבִֽיב
verses.translit: khy hv' rdh bkhl 'br hnhr mtpsch v'd 'zh bkhl mlkhy 'br hnhr vshlvm hyh lv mkhl 'bryv msbyb
verses.translation: But now the LORD my God hath given me rest on every side, so that there is neither adversary nor evil occurrent.

verses.original: וַ/יֵּשֶׁב֩ יְהוּדָ֨ה וְ/יִשְׂרָאֵ֜ל לָ/בֶ֗טַח אִ֣ישׁ תַּ֤חַת גַּפְנ/וֹ֙ וְ/תַ֣חַת תְּאֵֽנָת֔/וֹ מִ/דָּ֖ן וְ/עַד בְּאֵ֣ר שָׁ֑בַע כֹּ֖ל יְמֵ֥י שְׁלֹמֹֽה
verses.translit: vyshb yhvdh vyshr'l lbtch 'ysh tcht gpnv vtcht t'ntv mdn v'd b'r shb' khl ymy shlmh
verses.translation: And, behold, I purpose to build an house unto the name of the LORD my God, as the LORD spake unto David my father, saying, Thy son, whom I will set upon thy throne in thy room, he shall build an house unto my name.

verses.original: וַ/יְהִ֣י לִ/שְׁלֹמֹ֗ה אַרְבָּעִ֥ים אֶ֛לֶף אֻרְוֺ֥ת סוּסִ֖ים לְ/מֶרְכָּב֑/וֹ וּ/שְׁנֵים עָשָׂ֥ר אֶ֖לֶף פָּרָשִֽׁים
verses.translit: vyhy lshlmh 'rb'ym 'lf 'rvt svsym lmrkhbv vshnym 'shr 'lf prshym
verses.translation: Now therefore command thou that they hew me cedar trees out of Lebanon; and my servants shall be with thy servants: and unto thee will I give hire for thy servants according to all that thou shalt appoint: for thou knowest that there is not among us any that can skill to hew timber like unto the Sidonians.

verses.original: וְ/כִלְכְּלוּ֩ הַ/נִּצָּבִ֨ים הָ/אֵ֜לֶּה אֶת הַ/מֶּ֣לֶךְ שְׁלֹמֹ֗ה וְ/אֵ֧ת כָּל הַ/קָּרֵ֛ב אֶל שֻׁלְחַ֥ן הַ/מֶּֽלֶךְ שְׁלֹמֹ֖ה אִ֣ישׁ חָדְשׁ֑/וֹ לֹ֥א יְעַדְּר֖וּ דָּבָֽר
verses.translit: vkhlkhlv hntsbym h'lh 't hmlkh shlmh v't khl hqrb 'l shlchn hmlkh shlmh 'ysh chdshv l' y'drv dbr
verses.translation: And it came to pass, when Hiram heard the words of Solomon, that he rejoiced greatly, and said, Blessed be the LORD this day, which hath given unto David a wise son over this great people.

verses.original: וְ/הַ/שְּׂעֹרִ֣ים וְ/הַ/תֶּ֔בֶן לַ/סּוּסִ֖ים וְ/לָ/רָ֑כֶשׁ יָבִ֗אוּ אֶל הַ/מָּקוֹם֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר יִֽהְיֶה שָּׁ֔ם אִ֖ישׁ כְּ/מִשְׁפָּטֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: vhsh'rym vhtbn lsvsym vlrkhsh yb'v 'l hmqvm 'shr yhyh shm 'ysh khmshptv
verses.translation: And Hiram sent to Solomon, saying, I have considered the things which thou sentest to me for: and I will do all thy desire concerning timber of cedar, and concerning timber of fir.

verses.original: וַ/יִּתֵּן֩ אֱלֹהִ֨ים חָכְמָ֧ה לִ/שְׁלֹמֹ֛ה וּ/תְבוּנָ֖ה הַרְבֵּ֣ה מְאֹ֑ד וְ/רֹ֣חַב לֵ֔ב כַּ/ח֕וֹל אֲשֶׁ֖ר עַל שְׂפַ֥ת הַ/יָּֽם
verses.translit: vytn 'lhym chkhmh lshlmh vtbvnh hrbh m'd vrchb lb khchvl 'shr 'l shpt hym
verses.translation: My servants shall bring them down from Lebanon unto the sea: and I will convey them by sea in floats unto the place that thou shalt appoint me, and will cause them to be discharged there, and thou shalt receive them: and thou shalt accomplish my desire, in giving food for my household.

verses.original: וַ/תֵּ֨רֶב֙ חָכְמַ֣ת שְׁלֹמֹ֔ה מֵֽ/חָכְמַ֖ת כָּל בְּנֵי קֶ֑דֶם וּ/מִ/כֹּ֖ל חָכְמַ֥ת מִצְרָֽיִם
verses.translit: vtrb chkhmt shlmh mchkhmt khl bny qdm vmkhl chkhmt mtsrym
verses.translation: So Hiram gave Solomon cedar trees and fir trees according to all his desire.

verses.original: וַ/יֶּחְכַּם֮ מִ/כָּל הָֽ/אָדָם֒ מֵ/אֵיתָ֣ן הָ/אֶזְרָחִ֗י וְ/הֵימָ֧ן וְ/כַלְכֹּ֛ל וְ/דַרְדַּ֖ע בְּנֵ֣י מָח֑וֹל וַ/יְהִֽי שְׁמ֥/וֹ בְ/כָֽל הַ/גּוֹיִ֖ם סָבִֽיב
verses.translit: vychkhm mkhl h'dm m'ytn h'zrchy vhymn vkhlkhl vdrd' bny mchvl vyhy shmv bkhl hgvym sbyb
verses.translation: And Solomon gave Hiram twenty thousand measures of wheat for food to his household, and twenty measures of pure oil: thus gave Solomon to Hiram year by year.

verses.original: וַ/יְדַבֵּ֕ר שְׁלֹ֥שֶׁת אֲלָפִ֖ים מָשָׁ֑ל וַ/יְהִ֥י שִׁיר֖/וֹ חֲמִשָּׁ֥ה וָ/אָֽלֶף
verses.translit: vydbr shlsht 'lpym mshl vyhy shyrv chmshh v'lf
verses.translation: And the LORD gave Solomon wisdom, as he promised him: and there was peace between Hiram and Solomon; and they two made a league together.

verses.original: וַ/יְדַבֵּר֮ עַל הָֽ/עֵצִים֒ מִן הָ/אֶ֨רֶז֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר בַּ/לְּבָנ֔וֹן וְ/עַד֙ הָ/אֵז֔וֹב אֲשֶׁ֥ר יֹצֵ֖א בַּ/קִּ֑יר וַ/יְדַבֵּר֙ עַל הַ/בְּהֵמָ֣ה וְ/עַל הָ/ע֔וֹף וְ/עַל הָ/רֶ֖מֶשׂ וְ/עַל הַ/דָּגִֽים
verses.translit: vydbr 'l h'tsym mn h'rz 'shr blbnvn v'd h'zvb 'shr yts' bqyr vydbr 'l hbhmh v'l h'vf v'l hrmsh v'l hdgym
verses.translation: And king Solomon raised a levy out of all Israel; and the levy was thirty thousand men.

verses.original: וַ/יָּבֹ֨אוּ֙ מִ/כָּל הָ֣/עַמִּ֔ים לִ/שְׁמֹ֕עַ אֵ֖ת חָכְמַ֣ת שְׁלֹמֹ֑ה מֵ/אֵת֙ כָּל מַלְכֵ֣י הָ/אָ֔רֶץ אֲשֶׁ֥ר שָׁמְע֖וּ אֶת חָכְמָתֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: vyb'v mkhl h'mym lshm' 't chkhmt shlmh m't khl mlkhy h'rts 'shr shm'v 't chkhmtv
verses.translation: And he sent them to Lebanon, ten thousand a month by courses: a month they were in Lebanon, and two months at home: and Adoniram was over the levy.

verses.original: וַ֠/יִּשְׁלַח חִירָ֨ם מֶֽלֶךְ צ֤וֹר אֶת עֲבָדָי/ו֙ אֶל שְׁלֹמֹ֔ה כִּ֣י שָׁמַ֔ע כִּ֥י אֹת֛/וֹ מָשְׁח֥וּ לְ/מֶ֖לֶךְ תַּ֣חַת אָבִ֑י/הוּ כִּ֣י אֹהֵ֗ב הָיָ֥ה חִירָ֛ם לְ/דָוִ֖ד כָּל הַ/יָּמִֽים
verses.translit: vyshlch chyrm mlkh tsvr 't 'bdyv 'l shlmh khy shm' khy 'tv mshchv lmlkh tcht 'byhv khy 'hb hyh chyrm ldvd khl hymym
verses.translation: And Solomon had threescore and ten thousand that bare burdens, and fourscore thousand hewers in the mountains;

verses.original: וַ/יִּשְׁלַ֣ח שְׁלֹמֹ֔ה אֶל חִירָ֖ם לֵ/אמֹֽר
verses.translit: vyshlch shlmh 'l chyrm l'mr
verses.translation: Beside the chief of Solomon’s officers which were over the work, three thousand and three hundred, which ruled over the people that wrought in the work.

verses.original: אַתָּ֨ה יָדַ֜עְתָּ אֶת דָּוִ֣ד אָבִ֗/י כִּ֣י לֹ֤א יָכֹל֙ לִ/בְנ֣וֹת בַּ֗יִת לְ/שֵׁם֙ יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהָ֔י/ו מִ/פְּנֵ֥י הַ/מִּלְחָמָ֖ה אֲשֶׁ֣ר סְבָבֻ֑/הוּ עַ֤ד תֵּת יְהוָה֙ אֹתָ֔/ם תַּ֖חַת כַּפּ֥וֹת רגל/ו רַגְלָֽ/י
verses.translit: 'th yd't 't dvd 'by khy l' ykhl lbnvt byt lshm yhvh 'lhyv mpny hmlchmh 'shr sbbhv 'd tt yhvh 'tm tcht khpvt rglv rgly
verses.translation: And the king commanded, and they brought great stones, costly stones, and hewed stones, to lay the foundation of the house.

verses.original: וְ/עַתָּ֕ה הֵנִ֨יחַ יְהוָ֧ה אֱלֹהַ֛/י לִ֖/י מִ/סָּבִ֑יב אֵ֣ין שָׂטָ֔ן וְ/אֵ֖ין פֶּ֥גַע רָֽע
verses.translit: v'th hnych yhvh 'lhy ly msbyb 'yn shtn v'yn pg' r'
verses.translation: And Solomon’s builders and Hiram’s builders did hew them , and the stonesquarers: so they prepared timber and stones to build the house.

verses.original: וַ/יְהִ֣י בִ/שְׁמוֹנִ֣ים שָׁנָ֣ה וְ/אַרְבַּ֣ע מֵא֣וֹת שָׁנָ֡ה לְ/צֵ֣את בְּנֵֽי יִשְׂרָאֵ֣ל מֵ/אֶֽרֶץ מִצְרַיִם֩ בַּ/שָּׁנָ֨ה הָ/רְבִיעִ֜ית בְּ/חֹ֣דֶשׁ זִ֗ו ה֚וּא הַ/חֹ֣דֶשׁ הַ/שֵּׁנִ֔י לִ/מְלֹ֥ךְ שְׁלֹמֹ֖ה עַל יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וַ/יִּ֥בֶן הַ/בַּ֖יִת לַ/יהוָֽה
verses.translit: vyhy bshmvnym shnh v'rb' m'vt shnh lts't bny yshr'l m'rts mtsrym bshnh hrby'yt bchdsh zv hv' hchdsh hshny lmlkh shlmh 'l yshr'l vybn hbyt lyhvh
verses.translation: And it came to pass in the four hundred and eightieth year after the children of Israel were come out of the land of Egypt, in the fourth year of Solomon’s reign over Israel, in the month Zif, which is the second month, that he began to build the house of the LORD .

verses.original: וְ/הַ/בַּ֗יִת אֲשֶׁ֨ר בָּנָ֜ה הַ/מֶּ֤לֶךְ שְׁלֹמֹה֙ לַֽ/יהוָ֔ה שִׁשִּֽׁים אַמָּ֥ה אָרְכּ֖/וֹ וְ/עֶשְׂרִ֤ים רָחְבּ֑/וֹ וּ/שְׁלֹשִׁ֥ים אַמָּ֖ה קוֹמָתֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: vhbyt 'shr bnh hmlkh shlmh lyhvh shshym 'mh 'rkhv v'shrym rchbv vshlshym 'mh qvmtv
verses.translation: And the house which king Solomon built for the LORD , the length thereof was threescore cubits, and the breadth thereof twenty cubits , and the height thereof thirty cubits.

verses.original: וְ/הָ/אוּלָ֗ם עַל פְּנֵי֙ הֵיכַ֣ל הַ/בַּ֔יִת עֶשְׂרִ֣ים אַמָּה֙ אָרְכּ֔/וֹ עַל פְּנֵ֖י רֹ֣חַב הַ/בָּ֑יִת עֶ֧שֶׂר בָּ/אַמָּ֛ה רָחְבּ֖/וֹ עַל פְּנֵ֥י הַ/בָּֽיִת
verses.translit: vh'vlm 'l pny hykhl hbyt 'shrym 'mh 'rkhv 'l pny rchb hbyt 'shr b'mh rchbv 'l pny hbyt
verses.translation: And the porch before the temple of the house, twenty cubits was the length thereof, according to the breadth of the house; and ten cubits was the breadth thereof before the house.

verses.original: וַ/יַּ֣עַשׂ לַ/בָּ֔יִת חַלּוֹנֵ֖י שְׁקֻפִ֥ים אֲטֻמִֽים
verses.translit: vy'sh lbyt chlvny shqpym 'tmym
verses.translation: And for the house he made windows of narrow lights.

verses.original: וַ/יִּבֶן֩ עַל קִ֨יר הַ/בַּ֤יִת יצוע יָצִ֨יעַ֙ סָבִ֔יב אֶת קִיר֤וֹת הַ/בַּ֨יִת֙ סָבִ֔יב לַֽ/הֵיכָ֖ל וְ/לַ/דְּבִ֑יר וַ/יַּ֥עַשׂ צְלָע֖וֹת סָבִֽיב
verses.translit: vybn 'l qyr hbyt ytsv' ytsy' sbyb 't qyrvt hbyt sbyb lhykhl vldbyr vy'sh tsl'vt sbyb
verses.translation: And against the wall of the house he built chambers round about, against the walls of the house round about, both of the temple and of the oracle: and he made chambers round about:

verses.original: ה/יצוע הַ/יָּצִ֨יעַ הַ/תַּחְתֹּנָ֜ה חָמֵ֧שׁ בָּ/אַמָּ֣ה רָחְבָּ֗/הּ וְ/הַ/תִּֽיכֹנָה֙ שֵׁ֤שׁ בָּֽ/אַמָּה֙ רָחְבָּ֔/הּ וְ/הַ֨/שְּׁלִישִׁ֔ית שֶׁ֥בַע בָּ/אַמָּ֖ה רָחְבָּ֑/הּ כִּ֡י מִגְרָעוֹת֩ נָתַ֨ן לַ/בַּ֤יִת סָבִיב֙ ח֔וּצָ/ה לְ/בִלְתִּ֖י אֲחֹ֥ז בְּ/קִֽירוֹת הַ/בָּֽיִת
verses.translit: hytsv' hytsy' htchtnh chmsh b'mh rchbh vhtykhnh shsh b'mh rchbh vhshlyshyt shb' b'mh rchbh khy mgr'vt ntn lbyt sbyb chvtsh lblty 'chz bqyrvt hbyt
verses.translation: The nethermost chamber was five cubits broad, and the middle was six cubits broad, and the third was seven cubits broad: for without in the wall of the house he made narrowed rests round about, that the beams should not be fastened in the walls of the house.

verses.original: וְ/הַ/בַּ֨יִת֙ בְּ/הִבָּ֣נֹת֔/וֹ אֶֽבֶן שְׁלֵמָ֥ה מַסָּ֖ע נִבְנָ֑ה וּ/מַקָּב֤וֹת וְ/הַ/גַּרְזֶן֙ כָּל כְּלִ֣י בַרְזֶ֔ל לֹֽא נִשְׁמַ֥ע בַּ/בַּ֖יִת בְּ/הִבָּנֹתֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: vhbyt bhbntv 'bn shlmh ms' nbnh vmqbvt vhgrzn khl khly brzl l' nshm' bbyt bhbntv
verses.translation: And the house, when it was in building, was built of stone made ready before it was brought thither: so that there was neither hammer nor axe nor any tool of iron heard in the house, while it was in building.

verses.original: פֶּ֗תַח הַ/צֵּלָע֙ הַ/תִּ֣יכֹנָ֔ה אֶל כֶּ֥תֶף הַ/בַּ֖יִת הַ/יְמָנִ֑ית וּ/בְ/לוּלִּ֗ים יַֽעֲלוּ֙ עַל הַ/תִּ֣יכֹנָ֔ה וּ/מִן הַ/תִּֽיכֹנָ֖ה אֶל הַ/שְּׁלִשִֽׁים
verses.translit: ptch htsl' htykhnh 'l khtf hbyt hymnyt vblvlym y'lv 'l htykhnh vmn htykhnh 'l hshlshym
verses.translation: The door for the middle chamber was in the right side of the house: and they went up with winding stairs into the middle chamber , and out of the middle into the third.

verses.original: וַ/יִּ֥בֶן אֶת הַ/בַּ֖יִת וַ/יְכַלֵּ֑/הוּ וַ/יִּסְפֹּ֤ן אֶת הַ/בַּ֨יִת֙ גֵּבִ֔ים וּ/שְׂדֵרֹ֖ת בָּ/אֲרָזִֽים
verses.translit: vybn 't hbyt vykhlhv vyspn 't hbyt gbym vshdrt b'rzym
verses.translation: So he built the house, and finished it; and covered the house with beams and boards of cedar.

verses.original: וַ/יִּ֤בֶן אֶת ה/יצוע הַ/יָּצִ֨יעַ֙ עַל כָּל הַ/בַּ֔יִת חָמֵ֥שׁ אַמּ֖וֹת קֽוֹמָת֑/וֹ וַ/יֶּאֱחֹ֥ז אֶת הַ/בַּ֖יִת בַּ/עֲצֵ֥י אֲרָזִֽים
verses.translit: vybn 't hytsv' hytsy' 'l khl hbyt chmsh 'mvt qvmtv vy'chz 't hbyt b'tsy 'rzym
verses.translation: And then he built chambers against all the house, five cubits high: and they rested on the house with timber of cedar.

verses.original: וַֽ/יְהִי֙ דְּבַר יְהוָ֔ה אֶל שְׁלֹמֹ֖ה לֵ/אמֹֽר
verses.translit: vyhy dbr yhvh 'l shlmh l'mr
verses.translation: And the word of the LORD came to Solomon, saying,

verses.original: הַ/בַּ֨יִת הַ/זֶּ֜ה אֲשֶׁר אַתָּ֣ה בֹנֶ֗ה אִם תֵּלֵ֤ךְ בְּ/חֻקֹּתַ/י֙ וְ/אֶת מִשְׁפָּטַ֣/י תַּֽעֲשֶׂ֔ה וְ/שָׁמַרְתָּ֥ אֶת כָּל מִצְוֺתַ֖/י לָ/לֶ֣כֶת בָּ/הֶ֑ם וַ/הֲקִמֹתִ֤י אֶת דְּבָרִ/י֙ אִתָּ֔/ךְ אֲשֶׁ֥ר דִּבַּ֖רְתִּי אֶל דָּוִ֥ד אָבִֽי/ךָ
verses.translit: hbyt hzh 'shr 'th bnh 'm tlkh bchqty v't mshpty t'shh vshmrt 't khl mtsvty llkht bhm vhqmty 't dbry 'tkh 'shr dbrty 'l dvd 'bykh
verses.translation: Concerning this house which thou art in building, if thou wilt walk in my statutes, and execute my judgments, and keep all my commandments to walk in them; then will I perform my word with thee, which I spake unto David thy father:

verses.original: וְ/שָׁ֣כַנְתִּ֔י בְּ/ת֖וֹךְ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וְ/לֹ֥א אֶעֱזֹ֖ב אֶת עַמִּ֥/י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל
verses.translit: vshkhnty btvkh bny yshr'l vl' ''zb 't 'my yshr'l
verses.translation: And I will dwell among the children of Israel, and will not forsake my people Israel.

verses.original: וַ/יִּ֧בֶן שְׁלֹמֹ֛ה אֶת הַ/בַּ֖יִת וַ/יְכַלֵּֽ/הוּ
verses.translit: vybn shlmh 't hbyt vykhlhv
verses.translation: So Solomon built the house, and finished it.

verses.original: וַ/יִּבֶן֩ אֶת קִיר֨וֹת הַ/בַּ֤יִת מִ/בַּ֨יְתָ/ה֙ בְּ/צַלְע֣וֹת אֲרָזִ֔ים מִ/קַּרְקַ֤ע הַ/בַּ֨יִת֙ עַד קִיר֣וֹת הַ/סִּפֻּ֔ן צִפָּ֥ה עֵ֖ץ מִ/בָּ֑יִת וַ/יְצַ֛ף אֶת קַרְקַ֥ע הַ/בַּ֖יִת בְּ/צַלְע֥וֹת בְּרוֹשִֽׁים
verses.translit: vybn 't qyrvt hbyt mbyth btsl'vt 'rzym mqrq' hbyt 'd qyrvt hspn tsph 'ts mbyt vytsf 't qrq' hbyt btsl'vt brvshym
verses.translation: And he built the walls of the house within with boards of cedar, both the floor of the house, and the walls of the cieling: and he covered them on the inside with wood, and covered the floor of the house with planks of fir.

verses.original: וַ/יִּבֶן֩ אֶת עֶשְׂרִ֨ים אַמָּ֜ה מ/ירכותי מִֽ/יַּרְכְּתֵ֤י הַ/בַּ֨יִת֙ בְּ/צַלְע֣וֹת אֲרָזִ֔ים מִן הַ/קַּרְקַ֖ע עַד הַ/קִּיר֑וֹת וַ/יִּ֤בֶן ל/וֹ֙ מִ/בַּ֣יִת לִ/דְבִ֔יר לְ/קֹ֖דֶשׁ הַ/קֳּדָשִֽׁים
verses.translit: vybn 't 'shrym 'mh myrkhvty myrkhty hbyt btsl'vt 'rzym mn hqrq' 'd hqyrvt vybn lv mbyt ldbyr lqdsh hqdshym
