verses.translation: And he built twenty cubits on the sides of the house, both the floor and the walls with boards of cedar: he even built them for it within, even for the oracle, even for the most holy place .

verses.original: וְ/אַרְבָּעִ֥ים בָּ/אַמָּ֖ה הָיָ֣ה הַ/בָּ֑יִת ה֖וּא הַ/הֵיכָ֥ל לִ/פְנָֽ/י
verses.translit: v'rb'ym b'mh hyh hbyt hv' hhykhl lpny
verses.translation: And the house, that is , the temple before it, was forty cubits long .

verses.original: וְ/אֶ֤רֶז אֶל הַ/בַּ֨יִת֙ פְּנִ֔ימָה מִקְלַ֣עַת פְּקָעִ֔ים וּ/פְטוּרֵ֖י צִצִּ֑ים הַ/כֹּ֣ל אֶ֔רֶז אֵ֥ין אֶ֖בֶן נִרְאָֽה
verses.translit: v'rz 'l hbyt pnymh mql't pq'ym vptvry tstsym hkhl 'rz 'yn 'bn nr'h
verses.translation: And the cedar of the house within was carved with knops and open flowers: all was cedar; there was no stone seen.

verses.original: וּ/דְבִ֧יר בְּ/תוֹךְ הַ/בַּ֛יִת מִ/פְּנִ֖ימָה הֵכִ֑ין לְ/תִתֵּ֣ן שָׁ֔ם אֶת אֲר֖וֹן בְּרִ֥ית יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: vdbyr btvkh hbyt mpnymh hkhyn lttn shm 't 'rvn bryt yhvh
verses.translation: And the oracle he prepared in the house within, to set there the ark of the covenant of the LORD .

verses.original: וְ/לִ/פְנֵ֣י הַ/דְּבִ֡יר עֶשְׂרִים֩ אַמָּ֨ה אֹ֜רֶךְ וְ/עֶשְׂרִ֧ים אַמָּ֣ה רֹ֗חַב וְ/עֶשְׂרִ֤ים אַמָּה֙ קֽוֹמָת֔/וֹ וַ/יְצַפֵּ֖/הוּ זָהָ֣ב סָג֑וּר וַ/יְצַ֥ף מִזְבֵּ֖חַ אָֽרֶז
verses.translit: vlpny hdbyr 'shrym 'mh 'rkh v'shrym 'mh rchb v'shrym 'mh qvmtv vytsphv zhb sgvr vytsf mzbch 'rz
verses.translation: And the oracle in the forepart was twenty cubits in length, and twenty cubits in breadth, and twenty cubits in the height thereof: and he overlaid it with pure gold; and so covered the altar which was of cedar.

verses.original: וַ/יְצַ֨ף שְׁלֹמֹ֧ה אֶת הַ/בַּ֛יִת מִ/פְּנִ֖ימָה זָהָ֣ב סָג֑וּר וַ/יְעַבֵּ֞ר ב/רתיקות בְּ/רַתּוּק֤וֹת זָהָב֙ לִ/פְנֵ֣י הַ/דְּבִ֔יר וַ/יְצַפֵּ֖/הוּ זָהָֽב
verses.translit: vytsf shlmh 't hbyt mpnymh zhb sgvr vy'br brtyqvt brtvqvt zhb lpny hdbyr vytsphv zhb
verses.translation: So Solomon overlaid the house within with pure gold: and he made a partition by the chains of gold before the oracle; and he overlaid it with gold.

verses.original: וְ/אֶת כָּל הַ/בַּ֛יִת צִפָּ֥ה זָהָ֖ב עַד תֹּ֣ם כָּל הַ/בָּ֑יִת וְ/כָל הַ/מִּזְבֵּ֥חַ אֲֽשֶׁר לַ/דְּבִ֖יר צִפָּ֥ה זָהָֽב
verses.translit: v't khl hbyt tsph zhb 'd tm khl hbyt vkhl hmzbch 'shr ldbyr tsph zhb
verses.translation: And the whole house he overlaid with gold, until he had finished all the house: also the whole altar that was by the oracle he overlaid with gold.

verses.original: וַ/יַּ֣עַשׂ בַּ/דְּבִ֔יר שְׁנֵ֥י כְרוּבִ֖ים עֲצֵי שָׁ֑מֶן עֶ֥שֶׂר אַמּ֖וֹת קוֹמָתֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: vy'sh bdbyr shny khrvbym 'tsy shmn 'shr 'mvt qvmtv
verses.translation: And within the oracle he made two cherubims of olive tree, each ten cubits high.

verses.original: וְ/חָמֵ֣שׁ אַמּ֗וֹת כְּנַ֤ף הַ/כְּרוּב֙ הָֽ/אֶחָ֔ת וְ/חָמֵ֣שׁ אַמּ֔וֹת כְּנַ֥ף הַ/כְּר֖וּב הַ/שֵּׁנִ֑ית עֶ֣שֶׂר אַמּ֔וֹת מִ/קְצ֥וֹת כְּנָפָ֖י/ו וְ/עַד קְצ֥וֹת כְּנָפָֽי/ו
verses.translit: vchmsh 'mvt khnf hkhrvb h'cht vchmsh 'mvt khnf hkhrvb hshnyt 'shr 'mvt mqtsvt khnpyv v'd qtsvt khnpyv
verses.translation: And five cubits was the one wing of the cherub, and five cubits the other wing of the cherub: from the uttermost part of the one wing unto the uttermost part of the other were ten cubits.

verses.original: וְ/עֶ֨שֶׂר֙ בָּֽ/אַמָּ֔ה הַ/כְּר֖וּב הַ/שֵּׁנִ֑י מִדָּ֥ה אַחַ֛ת וְ/קֶ֥צֶב אֶחָ֖ד לִ/שְׁנֵ֥י הַ/כְּרֻבִֽים
verses.translit: v'shr b'mh hkhrvb hshny mdh 'cht vqtsb 'chd lshny hkhrbym
verses.translation: And the other cherub was ten cubits: both the cherubims were of one measure and one size.

verses.original: קוֹמַת֙ הַ/כְּר֣וּב הָֽ/אֶחָ֔ד עֶ֖שֶׂר בָּֽ/אַמָּ֑ה וְ/כֵ֖ן הַ/כְּר֥וּב הַ/שֵּׁנִֽי
verses.translit: qvmt hkhrvb h'chd 'shr b'mh vkhn hkhrvb hshny
verses.translation: The height of the one cherub was ten cubits, and so was it of the other cherub.

verses.original: וַ/יִּתֵּ֨ן אֶת הַ/כְּרוּבִ֜ים בְּ/ת֣וֹךְ הַ/בַּ֣יִת הַ/פְּנִימִ֗י וַֽ/יִּפְרְשׂוּ֮ אֶת כַּנְפֵ֣י הַ/כְּרֻבִים֒ וַ/תִּגַּ֤ע כְּנַף הָֽ/אֶחָד֙ בַּ/קִּ֔יר וּ/כְנַף֙ הַ/כְּר֣וּב הַ/שֵּׁנִ֔י נֹגַ֖עַת בַּ/קִּ֣יר הַ/שֵּׁנִ֑י וְ/כַנְפֵי/הֶם֙ אֶל תּ֣וֹךְ הַ/בַּ֔יִת נֹגְעֹ֖ת כָּנָ֥ף אֶל כָּנָֽף
verses.translit: vytn 't hkhrvbym btvkh hbyt hpnymy vyprshv 't khnpy hkhrbym vtg' khnf h'chd bqyr vkhnf hkhrvb hshny ng't bqyr hshny vkhnpyhm 'l tvkh hbyt ng't khnf 'l khnf
verses.translation: And he set the cherubims within the inner house: and they stretched forth the wings of the cherubims, so that the wing of the one touched the one wall, and the wing of the other cherub touched the other wall; and their wings touched one another in the midst of the house.

verses.original: וַ/יְצַ֥ף אֶת הַ/כְּרוּבִ֖ים זָהָֽב
verses.translit: vytsf 't hkhrvbym zhb
verses.translation: And he overlaid the cherubims with gold.

verses.original: וְ/אֵת֩ כָּל קִיר֨וֹת הַ/בַּ֜יִת מֵסַ֣ב קָלַ֗ע פִּתּוּחֵי֙ מִקְלְעוֹת֙ כְּרוּבִ֣ים וְ/תִֽמֹרֹ֔ת וּ/פְטוּרֵ֖י צִצִּ֑ים מִ/לִּ/פְנִ֖ים וְ/לַ/חִיצֽוֹן
verses.translit: v't khl qyrvt hbyt msb ql' ptvchy mql'vt khrvbym vtmrt vptvry tstsym mlpnym vlchytsvn
verses.translation: And he carved all the walls of the house round about with carved figures of cherubims and palm trees and open flowers, within and without.

verses.original: וְ/אֶת קַרְקַ֥ע הַ/בַּ֖יִת צִפָּ֣ה זָהָ֑ב לִ/פְנִ֖ימָה וְ/לַ/חִיצֽוֹן
verses.translit: v't qrq' hbyt tsph zhb lpnymh vlchytsvn
verses.translation: And the floor of the house he overlaid with gold, within and without.

verses.original: וְ/אֵת֙ פֶּ֣תַח הַ/דְּבִ֔יר עָשָׂ֖ה דַּלְת֣וֹת עֲצֵי שָׁ֑מֶן הָ/אַ֥יִל מְזוּז֖וֹת חֲמִשִֽׁית
verses.translit: v't ptch hdbyr 'shh dltvt 'tsy shmn h'yl mzvzvt chmshyt
verses.translation: And for the entering of the oracle he made doors of olive tree: the lintel and side posts were a fifth part of the wall .

verses.original: וּ/שְׁתֵּי֮ דַּלְת֣וֹת עֲצֵי שֶׁמֶן֒ וְ/קָלַ֣ע עֲ֠לֵי/הֶם מִקְלְע֨וֹת כְּרוּבִ֧ים וְ/תִמֹר֛וֹת וּ/פְטוּרֵ֥י צִצִּ֖ים וְ/צִפָּ֣ה זָהָ֑ב וַ/יָּ֛רֶד עַל הַ/כְּרוּבִ֥ים וְ/עַל הַ/תִּֽמֹר֖וֹת אֶת הַ/זָּהָֽב
verses.translit: vshty dltvt 'tsy shmn vql' 'lyhm mql'vt khrvbym vtmrvt vptvry tstsym vtsph zhb vyrd 'l hkhrvbym v'l htmrvt 't hzhb
verses.translation: The two doors also were of olive tree; and he carved upon them carvings of cherubims and palm trees and open flowers, and overlaid them with gold, and spread gold upon the cherubims, and upon the palm trees.

verses.original: וְ/כֵ֥ן עָשָׂ֛ה לְ/פֶ֥תַח הַֽ/הֵיכָ֖ל מְזוּז֣וֹת עֲצֵי שָׁ֑מֶן מֵ/אֵ֖ת רְבִעִֽית
verses.translit: vkhn 'shh lptch hhykhl mzvzvt 'tsy shmn m't rb'yt
verses.translation: So also made he for the door of the temple posts of olive tree, a fourth part of the wall .

verses.original: וּ/שְׁתֵּ֥י דַלְת֖וֹת עֲצֵ֣י בְרוֹשִׁ֑ים שְׁנֵ֨י צְלָעִ֜ים הַ/דֶּ֤לֶת הָֽ/אַחַת֙ גְּלִילִ֔ים וּ/שְׁנֵ֧י קְלָעִ֛ים הַ/דֶּ֥לֶת הַ/שֵּׁנִ֖ית גְּלִילִֽים
verses.translit: vshty dltvt 'tsy brvshym shny tsl'ym hdlt h'cht glylym vshny ql'ym hdlt hshnyt glylym
verses.translation: And the two doors were of fir tree: the two leaves of the one door were folding, and the two leaves of the other door were folding.

verses.original: וְ/קָלַ֤ע כְּרוּבִים֙ וְ/תִ֣מֹר֔וֹת וּ/פְטֻרֵ֖י צִצִּ֑ים וְ/צִפָּ֣ה זָהָ֔ב מְיֻשָּׁ֖ר עַל הַ/מְּחֻקֶּֽה
verses.translit: vql' khrvbym vtmrvt vptry tstsym vtsph zhb myshr 'l hmchqh
verses.translation: And he carved thereon cherubims and palm trees and open flowers: and covered them with gold fitted upon the carved work.

verses.original: וַ/יִּ֨בֶן֙ אֶת הֶ/חָצֵ֣ר הַ/פְּנִימִ֔ית שְׁלֹשָׁ֖ה טוּרֵ֣י גָזִ֑ית וְ/ט֖וּר כְּרֻתֹ֥ת אֲרָזִֽים
verses.translit: vybn 't hchtsr hpnymyt shlshh tvry gzyt vtvr khrtt 'rzym
verses.translation: And he built the inner court with three rows of hewed stone, and a row of cedar beams.

verses.original: בַּ/שָּׁנָה֙ הָֽ/רְבִיעִ֔ית יֻסַּ֖ד בֵּ֣ית יְהוָ֑ה בְּ/יֶ֖רַח זִֽו
verses.translit: bshnh hrby'yt ysd byt yhvh byrch zv
verses.translation: In the fourth year was the foundation of the house of the LORD laid, in the month Zif:

verses.original: וּ/בַ/שָּׁנָה֩ הָ/אַחַ֨ת עֶשְׂרֵ֜ה בְּ/יֶ֣רַח בּ֗וּל ה֚וּא הַ/חֹ֣דֶשׁ הַ/שְּׁמִינִ֔י כָּלָ֣ה הַ/בַּ֔יִת לְ/כָל דְּבָרָ֖י/ו וּ/לְ/כָל משפט/ו מִשְׁפָּטָ֑י/ו וַ/יִּבְנֵ֖/הוּ שֶׁ֥בַע שָׁנִֽים
verses.translit: vbshnh h'cht 'shrh byrch bvl hv' hchdsh hshmyny khlh hbyt lkhl dbryv vlkhl mshptv mshptyv vybnhv shb' shnym
verses.translation: And in the eleventh year, in the month Bul, which is the eighth month, was the house finished throughout all the parts thereof, and according to all the fashion of it. So was he seven years in building it.

verses.original: וְ/אֶת בֵּית/וֹ֙ בָּנָ֣ה שְׁלֹמֹ֔ה שְׁלֹ֥שׁ עֶשְׂרֵ֖ה שָׁנָ֑ה וַ/יְכַ֖ל אֶת כָּל בֵּיתֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: v't bytv bnh shlmh shlsh 'shrh shnh vykhl 't khl bytv
verses.translation: But Solomon was building his own house thirteen years, and he finished all his house.

verses.original: וַ/יִּ֜בֶן אֶת בֵּ֣ית יַ֣עַר הַ/לְּבָנ֗וֹן מֵאָ֨ה אַמָּ֤ה אָרְכּ/וֹ֙ וַ/חֲמִשִּׁ֤ים אַמָּה֙ רָחְבּ֔/וֹ וּ/שְׁלֹשִׁ֥ים אַמָּ֖ה קוֹמָת֑/וֹ עַ֗ל אַרְבָּעָה֙ טוּרֵי֙ עַמּוּדֵ֣י אֲרָזִ֔ים וּ/כְרֻת֥וֹת אֲרָזִ֖ים עַל הָ/עַמּוּדִֽים
verses.translit: vybn 't byt y'r hlbnvn m'h 'mh 'rkhv vchmshym 'mh rchbv vshlshym 'mh qvmtv 'l 'rb'h tvry 'mvdy 'rzym vkhrtvt 'rzym 'l h'mvdym
verses.translation: He built also the house of the forest of Lebanon; the length thereof was an hundred cubits, and the breadth thereof fifty cubits, and the height thereof thirty cubits, upon four rows of cedar pillars, with cedar beams upon the pillars.

verses.original: וְ/סָפֻ֣ן בָּ/אֶ֗רֶז מִ/מַּ֨עַל֙ עַל הַ/צְּלָעֹת֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר עַל הָֽ/עַמּוּדִ֔ים אַרְבָּעִ֖ים וַ/חֲמִשָּׁ֑ה חֲמִשָּׁ֥ה עָשָׂ֖ר הַ/טּֽוּר
verses.translit: vspn b'rz mm'l 'l htsl't 'shr 'l h'mvdym 'rb'ym vchmshh chmshh 'shr htvr
verses.translation: And it was covered with cedar above upon the beams, that lay on forty five pillars, fifteen in a row.

verses.original: וּ/שְׁקֻפִ֖ים שְׁלֹשָׁ֣ה טוּרִ֑ים וּ/מֶחֱזָ֥ה אֶל מֶחֱזָ֖ה שָׁלֹ֥שׁ פְּעָמִֽים
verses.translit: vshqpym shlshh tvrym vmchzh 'l mchzh shlsh p'mym
verses.translation: And there were windows in three rows, and light was against light in three ranks.

verses.original: וְ/כָל הַ/פְּתָחִ֥ים וְ/הַ/מְּזוּז֖וֹת רְבֻעִ֣ים שָׁ֑קֶף וּ/מ֧וּל מֶחֱזָ֛ה אֶל מֶחֱזָ֖ה שָׁלֹ֥שׁ פְּעָמִֽים
verses.translit: vkhl hptchym vhmzvzvt rb'ym shqf vmvl mchzh 'l mchzh shlsh p'mym
verses.translation: And all the doors and posts were square, with the windows: and light was against light in three ranks.

verses.original: וְ/אֵ֨ת אוּלָ֤ם הָֽ/עַמּוּדִים֙ עָשָׂ֔ה חֲמִשִּׁ֤ים אַמָּה֙ אָרְכּ֔/וֹ וּ/שְׁלֹשִׁ֥ים אַמָּ֖ה רָחְבּ֑/וֹ וְ/אוּלָם֙ עַל פְּנֵי/הֶ֔ם וְ/עַמֻּדִ֥ים וְ/עָ֖ב עַל פְּנֵי/הֶֽם
verses.translit: v't 'vlm h'mvdym 'shh chmshym 'mh 'rkhv vshlshym 'mh rchbv v'vlm 'l pnyhm v'mdym v'b 'l pnyhm
verses.translation: And he made a porch of pillars; the length thereof was fifty cubits, and the breadth thereof thirty cubits: and the porch was before them: and the other pillars and the thick beam were before them.

verses.original: וְ/אוּלָ֤ם הַ/כִּסֵּא֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר יִשְׁפָּט שָׁ֔ם אֻלָ֥ם הַ/מִּשְׁפָּ֖ט עָשָׂ֑ה וְ/סָפ֣וּן בָּ/אֶ֔רֶז מֵ/הַ/קַּרְקַ֖ע עַד הַ/קַּרְקָֽע
verses.translit: v'vlm hkhs' 'shr yshpt shm 'lm hmshpt 'shh vspvn b'rz mhqrq' 'd hqrq'
verses.translation: Then he made a porch for the throne where he might judge, even the porch of judgment: and it was covered with cedar from one side of the floor to the other.

verses.original: וּ/בֵית/וֹ֩ אֲשֶׁר יֵ֨שֶׁב שָׁ֜ם חָצֵ֣ר הָ/אַחֶ֗רֶת מִ/בֵּית֙ לָֽ/אוּלָ֔ם כַּ/מַּֽעֲשֶׂ֥ה הַ/זֶּ֖ה הָיָ֑ה וּ/בַ֜יִת יַעֲשֶׂ֤ה לְ/בַת פַּרְעֹה֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר לָקַ֣ח שְׁלֹמֹ֔ה כָּ/אוּלָ֖ם הַ/זֶּֽה
verses.translit: vbytv 'shr yshb shm chtsr h'chrt mbyt l'vlm khm'shh hzh hyh vbyt y'shh lbt pr'h 'shr lqch shlmh kh'vlm hzh
verses.translation: And his house where he dwelt had another court within the porch, which was of the like work. Solomon made also an house for Pharaoh’s daughter, whom he had taken to wife , like unto this porch.

verses.original: כָּל אֵ֜לֶּה אֲבָנִ֤ים יְקָרֹת֙ כְּ/מִדֹּ֣ת גָּזִ֔ית מְגֹרָר֥וֹת בַּ/מְּגֵרָ֖ה מִ/בַּ֣יִת וּ/מִ/ח֑וּץ וּ/מִ/מַּסָּד֙ עַד הַ/טְּפָח֔וֹת וּ/מִ/ח֖וּץ עַד הֶ/חָצֵ֥ר הַ/גְּדוֹלָֽה
verses.translit: khl 'lh 'bnym yqrt khmdt gzyt mgrrvt bmgrh mbyt vmchvts vmmsd 'd htpchvt vmchvts 'd hchtsr hgdvlh
verses.translation: All these were of costly stones, according to the measures of hewed stones, sawed with saws, within and without, even from the foundation unto the coping, and so on the outside toward the great court.

verses.original: וּ/מְיֻסָּ֕ד אֲבָנִ֥ים יְקָר֖וֹת אֲבָנִ֣ים גְּדֹל֑וֹת אַבְנֵי֙ עֶ֣שֶׂר אַמּ֔וֹת וְ/אַבְנֵ֖י שְׁמֹנֶ֥ה אַמּֽוֹת
verses.translit: vmysd 'bnym yqrvt 'bnym gdlvt 'bny 'shr 'mvt v'bny shmnh 'mvt
verses.translation: And the foundation was of costly stones, even great stones, stones of ten cubits, and stones of eight cubits.

verses.original: וּ/מִ/לְ/מַ֗עְלָ/ה אֲבָנִ֧ים יְקָר֛וֹת כְּ/מִדּ֥וֹת גָּזִ֖ית וָ/אָֽרֶז
verses.translit: vmlm'lh 'bnym yqrvt khmdvt gzyt v'rz
verses.translation: And above were costly stones, after the measures of hewed stones, and cedars.

verses.original: וְ/חָצֵ֨ר הַ/גְּדוֹלָ֜ה סָבִ֗יב שְׁלֹשָׁה֙ טוּרִ֣ים גָּזִ֔ית וְ/ט֖וּר כְּרֻתֹ֣ת אֲרָזִ֑ים וְ/לַ/חֲצַ֧ר בֵּית יְהוָ֛ה הַ/פְּנִימִ֖ית וּ/לְ/אֻלָ֥ם הַ/בָּֽיִת
verses.translit: vchtsr hgdvlh sbyb shlshh tvrym gzyt vtvr khrtt 'rzym vlchtsr byt yhvh hpnymyt vl'lm hbyt
verses.translation: And the great court round about was with three rows of hewed stones, and a row of cedar beams, both for the inner court of the house of the LORD , and for the porch of the house.

verses.original: וַ/יִּשְׁלַח֙ הַ/מֶּ֣לֶךְ שְׁלֹמֹ֔ה וַ/יִּקַּ֥ח אֶת חִירָ֖ם מִ/צֹּֽר
verses.translit: vyshlch hmlkh shlmh vyqch 't chyrm mtsr
verses.translation: And king Solomon sent and fetched Hiram out of Tyre.

verses.original: בֶּן אִשָּׁה֩ אַלְמָנָ֨ה ה֜וּא מִ/מַּטֵּ֣ה נַפְתָּלִ֗י וְ/אָבִ֣י/ו אִישׁ צֹרִי֮ חֹרֵ֣שׁ נְחֹשֶׁת֒ וַ֠/יִּמָּלֵא אֶת הַ/חָכְמָ֤ה וְ/אֶת הַ/תְּבוּנָה֙ וְ/אֶת הַ/דַּ֔עַת לַ/עֲשׂ֥וֹת כָּל מְלָאכָ֖ה בַּ/נְּחֹ֑שֶׁת וַ/יָּבוֹא֙ אֶל הַ/מֶּ֣לֶךְ שְׁלֹמֹ֔ה וַ/יַּ֖עַשׂ אֶת כָּל מְלַאכְתּֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: bn 'shh 'lmnh hv' mmth nptly v'byv 'ysh tsry chrsh nchsht vyml' 't hchkhmh v't htbvnh v't hd't l'shvt khl ml'khh bnchsht vybv' 'l hmlkh shlmh vy'sh 't khl ml'khtv
verses.translation: He was a widow’s son of the tribe of Naphtali, and his father was a man of Tyre, a worker in brass: and he was filled with wisdom, and understanding, and cunning to work all works in brass. And he came to king Solomon, and wrought all his work.

verses.original: וַ/יָּ֛צַר אֶת שְׁנֵ֥י הָ/עַמּוּדִ֖ים נְחֹ֑שֶׁת שְׁמֹנֶ֨ה עֶשְׂרֵ֜ה אַמָּ֗ה קוֹמַת֙ הָ/עַמּ֣וּד הָ/אֶחָ֔ד וְ/חוּט֙ שְׁתֵּים עֶשְׂרֵ֣ה אַמָּ֔ה יָסֹ֖ב אֶת הָ/עַמּ֥וּד הַ/שֵּׁנִֽי
verses.translit: vytsr 't shny h'mvdym nchsht shmnh 'shrh 'mh qvmt h'mvd h'chd vchvt shtym 'shrh 'mh ysb 't h'mvd hshny
verses.translation: For he cast two pillars of brass, of eighteen cubits high apiece: and a line of twelve cubits did compass either of them about.

verses.original: וּ/שְׁתֵּ֨י כֹתָרֹ֜ת עָשָׂ֗ה לָ/תֵ֛ת עַל רָאשֵׁ֥י הָֽ/עַמּוּדִ֖ים מֻצַ֣ק נְחֹ֑שֶׁת חָמֵ֣שׁ אַמּ֗וֹת קוֹמַת֙ הַ/כֹּתֶ֣רֶת הָ/אֶחָ֔ת וְ/חָמֵ֣שׁ אַמּ֔וֹת קוֹמַ֖ת הַ/כֹּתֶ֥רֶת הַ/שֵּׁנִֽית
verses.translit: vshty khtrt 'shh ltt 'l r'shy h'mvdym mtsq nchsht chmsh 'mvt qvmt hkhtrt h'cht vchmsh 'mvt qvmt hkhtrt hshnyt
verses.translation: And he made two chapiters of molten brass, to set upon the tops of the pillars: the height of the one chapiter was five cubits, and the height of the other chapiter was five cubits:

verses.original: שְׂבָכִ֞ים מַעֲשֵׂ֣ה שְׂבָכָ֗ה גְּדִלִים֙ מַעֲשֵׂ֣ה שַׁרְשְׁר֔וֹת לַ/כֹּ֣תָרֹ֔ת אֲשֶׁ֖ר עַל רֹ֣אשׁ הָ/עַמּוּדִ֑ים שִׁבְעָה֙ לַ/כֹּתֶ֣רֶת הָ/אֶחָ֔ת וְ/שִׁבְעָ֖ה לַ/כֹּתֶ֥רֶת הַ/שֵּׁנִֽית
verses.translit: shbkhym m'shh shbkhh gdlym m'shh shrshrvt lkhtrt 'shr 'l r'sh h'mvdym shb'h lkhtrt h'cht vshb'h lkhtrt hshnyt
verses.translation: And nets of checker work, and wreaths of chain work, for the chapiters which were upon the top of the pillars; seven for the one chapiter, and seven for the other chapiter.

verses.original: וַ/יַּ֖עַשׂ אֶת הָ/עַמּוּדִ֑ים וּ/שְׁנֵי֩ טוּרִ֨ים סָבִ֜יב עַל הַ/שְּׂבָכָ֣ה הָ/אֶחָ֗ת לְ/כַסּ֤וֹת אֶת הַ/כֹּֽתָרֹת֙ אֲשֶׁר֙ עַל רֹ֣אשׁ הָֽ/רִמֹּנִ֔ים וְ/כֵ֣ן עָשָׂ֔ה לַ/כֹּתֶ֖רֶת הַ/שֵּׁנִֽית
verses.translit: vy'sh 't h'mvdym vshny tvrym sbyb 'l hshbkhh h'cht lkhsvt 't hkhtrt 'shr 'l r'sh hrmnym vkhn 'shh lkhtrt hshnyt
verses.translation: And he made the pillars, and two rows round about upon the one network, to cover the chapiters that were upon the top, with pomegranates: and so did he for the other chapiter.

verses.original: וְ/כֹֽתָרֹ֗ת אֲשֶׁר֙ עַל רֹ֣אשׁ הָ/עַמּוּדִ֔ים מַעֲשֵׂ֖ה שׁוּשַׁ֣ן בָּֽ/אוּלָ֑ם אַרְבַּ֖ע אַמּֽוֹת
verses.translit: vkhtrt 'shr 'l r'sh h'mvdym m'shh shvshn b'vlm 'rb' 'mvt
verses.translation: And the chapiters that were upon the top of the pillars were of lily work in the porch, four cubits.

verses.original: וְ/כֹתָרֹ֗ת עַל שְׁנֵי֙ הָֽ/עַמּוּדִ֔ים גַּם מִ/מַּ֨עַל֙ מִ/לְּ/עֻמַּ֣ת הַ/בֶּ֔טֶן אֲשֶׁ֖ר לְ/עֵ֣בֶר שבכה הַ/שְּׂבָכָ֑ה וְ/הָ/רִמּוֹנִ֤ים מָאתַ֨יִם֙ טֻרִ֣ים סָבִ֔יב עַ֖ל הַ/כֹּתֶ֥רֶת הַ/שֵּׁנִֽית
verses.translit: vkhtrt 'l shny h'mvdym gm mm'l ml'mt hbtn 'shr l'br shbkhh hshbkhh vhrmvnym m'tym trym sbyb 'l hkhtrt hshnyt
verses.translation: And the chapiters upon the two pillars had pomegranates also above, over against the belly which was by the network: and the pomegranates were two hundred in rows round about upon the other chapiter.

verses.original: וַ/יָּ֨קֶם֙ אֶת הָֽ/עַמֻּדִ֔ים לְ/אֻלָ֖ם הַֽ/הֵיכָ֑ל וַ/יָּ֜קֶם אֶת הָ/עַמּ֣וּד הַ/יְמָנִ֗י וַ/יִּקְרָ֤א אֶת שְׁמ/וֹ֙ יָכִ֔ין וַ/יָּ֨קֶם֙ אֶת הָ/עַמּ֣וּד הַ/שְּׂמָאלִ֔י וַ/יִּקְרָ֥א אֶת שְׁמ֖/וֹ בֹּֽעַז
verses.translit: vyqm 't h'mdym l'lm hhykhl vyqm 't h'mvd hymny vyqr' 't shmv ykhyn vyqm 't h'mvd hshm'ly vyqr' 't shmv b'z
verses.translation: And he set up the pillars in the porch of the temple: and he set up the right pillar, and called the name thereof Jachin: and he set up the left pillar, and called the name thereof Boaz.

verses.original: וְ/עַ֛ל רֹ֥אשׁ הָ/עַמּוּדִ֖ים מַעֲשֵׂ֣ה שׁוֹשָׁ֑ן וַ/תִּתֹּ֖ם מְלֶ֥אכֶת הָ/עַמּוּדִֽים
verses.translit: v'l r'sh h'mvdym m'shh shvshn vttm ml'kht h'mvdym
verses.translation: And upon the top of the pillars was lily work: so was the work of the pillars finished.

verses.original: וַ/יַּ֥עַשׂ אֶת הַ/יָּ֖ם מוּצָ֑ק עֶ֣שֶׂר בָּ֠/אַמָּה מִ/שְּׂפָת֨/וֹ עַד שְׂפָת֜/וֹ עָגֹ֣ל סָבִ֗יב וְ/חָמֵ֤שׁ בָּֽ/אַמָּה֙ קוֹמָת֔/וֹ ו/קוה וְ/קָו֙ שְׁלֹשִׁ֣ים בָּֽ/אַמָּ֔ה יָסֹ֥ב אֹת֖/וֹ סָבִֽיב
verses.translit: vy'sh 't hym mvtsq 'shr b'mh mshptv 'd shptv 'gl sbyb vchmsh b'mh qvmtv vqvh vqv shlshym b'mh ysb 'tv sbyb
verses.translation: And he made a molten sea, ten cubits from the one brim to the other: it was round all about, and his height was five cubits: and a line of thirty cubits did compass it round about.

verses.original: וּ/פְקָעִים֩ מִ/תַּ֨חַת לִ/שְׂפָת֤/וֹ סָבִיב֙ סֹבְבִ֣ים אֹת֔/וֹ עֶ֚שֶׂר בָּֽ/אַמָּ֔ה מַקִּפִ֥ים אֶת הַ/יָּ֖ם סָבִ֑יב שְׁנֵ֤י טוּרִים֙ הַ/פְּקָעִ֔ים יְצֻקִ֖ים בִּ/יצֻקָתֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: vpq'ym mtcht lshptv sbyb sbbym 'tv 'shr b'mh mqpym 't hym sbyb shny tvrym hpq'ym ytsqym bytsqtv
verses.translation: And under the brim of it round about there were knops compassing it, ten in a cubit, compassing the sea round about: the knops were cast in two rows, when it was cast.

verses.original: עֹמֵ֞ד עַל שְׁנֵ֧י עָשָׂ֣ר בָּקָ֗ר שְׁלֹשָׁ֣ה פֹנִ֣ים צָפ֡וֹנָ/ה וּ/שְׁלֹשָׁה֩ פֹנִ֨ים יָ֜מָּ/ה וּ/שְׁלֹשָׁ֣ה פֹּנִ֣ים נֶ֗גְבָּ/ה וּ/שְׁלֹשָׁה֙ פֹּנִ֣ים מִזְרָ֔חָ/ה וְ/הַ/יָּ֥ם עֲלֵי/הֶ֖ם מִ/לְ/מָ֑עְלָ/ה וְ/כָל אֲחֹֽרֵי/הֶ֖ם בָּֽיְתָ/ה
verses.translit: 'md 'l shny 'shr bqr shlshh pnym tspvnh vshlshh pnym ymh vshlshh pnym ngbh vshlshh pnym mzrchh vhym 'lyhm mlm'lh vkhl 'chryhm byth
verses.translation: It stood upon twelve oxen, three looking toward the north, and three looking toward the west, and three looking toward the south, and three looking toward the east: and the sea was set above upon them, and all their hinder parts were inward.

verses.original: וְ/עָבְי֣/וֹ טֶ֔פַח וּ/שְׂפָת֛/וֹ כְּ/מַעֲשֵׂ֥ה שְׂפַת כּ֖וֹס פֶּ֣רַח שׁוֹשָׁ֑ן אַלְפַּ֥יִם בַּ֖ת יָכִֽיל
verses.translit: v'byv tpch vshptv khm'shh shpt khvs prch shvshn 'lpym bt ykhyl
verses.translation: And it was an hand breadth thick, and the brim thereof was wrought like the brim of a cup, with flowers of lilies: it contained two thousand baths.

verses.original: וַ/יַּ֧עַשׂ אֶת הַ/מְּכֹנ֛וֹת עֶ֖שֶׂר נְחֹ֑שֶׁת אַרְבַּ֣ע בָּ/אַמָּ֗ה אֹ֚רֶךְ הַ/מְּכוֹנָ֣ה הָֽ/אֶחָ֔ת וְ/אַרְבַּ֤ע בָּֽ/אַמָּה֙ רָחְבָּ֔/הּ וְ/שָׁלֹ֥שׁ בָּ/אַמָּ֖ה קוֹמָתָֽ/הּ
verses.translit: vy'sh 't hmkhnvt 'shr nchsht 'rb' b'mh 'rkh hmkhvnh h'cht v'rb' b'mh rchbh vshlsh b'mh qvmth
verses.translation: And he made ten bases of brass; four cubits was the length of one base, and four cubits the breadth thereof, and three cubits the height of it.

verses.original: וְ/זֶ֛ה מַעֲשֵׂ֥ה הַ/מְּכוֹנָ֖ה מִסְגְּרֹ֣ת לָ/הֶ֑ם וּ/מִסְגְּרֹ֖ת בֵּ֥ין הַ/שְׁלַבִּֽים
verses.translit: vzh m'shh hmkhvnh msgrt lhm vmsgrt byn hshlbym
verses.translation: And the work of the bases was on this manner: they had borders, and the borders were between the ledges:

verses.original: וְ/עַֽל הַ/מִּסְגְּר֞וֹת אֲשֶׁ֣ר בֵּ֣ין הַ/שְׁלַבִּ֗ים אֲרָי֤וֹת בָּקָר֙ וּ/כְרוּבִ֔ים וְ/עַל הַ/שְׁלַבִּ֖ים כֵּ֣ן מִ/מָּ֑עַל וּ/מִ/תַּ֨חַת֙ לַ/אֲרָי֣וֹת וְ/לַ/בָּקָ֔ר לֹי֖וֹת מַעֲשֵׂ֥ה מוֹרָֽד
verses.translit: v'l hmsgrvt 'shr byn hshlbym 'ryvt bqr vkhrvbym v'l hshlbym khn mm'l vmtcht l'ryvt vlbqr lyvt m'shh mvrd
verses.translation: And on the borders that were between the ledges were lions, oxen, and cherubims: and upon the ledges there was a base above: and beneath the lions and oxen were certain additions made of thin work.

verses.original: וְ/אַרְבָּעָה֩ אוֹפַנֵּ֨י נְחֹ֜שֶׁת לַ/מְּכוֹנָ֤ה הָֽ/אַחַת֙ וְ/סַרְנֵ֣י נְחֹ֔שֶׁת וְ/אַרְבָּעָ֥ה פַעֲמֹתָ֖י/ו כְּתֵפֹ֣ת לָ/הֶ֑ם מִ/תַּ֤חַת לַ/כִּיֹּר֙ הַ/כְּתֵפֹ֣ת יְצֻק֔וֹת מֵ/עֵ֥בֶר אִ֖ישׁ לֹיֽוֹת
verses.translit: v'rb'h 'vpny nchsht lmkhvnh h'cht vsrny nchsht v'rb'h p'mtyv khtpt lhm mtcht lkhyr hkhtpt ytsqvt m'br 'ysh lyvt
verses.translation: And every base had four brasen wheels, and plates of brass: and the four corners thereof had undersetters: under the laver were undersetters molten, at the side of every addition.

verses.original: וּ֠/פִי/הוּ מִ/בֵּ֨ית לַ/כֹּתֶ֤רֶת וָ/מַ֨עְלָ/ה֙ בָּֽ/אַמָּ֔ה וּ/פִ֨י/הָ֙ עָגֹ֣ל מַעֲשֵׂה כֵ֔ן אַמָּ֖ה וַ/חֲצִ֣י הָֽ/אַמָּ֑ה וְ/גַם עַל פִּ֨י/הָ֙ מִקְלָע֔וֹת וּ/מִסְגְּרֹתֵי/הֶ֥ם מְרֻבָּע֖וֹת לֹ֥א עֲגֻלּֽוֹת
verses.translit: vpyhv mbyt lkhtrt vm'lh b'mh vpyh 'gl m'shh khn 'mh vchtsy h'mh vgm 'l pyh mql'vt vmsgrtyhm mrb'vt l' 'glvt
verses.translation: And the mouth of it within the chapiter and above was a cubit: but the mouth thereof was round after the work of the base, a cubit and an half: and also upon the mouth of it were gravings with their borders, foursquare, not round.

verses.original: וְ/אַרְבַּ֣עַת הָ/אֽוֹפַנִּ֗ים לְ/מִ/תַּ֨חַת֙ לַֽ/מִּסְגְּר֔וֹת וִ/יד֥וֹת הָ/אֽוֹפַנִּ֖ים בַּ/מְּכוֹנָ֑ה וְ/קוֹמַת֙ הָ/אוֹפַ֣ן הָ/אֶחָ֔ד אַמָּ֖ה וַ/חֲצִ֥י הָ/אַמָּֽה
verses.translit: v'rb't h'vpnym lmtcht lmsgrvt vydvt h'vpnym bmkhvnh vqvmt h'vpn h'chd 'mh vchtsy h'mh
verses.translation: And under the borders were four wheels; and the axletrees of the wheels were joined to the base: and the height of a wheel was a cubit and half a cubit.

verses.original: וּ/מַֽעֲשֵׂה֙ הָ/א֣וֹפַנִּ֔ים כְּ/מַעֲשֵׂ֖ה אוֹפַ֣ן הַ/מֶּרְכָּבָ֑ה יְדוֹתָ֣/ם וְ/גַבֵּי/הֶ֗ם וְ/חִשֻּׁקֵי/הֶ֛ם וְ/חִשֻּׁרֵי/הֶ֖ם הַ/כֹּ֥ל מוּצָֽק
verses.translit: vm'shh h'vpnym khm'shh 'vpn hmrkhbh ydvtm vgbyhm vchshqyhm vchshryhm hkhl mvtsq
verses.translation: And the work of the wheels was like the work of a chariot wheel: their axletrees, and their naves, and their felloes, and their spokes, were all molten.

verses.original: וְ/אַרְבַּ֣ע כְּתֵפ֔וֹת אֶ֚ל אַרְבַּ֣ע פִּנּ֔וֹת הַ/מְּכֹנָ֖ה הָֽ/אֶחָ֑ת מִן הַ/מְּכֹנָ֖ה כְּתֵפֶֽי/הָ
verses.translit: v'rb' khtpvt 'l 'rb' pnvt hmkhnh h'cht mn hmkhnh khtpyh
verses.translation: And there were four undersetters to the four corners of one base: and the undersetters were of the very base itself.

verses.original: וּ/בְ/רֹ֣אשׁ הַ/מְּכוֹנָ֗ה חֲצִ֧י הָ/אַמָּ֛ה קוֹמָ֖ה עָגֹ֣ל סָבִ֑יב וְ/עַ֨ל רֹ֤אשׁ הַ/מְּכֹנָה֙ יְדֹתֶ֔י/הָ וּ/מִסְגְּרֹתֶ֖י/הָ מִמֶּֽ/נָּה
verses.translit: vbr'sh hmkhvnh chtsy h'mh qvmh 'gl sbyb v'l r'sh hmkhnh ydtyh vmsgrtyh mmnh
verses.translation: And in the top of the base was there a round compass of half a cubit high: and on the top of the base the ledges thereof and the borders thereof were of the same.

verses.original: וַ/יְפַתַּ֤ח עַל הַ/לֻּחֹת֙ יְדֹתֶ֔י/הָ וְ/עַל֙ ו/מסגרתי/ה מִסְגְּרֹתֶ֔י/הָ כְּרוּבִ֖ים אֲרָי֣וֹת וְ/תִמֹרֹ֑ת כְּ/מַֽעַר אִ֥ישׁ וְ/לֹי֖וֹת סָבִֽיב
verses.translit: vyptch 'l hlcht ydtyh v'l vmsgrtyh msgrtyh khrvbym 'ryvt vtmrt khm'r 'ysh vlyvt sbyb
verses.translation: For on the plates of the ledges thereof, and on the borders thereof, he graved cherubims, lions, and palm trees, according to the proportion of every one, and additions round about.

verses.original: כָּ/זֹ֣את עָשָׂ֔ה אֵ֖ת עֶ֣שֶׂר הַ/מְּכֹנ֑וֹת מוּצָ֨ק אֶחָ֜ד מִדָּ֥ה אַחַ֛ת קֶ֥צֶב אֶחָ֖ד לְ/כֻלָּֽ/הְנָה
verses.translit: khz't 'shh 't 'shr hmkhnvt mvtsq 'chd mdh 'cht qtsb 'chd lkhlhnh
verses.translation: After this manner he made the ten bases: all of them had one casting, one measure, and one size.

verses.original: וַ/יַּ֛עַשׂ עֲשָׂרָ֥ה כִיֹּר֖וֹת נְחֹ֑שֶׁת אַרְבָּעִ֨ים בַּ֜ת יָכִ֣יל הַ/כִּיּ֣וֹר הָ/אֶחָ֗ד אַרְבַּ֤ע בָּֽ/אַמָּה֙ הַ/כִּיּ֣וֹר הָ/אֶחָ֔ד כִּיּ֤וֹר אֶחָד֙ עַל הַ/מְּכוֹנָ֣ה הָ/אַחַ֔ת לְ/עֶ֖שֶׂר הַ/מְּכֹנֽוֹת
verses.translit: vy'sh 'shrh khyrvt nchsht 'rb'ym bt ykhyl hkhyvr h'chd 'rb' b'mh hkhyvr h'chd khyvr 'chd 'l hmkhvnh h'cht l'shr hmkhnvt
verses.translation: Then made he ten lavers of brass: one laver contained forty baths: and every laver was four cubits: and upon every one of the ten bases one laver.

verses.original: וַ/יִּתֵּן֙ אֶת הַ/מְּכֹנ֔וֹת חָמֵ֞שׁ עַל כֶּ֤תֶף הַ/בַּ֨יִת֙ מִ/יָּמִ֔ין וְ/חָמֵ֛שׁ עַל כֶּ֥תֶף הַ/בַּ֖יִת מִ/שְּׂמֹאל֑/וֹ וְ/אֶת הַ/יָּ֗ם נָתַ֞ן מִ/כֶּ֨תֶף הַ/בַּ֧יִת הַ/יְמָנִ֛ית קֵ֖דְמָ/ה מִ/מּ֥וּל נֶֽגֶב
verses.translit: vytn 't hmkhnvt chmsh 'l khtf hbyt mymyn vchmsh 'l khtf hbyt mshm'lv v't hym ntn mkhtf hbyt hymnyt qdmh mmvl ngb
verses.translation: And he put five bases on the right side of the house, and five on the left side of the house: and he set the sea on the right side of the house eastward over against the south.

verses.original: וַ/יַּ֣עַשׂ חִיר֔וֹם אֶת הַ֨/כִּיֹּר֔וֹת וְ/אֶת הַ/יָּעִ֖ים וְ/אֶת הַ/מִּזְרָק֑וֹת וַ/יְכַ֣ל חִירָ֗ם לַֽ/עֲשׂוֹת֙ אֶת כָּל הַ/מְּלָאכָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר עָשָׂ֛ה לַ/מֶּ֥לֶךְ שְׁלֹמֹ֖ה בֵּ֥ית יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: vy'sh chyrvm 't hkhyrvt v't hy'ym v't hmzrqvt vykhl chyrm l'shvt 't khl hml'khh 'shr 'shh lmlkh shlmh byt yhvh
verses.translation: And Hiram made the lavers, and the shovels, and the basons. So Hiram made an end of doing all the work that he made king Solomon for the house of the LORD :

verses.original: עַמֻּדִ֣ים שְׁנַ֔יִם וְ/גֻלֹּ֧ת הַ/כֹּתָרֹ֛ת אֲשֶׁר עַל רֹ֥אשׁ הָֽ/עַמֻּדִ֖ים שְׁתָּ֑יִם וְ/הַ/שְּׂבָכ֣וֹת שְׁתַּ֔יִם לְ/כַסּ֗וֹת אֶת שְׁתֵּי֙ גֻּלֹּ֣ת הַ/כֹּֽתָרֹ֔ת אֲשֶׁ֖ר עַל רֹ֥אשׁ הָ/עַמּוּדִֽים
verses.translit: 'mdym shnym vglt hkhtrt 'shr 'l r'sh h'mdym shtym vhshbkhvt shtym lkhsvt 't shty glt hkhtrt 'shr 'l r'sh h'mvdym
verses.translation: The two pillars, and the two bowls of the chapiters that were on the top of the two pillars; and the two networks, to cover the two bowls of the chapiters which were upon the top of the pillars;

verses.original: וְ/אֶת הָ/רִמֹּנִ֛ים אַרְבַּ֥ע מֵא֖וֹת לִ/שְׁתֵּ֣י הַ/שְּׂבָכ֑וֹת שְׁנֵֽי טוּרִ֤ים רִמֹּנִים֙ לַ/שְּׂבָכָ֣ה הָֽ/אֶחָ֔ת לְ/כַסּ֗וֹת אֶת שְׁתֵּי֙ גֻּלֹּ֣ת הַ/כֹּֽתָרֹ֔ת אֲשֶׁ֖ר עַל פְּנֵ֥י הָ/עַמּוּדִֽים
verses.translit: v't hrmnym 'rb' m'vt lshty hshbkhvt shny tvrym rmnym lshbkhh h'cht lkhsvt 't shty glt hkhtrt 'shr 'l pny h'mvdym
verses.translation: And four hundred pomegranates for the two networks, even two rows of pomegranates for one network, to cover the two bowls of the chapiters that were upon the pillars;

verses.original: וְ/אֶת הַ/מְּכֹנ֖וֹת עָ֑שֶׂר וְ/אֶת הַ/כִּיֹּרֹ֥ת עֲשָׂרָ֖ה עַל הַ/מְּכֹנֽוֹת
verses.translit: v't hmkhnvt 'shr v't hkhyrt 'shrh 'l hmkhnvt
verses.translation: And the ten bases, and ten lavers on the bases;

verses.original: וְ/אֶת הַ/יָּ֖ם הָ/אֶחָ֑ד וְ/אֶת הַ/בָּקָ֥ר שְׁנֵים עָשָׂ֖ר תַּ֥חַת הַ/יָּֽם
verses.translit: v't hym h'chd v't hbqr shnym 'shr tcht hym
verses.translation: And one sea, and twelve oxen under the sea;

verses.original: וְ/אֶת הַ/סִּיר֨וֹת וְ/אֶת הַ/יָּעִ֜ים וְ/אֶת הַ/מִּזְרָק֗וֹת וְ/אֵת֙ כָּל הַ/כֵּלִ֣ים ה/אהל הָ/אֵ֔לֶּה אֲשֶׁ֨ר עָשָׂ֥ה חִירָ֛ם לַ/מֶּ֥לֶךְ שְׁלֹמֹ֖ה בֵּ֣ית יְהוָ֑ה נְחֹ֖שֶׁת מְמֹרָֽט
verses.translit: v't hsyrvt v't hy'ym v't hmzrqvt v't khl hkhlym h'hl h'lh 'shr 'shh chyrm lmlkh shlmh byt yhvh nchsht mmrt
verses.translation: And the pots, and the shovels, and the basons: and all these vessels, which Hiram made to king Solomon for the house of the LORD , were of bright brass.

verses.original: בְּ/כִכַּ֤ר הַ/יַּרְדֵּן֙ יְצָקָ֣/ם הַ/מֶּ֔לֶךְ בְּ/מַעֲבֵ֖ה הָ/אֲדָמָ֑ה בֵּ֥ין סֻכּ֖וֹת וּ/בֵ֥ין צָרְתָֽן
verses.translit: bkhkhr hyrdn ytsqm hmlkh bm'bh h'dmh byn skhvt vbyn tsrtn
verses.translation: In the plain of Jordan did the king cast them, in the clay ground between Succoth and Zarthan.

verses.original: וַ/יַּנַּ֤ח שְׁלֹמֹה֙ אֶת כָּל הַ/כֵּלִ֔ים מֵ/רֹ֖ב מְאֹ֣ד מְאֹ֑ד לֹ֥א נֶחְקַ֖ר מִשְׁקַ֥ל הַ/נְּחֹֽשֶׁת
verses.translit: vynch shlmh 't khl hkhlym mrb m'd m'd l' nchqr mshql hnchsht
verses.translation: And Solomon left all the vessels unweighed , because they were exceeding many: neither was the weight of the brass found out.

verses.original: וַ/יַּ֣עַשׂ שְׁלֹמֹ֔ה אֵ֚ת כָּל הַ/כֵּלִ֔ים אֲשֶׁ֖ר בֵּ֣ית יְהוָ֑ה אֵ֚ת מִזְבַּ֣ח הַ/זָּהָ֔ב וְ/אֶת הַ/שֻּׁלְחָ֗ן אֲשֶׁ֥ר עָלָ֛י/ו לֶ֥חֶם הַ/פָּנִ֖ים זָהָֽב
verses.translit: vy'sh shlmh 't khl hkhlym 'shr byt yhvh 't mzbch hzhb v't hshlchn 'shr 'lyv lchm hpnym zhb
verses.translation: And Solomon made all the vessels that pertained unto the house of the LORD : the altar of gold, and the table of gold, whereupon the shewbread was ,

verses.original: וְ/אֶת הַ֠/מְּנֹרוֹת חָמֵ֨שׁ מִ/יָּמִ֜ין וְ/חָמֵ֧שׁ מִ/שְּׂמֹ֛אול לִ/פְנֵ֥י הַ/דְּבִ֖יר זָהָ֣ב סָג֑וּר וְ/הַ/פֶּ֧רַח וְ/הַ/נֵּרֹ֛ת וְ/הַ/מֶּלְקַחַ֖יִם זָהָֽב
verses.translit: v't hmnrvt chmsh mymyn vchmsh mshm'vl lpny hdbyr zhb sgvr vhprch vhnrt vhmlqchym zhb
verses.translation: And the candlesticks of pure gold, five on the right side , and five on the left, before the oracle, with the flowers, and the lamps, and the tongs of gold,

verses.original: וְ֠/הַ/סִּפּוֹת וְ/הַֽ/מְזַמְּר֧וֹת וְ/הַ/מִּזְרָק֛וֹת וְ/הַ/כַּפּ֥וֹת וְ/הַ/מַּחְתּ֖וֹת זָהָ֣ב סָג֑וּר וְ/הַ/פֹּת֡וֹת לְ/דַלְתוֹת֩ הַ/בַּ֨יִת הַ/פְּנִימִ֜י לְ/קֹ֣דֶשׁ הַ/קֳּדָשִׁ֗ים לְ/דַלְתֵ֥י הַ/בַּ֛יִת לַ/הֵיכָ֖ל זָהָֽב
verses.translit: vhspvt vhmzmrvt vhmzrqvt vhkhpvt vhmchtvt zhb sgvr vhptvt ldltvt hbyt hpnymy lqdsh hqdshym ldlty hbyt lhykhl zhb
verses.translation: And the bowls, and the snuffers, and the basons, and the spoons, and the censers of pure gold; and the hinges of gold, both for the doors of the inner house, the most holy place, and for the doors of the house, to wit , of the temple.

verses.original: וַ/תִּשְׁלַם֙ כָּל הַ/מְּלָאכָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר עָשָׂ֛ה הַ/מֶּ֥לֶךְ שְׁלֹמֹ֖ה בֵּ֣ית יְהוָ֑ה וַ/יָּבֵ֨א שְׁלֹמֹ֜ה אֶת קָדְשֵׁ֣י דָּוִ֣ד אָבִ֗י/ו אֶת הַ/כֶּ֤סֶף וְ/אֶת הַ/זָּהָב֙ וְ/אֶת הַ/כֵּלִ֔ים נָתַ֕ן בְּ/אֹצְר֖וֹת בֵּ֥ית יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: vtshlm khl hml'khh 'shr 'shh hmlkh shlmh byt yhvh vyb' shlmh 't qdshy dvd 'byv 't hkhsf v't hzhb v't hkhlym ntn b'tsrvt byt yhvh
verses.translation: So was ended all the work that king Solomon made for the house of the LORD . And Solomon brought in the things which David his father had dedicated; even the silver, and the gold, and the vessels, did he put among the treasures of the house of the LORD .

verses.original: אָ֣ז יַקְהֵ֣ל שְׁלֹמֹ֣ה אֶת זִקְנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֡ל אֶת כָּל רָאשֵׁ֣י הַ/מַּטּוֹת֩ נְשִׂיאֵ֨י הָ/אָב֜וֹת לִ/בְנֵ֧י יִשְׂרָאֵ֛ל אֶל הַ/מֶּ֥לֶךְ שְׁלֹמֹ֖ה יְרוּשָׁלִָ֑ם לְֽ/הַעֲל֞וֹת אֶת אֲר֧וֹן בְּרִית יְהוָ֛ה מֵ/עִ֥יר דָּוִ֖ד הִ֥יא צִיּֽוֹן
verses.translit: 'z yqhl shlmh 't zqny yshr'l 't khl r'shy hmtvt nshy'y h'bvt lbny yshr'l 'l hmlkh shlmh yrvshlm lh'lvt 't 'rvn bryt yhvh m'yr dvd hy' tsyvn
verses.translation: Then Solomon assembled the elders of Israel, and all the heads of the tribes, the chief of the fathers of the children of Israel, unto king Solomon in Jerusalem, that they might bring up the ark of the covenant of the LORD out of the city of David, which is Zion.

verses.original: וַ/יִּקָּ֨הֲל֜וּ אֶל הַ/מֶּ֤לֶךְ שְׁלֹמֹה֙ כָּל אִ֣ישׁ יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל בְּ/יֶ֥רַח הָ/אֵֽתָנִ֖ים בֶּ/חָ֑ג ה֖וּא הַ/חֹ֥דֶשׁ הַ/שְּׁבִיעִֽי
verses.translit: vyqhlv 'l hmlkh shlmh khl 'ysh yshr'l byrch h'tnym bchg hv' hchdsh hshby'y
verses.translation: And all the men of Israel assembled themselves unto king Solomon at the feast in the month Ethanim, which is the seventh month.

verses.original: וַ/יָּבֹ֕אוּ כֹּ֖ל זִקְנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וַ/יִּשְׂא֥וּ הַ/כֹּהֲנִ֖ים אֶת הָ/אָרֽוֹן
verses.translit: vyb'v khl zqny yshr'l vysh'v hkhhnym 't h'rvn
verses.translation: And all the elders of Israel came, and the priests took up the ark.

verses.original: וַֽ/יַּעֲל֞וּ אֶת אֲר֤וֹן יְהוָה֙ וְ/אֶת אֹ֣הֶל מוֹעֵ֔ד וְ/אֶֽת כָּל כְּלֵ֥י הַ/קֹּ֖דֶשׁ אֲשֶׁ֣ר בָּ/אֹ֑הֶל וַ/יַּעֲל֣וּ אֹתָ֔/ם הַ/כֹּהֲנִ֖ים וְ/הַ/לְוִיִּֽם
verses.translit: vy'lv 't 'rvn yhvh v't 'hl mv'd v't khl khly hqdsh 'shr b'hl vy'lv 'tm hkhhnym vhlvym
verses.translation: And they brought up the ark of the LORD , and the tabernacle of the congregation, and all the holy vessels that were in the tabernacle, even those did the priests and the Levites bring up.

verses.original: וְ/הַ/מֶּ֣לֶךְ שְׁלֹמֹ֗ה וְ/כָל עֲדַ֤ת יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ הַ/נּוֹעָדִ֣ים עָלָ֔י/ו אִתּ֖/וֹ לִ/פְנֵ֣י הָֽ/אָר֑וֹן מְזַבְּחִים֙ צֹ֣אן וּ/בָקָ֔ר אֲשֶׁ֧ר לֹֽא יִסָּפְר֛וּ וְ/לֹ֥א יִמָּנ֖וּ מֵ/רֹֽב
verses.translit: vhmlkh shlmh vkhl 'dt yshr'l hnv'dym 'lyv 'tv lpny h'rvn mzbchym ts'n vbqr 'shr l' ysprv vl' ymnv mrb
verses.translation: And king Solomon, and all the congregation of Israel, that were assembled unto him, were with him before the ark, sacrificing sheep and oxen, that could not be told nor numbered for multitude.

verses.original: וַ/יָּבִ֣אוּ הַ֠/כֹּהֲנִים אֶת אֲר֨וֹן בְּרִית יְהוָ֧ה אֶל מְקוֹמ֛/וֹ אֶל דְּבִ֥יר הַ/בַּ֖יִת אֶל קֹ֣דֶשׁ הַ/קֳּדָשִׁ֑ים אֶל תַּ֖חַת כַּנְפֵ֥י הַ/כְּרוּבִֽים
verses.translit: vyb'v hkhhnym 't 'rvn bryt yhvh 'l mqvmv 'l dbyr hbyt 'l qdsh hqdshym 'l tcht khnpy hkhrvbym
verses.translation: And the priests brought in the ark of the covenant of the LORD unto his place, into the oracle of the house, to the most holy place, even under the wings of the cherubims.

verses.original: כִּ֤י הַ/כְּרוּבִים֙ פֹּרְשִׂ֣ים כְּנָפַ֔יִם אֶל מְק֖וֹם הָֽ/אָר֑וֹן וַ/יָּסֹ֧כּוּ הַ/כְּרֻבִ֛ים עַל הָ/אָר֥וֹן וְ/עַל בַּדָּ֖י/ו מִ/לְ/מָֽעְלָ/ה
verses.translit: khy hkhrvbym prshym khnpym 'l mqvm h'rvn vyskhv hkhrbym 'l h'rvn v'l bdyv mlm'lh
verses.translation: For the cherubims spread forth their two wings over the place of the ark, and the cherubims covered the ark and the staves thereof above.

verses.original: וַֽ/יַּאֲרִכוּ֮ הַ/בַּדִּים֒ וַ/יֵּרָאוּ֩ רָאשֵׁ֨י הַ/בַּדִּ֤ים מִן הַ/קֹּ֨דֶשׁ֙ עַל פְּנֵ֣י הַ/דְּבִ֔יר וְ/לֹ֥א יֵרָא֖וּ הַ/ח֑וּצָ/ה וַ/יִּ֣הְיוּ שָׁ֔ם עַ֖ד הַ/יּ֥וֹם הַ/זֶּֽה
verses.translit: vy'rkhv hbdym vyr'v r'shy hbdym mn hqdsh 'l pny hdbyr vl' yr'v hchvtsh vyhyv shm 'd hyvm hzh
verses.translation: And they drew out the staves, that the ends of the staves were seen out in the holy place before the oracle, and they were not seen without: and there they are unto this day.

verses.original: אֵ֚ין בָּֽ/אָר֔וֹן רַ֗ק שְׁנֵי֙ לֻח֣וֹת הָ/אֲבָנִ֔ים אֲשֶׁ֨ר הִנִּ֥חַ שָׁ֛ם מֹשֶׁ֖ה בְּ/חֹרֵ֑ב אֲשֶׁ֨ר כָּרַ֤ת יְהוָה֙ עִם בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל בְּ/צֵאתָ֖/ם מֵ/אֶ֥רֶץ מִצְרָֽיִם
verses.translit: 'yn b'rvn rq shny lchvt h'bnym 'shr hnch shm mshh bchrb 'shr khrt yhvh 'm bny yshr'l bts'tm m'rts mtsrym
verses.translation: There was nothing in the ark save the two tables of stone, which Moses put there at Horeb, when the LORD made a covenant with the children of Israel, when they came out of the land of Egypt.

verses.original: וַ/יְהִ֕י בְּ/צֵ֥את הַ/כֹּהֲנִ֖ים מִן הַ/קֹּ֑דֶשׁ וְ/הֶ/עָנָ֥ן מָלֵ֖א אֶת בֵּ֥ית יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: vyhy bts't hkhhnym mn hqdsh vh'nn ml' 't byt yhvh
verses.translation: And it came to pass, when the priests were come out of the holy place , that the cloud filled the house of the LORD ,

verses.original: וְ/לֹֽא יָכְל֧וּ הַ/כֹּהֲנִ֛ים לַ/עֲמֹ֥ד לְ/שָׁרֵ֖ת מִ/פְּנֵ֥י הֶֽ/עָנָ֑ן כִּי מָלֵ֥א כְבוֹד יְהוָ֖ה אֶת בֵּ֥ית יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: vl' ykhlv hkhhnym l'md lshrt mpny h'nn khy ml' khbvd yhvh 't byt yhvh
verses.translation: So that the priests could not stand to minister because of the cloud: for the glory of the LORD had filled the house of the LORD .

verses.original: אָ֖ז אָמַ֣ר שְׁלֹמֹ֑ה יְהוָ֣ה אָמַ֔ר לִ/שְׁכֹּ֖ן בָּ/עֲרָפֶֽל
verses.translit: 'z 'mr shlmh yhvh 'mr lshkhn b'rpl
verses.translation: Then spake Solomon, The LORD said that he would dwell in the thick darkness.

verses.original: בָּנֹ֥ה בָנִ֛יתִי בֵּ֥ית זְבֻ֖ל לָ֑/ךְ מָכ֥וֹן לְ/שִׁבְתְּ/ךָ֖ עוֹלָמִֽים
verses.translit: bnh bnyty byt zbl lkh mkhvn lshbtkh 'vlmym
verses.translation: I have surely built thee an house to dwell in, a settled place for thee to abide in for ever.

verses.original: וַ/יַּסֵּ֤ב הַ/מֶּ֨לֶךְ֙ אֶת פָּנָ֔י/ו וַ/יְבָ֕רֶךְ אֵ֖ת כָּל קְהַ֣ל יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וְ/כָל קְהַ֥ל יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל עֹמֵֽד
verses.translit: vysb hmlkh 't pnyv vybrkh 't khl qhl yshr'l vkhl qhl yshr'l 'md
verses.translation: And the king turned his face about, and blessed all the congregation of Israel: (and all the congregation of Israel stood;)

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֗אמֶר בָּר֤וּךְ יְהוָה֙ אֱלֹהֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל אֲשֶׁר֙ דִּבֶּ֣ר בְּ/פִ֔י/ו אֵ֖ת דָּוִ֣ד אָבִ֑/י וּ/בְ/יָד֥/וֹ מִלֵּ֖א לֵ/אמֹֽר
verses.translit: vy'mr brvkh yhvh 'lhy yshr'l 'shr dbr bpyv 't dvd 'by vbydv ml' l'mr
verses.translation: And he said, Blessed be the LORD God of Israel, which spake with his mouth unto David my father, and hath with his hand fulfilled it , saying,

verses.original: מִן הַ/יּ֗וֹם אֲשֶׁ֨ר הוֹצֵ֜אתִי אֶת עַמִּ֣/י אֶת יִשְׂרָאֵל֮ מִ/מִּצְרַיִם֒ לֹֽא בָחַ֣רְתִּי בְ/עִ֗יר מִ/כֹּל֙ שִׁבְטֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל לִ/בְנ֣וֹת בַּ֔יִת לִ/הְי֥וֹת שְׁמִ֖/י שָׁ֑ם וָ/אֶבְחַ֣ר בְּ/דָוִ֔ד לִֽ/הְי֖וֹת עַל עַמִּ֥/י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל
verses.translit: mn hyvm 'shr hvts'ty 't 'my 't yshr'l mmtsrym l' bchrty b'yr mkhl shbty yshr'l lbnvt byt lhyvt shmy shm v'bchr bdvd lhyvt 'l 'my yshr'l
verses.translation: Since the day that I brought forth my people Israel out of Egypt, I chose no city out of all the tribes of Israel to build an house, that my name might be therein; but I chose David to be over my people Israel.

verses.original: וַ/יְהִ֕י עִם לְבַ֖ב דָּוִ֣ד אָבִ֑/י לִ/בְנ֣וֹת בַּ֔יִת לְ/שֵׁ֥ם יְהוָ֖ה אֱלֹהֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל
verses.translit: vyhy 'm lbb dvd 'by lbnvt byt lshm yhvh 'lhy yshr'l
verses.translation: And it was in the heart of David my father to build an house for the name of the LORD God of Israel.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֤אמֶר יְהוָה֙ אֶל דָּוִ֣ד אָבִ֔/י יַ֗עַן אֲשֶׁ֤ר הָיָה֙ עִם לְבָ֣בְ/ךָ֔ לִ/בְנ֥וֹת בַּ֖יִת לִ/שְׁמִ֑/י הֱטִיבֹ֔תָ כִּ֥י הָיָ֖ה עִם לְבָבֶֽ/ךָ
verses.translit: vy'mr yhvh 'l dvd 'by y'n 'shr hyh 'm lbbkh lbnvt byt lshmy htybt khy hyh 'm lbbkh
verses.translation: And the LORD said unto David my father, Whereas it was in thine heart to build an house unto my name, thou didst well that it was in thine heart.

verses.original: רַ֣ק אַתָּ֔ה לֹ֥א תִבְנֶ֖ה הַ/בָּ֑יִת כִּ֤י אִם בִּנְ/ךָ֙ הַ/יֹּצֵ֣א מֵ/חֲלָצֶ֔י/ךָ הֽוּא יִבְנֶ֥ה הַ/בַּ֖יִת לִ/שְׁמִֽ/י
verses.translit: rq 'th l' tbnh hbyt khy 'm bnkh hyts' mchltsykh hv' ybnh hbyt lshmy
verses.translation: Nevertheless thou shalt not build the house; but thy son that shall come forth out of thy loins, he shall build the house unto my name.

verses.original: וַ/יָּ֣קֶם יְהוָ֔ה אֶת דְּבָר֖/וֹ אֲשֶׁ֣ר דִּבֵּ֑ר וָ/אָקֻ֡ם תַּחַת֩ דָּוִ֨ד אָבִ֜/י וָ/אֵשֵׁ֣ב עַל כִּסֵּ֣א יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל כַּֽ/אֲשֶׁר֙ דִּבֶּ֣ר יְהוָ֔ה וָ/אֶבְנֶ֣ה הַ/בַּ֔יִת לְ/שֵׁ֥ם יְהוָ֖ה אֱלֹהֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל
verses.translit: vyqm yhvh 't dbrv 'shr dbr v'qm tcht dvd 'by v'shb 'l khs' yshr'l kh'shr dbr yhvh v'bnh hbyt lshm yhvh 'lhy yshr'l
verses.translation: And the LORD hath performed his word that he spake, and I am risen up in the room of David my father, and sit on the throne of Israel, as the LORD promised, and have built an house for the name of the LORD God of Israel.

verses.original: וָ/אָשִׂ֨ם שָׁ֤ם מָקוֹם֙ לָֽ/אָר֔וֹן אֲשֶׁר שָׁ֖ם בְּרִ֣ית יְהוָ֑ה אֲשֶׁ֤ר כָּרַת֙ עִם אֲבֹתֵ֔י/נוּ בְּ/הוֹצִיא֥/וֹ אֹתָ֖/ם מֵ/אֶ֥רֶץ מִצְרָֽיִם
verses.translit: v'shm shm mqvm l'rvn 'shr shm bryt yhvh 'shr khrt 'm 'btynv bhvtsy'v 'tm m'rts mtsrym
verses.translation: And I have set there a place for the ark, wherein is the covenant of the LORD , which he made with our fathers, when he brought them out of the land of Egypt.

verses.original: וַ/יַּעֲמֹ֣ד שְׁלֹמֹ֗ה לִ/פְנֵי֙ מִזְבַּ֣ח יְהוָ֔ה נֶ֖גֶד כָּל קְהַ֣ל יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וַ/יִּפְרֹ֥שׂ כַּפָּ֖י/ו הַ/שָּׁמָֽיִם
verses.translit: vy'md shlmh lpny mzbch yhvh ngd khl qhl yshr'l vyprsh khpyv hshmym
verses.translation: And Solomon stood before the altar of the LORD in the presence of all the congregation of Israel, and spread forth his hands toward heaven:

verses.original: וַ/יֹּאמַ֗ר יְהוָ֞ה אֱלֹהֵ֤י יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ אֵין כָּמ֣וֹ/ךָ אֱלֹהִ֔ים בַּ/שָּׁמַ֣יִם מִ/מַּ֔עַל וְ/עַל הָ/אָ֖רֶץ מִ/תָּ֑חַת שֹׁמֵ֤ר הַ/בְּרִית֙ וְֽ/הַ/חֶ֔סֶד לַ/עֲבָדֶ֕י/ךָ הַ/הֹלְכִ֥ים לְ/פָנֶ֖י/ךָ בְּ/כָל לִבָּֽ/ם
verses.translit: vy'mr yhvh 'lhy yshr'l 'yn khmvkh 'lhym bshmym mm'l v'l h'rts mtcht shmr hbryt vhchsd l'bdykh hhlkhym lpnykh bkhl lbm
verses.translation: And he said, LORD God of Israel, there is no God like thee, in heaven above, or on earth beneath, who keepest covenant and mercy with thy servants that walk before thee with all their heart:

verses.translit: 'shr shmrt l'bdkh dvd 'by 't 'shr dbrt lv vtdbr bpykh vbydkh ml't khyvm hzh
verses.translation: Who hast kept with thy servant David my father that thou promisedst him: thou spakest also with thy mouth, and hast fulfilled it with thine hand, as it is this day.

verses.original: וְ/עַתָּ֞ה יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל שְׁ֠מֹר לְ/עַבְדְּ/ךָ֨ דָוִ֤ד אָבִ/י֙ אֵת֩ אֲשֶׁ֨ר דִּבַּ֤רְתָּ לּ/וֹ֙ לֵ/אמֹ֔ר לֹא יִכָּרֵ֨ת לְ/ךָ֥ אִישׁ֙ מִ/לְּ/פָנַ֔/י יֹשֵׁ֖ב עַל כִּסֵּ֣א יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל רַ֠ק אִם יִשְׁמְר֨וּ בָנֶ֤י/ךָ אֶת דַּרְכָּ/ם֙ לָ/לֶ֣כֶת לְ/פָנַ֔/י כַּ/אֲשֶׁ֥ר הָלַ֖כְתָּ לְ/פָנָֽ/י
verses.translit: v'th yhvh 'lhy yshr'l shmr l'bdkh dvd 'by 't 'shr dbrt lv l'mr l' ykhrt lkh 'ysh mlpny yshb 'l khs' yshr'l rq 'm yshmrv bnykh 't drkhm llkht lpny kh'shr hlkht lpny
verses.translation: Therefore now, LORD God of Israel, keep with thy servant David my father that thou promisedst him, saying, There shall not fail thee a man in my sight to sit on the throne of Israel; so that thy children take heed to their way, that they walk before me as thou hast walked before me.

verses.original: וְ/עַתָּ֖ה אֱלֹהֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל יֵאָ֤מֶן נָא֙ דברי/ך דְּבָ֣רְ/ךָ֔ אֲשֶׁ֣ר דִּבַּ֔רְתָּ לְ/עַבְדְּ/ךָ֖ דָּוִ֥ד אָבִֽ/י
verses.translit: v'th 'lhy yshr'l y'mn n' dbrykh dbrkh 'shr dbrt l'bdkh dvd 'by
verses.translation: And now, O God of Israel, let thy word, I pray thee, be verified, which thou spakest unto thy servant David my father.

verses.original: כִּ֚י הַֽ/אֻמְנָ֔ם יֵשֵׁ֥ב אֱלֹהִ֖ים עַל הָ/אָ֑רֶץ הִ֠נֵּה הַ/שָּׁמַ֜יִם וּ/שְׁמֵ֤י הַ/שָּׁמַ֨יִם֙ לֹ֣א יְכַלְכְּל֔וּ/ךָ אַ֕ף כִּֽי הַ/בַּ֥יִת הַ/זֶּ֖ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר בָּנִֽיתִי
verses.translit: khy h'mnm yshb 'lhym 'l h'rts hnh hshmym vshmy hshmym l' ykhlkhlvkh 'f khy hbyt hzh 'shr bnyty
verses.translation: But will God indeed dwell on the earth? behold, the heaven and heaven of heavens cannot contain thee; how much less this house that I have builded?

verses.original: וּ/פָנִ֜יתָ אֶל תְּפִלַּ֧ת עַבְדְּ/ךָ֛ וְ/אֶל תְּחִנָּת֖/וֹ יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהָ֑/י לִ/שְׁמֹ֤עַ אֶל הָֽ/רִנָּה֙ וְ/אֶל הַ/תְּפִלָּ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֧ר עַבְדְּ/ךָ֛ מִתְפַּלֵּ֥ל לְ/פָנֶ֖י/ךָ הַ/יּֽוֹם
verses.translit: vpnyt 'l tplt 'bdkh v'l tchntv yhvh 'lhy lshm' 'l hrnh v'l htplh 'shr 'bdkh mtpll lpnykh hyvm
verses.translation: Yet have thou respect unto the prayer of thy servant, and to his supplication, O LORD my God, to hearken unto the cry and to the prayer, which thy servant prayeth before thee to day:

verses.original: לִ/הְיוֹת֩ עֵינֶ֨/ךָ פְתֻח֜וֹת אֶל הַ/בַּ֤יִת הַ/זֶּה֙ לַ֣יְלָה וָ/י֔וֹם אֶל הַ֨/מָּק֔וֹם אֲשֶׁ֣ר אָמַ֔רְתָּ יִהְיֶ֥ה שְׁמִ֖/י שָׁ֑ם לִ/שְׁמֹ֨עַ֙ אֶל הַ/תְּפִלָּ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֣ר יִתְפַּלֵּ֣ל עַבְדְּ/ךָ֔ אֶל הַ/מָּק֖וֹם הַ/זֶּֽה
verses.translit: lhyvt 'ynkh ptchvt 'l hbyt hzh lylh vyvm 'l hmqvm 'shr 'mrt yhyh shmy shm lshm' 'l htplh 'shr ytpll 'bdkh 'l hmqvm hzh
verses.translation: That thine eyes may be open toward this house night and day, even toward the place of which thou hast said, My name shall be there: that thou mayest hearken unto the prayer which thy servant shall make toward this place.

verses.original: וְ/שָׁ֨מַעְתָּ֜ אֶל תְּחִנַּ֤ת עַבְדְּ/ךָ֙ וְ/עַמְּ/ךָ֣ יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל אֲשֶׁ֥ר יִֽתְפַּֽלְל֖וּ אֶל הַ/מָּק֣וֹם הַ/זֶּ֑ה וְ֠/אַתָּה תִּשְׁמַ֞ע אֶל מְק֤וֹם שִׁבְתְּ/ךָ֙ אֶל הַ/שָּׁמַ֔יִם וְ/שָׁמַעְתָּ֖ וְ/סָלָֽחְתָּ
verses.translit: vshm't 'l tchnt 'bdkh v'mkh yshr'l 'shr ytpllv 'l hmqvm hzh v'th tshm' 'l mqvm shbtkh 'l hshmym vshm't vslcht
verses.translation: And hearken thou to the supplication of thy servant, and of thy people Israel, when they shall pray toward this place: and hear thou in heaven thy dwelling place: and when thou hearest, forgive.

verses.original: אֵת֩ אֲשֶׁ֨ר יֶחֱטָ֥א אִישׁ֙ לְ/רֵעֵ֔/הוּ וְ/נָֽשָׁא ב֥/וֹ אָלָ֖ה לְ/הַֽאֲלֹת֑/וֹ וּ/בָ֗א אָלָ֛ה לִ/פְנֵ֥י מִֽזְבַּחֲ/ךָ֖ בַּ/בַּ֥יִת הַ/זֶּֽה
verses.translit: 't 'shr ycht' 'ysh lr'hv vnsh' bv 'lh lh'ltv vb' 'lh lpny mzbchkh bbyt hzh
verses.translation: If any man trespass against his neighbour, and an oath be laid upon him to cause him to swear, and the oath come before thine altar in this house:

verses.original: וְ/אַתָּ֣ה תִּשְׁמַ֣ע הַ/שָּׁמַ֗יִם וְ/עָשִׂ֨יתָ֙ וְ/שָׁפַטְתָּ֣ אֶת עֲבָדֶ֔י/ךָ לְ/הַרְשִׁ֣יעַ רָשָׁ֔ע לָ/תֵ֥ת דַּרְכּ֖/וֹ בְּ/רֹאשׁ֑/וֹ וּ/לְ/הַצְדִּ֣יק צַדִּ֔יק לָ֥/תֶת ל֖/וֹ כְּ/צִדְקָתֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: v'th tshm' hshmym v'shyt vshptt 't 'bdykh lhrshy' rsh' ltt drkhv br'shv vlhtsdyq tsdyq ltt lv khtsdqtv
verses.translation: Then hear thou in heaven, and do, and judge thy servants, condemning the wicked, to bring his way upon his head; and justifying the righteous, to give him according to his righteousness.

verses.original: בְּֽ/הִנָּגֵ֞ף עַמְּ/ךָ֧ יִשְׂרָאֵ֛ל לִ/פְנֵ֥י אוֹיֵ֖ב אֲשֶׁ֣ר יֶחֶטְאוּ לָ֑/ךְ וְ/שָׁ֤בוּ אֵלֶ֨י/ךָ֙ וְ/הוֹד֣וּ אֶת שְׁמֶ֔/ךָ וְ/הִֽתְפַּֽלְל֧וּ וְ/הִֽתְחַנְּנ֛וּ אֵלֶ֖י/ךָ בַּ/בַּ֥יִת הַ/זֶּֽה
verses.translit: bhngf 'mkh yshr'l lpny 'vyb 'shr ycht'v lkh vshbv 'lykh vhvdv 't shmkh vhtpllv vhtchnnv 'lykh bbyt hzh
verses.translation: When thy people Israel be smitten down before the enemy, because they have sinned against thee, and shall turn again to thee, and confess thy name, and pray, and make supplication unto thee in this house:

verses.original: וְ/אַתָּה֙ תִּשְׁמַ֣ע הַ/שָּׁמַ֔יִם וְ/סָ֣לַחְתָּ֔ לְ/חַטַּ֖את עַמְּ/ךָ֣ יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וַ/הֲשֵֽׁבֹתָ/ם֙ אֶל הָ֣/אֲדָמָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר נָתַ֖תָּ לַ/אֲבוֹתָֽ/ם
verses.translit: v'th tshm' hshmym vslcht lcht't 'mkh yshr'l vhshbtm 'l h'dmh 'shr ntt l'bvtm
verses.translation: Then hear thou in heaven, and forgive the sin of thy people Israel, and bring them again unto the land which thou gavest unto their fathers.

verses.original: בְּ/הֵעָצֵ֥ר שָׁמַ֛יִם וְ/לֹא יִהְיֶ֥ה מָטָ֖ר כִּ֣י יֶחֶטְאוּ לָ֑/ךְ וְ/הִֽתְפַּֽלְל֞וּ אֶל הַ/מָּק֤וֹם הַ/זֶּה֙ וְ/הוֹד֣וּ אֶת שְׁמֶ֔/ךָ וּ/מֵ/חַטָּאתָ֥/ם יְשׁוּב֖וּ/ן כִּ֥י תַעֲנֵֽ/ם
verses.translit: bh'tsr shmym vl' yhyh mtr khy ycht'v lkh vhtpllv 'l hmqvm hzh vhvdv 't shmkh vmcht'tm yshvbvn khy t'nm
verses.translation: When heaven is shut up, and there is no rain, because they have sinned against thee; if they pray toward this place, and confess thy name, and turn from their sin, when thou afflictest them:

verses.original: וְ/אַתָּ֣ה תִּשְׁמַ֣ע הַ/שָּׁמַ֗יִם וְ/סָ֨לַחְתָּ֜ לְ/חַטַּ֤את עֲבָדֶ֨י/ךָ֙ וְ/עַמְּ/ךָ֣ יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל כִּ֥י תוֹרֵ֛/ם אֶת הַ/דֶּ֥רֶךְ הַ/טּוֹבָ֖ה אֲשֶׁ֣ר יֵֽלְכוּ בָ֑/הּ וְ/נָתַתָּ֤ה מָטָר֙ עַל אַרְצְ/ךָ֔ אֲשֶׁר נָתַ֥תָּה לְ/עַמְּ/ךָ֖ לְ/נַחֲלָֽה
verses.translit: v'th tshm' hshmym vslcht lcht't 'bdykh v'mkh yshr'l khy tvrm 't hdrkh htvbh 'shr ylkhv bh vntth mtr 'l 'rtskh 'shr ntth l'mkh lnchlh
verses.translation: Then hear thou in heaven, and forgive the sin of thy servants, and of thy people Israel, that thou teach them the good way wherein they should walk, and give rain upon thy land, which thou hast given to thy people for an inheritance.

verses.original: רָעָ֞ב כִּֽי יִהְיֶ֣ה בָ/אָ֗רֶץ דֶּ֣בֶר כִּֽי יִ֠הְיֶה שִׁדָּפ֨וֹן יֵרָק֜וֹן אַרְבֶּ֤ה חָסִיל֙ כִּ֣י יִהְיֶ֔ה כִּ֧י יָֽצַר ל֛/וֹ אֹיְב֖/וֹ בְּ/אֶ֣רֶץ שְׁעָרָ֑י/ו כָּל נֶ֖גַע כָּֽל מַחֲלָֽה
verses.translit: r'b khy yhyh b'rts dbr khy yhyh shdpvn yrqvn 'rbh chsyl khy yhyh khy ytsr lv 'ybv b'rts sh'ryv khl ng' khl mchlh
verses.translation: If there be in the land famine, if there be pestilence, blasting, mildew, locust, or if there be caterpiller; if their enemy besiege them in the land of their cities; whatsoever plague, whatsoever sickness there be;

verses.original: כָּל תְּפִלָּ֣ה כָל תְּחִנָּ֗ה אֲשֶׁ֤ר תִֽהְיֶה֙ לְ/כָל הָ֣/אָדָ֔ם לְ/כֹ֖ל עַמְּ/ךָ֣ יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל אֲשֶׁ֣ר יֵדְע֗וּ/ן אִ֚ישׁ נֶ֣גַע לְבָב֔/וֹ וּ/פָרַ֥שׂ כַּפָּ֖י/ו אֶל הַ/בַּ֥יִת הַ/זֶּֽה
verses.translit: khl tplh khl tchnh 'shr thyh lkhl h'dm lkhl 'mkh yshr'l 'shr yd'vn 'ysh ng' lbbv vprsh khpyv 'l hbyt hzh
verses.translation: What prayer and supplication soever be made by any man, or by all thy people Israel, which shall know every man the plague of his own heart, and spread forth his hands toward this house:

verses.original: וְ֠/אַתָּה תִּשְׁמַ֨ע הַ/שָּׁמַ֜יִם מְכ֤וֹן שִׁבְתֶּ֨/ךָ֙ וְ/סָלַחְתָּ֣ וְ/עָשִׂ֔יתָ וְ/נָתַתָּ֤ לָ/אִישׁ֙ כְּ/כָל דְּרָכָ֔י/ו אֲשֶׁ֥ר תֵּדַ֖ע אֶת לְבָב֑/וֹ כִּֽי אַתָּ֤ה יָדַ֨עְתָּ֙ לְ/בַדְּ/ךָ֔ אֶת לְבַ֖ב כָּל בְּנֵ֥י הָ/אָדָֽם
verses.translit: v'th tshm' hshmym mkhvn shbtkh vslcht v'shyt vntt l'ysh khkhl drkhyv 'shr td' 't lbbv khy 'th yd't lbdkh 't lbb khl bny h'dm
verses.translation: Then hear thou in heaven thy dwelling place, and forgive, and do, and give to every man according to his ways, whose heart thou knowest; (for thou, even thou only, knowest the hearts of all the children of men;)

verses.original: לְמַ֨עַן֙ יִֽרָא֔וּ/ךָ כָּל הַ֨/יָּמִ֔ים אֲשֶׁר הֵ֥ם חַיִּ֖ים עַל פְּנֵ֣י הָ/אֲדָמָ֑ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר נָתַ֖תָּה לַ/אֲבֹתֵֽי/נוּ
verses.translit: lm'n yr'vkh khl hymym 'shr hm chyym 'l pny h'dmh 'shr ntth l'btynv
verses.translation: That they may fear thee all the days that they live in the land which thou gavest unto our fathers.

verses.original: וְ/גַם֙ אֶל הַ/נָּכְרִ֔י אֲשֶׁ֛ר לֹא מֵ/עַמְּ/ךָ֥ יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל ה֑וּא וּ/בָ֛א מֵ/אֶ֥רֶץ רְחוֹקָ֖ה לְמַ֥עַן שְׁמֶֽ/ךָ
verses.translit: vgm 'l hnkhry 'shr l' m'mkh yshr'l hv' vb' m'rts rchvqh lm'n shmkh
verses.translation: Moreover concerning a stranger, that is not of thy people Israel, but cometh out of a far country for thy name’s sake;

verses.original: כִּ֤י יִשְׁמְעוּ/ן֙ אֶת שִׁמְ/ךָ֣ הַ/גָּד֔וֹל וְ/אֶת יָֽדְ/ךָ֙ הַֽ/חֲזָקָ֔ה וּֽ/זְרֹעֲ/ךָ֖ הַ/נְּטוּיָ֑ה וּ/בָ֥א וְ/הִתְפַּלֵּ֖ל אֶל הַ/בַּ֥יִת הַ/זֶּֽה
verses.translit: khy yshm'vn 't shmkh hgdvl v't ydkh hchzqh vzr'kh hntvyh vb' vhtpll 'l hbyt hzh
verses.translation: (For they shall hear of thy great name, and of thy strong hand, and of thy stretched out arm;) when he shall come and pray toward this house;

verses.original: אַתָּ֞ה תִּשְׁמַ֤ע הַ/שָּׁמַ֨יִם֙ מְכ֣וֹן שִׁבְתֶּ֔/ךָ וְ/עָשִׂ֕יתָ כְּ/כֹ֛ל אֲשֶׁר יִקְרָ֥א אֵלֶ֖י/ךָ הַ/נָּכְרִ֑י לְמַ֣עַן יֵדְעוּ/ן֩ כָּל עַמֵּ֨י הָ/אָ֜רֶץ אֶת שְׁמֶ֗/ךָ לְ/יִרְאָ֤ה אֹֽתְ/ךָ֙ כְּ/עַמְּ/ךָ֣ יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל וְ/לָ/דַ֕עַת כִּי שִׁמְ/ךָ֣ נִקְרָ֔א עַל הַ/בַּ֥יִת הַ/זֶּ֖ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר בָּנִֽיתִי
verses.translit: 'th tshm' hshmym mkhvn shbtkh v'shyt khkhl 'shr yqr' 'lykh hnkhry lm'n yd'vn khl 'my h'rts 't shmkh lyr'h 'tkh kh'mkh yshr'l vld't khy shmkh nqr' 'l hbyt hzh 'shr bnyty
verses.translation: Hear thou in heaven thy dwelling place, and do according to all that the stranger calleth to thee for: that all people of the earth may know thy name, to fear thee, as do thy people Israel; and that they may know that this house, which I have builded, is called by thy name.

verses.original: כִּי יֵצֵ֨א עַמְּ/ךָ֤ לַ/מִּלְחָמָה֙ עַל אֹ֣יְב֔/וֹ בַּ/דֶּ֖רֶךְ אֲשֶׁ֣ר תִּשְׁלָחֵ֑/ם וְ/הִתְפַּֽלְל֣וּ אֶל יְהוָ֗ה דֶּ֤רֶךְ הָ/עִיר֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר בָּחַ֣רְתָּ בָּ֔/הּ וְ/הַ/בַּ֖יִת אֲשֶׁר בָּנִ֥תִי לִ/שְׁמֶֽ/ךָ
verses.translit: khy yts' 'mkh lmlchmh 'l 'ybv bdrkh 'shr tshlchm vhtpllv 'l yhvh drkh h'yr 'shr bchrt bh vhbyt 'shr bnty lshmkh
verses.translation: If thy people go out to battle against their enemy, whithersoever thou shalt send them, and shall pray unto the LORD toward the city which thou hast chosen, and toward the house that I have built for thy name:

verses.original: וְ/שָׁמַעְתָּ֙ הַ/שָּׁמַ֔יִם אֶת תְּפִלָּתָ֖/ם וְ/אֶת תְּחִנָּתָ֑/ם וְ/עָשִׂ֖יתָ מִשְׁפָּטָֽ/ם
verses.translit: vshm't hshmym 't tpltm v't tchntm v'shyt mshptm
verses.translation: Then hear thou in heaven their prayer and their supplication, and maintain their cause.

verses.original: כִּ֣י יֶֽחֶטְאוּ לָ֗/ךְ כִּ֣י אֵ֤ין אָדָם֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר לֹא יֶחֱטָ֔א וְ/אָנַפְתָּ֣ בָ֔/ם וּ/נְתַתָּ֖/ם לִ/פְנֵ֣י אוֹיֵ֑ב וְ/שָׁב֤וּ/ם שֹֽׁבֵי/הֶם֙ אֶל אֶ֣רֶץ הָ/אוֹיֵ֔ב רְחוֹקָ֖ה א֥וֹ קְרוֹבָֽה
verses.translit: khy ycht'v lkh khy 'yn 'dm 'shr l' ycht' v'npt bm vnttm lpny 'vyb vshbvm shbyhm 'l 'rts h'vyb rchvqh 'v qrvbh
verses.translation: If they sin against thee, (for there is no man that sinneth not,) and thou be angry with them, and deliver them to the enemy, so that they carry them away captives unto the land of the enemy, far or near;

verses.original: וְ/הֵשִׁ֨יבוּ֙ אֶל לִבָּ֔/ם בָּ/אָ֖רֶץ אֲשֶׁ֣ר נִשְׁבּוּ שָׁ֑ם וְ/שָׁ֣בוּ וְ/הִֽתְחַנְּנ֣וּ אֵלֶ֗י/ךָ בְּ/אֶ֤רֶץ שֹֽׁבֵי/הֶם֙ לֵ/אמֹ֔ר חָטָ֥אנוּ וְ/הֶעֱוִ֖ינוּ רָשָֽׁעְנוּ
verses.translit: vhshybv 'l lbm b'rts 'shr nshbv shm vshbv vhtchnnv 'lykh b'rts shbyhm l'mr cht'nv vh'vynv rsh'nv
verses.translation: Yet if they shall bethink themselves in the land whither they were carried captives, and repent, and make supplication unto thee in the land of them that carried them captives, saying, We have sinned, and have done perversely, we have committed wickedness;

verses.original: וְ/שָׁ֣בוּ אֵלֶ֗י/ךָ בְּ/כָל לְבָבָ/ם֙ וּ/בְ/כָל נַפְשָׁ֔/ם בְּ/אֶ֥רֶץ אֹיְבֵי/הֶ֖ם אֲשֶׁר שָׁב֣וּ אֹתָ֑/ם וְ/הִֽתְפַּֽלְל֣וּ אֵלֶ֗י/ךָ דֶּ֤רֶךְ אַרְצָ/ם֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר נָתַ֣תָּה לַ/אֲבוֹתָ֔/ם הָ/עִיר֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר בָּחַ֔רְתָּ וְ/הַ/בַּ֖יִת אֲשֶׁר בנית בָּנִ֥יתִי לִ/שְׁמֶֽ/ךָ
verses.translit: vshbv 'lykh bkhl lbbm vbkhl npshm b'rts 'ybyhm 'shr shbv 'tm vhtpllv 'lykh drkh 'rtsm 'shr ntth l'bvtm h'yr 'shr bchrt vhbyt 'shr bnyt bnyty lshmkh
verses.translation: And so return unto thee with all their heart, and with all their soul, in the land of their enemies, which led them away captive, and pray unto thee toward their land, which thou gavest unto their fathers, the city which thou hast chosen, and the house which I have built for thy name:

verses.original: וְ/שָׁמַעְתָּ֤ הַ/שָּׁמַ֨יִם֙ מְכ֣וֹן שִׁבְתְּ/ךָ֔ אֶת תְּפִלָּתָ֖/ם וְ/אֶת תְּחִנָּתָ֑/ם וְ/עָשִׂ֖יתָ מִשְׁפָּטָֽ/ם
verses.translit: vshm't hshmym mkhvn shbtkh 't tpltm v't tchntm v'shyt mshptm
verses.translation: Then hear thou their prayer and their supplication in heaven thy dwelling place, and maintain their cause,

verses.original: וְ/סָלַחְתָּ֤ לְ/עַמְּ/ךָ֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר חָֽטְאוּ לָ֔/ךְ וּ/לְ/כָל פִּשְׁעֵי/הֶ֖ם אֲשֶׁ֣ר פָּשְׁעוּ בָ֑/ךְ וּ/נְתַתָּ֧/ם לְ/רַחֲמִ֛ים לִ/פְנֵ֥י שֹׁבֵי/הֶ֖ם וְ/רִֽחֲמֽוּ/ם
verses.translit: vslcht l'mkh 'shr cht'v lkh vlkhl psh'yhm 'shr psh'v bkh vnttm lrchmym lpny shbyhm vrchmvm
verses.translation: And forgive thy people that have sinned against thee, and all their transgressions wherein they have transgressed against thee, and give them compassion before them who carried them captive, that they may have compassion on them:

verses.original: כִּֽי עַמְּ/ךָ֥ וְ/נַחֲלָתְ/ךָ֖ הֵ֑ם אֲשֶׁ֤ר הוֹצֵ֨אתָ֙ מִ/מִּצְרַ֔יִם מִ/תּ֖וֹךְ כּ֥וּר הַ/בַּרְזֶֽל
verses.translit: khy 'mkh vnchltkh hm 'shr hvts't mmtsrym mtvkh khvr hbrzl
verses.translation: For they be thy people, and thine inheritance, which thou broughtest forth out of Egypt, from the midst of the furnace of iron:

verses.original: לִ/הְי֨וֹת עֵינֶ֤י/ךָ פְתֻחוֹת֙ אֶל תְּחִנַּ֣ת עַבְדְּ/ךָ֔ וְ/אֶל תְּחִנַּ֖ת עַמְּ/ךָ֣ יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל לִ/שְׁמֹ֣עַ אֲלֵי/הֶ֔ם בְּ/כֹ֖ל קָרְאָ֥/ם אֵלֶֽי/ךָ
verses.translit: lhyvt 'ynykh ptchvt 'l tchnt 'bdkh v'l tchnt 'mkh yshr'l lshm' 'lyhm bkhl qr'm 'lykh
verses.translation: That thine eyes may be open unto the supplication of thy servant, and unto the supplication of thy people Israel, to hearken unto them in all that they call for unto thee.

verses.original: כִּֽי אַתָּ֞ה הִבְדַּלְתָּ֤/ם לְ/ךָ֙ לְֽ/נַחֲלָ֔ה מִ/כֹּ֖ל עַמֵּ֣י הָ/אָ֑רֶץ כַּ/אֲשֶׁ֨ר דִּבַּ֜רְתָּ בְּ/יַ֣ד מֹשֶׁ֣ה עַבְדֶּ֗/ךָ בְּ/הוֹצִיאֲ/ךָ֧ אֶת אֲבֹתֵ֛י/נוּ מִ/מִּצְרַ֖יִם אֲדֹנָ֥/י יְהוִֽה
verses.translit: khy 'th hbdltm lkh lnchlh mkhl 'my h'rts kh'shr dbrt byd mshh 'bdkh bhvtsy'kh 't 'btynv mmtsrym 'dny yhvh
verses.translation: For thou didst separate them from among all the people of the earth, to be thine inheritance, as thou spakest by the hand of Moses thy servant, when thou broughtest our fathers out of Egypt, O Lord GOD .

verses.original: וַ/יְהִ֣י כְּ/כַלּ֣וֹת שְׁלֹמֹ֗ה לְ/הִתְפַּלֵּל֙ אֶל יְהוָ֔ה אֵ֛ת כָּל הַ/תְּפִלָּ֥ה וְ/הַ/תְּחִנָּ֖ה הַ/זֹּ֑את קָ֞ם מִ/לִּ/פְנֵ֨י מִזְבַּ֤ח יְהוָה֙ מִ/כְּרֹ֣עַ עַל בִּרְכָּ֔י/ו וְ/כַפָּ֖י/ו פְּרֻשׂ֥וֹת הַ/שָּׁמָֽיִם
verses.translit: vyhy khkhlvt shlmh lhtpll 'l yhvh 't khl htplh vhtchnh hz't qm mlpny mzbch yhvh mkhr' 'l brkhyv vkhpyv prshvt hshmym
verses.translation: And it was so , that when Solomon had made an end of praying all this prayer and supplication unto the LORD , he arose from before the altar of the LORD , from kneeling on his knees with his hands spread up to heaven.

verses.original: וַֽ/יַּעְמֹ֕ד וַ/יְבָ֕רֶךְ אֵ֖ת כָּל קְהַ֣ל יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל ק֥וֹל גָּד֖וֹל לֵ/אמֹֽר
verses.translit: vy'md vybrkh 't khl qhl yshr'l qvl gdvl l'mr
verses.translation: And he stood, and blessed all the congregation of Israel with a loud voice, saying,

verses.original: בָּר֣וּךְ יְהוָ֗ה אֲשֶׁ֨ר נָתַ֤ן מְנוּחָה֙ לְ/עַמּ֣/וֹ יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל כְּ/כֹ֖ל אֲשֶׁ֣ר דִּבֵּ֑ר לֹֽא נָפַ֞ל דָּבָ֣ר אֶחָ֗ד מִ/כֹּל֙ דְּבָר֣/וֹ הַ/טּ֔וֹב אֲשֶׁ֣ר דִּבֶּ֔ר בְּ/יַ֖ד מֹשֶׁ֥ה עַבְדּֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: brvkh yhvh 'shr ntn mnvchh l'mv yshr'l khkhl 'shr dbr l' npl dbr 'chd mkhl dbrv htvb 'shr dbr byd mshh 'bdv
verses.translation: Blessed be the LORD , that hath given rest unto his people Israel, according to all that he promised: there hath not failed one word of all his good promise, which he promised by the hand of Moses his servant.

verses.original: יְהִ֨י יְהוָ֤ה אֱלֹהֵ֨י/נוּ֙ עִמָּ֔/נוּ כַּ/אֲשֶׁ֥ר הָיָ֖ה עִם אֲבֹתֵ֑י/נוּ אַל יַעַזְבֵ֖/נוּ וְ/אַֽל יִטְּשֵֽׁ/נוּ
verses.translit: yhy yhvh 'lhynv 'mnv kh'shr hyh 'm 'btynv 'l y'zbnv v'l ytshnv
verses.translation: The LORD our God be with us, as he was with our fathers: let him not leave us, nor forsake us:

verses.original: לְ/הַטּ֥וֹת לְבָבֵ֖/נוּ אֵלָ֑י/ו לָ/לֶ֣כֶת בְּ/כָל דְּרָכָ֗י/ו וְ/לִ/שְׁמֹ֨ר מִצְוֺתָ֤י/ו וְ/חֻקָּי/ו֙ וּ/מִשְׁפָּטָ֔י/ו אֲשֶׁ֥ר צִוָּ֖ה אֶת אֲבֹתֵֽי/נוּ
verses.translit: lhtvt lbbnv 'lyv llkht bkhl drkhyv vlshmr mtsvtyv vchqyv vmshptyv 'shr tsvh 't 'btynv
verses.translation: That he may incline our hearts unto him, to walk in all his ways, and to keep his commandments, and his statutes, and his judgments, which he commanded our fathers.

verses.original: וְ/יִֽהְי֨וּ דְבָרַ֜/י אֵ֗לֶּה אֲשֶׁ֤ר הִתְחַנַּ֨נְתִּי֙ לִ/פְנֵ֣י יְהוָ֔ה קְרֹבִ֛ים אֶל יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֵ֖י/נוּ יוֹמָ֣ם וָ/לָ֑יְלָה לַ/עֲשׂ֣וֹת מִשְׁפַּ֣ט עַבְדּ֗/וֹ וּ/מִשְׁפַּ֛ט עַמּ֥/וֹ יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל דְּבַר י֥וֹם בְּ/יוֹמֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: vyhyv dbry 'lh 'shr htchnnty lpny yhvh qrbym 'l yhvh 'lhynv yvmm vlylh l'shvt mshpt 'bdv vmshpt 'mv yshr'l dbr yvm byvmv
verses.translation: And let these my words, wherewith I have made supplication before the LORD , be nigh unto the LORD our God day and night, that he maintain the cause of his servant, and the cause of his people Israel at all times, as the matter shall require:

verses.original: לְמַ֗עַן דַּ֚עַת כָּל עַמֵּ֣י הָ/אָ֔רֶץ כִּ֥י יְהוָ֖ה ה֣וּא הָ/אֱלֹהִ֑ים אֵ֖ין עֽוֹד
verses.translit: lm'n d't khl 'my h'rts khy yhvh hv' h'lhym 'yn 'vd
verses.translation: That all the people of the earth may know that the LORD is God, and that there is none else.

verses.original: וְ/הָיָ֤ה לְבַבְ/כֶם֙ שָׁלֵ֔ם עִ֖ם יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֵ֑י/נוּ לָ/לֶ֧כֶת בְּ/חֻקָּ֛י/ו וְ/לִ/שְׁמֹ֥ר מִצְוֺתָ֖י/ו כַּ/יּ֥וֹם הַ/זֶּֽה
verses.translit: vhyh lbbkhm shlm 'm yhvh 'lhynv llkht bchqyv vlshmr mtsvtyv khyvm hzh
verses.translation: Let your heart therefore be perfect with the LORD our God, to walk in his statutes, and to keep his commandments, as at this day.

verses.original: וְֽ/הַ/מֶּ֔לֶךְ וְ/כָל יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל עִמּ֑/וֹ זֹבְחִ֥ים זֶ֖בַח לִ/פְנֵ֥י יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: vhmlkh vkhl yshr'l 'mv zbchym zbch lpny yhvh
verses.translation: And the king, and all Israel with him, offered sacrifice before the LORD .

verses.original: וַ/יִּזְבַּ֣ח שְׁלֹמֹ֗ה אֵ֣ת זֶ֣בַח הַ/שְּׁלָמִים֮ אֲשֶׁ֣ר זָבַ֣ח לַ/יהוָה֒ בָּקָ֗ר עֶשְׂרִ֤ים וּ/שְׁנַ֨יִם֙ אֶ֔לֶף וְ/צֹ֕אן מֵאָ֥ה וְ/עֶשְׂרִ֖ים אָ֑לֶף וַֽ/יַּחְנְכוּ֙ אֶת בֵּ֣ית יְהוָ֔ה הַ/מֶּ֖לֶךְ וְ/כָל בְּנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל
verses.translit: vyzbch shlmh 't zbch hshlmym 'shr zbch lyhvh bqr 'shrym vshnym 'lf vts'n m'h v'shrym 'lf vychnkhv 't byt yhvh hmlkh vkhl bny yshr'l
verses.translation: And Solomon offered a sacrifice of peace offerings, which he offered unto the LORD , two and twenty thousand oxen, and an hundred and twenty thousand sheep. So the king and all the children of Israel dedicated the house of the LORD .

verses.original: בַּ/יּ֣וֹם הַ/ה֗וּא קִדַּ֨שׁ הַ/מֶּ֜לֶךְ אֶת תּ֣וֹךְ הֶ/חָצֵ֗ר אֲשֶׁר֙ לִ/פְנֵ֣י בֵית יְהוָ֔ה כִּי עָ֣שָׂה שָׁ֗ם אֶת הָֽ/עֹלָה֙ וְ/אֶת הַ/מִּנְחָ֔ה וְ/אֵ֖ת חֶלְבֵ֣י הַ/שְּׁלָמִ֑ים כִּֽי מִזְבַּ֤ח הַ/נְּחֹ֨שֶׁת֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר לִ/פְנֵ֣י יְהוָ֔ה קָטֹ֗ן מֵֽ/הָכִיל֙ אֶת הָ/עֹלָ֣ה וְ/אֶת הַ/מִּנְחָ֔ה וְ/אֵ֖ת חֶלְבֵ֥י הַ/שְּׁלָמִֽים
verses.translit: byvm hhv' qdsh hmlkh 't tvkh hchtsr 'shr lpny byt yhvh khy 'shh shm 't h'lh v't hmnchh v't chlby hshlmym khy mzbch hnchsht 'shr lpny yhvh qtn mhkhyl 't h'lh v't hmnchh v't chlby hshlmym
verses.translation: The same day did the king hallow the middle of the court that was before the house of the LORD : for there he offered burnt offerings, and meat offerings, and the fat of the peace offerings: because the brasen altar that was before the LORD was too little to receive the burnt offerings, and meat offerings, and the fat of the peace offerings.

verses.original: וַ/יַּ֣עַשׂ שְׁלֹמֹ֣ה בָֽ/עֵת הַ/הִ֣יא אֶת הֶ/חָ֡ג וְ/כָל יִשְׂרָאֵ֣ל עִמּ/וֹ֩ קָהָ֨ל גָּד֜וֹל מִ/לְּב֥וֹא חֲמָ֣ת עַד נַ֣חַל מִצְרַ֗יִם לִ/פְנֵי֙ יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֵ֔י/נוּ שִׁבְעַ֥ת יָמִ֖ים וְ/שִׁבְעַ֣ת יָמִ֑ים אַרְבָּעָ֥ה עָשָׂ֖ר יֽוֹם
verses.translit: vy'sh shlmh b't hhy' 't hchg vkhl yshr'l 'mv qhl gdvl mlbv' chmt 'd nchl mtsrym lpny yhvh 'lhynv shb't ymym vshb't ymym 'rb'h 'shr yvm
verses.translation: And at that time Solomon held a feast, and all Israel with him, a great congregation, from the entering in of Hamath unto the river of Egypt, before the LORD our God, seven days and seven days, even fourteen days.

verses.original: בַּ/יּ֤וֹם הַ/שְּׁמִינִי֙ שִׁלַּ֣ח אֶת הָ/עָ֔ם וַֽ/יְבָרֲכ֖וּ אֶת הַ/מֶּ֑לֶךְ וַ/יֵּלְכ֣וּ לְ/אָהֳלֵי/הֶ֗ם שְׂמֵחִים֙ וְ/ט֣וֹבֵי לֵ֔ב עַ֣ל כָּל הַ/טּוֹבָ֗ה אֲשֶׁ֨ר עָשָׂ֤ה יְהוָה֙ לְ/דָוִ֣ד עַבְדּ֔/וֹ וּ/לְ/יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל עַמּֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: byvm hshmyny shlch 't h'm vybrkhv 't hmlkh vylkhv l'hlyhm shmchym vtvby lb 'l khl htvbh 'shr 'shh yhvh ldvd 'bdv vlyshr'l 'mv
verses.translation: On the eighth day he sent the people away: and they blessed the king, and went unto their tents joyful and glad of heart for all the goodness that the LORD had done for David his servant, and for Israel his people.

verses.original: וַ/יְהִי֙ כְּ/כַלּ֣וֹת שְׁלֹמֹ֔ה לִ/בְנ֥וֹת אֶת בֵּית יְהוָ֖ה וְ/אֶת בֵּ֣ית הַ/מֶּ֑לֶךְ וְ/אֵת֙ כָּל חֵ֣שֶׁק שְׁלֹמֹ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר חָפֵ֖ץ לַ/עֲשֽׂוֹת
verses.translit: vyhy khkhlvt shlmh lbnvt 't byt yhvh v't byt hmlkh v't khl chshq shlmh 'shr chpts l'shvt
verses.translation: And it came to pass, when Solomon had finished the building of the house of the LORD , and the king’s house, and all Solomon’s desire which he was pleased to do,

verses.original: וַ/יֵּרָ֧א יְהוָ֛ה אֶל שְׁלֹמֹ֖ה שֵׁנִ֑ית כַּ/אֲשֶׁ֛ר נִרְאָ֥ה אֵלָ֖י/ו בְּ/גִבְעֽוֹן
verses.translit: vyr' yhvh 'l shlmh shnyt kh'shr nr'h 'lyv bgb'vn
verses.translation: That the LORD appeared to Solomon the second time, as he had appeared unto him at Gibeon.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֨אמֶר יְהוָ֜ה אֵלָ֗י/ו שָׁ֠מַעְתִּי אֶת תְּפִלָּתְ/ךָ֣ וְ/אֶת תְּחִנָּתְ/ךָ֮ אֲשֶׁ֣ר הִתְחַנַּ֣נְתָּה לְ/פָנַ/י֒ הִקְדַּ֗שְׁתִּי אֶת הַ/בַּ֤יִת הַ/זֶּה֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר בָּנִ֔תָה לָ/שֽׂוּם שְׁמִ֥/י שָׁ֖ם עַד עוֹלָ֑ם וְ/הָי֨וּ עֵינַ֧/י וְ/לִבִּ֛/י שָׁ֖ם כָּל הַ/יָּמִֽים
verses.translit: vy'mr yhvh 'lyv shm'ty 't tpltkh v't tchntkh 'shr htchnnth lpny hqdshty 't hbyt hzh 'shr bnth lshvm shmy shm 'd 'vlm vhyv 'yny vlby shm khl hymym
verses.translation: And the LORD said unto him, I have heard thy prayer and thy supplication, that thou hast made before me: I have hallowed this house, which thou hast built, to put my name there for ever; and mine eyes and mine heart shall be there perpetually.

verses.original: וְ/אַתָּ֞ה אִם תֵּלֵ֣ךְ לְ/פָנַ֗/י כַּ/אֲשֶׁ֨ר הָלַ֜ךְ דָּוִ֤ד אָבִ֨י/ךָ֙ בְּ/תָם לֵבָ֣ב וּ/בְ/יֹ֔שֶׁר לַ/עֲשׂ֕וֹת כְּ/כֹ֖ל אֲשֶׁ֣ר צִוִּיתִ֑י/ךָ חֻקַּ֥/י וּ/מִשְׁפָּטַ֖/י תִּשְׁמֹֽר
verses.translit: v'th 'm tlkh lpny kh'shr hlkh dvd 'bykh btm lbb vbyshr l'shvt khkhl 'shr tsvytykh chqy vmshpty tshmr
verses.translation: And if thou wilt walk before me, as David thy father walked, in integrity of heart, and in uprightness, to do according to all that I have commanded thee, and wilt keep my statutes and my judgments:

verses.original: וַ/הֲקִ֨מֹתִ֜י אֶת כִּסֵּ֧א מַֽמְלַכְתְּ/ךָ֛ עַל יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל לְ/עֹלָ֑ם כַּ/אֲשֶׁ֣ר דִּבַּ֗רְתִּי עַל דָּוִ֤ד אָבִ֨י/ךָ֙ לֵ/אמֹ֔ר לֹֽא יִכָּרֵ֤ת לְ/ךָ֙ אִ֔ישׁ מֵ/עַ֖ל כִּסֵּ֥א יִשְׂרָאֵֽל
verses.translit: vhqmty 't khs' mmlkhtkh 'l yshr'l l'lm kh'shr dbrty 'l dvd 'bykh l'mr l' ykhrt lkh 'ysh m'l khs' yshr'l
verses.translation: Then I will establish the throne of thy kingdom upon Israel for ever, as I promised to David thy father, saying, There shall not fail thee a man upon the throne of Israel.

verses.original: אִם שׁ֨וֹב תְּשֻׁב֜וּ/ן אַתֶּ֤ם וּ/בְנֵי/כֶם֙ מֵֽ/אַחֲרַ֔/י וְ/לֹ֤א תִשְׁמְרוּ֙ מִצְוֺתַ֣/י חֻקֹּתַ֔/י אֲשֶׁ֥ר נָתַ֖תִּי לִ/פְנֵי/כֶ֑ם וַ/הֲלַכְתֶּ֗ם וַ/עֲבַדְתֶּם֙ אֱלֹהִ֣ים אֲחֵרִ֔ים וְ/הִשְׁתַּחֲוִיתֶ֖ם לָ/הֶֽם
verses.translit: 'm shvb tshbvn 'tm vbnykhm m'chry vl' tshmrv mtsvty chqty 'shr ntty lpnykhm vhlkhtm v'bdtm 'lhym 'chrym vhshtchvytm lhm
verses.translation: But if ye shall at all turn from following me, ye or your children, and will not keep my commandments and my statutes which I have set before you, but go and serve other gods, and worship them:

verses.original: וְ/הִכְרַתִּ֣י אֶת יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל מֵ/עַ֨ל פְּנֵ֤י הָ/אֲדָמָה֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר נָתַ֣תִּי לָ/הֶ֔ם וְ/אֶת הַ/בַּ֨יִת֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר הִקְדַּ֣שְׁתִּי לִ/שְׁמִ֔/י אֲשַׁלַּ֖ח מֵ/עַ֣ל פָּנָ֑/י וְ/הָיָ֧ה יִשְׂרָאֵ֛ל לְ/מָשָׁ֥ל וְ/לִ/שְׁנִינָ֖ה בְּ/כָל הָ/עַמִּֽים
verses.translit: vhkhrty 't yshr'l m'l pny h'dmh 'shr ntty lhm v't hbyt 'shr hqdshty lshmy 'shlch m'l pny vhyh yshr'l lmshl vlshnynh bkhl h'mym
verses.translation: Then will I cut off Israel out of the land which I have given them; and this house, which I have hallowed for my name, will I cast out of my sight; and Israel shall be a proverb and a byword among all people:

verses.original: וְ/הַ/בַּ֤יִת הַ/זֶּה֙ יִהְיֶ֣ה עֶלְי֔וֹן כָּל עֹבֵ֥ר עָלָ֖י/ו יִשֹּׁ֣ם וְ/שָׁרָ֑ק וְ/אָמְר֗וּ עַל מֶ֨ה עָשָׂ֤ה יְהוָה֙ כָּ֔כָה לָ/אָ֥רֶץ הַ/זֹּ֖את וְ/לַ/בַּ֥יִת הַ/זֶּֽה
verses.translit: vhbyt hzh yhyh 'lyvn khl 'br 'lyv yshm vshrq v'mrv 'l mh 'shh yhvh khkhh l'rts hz't vlbyt hzh
verses.translation: And at this house, which is high, every one that passeth by it shall be astonished, and shall hiss; and they shall say, Why hath the LORD done thus unto this land, and to this house?

verses.original: וְ/אָמְר֗וּ עַל֩ אֲשֶׁ֨ר עָזְב֜וּ אֶת יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֵי/הֶ֗ם אֲשֶׁ֨ר הוֹצִ֣יא אֶת אֲבֹתָ/ם֮ מֵ/אֶ֣רֶץ מִצְרַיִם֒ וַֽ/יַּחֲזִ֨קוּ֙ בֵּ/אלֹהִ֣ים אֲחֵרִ֔ים ו/ישתחו וַ/יִּשְׁתַּחֲו֥וּ לָ/הֶ֖ם וַ/יַּעַבְדֻ֑/ם עַל כֵּ֗ן הֵבִ֤יא יְהוָה֙ עֲלֵי/הֶ֔ם אֵ֥ת כָּל הָ/רָעָ֖ה הַ/זֹּֽאת
verses.translit: v'mrv 'l 'shr 'zbv 't yhvh 'lhyhm 'shr hvtsy' 't 'btm m'rts mtsrym vychzqv b'lhym 'chrym vyshtchv vyshtchvv lhm vy'bdm 'l khn hby' yhvh 'lyhm 't khl hr'h hz't
verses.translation: And they shall answer, Because they forsook the LORD their God, who brought forth their fathers out of the land of Egypt, and have taken hold upon other gods, and have worshipped them, and served them: therefore hath the LORD brought upon them all this evil.

verses.original: וַ/יְהִ֗י מִ/קְצֵה֙ עֶשְׂרִ֣ים שָׁנָ֔ה אֲשֶׁר בָּנָ֥ה שְׁלֹמֹ֖ה אֶת שְׁנֵ֣י הַ/בָּתִּ֑ים אֶת בֵּ֥ית יְהוָ֖ה וְ/אֶת בֵּ֥ית הַ/מֶּֽלֶךְ
verses.translit: vyhy mqtsh 'shrym shnh 'shr bnh shlmh 't shny hbtym 't byt yhvh v't byt hmlkh
verses.translation: And it came to pass at the end of twenty years, when Solomon had built the two houses, the house of the LORD , and the king’s house,

verses.original: חִירָ֣ם מֶֽלֶךְ צֹ֠ר נִשָּׂ֨א אֶת שְׁלֹמֹ֜ה בַּ/עֲצֵי֩ אֲרָזִ֨ים וּ/בַ/עֲצֵ֧י בְרוֹשִׁ֛ים וּ/בַ/זָּהָ֖ב לְ/כָל חֶפְצ֑/וֹ אָ֡ז יִתֵּן֩ הַ/מֶּ֨לֶךְ שְׁלֹמֹ֤ה לְ/חִירָם֙ עֶשְׂרִ֣ים עִ֔יר בְּ/אֶ֖רֶץ הַ/גָּלִֽיל
verses.translit: chyrm mlkh tsr nsh' 't shlmh b'tsy 'rzym vb'tsy brvshym vbzhb lkhl chptsv 'z ytn hmlkh shlmh lchyrm 'shrym 'yr b'rts hglyl
verses.translation: ( Now Hiram the king of Tyre had furnished Solomon with cedar trees and fir trees, and with gold, according to all his desire,) that then king Solomon gave Hiram twenty cities in the land of Galilee.

verses.original: וַ/יֵּצֵ֤א חִירָם֙ מִ/צֹּ֔ר לִ/רְאוֹת֙ אֶת הֶ֣/עָרִ֔ים אֲשֶׁ֥ר נָתַן ל֖/וֹ שְׁלֹמֹ֑ה וְ/לֹ֥א יָשְׁר֖וּ בְּ/עֵינָֽי/ו
verses.translit: vyts' chyrm mtsr lr'vt 't h'rym 'shr ntn lv shlmh vl' yshrv b'ynyv
verses.translation: And Hiram came out from Tyre to see the cities which Solomon had given him; and they pleased him not.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֕אמֶר מָ֚ה הֶ/עָרִ֣ים הָ/אֵ֔לֶּה אֲשֶׁר נָתַ֥תָּה לִּ֖/י אָחִ֑/י וַ/יִּקְרָ֤א לָ/הֶם֙ אֶ֣רֶץ כָּב֔וּל עַ֖ד הַ/יּ֥וֹם הַ/זֶּֽה
verses.translit: vy'mr mh h'rym h'lh 'shr ntth ly 'chy vyqr' lhm 'rts khbvl 'd hyvm hzh
verses.translation: And he said, What cities are these which thou hast given me, my brother? And he called them the land of Cabul unto this day.

verses.original: וַ/יִּשְׁלַ֥ח חִירָ֖ם לַ/מֶּ֑לֶךְ מֵאָ֥ה וְ/עֶשְׂרִ֖ים כִּכַּ֥ר זָהָֽב
verses.translit: vyshlch chyrm lmlkh m'h v'shrym khkhr zhb
verses.translation: And Hiram sent to the king sixscore talents of gold.

verses.original: וְ/זֶ֨ה דְבַר הַ/מַּ֜ס אֲשֶֽׁר הֶעֱלָ֣ה הַ/מֶּ֣לֶךְ שְׁלֹמֹ֗ה לִ/בְנוֹת֩ אֶת בֵּ֨ית יְהוָ֤ה וְ/אֶת בֵּית/וֹ֙ וְ/אֶת הַ/מִּלּ֔וֹא וְ/אֵ֖ת חוֹמַ֣ת יְרוּשָׁלִָ֑ם וְ/אֶת חָצֹ֥ר וְ/אֶת מְגִדּ֖וֹ וְ/אֶת גָּֽזֶר
verses.translit: vzh dbr hms 'shr h'lh hmlkh shlmh lbnvt 't byt yhvh v't bytv v't hmlv' v't chvmt yrvshlm v't chtsr v't mgdv v't gzr
verses.translation: And this is the reason of the levy which king Solomon raised; for to build the house of the LORD , and his own house, and Millo, and the wall of Jerusalem, and Hazor, and Megiddo, and Gezer.

verses.original: פַּרְעֹ֨ה מֶֽלֶךְ מִצְרַ֜יִם עָלָ֗ה וַ/יִּלְכֹּ֤ד אֶת גֶּ֨זֶר֙ וַ/יִּשְׂרְפָ֣/הּ בָּ/אֵ֔שׁ וְ/אֶת הַֽ/כְּנַעֲנִ֛י הַ/יֹּשֵׁ֥ב בָּ/עִ֖יר הָרָ֑ג וַֽ/יִּתְּנָ/הּ֙ שִׁלֻּחִ֔ים לְ/בִתּ֖/וֹ אֵ֥שֶׁת שְׁלֹמֹֽה
verses.translit: pr'h mlkh mtsrym 'lh vylkhd 't gzr vyshrph b'sh v't hkhn'ny hyshb b'yr hrg vytnh shlchym lbtv 'sht shlmh
verses.translation: For Pharaoh king of Egypt had gone up, and taken Gezer, and burnt it with fire, and slain the Canaanites that dwelt in the city, and given it for a present unto his daughter, Solomon’s wife.

verses.original: וַ/יִּ֤בֶן שְׁלֹמֹה֙ אֶת גָּ֔זֶר וְ/אֶת בֵּ֥ית חֹרֹ֖ן תַּחְתּֽוֹן
verses.translit: vybn shlmh 't gzr v't byt chrn tchtvn
verses.translation: And Solomon built Gezer, and Beth-horon the nether,

verses.original: וְ/אֶֽת בַּעֲלָ֛ת וְ/אֶת תמר תַּדְמֹ֥ר בַּ/מִּדְבָּ֖ר בָּ/אָֽרֶץ
verses.translit: v't b'lt v't tmr tdmr bmdbr b'rts
verses.translation: And Baalath, and Tadmor in the wilderness, in the land,

verses.original: וְ/אֵ֨ת כָּל עָרֵ֤י הַֽ/מִּסְכְּנוֹת֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר הָי֣וּ לִ/שְׁלֹמֹ֔ה וְ/אֵת֙ עָרֵ֣י הָ/רֶ֔כֶב וְ/אֵ֖ת עָרֵ֣י הַ/פָּרָשִׁ֑ים וְ/אֵ֣ת חֵ֣שֶׁק שְׁלֹמֹ֗ה אֲשֶׁ֤ר חָשַׁק֙ לִ/בְנ֤וֹת בִּ/ירוּשָׁלִַ֨ם֙ וּ/בַ/לְּבָנ֔וֹן וּ/בְ/כֹ֖ל אֶ֥רֶץ מֶמְשַׁלְתּֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: v't khl 'ry hmskhnvt 'shr hyv lshlmh v't 'ry hrkhb v't 'ry hprshym v't chshq shlmh 'shr chshq lbnvt byrvshlm vblbnvn vbkhl 'rts mmshltv
verses.translation: And all the cities of store that Solomon had, and cities for his chariots, and cities for his horsemen, and that which Solomon desired to build in Jerusalem, and in Lebanon, and in all the land of his dominion.

verses.original: כָּל הָ֠/עָם הַ/נּוֹתָ֨ר מִן הָ/אֱמֹרִ֜י הַ/חִתִּ֤י הַ/פְּרִזִּי֙ הַ/חִוִּ֣י וְ/הַ/יְבוּסִ֔י אֲשֶׁ֛ר לֹֽא מִ/בְּנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל הֵֽמָּה
verses.translit: khl h'm hnvtr mn h'mry hchty hprzy hchvy vhybvsy 'shr l' mbny yshr'l hmh
verses.translation: And all the people that were left of the Amorites, Hittites, Perizzites, Hivites, and Jebusites, which were not of the children of Israel,

verses.original: בְּנֵי/הֶ֗ם אֲשֶׁ֨ר נֹתְר֤וּ אַחֲרֵי/הֶם֙ בָּ/אָ֔רֶץ אֲשֶׁ֧ר לֹֽא יָכְל֛וּ בְּנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל לְ/הַֽחֲרִימָ֑/ם וַ/יַּעֲלֵ֤/ם שְׁלֹמֹה֙ לְ/מַס עֹבֵ֔ד עַ֖ד הַ/יּ֥וֹם הַ/זֶּֽה
verses.translit: bnyhm 'shr ntrv 'chryhm b'rts 'shr l' ykhlv bny yshr'l lhchrymm vy'lm shlmh lms 'bd 'd hyvm hzh
verses.translation: Their children that were left after them in the land, whom the children of Israel also were not able utterly to destroy, upon those did Solomon levy a tribute of bondservice unto this day.

verses.original: וּ/מִ/בְּנֵי֙ יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל לֹֽא נָתַ֥ן שְׁלֹמֹ֖ה עָ֑בֶד כִּי הֵ֞ם אַנְשֵׁ֣י הַ/מִּלְחָמָ֗ה וַ/עֲבָדָי/ו֙ וְ/שָׂרָ֣י/ו וְ/שָׁלִשָׁ֔י/ו וְ/שָׂרֵ֥י רִכְבּ֖/וֹ וּ/פָרָשָֽׁי/ו
verses.translit: vmbny yshr'l l' ntn shlmh 'bd khy hm 'nshy hmlchmh v'bdyv vshryv vshlshyv vshry rkhbv vprshyv
verses.translation: But of the children of Israel did Solomon make no bondmen: but they were men of war, and his servants, and his princes, and his captains, and rulers of his chariots, and his horsemen.

verses.original: אֵ֣לֶּה שָׂרֵ֣י הַ/נִּצָּבִ֗ים אֲשֶׁ֤ר עַל הַ/מְּלָאכָה֙ לִ/שְׁלֹמֹ֔ה חֲמִשִּׁ֖ים וַ/חֲמֵ֣שׁ מֵא֑וֹת הָ/רֹדִ֣ים בָּ/עָ֔ם הָ/עֹשִׂ֖ים בַּ/מְּלָאכָֽה
verses.translit: 'lh shry hntsbym 'shr 'l hml'khh lshlmh chmshym vchmsh m'vt hrdym b'm h'shym bml'khh
verses.translation: These were the chief of the officers that were over Solomon’s work, five hundred and fifty, which bare rule over the people that wrought in the work.

verses.original: אַ֣ךְ בַּת פַּרְעֹ֗ה עָֽלְתָה֙ מֵ/עִ֣יר דָּוִ֔ד אֶל בֵּיתָ֖/הּ אֲשֶׁ֣ר בָּֽנָה לָ֑/הּ אָ֖ז בָּנָ֥ה אֶת הַ/מִּלּֽוֹא
verses.translit: 'kh bt pr'h 'lth m'yr dvd 'l byth 'shr bnh lh 'z bnh 't hmlv'
verses.translation: But Pharaoh’s daughter came up out of the city of David unto her house which Solomon had built for her: then did he build Millo.

verses.original: וְ/הֶעֱלָ֣ה שְׁלֹמֹ֡ה שָׁלֹשׁ֩ פְּעָמִ֨ים בַּ/שָּׁנָ֜ה עֹל֣וֹת וּ/שְׁלָמִ֗ים עַל הַ/מִּזְבֵּ֨חַ֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר בָּנָ֣ה לַ/יהוָ֔ה וְ/הַקְטֵ֣יר אִתּ֔/וֹ אֲשֶׁ֖ר לִ/פְנֵ֣י יְהוָ֑ה וְ/שִׁלַּ֖ם אֶת הַ/בָּֽיִת
verses.translit: vh'lh shlmh shlsh p'mym bshnh 'lvt vshlmym 'l hmzbch 'shr bnh lyhvh vhqtyr 'tv 'shr lpny yhvh vshlm 't hbyt
verses.translation: And three times in a year did Solomon offer burnt offerings and peace offerings upon the altar which he built unto the LORD , and he burnt incense upon the altar that was before the LORD . So he finished the house.

verses.original: וָ/אֳנִ֡י עָשָׂה֩ הַ/מֶּ֨לֶךְ שְׁלֹמֹ֜ה בְּ/עֶצְיֽוֹן גֶּ֨בֶר אֲשֶׁ֧ר אֶת אֵל֛וֹת עַל שְׂפַ֥ת יַם ס֖וּף בְּ/אֶ֥רֶץ אֱדֽוֹם
verses.translit: v'ny 'shh hmlkh shlmh b'tsyvn gbr 'shr 't 'lvt 'l shpt ym svf b'rts 'dvm
verses.translation: And king Solomon made a navy of ships in Ezion-geber, which is beside Eloth, on the shore of the Red sea, in the land of Edom.

verses.original: וַ/יִּשְׁלַ֨ח חִירָ֤ם בָּֽ/אֳנִי֙ אֶת עֲבָדָ֔י/ו אַנְשֵׁ֣י אֳנִיּ֔וֹת יֹדְעֵ֖י הַ/יָּ֑ם עִ֖ם עַבְדֵ֥י שְׁלֹמֹֽה
verses.translit: vyshlch chyrm b'ny 't 'bdyv 'nshy 'nyvt yd'y hym 'm 'bdy shlmh
verses.translation: And Hiram sent in the navy his servants, shipmen that had knowledge of the sea, with the servants of Solomon.

verses.original: וַ/יָּבֹ֣אוּ אוֹפִ֔ירָ/ה וַ/יִּקְח֤וּ מִ/שָּׁם֙ זָהָ֔ב אַרְבַּע מֵא֥וֹת וְ/עֶשְׂרִ֖ים כִּכָּ֑ר וַ/יָּבִ֖אוּ אֶל הַ/מֶּ֥לֶךְ שְׁלֹמֹֽה
verses.translit: vyb'v 'vpyrh vyqchv mshm zhb 'rb' m'vt v'shrym khkhr vyb'v 'l hmlkh shlmh
verses.translation: And they came to Ophir, and fetched from thence gold, four hundred and twenty talents, and brought it to king Solomon.

verses.original: וּ/מַֽלְכַּת שְׁבָ֗א שֹׁמַ֛עַת אֶת שֵׁ֥מַע שְׁלֹמֹ֖ה לְ/שֵׁ֣ם יְהוָ֑ה וַ/תָּבֹ֥א לְ/נַסֹּת֖/וֹ בְּ/חִידֽוֹת
verses.translit: vmlkht shb' shm't 't shm' shlmh lshm yhvh vtb' lnstv bchydvt
verses.translation: And when the queen of Sheba heard of the fame of Solomon concerning the name of the LORD , she came to prove him with hard questions.

verses.original: וַ/תָּבֹ֣א יְרוּשָׁלְַ֗מָ/ה בְּ/חַיִל֮ כָּבֵ֣ד מְאֹד֒ גְּ֠מַלִּים נֹשְׂאִ֨ים בְּשָׂמִ֧ים וְ/זָהָ֛ב רַב מְאֹ֖ד וְ/אֶ֣בֶן יְקָרָ֑ה וַ/תָּבֹא֙ אֶל שְׁלֹמֹ֔ה וַ/תְּדַבֵּ֣ר אֵלָ֔י/ו אֵ֛ת כָּל אֲשֶׁ֥ר הָיָ֖ה עִם לְבָבָֽ/הּ
verses.translit: vtb' yrvshlmh bchyl khbd m'd gmlym nsh'ym bshmym vzhb rb m'd v'bn yqrh vtb' 'l shlmh vtdbr 'lyv 't khl 'shr hyh 'm lbbh
verses.translation: And she came to Jerusalem with a very great train, with camels that bare spices, and very much gold, and precious stones: and when she was come to Solomon, she communed with him of all that was in her heart.

verses.original: וַ/יַּגֶּד לָ֥/הּ שְׁלֹמֹ֖ה אֶת כָּל דְּבָרֶ֑י/הָ לֹֽא הָיָ֤ה דָּבָר֙ נֶעְלָ֣ם מִן הַ/מֶּ֔לֶךְ אֲשֶׁ֧ר לֹ֦א הִגִּ֖יד לָֽ/הּ
verses.translit: vygd lh shlmh 't khl dbryh l' hyh dbr n'lm mn hmlkh 'shr l' hgyd lh
verses.translation: And Solomon told her all her questions: there was not any thing hid from the king, which he told her not.

verses.original: וַ/תֵּ֨רֶא֙ מַֽלְכַּת שְׁבָ֔א אֵ֖ת כָּל חָכְמַ֣ת שְׁלֹמֹ֑ה וְ/הַ/בַּ֖יִת אֲשֶׁ֥ר בָּנָֽה
verses.translit: vtr' mlkht shb' 't khl chkhmt shlmh vhbyt 'shr bnh
verses.translation: And when the queen of Sheba had seen all Solomon’s wisdom, and the house that he had built,

verses.original: וּ/מַאֲכַ֣ל שֻׁלְחָנ֡/וֹ וּ/מוֹשַׁ֣ב עֲבָדָי/ו֩ וּ/מַעֲמַ֨ד משרת/ו מְשָׁרְתָ֜י/ו וּ/מַלְבֻּֽשֵׁי/הֶם֙ וּ/מַשְׁקָ֔י/ו וְ/עֹ֣לָת֔/וֹ אֲשֶׁ֥ר יַעֲלֶ֖ה בֵּ֣ית יְהוָ֑ה וְ/לֹא הָ֥יָה בָ֛/הּ ע֖וֹד רֽוּחַ
verses.translit: vm'khl shlchnv vmvshb 'bdyv vm'md mshrtv mshrtyv vmlbshyhm vmshqyv v'ltv 'shr y'lh byt yhvh vl' hyh bh 'vd rvch
verses.translation: And the meat of his table, and the sitting of his servants, and the attendance of his ministers, and their apparel, and his cupbearers, and his ascent by which he went up unto the house of the LORD ; there was no more spirit in her.

verses.original: וַ/תֹּ֨אמֶר֙ אֶל הַ/מֶּ֔לֶךְ אֱמֶת֙ הָיָ֣ה הַ/דָּבָ֔ר אֲשֶׁ֥ר שָׁמַ֖עְתִּי בְּ/אַרְצִ֑/י עַל דְּבָרֶ֖י/ךָ וְ/עַל חָכְמָתֶֽ/ךָ
verses.translit: vt'mr 'l hmlkh 'mt hyh hdbr 'shr shm'ty b'rtsy 'l dbrykh v'l chkhmtkh
verses.translation: And she said to the king, It was a true report that I heard in mine own land of thy acts and of thy wisdom.

verses.original: וְ/לֹֽא הֶאֱמַ֣נְתִּי לַ/דְּבָרִ֗ים עַ֤ד אֲשֶׁר בָּ֨אתִי֙ וַ/תִּרְאֶ֣ינָה עֵינַ֔/י וְ/הִנֵּ֥ה לֹֽא הֻגַּד לִ֖/י הַ/חֵ֑צִי הוֹסַ֤פְתָּ חָכְמָה֙ וָ/ט֔וֹב אֶל הַ/שְּׁמוּעָ֖ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר שָׁמָֽעְתִּי
verses.translit: vl' h'mnty ldbrym 'd 'shr b'ty vtr'ynh 'yny vhnh l' hgd ly hchtsy hvspt chkhmh vtvb 'l hshmv'h 'shr shm'ty
verses.translation: Howbeit I believed not the words, until I came, and mine eyes had seen it: and, behold, the half was not told me: thy wisdom and prosperity exceedeth the fame which I heard.

verses.original: אַשְׁרֵ֣י אֲנָשֶׁ֔י/ךָ אַשְׁרֵ֖י עֲבָדֶ֣י/ךָ אֵ֑לֶּה הָֽ/עֹמְדִ֤ים לְ/פָנֶ֨י/ךָ֙ תָּמִ֔יד הַ/שֹּׁמְעִ֖ים אֶת חָכְמָתֶֽ/ךָ
verses.translit: 'shry 'nshykh 'shry 'bdykh 'lh h'mdym lpnykh tmyd hshm'ym 't chkhmtkh
