verses.translation: Happy are thy men, happy are these thy servants, which stand continually before thee, and that hear thy wisdom.

verses.original: יְהִ֨י יְהוָ֤ה אֱלֹהֶ֨י/ךָ֙ בָּר֔וּךְ אֲשֶׁר֙ חָפֵ֣ץ בְּ/ךָ֔ לְ/תִתְּ/ךָ֖ עַל כִּסֵּ֣א יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל בְּ/אַהֲבַ֨ת יְהוָ֤ה אֶת יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ לְ/עֹלָ֔ם וַ/יְשִֽׂימְ/ךָ֣ לְ/מֶ֔לֶךְ לַ/עֲשׂ֥וֹת מִשְׁפָּ֖ט וּ/צְדָקָֽה
verses.translit: yhy yhvh 'lhykh brvkh 'shr chpts bkh lttkh 'l khs' yshr'l b'hbt yhvh 't yshr'l l'lm vyshymkh lmlkh l'shvt mshpt vtsdqh
verses.translation: Blessed be the LORD thy God, which delighted in thee, to set thee on the throne of Israel: because the LORD loved Israel for ever, therefore made he thee king, to do judgment and justice.

verses.original: וַ/תִּתֵּ֨ן לַ/מֶּ֜לֶךְ מֵאָ֥ה וְ/עֶשְׂרִ֣ים כִּכַּ֣ר זָהָ֗ב וּ/בְשָׂמִ֛ים הַרְבֵּ֥ה מְאֹ֖ד וְ/אֶ֣בֶן יְקָרָ֑ה לֹא בָא֩ כַ/בֹּ֨שֶׂם הַ/ה֥וּא עוֹד֙ לָ/רֹ֔ב אֲשֶׁר נָתְנָ֥ה מַֽלְכַּת שְׁבָ֖א לַ/מֶּ֥לֶךְ שְׁלֹמֹֽה
verses.translit: vttn lmlkh m'h v'shrym khkhr zhb vbshmym hrbh m'd v'bn yqrh l' b' khbshm hhv' 'vd lrb 'shr ntnh mlkht shb' lmlkh shlmh
verses.translation: And she gave the king an hundred and twenty talents of gold, and of spices very great store, and precious stones: there came no more such abundance of spices as these which the queen of Sheba gave to king Solomon.

verses.original: וְ/גַם֙ אֳנִ֣י חִירָ֔ם אֲשֶׁר נָשָׂ֥א זָהָ֖ב מֵ/אוֹפִ֑יר הֵבִ֨יא מֵ/אֹפִ֜יר עֲצֵ֧י אַלְמֻגִּ֛ים הַרְבֵּ֥ה מְאֹ֖ד וְ/אֶ֥בֶן יְקָרָֽה
verses.translit: vgm 'ny chyrm 'shr nsh' zhb m'vpyr hby' m'pyr 'tsy 'lmgym hrbh m'd v'bn yqrh
verses.translation: And the navy also of Hiram, that brought gold from Ophir, brought in from Ophir great plenty of almug trees, and precious stones.

verses.original: וַ/יַּ֣עַשׂ הַ֠/מֶּלֶךְ אֶת עֲצֵ֨י הָ/אַלְמֻגִּ֜ים מִסְעָ֤ד לְ/בֵית יְהוָה֙ וּ/לְ/בֵ֣ית הַ/מֶּ֔לֶךְ וְ/כִנֹּר֥וֹת וּ/נְבָלִ֖ים לַ/שָּׁרִ֑ים לֹ֣א בָֽא כֵ֞ן עֲצֵ֤י אַלְמֻגִּים֙ וְ/לֹ֣א נִרְאָ֔ה עַ֖ד הַ/יּ֥וֹם הַ/זֶּֽה
verses.translit: vy'sh hmlkh 't 'tsy h'lmgym ms'd lbyt yhvh vlbyt hmlkh vkhnrvt vnblym lshrym l' b' khn 'tsy 'lmgym vl' nr'h 'd hyvm hzh
verses.translation: And the king made of the almug trees pillars for the house of the LORD , and for the king’s house, harps also and psalteries for singers: there came no such almug trees, nor were seen unto this day.

verses.original: וְ/הַ/מֶּ֨לֶךְ שְׁלֹמֹ֜ה נָתַ֣ן לְ/מַֽלְכַּת שְׁבָ֗א אֶת כָּל חֶפְצָ/הּ֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר שָׁאָ֔לָה מִ/לְּ/בַד֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר נָֽתַן לָ֔/הּ כְּ/יַ֖ד הַ/מֶּ֣לֶךְ שְׁלֹמֹ֑ה וַ/תֵּ֛פֶן וַ/תֵּ֥לֶךְ לְ/אַרְצָ֖/הּ הִ֥יא וַ/עֲבָדֶֽי/הָ
verses.translit: vhmlkh shlmh ntn lmlkht shb' 't khl chptsh 'shr sh'lh mlbd 'shr ntn lh khyd hmlkh shlmh vtpn vtlkh l'rtsh hy' v'bdyh
verses.translation: And king Solomon gave unto the queen of Sheba all her desire, whatsoever she asked, beside that which Solomon gave her of his royal bounty. So she turned and went to her own country, she and her servants.

verses.original: וַֽ/יְהִי֙ מִשְׁקַ֣ל הַ/זָּהָ֔ב אֲשֶׁר בָּ֥א לִ/שְׁלֹמֹ֖ה בְּ/שָׁנָ֣ה אֶחָ֑ת שֵׁ֥שׁ מֵא֛וֹת שִׁשִּׁ֥ים וָ/שֵׁ֖שׁ כִּכַּ֥ר זָהָֽב
verses.translit: vyhy mshql hzhb 'shr b' lshlmh bshnh 'cht shsh m'vt shshym vshsh khkhr zhb
verses.translation: Now the weight of gold that came to Solomon in one year was six hundred threescore and six talents of gold,

verses.original: לְ/בַד֙ מֵ/אַנְשֵׁ֣י הַ/תָּרִ֔ים וּ/מִסְחַ֖ר הָ/רֹכְלִ֑ים וְ/כָל מַלְכֵ֥י הָ/עֶ֖רֶב וּ/פַח֥וֹת הָ/אָֽרֶץ
verses.translit: lbd m'nshy htrym vmschr hrkhlym vkhl mlkhy h'rb vpchvt h'rts
verses.translation: Beside that he had of the merchantmen, and of the traffick of the spice merchants, and of all the kings of Arabia, and of the governors of the country.

verses.original: וַ/יַּ֨עַשׂ הַ/מֶּ֧לֶךְ שְׁלֹמֹ֛ה מָאתַ֥יִם צִנָּ֖ה זָהָ֣ב שָׁח֑וּט שֵׁשׁ מֵא֣וֹת זָהָ֔ב יַעֲלֶ֖ה עַל הַ/צִּנָּ֥ה הָ/אֶחָֽת
verses.translit: vy'sh hmlkh shlmh m'tym tsnh zhb shchvt shsh m'vt zhb y'lh 'l htsnh h'cht
verses.translation: And king Solomon made two hundred targets of beaten gold: six hundred shekels of gold went to one target.

verses.original: וּ/שְׁלֹשׁ מֵא֤וֹת מָֽגִנִּים֙ זָהָ֣ב שָׁח֔וּט שְׁלֹ֤שֶׁת מָנִים֙ זָהָ֔ב יַעֲלֶ֖ה עַל הַ/מָּגֵ֣ן הָ/אֶחָ֑ת וַ/יִּתְּנֵ֣/ם הַ/מֶּ֔לֶךְ בֵּ֖ית יַ֥עַר הַ/לְּבָנֽוֹן
verses.translit: vshlsh m'vt mgnym zhb shchvt shlsht mnym zhb y'lh 'l hmgn h'cht vytnm hmlkh byt y'r hlbnvn
verses.translation: And he made three hundred shields of beaten gold; three pound of gold went to one shield: and the king put them in the house of the forest of Lebanon.

verses.original: וַ/יַּ֧עַשׂ הַ/מֶּ֛לֶךְ כִּסֵּא שֵׁ֖ן גָּד֑וֹל וַ/יְצַפֵּ֖/הוּ זָהָ֥ב מוּפָֽז
verses.translit: vy'sh hmlkh khs' shn gdvl vytsphv zhb mvpz
verses.translation: Moreover the king made a great throne of ivory, and overlaid it with the best gold.

verses.original: שֵׁ֧שׁ מַעֲל֣וֹת לַ/כִּסֵּ֗ה וְ/רֹאשׁ עָגֹ֤ל לַ/כִּסֵּה֙ מֵ/אַֽחֲרָ֔י/ו וְ/יָדֹ֛ת מִ/זֶּ֥ה וּ/מִ/זֶּ֖ה אֶל מְק֣וֹם הַ/שָּׁ֑בֶת וּ/שְׁנַ֣יִם אֲרָי֔וֹת עֹמְדִ֖ים אֵ֥צֶל הַ/יָּדֽוֹת
verses.translit: shsh m'lvt lkhsh vr'sh 'gl lkhsh m'chryv vydt mzh vmzh 'l mqvm hshbt vshnym 'ryvt 'mdym 'tsl hydvt
verses.translation: The throne had six steps, and the top of the throne was round behind: and there were stays on either side on the place of the seat, and two lions stood beside the stays.

verses.original: וּ/שְׁנֵ֧ים עָשָׂ֣ר אֲרָיִ֗ים עֹמְדִ֥ים שָׁ֛ם עַל שֵׁ֥שׁ הַֽ/מַּעֲל֖וֹת מִ/זֶּ֣ה וּ/מִ/זֶּ֑ה לֹֽא נַעֲשָׂ֥ה כֵ֖ן לְ/כָל מַמְלָכֽוֹת
verses.translit: vshnym 'shr 'ryym 'mdym shm 'l shsh hm'lvt mzh vmzh l' n'shh khn lkhl mmlkhvt
verses.translation: And twelve lions stood there on the one side and on the other upon the six steps: there was not the like made in any kingdom.

verses.original: וְ֠/כֹל כְּלֵ֞י מַשְׁקֵ֨ה הַ/מֶּ֤לֶךְ שְׁלֹמֹה֙ זָהָ֔ב וְ/כֹ֗ל כְּלֵ֛י בֵּֽית יַ֥עַר הַ/לְּבָנ֖וֹן זָהָ֣ב סָג֑וּר אֵ֣ין כֶּ֗סֶף לֹ֥א נֶחְשָׁ֛ב בִּ/ימֵ֥י שְׁלֹמֹ֖ה לִ/מְאֽוּמָה
verses.translit: vkhl khly mshqh hmlkh shlmh zhb vkhl khly byt y'r hlbnvn zhb sgvr 'yn khsf l' nchshb bymy shlmh lm'vmh
verses.translation: And all king Solomon’s drinking vessels were of gold, and all the vessels of the house of the forest of Lebanon were of pure gold; none were of silver: it was nothing accounted of in the days of Solomon.

verses.original: כִּי֩ אֳנִ֨י תַרְשִׁ֤ישׁ לַ/מֶּ֨לֶךְ֙ בַּ/יָּ֔ם עִ֖ם אֳנִ֣י חִירָ֑ם אַחַת֩ לְ/שָׁלֹ֨שׁ שָׁנִ֜ים תָּב֣וֹא אֳנִ֣י תַרְשִׁ֗ישׁ נֹֽשְׂאֵת֙ זָהָ֣ב וָ/כֶ֔סֶף שֶׁנְהַבִּ֥ים וְ/קֹפִ֖ים וְ/תֻכִּיִּֽים
verses.translit: khy 'ny trshysh lmlkh bym 'm 'ny chyrm 'cht lshlsh shnym tbv' 'ny trshysh nsh't zhb vkhsf shnhbym vqpym vtkhyym
verses.translation: For the king had at sea a navy of Tharshish with the navy of Hiram: once in three years came the navy of Tharshish, bringing gold, and silver, ivory, and apes, and peacocks.

verses.original: וַ/יִּגְדַּל֙ הַ/מֶּ֣לֶךְ שְׁלֹמֹ֔ה מִ/כֹּ֖ל מַלְכֵ֣י הָ/אָ֑רֶץ לְ/עֹ֖שֶׁר וּ/לְ/חָכְמָֽה
verses.translit: vygdl hmlkh shlmh mkhl mlkhy h'rts l'shr vlchkhmh
verses.translation: So king Solomon exceeded all the kings of the earth for riches and for wisdom.

verses.original: וְ/כָ֨ל הָ/אָ֔רֶץ מְבַקְשִׁ֖ים אֶת פְּנֵ֣י שְׁלֹמֹ֑ה לִ/שְׁמֹ֨עַ֙ אֶת חָכְמָת֔/וֹ אֲשֶׁר נָתַ֥ן אֱלֹהִ֖ים בְּ/לִבּֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: vkhl h'rts mbqshym 't pny shlmh lshm' 't chkhmtv 'shr ntn 'lhym blbv
verses.translation: And all the earth sought to Solomon, to hear his wisdom, which God had put in his heart.

verses.original: וְ/הֵ֣מָּה מְבִאִ֣ים אִ֣ישׁ מִנְחָת֡/וֹ כְּלֵ֣י כֶסֶף֩ וּ/כְלֵ֨י זָהָ֤ב וּ/שְׂלָמוֹת֙ וְ/נֵ֣שֶׁק וּ/בְשָׂמִ֔ים סוּסִ֖ים וּ/פְרָדִ֑ים דְּבַר שָׁנָ֖ה בְּ/שָׁנָֽה
verses.translit: vhmh mb'ym 'ysh mnchtv khly khsf vkhly zhb vshlmvt vnshq vbshmym svsym vprdym dbr shnh bshnh
verses.translation: And they brought every man his present, vessels of silver, and vessels of gold, and garments, and armour, and spices, horses, and mules, a rate year by year.

verses.original: וַ/יֶּאֱסֹ֣ף שְׁלֹמֹה֮ רֶ֣כֶב וּ/פָרָשִׁים֒ וַ/יְהִי ל֗/וֹ אֶ֤לֶף וְ/אַרְבַּע מֵאוֹת֙ רֶ֔כֶב וּ/שְׁנֵים עָשָׂ֥ר אֶ֖לֶף פָּֽרָשִׁ֑ים וַ/יַּנְחֵ/ם֙ בְּ/עָרֵ֣י הָ/רֶ֔כֶב וְ/עִם הַ/מֶּ֖לֶךְ בִּ/ירוּשָׁלִָֽם
verses.translit: vy'sf shlmh rkhb vprshym vyhy lv 'lf v'rb' m'vt rkhb vshnym 'shr 'lf prshym vynchm b'ry hrkhb v'm hmlkh byrvshlm
verses.translation: And Solomon gathered together chariots and horsemen: and he had a thousand and four hundred chariots, and twelve thousand horsemen, whom he bestowed in the cities for chariots, and with the king at Jerusalem.

verses.original: וַ/יִּתֵּ֨ן הַ/מֶּ֧לֶךְ אֶת הַ/כֶּ֛סֶף בִּ/ירוּשָׁלִַ֖ם כָּ/אֲבָנִ֑ים וְ/אֵ֣ת הָ/אֲרָזִ֗ים נָתַ֛ן כַּ/שִּׁקְמִ֥ים אֲשֶׁר בַּ/שְּׁפֵלָ֖ה לָ/רֹֽב
verses.translit: vytn hmlkh 't hkhsf byrvshlm kh'bnym v't h'rzym ntn khshqmym 'shr bshplh lrb
verses.translation: And the king made silver to be in Jerusalem as stones, and cedars made he to be as the sycomore trees that are in the vale, for abundance.

verses.original: וּ/מוֹצָ֧א הַ/סּוּסִ֛ים אֲשֶׁ֥ר לִ/שְׁלֹמֹ֖ה מִ/מִּצְרָ֑יִם וּ/מִ/קְוֵ֕ה סֹחֲרֵ֣י הַ/מֶּ֔לֶךְ יִקְח֥וּ מִ/קְוֵ֖ה בִּ/מְחִֽיר
verses.translit: vmvts' hsvsym 'shr lshlmh mmtsrym vmqvh schry hmlkh yqchv mqvh bmchyr
verses.translation: And Solomon had horses brought out of Egypt, and linen yarn: the king’s merchants received the linen yarn at a price.

verses.original: וַֽ֠/תַּעֲלֶה וַ/תֵּצֵ֨א מֶרְכָּבָ֤ה מִ/מִּצְרַ֨יִם֙ בְּ/שֵׁ֣שׁ מֵא֣וֹת כֶּ֔סֶף וְ/ס֖וּס בַּ/חֲמִשִּׁ֣ים וּ/מֵאָ֑ה וְ֠/כֵן לְ/כָל מַלְכֵ֧י הַ/חִתִּ֛ים וּ/לְ/מַלְכֵ֥י אֲרָ֖ם בְּ/יָדָ֥/ם יֹצִֽאוּ
verses.translit: vt'lh vtts' mrkhbh mmtsrym bshsh m'vt khsf vsvs bchmshym vm'h vkhn lkhl mlkhy hchtym vlmlkhy 'rm bydm yts'v
verses.translation: And a chariot came up and went out of Egypt for six hundred shekels of silver, and an horse for an hundred and fifty: and so for all the kings of the Hittites, and for the kings of Syria, did they bring them out by their means.

verses.original: וְ/הַ/מֶּ֣לֶךְ שְׁלֹמֹ֗ה אָהַ֞ב נָשִׁ֧ים נָכְרִיּ֛וֹת רַבּ֖וֹת וְ/אֶת בַּת פַּרְעֹ֑ה מוֹאֲבִיּ֤וֹת עַמֳּנִיּוֹת֙ אֲדֹ֣מִיֹּ֔ת צֵדְנִיֹּ֖ת חִתִּיֹּֽת
verses.translit: vhmlkh shlmh 'hb nshym nkhryvt rbvt v't bt pr'h mv'byvt 'mnyvt 'dmyt tsdnyt chtyt
verses.translation: But king Solomon loved many strange women, together with the daughter of Pharaoh, women of the Moabites, Ammonites, Edomites, Zidonians, and Hittites;

verses.original: מִן הַ/גּוֹיִ֗ם אֲשֶׁ֣ר אָֽמַר יְהוָה֩ אֶל בְּנֵ֨י יִשְׂרָאֵ֜ל לֹֽא תָבֹ֣אוּ בָ/הֶ֗ם וְ/הֵם֙ לֹא יָבֹ֣אוּ בָ/כֶ֔ם אָכֵן֙ יַטּ֣וּ אֶת לְבַבְ/כֶ֔ם אַחֲרֵ֖י אֱלֹהֵי/הֶ֑ם בָּ/הֶ֛ם דָּבַ֥ק שְׁלֹמֹ֖ה לְ/אַהֲבָֽה
verses.translit: mn hgvym 'shr 'mr yhvh 'l bny yshr'l l' tb'v bhm vhm l' yb'v bkhm 'khn ytv 't lbbkhm 'chry 'lhyhm bhm dbq shlmh l'hbh
verses.translation: Of the nations concerning which the LORD said unto the children of Israel, Ye shall not go in to them, neither shall they come in unto you: for surely they will turn away your heart after their gods: Solomon clave unto these in love.

verses.original: וַ/יְהִי ל֣/וֹ נָשִׁ֗ים שָׂרוֹת֙ שְׁבַ֣ע מֵא֔וֹת וּ/פִֽלַגְשִׁ֖ים שְׁלֹ֣שׁ מֵא֑וֹת וַ/יַּטּ֥וּ נָשָׁ֖י/ו אֶת לִבּֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: vyhy lv nshym shrvt shb' m'vt vplgshym shlsh m'vt vytv nshyv 't lbv
verses.translation: And he had seven hundred wives, princesses, and three hundred concubines: and his wives turned away his heart.

verses.original: וַ/יְהִ֗י לְ/עֵת֙ זִקְנַ֣ת שְׁלֹמֹ֔ה נָשָׁי/ו֙ הִטּ֣וּ אֶת לְבָב֔/וֹ אַחֲרֵ֖י אֱלֹהִ֣ים אֲחֵרִ֑ים וְ/לֹא הָיָ֨ה לְבָב֤/וֹ שָׁלֵם֙ עִם יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהָ֔י/ו כִּ/לְבַ֖ב דָּוִ֥יד אָבִֽי/ו
verses.translit: vyhy l't zqnt shlmh nshyv htv 't lbbv 'chry 'lhym 'chrym vl' hyh lbbv shlm 'm yhvh 'lhyv khlbb dvyd 'byv
verses.translation: For it came to pass, when Solomon was old, that his wives turned away his heart after other gods: and his heart was not perfect with the LORD his God, as was the heart of David his father.

verses.original: וַ/יֵּ֣לֶךְ שְׁלֹמֹ֔ה אַחֲרֵ֣י עַשְׁתֹּ֔רֶת אֱלֹהֵ֖י צִדֹנִ֑ים וְ/אַחֲרֵ֣י מִלְכֹּ֔ם שִׁקֻּ֖ץ עַמֹּנִֽים
verses.translit: vylkh shlmh 'chry 'shtrt 'lhy tsdnym v'chry mlkhm shqts 'mnym
verses.translation: For Solomon went after Ashtoreth the goddess of the Zidonians, and after Milcom the abomination of the Ammonites.

verses.original: וַ/יַּ֧עַשׂ שְׁלֹמֹ֛ה הָ/רַ֖ע בְּ/עֵינֵ֣י יְהוָ֑ה וְ/לֹ֥א מִלֵּ֛א אַחֲרֵ֥י יְהוָ֖ה כְּ/דָוִ֥ד אָבִֽי/ו
verses.translit: vy'sh shlmh hr' b'yny yhvh vl' ml' 'chry yhvh khdvd 'byv
verses.translation: And Solomon did evil in the sight of the LORD , and went not fully after the LORD , as did David his father.

verses.original: אָז֩ יִבְנֶ֨ה שְׁלֹמֹ֜ה בָּמָ֗ה לִ/כְמוֹשׁ֙ שִׁקֻּ֣ץ מוֹאָ֔ב בָּ/הָ֕ר אֲשֶׁ֖ר עַל פְּנֵ֣י יְרוּשָׁלִָ֑ם וּ/לְ/מֹ֕לֶךְ שִׁקֻּ֖ץ בְּנֵ֥י עַמּֽוֹן
verses.translit: 'z ybnh shlmh bmh lkhmvsh shqts mv'b bhr 'shr 'l pny yrvshlm vlmlkh shqts bny 'mvn
verses.translation: Then did Solomon build an high place for Chemosh, the abomination of Moab, in the hill that is before Jerusalem, and for Molech, the abomination of the children of Ammon.

verses.original: וְ/כֵ֣ן עָשָׂ֔ה לְ/כָל נָשָׁ֖י/ו הַ/נָּכְרִיּ֑וֹת מַקְטִיר֥וֹת וּֽ/מְזַבְּח֖וֹת לֵ/אלֹהֵי/הֶֽן
verses.translit: vkhn 'shh lkhl nshyv hnkhryvt mqtyrvt vmzbchvt l'lhyhn
verses.translation: And likewise did he for all his strange wives, which burnt incense and sacrificed unto their gods.

verses.original: וַ/יִּתְאַנַּ֥ף יְהוָ֖ה בִּ/שְׁלֹמֹ֑ה כִּֽי נָטָ֣ה לְבָב֗/וֹ מֵ/עִ֤ם יְהוָה֙ אֱלֹהֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל הַ/נִּרְאָ֥ה אֵלָ֖י/ו פַּעֲמָֽיִם
verses.translit: vyt'nf yhvh bshlmh khy nth lbbv m'm yhvh 'lhy yshr'l hnr'h 'lyv p'mym
verses.translation: And the LORD was angry with Solomon, because his heart was turned from the LORD God of Israel, which had appeared unto him twice,

verses.original: וְ/צִוָּ֤ה אֵלָי/ו֙ עַל הַ/דָּבָ֣ר הַ/זֶּ֔ה לְ/בִ֨לְתִּי לֶ֔כֶת אַחֲרֵ֖י אֱלֹהִ֣ים אֲחֵרִ֑ים וְ/לֹ֣א שָׁמַ֔ר אֵ֥ת אֲשֶׁר צִוָּ֖ה יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: vtsvh 'lyv 'l hdbr hzh lblty lkht 'chry 'lhym 'chrym vl' shmr 't 'shr tsvh yhvh
verses.translation: And had commanded him concerning this thing, that he should not go after other gods: but he kept not that which the LORD commanded.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֨אמֶר יְהוָ֜ה לִ/שְׁלֹמֹ֗ה יַ֚עַן אֲשֶׁ֣ר הָֽיְתָה זֹּ֣את עִמָּ֔/ךְ וְ/לֹ֤א שָׁמַ֨רְתָּ֙ בְּרִיתִ֣/י וְ/חֻקֹּתַ֔/י אֲשֶׁ֥ר צִוִּ֖יתִי עָלֶ֑י/ךָ קָרֹ֨עַ אֶקְרַ֤ע אֶת הַ/מַּמְלָכָה֙ מֵֽ/עָלֶ֔י/ךָ וּ/נְתַתִּ֖י/הָ לְ/עַבְדֶּֽ/ךָ
verses.translit: vy'mr yhvh lshlmh y'n 'shr hyth z't 'mkh vl' shmrt bryty vchqty 'shr tsvyty 'lykh qr' 'qr' 't hmmlkhh m'lykh vnttyh l'bdkh
verses.translation: Wherefore the LORD said unto Solomon, Forasmuch as this is done of thee, and thou hast not kept my covenant and my statutes, which I have commanded thee, I will surely rend the kingdom from thee, and will give it to thy servant.

verses.original: אַךְ בְּ/יָמֶ֨י/ךָ֙ לֹ֣א אֶעֱשֶׂ֔/נָּה לְמַ֖עַן דָּוִ֣ד אָבִ֑י/ךָ מִ/יַּ֥ד בִּנְ/ךָ֖ אֶקְרָעֶֽ/נָּה
verses.translit: 'kh bymykh l' ''shnh lm'n dvd 'bykh myd bnkh 'qr'nh
verses.translation: Notwithstanding in thy days I will not do it for David thy father’s sake: but I will rend it out of the hand of thy son.

verses.original: רַ֤ק אֶת כָּל הַ/מַּמְלָכָה֙ לֹ֣א אֶקְרָ֔ע שֵׁ֥בֶט אֶחָ֖ד אֶתֵּ֣ן לִ/בְנֶ֑/ךָ לְמַ֨עַן֙ דָּוִ֣ד עַבְדִּ֔/י וּ/לְמַ֥עַן יְרוּשָׁלִַ֖ם אֲשֶׁ֥ר בָּחָֽרְתִּי
verses.translit: rq 't khl hmmlkhh l' 'qr' shbt 'chd 'tn lbnkh lm'n dvd 'bdy vlm'n yrvshlm 'shr bchrty
verses.translation: Howbeit I will not rend away all the kingdom; but will give one tribe to thy son for David my servant’s sake, and for Jerusalem’s sake which I have chosen.

verses.original: וַ/יָּ֨קֶם יְהוָ֤ה שָׂטָן֙ לִ/שְׁלֹמֹ֔ה אֵ֖ת הֲדַ֣ד הָ/אֲדֹמִ֑י מִ/זֶּ֧רַע הַ/מֶּ֛לֶךְ ה֖וּא בֶּ/אֱדֽוֹם
verses.translit: vyqm yhvh shtn lshlmh 't hdd h'dmy mzr' hmlkh hv' b'dvm
verses.translation: And the LORD stirred up an adversary unto Solomon, Hadad the Edomite: he was of the king’s seed in Edom.

verses.original: וַ/יְהִ֗י בִּֽ/הְי֤וֹת דָּוִד֙ אֶת אֱד֔וֹם בַּ/עֲל֗וֹת יוֹאָב֙ שַׂ֣ר הַ/צָּבָ֔א לְ/קַבֵּ֖ר אֶת הַ/חֲלָלִ֑ים וַ/יַּ֥ךְ כָּל זָכָ֖ר בֶּ/אֱדֽוֹם
verses.translit: vyhy bhyvt dvd 't 'dvm b'lvt yv'b shr htsb' lqbr 't hchllym vykh khl zkhr b'dvm
verses.translation: For it came to pass, when David was in Edom, and Joab the captain of the host was gone up to bury the slain, after he had smitten every male in Edom;

verses.original: כִּ֣י שֵׁ֧שֶׁת חֳדָשִׁ֛ים יָֽשַׁב שָׁ֥ם יוֹאָ֖ב וְ/כָל יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל עַד הִכְרִ֥ית כָּל זָכָ֖ר בֶּ/אֱדֽוֹם
verses.translit: khy shsht chdshym yshb shm yv'b vkhl yshr'l 'd hkhryt khl zkhr b'dvm
verses.translation: (For six months did Joab remain there with all Israel, until he had cut off every male in Edom:)

verses.original: וַ/יִּבְרַ֣ח אֲדַ֡ד הוּא֩ וַ/אֲנָשִׁ֨ים אֲדֹמִיִּ֜ים מֵ/עַבְדֵ֥י אָבִ֛י/ו אִתּ֖/וֹ לָ/ב֣וֹא מִצְרָ֑יִם וַ/הֲדַ֖ד נַ֥עַר קָטָֽן
verses.translit: vybrch 'dd hv' v'nshym 'dmyym m'bdy 'byv 'tv lbv' mtsrym vhdd n'r qtn
verses.translation: That Hadad fled, he and certain Edomites of his father’s servants with him, to go into Egypt; Hadad being yet a little child.

verses.original: וַ/יָּקֻ֨מוּ֙ מִ/מִּדְיָ֔ן וַ/יָּבֹ֖אוּ פָּארָ֑ן וַ/יִּקְחוּ֩ אֲנָשִׁ֨ים עִמָּ֜/ם מִ/פָּארָ֗ן וַ/יָּבֹ֤אוּ מִצְרַ֨יִם֙ אֶל פַּרְעֹ֣ה מֶֽלֶךְ מִצְרַ֔יִם וַ/יִּתֶּן ל֣/וֹ בַ֗יִת וְ/לֶ֨חֶם֙ אָ֣מַר ל֔/וֹ וְ/אֶ֖רֶץ נָ֥תַן לֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: vyqmv mmdyn vyb'v p'rn vyqchv 'nshym 'mm mp'rn vyb'v mtsrym 'l pr'h mlkh mtsrym vytn lv byt vlchm 'mr lv v'rts ntn lv
verses.translation: And they arose out of Midian, and came to Paran: and they took men with them out of Paran, and they came to Egypt, unto Pharaoh king of Egypt; which gave him an house, and appointed him victuals, and gave him land.

verses.original: וַ/יִּמְצָא֙ הֲדַ֥ד חֵ֛ן בְּ/עֵינֵ֥י פַרְעֹ֖ה מְאֹ֑ד וַ/יִּתֶּן ל֤/וֹ אִשָּׁה֙ אֶת אֲח֣וֹת אִשְׁתּ֔/וֹ אֲח֖וֹת תַּחְפְּנֵ֥יס הַ/גְּבִירָֽה
verses.translit: vymts' hdd chn b'yny pr'h m'd vytn lv 'shh 't 'chvt 'shtv 'chvt tchpnys hgbyrh
verses.translation: And Hadad found great favour in the sight of Pharaoh, so that he gave him to wife the sister of his own wife, the sister of Tahpenes the queen.

verses.original: וַ/תֵּ֨לֶד ל֜/וֹ אֲח֣וֹת תַּחְפְּנֵ֗יס אֵ֚ת גְּנֻבַ֣ת בְּנ֔/וֹ וַ/תִּגְמְלֵ֣/הוּ תַחְפְּנֵ֔ס בְּ/ת֖וֹךְ בֵּ֣ית פַּרְעֹ֑ה וַ/יְהִ֤י גְנֻבַת֙ בֵּ֣ית פַּרְעֹ֔ה בְּ/ת֖וֹךְ בְּנֵ֥י פַרְעֹֽה
verses.translit: vtld lv 'chvt tchpnys 't gnbt bnv vtgmlhv tchpns btvkh byt pr'h vyhy gnbt byt pr'h btvkh bny pr'h
verses.translation: And the sister of Tahpenes bare him Genubath his son, whom Tahpenes weaned in Pharaoh’s house: and Genubath was in Pharaoh’s household among the sons of Pharaoh.

verses.original: וַ/הֲדַ֞ד שָׁמַ֣ע בְּ/מִצְרַ֗יִם כִּֽי שָׁכַ֤ב דָּוִד֙ עִם אֲבֹתָ֔י/ו וְ/כִי מֵ֖ת יוֹאָ֣ב שַֽׂר הַ/צָּבָ֑א וַ/יֹּ֤אמֶר הֲדַד֙ אֶל פַּרְעֹ֔ה שַׁלְּחֵ֖/נִי וְ/אֵלֵ֥ךְ אֶל אַרְצִֽ/י
verses.translit: vhdd shm' bmtsrym khy shkhb dvd 'm 'btyv vkhy mt yv'b shr htsb' vy'mr hdd 'l pr'h shlchny v'lkh 'l 'rtsy
verses.translation: And when Hadad heard in Egypt that David slept with his fathers, and that Joab the captain of the host was dead, Hadad said to Pharaoh, Let me depart, that I may go to mine own country.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֧אמֶר ל֣/וֹ פַרְעֹ֗ה כִּ֠י מָה אַתָּ֤ה חָסֵר֙ עִמִּ֔/י וְ/הִנְּ/ךָ֥ מְבַקֵּ֖שׁ לָ/לֶ֣כֶת אֶל אַרְצֶ֑/ךָ וַ/יֹּ֣אמֶר לֹ֔א כִּ֥י שַׁלֵּ֖חַ תְּשַׁלְּחֵֽ/נִי
verses.translit: vy'mr lv pr'h khy mh 'th chsr 'my vhnkh mbqsh llkht 'l 'rtskh vy'mr l' khy shlch tshlchny
verses.translation: Then Pharaoh said unto him, But what hast thou lacked with me, that, behold, thou seekest to go to thine own country? And he answered, Nothing: howbeit let me go in any wise.

verses.original: וַ/יָּ֨קֶם אֱלֹהִ֥ים ל/וֹ֙ שָׂטָ֔ן אֶת רְז֖וֹן בֶּן אֶלְיָדָ֑ע אֲשֶׁ֣ר בָּרַ֗ח מֵ/אֵ֛ת הֲדַדְעֶ֥זֶר מֶֽלֶךְ צוֹבָ֖ה אֲדֹנָֽי/ו
verses.translit: vyqm 'lhym lv shtn 't rzvn bn 'lyd' 'shr brch m't hdd'zr mlkh tsvbh 'dnyv
verses.translation: And God stirred him up another adversary, Rezon the son of Eliadah, which fled from his lord Hadadezer king of Zobah:

verses.original: וַ/יִּקְבֹּ֤ץ עָלָי/ו֙ אֲנָשִׁ֔ים וַ/יְהִ֣י שַׂר גְּד֔וּד בַּ/הֲרֹ֥ג דָּוִ֖ד אֹתָ֑/ם וַ/יֵּלְכ֤וּ דַמֶּ֨שֶׂק֙ וַ/יֵּ֣שְׁבוּ בָ֔/הּ וַֽ/יִּמְלְכ֖וּ בְּ/דַמָּֽשֶׂק
verses.translit: vyqbts 'lyv 'nshym vyhy shr gdvd bhrg dvd 'tm vylkhv dmshq vyshbv bh vymlkhv bdmshq
verses.translation: And he gathered men unto him, and became captain over a band, when David slew them of Zobah: and they went to Damascus, and dwelt therein, and reigned in Damascus.

verses.original: וַ/יְהִ֨י שָׂטָ֤ן לְ/יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ כָּל יְמֵ֣י שְׁלֹמֹ֔ה וְ/אֶת הָ/רָעָ֖ה אֲשֶׁ֣ר הֲדָ֑ד וַ/יָּ֨קָץ֙ בְּ/יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל וַ/יִּמְלֹ֖ךְ עַל אֲרָֽם
verses.translit: vyhy shtn lyshr'l khl ymy shlmh v't hr'h 'shr hdd vyqts byshr'l vymlkh 'l 'rm
verses.translation: And he was an adversary to Israel all the days of Solomon, beside the mischief that Hadad did: and he abhorred Israel, and reigned over Syria.

verses.original: וְ/יָרָבְעָם֩ בֶּן נְבָ֨ט אֶפְרָתִ֜י מִן הַ/צְּרֵדָ֗ה וְ/שֵׁ֤ם אִמּ/וֹ֙ צְרוּעָה֙ אִשָּׁ֣ה אַלְמָנָ֔ה עֶ֖בֶד לִ/שְׁלֹמֹ֑ה וַ/יָּ֥רֶם יָ֖ד בַּ/מֶּֽלֶךְ
verses.translit: vyrb'm bn nbt 'prty mn htsrdh vshm 'mv tsrv'h 'shh 'lmnh 'bd lshlmh vyrm yd bmlkh
verses.translation: And Jeroboam the son of Nebat, an Ephrathite of Zereda, Solomon’s servant, whose mother’s name was Zeruah, a widow woman, even he lifted up his hand against the king.

verses.original: וְ/זֶ֣ה הַ/דָּבָ֔ר אֲשֶׁר הֵרִ֥ים יָ֖ד בַּ/מֶּ֑לֶךְ שְׁלֹמֹה֙ בָּנָ֣ה אֶת הַ/מִּלּ֔וֹא סָגַ֕ר אֶת פֶּ֕רֶץ עִ֖יר דָּוִ֥ד אָבִֽי/ו
verses.translit: vzh hdbr 'shr hrym yd bmlkh shlmh bnh 't hmlv' sgr 't prts 'yr dvd 'byv
verses.translation: And this was the cause that he lifted up his hand against the king: Solomon built Millo, and repaired the breaches of the city of David his father.

verses.original: וְ/הָ/אִ֥ישׁ יָרָבְעָ֖ם גִּבּ֣וֹר חָ֑יִל וַ/יַּ֨רְא שְׁלֹמֹ֜ה אֶת הַ/נַּ֗עַר כִּֽי עֹשֵׂ֤ה מְלָאכָה֙ ה֔וּא וַ/יַּפְקֵ֣ד אֹת֔/וֹ לְ/כָל סֵ֖בֶל בֵּ֥ית יוֹסֵֽף
verses.translit: vh'ysh yrb'm gbvr chyl vyr' shlmh 't hn'r khy 'shh ml'khh hv' vypqd 'tv lkhl sbl byt yvsf
verses.translation: And the man Jeroboam was a mighty man of valour: and Solomon seeing the young man that he was industrious, he made him ruler over all the charge of the house of Joseph.

verses.original: וַֽ/יְהִי֙ בָּ/עֵ֣ת הַ/הִ֔יא וְ/יָֽרָבְעָ֖ם יָצָ֣א מִ/ירוּשָׁלִָ֑ם וַ/יִּמְצָ֣א אֹת֡/וֹ אֲחִיָּה֩ הַ/שִּׁילֹנִ֨י הַ/נָּבִ֜יא בַּ/דֶּ֗רֶךְ וְ/ה֤וּא מִתְכַּסֶּה֙ בְּ/שַׂלְמָ֣ה חֲדָשָׁ֔ה וּ/שְׁנֵי/הֶ֥ם לְ/בַדָּ֖/ם בַּ/שָּׂדֶֽה
verses.translit: vyhy b't hhy' vyrb'm yts' myrvshlm vymts' 'tv 'chyh hshylny hnby' bdrkh vhv' mtkhsh bshlmh chdshh vshnyhm lbdm bshdh
verses.translation: And it came to pass at that time when Jeroboam went out of Jerusalem, that the prophet Ahijah the Shilonite found him in the way; and he had clad himself with a new garment; and they two were alone in the field:

verses.original: וַ/יִּתְפֹּ֣שׂ אֲחִיָּ֔ה בַּ/שַּׂלְמָ֥ה הַ/חֲדָשָׁ֖ה אֲשֶׁ֣ר עָלָ֑י/ו וַ/יִּ֨קְרָעֶ֔/הָ שְׁנֵ֥ים עָשָׂ֖ר קְרָעִֽים
verses.translit: vytpsh 'chyh bshlmh hchdshh 'shr 'lyv vyqr'h shnym 'shr qr'ym
verses.translation: And Ahijah caught the new garment that was on him, and rent it in twelve pieces:

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֨אמֶר֙ לְ/יָֽרָבְעָ֔ם קַח לְ/ךָ֖ עֲשָׂרָ֣ה קְרָעִ֑ים כִּ֣י כֹה֩ אָמַ֨ר יְהוָ֜ה אֱלֹהֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל הִנְ/נִ֨י קֹרֵ֤עַ אֶת הַ/מַּמְלָכָה֙ מִ/יַּ֣ד שְׁלֹמֹ֔ה וְ/נָתַתִּ֣י לְ/ךָ֔ אֵ֖ת עֲשָׂרָ֥ה הַ/שְּׁבָטִֽים
verses.translit: vy'mr lyrb'm qch lkh 'shrh qr'ym khy khh 'mr yhvh 'lhy yshr'l hnny qr' 't hmmlkhh myd shlmh vntty lkh 't 'shrh hshbtym
verses.translation: And he said to Jeroboam, Take thee ten pieces: for thus saith the LORD , the God of Israel, Behold, I will rend the kingdom out of the hand of Solomon, and will give ten tribes to thee:

verses.original: וְ/הַ/שֵּׁ֥בֶט הָ/אֶחָ֖ד יִֽהְיֶה לּ֑/וֹ לְמַ֣עַן עַבְדִּ֣/י דָוִ֗ד וּ/לְמַ֨עַן֙ יְר֣וּשָׁלִַ֔ם הָ/עִיר֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר בָּחַ֣רְתִּי בָ֔/הּ מִ/כֹּ֖ל שִׁבְטֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל
verses.translit: vhshbt h'chd yhyh lv lm'n 'bdy dvd vlm'n yrvshlm h'yr 'shr bchrty bh mkhl shbty yshr'l
verses.translation: (But he shall have one tribe for my servant David’s sake, and for Jerusalem’s sake, the city which I have chosen out of all the tribes of Israel:)

verses.original: יַ֣עַן אֲשֶׁ֣ר עֲזָב֗וּ/נִי וַ/יִּֽשְׁתַּחֲווּ֮ לְ/עַשְׁתֹּרֶת֮ אֱלֹהֵ֣י צִֽדֹנִין֒ לִ/כְמוֹשׁ֙ אֱלֹהֵ֣י מוֹאָ֔ב וּ/לְ/מִלְכֹּ֖ם אֱלֹהֵ֣י בְנֵֽי עַמּ֑וֹן וְ/לֹֽא הָלְכ֣וּ בִ/דְרָכַ֗/י לַ/עֲשׂ֨וֹת הַ/יָּשָׁ֧ר בְּ/עֵינַ֛/י וְ/חֻקֹּתַ֥/י וּ/מִשְׁפָּטַ֖/י כְּ/דָוִ֥ד אָבִֽי/ו
verses.translit: y'n 'shr 'zbvny vyshtchvv l'shtrt 'lhy tsdnyn lkhmvsh 'lhy mv'b vlmlkhm 'lhy bny 'mvn vl' hlkhv bdrkhy l'shvt hyshr b'yny vchqty vmshpty khdvd 'byv
verses.translation: Because that they have forsaken me, and have worshipped Ashtoreth the goddess of the Zidonians, Chemosh the god of the Moabites, and Milcom the god of the children of Ammon, and have not walked in my ways, to do that which is right in mine eyes, and to keep my statutes and my judgments, as did David his father.

verses.original: וְ/לֹֽא אֶקַּ֥ח אֶת כָּל הַ/מַּמְלָכָ֖ה מִ/יָּד֑/וֹ כִּ֣י נָשִׂ֣יא אֲשִׁתֶ֗/נּוּ כֹּ֚ל יְמֵ֣י חַיָּ֔י/ו לְמַ֨עַן דָּוִ֤ד עַבְדִּ/י֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר בָּחַ֣רְתִּי אֹת֔/וֹ אֲשֶׁ֥ר שָׁמַ֖ר מִצְוֺתַ֥/י וְ/חֻקֹּתָֽ/י
verses.translit: vl' 'qch 't khl hmmlkhh mydv khy nshy' 'shtnv khl ymy chyyv lm'n dvd 'bdy 'shr bchrty 'tv 'shr shmr mtsvty vchqty
verses.translation: Howbeit I will not take the whole kingdom out of his hand: but I will make him prince all the days of his life for David my servant’s sake, whom I chose, because he kept my commandments and my statutes:

verses.original: וְ/לָקַחְתִּ֥י הַ/מְּלוּכָ֖ה מִ/יַּ֣ד בְּנ֑/וֹ וּ/נְתַתִּ֣י/הָ לְּ/ךָ֔ אֵ֖ת עֲשֶׂ֥רֶת הַ/שְּׁבָטִֽים
verses.translit: vlqchty hmlvkhh myd bnv vnttyh lkh 't 'shrt hshbtym
verses.translation: But I will take the kingdom out of his son’s hand, and will give it unto thee, even ten tribes.

verses.original: וְ/לִ/בְנ֖/וֹ אֶתֵּ֣ן שֵֽׁבֶט אֶחָ֑ד לְמַ֣עַן הֱיֽוֹת נִ֣יר לְ/דָֽוִיד עַ֠בְדִּ/י כָּֽל הַ/יָּמִ֤ים לְ/פָנַ/י֙ בִּ/יר֣וּשָׁלִַ֔ם הָ/עִיר֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר בָּחַ֣רְתִּי לִ֔/י לָ/שׂ֥וּם שְׁמִ֖/י שָֽׁם
verses.translit: vlbnv 'tn shbt 'chd lm'n hyvt nyr ldvyd 'bdy khl hymym lpny byrvshlm h'yr 'shr bchrty ly lshvm shmy shm
verses.translation: And unto his son will I give one tribe, that David my servant may have a light alway before me in Jerusalem, the city which I have chosen me to put my name there.

verses.original: וְ/אֹתְ/ךָ֣ אֶקַּ֔ח וּ/מָ֣לַכְתָּ֔ בְּ/כֹ֥ל אֲשֶׁר תְּאַוֶּ֖ה נַפְשֶׁ֑/ךָ וְ/הָיִ֥יתָ מֶּ֖לֶךְ עַל יִשְׂרָאֵֽל
verses.translit: v'tkh 'qch vmlkht bkhl 'shr t'vh npshkh vhyyt mlkh 'l yshr'l
verses.translation: And I will take thee, and thou shalt reign according to all that thy soul desireth, and shalt be king over Israel.

verses.original: וְ/הָיָ֗ה אִם תִּשְׁמַע֮ אֶת כָּל אֲשֶׁ֣ר אֲצַוֶּ/ךָ֒ וְ/הָלַכְתָּ֣ בִ/דְרָכַ֗/י וְ/עָשִׂ֨יתָ הַ/יָּשָׁ֤ר בְּ/עֵינַ/י֙ לִ/שְׁמ֤וֹר חֻקּוֹתַ/י֙ וּ/מִצְוֺתַ֔/י כַּ/אֲשֶׁ֥ר עָשָׂ֖ה דָּוִ֣ד עַבְדִּ֑/י וְ/הָיִ֣יתִי עִמָּ֗/ךְ וּ/בָנִ֨יתִי לְ/ךָ֤ בַֽיִת נֶאֱמָן֙ כַּ/אֲשֶׁ֣ר בָּנִ֣יתִי לְ/דָוִ֔ד וְ/נָתַתִּ֥י לְ/ךָ֖ אֶת יִשְׂרָאֵֽל
verses.translit: vhyh 'm tshm' 't khl 'shr 'tsvkh vhlkht bdrkhy v'shyt hyshr b'yny lshmvr chqvty vmtsvty kh'shr 'shh dvd 'bdy vhyyty 'mkh vbnyty lkh byt n'mn kh'shr bnyty ldvd vntty lkh 't yshr'l
verses.translation: And it shall be, if thou wilt hearken unto all that I command thee, and wilt walk in my ways, and do that is right in my sight, to keep my statutes and my commandments, as David my servant did; that I will be with thee, and build thee a sure house, as I built for David, and will give Israel unto thee.

verses.original: וַֽ/אעַנֶּ֛ה אֶת זֶ֥רַע דָּוִ֖ד לְמַ֣עַן זֹ֑את אַ֖ךְ לֹ֥א כָל הַ/יָּמִֽים
verses.translit: v''nh 't zr' dvd lm'n z't 'kh l' khl hymym
verses.translation: And I will for this afflict the seed of David, but not for ever.

verses.original: וַ/יְבַקֵּ֥שׁ שְׁלֹמֹ֖ה לְ/הָמִ֣ית אֶת יָרָבְעָ֑ם וַ/יָּ֣קָם יָרָבְעָ֗ם וַ/יִּבְרַ֤ח מִצְרַ֨יִם֙ אֶל שִׁישַׁ֣ק מֶֽלֶךְ מִצְרַ֔יִם וַ/יְהִ֥י בְ/מִצְרַ֖יִם עַד מ֥וֹת שְׁלֹמֹֽה
verses.translit: vybqsh shlmh lhmyt 't yrb'm vyqm yrb'm vybrch mtsrym 'l shyshq mlkh mtsrym vyhy bmtsrym 'd mvt shlmh
verses.translation: Solomon sought therefore to kill Jeroboam. And Jeroboam arose, and fled into Egypt, unto Shishak king of Egypt, and was in Egypt until the death of Solomon.

verses.original: וְ/יֶ֨תֶר דִּבְרֵ֧י שְׁלֹמֹ֛ה וְ/כָל אֲשֶׁ֥ר עָשָׂ֖ה וְ/חָכְמָת֑/וֹ הֲ/לֽוֹא הֵ֣ם כְּתֻבִ֔ים עַל סֵ֖פֶר דִּבְרֵ֥י שְׁלֹמֹֽה
verses.translit: vytr dbry shlmh vkhl 'shr 'shh vchkhmtv hlv' hm khtbym 'l spr dbry shlmh
verses.translation: And the rest of the acts of Solomon, and all that he did, and his wisdom, are they not written in the book of the acts of Solomon?

verses.original: וְ/הַ/יָּמִ֗ים אֲשֶׁר֩ מָלַ֨ךְ שְׁלֹמֹ֤ה בִ/ירוּשָׁלִַ֨ם֙ עַל כָּל יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל אַרְבָּעִ֖ים שָׁנָֽה
verses.translit: vhymym 'shr mlkh shlmh byrvshlm 'l khl yshr'l 'rb'ym shnh
verses.translation: And the time that Solomon reigned in Jerusalem over all Israel was forty years.

verses.original: וַ/יִּשְׁכַּ֤ב שְׁלֹמֹה֙ עִם אֲבֹתָ֔י/ו וַ/יִּ֨קָּבֵ֔ר בְּ/עִ֖יר דָּוִ֣ד אָבִ֑י/ו וַ/יִּמְלֹ֛ךְ רְחַבְעָ֥ם בְּנ֖/וֹ תַּחְתָּֽי/ו
verses.translit: vyshkhb shlmh 'm 'btyv vyqbr b'yr dvd 'byv vymlkh rchb'm bnv tchtyv
verses.translation: And Solomon slept with his fathers, and was buried in the city of David his father: and Rehoboam his son reigned in his stead.

verses.original: וַ/יֵּ֥לֶךְ רְחַבְעָ֖ם שְׁכֶ֑ם כִּ֥י שְׁכֶ֛ם בָּ֥א כָל יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל לְ/הַמְלִ֥יךְ אֹתֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: vylkh rchb'm shkhm khy shkhm b' khl yshr'l lhmlykh 'tv
verses.translation: And Rehoboam went to Shechem: for all Israel were come to Shechem to make him king.

verses.original: וַ/יְהִ֞י כִּ/שְׁמֹ֣עַ יָרָבְעָ֣ם בֶּן נְבָ֗ט וְ/הוּא֙ עוֹדֶ֣/נּוּ בְ/מִצְרַ֔יִם אֲשֶׁ֣ר בָּרַ֔ח מִ/פְּנֵ֖י הַ/מֶּ֣לֶךְ שְׁלֹמֹ֑ה וַ/יֵּ֥שֶׁב יָרָבְעָ֖ם בְּ/מִצְרָֽיִם
verses.translit: vyhy khshm' yrb'm bn nbt vhv' 'vdnv bmtsrym 'shr brch mpny hmlkh shlmh vyshb yrb'm bmtsrym
verses.translation: And it came to pass, when Jeroboam the son of Nebat, who was yet in Egypt, heard of it , (for he was fled from the presence of king Solomon, and Jeroboam dwelt in Egypt;)

verses.original: וַֽ/יִּשְׁלְחוּ֙ וַ/יִּקְרְאוּ ל֔/וֹ ו/יבאו וַ/יָּבֹ֥א יָרָבְעָ֖ם וְ/כָל קְהַ֣ל יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וַֽ/יְדַבְּר֔וּ אֶל רְחַבְעָ֖ם לֵ/אמֹֽר
verses.translit: vyshlchv vyqr'v lv vyb'v vyb' yrb'm vkhl qhl yshr'l vydbrv 'l rchb'm l'mr
verses.translation: That they sent and called him. And Jeroboam and all the congregation of Israel came, and spake unto Rehoboam, saying,

verses.original: אָבִ֖י/ךָ הִקְשָׁ֣ה אֶת עֻלֵּ֑/נוּ וְ/אַתָּ֡ה עַתָּ֣ה הָקֵל֩ מֵ/עֲבֹדַ֨ת אָבִ֜י/ךָ הַ/קָּשָׁ֗ה וּ/מֵ/עֻלּ֧/וֹ הַ/כָּבֵ֛ד אֲשֶׁר נָתַ֥ן עָלֵ֖י/נוּ וְ/נַעַבְדֶֽ/ךָּ
verses.translit: 'bykh hqshh 't 'lnv v'th 'th hql m'bdt 'bykh hqshh vm'lv hkhbd 'shr ntn 'lynv vn'bdkh
verses.translation: Thy father made our yoke grievous: now therefore make thou the grievous service of thy father, and his heavy yoke which he put upon us, lighter, and we will serve thee.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֣אמֶר אֲלֵי/הֶ֗ם לְכ֥וּ עֹ֛ד שְׁלֹשָׁ֥ה יָמִ֖ים וְ/שׁ֣וּבוּ אֵלָ֑/י וַ/יֵּלְכ֖וּ הָ/עָֽם
verses.translit: vy'mr 'lyhm lkhv 'd shlshh ymym vshvbv 'ly vylkhv h'm
verses.translation: And he said unto them, Depart yet for three days, then come again to me. And the people departed.

verses.original: וַ/יִּוָּעַ֞ץ הַ/מֶּ֣לֶךְ רְחַבְעָ֗ם אֶת הַ/זְּקֵנִים֙ אֲשֶׁר הָי֣וּ עֹמְדִ֗ים אֶת פְּנֵי֙ שְׁלֹמֹ֣ה אָבִ֔י/ו בִּֽ/הְיֹת֥/וֹ חַ֖י לֵ/אמֹ֑ר אֵ֚יךְ אַתֶּ֣ם נֽוֹעָצִ֔ים לְ/הָשִׁ֥יב אֶת הָֽ/עָם הַ/זֶּ֖ה דָּבָֽר
verses.translit: vyv'ts hmlkh rchb'm 't hzqnym 'shr hyv 'mdym 't pny shlmh 'byv bhytv chy l'mr 'ykh 'tm nv'tsym lhshyb 't h'm hzh dbr
verses.translation: And king Rehoboam consulted with the old men, that stood before Solomon his father while he yet lived, and said, How do ye advise that I may answer this people?

verses.original: ו/ידבר וַ/יְדַבְּר֨וּ אֵלָ֜י/ו לֵ/אמֹ֗ר אִם הַ֠/יּוֹם תִּֽהְיֶה עֶ֜בֶד לָ/עָ֤ם הַ/זֶּה֙ וַֽ/עֲבַדְתָּ֔/ם וַ/עֲנִיתָ֕/ם וְ/דִבַּרְתָּ֥ אֲלֵי/הֶ֖ם דְּבָרִ֣ים טוֹבִ֑ים וְ/הָי֥וּ לְ/ךָ֛ עֲבָדִ֖ים כָּל הַ/יָּמִֽים
verses.translit: vydbr vydbrv 'lyv l'mr 'm hyvm thyh 'bd l'm hzh v'bdtm v'nytm vdbrt 'lyhm dbrym tvbym vhyv lkh 'bdym khl hymym
verses.translation: And they spake unto him, saying, If thou wilt be a servant unto this people this day, and wilt serve them, and answer them, and speak good words to them, then they will be thy servants for ever.

verses.original: וַֽ/יַּעֲזֹ֛ב אֶת עֲצַ֥ת הַ/זְּקֵנִ֖ים אֲשֶׁ֣ר יְעָצֻ֑/הוּ וַ/יִּוָּעַ֗ץ אֶת הַ/יְלָדִים֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר גָּדְל֣וּ אִתּ֔/וֹ אֲשֶׁ֥ר הָ/עֹמְדִ֖ים לְ/פָנָֽי/ו
verses.translit: vy'zb 't 'tst hzqnym 'shr y'tshv vyv'ts 't hyldym 'shr gdlv 'tv 'shr h'mdym lpnyv
verses.translation: But he forsook the counsel of the old men, which they had given him, and consulted with the young men that were grown up with him, and which stood before him:

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֣אמֶר אֲלֵי/הֶ֗ם מָ֚ה אַתֶּ֣ם נֽוֹעָצִ֔ים וְ/נָשִׁ֥יב דָּבָ֖ר אֶת הָ/עָ֣ם הַ/זֶּ֑ה אֲשֶׁ֨ר דִּבְּר֤וּ אֵלַ/י֙ לֵ/אמֹ֔ר הָקֵל֙ מִן הָ/עֹ֔ל אֲשֶׁר נָתַ֥ן אָבִ֖י/ךָ עָלֵֽי/נוּ
verses.translit: vy'mr 'lyhm mh 'tm nv'tsym vnshyb dbr 't h'm hzh 'shr dbrv 'ly l'mr hql mn h'l 'shr ntn 'bykh 'lynv
verses.translation: And he said unto them, What counsel give ye that we may answer this people, who have spoken to me, saying, Make the yoke which thy father did put upon us lighter?

verses.original: וַ/יְדַבְּר֣וּ אֵלָ֗י/ו הַ/יְלָדִים֙ אֲשֶׁ֨ר גָּדְל֣וּ אִתּ/וֹ֮ לֵ/אמֹר֒ כֹּֽה תֹאמַ֣ר לָ/עָ֣ם הַ/זֶּ֡ה אֲשֶׁר֩ דִּבְּר֨וּ אֵלֶ֜י/ךָ לֵ/אמֹ֗ר אָבִ֨י/ךָ֙ הִכְבִּ֣יד אֶת עֻלֵּ֔/נוּ וְ/אַתָּ֖ה הָקֵ֣ל מֵ/עָלֵ֑י/נוּ כֹּ֚ה תְּדַבֵּ֣ר אֲלֵי/הֶ֔ם קָֽטָנִּ֥/י עָבָ֖ה מִ/מָּתְנֵ֥י אָבִֽ/י
verses.translit: vydbrv 'lyv hyldym 'shr gdlv 'tv l'mr khh t'mr l'm hzh 'shr dbrv 'lykh l'mr 'bykh hkhbyd 't 'lnv v'th hql m'lynv khh tdbr 'lyhm qtny 'bh mmtny 'by
verses.translation: And the young men that were grown up with him spake unto him, saying, Thus shalt thou speak unto this people that spake unto thee, saying, Thy father made our yoke heavy, but make thou it lighter unto us; thus shalt thou say unto them, My little finger shall be thicker than my father’s loins.

verses.original: וְ/עַתָּ֗ה אָבִ/י֙ הֶעְמִ֤יס עֲלֵי/כֶם֙ עֹ֣ל כָּבֵ֔ד וַ/אֲנִ֖י אוֹסִ֣יף עַֽל עֻלְּ/כֶ֑ם אָבִ֗/י יִסַּ֤ר אֶתְ/כֶם֙ בַּ/שּׁוֹטִ֔ים וַ/אֲנִ֕י אֲיַסֵּ֥ר אֶתְ/כֶ֖ם בָּ/עַקְרַבִּֽים
verses.translit: v'th 'by h'mys 'lykhm 'l khbd v'ny 'vsyf 'l 'lkhm 'by ysr 'tkhm bshvtym v'ny 'ysr 'tkhm b'qrbym
verses.translation: And now whereas my father did lade you with a heavy yoke, I will add to your yoke: my father hath chastised you with whips, but I will chastise you with scorpions.

verses.original: ו/יבו וַ/יָּב֨וֹא יָרָבְעָ֧ם וְ/כָל הָ/עָ֛ם אֶל רְחַבְעָ֖ם בַּ/יּ֣וֹם הַ/שְּׁלִישִׁ֑י כַּ/אֲשֶׁ֨ר דִּבֶּ֤ר הַ/מֶּ֨לֶךְ֙ לֵ/אמֹ֔ר שׁ֥וּבוּ אֵלַ֖/י בַּ/יּ֥וֹם הַ/שְּׁלִישִֽׁי
verses.translit: vybv vybv' yrb'm vkhl h'm 'l rchb'm byvm hshlyshy kh'shr dbr hmlkh l'mr shvbv 'ly byvm hshlyshy
verses.translation: So Jeroboam and all the people came to Rehoboam the third day, as the king had appointed, saying, Come to me again the third day.

verses.original: וַ/יַּ֧עַן הַ/מֶּ֛לֶךְ אֶת הָ/עָ֖ם קָשָׁ֑ה וַֽ/יַּעֲזֹ֛ב אֶת עֲצַ֥ת הַ/זְּקֵנִ֖ים אֲשֶׁ֥ר יְעָצֻֽ/הוּ
verses.translit: vy'n hmlkh 't h'm qshh vy'zb 't 'tst hzqnym 'shr y'tshv
verses.translation: And the king answered the people roughly, and forsook the old men’s counsel that they gave him;

verses.original: וַ/יְדַבֵּ֣ר אֲלֵי/הֶ֗ם כַּ/עֲצַ֤ת הַ/יְלָדִים֙ לֵ/אמֹ֔ר אָבִ/י֙ הִכְבִּ֣יד אֶֽת עֻלְּ/כֶ֔ם וַ/אֲנִ֖י אֹסִ֣יף עַֽל עֻלְּ/כֶ֑ם אָבִ֗/י יִסַּ֤ר אֶתְ/כֶם֙ בַּ/שּׁוֹטִ֔ים וַ/אֲנִ֕י אֲיַסֵּ֥ר אֶתְ/כֶ֖ם בָּ/עַקְרַבִּֽים
verses.translit: vydbr 'lyhm kh'tst hyldym l'mr 'by hkhbyd 't 'lkhm v'ny 'syf 'l 'lkhm 'by ysr 'tkhm bshvtym v'ny 'ysr 'tkhm b'qrbym
verses.translation: And spake to them after the counsel of the young men, saying, My father made your yoke heavy, and I will add to your yoke: my father also chastised you with whips, but I will chastise you with scorpions.

verses.original: וְ/לֹֽא שָׁמַ֥ע הַ/מֶּ֖לֶךְ אֶל הָ/עָ֑ם כִּֽי הָיְתָ֤ה סִבָּה֙ מֵ/עִ֣ם יְהוָ֔ה לְמַ֜עַן הָקִ֣ים אֶת דְּבָר֗/וֹ אֲשֶׁ֨ר דִּבֶּ֤ר יְהוָה֙ בְּ/יַד֙ אֲחִיָּ֣ה הַ/שִּׁילֹנִ֔י אֶל יָרָבְעָ֖ם בֶּן נְבָֽט
verses.translit: vl' shm' hmlkh 'l h'm khy hyth sbh m'm yhvh lm'n hqym 't dbrv 'shr dbr yhvh byd 'chyh hshylny 'l yrb'm bn nbt
verses.translation: Wherefore the king hearkened not unto the people; for the cause was from the LORD , that he might perform his saying, which the LORD spake by Ahijah the Shilonite unto Jeroboam the son of Nebat.

verses.original: וַ/יַּ֣רְא כָּל יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל כִּ֠י לֹֽא שָׁמַ֣ע הַ/מֶּלֶךְ֮ אֲלֵי/הֶם֒ וַ/יָּשִׁ֣בוּ הָ/עָ֣ם אֶת הַ/מֶּ֣לֶךְ דָּבָ֣ר לֵ/אמֹ֡ר מַה לָּ/נוּ֩ חֵ֨לֶק בְּ/דָוִ֜ד וְ/לֹֽא נַחֲלָ֣ה בְּ/בֶן יִשַׁ֗י לְ/אֹהָלֶ֨י/ךָ֙ יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל עַתָּ֕ה רְאֵ֥ה בֵיתְ/ךָ֖ דָּוִ֑ד וַ/יֵּ֥לֶךְ יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל לְ/אֹהָלָֽי/ו
verses.translit: vyr' khl yshr'l khy l' shm' hmlkh 'lyhm vyshbv h'm 't hmlkh dbr l'mr mh lnv chlq bdvd vl' nchlh bbn yshy l'hlykh yshr'l 'th r'h bytkh dvd vylkh yshr'l l'hlyv
verses.translation: So when all Israel saw that the king hearkened not unto them, the people answered the king, saying, What portion have we in David? neither have we inheritance in the son of Jesse: to your tents, O Israel: now see to thine own house, David. So Israel departed unto their tents.

verses.original: וּ/בְנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל הַ/יֹּשְׁבִ֖ים בְּ/עָרֵ֣י יְהוּדָ֑ה וַ/יִּמְלֹ֥ךְ עֲלֵי/הֶ֖ם רְחַבְעָֽם
verses.translit: vbny yshr'l hyshbym b'ry yhvdh vymlkh 'lyhm rchb'm
verses.translation: But as for the children of Israel which dwelt in the cities of Judah, Rehoboam reigned over them.

verses.original: וַ/יִּשְׁלַ֞ח הַ/מֶּ֣לֶךְ רְחַבְעָ֗ם אֶת אֲדֹרָם֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר עַל הַ/מַּ֔ס וַ/יִּרְגְּמ֨וּ כָל יִשְׂרָאֵ֥ל בּ֛/וֹ אֶ֖בֶן וַ/יָּמֹ֑ת וְ/הַ/מֶּ֣לֶךְ רְחַבְעָ֗ם הִתְאַמֵּץ֙ לַ/עֲל֣וֹת בַּ/מֶּרְכָּבָ֔ה לָ/נ֖וּס יְרוּשָׁלִָֽם
verses.translit: vyshlch hmlkh rchb'm 't 'drm 'shr 'l hms vyrgmv khl yshr'l bv 'bn vymt vhmlkh rchb'm ht'mts l'lvt bmrkhbh lnvs yrvshlm
verses.translation: Then king Rehoboam sent Adoram, who was over the tribute; and all Israel stoned him with stones, that he died. Therefore king Rehoboam made speed to get him up to his chariot, to flee to Jerusalem.

verses.original: וַ/יִּפְשְׁע֤וּ יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ בְּ/בֵ֣ית דָּוִ֔ד עַ֖ד הַ/יּ֥וֹם הַ/זֶּֽה
verses.translit: vypsh'v yshr'l bbyt dvd 'd hyvm hzh
verses.translation: So Israel rebelled against the house of David unto this day.

verses.original: וַ/יְהִ֞י כִּ/שְׁמֹ֤עַ כָּל יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ כִּֽי שָׁ֣ב יָרָבְעָ֔ם וַֽ/יִּשְׁלְח֗וּ וַ/יִּקְרְא֤וּ אֹת/וֹ֙ אֶל הָ֣/עֵדָ֔ה וַ/יַּמְלִ֥יכוּ אֹת֖/וֹ עַל כָּל יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל לֹ֤א הָיָה֙ אַחֲרֵ֣י בֵית דָּוִ֔ד זוּלָתִ֥י שֵֽׁבֶט יְהוּדָ֖ה לְ/בַדּֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: vyhy khshm' khl yshr'l khy shb yrb'm vyshlchv vyqr'v 'tv 'l h'dh vymlykhv 'tv 'l khl yshr'l l' hyh 'chry byt dvd zvlty shbt yhvdh lbdv
verses.translation: And it came to pass, when all Israel heard that Jeroboam was come again, that they sent and called him unto the congregation, and made him king over all Israel: there was none that followed the house of David, but the tribe of Judah only.

verses.original: ו/יבאו וַ/יָּבֹ֣א רְחַבְעָם֮ יְרוּשָׁלִַם֒ וַ/יַּקְהֵל֩ אֶת כָּל בֵּ֨ית יְהוּדָ֜ה וְ/אֶת שֵׁ֣בֶט בִּנְיָמִ֗ן מֵאָ֨ה וּ/שְׁמֹנִ֥ים אֶ֛לֶף בָּח֖וּר עֹשֵׂ֣ה מִלְחָמָ֑ה לְ/הִלָּחֵם֙ עִם בֵּ֣ית יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל לְ/הָשִׁיב֙ אֶת הַ/מְּלוּכָ֔ה לִ/רְחַבְעָ֖ם בֶּן שְׁלֹמֹֽה
verses.translit: vyb'v vyb' rchb'm yrvshlm vyqhl 't khl byt yhvdh v't shbt bnymn m'h vshmnym 'lf bchvr 'shh mlchmh lhlchm 'm byt yshr'l lhshyb 't hmlvkhh lrchb'm bn shlmh
verses.translation: And when Rehoboam was come to Jerusalem, he assembled all the house of Judah, with the tribe of Benjamin, an hundred and fourscore thousand chosen men, which were warriors, to fight against the house of Israel, to bring the kingdom again to Rehoboam the son of Solomon.

verses.original: וַ/יְהִי֙ דְּבַ֣ר הָֽ/אֱלֹהִ֔ים אֶל שְׁמַעְיָ֥ה אִישׁ הָ/אֱלֹהִ֖ים לֵ/אמֹֽר
verses.translit: vyhy dbr h'lhym 'l shm'yh 'ysh h'lhym l'mr
verses.translation: But the word of God came unto Shemaiah the man of God, saying,

verses.original: אֱמֹ֗ר אֶל רְחַבְעָ֤ם בֶּן שְׁלֹמֹה֙ מֶ֣לֶךְ יְהוּדָ֔ה וְ/אֶל כָּל בֵּ֥ית יְהוּדָ֖ה וּ/בִנְיָמִ֑ין וְ/יֶ֥תֶר הָ/עָ֖ם לֵ/אמֹֽר
verses.translit: 'mr 'l rchb'm bn shlmh mlkh yhvdh v'l khl byt yhvdh vbnymyn vytr h'm l'mr
verses.translation: Speak unto Rehoboam, the son of Solomon, king of Judah, and unto all the house of Judah and Benjamin, and to the remnant of the people, saying,

verses.original: כֹּ֣ה אָמַ֣ר יְהוָ֡ה לֹֽא תַעֲלוּ֩ וְ/לֹא תִלָּ֨חֲמ֜וּ/ן עִם אֲחֵי/כֶ֣ם בְּנֵֽי יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל שׁ֚וּבוּ אִ֣ישׁ לְ/בֵית֔/וֹ כִּ֧י מֵ/אִתִּ֛/י נִהְיָ֖ה הַ/דָּבָ֣ר הַ/זֶּ֑ה וַ/יִּשְׁמְעוּ֙ אֶת דְּבַ֣ר יְהוָ֔ה וַ/יָּשֻׁ֥בוּ לָ/לֶ֖כֶת כִּ/דְבַ֥ר יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: khh 'mr yhvh l' t'lv vl' tlchmvn 'm 'chykhm bny yshr'l shvbv 'ysh lbytv khy m'ty nhyh hdbr hzh vyshm'v 't dbr yhvh vyshbv llkht khdbr yhvh
verses.translation: Thus saith the LORD , Ye shall not go up, nor fight against your brethren the children of Israel: return every man to his house; for this thing is from me. They hearkened therefore to the word of the LORD , and returned to depart, according to the word of the LORD .

verses.original: וַ/יִּ֨בֶן יָרָבְעָ֧ם אֶת שְׁכֶ֛ם בְּ/הַ֥ר אֶפְרַ֖יִם וַ/יֵּ֣שֶׁב בָּ֑/הּ וַ/יֵּצֵ֣א מִ/שָּׁ֔ם וַ/יִּ֖בֶן אֶת פְּנוּאֵֽל
verses.translit: vybn yrb'm 't shkhm bhr 'prym vyshb bh vyts' mshm vybn 't pnv'l
verses.translation: Then Jeroboam built Shechem in mount Ephraim, and dwelt therein; and went out from thence, and built Penuel.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֥אמֶר יָרָבְעָ֖ם בְּ/לִבּ֑/וֹ עַתָּ֛ה תָּשׁ֥וּב הַ/מַּמְלָכָ֖ה לְ/בֵ֥ית דָּוִֽד
verses.translit: vy'mr yrb'm blbv 'th tshvb hmmlkhh lbyt dvd
verses.translation: And Jeroboam said in his heart, Now shall the kingdom return to the house of David:

verses.original: אִֽם יַעֲלֶ֣ה הָ/עָ֣ם הַ/זֶּ֗ה לַ/עֲשׂ֨וֹת זְבָחִ֤ים בְּ/בֵית יְהוָה֙ בִּ/יר֣וּשָׁלִַ֔ם וְ֠/שָׁב לֵ֣ב הָ/עָ֤ם הַ/זֶּה֙ אֶל אֲדֹ֣נֵי/הֶ֔ם אֶל רְחַבְעָ֖ם מֶ֣לֶךְ יְהוּדָ֑ה וַ/הֲרָגֻ֕/נִי וְ/שָׁ֖בוּ אֶל רְחַבְעָ֥ם מֶֽלֶךְ יְהוּדָֽה
verses.translit: 'm y'lh h'm hzh l'shvt zbchym bbyt yhvh byrvshlm vshb lb h'm hzh 'l 'dnyhm 'l rchb'm mlkh yhvdh vhrgny vshbv 'l rchb'm mlkh yhvdh
verses.translation: If this people go up to do sacrifice in the house of the LORD at Jerusalem, then shall the heart of this people turn again unto their lord, even unto Rehoboam king of Judah, and they shall kill me, and go again to Rehoboam king of Judah.

verses.original: וַ/יִּוָּעַ֣ץ הַ/מֶּ֔לֶךְ וַ/יַּ֕עַשׂ שְׁנֵ֖י עֶגְלֵ֣י זָהָ֑ב וַ/יֹּ֣אמֶר אֲלֵ/הֶ֗ם רַב לָ/כֶם֙ מֵ/עֲל֣וֹת יְרוּשָׁלִַ֔ם הִנֵּ֤ה אֱלֹהֶ֨י/ךָ֙ יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל אֲשֶׁ֥ר הֶעֱל֖וּ/ךָ מֵ/אֶ֥רֶץ מִצְרָֽיִם
verses.translit: vyv'ts hmlkh vy'sh shny 'gly zhb vy'mr 'lhm rb lkhm m'lvt yrvshlm hnh 'lhykh yshr'l 'shr h'lvkh m'rts mtsrym
verses.translation: Whereupon the king took counsel, and made two calves of gold, and said unto them, It is too much for you to go up to Jerusalem: behold thy gods, O Israel, which brought thee up out of the land of Egypt.

verses.original: וַ/יָּ֥שֶׂם אֶת הָ/אֶחָ֖ד בְּ/בֵֽית אֵ֑ל וְ/אֶת הָ/אֶחָ֖ד נָתַ֥ן בְּ/דָֽן
verses.translit: vyshm 't h'chd bbyt 'l v't h'chd ntn bdn
verses.translation: And he set the one in Beth-el, and the other put he in Dan.

verses.original: וַ/יְהִ֛י הַ/דָּבָ֥ר הַ/זֶּ֖ה לְ/חַטָּ֑את וַ/יֵּלְכ֥וּ הָ/עָ֛ם לִ/פְנֵ֥י הָ/אֶחָ֖ד עַד דָּֽן
verses.translit: vyhy hdbr hzh lcht't vylkhv h'm lpny h'chd 'd dn
verses.translation: And this thing became a sin: for the people went to worship before the one, even unto Dan.

verses.original: וַ/יַּ֖עַשׂ אֶת בֵּ֣ית בָּמ֑וֹת וַ/יַּ֤עַשׂ כֹּֽהֲנִים֙ מִ/קְצ֣וֹת הָ/עָ֔ם אֲשֶׁ֥ר לֹֽא הָי֖וּ מִ/בְּנֵ֥י לֵוִֽי
verses.translit: vy'sh 't byt bmvt vy'sh khhnym mqtsvt h'm 'shr l' hyv mbny lvy
verses.translation: And he made an house of high places, and made priests of the lowest of the people, which were not of the sons of Levi.

verses.original: וַ/יַּ֣עַשׂ יָרָבְעָ֣ם חָ֡ג בַּ/חֹ֣דֶשׁ הַ/שְּׁמִינִ֣י בַּ/חֲמִשָּֽׁה עָשָׂר֩ י֨וֹם לַ/חֹ֜דֶשׁ כֶּ/חָ֣ג אֲשֶׁ֣ר בִּ/יהוּדָ֗ה וַ/יַּ֨עַל֙ עַל הַ/מִּזְבֵּ֔חַ כֵּ֤ן עָשָׂה֙ בְּ/בֵֽית אֵ֔ל לְ/זַבֵּ֖חַ לָ/עֲגָלִ֣ים אֲשֶׁר עָשָׂ֑ה וְ/הֶעֱמִיד֙ בְּ/בֵ֣ית אֵ֔ל אֶת כֹּהֲנֵ֥י הַ/בָּמ֖וֹת אֲשֶׁ֥ר עָשָֽׂה
verses.translit: vy'sh yrb'm chg bchdsh hshmyny bchmshh 'shr yvm lchdsh khchg 'shr byhvdh vy'l 'l hmzbch khn 'shh bbyt 'l lzbch l'glym 'shr 'shh vh'myd bbyt 'l 't khhny hbmvt 'shr 'shh
verses.translation: And Jeroboam ordained a feast in the eighth month, on the fifteenth day of the month, like unto the feast that is in Judah, and he offered upon the altar. So did he in Beth-el, sacrificing unto the calves that he had made: and he placed in Beth-el the priests of the high places which he had made.

verses.original: וַ/יַּ֜עַל עַֽל הַ/מִּזְבֵּ֣חַ אֲשֶׁר עָשָׂ֣ה בְּ/בֵֽית אֵ֗ל בַּ/חֲמִשָּׁ֨ה עָשָׂ֥ר יוֹם֙ בַּ/חֹ֣דֶשׁ הַ/שְּׁמִינִ֔י בַּ/חֹ֖דֶשׁ אֲשֶׁר בָּדָ֣א מ/ל/בד מִ/לִּבּ֑/וֹ וַ/יַּ֤עַשׂ חָג֙ לִ/בְנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל וַ/יַּ֥עַל עַל הַ/מִּזְבֵּ֖חַ לְ/הַקְטִֽיר
verses.translit: vy'l 'l hmzbch 'shr 'shh bbyt 'l bchmshh 'shr yvm bchdsh hshmyny bchdsh 'shr bd' mlbd mlbv vy'sh chg lbny yshr'l vy'l 'l hmzbch lhqtyr
verses.translation: So he offered upon the altar which he had made in Beth-el the fifteenth day of the eighth month, even in the month which he had devised of his own heart; and ordained a feast unto the children of Israel: and he offered upon the altar, and burnt incense.

verses.original: וְ/הִנֵּ֣ה אִ֣ישׁ אֱלֹהִ֗ים בָּ֧א מִ/יהוּדָ֛ה בִּ/דְבַ֥ר יְהוָ֖ה אֶל בֵּֽית אֵ֑ל וְ/יָרָבְעָ֛ם עֹמֵ֥ד עַל הַ/מִּזְבֵּ֖חַ לְ/הַקְטִֽיר
verses.translit: vhnh 'ysh 'lhym b' myhvdh bdbr yhvh 'l byt 'l vyrb'm 'md 'l hmzbch lhqtyr
verses.translation: And, behold, there came a man of God out of Judah by the word of the LORD unto Beth-el: and Jeroboam stood by the altar to burn incense.

verses.original: וַ/יִּקְרָ֤א עַל הַ/מִּזְבֵּ֨חַ֙ בִּ/דְבַ֣ר יְהוָ֔ה וַ/יֹּ֨אמֶר֙ מִזְבֵּ֣חַ מִזְבֵּ֔חַ כֹּ֖ה אָמַ֣ר יְהוָ֑ה הִנֵּֽה בֵ֞ן נוֹלָ֤ד לְ/בֵית דָּוִד֙ יֹאשִׁיָּ֣הוּ שְׁמ֔/וֹ וְ/זָבַ֣ח עָלֶ֗י/ךָ אֶת כֹּהֲנֵ֤י הַ/בָּמוֹת֙ הַ/מַּקְטִרִ֣ים עָלֶ֔י/ךָ וְ/עַצְמ֥וֹת אָדָ֖ם יִשְׂרְפ֥וּ עָלֶֽי/ךָ
verses.translit: vyqr' 'l hmzbch bdbr yhvh vy'mr mzbch mzbch khh 'mr yhvh hnh bn nvld lbyt dvd y'shyhv shmv vzbch 'lykh 't khhny hbmvt hmqtrym 'lykh v'tsmvt 'dm yshrpv 'lykh
verses.translation: And he cried against the altar in the word of the LORD , and said, O altar, altar, thus saith the LORD ; Behold, a child shall be born unto the house of David, Josiah by name; and upon thee shall he offer the priests of the high places that burn incense upon thee, and men’s bones shall be burnt upon thee.

verses.original: וְ/נָתַן֩ בַּ/יּ֨וֹם הַ/ה֤וּא מוֹפֵת֙ לֵ/אמֹ֔ר זֶ֣ה הַ/מּוֹפֵ֔ת אֲשֶׁ֖ר דִּבֶּ֣ר יְהוָ֑ה הִנֵּ֤ה הַ/מִּזְבֵּ֨חַ֙ נִקְרָ֔ע וְ/נִשְׁפַּ֖ךְ הַ/דֶּ֥שֶׁן אֲשֶׁר עָלָֽי/ו
verses.translit: vntn byvm hhv' mvpt l'mr zh hmvpt 'shr dbr yhvh hnh hmzbch nqr' vnshpkh hdshn 'shr 'lyv
verses.translation: And he gave a sign the same day, saying, This is the sign which the LORD hath spoken; Behold, the altar shall be rent, and the ashes that are upon it shall be poured out.

verses.original: וַ/יְהִי֩ כִ/שְׁמֹ֨עַ הַ/מֶּ֜לֶךְ אֶת דְּבַ֣ר אִישׁ הָ/אֱלֹהִ֗ים אֲשֶׁ֨ר קָרָ֤א עַל הַ/מִּזְבֵּ֨חַ֙ בְּ/בֵֽית אֵ֔ל וַ/יִּשְׁלַ֨ח יָרָבְעָ֧ם אֶת יָד֛/וֹ מֵ/עַ֥ל הַ/מִּזְבֵּ֖חַ לֵ/אמֹ֣ר תִּפְשֻׂ֑/הוּ וַ/תִּיבַ֤שׁ יָד/וֹ֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר שָׁלַ֣ח עָלָ֔י/ו וְ/לֹ֥א יָכֹ֖ל לַ/הֲשִׁיבָ֥/הּ אֵלָֽי/ו
verses.translit: vyhy khshm' hmlkh 't dbr 'ysh h'lhym 'shr qr' 'l hmzbch bbyt 'l vyshlch yrb'm 't ydv m'l hmzbch l'mr tpshhv vtybsh ydv 'shr shlch 'lyv vl' ykhl lhshybh 'lyv
verses.translation: And it came to pass, when king Jeroboam heard the saying of the man of God, which had cried against the altar in Beth-el, that he put forth his hand from the altar, saying, Lay hold on him. And his hand, which he put forth against him, dried up, so that he could not pull it in again to him.

verses.original: וְ/הַ/מִּזְבֵּ֣חַ נִקְרָ֔ע וַ/יִּשָּׁפֵ֥ךְ הַ/דֶּ֖שֶׁן מִן הַ/מִּזְבֵּ֑חַ כַּ/מּוֹפֵ֗ת אֲשֶׁ֥ר נָתַ֛ן אִ֥ישׁ הָ/אֱלֹהִ֖ים בִּ/דְבַ֥ר יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: vhmzbch nqr' vyshpkh hdshn mn hmzbch khmvpt 'shr ntn 'ysh h'lhym bdbr yhvh
verses.translation: The altar also was rent, and the ashes poured out from the altar, according to the sign which the man of God had given by the word of the LORD .

verses.original: וַ/יַּ֨עַן הַ/מֶּ֜לֶךְ וַ/יֹּ֣אמֶר אֶל אִ֣ישׁ הָ/אֱלֹהִ֗ים חַל נָ֞א אֶת פְּנֵ֨י יְהוָ֤ה אֱלֹהֶ֨י/ךָ֙ וְ/הִתְפַּלֵּ֣ל בַּעֲדִ֔/י וְ/תָשֹׁ֥ב יָדִ֖/י אֵלָ֑/י וַ/יְחַ֤ל אִישׁ הָֽ/אֱלֹהִים֙ אֶת פְּנֵ֣י יְהוָ֔ה וַ/תָּ֤שָׁב יַד הַ/מֶּ֨לֶךְ֙ אֵלָ֔י/ו וַ/תְּהִ֖י כְּ/בָ/רִֽאשֹׁנָֽה
verses.translit: vy'n hmlkh vy'mr 'l 'ysh h'lhym chl n' 't pny yhvh 'lhykh vhtpll b'dy vtshb ydy 'ly vychl 'ysh h'lhym 't pny yhvh vtshb yd hmlkh 'lyv vthy khbr'shnh
verses.translation: And the king answered and said unto the man of God, Intreat now the face of the LORD thy God, and pray for me, that my hand may be restored me again. And the man of God besought the LORD , and the king’s hand was restored him again, and became as it was before. , and: Heb. the face of the LORD , etc

verses.original: וַ/יְדַבֵּ֤ר הַ/מֶּ֨לֶךְ֙ אֶל אִ֣ישׁ הָ/אֱלֹהִ֔ים בֹּאָ/ה אִתִּ֥/י הַ/בַּ֖יְתָ/ה וּֽ/סְעָ֑דָ/ה וְ/אֶתְּנָ֥ה לְ/ךָ֖ מַתָּֽת
verses.translit: vydbr hmlkh 'l 'ysh h'lhym b'h 'ty hbyth vs'dh v'tnh lkh mtt
verses.translation: And the king said unto the man of God, Come home with me, and refresh thyself, and I will give thee a reward.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֤אמֶר אִישׁ הָֽ/אֱלֹהִים֙ אֶל הַ/מֶּ֔לֶךְ אִם תִּתֶּן לִ/י֙ אֶת חֲצִ֣י בֵיתֶ֔/ךָ לֹ֥א אָבֹ֖א עִמָּ֑/ךְ וְ/לֹֽא אֹ֤כַל לֶ֨חֶם֙ וְ/לֹ֣א אֶשְׁתֶּה מַּ֔יִם בַּ/מָּק֖וֹם הַ/זֶּֽה
verses.translit: vy'mr 'ysh h'lhym 'l hmlkh 'm ttn ly 't chtsy bytkh l' 'b' 'mkh vl' 'khl lchm vl' 'shth mym bmqvm hzh
verses.translation: And the man of God said unto the king, If thou wilt give me half thine house, I will not go in with thee, neither will I eat bread nor drink water in this place:

verses.original: כִּֽי כֵ֣ן צִוָּ֣ה אֹתִ֗/י בִּ/דְבַ֤ר יְהוָה֙ לֵ/אמֹ֔ר לֹא תֹ֥אכַל לֶ֖חֶם וְ/לֹ֣א תִשְׁתֶּה מָּ֑יִם וְ/לֹ֣א תָשׁ֔וּב בַּ/דֶּ֖רֶךְ אֲשֶׁ֥ר הָלָֽכְתָּ
verses.translit: khy khn tsvh 'ty bdbr yhvh l'mr l' t'khl lchm vl' tshth mym vl' tshvb bdrkh 'shr hlkht
verses.translation: For so was it charged me by the word of the LORD , saying, Eat no bread, nor drink water, nor turn again by the same way that thou camest.

verses.original: וַ/יֵּ֖לֶךְ בְּ/דֶ֣רֶךְ אַחֵ֑ר וְ/לֹֽא שָׁ֣ב בַּ/דֶּ֔רֶךְ אֲשֶׁ֛ר בָּ֥א בָ֖/הּ אֶל בֵּֽית אֵֽל
verses.translit: vylkh bdrkh 'chr vl' shb bdrkh 'shr b' bh 'l byt 'l
verses.translation: So he went another way, and returned not by the way that he came to Beth-el.

verses.original: וְ/נָבִ֤יא אֶחָד֙ זָקֵ֔ן יֹשֵׁ֖ב בְּ/בֵֽית אֵ֑ל וַ/יָּב֣וֹא בְנ֡/וֹ וַ/יְסַפֶּר ל֣/וֹ אֶת כָּל הַ/מַּעֲשֶׂ֣ה אֲשֶׁר עָשָׂה֩ אִישׁ הָ/אֱלֹהִ֨ים הַ/יּ֜וֹם בְּ/בֵֽית אֵ֗ל אֶת הַ/דְּבָרִים֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר דִּבֶּ֣ר אֶל הַ/מֶּ֔לֶךְ וַֽ/יְסַפְּר֖וּ/ם לַ/אֲבִי/הֶֽם
verses.translit: vnby' 'chd zqn yshb bbyt 'l vybv' bnv vyspr lv 't khl hm'shh 'shr 'shh 'ysh h'lhym hyvm bbyt 'l 't hdbrym 'shr dbr 'l hmlkh vysprvm l'byhm
verses.translation: Now there dwelt an old prophet in Beth-el; and his sons came and told him all the works that the man of God had done that day in Beth-el: the words which he had spoken unto the king, them they told also to their father.

verses.original: וַ/יְדַבֵּ֤ר אֲלֵ/הֶם֙ אֲבִי/הֶ֔ם אֵֽי זֶ֥ה הַ/דֶּ֖רֶךְ הָלָ֑ךְ וַ/יִּרְא֣וּ בָנָ֗י/ו אֶת הַ/דֶּ֨רֶךְ֙ אֲשֶׁ֤ר הָלַךְ֙ אִ֣ישׁ הָ/אֱלֹהִ֔ים אֲשֶׁר בָּ֖א מִ/יהוּדָֽה
verses.translit: vydbr 'lhm 'byhm 'y zh hdrkh hlkh vyr'v bnyv 't hdrkh 'shr hlkh 'ysh h'lhym 'shr b' myhvdh
verses.translation: And their father said unto them, What way went he? For his sons had seen what way the man of God went, which came from Judah.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֨אמֶר֙ אֶל בָּנָ֔י/ו חִבְשׁוּ לִ֖/י הַ/חֲמ֑וֹר וַ/יַּחְבְּשׁוּ ל֣/וֹ הַ/חֲמ֔וֹר וַ/יִּרְכַּ֖ב עָלָֽי/ו
verses.translit: vy'mr 'l bnyv chbshv ly hchmvr vychbshv lv hchmvr vyrkhb 'lyv
verses.translation: And he said unto his sons, Saddle me the ass. So they saddled him the ass: and he rode thereon,

verses.original: וַ/יֵּ֗לֶךְ אַֽחֲרֵי֙ אִ֣ישׁ הָ/אֱלֹהִ֔ים וַ/יִּ֨מְצָאֵ֔/הוּ יֹשֵׁ֖ב תַּ֣חַת הָ/אֵלָ֑ה וַ/יֹּ֣אמֶר אֵלָ֗י/ו הַ/אַתָּ֧ה אִישׁ הָ/אֱלֹהִ֛ים אֲשֶׁר בָּ֥אתָ מִֽ/יהוּדָ֖ה וַ/יֹּ֥אמֶר אָֽנִי
verses.translit: vylkh 'chry 'ysh h'lhym vymts'hv yshb tcht h'lh vy'mr 'lyv h'th 'ysh h'lhym 'shr b't myhvdh vy'mr 'ny
verses.translation: And went after the man of God, and found him sitting under an oak: and he said unto him, Art thou the man of God that camest from Judah? And he said, I am .

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֣אמֶר אֵלָ֔י/ו לֵ֥ךְ אִתִּ֖/י הַ/בָּ֑יְתָ/ה וֶ/אֱכֹ֖ל לָֽחֶם
verses.translit: vy'mr 'lyv lkh 'ty hbyth v'khl lchm
verses.translation: Then he said unto him, Come home with me, and eat bread.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֗אמֶר לֹ֥א אוּכַ֛ל לָ/שׁ֥וּב אִתָּ֖/ךְ וְ/לָ/ב֣וֹא אִתָּ֑/ךְ וְ/לֹֽא אֹ֣כַל לֶ֗חֶם וְ/לֹֽא אֶשְׁתֶּ֤ה אִתְּ/ךָ֙ מַ֔יִם בַּ/מָּק֖וֹם הַ/זֶּֽה
verses.translit: vy'mr l' 'vkhl lshvb 'tkh vlbv' 'tkh vl' 'khl lchm vl' 'shth 'tkh mym bmqvm hzh
verses.translation: And he said, I may not return with thee, nor go in with thee: neither will I eat bread nor drink water with thee in this place:

verses.original: כִּֽי דָבָ֤ר אֵלַ/י֙ בִּ/דְבַ֣ר יְהוָ֔ה לֹֽא תֹאכַ֣ל לֶ֔חֶם וְ/לֹֽא תִשְׁתֶּ֥ה שָׁ֖ם מָ֑יִם לֹא תָשׁ֣וּב לָ/לֶ֔כֶת בַּ/דֶּ֖רֶךְ אֲשֶׁר הָלַ֥כְתָּ בָּֽ/הּ
verses.translit: khy dbr 'ly bdbr yhvh l' t'khl lchm vl' tshth shm mym l' tshvb llkht bdrkh 'shr hlkht bh
verses.translation: For it was said to me by the word of the LORD , Thou shalt eat no bread nor drink water there, nor turn again to go by the way that thou camest.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֣אמֶר ל֗/וֹ גַּם אֲנִ֣י נָבִיא֮ כָּמוֹ/ךָ֒ וּ/מַלְאָ֡ךְ דִּבֶּ֣ר אֵלַ/י֩ בִּ/דְבַ֨ר יְהוָ֜ה לֵ/אמֹ֗ר הֲשִׁבֵ֤/הוּ אִתְּ/ךָ֙ אֶל בֵּיתֶ֔/ךָ וְ/יֹ֥אכַל לֶ֖חֶם וְ/יֵ֣שְׁתְּ מָ֑יִם כִּחֵ֖שׁ לֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: vy'mr lv gm 'ny nby' khmvkh vml'kh dbr 'ly bdbr yhvh l'mr hshbhv 'tkh 'l bytkh vy'khl lchm vysht mym khchsh lv
verses.translation: He said unto him, I am a prophet also as thou art; and an angel spake unto me by the word of the LORD , saying, Bring him back with thee into thine house, that he may eat bread and drink water. But he lied unto him.

verses.original: וַ/יָּ֣שָׁב אִתּ֗/וֹ וַ/יֹּ֥אכַל לֶ֛חֶם בְּ/בֵית֖/וֹ וַ/יֵּ֥שְׁתְּ מָֽיִם
verses.translit: vyshb 'tv vy'khl lchm bbytv vysht mym
verses.translation: So he went back with him, and did eat bread in his house, and drank water.

verses.original: וַ/יְהִ֕י הֵ֥ם יֹשְׁבִ֖ים אֶל הַ/שֻּׁלְחָ֑ן וַֽ/יְהִי֙ דְּבַר יְהוָ֔ה אֶל הַ/נָּבִ֖יא אֲשֶׁ֥ר הֱשִׁיבֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: vyhy hm yshbym 'l hshlchn vyhy dbr yhvh 'l hnby' 'shr hshybv
verses.translation: And it came to pass, as they sat at the table, that the word of the LORD came unto the prophet that brought him back:

verses.original: וַ/יִּקְרָ֞א אֶל אִ֣ישׁ הָ/אֱלֹהִ֗ים אֲשֶׁר בָּ֤א מִֽ/יהוּדָה֙ לֵ/אמֹ֔ר כֹּ֖ה אָמַ֣ר יְהוָ֑ה יַ֗עַן כִּ֤י מָרִ֨יתָ֙ פִּ֣י יְהוָ֔ה וְ/לֹ֤א שָׁמַ֨רְתָּ֙ אֶת הַ/מִּצְוָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר צִוְּ/ךָ֖ יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֶֽי/ךָ
verses.translit: vyqr' 'l 'ysh h'lhym 'shr b' myhvdh l'mr khh 'mr yhvh y'n khy mryt py yhvh vl' shmrt 't hmtsvh 'shr tsvkh yhvh 'lhykh
verses.translation: And he cried unto the man of God that came from Judah, saying, Thus saith the LORD , Forasmuch as thou hast disobeyed the mouth of the LORD , and hast not kept the commandment which the LORD thy God commanded thee,

verses.original: וַ/תָּ֗שָׁב וַ/תֹּ֤אכַל לֶ֨חֶם֙ וַ/תֵּ֣שְׁתְּ מַ֔יִם בַּ/מָּקוֹם֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר דִּבֶּ֣ר אֵלֶ֔י/ךָ אַל תֹּ֥אכַל לֶ֖חֶם וְ/אַל תֵּ֣שְׁתְּ מָ֑יִם לֹֽא תָב֥וֹא נִבְלָתְ/ךָ֖ אֶל קֶ֥בֶר אֲבֹתֶֽי/ךָ
verses.translit: vtshb vt'khl lchm vtsht mym bmqvm 'shr dbr 'lykh 'l t'khl lchm v'l tsht mym l' tbv' nbltkh 'l qbr 'btykh
verses.translation: But camest back, and hast eaten bread and drunk water in the place, of the which the Lord did say to thee, Eat no bread, and drink no water; thy carcase shall not come unto the sepulchre of thy fathers.

verses.original: וַ/יְהִ֗י אַחֲרֵ֛י אָכְל֥/וֹ לֶ֖חֶם וְ/אַחֲרֵ֣י שְׁתוֹת֑/וֹ וַ/יַּחֲבָשׁ ל֣/וֹ הַ/חֲמ֔וֹר לַ/נָּבִ֖יא אֲשֶׁ֥ר הֱשִׁיבֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: vyhy 'chry 'khlv lchm v'chry shtvtv vychbsh lv hchmvr lnby' 'shr hshybv
verses.translation: And it came to pass, after he had eaten bread, and after he had drunk, that he saddled for him the ass, to wit , for the prophet whom he had brought back.

verses.original: וַ/יֵּ֕לֶךְ וַ/יִּמְצָאֵ֧/הוּ אַרְיֵ֛ה בַּ/דֶּ֖רֶךְ וַ/יְמִיתֵ֑/הוּ וַ/תְּהִ֤י נִבְלָת/וֹ֙ מֻשְׁלֶ֣כֶת בַּ/דֶּ֔רֶךְ וְ/הַ/חֲמוֹר֙ עֹמֵ֣ד אֶצְלָ֔/הּ וְ/הָ֣/אַרְיֵ֔ה עֹמֵ֖ד אֵ֥צֶל הַ/נְּבֵלָֽה
verses.translit: vylkh vymts'hv 'ryh bdrkh vymythv vthy nbltv mshlkht bdrkh vhchmvr 'md 'tslh vh'ryh 'md 'tsl hnblh
verses.translation: And when he was gone, a lion met him by the way, and slew him: and his carcase was cast in the way, and the ass stood by it, the lion also stood by the carcase.

verses.original: וְ/הִנֵּ֧ה אֲנָשִׁ֣ים עֹבְרִ֗ים וַ/יִּרְא֤וּ אֶת הַ/נְּבֵלָה֙ מֻשְׁלֶ֣כֶת בַּ/דֶּ֔רֶךְ וְ/אֶת הָ֣/אַרְיֵ֔ה עֹמֵ֖ד אֵ֣צֶל הַ/נְּבֵלָ֑ה וַ/יָּבֹ֨אוּ֙ וַ/יְדַבְּר֣וּ בָ/עִ֔יר אֲשֶׁ֛ר הַ/נָּבִ֥יא הַ/זָּקֵ֖ן יֹשֵׁ֥ב בָּֽ/הּ
verses.translit: vhnh 'nshym 'brym vyr'v 't hnblh mshlkht bdrkh v't h'ryh 'md 'tsl hnblh vyb'v vydbrv b'yr 'shr hnby' hzqn yshb bh
verses.translation: And, behold, men passed by, and saw the carcase cast in the way, and the lion standing by the carcase: and they came and told it in the city where the old prophet dwelt.

verses.original: וַ/יִּשְׁמַ֣ע הַ/נָּבִיא֮ אֲשֶׁ֣ר הֱשִׁיב֣/וֹ מִן הַ/דֶּרֶךְ֒ וַ/יֹּ֨אמֶר֙ אִ֣ישׁ הָ/אֱלֹהִ֣ים ה֔וּא אֲשֶׁ֥ר מָרָ֖ה אֶת פִּ֣י יְהוָ֑ה וַ/יִּתְּנֵ֨/הוּ יְהוָ֜ה לָ/אַרְיֵ֗ה וַֽ/יִּשְׁבְּרֵ֨/הוּ֙ וַ/יְמִתֵ֔/הוּ כִּ/דְבַ֥ר יְהוָ֖ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר דִּבֶּר לֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: vyshm' hnby' 'shr hshybv mn hdrkh vy'mr 'ysh h'lhym hv' 'shr mrh 't py yhvh vytnhv yhvh l'ryh vyshbrhv vymthv khdbr yhvh 'shr dbr lv
verses.translation: And when the prophet that brought him back from the way heard thereof , he said, It is the man of God, who was disobedient unto the word of the LORD : therefore the LORD hath delivered him unto the lion, which hath torn him, and slain him, according to the word of the LORD , which he spake unto him.

verses.original: וַ/יְדַבֵּ֤ר אֶל בָּנָי/ו֙ לֵ/אמֹ֔ר חִבְשׁוּ לִ֖/י אֶֽת הַ/חֲמ֑וֹר וַֽ/יַּחֲבֹֽשׁוּ
verses.translit: vydbr 'l bnyv l'mr chbshv ly 't hchmvr vychbshv
verses.translation: And he spake to his sons, saying, Saddle me the ass. And they saddled him .

verses.original: וַ/יֵּ֗לֶךְ וַ/יִּמְצָ֤א אֶת נִבְלָת/וֹ֙ מֻשְׁלֶ֣כֶת בַּ/דֶּ֔רֶךְ וַֽ/חֲמוֹר֙ וְ/הָ֣/אַרְיֵ֔ה עֹמְדִ֖ים אֵ֣צֶל הַ/נְּבֵלָ֑ה לֹֽא אָכַ֤ל הָֽ/אַרְיֵה֙ אֶת הַ/נְּבֵלָ֔ה וְ/לֹ֥א שָׁבַ֖ר אֶֽת הַ/חֲמֽוֹר
verses.translit: vylkh vymts' 't nbltv mshlkht bdrkh vchmvr vh'ryh 'mdym 'tsl hnblh l' 'khl h'ryh 't hnblh vl' shbr 't hchmvr
verses.translation: And he went and found his carcase cast in the way, and the ass and the lion standing by the carcase: the lion had not eaten the carcase, nor torn the ass.

verses.original: וַ/יִּשָּׂ֨א הַ/נָּבִ֜יא אֶת נִבְלַ֧ת אִישׁ הָ/אֱלֹהִ֛ים וַ/יַּנִּחֵ֥/הוּ אֶֽל הַ/חֲמ֖וֹר וַ/יְשִׁיבֵ֑/הוּ וַ/יָּבֹ֗א אֶל עִיר֙ הַ/נָּבִ֣יא הַ/זָּקֵ֔ן לִ/סְפֹּ֖ד וּ/לְ/קָבְרֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: vysh' hnby' 't nblt 'ysh h'lhym vynchhv 'l hchmvr vyshybhv vyb' 'l 'yr hnby' hzqn lspd vlqbrv
verses.translation: And the prophet took up the carcase of the man of God, and laid it upon the ass, and brought it back: and the old prophet came to the city, to mourn and to bury him.

verses.original: וַ/יַּנַּ֥ח אֶת נִבְלָת֖/וֹ בְּ/קִבְר֑/וֹ וַ/יִּסְפְּד֥וּ עָלָ֖י/ו ה֥וֹי אָחִֽ/י
verses.translit: vynch 't nbltv bqbrv vyspdv 'lyv hvy 'chy
verses.translation: And he laid his carcase in his own grave; and they mourned over him, saying , Alas, my brother!

verses.original: וַ/יְהִי֮ אַחֲרֵ֣י קָבְר֣/וֹ אֹת/וֹ֒ וַ/יֹּ֤אמֶר אֶל בָּנָי/ו֙ לֵ/אמֹ֔ר בְּ/מוֹתִ/י֙ וּ/קְבַרְתֶּ֣ם אֹתִ֔/י בַּ/קֶּ֕בֶר אֲשֶׁ֛ר אִ֥ישׁ הָ/אֱלֹהִ֖ים קָב֣וּר בּ֑/וֹ אֵ֚צֶל עַצְמֹתָ֔י/ו הַנִּ֖יחוּ אֶת עַצְמֹתָֽ/י
verses.translit: vyhy 'chry qbrv 'tv vy'mr 'l bnyv l'mr bmvty vqbrtm 'ty bqbr 'shr 'ysh h'lhym qbvr bv 'tsl 'tsmtyv hnychv 't 'tsmty
verses.translation: And it came to pass, after he had buried him, that he spake to his sons, saying, When I am dead, then bury me in the sepulchre wherein the man of God is buried; lay my bones beside his bones:

verses.original: כִּי֩ הָיֹ֨ה יִהְיֶ֜ה הַ/דָּבָ֗ר אֲשֶׁ֤ר קָרָא֙ בִּ/דְבַ֣ר יְהוָ֔ה עַל הַ/מִּזְבֵּ֖חַ אֲשֶׁ֣ר בְּ/בֵֽית אֵ֑ל וְ/עַל֙ כָּל בָּתֵּ֣י הַ/בָּמ֔וֹת אֲשֶׁ֖ר בְּ/עָרֵ֥י שֹׁמְרֽוֹן
verses.translit: khy hyh yhyh hdbr 'shr qr' bdbr yhvh 'l hmzbch 'shr bbyt 'l v'l khl bty hbmvt 'shr b'ry shmrvn
verses.translation: For the saying which he cried by the word of the LORD against the altar in Beth-el, and against all the houses of the high places which are in the cities of Samaria, shall surely come to pass.

verses.original: אַחַר֙ הַ/דָּבָ֣ר הַ/זֶּ֔ה לֹֽא שָׁ֥ב יָרָבְעָ֖ם מִ/דַּרְכּ֣/וֹ הָ/רָעָ֑ה וַ֠/יָּשָׁב וַ/יַּ֜עַשׂ מִ/קְצ֤וֹת הָ/עָם֙ כֹּהֲנֵ֣י בָמ֔וֹת הֶֽ/חָפֵץ֙ יְמַלֵּ֣א אֶת יָד֔/וֹ וִ/יהִ֖י כֹּהֲנֵ֥י בָמֽוֹת
verses.translit: 'chr hdbr hzh l' shb yrb'm mdrkhv hr'h vyshb vy'sh mqtsvt h'm khhny bmvt hchpts yml' 't ydv vyhy khhny bmvt
verses.translation: After this thing Jeroboam returned not from his evil way, but made again of the lowest of the people priests of the high places: whosoever would, he consecrated him, and he became one of the priests of the high places.

verses.original: וַ/יְהִי֙ בַּ/דָּבָ֣ר הַ/זֶּ֔ה לְ/חַטַּ֖את בֵּ֣ית יָרָבְעָ֑ם וּ/לְ/הַכְחִיד֙ וּ/לְ/הַשְׁמִ֔יד מֵ/עַ֖ל פְּנֵ֥י הָ/אֲדָמָֽה
verses.translit: vyhy bdbr hzh lcht't byt yrb'm vlhkhchyd vlhshmyd m'l pny h'dmh
verses.translation: And this thing became sin unto the house of Jeroboam, even to cut it off, and to destroy it from off the face of the earth.

verses.original: בָּ/עֵ֣ת הַ/הִ֔יא חָלָ֖ה אֲבִיָּ֥ה בֶן יָרָבְעָֽם
verses.translit: b't hhy' chlh 'byh bn yrb'm
verses.translation: At that time Abijah the son of Jeroboam fell sick.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֨אמֶר יָרָבְעָ֜ם לְ/אִשְׁתּ֗/וֹ ק֤וּמִי נָא֙ וְ/הִשְׁתַּנִּ֔ית וְ/לֹ֣א יֵֽדְע֔וּ כִּי אתי אַ֖תְּ אֵ֣שֶׁת יָרָבְעָ֑ם וְ/הָלַ֣כְתְּ שִׁלֹ֗ה הִנֵּה שָׁם֙ אֲחִיָּ֣ה הַ/נָּבִ֔יא הֽוּא דִבֶּ֥ר עָלַ֛/י לְ/מֶ֖לֶךְ עַל הָ/עָ֥ם הַ/זֶּֽה
verses.translit: vy'mr yrb'm l'shtv qvmy n' vhshtnyt vl' yd'v khy 'ty 't 'sht yrb'm vhlkht shlh hnh shm 'chyh hnby' hv' dbr 'ly lmlkh 'l h'm hzh
verses.translation: And Jeroboam said to his wife, Arise, I pray thee, and disguise thyself, that thou be not known to be the wife of Jeroboam; and get thee to Shiloh: behold, there is Ahijah the prophet, which told me that I should be king over this people.

verses.original: וְ/לָקַ֣חַתְּ בְּ֠/יָדֵ/ךְ עֲשָׂרָ֨ה לֶ֧חֶם וְ/נִקֻּדִ֛ים וּ/בַקְבֻּ֥ק דְּבַ֖שׁ וּ/בָ֣את אֵלָ֑י/ו ה֚וּא יַגִּ֣יד לָ֔/ךְ מַה יִּֽהְיֶ֖ה לַ/נָּֽעַר
verses.translit: vlqcht bydkh 'shrh lchm vnqdym vbqbq dbsh vb't 'lyv hv' ygyd lkh mh yhyh ln'r
verses.translation: And take with thee ten loaves, and cracknels, and a cruse of honey, and go to him: he shall tell thee what shall become of the child.

verses.original: וַ/תַּ֤עַשׂ כֵּן֙ אֵ֣שֶׁת יָרָבְעָ֔ם וַ/תָּ֨קָם֙ וַ/תֵּ֣לֶךְ שִׁלֹ֔ה וַ/תָּבֹ֖א בֵּ֣ית אֲחִיָּ֑ה וַ/אֲחִיָּ֨הוּ֙ לֹֽא יָכֹ֣ל לִ/רְא֔וֹת כִּ֛י קָ֥מוּ עֵינָ֖י/ו מִ/שֵּׂיבֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: vt'sh khn 'sht yrb'm vtqm vtlkh shlh vtb' byt 'chyh v'chyhv l' ykhl lr'vt khy qmv 'ynyv mshybv
verses.translation: And Jeroboam’s wife did so, and arose, and went to Shiloh, and came to the house of Ahijah. But Ahijah could not see; for his eyes were set by reason of his age.

verses.original: וַ/יהוָ֞ה אָמַ֣ר אֶל אֲחִיָּ֗הוּ הִנֵּ֣ה אֵ֣שֶׁת יָרָבְעָ֡ם בָּאָ֣ה לִ/דְרֹשׁ֩ דָּבָ֨ר מֵ/עִמְּ/ךָ֤ אֶל בְּנָ/הּ֙ כִּֽי חֹלֶ֣ה ה֔וּא כָּ/זֹ֥ה וְ/כָ/זֶ֖ה תְּדַבֵּ֣ר אֵלֶ֑י/הָ וִ/יהִ֣י כְ/בֹאָ֔/הּ וְ/הִ֖יא מִתְנַכֵּרָֽה
verses.translit: vyhvh 'mr 'l 'chyhv hnh 'sht yrb'm b'h ldrsh dbr m'mkh 'l bnh khy chlh hv' khzh vkhzh tdbr 'lyh vyhy khb'h vhy' mtnkhrh
verses.translation: And the LORD said unto Ahijah, Behold, the wife of Jeroboam cometh to ask a thing of thee for her son; for he is sick: thus and thus shalt thou say unto her: for it shall be, when she cometh in, that she shall feign herself to be another woman .

verses.original: וַ/יְהִי֩ כִ/שְׁמֹ֨עַ אֲחִיָּ֜הוּ אֶת ק֤וֹל רַגְלֶ֨י/הָ֙ בָּאָ֣ה בַ/פֶּ֔תַח וַ/יֹּ֕אמֶר בֹּ֖אִי אֵ֣שֶׁת יָרָבְעָ֑ם לָ֣/מָּה זֶּ֗ה אַ֚תְּ מִתְנַכֵּרָ֔ה וְ/אָ֣נֹכִ֔י שָׁל֥וּחַ אֵלַ֖יִ/ךְ קָשָֽׁה
verses.translit: vyhy khshm' 'chyhv 't qvl rglyh b'h bptch vy'mr b'y 'sht yrb'm lmh zh 't mtnkhrh v'nkhy shlvch 'lykh qshh
verses.translation: And it was so , when Ahijah heard the sound of her feet, as she came in at the door, that he said, Come in, thou wife of Jeroboam; why feignest thou thyself to be another? for I am sent to thee with heavy tidings .

verses.original: לְכִ֞י אִמְרִ֣י לְ/יָרָבְעָ֗ם כֹּֽה אָמַ֤ר יְהוָה֙ אֱלֹהֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל יַ֛עַן אֲשֶׁ֥ר הֲרִימֹתִ֖י/ךָ מִ/תּ֣וֹךְ הָ/עָ֑ם וָ/אֶתֶּנְ/ךָ֣ נָגִ֔יד עַ֖ל עַמִּ֥/י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל
verses.translit: lkhy 'mry lyrb'm khh 'mr yhvh 'lhy yshr'l y'n 'shr hrymtykh mtvkh h'm v'tnkh ngyd 'l 'my yshr'l
verses.translation: Go, tell Jeroboam, Thus saith the LORD God of Israel, Forasmuch as I exalted thee from among the people, and made thee prince over my people Israel,

verses.original: וָ/אֶקְרַ֤ע אֶת הַ/מַּמְלָכָה֙ מִ/בֵּ֣ית דָּוִ֔ד וָ/אֶתְּנֶ֖/הָ לָ֑/ךְ וְ/לֹֽא הָיִ֜יתָ כְּ/עַבְדִּ֣/י דָוִ֗ד אֲשֶׁר֩ שָׁמַ֨ר מִצְוֺתַ֜/י וַ/אֲשֶׁר הָלַ֤ךְ אַחֲרַ/י֙ בְּ/כָל לְבָב֔/וֹ לַ/עֲשׂ֕וֹת רַ֖ק הַ/יָּשָׁ֥ר בְּ/עֵינָֽ/י
verses.translit: v'qr' 't hmmlkhh mbyt dvd v'tnh lkh vl' hyyt kh'bdy dvd 'shr shmr mtsvty v'shr hlkh 'chry bkhl lbbv l'shvt rq hyshr b'yny
verses.translation: And rent the kingdom away from the house of David, and gave it thee: and yet thou hast not been as my servant David, who kept my commandments, and who followed me with all his heart, to do that only which was right in mine eyes;

verses.original: וַ/תָּ֣רַע לַ/עֲשׂ֔וֹת מִ/כֹּ֖ל אֲשֶׁר הָי֣וּ לְ/פָנֶ֑י/ךָ וַ/תֵּ֡לֶךְ וַ/תַּעֲשֶׂה לְּ/ךָ֩ אֱלֹהִ֨ים אֲחֵרִ֤ים וּ/מַסֵּכוֹת֙ לְ/הַכְעִיסֵ֔/נִי וְ/אֹתִ֥/י הִשְׁלַ֖כְתָּ אַחֲרֵ֥י גַוֶּֽ/ךָ
verses.translit: vtr' l'shvt mkhl 'shr hyv lpnykh vtlkh vt'shh lkh 'lhym 'chrym vmskhvt lhkh'ysny v'ty hshlkht 'chry gvkh
verses.translation: But hast done evil above all that were before thee: for thou hast gone and made thee other gods, and molten images, to provoke me to anger, and hast cast me behind thy back:

verses.original: לָ/כֵ֗ן הִנְ/נִ֨י מֵבִ֤יא רָעָה֙ אֶל בֵּ֣ית יָרָבְעָ֔ם וְ/הִכְרַתִּ֤י לְ/יָֽרָבְעָם֙ מַשְׁתִּ֣ין בְּ/קִ֔יר עָצ֥וּר וְ/עָז֖וּב בְּ/יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וּ/בִֽעַרְתִּי֙ אַחֲרֵ֣י בֵית יָרָבְעָ֔ם כַּ/אֲשֶׁ֛ר יְבַעֵ֥ר הַ/גָּלָ֖ל עַד תֻּמּֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: lkhn hnny mby' r'h 'l byt yrb'm vhkhrty lyrb'm mshtyn bqyr 'tsvr v'zvb byshr'l vb'rty 'chry byt yrb'm kh'shr yb'r hgll 'd tmv
verses.translation: Therefore, behold, I will bring evil upon the house of Jeroboam, and will cut off from Jeroboam him that pisseth against the wall, and him that is shut up and left in Israel, and will take away the remnant of the house of Jeroboam, as a man taketh away dung, till it be all gone.

verses.original: הַ/מֵּ֨ת לְ/יָֽרָבְעָ֤ם בָּ/עִיר֙ יֹאכְל֣וּ הַ/כְּלָבִ֔ים וְ/הַ/מֵּת֙ בַּ/שָּׂדֶ֔ה יֹאכְל֖וּ ע֣וֹף הַ/שָּׁמָ֑יִם כִּ֥י יְהוָ֖ה דִּבֵּֽר
verses.translit: hmt lyrb'm b'yr y'khlv hkhlbym vhmt bshdh y'khlv 'vf hshmym khy yhvh dbr
verses.translation: Him that dieth of Jeroboam in the city shall the dogs eat; and him that dieth in the field shall the fowls of the air eat: for the LORD hath spoken it .

verses.original: וְ/אַ֥תְּ ק֖וּמִי לְכִ֣י לְ/בֵיתֵ֑/ךְ בְּ/בֹאָ֥ה רַגְלַ֛יִ/ךְ הָ/עִ֖ירָ/ה וּ/מֵ֥ת הַ/יָּֽלֶד
verses.translit: v't qvmy lkhy lbytkh bb'h rglykh h'yrh vmt hyld
verses.translation: Arise thou therefore, get thee to thine own house: and when thy feet enter into the city, the child shall die.

verses.original: וְ/סָֽפְדוּ ל֤/וֹ כָל יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ וְ/קָבְר֣וּ אֹת֔/וֹ כִּֽי זֶ֣ה לְ/בַדּ֔/וֹ יָבֹ֥א לְ/יָרָבְעָ֖ם אֶל קָ֑בֶר יַ֣עַן נִמְצָא ב֞/וֹ דָּבָ֣ר ט֗וֹב אֶל יְהוָ֛ה אֱלֹהֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל בְּ/בֵ֥ית יָרָבְעָֽם
verses.translit: vspdv lv khl yshr'l vqbrv 'tv khy zh lbdv yb' lyrb'm 'l qbr y'n nmts' bv dbr tvb 'l yhvh 'lhy yshr'l bbyt yrb'm
verses.translation: And all Israel shall mourn for him, and bury him: for he only of Jeroboam shall come to the grave, because in him there is found some good thing toward the LORD God of Israel in the house of Jeroboam.

verses.original: וְ/הֵקִים֩ יְהוָ֨ה ל֥/וֹ מֶ֨לֶךְ֙ עַל יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל אֲשֶׁ֥ר יַכְרִ֛ית אֶת בֵּ֥ית יָרָבְעָ֖ם זֶ֣ה הַ/יּ֑וֹם וּ/מֶ֖ה גַּם עָֽתָּה
verses.translit: vhqym yhvh lv mlkh 'l yshr'l 'shr ykhryt 't byt yrb'm zh hyvm vmh gm 'th
verses.translation: Moreover the LORD shall raise him up a king over Israel, who shall cut off the house of Jeroboam that day: but what? even now.

verses.original: וְ/הִכָּ֨ה יְהוָ֜ה אֶת יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל כַּ/אֲשֶׁ֨ר יָנ֣וּד הַ/קָּנֶה֮ בַּ/מַּיִם֒ וְ/נָתַ֣שׁ אֶת יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל מֵ֠/עַל הָ/אֲדָמָ֨ה הַ/טּוֹבָ֤ה הַ/זֹּאת֙ אֲשֶׁ֤ר נָתַן֙ לַ/אֲב֣וֹתֵי/הֶ֔ם וְ/זֵרָ֖/ם מֵ/עֵ֣בֶר לַ/נָּהָ֑ר יַ֗עַן אֲשֶׁ֤ר עָשׂוּ֙ אֶת אֲשֵׁ֣רֵי/הֶ֔ם מַכְעִיסִ֖ים אֶת יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: vhkhh yhvh 't yshr'l kh'shr ynvd hqnh bmym vntsh 't yshr'l m'l h'dmh htvbh hz't 'shr ntn l'bvtyhm vzrm m'br lnhr y'n 'shr 'shv 't 'shryhm mkh'ysym 't yhvh
verses.translation: For the LORD shall smite Israel, as a reed is shaken in the water, and he shall root up Israel out of this good land, which he gave to their fathers, and shall scatter them beyond the river, because they have made their groves, provoking the LORD to anger.

verses.original: וְ/יִתֵּ֖ן אֶת יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל בִּ/גְלַ֞ל חַטֹּ֤אות יָֽרָבְעָם֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר חָטָ֔א וַ/אֲשֶׁ֥ר הֶחֱטִ֖יא אֶת יִשְׂרָאֵֽל
verses.translit: vytn 't yshr'l bgll cht'vt yrb'm 'shr cht' v'shr hchty' 't yshr'l
verses.translation: And he shall give Israel up because of the sins of Jeroboam, who did sin, and who made Israel to sin.

verses.original: וַ/תָּ֨קָם֙ אֵ֣שֶׁת יָרָבְעָ֔ם וַ/תֵּ֖לֶךְ וַ/תָּבֹ֣א תִרְצָ֑תָ/ה הִ֛יא בָּאָ֥ה בְ/סַף הַ/בַּ֖יִת וְ/הַ/נַּ֥עַר מֵֽת
verses.translit: vtqm 'sht yrb'm vtlkh vtb' trtsth hy' b'h bsf hbyt vhn'r mt
verses.translation: And Jeroboam’s wife arose, and departed, and came to Tirzah: and when she came to the threshold of the door, the child died;

verses.original: וַ/יִּקְבְּר֥וּ אֹת֛/וֹ וַ/יִּסְפְּדוּ ל֖/וֹ כָּל יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל כִּ/דְבַ֤ר יְהוָה֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר דִּבֶּ֔ר בְּ/יַד עַבְדּ֖/וֹ אֲחִיָּ֥הוּ הַ/נָּבִֽיא
verses.translit: vyqbrv 'tv vyspdv lv khl yshr'l khdbr yhvh 'shr dbr byd 'bdv 'chyhv hnby'
verses.translation: And they buried him; and all Israel mourned for him, according to the word of the LORD , which he spake by the hand of his servant Ahijah the prophet.

verses.original: וְ/יֶ֨תֶר֙ דִּבְרֵ֣י יָֽרָבְעָ֔ם אֲשֶׁ֥ר נִלְחַ֖ם וַ/אֲשֶׁ֣ר מָלָ֑ךְ הִנָּ֣/ם כְּתוּבִ֗ים עַל סֵ֛פֶר דִּבְרֵ֥י הַ/יָּמִ֖ים לְ/מַלְכֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל
verses.translit: vytr dbry yrb'm 'shr nlchm v'shr mlkh hnm khtvbym 'l spr dbry hymym lmlkhy yshr'l
verses.translation: And the rest of the acts of Jeroboam, how he warred, and how he reigned, behold, they are written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel.

verses.original: וְ/הַ/יָּמִים֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר מָלַ֣ךְ יָרָבְעָ֔ם עֶשְׂרִ֥ים וּ/שְׁתַּ֖יִם שָׁנָ֑ה וַ/יִּשְׁכַּב֙ עִם אֲבֹתָ֔י/ו וַ/יִּמְלֹ֛ךְ נָדָ֥ב בְּנ֖/וֹ תַּחְתָּֽי/ו
verses.translit: vhymym 'shr mlkh yrb'm 'shrym vshtym shnh vyshkhb 'm 'btyv vymlkh ndb bnv tchtyv
verses.translation: And the days which Jeroboam reigned were two and twenty years: and he slept with his fathers, and Nadab his son reigned in his stead.

verses.original: וּ/רְחַבְעָם֙ בֶּן שְׁלֹמֹ֔ה מָלַ֖ךְ בִּֽ/יהוּדָ֑ה בֶּן אַרְבָּעִ֣ים וְ/אַחַ֣ת שָׁנָה֩ רְחַבְעָ֨ם בְּ/מָלְכ֜/וֹ וּֽ/שֲׁבַ֨ע עֶשְׂרֵ֥ה שָׁנָ֣ה מָלַ֣ךְ בִּ/ירוּשָׁלִַ֗ם הָ֠/עִיר אֲשֶׁר בָּחַ֨ר יְהוָ֜ה לָ/שׂ֨וּם אֶת שְׁמ֥/וֹ שָׁם֙ מִ/כֹּל֙ שִׁבְטֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל וְ/שֵׁ֣ם אִמּ֔/וֹ נַעֲמָ֖ה הָ/עַמֹּנִֽית
verses.translit: vrchb'm bn shlmh mlkh byhvdh bn 'rb'ym v'cht shnh rchb'm bmlkhv vshb' 'shrh shnh mlkh byrvshlm h'yr 'shr bchr yhvh lshvm 't shmv shm mkhl shbty yshr'l vshm 'mv n'mh h'mnyt
verses.translation: And Rehoboam the son of Solomon reigned in Judah. Rehoboam was forty and one years old when he began to reign, and he reigned seventeen years in Jerusalem, the city which the LORD did choose out of all the tribes of Israel, to put his name there. And his mother’s name was Naamah an Ammonitess.

verses.original: וַ/יַּ֧עַשׂ יְהוּדָ֛ה הָ/רַ֖ע בְּ/עֵינֵ֣י יְהוָ֑ה וַ/יְקַנְא֣וּ אֹת֗/וֹ מִ/כֹּל֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר עָשׂ֣וּ אֲבֹתָ֔/ם בְּ/חַטֹּאתָ֖/ם אֲשֶׁ֥ר חָטָֽאוּ
verses.translit: vy'sh yhvdh hr' b'yny yhvh vyqn'v 'tv mkhl 'shr 'shv 'btm bcht'tm 'shr cht'v
verses.translation: And Judah did evil in the sight of the LORD , and they provoked him to jealousy with their sins which they had committed, above all that their fathers had done.

verses.original: וַ/יִּבְנ֨וּ גַם הֵ֧מָּה לָ/הֶ֛ם בָּמ֥וֹת וּ/מַצֵּב֖וֹת וַ/אֲשֵׁרִ֑ים עַ֚ל כָּל גִּבְעָ֣ה גְבֹהָ֔ה וְ/תַ֖חַת כָּל עֵ֥ץ רַעֲנָֽן
verses.translit: vybnv gm hmh lhm bmvt vmtsbvt v'shrym 'l khl gb'h gbhh vtcht khl 'ts r'nn
verses.translation: For they also built them high places, and images, and groves, on every high hill, and under every green tree.

verses.original: וְ/גַם קָדֵ֖שׁ הָיָ֣ה בָ/אָ֑רֶץ עָשׂ֗וּ כְּ/כֹל֙ הַ/תּוֹעֲבֹ֣ת הַ/גּוֹיִ֔ם אֲשֶׁר֙ הוֹרִ֣ישׁ יְהוָ֔ה מִ/פְּנֵ֖י בְּנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל
verses.translit: vgm qdsh hyh b'rts 'shv khkhl htv'bt hgvym 'shr hvrysh yhvh mpny bny yshr'l
verses.translation: And there were also sodomites in the land: and they did according to all the abominations of the nations which the LORD cast out before the children of Israel.

verses.original: וַ/יְהִ֛י בַּ/שָּׁנָ֥ה הַ/חֲמִישִׁ֖ית לַ/מֶּ֣לֶךְ רְחַבְעָ֑ם עָלָ֛ה שושק שִׁישַׁ֥ק מֶֽלֶךְ מִצְרַ֖יִם עַל יְרוּשָׁלִָֽם
verses.translit: vyhy bshnh hchmyshyt lmlkh rchb'm 'lh shvshq shyshq mlkh mtsrym 'l yrvshlm
verses.translation: And it came to pass in the fifth year of king Rehoboam, that Shishak king of Egypt came up against Jerusalem:

verses.original: וַ/יִּקַּ֞ח אֶת אֹצְר֣וֹת בֵּית יְהוָ֗ה וְ/אֶת אֽוֹצְרוֹת֙ בֵּ֣ית הַ/מֶּ֔לֶךְ וְ/אֶת הַ/כֹּ֖ל לָקָ֑ח וַ/יִּקַּח֙ אֶת כָּל מָגִנֵּ֣י הַ/זָּהָ֔ב אֲשֶׁ֥ר עָשָׂ֖ה שְׁלֹמֹֽה
verses.translit: vyqch 't 'tsrvt byt yhvh v't 'vtsrvt byt hmlkh v't hkhl lqch vyqch 't khl mgny hzhb 'shr 'shh shlmh
verses.translation: And he took away the treasures of the house of the LORD , and the treasures of the king’s house; he even took away all: and he took away all the shields of gold which Solomon had made.

verses.original: וַ/יַּ֨עַשׂ הַ/מֶּ֤לֶךְ רְחַבְעָם֙ תַּחְתָּ֔/ם מָגִנֵּ֖י נְחֹ֑שֶׁת וְ/הִפְקִ֗יד עַל יַד֙ שָׂרֵ֣י הָ/רָצִ֔ים הַ/שֹּׁ֣מְרִ֔ים פֶּ֖תַח בֵּ֥ית הַ/מֶּֽלֶךְ
verses.translit: vy'sh hmlkh rchb'm tchtm mgny nchsht vhpqyd 'l yd shry hrtsym hshmrym ptch byt hmlkh
verses.translation: And king Rehoboam made in their stead brasen shields, and committed them unto the hands of the chief of the guard, which kept the door of the king’s house.

verses.original: וַ/יְהִ֛י מִ/דֵּי בֹ֥א הַ/מֶּ֖לֶךְ בֵּ֣ית יְהוָ֑ה יִשָּׂאוּ/ם֙ הָֽ/רָצִ֔ים וֶ/הֱשִׁיב֖וּ/ם אֶל תָּ֥א הָ/רָצִֽים
verses.translit: vyhy mdy b' hmlkh byt yhvh ysh'vm hrtsym vhshybvm 'l t' hrtsym
verses.translation: And it was so , when the king went into the house of the LORD , that the guard bare them, and brought them back into the guard chamber.

verses.original: וְ/יֶ֛תֶר דִּבְרֵ֥י רְחַבְעָ֖ם וְ/כָל אֲשֶׁ֣ר עָשָׂ֑ה הֲ/לֹא הֵ֣מָּה כְתוּבִ֗ים עַל סֵ֛פֶר דִּבְרֵ֥י הַ/יָּמִ֖ים לְ/מַלְכֵ֥י יְהוּדָֽה
verses.translit: vytr dbry rchb'm vkhl 'shr 'shh hl' hmh khtvbym 'l spr dbry hymym lmlkhy yhvdh
verses.translation: Now the rest of the acts of Rehoboam, and all that he did, are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah?

verses.original: וּ/מִלְחָמָ֨ה הָיְתָ֧ה בֵין רְחַבְעָ֛ם וּ/בֵ֥ין יָרָבְעָ֖ם כָּל הַ/יָּמִֽים
verses.translit: vmlchmh hyth byn rchb'm vbyn yrb'm khl hymym
verses.translation: And there was war between Rehoboam and Jeroboam all their days.

verses.original: וַ/יִּשְׁכַּ֨ב רְחַבְעָ֜ם עִם אֲבֹתָ֗י/ו וַ/יִּקָּבֵ֤ר עִם אֲבֹתָי/ו֙ בְּ/עִ֣יר דָּוִ֔ד וְ/שֵׁ֣ם אִמּ֔/וֹ נַעֲמָ֖ה הָ/עַמֹּנִ֑ית וַ/יִּמְלֹ֛ךְ אֲבִיָּ֥ם בְּנ֖/וֹ תַּחְתָּֽי/ו
verses.translit: vyshkhb rchb'm 'm 'btyv vyqbr 'm 'btyv b'yr dvd vshm 'mv n'mh h'mnyt vymlkh 'bym bnv tchtyv
verses.translation: And Rehoboam slept with his fathers, and was buried with his fathers in the city of David. And his mother’s name was Naamah an Ammonitess. And Abijam his son reigned in his stead.

verses.original: וּ/בִ/שְׁנַת֙ שְׁמֹנֶ֣ה עֶשְׂרֵ֔ה לַ/מֶּ֖לֶךְ יָרָבְעָ֣ם בֶּן נְבָ֑ט מָלַ֥ךְ אֲבִיָּ֖ם עַל יְהוּדָֽה
verses.translit: vbshnt shmnh 'shrh lmlkh yrb'm bn nbt mlkh 'bym 'l yhvdh
verses.translation: Now in the eighteenth year of king Jeroboam the son of Nebat reigned Abijam over Judah.

verses.original: שָׁלֹ֣שׁ שָׁנִ֔ים מָלַ֖ךְ בִּ/ירוּשָׁלִָ֑ם וְ/שֵׁ֣ם אִמּ֔/וֹ מַעֲכָ֖ה בַּת אֲבִישָׁלֽוֹם
verses.translit: shlsh shnym mlkh byrvshlm vshm 'mv m'khh bt 'byshlvm
verses.translation: Three years reigned he in Jerusalem. And his mother’s name was Maachah, the daughter of Abishalom.

verses.original: וַ/יֵּ֕לֶךְ בְּ/כָל חַטֹּ֥אות אָבִ֖י/ו אֲשֶׁר עָשָׂ֣ה לְ/פָנָ֑י/ו וְ/לֹא הָיָ֨ה לְבָב֤/וֹ שָׁלֵם֙ עִם יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהָ֔י/ו כִּ/לְבַ֖ב דָּוִ֥ד אָבִֽי/ו
verses.translit: vylkh bkhl cht'vt 'byv 'shr 'shh lpnyv vl' hyh lbbv shlm 'm yhvh 'lhyv khlbb dvd 'byv
verses.translation: And he walked in all the sins of his father, which he had done before him: and his heart was not perfect with the LORD his God, as the heart of David his father.

verses.original: כִּ֚י לְמַ֣עַן דָּוִ֔ד נָתַן֩ יְהוָ֨ה אֱלֹהָ֥י/ו ל֛/וֹ נִ֖יר בִּ/ירוּשָׁלִָ֑ם לְ/הָקִ֤ים אֶת בְּנ/וֹ֙ אַחֲרָ֔י/ו וּֽ/לְ/הַעֲמִ֖יד אֶת יְרוּשָׁלִָֽם
verses.translit: khy lm'n dvd ntn yhvh 'lhyv lv nyr byrvshlm lhqym 't bnv 'chryv vlh'myd 't yrvshlm
verses.translation: Nevertheless for David’s sake did the LORD his God give him a lamp in Jerusalem, to set up his son after him, and to establish Jerusalem:

verses.original: אֲשֶׁ֨ר עָשָׂ֥ה דָוִ֛ד אֶת הַ/יָּשָׁ֖ר בְּ/עֵינֵ֣י יְהוָ֑ה וְ/לֹֽא סָ֞ר מִ/כֹּ֣ל אֲשֶׁר צִוָּ֗/הוּ כֹּ֚ל יְמֵ֣י חַיָּ֔י/ו רַ֕ק בִּ/דְבַ֖ר אוּרִיָּ֥ה הַ/חִתִּֽי
verses.translit: 'shr 'shh dvd 't hyshr b'yny yhvh vl' sr mkhl 'shr tsvhv khl ymy chyyv rq bdbr 'vryh hchty
verses.translation: Because David did that which was right in the eyes of the LORD , and turned not aside from any thing that he commanded him all the days of his life, save only in the matter of Uriah the Hittite.

verses.original: וּ/מִלְחָמָ֨ה הָיְתָ֧ה בֵין רְחַבְעָ֛ם וּ/בֵ֥ין יָרָבְעָ֖ם כָּל יְמֵ֥י חַיָּֽי/ו
verses.translit: vmlchmh hyth byn rchb'm vbyn yrb'm khl ymy chyyv
verses.translation: And there was war between Rehoboam and Jeroboam all the days of his life.

verses.original: וְ/יֶ֨תֶר דִּבְרֵ֤י אֲבִיָּם֙ וְ/כָל אֲשֶׁ֣ר עָשָׂ֔ה הֲ/לֽוֹא הֵ֣ם כְּתוּבִ֗ים עַל סֵ֛פֶר דִּבְרֵ֥י הַ/יָּמִ֖ים לְ/מַלְכֵ֣י יְהוּדָ֑ה וּ/מִלְחָמָ֥ה הָיְתָ֛ה בֵּ֥ין אֲבִיָּ֖ם וּ/בֵ֥ין יָרָבְעָֽם
verses.translit: vytr dbry 'bym vkhl 'shr 'shh hlv' hm khtvbym 'l spr dbry hymym lmlkhy yhvdh vmlchmh hyth byn 'bym vbyn yrb'm
verses.translation: Now the rest of the acts of Abijam, and all that he did, are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah? And there was war between Abijam and Jeroboam.

verses.original: וַ/יִּשְׁכַּ֤ב אֲבִיָּם֙ עִם אֲבֹתָ֔י/ו וַ/יִּקְבְּר֥וּ אֹת֖/וֹ בְּ/עִ֣יר דָּוִ֑ד וַ/יִּמְלֹ֛ךְ אָסָ֥א בְנ֖/וֹ תַּחְתָּֽי/ו
verses.translit: vyshkhb 'bym 'm 'btyv vyqbrv 'tv b'yr dvd vymlkh 's' bnv tchtyv
verses.translation: And Abijam slept with his fathers; and they buried him in the city of David: and Asa his son reigned in his stead.

verses.original: וּ/בִ/שְׁנַ֣ת עֶשְׂרִ֔ים לְ/יָרָבְעָ֖ם מֶ֣לֶךְ יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל מָלַ֥ךְ אָסָ֖א מֶ֥לֶךְ יְהוּדָֽה
verses.translit: vbshnt 'shrym lyrb'm mlkh yshr'l mlkh 's' mlkh yhvdh
verses.translation: And in the twentieth year of Jeroboam king of Israel reigned Asa over Judah.

verses.original: וְ/אַרְבָּעִ֤ים וְ/אַחַת֙ שָׁנָ֔ה מָלַ֖ךְ בִּ/ירוּשָׁלִָ֑ם וְ/שֵׁ֣ם אִמּ֔/וֹ מַעֲכָ֖ה בַּת אֲבִישָׁלֽוֹם
verses.translit: v'rb'ym v'cht shnh mlkh byrvshlm vshm 'mv m'khh bt 'byshlvm
verses.translation: And forty and one years reigned he in Jerusalem. And his mother’s name was Maachah, the daughter of Abishalom.

verses.original: וַ/יַּ֧עַשׂ אָסָ֛א הַ/יָּשָׁ֖ר בְּ/עֵינֵ֣י יְהוָ֑ה כְּ/דָוִ֖ד אָבִֽי/ו
verses.translit: vy'sh 's' hyshr b'yny yhvh khdvd 'byv
verses.translation: And Asa did that which was right in the eyes of the LORD , as did David his father.

verses.original: וַ/יַּעֲבֵ֥ר הַ/קְּדֵשִׁ֖ים מִן הָ/אָ֑רֶץ וַ/יָּ֨סַר֙ אֶת כָּל הַ/גִּלֻּלִ֔ים אֲשֶׁ֥ר עָשׂ֖וּ אֲבֹתָֽי/ו
verses.translit: vy'br hqdshym mn h'rts vysr 't khl hgllym 'shr 'shv 'btyv
