verses.translation: And he took away the sodomites out of the land, and removed all the idols that his fathers had made.

verses.original: וְ/גַ֣ם אֶת מַעֲכָ֣ה אִמּ֗/וֹ וַ/יְסִרֶ֨/הָ֙ מִ/גְּבִירָ֔ה אֲשֶׁר עָשְׂתָ֥ה מִפְלֶ֖צֶת לָ/אֲשֵׁרָ֑ה וַ/יִּכְרֹ֤ת אָסָא֙ אֶת מִפְלַצְתָּ֔/הּ וַ/יִּשְׂרֹ֖ף בְּ/נַ֥חַל קִדְרֽוֹן
verses.translit: vgm 't m'khh 'mv vysrh mgbyrh 'shr 'shth mpltst l'shrh vykhrt 's' 't mpltsth vyshrf bnchl qdrvn
verses.translation: And also Maachah his mother, even her he removed from being queen, because she had made an idol in a grove; and Asa destroyed her idol, and burnt it by the brook Kidron.

verses.original: וְ/הַ/בָּמ֖וֹת לֹא סָ֑רוּ רַ֣ק לְבַב אָסָ֗א הָיָ֥ה שָׁלֵ֛ם עִם יְהוָ֖ה כָּל יָמָֽי/ו
verses.translit: vhbmvt l' srv rq lbb 's' hyh shlm 'm yhvh khl ymyv
verses.translation: But the high places were not removed: nevertheless Asa’s heart was perfect with the LORD all his days.

verses.original: וַ/יָּבֵא֙ אֶת קָדְשֵׁ֣י אָבִ֔י/ו ו/קדש/ו וְ/קָדְשֵׁ֖י בֵּ֣ית יְהוָ֑ה כֶּ֥סֶף וְ/זָהָ֖ב וְ/כֵלִֽים
verses.translit: vyb' 't qdshy 'byv vqdshv vqdshy byt yhvh khsf vzhb vkhlym
verses.translation: And he brought in the things which his father had dedicated, and the things which himself had dedicated, into the house of the LORD , silver, and gold, and vessels.

verses.original: וּ/מִלְחָמָ֨ה הָיְתָ֜ה בֵּ֣ין אָסָ֗א וּ/בֵ֛ין בַּעְשָׁ֥א מֶֽלֶךְ יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל כָּל יְמֵי/הֶֽם
verses.translit: vmlchmh hyth byn 's' vbyn b'sh' mlkh yshr'l khl ymyhm
verses.translation: And there was war between Asa and Baasha king of Israel all their days.

verses.original: וַ/יַּ֨עַל בַּעְשָׁ֤א מֶֽלֶךְ יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ עַל יְהוּדָ֔ה וַ/יִּ֖בֶן אֶת הָ/רָמָ֑ה לְ/בִלְתִּ֗י תֵּ֚ת יֹצֵ֣א וָ/בָ֔א לְ/אָסָ֖א מֶ֥לֶךְ יְהוּדָֽה
verses.translit: vy'l b'sh' mlkh yshr'l 'l yhvdh vybn 't hrmh lblty tt yts' vb' l's' mlkh yhvdh
verses.translation: And Baasha king of Israel went up against Judah, and built Ramah, that he might not suffer any to go out or come in to Asa king of Judah.

verses.original: וַ/יִּקַּ֣ח אָ֠סָא אֶת כָּל הַ/כֶּ֨סֶף וְ/הַ/זָּהָ֜ב הַֽ/נּוֹתָרִ֣ים בְּ/אוֹצְר֣וֹת בֵּית יְהוָ֗ה וְ/אֶת אֽוֹצְרוֹת֙ בֵּ֣ית מלך הַ/מֶּ֔לֶךְ וַֽ/יִּתְּנֵ֖/ם בְּ/יַד עֲבָדָ֑י/ו וַ/יִּשְׁלָחֵ֞/ם הַ/מֶּ֣לֶךְ אָסָ֗א אֶל בֶּן הֲ֠דַד בֶּן טַבְרִמֹּ֤ן בֶּן חֶזְיוֹן֙ מֶ֣לֶךְ אֲרָ֔ם הַ/יֹּשֵׁ֥ב בְּ/דַמֶּ֖שֶׂק לֵ/אמֹֽר
verses.translit: vyqch 's' 't khl hkhsf vhzhb hnvtrym b'vtsrvt byt yhvh v't 'vtsrvt byt mlkh hmlkh vytnm byd 'bdyv vyshlchm hmlkh 's' 'l bn hdd bn tbrmn bn chzyvn mlkh 'rm hyshb bdmshq l'mr
verses.translation: Then Asa took all the silver and the gold that were left in the treasures of the house of the LORD , and the treasures of the king’s house, and delivered them into the hand of his servants: and king Asa sent them to Ben-hadad, the son of Tabrimon, the son of Hezion, king of Syria, that dwelt at Damascus, saying,

verses.original: בְּרִית֙ בֵּינִ֣/י וּ/בֵינֶ֔/ךָ בֵּ֥ין אָבִ֖/י וּ/בֵ֣ין אָבִ֑י/ךָ הִנֵּה֩ שָׁלַ֨חְתִּֽי לְ/ךָ֥ שֹׁ֨חַד֙ כֶּ֣סֶף וְ/זָהָ֔ב לֵ֣ךְ הָפֵ֗רָ/ה אֶת בְּרִֽיתְ/ךָ֙ אֶת בַּעְשָׁ֣א מֶֽלֶךְ יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל וְ/יַעֲלֶ֖ה מֵ/עָלָֽ/י
verses.translit: bryt byny vbynkh byn 'by vbyn 'bykh hnh shlchty lkh shchd khsf vzhb lkh hprh 't brytkh 't b'sh' mlkh yshr'l vy'lh m'ly
verses.translation: There is a league between me and thee, and between my father and thy father: behold, I have sent unto thee a present of silver and gold; come and break thy league with Baasha king of Israel, that he may depart from me.

verses.original: וַ/יִּשְׁמַ֨ע בֶּן הֲדַ֜ד אֶל הַ/מֶּ֣לֶךְ אָסָ֗א וַ֠/יִּשְׁלַח אֶת שָׂרֵ֨י הַ/חֲיָלִ֤ים אֲשֶׁר ל/וֹ֙ עַל עָרֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל וַ/יַּךְ֙ אֶת עִיּ֣וֹן וְ/אֶת דָּ֔ן וְ/אֵ֖ת אָבֵ֣ל בֵּֽית מַעֲכָ֑ה וְ/אֵת֙ כָּל כִּנְר֔וֹת עַ֖ל כָּל אֶ֥רֶץ נַפְתָּלִֽי
verses.translit: vyshm' bn hdd 'l hmlkh 's' vyshlch 't shry hchylym 'shr lv 'l 'ry yshr'l vykh 't 'yvn v't dn v't 'bl byt m'khh v't khl khnrvt 'l khl 'rts nptly
verses.translation: So Ben-hadad hearkened unto king Asa, and sent the captains of the hosts which he had against the cities of Israel, and smote Ijon, and Dan, and Abel-beth-maachah, and all Cinneroth, with all the land of Naphtali.

verses.original: וַֽ/יְהִי֙ כִּ/שְׁמֹ֣עַ בַּעְשָׁ֔א וַ/יֶּחְדַּ֕ל מִ/בְּנ֖וֹת אֶת הָֽ/רָמָ֑ה וַ/יֵּ֖שֶׁב בְּ/תִרְצָֽה
verses.translit: vyhy khshm' b'sh' vychdl mbnvt 't hrmh vyshb btrtsh
verses.translation: And it came to pass, when Baasha heard thereof , that he left off building of Ramah, and dwelt in Tirzah.

verses.original: וְ/הַ/מֶּ֨לֶךְ אָסָ֜א הִשְׁמִ֤יעַ אֶת כָּל יְהוּדָה֙ אֵ֣ין נָקִ֔י וַ/יִּשְׂא֞וּ אֶת אַבְנֵ֤י הָֽ/רָמָה֙ וְ/אֶת עֵצֶ֔י/הָ אֲשֶׁ֥ר בָּנָ֖ה בַּעְשָׁ֑א וַ/יִּ֤בֶן בָּ/ם֙ הַ/מֶּ֣לֶךְ אָסָ֔א אֶת גֶּ֥בַע בִּנְיָמִ֖ן וְ/אֶת הַ/מִּצְפָּֽה
verses.translit: vhmlkh 's' hshmy' 't khl yhvdh 'yn nqy vysh'v 't 'bny hrmh v't 'tsyh 'shr bnh b'sh' vybn bm hmlkh 's' 't gb' bnymn v't hmtsph
verses.translation: Then king Asa made a proclamation throughout all Judah; none was exempted: and they took away the stones of Ramah, and the timber thereof, wherewith Baasha had builded; and king Asa built with them Geba of Benjamin, and Mizpah.

verses.original: וְ/יֶ֣תֶר כָּל דִּבְרֵֽי אָ֠סָא וְ/כָל גְּב֨וּרָת֜/וֹ וְ/כָל אֲשֶׁ֣ר עָשָׂ֗ה וְ/הֶֽ/עָרִים֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר בָּנָ֔ה הֲ/לֹֽא הֵ֣מָּה כְתוּבִ֗ים עַל סֵ֛פֶר דִּבְרֵ֥י הַ/יָּמִ֖ים לְ/מַלְכֵ֣י יְהוּדָ֑ה רַ֚ק לְ/עֵ֣ת זִקְנָת֔/וֹ חָלָ֖ה אֶת רַגְלָֽי/ו
verses.translit: vytr khl dbry 's' vkhl gbvrtv vkhl 'shr 'shh vh'rym 'shr bnh hl' hmh khtvbym 'l spr dbry hymym lmlkhy yhvdh rq l't zqntv chlh 't rglyv
verses.translation: The rest of all the acts of Asa, and all his might, and all that he did, and the cities which he built, are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah? Nevertheless in the time of his old age he was diseased in his feet.

verses.original: וַ/יִּשְׁכַּ֤ב אָסָא֙ עִם אֲבֹתָ֔י/ו וַ/יִּקָּבֵר֙ עִם אֲבֹתָ֔י/ו בְּ/עִ֖יר דָּוִ֣ד אָבִ֑י/ו וַ/יִּמְלֹ֛ךְ יְהוֹשָׁפָ֥ט בְּנ֖/וֹ תַּחְתָּֽי/ו
verses.translit: vyshkhb 's' 'm 'btyv vyqbr 'm 'btyv b'yr dvd 'byv vymlkh yhvshpt bnv tchtyv
verses.translation: And Asa slept with his fathers, and was buried with his fathers in the city of David his father: and Jehoshaphat his son reigned in his stead.

verses.original: וְ/נָדָ֣ב בֶּן יָרָבְעָ֗ם מָלַךְ֙ עַל יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל בִּ/שְׁנַ֣ת שְׁתַּ֔יִם לְ/אָסָ֖א מֶ֣לֶךְ יְהוּדָ֑ה וַ/יִּמְלֹ֥ךְ עַל יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל שְׁנָתָֽיִם
verses.translit: vndb bn yrb'm mlkh 'l yshr'l bshnt shtym l's' mlkh yhvdh vymlkh 'l yshr'l shntym
verses.translation: And Nadab the son of Jeroboam began to reign over Israel in the second year of Asa king of Judah, and reigned over Israel two years.

verses.original: וַ/יַּ֥עַשׂ הָ/רַ֖ע בְּ/עֵינֵ֣י יְהוָ֑ה וַ/יֵּ֨לֶךְ֙ בְּ/דֶ֣רֶךְ אָבִ֔י/ו וּ֨/בְ/חַטָּאת֔/וֹ אֲשֶׁ֥ר הֶחֱטִ֖יא אֶת יִשְׂרָאֵֽל
verses.translit: vy'sh hr' b'yny yhvh vylkh bdrkh 'byv vbcht'tv 'shr hchty' 't yshr'l
verses.translation: And he did evil in the sight of the LORD , and walked in the way of his father, and in his sin wherewith he made Israel to sin.

verses.original: וַ/יִּקְשֹׁ֨ר עָלָ֜י/ו בַּעְשָׁ֤א בֶן אֲחִיָּה֙ לְ/בֵ֣ית יִשָּׂשכָ֔ר וַ/יַּכֵּ֣/הוּ בַעְשָׁ֔א בְּ/גִבְּת֖וֹן אֲשֶׁ֣ר לַ/פְּלִשְׁתִּ֑ים וְ/נָדָב֙ וְ/כָל יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל צָרִ֖ים עַֽל גִּבְּתֽוֹן
verses.translit: vyqshr 'lyv b'sh' bn 'chyh lbyt yshshkhr vykhhv b'sh' bgbtvn 'shr lplshtym vndb vkhl yshr'l tsrym 'l gbtvn
verses.translation: And Baasha the son of Ahijah, of the house of Issachar, conspired against him; and Baasha smote him at Gibbethon, which belonged to the Philistines; for Nadab and all Israel laid siege to Gibbethon.

verses.original: וַ/יְמִתֵ֣/הוּ בַעְשָׁ֔א בִּ/שְׁנַ֣ת שָׁלֹ֔שׁ לְ/אָסָ֖א מֶ֣לֶךְ יְהוּדָ֑ה וַ/יִּמְלֹ֖ךְ תַּחְתָּֽי/ו
verses.translit: vymthv b'sh' bshnt shlsh l's' mlkh yhvdh vymlkh tchtyv
verses.translation: Even in the third year of Asa king of Judah did Baasha slay him, and reigned in his stead.

verses.original: וַ/יְהִ֣י כְ/מָלְכ֗/וֹ הִכָּה֙ אֶת כָּל בֵּ֣ית יָרָבְעָ֔ם לֹֽא הִשְׁאִ֧יר כָּל נְשָׁמָ֛ה לְ/יָרָבְעָ֖ם עַד הִשְׁמִד֑/וֹ כִּ/דְבַ֣ר יְהוָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֣ר דִּבֶּ֔ר בְּ/יַד עַבְדּ֖/וֹ אֲחִיָּ֥ה הַ/שִּׁילֹנִֽי
verses.translit: vyhy khmlkhv hkhh 't khl byt yrb'm l' hsh'yr khl nshmh lyrb'm 'd hshmdv khdbr yhvh 'shr dbr byd 'bdv 'chyh hshylny
verses.translation: And it came to pass, when he reigned, that he smote all the house of Jeroboam; he left not to Jeroboam any that breathed, until he had destroyed him, according unto the saying of the LORD , which he spake by his servant Ahijah the Shilonite:

verses.original: עַל חַטֹּ֤אות יָרָבְעָם֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר חָטָ֔א וַ/אֲשֶׁ֥ר הֶחֱטִ֖יא אֶת יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל בְּ/כַעְס֕/וֹ אֲשֶׁ֣ר הִכְעִ֔יס אֶת יְהוָ֖ה אֱלֹהֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל
verses.translit: 'l cht'vt yrb'm 'shr cht' v'shr hchty' 't yshr'l bkh'sv 'shr hkh'ys 't yhvh 'lhy yshr'l
verses.translation: Because of the sins of Jeroboam which he sinned, and which he made Israel sin, by his provocation wherewith he provoked the LORD God of Israel to anger.

verses.original: וְ/יֶ֛תֶר דִּבְרֵ֥י נָדָ֖ב וְ/כָל אֲשֶׁ֣ר עָשָׂ֑ה הֲ/לֹא הֵ֣ם כְּתוּבִ֗ים עַל סֵ֛פֶר דִּבְרֵ֥י הַ/יָּמִ֖ים לְ/מַלְכֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל
verses.translit: vytr dbry ndb vkhl 'shr 'shh hl' hm khtvbym 'l spr dbry hymym lmlkhy yshr'l
verses.translation: Now the rest of the acts of Nadab, and all that he did, are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel?

verses.original: וּ/מִלְחָמָ֨ה הָיְתָ֜ה בֵּ֣ין אָסָ֗א וּ/בֵ֛ין בַּעְשָׁ֥א מֶֽלֶךְ יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל כָּל יְמֵי/הֶֽם
verses.translit: vmlchmh hyth byn 's' vbyn b'sh' mlkh yshr'l khl ymyhm
verses.translation: And there was war between Asa and Baasha king of Israel all their days.

verses.original: בִּ/שְׁנַ֣ת שָׁלֹ֔שׁ לְ/אָסָ֖א מֶ֣לֶךְ יְהוּדָ֑ה מָ֠לַךְ בַּעְשָׁ֨א בֶן אֲחִיָּ֤ה עַל כָּל יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ בְּ/תִרְצָ֔ה עֶשְׂרִ֥ים וְ/אַרְבַּ֖ע שָׁנָֽה
verses.translit: bshnt shlsh l's' mlkh yhvdh mlkh b'sh' bn 'chyh 'l khl yshr'l btrtsh 'shrym v'rb' shnh
verses.translation: In the third year of Asa king of Judah began Baasha the son of Ahijah to reign over all Israel in Tirzah, twenty and four years.

verses.original: וַ/יַּ֥עַשׂ הָ/רַ֖ע בְּ/עֵינֵ֣י יְהוָ֑ה וַ/יֵּ֨לֶךְ֙ בְּ/דֶ֣רֶךְ יָרָבְעָ֔ם וּ֨/בְ/חַטָּאת֔/וֹ אֲשֶׁ֥ר הֶחֱטִ֖יא אֶת יִשְׂרָאֵֽל
verses.translit: vy'sh hr' b'yny yhvh vylkh bdrkh yrb'm vbcht'tv 'shr hchty' 't yshr'l
verses.translation: And he did evil in the sight of the LORD , and walked in the way of Jeroboam, and in his sin wherewith he made Israel to sin.

verses.original: וַ/יְהִ֤י דְבַר יְהוָה֙ אֶל יֵה֣וּא בֶן חֲנָ֔נִי עַל בַּעְשָׁ֖א לֵ/אמֹֽר
verses.translit: vyhy dbr yhvh 'l yhv' bn chnny 'l b'sh' l'mr
verses.translation: Then the word of the LORD came to Jehu the son of Hanani against Baasha, saying,

verses.original: יַ֗עַן אֲשֶׁ֤ר הֲרִימֹתִ֨י/ךָ֙ מִן הֶ֣/עָפָ֔ר וָ/אֶתֶּנְ/ךָ֣ נָגִ֔יד עַ֖ל עַמִּ֣/י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וַ/תֵּ֣לֶךְ בְּ/דֶ֣רֶךְ יָרָבְעָ֗ם וַֽ/תַּחֲטִא֙ אֶת עַמִּ֣/י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל לְ/הַכְעִיסֵ֖/נִי בְּ/חַטֹּאתָֽ/ם
verses.translit: y'n 'shr hrymtykh mn h'pr v'tnkh ngyd 'l 'my yshr'l vtlkh bdrkh yrb'm vtcht' 't 'my yshr'l lhkh'ysny bcht'tm
verses.translation: Forasmuch as I exalted thee out of the dust, and made thee prince over my people Israel; and thou hast walked in the way of Jeroboam, and hast made my people Israel to sin, to provoke me to anger with their sins;

verses.original: הִנְ/נִ֥י מַבְעִ֛יר אַחֲרֵ֥י בַעְשָׁ֖א וְ/אַחֲרֵ֣י בֵית֑/וֹ וְ/נָֽתַתִּי֙ אֶת בֵּ֣יתְ/ךָ֔ כְּ/בֵ֖ית יָרָבְעָ֥ם בֶּן נְבָֽט
verses.translit: hnny mb'yr 'chry b'sh' v'chry bytv vntty 't bytkh khbyt yrb'm bn nbt
verses.translation: Behold, I will take away the posterity of Baasha, and the posterity of his house; and will make thy house like the house of Jeroboam the son of Nebat.

verses.original: הַ/מֵּ֤ת לְ/בַעְשָׁא֙ בָּ/עִ֔יר יֹֽאכְל֖וּ הַ/כְּלָבִ֑ים וְ/הַ/מֵּ֥ת ל/וֹ֙ בַּ/שָּׂדֶ֔ה יֹאכְל֖וּ ע֥וֹף הַ/שָּׁמָֽיִם
verses.translit: hmt lb'sh' b'yr y'khlv hkhlbym vhmt lv bshdh y'khlv 'vf hshmym
verses.translation: Him that dieth of Baasha in the city shall the dogs eat; and him that dieth of his in the fields shall the fowls of the air eat.

verses.original: וְ/יֶ֨תֶר דִּבְרֵ֥י בַעְשָׁ֛א וַ/אֲשֶׁ֥ר עָשָׂ֖ה וּ/גְבֽוּרָת֑/וֹ הֲ/לֹא הֵ֣ם כְּתוּבִ֗ים עַל סֵ֛פֶר דִּבְרֵ֥י הַ/יָּמִ֖ים לְ/מַלְכֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל
verses.translit: vytr dbry b'sh' v'shr 'shh vgbvrtv hl' hm khtvbym 'l spr dbry hymym lmlkhy yshr'l
verses.translation: Now the rest of the acts of Baasha, and what he did, and his might, are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel?

verses.original: וַ/יִּשְׁכַּ֤ב בַּעְשָׁא֙ עִם אֲבֹתָ֔י/ו וַ/יִּקָּבֵ֖ר בְּ/תִרְצָ֑ה וַ/יִּמְלֹ֛ךְ אֵלָ֥ה בְנ֖/וֹ תַּחְתָּֽי/ו
verses.translit: vyshkhb b'sh' 'm 'btyv vyqbr btrtsh vymlkh 'lh bnv tchtyv
verses.translation: So Baasha slept with his fathers, and was buried in Tirzah: and Elah his son reigned in his stead.

verses.original: וְ/גַ֡ם בְּ/יַד יֵה֨וּא בֶן חֲנָ֜נִי הַ/נָּבִ֗יא דְּבַר יְהוָ֡ה הָיָה֩ אֶל בַּעְשָׁ֨א וְ/אֶל בֵּית֜/וֹ וְ/עַ֥ל כָּל הָ/רָעָ֣ה אֲשֶׁר עָשָׂ֣ה בְּ/עֵינֵ֣י יְהוָ֗ה לְ/הַכְעִיס/וֹ֙ בְּ/מַעֲשֵׂ֣ה יָדָ֔י/ו לִ/הְי֖וֹת כְּ/בֵ֣ית יָרָבְעָ֑ם וְ/עַ֥ל אֲשֶׁר הִכָּ֖ה אֹתֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: vgm byd yhv' bn chnny hnby' dbr yhvh hyh 'l b'sh' v'l bytv v'l khl hr'h 'shr 'shh b'yny yhvh lhkh'ysv bm'shh ydyv lhyvt khbyt yrb'm v'l 'shr hkhh 'tv
verses.translation: And also by the hand of the prophet Jehu the son of Hanani came the word of the LORD against Baasha, and against his house, even for all the evil that he did in the sight of the LORD , in provoking him to anger with the work of his hands, in being like the house of Jeroboam; and because he killed him.

verses.original: בִּ/שְׁנַ֨ת עֶשְׂרִ֤ים וָ/שֵׁשׁ֙ שָׁנָ֔ה לְ/אָסָ֖א מֶ֣לֶךְ יְהוּדָ֑ה מָ֠לַךְ אֵלָ֨ה בֶן בַּעְשָׁ֧א עַל יִשְׂרָאֵ֛ל בְּ/תִרְצָ֖ה שְׁנָתָֽיִם
verses.translit: bshnt 'shrym vshsh shnh l's' mlkh yhvdh mlkh 'lh bn b'sh' 'l yshr'l btrtsh shntym
verses.translation: In the twenty and sixth year of Asa king of Judah began Elah the son of Baasha to reign over Israel in Tirzah, two years.

verses.original: וַ/יִּקְשֹׁ֤ר עָלָי/ו֙ עַבְדּ֣/וֹ זִמְרִ֔י שַׂ֖ר מַחֲצִ֣ית הָ/רָ֑כֶב וְ/ה֤וּא בְ/תִרְצָה֙ שֹׁתֶ֣ה שִׁכּ֔וֹר בֵּ֣ית אַרְצָ֔א אֲשֶׁ֥ר עַל הַ/בַּ֖יִת בְּ/תִרְצָֽה
verses.translit: vyqshr 'lyv 'bdv zmry shr mchtsyt hrkhb vhv' btrtsh shth shkhvr byt 'rts' 'shr 'l hbyt btrtsh
verses.translation: And his servant Zimri, captain of half his chariots, conspired against him, as he was in Tirzah, drinking himself drunk in the house of Arza steward of his house in Tirzah.

verses.original: וַ/יָּבֹ֤א זִמְרִי֙ וַ/יַּכֵּ֣/הוּ וַ/יְמִיתֵ֔/הוּ בִּ/שְׁנַת֙ עֶשְׂרִ֣ים וָ/שֶׁ֔בַע לְ/אָסָ֖א מֶ֣לֶךְ יְהוּדָ֑ה וַ/יִּמְלֹ֖ךְ תַּחְתָּֽי/ו
verses.translit: vyb' zmry vykhhv vymythv bshnt 'shrym vshb' l's' mlkh yhvdh vymlkh tchtyv
verses.translation: And Zimri went in and smote him, and killed him, in the twenty and seventh year of Asa king of Judah, and reigned in his stead.

verses.original: וַ/יְהִ֨י בְ/מָלְכ֜/וֹ כְּ/שִׁבְתּ֣/וֹ עַל כִּסְא֗/וֹ הִכָּה֙ אֶת כָּל בֵּ֣ית בַּעְשָׁ֔א לֹֽא הִשְׁאִ֥יר ל֖/וֹ מַשְׁתִּ֣ין בְּ/קִ֑יר וְ/גֹאֲלָ֖י/ו וְ/רֵעֵֽ/הוּ
verses.translit: vyhy bmlkhv khshbtv 'l khs'v hkhh 't khl byt b'sh' l' hsh'yr lv mshtyn bqyr vg'lyv vr'hv
verses.translation: And it came to pass, when he began to reign, as soon as he sat on his throne, that he slew all the house of Baasha: he left him not one that pisseth against a wall, neither of his kinsfolks, nor of his friends.

verses.original: וַ/יַּשְׁמֵ֣ד זִמְרִ֔י אֵ֖ת כָּל בֵּ֣ית בַּעְשָׁ֑א כִּ/דְבַ֤ר יְהוָה֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר דִּבֶּ֣ר אֶל בַּעְשָׁ֔א בְּ/יַ֖ד יֵה֥וּא הַ/נָּבִֽיא
verses.translit: vyshmd zmry 't khl byt b'sh' khdbr yhvh 'shr dbr 'l b'sh' byd yhv' hnby'
verses.translation: Thus did Zimri destroy all the house of Baasha, according to the word of the LORD , which he spake against Baasha by Jehu the prophet,

verses.original: אֶ֚ל כָּל חַטֹּ֣אות בַּעְשָׁ֔א וְ/חַטֹּ֖אות אֵלָ֣ה בְנ֑/וֹ אֲשֶׁ֣ר חָטְא֗וּ וַ/אֲשֶׁ֤ר הֶחֱטִ֨יאוּ֙ אֶת יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל לְ/הַכְעִ֗יס אֶת יְהוָ֛ה אֱלֹהֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל בְּ/הַבְלֵי/הֶֽם
verses.translit: 'l khl cht'vt b'sh' vcht'vt 'lh bnv 'shr cht'v v'shr hchty'v 't yshr'l lhkh'ys 't yhvh 'lhy yshr'l bhblyhm
verses.translation: For all the sins of Baasha, and the sins of Elah his son, by which they sinned, and by which they made Israel to sin, in provoking the LORD God of Israel to anger with their vanities.

verses.original: וְ/יֶ֛תֶר דִּבְרֵ֥י אֵלָ֖ה וְ/כָל אֲשֶׁ֣ר עָשָׂ֑ה הֲ/לֽוֹא הֵ֣ם כְּתוּבִ֗ים עַל סֵ֛פֶר דִּבְרֵ֥י הַ/יָּמִ֖ים לְ/מַלְכֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל
verses.translit: vytr dbry 'lh vkhl 'shr 'shh hlv' hm khtvbym 'l spr dbry hymym lmlkhy yshr'l
verses.translation: Now the rest of the acts of Elah, and all that he did, are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel?

verses.original: בִּ/שְׁנַת֩ עֶשְׂרִ֨ים וָ/שֶׁ֜בַע שָׁנָ֗ה לְ/אָסָא֙ מֶ֣לֶךְ יְהוּדָ֔ה מָלַ֥ךְ זִמְרִ֛י שִׁבְעַ֥ת יָמִ֖ים בְּ/תִרְצָ֑ה וְ/הָ/עָ֣ם חֹנִ֔ים עַֽל גִּבְּת֖וֹן אֲשֶׁ֥ר לַ/פְּלִשְׁתִּֽים
verses.translit: bshnt 'shrym vshb' shnh l's' mlkh yhvdh mlkh zmry shb't ymym btrtsh vh'm chnym 'l gbtvn 'shr lplshtym
verses.translation: In the twenty and seventh year of Asa king of Judah did Zimri reign seven days in Tirzah. And the people were encamped against Gibbethon, which belonged to the Philistines.

verses.original: וַ/יִּשְׁמַ֤ע הָ/עָם֙ הַ/חֹנִ֣ים לֵ/אמֹ֔ר קָשַׁ֣ר זִמְרִ֔י וְ/גַ֖ם הִכָּ֣ה אֶת הַ/מֶּ֑לֶךְ וַ/יַּמְלִ֣כוּ כָֽל יִ֠שְׂרָאֵל אֶת עָמְרִ֨י שַׂר צָבָ֧א עַל יִשְׂרָאֵ֛ל בַּ/יּ֥וֹם הַ/ה֖וּא בַּֽ/מַּחֲנֶֽה
verses.translit: vyshm' h'm hchnym l'mr qshr zmry vgm hkhh 't hmlkh vymlkhv khl yshr'l 't 'mry shr tsb' 'l yshr'l byvm hhv' bmchnh
verses.translation: And the people that were encamped heard say, Zimri hath conspired, and hath also slain the king: wherefore all Israel made Omri, the captain of the host, king over Israel that day in the camp.

verses.original: וַ/יַּעֲלֶ֥ה עָמְרִ֛י וְ/כָל יִשְׂרָאֵ֥ל עִמּ֖/וֹ מִֽ/גִּבְּת֑וֹן וַ/יָּצֻ֖רוּ עַל תִּרְצָֽה
verses.translit: vy'lh 'mry vkhl yshr'l 'mv mgbtvn vytsrv 'l trtsh
verses.translation: And Omri went up from Gibbethon, and all Israel with him, and they besieged Tirzah.

verses.original: וַ/יְהִ֞י כִּ/רְא֤וֹת זִמְרִי֙ כִּֽי נִלְכְּדָ֣ה הָ/עִ֔יר וַ/יָּבֹ֖א אֶל אַרְמ֣וֹן בֵּית הַ/מֶּ֑לֶךְ וַ/יִּשְׂרֹ֨ף עָלָ֧י/ו אֶת בֵּֽית מֶ֛לֶךְ בָּ/אֵ֖שׁ וַ/יָּמֹֽת
verses.translit: vyhy khr'vt zmry khy nlkhdh h'yr vyb' 'l 'rmvn byt hmlkh vyshrf 'lyv 't byt mlkh b'sh vymt
verses.translation: And it came to pass, when Zimri saw that the city was taken, that he went into the palace of the king’s house, and burnt the king’s house over him with fire, and died,

verses.original: עַל חטאת/ו חַטֹּאתָי/ו֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר חָטָ֔א לַ/עֲשׂ֥וֹת הָ/רַ֖ע בְּ/עֵינֵ֣י יְהוָ֑ה לָ/לֶ֨כֶת֙ בְּ/דֶ֣רֶךְ יָרָבְעָ֔ם וּ/בְ/חַטָּאת/וֹ֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר עָשָׂ֔ה לְ/הַחֲטִ֖יא אֶת יִשְׂרָאֵֽל
verses.translit: 'l cht'tv cht'tyv 'shr cht' l'shvt hr' b'yny yhvh llkht bdrkh yrb'm vbcht'tv 'shr 'shh lhchty' 't yshr'l
verses.translation: For his sins which he sinned in doing evil in the sight of the LORD , in walking in the way of Jeroboam, and in his sin which he did, to make Israel to sin.

verses.original: וְ/יֶ֨תֶר֙ דִּבְרֵ֣י זִמְרִ֔י וְ/קִשְׁר֖/וֹ אֲשֶׁ֣ר קָשָׁ֑ר הֲ/לֹֽא הֵ֣ם כְּתוּבִ֗ים עַל סֵ֛פֶר דִּבְרֵ֥י הַ/יָּמִ֖ים לְ/מַלְכֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל
verses.translit: vytr dbry zmry vqshrv 'shr qshr hl' hm khtvbym 'l spr dbry hymym lmlkhy yshr'l
verses.translation: Now the rest of the acts of Zimri, and his treason that he wrought, are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel?

verses.original: אָ֧ז יֵחָלֵ֛ק הָ/עָ֥ם יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל לַ/חֵ֑צִי חֲצִ֨י הָ/עָ֜ם הָ֠יָה אַחֲרֵ֨י תִבְנִ֤י בֶן גִּינַת֙ לְ/הַמְלִיכ֔/וֹ וְ/הַ/חֲצִ֖י אַחֲרֵ֥י עָמְרִֽי
verses.translit: 'z ychlq h'm yshr'l lchtsy chtsy h'm hyh 'chry tbny bn gynt lhmlykhv vhchtsy 'chry 'mry
verses.translation: Then were the people of Israel divided into two parts: half of the people followed Tibni the son of Ginath, to make him king; and half followed Omri.

verses.original: וַ/יֶּחֱזַ֤ק הָ/עָם֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר אַחֲרֵ֣י עָמְרִ֔י אֶת הָ/עָ֕ם אֲשֶׁ֥ר אַחֲרֵ֖י תִּבְנִ֣י בֶן גִּינַ֑ת וַ/יָּ֣מָת תִּבְנִ֔י וַ/יִּמְלֹ֖ךְ עָמְרִֽי
verses.translit: vychzq h'm 'shr 'chry 'mry 't h'm 'shr 'chry tbny bn gynt vymt tbny vymlkh 'mry
verses.translation: But the people that followed Omri prevailed against the people that followed Tibni the son of Ginath: so Tibni died, and Omri reigned.

verses.original: בִּ/שְׁנַת֩ שְׁלֹשִׁ֨ים וְ/אַחַ֜ת שָׁנָ֗ה לְ/אָסָא֙ מֶ֣לֶךְ יְהוּדָ֔ה מָלַ֤ךְ עָמְרִי֙ עַל יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל שְׁתֵּ֥ים עֶשְׂרֵ֖ה שָׁנָ֑ה בְּ/תִרְצָ֖ה מָלַ֥ךְ שֵׁשׁ שָׁנִֽים
verses.translit: bshnt shlshym v'cht shnh l's' mlkh yhvdh mlkh 'mry 'l yshr'l shtym 'shrh shnh btrtsh mlkh shsh shnym
verses.translation: In the thirty and first year of Asa king of Judah began Omri to reign over Israel, twelve years: six years reigned he in Tirzah.

verses.original: וַ/יִּ֜קֶן אֶת הָ/הָ֥ר שֹׁמְר֛וֹן מֵ֥/אֶת שֶׁ֖מֶר בְּ/כִכְּרַ֣יִם כָּ֑סֶף וַ/יִּ֨בֶן֙ אֶת הָ/הָ֔ר וַ/יִּקְרָ֗א אֶת שֵׁ֤ם הָ/עִיר֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר בָּנָ֔ה עַ֣ל שֶׁם שֶׁ֔מֶר אֲדֹנֵ֖י הָ/הָ֥ר שֹׁמְרֽוֹן
verses.translit: vyqn 't hhr shmrvn m't shmr bkhkhrym khsf vybn 't hhr vyqr' 't shm h'yr 'shr bnh 'l shm shmr 'dny hhr shmrvn
verses.translation: And he bought the hill Samaria of Shemer for two talents of silver, and built on the hill, and called the name of the city which he built, after the name of Shemer, owner of the hill, Samaria.

verses.original: וַ/יַּעֲשֶׂ֥ה עָמְרִ֛י הָ/רַ֖ע בְּ/עֵינֵ֣י יְהוָ֑ה וַ/יָּ֕רַע מִ/כֹּ֖ל אֲשֶׁ֥ר לְ/פָנָֽי/ו
verses.translit: vy'shh 'mry hr' b'yny yhvh vyr' mkhl 'shr lpnyv
verses.translation: But Omri wrought evil in the eyes of the LORD , and did worse than all that were before him.

verses.original: וַ/יֵּ֗לֶךְ בְּ/כָל דֶּ֨רֶךְ֙ יָרָבְעָ֣ם בֶּן נְבָ֔ט ו/ב/חטאתי/ו וּ/בְ/חַטָּאת֔/וֹ אֲשֶׁ֥ר הֶחֱטִ֖יא אֶת יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל לְ/הַכְעִ֗יס אֶת יְהוָ֛ה אֱלֹהֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל בְּ/הַבְלֵי/הֶֽם
verses.translit: vylkh bkhl drkh yrb'm bn nbt vbcht'tyv vbcht'tv 'shr hchty' 't yshr'l lhkh'ys 't yhvh 'lhy yshr'l bhblyhm
verses.translation: For he walked in all the way of Jeroboam the son of Nebat, and in his sin wherewith he made Israel to sin, to provoke the LORD God of Israel to anger with their vanities.

verses.original: וְ/יֶ֨תֶר דִּבְרֵ֤י עָמְרִי֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר עָשָׂ֔ה וּ/גְבוּרָת֖/וֹ אֲשֶׁ֣ר עָשָׂ֑ה הֲ/לֹֽא הֵ֣ם כְּתוּבִ֗ים עַל סֵ֛פֶר דִּבְרֵ֥י הַ/יָּמִ֖ים לְ/מַלְכֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל
verses.translit: vytr dbry 'mry 'shr 'shh vgbvrtv 'shr 'shh hl' hm khtvbym 'l spr dbry hymym lmlkhy yshr'l
verses.translation: Now the rest of the acts of Omri which he did, and his might that he shewed, are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel?

verses.original: וַ/יִּשְׁכַּ֤ב עָמְרִי֙ עִם אֲבֹתָ֔י/ו וַ/יִּקָּבֵ֖ר בְּ/שֹׁמְר֑וֹן וַ/יִּמְלֹ֛ךְ אַחְאָ֥ב בְּנ֖/וֹ תַּחְתָּֽי/ו
verses.translit: vyshkhb 'mry 'm 'btyv vyqbr bshmrvn vymlkh 'ch'b bnv tchtyv
verses.translation: So Omri slept with his fathers, and was buried in Samaria: and Ahab his son reigned in his stead.

verses.original: וְ/אַחְאָ֣ב בֶּן עָמְרִ֗י מָלַךְ֙ עַל יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל בִּ/שְׁנַ֨ת שְׁלֹשִׁ֤ים וּ/שְׁמֹנֶה֙ שָׁנָ֔ה לְ/אָסָ֖א מֶ֣לֶךְ יְהוּדָ֑ה וַ֠/יִּמְלֹךְ אַחְאָ֨ב בֶּן עָמְרִ֤י עַל יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ בְּ/שֹׁ֣מְר֔וֹן עֶשְׂרִ֥ים וּ/שְׁתַּ֖יִם שָׁנָֽה
verses.translit: v'ch'b bn 'mry mlkh 'l yshr'l bshnt shlshym vshmnh shnh l's' mlkh yhvdh vymlkh 'ch'b bn 'mry 'l yshr'l bshmrvn 'shrym vshtym shnh
verses.translation: And in the thirty and eighth year of Asa king of Judah began Ahab the son of Omri to reign over Israel: and Ahab the son of Omri reigned over Israel in Samaria twenty and two years.

verses.original: וַ/יַּ֨עַשׂ אַחְאָ֧ב בֶּן עָמְרִ֛י הָ/רַ֖ע בְּ/עֵינֵ֣י יְהוָ֑ה מִ/כֹּ֖ל אֲשֶׁ֥ר לְ/פָנָֽי/ו
verses.translit: vy'sh 'ch'b bn 'mry hr' b'yny yhvh mkhl 'shr lpnyv
verses.translation: And Ahab the son of Omri did evil in the sight of the LORD above all that were before him.

verses.original: וַ/יְהִי֙ הֲ/נָקֵ֣ל לֶכְתּ֔/וֹ בְּ/חַטֹּ֖אות יָרָבְעָ֣ם בֶּן נְבָ֑ט וַ/יִּקַּ֨ח אִשָּׁ֜ה אֶת אִיזֶ֗בֶל בַּת אֶתְבַּ֨עַל֙ מֶ֣לֶךְ צִידֹנִ֔ים וַ/יֵּ֨לֶךְ֙ וַֽ/יַּעֲבֹ֣ד אֶת הַ/בַּ֔עַל וַ/יִּשְׁתַּ֖חוּ לֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: vyhy hnql lkhtv bcht'vt yrb'm bn nbt vyqch 'shh 't 'yzbl bt 'tb'l mlkh tsydnym vylkh vy'bd 't hb'l vyshtchv lv
verses.translation: And it came to pass, as if it had been a light thing for him to walk in the sins of Jeroboam the son of Nebat, that he took to wife Jezebel the daughter of Ethbaal king of the Zidonians, and went and served Baal, and worshipped him.

verses.original: וַ/יָּ֥קֶם מִזְבֵּ֖חַ לַ/בָּ֑עַל בֵּ֣ית הַ/בַּ֔עַל אֲשֶׁ֥ר בָּנָ֖ה בְּ/שֹׁמְרֽוֹן
verses.translit: vyqm mzbch lb'l byt hb'l 'shr bnh bshmrvn
verses.translation: And he reared up an altar for Baal in the house of Baal, which he had built in Samaria.

verses.original: וַ/יַּ֥עַשׂ אַחְאָ֖ב אֶת הָ/אֲשֵׁרָ֑ה וַ/יּ֨וֹסֶף אַחְאָ֜ב לַ/עֲשׂ֗וֹת לְ/הַכְעִיס֙ אֶת יְהֹוָה֙ אֱלֹהֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל מִ/כֹּ֨ל מַלְכֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל אֲשֶׁ֥ר הָי֖וּ לְ/פָנָֽי/ו
verses.translit: vy'sh 'ch'b 't h'shrh vyvsf 'ch'b l'shvt lhkh'ys 't yhvh 'lhy yshr'l mkhl mlkhy yshr'l 'shr hyv lpnyv
verses.translation: And Ahab made a grove; and Ahab did more to provoke the LORD God of Israel to anger than all the kings of Israel that were before him.

verses.original: בְּ/יָמָ֞י/ו בָּנָ֥ה חִיאֵ֛ל בֵּ֥ית הָאֱלִ֖י אֶת יְרִיחֹ֑ה בַּ/אֲבִירָ֨ם בְּכֹר֜/וֹ יִסְּדָ֗/הּ ו/ב/שגיב וּ/בִ/שְׂג֤וּב צְעִיר/וֹ֙ הִצִּ֣יב דְּלָתֶ֔י/הָ כִּ/דְבַ֣ר יְהוָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֣ר דִּבֶּ֔ר בְּ/יַ֖ד יְהוֹשֻׁ֥עַ בִּן נֽוּן
verses.translit: bymyv bnh chy'l byt h'ly 't yrychh b'byrm bkhrv ysdh vbshgyb vbshgvb ts'yrv htsyb dltyh khdbr yhvh 'shr dbr byd yhvsh' bn nvn
verses.translation: In his days did Hiel the Beth-elite build Jericho: he laid the foundation thereof in Abiram his firstborn, and set up the gates thereof in his youngest son Segub, according to the word of the LORD , which he spake by Joshua the son of Nun.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּאמֶר֩ אֵלִיָּ֨הוּ הַ/תִּשְׁבִּ֜י מִ/תֹּשָׁבֵ֣י גִלְעָד֮ אֶל אַחְאָב֒ חַי יְהוָ֞ה אֱלֹהֵ֤י יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר עָמַ֣דְתִּי לְ/פָנָ֔י/ו אִם יִהְיֶ֛ה הַ/שָּׁנִ֥ים הָ/אֵ֖לֶּה טַ֣ל וּ/מָטָ֑ר כִּ֖י אִם לְ/פִ֥י דְבָרִֽ/י
verses.translit: vy'mr 'lyhv htshby mtshby gl'd 'l 'ch'b chy yhvh 'lhy yshr'l 'shr 'mdty lpnyv 'm yhyh hshnym h'lh tl vmtr khy 'm lpy dbry
verses.translation: And Elijah the Tishbite, who was of the inhabitants of Gilead, said unto Ahab, As the LORD God of Israel liveth, before whom I stand, there shall not be dew nor rain these years, but according to my word.

verses.original: וַ/יְהִ֥י דְבַר יְהוָ֖ה אֵלָ֥י/ו לֵ/אמֹֽר
verses.translit: vyhy dbr yhvh 'lyv l'mr
verses.translation: And the word of the LORD came unto him, saying,

verses.original: לֵ֣ךְ מִ/זֶּ֔ה וּ/פָנִ֥יתָ לְּ/ךָ֖ קֵ֑דְמָ/ה וְ/נִסְתַּרְתָּ֙ בְּ/נַ֣חַל כְּרִ֔ית אֲשֶׁ֖ר עַל פְּנֵ֥י הַ/יַּרְדֵּֽן
verses.translit: lkh mzh vpnyt lkh qdmh vnstrt bnchl khryt 'shr 'l pny hyrdn
verses.translation: Get thee hence, and turn thee eastward, and hide thyself by the brook Cherith, that is before Jordan.

verses.original: וְ/הָיָ֖ה מֵ/הַ/נַּ֣חַל תִּשְׁתֶּ֑ה וְ/אֶת הָ/עֹרְבִ֣ים צִוִּ֔יתִי לְ/כַלְכֶּלְ/ךָ֖ שָֽׁם
verses.translit: vhyh mhnchl tshth v't h'rbym tsvyty lkhlkhlkh shm
verses.translation: And it shall be, that thou shalt drink of the brook; and I have commanded the ravens to feed thee there.

verses.original: וַ/יֵּ֥לֶךְ וַ/יַּ֖עַשׂ כִּ/דְבַ֣ר יְהוָ֑ה וַ/יֵּ֗לֶךְ וַ/יֵּ֨שֶׁב֙ בְּ/נַ֣חַל כְּרִ֔ית אֲשֶׁ֖ר עַל פְּנֵ֥י הַ/יַּרְדֵּֽן
verses.translit: vylkh vy'sh khdbr yhvh vylkh vyshb bnchl khryt 'shr 'l pny hyrdn
verses.translation: So he went and did according unto the word of the LORD : for he went and dwelt by the brook Cherith, that is before Jordan.

verses.original: וְ/הָ/עֹרְבִ֗ים מְבִיאִ֨ים ל֜/וֹ לֶ֤חֶם וּ/בָשָׂר֙ בַּ/בֹּ֔קֶר וְ/לֶ֥חֶם וּ/בָשָׂ֖ר בָּ/עָ֑רֶב וּ/מִן הַ/נַּ֖חַל יִשְׁתֶּֽה
verses.translit: vh'rbym mby'ym lv lchm vbshr bbqr vlchm vbshr b'rb vmn hnchl yshth
verses.translation: And the ravens brought him bread and flesh in the morning, and bread and flesh in the evening; and he drank of the brook.

verses.original: וַ/יְהִ֛י מִ/קֵּ֥ץ יָמִ֖ים וַ/יִּיבַ֣שׁ הַ/נָּ֑חַל כִּ֛י לֹֽא הָיָ֥ה גֶ֖שֶׁם בָּ/אָֽרֶץ
verses.translit: vyhy mqts ymym vyybsh hnchl khy l' hyh gshm b'rts
verses.translation: And it came to pass after a while, that the brook dried up, because there had been no rain in the land.

verses.original: וַ/יְהִ֥י דְבַר יְהוָ֖ה אֵלָ֥י/ו לֵ/אמֹֽר
verses.translit: vyhy dbr yhvh 'lyv l'mr
verses.translation: And the word of the LORD came unto him, saying,

verses.original: ק֣וּם לֵ֤ךְ צָרְפַ֨תָ/ה֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר לְ/צִיד֔וֹן וְ/יָשַׁבְתָּ֖ שָׁ֑ם הִנֵּ֨ה צִוִּ֥יתִי שָׁ֛ם אִשָּׁ֥ה אַלְמָנָ֖ה לְ/כַלְכְּלֶֽ/ךָ
verses.translit: qvm lkh tsrpth 'shr ltsydvn vyshbt shm hnh tsvyty shm 'shh 'lmnh lkhlkhlkh
verses.translation: Arise, get thee to Zarephath, which belongeth to Zidon, and dwell there: behold, I have commanded a widow woman there to sustain thee.

verses.original: וַ/יָּ֣קָם וַ/יֵּ֣לֶךְ צָרְפַ֗תָ/ה וַ/יָּבֹא֙ אֶל פֶּ֣תַח הָ/עִ֔יר וְ/הִנֵּֽה שָׁ֛ם אִשָּׁ֥ה אַלְמָנָ֖ה מְקֹשֶׁ֣שֶׁת עֵצִ֑ים וַ/יִּקְרָ֤א אֵלֶ֨י/הָ֙ וַ/יֹּאמַ֔ר קְחִי נָ֨א לִ֧/י מְעַט מַ֛יִם בַּ/כְּלִ֖י וְ/אֶשְׁתֶּֽה
verses.translit: vyqm vylkh tsrpth vyb' 'l ptch h'yr vhnh shm 'shh 'lmnh mqshsht 'tsym vyqr' 'lyh vy'mr qchy n' ly m't mym bkhly v'shth
verses.translation: So he arose and went to Zarephath. And when he came to the gate of the city, behold, the widow woman was there gathering of sticks: and he called to her, and said, Fetch me, I pray thee, a little water in a vessel, that I may drink.

verses.original: וַ/תֵּ֖לֶךְ לָ/קַ֑חַת וַ/יִּקְרָ֤א אֵלֶ֨י/הָ֙ וַ/יֹּאמַ֔ר לִֽקְחִי נָ֥א לִ֛/י פַּת לֶ֖חֶם בְּ/יָדֵֽ/ךְ
verses.translit: vtlkh lqcht vyqr' 'lyh vy'mr lqchy n' ly pt lchm bydkh
verses.translation: And as she was going to fetch it , he called to her, and said, Bring me, I pray thee, a morsel of bread in thine hand.

verses.original: וַ/תֹּ֗אמֶר חַי יְהוָ֤ה אֱלֹהֶ֨י/ךָ֙ אִם יֶשׁ לִ֣/י מָע֔וֹג כִּ֣י אִם מְלֹ֤א כַף קֶ֨מַח֙ בַּ/כַּ֔ד וּ/מְעַט שֶׁ֖מֶן בַּ/צַּפָּ֑חַת וְ/הִנְ/נִ֨י מְקֹשֶׁ֜שֶׁת שְׁנַ֣יִם עֵצִ֗ים וּ/בָ֨אתִי֙ וַ/עֲשִׂיתִ֨י/הוּ֙ לִ֣/י וְ/לִ/בְנִ֔/י וַ/אֲכַלְנֻ֖/הוּ וָ/מָֽתְנוּ
verses.translit: vt'mr chy yhvh 'lhykh 'm ysh ly m'vg khy 'm ml' khf qmch bkhd vm't shmn btspcht vhnny mqshsht shnym 'tsym vb'ty v'shytyhv ly vlbny v'khlnhv vmtnv
verses.translation: And she said, As the LORD thy God liveth, I have not a cake, but an handful of meal in a barrel, and a little oil in a cruse: and, behold, I am gathering two sticks, that I may go in and dress it for me and my son, that we may eat it, and die.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֨אמֶר אֵלֶ֤י/הָ אֵלִיָּ֨הוּ֙ אַל תִּ֣ירְאִ֔י בֹּ֖אִי עֲשִׂ֣י כִ/דְבָרֵ֑/ךְ אַ֣ךְ עֲשִׂי לִ֣/י מִ֠/שָּׁם עֻגָ֨ה קְטַנָּ֤ה בָ/רִאשֹׁנָה֙ וְ/הוֹצֵ֣אתְ לִ֔/י וְ/לָ֣/ךְ וְ/לִ/בְנֵ֔/ךְ תַּעֲשִׂ֖י בָּ/אַחֲרֹנָֽה
verses.translit: vy'mr 'lyh 'lyhv 'l tyr'y b'y 'shy khdbrkh 'kh 'shy ly mshm 'gh qtnh br'shnh vhvts't ly vlkh vlbnkh t'shy b'chrnh
verses.translation: And Elijah said unto her, Fear not; go and do as thou hast said: but make me thereof a little cake first, and bring it unto me, and after make for thee and for thy son.

verses.original: כִּ֣י כֹה֩ אָמַ֨ר יְהוָ֜ה אֱלֹהֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל כַּ֤ד הַ/קֶּ֨מַח֙ לֹ֣א תִכְלָ֔ה וְ/צַפַּ֥חַת הַ/שֶּׁ֖מֶן לֹ֣א תֶחְסָ֑ר עַ֠ד י֧וֹם תתן תֵּת יְהוָ֛ה גֶּ֖שֶׁם עַל פְּנֵ֥י הָ/אֲדָמָֽה
verses.translit: khy khh 'mr yhvh 'lhy yshr'l khd hqmch l' tkhlh vtspcht hshmn l' tchsr 'd yvm ttn tt yhvh gshm 'l pny h'dmh
verses.translation: For thus saith the LORD God of Israel, The barrel of meal shall not waste, neither shall the cruse of oil fail, until the day that the LORD sendeth rain upon the earth.

verses.original: וַ/תֵּ֥לֶךְ וַ/תַּעֲשֶׂ֖ה כִּ/דְבַ֣ר אֵלִיָּ֑הוּ וַ/תֹּ֧אכַל הוא ו/היא הִֽיא וָ/ה֛וּא וּ/בֵיתָ֖/הּ יָמִֽים
verses.translit: vtlkh vt'shh khdbr 'lyhv vt'khl hv' vhy' hy' vhv' vbyth ymym
verses.translation: And she went and did according to the saying of Elijah: and she, and he, and her house, did eat many days.

verses.original: כַּ֤ד הַ/קֶּ֨מַח֙ לֹ֣א כָלָ֔תָה וְ/צַפַּ֥חַת הַ/שֶּׁ֖מֶן לֹ֣א חָסֵ֑ר כִּ/דְבַ֣ר יְהוָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר דִּבֶּ֖ר בְּ/יַ֥ד אֵלִיָּֽהוּ
verses.translit: khd hqmch l' khlth vtspcht hshmn l' chsr khdbr yhvh 'shr dbr byd 'lyhv
verses.translation: And the barrel of meal wasted not, neither did the cruse of oil fail, according to the word of the LORD , which he spake by Elijah.

verses.original: וַ/יְהִ֗י אַחַר֙ הַ/דְּבָרִ֣ים הָ/אֵ֔לֶּה חָלָ֕ה בֶּן הָ/אִשָּׁ֖ה בַּעֲלַ֣ת הַ/בָּ֑יִת וַ/יְהִ֤י חָלְי/וֹ֙ חָזָ֣ק מְאֹ֔ד עַ֛ד אֲשֶׁ֥ר לֹא נֽוֹתְרָה בּ֖/וֹ נְשָׁמָֽה
verses.translit: vyhy 'chr hdbrym h'lh chlh bn h'shh b'lt hbyt vyhy chlyv chzq m'd 'd 'shr l' nvtrh bv nshmh
verses.translation: And it came to pass after these things, that the son of the woman, the mistress of the house, fell sick; and his sickness was so sore, that there was no breath left in him.

verses.original: וַ/תֹּ֨אמֶר֙ אֶל אֵ֣לִיָּ֔הוּ מַה לִּ֥/י וָ/לָ֖/ךְ אִ֣ישׁ הָ/אֱלֹהִ֑ים בָּ֧אתָ אֵלַ֛/י לְ/הַזְכִּ֥יר אֶת עֲוֺנִ֖/י וּ/לְ/הָמִ֥ית אֶת בְּנִֽ/י
verses.translit: vt'mr 'l 'lyhv mh ly vlkh 'ysh h'lhym b't 'ly lhzkhyr 't 'vny vlhmyt 't bny
verses.translation: And she said unto Elijah, What have I to do with thee, O thou man of God? art thou come unto me to call my sin to remembrance, and to slay my son?

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֥אמֶר אֵלֶ֖י/הָ תְּנִֽי לִ֣/י אֶת בְּנֵ֑/ךְ וַ/יִּקָּחֵ֣/הוּ מֵ/חֵיקָ֗/הּ וַֽ/יַּעֲלֵ֨/הוּ֙ אֶל הָ/עֲלִיָּ֗ה אֲשֶׁר הוּא֙ יֹשֵׁ֣ב שָׁ֔ם וַ/יַּשְׁכִּבֵ֖/הוּ עַל מִטָּתֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: vy'mr 'lyh tny ly 't bnkh vyqchhv mchyqh vy'lhv 'l h'lyh 'shr hv' yshb shm vyshkhbhv 'l mttv
verses.translation: And he said unto her, Give me thy son. And he took him out of her bosom, and carried him up into a loft, where he abode, and laid him upon his own bed.

verses.original: וַ/יִּקְרָ֥א אֶל יְהוָ֖ה וַ/יֹּאמַ֑ר יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהָ֔/י הֲ֠/גַם עַל הָ/אַלְמָנָ֞ה אֲשֶׁר אֲנִ֨י מִתְגּוֹרֵ֥ר עִמָּ֛/הּ הֲרֵע֖וֹתָ לְ/הָמִ֥ית אֶת בְּנָֽ/הּ
verses.translit: vyqr' 'l yhvh vy'mr yhvh 'lhy hgm 'l h'lmnh 'shr 'ny mtgvrr 'mh hr'vt lhmyt 't bnh
verses.translation: And he cried unto the LORD , and said, O LORD my God, hast thou also brought evil upon the widow with whom I sojourn, by slaying her son?

verses.original: וַ/יִּתְמֹדֵ֤ד עַל הַ/יֶּ֨לֶד֙ שָׁלֹ֣שׁ פְּעָמִ֔ים וַ/יִּקְרָ֥א אֶל יְהוָ֖ה וַ/יֹּאמַ֑ר יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהָ֔/י תָּ֥שָׁב נָ֛א נֶֽפֶשׁ הַ/יֶּ֥לֶד הַ/זֶּ֖ה עַל קִרְבּֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: vytmdd 'l hyld shlsh p'mym vyqr' 'l yhvh vy'mr yhvh 'lhy tshb n' npsh hyld hzh 'l qrbv
verses.translation: And he stretched himself upon the child three times, and cried unto the LORD , and said, O LORD my God, I pray thee, let this child’s soul come into him again.

verses.original: וַ/יִּשְׁמַ֥ע יְהוָ֖ה בְּ/ק֣וֹל אֵלִיָּ֑הוּ וַ/תָּ֧שָׁב נֶֽפֶשׁ הַ/יֶּ֛לֶד עַל קִרְבּ֖/וֹ וַ/יֶּֽחִי
verses.translit: vyshm' yhvh bqvl 'lyhv vtshb npsh hyld 'l qrbv vychy
verses.translation: And the LORD heard the voice of Elijah; and the soul of the child came into him again, and he revived.

verses.original: וַ/יִּקַּ֨ח אֵלִיָּ֜הוּ אֶת הַ/יֶּ֗לֶד וַ/יֹּרִדֵ֤/הוּ מִן הָ/עֲלִיָּה֙ הַ/בַּ֔יְתָ/ה וַֽ/יִּתְּנֵ֖/הוּ לְ/אִמּ֑/וֹ וַ/יֹּ֨אמֶר֙ אֵ֣לִיָּ֔הוּ רְאִ֖י חַ֥י בְּנֵֽ/ךְ
verses.translit: vyqch 'lyhv 't hyld vyrdhv mn h'lyh hbyth vytnhv l'mv vy'mr 'lyhv r'y chy bnkh
verses.translation: And Elijah took the child, and brought him down out of the chamber into the house, and delivered him unto his mother: and Elijah said, See, thy son liveth.

verses.original: וַ/תֹּ֤אמֶר הָֽ/אִשָּׁה֙ אֶל אֵ֣לִיָּ֔הוּ עַתָּה֙ זֶ֣ה יָדַ֔עְתִּי כִּ֛י אִ֥ישׁ אֱלֹהִ֖ים אָ֑תָּה וּ/דְבַר יְהוָ֥ה בְּ/פִ֖י/ךָ אֱמֶֽת
verses.translit: vt'mr h'shh 'l 'lyhv 'th zh yd'ty khy 'ysh 'lhym 'th vdbr yhvh bpykh 'mt
verses.translation: And the woman said to Elijah, Now by this I know that thou art a man of God, and that the word of the LORD in thy mouth is truth.

verses.original: וַ/יְהִי֙ יָמִ֣ים רַבִּ֔ים וּ/דְבַר יְהוָ֗ה הָיָה֙ אֶל אֵ֣לִיָּ֔הוּ בַּ/שָּׁנָ֥ה הַ/שְּׁלִישִׁ֖ית לֵ/אמֹ֑ר לֵ֚ךְ הֵרָאֵ֣ה אֶל אַחְאָ֔ב וְ/אֶתְּנָ֥ה מָטָ֖ר עַל פְּנֵ֥י הָ/אֲדָמָֽה
verses.translit: vyhy ymym rbym vdbr yhvh hyh 'l 'lyhv bshnh hshlyshyt l'mr lkh hr'h 'l 'ch'b v'tnh mtr 'l pny h'dmh
verses.translation: And it came to pass after many days, that the word of the LORD came to Elijah in the third year, saying, Go, shew thyself unto Ahab; and I will send rain upon the earth.

verses.original: וַ/יֵּ֨לֶךְ֙ אֵֽלִיָּ֔הוּ לְ/הֵרָא֖וֹת אֶל אַחְאָ֑ב וְ/הָ/רָעָ֖ב חָזָ֥ק בְּ/שֹׁמְרֽוֹן
verses.translit: vylkh 'lyhv lhr'vt 'l 'ch'b vhr'b chzq bshmrvn
verses.translation: And Elijah went to shew himself unto Ahab. And there was a sore famine in Samaria.

verses.original: וַ/יִּקְרָ֣א אַחְאָ֔ב אֶל עֹבַדְיָ֖הוּ אֲשֶׁ֣ר עַל הַ/בָּ֑יִת וְ/עֹבַדְיָ֗הוּ הָיָ֥ה יָרֵ֛א אֶת יְהוָ֖ה מְאֹֽד
verses.translit: vyqr' 'ch'b 'l 'bdyhv 'shr 'l hbyt v'bdyhv hyh yr' 't yhvh m'd
verses.translation: And Ahab called Obadiah, which was the governor of his house. (Now Obadiah feared the LORD greatly:

verses.original: וַ/יְהִי֙ בְּ/הַכְרִ֣ית אִיזֶ֔בֶל אֵ֖ת נְבִיאֵ֣י יְהוָ֑ה וַ/יִּקַּ֨ח עֹבַדְיָ֜הוּ מֵאָ֣ה נְבִאִ֗ים וַֽ/יַּחְבִּיאֵ֞/ם חֲמִשִּׁ֥ים אִישׁ֙ בַּ/מְּעָרָ֔ה וְ/כִלְכְּלָ֖/ם לֶ֥חֶם וָ/מָֽיִם
verses.translit: vyhy bhkhryt 'yzbl 't nby'y yhvh vyqch 'bdyhv m'h nb'ym vychby'm chmshym 'ysh bm'rh vkhlkhlm lchm vmym
verses.translation: For it was so , when Jezebel cut off the prophets of the LORD , that Obadiah took an hundred prophets, and hid them by fifty in a cave, and fed them with bread and water.)

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֤אמֶר אַחְאָב֙ אֶל עֹ֣בַדְיָ֔הוּ לֵ֤ךְ בָּ/אָ֨רֶץ֙ אֶל כָּל מַעְיְנֵ֣י הַ/מַּ֔יִם וְ/אֶ֖ל כָּל הַ/נְּחָלִ֑ים אוּלַ֣י נִמְצָ֣א חָצִ֗יר וּ/נְחַיֶּה֙ ס֣וּס וָ/פֶ֔רֶד וְ/ל֥וֹא נַכְרִ֖ית מֵ/הַ/בְּהֵמָֽה
verses.translit: vy'mr 'ch'b 'l 'bdyhv lkh b'rts 'l khl m'yny hmym v'l khl hnchlym 'vly nmts' chtsyr vnchyh svs vprd vlv' nkhryt mhbhmh
verses.translation: And Ahab said unto Obadiah, Go into the land, unto all fountains of water, and unto all brooks: peradventure we may find grass to save the horses and mules alive, that we lose not all the beasts.

verses.original: וַֽ/יְחַלְּק֥וּ לָ/הֶ֛ם אֶת הָ/אָ֖רֶץ לַֽ/עֲבָר בָּ֑/הּ אַחְאָ֞ב הָלַ֨ךְ בְּ/דֶ֤רֶךְ אֶחָד֙ לְ/בַדּ֔/וֹ וְ/עֹֽבַדְיָ֛הוּ הָלַ֥ךְ בְּ/דֶרֶךְ אֶחָ֖ד לְ/בַדּֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: vychlqv lhm 't h'rts l'br bh 'ch'b hlkh bdrkh 'chd lbdv v'bdyhv hlkh bdrkh 'chd lbdv
verses.translation: So they divided the land between them to pass throughout it: Ahab went one way by himself, and Obadiah went another way by himself.

verses.original: וַ/יְהִ֤י עֹבַדְיָ֨הוּ֙ בַּ/דֶּ֔רֶךְ וְ/הִנֵּ֥ה אֵלִיָּ֖הוּ לִ/קְרָאת֑/וֹ וַ/יַּכִּרֵ֨/הוּ֙ וַ/יִּפֹּ֣ל עַל פָּנָ֔י/ו וַ/יֹּ֕אמֶר הַ/אַתָּ֥ה זֶ֖ה אֲדֹנִ֥/י אֵלִיָּֽהוּ
verses.translit: vyhy 'bdyhv bdrkh vhnh 'lyhv lqr'tv vykhrhv vypl 'l pnyv vy'mr h'th zh 'dny 'lyhv
verses.translation: And as Obadiah was in the way, behold, Elijah met him: and he knew him, and fell on his face, and said, Art thou that my lord Elijah?

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֥אמֶר ל֖/וֹ אָ֑נִי לֵ֛ךְ אֱמֹ֥ר לַ/אדֹנֶ֖י/ךָ הִנֵּ֥ה אֵלִיָּֽהוּ
verses.translit: vy'mr lv 'ny lkh 'mr l'dnykh hnh 'lyhv
verses.translation: And he answered him, I am: go, tell thy lord, Behold, Elijah is here .

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֖אמֶר מֶ֣ה חָטָ֑אתִי כִּֽי אַתָּ֞ה נֹתֵ֧ן אֶֽת עַבְדְּ/ךָ֛ בְּ/יַד אַחְאָ֖ב לַ/הֲמִיתֵֽ/נִי
verses.translit: vy'mr mh cht'ty khy 'th ntn 't 'bdkh byd 'ch'b lhmytny
verses.translation: And he said, What have I sinned, that thou wouldest deliver thy servant into the hand of Ahab, to slay me?

verses.original: חַ֣י יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶ֗י/ךָ אִם יֶשׁ גּ֤וֹי וּ/מַמְלָכָה֙ אֲ֠שֶׁר לֹֽא שָׁלַ֨ח אֲדֹנִ֥/י שָׁם֙ לְ/בַקֶּשְׁ/ךָ֔ וְ/אָמְר֖וּ אָ֑יִן וְ/הִשְׁבִּ֤יעַ אֶת הַ/מַּמְלָכָה֙ וְ/אֶת הַ/גּ֔וֹי כִּ֖י לֹ֥א יִמְצָאֶֽ/כָּה
verses.translit: chy yhvh 'lhykh 'm ysh gvy vmmlkhh 'shr l' shlch 'dny shm lbqshkh v'mrv 'yn vhshby' 't hmmlkhh v't hgvy khy l' ymts'khh
verses.translation: As the LORD thy God liveth, there is no nation or kingdom, whither my lord hath not sent to seek thee: and when they said, He is not there; he took an oath of the kingdom and nation, that they found thee not.

verses.original: וְ/עַתָּ֖ה אַתָּ֣ה אֹמֵ֑ר לֵ֛ךְ אֱמֹ֥ר לַ/אדֹנֶ֖י/ךָ הִנֵּ֥ה אֵלִיָּֽהוּ
verses.translit: v'th 'th 'mr lkh 'mr l'dnykh hnh 'lyhv
verses.translation: And now thou sayest, Go, tell thy lord, Behold, Elijah is here .

verses.original: וְ/הָיָ֞ה אֲנִ֣י אֵלֵ֣ךְ מֵ/אִתָּ֗/ךְ וְ/ר֨וּחַ יְהוָ֤ה יִֽשָּׂאֲ/ךָ֙ עַ֚ל אֲשֶׁ֣ר לֹֽא אֵדָ֔ע וּ/בָ֨אתִי לְ/הַגִּ֧יד לְ/אַחְאָ֛ב וְ/לֹ֥א יִֽמְצָאֲ/ךָ֖ וַ/הֲרָגָ֑/נִי וְ/עַבְדְּ/ךָ֛ יָרֵ֥א אֶת יְהוָ֖ה מִ/נְּעֻרָֽ/י
verses.translit: vhyh 'ny 'lkh m'tkh vrvch yhvh ysh'kh 'l 'shr l' 'd' vb'ty lhgyd l'ch'b vl' ymts'kh vhrgny v'bdkh yr' 't yhvh mn'ry
verses.translation: And it shall come to pass, as soon as I am gone from thee, that the Spirit of the LORD shall carry thee whither I know not; and so when I come and tell Ahab, and he cannot find thee, he shall slay me: but I thy servant fear the LORD from my youth.

verses.original: הֲ/לֹֽא הֻגַּ֤ד לַֽ/אדֹנִ/י֙ אֵ֣ת אֲשֶׁר עָשִׂ֔יתִי בַּ/הֲרֹ֣ג אִיזֶ֔בֶל אֵ֖ת נְבִיאֵ֣י יְהוָ֑ה וָ/אַחְבִּא֩ מִ/נְּבִיאֵ֨י יְהוָ֜ה מֵ֣אָה אִ֗ישׁ חֲמִשִּׁ֨ים חֲמִשִּׁ֥ים אִישׁ֙ בַּ/מְּעָרָ֔ה וָ/אֲכַלְכְּלֵ֖/ם לֶ֥חֶם וָ/מָֽיִם
verses.translit: hl' hgd l'dny 't 'shr 'shyty bhrg 'yzbl 't nby'y yhvh v'chb' mnby'y yhvh m'h 'ysh chmshym chmshym 'ysh bm'rh v'khlkhlm lchm vmym
verses.translation: Was it not told my lord what I did when Jezebel slew the prophets of the LORD , how I hid an hundred men of the LORD’s prophets by fifty in a cave, and fed them with bread and water?

verses.original: וְ/עַתָּה֙ אַתָּ֣ה אֹמֵ֔ר לֵ֛ךְ אֱמֹ֥ר לַֽ/אדֹנֶ֖י/ךָ הִנֵּ֣ה אֵלִיָּ֑הוּ וַ/הֲרָגָֽ/נִי
verses.translit: v'th 'th 'mr lkh 'mr l'dnykh hnh 'lyhv vhrgny
verses.translation: And now thou sayest, Go, tell thy lord, Behold, Elijah is here: and he shall slay me.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֨אמֶר֙ אֵֽלִיָּ֔הוּ חַ֚י יְהוָ֣ה צְבָא֔וֹת אֲשֶׁ֥ר עָמַ֖דְתִּי לְ/פָנָ֑י/ו כִּ֥י הַ/יּ֖וֹם אֵרָאֶ֥ה אֵלָֽי/ו
verses.translit: vy'mr 'lyhv chy yhvh tsb'vt 'shr 'mdty lpnyv khy hyvm 'r'h 'lyv
verses.translation: And Elijah said, As the LORD of hosts liveth, before whom I stand, I will surely shew myself unto him to day.

verses.original: וַ/יֵּ֧לֶךְ עֹבַדְיָ֛הוּ לִ/קְרַ֥את אַחְאָ֖ב וַ/יַּגֶּד ל֑/וֹ וַ/יֵּ֥לֶךְ אַחְאָ֖ב לִ/קְרַ֥את אֵלִיָּֽהוּ
verses.translit: vylkh 'bdyhv lqr't 'ch'b vygd lv vylkh 'ch'b lqr't 'lyhv
verses.translation: So Obadiah went to meet Ahab, and told him: and Ahab went to meet Elijah.

verses.original: וַ/יְהִ֛י כִּ/רְא֥וֹת אַחְאָ֖ב אֶת אֵלִיָּ֑הוּ וַ/יֹּ֤אמֶר אַחְאָב֙ אֵלָ֔י/ו הַ/אַתָּ֥ה זֶ֖ה עֹכֵ֥ר יִשְׂרָאֵֽל
verses.translit: vyhy khr'vt 'ch'b 't 'lyhv vy'mr 'ch'b 'lyv h'th zh 'khr yshr'l
verses.translation: And it came to pass, when Ahab saw Elijah, that Ahab said unto him, Art thou he that troubleth Israel?

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֗אמֶר לֹ֤א עָכַ֨רְתִּי֙ אֶת יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל כִּ֥י אִם אַתָּ֖ה וּ/בֵ֣ית אָבִ֑י/ךָ בַּֽ/עֲזָבְ/כֶם֙ אֶת מִצְוֺ֣ת יְהוָ֔ה וַ/תֵּ֖לֶךְ אַחֲרֵ֥י הַ/בְּעָלִֽים
verses.translit: vy'mr l' 'khrty 't yshr'l khy 'm 'th vbyt 'bykh b'zbkhm 't mtsvt yhvh vtlkh 'chry hb'lym
verses.translation: And he answered, I have not troubled Israel; but thou, and thy father’s house, in that ye have forsaken the commandments of the LORD , and thou hast followed Baalim.

verses.original: וְ/עַתָּ֗ה שְׁלַ֨ח קְבֹ֥ץ אֵלַ֛/י אֶת כָּל יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל אֶל הַ֣ר הַ/כַּרְמֶ֑ל וְ/אֶת נְבִיאֵ֨י הַ/בַּ֜עַל אַרְבַּ֧ע מֵא֣וֹת וַ/חֲמִשִּׁ֗ים וּ/נְבִיאֵ֤י הָֽ/אֲשֵׁרָה֙ אַרְבַּ֣ע מֵא֔וֹת אֹכְלֵ֖י שֻׁלְחַ֥ן אִיזָֽבֶל
verses.translit: v'th shlch qbts 'ly 't khl yshr'l 'l hr hkhrml v't nby'y hb'l 'rb' m'vt vchmshym vnby'y h'shrh 'rb' m'vt 'khly shlchn 'yzbl
verses.translation: Now therefore send, and gather to me all Israel unto mount Carmel, and the prophets of Baal four hundred and fifty, and the prophets of the groves four hundred, which eat at Jezebel’s table.

verses.original: וַ/יִּשְׁלַ֥ח אַחְאָ֖ב בְּ/כָל בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וַ/יִּקְבֹּ֥ץ אֶת הַ/נְּבִיאִ֖ים אֶל הַ֥ר הַ/כַּרְמֶֽל
verses.translit: vyshlch 'ch'b bkhl bny yshr'l vyqbts 't hnby'ym 'l hr hkhrml
verses.translation: So Ahab sent unto all the children of Israel, and gathered the prophets together unto mount Carmel.

verses.original: וַ/יִּגַּ֨שׁ אֵלִיָּ֜הוּ אֶל כָּל הָ/עָ֗ם וַ/יֹּ֨אמֶר֙ עַד מָתַ֞י אַתֶּ֣ם פֹּסְחִים֮ עַל שְׁתֵּ֣י הַ/סְּעִפִּים֒ אִם יְהוָ֤ה הָֽ/אֱלֹהִים֙ לְכ֣וּ אַחֲרָ֔י/ו וְ/אִם הַ/בַּ֖עַל לְכ֣וּ אַחֲרָ֑י/ו וְ/לֹֽא עָנ֥וּ הָ/עָ֛ם אֹת֖/וֹ דָּבָֽר
verses.translit: vygsh 'lyhv 'l khl h'm vy'mr 'd mty 'tm pschym 'l shty hs'pym 'm yhvh h'lhym lkhv 'chryv v'm hb'l lkhv 'chryv vl' 'nv h'm 'tv dbr
verses.translation: And Elijah came unto all the people, and said, How long halt ye between two opinions? if the LORD be God, follow him: but if Baal, then follow him. And the people answered him not a word.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֤אמֶר אֵלִיָּ֨הוּ֙ אֶל הָ/עָ֔ם אֲנִ֞י נוֹתַ֧רְתִּי נָבִ֛יא לַ/יהוָ֖ה לְ/בַדִּ֑/י וּ/נְבִיאֵ֣י הַ/בַּ֔עַל אַרְבַּע מֵא֥וֹת וַ/חֲמִשִּׁ֖ים אִֽישׁ
verses.translit: vy'mr 'lyhv 'l h'm 'ny nvtrty nby' lyhvh lbdy vnby'y hb'l 'rb' m'vt vchmshym 'ysh
verses.translation: Then said Elijah unto the people, I, even I only, remain a prophet of the LORD ; but Baal’s prophets are four hundred and fifty men.

verses.original: וְ/יִתְּנוּ לָ֜/נוּ שְׁנַ֣יִם פָּרִ֗ים וְ/יִבְחֲר֣וּ לָ/הֶם֩ הַ/פָּ֨ר הָ/אֶחָ֜ד וִֽ/ינַתְּחֻ֗/הוּ וְ/יָשִׂ֨ימוּ֙ עַל הָ֣/עֵצִ֔ים וְ/אֵ֖שׁ לֹ֣א יָשִׂ֑ימוּ וַ/אֲנִ֞י אֶעֱשֶׂ֣ה אֶת הַ/פָּ֣ר הָ/אֶחָ֗ד וְ/נָֽתַתִּי֙ עַל הָ֣/עֵצִ֔ים וְ/אֵ֖שׁ לֹ֥א אָשִֽׂים
verses.translit: vytnv lnv shnym prym vybchrv lhm hpr h'chd vyntchhv vyshymv 'l h'tsym v'sh l' yshymv v'ny ''shh 't hpr h'chd vntty 'l h'tsym v'sh l' 'shym
verses.translation: Let them therefore give us two bullocks; and let them choose one bullock for themselves, and cut it in pieces, and lay it on wood, and put no fire under: and I will dress the other bullock, and lay it on wood, and put no fire under:

verses.original: וּ/קְרָאתֶ֞ם בְּ/שֵׁ֣ם אֱלֹֽהֵי/כֶ֗ם וַֽ/אֲנִי֙ אֶקְרָ֣א בְ/שֵׁם יְהוָ֔ה וְ/הָיָ֧ה הָ/אֱלֹהִ֛ים אֲשֶׁר יַעֲנֶ֥ה בָ/אֵ֖שׁ ה֣וּא הָ/אֱלֹהִ֑ים וַ/יַּ֧עַן כָּל הָ/עָ֛ם וַ/יֹּאמְר֖וּ ט֥וֹב הַ/דָּבָֽר
verses.translit: vqr'tm bshm 'lhykhm v'ny 'qr' bshm yhvh vhyh h'lhym 'shr y'nh b'sh hv' h'lhym vy'n khl h'm vy'mrv tvb hdbr
verses.translation: And call ye on the name of your gods, and I will call on the name of the LORD : and the God that answereth by fire, let him be God. And all the people answered and said, It is well spoken.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֨אמֶר אֵלִיָּ֜הוּ לִ/נְבִיאֵ֣י הַ/בַּ֗עַל בַּחֲר֨וּ לָ/כֶ֜ם הַ/פָּ֤ר הָֽ/אֶחָד֙ וַ/עֲשׂ֣וּ רִאשֹׁנָ֔ה כִּ֥י אַתֶּ֖ם הָ/רַבִּ֑ים וְ/קִרְאוּ֙ בְּ/שֵׁ֣ם אֱלֹהֵי/כֶ֔ם וְ/אֵ֖שׁ לֹ֥א תָשִֽׂימוּ
verses.translit: vy'mr 'lyhv lnby'y hb'l bchrv lkhm hpr h'chd v'shv r'shnh khy 'tm hrbym vqr'v bshm 'lhykhm v'sh l' tshymv
verses.translation: And Elijah said unto the prophets of Baal, Choose you one bullock for yourselves, and dress it first; for ye are many; and call on the name of your gods, but put no fire under .

verses.original: וַ֠/יִּקְחוּ אֶת הַ/פָּ֨ר אֲשֶׁר נָתַ֣ן לָ/הֶם֮ וַֽ/יַּעֲשׂוּ֒ וַ/יִּקְרְא֣וּ בְ/שֵׁם הַ֠/בַּעַל מֵ/הַ/בֹּ֨קֶר וְ/עַד הַ/צָּהֳרַ֤יִם לֵ/אמֹר֙ הַ/בַּ֣עַל עֲנֵ֔/נוּ וְ/אֵ֥ין ק֖וֹל וְ/אֵ֣ין עֹנֶ֑ה וַֽ/יְפַסְּח֔וּ עַל הַ/מִּזְבֵּ֖חַ אֲשֶׁ֥ר עָשָֽׂה
verses.translit: vyqchv 't hpr 'shr ntn lhm vy'shv vyqr'v bshm hb'l mhbqr v'd htshrym l'mr hb'l 'nnv v'yn qvl v'yn 'nh vypschv 'l hmzbch 'shr 'shh
verses.translation: And they took the bullock which was given them, and they dressed it , and called on the name of Baal from morning even until noon, saying, O Baal, hear us. But there was no voice, nor any that answered. And they leaped upon the altar which was made.

verses.original: וַ/יְהִ֨י בַֽ/צָּהֳרַ֜יִם וַ/יְהַתֵּ֧ל בָּ/הֶ֣ם אֵלִיָּ֗הוּ וַ/יֹּ֨אמֶר֙ קִרְא֤וּ בְ/קוֹל גָּדוֹל֙ כִּֽי אֱלֹהִ֣ים ה֔וּא כִּ֣י שִׂ֧יחַ וְ/כִֽי שִׂ֛יג ל֖/וֹ וְ/כִֽי דֶ֣רֶךְ ל֑/וֹ אוּלַ֛י יָשֵׁ֥ן ה֖וּא וְ/יִקָֽץ
verses.translit: vyhy btshrym vyhtl bhm 'lyhv vy'mr qr'v bqvl gdvl khy 'lhym hv' khy shych vkhy shyg lv vkhy drkh lv 'vly yshn hv' vyqts
verses.translation: And it came to pass at noon, that Elijah mocked them, and said, Cry aloud: for he is a god; either he is talking, or he is pursuing, or he is in a journey, or peradventure he sleepeth, and must be awaked.

verses.original: וַֽ/יִּקְרְאוּ֙ בְּ/ק֣וֹל גָּד֔וֹל וַ/יִּתְגֹּֽדְדוּ֙ כְּ/מִשְׁפָּטָ֔/ם בַּ/חֲרָב֖וֹת וּ/בָֽ/רְמָחִ֑ים עַד שְׁפָךְ דָּ֖ם עֲלֵי/הֶֽם
verses.translit: vyqr'v bqvl gdvl vytgddv khmshptm bchrbvt vbrmchym 'd shpkh dm 'lyhm
verses.translation: And they cried aloud, and cut themselves after their manner with knives and lancets, till the blood gushed out upon them.

verses.original: וַֽ/יְהִי֙ כַּ/עֲבֹ֣ר הַֽ/צָּהֳרַ֔יִם וַ/יִּֽתְנַבְּא֔וּ עַ֖ד לַ/עֲל֣וֹת הַ/מִּנְחָ֑ה וְ/אֵֽין ק֥וֹל וְ/אֵין עֹנֶ֖ה וְ/אֵ֥ין קָֽשֶׁב
verses.translit: vyhy kh'br htshrym vytnb'v 'd l'lvt hmnchh v'yn qvl v'yn 'nh v'yn qshb
verses.translation: And it came to pass, when midday was past, and they prophesied until the time of the offering of the evening sacrifice, that there was neither voice, nor any to answer, nor any that regarded.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֨אמֶר אֵלִיָּ֤הוּ לְ/כָל הָ/עָם֙ גְּשׁ֣וּ אֵלַ֔/י וַ/יִּגְּשׁ֥וּ כָל הָ/עָ֖ם אֵלָ֑י/ו וַ/יְרַפֵּ֛א אֶת מִזְבַּ֥ח יְהוָ֖ה הֶ/הָרֽוּס
verses.translit: vy'mr 'lyhv lkhl h'm gshv 'ly vygshv khl h'm 'lyv vyrp' 't mzbch yhvh hhrvs
verses.translation: And Elijah said unto all the people, Come near unto me. And all the people came near unto him. And he repaired the altar of the LORD that was broken down.

verses.original: וַ/יִּקַּ֣ח אֵלִיָּ֗הוּ שְׁתֵּ֤ים עֶשְׂרֵה֙ אֲבָנִ֔ים כְּ/מִסְפַּ֖ר שִׁבְטֵ֣י בְנֵֽי יַעֲקֹ֑ב אֲשֶׁר֩ הָיָ֨ה דְבַר יְהוָ֤ה אֵלָי/ו֙ לֵ/אמֹ֔ר יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל יִהְיֶ֥ה שְׁמֶֽ/ךָ
verses.translit: vyqch 'lyhv shtym 'shrh 'bnym khmspr shbty bny y'qb 'shr hyh dbr yhvh 'lyv l'mr yshr'l yhyh shmkh
verses.translation: And Elijah took twelve stones, according to the number of the tribes of the sons of Jacob, unto whom the word of the LORD came, saying, Israel shall be thy name:

verses.original: וַ/יִּבְנֶ֧ה אֶת הָ/אֲבָנִ֛ים מִזְבֵּ֖חַ בְּ/שֵׁ֣ם יְהוָ֑ה וַ/יַּ֣עַשׂ תְּעָלָ֗ה כְּ/בֵית֙ סָאתַ֣יִם זֶ֔רַע סָבִ֖יב לַ/מִּזְבֵּֽחַ
verses.translit: vybnh 't h'bnym mzbch bshm yhvh vy'sh t'lh khbyt s'tym zr' sbyb lmzbch
verses.translation: And with the stones he built an altar in the name of the LORD : and he made a trench about the altar, as great as would contain two measures of seed.

verses.original: וַֽ/יַּעֲרֹ֖ךְ אֶת הָֽ/עֵצִ֑ים וַ/יְנַתַּח֙ אֶת הַ/פָּ֔ר וַ/יָּ֖שֶׂם עַל הָ/עֵצִֽים
verses.translit: vy'rkh 't h'tsym vyntch 't hpr vyshm 'l h'tsym
verses.translation: And he put the wood in order, and cut the bullock in pieces, and laid him on the wood, and said, Fill four barrels with water, and pour it on the burnt sacrifice, and on the wood.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֗אמֶר מִלְא֨וּ אַרְבָּעָ֤ה כַדִּים֙ מַ֔יִם וְ/יִֽצְק֥וּ עַל הָ/עֹלָ֖ה וְ/עַל הָ/עֵצִ֑ים וַ/יֹּ֤אמֶר שְׁנוּ֙ וַ/יִּשְׁנ֔וּ וַ/יֹּ֥אמֶר שַׁלֵּ֖שׁוּ וַ/יְשַׁלֵּֽשׁוּ
verses.translit: vy'mr ml'v 'rb'h khdym mym vytsqv 'l h'lh v'l h'tsym vy'mr shnv vyshnv vy'mr shlshv vyshlshv
verses.translation: And he said, Do it the second time. And they did it the second time. And he said, Do it the third time. And they did it the third time.

verses.original: וַ/יֵּלְכ֣וּ הַ/מַּ֔יִם סָבִ֖יב לַ/מִּזְבֵּ֑חַ וְ/גַ֥ם אֶת הַ/תְּעָלָ֖ה מִלֵּא מָֽיִם
verses.translit: vylkhv hmym sbyb lmzbch vgm 't ht'lh ml' mym
verses.translation: And the water ran round about the altar; and he filled the trench also with water.

verses.original: וַ/יְהִ֣י בַּ/עֲל֣וֹת הַ/מִּנְחָ֗ה וַ/יִּגַּ֞שׁ אֵלִיָּ֣הוּ הַ/נָּבִיא֮ וַ/יֹּאמַר֒ יְהוָ֗ה אֱלֹהֵי֙ אַבְרָהָם֙ יִצְחָ֣ק וְ/יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל הַ/יּ֣וֹם יִוָּדַ֗ע כִּֽי אַתָּ֧ה אֱלֹהִ֛ים בְּ/יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל וַ/אֲנִ֣י עַבְדֶּ֑/ךָ ו/ב/דברי/ך וּ/בִ/דְבָרְ/ךָ֣ עָשִׂ֔יתִי אֵ֥ת כָּל הַ/דְּבָרִ֖ים הָ/אֵֽלֶּה
verses.translit: vyhy b'lvt hmnchh vygsh 'lyhv hnby' vy'mr yhvh 'lhy 'brhm ytschq vyshr'l hyvm yvd' khy 'th 'lhym byshr'l v'ny 'bdkh vbdbrykh vbdbrkh 'shyty 't khl hdbrym h'lh
verses.translation: And it came to pass at the time of the offering of the evening sacrifice, that Elijah the prophet came near, and said, LORD God of Abraham, Isaac, and of Israel, let it be known this day that thou art God in Israel, and that I am thy servant, and that I have done all these things at thy word.

verses.original: עֲנֵ֤/נִי יְהוָה֙ עֲנֵ֔/נִי וְ/יֵֽדְעוּ֙ הָ/עָ֣ם הַ/זֶּ֔ה כִּֽי אַתָּ֥ה יְהוָ֖ה הָ/אֱלֹהִ֑ים וְ/אַתָּ֛ה הֲסִבֹּ֥תָ אֶת לִבָּ֖/ם אֲחֹרַנִּֽית
verses.translit: 'nny yhvh 'nny vyd'v h'm hzh khy 'th yhvh h'lhym v'th hsbt 't lbm 'chrnyt
verses.translation: Hear me, O LORD , hear me, that this people may know that thou art the LORD God, and that thou hast turned their heart back again.

verses.original: וַ/תִּפֹּ֣ל אֵשׁ יְהוָ֗ה וַ/תֹּ֤אכַל אֶת הָֽ/עֹלָה֙ וְ/אֶת הָ֣/עֵצִ֔ים וְ/אֶת הָ/אֲבָנִ֖ים וְ/אֶת הֶ/עָפָ֑ר וְ/אֶת הַ/מַּ֥יִם אֲשֶׁר בַּ/תְּעָלָ֖ה לִחֵֽכָה
verses.translit: vtpl 'sh yhvh vt'khl 't h'lh v't h'tsym v't h'bnym v't h'pr v't hmym 'shr bt'lh lchkhh
verses.translation: Then the fire of the LORD fell, and consumed the burnt sacrifice, and the wood, and the stones, and the dust, and licked up the water that was in the trench.

verses.original: וַ/יַּרְא֙ כָּל הָ/עָ֔ם וַֽ/יִּפְּל֖וּ עַל פְּנֵי/הֶ֑ם וַ/יֹּ֣אמְר֔וּ יְהוָה֙ ה֣וּא הָ/אֱלֹהִ֔ים יְהוָ֖ה ה֥וּא הָ/אֱלֹהִֽים
verses.translit: vyr' khl h'm vyplv 'l pnyhm vy'mrv yhvh hv' h'lhym yhvh hv' h'lhym
verses.translation: And when all the people saw it , they fell on their faces: and they said, The LORD , he is the God; the LORD , he is the God.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּאמֶר֩ אֵלִיָּ֨הוּ לָ/הֶ֜ם תִּפְשׂ֣וּ אֶת נְבִיאֵ֣י הַ/בַּ֗עַל אִ֛ישׁ אַל יִמָּלֵ֥ט מֵ/הֶ֖ם וַֽ/יִּתְפְּשׂ֑וּ/ם וַ/יּוֹרִדֵ֤/ם אֵלִיָּ֨הוּ֙ אֶל נַ֣חַל קִישׁ֔וֹן וַ/יִּשְׁחָטֵ֖/ם שָֽׁם
verses.translit: vy'mr 'lyhv lhm tpshv 't nby'y hb'l 'ysh 'l ymlt mhm vytpshvm vyvrdm 'lyhv 'l nchl qyshvn vyshchtm shm
verses.translation: And Elijah said unto them, Take the prophets of Baal; let not one of them escape. And they took them: and Elijah brought them down to the brook Kishon, and slew them there.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֤אמֶר אֵלִיָּ֨הוּ֙ לְ/אַחְאָ֔ב עֲלֵ֖ה אֱכֹ֣ל וּ/שְׁתֵ֑ה כִּי ק֖וֹל הֲמ֥וֹן הַ/גָּֽשֶׁם
verses.translit: vy'mr 'lyhv l'ch'b 'lh 'khl vshth khy qvl hmvn hgshm
verses.translation: And Elijah said unto Ahab, Get thee up, eat and drink; for there is a sound of abundance of rain.

verses.original: וַ/יַּעֲלֶ֥ה אַחְאָ֖ב לֶ/אֱכֹ֣ל וְ/לִ/שְׁתּ֑וֹת וְ/אֵ֨לִיָּ֜הוּ עָלָ֨ה אֶל רֹ֤אשׁ הַ/כַּרְמֶל֙ וַ/יִּגְהַ֣ר אַ֔רְצָ/ה וַ/יָּ֥שֶׂם פָּנָ֖י/ו בֵּ֥ין ברכ/ו בִּרְכָּֽי/ו
verses.translit: vy'lh 'ch'b l'khl vlshtvt v'lyhv 'lh 'l r'sh hkhrml vyghr 'rtsh vyshm pnyv byn brkhv brkhyv
verses.translation: So Ahab went up to eat and to drink. And Elijah went up to the top of Carmel; and he cast himself down upon the earth, and put his face between his knees,

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֣אמֶר אֶֽל נַעֲר֗/וֹ עֲלֵֽה נָא֙ הַבֵּ֣ט דֶּֽרֶךְ יָ֔ם וַ/יַּ֨עַל֙ וַ/יַּבֵּ֔ט וַ/יֹּ֖אמֶר אֵ֣ין מְא֑וּמָה וַ/יֹּ֕אמֶר שֻׁ֖ב שֶׁ֥בַע פְּעָמִֽים
verses.translit: vy'mr 'l n'rv 'lh n' hbt drkh ym vy'l vybt vy'mr 'yn m'vmh vy'mr shb shb' p'mym
verses.translation: And said to his servant, Go up now, look toward the sea. And he went up, and looked, and said, There is nothing. And he said, Go again seven times.

verses.original: וַֽ/יְהִי֙ בַּ/שְּׁבִעִ֔ית וַ/יֹּ֗אמֶר הִנֵּה עָ֛ב קְטַנָּ֥ה כְּ/כַף אִ֖ישׁ עֹלָ֣ה מִ/יָּ֑ם וַ/יֹּ֗אמֶר עֲלֵ֨ה אֱמֹ֤ר אֶל אַחְאָב֙ אֱסֹ֣ר וָ/רֵ֔ד וְ/לֹ֥א יַעַצָרְ/כָ֖ה הַ/גָּֽשֶׁם
verses.translit: vyhy bshb'yt vy'mr hnh 'b qtnh khkhf 'ysh 'lh mym vy'mr 'lh 'mr 'l 'ch'b 'sr vrd vl' y'tsrkhh hgshm
verses.translation: And it came to pass at the seventh time, that he said, Behold, there ariseth a little cloud out of the sea, like a man’s hand. And he said, Go up, say unto Ahab, Prepare thy chariot , and get thee down, that the rain stop thee not.

verses.original: וַ/יְהִ֣י עַד כֹּ֣ה וְ/עַד כֹּ֗ה וְ/הַ/שָּׁמַ֨יִם֙ הִֽתְקַדְּרוּ֙ עָבִ֣ים וְ/ר֔וּחַ וַ/יְהִ֖י גֶּ֣שֶׁם גָּד֑וֹל וַ/יִּרְכַּ֥ב אַחְאָ֖ב וַ/יֵּ֥לֶךְ יִזְרְעֶֽאלָ/ה
verses.translit: vyhy 'd khh v'd khh vhshmym htqdrv 'bym vrvch vyhy gshm gdvl vyrkhb 'ch'b vylkh yzr''lh
verses.translation: And it came to pass in the mean while, that the heaven was black with clouds and wind, and there was a great rain. And Ahab rode, and went to Jezreel.

verses.original: וְ/יַד יְהוָ֗ה הָֽיְתָה֙ אֶל אֵ֣לִיָּ֔הוּ וַ/יְשַׁנֵּ֖ס מָתְנָ֑י/ו וַ/יָּ֨רָץ֙ לִ/פְנֵ֣י אַחְאָ֔ב עַד בֹּאֲ/כָ֖ה יִזְרְעֶֽאלָ/ה
verses.translit: vyd yhvh hyth 'l 'lyhv vyshns mtnyv vyrts lpny 'ch'b 'd b'khh yzr''lh
verses.translation: And the hand of the LORD was on Elijah; and he girded up his loins, and ran before Ahab to the entrance of Jezreel.

verses.original: וַ/יַּגֵּ֤ד אַחְאָב֙ לְ/אִיזֶ֔בֶל אֵ֛ת כָּל אֲשֶׁ֥ר עָשָׂ֖ה אֵלִיָּ֑הוּ וְ/אֵ֨ת כָּל אֲשֶׁ֥ר הָרַ֛ג אֶת כָּל הַ/נְּבִיאִ֖ים בֶּ/חָֽרֶב
verses.translit: vygd 'ch'b l'yzbl 't khl 'shr 'shh 'lyhv v't khl 'shr hrg 't khl hnby'ym bchrb
verses.translation: And Ahab told Jezebel all that Elijah had done, and withal how he had slain all the prophets with the sword.

verses.original: וַ/תִּשְׁלַ֤ח אִיזֶ֨בֶל֙ מַלְאָ֔ךְ אֶל אֵלִיָּ֖הוּ לֵ/אמֹ֑ר כֹּֽה יַעֲשׂ֤וּ/ן אֱלֹהִים֙ וְ/כֹ֣ה יוֹסִפ֔וּ/ן כִּֽי כָ/עֵ֤ת מָחָר֙ אָשִׂ֣ים אֶֽת נַפְשְׁ/ךָ֔ כְּ/נֶ֖פֶשׁ אַחַ֥ד מֵ/הֶֽם
verses.translit: vtshlch 'yzbl ml'kh 'l 'lyhv l'mr khh y'shvn 'lhym vkhh yvspvn khy kh't mchr 'shym 't npshkh khnpsh 'chd mhm
verses.translation: Then Jezebel sent a messenger unto Elijah, saying, So let the gods do to me , and more also, if I make not thy life as the life of one of them by to morrow about this time.

verses.original: וַ/יַּ֗רְא וַ/יָּ֨קָם֙ וַ/יֵּ֣לֶךְ אֶל נַפְשׁ֔/וֹ וַ/יָּבֹ֕א בְּאֵ֥ר שֶׁ֖בַע אֲשֶׁ֣ר לִֽ/יהוּדָ֑ה וַ/יַּנַּ֥ח אֶֽת נַעֲר֖/וֹ שָֽׁם
verses.translit: vyr' vyqm vylkh 'l npshv vyb' b'r shb' 'shr lyhvdh vynch 't n'rv shm
verses.translation: And when he saw that , he arose, and went for his life, and came to Beer-sheba, which belongeth to Judah, and left his servant there.

verses.original: וְ/הֽוּא הָלַ֤ךְ בַּ/מִּדְבָּר֙ דֶּ֣רֶךְ י֔וֹם וַ/יָּבֹ֕א וַ/יֵּ֕שֶׁב תַּ֖חַת רֹ֣תֶם אחת אֶחָ֑ד וַ/יִּשְׁאַ֤ל אֶת נַפְשׁ/וֹ֙ לָ/מ֔וּת וַ/יֹּ֣אמֶר רַ֗ב עַתָּ֤ה יְהוָה֙ קַ֣ח נַפְשִׁ֔/י כִּֽי לֹא ט֥וֹב אָנֹכִ֖י מֵ/אֲבֹתָֽ/י
verses.translit: vhv' hlkh bmdbr drkh yvm vyb' vyshb tcht rtm 'cht 'chd vysh'l 't npshv lmvt vy'mr rb 'th yhvh qch npshy khy l' tvb 'nkhy m'bty
verses.translation: But he himself went a day’s journey into the wilderness, and came and sat down under a juniper tree: and he requested for himself that he might die; and said, It is enough; now, O LORD , take away my life; for I am not better than my fathers.

verses.original: וַ/יִּשְׁכַּב֙ וַ/יִּישַׁ֔ן תַּ֖חַת רֹ֣תֶם אֶחָ֑ד וְ/הִנֵּֽה זֶ֤ה מַלְאָךְ֙ נֹגֵ֣עַ בּ֔/וֹ וַ/יֹּ֥אמֶר ל֖/וֹ ק֥וּם אֱכֽוֹל
verses.translit: vyshkhb vyyshn tcht rtm 'chd vhnh zh ml'kh ng' bv vy'mr lv qvm 'khvl
verses.translation: And as he lay and slept under a juniper tree, behold, then an angel touched him, and said unto him, Arise and eat.

verses.original: וַ/יַּבֵּ֕ט וְ/הִנֵּ֧ה מְרַאֲשֹׁתָ֛י/ו עֻגַ֥ת רְצָפִ֖ים וְ/צַפַּ֣חַת מָ֑יִם וַ/יֹּ֣אכַל וַ/יֵּ֔שְׁתְּ וַ/יָּ֖שָׁב וַ/יִּשְׁכָּֽב
verses.translit: vybt vhnh mr'shtyv 'gt rtspym vtspcht mym vy'khl vysht vyshb vyshkhb
verses.translation: And he looked, and, behold, there was a cake baken on the coals, and a cruse of water at his head. And he did eat and drink, and laid him down again.

verses.original: וַ/יָּשָׁב֩ מַלְאַ֨ךְ יְהוָ֤ה שֵׁנִית֙ וַ/יִּגַּע בּ֔/וֹ וַ/יֹּ֖אמֶר ק֣וּם אֱכֹ֑ל כִּ֛י רַ֥ב מִמְּ/ךָ֖ הַ/דָּֽרֶךְ
verses.translit: vyshb ml'kh yhvh shnyt vyg' bv vy'mr qvm 'khl khy rb mmkh hdrkh
verses.translation: And the angel of the LORD came again the second time, and touched him, and said, Arise and eat; because the journey is too great for thee.

verses.original: וַ/יָּ֖קָם וַ/יֹּ֣אכַל וַ/יִּשְׁתֶּ֑ה וַ/יֵּ֜לֶךְ בְּ/כֹ֣חַ הָ/אֲכִילָ֣ה הַ/הִ֗יא אַרְבָּעִ֥ים יוֹם֙ וְ/אַרְבָּעִ֣ים לַ֔יְלָה עַ֛ד הַ֥ר הָ/אֱלֹהִ֖ים חֹרֵֽב
verses.translit: vyqm vy'khl vyshth vylkh bkhch h'khylh hhy' 'rb'ym yvm v'rb'ym lylh 'd hr h'lhym chrb
verses.translation: And he arose, and did eat and drink, and went in the strength of that meat forty days and forty nights unto Horeb the mount of God.

verses.original: וַ/יָּבֹא שָׁ֥ם אֶל הַ/מְּעָרָ֖ה וַ/יָּ֣לֶן שָׁ֑ם וְ/הִנֵּ֤ה דְבַר יְהוָה֙ אֵלָ֔י/ו וַ/יֹּ֣אמֶר ל֔/וֹ מַה לְּ/ךָ֥ פֹ֖ה אֵלִיָּֽהוּ
verses.translit: vyb' shm 'l hm'rh vyln shm vhnh dbr yhvh 'lyv vy'mr lv mh lkh ph 'lyhv
verses.translation: And he came thither unto a cave, and lodged there; and, behold, the word of the LORD came to him, and he said unto him, What doest thou here, Elijah?

verses.original: וַ/יֹּאמֶר֩ קַנֹּ֨א קִנֵּ֜אתִי לַ/יהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֵ֣י צְבָא֗וֹת כִּֽי עָזְב֤וּ בְרִֽיתְ/ךָ֙ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל אֶת מִזְבְּחֹתֶ֣י/ךָ הָרָ֔סוּ וְ/אֶת נְבִיאֶ֖י/ךָ הָרְג֣וּ בֶ/חָ֑רֶב וָֽ/אִוָּתֵ֤ר אֲנִי֙ לְ/בַדִּ֔/י וַ/יְבַקְשׁ֥וּ אֶת נַפְשִׁ֖/י לְ/קַחְתָּֽ/הּ
verses.translit: vy'mr qn' qn'ty lyhvh 'lhy tsb'vt khy 'zbv brytkh bny yshr'l 't mzbchtykh hrsv v't nby'ykh hrgv bchrb v'vtr 'ny lbdy vybqshv 't npshy lqchth
verses.translation: And he said, I have been very jealous for the LORD God of hosts: for the children of Israel have forsaken thy covenant, thrown down thine altars, and slain thy prophets with the sword; and I, even I only, am left; and they seek my life, to take it away.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֗אמֶר צֵ֣א וְ/עָמַדְתָּ֣ בָ/הָר֮ לִ/פְנֵ֣י יְהוָה֒ וְ/הִנֵּ֧ה יְהוָ֣ה עֹבֵ֗ר וְ/ר֣וּחַ גְּדוֹלָ֡ה וְ/חָזָ֞ק מְפָרֵק֩ הָרִ֨ים וּ/מְשַׁבֵּ֤ר סְלָעִים֙ לִ/פְנֵ֣י יְהוָ֔ה לֹ֥א בָ/ר֖וּחַ יְהוָ֑ה וְ/אַחַ֤ר הָ/ר֨וּחַ רַ֔עַשׁ לֹ֥א בָ/רַ֖עַשׁ יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: vy'mr ts' v'mdt bhr lpny yhvh vhnh yhvh 'br vrvch gdvlh vchzq mprq hrym vmshbr sl'ym lpny yhvh l' brvch yhvh v'chr hrvch r'sh l' br'sh yhvh
verses.translation: And he said, Go forth, and stand upon the mount before the LORD . And, behold, the LORD passed by, and a great and strong wind rent the mountains, and brake in pieces the rocks before the LORD ; but the LORD was not in the wind: and after the wind an earthquake; but the LORD was not in the earthquake:

verses.original: וְ/אַחַ֤ר הָ/רַ֨עַשׁ֙ אֵ֔שׁ לֹ֥א בָ/אֵ֖שׁ יְהוָ֑ה וְ/אַחַ֣ר הָ/אֵ֔שׁ ק֖וֹל דְּמָמָ֥ה דַקָּֽה
verses.translit: v'chr hr'sh 'sh l' b'sh yhvh v'chr h'sh qvl dmmh dqh
verses.translation: And after the earthquake a fire; but the LORD was not in the fire: and after the fire a still small voice.

verses.original: וַ/יְהִ֣י כִּ/שְׁמֹ֣עַ אֵלִיָּ֗הוּ וַ/יָּ֤לֶט פָּנָי/ו֙ בְּ/אַדַּרְתּ֔/וֹ וַ/יֵּצֵ֕א וַֽ/יַּעֲמֹ֖ד פֶּ֣תַח הַ/מְּעָרָ֑ה וְ/הִנֵּ֤ה אֵלָי/ו֙ ק֔וֹל וַ/יֹּ֕אמֶר מַה לְּ/ךָ֥ פֹ֖ה אֵלִיָּֽהוּ
verses.translit: vyhy khshm' 'lyhv vylt pnyv b'drtv vyts' vy'md ptch hm'rh vhnh 'lyv qvl vy'mr mh lkh ph 'lyhv
verses.translation: And it was so , when Elijah heard it , that he wrapped his face in his mantle, and went out, and stood in the entering in of the cave. And, behold, there came a voice unto him, and said, What doest thou here, Elijah?

verses.original: וַ/יֹּאמֶר֩ קַנֹּ֨א קִנֵּ֜אתִי לַ/יהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֵ֣י צְבָא֗וֹת כִּֽי עָזְב֤וּ בְרִֽיתְ/ךָ֙ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל אֶת מִזְבְּחֹתֶ֣י/ךָ הָרָ֔סוּ וְ/אֶת נְבִיאֶ֖י/ךָ הָרְג֣וּ בֶ/חָ֑רֶב וָ/אִוָּתֵ֤ר אֲנִי֙ לְ/בַדִּ֔/י וַ/יְבַקְשׁ֥וּ אֶת נַפְשִׁ֖/י לְ/קַחְתָּֽ/הּ
verses.translit: vy'mr qn' qn'ty lyhvh 'lhy tsb'vt khy 'zbv brytkh bny yshr'l 't mzbchtykh hrsv v't nby'ykh hrgv bchrb v'vtr 'ny lbdy vybqshv 't npshy lqchth
verses.translation: And he said, I have been very jealous for the LORD God of hosts: because the children of Israel have forsaken thy covenant, thrown down thine altars, and slain thy prophets with the sword; and I, even I only, am left; and they seek my life, to take it away.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֤אמֶר יְהוָה֙ אֵלָ֔י/ו לֵ֛ךְ שׁ֥וּב לְ/דַרְכְּ/ךָ֖ מִדְבַּ֣רָ/ה דַמָּ֑שֶׂק וּ/בָ֗אתָ וּ/מָשַׁחְתָּ֧ אֶת חֲזָאֵ֛ל לְ/מֶ֖לֶךְ עַל אֲרָֽם
verses.translit: vy'mr yhvh 'lyv lkh shvb ldrkhkh mdbrh dmshq vb't vmshcht 't chz'l lmlkh 'l 'rm
verses.translation: And the LORD said unto him, Go, return on thy way to the wilderness of Damascus: and when thou comest, anoint Hazael to be king over Syria:

verses.original: וְ/אֵת֙ יֵה֣וּא בֶן נִמְשִׁ֔י תִּמְשַׁ֥ח לְ/מֶ֖לֶךְ עַל יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וְ/אֶת אֱלִישָׁ֤ע בֶּן שָׁפָט֙ מֵ/אָבֵ֣ל מְחוֹלָ֔ה תִּמְשַׁ֥ח לְ/נָבִ֖יא תַּחְתֶּֽי/ךָ
verses.translit: v't yhv' bn nmshy tmshch lmlkh 'l yshr'l v't 'lysh' bn shpt m'bl mchvlh tmshch lnby' tchtykh
verses.translation: And Jehu the son of Nimshi shalt thou anoint to be king over Israel: and Elisha the son of Shaphat of Abel-meholah shalt thou anoint to be prophet in thy room.

verses.original: וְ/הָיָ֗ה הַ/נִּמְלָ֛ט מֵ/חֶ֥רֶב חֲזָאֵ֖ל יָמִ֣ית יֵה֑וּא וְ/הַ/נִּמְלָ֛ט מֵ/חֶ֥רֶב יֵה֖וּא יָמִ֥ית אֱלִישָֽׁע
verses.translit: vhyh hnmlt mchrb chz'l ymyt yhv' vhnmlt mchrb yhv' ymyt 'lysh'
verses.translation: And it shall come to pass, that him that escapeth the sword of Hazael shall Jehu slay: and him that escapeth from the sword of Jehu shall Elisha slay.

verses.original: וְ/הִשְׁאַרְתִּ֥י בְ/יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל שִׁבְעַ֣ת אֲלָפִ֑ים כָּל הַ/בִּרְכַּ֗יִם אֲשֶׁ֤ר לֹֽא כָֽרְעוּ֙ לַ/בַּ֔עַל וְ/כָ֨ל הַ/פֶּ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר לֹֽא נָשַׁ֖ק לֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: vhsh'rty byshr'l shb't 'lpym khl hbrkhym 'shr l' khr'v lb'l vkhl hph 'shr l' nshq lv
verses.translation: Yet I have left me seven thousand in Israel, all the knees which have not bowed unto Baal, and every mouth which hath not kissed him.

verses.original: וַ/יֵּ֣לֶךְ מִ֠/שָּׁם וַ/יִּמְצָ֞א אֶת אֱלִישָׁ֤ע בֶּן שָׁפָט֙ וְ/ה֣וּא חֹרֵ֔שׁ שְׁנֵים עָשָׂ֤ר צְמָדִים֙ לְ/פָנָ֔י/ו וְ/ה֖וּא בִּ/שְׁנֵ֣ים הֶ/עָשָׂ֑ר וַ/יַּעֲבֹ֤ר אֵלִיָּ֨הוּ֙ אֵלָ֔י/ו וַ/יַּשְׁלֵ֥ךְ אַדַּרְתּ֖/וֹ אֵלָֽי/ו
verses.translit: vylkh mshm vymts' 't 'lysh' bn shpt vhv' chrsh shnym 'shr tsmdym lpnyv vhv' bshnym h'shr vy'br 'lyhv 'lyv vyshlkh 'drtv 'lyv
verses.translation: So he departed thence, and found Elisha the son of Shaphat, who was plowing with twelve yoke of oxen before him, and he with the twelfth: and Elijah passed by him, and cast his mantle upon him.

verses.original: וַ/יַּעֲזֹ֣ב אֶת הַ/בָּקָ֗ר וַ/יָּ֨רָץ֙ אַחֲרֵ֣י אֵֽלִיָּ֔הוּ וַ/יֹּ֗אמֶר אֶשְּׁקָה נָּא֙ לְ/אָבִ֣/י וּ/לְ/אִמִּ֔/י וְ/אֵלְכָ֖ה אַחֲרֶ֑י/ךָ וַ/יֹּ֤אמֶר ל/וֹ֙ לֵ֣ךְ שׁ֔וּב כִּ֥י מֶה עָשִׂ֖יתִי לָֽ/ךְ
verses.translit: vy'zb 't hbqr vyrts 'chry 'lyhv vy'mr 'shqh n' l'by vl'my v'lkhh 'chrykh vy'mr lv lkh shvb khy mh 'shyty lkh
verses.translation: And he left the oxen, and ran after Elijah, and said, Let me, I pray thee, kiss my father and my mother, and then I will follow thee. And he said unto him, Go back again: for what have I done to thee?

verses.original: וַ/יָּ֨שָׁב מֵ/אַחֲרָ֜י/ו וַ/יִּקַּ֣ח אֶת צֶ֧מֶד הַ/בָּקָ֣ר וַ/יִּזְבָּחֵ֗/הוּ וּ/בִ/כְלִ֤י הַ/בָּקָר֙ בִּשְּׁלָ֣/ם הַ/בָּשָׂ֔ר וַ/יִּתֵּ֥ן לָ/עָ֖ם וַ/יֹּאכֵ֑לוּ וַ/יָּ֗קָם וַ/יֵּ֛לֶךְ אַחֲרֵ֥י אֵלִיָּ֖הוּ וַ/יְשָׁרְתֵֽ/הוּ
verses.translit: vyshb m'chryv vyqch 't tsmd hbqr vyzbchhv vbkhly hbqr bshlm hbshr vytn l'm vy'khlv vyqm vylkh 'chry 'lyhv vyshrthv
verses.translation: And he returned back from him, and took a yoke of oxen, and slew them, and boiled their flesh with the instruments of the oxen, and gave unto the people, and they did eat. Then he arose, and went after Elijah, and ministered unto him.

verses.original: וּ/בֶן הֲדַ֣ד מֶֽלֶךְ אֲרָ֗ם קָבַץ֙ אֶת כָּל חֵיל֔/וֹ וּ/שְׁלֹשִׁ֨ים וּ/שְׁנַ֥יִם מֶ֛לֶךְ אִתּ֖/וֹ וְ/ס֣וּס וָ/רָ֑כֶב וַ/יַּ֗עַל וַ/יָּ֨צַר֙ עַל שֹׁ֣מְר֔וֹן וַ/יִּלָּ֖חֶם בָּֽ/הּ
verses.translit: vbn hdd mlkh 'rm qbts 't khl chylv vshlshym vshnym mlkh 'tv vsvs vrkhb vy'l vytsr 'l shmrvn vylchm bh
verses.translation: And Ben-hadad the king of Syria gathered all his host together: and there were thirty and two kings with him, and horses, and chariots: and he went up and besieged Samaria, and warred against it.

verses.original: וַ/יִּשְׁלַ֧ח מַלְאָכִ֛ים אֶל אַחְאָ֥ב מֶֽלֶךְ יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל הָ/עִֽירָ/ה
verses.translit: vyshlch ml'khym 'l 'ch'b mlkh yshr'l h'yrh
verses.translation: And he sent messengers to Ahab king of Israel into the city, and said unto him, Thus saith Ben-hadad,

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֣אמֶר ל֗/וֹ כֹּ֚ה אָמַ֣ר בֶּן הֲדַ֔ד כַּסְפְּ/ךָ֥ וּֽ/זְהָבְ/ךָ֖ לִֽ/י ה֑וּא וְ/נָשֶׁ֧י/ךָ וּ/בָנֶ֛י/ךָ הַ/טּוֹבִ֖ים לִ/י הֵֽם
verses.translit: vy'mr lv khh 'mr bn hdd khspkh vzhbkh ly hv' vnshykh vbnykh htvbym ly hm
verses.translation: Thy silver and thy gold is mine; thy wives also and thy children, even the goodliest, are mine.

verses.original: וַ/יַּ֤עַן מֶֽלֶךְ יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ וַ/יֹּ֔אמֶר כִּ/דְבָרְ/ךָ֖ אֲדֹנִ֣/י הַ/מֶּ֑לֶךְ לְ/ךָ֥ אֲנִ֖י וְ/כָל אֲשֶׁר לִֽ/י
verses.translit: vy'n mlkh yshr'l vy'mr khdbrkh 'dny hmlkh lkh 'ny vkhl 'shr ly
verses.translation: And the king of Israel answered and said, My lord, O king, according to thy saying, I am thine, and all that I have.

verses.original: וַ/יָּשֻׁ֨בוּ֙ הַ/מַּלְאָכִ֔ים וַ/יֹּ֣אמְר֔וּ כֹּֽה אָמַ֥ר בֶּן הֲדַ֖ד לֵ/אמֹ֑ר כִּֽי שָׁלַ֤חְתִּי אֵלֶ֨י/ךָ֙ לֵ/אמֹ֔ר כַּסְפְּ/ךָ֧ וּ/זְהָבְ/ךָ֛ וְ/נָשֶׁ֥י/ךָ וּ/בָנֶ֖י/ךָ לִ֥/י תִתֵּֽן
verses.translit: vyshbv hml'khym vy'mrv khh 'mr bn hdd l'mr khy shlchty 'lykh l'mr khspkh vzhbkh vnshykh vbnykh ly ttn
verses.translation: And the messengers came again, and said, Thus speaketh Ben-hadad, saying, Although I have sent unto thee, saying, Thou shalt deliver me thy silver, and thy gold, and thy wives, and thy children;

verses.original: כִּ֣י אִם כָּ/עֵ֣ת מָחָ֗ר אֶשְׁלַ֤ח אֶת עֲבָדַ/י֙ אֵלֶ֔י/ךָ וְ/חִפְּשׂוּ֙ אֶת בֵּ֣יתְ/ךָ֔ וְ/אֵ֖ת בָּתֵּ֣י עֲבָדֶ֑י/ךָ וְ/הָיָה֙ כָּל מַחְמַ֣ד עֵינֶ֔י/ךָ יָשִׂ֥ימוּ בְ/יָדָ֖/ם וְ/לָקָֽחוּ
verses.translit: khy 'm kh't mchr 'shlch 't 'bdy 'lykh vchpshv 't bytkh v't bty 'bdykh vhyh khl mchmd 'ynykh yshymv bydm vlqchv
verses.translation: Yet I will send my servants unto thee to morrow about this time, and they shall search thine house, and the houses of thy servants; and it shall be, that whatsoever is pleasant in thine eyes, they shall put it in their hand, and take it away.

verses.original: וַ/יִּקְרָ֤א מֶֽלֶךְ יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ לְ/כָל זִקְנֵ֣י הָ/אָ֔רֶץ וַ/יֹּ֨אמֶר֙ דְּעֽוּ נָ֣א וּ/רְא֔וּ כִּ֥י רָעָ֖ה זֶ֣ה מְבַקֵּ֑שׁ כִּֽי שָׁלַ֨ח אֵלַ֜/י לְ/נָשַׁ֤/י וּ/לְ/בָנַ/י֙ וּ/לְ/כַסְפִּ֣/י וְ/לִ/זְהָבִ֔/י וְ/לֹ֥א מָנַ֖עְתִּי מִמֶּֽ/נּוּ
verses.translit: vyqr' mlkh yshr'l lkhl zqny h'rts vy'mr d'v n' vr'v khy r'h zh mbqsh khy shlch 'ly lnshy vlbny vlkhspy vlzhby vl' mn'ty mmnv
verses.translation: Then the king of Israel called all the elders of the land, and said, Mark, I pray you, and see how this man seeketh mischief: for he sent unto me for my wives, and for my children, and for my silver, and for my gold; and I denied him not.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּאמְר֥וּ אֵלָ֛י/ו כָּל הַ/זְּקֵנִ֖ים וְ/כָל הָ/עָ֑ם אַל תִּשְׁמַ֖ע וְ/ל֥וֹא תֹאבֶֽה
verses.translit: vy'mrv 'lyv khl hzqnym vkhl h'm 'l tshm' vlv' t'bh
verses.translation: And all the elders and all the people said unto him, Hearken not unto him , nor consent.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֜אמֶר לְ/מַלְאֲכֵ֣י בֶן הֲדַ֗ד אִמְר֞וּ לַֽ/אדֹנִ֤/י הַ/מֶּ֨לֶךְ֙ כֹּל֩ אֲשֶׁר שָׁלַ֨חְתָּ אֶל עַבְדְּ/ךָ֤ בָ/רִֽאשֹׁנָה֙ אֶעֱשֶׂ֔ה וְ/הַ/דָּבָ֣ר הַ/זֶּ֔ה לֹ֥א אוּכַ֖ל לַ/עֲשׂ֑וֹת וַ/יֵּֽלְכוּ֙ הַ/מַּלְאָכִ֔ים וַ/יְשִׁבֻ֖/הוּ דָּבָֽר
verses.translit: vy'mr lml'khy bn hdd 'mrv l'dny hmlkh khl 'shr shlcht 'l 'bdkh br'shnh ''shh vhdbr hzh l' 'vkhl l'shvt vylkhv hml'khym vyshbhv dbr
verses.translation: Wherefore he said unto the messengers of Ben-hadad, Tell my lord the king, All that thou didst send for to thy servant at the first I will do: but this thing I may not do. And the messengers departed, and brought him word again.

verses.original: וַ/יִּשְׁלַ֤ח אֵלָי/ו֙ בֶּן הֲדַ֔ד וַ/יֹּ֕אמֶר כֹּֽה יַעֲשׂ֥וּ/ן לִ֛/י אֱלֹהִ֖ים וְ/כֹ֣ה יוֹסִ֑פוּ אִם יִשְׂפֹּק֙ עֲפַ֣ר שֹׁמְר֔וֹן לִ/שְׁעָלִ֕ים לְ/כָל הָ/עָ֖ם אֲשֶׁ֥ר בְּ/רַגְלָֽ/י
verses.translit: vyshlch 'lyv bn hdd vy'mr khh y'shvn ly 'lhym vkhh yvspv 'm yshpq 'pr shmrvn lsh'lym lkhl h'm 'shr brgly
verses.translation: And Ben-hadad sent unto him, and said, The gods do so unto me, and more also, if the dust of Samaria shall suffice for handfuls for all the people that follow me.

verses.original: וַ/יַּ֤עַן מֶֽלֶךְ יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ וַ/יֹּ֣אמֶר דַּבְּר֔וּ אַל יִתְהַלֵּ֥ל חֹגֵ֖ר כִּ/מְפַתֵּֽחַ
verses.translit: vy'n mlkh yshr'l vy'mr dbrv 'l ythll chgr khmptch
verses.translation: And the king of Israel answered and said, Tell him , Let not him that girdeth on his harness boast himself as he that putteth it off.

verses.original: וַ/יְהִ֗י כִּ/שְׁמֹ֨עַ֙ אֶת הַ/דָּבָ֣ר הַ/זֶּ֔ה וְ/ה֥וּא שֹׁתֶ֛ה ה֥וּא וְ/הַ/מְּלָכִ֖ים בַּ/סֻּכּ֑וֹת וַ/יֹּ֤אמֶר אֶל עֲבָדָי/ו֙ שִׂ֔ימוּ וַ/יָּשִׂ֖ימוּ עַל הָ/עִֽיר
verses.translit: vyhy khshm' 't hdbr hzh vhv' shth hv' vhmlkhym bskhvt vy'mr 'l 'bdyv shymv vyshymv 'l h'yr
verses.translation: And it came to pass, when Ben-hadad heard this message, as he was drinking, he and the kings in the pavilions, that he said unto his servants, Set yourselves in array . And they set themselves in array against the city.

verses.original: וְ/הִנֵּ֣ה נָבִ֣יא אֶחָ֗ד נִגַּשׁ֮ אֶל אַחְאָ֣ב מֶֽלֶךְ יִשְׂרָאֵל֒ וַ/יֹּ֗אמֶר כֹּ֚ה אָמַ֣ר יְהוָ֔ה הְֽ/רָאִ֔יתָ אֵ֛ת כָּל הֶ/הָמ֥וֹן הַ/גָּד֖וֹל הַ/זֶּ֑ה הִנְ/נִ֨י נֹתְנ֤/וֹ בְ/יָֽדְ/ךָ֙ הַ/יּ֔וֹם וְ/יָדַעְתָּ֖ כִּֽי אֲנִ֥י יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: vhnh nby' 'chd ngsh 'l 'ch'b mlkh yshr'l vy'mr khh 'mr yhvh hr'yt 't khl hhmvn hgdvl hzh hnny ntnv bydkh hyvm vyd't khy 'ny yhvh
verses.translation: And, behold, there came a prophet unto Ahab king of Israel, saying, Thus saith the LORD , Hast thou seen all this great multitude? behold, I will deliver it into thine hand this day; and thou shalt know that I am the LORD .

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֤אמֶר אַחְאָב֙ בְּ/מִ֔י וַ/יֹּ֨אמֶר֙ כֹּֽה אָמַ֣ר יְהוָ֔ה בְּ/נַעֲרֵ֖י שָׂרֵ֣י הַ/מְּדִינ֑וֹת וַ/יֹּ֛אמֶר מִֽי יֶאְסֹ֥ר הַ/מִּלְחָמָ֖ה וַ/יֹּ֥אמֶר אָֽתָּה
verses.translit: vy'mr 'ch'b bmy vy'mr khh 'mr yhvh bn'ry shry hmdynvt vy'mr my y'sr hmlchmh vy'mr 'th
verses.translation: And Ahab said, By whom? And he said, Thus saith the LORD , Even by the young men of the princes of the provinces. Then he said, Who shall order the battle? And he answered, Thou.

verses.original: וַ/יִּפְקֹ֗ד אֶֽת נַעֲרֵי֙ שָׂרֵ֣י הַ/מְּדִינ֔וֹת וַ/יִּהְי֕וּ מָאתַ֖יִם שְׁנַ֣יִם וּ/שְׁלֹשִׁ֑ים וְ/אַחֲרֵי/הֶ֗ם פָּקַ֧ד אֶת כָּל הָ/עָ֛ם כָּל בְּנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל שִׁבְעַ֥ת אֲלָפִֽים
verses.translit: vypqd 't n'ry shry hmdynvt vyhyv m'tym shnym vshlshym v'chryhm pqd 't khl h'm khl bny yshr'l shb't 'lpym
verses.translation: Then he numbered the young men of the princes of the provinces, and they were two hundred and thirty two: and after them he numbered all the people, even all the children of Israel, being seven thousand.

verses.original: וַ/יֵּצְא֖וּ בַּֽ/צָּהֳרָ֑יִם וּ/בֶן הֲדַד֩ שֹׁתֶ֨ה שִׁכּ֜וֹר בַּ/סֻּכּ֗וֹת ה֧וּא וְ/הַ/מְּלָכִ֛ים שְׁלֹשִֽׁים וּ/שְׁנַ֥יִם מֶ֖לֶךְ עֹזֵ֥ר אֹתֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: vyts'v btshrym vbn hdd shth shkhvr bskhvt hv' vhmlkhym shlshym vshnym mlkh 'zr 'tv
verses.translation: And they went out at noon. But Ben-hadad was drinking himself drunk in the pavilions, he and the kings, the thirty and two kings that helped him.

verses.original: וַ/יֵּצְא֗וּ נַעֲרֵ֛י שָׂרֵ֥י הַ/מְּדִינ֖וֹת בָּ/רִֽאשֹׁנָ֑ה וַ/יִּשְׁלַ֣ח בֶּן הֲדַ֗ד וַ/יַּגִּ֤ידוּ ל/וֹ֙ לֵ/אמֹ֔ר אֲנָשִׁ֕ים יָצְא֖וּ מִ/שֹּׁמְרֽוֹן
verses.translit: vyts'v n'ry shry hmdynvt br'shnh vyshlch bn hdd vygydv lv l'mr 'nshym yts'v mshmrvn
verses.translation: And the young men of the princes of the provinces went out first; and Ben-hadad sent out, and they told him, saying, There are men come out of Samaria.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֛אמֶר אִם לְ/שָׁל֥וֹם יָצָ֖אוּ תִּפְשׂ֣וּ/ם חַיִּ֑ים וְ/אִ֧ם לְ/מִלְחָמָ֛ה יָצָ֖אוּ חַיִּ֥ים תִּפְשֽׂוּ/ם
verses.translit: vy'mr 'm lshlvm yts'v tpshvm chyym v'm lmlchmh yts'v chyym tpshvm
verses.translation: And he said, Whether they be come out for peace, take them alive; or whether they be come out for war, take them alive.

verses.original: וְ/אֵ֨לֶּה֙ יָצְא֣וּ מִן הָ/עִ֔יר נַעֲרֵ֖י שָׂרֵ֣י הַ/מְּדִינ֑וֹת וְ/הַ/חַ֖יִל אֲשֶׁ֥ר אַחֲרֵי/הֶֽם
verses.translit: v'lh yts'v mn h'yr n'ry shry hmdynvt vhchyl 'shr 'chryhm
verses.translation: So these young men of the princes of the provinces came out of the city, and the army which followed them.

verses.original: וַ/יַּכּוּ֙ אִ֣ישׁ אִישׁ֔/וֹ וַ/יָּנֻ֣סוּ אֲרָ֔ם וַֽ/יִּרְדְּפֵ֖/ם יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וַ/יִּמָּלֵ֗ט בֶּן הֲדַד֙ מֶ֣לֶךְ אֲרָ֔ם עַל ס֖וּס וּ/פָרָשִֽׁים
verses.translit: vykhv 'ysh 'yshv vynsv 'rm vyrdpm yshr'l vymlt bn hdd mlkh 'rm 'l svs vprshym
verses.translation: And they slew every one his man: and the Syrians fled; and Israel pursued them: and Ben-hadad the king of Syria escaped on an horse with the horsemen.

verses.original: וַ/יֵּצֵא֙ מֶ֣לֶךְ יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל וַ/יַּ֥ךְ אֶת הַ/סּ֖וּס וְ/אֶת הָ/רָ֑כֶב וְ/הִכָּ֥ה בַ/אֲרָ֖ם מַכָּ֥ה גְדוֹלָֽה
verses.translit: vyts' mlkh yshr'l vykh 't hsvs v't hrkhb vhkhh b'rm mkhh gdvlh
verses.translation: And the king of Israel went out, and smote the horses and chariots, and slew the Syrians with a great slaughter.

verses.original: וַ/יִּגַּ֤שׁ הַ/נָּבִיא֙ אֶל מֶ֣לֶךְ יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל וַ/יֹּ֤אמֶר ל/וֹ֙ לֵ֣ךְ הִתְחַזַּ֔ק וְ/דַ֥ע וּ/רְאֵ֖ה אֵ֣ת אֲשֶֽׁר תַּעֲשֶׂ֑ה כִּ֚י לִ/תְשׁוּבַ֣ת הַ/שָּׁנָ֔ה מֶ֥לֶךְ אֲרָ֖ם עֹלֶ֥ה עָלֶֽי/ךָ
verses.translit: vygsh hnby' 'l mlkh yshr'l vy'mr lv lkh htchzq vd' vr'h 't 'shr t'shh khy ltshvbt hshnh mlkh 'rm 'lh 'lykh
verses.translation: And the prophet came to the king of Israel, and said unto him, Go, strengthen thyself, and mark, and see what thou doest: for at the return of the year the king of Syria will come up against thee.

verses.original: וְ/עַבְדֵ֨י מֶֽלֶךְ אֲרָ֜ם אָמְר֣וּ אֵלָ֗י/ו אֱלֹהֵ֤י הָרִים֙ אֱלֹ֣הֵי/הֶ֔ם עַל כֵּ֖ן חָזְק֣וּ מִמֶּ֑/נּוּ וְ/אוּלָ֗ם נִלָּחֵ֤ם אִתָּ/ם֙ בַּ/מִּישׁ֔וֹר אִם לֹ֥א נֶחֱזַ֖ק מֵ/הֶֽם
verses.translit: v'bdy mlkh 'rm 'mrv 'lyv 'lhy hrym 'lhyhm 'l khn chzqv mmnv v'vlm nlchm 'tm bmyshvr 'm l' nchzq mhm
verses.translation: And the servants of the king of Syria said unto him, Their gods are gods of the hills; therefore they were stronger than we; but let us fight against them in the plain, and surely we shall be stronger than they.

verses.original: וְ/אֶת הַ/דָּבָ֥ר הַ/זֶּ֖ה עֲשֵׂ֑ה הָסֵ֤ר הַ/מְּלָכִים֙ אִ֣ישׁ מִ/מְּקֹמ֔/וֹ וְ/שִׂ֥ים פַּח֖וֹת תַּחְתֵּי/הֶֽם
verses.translit: v't hdbr hzh 'shh hsr hmlkhym 'ysh mmqmv vshym pchvt tchtyhm
verses.translation: And do this thing, Take the kings away, every man out of his place, and put captains in their rooms:

verses.original: וְ/אַתָּ֣ה תִֽמְנֶה לְ/ךָ֣ חַ֡יִל כַּ/חַיִל֩ הַ/נֹּפֵ֨ל מֵ/אוֹתָ֜/ךְ וְ/ס֣וּס כַּ/סּ֣וּס וְ/רֶ֣כֶב כָּ/רֶ֗כֶב וְ/נִֽלָּחֲמָ֤ה אוֹתָ/ם֙ בַּ/מִּישׁ֔וֹר אִם לֹ֥א נֶחֱזַ֖ק מֵ/הֶ֑ם וַ/יִּשְׁמַ֥ע לְ/קֹלָ֖/ם וַ/יַּ֥עַשׂ כֵּֽן
verses.translit: v'th tmnh lkh chyl khchyl hnpl m'vtkh vsvs khsvs vrkhb khrkhb vnlchmh 'vtm bmyshvr 'm l' nchzq mhm vyshm' lqlm vy'sh khn
verses.translation: And number thee an army, like the army that thou hast lost, horse for horse, and chariot for chariot: and we will fight against them in the plain, and surely we shall be stronger than they. And he hearkened unto their voice, and did so.

verses.original: וַֽ/יְהִי֙ לִ/תְשׁוּבַ֣ת הַ/שָּׁנָ֔ה וַ/יִּפְקֹ֥ד בֶּן הֲדַ֖ד אֶת אֲרָ֑ם וַ/יַּ֣עַל אֲפֵ֔קָ/ה לַ/מִּלְחָמָ֖ה עִם יִשְׂרָאֵֽל
verses.translit: vyhy ltshvbt hshnh vypqd bn hdd 't 'rm vy'l 'pqh lmlchmh 'm yshr'l
verses.translation: And it came to pass at the return of the year, that Ben-hadad numbered the Syrians, and went up to Aphek, to fight against Israel.

verses.original: וּ/בְנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל הָתְפָּקְדוּ֙ וְ/כָלְכְּל֔וּ וַ/יֵּלְכ֖וּ לִ/קְרָאתָ֑/ם וַ/יַּחֲנ֨וּ בְנֵֽי יִשְׂרָאֵ֜ל נֶגְדָּ֗/ם כִּ/שְׁנֵי֙ חֲשִׂפֵ֣י עִזִּ֔ים וַ/אֲרָ֖ם מִלְא֥וּ אֶת הָ/אָֽרֶץ
verses.translit: vbny yshr'l htpqdv vkhlkhlv vylkhv lqr'tm vychnv bny yshr'l ngdm khshny chshpy 'zym v'rm ml'v 't h'rts
verses.translation: And the children of Israel were numbered, and were all present, and went against them: and the children of Israel pitched before them like two little flocks of kids; but the Syrians filled the country.

verses.original: וַ/יִּגַּ֞שׁ אִ֣ישׁ הָ/אֱלֹהִ֗ים וַ/יֹּאמֶר֮ אֶל מֶ֣לֶךְ יִשְׂרָאֵל֒ וַ/יֹּ֜אמֶר כֹּֽה אָמַ֣ר יְהוָ֗ה יַ֠עַן אֲשֶׁ֨ר אָמְר֤וּ אֲרָם֙ אֱלֹהֵ֤י הָרִים֙ יְהוָ֔ה וְ/לֹֽא אֱלֹהֵ֥י עֲמָקִ֖ים ה֑וּא וְ֠/נָתַתִּי אֶת כָּל הֶ/הָמ֨וֹן הַ/גָּ֤דוֹל הַ/זֶּה֙ בְּ/יָדֶ֔/ךָ וִֽ/ידַעְתֶּ֖ם כִּֽי אֲנִ֥י יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: vygsh 'ysh h'lhym vy'mr 'l mlkh yshr'l vy'mr khh 'mr yhvh y'n 'shr 'mrv 'rm 'lhy hrym yhvh vl' 'lhy 'mqym hv' vntty 't khl hhmvn hgdvl hzh bydkh vyd'tm khy 'ny yhvh
verses.translation: And there came a man of God, and spake unto the king of Israel, and said, Thus saith the LORD , Because the Syrians have said, The LORD is God of the hills, but he is not God of the valleys, therefore will I deliver all this great multitude into thine hand, and ye shall know that I am the LORD .
