verses.original: וַֽ/יַּחֲנ֧וּ אֵ֦לֶּה נֹ֥כַח אֵ֖לֶּה שִׁבְעַ֣ת יָמִ֑ים וַ/יְהִ֣י בַּ/יּ֣וֹם הַ/שְּׁבִיעִ֗י וַ/תִּקְרַב֙ הַ/מִּלְחָמָ֔ה וַ/יַּכּ֨וּ בְנֵֽי יִשְׂרָאֵ֧ל אֶת אֲרָ֛ם מֵאָה אֶ֥לֶף רַגְלִ֖י בְּ/י֥וֹם אֶחָֽד
verses.translit: vychnv 'lh nkhch 'lh shb't ymym vyhy byvm hshby'y vtqrb hmlchmh vykhv bny yshr'l 't 'rm m'h 'lf rgly byvm 'chd
verses.translation: And they pitched one over against the other seven days. And so it was, that in the seventh day the battle was joined: and the children of Israel slew of the Syrians an hundred thousand footmen in one day.

verses.original: וַ/יָּנֻ֨סוּ הַ/נּוֹתָרִ֥ים אֲפֵקָ/ה֮ אֶל הָ/עִיר֒ וַ/תִּפֹּל֙ הַ/חוֹמָ֔ה עַל עֶשְׂרִ֨ים וְ/שִׁבְעָ֥ה אֶ֛לֶף אִ֖ישׁ הַ/נּוֹתָרִ֑ים וּ/בֶן הֲדַ֣ד נָ֔ס וַ/יָּבֹ֥א אֶל הָ/עִ֖יר חֶ֥דֶר בְּ/חָֽדֶר
verses.translit: vynsv hnvtrym 'pqh 'l h'yr vtpl hchvmh 'l 'shrym vshb'h 'lf 'ysh hnvtrym vbn hdd ns vyb' 'l h'yr chdr bchdr
verses.translation: But the rest fled to Aphek, into the city; and there a wall fell upon twenty and seven thousand of the men that were left. And Ben-hadad fled, and came into the city, into an inner chamber.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּאמְר֣וּ אֵלָי/ו֮ עֲבָדָי/ו֒ הִנֵּֽה נָ֣א שָׁמַ֔עְנוּ כִּ֗י מַלְכֵי֙ בֵּ֣ית יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל כִּֽי מַלְכֵ֥י חֶ֖סֶד הֵ֑ם נָשִׂ֣ימָה נָּא֩ שַׂקִּ֨ים בְּ/מָתְנֵ֜י/נוּ וַ/חֲבָלִ֣ים בְּ/רֹאשֵׁ֗/נוּ וְ/נֵצֵא֙ אֶל מֶ֣לֶךְ יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל אוּלַ֖י יְחַיֶּ֥ה אֶת נַפְשֶֽׁ/ךָ
verses.translit: vy'mrv 'lyv 'bdyv hnh n' shm'nv khy mlkhy byt yshr'l khy mlkhy chsd hm nshymh n' shqym bmtnynv vchblym br'shnv vnts' 'l mlkh yshr'l 'vly ychyh 't npshkh
verses.translation: And his servants said unto him, Behold now, we have heard that the kings of the house of Israel are merciful kings: let us, I pray thee, put sackcloth on our loins, and ropes upon our heads, and go out to the king of Israel: peradventure he will save thy life.

verses.original: וַ/יַּחְגְּרוּ֩ שַׂקִּ֨ים בְּ/מָתְנֵי/הֶ֜ם וַ/חֲבָלִ֣ים בְּ/רָאשֵׁי/הֶ֗ם וַ/יָּבֹ֨אוּ֙ אֶל מֶ֣לֶךְ יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל וַ/יֹּ֣אמְר֔וּ עַבְדְּ/ךָ֧ בֶן הֲדַ֛ד אָמַ֖ר תְּחִֽי נָ֣א נַפְשִׁ֑/י וַ/יֹּ֛אמֶר הַ/עוֹדֶ֥/נּוּ חַ֖י אָחִ֥/י הֽוּא
verses.translit: vychgrv shqym bmtnyhm vchblym br'shyhm vyb'v 'l mlkh yshr'l vy'mrv 'bdkh bn hdd 'mr tchy n' npshy vy'mr h'vdnv chy 'chy hv'
verses.translation: So they girded sackcloth on their loins, and put ropes on their heads, and came to the king of Israel, and said, Thy servant Ben-hadad saith, I pray thee, let me live. And he said, Is he yet alive? he is my brother.

verses.original: וְ/הָ/אֲנָשִׁים֩ יְנַחֲשׁ֨וּ וַֽ/יְמַהֲר֜וּ וַ/יַּחְלְט֣וּ הֲ/מִמֶּ֗/נּוּ וַ/יֹּֽאמְרוּ֙ אָחִ֣י/ךָ בֶן הֲדַ֔ד וַ/יֹּ֖אמֶר בֹּ֣אוּ קָחֻ֑/הוּ וַ/יֵּצֵ֤א אֵלָי/ו֙ בֶּן הֲדַ֔ד וַֽ/יַּעֲלֵ֖/הוּ עַל הַ/מֶּרְכָּבָֽה
verses.translit: vh'nshym ynchshv vymhrv vychltv hmmnv vy'mrv 'chykh bn hdd vy'mr b'v qchhv vyts' 'lyv bn hdd vy'lhv 'l hmrkhbh
verses.translation: Now the men did diligently observe whether any thing would come from him, and did hastily catch it: and they said, Thy brother Ben-hadad. Then he said, Go ye, bring him. Then Ben-hadad came forth to him; and he caused him to come up into the chariot.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֣אמֶר אֵלָ֡י/ו הֶ/עָרִ֣ים אֲשֶׁר לָֽקַח אָבִ/י֩ מֵ/אֵ֨ת אָבִ֜י/ךָ אָשִׁ֗יב וְ֠/חוּצוֹת תָּשִׂ֨ים לְ/ךָ֤ בְ/דַמֶּ֨שֶׂק֙ כַּ/אֲשֶׁר שָׂ֤ם אָבִ/י֙ בְּ/שֹׁ֣מְר֔וֹן וַ/אֲנִ֖י בַּ/בְּרִ֣ית אֲשַׁלְּחֶ֑/ךָּ וַ/יִּכְרָת ל֥/וֹ בְרִ֖ית וַֽ/יְשַׁלְּחֵֽ/הוּ
verses.translit: vy'mr 'lyv h'rym 'shr lqch 'by m't 'bykh 'shyb vchvtsvt tshym lkh bdmshq kh'shr shm 'by bshmrvn v'ny bbryt 'shlchkh vykhrt lv bryt vyshlchhv
verses.translation: And Ben-hadad said unto him, The cities, which my father took from thy father, I will restore; and thou shalt make streets for thee in Damascus, as my father made in Samaria. Then said Ahab , I will send thee away with this covenant. So he made a covenant with him, and sent him away.

verses.original: וְ/אִ֨ישׁ אֶחָ֜ד מִ/בְּנֵ֣י הַ/נְּבִיאִ֗ים אָמַ֧ר אֶל רֵעֵ֛/הוּ בִּ/דְבַ֥ר יְהוָ֖ה הַכֵּ֣י/נִי נָ֑א וַ/יְמָאֵ֥ן הָ/אִ֖ישׁ לְ/הַכֹּתֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: v'ysh 'chd mbny hnby'ym 'mr 'l r'hv bdbr yhvh hkhyny n' vym'n h'ysh lhkhtv
verses.translation: And a certain man of the sons of the prophets said unto his neighbour in the word of the LORD , Smite me, I pray thee. And the man refused to smite him.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֣אמֶר ל֗/וֹ יַ֚עַן אֲשֶׁ֤ר לֹֽא שָׁמַ֨עְתָּ֙ בְּ/ק֣וֹל יְהוָ֔ה הִנְּ/ךָ֤ הוֹלֵךְ֙ מֵֽ/אִתִּ֔/י וְ/הִכְּ/ךָ֖ הָ/אַרְיֵ֑ה וַ/יֵּ֨לֶךְ֙ מֵֽ/אֶצְל֔/וֹ וַ/יִּמְצָאֵ֥/הוּ הָ/אַרְיֵ֖ה וַ/יַּכֵּֽ/הוּ
verses.translit: vy'mr lv y'n 'shr l' shm't bqvl yhvh hnkh hvlkh m'ty vhkhkh h'ryh vylkh m'tslv vymts'hv h'ryh vykhhv
verses.translation: Then said he unto him, Because thou hast not obeyed the voice of the LORD , behold, as soon as thou art departed from me, a lion shall slay thee. And as soon as he was departed from him, a lion found him, and slew him.

verses.original: וַ/יִּמְצָא֙ אִ֣ישׁ אַחֵ֔ר וַ/יֹּ֖אמֶר הַכֵּ֣י/נִי נָ֑א וַ/יַּכֵּ֥/הוּ הָ/אִ֖ישׁ הַכֵּ֥ה וּ/פָצֹֽעַ
verses.translit: vymts' 'ysh 'chr vy'mr hkhyny n' vykhhv h'ysh hkhh vpts'
verses.translation: Then he found another man, and said, Smite me, I pray thee. And the man smote him, so that in smiting he wounded him .

verses.original: וַ/יֵּ֨לֶךְ֙ הַ/נָּבִ֔יא וַ/יַּעֲמֹ֥ד לַ/מֶּ֖לֶךְ עַל הַ/דָּ֑רֶךְ וַ/יִּתְחַפֵּ֥שׂ בָּ/אֲפֵ֖ר עַל עֵינָֽי/ו
verses.translit: vylkh hnby' vy'md lmlkh 'l hdrkh vytchpsh b'pr 'l 'ynyv
verses.translation: So the prophet departed, and waited for the king by the way, and disguised himself with ashes upon his face.

verses.original: וַ/יְהִ֤י הַ/מֶּ֨לֶךְ֙ עֹבֵ֔ר וְ/ה֖וּא צָעַ֣ק אֶל הַ/מֶּ֑לֶךְ וַ/יֹּ֜אמֶר עַבְדְּ/ךָ֣ יָצָ֣א בְ/קֶֽרֶב הַ/מִּלְחָמָ֗ה וְ/הִנֵּֽה אִ֨ישׁ סָ֜ר וַ/יָּבֵ֧א אֵלַ֣/י אִ֗ישׁ וַ/יֹּ֨אמֶר֙ שְׁמֹר֙ אֶת הָ/אִ֣ישׁ הַ/זֶּ֔ה אִם הִפָּקֵד֙ יִפָּקֵ֔ד וְ/הָיְתָ֤ה נַפְשְׁ/ךָ֙ תַּ֣חַת נַפְשׁ֔/וֹ א֥וֹ כִכַּר כֶּ֖סֶף תִּשְׁקֽוֹל
verses.translit: vyhy hmlkh 'br vhv' ts'q 'l hmlkh vy'mr 'bdkh yts' bqrb hmlchmh vhnh 'ysh sr vyb' 'ly 'ysh vy'mr shmr 't h'ysh hzh 'm hpqd ypqd vhyth npshkh tcht npshv 'v khkhr khsf tshqvl
verses.translation: And as the king passed by, he cried unto the king: and he said, Thy servant went out into the midst of the battle; and, behold, a man turned aside, and brought a man unto me, and said, Keep this man: if by any means he be missing, then shall thy life be for his life, or else thou shalt pay a talent of silver.

verses.original: וַ/יְהִ֣י עַבְדְּ/ךָ֗ עֹשֵׂ֥ה הֵ֛נָּה וָ/הֵ֖נָּה וְ/ה֣וּא אֵינֶ֑/נּוּ וַ/יֹּ֨אמֶר אֵלָ֧י/ו מֶֽלֶךְ יִשְׂרָאֵ֛ל כֵּ֥ן מִשְׁפָּטֶ֖/ךָ אַתָּ֥ה חָרָֽצְתָּ
verses.translit: vyhy 'bdkh 'shh hnh vhnh vhv' 'ynnv vy'mr 'lyv mlkh yshr'l khn mshptkh 'th chrtst
verses.translation: And as thy servant was busy here and there, he was gone. And the king of Israel said unto him, So shall thy judgment be; thyself hast decided it .

verses.original: וַ/יְמַהֵ֕ר וַ/יָּ֨סַר֙ אֶת הָ֣/אֲפֵ֔ר מ/על מֵ/עֲלֵ֖י עֵינָ֑י/ו וַ/יַּכֵּ֤ר אֹת/וֹ֙ מֶ֣לֶךְ יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל כִּ֥י מֵֽ/הַ/נְּבִאִ֖ים הֽוּא
verses.translit: vymhr vysr 't h'pr m'l m'ly 'ynyv vykhr 'tv mlkh yshr'l khy mhnb'ym hv'
verses.translation: And he hasted, and took the ashes away from his face; and the king of Israel discerned him that he was of the prophets.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֣אמֶר אֵלָ֗י/ו כֹּ֚ה אָמַ֣ר יְהוָ֔ה יַ֛עַן שִׁלַּ֥חְתָּ אֶת אִישׁ חֶרְמִ֖/י מִ/יָּ֑ד וְ/הָיְתָ֤ה נַפְשְׁ/ךָ֙ תַּ֣חַת נַפְשׁ֔/וֹ וְ/עַמְּ/ךָ֖ תַּ֥חַת עַמּֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: vy'mr 'lyv khh 'mr yhvh y'n shlcht 't 'ysh chrmy myd vhyth npshkh tcht npshv v'mkh tcht 'mv
verses.translation: And he said unto him, Thus saith the LORD , Because thou hast let go out of thy hand a man whom I appointed to utter destruction, therefore thy life shall go for his life, and thy people for his people.

verses.original: וַ/יֵּ֧לֶךְ מֶֽלֶךְ יִשְׂרָאֵ֛ל עַל בֵּית֖/וֹ סַ֣ר וְ/זָעֵ֑ף וַ/יָּבֹ֖א שֹׁמְרֽוֹנָ/ה
verses.translit: vylkh mlkh yshr'l 'l bytv sr vz'f vyb' shmrvnh
verses.translation: And the king of Israel went to his house heavy and displeased, and came to Samaria.

verses.original: וַ/יְהִ֗י אַחַר֙ הַ/דְּבָרִ֣ים הָ/אֵ֔לֶּה כֶּ֧רֶם הָיָ֛ה לְ/נָב֥וֹת הַ/יִּזְרְעֵאלִ֖י אֲשֶׁ֣ר בְּ/יִזְרְעֶ֑אל אֵ֚צֶל הֵיכַ֣ל אַחְאָ֔ב מֶ֖לֶךְ שֹׁמְרֽוֹן
verses.translit: vyhy 'chr hdbrym h'lh khrm hyh lnbvt hyzr''ly 'shr byzr''l 'tsl hykhl 'ch'b mlkh shmrvn
verses.translation: And it came to pass after these things, that Naboth the Jezreelite had a vineyard, which was in Jezreel, hard by the palace of Ahab king of Samaria.

verses.original: וַ/יְדַבֵּ֣ר אַחְאָ֣ב אֶל נָב֣וֹת לֵ/אמֹר֩ תְּנָ/ה לִּ֨/י אֶֽת כַּרְמְ/ךָ֜ וִֽ/יהִי לִ֣/י לְ/גַן יָרָ֗ק כִּ֣י ה֤וּא קָרוֹב֙ אֵ֣צֶל בֵּיתִ֔/י וְ/אֶתְּנָ֤ה לְ/ךָ֙ תַּחְתָּ֔י/ו כֶּ֖רֶם ט֣וֹב מִמֶּ֑/נּוּ אִ֚ם ט֣וֹב בְּ/עֵינֶ֔י/ךָ אֶתְּנָה לְ/ךָ֥ כֶ֖סֶף מְחִ֥יר זֶֽה
verses.translit: vydbr 'ch'b 'l nbvt l'mr tnh ly 't khrmkh vyhy ly lgn yrq khy hv' qrvb 'tsl byty v'tnh lkh tchtyv khrm tvb mmnv 'm tvb b'ynykh 'tnh lkh khsf mchyr zh
verses.translation: And Ahab spake unto Naboth, saying, Give me thy vineyard, that I may have it for a garden of herbs, because it is near unto my house: and I will give thee for it a better vineyard than it; or , if it seem good to thee, I will give thee the worth of it in money.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֥אמֶר נָב֖וֹת אֶל אַחְאָ֑ב חָלִ֤ילָ/ה לִּ/י֙ מֵֽ/יהוָ֔ה מִ/תִּתִּ֛/י אֶת נַחֲלַ֥ת אֲבֹתַ֖/י לָֽ/ךְ
verses.translit: vy'mr nbvt 'l 'ch'b chlylh ly myhvh mtty 't nchlt 'bty lkh
verses.translation: And Naboth said to Ahab, The LORD forbid it me, that I should give the inheritance of my fathers unto thee.

verses.original: וַ/יָּבֹא֩ אַחְאָ֨ב אֶל בֵּית֜/וֹ סַ֣ר וְ/זָעֵ֗ף עַל הַ/דָּבָר֙ אֲשֶׁר דִּבֶּ֣ר אֵלָ֗י/ו נָבוֹת֙ הַ/יִּזְרְעֵאלִ֔י וַ/יֹּ֕אמֶר לֹֽא אֶתֵּ֥ן לְ/ךָ֖ אֶת נַחֲלַ֣ת אֲבוֹתָ֑/י וַ/יִּשְׁכַּב֙ עַל מִטָּת֔/וֹ וַ/יַּסֵּ֥ב אֶת פָּנָ֖י/ו וְ/לֹֽא אָ֥כַל לָֽחֶם
verses.translit: vyb' 'ch'b 'l bytv sr vz'f 'l hdbr 'shr dbr 'lyv nbvt hyzr''ly vy'mr l' 'tn lkh 't nchlt 'bvty vyshkhb 'l mttv vysb 't pnyv vl' 'khl lchm
verses.translation: And Ahab came into his house heavy and displeased because of the word which Naboth the Jezreelite had spoken to him: for he had said, I will not give thee the inheritance of my fathers. And he laid him down upon his bed, and turned away his face, and would eat no bread.

verses.original: וַ/תָּבֹ֥א אֵלָ֖י/ו אִיזֶ֣בֶל אִשְׁתּ֑/וֹ וַ/תְּדַבֵּ֣ר אֵלָ֗י/ו מַה זֶּה֙ רוּחֲ/ךָ֣ סָרָ֔ה וְ/אֵינְ/ךָ֖ אֹכֵ֥ל לָֽחֶם
verses.translit: vtb' 'lyv 'yzbl 'shtv vtdbr 'lyv mh zh rvchkh srh v'ynkh 'khl lchm
verses.translation: But Jezebel his wife came to him, and said unto him, Why is thy spirit so sad, that thou eatest no bread?

verses.original: וַ/יְדַבֵּ֣ר אֵלֶ֗י/הָ כִּֽי אֲ֠דַבֵּר אֶל נָב֨וֹת הַ/יִּזְרְעֵאלִ֜י וָ/אֹ֣מַר ל֗/וֹ תְּנָ/ה לִּ֤/י אֶֽת כַּרְמְ/ךָ֙ בְּ/כֶ֔סֶף א֚וֹ אִם חָפֵ֣ץ אַתָּ֔ה אֶתְּנָה לְ/ךָ֥ כֶ֖רֶם תַּחְתָּ֑י/ו וַ/יֹּ֕אמֶר לֹֽא אֶתֵּ֥ן לְ/ךָ֖ אֶת כַּרְמִֽ/י
verses.translit: vydbr 'lyh khy 'dbr 'l nbvt hyzr''ly v'mr lv tnh ly 't khrmkh bkhsf 'v 'm chpts 'th 'tnh lkh khrm tchtyv vy'mr l' 'tn lkh 't khrmy
verses.translation: And he said unto her, Because I spake unto Naboth the Jezreelite, and said unto him, Give me thy vineyard for money; or else, if it please thee, I will give thee another vineyard for it: and he answered, I will not give thee my vineyard.

verses.original: וַ/תֹּ֤אמֶר אֵלָי/ו֙ אִיזֶ֣בֶל אִשְׁתּ֔/וֹ אַתָּ֕ה עַתָּ֛ה תַּעֲשֶׂ֥ה מְלוּכָ֖ה עַל יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל ק֤וּם אֱכָל לֶ֨חֶם֙ וְ/יִטַ֣ב לִבֶּ֔/ךָ אֲנִי֙ אֶתֵּ֣ן לְ/ךָ֔ אֶת כֶּ֖רֶם נָב֥וֹת הַ/יִּזְרְעֵאלִֽי
verses.translit: vt'mr 'lyv 'yzbl 'shtv 'th 'th t'shh mlvkhh 'l yshr'l qvm 'khl lchm vytb lbkh 'ny 'tn lkh 't khrm nbvt hyzr''ly
verses.translation: And Jezebel his wife said unto him, Dost thou now govern the kingdom of Israel? arise, and eat bread, and let thine heart be merry: I will give thee the vineyard of Naboth the Jezreelite.

verses.original: וַ/תִּכְתֹּ֤ב סְפָרִים֙ בְּ/שֵׁ֣ם אַחְאָ֔ב וַ/תַּחְתֹּ֖ם בְּ/חֹתָמ֑/וֹ וַ/תִּשְׁלַ֣ח ה/ספרים סְפָרִ֗ים אֶל הַ/זְקֵנִ֤ים וְ/אֶל הַֽ/חֹרִים֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר בְּ/עִיר֔/וֹ הַ/יֹּשְׁבִ֖ים אֶת נָבֽוֹת
verses.translit: vtkhtb sprym bshm 'ch'b vtchtm bchtmv vtshlch hsprym sprym 'l hzqnym v'l hchrym 'shr b'yrv hyshbym 't nbvt
verses.translation: So she wrote letters in Ahab’s name, and sealed them with his seal, and sent the letters unto the elders and to the nobles that were in his city, dwelling with Naboth.

verses.original: וַ/תִּכְתֹּ֥ב בַּ/סְּפָרִ֖ים לֵ/אמֹ֑ר קִֽרְאוּ צ֔וֹם וְ/הוֹשִׁ֥יבוּ אֶת נָב֖וֹת בְּ/רֹ֥אשׁ הָ/עָֽם
verses.translit: vtkhtb bsprym l'mr qr'v tsvm vhvshybv 't nbvt br'sh h'm
verses.translation: And she wrote in the letters, saying, Proclaim a fast, and set Naboth on high among the people:

verses.original: וְ֠/הוֹשִׁיבוּ שְׁנַ֨יִם אֲנָשִׁ֥ים בְּנֵֽי בְלִיַּעַל֮ נֶגְדּ/וֹ֒ וִ/יעִדֻ֣/הוּ לֵ/אמֹ֔ר בֵּרַ֥כְתָּ אֱלֹהִ֖ים וָ/מֶ֑לֶךְ וְ/הוֹצִיאֻ֥/הוּ וְ/סִקְלֻ֖/הוּ וְ/יָמֹֽת
verses.translit: vhvshybv shnym 'nshym bny bly'l ngdv vy'dhv l'mr brkht 'lhym vmlkh vhvtsy'hv vsqlhv vymt
verses.translation: And set two men, sons of Belial, before him, to bear witness against him, saying, Thou didst blaspheme God and the king. And then carry him out, and stone him, that he may die.

verses.original: וַ/יַּעֲשׂוּ֩ אַנְשֵׁ֨י עִיר֜/וֹ הַ/זְּקֵנִ֣ים וְ/הַ/חֹרִ֗ים אֲשֶׁ֤ר הַ/יֹּֽשְׁבִים֙ בְּ/עִיר֔/וֹ כַּ/אֲשֶׁ֛ר שָׁלְחָ֥ה אֲלֵי/הֶ֖ם אִיזָ֑בֶל כַּ/אֲשֶׁ֤ר כָּתוּב֙ בַּ/סְּפָרִ֔ים אֲשֶׁ֥ר שָׁלְחָ֖ה אֲלֵי/הֶֽם
verses.translit: vy'shv 'nshy 'yrv hzqnym vhchrym 'shr hyshbym b'yrv kh'shr shlchh 'lyhm 'yzbl kh'shr khtvb bsprym 'shr shlchh 'lyhm
verses.translation: And the men of his city, even the elders and the nobles who were the inhabitants in his city, did as Jezebel had sent unto them, and as it was written in the letters which she had sent unto them.

verses.original: קָרְא֖וּ צ֑וֹם וְ/הֹשִׁ֥יבוּ אֶת נָב֖וֹת בְּ/רֹ֥אשׁ הָ/עָֽם
verses.translit: qr'v tsvm vhshybv 't nbvt br'sh h'm
verses.translation: They proclaimed a fast, and set Naboth on high among the people.

verses.original: וַ֠/יָּבֹאוּ שְׁנֵ֨י הָ/אֲנָשִׁ֥ים בְּנֵֽי בְלִיַּעַל֮ וַ/יֵּשְׁב֣וּ נֶגְדּ/וֹ֒ וַ/יְעִדֻ/הוּ֩ אַנְשֵׁ֨י הַ/בְּלִיַּ֜עַל אֶת נָב֗וֹת נֶ֤גֶד הָ/עָם֙ לֵ/אמֹ֔ר בֵּרַ֥ךְ נָב֛וֹת אֱלֹהִ֖ים וָ/מֶ֑לֶךְ וַ/יֹּצִאֻ֨/הוּ֙ מִ/ח֣וּץ לָ/עִ֔יר וַ/יִּסְקְלֻ֥/הוּ בָ/אֲבָנִ֖ים וַ/יָּמֹֽת
verses.translit: vyb'v shny h'nshym bny bly'l vyshbv ngdv vy'dhv 'nshy hbly'l 't nbvt ngd h'm l'mr brkh nbvt 'lhym vmlkh vyts'hv mchvts l'yr vysqlhv b'bnym vymt
verses.translation: And there came in two men, children of Belial, and sat before him: and the men of Belial witnessed against him, even against Naboth, in the presence of the people, saying, Naboth did blaspheme God and the king. Then they carried him forth out of the city, and stoned him with stones, that he died.

verses.original: וַֽ/יִּשְׁלְח֖וּ אֶל אִיזֶ֣בֶל לֵ/אמֹ֑ר סֻקַּ֥ל נָב֖וֹת וַ/יָּמֹֽת
verses.translit: vyshlchv 'l 'yzbl l'mr sql nbvt vymt
verses.translation: Then they sent to Jezebel, saying, Naboth is stoned, and is dead.

verses.original: וַֽ/יְהִי֙ כִּ/שְׁמֹ֣עַ אִיזֶ֔בֶל כִּֽי סֻקַּ֥ל נָב֖וֹת וַ/יָּמֹ֑ת וַ/תֹּ֨אמֶר אִיזֶ֜בֶל אֶל אַחְאָ֗ב ק֣וּם רֵ֞שׁ אֶת כֶּ֣רֶם נָב֣וֹת הַ/יִּזְרְעֵאלִ֗י אֲשֶׁ֤ר מֵאֵן֙ לָ/תֶת לְ/ךָ֣ בְ/כֶ֔סֶף כִּ֣י אֵ֥ין נָב֛וֹת חַ֖י כִּי מֵֽת
verses.translit: vyhy khshm' 'yzbl khy sql nbvt vymt vt'mr 'yzbl 'l 'ch'b qvm rsh 't khrm nbvt hyzr''ly 'shr m'n ltt lkh bkhsf khy 'yn nbvt chy khy mt
verses.translation: And it came to pass, when Jezebel heard that Naboth was stoned, and was dead, that Jezebel said to Ahab, Arise, take possession of the vineyard of Naboth the Jezreelite, which he refused to give thee for money: for Naboth is not alive, but dead.

verses.original: וַ/יְהִ֛י כִּ/שְׁמֹ֥עַ אַחְאָ֖ב כִּ֣י מֵ֣ת נָב֑וֹת וַ/יָּ֣קָם אַחְאָ֗ב לָ/רֶ֛דֶת אֶל כֶּ֛רֶם נָב֥וֹת הַ/יִּזְרְעֵאלִ֖י לְ/רִשְׁתּֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: vyhy khshm' 'ch'b khy mt nbvt vyqm 'ch'b lrdt 'l khrm nbvt hyzr''ly lrshtv
verses.translation: And it came to pass, when Ahab heard that Naboth was dead, that Ahab rose up to go down to the vineyard of Naboth the Jezreelite, to take possession of it.

verses.original: וַ/יְהִי֙ דְּבַר יְהוָ֔ה אֶל אֵלִיָּ֥הוּ הַ/תִּשְׁבִּ֖י לֵ/אמֹֽר
verses.translit: vyhy dbr yhvh 'l 'lyhv htshby l'mr
verses.translation: And the word of the LORD came to Elijah the Tishbite, saying,

verses.original: ק֣וּם רֵ֗ד לִ/קְרַ֛את אַחְאָ֥ב מֶֽלֶךְ יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל אֲשֶׁ֣ר בְּ/שֹׁמְר֑וֹן הִנֵּה֙ בְּ/כֶ֣רֶם נָב֔וֹת אֲשֶׁר יָ֥רַד שָׁ֖ם לְ/רִשְׁתּֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: qvm rd lqr't 'ch'b mlkh yshr'l 'shr bshmrvn hnh bkhrm nbvt 'shr yrd shm lrshtv
verses.translation: Arise, go down to meet Ahab king of Israel, which is in Samaria: behold, he is in the vineyard of Naboth, whither he is gone down to possess it.

verses.original: וְ/דִבַּרְתָּ֨ אֵלָ֜י/ו לֵ/אמֹ֗ר כֹּ֚ה אָמַ֣ר יְהוָ֔ה הֲ/רָצַ֖חְתָּ וְ/גַם יָרָ֑שְׁתָּ וְ/דִבַּרְתָּ֨ אֵלָ֜י/ו לֵ/אמֹ֗ר כֹּ֚ה אָמַ֣ר יְהוָ֔ה בִּ/מְק֗וֹם אֲשֶׁ֨ר לָקְק֤וּ הַ/כְּלָבִים֙ אֶת דַּ֣ם נָב֔וֹת יָלֹ֧קּוּ הַ/כְּלָבִ֛ים אֶת דָּמְ/ךָ֖ גַּם אָֽתָּה
verses.translit: vdbrt 'lyv l'mr khh 'mr yhvh hrtscht vgm yrsht vdbrt 'lyv l'mr khh 'mr yhvh bmqvm 'shr lqqv hkhlbym 't dm nbvt ylqv hkhlbym 't dmkh gm 'th
verses.translation: And thou shalt speak unto him, saying, Thus saith the LORD , Hast thou killed, and also taken possession? And thou shalt speak unto him, saying, Thus saith the LORD , In the place where dogs licked the blood of Naboth shall dogs lick thy blood, even thine.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֤אמֶר אַחְאָב֙ אֶל אֵ֣לִיָּ֔הוּ הַֽ/מְצָאתַ֖/נִי אֹיְבִ֑/י וַ/יֹּ֣אמֶר מָצָ֔אתִי יַ֚עַן הִתְמַכֶּרְ/ךָ֔ לַ/עֲשׂ֥וֹת הָ/רַ֖ע בְּ/עֵינֵ֥י יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: vy'mr 'ch'b 'l 'lyhv hmts'tny 'yby vy'mr mts'ty y'n htmkhrkh l'shvt hr' b'yny yhvh
verses.translation: And Ahab said to Elijah, Hast thou found me, O mine enemy? And he answered, I have found thee: because thou hast sold thyself to work evil in the sight of the LORD .

verses.original: הִנְ/נִ֨י מבי מֵבִ֤יא אֵלֶ֨י/ךָ֙ רָעָ֔ה וּ/בִעַרְתִּ֖י אַחֲרֶ֑י/ךָ וְ/הִכְרַתִּ֤י לְ/אַחְאָב֙ מַשְׁתִּ֣ין בְּ/קִ֔יר וְ/עָצ֥וּר וְ/עָז֖וּב בְּ/יִשְׂרָאֵֽל
verses.translit: hnny mby mby' 'lykh r'h vb'rty 'chrykh vhkhrty l'ch'b mshtyn bqyr v'tsvr v'zvb byshr'l
verses.translation: Behold, I will bring evil upon thee, and will take away thy posterity, and will cut off from Ahab him that pisseth against the wall, and him that is shut up and left in Israel,

verses.original: וְ/נָתַתִּ֣י אֶת בֵּיתְ/ךָ֗ כְּ/בֵית֙ יָרָבְעָ֣ם בֶּן נְבָ֔ט וּ/כְ/בֵ֖ית בַּעְשָׁ֣א בֶן אֲחִיָּ֑ה אֶל הַ/כַּ֨עַס֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר הִכְעַ֔סְתָּ וַֽ/תַּחֲטִ֖א אֶת יִשְׂרָאֵֽל
verses.translit: vntty 't bytkh khbyt yrb'm bn nbt vkhbyt b'sh' bn 'chyh 'l hkh's 'shr hkh'st vtcht' 't yshr'l
verses.translation: And will make thine house like the house of Jeroboam the son of Nebat, and like the house of Baasha the son of Ahijah, for the provocation wherewith thou hast provoked me to anger, and made Israel to sin.

verses.original: וְ/גַ֨ם לְ/אִיזֶ֔בֶל דִּבֶּ֥ר יְהוָ֖ה לֵ/אמֹ֑ר הַ/כְּלָבִ֛ים יֹאכְל֥וּ אֶת אִיזֶ֖בֶל בְּ/חֵ֥ל יִזְרְעֶֽאל
verses.translit: vgm l'yzbl dbr yhvh l'mr hkhlbym y'khlv 't 'yzbl bchl yzr''l
verses.translation: And of Jezebel also spake the LORD , saying, The dogs shall eat Jezebel by the wall of Jezreel.

verses.original: הַ/מֵּ֤ת לְ/אַחְאָב֙ בָּ/עִ֔יר יֹאכְל֖וּ הַ/כְּלָבִ֑ים וְ/הַ/מֵּת֙ בַּ/שָּׂדֶ֔ה יֹאכְל֖וּ ע֥וֹף הַ/שָּׁמָֽיִם
verses.translit: hmt l'ch'b b'yr y'khlv hkhlbym vhmt bshdh y'khlv 'vf hshmym
verses.translation: Him that dieth of Ahab in the city the dogs shall eat; and him that dieth in the field shall the fowls of the air eat.

verses.original: רַ֚ק לֹֽא הָיָ֣ה כְ/אַחְאָ֔ב אֲשֶׁ֣ר הִתְמַכֵּ֔ר לַ/עֲשׂ֥וֹת הָ/רַ֖ע בְּ/עֵינֵ֣י יְהוָ֑ה אֲשֶׁר הֵסַ֥תָּה אֹת֖/וֹ אִיזֶ֥בֶל אִשְׁתּֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: rq l' hyh kh'ch'b 'shr htmkhr l'shvt hr' b'yny yhvh 'shr hsth 'tv 'yzbl 'shtv
verses.translation: But there was none like unto Ahab, which did sell himself to work wickedness in the sight of the LORD , whom Jezebel his wife stirred up.

verses.original: וַ/יַּתְעֵ֣ב מְאֹ֔ד לָ/לֶ֖כֶת אַחֲרֵ֣י הַ/גִּלֻּלִ֑ים כְּ/כֹל֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר עָשׂ֣וּ הָ/אֱמֹרִ֔י אֲשֶׁר֙ הוֹרִ֣ישׁ יְהוָ֔ה מִ/פְּנֵ֖י בְּנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל
verses.translit: vyt'b m'd llkht 'chry hgllym khkhl 'shr 'shv h'mry 'shr hvrysh yhvh mpny bny yshr'l
verses.translation: And he did very abominably in following idols, according to all things as did the Amorites, whom the LORD cast out before the children of Israel.

verses.original: וַ/יְהִי֩ כִ/שְׁמֹ֨עַ אַחְאָ֜ב אֶת הַ/דְּבָרִ֤ים הָ/אֵ֨לֶּה֙ וַ/יִּקְרַ֣ע בְּגָדָ֔י/ו וַ/יָּֽשֶׂם שַׂ֥ק עַל בְּשָׂר֖/וֹ וַ/יָּצ֑וֹם וַ/יִּשְׁכַּ֣ב בַּ/שָּׂ֔ק וַ/יְהַלֵּ֖ךְ אַֽט
verses.translit: vyhy khshm' 'ch'b 't hdbrym h'lh vyqr' bgdyv vyshm shq 'l bshrv vytsvm vyshkhb bshq vyhlkh 't
verses.translation: And it came to pass, when Ahab heard those words, that he rent his clothes, and put sackcloth upon his flesh, and fasted, and lay in sackcloth, and went softly.

verses.original: וַֽ/יְהִי֙ דְּבַר יְהוָ֔ה אֶל אֵלִיָּ֥הוּ הַ/תִּשְׁבִּ֖י לֵ/אמֹֽר
verses.translit: vyhy dbr yhvh 'l 'lyhv htshby l'mr
verses.translation: And the word of the LORD came to Elijah the Tishbite, saying,

verses.original: הֲֽ/רָאִ֔יתָ כִּֽי נִכְנַ֥ע אַחְאָ֖ב מִ/לְּ/פָנָ֑/י יַ֜עַן כִּֽי נִכְנַ֣ע מִ/פָּנַ֗/י לֹֽא אבי אָבִ֤יא הָֽ/רָעָה֙ בְּ/יָמָ֔י/ו בִּ/ימֵ֣י בְנ֔/וֹ אָבִ֥יא הָ/רָעָ֖ה עַל בֵּיתֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: hr'yt khy nkhn' 'ch'b mlpny y'n khy nkhn' mpny l' 'by 'by' hr'h bymyv bymy bnv 'by' hr'h 'l bytv
verses.translation: Seest thou how Ahab humbleth himself before me? because he humbleth himself before me, I will not bring the evil in his days: but in his son’s days will I bring the evil upon his house.

verses.original: וַ/יֵּשְׁב֖וּ שָׁלֹ֣שׁ שָׁנִ֑ים אֵ֚ין מִלְחָמָ֔ה בֵּ֥ין אֲרָ֖ם וּ/בֵ֥ין יִשְׂרָאֵֽל
verses.translit: vyshbv shlsh shnym 'yn mlchmh byn 'rm vbyn yshr'l
verses.translation: And they continued three years without war between Syria and Israel.

verses.original: וַ/יְהִ֖י בַּ/שָּׁנָ֣ה הַ/שְּׁלִישִׁ֑ית וַ/יֵּ֛רֶד יְהוֹשָׁפָ֥ט מֶֽלֶךְ יְהוּדָ֖ה אֶל מֶ֥לֶךְ יִשְׂרָאֵֽל
verses.translit: vyhy bshnh hshlyshyt vyrd yhvshpt mlkh yhvdh 'l mlkh yshr'l
verses.translation: And it came to pass in the third year, that Jehoshaphat the king of Judah came down to the king of Israel.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֤אמֶר מֶֽלֶךְ יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ אֶל עֲבָדָ֔י/ו הַ/יְדַעְתֶּ֕ם כִּֽי לָ֖/נוּ רָמֹ֣ת גִּלְעָ֑ד וַ/אֲנַ֣חְנוּ מַחְשִׁ֔ים מִ/קַּ֣חַת אֹתָ֔/הּ מִ/יַּ֖ד מֶ֥לֶךְ אֲרָֽם
verses.translit: vy'mr mlkh yshr'l 'l 'bdyv hyd'tm khy lnv rmt gl'd v'nchnv mchshym mqcht 'th myd mlkh 'rm
verses.translation: And the king of Israel said unto his servants, Know ye that Ramoth in Gilead is ours, and we be still, and take it not out of the hand of the king of Syria?

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֨אמֶר֙ אֶל יְה֣וֹשָׁפָ֔ט הֲ/תֵלֵ֥ךְ אִתִּ֛/י לַ/מִּלְחָמָ֖ה רָמֹ֣ת גִּלְעָ֑ד וַ/יֹּ֤אמֶר יְהֽוֹשָׁפָט֙ אֶל מֶ֣לֶךְ יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל כָּמ֧וֹ/נִי כָמ֛וֹ/ךָ כְּ/עַמִּ֥/י כְ/עַמֶּ֖/ךָ כְּ/סוּסַ֥/י כְּ/סוּסֶֽי/ךָ
verses.translit: vy'mr 'l yhvshpt htlkh 'ty lmlchmh rmt gl'd vy'mr yhvshpt 'l mlkh yshr'l khmvny khmvkh kh'my kh'mkh khsvsy khsvsykh
verses.translation: And he said unto Jehoshaphat, Wilt thou go with me to battle to Ramoth-gilead? And Jehoshaphat said to the king of Israel, I am as thou art , my people as thy people, my horses as thy horses.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֥אמֶר יְהוֹשָׁפָ֖ט אֶל מֶ֣לֶךְ יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל דְּרָשׁ נָ֥א כַ/יּ֖וֹם אֶת דְּבַ֥ר יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: vy'mr yhvshpt 'l mlkh yshr'l drsh n' khyvm 't dbr yhvh
verses.translation: And Jehoshaphat said unto the king of Israel, Enquire, I pray thee, at the word of the LORD to day.

verses.original: וַ/יִּקְבֹּ֨ץ מֶֽלֶךְ יִשְׂרָאֵ֥ל אֶֽת הַ/נְּבִיאִים֮ כְּ/אַרְבַּ֣ע מֵא֣וֹת אִישׁ֒ וַ/יֹּ֣אמֶר אֲלֵ/הֶ֗ם הַ/אֵלֵ֞ךְ עַל רָמֹ֥ת גִּלְעָ֛ד לַ/מִּלְחָמָ֖ה אִם אֶחְדָּ֑ל וַ/יֹּאמְר֣וּ עֲלֵ֔ה וְ/יִתֵּ֥ן אֲדֹנָ֖/י בְּ/יַ֥ד הַ/מֶּֽלֶךְ
verses.translit: vyqbts mlkh yshr'l 't hnby'ym kh'rb' m'vt 'ysh vy'mr 'lhm h'lkh 'l rmt gl'd lmlchmh 'm 'chdl vy'mrv 'lh vytn 'dny byd hmlkh
verses.translation: Then the king of Israel gathered the prophets together, about four hundred men, and said unto them, Shall I go against Ramoth-gilead to battle, or shall I forbear? And they said, Go up; for the Lord shall deliver it into the hand of the king.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֨אמֶר֙ יְה֣וֹשָׁפָ֔ט הַ/אֵ֨ין פֹּ֥ה נָבִ֛יא לַ/יהוָ֖ה ע֑וֹד וְ/נִדְרְשָׁ֖ה מֵ/אוֹתֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: vy'mr yhvshpt h'yn ph nby' lyhvh 'vd vndrshh m'vtv
verses.translation: And Jehoshaphat said, Is there not here a prophet of the LORD besides, that we might enquire of him?

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֣אמֶר מֶֽלֶךְ יִשְׂרָאֵ֣ל אֶֽל יְהוֹשָׁפָ֡ט ע֣וֹד אִישׁ אֶחָ֡ד לִ/דְרֹשׁ֩ אֶת יְהוָ֨ה מֵ/אֹת֜/וֹ וַ/אֲנִ֣י שְׂנֵאתִ֗י/ו כִּ֠י לֹֽא יִתְנַבֵּ֨א עָלַ֥/י טוֹב֙ כִּ֣י אִם רָ֔ע מִיכָ֖יְהוּ בֶּן יִמְלָ֑ה וַ/יֹּ֨אמֶר֙ יְה֣וֹשָׁפָ֔ט אַל יֹאמַ֥ר הַ/מֶּ֖לֶךְ כֵּֽן
verses.translit: vy'mr mlkh yshr'l 'l yhvshpt 'vd 'ysh 'chd ldrsh 't yhvh m'tv v'ny shn'tyv khy l' ytnb' 'ly tvb khy 'm r' mykhyhv bn ymlh vy'mr yhvshpt 'l y'mr hmlkh khn
verses.translation: And the king of Israel said unto Jehoshaphat, There is yet one man, Micaiah the son of Imlah, by whom we may enquire of the LORD : but I hate him; for he doth not prophesy good concerning me, but evil. And Jehoshaphat said, Let not the king say so.

verses.original: וַ/יִּקְרָא֙ מֶ֣לֶךְ יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל אֶל סָרִ֖יס אֶחָ֑ד וַ/יֹּ֕אמֶר מַהֲרָ֖/ה מִיכָ֥יְהוּ בֶן יִמְלָֽה
verses.translit: vyqr' mlkh yshr'l 'l srys 'chd vy'mr mhrh mykhyhv bn ymlh
verses.translation: Then the king of Israel called an officer, and said, Hasten hither Micaiah the son of Imlah.

verses.original: וּ/מֶ֣לֶךְ יִשְׂרָאֵ֡ל וִֽ/יהוֹשָׁפָ֣ט מֶֽלֶךְ יְהוּדָ֡ה יֹשְׁבִים֩ אִ֨ישׁ עַל כִּסְא֜/וֹ מְלֻבָּשִׁ֤ים בְּגָדִים֙ בְּ/גֹ֔רֶן פֶּ֖תַח שַׁ֣עַר שֹׁמְר֑וֹן וְ/כָ֨ל הַ/נְּבִיאִ֔ים מִֽתְנַבְּאִ֖ים לִ/פְנֵי/הֶֽם
verses.translit: vmlkh yshr'l vyhvshpt mlkh yhvdh yshbym 'ysh 'l khs'v mlbshym bgdym bgrn ptch sh'r shmrvn vkhl hnby'ym mtnb'ym lpnyhm
verses.translation: And the king of Israel and Jehoshaphat the king of Judah sat each on his throne, having put on their robes, in a void place in the entrance of the gate of Samaria; and all the prophets prophesied before them.

verses.original: וַ/יַּ֥עַשׂ ל֛/וֹ צִדְקִיָּ֥ה בֶֽן כְּנַעֲנָ֖ה קַרְנֵ֣י בַרְזֶ֑ל וַ/יֹּ֨אמֶר֙ כֹּֽה אָמַ֣ר יְהוָ֔ה בְּ/אֵ֛לֶּה תְּנַגַּ֥ח אֶת אֲרָ֖ם עַד כַּלֹּתָֽ/ם
verses.translit: vy'sh lv tsdqyh bn khn'nh qrny brzl vy'mr khh 'mr yhvh b'lh tngch 't 'rm 'd khltm
verses.translation: And Zedekiah the son of Chenaanah made him horns of iron: and he said, Thus saith the LORD , With these shalt thou push the Syrians, until thou have consumed them.

verses.original: וְ/כָל הַ/נְּבִאִ֔ים נִבְּאִ֥ים כֵּ֖ן לֵ/אמֹ֑ר עֲלֵ֞ה רָמֹ֤ת גִּלְעָד֙ וְ/הַצְלַ֔ח וְ/נָתַ֥ן יְהוָ֖ה בְּ/יַ֥ד הַ/מֶּֽלֶךְ
verses.translit: vkhl hnb'ym nb'ym khn l'mr 'lh rmt gl'd vhtslch vntn yhvh byd hmlkh
verses.translation: And all the prophets prophesied so, saying, Go up to Ramoth-gilead, and prosper: for the LORD shall deliver it into the king’s hand.

verses.original: וְ/הַ/מַּלְאָ֞ךְ אֲשֶׁר הָלַ֣ךְ לִ/קְרֹ֣א מִיכָ֗יְהוּ דִּבֶּ֤ר אֵלָי/ו֙ לֵ/אמֹ֔ר הִנֵּה נָ֞א דִּבְרֵ֧י הַ/נְּבִיאִ֛ים פֶּֽה אֶחָ֥ד ט֖וֹב אֶל הַ/מֶּ֑לֶךְ יְהִֽי נָ֣א דברי/ך דְבָרְ/ךָ֗ כִּ/דְבַ֛ר אַחַ֥ד מֵ/הֶ֖ם וְ/דִבַּ֥רְתָּ טּֽוֹב
verses.translit: vhml'kh 'shr hlkh lqr' mykhyhv dbr 'lyv l'mr hnh n' dbry hnby'ym ph 'chd tvb 'l hmlkh yhy n' dbrykh dbrkh khdbr 'chd mhm vdbrt tvb
verses.translation: And the messenger that was gone to call Micaiah spake unto him, saying, Behold now, the words of the prophets declare good unto the king with one mouth: let thy word, I pray thee, be like the word of one of them, and speak that which is good.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֖אמֶר מִיכָ֑יְהוּ חַי יְהוָ֕ה כִּ֠י אֶת אֲשֶׁ֨ר יֹאמַ֧ר יְהוָ֛ה אֵלַ֖/י אֹת֥/וֹ אֲדַבֵּֽר
verses.translit: vy'mr mykhyhv chy yhvh khy 't 'shr y'mr yhvh 'ly 'tv 'dbr
verses.translation: And Micaiah said, As the LORD liveth, what the LORD saith unto me, that will I speak.

verses.original: וַ/יָּבוֹא֮ אֶל הַ/מֶּלֶךְ֒ וַ/יֹּ֨אמֶר הַ/מֶּ֜לֶךְ אֵלָ֗י/ו מִיכָ֨יְהוּ֙ הֲ/נֵלֵ֞ךְ אֶל רָמֹ֥ת גִּלְעָ֛ד לַ/מִּלְחָמָ֖ה אִם נֶחְדָּ֑ל וַ/יֹּ֤אמֶר אֵלָי/ו֙ עֲלֵ֣ה וְ/הַצְלַ֔ח וְ/נָתַ֥ן יְהוָ֖ה בְּ/יַ֥ד הַ/מֶּֽלֶךְ
verses.translit: vybv' 'l hmlkh vy'mr hmlkh 'lyv mykhyhv hnlkh 'l rmt gl'd lmlchmh 'm nchdl vy'mr 'lyv 'lh vhtslch vntn yhvh byd hmlkh
verses.translation: So he came to the king. And the king said unto him, Micaiah, shall we go against Ramoth-gilead to battle, or shall we forbear? And he answered him, Go, and prosper: for the LORD shall deliver it into the hand of the king.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֤אמֶר אֵלָי/ו֙ הַ/מֶּ֔לֶךְ עַד כַּ/מֶּ֥ה פְעָמִ֖ים אֲנִ֣י מַשְׁבִּעֶ֑/ךָ אֲ֠שֶׁר לֹֽא תְדַבֵּ֥ר אֵלַ֛/י רַק אֱמֶ֖ת בְּ/שֵׁ֥ם יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: vy'mr 'lyv hmlkh 'd khmh p'mym 'ny mshb'kh 'shr l' tdbr 'ly rq 'mt bshm yhvh
verses.translation: And the king said unto him, How many times shall I adjure thee that thou tell me nothing but that which is true in the name of the LORD ?

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֗אמֶר רָאִ֤יתִי אֶת כָּל יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ נְפֹצִ֣ים אֶל הֶ/הָרִ֔ים כַּ/צֹּ֕אן אֲשֶׁ֥ר אֵין לָ/הֶ֖ם רֹעֶ֑ה וַ/יֹּ֤אמֶר יְהוָה֙ לֹֽא אֲדֹנִ֣ים לָ/אֵ֔לֶּה יָשׁ֥וּבוּ אִישׁ לְ/בֵית֖/וֹ בְּ/שָׁלֽוֹם
verses.translit: vy'mr r'yty 't khl yshr'l nptsym 'l hhrym khts'n 'shr 'yn lhm r'h vy'mr yhvh l' 'dnym l'lh yshvbv 'ysh lbytv bshlvm
verses.translation: And he said, I saw all Israel scattered upon the hills, as sheep that have not a shepherd: and the LORD said, These have no master: let them return every man to his house in peace.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֥אמֶר מֶֽלֶךְ יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל אֶל יְהוֹשָׁפָ֑ט הֲ/לוֹא֙ אָמַ֣רְתִּי אֵלֶ֔י/ךָ לֽוֹא יִתְנַבֵּ֥א עָלַ֛/י ט֖וֹב כִּ֥י אִם רָֽע
verses.translit: vy'mr mlkh yshr'l 'l yhvshpt hlv' 'mrty 'lykh lv' ytnb' 'ly tvb khy 'm r'
verses.translation: And the king of Israel said unto Jehoshaphat, Did I not tell thee that he would prophesy no good concerning me, but evil?

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֕אמֶר לָ/כֵ֖ן שְׁמַ֣ע דְּבַר יְהוָ֑ה רָאִ֤יתִי אֶת יְהוָה֙ יֹשֵׁ֣ב עַל כִּסְא֔/וֹ וְ/כָל צְבָ֤א הַ/שָּׁמַ֨יִם֙ עֹמֵ֣ד עָלָ֔י/ו מִ/ימִינ֖/וֹ וּ/מִ/שְּׂמֹאלֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: vy'mr lkhn shm' dbr yhvh r'yty 't yhvh yshb 'l khs'v vkhl tsb' hshmym 'md 'lyv mymynv vmshm'lv
verses.translation: And he said, Hear thou therefore the word of the LORD : I saw the LORD sitting on his throne, and all the host of heaven standing by him on his right hand and on his left.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֣אמֶר יְהוָ֗ה מִ֤י יְפַתֶּה֙ אֶת אַחְאָ֔ב וְ/יַ֕עַל וְ/יִפֹּ֖ל בְּ/רָמֹ֣ת גִּלְעָ֑ד וַ/יֹּ֤אמֶר זֶה֙ בְּ/כֹ֔ה וְ/זֶ֥ה אֹמֵ֖ר בְּ/כֹֽה
verses.translit: vy'mr yhvh my ypth 't 'ch'b vy'l vypl brmt gl'd vy'mr zh bkhh vzh 'mr bkhh
verses.translation: And the LORD said, Who shall persuade Ahab, that he may go up and fall at Ramoth-gilead? And one said on this manner, and another said on that manner.

verses.original: וַ/יֵּצֵ֣א הָ/ר֗וּחַ וַֽ/יַּעֲמֹד֙ לִ/פְנֵ֣י יְהוָ֔ה וַ/יֹּ֖אמֶר אֲנִ֣י אֲפַתֶּ֑/נּוּ וַ/יֹּ֧אמֶר יְהוָ֛ה אֵלָ֖י/ו בַּ/מָּֽה
verses.translit: vyts' hrvch vy'md lpny yhvh vy'mr 'ny 'ptnv vy'mr yhvh 'lyv bmh
verses.translation: And there came forth a spirit, and stood before the LORD , and said, I will persuade him.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֗אמֶר אֵצֵא֙ וְ/הָיִ֨יתִי֙ ר֣וּחַ שֶׁ֔קֶר בְּ/פִ֖י כָּל נְבִיאָ֑י/ו וַ/יֹּ֗אמֶר תְּפַתֶּה֙ וְ/גַם תּוּכָ֔ל צֵ֖א וַ/עֲשֵׂה כֵֽן
verses.translit: vy'mr 'ts' vhyyty rvch shqr bpy khl nby'yv vy'mr tpth vgm tvkhl ts' v'shh khn
verses.translation: And the LORD said unto him, Wherewith? And he said, I will go forth, and I will be a lying spirit in the mouth of all his prophets. And he said, Thou shalt persuade him , and prevail also: go forth, and do so.

verses.original: וְ/עַתָּ֗ה הִנֵּ֨ה נָתַ֤ן יְהוָה֙ ר֣וּחַ שֶׁ֔קֶר בְּ/פִ֖י כָּל נְבִיאֶ֣י/ךָ אֵ֑לֶּה וַֽ/יהוָ֔ה דִּבֶּ֥ר עָלֶ֖י/ךָ רָעָֽה
verses.translit: v'th hnh ntn yhvh rvch shqr bpy khl nby'ykh 'lh vyhvh dbr 'lykh r'h
verses.translation: Now therefore, behold, the LORD hath put a lying spirit in the mouth of all these thy prophets, and the LORD hath spoken evil concerning thee.

verses.original: וַ/יִּגַּשׁ֙ צִדְקִיָּ֣הוּ בֶֽן כְּנַעֲנָ֔ה וַ/יַּכֶּ֥ה אֶת מִיכָ֖יְהוּ עַל הַ/לֶּ֑חִי וַ/יֹּ֕אמֶר אֵי זֶ֨ה עָבַ֧ר רֽוּחַ יְהוָ֛ה מֵ/אִתִּ֖/י לְ/דַבֵּ֥ר אוֹתָֽ/ךְ
verses.translit: vygsh tsdqyhv bn khn'nh vykhh 't mykhyhv 'l hlchy vy'mr 'y zh 'br rvch yhvh m'ty ldbr 'vtkh
verses.translation: But Zedekiah the son of Chenaanah went near, and smote Micaiah on the cheek, and said, Which way went the Spirit of the LORD from me to speak unto thee?

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֣אמֶר מִיכָ֔יְהוּ הִנְּ/ךָ֥ רֹאֶ֖ה בַּ/יּ֣וֹם הַ/ה֑וּא אֲשֶׁ֥ר תָּבֹ֛א חֶ֥דֶר בְּ/חֶ֖דֶר לְ/הֵחָבֵֽה
verses.translit: vy'mr mykhyhv hnkh r'h byvm hhv' 'shr tb' chdr bchdr lhchbh
verses.translation: And Micaiah said, Behold, thou shalt see in that day, when thou shalt go into an inner chamber to hide thyself.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֨אמֶר֙ מֶ֣לֶךְ יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל קַ֚ח אֶת מִיכָ֔יְהוּ וַ/הֲשִׁיבֵ֖/הוּ אֶל אָמֹ֣ן שַׂר הָ/עִ֑יר וְ/אֶל יוֹאָ֖שׁ בֶּן הַ/מֶּֽלֶךְ
verses.translit: vy'mr mlkh yshr'l qch 't mykhyhv vhshybhv 'l 'mn shr h'yr v'l yv'sh bn hmlkh
verses.translation: And the king of Israel said, Take Micaiah, and carry him back unto Amon the governor of the city, and to Joash the king’s son;

verses.original: וְ/אָמַרְתָּ֗ כֹּ֚ה אָמַ֣ר הַ/מֶּ֔לֶךְ שִׂ֥ימוּ אֶת זֶ֖ה בֵּ֣ית הַ/כֶּ֑לֶא וְ/הַאֲכִילֻ֨/הוּ לֶ֤חֶם לַ֨חַץ֙ וּ/מַ֣יִם לַ֔חַץ עַ֖ד בֹּאִ֥/י בְ/שָׁלֽוֹם
verses.translit: v'mrt khh 'mr hmlkh shymv 't zh byt hkhl' vh'khylhv lchm lchts vmym lchts 'd b'y bshlvm
verses.translation: And say, Thus saith the king, Put this fellow in the prison, and feed him with bread of affliction and with water of affliction, until I come in peace.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֣אמֶר מִיכָ֔יְהוּ אִם שׁ֤וֹב תָּשׁוּב֙ בְּ/שָׁל֔וֹם לֹֽא דִבֶּ֥ר יְהוָ֖ה בִּ֑/י וַ/יֹּ֕אמֶר שִׁמְע֖וּ עַמִּ֥ים כֻּלָּֽ/ם
verses.translit: vy'mr mykhyhv 'm shvb tshvb bshlvm l' dbr yhvh by vy'mr shm'v 'mym khlm
verses.translation: And Micaiah said, If thou return at all in peace, the LORD hath not spoken by me. And he said, Hearken, O people, every one of you.

verses.original: וַ/יַּ֧עַל מֶֽלֶךְ יִשְׂרָאֵ֛ל וְ/יהוֹשָׁפָ֥ט מֶֽלֶךְ יְהוּדָ֖ה רָמֹ֥ת גִּלְעָֽד
verses.translit: vy'l mlkh yshr'l vyhvshpt mlkh yhvdh rmt gl'd
verses.translation: So the king of Israel and Jehoshaphat the king of Judah went up to Ramoth-gilead.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּאמֶר֩ מֶ֨לֶךְ יִשְׂרָאֵ֜ל אֶל יְהוֹשָׁפָ֗ט הִתְחַפֵּשׂ֙ וָ/בֹ֣א בַ/מִּלְחָמָ֔ה וְ/אַתָּ֖ה לְבַ֣שׁ בְּגָדֶ֑י/ךָ וַ/יִּתְחַפֵּשׂ֙ מֶ֣לֶךְ יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל וַ/יָּב֖וֹא בַּ/מִּלְחָמָֽה
verses.translit: vy'mr mlkh yshr'l 'l yhvshpt htchpsh vb' bmlchmh v'th lbsh bgdykh vytchpsh mlkh yshr'l vybv' bmlchmh
verses.translation: And the king of Israel said unto Jehoshaphat, I will disguise myself, and enter into the battle; but put thou on thy robes. And the king of Israel disguised himself, and went into the battle.

verses.original: וּ/מֶ֣לֶךְ אֲרָ֡ם צִוָּ֣ה אֶת שָׂרֵי֩ הָ/רֶ֨כֶב אֲשֶׁר ל֜/וֹ שְׁלֹשִׁ֤ים וּ/שְׁנַ֨יִם֙ לֵ/אמֹ֔ר לֹ֚א תִּלָּ֣חֲמ֔וּ אֶת קָטֹ֖ן וְ/אֶת גָּד֑וֹל כִּ֛י אִֽם אֶת מֶ֥לֶךְ יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל לְ/בַדּֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: vmlkh 'rm tsvh 't shry hrkhb 'shr lv shlshym vshnym l'mr l' tlchmv 't qtn v't gdvl khy 'm 't mlkh yshr'l lbdv
verses.translation: But the king of Syria commanded his thirty and two captains that had rule over his chariots, saying, Fight neither with small nor great, save only with the king of Israel.

verses.original: וַ/יְהִ֡י כִּ/רְאוֹת֩ שָׂרֵ֨י הָ/רֶ֜כֶב אֶת יְהוֹשָׁפָ֗ט וְ/הֵ֤מָּה אָֽמְרוּ֙ אַ֣ךְ מֶֽלֶךְ יִשְׂרָאֵ֣ל ה֔וּא וַ/יָּסֻ֥רוּ עָלָ֖י/ו לְ/הִלָּחֵ֑ם וַ/יִּזְעַ֖ק יְהוֹשָׁפָֽט
verses.translit: vyhy khr'vt shry hrkhb 't yhvshpt vhmh 'mrv 'kh mlkh yshr'l hv' vysrv 'lyv lhlchm vyz'q yhvshpt
verses.translation: And it came to pass, when the captains of the chariots saw Jehoshaphat, that they said, Surely it is the king of Israel. And they turned aside to fight against him: and Jehoshaphat cried out.

verses.original: וַ/יְהִ֗י כִּ/רְאוֹת֙ שָׂרֵ֣י הָ/רֶ֔כֶב כִּֽי לֹא מֶ֥לֶךְ יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל ה֑וּא וַ/יָּשׁ֖וּבוּ מֵ/אַחֲרָֽי/ו
verses.translit: vyhy khr'vt shry hrkhb khy l' mlkh yshr'l hv' vyshvbv m'chryv
verses.translation: And it came to pass, when the captains of the chariots perceived that it was not the king of Israel, that they turned back from pursuing him.

verses.original: וְ/אִ֗ישׁ מָשַׁ֤ךְ בַּ/קֶּ֨שֶׁת֙ לְ/תֻמּ֔/וֹ וַ/יַּכֶּה֙ אֶת מֶ֣לֶךְ יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל בֵּ֥ין הַ/דְּבָקִ֖ים וּ/בֵ֣ין הַ/שִּׁרְיָ֑ן וַ/יֹּ֣אמֶר לְ/רַכָּב֗/וֹ הֲפֹ֥ךְ יָדְ/ךָ֛ וְ/הוֹצִיאֵ֥/נִי מִן הַֽ/מַּחֲנֶ֖ה כִּ֥י הָחֳלֵֽיתִי
verses.translit: v'ysh mshkh bqsht ltmv vykhh 't mlkh yshr'l byn hdbqym vbyn hshryn vy'mr lrkhbv hpkh ydkh vhvtsy'ny mn hmchnh khy hchlyty
verses.translation: And a certain man drew a bow at a venture, and smote the king of Israel between the joints of the harness: wherefore he said unto the driver of his chariot, Turn thine hand, and carry me out of the host; for I am wounded.

verses.original: וַ/תַּעֲלֶ֤ה הַ/מִּלְחָמָה֙ בַּ/יּ֣וֹם הַ/ה֔וּא וְ/הַ/מֶּ֗לֶךְ הָיָ֧ה מָעֳמָ֛ד בַּ/מֶּרְכָּבָ֖ה נֹ֣כַח אֲרָ֑ם וַ/יָּ֣מָת בָּ/עֶ֔רֶב וַ/יִּ֥צֶק דַּֽם הַ/מַּכָּ֖ה אֶל חֵ֥יק הָ/רָֽכֶב
verses.translit: vt'lh hmlchmh byvm hhv' vhmlkh hyh m'md bmrkhbh nkhch 'rm vymt b'rb vytsq dm hmkhh 'l chyq hrkhb
verses.translation: And the battle increased that day: and the king was stayed up in his chariot against the Syrians, and died at even: and the blood ran out of the wound into the midst of the chariot.

verses.original: וַ/יַּעֲבֹ֤ר הָ/רִנָּה֙ בַּֽ/מַּחֲנֶ֔ה כְּ/בֹ֥א הַ/שֶּׁ֖מֶשׁ לֵ/אמֹ֑ר אִ֥ישׁ אֶל עִיר֖/וֹ וְ/אִ֥ישׁ אֶל אַרְצֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: vy'br hrnh bmchnh khb' hshmsh l'mr 'ysh 'l 'yrv v'ysh 'l 'rtsv
verses.translation: And there went a proclamation throughout the host about the going down of the sun, saying, Every man to his city, and every man to his own country.

verses.original: וַ/יָּ֣מָת הַ/מֶּ֔לֶךְ וַ/יָּב֖וֹא שֹׁמְר֑וֹן וַ/יִּקְבְּר֥וּ אֶת הַ/מֶּ֖לֶךְ בְּ/שֹׁמְרֽוֹן
verses.translit: vymt hmlkh vybv' shmrvn vyqbrv 't hmlkh bshmrvn
verses.translation: So the king died, and was brought to Samaria; and they buried the king in Samaria.

verses.original: וַ/יִּשְׁטֹ֨ף אֶת הָ/רֶ֜כֶב עַ֣ל בְּרֵכַ֣ת שֹׁמְר֗וֹן וַ/יָּלֹ֤קּוּ הַ/כְּלָבִים֙ אֶת דָּמ֔/וֹ וְ/הַ/זֹּנ֖וֹת רָחָ֑צוּ כִּ/דְבַ֥ר יְהוָ֖ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר דִּבֵּֽר
verses.translit: vyshtf 't hrkhb 'l brkht shmrvn vylqv hkhlbym 't dmv vhznvt rchtsv khdbr yhvh 'shr dbr
verses.translation: And one washed the chariot in the pool of Samaria; and the dogs licked up his blood; and they washed his armour; according unto the word of the LORD which he spake.

verses.original: וְ/יֶתֶר֩ דִּבְרֵ֨י אַחְאָ֜ב וְ/כָל אֲשֶׁ֣ר עָשָׂ֗ה וּ/בֵ֤ית הַ/שֵּׁן֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר בָּנָ֔ה וְ/כָל הֶ/עָרִ֖ים אֲשֶׁ֣ר בָּנָ֑ה הֲ/לֽוֹא הֵ֣ם כְּתוּבִ֗ים עַל סֵ֛פֶר דִּבְרֵ֥י הַ/יָּמִ֖ים לְ/מַלְכֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל
verses.translit: vytr dbry 'ch'b vkhl 'shr 'shh vbyt hshn 'shr bnh vkhl h'rym 'shr bnh hlv' hm khtvbym 'l spr dbry hymym lmlkhy yshr'l
verses.translation: Now the rest of the acts of Ahab, and all that he did, and the ivory house which he made, and all the cities that he built, are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel?

verses.original: וַ/יִּשְׁכַּ֥ב אַחְאָ֖ב עִם אֲבֹתָ֑י/ו וַ/יִּמְלֹ֛ךְ אֲחַזְיָ֥הוּ בְנ֖/וֹ תַּחְתָּֽי/ו
verses.translit: vyshkhb 'ch'b 'm 'btyv vymlkh 'chzyhv bnv tchtyv
verses.translation: So Ahab slept with his fathers; and Ahaziah his son reigned in his stead.

verses.original: וִ/יהֽוֹשָׁפָט֙ בֶּן אָסָ֔א מָלַ֖ךְ עַל יְהוּדָ֑ה בִּ/שְׁנַ֣ת אַרְבַּ֔ע לְ/אַחְאָ֖ב מֶ֥לֶךְ יִשְׂרָאֵֽל
verses.translit: vyhvshpt bn 's' mlkh 'l yhvdh bshnt 'rb' l'ch'b mlkh yshr'l
verses.translation: And Jehoshaphat the son of Asa began to reign over Judah in the fourth year of Ahab king of Israel.

verses.original: יְהוֹשָׁפָ֗ט בֶּן שְׁלֹשִׁ֨ים וְ/חָמֵ֤שׁ שָׁנָה֙ בְּ/מָלְכ֔/וֹ וְ/עֶשְׂרִ֤ים וְ/חָמֵשׁ֙ שָׁנָ֔ה מָלַ֖ךְ בִּ/ירוּשָׁלִָ֑ם וְ/שֵׁ֣ם אִמּ֔/וֹ עֲזוּבָ֖ה בַּת שִׁלְחִֽי
verses.translit: yhvshpt bn shlshym vchmsh shnh bmlkhv v'shrym vchmsh shnh mlkh byrvshlm vshm 'mv 'zvbh bt shlchy
verses.translation: Jehoshaphat was thirty and five years old when he began to reign; and he reigned twenty and five years in Jerusalem. And his mother’s name was Azubah the daughter of Shilhi.

verses.original: וַ/יֵּ֗לֶךְ בְּ/כָל דֶּ֛רֶךְ אָסָ֥א אָבִ֖י/ו לֹא סָ֣ר מִמֶּ֑/נּוּ לַ/עֲשׂ֥וֹת הַ/יָּשָׁ֖ר בְּ/עֵינֵ֥י יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: vylkh bkhl drkh 's' 'byv l' sr mmnv l'shvt hyshr b'yny yhvh
verses.translation: And he walked in all the ways of Asa his father; he turned not aside from it, doing that which was right in the eyes of the LORD : nevertheless the high places were not taken away; for the people offered and burnt incense yet in the high places.

verses.original: אַ֥ךְ הַ/בָּמ֖וֹת לֹֽא סָ֑רוּ ע֥וֹד הָ/עָ֛ם מְזַבְּחִ֥ים וּֽ/מְקַטְּרִ֖ים בַּ/בָּמֽוֹת
verses.translit: 'kh hbmvt l' srv 'vd h'm mzbchym vmqtrym bbmvt
verses.translation: And Jehoshaphat made peace with the king of Israel.

verses.original: וַ/יַּשְׁלֵ֥ם יְהוֹשָׁפָ֖ט עִם מֶ֥לֶךְ יִשְׂרָאֵֽל
verses.translit: vyshlm yhvshpt 'm mlkh yshr'l
verses.translation: Now the rest of the acts of Jehoshaphat, and his might that he shewed, and how he warred, are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah?

verses.original: וְ/יֶ֨תֶר דִּבְרֵ֧י יְהוֹשָׁפָ֛ט וּ/גְבוּרָת֥/וֹ אֲשֶׁר עָשָׂ֖ה וַ/אֲשֶׁ֣ר נִלְחָ֑ם הֲ/לֹֽא הֵ֣ם כְּתוּבִ֗ים עַל סֵ֛פֶר דִּבְרֵ֥י הַ/יָּמִ֖ים לְ/מַלְכֵ֥י יְהוּדָֽה
verses.translit: vytr dbry yhvshpt vgbvrtv 'shr 'shh v'shr nlchm hl' hm khtvbym 'l spr dbry hymym lmlkhy yhvdh
verses.translation: And the remnant of the sodomites, which remained in the days of his father Asa, he took out of the land.

verses.original: וְ/יֶ֨תֶר֙ הַ/קָּדֵ֔שׁ אֲשֶׁ֣ר נִשְׁאַ֔ר בִּ/ימֵ֖י אָסָ֣א אָבִ֑י/ו בִּעֵ֖ר מִן הָ/אָֽרֶץ
verses.translit: vytr hqdsh 'shr nsh'r bymy 's' 'byv b'r mn h'rts
verses.translation: There was then no king in Edom: a deputy was king.

verses.original: וּ/מֶ֥לֶךְ אֵ֛ין בֶּ/אֱד֖וֹם נִצָּ֥ב מֶֽלֶךְ
verses.translit: vmlkh 'yn b'dvm ntsb mlkh
verses.translation: Jehoshaphat made ships of Tharshish to go to Ophir for gold: but they went not; for the ships were broken at Ezion-geber.

verses.original: יְהוֹשָׁפָ֡ט עשר עָשָׂה֩ אֳנִיּ֨וֹת תַּרְשִׁ֜ישׁ לָ/לֶ֧כֶת אוֹפִ֛ירָ/ה לַ/זָּהָ֖ב וְ/לֹ֣א הָלָ֑ךְ כִּֽי נשברה נִשְׁבְּר֥וּ אֳנִיּ֖וֹת בְּ/עֶצְי֥וֹן גָּֽבֶר
verses.translit: yhvshpt 'shr 'shh 'nyvt trshysh llkht 'vpyrh lzhb vl' hlkh khy nshbrh nshbrv 'nyvt b'tsyvn gbr
verses.translation: Then said Ahaziah the son of Ahab unto Jehoshaphat, Let my servants go with thy servants in the ships. But Jehoshaphat would not.

verses.original: אָ֠ז אָמַ֞ר אֲחַזְיָ֤הוּ בֶן אַחְאָב֙ אֶל יְה֣וֹשָׁפָ֔ט יֵלְכ֧וּ עֲבָדַ֛/י עִם עֲבָדֶ֖י/ךָ בָּ/אֳנִיּ֑וֹת וְ/לֹ֥א אָבָ֖ה יְהוֹשָׁפָֽט
verses.translit: 'z 'mr 'chzyhv bn 'ch'b 'l yhvshpt ylkhv 'bdy 'm 'bdykh b'nyvt vl' 'bh yhvshpt
verses.translation: And Jehoshaphat slept with his fathers, and was buried with his fathers in the city of David his father: and Jehoram his son reigned in his stead.

verses.original: וַ/יִּשְׁכַּ֤ב יְהֽוֹשָׁפָט֙ עִם אֲבֹתָ֔י/ו וַ/יִּקָּבֵר֙ עִם אֲבֹתָ֔י/ו בְּ/עִ֖יר דָּוִ֣ד אָבִ֑י/ו וַ/יִּמְלֹ֛ךְ יְהוֹרָ֥ם בְּנ֖/וֹ תַּחְתָּֽי/ו
verses.translit: vyshkhb yhvshpt 'm 'btyv vyqbr 'm 'btyv b'yr dvd 'byv vymlkh yhvrm bnv tchtyv
verses.translation: Ahaziah the son of Ahab began to reign over Israel in Samaria the seventeenth year of Jehoshaphat king of Judah, and reigned two years over Israel.

verses.original: אֲחַזְיָ֣הוּ בֶן אַחְאָ֗ב מָלַ֤ךְ עַל יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ בְּ/שֹׁ֣מְר֔וֹן בִּ/שְׁנַת֙ שְׁבַ֣ע עֶשְׂרֵ֔ה לִ/יהוֹשָׁפָ֖ט מֶ֣לֶךְ יְהוּדָ֑ה וַ/יִּמְלֹ֥ךְ עַל יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל שְׁנָתָֽיִם
verses.translit: 'chzyhv bn 'ch'b mlkh 'l yshr'l bshmrvn bshnt shb' 'shrh lyhvshpt mlkh yhvdh vymlkh 'l yshr'l shntym
verses.translation: And he did evil in the sight of the LORD , and walked in the way of his father, and in the way of his mother, and in the way of Jeroboam the son of Nebat, who made Israel to sin:

verses.original: וַ/יַּ֥עַשׂ הָ/רַ֖ע בְּ/עֵינֵ֣י יְהוָ֑ה וַ/יֵּ֗לֶךְ בְּ/דֶ֤רֶךְ אָבִי/ו֙ וּ/בְ/דֶ֣רֶךְ אִמּ֔/וֹ וּ/בְ/דֶ֨רֶךְ֙ יָרָבְעָ֣ם בֶּן נְבָ֔ט אֲשֶׁ֥ר הֶחֱטִ֖יא אֶת יִשְׂרָאֵֽל
verses.translit: vy'sh hr' b'yny yhvh vylkh bdrkh 'byv vbdrkh 'mv vbdrkh yrb'm bn nbt 'shr hchty' 't yshr'l
verses.translation: For he served Baal, and worshipped him, and provoked to anger the LORD God of Israel, according to all that his father had done.

verses.original: וַ/יִּפְשַׁ֤ע מוֹאָב֙ בְּ/יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל אַחֲרֵ֖י מ֥וֹת אַחְאָֽב
verses.translit: vypsh' mv'b byshr'l 'chry mvt 'ch'b
verses.translation: Then Moab rebelled against Israel after the death of Ahab.

verses.original: וַ/יִּפֹּ֨ל אֲחַזְיָ֜ה בְּעַ֣ד הַ/שְּׂבָכָ֗ה בַּ/עֲלִיָּת֛/וֹ אֲשֶׁ֥ר בְּ/שֹׁמְר֖וֹן וַ/יָּ֑חַל וַ/יִּשְׁלַ֣ח מַלְאָכִ֔ים וַ/יֹּ֤אמֶר אֲלֵ/הֶם֙ לְכ֣וּ דִרְשׁ֗וּ בְּ/בַ֤עַל זְבוּב֙ אֱלֹהֵ֣י עֶקְר֔וֹן אִם אֶחְיֶ֖ה מֵ/חֳלִ֥י זֶֽה
verses.translit: vypl 'chzyh b'd hshbkhh b'lytv 'shr bshmrvn vychl vyshlch ml'khym vy'mr 'lhm lkhv drshv bb'l zbvb 'lhy 'qrvn 'm 'chyh mchly zh
verses.translation: And Ahaziah fell down through a lattice in his upper chamber that was in Samaria, and was sick: and he sent messengers, and said unto them, Go, enquire of Baal-zebub the god of Ekron whether I shall recover of this disease.

verses.original: וּ/מַלְאַ֣ךְ יְהוָ֗ה דִּבֶּר֙ אֶל אֵלִיָּ֣ה הַ/תִּשְׁבִּ֔י ק֣וּם עֲלֵ֔ה לִ/קְרַ֖את מַלְאֲכֵ֣י מֶֽלֶךְ שֹׁמְר֑וֹן וְ/דַבֵּ֣ר אֲלֵ/הֶ֔ם הַֽ/מִ/בְּלִ֤י אֵין אֱלֹהִים֙ בְּ/יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל אַתֶּם֙ הֹֽלְכִ֔ים לִ/דְרֹ֕שׁ בְּ/בַ֥עַל זְב֖וּב אֱלֹהֵ֥י עֶקְרֽוֹן
verses.translit: vml'kh yhvh dbr 'l 'lyh htshby qvm 'lh lqr't ml'khy mlkh shmrvn vdbr 'lhm hmbly 'yn 'lhym byshr'l 'tm hlkhym ldrsh bb'l zbvb 'lhy 'qrvn
verses.translation: But the angel of the LORD said to Elijah the Tishbite, Arise, go up to meet the messengers of the king of Samaria, and say unto them, Is it not because there is not a God in Israel, that ye go to enquire of Baal-zebub the god of Ekron?

verses.original: וְ/לָ/כֵן֙ כֹּֽה אָמַ֣ר יְהוָ֔ה הַ/מִּטָּ֞ה אֲשֶׁר עָלִ֥יתָ שָּׁ֛ם לֹֽא תֵרֵ֥ד מִמֶּ֖/נָּה כִּ֣י מ֣וֹת תָּמ֑וּת וַ/יֵּ֖לֶךְ אֵלִיָּֽה
verses.translit: vlkhn khh 'mr yhvh hmth 'shr 'lyt shm l' trd mmnh khy mvt tmvt vylkh 'lyh
verses.translation: Now therefore thus saith the LORD , Thou shalt not come down from that bed on which thou art gone up, but shalt surely die. And Elijah departed.

verses.original: וַ/יָּשׁ֥וּבוּ הַ/מַּלְאָכִ֖ים אֵלָ֑י/ו וַ/יֹּ֥אמֶר אֲלֵי/הֶ֖ם מַה זֶּ֥ה שַׁבְתֶּֽם
verses.translit: vyshvbv hml'khym 'lyv vy'mr 'lyhm mh zh shbtm
verses.translation: And when the messengers turned back unto him, he said unto them, Why are ye now turned back?

verses.original: וַ/יֹּאמְר֨וּ אֵלָ֜י/ו אִ֣ישׁ עָלָ֣ה לִ/קְרָאתֵ֗/נוּ וַ/יֹּ֣אמֶר אֵלֵי/נוּ֮ לְכ֣וּ שׁוּבוּ֮ אֶל הַ/מֶּ֣לֶךְ אֲשֶׁר שָׁלַ֣ח אֶתְ/כֶם֒ וְ/דִבַּרְתֶּ֣ם אֵלָ֗י/ו כֹּ֚ה אָמַ֣ר יְהוָ֔ה הַֽ/מִ/בְּלִ֤י אֵין אֱלֹהִים֙ בְּ/יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל אַתָּ֣ה שֹׁלֵ֔חַ לִ/דְרֹ֕שׁ בְּ/בַ֥עַל זְב֖וּב אֱלֹהֵ֣י עֶקְר֑וֹן לָ֠/כֵן הַ/מִּטָּ֞ה אֲשֶׁר עָלִ֥יתָ שָּׁ֛ם לֹֽא תֵרֵ֥ד מִמֶּ֖/נָּה כִּֽי מ֥וֹת תָּמֽוּת
verses.translit: vy'mrv 'lyv 'ysh 'lh lqr'tnv vy'mr 'lynv lkhv shvbv 'l hmlkh 'shr shlch 'tkhm vdbrtm 'lyv khh 'mr yhvh hmbly 'yn 'lhym byshr'l 'th shlch ldrsh bb'l zbvb 'lhy 'qrvn lkhn hmth 'shr 'lyt shm l' trd mmnh khy mvt tmvt
verses.translation: And they said unto him, There came a man up to meet us, and said unto us, Go, turn again unto the king that sent you, and say unto him, Thus saith the LORD , Is it not because there is not a God in Israel, that thou sendest to enquire of Baal-zebub the god of Ekron? therefore thou shalt not come down from that bed on which thou art gone up, but shalt surely die.

verses.original: וַ/יְדַבֵּ֣ר אֲלֵ/הֶ֔ם מֶ֚ה מִשְׁפַּ֣ט הָ/אִ֔ישׁ אֲשֶׁ֥ר עָלָ֖ה לִ/קְרַאתְ/כֶ֑ם וַ/יְדַבֵּ֣ר אֲלֵי/כֶ֔ם אֶת הַ/דְּבָרִ֖ים הָ/אֵֽלֶּה
verses.translit: vydbr 'lhm mh mshpt h'ysh 'shr 'lh lqr'tkhm vydbr 'lykhm 't hdbrym h'lh
verses.translation: And he said unto them, What manner of man was he which came up to meet you, and told you these words?

verses.original: וַ/יֹּאמְר֣וּ אֵלָ֗י/ו אִ֚ישׁ בַּ֣עַל שֵׂעָ֔ר וְ/אֵז֥וֹר ע֖וֹר אָז֣וּר בְּ/מָתְנָ֑י/ו וַ/יֹּאמַ֕ר אֵלִיָּ֥ה הַ/תִּשְׁבִּ֖י הֽוּא
verses.translit: vy'mrv 'lyv 'ysh b'l sh'r v'zvr 'vr 'zvr bmtnyv vy'mr 'lyh htshby hv'
verses.translation: And they answered him, He was an hairy man, and girt with a girdle of leather about his loins. And he said, It is Elijah the Tishbite.

verses.original: וַ/יִּשְׁלַ֥ח אֵלָ֛י/ו שַׂר חֲמִשִּׁ֖ים וַ/חֲמִשָּׁ֑י/ו וַ/יַּ֣עַל אֵלָ֗י/ו וְ/הִנֵּה֙ יֹשֵׁב֙ עַל רֹ֣אשׁ הָ/הָ֔ר וַ/יְדַבֵּ֣ר אֵלָ֔י/ו אִ֚ישׁ הָֽ/אֱלֹהִ֔ים הַ/מֶּ֥לֶךְ דִּבֶּ֖ר רֵֽדָ/ה
verses.translit: vyshlch 'lyv shr chmshym vchmshyv vy'l 'lyv vhnh yshb 'l r'sh hhr vydbr 'lyv 'ysh h'lhym hmlkh dbr rdh
verses.translation: Then the king sent unto him a captain of fifty with his fifty. And he went up to him: and, behold, he sat on the top of an hill. And he spake unto him, Thou man of God, the king hath said, Come down.

verses.original: וַ/יַּעֲנֶ֣ה אֵלִיָּ֗הוּ וַ/יְדַבֵּר֮ אֶל שַׂ֣ר הַ/חֲמִשִּׁים֒ וְ/אִם אִ֤ישׁ אֱלֹהִים֙ אָ֔נִי תֵּ֤רֶד אֵשׁ֙ מִן הַ/שָּׁמַ֔יִם וְ/תֹאכַ֥ל אֹתְ/ךָ֖ וְ/אֶת חֲמִשֶּׁ֑י/ךָ וַ/תֵּ֤רֶד אֵשׁ֙ מִן הַ/שָּׁמַ֔יִם וַ/תֹּ֥אכַל אֹת֖/וֹ וְ/אֶת חֲמִשָּֽׁי/ו
verses.translit: vy'nh 'lyhv vydbr 'l shr hchmshym v'm 'ysh 'lhym 'ny trd 'sh mn hshmym vt'khl 'tkh v't chmshykh vtrd 'sh mn hshmym vt'khl 'tv v't chmshyv
verses.translation: And Elijah answered and said to the captain of fifty, If I be a man of God, then let fire come down from heaven, and consume thee and thy fifty. And there came down fire from heaven, and consumed him and his fifty.

verses.original: וַ/יָּ֜שָׁב וַ/יִּשְׁלַ֥ח אֵלָ֛י/ו שַׂר חֲמִשִּׁ֥ים אַחֵ֖ר וַ/חֲמִשָּׁ֑י/ו וַ/יַּ֨עַן֙ וַ/יְדַבֵּ֣ר אֵלָ֔י/ו אִ֚ישׁ הָ/אֱלֹהִ֔ים כֹּֽה אָמַ֥ר הַ/מֶּ֖לֶךְ מְהֵרָ֥ה רֵֽדָ/ה
verses.translit: vyshb vyshlch 'lyv shr chmshym 'chr vchmshyv vy'n vydbr 'lyv 'ysh h'lhym khh 'mr hmlkh mhrh rdh
verses.translation: Again also he sent unto him another captain of fifty with his fifty. And he answered and said unto him, O man of God, thus hath the king said, Come down quickly.

verses.original: וַ/יַּ֣עַן אֵלִיָּה֮ וַ/יְדַבֵּ֣ר אֲלֵי/הֶם֒ אִם אִ֤ישׁ הָֽ/אֱלֹהִים֙ אָ֔נִי תֵּ֤רֶד אֵשׁ֙ מִן הַ/שָּׁמַ֔יִם וְ/תֹאכַ֥ל אֹתְ/ךָ֖ וְ/אֶת חֲמִשֶּׁ֑י/ךָ וַ/תֵּ֤רֶד אֵשׁ אֱלֹהִים֙ מִן הַ/שָּׁמַ֔יִם וַ/תֹּ֥אכַל אֹת֖/וֹ וְ/אֶת חֲמִשָּֽׁי/ו
verses.translit: vy'n 'lyh vydbr 'lyhm 'm 'ysh h'lhym 'ny trd 'sh mn hshmym vt'khl 'tkh v't chmshykh vtrd 'sh 'lhym mn hshmym vt'khl 'tv v't chmshyv
verses.translation: And Elijah answered and said unto them, If I be a man of God, let fire come down from heaven, and consume thee and thy fifty. And the fire of God came down from heaven, and consumed him and his fifty.

verses.original: וַ/יָּ֗שָׁב וַ/יִּשְׁלַ֛ח שַׂר חֲמִשִּׁ֥ים שְׁלִשִׁ֖ים וַ/חֲמִשָּׁ֑י/ו וַ/יַּ֡עַל וַ/יָּבֹא֩ שַׂר הַ/חֲמִשִּׁ֨ים הַ/שְּׁלִישִׁ֜י וַ/יִּכְרַ֥ע עַל בִּרְכָּ֣י/ו לְ/נֶ֣גֶד אֵלִיָּ֗הוּ וַ/יִּתְחַנֵּ֤ן אֵלָי/ו֙ וַ/יְדַבֵּ֣ר אֵלָ֔י/ו אִ֚ישׁ הָֽ/אֱלֹהִ֔ים תִּֽיקַר נָ֣א נַפְשִׁ֗/י וְ/נֶ֨פֶשׁ עֲבָדֶ֥י/ךָֽ אֵ֛לֶּה חֲמִשִּׁ֖ים בְּ/עֵינֶֽי/ךָ
verses.translit: vyshb vyshlch shr chmshym shlshym vchmshyv vy'l vyb' shr hchmshym hshlyshy vykhr' 'l brkhyv lngd 'lyhv vytchnn 'lyv vydbr 'lyv 'ysh h'lhym tyqr n' npshy vnpsh 'bdykh 'lh chmshym b'ynykh
verses.translation: And he sent again a captain of the third fifty with his fifty. And the third captain of fifty went up, and came and fell on his knees before Elijah, and besought him, and said unto him, O man of God, I pray thee, let my life, and the life of these fifty thy servants, be precious in thy sight.

verses.original: הִ֠נֵּה יָ֤רְדָה אֵשׁ֙ מִן הַ/שָּׁמַ֔יִם וַ֠/תֹּאכַל אֶת שְׁנֵ֞י שָׂרֵ֧י הַ/חֲמִשִּׁ֛ים הָ/רִאשֹׁנִ֖ים וְ/אֶת חֲמִשֵּׁי/הֶ֑ם וְ/עַתָּ֕ה תִּיקַ֥ר נַפְשִׁ֖/י בְּ/עֵינֶֽי/ךָ
verses.translit: hnh yrdh 'sh mn hshmym vt'khl 't shny shry hchmshym hr'shnym v't chmshyhm v'th tyqr npshy b'ynykh
verses.translation: Behold, there came fire down from heaven, and burnt up the two captains of the former fifties with their fifties: therefore let my life now be precious in thy sight.

verses.original: וַ/יְדַבֵּ֞ר מַלְאַ֤ךְ יְהוָה֙ אֶל אֵ֣לִיָּ֔הוּ רֵ֣ד אוֹת֔/וֹ אַל תִּירָ֖א מִ/פָּנָ֑י/ו וַ/יָּ֛קָם וַ/יֵּ֥רֶד אוֹת֖/וֹ אֶל הַ/מֶּֽלֶךְ
verses.translit: vydbr ml'kh yhvh 'l 'lyhv rd 'vtv 'l tyr' mpnyv vyqm vyrd 'vtv 'l hmlkh
verses.translation: And the angel of the LORD said unto Elijah, Go down with him: be not afraid of him. And he arose, and went down with him unto the king.

verses.original: וַ/יְדַבֵּ֨ר אֵלָ֜י/ו כֹּֽה אָמַ֣ר יְהוָ֗ה יַ֜עַן אֲשֶׁר שָׁלַ֣חְתָּ מַלְאָכִים֮ לִ/דְרֹשׁ֮ בְּ/בַ֣עַל זְבוּב֮ אֱלֹהֵ֣י עֶקְרוֹן֒ הַֽ/מִ/בְּלִ֤י אֵין אֱלֹהִים֙ בְּ/יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל לִ/דְרֹ֖שׁ בִּ/דְבָר֑/וֹ לָ֠/כֵן הַ/מִּטָּ֞ה אֲשֶׁר עָלִ֥יתָ שָּׁ֛ם לֹֽא תֵרֵ֥ד מִמֶּ֖/נָּה כִּֽי מ֥וֹת תָּמֽוּת
verses.translit: vydbr 'lyv khh 'mr yhvh y'n 'shr shlcht ml'khym ldrsh bb'l zbvb 'lhy 'qrvn hmbly 'yn 'lhym byshr'l ldrsh bdbrv lkhn hmth 'shr 'lyt shm l' trd mmnh khy mvt tmvt
verses.translation: And he said unto him, Thus saith the LORD , Forasmuch as thou hast sent messengers to enquire of Baal-zebub the god of Ekron, is it not because there is no God in Israel to enquire of his word? therefore thou shalt not come down off that bed on which thou art gone up, but shalt surely die.

verses.original: וַ/יָּ֜מָת כִּ/דְבַ֥ר יְהוָ֣ה אֲשֶׁר דִּבֶּ֣ר אֵלִיָּ֗הוּ וַ/יִּמְלֹ֤ךְ יְהוֹרָם֙ תַּחְתָּ֔י/ו בִּ/שְׁנַ֣ת שְׁתַּ֔יִם לִ/יהוֹרָ֥ם בֶּן יְהוֹשָׁפָ֖ט מֶ֣לֶךְ יְהוּדָ֑ה כִּ֛י לֹֽא הָ֥יָה ל֖/וֹ בֵּֽן
verses.translit: vymt khdbr yhvh 'shr dbr 'lyhv vymlkh yhvrm tchtyv bshnt shtym lyhvrm bn yhvshpt mlkh yhvdh khy l' hyh lv bn
verses.translation: So he died according to the word of the LORD which Elijah had spoken. And Jehoram reigned in his stead in the second year of Jehoram the son of Jehoshaphat king of Judah; because he had no son.

verses.original: וְ/יֶ֛תֶר דִּבְרֵ֥י אֲחַזְיָ֖הוּ אֲשֶׁ֣ר עָשָׂ֑ה הֲ/לֽוֹא הֵ֣מָּה כְתוּבִ֗ים עַל סֵ֛פֶר דִּבְרֵ֥י הַ/יָּמִ֖ים לְ/מַלְכֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל
verses.translit: vytr dbry 'chzyhv 'shr 'shh hlv' hmh khtvbym 'l spr dbry hymym lmlkhy yshr'l
verses.translation: Now the rest of the acts of Ahaziah which he did, are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel?

verses.original: וַ/יְהִ֗י בְּ/הַעֲל֤וֹת יְהוָה֙ אֶת אֵ֣לִיָּ֔הוּ בַּֽ/סְעָרָ֖ה הַ/שָּׁמָ֑יִם וַ/יֵּ֧לֶךְ אֵלִיָּ֛הוּ וֶ/אֱלִישָׁ֖ע מִן הַ/גִּלְגָּֽל
verses.translit: vyhy bh'lvt yhvh 't 'lyhv bs'rh hshmym vylkh 'lyhv v'lysh' mn hglgl
verses.translation: And it came to pass, when the LORD would take up Elijah into heaven by a whirlwind, that Elijah went with Elisha from Gilgal.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּאמֶר֩ אֵלִיָּ֨הוּ אֶל אֱלִישָׁ֜ע שֵֽׁב נָ֣א פֹ֗ה כִּ֤י יְהוָה֙ שְׁלָחַ֣/נִי עַד בֵּֽית אֵ֔ל וַ/יֹּ֣אמֶר אֱלִישָׁ֔ע חַי יְהוָ֥ה וְ/חֵֽי נַפְשְׁ/ךָ֖ אִם אֶעֶזְבֶ֑/ךָּ וַ/יֵּרְד֖וּ בֵּֽית אֵֽל
verses.translit: vy'mr 'lyhv 'l 'lysh' shb n' ph khy yhvh shlchny 'd byt 'l vy'mr 'lysh' chy yhvh vchy npshkh 'm ''zbkh vyrdv byt 'l
verses.translation: And Elijah said unto Elisha, Tarry here, I pray thee; for the LORD hath sent me to Beth-el. And Elisha said unto him, As the LORD liveth, and as thy soul liveth, I will not leave thee. So they went down to Beth-el.

verses.original: וַ/יֵּצְא֨וּ בְנֵֽי הַ/נְּבִיאִ֥ים אֲשֶׁר בֵּֽית אֵל֮ אֶל אֱלִישָׁע֒ וַ/יֹּאמְר֣וּ אֵלָ֔י/ו הֲ/יָדַ֕עְתָּ כִּ֣י הַ/יּ֗וֹם יְהוָ֛ה לֹקֵ֥חַ אֶת אֲדֹנֶ֖י/ךָ מֵ/עַ֣ל רֹאשֶׁ֑/ךָ וַ/יֹּ֛אמֶר גַּם אֲנִ֥י יָדַ֖עְתִּי הֶחֱשֽׁוּ
verses.translit: vyts'v bny hnby'ym 'shr byt 'l 'l 'lysh' vy'mrv 'lyv hyd't khy hyvm yhvh lqch 't 'dnykh m'l r'shkh vy'mr gm 'ny yd'ty hchshv
verses.translation: And the sons of the prophets that were at Beth-el came forth to Elisha, and said unto him, Knowest thou that the LORD will take away thy master from thy head to day? And he said, Yea, I know it; hold ye your peace.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּאמֶר֩ ל֨/וֹ אֵלִיָּ֜הוּ אֱלִישָׁ֣ע שֵֽׁב נָ֣א פֹ֗ה כִּ֤י יְהוָה֙ שְׁלָחַ֣/נִי יְרִיח֔וֹ וַ/יֹּ֕אמֶר חַי יְהוָ֥ה וְ/חֵֽי נַפְשְׁ/ךָ֖ אִם אֶעֶזְבֶ֑/ךָּ וַ/יָּבֹ֖אוּ יְרִיחֽוֹ
verses.translit: vy'mr lv 'lyhv 'lysh' shb n' ph khy yhvh shlchny yrychv vy'mr chy yhvh vchy npshkh 'm ''zbkh vyb'v yrychv
verses.translation: And Elijah said unto him, Elisha, tarry here, I pray thee; for the LORD hath sent me to Jericho. And he said, As the LORD liveth, and as thy soul liveth, I will not leave thee. So they came to Jericho.

verses.original: וַ/יִּגְּשׁ֨וּ בְנֵֽי הַ/נְּבִיאִ֥ים אֲשֶׁר בִּֽ/ירִיחוֹ֮ אֶל אֱלִישָׁע֒ וַ/יֹּאמְר֣וּ אֵלָ֔י/ו הֲ/יָדַ֕עְתָּ כִּ֣י הַ/יּ֗וֹם יְהוָ֛ה לֹקֵ֥חַ אֶת אֲדֹנֶ֖י/ךָ מֵ/עַ֣ל רֹאשֶׁ֑/ךָ וַ/יֹּ֛אמֶר גַּם אֲנִ֥י יָדַ֖עְתִּי הֶחֱשֽׁוּ
verses.translit: vygshv bny hnby'ym 'shr byrychv 'l 'lysh' vy'mrv 'lyv hyd't khy hyvm yhvh lqch 't 'dnykh m'l r'shkh vy'mr gm 'ny yd'ty hchshv
verses.translation: And the sons of the prophets that were at Jericho came to Elisha, and said unto him, Knowest thou that the LORD will take away thy master from thy head to day? And he answered, Yea, I know it; hold ye your peace.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּאמֶר֩ ל֨/וֹ אֵלִיָּ֜הוּ שֵֽׁב נָ֣א פֹ֗ה כִּ֤י יְהוָה֙ שְׁלָחַ֣/נִי הַ/יַּרְדֵּ֔נָ/ה וַ/יֹּ֕אמֶר חַי יְהוָ֥ה וְ/חֵֽי נַפְשְׁ/ךָ֖ אִם אֶעֶזְבֶ֑/ךָּ וַ/יֵּלְכ֖וּ שְׁנֵי/הֶֽם
verses.translit: vy'mr lv 'lyhv shb n' ph khy yhvh shlchny hyrdnh vy'mr chy yhvh vchy npshkh 'm ''zbkh vylkhv shnyhm
verses.translation: And Elijah said unto him, Tarry, I pray thee, here; for the LORD hath sent me to Jordan. And he said, As the LORD liveth, and as thy soul liveth, I will not leave thee. And they two went on.

verses.original: וַ/חֲמִשִּׁ֨ים אִ֜ישׁ מִ/בְּנֵ֤י הַ/נְּבִיאִים֙ הָֽלְכ֔וּ וַ/יַּעַמְד֥וּ מִ/נֶּ֖גֶד מֵ/רָח֑וֹק וּ/שְׁנֵי/הֶ֖ם עָמְד֥וּ עַל הַ/יַּרְדֵּֽן
verses.translit: vchmshym 'ysh mbny hnby'ym hlkhv vy'mdv mngd mrchvq vshnyhm 'mdv 'l hyrdn
verses.translation: And fifty men of the sons of the prophets went, and stood to view afar off: and they two stood by Jordan.

verses.original: וַ/יִּקַּח֩ אֵלִיָּ֨הוּ אֶת אַדַּרְתּ֤/וֹ וַ/יִּגְלֹם֙ וַ/יַּכֶּ֣ה אֶת הַ/מַּ֔יִם וַ/יֵּחָצ֖וּ הֵ֣נָּה וָ/הֵ֑נָּה וַ/יַּעַבְר֥וּ שְׁנֵי/הֶ֖ם בֶּ/חָרָבָֽה
verses.translit: vyqch 'lyhv 't 'drtv vyglm vykhh 't hmym vychtsv hnh vhnh vy'brv shnyhm bchrbh
verses.translation: And Elijah took his mantle, and wrapped it together, and smote the waters, and they were divided hither and thither, so that they two went over on dry ground.

verses.original: וַ/יְהִ֣י כְ/עָבְרָ֗/ם וְ/אֵ֨לִיָּ֜הוּ אָמַ֤ר אֶל אֱלִישָׁע֙ שְׁאַל֙ מָ֣ה אֶֽעֱשֶׂה לָּ֔/ךְ בְּ/טֶ֖רֶם אֶלָּקַ֣ח מֵ/עִמָּ֑/ךְ וַ/יֹּ֣אמֶר אֱלִישָׁ֔ע וִֽ/יהִי נָ֛א פִּֽי שְׁנַ֥יִם בְּ/רוּחֲ/ךָ֖ אֵלָֽ/י
verses.translit: vyhy kh'brm v'lyhv 'mr 'l 'lysh' sh'l mh ''shh lkh btrm 'lqch m'mkh vy'mr 'lysh' vyhy n' py shnym brvchkh 'ly
verses.translation: And it came to pass, when they were gone over, that Elijah said unto Elisha, Ask what I shall do for thee, before I be taken away from thee. And Elisha said, I pray thee, let a double portion of thy spirit be upon me.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֖אמֶר הִקְשִׁ֣יתָ לִ/שְׁא֑וֹל אִם תִּרְאֶ֨ה אֹתִ֜/י לֻקָּ֤ח מֵֽ/אִתָּ/ךְ֙ יְהִֽי לְ/ךָ֣ כֵ֔ן וְ/אִם אַ֖יִן לֹ֥א יִהְיֶֽה
verses.translit: vy'mr hqshyt lsh'vl 'm tr'h 'ty lqch m'tkh yhy lkh khn v'm 'yn l' yhyh
verses.translation: And he said, Thou hast asked a hard thing: nevertheless , if thou see me when I am taken from thee, it shall be so unto thee; but if not, it shall not be so .

verses.original: וַ/יְהִ֗י הֵ֣מָּה הֹלְכִ֤ים הָלוֹךְ֙ וְ/דַבֵּ֔ר וְ/הִנֵּ֤ה רֶֽכֶב אֵשׁ֙ וְ/ס֣וּסֵי אֵ֔שׁ וַ/יַּפְרִ֖דוּ בֵּ֣ין שְׁנֵי/הֶ֑ם וַ/יַּ֨עַל֙ אֵ֣לִיָּ֔הוּ בַּֽ/סְעָרָ֖ה הַ/שָּׁמָֽיִם
verses.translit: vyhy hmh hlkhym hlvkh vdbr vhnh rkhb 'sh vsvsy 'sh vyprdv byn shnyhm vy'l 'lyhv bs'rh hshmym
verses.translation: And it came to pass, as they still went on, and talked, that, behold, there appeared a chariot of fire, and horses of fire, and parted them both asunder; and Elijah went up by a whirlwind into heaven.

verses.original: וֶ/אֱלִישָׁ֣ע רֹאֶ֗ה וְ/ה֤וּא מְצַעֵק֙ אָבִ֣/י אָבִ֗/י רֶ֤כֶב יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ וּ/פָ֣רָשָׁ֔י/ו וְ/לֹ֥א רָאָ֖/הוּ ע֑וֹד וַֽ/יַּחֲזֵק֙ בִּ/בְגָדָ֔י/ו וַ/יִּקְרָעֵ֖/ם לִ/שְׁנַ֥יִם קְרָעִֽים
verses.translit: v'lysh' r'h vhv' mts'q 'by 'by rkhb yshr'l vprshyv vl' r'hv 'vd vychzq bbgdyv vyqr'm lshnym qr'ym
verses.translation: And Elisha saw it , and he cried, My father, my father, the chariot of Israel, and the horsemen thereof. And he saw him no more: and he took hold of his own clothes, and rent them in two pieces.

verses.original: וַ/יָּ֨רֶם֙ אֶת אַדֶּ֣רֶת אֵלִיָּ֔הוּ אֲשֶׁ֥ר נָפְלָ֖ה מֵ/עָלָ֑י/ו וַ/יָּ֥שָׁב וַֽ/יַּעֲמֹ֖ד עַל שְׂפַ֥ת הַ/יַּרְדֵּֽן
verses.translit: vyrm 't 'drt 'lyhv 'shr nplh m'lyv vyshb vy'md 'l shpt hyrdn
verses.translation: He took up also the mantle of Elijah that fell from him, and went back, and stood by the bank of Jordan;

verses.original: וַ/יִּקַּח֩ אֶת אַדֶּ֨רֶת אֵלִיָּ֜הוּ אֲשֶׁר נָפְלָ֤ה מֵֽ/עָלָי/ו֙ וַ/יַּכֶּ֣ה אֶת הַ/מַּ֔יִם וַ/יֹּאמַ֕ר אַיֵּ֕ה יְהוָ֖ה אֱלֹהֵ֣י אֵלִיָּ֑הוּ אַף ה֣וּא וַ/יַּכֶּ֣ה אֶת הַ/מַּ֗יִם וַ/יֵּֽחָצוּ֙ הֵ֣נָּה וָ/הֵ֔נָּה וַֽ/יַּעֲבֹ֖ר אֱלִישָֽׁע
verses.translit: vyqch 't 'drt 'lyhv 'shr nplh m'lyv vykhh 't hmym vy'mr 'yh yhvh 'lhy 'lyhv 'f hv' vykhh 't hmym vychtsv hnh vhnh vy'br 'lysh'
verses.translation: And he took the mantle of Elijah that fell from him, and smote the waters, and said, Where is the LORD God of Elijah? and when he also had smitten the waters, they parted hither and thither: and Elisha went over.

verses.original: וַ/יִּרְאֻ֨/הוּ בְנֵֽי הַ/נְּבִיאִ֤ים אֲשֶׁר בִּֽ/ירִיחוֹ֙ מִ/נֶּ֔גֶד וַ/יֹּ֣אמְר֔וּ נָ֛חָה ר֥וּחַ אֵלִיָּ֖הוּ עַל אֱלִישָׁ֑ע וַ/יָּבֹ֨אוּ֙ לִ/קְרָאת֔/וֹ וַ/יִּשְׁתַּחֲווּ ל֖/וֹ אָֽרְצָ/ה
verses.translit: vyr'hv bny hnby'ym 'shr byrychv mngd vy'mrv nchh rvch 'lyhv 'l 'lysh' vyb'v lqr'tv vyshtchvv lv 'rtsh
verses.translation: And when the sons of the prophets which were to view at Jericho saw him, they said, The spirit of Elijah doth rest on Elisha. And they came to meet him, and bowed themselves to the ground before him.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּאמְר֣וּ אֵלָ֡י/ו הִנֵּה נָ֣א יֵֽשׁ אֶת עֲבָדֶי/ךָ֩ חֲמִשִּׁ֨ים אֲנָשִׁ֜ים בְּנֵֽי חַ֗יִל יֵ֣לְכוּ נָא֮ וִ/יבַקְשׁ֣וּ אֶת אֲדֹנֶי/ךָ֒ פֶּן נְשָׂא/וֹ֙ ר֣וּחַ יְהוָ֔ה וַ/יַּשְׁלִכֵ֨/הוּ֙ בְּ/אַחַ֣ד הֶ/הָרִ֔ים א֖וֹ בְּ/אַחַ֣ת ה/גיאות הַ/גֵּאָי֑וֹת וַ/יֹּ֖אמֶר לֹ֥א תִשְׁלָֽחוּ
verses.translit: vy'mrv 'lyv hnh n' ysh 't 'bdykh chmshym 'nshym bny chyl ylkhv n' vybqshv 't 'dnykh pn nsh'v rvch yhvh vyshlkhhv b'chd hhrym 'v b'cht hgy'vt hg'yvt vy'mr l' tshlchv
verses.translation: And they said unto him, Behold now, there be with thy servants fifty strong men; let them go, we pray thee, and seek thy master: lest peradventure the Spirit of the LORD hath taken him up, and cast him upon some mountain, or into some valley. And he said, Ye shall not send.

verses.original: וַ/יִּפְצְרוּ ב֥/וֹ עַד בֹּ֖שׁ וַ/יֹּ֣אמֶר שְׁלָ֑חוּ וַֽ/יִּשְׁלְחוּ֙ חֲמִשִּׁ֣ים אִ֔ישׁ וַ/יְבַקְשׁ֥וּ שְׁלֹשָֽׁה יָמִ֖ים וְ/לֹ֥א מְצָאֻֽ/הוּ
verses.translit: vyptsrv bv 'd bsh vy'mr shlchv vyshlchv chmshym 'ysh vybqshv shlshh ymym vl' mts'hv
verses.translation: And when they urged him till he was ashamed, he said, Send. They sent therefore fifty men; and they sought three days, but found him not.

verses.original: וַ/יָּשֻׁ֣בוּ אֵלָ֔י/ו וְ/ה֖וּא יֹשֵׁ֣ב בִּ/ירִיח֑וֹ וַ/יֹּ֣אמֶר אֲלֵ/הֶ֔ם הֲ/לֽוֹא אָמַ֥רְתִּי אֲלֵי/כֶ֖ם אַל תֵּלֵֽכוּ
verses.translit: vyshbv 'lyv vhv' yshb byrychv vy'mr 'lhm hlv' 'mrty 'lykhm 'l tlkhv
verses.translation: And when they came again to him, (for he tarried at Jericho,) he said unto them, Did I not say unto you, Go not?

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֨אמְר֜וּ אַנְשֵׁ֤י הָ/עִיר֙ אֶל אֱלִישָׁ֔ע הִנֵּה נָ֞א מוֹשַׁ֤ב הָ/עִיר֙ ט֔וֹב כַּ/אֲשֶׁ֥ר אֲדֹנִ֖/י רֹאֶ֑ה וְ/הַ/מַּ֥יִם רָעִ֖ים וְ/הָ/אָ֥רֶץ מְשַׁכָּֽלֶת
verses.translit: vy'mrv 'nshy h'yr 'l 'lysh' hnh n' mvshb h'yr tvb kh'shr 'dny r'h vhmym r'ym vh'rts mshkhlt
verses.translation: And the men of the city said unto Elisha, Behold, I pray thee, the situation of this city is pleasant, as my lord seeth: but the water is naught, and the ground barren.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֗אמֶר קְחוּ לִ/י֙ צְלֹחִ֣ית חֲדָשָׁ֔ה וְ/שִׂ֥ימוּ שָׁ֖ם מֶ֑לַח וַ/יִּקְח֖וּ אֵלָֽי/ו
verses.translit: vy'mr qchv ly tslchyt chdshh vshymv shm mlch vyqchv 'lyv
verses.translation: And he said, Bring me a new cruse, and put salt therein. And they brought it to him.

verses.original: וַ/יֵּצֵא֙ אֶל מוֹצָ֣א הַ/מַּ֔יִם וַ/יַּשְׁלֶךְ שָׁ֖ם מֶ֑לַח וַ/יֹּ֜אמֶר כֹּֽה אָמַ֣ר יְהוָ֗ה רִפִּ֨אתִי֙ לַ/מַּ֣יִם הָ/אֵ֔לֶּה לֹֽא יִהְיֶ֥ה מִ/שָּׁ֛ם ע֖וֹד מָ֥וֶת וּ/מְשַׁכָּֽלֶת
verses.translit: vyts' 'l mvts' hmym vyshlkh shm mlch vy'mr khh 'mr yhvh rp'ty lmym h'lh l' yhyh mshm 'vd mvt vmshkhlt
verses.translation: And he went forth unto the spring of the waters, and cast the salt in there, and said, Thus saith the LORD , I have healed these waters; there shall not be from thence any more death or barren land .

verses.original: וַ/יֵּרָפ֣וּ הַ/מַּ֔יִם עַ֖ד הַ/יּ֣וֹם הַ/זֶּ֑ה כִּ/דְבַ֥ר אֱלִישָׁ֖ע אֲשֶׁ֥ר דִּבֵּֽר
verses.translit: vyrpv hmym 'd hyvm hzh khdbr 'lysh' 'shr dbr
verses.translation: So the waters were healed unto this day, according to the saying of Elisha which he spake.

verses.original: וַ/יַּ֥עַל מִ/שָּׁ֖ם בֵּֽית אֵ֑ל וְ/ה֣וּא עֹלֶ֣ה בַ/דֶּ֗רֶךְ וּ/נְעָרִ֤ים קְטַנִּים֙ יָצְא֣וּ מִן הָ/עִ֔יר וַ/יִּתְקַלְּסוּ ב/וֹ֙ וַ/יֹּ֣אמְרוּ ל֔/וֹ עֲלֵ֥ה קֵרֵ֖חַ עֲלֵ֥ה קֵרֵֽחַ
verses.translit: vy'l mshm byt 'l vhv' 'lh bdrkh vn'rym qtnym yts'v mn h'yr vytqlsv bv vy'mrv lv 'lh qrch 'lh qrch
verses.translation: And he went up from thence unto Beth-el: and as he was going up by the way, there came forth little children out of the city, and mocked him, and said unto him, Go up, thou bald head; go up, thou bald head.

verses.original: וַ/יִּ֤פֶן אַֽחֲרָי/ו֙ וַ/יִּרְאֵ֔/ם וַֽ/יְקַלְלֵ֖/ם בְּ/שֵׁ֣ם יְהוָ֑ה וַ/תֵּצֶ֨אנָה שְׁתַּ֤יִם דֻּבִּים֙ מִן הַ/יַּ֔עַר וַ/תְּבַקַּ֣עְנָה מֵ/הֶ֔ם אַרְבָּעִ֥ים וּ/שְׁנֵ֖י יְלָדִֽים
verses.translit: vypn 'chryv vyr'm vyqllm bshm yhvh vtts'nh shtym dbym mn hy'r vtbq'nh mhm 'rb'ym vshny yldym
verses.translation: And he turned back, and looked on them, and cursed them in the name of the LORD . And there came forth two she bears out of the wood, and tare forty and two children of them.

verses.original: וַ/יֵּ֥לֶךְ מִ/שָּׁ֖ם אֶל הַ֣ר הַ/כַּרְמֶ֑ל וּ/מִ/שָּׁ֖ם שָׁ֥ב שֹׁמְרֽוֹן
verses.translit: vylkh mshm 'l hr hkhrml vmshm shb shmrvn
verses.translation: And he went from thence to mount Carmel, and from thence he returned to Samaria.

verses.original: וִ/יהוֹרָ֣ם בֶּן אַחְאָ֗ב מָלַ֤ךְ עַל יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ בְּ/שֹׁ֣מְר֔וֹן בִּ/שְׁנַת֙ שְׁמֹנֶ֣ה עֶשְׂרֵ֔ה לִ/יהוֹשָׁפָ֖ט מֶ֣לֶךְ יְהוּדָ֑ה וַ/יִּמְלֹ֖ךְ שְׁתֵּים עֶשְׂרֵ֥ה שָׁנָֽה
verses.translit: vyhvrm bn 'ch'b mlkh 'l yshr'l bshmrvn bshnt shmnh 'shrh lyhvshpt mlkh yhvdh vymlkh shtym 'shrh shnh
verses.translation: Now Jehoram the son of Ahab began to reign over Israel in Samaria the eighteenth year of Jehoshaphat king of Judah, and reigned twelve years.

verses.original: וַ/יַּעֲשֶׂ֤ה הָ/רַע֙ בְּ/עֵינֵ֣י יְהוָ֔ה רַ֕ק לֹ֥א כְ/אָבִ֖י/ו וּ/כְ/אִמּ֑/וֹ וַ/יָּ֨סַר֙ אֶת מַצְּבַ֣ת הַ/בַּ֔עַל אֲשֶׁ֥ר עָשָׂ֖ה אָבִֽי/ו
verses.translit: vy'shh hr' b'yny yhvh rq l' kh'byv vkh'mv vysr 't mtsbt hb'l 'shr 'shh 'byv
verses.translation: And he wrought evil in the sight of the LORD ; but not like his father, and like his mother: for he put away the image of Baal that his father had made.

verses.original: רַ֠ק בְּ/חַטֹּ֞אות יָרָבְעָ֧ם בֶּֽן נְבָ֛ט אֲשֶׁר הֶחֱטִ֥יא אֶת יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל דָּבֵ֑ק לֹא סָ֖ר מִמֶּֽ/נָּה
verses.translit: rq bcht'vt yrb'm bn nbt 'shr hchty' 't yshr'l dbq l' sr mmnh
verses.translation: Nevertheless he cleaved unto the sins of Jeroboam the son of Nebat, which made Israel to sin; he departed not therefrom.

verses.original: וּ/מֵישַׁ֥ע מֶֽלֶךְ מוֹאָ֖ב הָיָ֣ה נֹקֵ֑ד וְ/הֵשִׁ֤יב לְ/מֶֽלֶךְ יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ מֵאָה אֶ֣לֶף כָּרִ֔ים וּ/מֵ֥אָה אֶ֖לֶף אֵילִ֥ים צָֽמֶר
verses.translit: vmysh' mlkh mv'b hyh nqd vhshyb lmlkh yshr'l m'h 'lf khrym vm'h 'lf 'ylym tsmr
verses.translation: And Mesha king of Moab was a sheepmaster, and rendered unto the king of Israel an hundred thousand lambs, and an hundred thousand rams, with the wool.

verses.original: וַ/יְהִ֖י כְּ/מ֣וֹת אַחְאָ֑ב וַ/יִּפְשַׁ֥ע מֶֽלֶךְ מוֹאָ֖ב בְּ/מֶ֥לֶךְ יִשְׂרָאֵֽל
verses.translit: vyhy khmvt 'ch'b vypsh' mlkh mv'b bmlkh yshr'l
verses.translation: But it came to pass, when Ahab was dead, that the king of Moab rebelled against the king of Israel.

verses.original: וַ/יֵּצֵ֞א הַ/מֶּ֧לֶךְ יְהוֹרָ֛ם בַּ/יּ֥וֹם הַ/ה֖וּא מִ/שֹּׁמְר֑וֹן וַ/יִּפְקֹ֖ד אֶת כָּל יִשְׂרָאֵֽל
verses.translit: vyts' hmlkh yhvrm byvm hhv' mshmrvn vypqd 't khl yshr'l
verses.translation: And king Jehoram went out of Samaria the same time, and numbered all Israel.

verses.original: וַ/יֵּ֡לֶךְ וַ/יִּשְׁלַח֩ אֶל יְהוֹשָׁפָ֨ט מֶֽלֶךְ יְהוּדָ֜ה לֵ/אמֹ֗ר מֶ֤לֶךְ מוֹאָב֙ פָּשַׁ֣ע בִּ֔/י הֲ/תֵלֵ֥ךְ אִתִּ֛/י אֶל מוֹאָ֖ב לַ/מִּלְחָמָ֑ה וַ/יֹּ֣אמֶר אֶעֱלֶ֔ה כָּמ֧וֹ/נִי כָמ֛וֹ/ךָ כְּ/עַמִּ֥/י כְ/עַמֶּ֖/ךָ כְּ/סוּסַ֥/י כְּ/סוּסֶֽי/ךָ
verses.translit: vylkh vyshlch 'l yhvshpt mlkh yhvdh l'mr mlkh mv'b psh' by htlkh 'ty 'l mv'b lmlchmh vy'mr ''lh khmvny khmvkh kh'my kh'mkh khsvsy khsvsykh
verses.translation: And he went and sent to Jehoshaphat the king of Judah, saying, The king of Moab hath rebelled against me: wilt thou go with me against Moab to battle? And he said, I will go up: I am as thou art , my people as thy people, and my horses as thy horses.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֕אמֶר אֵי זֶ֥ה הַ/דֶּ֖רֶךְ נַעֲלֶ֑ה וַ/יֹּ֕אמֶר דֶּ֖רֶךְ מִדְבַּ֥ר אֱדֽוֹם
verses.translit: vy'mr 'y zh hdrkh n'lh vy'mr drkh mdbr 'dvm
verses.translation: And he said, Which way shall we go up? And he answered, The way through the wilderness of Edom.

verses.original: וַ/יֵּלֶךְ֩ מֶ֨לֶךְ יִשְׂרָאֵ֤ל וּ/מֶֽלֶך יְהוּדָה֙ וּ/מֶ֣לֶךְ אֱד֔וֹם וַ/יָּסֹ֕בּוּ דֶּ֖רֶךְ שִׁבְעַ֣ת יָמִ֑ים וְ/לֹא הָיָ֨ה מַ֧יִם לַֽ/מַּחֲנֶ֛ה וְ/לַ/בְּהֵמָ֖ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר בְּ/רַגְלֵי/הֶֽם
verses.translit: vylkh mlkh yshr'l vmlkh yhvdh vmlkh 'dvm vysbv drkh shb't ymym vl' hyh mym lmchnh vlbhmh 'shr brglyhm
verses.translation: So the king of Israel went, and the king of Judah, and the king of Edom: and they fetched a compass of seven days’ journey: and there was no water for the host, and for the cattle that followed them.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֖אמֶר מֶ֣לֶךְ יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל אֲהָ֕הּ כִּֽי קָרָ֣א יְהוָ֗ה לִ/שְׁלֹ֨שֶׁת֙ הַ/מְּלָכִ֣ים הָ/אֵ֔לֶּה לָ/תֵ֥ת אוֹתָ֖/ם בְּ/יַד מוֹאָֽב
verses.translit: vy'mr mlkh yshr'l 'hh khy qr' yhvh lshlsht hmlkhym h'lh ltt 'vtm byd mv'b
verses.translation: And the king of Israel said, Alas! that the LORD hath called these three kings together, to deliver them into the hand of Moab!

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֣אמֶר יְהוֹשָׁפָ֗ט הַ/אֵ֨ין פֹּ֤ה נָבִיא֙ לַֽ/יהוָ֔ה וְ/נִדְרְשָׁ֥ה אֶת יְהוָ֖ה מֵ/אוֹת֑/וֹ וַ֠/יַּעַן אֶחָ֞ד מֵ/עַבְדֵ֤י מֶֽלֶךְ יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ וַ/יֹּ֔אמֶר פֹּ֚ה אֱלִישָׁ֣ע בֶּן שָׁפָ֔ט אֲשֶׁר יָ֥צַק מַ֖יִם עַל יְדֵ֥י אֵלִיָּֽהוּ
verses.translit: vy'mr yhvshpt h'yn ph nby' lyhvh vndrshh 't yhvh m'vtv vy'n 'chd m'bdy mlkh yshr'l vy'mr ph 'lysh' bn shpt 'shr ytsq mym 'l ydy 'lyhv
verses.translation: But Jehoshaphat said, Is there not here a prophet of the LORD , that we may enquire of the LORD by him? And one of the king of Israel’s servants answered and said, Here is Elisha the son of Shaphat, which poured water on the hands of Elijah.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֨אמֶר֙ יְה֣וֹשָׁפָ֔ט יֵ֥שׁ אוֹת֖/וֹ דְּבַר יְהוָ֑ה וַ/יֵּרְד֣וּ אֵלָ֗י/ו מֶ֧לֶךְ יִשְׂרָאֵ֛ל וִ/יהוֹשָׁפָ֖ט וּ/מֶ֥לֶךְ אֱדֽוֹם
verses.translit: vy'mr yhvshpt ysh 'vtv dbr yhvh vyrdv 'lyv mlkh yshr'l vyhvshpt vmlkh 'dvm
verses.translation: And Jehoshaphat said, The word of the LORD is with him. So the king of Israel and Jehoshaphat and the king of Edom went down to him.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֨אמֶר אֱלִישָׁ֜ע אֶל מֶ֤לֶךְ יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ מַה לִּ֣/י וָ/לָ֔/ךְ לֵ֚ךְ אֶל נְבִיאֵ֣י אָבִ֔י/ךָ וְ/אֶל נְבִיאֵ֖י אִמֶּ֑/ךָ וַ/יֹּ֤אמֶר ל/וֹ֙ מֶ֣לֶךְ יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל אַ֗ל כִּֽי קָרָ֤א יְהוָה֙ לִ/שְׁלֹ֨שֶׁת֙ הַ/מְּלָכִ֣ים הָ/אֵ֔לֶּה לָ/תֵ֥ת אוֹתָ֖/ם בְּ/יַד מוֹאָֽב
verses.translit: vy'mr 'lysh' 'l mlkh yshr'l mh ly vlkh lkh 'l nby'y 'bykh v'l nby'y 'mkh vy'mr lv mlkh yshr'l 'l khy qr' yhvh lshlsht hmlkhym h'lh ltt 'vtm byd mv'b
verses.translation: And Elisha said unto the king of Israel, What have I to do with thee? get thee to the prophets of thy father, and to the prophets of thy mother. And the king of Israel said unto him, Nay: for the LORD hath called these three kings together, to deliver them into the hand of Moab.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֣אמֶר אֱלִישָׁ֗ע חַי יְהוָ֤ה צְבָאוֹת֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר עָמַ֣דְתִּי לְ/פָנָ֔י/ו כִּ֗י לוּלֵ֛י פְּנֵ֛י יְהוֹשָׁפָ֥ט מֶֽלֶךְ יְהוּדָ֖ה אֲנִ֣י נֹשֵׂ֑א אִם אַבִּ֥יט אֵלֶ֖י/ךָ וְ/אִם אֶרְאֶֽ/ךָּ
verses.translit: vy'mr 'lysh' chy yhvh tsb'vt 'shr 'mdty lpnyv khy lvly pny yhvshpt mlkh yhvdh 'ny nsh' 'm 'byt 'lykh v'm 'r'kh
verses.translation: And Elisha said, As the LORD of hosts liveth, before whom I stand, surely, were it not that I regard the presence of Jehoshaphat the king of Judah, I would not look toward thee, nor see thee.

verses.original: וְ/עַתָּ֖ה קְחוּ לִ֣/י מְנַגֵּ֑ן וְ/הָיָה֙ כְּ/נַגֵּ֣ן הַֽ/מְנַגֵּ֔ן וַ/תְּהִ֥י עָלָ֖י/ו יַד יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: v'th qchv ly mngn vhyh khngn hmngn vthy 'lyv yd yhvh
verses.translation: But now bring me a minstrel. And it came to pass, when the minstrel played, that the hand of the LORD came upon him.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֕אמֶר כֹּ֖ה אָמַ֣ר יְהוָ֑ה עָשֹׂ֛ה הַ/נַּ֥חַל הַ/זֶּ֖ה גֵּבִ֥ים גֵּבִֽים
verses.translit: vy'mr khh 'mr yhvh 'shh hnchl hzh gbym gbym
verses.translation: And he said, Thus saith the LORD , Make this valley full of ditches.

verses.original: כִּֽי כֹ֣ה אָמַ֣ר יְהוָ֗ה לֹֽא תִרְא֥וּ ר֨וּחַ֙ וְ/לֹֽא תִרְא֣וּ גֶ֔שֶׁם וְ/הַ/נַּ֥חַל הַ/ה֖וּא יִמָּ֣לֵא מָ֑יִם וּ/שְׁתִיתֶ֛ם אַתֶּ֥ם וּ/מִקְנֵי/כֶ֖ם וּֽ/בְהֶמְתְּ/כֶֽם
verses.translit: khy khh 'mr yhvh l' tr'v rvch vl' tr'v gshm vhnchl hhv' yml' mym vshtytm 'tm vmqnykhm vbhmtkhm
verses.translation: For thus saith the LORD , Ye shall not see wind, neither shall ye see rain; yet that valley shall be filled with water, that ye may drink, both ye, and your cattle, and your beasts.

verses.original: וְ/נָקַ֥ל זֹ֖את בְּ/עֵינֵ֣י יְהוָ֑ה וְ/נָתַ֥ן אֶת מוֹאָ֖ב בְּ/יֶדְ/כֶֽם
verses.translit: vnql z't b'yny yhvh vntn 't mv'b bydkhm
verses.translation: And this is but a light thing in the sight of the LORD : he will deliver the Moabites also into your hand.

verses.original: וְ/הִכִּיתֶ֞ם כָּל עִ֤יר מִבְצָר֙ וְ/כָל עִ֣יר מִבְח֔וֹר וְ/כָל עֵ֥ץ טוֹב֙ תַּפִּ֔ילוּ וְ/כָל מַעְיְנֵי מַ֖יִם תִּסְתֹּ֑מוּ וְ/כֹל֙ הַ/חֶלְקָ֣ה הַ/טּוֹבָ֔ה תַּכְאִ֖בוּ בָּ/אֲבָנִֽים
verses.translit: vhkhytm khl 'yr mbtsr vkhl 'yr mbchvr vkhl 'ts tvb tpylv vkhl m'yny mym tstmv vkhl hchlqh htvbh tkh'bv b'bnym
verses.translation: And ye shall smite every fenced city, and every choice city, and shall fell every good tree, and stop all wells of water, and mar every good piece of land with stones.

verses.original: וַ/יְהִ֤י בַ/בֹּ֨קֶר֙ כַּ/עֲל֣וֹת הַ/מִּנְחָ֔ה וְ/הִנֵּה מַ֥יִם בָּאִ֖ים מִ/דֶּ֣רֶךְ אֱד֑וֹם וַ/תִּמָּלֵ֥א הָ/אָ֖רֶץ אֶת הַ/מָּֽיִם
verses.translit: vyhy bbqr kh'lvt hmnchh vhnh mym b'ym mdrkh 'dvm vtml' h'rts 't hmym
verses.translation: And it came to pass in the morning, when the meat offering was offered, that, behold, there came water by the way of Edom, and the country was filled with water.

verses.original: וְ/כָל מוֹאָב֙ שָֽׁמְע֔וּ כִּֽי עָל֥וּ הַ/מְּלָכִ֖ים לְ/הִלָּ֣חֶם בָּ֑/ם וַ/יִּצָּעֲק֗וּ מִ/כֹּ֨ל חֹגֵ֤ר חֲגֹרָה֙ וָ/מַ֔עְלָ/ה וַ/יַּעַמְד֖וּ עַֽל הַ/גְּבֽוּל
verses.translit: vkhl mv'b shm'v khy 'lv hmlkhym lhlchm bm vyts'qv mkhl chgr chgrh vm'lh vy'mdv 'l hgbvl
verses.translation: And when all the Moabites heard that the kings were come up to fight against them, they gathered all that were able to put on armour, and upward, and stood in the border.

verses.original: וַ/יַּשְׁכִּ֣ימוּ בַ/בֹּ֔קֶר וְ/הַ/שֶּׁ֖מֶשׁ זָרְחָ֣ה עַל הַ/מָּ֑יִם וַ/יִּרְא֨וּ מוֹאָ֥ב מִ/נֶּ֛גֶד אֶת הַ/מַּ֖יִם אֲדֻמִּ֥ים כַּ/דָּֽם
verses.translit: vyshkhymv bbqr vhshmsh zrchh 'l hmym vyr'v mv'b mngd 't hmym 'dmym khdm
verses.translation: And they rose up early in the morning, and the sun shone upon the water, and the Moabites saw the water on the other side as red as blood:

verses.original: וַ/יֹּֽאמְרוּ֙ דָּ֣ם זֶ֔ה הָחֳרֵ֤ב נֶֽחֶרְבוּ֙ הַ/מְּלָכִ֔ים וַ/יַּכּ֖וּ אִ֣ישׁ אֶת רֵעֵ֑/הוּ וְ/עַתָּ֥ה לַ/שָּׁלָ֖ל מוֹאָֽב
verses.translit: vy'mrv dm zh hchrb nchrbv hmlkhym vykhv 'ysh 't r'hv v'th lshll mv'b
verses.translation: And they said, This is blood: the kings are surely slain, and they have smitten one another: now therefore, Moab, to the spoil.

verses.original: וַ/יָּבֹאוּ֮ אֶל מַחֲנֵ֣ה יִשְׂרָאֵל֒ וַ/יָּקֻ֤מוּ יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ וַ/יַּכּ֣וּ אֶת מוֹאָ֔ב וַ/יָּנֻ֖סוּ מִ/פְּנֵי/הֶ֑ם ו/יבו וַ/יַּכּוּ בָ֔/הּ וְ/הַכּ֖וֹת אֶת מוֹאָֽב
verses.translit: vyb'v 'l mchnh yshr'l vyqmv yshr'l vykhv 't mv'b vynsv mpnyhm vybv vykhv bh vhkhvt 't mv'b
verses.translation: And when they came to the camp of Israel, the Israelites rose up and smote the Moabites, so that they fled before them: but they went forward smiting the Moabites, even in their country.

verses.original: וְ/הֶ/עָרִ֣ים יַהֲרֹ֡סוּ וְ/כָל חֶלְקָ֣ה ט֠וֹבָה יַשְׁלִ֨יכוּ אִישׁ אַבְנ֜/וֹ וּ/מִלְא֗וּ/הָ וְ/כָל מַעְיַן מַ֤יִם יִסְתֹּ֨מוּ֙ וְ/כָל עֵֽץ ט֣וֹב יַפִּ֔ילוּ עַד הִשְׁאִ֧יר אֲבָנֶ֛י/הָ בַּ/קִּ֖יר חֲרָ֑שֶׂת וַ/יָּסֹ֥בּוּ הַ/קַּלָּעִ֖ים וַ/יַּכּֽוּ/הָ
verses.translit: vh'rym yhrsv vkhl chlqh tvbh yshlykhv 'ysh 'bnv vml'vh vkhl m'yn mym ystmv vkhl 'ts tvb ypylv 'd hsh'yr 'bnyh bqyr chrsht vysbv hql'ym vykhvh
verses.translation: And they beat down the cities, and on every good piece of land cast every man his stone, and filled it; and they stopped all the wells of water, and felled all the good trees: only in Kir-haraseth left they the stones thereof; howbeit the slingers went about it , and smote it.

verses.original: וַ/יַּרְא֙ מֶ֣לֶךְ מוֹאָ֔ב כִּֽי חָזַ֥ק מִמֶּ֖/נּוּ הַ/מִּלְחָמָ֑ה וַ/יִּקַּ֣ח א֠וֹת/וֹ שְׁבַע מֵא֨וֹת אִ֜ישׁ שֹׁ֣לֵֽף חֶ֗רֶב לְ/הַבְקִ֛יעַ אֶל מֶ֥לֶךְ אֱד֖וֹם וְ/לֹ֥א יָכֹֽלוּ
verses.translit: vyr' mlkh mv'b khy chzq mmnv hmlchmh vyqch 'vtv shb' m'vt 'ysh shlf chrb lhbqy' 'l mlkh 'dvm vl' ykhlv
verses.translation: And when the king of Moab saw that the battle was too sore for him, he took with him seven hundred men that drew swords, to break through even unto the king of Edom: but they could not.

verses.original: וַ/יִּקַּח֩ אֶת בְּנ֨/וֹ הַ/בְּכ֜וֹר אֲשֶׁר יִמְלֹ֣ךְ תַּחְתָּ֗י/ו וַ/יַּעֲלֵ֤/הוּ עֹלָה֙ עַל הַ֣/חֹמָ֔ה וַ/יְהִ֥י קֶצֶף גָּד֖וֹל עַל יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וַ/יִּסְעוּ֙ מֵֽ/עָלָ֔י/ו וַ/יָּשֻׁ֖בוּ לָ/אָֽרֶץ
verses.translit: vyqch 't bnv hbkhvr 'shr ymlkh tchtyv vy'lhv 'lh 'l hchmh vyhy qtsf gdvl 'l yshr'l vys'v m'lyv vyshbv l'rts
verses.translation: Then he took his eldest son that should have reigned in his stead, and offered him for a burnt offering upon the wall. And there was great indignation against Israel: and they departed from him, and returned to their own land.

verses.original: וְ/אִשָּׁ֣ה אַחַ֣ת מִ/נְּשֵׁ֣י בְנֵֽי הַ֠/נְּבִיאִים צָעֲקָ֨ה אֶל אֱלִישָׁ֜ע לֵ/אמֹ֗ר עַבְדְּ/ךָ֤ אִישִׁ/י֙ מֵ֔ת וְ/אַתָּ֣ה יָדַ֔עְתָּ כִּ֣י עַבְדְּ/ךָ֔ הָיָ֥ה יָרֵ֖א אֶת יְהוָ֑ה וְ/הַ֨/נֹּשֶׁ֔ה בָּ֗א לָ/קַ֜חַת אֶת שְׁנֵ֧י יְלָדַ֛/י ל֖/וֹ לַ/עֲבָדִֽים
verses.translit: v'shh 'cht mnshy bny hnby'ym ts'qh 'l 'lysh' l'mr 'bdkh 'yshy mt v'th yd't khy 'bdkh hyh yr' 't yhvh vhnshh b' lqcht 't shny yldy lv l'bdym
verses.translation: Now there cried a certain woman of the wives of the sons of the prophets unto Elisha, saying, Thy servant my husband is dead; and thou knowest that thy servant did fear the LORD : and the creditor is come to take unto him my two sons to be bondmen.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֨אמֶר אֵלֶ֤י/הָ אֱלִישָׁע֙ מָ֣ה אֶֽעֱשֶׂה לָּ֔/ךְ הַגִּ֣ידִי לִ֔/י מַה יֶּשׁ ל/כי לָ֖/ךְ בַּ/בָּ֑יִת וַ/תֹּ֗אמֶר אֵ֣ין לְ/שִׁפְחָתְ/ךָ֥ כֹל֙ בַּ/בַּ֔יִת כִּ֖י אִם אָס֥וּךְ שָֽׁמֶן
verses.translit: vy'mr 'lyh 'lysh' mh ''shh lkh hgydy ly mh ysh lkhy lkh bbyt vt'mr 'yn lshpchtkh khl bbyt khy 'm 'svkh shmn
verses.translation: And Elisha said unto her, What shall I do for thee? tell me, what hast thou in the house? And she said, Thine handmaid hath not any thing in the house, save a pot of oil.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֗אמֶר לְכִ֨י שַׁאֲלִי לָ֤/ךְ כֵּלִים֙ מִן הַ/ח֔וּץ מֵ/אֵ֖ת כָּל שכנ/כי שְׁכֵנָ֑יִ/ךְ כֵּלִ֥ים רֵקִ֖ים אַל תַּמְעִֽיטִי
verses.translit: vy'mr lkhy sh'ly lkh khlym mn hchvts m't khl shkhnkhy shkhnykh khlym rqym 'l tm'yty
verses.translation: Then he said, Go, borrow thee vessels abroad of all thy neighbours, even empty vessels; borrow not a few.

verses.original: וּ/בָ֗את וְ/סָגַ֤רְתְּ הַ/דֶּ֨לֶת֙ בַּעֲדֵ֣/ךְ וּ/בְעַד בָּנַ֔יִ/ךְ וְ/יָצַ֕קְתְּ עַ֥ל כָּל הַ/כֵּלִ֖ים הָ/אֵ֑לֶּה וְ/הַ/מָּלֵ֖א תַּסִּֽיעִי
verses.translit: vb't vsgrt hdlt b'dkh vb'd bnykh vytsqt 'l khl hkhlym h'lh vhml' tsy'y
