verses.translation: And when thou art come in, thou shalt shut the door upon thee and upon thy sons, and shalt pour out into all those vessels, and thou shalt set aside that which is full.

verses.original: וַ/תֵּ֨לֶךְ֙ מֵֽ/אִתּ֔/וֹ וַ/תִּסְגֹּ֣ר הַ/דֶּ֔לֶת בַּעֲדָ֖/הּ וּ/בְעַ֣ד בָּנֶ֑י/הָ הֵ֛ם מַגִּשִׁ֥ים אֵלֶ֖י/הָ וְ/הִ֥יא מיצקת מוֹצָֽקֶת
verses.translit: vtlkh m'tv vtsgr hdlt b'dh vb'd bnyh hm mgshym 'lyh vhy' mytsqt mvtsqt
verses.translation: So she went from him, and shut the door upon her and upon her sons, who brought the vessels to her; and she poured out.

verses.original: וַ/יְהִ֣י כִּ/מְלֹ֣את הַ/כֵּלִ֗ים וַ/תֹּ֤אמֶר אֶל בְּנָ/הּ֙ הַגִּ֨ישָׁ/ה אֵלַ֥/י עוֹד֙ כֶּ֔לִי וַ/יֹּ֣אמֶר אֵלֶ֔י/הָ אֵ֥ין ע֖וֹד כֶּ֑לִי וַֽ/יַּעֲמֹ֖ד הַ/שָּֽׁמֶן
verses.translit: vyhy khml't hkhlym vt'mr 'l bnh hgyshh 'ly 'vd khly vy'mr 'lyh 'yn 'vd khly vy'md hshmn
verses.translation: And it came to pass, when the vessels were full, that she said unto her son, Bring me yet a vessel. And he said unto her, There is not a vessel more. And the oil stayed.

verses.original: וַ/תָּבֹ֗א וַ/תַּגֵּד֙ לְ/אִ֣ישׁ הָ/אֱלֹהִ֔ים וַ/יֹּ֗אמֶר לְכִי֙ מִכְרִ֣י אֶת הַ/שֶּׁ֔מֶן וְ/שַׁלְּמִ֖י אֶת נשי/כי נִשְׁיֵ֑/ךְ וְ/אַ֣תְּ בני/כי וּ/בָנַ֔יִ/ךְ תִֽחְיִ֖י בַּ/נּוֹתָֽר
verses.translit: vtb' vtgd l'ysh h'lhym vy'mr lkhy mkhry 't hshmn vshlmy 't nshykhy nshykh v't bnykhy vbnykh tchyy bnvtr
verses.translation: Then she came and told the man of God. And he said, Go, sell the oil, and pay thy debt, and live thou and thy children of the rest.

verses.original: וַ/יְהִ֨י הַ/יּ֜וֹם וַ/יַּעֲבֹ֧ר אֱלִישָׁ֣ע אֶל שׁוּנֵ֗ם וְ/שָׁם֙ אִשָּׁ֣ה גְדוֹלָ֔ה וַ/תַּחֲזֶק בּ֖/וֹ לֶ/אֱכָל לָ֑חֶם וַֽ/יְהִי֙ מִ/דֵּ֣י עָבְר֔/וֹ יָסֻ֥ר שָׁ֖מָּ/ה לֶ/אֱכָל לָֽחֶם
verses.translit: vyhy hyvm vy'br 'lysh' 'l shvnm vshm 'shh gdvlh vtchzq bv l'khl lchm vyhy mdy 'brv ysr shmh l'khl lchm
verses.translation: And it fell on a day, that Elisha passed to Shunem, where was a great woman; and she constrained him to eat bread. And so it was, that as oft as he passed by, he turned in thither to eat bread.

verses.original: וַ/תֹּ֨אמֶר֙ אֶל אִישָׁ֔/הּ הִנֵּה נָ֣א יָדַ֔עְתִּי כִּ֛י אִ֥ישׁ אֱלֹהִ֖ים קָד֣וֹשׁ ה֑וּא עֹבֵ֥ר עָלֵ֖י/נוּ תָּמִֽיד
verses.translit: vt'mr 'l 'yshh hnh n' yd'ty khy 'ysh 'lhym qdvsh hv' 'br 'lynv tmyd
verses.translation: And she said unto her husband, Behold now, I perceive that this is an holy man of God, which passeth by us continually.

verses.original: נַֽעֲשֶׂה נָּ֤א עֲלִיַּת קִיר֙ קְטַנָּ֔ה וְ/נָשִׂ֨ים ל֥/וֹ שָׁ֛ם מִטָּ֥ה וְ/שֻׁלְחָ֖ן וְ/כִסֵּ֣א וּ/מְנוֹרָ֑ה וְ/הָיָ֛ה בְּ/בֹא֥/וֹ אֵלֵ֖י/נוּ יָס֥וּר שָֽׁמָּ/ה
verses.translit: n'shh n' 'lyt qyr qtnh vnshym lv shm mth vshlchn vkhs' vmnvrh vhyh bb'v 'lynv ysvr shmh
verses.translation: Let us make a little chamber, I pray thee, on the wall; and let us set for him there a bed, and a table, and a stool, and a candlestick: and it shall be, when he cometh to us, that he shall turn in thither.

verses.original: וַ/יְהִ֥י הַ/יּ֖וֹם וַ/יָּ֣בֹא שָׁ֑מָּ/ה וַ/יָּ֥סַר אֶל הָ/עֲלִיָּ֖ה וַ/יִּשְׁכַּב שָֽׁמָּ/ה
verses.translit: vyhy hyvm vyb' shmh vysr 'l h'lyh vyshkhb shmh
verses.translation: And it fell on a day, that he came thither, and he turned into the chamber, and lay there.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֨אמֶר֙ אֶל גֵּחֲזִ֣י נַעֲר֔/וֹ קְרָ֖א לַ/שּׁוּנַמִּ֣ית הַ/זֹּ֑את וַ/יִּקְרָא לָ֔/הּ וַֽ/תַּעֲמֹ֖ד לְ/פָנָֽי/ו
verses.translit: vy'mr 'l gchzy n'rv qr' lshvnmyt hz't vyqr' lh vt'md lpnyv
verses.translation: And he said to Gehazi his servant, Call this Shunammite. And when he had called her, she stood before him.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֣אמֶר ל֗/וֹ אֱמָר נָ֣א אֵלֶי/הָ֮ הִנֵּ֣ה חָרַ֣דְתְּ אֵלֵי/נוּ֮ אֶת כָּל הַ/חֲרָדָ֣ה הַ/זֹּאת֒ מֶ֚ה לַ/עֲשׂ֣וֹת לָ֔/ךְ הֲ/יֵ֤שׁ לְ/דַבֶּר לָ/ךְ֙ אֶל הַ/מֶּ֔לֶךְ א֖וֹ אֶל שַׂ֣ר הַ/צָּבָ֑א וַ/תֹּ֕אמֶר בְּ/ת֥וֹךְ עַמִּ֖/י אָנֹכִ֥י יֹשָֽׁבֶת
verses.translit: vy'mr lv 'mr n' 'lyh hnh chrdt 'lynv 't khl hchrdh hz't mh l'shvt lkh hysh ldbr lkh 'l hmlkh 'v 'l shr htsb' vt'mr btvkh 'my 'nkhy yshbt
verses.translation: And he said unto him, Say now unto her, Behold, thou hast been careful for us with all this care; what is to be done for thee? wouldest thou be spoken for to the king, or to the captain of the host? And she answered, I dwell among mine own people.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֕אמֶר וּ/מֶ֖ה לַ/עֲשׂ֣וֹת לָ֑/הּ וַ/יֹּ֣אמֶר גֵּיחֲזִ֗י אֲבָ֛ל בֵּ֥ן אֵֽין לָ֖/הּ וְ/אִישָׁ֥/הּ זָקֵֽן
verses.translit: vy'mr vmh l'shvt lh vy'mr gychzy 'bl bn 'yn lh v'yshh zqn
verses.translation: And he said, What then is to be done for her? And Gehazi answered, Verily she hath no child, and her husband is old.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֖אמֶר קְרָא לָ֑/הּ וַ/יִּקְרָא לָ֔/הּ וַֽ/תַּעֲמֹ֖ד בַּ/פָּֽתַח
verses.translit: vy'mr qr' lh vyqr' lh vt'md bptch
verses.translation: And he said, Call her. And when he had called her, she stood in the door.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֗אמֶר לַ/מּוֹעֵ֤ד הַ/זֶּה֙ כָּ/עֵ֣ת חַיָּ֔ה אתי אַ֖תְּ חֹבֶ֣קֶת בֵּ֑ן וַ/תֹּ֗אמֶר אַל אֲדֹנִ/י֙ אִ֣ישׁ הָ/אֱלֹהִ֔ים אַל תְּכַזֵּ֖ב בְּ/שִׁפְחָתֶֽ/ךָ
verses.translit: vy'mr lmv'd hzh kh't chyh 'ty 't chbqt bn vt'mr 'l 'dny 'ysh h'lhym 'l tkhzb bshpchtkh
verses.translation: And he said, About this season, according to the time of life, thou shalt embrace a son. And she said, Nay, my lord, thou man of God, do not lie unto thine handmaid.

verses.original: וַ/תַּ֥הַר הָ/אִשָּׁ֖ה וַ/תֵּ֣לֶד בֵּ֑ן לַ/מּוֹעֵ֤ד הַ/זֶּה֙ כָּ/עֵ֣ת חַיָּ֔ה אֲשֶׁר דִּבֶּ֥ר אֵלֶ֖י/הָ אֱלִישָֽׁע
verses.translit: vthr h'shh vtld bn lmv'd hzh kh't chyh 'shr dbr 'lyh 'lysh'
verses.translation: And the woman conceived, and bare a son at that season that Elisha had said unto her, according to the time of life.

verses.original: וַ/יִּגְדַּ֖ל הַ/יָּ֑לֶד וַ/יְהִ֣י הַ/יּ֔וֹם וַ/יֵּצֵ֥א אֶל אָבִ֖י/ו אֶל הַ/קֹּצְרִֽים
verses.translit: vygdl hyld vyhy hyvm vyts' 'l 'byv 'l hqtsrym
verses.translation: And when the child was grown, it fell on a day, that he went out to his father to the reapers.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֥אמֶר אֶל אָבִ֖י/ו רֹאשִׁ֣/י רֹאשִׁ֑/י וַ/יֹּ֨אמֶר֙ אֶל הַ/נַּ֔עַר שָׂאֵ֖/הוּ אֶל אִמּֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: vy'mr 'l 'byv r'shy r'shy vy'mr 'l hn'r sh'hv 'l 'mv
verses.translation: And he said unto his father, My head, my head. And he said to a lad, Carry him to his mother.

verses.original: וַ/יִּשָּׂאֵ֔/הוּ וַ/יְבִיאֵ֖/הוּ אֶל אִמּ֑/וֹ וַ/יֵּ֧שֶׁב עַל בִּרְכֶּ֛י/הָ עַד הַֽ/צָּהֳרַ֖יִם וַ/יָּמֹֽת
verses.translit: vysh'hv vyby'hv 'l 'mv vyshb 'l brkhyh 'd htshrym vymt
verses.translation: And when he had taken him, and brought him to his mother, he sat on her knees till noon, and then died.

verses.original: וַ/תַּ֨עַל֙ וַ/תַּשְׁכִּבֵ֔/הוּ עַל מִטַּ֖ת אִ֣ישׁ הָ/אֱלֹהִ֑ים וַ/תִּסְגֹּ֥ר בַּעֲד֖/וֹ וַ/תֵּצֵֽא
verses.translit: vt'l vtshkhbhv 'l mtt 'ysh h'lhym vtsgr b'dv vtts'
verses.translation: And she went up, and laid him on the bed of the man of God, and shut the door upon him, and went out.

verses.original: וַ/תִּקְרָא֮ אֶל אִישָׁ/הּ֒ וַ/תֹּ֗אמֶר שִׁלְחָ֨/ה נָ֥א לִ/י֙ אֶחָ֣ד מִן הַ/נְּעָרִ֔ים וְ/אַחַ֖ת הָ/אֲתֹנ֑וֹת וְ/אָר֛וּצָה עַד אִ֥ישׁ הָ/אֱלֹהִ֖ים וְ/אָשֽׁוּבָה
verses.translit: vtqr' 'l 'yshh vt'mr shlchh n' ly 'chd mn hn'rym v'cht h'tnvt v'rvtsh 'd 'ysh h'lhym v'shvbh
verses.translation: And she called unto her husband, and said, Send me, I pray thee, one of the young men, and one of the asses, that I may run to the man of God, and come again.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֗אמֶר מַ֠דּוּעַ אתי אַ֣תְּ הלכתי הֹלֶ֤כֶת אֵלָי/ו֙ הַ/יּ֔וֹם לֹֽא חֹ֖דֶשׁ וְ/לֹ֣א שַׁבָּ֑ת וַ/תֹּ֖אמֶר שָׁלֽוֹם
verses.translit: vy'mr mdv' 'ty 't hlkhty hlkht 'lyv hyvm l' chdsh vl' shbt vt'mr shlvm
verses.translation: And he said, Wherefore wilt thou go to him to day? it is neither new moon, nor sabbath. And she said, It shall be well.

verses.original: וַֽ/תַּחֲבֹשׁ֙ הָֽ/אָת֔וֹן וַ/תֹּ֥אמֶר אֶֽל נַעֲרָ֖/הּ נְהַ֣ג וָ/לֵ֑ךְ אַל תַּעֲצָר לִ֣/י לִ/רְכֹּ֔ב כִּ֖י אִם אָמַ֥רְתִּי לָֽ/ךְ
verses.translit: vtchbsh h'tvn vt'mr 'l n'rh nhg vlkh 'l t'tsr ly lrkhb khy 'm 'mrty lkh
verses.translation: Then she saddled an ass, and said to her servant, Drive, and go forward; slack not thy riding for me, except I bid thee.

verses.original: וַ/תֵּ֗לֶךְ וַ/תָּב֛וֹא אֶל אִ֥ישׁ הָ/אֱלֹהִ֖ים אֶל הַ֣ר הַ/כַּרְמֶ֑ל וַ֠/יְהִי כִּ/רְא֨וֹת אִישׁ הָ/אֱלֹהִ֤ים אֹתָ/הּ֙ מִ/נֶּ֔גֶד וַ/יֹּ֨אמֶר֙ אֶל גֵּיחֲזִ֣י נַעֲר֔/וֹ הִנֵּ֖ה הַ/שּׁוּנַמִּ֥ית הַלָּֽז
verses.translit: vtlkh vtbv' 'l 'ysh h'lhym 'l hr hkhrml vyhy khr'vt 'ysh h'lhym 'th mngd vy'mr 'l gychzy n'rv hnh hshvnmyt hlz
verses.translation: So she went and came unto the man of God to mount Carmel. And it came to pass, when the man of God saw her afar off, that he said to Gehazi his servant, Behold, yonder is that Shunammite:

verses.original: עַתָּה֮ רֽוּץ נָ֣א לִ/קְרָאתָ/הּ֒ וֶ/אֱמָר לָ֗/הּ הֲ/שָׁל֥וֹם לָ֛/ךְ הֲ/שָׁל֥וֹם לְ/אִישֵׁ֖/ךְ הֲ/שָׁל֣וֹם לַ/יָּ֑לֶד וַ/תֹּ֖אמֶר שָׁלֽוֹם
verses.translit: 'th rvts n' lqr'th v'mr lh hshlvm lkh hshlvm l'yshkh hshlvm lyld vt'mr shlvm
verses.translation: Run now, I pray thee, to meet her, and say unto her, Is it well with thee? is it well with thy husband? is it well with the child? And she answered, It is well.

verses.original: וַ/תָּבֹ֞א אֶל אִ֤ישׁ הָֽ/אֱלֹהִים֙ אֶל הָ/הָ֔ר וַֽ/תַּחֲזֵ֖ק בְּ/רַגְלָ֑י/ו וַ/יִּגַּ֨שׁ גֵּֽיחֲזִ֜י לְ/הָדְפָ֗/הּ וַ/יֹּאמֶר֩ אִ֨ישׁ הָ/אֱלֹהִ֤ים הַרְפֵּֽה לָ/הּ֙ כִּֽי נַפְשָׁ֣/הּ מָֽרָה לָ֔/הּ וַֽ/יהוָה֙ הֶעְלִ֣ים מִמֶּ֔/נִּי וְ/לֹ֥א הִגִּ֖יד לִֽ/י
verses.translit: vtb' 'l 'ysh h'lhym 'l hhr vtchzq brglyv vygsh gychzy lhdph vy'mr 'ysh h'lhym hrph lh khy npshh mrh lh vyhvh h'lym mmny vl' hgyd ly
verses.translation: And when she came to the man of God to the hill, she caught him by the feet: but Gehazi came near to thrust her away. And the man of God said, Let her alone; for her soul is vexed within her: and the LORD hath hid it from me, and hath not told me.

verses.original: וַ/תֹּ֕אמֶר הֲ/שָׁאַ֥לְתִּי בֵ֖ן מֵ/אֵ֣ת אֲדֹנִ֑/י הֲ/לֹ֣א אָמַ֔רְתִּי לֹ֥א תַשְׁלֶ֖ה אֹתִֽ/י
verses.translit: vt'mr hsh'lty bn m't 'dny hl' 'mrty l' tshlh 'ty
verses.translation: Then she said, Did I desire a son of my lord? did I not say, Do not deceive me?

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֨אמֶר לְ/גֵיחֲזִ֜י חֲגֹ֣ר מָתְנֶ֗י/ךָ וְ/קַ֨ח מִשְׁעַנְתִּ֣/י בְ/יָדְ/ךָ֮ וָ/לֵךְ֒ כִּֽי תִמְצָ֥א אִישׁ֙ לֹ֣א תְבָרְכֶ֔/נּוּ וְ/כִֽי יְבָרֶכְ/ךָ֥ אִ֖ישׁ לֹ֣א תַעֲנֶ/נּ֑וּ וְ/שַׂמְתָּ֥ מִשְׁעַנְתִּ֖/י עַל פְּנֵ֥י הַ/נָּֽעַר
verses.translit: vy'mr lgychzy chgr mtnykh vqch msh'nty bydkh vlkh khy tmts' 'ysh l' tbrkhnv vkhy ybrkhkh 'ysh l' t'nnv vshmt msh'nty 'l pny hn'r
verses.translation: Then he said to Gehazi, Gird up thy loins, and take my staff in thine hand, and go thy way: if thou meet any man, salute him not; and if any salute thee, answer him not again: and lay my staff upon the face of the child.

verses.original: וַ/תֹּ֨אמֶר֙ אֵ֣ם הַ/נַּ֔עַר חַי יְהוָ֥ה וְ/חֵֽי נַפְשְׁ/ךָ֖ אִם אֶעֶזְבֶ֑/ךָּ וַ/יָּ֖קָם וַ/יֵּ֥לֶךְ אַחֲרֶֽי/הָ
verses.translit: vt'mr 'm hn'r chy yhvh vchy npshkh 'm ''zbkh vyqm vylkh 'chryh
verses.translation: And the mother of the child said, As the LORD liveth, and as thy soul liveth, I will not leave thee. And he arose, and followed her.

verses.original: וְ/גֵחֲזִ֞י עָבַ֣ר לִ/פְנֵי/הֶ֗ם וַ/יָּ֤שֶׂם אֶת הַ/מִּשְׁעֶ֨נֶת֙ עַל פְּנֵ֣י הַ/נַּ֔עַר וְ/אֵ֥ין ק֖וֹל וְ/אֵ֣ין קָ֑שֶׁב וַ/יָּ֤שָׁב לִ/קְרָאת/וֹ֙ וַ/יַּגֶּד ל֣/וֹ לֵ/אמֹ֔ר לֹ֥א הֵקִ֖יץ הַ/נָּֽעַר
verses.translit: vgchzy 'br lpnyhm vyshm 't hmsh'nt 'l pny hn'r v'yn qvl v'yn qshb vyshb lqr'tv vygd lv l'mr l' hqyts hn'r
verses.translation: And Gehazi passed on before them, and laid the staff upon the face of the child; but there was neither voice, nor hearing. Wherefore he went again to meet him, and told him, saying, The child is not awaked.

verses.original: וַ/יָּבֹ֥א אֱלִישָׁ֖ע הַ/בָּ֑יְתָ/ה וְ/הִנֵּ֤ה הַ/נַּ֨עַר֙ מֵ֔ת מֻשְׁכָּ֖ב עַל מִטָּתֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: vyb' 'lysh' hbyth vhnh hn'r mt mshkhb 'l mttv
verses.translation: And when Elisha was come into the house, behold, the child was dead, and laid upon his bed.

verses.original: וַ/יָּבֹ֕א וַ/יִּסְגֹּ֥ר הַ/דֶּ֖לֶת בְּעַ֣ד שְׁנֵי/הֶ֑ם וַ/יִּתְפַּלֵּ֖ל אֶל יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: vyb' vysgr hdlt b'd shnyhm vytpll 'l yhvh
verses.translation: He went in therefore, and shut the door upon them twain, and prayed unto the LORD .

verses.original: וַ/יַּ֜עַל וַ/יִּשְׁכַּ֣ב עַל הַ/יֶּ֗לֶד וַ/יָּשֶׂם֩ פִּ֨י/ו עַל פִּ֜י/ו וְ/עֵינָ֤י/ו עַל עֵינָי/ו֙ וְ/כַפָּ֣י/ו עַל כפ/ו כַּפָּ֔י/ו וַ/יִּגְהַ֖ר עָלָ֑י/ו וַ/יָּ֖חָם בְּשַׂ֥ר הַ/יָּֽלֶד
verses.translit: vy'l vyshkhb 'l hyld vyshm pyv 'l pyv v'ynyv 'l 'ynyv vkhpyv 'l khpv khpyv vyghr 'lyv vychm bshr hyld
verses.translation: And he went up, and lay upon the child, and put his mouth upon his mouth, and his eyes upon his eyes, and his hands upon his hands: and he stretched himself upon the child; and the flesh of the child waxed warm.

verses.original: וַ/יָּ֜שָׁב וַ/יֵּ֣לֶךְ בַּ/בַּ֗יִת אַחַ֥ת הֵ֨נָּה֙ וְ/אַחַ֣ת הֵ֔נָּה וַ/יַּ֖עַל וַ/יִּגְהַ֣ר עָלָ֑י/ו וַ/יְזוֹרֵ֤ר הַ/נַּ֨עַר֙ עַד שֶׁ֣בַע פְּעָמִ֔ים וַ/יִּפְקַ֥ח הַ/נַּ֖עַר אֶת עֵינָֽי/ו
verses.translit: vyshb vylkh bbyt 'cht hnh v'cht hnh vy'l vyghr 'lyv vyzvrr hn'r 'd shb' p'mym vypqch hn'r 't 'ynyv
verses.translation: Then he returned, and walked in the house to and fro; and went up, and stretched himself upon him: and the child sneezed seven times, and the child opened his eyes.

verses.original: וַ/יִּקְרָ֣א אֶל גֵּיחֲזִ֗י וַ/יֹּ֨אמֶר֙ קְרָא֙ אֶל הַ/שֻּׁנַמִּ֣ית הַ/זֹּ֔את וַ/יִּקְרָאֶ֖/הָ וַ/תָּב֣וֹא אֵלָ֑י/ו וַ/יֹּ֖אמֶר שְׂאִ֥י בְנֵֽ/ךְ
verses.translit: vyqr' 'l gychzy vy'mr qr' 'l hshnmyt hz't vyqr'h vtbv' 'lyv vy'mr sh'y bnkh
verses.translation: And he called Gehazi, and said, Call this Shunammite. So he called her. And when she was come in unto him, he said, Take up thy son.

verses.original: וַ/תָּבֹא֙ וַ/תִּפֹּ֣ל עַל רַגְלָ֔י/ו וַ/תִּשְׁתַּ֖חוּ אָ֑רְצָ/ה וַ/תִּשָּׂ֥א אֶת בְּנָ֖/הּ וַ/תֵּצֵֽא
verses.translit: vtb' vtpl 'l rglyv vtshtchv 'rtsh vtsh' 't bnh vtts'
verses.translation: Then she went in, and fell at his feet, and bowed herself to the ground, and took up her son, and went out.

verses.original: וֶ/אֱלִישָׁ֞ע שָׁ֤ב הַ/גִּלְגָּ֨לָ/ה֙ וְ/הָ/רָעָ֣ב בָּ/אָ֔רֶץ וּ/בְנֵי֙ הַ/נְּבִיאִ֔ים יֹשְׁבִ֖ים לְ/פָנָ֑י/ו וַ/יֹּ֣אמֶר לְ/נַעֲר֗/וֹ שְׁפֹת֙ הַ/סִּ֣יר הַ/גְּדוֹלָ֔ה וּ/בַשֵּׁ֥ל נָזִ֖יד לִ/בְנֵ֥י הַ/נְּבִיאִֽים
verses.translit: v'lysh' shb hglglh vhr'b b'rts vbny hnby'ym yshbym lpnyv vy'mr ln'rv shpt hsyr hgdvlh vbshl nzyd lbny hnby'ym
verses.translation: And Elisha came again to Gilgal: and there was a dearth in the land; and the sons of the prophets were sitting before him: and he said unto his servant, Set on the great pot, and seethe pottage for the sons of the prophets.

verses.original: וַ/יֵּצֵ֨א אֶחָ֣ד אֶל הַ/שָּׂדֶה֮ לְ/לַקֵּ֣ט אֹרֹת֒ וַ/יִּמְצָא֙ גֶּ֣פֶן שָׂדֶ֔ה וַ/יְלַקֵּ֥ט מִמֶּ֛/נּוּ פַּקֻּעֹ֥ת שָׂדֶ֖ה מְלֹ֣א בִגְד֑/וֹ וַ/יָּבֹ֗א וַ/יְפַלַּ֛ח אֶל סִ֥יר הַ/נָּזִ֖יד כִּֽי לֹ֥א יָדָֽעוּ
verses.translit: vyts' 'chd 'l hshdh llqt 'rt vymts' gpn shdh vylqt mmnv pq't shdh ml' bgdv vyb' vyplch 'l syr hnzyd khy l' yd'v
verses.translation: And one went out into the field to gather herbs, and found a wild vine, and gathered thereof wild gourds his lap full, and came and shred them into the pot of pottage: for they knew them not.

verses.original: וַ/יִּֽצְק֥וּ לַ/אֲנָשִׁ֖ים לֶ/אֱכ֑וֹל וַ֠/יְהִי כְּ/אָכְלָ֨/ם מֵ/הַ/נָּזִ֜יד וְ/הֵ֣מָּה צָעָ֗קוּ וַ/יֹּֽאמְרוּ֙ מָ֤וֶת בַּ/סִּיר֙ אִ֣ישׁ הָ/אֱלֹהִ֔ים וְ/לֹ֥א יָכְל֖וּ לֶ/אֱכֹֽל
verses.translit: vytsqv l'nshym l'khvl vyhy kh'khlm mhnzyd vhmh ts'qv vy'mrv mvt bsyr 'ysh h'lhym vl' ykhlv l'khl
verses.translation: So they poured out for the men to eat. And it came to pass, as they were eating of the pottage, that they cried out, and said, O thou man of God, there is death in the pot. And they could not eat thereof .

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֨אמֶר֙ וּ/קְחוּ קֶ֔מַח וַ/יַּשְׁלֵ֖ךְ אֶל הַ/סִּ֑יר וַ/יֹּ֗אמֶר צַ֤ק לָ/עָם֙ וְ/יֹאכֵ֔לוּ וְ/לֹ֥א הָיָ֛ה דָּבָ֥ר רָ֖ע בַּ/סִּֽיר
verses.translit: vy'mr vqchv qmch vyshlkh 'l hsyr vy'mr tsq l'm vy'khlv vl' hyh dbr r' bsyr
verses.translation: But he said, Then bring meal. And he cast it into the pot; and he said, Pour out for the people, that they may eat. And there was no harm in the pot.

verses.original: וְ/אִ֨ישׁ בָּ֜א מִ/בַּ֣עַל שָׁלִ֗שָׁה וַ/יָּבֵא֩ לְ/אִ֨ישׁ הָ/אֱלֹהִ֜ים לֶ֤חֶם בִּכּוּרִים֙ עֶשְׂרִֽים לֶ֣חֶם שְׂעֹרִ֔ים וְ/כַרְמֶ֖ל בְּ/צִקְלֹנ֑/וֹ וַ/יֹּ֕אמֶר תֵּ֥ן לָ/עָ֖ם וְ/יֹאכֵֽלוּ
verses.translit: v'ysh b' mb'l shlshh vyb' l'ysh h'lhym lchm bkhvrym 'shrym lchm sh'rym vkhrml btsqlnv vy'mr tn l'm vy'khlv
verses.translation: And there came a man from Baal-shalisha, and brought the man of God bread of the firstfruits, twenty loaves of barley, and full ears of corn in the husk thereof. And he said, Give unto the people, that they may eat.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֨אמֶר֙ מְשָׁ֣רְת֔/וֹ מָ֚ה אֶתֵּ֣ן זֶ֔ה לִ/פְנֵ֖י מֵ֣אָה אִ֑ישׁ וַ/יֹּ֗אמֶר תֵּ֤ן לָ/עָם֙ וְ/יֹאכֵ֔לוּ כִּ֣י כֹ֥ה אָמַ֛ר יְהוָ֖ה אָכֹ֥ל וְ/הוֹתֵֽר
verses.translit: vy'mr mshrtv mh 'tn zh lpny m'h 'ysh vy'mr tn l'm vy'khlv khy khh 'mr yhvh 'khl vhvtr
verses.translation: And his servitor said, What, should I set this before an hundred men? He said again, Give the people, that they may eat: for thus saith the LORD , They shall eat, and shall leave thereof .

verses.original: וַ/יִּתֵּ֧ן לִ/פְנֵי/הֶ֛ם וַ/יֹּאכְל֥וּ וַ/יּוֹתִ֖רוּ כִּ/דְבַ֥ר יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: vytn lpnyhm vy'khlv vyvtrv khdbr yhvh
verses.translation: So he set it before them, and they did eat, and left thereof , according to the word of the LORD .

verses.original: וְ֠/נַעֲמָן שַׂר צְבָ֨א מֶֽלֶךְ אֲרָ֜ם הָיָ֣ה אִישׁ֩ גָּד֨וֹל לִ/פְנֵ֤י אֲדֹנָי/ו֙ וּ/נְשֻׂ֣א פָנִ֔ים כִּֽי ב֛/וֹ נָֽתַן יְהוָ֥ה תְּשׁוּעָ֖ה לַ/אֲרָ֑ם וְ/הָ/אִ֗ישׁ הָיָ֛ה גִּבּ֥וֹר חַ֖יִל מְצֹרָֽע
verses.translit: vn'mn shr tsb' mlkh 'rm hyh 'ysh gdvl lpny 'dnyv vnsh' pnym khy bv ntn yhvh tshv'h l'rm vh'ysh hyh gbvr chyl mtsr'
verses.translation: Now Naaman, captain of the host of the king of Syria, was a great man with his master, and honourable, because by him the LORD had given deliverance unto Syria: he was also a mighty man in valour, but he was a leper.

verses.original: וַ/אֲרָם֙ יָצְא֣וּ גְדוּדִ֔ים וַ/יִּשְׁבּ֛וּ מֵ/אֶ֥רֶץ יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל נַעֲרָ֣ה קְטַנָּ֑ה וַ/תְּהִ֕י לִ/פְנֵ֖י אֵ֥שֶׁת נַעֲמָֽן
verses.translit: v'rm yts'v gdvdym vyshbv m'rts yshr'l n'rh qtnh vthy lpny 'sht n'mn
verses.translation: And the Syrians had gone out by companies, and had brought away captive out of the land of Israel a little maid; and she waited on Naaman’s wife.

verses.original: וַ/תֹּ֨אמֶר֙ אֶל גְּבִרְתָּ֔/הּ אַחֲלֵ֣י אֲדֹנִ֔/י לִ/פְנֵ֥י הַ/נָּבִ֖יא אֲשֶׁ֣ר בְּ/שֹׁמְר֑וֹן אָ֛ז יֶאֱסֹ֥ף אֹת֖/וֹ מִ/צָּרַעְתּֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: vt'mr 'l gbrth 'chly 'dny lpny hnby' 'shr bshmrvn 'z y'sf 'tv mtsr'tv
verses.translation: And she said unto her mistress, Would God my lord were with the prophet that is in Samaria! for he would recover him of his leprosy.

verses.original: וַ/יָּבֹ֕א וַ/יַּגֵּ֥ד לַ/אדֹנָ֖י/ו לֵ/אמֹ֑ר כָּ/זֹ֤את וְ/כָ/זֹאת֙ דִּבְּרָ֣ה הַֽ/נַּעֲרָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֖ר מֵ/אֶ֥רֶץ יִשְׂרָאֵֽל
verses.translit: vyb' vygd l'dnyv l'mr khz't vkhz't dbrh hn'rh 'shr m'rts yshr'l
verses.translation: And one went in, and told his lord, saying, Thus and thus said the maid that is of the land of Israel.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֤אמֶר מֶֽלֶךְ אֲרָם֙ לֶךְ בֹּ֔א וְ/אֶשְׁלְחָ֥ה סֵ֖פֶר אֶל מֶ֣לֶךְ יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וַ/יֵּלֶךְ֩ וַ/יִּקַּ֨ח בְּ/יָד֜/וֹ עֶ֣שֶׂר כִּכְּרֵי כֶ֗סֶף וְ/שֵׁ֤שֶׁת אֲלָפִים֙ זָהָ֔ב וְ/עֶ֖שֶׂר חֲלִיפ֥וֹת בְּגָדִֽים
verses.translit: vy'mr mlkh 'rm lkh b' v'shlchh spr 'l mlkh yshr'l vylkh vyqch bydv 'shr khkhry khsf vshsht 'lpym zhb v'shr chlypvt bgdym
verses.translation: And the king of Syria said, Go to, go, and I will send a letter unto the king of Israel. And he departed, and took with him ten talents of silver, and six thousand pieces of gold, and ten changes of raiment.

verses.original: וַ/יָּבֵ֣א הַ/סֵּ֔פֶר אֶל מֶ֥לֶךְ יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל לֵ/אמֹ֑ר וְ/עַתָּ֗ה כְּ/ב֨וֹא הַ/סֵּ֤פֶר הַ/זֶּה֙ אֵלֶ֔י/ךָ הִנֵּ֨ה שָׁלַ֤חְתִּי אֵלֶ֨י/ךָ֙ אֶת נַעֲמָ֣ן עַבְדִּ֔/י וַ/אֲסַפְתּ֖/וֹ מִ/צָּרַעְתּֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: vyb' hspr 'l mlkh yshr'l l'mr v'th khbv' hspr hzh 'lykh hnh shlchty 'lykh 't n'mn 'bdy v'sptv mtsr'tv
verses.translation: And he brought the letter to the king of Israel, saying, Now when this letter is come unto thee, behold, I have therewith sent Naaman my servant to thee, that thou mayest recover him of his leprosy.

verses.original: וַ/יְהִ֡י כִּ/קְרֹא֩ מֶֽלֶךְ יִשְׂרָאֵ֨ל אֶת הַ/סֵּ֜פֶר וַ/יִּקְרַ֣ע בְּגָדָ֗י/ו וַ/יֹּ֨אמֶר֙ הַ/אֱלֹהִ֥ים אָ֨נִי֙ לְ/הָמִ֣ית וּֽ/לְ/הַחֲי֔וֹת כִּֽי זֶה֙ שֹׁלֵ֣חַ אֵלַ֔/י לֶ/אֱסֹ֥ף אִ֖ישׁ מִ/צָּֽרַעְתּ֑/וֹ כִּ֤י אַךְ דְּעֽוּ נָא֙ וּ/רְא֔וּ כִּֽי מִתְאַנֶּ֥ה ה֖וּא לִֽ/י
verses.translit: vyhy khqr' mlkh yshr'l 't hspr vyqr' bgdyv vy'mr h'lhym 'ny lhmyt vlhchyvt khy zh shlch 'ly l'sf 'ysh mtsr'tv khy 'kh d'v n' vr'v khy mt'nh hv' ly
verses.translation: And it came to pass, when the king of Israel had read the letter, that he rent his clothes, and said, Am I God, to kill and to make alive, that this man doth send unto me to recover a man of his leprosy? wherefore consider, I pray you, and see how he seeketh a quarrel against me.

verses.original: וַ/יְהִ֞י כִּ/שְׁמֹ֣עַ אֱלִישָׁ֣ע אִישׁ הָ/אֱלֹהִ֗ים כִּֽי קָרַ֤ע מֶֽלֶךְ יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ אֶת בְּגָדָ֔י/ו וַ/יִּשְׁלַח֙ אֶל הַ/מֶּ֣לֶךְ לֵ/אמֹ֔ר לָ֥/מָּה קָרַ֖עְתָּ בְּגָדֶ֑י/ךָ יָבֹֽא נָ֣א אֵלַ֔/י וְ/יֵדַ֕ע כִּ֛י יֵ֥שׁ נָבִ֖יא בְּ/יִשְׂרָאֵֽל
verses.translit: vyhy khshm' 'lysh' 'ysh h'lhym khy qr' mlkh yshr'l 't bgdyv vyshlch 'l hmlkh l'mr lmh qr't bgdykh yb' n' 'ly vyd' khy ysh nby' byshr'l
verses.translation: And it was so , when Elisha the man of God had heard that the king of Israel had rent his clothes, that he sent to the king, saying, Wherefore hast thou rent thy clothes? let him come now to me, and he shall know that there is a prophet in Israel.

verses.original: וַ/יָּבֹ֥א נַעֲמָ֖ן ב/סוס/ו בְּ/סוּסָ֣י/ו וּ/בְ/רִכְבּ֑/וֹ וַ/יַּעֲמֹ֥ד פֶּֽתַח הַ/בַּ֖יִת לֶ/אֱלִישָֽׁע
verses.translit: vyb' n'mn bsvsv bsvsyv vbrkhbv vy'md ptch hbyt l'lysh'
verses.translation: So Naaman came with his horses and with his chariot, and stood at the door of the house of Elisha.

verses.original: וַ/יִּשְׁלַ֥ח אֵלָ֛י/ו אֱלִישָׁ֖ע מַלְאָ֣ךְ לֵ/אמֹ֑ר הָל֗וֹךְ וְ/רָחַצְתָּ֤ שֶֽׁבַע פְּעָמִים֙ בַּ/יַּרְדֵּ֔ן וְ/יָשֹׁ֧ב בְּשָׂרְ/ךָ֛ לְ/ךָ֖ וּ/טְהָֽר
verses.translit: vyshlch 'lyv 'lysh' ml'kh l'mr hlvkh vrchtst shb' p'mym byrdn vyshb bshrkh lkh vthr
verses.translation: And Elisha sent a messenger unto him, saying, Go and wash in Jordan seven times, and thy flesh shall come again to thee, and thou shalt be clean.

verses.original: וַ/יִּקְצֹ֥ף נַעֲמָ֖ן וַ/יֵּלַ֑ךְ וַ/יֹּאמֶר֩ הִנֵּ֨ה אָמַ֜רְתִּי אֵלַ֣/י יֵצֵ֣א יָצ֗וֹא וְ/עָמַד֙ וְ/קָרָא֙ בְּ/שֵׁם יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהָ֔י/ו וְ/הֵנִ֥יף יָד֛/וֹ אֶל הַ/מָּק֖וֹם וְ/אָסַ֥ף הַ/מְּצֹרָֽע
verses.translit: vyqtsf n'mn vylkh vy'mr hnh 'mrty 'ly yts' ytsv' v'md vqr' bshm yhvh 'lhyv vhnyf ydv 'l hmqvm v'sf hmtsr'
verses.translation: But Naaman was wroth, and went away, and said, Behold, I thought, He will surely come out to me, and stand, and call on the name of the LORD his God, and strike his hand over the place, and recover the leper.

verses.original: הֲ/לֹ֡א טוֹב֩ אבנה אֲמָנָ֨ה וּ/פַרְפַּ֜ר נַהֲר֣וֹת דַּמֶּ֗שֶׂק מִ/כֹּל֙ מֵימֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל הֲ/לֹֽא אֶרְחַ֥ץ בָּ/הֶ֖ם וְ/טָהָ֑רְתִּי וַ/יִּ֖פֶן וַ/יֵּ֥לֶךְ בְּ/חֵמָֽה
verses.translit: hl' tvb 'bnh 'mnh vprpr nhrvt dmshq mkhl mymy yshr'l hl' 'rchts bhm vthrty vypn vylkh bchmh
verses.translation: Are not Abana and Pharpar, rivers of Damascus, better than all the waters of Israel? may I not wash in them, and be clean? So he turned and went away in a rage.

verses.original: וַ/יִּגְּשׁ֣וּ עֲבָדָי/ו֮ וַ/יְדַבְּר֣וּ אֵלָי/ו֒ וַ/יֹּאמְר֗וּ אָבִי֙ דָּבָ֣ר גָּד֗וֹל הַ/נָּבִ֛יא דִּבֶּ֥ר אֵלֶ֖י/ךָ הֲ/ל֣וֹא תַעֲשֶׂ֑ה וְ/אַ֛ף כִּֽי אָמַ֥ר אֵלֶ֖י/ךָ רְחַ֥ץ וּ/טְהָֽר
verses.translit: vygshv 'bdyv vydbrv 'lyv vy'mrv 'by dbr gdvl hnby' dbr 'lykh hlv' t'shh v'f khy 'mr 'lykh rchts vthr
verses.translation: And his servants came near, and spake unto him, and said, My father, if the prophet had bid thee do some great thing, wouldest thou not have done it ? how much rather then, when he saith to thee, Wash, and be clean?

verses.original: וַ/יֵּ֗רֶד וַ/יִּטְבֹּ֤ל בַּ/יַּרְדֵּן֙ שֶׁ֣בַע פְּעָמִ֔ים כִּ/דְבַ֖ר אִ֣ישׁ הָ/אֱלֹהִ֑ים וַ/יָּ֣שָׁב בְּשָׂר֗/וֹ כִּ/בְשַׂ֛ר נַ֥עַר קָטֹ֖ן וַ/יִּטְהָֽר
verses.translit: vyrd vytbl byrdn shb' p'mym khdbr 'ysh h'lhym vyshb bshrv khbshr n'r qtn vythr
verses.translation: Then went he down, and dipped himself seven times in Jordan, according to the saying of the man of God: and his flesh came again like unto the flesh of a little child, and he was clean.

verses.original: וַ/יָּשָׁב֩ אֶל אִ֨ישׁ הָ/אֱלֹהִ֜ים ה֣וּא וְ/כָֽל מַחֲנֵ֗/הוּ וַ/יָּבֹא֮ וַ/יַּעֲמֹ֣ד לְ/פָנָי/ו֒ וַ/יֹּ֗אמֶר הִנֵּה נָ֤א יָדַ֨עְתִּי֙ כִּ֣י אֵ֤ין אֱלֹהִים֙ בְּ/כָל הָ/אָ֔רֶץ כִּ֖י אִם בְּ/יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וְ/עַתָּ֛ה קַח נָ֥א בְרָכָ֖ה מֵ/אֵ֥ת עַבְדֶּֽ/ךָ
verses.translit: vyshb 'l 'ysh h'lhym hv' vkhl mchnhv vyb' vy'md lpnyv vy'mr hnh n' yd'ty khy 'yn 'lhym bkhl h'rts khy 'm byshr'l v'th qch n' brkhh m't 'bdkh
verses.translation: And he returned to the man of God, he and all his company, and came, and stood before him: and he said, Behold, now I know that there is no God in all the earth, but in Israel: now therefore, I pray thee, take a blessing of thy servant.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֕אמֶר חַי יְהוָ֛ה אֲשֶׁר עָמַ֥דְתִּי לְ/פָנָ֖י/ו אִם אֶקָּ֑ח וַ/יִּפְצַר בּ֥/וֹ לָ/קַ֖חַת וַ/יְמָאֵֽן
verses.translit: vy'mr chy yhvh 'shr 'mdty lpnyv 'm 'qch vyptsr bv lqcht vym'n
verses.translation: But he said, As the LORD liveth, before whom I stand, I will receive none. And he urged him to take it; but he refused.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּאמֶר֮ נַעֲמָן֒ וָ/לֹ֕א יֻתַּן נָ֣א לְ/עַבְדְּ/ךָ֔ מַשָּׂ֥א צֶֽמֶד פְּרָדִ֖ים אֲדָמָ֑ה כִּ֡י לֽוֹא יַעֲשֶׂה֩ ע֨וֹד עַבְדְּ/ךָ֜ עֹלָ֤ה וָ/זֶ֨בַח֙ לֵ/אלֹהִ֣ים אֲחֵרִ֔ים כִּ֖י אִם לַ/יהוָֽה
verses.translit: vy'mr n'mn vl' ytn n' l'bdkh msh' tsmd prdym 'dmh khy lv' y'shh 'vd 'bdkh 'lh vzbch l'lhym 'chrym khy 'm lyhvh
verses.translation: And Naaman said, Shall there not then, I pray thee, be given to thy servant two mules’ burden of earth? for thy servant will henceforth offer neither burnt offering nor sacrifice unto other gods, but unto the LORD .

verses.original: לַ/דָּבָ֣ר הַ/זֶּ֔ה יִסְלַ֥ח יְהוָ֖ה לְ/עַבְדֶּ֑/ךָ בְּ/ב֣וֹא אֲדֹנִ֣/י בֵית רִמּוֹן֩ לְ/הִשְׁתַּחֲוֺ֨ת שָׁ֜מָּ/ה וְ/ה֣וּא נִשְׁעָ֣ן עַל יָדִ֗/י וְ/הִֽשְׁתַּחֲוֵ֨יתִי֙ בֵּ֣ית רִמֹּ֔ן בְּ/הִשְׁתַּחֲוָיָ֨תִ/י֙ בֵּ֣ית רִמֹּ֔ן יִסְלַח נא יְהוָ֥ה לְ/עַבְדְּ/ךָ֖ בַּ/דָּבָ֥ר הַ/זֶּֽה
verses.translit: ldbr hzh yslch yhvh l'bdkh bbv' 'dny byt rmvn lhshtchvt shmh vhv' nsh'n 'l ydy vhshtchvyty byt rmn bhshtchvyty byt rmn yslch n' yhvh l'bdkh bdbr hzh
verses.translation: In this thing the LORD pardon thy servant, that when my master goeth into the house of Rimmon to worship there, and he leaneth on my hand, and I bow myself in the house of Rimmon: when I bow down myself in the house of Rimmon, the LORD pardon thy servant in this thing.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֥אמֶר ל֖/וֹ לֵ֣ךְ לְ/שָׁל֑וֹם וַ/יֵּ֥לֶךְ מֵ/אִתּ֖/וֹ כִּבְרַת אָֽרֶץ
verses.translit: vy'mr lv lkh lshlvm vylkh m'tv khbrt 'rts
verses.translation: And he said unto him, Go in peace. So he departed from him a little way.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֣אמֶר גֵּיחֲזִ֗י נַעַר֮ אֱלִישָׁ֣ע אִישׁ הָ/אֱלֹהִים֒ הִנֵּ֣ה חָשַׂ֣ךְ אֲדֹנִ֗/י אֶֽת נַעֲמָ֤ן הָֽ/אֲרַמִּי֙ הַ/זֶּ֔ה מִ/קַּ֥חַת מִ/יָּד֖/וֹ אֵ֣ת אֲשֶׁר הֵבִ֑יא חַי יְהוָה֙ כִּֽי אִם רַ֣צְתִּי אַחֲרָ֔י/ו וְ/לָקַחְתִּ֥י מֵ/אִתּ֖/וֹ מְאֽוּמָה
verses.translit: vy'mr gychzy n'r 'lysh' 'ysh h'lhym hnh chshkh 'dny 't n'mn h'rmy hzh mqcht mydv 't 'shr hby' chy yhvh khy 'm rtsty 'chryv vlqchty m'tv m'vmh
verses.translation: But Gehazi, the servant of Elisha the man of God, said, Behold, my master hath spared Naaman this Syrian, in not receiving at his hands that which he brought: but, as the LORD liveth, I will run after him, and take somewhat of him.

verses.original: וַ/יִּרְדֹּ֥ף גֵּיחֲזִ֖י אַחֲרֵ֣י נַֽעֲמָ֑ן וַ/יִּרְאֶ֤ה נַֽעֲמָן֙ רָ֣ץ אַחֲרָ֔י/ו וַ/יִּפֹּ֞ל מֵ/עַ֧ל הַ/מֶּרְכָּבָ֛ה לִ/קְרָאת֖/וֹ וַ/יֹּ֥אמֶר הֲ/שָׁלֽוֹם
verses.translit: vyrdf gychzy 'chry n'mn vyr'h n'mn rts 'chryv vypl m'l hmrkhbh lqr'tv vy'mr hshlvm
verses.translation: So Gehazi followed after Naaman. And when Naaman saw him running after him, he lighted down from the chariot to meet him, and said, Is all well?

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֣אמֶר שָׁל֗וֹם אֲדֹנִ/י֮ שְׁלָחַ֣/נִי לֵ/אמֹר֒ הִנֵּ֣ה עַתָּ֡ה זֶ֠ה בָּ֣אוּ אֵלַ֧/י שְׁנֵֽי נְעָרִ֛ים מֵ/הַ֥ר אֶפְרַ֖יִם מִ/בְּנֵ֣י הַ/נְּבִיאִ֑ים תְּנָ/ה נָּ֤א לָ/הֶם֙ כִּכַּר כֶּ֔סֶף וּ/שְׁתֵּ֖י חֲלִפ֥וֹת בְּגָדִֽים
verses.translit: vy'mr shlvm 'dny shlchny l'mr hnh 'th zh b'v 'ly shny n'rym mhr 'prym mbny hnby'ym tnh n' lhm khkhr khsf vshty chlpvt bgdym
verses.translation: And he said, All is well. My master hath sent me, saying, Behold, even now there be come to me from mount Ephraim two young men of the sons of the prophets: give them, I pray thee, a talent of silver, and two changes of garments.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֣אמֶר נַעֲמָ֔ן הוֹאֵ֖ל קַ֣ח כִּכָּרָ֑יִם וַ/יִּפְרָץ בּ֗/וֹ וַ/יָּצַר֩ כִּכְּרַ֨יִם כֶּ֜סֶף בִּ/שְׁנֵ֣י חֲרִטִ֗ים וּ/שְׁתֵּי֙ חֲלִפ֣וֹת בְּגָדִ֔ים וַ/יִּתֵּן֙ אֶל שְׁנֵ֣י נְעָרָ֔י/ו וַ/יִּשְׂא֖וּ לְ/פָנָֽי/ו
verses.translit: vy'mr n'mn hv'l qch khkhrym vyprts bv vytsr khkhrym khsf bshny chrtym vshty chlpvt bgdym vytn 'l shny n'ryv vysh'v lpnyv
verses.translation: And Naaman said, Be content, take two talents. And he urged him, and bound two talents of silver in two bags, with two changes of garments, and laid them upon two of his servants; and they bare them before him.

verses.original: וַ/יָּבֹא֙ אֶל הָ/עֹ֔פֶל וַ/יִּקַּ֥ח מִ/יָּדָ֖/ם וַ/יִּפְקֹ֣ד בַּ/בָּ֑יִת וַ/יְשַׁלַּ֥ח אֶת הָ/אֲנָשִׁ֖ים וַ/יֵּלֵֽכוּ
verses.translit: vyb' 'l h'pl vyqch mydm vypqd bbyt vyshlch 't h'nshym vylkhv
verses.translation: And when he came to the tower, he took them from their hand, and bestowed them in the house: and he let the men go, and they departed.

verses.original: וְ/הוּא בָא֙ וַ/יַּעֲמֹ֣ד אֶל אֲדֹנָ֔י/ו וַ/יֹּ֤אמֶר אֵלָי/ו֙ אֱלִישָׁ֔ע מ/אן מֵ/אַ֖יִן גֵּחֲזִ֑י וַ/יֹּ֕אמֶר לֹֽא הָלַ֥ךְ עַבְדְּ/ךָ֖ אָ֥נֶה וָ/אָֽנָה
verses.translit: vhv' b' vy'md 'l 'dnyv vy'mr 'lyv 'lysh' m'n m'yn gchzy vy'mr l' hlkh 'bdkh 'nh v'nh
verses.translation: But he went in, and stood before his master. And Elisha said unto him, Whence comest thou , Gehazi? And he said, Thy servant went no whither.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֤אמֶר אֵלָי/ו֙ לֹא לִבִּ֣/י הָלַ֔ךְ כַּ/אֲשֶׁ֧ר הָֽפַךְ אִ֛ישׁ מֵ/עַ֥ל מֶרְכַּבְתּ֖/וֹ לִ/קְרָאתֶ֑/ךָ הַ/עֵ֞ת לָ/קַ֤חַת אֶת הַ/כֶּ֨סֶף֙ וְ/לָ/קַ֣חַת בְּגָדִ֔ים וְ/זֵיתִ֤ים וּ/כְרָמִים֙ וְ/צֹ֣אן וּ/בָקָ֔ר וַ/עֲבָדִ֖ים וּ/שְׁפָחֽוֹת
verses.translit: vy'mr 'lyv l' lby hlkh kh'shr hpkh 'ysh m'l mrkhbtv lqr'tkh h't lqcht 't hkhsf vlqcht bgdym vzytym vkhrmym vts'n vbqr v'bdym vshpchvt
verses.translation: And he said unto him, Went not mine heart with thee , when the man turned again from his chariot to meet thee? Is it a time to receive money, and to receive garments, and oliveyards, and vineyards, and sheep, and oxen, and menservants, and maidservants?

verses.original: וְ/צָרַ֤עַת נַֽעֲמָן֙ תִּֽדְבַּק בְּ/ךָ֔ וּֽ/בְ/זַרְעֲ/ךָ לְ/עוֹלָ֑ם וַ/יֵּצֵ֥א מִ/לְּ/פָנָ֖י/ו מְצֹרָ֥ע כַּ/שָּֽׁלֶג
verses.translit: vtsr't n'mn tdbq bkh vbzr'kh l'vlm vyts' mlpnyv mtsr' khshlg
verses.translation: The leprosy therefore of Naaman shall cleave unto thee, and unto thy seed for ever. And he went out from his presence a leper as white as snow.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּאמְר֥וּ בְנֵֽי הַ/נְּבִיאִ֖ים אֶל אֱלִישָׁ֑ע הִנֵּֽה נָ֣א הַ/מָּק֗וֹם אֲשֶׁ֨ר אֲנַ֜חְנוּ יֹשְׁבִ֥ים שָׁ֛ם לְ/פָנֶ֖י/ךָ צַ֥ר מִמֶּֽ/נּוּ
verses.translit: vy'mrv bny hnby'ym 'l 'lysh' hnh n' hmqvm 'shr 'nchnv yshbym shm lpnykh tsr mmnv
verses.translation: And the sons of the prophets said unto Elisha, Behold now, the place where we dwell with thee is too strait for us.

verses.original: נֵֽלְכָה נָּ֣א עַד הַ/יַּרְדֵּ֗ן וְ/נִקְחָ֤ה מִ/שָּׁם֙ אִ֚ישׁ קוֹרָ֣ה אֶחָ֔ת וְ/נַעֲשֶׂה לָּ֥/נוּ שָׁ֛ם מָק֖וֹם לָ/שֶׁ֣בֶת שָׁ֑ם וַ/יֹּ֖אמֶר לֵֽכוּ
verses.translit: nlkhh n' 'd hyrdn vnqchh mshm 'ysh qvrh 'cht vn'shh lnv shm mqvm lshbt shm vy'mr lkhv
verses.translation: Let us go, we pray thee, unto Jordan, and take thence every man a beam, and let us make us a place there, where we may dwell. And he answered, Go ye.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֨אמֶר֙ הָֽ/אֶחָ֔ד ה֥וֹאֶל נָ֖א וְ/לֵ֣ךְ אֶת עֲבָדֶ֑י/ךָ וַ/יֹּ֖אמֶר אֲנִ֥י אֵלֵֽךְ
verses.translit: vy'mr h'chd hv'l n' vlkh 't 'bdykh vy'mr 'ny 'lkh
verses.translation: And one said, Be content, I pray thee, and go with thy servants. And he answered, I will go.

verses.translit: vylkh 'tm vyb'v hyrdnh vygzrv h'tsym
verses.translation: So he went with them. And when they came to Jordan, they cut down wood.

verses.original: וַ/יְהִ֤י הָֽ/אֶחָד֙ מַפִּ֣יל הַ/קּוֹרָ֔ה וְ/אֶת הַ/בַּרְזֶ֖ל נָפַ֣ל אֶל הַ/מָּ֑יִם וַ/יִּצְעַ֥ק וַ/יֹּ֛אמֶר אֲהָ֥הּ אֲדֹנִ֖/י וְ/ה֥וּא שָׁאֽוּל
verses.translit: vyhy h'chd mpyl hqvrh v't hbrzl npl 'l hmym vyts'q vy'mr 'hh 'dny vhv' sh'vl
verses.translation: But as one was felling a beam, the axe head fell into the water: and he cried, and said, Alas, master! for it was borrowed.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֥אמֶר אִישׁ הָ/אֱלֹהִ֖ים אָ֣נָה נָפָ֑ל וַ/יַּרְאֵ֨/הוּ֙ אֶת הַ/מָּק֔וֹם וַ/יִּקְצָב עֵץ֙ וַ/יַּשְׁלֶךְ שָׁ֔מָּ/ה וַ/יָּ֖צֶף הַ/בַּרְזֶֽל
verses.translit: vy'mr 'ysh h'lhym 'nh npl vyr'hv 't hmqvm vyqtsb 'ts vyshlkh shmh vytsf hbrzl
verses.translation: And the man of God said, Where fell it? And he shewed him the place. And he cut down a stick, and cast it in thither; and the iron did swim.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֖אמֶר הָ֣רֶם לָ֑/ךְ וַ/יִּשְׁלַ֥ח יָד֖/וֹ וַ/יִּקָּחֵֽ/הוּ
verses.translit: vy'mr hrm lkh vyshlch ydv vyqchhv
verses.translation: Therefore said he, Take it up to thee. And he put out his hand, and took it.

verses.original: וּ/מֶ֣לֶךְ אֲרָ֔ם הָיָ֥ה נִלְחָ֖ם בְּ/יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וַ/יִּוָּעַץ֙ אֶל עֲבָדָ֣י/ו לֵ/אמֹ֗ר אֶל מְק֛וֹם פְּלֹנִ֥י אַלְמֹנִ֖י תַּחֲנֹתִֽ/י
verses.translit: vmlkh 'rm hyh nlchm byshr'l vyv'ts 'l 'bdyv l'mr 'l mqvm plny 'lmny tchnty
verses.translation: Then the king of Syria warred against Israel, and took counsel with his servants, saying, In such and such a place shall be my camp.

verses.original: וַ/יִּשְׁלַ֞ח אִ֣ישׁ הָ/אֱלֹהִ֗ים אֶל מֶ֤לֶךְ יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ לֵ/אמֹ֔ר הִשָּׁ֕מֶר מֵ/עֲבֹ֖ר הַ/מָּק֣וֹם הַ/זֶּ֑ה כִּֽי שָׁ֖ם אֲרָ֥ם נְחִתִּֽים
verses.translit: vyshlch 'ysh h'lhym 'l mlkh yshr'l l'mr hshmr m'br hmqvm hzh khy shm 'rm nchtym
verses.translation: And the man of God sent unto the king of Israel, saying, Beware that thou pass not such a place; for thither the Syrians are come down.

verses.original: וַ/יִּשְׁלַ֞ח מֶ֣לֶךְ יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל אֶֽל הַ/מָּק֞וֹם אֲשֶׁ֨ר אָֽמַר ל֧/וֹ אִישׁ הָ/אֱלֹהִ֛ים ו/הזהיר/ה וְ/הִזְהִיר֖/וֹ וְ/נִשְׁמַ֣ר שָׁ֑ם לֹ֥א אַחַ֖ת וְ/לֹ֥א שְׁתָּֽיִם
verses.translit: vyshlch mlkh yshr'l 'l hmqvm 'shr 'mr lv 'ysh h'lhym vhzhyrh vhzhyrv vnshmr shm l' 'cht vl' shtym
verses.translation: And the king of Israel sent to the place which the man of God told him and warned him of, and saved himself there, not once nor twice.

verses.original: וַ/יִּסָּעֵר֙ לֵ֣ב מֶֽלֶךְ אֲרָ֔ם עַל הַ/דָּבָ֖ר הַ/זֶּ֑ה וַ/יִּקְרָ֤א אֶל עֲבָדָי/ו֙ וַ/יֹּ֣אמֶר אֲלֵי/הֶ֔ם הֲ/לוֹא֙ תַּגִּ֣ידוּ לִ֔/י מִ֥י מִ/שֶּׁ/לָּ֖/נוּ אֶל מֶ֥לֶךְ יִשְׂרָאֵֽל
verses.translit: vys'r lb mlkh 'rm 'l hdbr hzh vyqr' 'l 'bdyv vy'mr 'lyhm hlv' tgydv ly my mshlnv 'l mlkh yshr'l
verses.translation: Therefore the heart of the king of Syria was sore troubled for this thing; and he called his servants, and said unto them, Will ye not shew me which of us is for the king of Israel?

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֨אמֶר֙ אַחַ֣ד מֵֽ/עֲבָדָ֔י/ו ל֖וֹא אֲדֹנִ֣/י הַ/מֶּ֑לֶךְ כִּֽי אֱלִישָׁ֤ע הַ/נָּבִיא֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר בְּ/יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל יַגִּיד֙ לְ/מֶ֣לֶךְ יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל אֶת הַ֨/דְּבָרִ֔ים אֲשֶׁ֥ר תְּדַבֵּ֖ר בַּ/חֲדַ֥ר מִשְׁכָּבֶֽ/ךָ
verses.translit: vy'mr 'chd m'bdyv lv' 'dny hmlkh khy 'lysh' hnby' 'shr byshr'l ygyd lmlkh yshr'l 't hdbrym 'shr tdbr bchdr mshkhbkh
verses.translation: And one of his servants said, None, my lord, O king: but Elisha, the prophet that is in Israel, telleth the king of Israel the words that thou speakest in thy bedchamber.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֗אמֶר לְכ֤וּ וּ/רְאוּ֙ אֵיכֹ֣ה ה֔וּא וְ/אֶשְׁלַ֖ח וְ/אֶקָּחֵ֑/הוּ וַ/יֻּגַּד ל֥/וֹ לֵ/אמֹ֖ר הִנֵּ֥ה בְ/דֹתָֽן
verses.translit: vy'mr lkhv vr'v 'ykhh hv' v'shlch v'qchhv vygd lv l'mr hnh bdtn
verses.translation: And he said, Go and spy where he is , that I may send and fetch him. And it was told him, saying, Behold, he is in Dothan.

verses.original: וַ/יִּשְׁלַח שָׁ֛מָּ/ה סוּסִ֥ים וְ/רֶ֖כֶב וְ/חַ֣יִל כָּבֵ֑ד וַ/יָּבֹ֣אוּ לַ֔יְלָה וַ/יַּקִּ֖פוּ עַל הָ/עִֽיר
verses.translit: vyshlch shmh svsym vrkhb vchyl khbd vyb'v lylh vyqpv 'l h'yr
verses.translation: Therefore sent he thither horses, and chariots, and a great host: and they came by night, and compassed the city about.

verses.original: וַ֠/יַּשְׁכֵּם מְשָׁרֵ֨ת אִ֥ישׁ הָֽ/אֱלֹהִים֮ לָ/קוּם֒ וַ/יֵּצֵ֕א וְ/הִנֵּה חַ֛יִל סוֹבֵ֥ב אֶת הָ/עִ֖יר וְ/ס֣וּס וָ/רָ֑כֶב וַ/יֹּ֨אמֶר נַעֲר֥/וֹ אֵלָ֛י/ו אֲהָ֥הּ אֲדֹנִ֖/י אֵיכָ֥ה נַֽעֲשֶֽׂה
verses.translit: vyshkhm mshrt 'ysh h'lhym lqvm vyts' vhnh chyl svbb 't h'yr vsvs vrkhb vy'mr n'rv 'lyv 'hh 'dny 'ykhh n'shh
verses.translation: And when the servant of the man of God was risen early, and gone forth, behold, an host compassed the city both with horses and chariots. And his servant said unto him, Alas, my master! how shall we do?

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֖אמֶר אַל תִּירָ֑א כִּ֤י רַבִּים֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר אִתָּ֔/נוּ מֵ/אֲשֶׁ֖ר אוֹתָֽ/ם
verses.translit: vy'mr 'l tyr' khy rbym 'shr 'tnv m'shr 'vtm
verses.translation: And he answered, Fear not: for they that be with us are more than they that be with them.

verses.original: וַ/יִּתְפַּלֵּ֤ל אֱלִישָׁע֙ וַ/יֹּאמַ֔ר יְהוָ֕ה פְּקַח נָ֥א אֶת עֵינָ֖י/ו וְ/יִרְאֶ֑ה וַ/יִּפְקַ֤ח יְהוָה֙ אֶת עֵינֵ֣י הַ/נַּ֔עַר וַ/יַּ֗רְא וְ/הִנֵּ֨ה הָ/הָ֜ר מָלֵ֨א סוּסִ֥ים וְ/רֶ֛כֶב אֵ֖שׁ סְבִיבֹ֥ת אֱלִישָֽׁע
verses.translit: vytpll 'lysh' vy'mr yhvh pqch n' 't 'ynyv vyr'h vypqch yhvh 't 'yny hn'r vyr' vhnh hhr ml' svsym vrkhb 'sh sbybt 'lysh'
verses.translation: And Elisha prayed, and said, LORD , I pray thee, open his eyes, that he may see. And the LORD opened the eyes of the young man; and he saw: and, behold, the mountain was full of horses and chariots of fire round about Elisha.

verses.original: וַ/יֵּרְדוּ֮ אֵלָי/ו֒ וַ/יִּתְפַּלֵּ֨ל אֱלִישָׁ֤ע אֶל יְהוָה֙ וַ/יֹּאמַ֔ר הַךְ נָ֥א אֶת הַ/גּוֹי הַ/זֶּ֖ה בַּ/סַּנְוֵרִ֑ים וַ/יַּכֵּ֥/ם בַּ/סַּנְוֵרִ֖ים כִּ/דְבַ֥ר אֱלִישָֽׁע
verses.translit: vyrdv 'lyv vytpll 'lysh' 'l yhvh vy'mr hkh n' 't hgvy hzh bsnvrym vykhm bsnvrym khdbr 'lysh'
verses.translation: And when they came down to him, Elisha prayed unto the LORD , and said, Smite this people, I pray thee, with blindness. And he smote them with blindness according to the word of Elisha.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֨אמֶר אֲלֵ/הֶ֜ם אֱלִישָׁ֗ע לֹ֣א זֶ֣ה הַ/דֶּרֶךְ֮ וְ/לֹ֣א זֹ֣ה הָ/עִיר֒ לְכ֣וּ אַחֲרַ֔/י וְ/אוֹלִ֣יכָה אֶתְ/כֶ֔ם אֶל הָ/אִ֖ישׁ אֲשֶׁ֣ר תְּבַקֵּשׁ֑וּ/ן וַ/יֹּ֥לֶךְ אוֹתָ֖/ם שֹׁמְרֽוֹנָ/ה
verses.translit: vy'mr 'lhm 'lysh' l' zh hdrkh vl' zh h'yr lkhv 'chry v'vlykhh 'tkhm 'l h'ysh 'shr tbqshvn vylkh 'vtm shmrvnh
verses.translation: And Elisha said unto them, This is not the way, neither is this the city: follow me, and I will bring you to the man whom ye seek. But he led them to Samaria.

verses.original: וַ/יְהִי֮ כְּ/בֹאָ֣/ם שֹׁמְרוֹן֒ וַ/יֹּ֣אמֶר אֱלִישָׁ֔ע יְהוָ֕ה פְּקַ֥ח אֶת עֵינֵֽי אֵ֖לֶּה וְ/יִרְא֑וּ וַ/יִּפְקַ֤ח יְהוָה֙ אֶת עֵ֣ינֵי/הֶ֔ם וַ/יִּרְא֕וּ וְ/הִנֵּ֖ה בְּ/ת֥וֹךְ שֹׁמְרֽוֹן
verses.translit: vyhy khb'm shmrvn vy'mr 'lysh' yhvh pqch 't 'yny 'lh vyr'v vypqch yhvh 't 'ynyhm vyr'v vhnh btvkh shmrvn
verses.translation: And it came to pass, when they were come into Samaria, that Elisha said, LORD , open the eyes of these men , that they may see. And the LORD opened their eyes, and they saw; and, behold, they were in the midst of Samaria.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֤אמֶר מֶֽלֶךְ יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ אֶל אֱלִישָׁ֔ע כִּ/רְאֹת֖/וֹ אוֹתָ֑/ם הַ/אַכֶּ֥ה אַכֶּ֖ה אָבִֽ/י
verses.translit: vy'mr mlkh yshr'l 'l 'lysh' khr'tv 'vtm h'khh 'khh 'by
verses.translation: And the king of Israel said unto Elisha, when he saw them, My father, shall I smite them ? shall I smite them ?

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֨אמֶר֙ לֹ֣א תַכֶּ֔ה הַ/אֲשֶׁ֥ר שָׁבִ֛יתָ בְּ/חַרְבְּ/ךָ֥ וּֽ/בְ/קַשְׁתְּ/ךָ֖ אַתָּ֣ה מַכֶּ֑ה שִׂים֩ לֶ֨חֶם וָ/מַ֜יִם לִ/פְנֵי/הֶ֗ם וְ/יֹֽאכְלוּ֙ וְ/יִשְׁתּ֔וּ וְ/יֵלְכ֖וּ אֶל אֲדֹנֵי/הֶֽם
verses.translit: vy'mr l' tkhh h'shr shbyt bchrbkh vbqshtkh 'th mkhh shym lchm vmym lpnyhm vy'khlv vyshtv vylkhv 'l 'dnyhm
verses.translation: And he answered, Thou shalt not smite them: wouldest thou smite those whom thou hast taken captive with thy sword and with thy bow? set bread and water before them, that they may eat and drink, and go to their master.

verses.original: וַ/יִּכְרֶ֨ה לָ/הֶ֜ם כֵּרָ֣ה גְדוֹלָ֗ה וַ/יֹּֽאכְלוּ֙ וַ/יִּשְׁתּ֔וּ וַֽ/יְשַׁלְּחֵ֔/ם וַ/יֵּלְכ֖וּ אֶל אֲדֹֽנֵי/הֶ֑ם וְ/לֹֽא יָ֤סְפוּ עוֹד֙ גְּדוּדֵ֣י אֲרָ֔ם לָ/ב֖וֹא בְּ/אֶ֥רֶץ יִשְׂרָאֵֽל
verses.translit: vykhrh lhm khrh gdvlh vy'khlv vyshtv vyshlchm vylkhv 'l 'dnyhm vl' yspv 'vd gdvdy 'rm lbv' b'rts yshr'l
verses.translation: And he prepared great provision for them: and when they had eaten and drunk, he sent them away, and they went to their master. So the bands of Syria came no more into the land of Israel.

verses.original: וַֽ/יְהִי֙ אַחֲרֵי כֵ֔ן וַ/יִּקְבֹּ֛ץ בֶּן הֲדַ֥ד מֶֽלֶךְ אֲרָ֖ם אֶת כָּל מַחֲנֵ֑/הוּ וַ/יַּ֕עַל וַ/יָּ֖צַר עַל שֹׁמְרֽוֹן
verses.translit: vyhy 'chry khn vyqbts bn hdd mlkh 'rm 't khl mchnhv vy'l vytsr 'l shmrvn
verses.translation: And it came to pass after this, that Ben-hadad king of Syria gathered all his host, and went up, and besieged Samaria.

verses.original: וַ/יְהִ֨י רָעָ֤ב גָּדוֹל֙ בְּ/שֹׁ֣מְר֔וֹן וְ/הִנֵּ֖ה צָרִ֣ים עָלֶ֑י/הָ עַ֣ד הֱי֤וֹת רֹאשׁ חֲמוֹר֙ בִּ/שְׁמֹנִ֣ים כֶּ֔סֶף וְ/רֹ֛בַע הַ/קַּ֥ב חרי יונים דִּבְיוֹנִ֖ים בַּ/חֲמִשָּׁה כָֽסֶף
verses.translit: vyhy r'b gdvl bshmrvn vhnh tsrym 'lyh 'd hyvt r'sh chmvr bshmnym khsf vrb' hqb chry yvnym dbyvnym bchmshh khsf
verses.translation: And there was a great famine in Samaria: and, behold, they besieged it, until an ass’s head was sold for fourscore pieces of silver, and the fourth part of a cab of dove’s dung for five pieces of silver.

verses.original: וַֽ/יְהִי֙ מֶ֣לֶךְ יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל עֹבֵ֖ר עַל הַ/חֹמָ֑ה וְ/אִשָּׁ֗ה צָעֲקָ֤ה אֵלָי/ו֙ לֵ/אמֹ֔ר הוֹשִׁ֖יעָ/ה אֲדֹנִ֥/י הַ/מֶּֽלֶךְ
verses.translit: vyhy mlkh yshr'l 'br 'l hchmh v'shh ts'qh 'lyv l'mr hvshy'h 'dny hmlkh
verses.translation: And as the king of Israel was passing by upon the wall, there cried a woman unto him, saying, Help, my lord, O king.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֨אמֶר֙ אַל יוֹשִׁעֵ֣/ךְ יְהוָ֔ה מֵ/אַ֖יִן אֽוֹשִׁיעֵ֑/ךְ הֲ/מִן הַ/גֹּ֖רֶן א֥וֹ מִן הַ/יָּֽקֶב
verses.translit: vy'mr 'l yvsh'kh yhvh m'yn 'vshy'kh hmn hgrn 'v mn hyqb
verses.translation: And he said, If the LORD do not help thee, whence shall I help thee? out of the barnfloor, or out of the winepress? save thee

verses.original: וַ/יֹּֽאמֶר לָ֥/הּ הַ/מֶּ֖לֶךְ מַה לָּ֑/ךְ וַ/תֹּ֗אמֶר הָ/אִשָּׁ֨ה הַ/זֹּ֜את אָמְרָ֣ה אֵלַ֗/י תְּנִ֤י אֶת בְּנֵ/ךְ֙ וְ/נֹאכְלֶ֣/נּוּ הַ/יּ֔וֹם וְ/אֶת בְּנִ֖/י נֹאכַ֥ל מָחָֽר
verses.translit: vy'mr lh hmlkh mh lkh vt'mr h'shh hz't 'mrh 'ly tny 't bnkh vn'khlnv hyvm v't bny n'khl mchr
verses.translation: And the king said unto her, What aileth thee? And she answered, This woman said unto me, Give thy son, that we may eat him to day, and we will eat my son to morrow.

verses.original: וַ/נְּבַשֵּׁ֥ל אֶת בְּנִ֖/י וַ/נֹּֽאכְלֵ֑/הוּ וָ/אֹמַ֨ר אֵלֶ֜י/הָ בַּ/יּ֣וֹם הָ/אַחֵ֗ר תְּנִ֤י אֶת בְּנֵ/ךְ֙ וְ/נֹ֣אכְלֶ֔/נּוּ וַ/תַּחְבִּ֖א אֶת בְּנָֽ/הּ
verses.translit: vnbshl 't bny vn'khlhv v'mr 'lyh byvm h'chr tny 't bnkh vn'khlnv vtchb' 't bnh
verses.translation: So we boiled my son, and did eat him: and I said unto her on the next day, Give thy son, that we may eat him: and she hath hid her son.

verses.original: וַ/יְהִי֩ כִ/שְׁמֹ֨עַ הַ/מֶּ֜לֶךְ אֶת דִּבְרֵ֤י הָֽ/אִשָּׁה֙ וַ/יִּקְרַ֣ע אֶת בְּגָדָ֔י/ו וְ/ה֖וּא עֹבֵ֣ר עַל הַ/חֹמָ֑ה וַ/יַּ֣רְא הָ/עָ֔ם וְ/הִנֵּ֥ה הַ/שַּׂ֛ק עַל בְּשָׂר֖/וֹ מִ/בָּֽיִת
verses.translit: vyhy khshm' hmlkh 't dbry h'shh vyqr' 't bgdyv vhv' 'br 'l hchmh vyr' h'm vhnh hshq 'l bshrv mbyt
verses.translation: And it came to pass, when the king heard the words of the woman, that he rent his clothes; and he passed by upon the wall, and the people looked, and, behold, he had sackcloth within upon his flesh.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֕אמֶר כֹּֽה יַעֲשֶׂה לִּ֥/י אֱלֹהִ֖ים וְ/כֹ֣ה יוֹסִ֑ף אִֽם יַעֲמֹ֞ד רֹ֣אשׁ אֱלִישָׁ֧ע בֶּן שָׁפָ֛ט עָלָ֖י/ו הַ/יּֽוֹם
verses.translit: vy'mr khh y'shh ly 'lhym vkhh yvsf 'm y'md r'sh 'lysh' bn shpt 'lyv hyvm
verses.translation: Then he said, God do so and more also to me, if the head of Elisha the son of Shaphat shall stand on him this day.

verses.original: וֶ/אֱלִישָׁע֙ יֹשֵׁ֣ב בְּ/בֵית֔/וֹ וְ/הַ/זְּקֵנִ֖ים יֹשְׁבִ֣ים אִתּ֑/וֹ וַ/יִּשְׁלַ֨ח אִ֜ישׁ מִ/לְּ/פָנָ֗י/ו בְּ/טֶ֣רֶם יָבֹא֩ הַ/מַּלְאָ֨ךְ אֵלָ֜י/ו וְ/ה֣וּא אָמַ֣ר אֶל הַ/זְּקֵנִ֗ים הַ/רְּאִיתֶם֙ כִּֽי שָׁלַ֞ח בֶּן הַֽ/מְרַצֵּ֤חַ הַ/זֶּה֙ לְ/הָסִ֣יר אֶת רֹאשִׁ֔/י רְא֣וּ כְּ/בֹ֣א הַ/מַּלְאָ֗ךְ סִגְר֤וּ הַ/דֶּ֨לֶת֙ וּ/לְחַצְתֶּ֤ם אֹת/וֹ֙ בַּ/דֶּ֔לֶת הֲ/ל֗וֹא ק֛וֹל רַגְלֵ֥י אֲדֹנָ֖י/ו אַחֲרָֽי/ו
verses.translit: v'lysh' yshb bbytv vhzqnym yshbym 'tv vyshlch 'ysh mlpnyv btrm yb' hml'kh 'lyv vhv' 'mr 'l hzqnym hr'ytm khy shlch bn hmrtsch hzh lhsyr 't r'shy r'v khb' hml'kh sgrv hdlt vlchtstm 'tv bdlt hlv' qvl rgly 'dnyv 'chryv
verses.translation: But Elisha sat in his house, and the elders sat with him; and the king sent a man from before him: but ere the messenger came to him, he said to the elders, See ye how this son of a murderer hath sent to take away mine head? look, when the messenger cometh, shut the door, and hold him fast at the door: is not the sound of his master’s feet behind him?

verses.original: עוֹדֶ֨/נּוּ֙ מְדַבֵּ֣ר עִמָּ֔/ם וְ/הִנֵּ֥ה הַ/מַּלְאָ֖ךְ יֹרֵ֣ד אֵלָ֑י/ו וַ/יֹּ֗אמֶר הִנֵּֽה זֹ֤את הָֽ/רָעָה֙ מֵ/אֵ֣ת יְהוָ֔ה מָֽה אוֹחִ֥יל לַ/יהוָ֖ה עֽוֹד
verses.translit: 'vdnv mdbr 'mm vhnh hml'kh yrd 'lyv vy'mr hnh z't hr'h m't yhvh mh 'vchyl lyhvh 'vd
verses.translation: And while he yet talked with them, behold, the messenger came down unto him: and he said, Behold, this evil is of the LORD ; what should I wait for the LORD any longer?

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֣אמֶר אֱלִישָׁ֔ע שִׁמְע֖וּ דְּבַר יְהוָ֑ה כֹּ֣ה אָמַ֣ר יְהוָ֗ה כָּ/עֵ֤ת מָחָר֙ סְאָֽה סֹ֣לֶת בְּ/שֶׁ֗קֶל וְ/סָאתַ֧יִם שְׂעֹרִ֛ים בְּ/שֶׁ֖קֶל בְּ/שַׁ֥עַר שֹׁמְרֽוֹן
verses.translit: vy'mr 'lysh' shm'v dbr yhvh khh 'mr yhvh kh't mchr s'h slt bshql vs'tym sh'rym bshql bsh'r shmrvn
verses.translation: Then Elisha said, Hear ye the word of the LORD ; Thus saith the LORD , To morrow about this time shall a measure of fine flour be sold for a shekel, and two measures of barley for a shekel, in the gate of Samaria.

verses.original: וַ/יַּ֣עַן הַ/שָּׁלִ֡ישׁ אֲשֶׁר לַ/מֶּלֶךְ֩ נִשְׁעָ֨ן עַל יָד֜/וֹ אֶת אִ֣ישׁ הָ/אֱלֹהִים֮ וַ/יֹּאמַר֒ הִנֵּ֣ה יְהוָ֗ה עֹשֶׂ֤ה אֲרֻבּוֹת֙ בַּ/שָּׁמַ֔יִם הֲ/יִהְיֶ֖ה הַ/דָּבָ֣ר הַ/זֶּ֑ה וַ/יֹּ֗אמֶר הִנְּ/כָ֤ה רֹאֶה֙ בְּ/עֵינֶ֔י/ךָ וּ/מִ/שָּׁ֖ם לֹ֥א תֹאכֵֽל
verses.translit: vy'n hshlysh 'shr lmlkh nsh'n 'l ydv 't 'ysh h'lhym vy'mr hnh yhvh 'shh 'rbvt bshmym hyhyh hdbr hzh vy'mr hnkhh r'h b'ynykh vmshm l' t'khl
verses.translation: Then a lord on whose hand the king leaned answered the man of God, and said, Behold, if the LORD would make windows in heaven, might this thing be? And he said, Behold, thou shalt see it with thine eyes, but shalt not eat thereof.

verses.original: וְ/אַרְבָּעָ֧ה אֲנָשִׁ֛ים הָי֥וּ מְצֹרָעִ֖ים פֶּ֣תַח הַ/שָּׁ֑עַר וַ/יֹּֽאמְרוּ֙ אִ֣ישׁ אֶל רֵעֵ֔/הוּ מָ֗ה אֲנַ֛חְנוּ יֹשְׁבִ֥ים פֹּ֖ה עַד מָֽתְנוּ
verses.translit: v'rb'h 'nshym hyv mtsr'ym ptch hsh'r vy'mrv 'ysh 'l r'hv mh 'nchnv yshbym ph 'd mtnv
verses.translation: And there were four leprous men at the entering in of the gate: and they said one to another, Why sit we here until we die?

verses.original: אִם אָמַרְנוּ֩ נָב֨וֹא הָ/עִ֜יר וְ/הָ/רָעָ֤ב בָּ/עִיר֙ וָ/מַ֣תְנוּ שָׁ֔ם וְ/אִם יָשַׁ֥בְנוּ פֹ֖ה וָ/מָ֑תְנוּ וְ/עַתָּ֗ה לְכוּ֙ וְ/נִפְּלָה֙ אֶל מַחֲנֵ֣ה אֲרָ֔ם אִם יְחַיֻּ֣/נוּ נִֽחְיֶ֔ה וְ/אִם יְמִיתֻ֖/נוּ וָ/מָֽתְנוּ
verses.translit: 'm 'mrnv nbv' h'yr vhr'b b'yr vmtnv shm v'm yshbnv ph vmtnv v'th lkhv vnplh 'l mchnh 'rm 'm ychynv nchyh v'm ymytnv vmtnv
verses.translation: If we say, We will enter into the city, then the famine is in the city, and we shall die there: and if we sit still here, we die also. Now therefore come, and let us fall unto the host of the Syrians: if they save us alive, we shall live; and if they kill us, we shall but die.

verses.original: וַ/יָּק֣וּמוּ בַ/נֶּ֔שֶׁף לָ/ב֖וֹא אֶל מַחֲנֵ֣ה אֲרָ֑ם וַ/יָּבֹ֗אוּ עַד קְצֵה֙ מַחֲנֵ֣ה אֲרָ֔ם וְ/הִנֵּ֥ה אֵֽין שָׁ֖ם אִֽישׁ
verses.translit: vyqvmv bnshf lbv' 'l mchnh 'rm vyb'v 'd qtsh mchnh 'rm vhnh 'yn shm 'ysh
verses.translation: And they rose up in the twilight, to go unto the camp of the Syrians: and when they were come to the uttermost part of the camp of Syria, behold, there was no man there.

verses.original: וַ/אדֹנָ֞/י הִשְׁמִ֣יעַ אֶת מַחֲנֵ֣ה אֲרָ֗ם ק֥וֹל רֶ֨כֶב֙ ק֣וֹל ס֔וּס ק֖וֹל חַ֣יִל גָּד֑וֹל וַ/יֹּאמְר֞וּ אִ֣ישׁ אֶל אָחִ֗י/ו הִנֵּ֣ה שָֽׂכַר עָלֵי/נוּ֩ מֶ֨לֶךְ יִשְׂרָאֵ֜ל אֶת מַלְכֵ֧י הַ/חִתִּ֛ים וְ/אֶת מַלְכֵ֥י מִצְרַ֖יִם לָ/ב֥וֹא עָלֵֽי/נוּ
verses.translit: v'dny hshmy' 't mchnh 'rm qvl rkhb qvl svs qvl chyl gdvl vy'mrv 'ysh 'l 'chyv hnh shkhr 'lynv mlkh yshr'l 't mlkhy hchtym v't mlkhy mtsrym lbv' 'lynv
verses.translation: For the Lord had made the host of the Syrians to hear a noise of chariots, and a noise of horses, even the noise of a great host: and they said one to another, Lo, the king of Israel hath hired against us the kings of the Hittites, and the kings of the Egyptians, to come upon us.

verses.original: וַ/יָּקוּמוּ֮ וַ/יָּנ֣וּסוּ בַ/נֶּשֶׁף֒ וַ/יַּעַזְב֣וּ אֶת אָהֳלֵי/הֶ֗ם וְ/אֶת סֽוּסֵי/הֶם֙ וְ/אֶת חֲמֹ֣רֵי/הֶ֔ם הַֽ/מַּחֲנֶ֖ה כַּ/אֲשֶׁר הִ֑יא וַ/יָּנֻ֖סוּ אֶל נַפְשָֽׁ/ם
verses.translit: vyqvmv vynvsv bnshf vy'zbv 't 'hlyhm v't svsyhm v't chmryhm hmchnh kh'shr hy' vynsv 'l npshm
verses.translation: Wherefore they arose and fled in the twilight, and left their tents, and their horses, and their asses, even the camp as it was , and fled for their life.

verses.original: וַ/יָּבֹאוּ֩ הַֽ/מְצֹרָעִ֨ים הָ/אֵ֜לֶּה עַד קְצֵ֣ה הַֽ/מַּחֲנֶ֗ה וַ/יָּבֹ֜אוּ אֶל אֹ֤הֶל אֶחָד֙ וַ/יֹּאכְל֣וּ וַ/יִּשְׁתּ֔וּ וַ/יִּשְׂא֣וּ מִ/שָּׁ֗ם כֶּ֤סֶף וְ/זָהָב֙ וּ/בְגָדִ֔ים וַ/יֵּלְכ֖וּ וַ/יַּטְמִ֑נוּ וַ/יָּשֻׁ֗בוּ וַ/יָּבֹ֨אוּ֙ אֶל אֹ֣הֶל אַחֵ֔ר וַ/יִּשְׂא֣וּ מִ/שָּׁ֔ם וַ/יֵּלְכ֖וּ וַ/יַּטְמִֽנוּ
verses.translit: vyb'v hmtsr'ym h'lh 'd qtsh hmchnh vyb'v 'l 'hl 'chd vy'khlv vyshtv vysh'v mshm khsf vzhb vbgdym vylkhv vytmnv vyshbv vyb'v 'l 'hl 'chr vysh'v mshm vylkhv vytmnv
verses.translation: And when these lepers came to the uttermost part of the camp, they went into one tent, and did eat and drink, and carried thence silver, and gold, and raiment, and went and hid it; and came again, and entered into another tent, and carried thence also , and went and hid it .

verses.original: וַ/יֹּאמְרוּ֩ אִ֨ישׁ אֶל רֵעֵ֜/הוּ לֹֽא כֵ֣ן אֲנַ֣חְנוּ עֹשִׂ֗ים הַ/יּ֤וֹם הַ/זֶּה֙ יוֹם בְּשֹׂרָ֣ה ה֔וּא וַ/אֲנַ֣חְנוּ מַחְשִׁ֗ים וְ/חִכִּ֛ינוּ עַד א֥וֹר הַ/בֹּ֖קֶר וּ/מְצָאָ֣/נוּ עָו֑וֹן וְ/עַתָּה֙ לְכ֣וּ וְ/נָבֹ֔אָה וְ/נַגִּ֖ידָה בֵּ֥ית הַ/מֶּֽלֶךְ
verses.translit: vy'mrv 'ysh 'l r'hv l' khn 'nchnv 'shym hyvm hzh yvm bshrh hv' v'nchnv mchshym vchkhynv 'd 'vr hbqr vmts'nv 'vvn v'th lkhv vnb'h vngydh byt hmlkh
verses.translation: Then they said one to another, We do not well: this day is a day of good tidings, and we hold our peace: if we tarry till the morning light, some mischief will come upon us: now therefore come, that we may go and tell the king’s household.

verses.original: וַ/יָּבֹ֗אוּ וַֽ/יִּקְרְאוּ֮ אֶל שֹׁעֵ֣ר הָ/עִיר֒ וַ/יַּגִּ֤ידוּ לָ/הֶם֙ לֵ/אמֹ֔ר בָּ֚אנוּ אֶל מַחֲנֵ֣ה אֲרָ֔ם וְ/הִנֵּ֥ה אֵֽין שָׁ֛ם אִ֖ישׁ וְ/ק֣וֹל אָדָ֑ם כִּ֣י אִם הַ/סּ֤וּס אָסוּר֙ וְ/הַ/חֲמ֣וֹר אָס֔וּר וְ/אֹהָלִ֖ים כַּ/אֲשֶׁר הֵֽמָּה
verses.translit: vyb'v vyqr'v 'l sh'r h'yr vygydv lhm l'mr b'nv 'l mchnh 'rm vhnh 'yn shm 'ysh vqvl 'dm khy 'm hsvs 'svr vhchmvr 'svr v'hlym kh'shr hmh
verses.translation: So they came and called unto the porter of the city: and they told them, saying, We came to the camp of the Syrians, and, behold, there was no man there, neither voice of man, but horses tied, and asses tied, and the tents as they were .

verses.original: וַ/יִּקְרָ֖א הַ/שֹּֽׁעֲרִ֑ים וַ/יַּגִּ֕ידוּ בֵּ֥ית הַ/מֶּ֖לֶךְ פְּנִֽימָה
verses.translit: vyqr' hsh'rym vygydv byt hmlkh pnymh
verses.translation: And he called the porters; and they told it to the king’s house within.

verses.original: וַ/יָּ֨קָם הַ/מֶּ֜לֶךְ לַ֗יְלָה וַ/יֹּ֨אמֶר֙ אֶל עֲבָדָ֔י/ו אַגִּֽידָה נָּ֣א לָ/כֶ֔ם אֵ֛ת אֲשֶׁר עָ֥שׂוּ לָ֖/נוּ אֲרָ֑ם יָדְע֞וּ כִּי רְעֵבִ֣ים אֲנַ֗חְנוּ וַ/יֵּצְא֤וּ מִן הַֽ/מַּחֲנֶה֙ לְ/הֵחָבֵ֤ה ב/ה/שדה בַ/שָּׂדֶה֙ לֵ/אמֹ֔ר כִּֽי יֵצְא֤וּ מִן הָ/עִיר֙ וְ/נִתְפְּשֵׂ֣/ם חַיִּ֔ים וְ/אֶל הָ/עִ֖יר נָבֹֽא
verses.translit: vyqm hmlkh lylh vy'mr 'l 'bdyv 'gydh n' lkhm 't 'shr 'shv lnv 'rm yd'v khy r'bym 'nchnv vyts'v mn hmchnh lhchbh bhshdh bshdh l'mr khy yts'v mn h'yr vntpshm chyym v'l h'yr nb'
verses.translation: And the king arose in the night, and said unto his servants, I will now shew you what the Syrians have done to us. They know that we be hungry; therefore are they gone out of the camp to hide themselves in the field, saying, When they come out of the city, we shall catch them alive, and get into the city.

verses.original: וַ/יַּעַן֩ אֶחָ֨ד מֵ/עֲבָדָ֜י/ו וַ/יֹּ֗אמֶר וְ/יִקְחוּ נָ֞א חֲמִשָּׁ֣ה מִן הַ/סּוּסִים֮ הַֽ/נִּשְׁאָרִים֮ אֲשֶׁ֣ר נִשְׁאֲרוּ בָ/הּ֒ הִנָּ֗/ם כְּ/כָל ה/המון הֲמ֤וֹן יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר נִשְׁאֲרוּ בָ֔/הּ הִנָּ֕/ם כְּ/כָל הֲמ֥וֹן יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל אֲשֶׁר תָּ֑מּוּ וְ/נִשְׁלְחָ֖ה וְ/נִרְאֶֽה
verses.translit: vy'n 'chd m'bdyv vy'mr vyqchv n' chmshh mn hsvsym hnsh'rym 'shr nsh'rv bh hnm khkhl hhmvn hmvn yshr'l 'shr nsh'rv bh hnm khkhl hmvn yshr'l 'shr tmv vnshlchh vnr'h
verses.translation: And one of his servants answered and said, Let some take, I pray thee, five of the horses that remain, which are left in the city, (behold, they are as all the multitude of Israel that are left in it: behold, I say , they are even as all the multitude of the Israelites that are consumed:) and let us send and see.

verses.original: וַ/יִּקְח֕וּ שְׁנֵ֖י רֶ֣כֶב סוּסִ֑ים וַ/יִּשְׁלַ֨ח הַ/מֶּ֜לֶךְ אַחֲרֵ֧י מַחֲנֵֽה אֲרָ֛ם לֵ/אמֹ֖ר לְכ֥וּ וּ/רְאֽוּ
verses.translit: vyqchv shny rkhb svsym vyshlch hmlkh 'chry mchnh 'rm l'mr lkhv vr'v
verses.translation: They took therefore two chariot horses; and the king sent after the host of the Syrians, saying, Go and see.

verses.original: וַ/יֵּלְכ֣וּ אַחֲרֵי/הֶם֮ עַד הַ/יַּרְדֵּן֒ וְ/הִנֵּ֣ה כָל הַ/דֶּ֗רֶךְ מְלֵאָ֤ה בְגָדִים֙ וְ/כֵלִ֔ים אֲשֶׁר הִשְׁלִ֥יכוּ אֲרָ֖ם ב/החפז/ם בְּ/חָפְזָ֑/ם וַ/יָּשֻׁ֨בוּ֙ הַ/מַּלְאָכִ֔ים וַ/יַּגִּ֖דוּ לַ/מֶּֽלֶךְ
verses.translit: vylkhv 'chryhm 'd hyrdn vhnh khl hdrkh ml'h bgdym vkhlym 'shr hshlykhv 'rm bhchpzm bchpzm vyshbv hml'khym vygdv lmlkh
verses.translation: And they went after them unto Jordan: and, lo, all the way was full of garments and vessels, which the Syrians had cast away in their haste. And the messengers returned, and told the king.

verses.original: וַ/יֵּצֵ֣א הָ/עָ֔ם וַ/יָּבֹ֕זּוּ אֵ֖ת מַחֲנֵ֣ה אֲרָ֑ם וַ/יְהִ֨י סְאָה סֹ֜לֶת בְּ/שֶׁ֗קֶל וְ/סָאתַ֧יִם שְׂעֹרִ֛ים בְּ/שֶׁ֖קֶל כִּ/דְבַ֥ר יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: vyts' h'm vybzv 't mchnh 'rm vyhy s'h slt bshql vs'tym sh'rym bshql khdbr yhvh
verses.translation: And the people went out, and spoiled the tents of the Syrians. So a measure of fine flour was sold for a shekel, and two measures of barley for a shekel, according to the word of the LORD .

verses.original: וְ/הַ/מֶּלֶךְ֩ הִפְקִ֨יד אֶת הַ/שָּׁלִ֜ישׁ אֲשֶׁר נִשְׁעָ֤ן עַל יָד/וֹ֙ עַל הַ/שַּׁ֔עַר וַ/יִּרְמְסֻ֧/הוּ הָ/עָ֛ם בַּ/שַּׁ֖עַר וַ/יָּמֹ֑ת כַּ/אֲשֶׁ֤ר דִּבֶּר֙ אִ֣ישׁ הָ/אֱלֹהִ֔ים אֲשֶׁ֣ר דִּבֶּ֔ר בְּ/רֶ֥דֶת הַ/מֶּ֖לֶךְ אֵלָֽי/ו
verses.translit: vhmlkh hpqyd 't hshlysh 'shr nsh'n 'l ydv 'l hsh'r vyrmshv h'm bsh'r vymt kh'shr dbr 'ysh h'lhym 'shr dbr brdt hmlkh 'lyv
verses.translation: And the king appointed the lord on whose hand he leaned to have the charge of the gate: and the people trode upon him in the gate, and he died, as the man of God had said, who spake when the king came down to him.

verses.original: וַ/יְהִ֗י כְּ/דַבֵּר֙ אִ֣ישׁ הָ/אֱלֹהִ֔ים אֶל הַ/מֶּ֖לֶךְ לֵ/אמֹ֑ר סָאתַ֨יִם שְׂעֹרִ֜ים בְּ/שֶׁ֗קֶל וּֽ/סְאָה סֹ֨לֶת֙ בְּ/שֶׁ֔קֶל יִהְיֶה֙ כָּ/עֵ֣ת מָחָ֔ר בְּ/שַׁ֖עַר שֹׁמְרֽוֹן
verses.translit: vyhy khdbr 'ysh h'lhym 'l hmlkh l'mr s'tym sh'rym bshql vs'h slt bshql yhyh kh't mchr bsh'r shmrvn
verses.translation: And it came to pass as the man of God had spoken to the king, saying, Two measures of barley for a shekel, and a measure of fine flour for a shekel, shall be to morrow about this time in the gate of Samaria:

verses.original: וַ/יַּ֨עַן הַ/שָּׁלִ֜ישׁ אֶת אִ֣ישׁ הָ/אֱלֹהִים֮ וַ/יֹּאמַר֒ וְ/הִנֵּ֣ה יְהוָ֗ה עֹשֶׂ֤ה אֲרֻבּוֹת֙ בַּ/שָּׁמַ֔יִם הֲ/יִהְיֶ֖ה כַּ/דָּבָ֣ר הַ/זֶּ֑ה וַ/יֹּ֗אמֶר הִנְּ/ךָ֤ רֹאֶה֙ בְּ/עֵינֶ֔י/ךָ וּ/מִ/שָּׁ֖ם לֹ֥א תֹאכֵֽל
verses.translit: vy'n hshlysh 't 'ysh h'lhym vy'mr vhnh yhvh 'shh 'rbvt bshmym hyhyh khdbr hzh vy'mr hnkh r'h b'ynykh vmshm l' t'khl
verses.translation: And that lord answered the man of God, and said, Now, behold, if the LORD should make windows in heaven, might such a thing be? And he said, Behold, thou shalt see it with thine eyes, but shalt not eat thereof.

verses.original: וַ/יְהִי ל֖/וֹ כֵּ֑ן וַ/יִּרְמְס֨וּ אֹת֥/וֹ הָ/עָ֛ם בַּ/שַּׁ֖עַר וַ/יָּמֹֽת
verses.translit: vyhy lv khn vyrmsv 'tv h'm bsh'r vymt
verses.translation: And so it fell out unto him: for the people trode upon him in the gate, and he died.

verses.original: וֶ/אֱלִישָׁ֡ע דִּבֶּ֣ר אֶל הָ/אִשָּׁה֩ אֲשֶׁר הֶחֱיָ֨ה אֶת בְּנָ֜/הּ לֵ/אמֹ֗ר ק֤וּמִי וּ/לְכִי֙ אתי אַ֣תְּ וּ/בֵיתֵ֔/ךְ וְ/ג֖וּרִי בַּ/אֲשֶׁ֣ר תָּג֑וּרִי כִּֽי קָרָ֤א יְהוָה֙ לָֽ/רָעָ֔ב וְ/גַם בָּ֥א אֶל הָ/אָ֖רֶץ שֶׁ֥בַע שָׁנִֽים
verses.translit: v'lysh' dbr 'l h'shh 'shr hchyh 't bnh l'mr qvmy vlkhy 'ty 't vbytkh vgvry b'shr tgvry khy qr' yhvh lr'b vgm b' 'l h'rts shb' shnym
verses.translation: Then spake Elisha unto the woman, whose son he had restored to life, saying, Arise, and go thou and thine household, and sojourn wheresoever thou canst sojourn: for the LORD hath called for a famine; and it shall also come upon the land seven years.

verses.original: וַ/תָּ֨קָם֙ הָֽ/אִשָּׁ֔ה וַ/תַּ֕עַשׂ כִּ/דְבַ֖ר אִ֣ישׁ הָ/אֱלֹהִ֑ים וַ/תֵּ֤לֶךְ הִיא֙ וּ/בֵיתָ֔/הּ וַ/תָּ֥גָר בְּ/אֶֽרֶץ פְּלִשְׁתִּ֖ים שֶׁ֥בַע שָׁנִֽים
verses.translit: vtqm h'shh vt'sh khdbr 'ysh h'lhym vtlkh hy' vbyth vtgr b'rts plshtym shb' shnym
verses.translation: And the woman arose, and did after the saying of the man of God: and she went with her household, and sojourned in the land of the Philistines seven years.

verses.original: וַ/יְהִ֗י מִ/קְצֵה֙ שֶׁ֣בַע שָׁנִ֔ים וַ/תָּ֥שָׁב הָ/אִשָּׁ֖ה מֵ/אֶ֣רֶץ פְּלִשְׁתִּ֑ים וַ/תֵּצֵא֙ לִ/צְעֹ֣ק אֶל הַ/מֶּ֔לֶךְ אֶל בֵּיתָ֖/הּ וְ/אֶל שָׂדָֽ/הּ
verses.translit: vyhy mqtsh shb' shnym vtshb h'shh m'rts plshtym vtts' lts'q 'l hmlkh 'l byth v'l shdh
verses.translation: And it came to pass at the seven years’ end, that the woman returned out of the land of the Philistines: and she went forth to cry unto the king for her house and for her land.

verses.original: וְ/הַ/מֶּ֗לֶךְ מְדַבֵּר֙ אֶל גֵּ֣חֲזִ֔י נַ֥עַר אִישׁ הָ/אֱלֹהִ֖ים לֵ/אמֹ֑ר סַפְּרָ/ה נָּ֣א לִ֔/י אֵ֥ת כָּל הַ/גְּדֹל֖וֹת אֲשֶׁר עָשָׂ֥ה אֱלִישָֽׁע
verses.translit: vhmlkh mdbr 'l gchzy n'r 'ysh h'lhym l'mr sprh n' ly 't khl hgdlvt 'shr 'shh 'lysh'
verses.translation: And the king talked with Gehazi the servant of the man of God, saying, Tell me, I pray thee, all the great things that Elisha hath done.

verses.original: וַ֠/יְהִי ה֥וּא מְסַפֵּ֣ר לַ/מֶּלֶךְ֮ אֵ֣ת אֲשֶׁר הֶחֱיָ֣ה אֶת הַ/מֵּת֒ וְ/הִנֵּ֨ה הָ/אִשָּׁ֜ה אֲשֶׁר הֶחֱיָ֤ה אֶת בְּנָ/הּ֙ צֹעֶ֣קֶת אֶל הַ/מֶּ֔לֶךְ עַל בֵּיתָ֖/הּ וְ/עַל שָׂדָ֑/הּ וַ/יֹּ֤אמֶר גֵּֽחֲזִי֙ אֲדֹנִ֣/י הַ/מֶּ֔לֶךְ זֹ֚את הָֽ/אִשָּׁ֔ה וְ/זֶה בְּנָ֖/הּ אֲשֶׁר הֶחֱיָ֥ה אֱלִישָֽׁע
verses.translit: vyhy hv' mspr lmlkh 't 'shr hchyh 't hmt vhnh h'shh 'shr hchyh 't bnh ts'qt 'l hmlkh 'l byth v'l shdh vy'mr gchzy 'dny hmlkh z't h'shh vzh bnh 'shr hchyh 'lysh'
verses.translation: And it came to pass, as he was telling the king how he had restored a dead body to life, that, behold, the woman, whose son he had restored to life, cried to the king for her house and for her land. And Gehazi said, My lord, O king, this is the woman, and this is her son, whom Elisha restored to life.

verses.original: וַ/יִּשְׁאַ֥ל הַ/מֶּ֛לֶךְ לָ/אִשָּׁ֖ה וַ/תְּסַפֶּר ל֑/וֹ וַ/יִּתֶּן לָ֣/הּ הַ/מֶּלֶךְ֩ סָרִ֨יס אֶחָ֜ד לֵ/אמֹ֗ר הָשֵׁ֤יב אֶת כָּל אֲשֶׁר לָ/הּ֙ וְ/אֵת֙ כָּל תְּבוּאֹ֣ת הַ/שָּׂדֶ֔ה מִ/יּ֛וֹם עָזְבָ֥ה אֶת הָ/אָ֖רֶץ וְ/עַד עָֽתָּה
verses.translit: vysh'l hmlkh l'shh vtspr lv vytn lh hmlkh srys 'chd l'mr hshyb 't khl 'shr lh v't khl tbv't hshdh myvm 'zbh 't h'rts v'd 'th
verses.translation: And when the king asked the woman, she told him. So the king appointed unto her a certain officer, saying, Restore all that was hers, and all the fruits of the field since the day that she left the land, even until now.

verses.original: וַ/יָּבֹ֤א אֱלִישָׁע֙ דַּמֶּ֔שֶׂק וּ/בֶן הֲדַ֥ד מֶֽלֶךְ אֲרָ֖ם חֹלֶ֑ה וַ/יֻּגַּד ל֣/וֹ לֵ/אמֹ֔ר בָּ֛א אִ֥ישׁ הָ/אֱלֹהִ֖ים עַד הֵֽנָּה
verses.translit: vyb' 'lysh' dmshq vbn hdd mlkh 'rm chlh vygd lv l'mr b' 'ysh h'lhym 'd hnh
verses.translation: And Elisha came to Damascus; and Ben-hadad the king of Syria was sick; and it was told him, saying, The man of God is come hither.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֨אמֶר הַ/מֶּ֜לֶךְ אֶל חֲזָהאֵ֗ל קַ֤ח בְּ/יָֽדְ/ךָ֙ מִנְחָ֔ה וְ/לֵ֕ךְ לִ/קְרַ֖את אִ֣ישׁ הָ/אֱלֹהִ֑ים וְ/דָרַשְׁתָּ֨ אֶת יְהוָ֤ה מֵֽ/אוֹת/וֹ֙ לֵ/אמֹ֔ר הַ/אֶחְיֶ֖ה מֵ/חֳלִ֥י זֶֽה
verses.translit: vy'mr hmlkh 'l chzh'l qch bydkh mnchh vlkh lqr't 'ysh h'lhym vdrsht 't yhvh m'vtv l'mr h'chyh mchly zh
verses.translation: And the king said unto Hazael, Take a present in thine hand, and go, meet the man of God, and enquire of the LORD by him, saying, Shall I recover of this disease?

verses.original: וַ/יֵּ֣לֶךְ חֲזָאֵל֮ לִ/קְרָאת/וֹ֒ וַ/יִּקַּ֨ח מִנְחָ֤ה בְ/יָד/וֹ֙ וְ/כָל ט֣וּב דַּמֶּ֔שֶׂק מַשָּׂ֖א אַרְבָּעִ֣ים גָּמָ֑ל וַ/יָּבֹא֙ וַ/יַּעֲמֹ֣ד לְ/פָנָ֔י/ו וַ/יֹּ֗אמֶר בִּנְ/ךָ֨ בֶן הֲדַ֤ד מֶֽלֶךְ אֲרָם֙ שְׁלָחַ֤/נִי אֵלֶ֨י/ךָ֙ לֵ/אמֹ֔ר הַ/אֶחְיֶ֖ה מֵ/חֳלִ֥י זֶֽה
verses.translit: vylkh chz'l lqr'tv vyqch mnchh bydv vkhl tvb dmshq msh' 'rb'ym gml vyb' vy'md lpnyv vy'mr bnkh bn hdd mlkh 'rm shlchny 'lykh l'mr h'chyh mchly zh
verses.translation: So Hazael went to meet him, and took a present with him, even of every good thing of Damascus, forty camels’ burden, and came and stood before him, and said, Thy son Ben-hadad king of Syria hath sent me to thee, saying, Shall I recover of this disease?

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֤אמֶר אֵלָי/ו֙ אֱלִישָׁ֔ע לֵ֥ךְ אֱמָר לא ל֖/וֹ חָיֹ֣ה תִחְיֶ֑ה וְ/הִרְאַ֥/נִי יְהוָ֖ה כִּֽי מ֥וֹת יָמֽוּת
verses.translit: vy'mr 'lyv 'lysh' lkh 'mr l' lv chyh tchyh vhr'ny yhvh khy mvt ymvt
verses.translation: And Elisha said unto him, Go, say unto him, Thou mayest certainly recover: howbeit the LORD hath shewed me that he shall surely die.

verses.original: וַ/יַּעֲמֵ֥ד אֶת פָּנָ֖י/ו וַ/יָּ֣שֶׂם עַד בֹּ֑שׁ וַ/יֵּ֖בְךְּ אִ֥ישׁ הָ/אֱלֹהִֽים
verses.translit: vy'md 't pnyv vyshm 'd bsh vybkh 'ysh h'lhym
verses.translation: And he settled his countenance stedfastly, until he was ashamed: and the man of God wept.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֣אמֶר חֲזָאֵ֔ל מַדּ֖וּעַ אֲדֹנִ֣/י בֹכֶ֑ה וַ/יֹּ֡אמֶר כִּֽי יָדַ֡עְתִּי אֵ֣ת אֲשֶׁר תַּעֲשֶׂה֩ לִ/בְנֵ֨י יִשְׂרָאֵ֜ל רָעָ֗ה מִבְצְרֵי/הֶ֞ם תְּשַׁלַּ֤ח בָּ/אֵשׁ֙ וּ/בַחֻֽרֵי/הֶם֙ בַּ/חֶ֣רֶב תַּהֲרֹ֔ג וְ/עֹלְלֵי/הֶ֣ם תְּרַטֵּ֔שׁ וְ/הָרֹתֵי/הֶ֖ם תְּבַקֵּֽעַ
verses.translit: vy'mr chz'l mdv' 'dny bkhh vy'mr khy yd'ty 't 'shr t'shh lbny yshr'l r'h mbtsryhm tshlch b'sh vbchryhm bchrb thrg v'llyhm trtsh vhrtyhm tbq'
verses.translation: And Hazael said, Why weepeth my lord? And he answered, Because I know the evil that thou wilt do unto the children of Israel: their strong holds wilt thou set on fire, and their young men wilt thou slay with the sword, and wilt dash their children, and rip up their women with child.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֣אמֶר חֲזָהאֵ֔ל כִּ֣י מָ֤ה עַבְדְּ/ךָ֙ הַ/כֶּ֔לֶב כִּ֣י יַעֲשֶׂ֔ה הַ/דָּבָ֥ר הַ/גָּד֖וֹל הַ/זֶּ֑ה וַ/יֹּ֣אמֶר אֱלִישָׁ֔ע הִרְאַ֧/נִי יְהוָ֛ה אֹתְ/ךָ֖ מֶ֥לֶךְ עַל אֲרָֽם
verses.translit: vy'mr chzh'l khy mh 'bdkh hkhlb khy y'shh hdbr hgdvl hzh vy'mr 'lysh' hr'ny yhvh 'tkh mlkh 'l 'rm
verses.translation: And Hazael said, But what, is thy servant a dog, that he should do this great thing? And Elisha answered, The LORD hath shewed me that thou shalt be king over Syria.

verses.original: וַ/יֵּ֣לֶךְ מֵ/אֵ֣ת אֱלִישָׁ֗ע וַ/יָּבֹא֙ אֶל אֲדֹנָ֔י/ו וַ/יֹּ֣אמֶר ל֔/וֹ מָֽה אָמַ֥ר לְ/ךָ֖ אֱלִישָׁ֑ע וַ/יֹּ֕אמֶר אָ֥מַר לִ֖/י חָיֹ֥ה תִחְיֶֽה
verses.translit: vylkh m't 'lysh' vyb' 'l 'dnyv vy'mr lv mh 'mr lkh 'lysh' vy'mr 'mr ly chyh tchyh
verses.translation: So he departed from Elisha, and came to his master; who said to him, What said Elisha to thee? And he answered, He told me that thou shouldest surely recover.

verses.original: וַ/יְהִ֣י מִֽ/מָּחֳרָ֗ת וַ/יִּקַּ֤ח הַ/מַּכְבֵּר֙ וַ/יִּטְבֹּ֣ל בַּ/מַּ֔יִם וַ/יִּפְרֹ֥שׂ עַל פָּנָ֖י/ו וַ/יָּמֹ֑ת וַ/יִּמְלֹ֥ךְ חֲזָהאֵ֖ל תַּחְתָּֽי/ו
verses.translit: vyhy mmchrt vyqch hmkhbr vytbl bmym vyprsh 'l pnyv vymt vymlkh chzh'l tchtyv
verses.translation: And it came to pass on the morrow, that he took a thick cloth, and dipped it in water, and spread it on his face, so that he died: and Hazael reigned in his stead.

verses.original: וּ/בִ/שְׁנַ֣ת חָמֵ֗שׁ לְ/יוֹרָ֤ם בֶּן אַחְאָב֙ מֶ֣לֶךְ יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל וִ/יהוֹשָׁפָ֖ט מֶ֣לֶךְ יְהוּדָ֑ה מָלַ֛ךְ יְהוֹרָ֥ם בֶּן יְהוֹשָׁפָ֖ט מֶ֥לֶךְ יְהוּדָֽה
verses.translit: vbshnt chmsh lyvrm bn 'ch'b mlkh yshr'l vyhvshpt mlkh yhvdh mlkh yhvrm bn yhvshpt mlkh yhvdh
verses.translation: And in the fifth year of Joram the son of Ahab king of Israel, Jehoshaphat being then king of Judah, Jehoram the son of Jehoshaphat king of Judah began to reign.

verses.original: בֶּן שְׁלֹשִׁ֥ים וּ/שְׁתַּ֛יִם שָׁנָ֖ה הָיָ֣ה בְ/מָלְכ֑/וֹ וּ/שְׁמֹנֶ֣ה שנה שָׁנִ֔ים מָלַ֖ךְ בִּ/ירוּשָׁלִָֽם
verses.translit: bn shlshym vshtym shnh hyh bmlkhv vshmnh shnh shnym mlkh byrvshlm
verses.translation: Thirty and two years old was he when he began to reign; and he reigned eight years in Jerusalem.

verses.original: וַ/יֵּ֜לֶךְ בְּ/דֶ֣רֶךְ מַלְכֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל כַּ/אֲשֶׁ֤ר עָשׂוּ֙ בֵּ֣ית אַחְאָ֔ב כִּ֚י בַּת אַחְאָ֔ב הָֽיְתָה לּ֖/וֹ לְ/אִשָּׁ֑ה וַ/יַּ֥עַשׂ הָ/רַ֖ע בְּ/עֵינֵ֥י יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: vylkh bdrkh mlkhy yshr'l kh'shr 'shv byt 'ch'b khy bt 'ch'b hyth lv l'shh vy'sh hr' b'yny yhvh
verses.translation: And he walked in the way of the kings of Israel, as did the house of Ahab: for the daughter of Ahab was his wife: and he did evil in the sight of the LORD .

verses.original: וְ/לֹֽא אָבָ֤ה יְהוָה֙ לְ/הַשְׁחִ֣ית אֶת יְהוּדָ֔ה לְמַ֖עַן דָּוִ֣ד עַבְדּ֑/וֹ כַּ/אֲשֶׁ֣ר אָֽמַר ל֗/וֹ לָ/תֵ֨ת ל֥/וֹ נִ֛יר לְ/בָנָ֖י/ו כָּל הַ/יָּמִֽים
verses.translit: vl' 'bh yhvh lhshchyt 't yhvdh lm'n dvd 'bdv kh'shr 'mr lv ltt lv nyr lbnyv khl hymym
verses.translation: Yet the LORD would not destroy Judah for David his servant’s sake, as he promised him to give him alway a light, and to his children.

verses.original: בְּ/יָמָי/ו֙ פָּשַׁ֣ע אֱד֔וֹם מִ/תַּ֖חַת יַד יְהוּדָ֑ה וַ/יַּמְלִ֥כוּ עֲלֵי/הֶ֖ם מֶֽלֶךְ
verses.translit: bymyv psh' 'dvm mtcht yd yhvdh vymlkhv 'lyhm mlkh
verses.translation: In his days Edom revolted from under the hand of Judah, and made a king over themselves.

verses.original: וַ/יַּעֲבֹ֤ר יוֹרָם֙ צָעִ֔ירָ/ה וְ/כָל הָ/רֶ֖כֶב עִמּ֑/וֹ וַֽ/יְהִי ה֞וּא קָ֣ם לַ֗יְלָה וַ/יַּכֶּ֨ה אֶת אֱד֜וֹם הַ/סֹּבֵ֤יב אֵלָי/ו֙ וְ/אֵת֙ שָׂרֵ֣י הָ/רֶ֔כֶב וַ/יָּ֥נָס הָ/עָ֖ם לְ/אֹהָלָֽי/ו
verses.translit: vy'br yvrm ts'yrh vkhl hrkhb 'mv vyhy hv' qm lylh vykhh 't 'dvm hsbyb 'lyv v't shry hrkhb vyns h'm l'hlyv
verses.translation: So Joram went over to Zair, and all the chariots with him: and he rose by night, and smote the Edomites which compassed him about, and the captains of the chariots: and the people fled into their tents.

verses.original: וַ/יִּפְשַׁ֣ע אֱד֗וֹם מִ/תַּ֨חַת֙ יַד יְהוּדָ֔ה עַ֖ד הַ/יּ֣וֹם הַ/זֶּ֑ה אָ֛ז תִּפְשַׁ֥ע לִבְנָ֖ה בָּ/עֵ֥ת הַ/הִֽיא
verses.translit: vypsh' 'dvm mtcht yd yhvdh 'd hyvm hzh 'z tpsh' lbnh b't hhy'
verses.translation: Yet Edom revolted from under the hand of Judah unto this day. Then Libnah revolted at the same time.

verses.original: וְ/יֶ֛תֶר דִּבְרֵ֥י יוֹרָ֖ם וְ/כָל אֲשֶׁ֣ר עָשָׂ֑ה הֲ/לֽוֹא הֵ֣ם כְּתוּבִ֗ים עַל סֵ֛פֶר דִּבְרֵ֥י הַ/יָּמִ֖ים לְ/מַלְכֵ֥י יְהוּדָֽה
verses.translit: vytr dbry yvrm vkhl 'shr 'shh hlv' hm khtvbym 'l spr dbry hymym lmlkhy yhvdh
verses.translation: And the rest of the acts of Joram, and all that he did, are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah?

verses.original: וַ/יִּשְׁכַּ֤ב יוֹרָם֙ עִם אֲבֹתָ֔י/ו וַ/יִּקָּבֵ֥ר עִם אֲבֹתָ֖י/ו בְּ/עִ֣יר דָּוִ֑ד וַ/יִּמְלֹ֛ךְ אֲחַזְיָ֥הוּ בְנ֖/וֹ תַּחְתָּֽי/ו
verses.translit: vyshkhb yvrm 'm 'btyv vyqbr 'm 'btyv b'yr dvd vymlkh 'chzyhv bnv tchtyv
verses.translation: And Joram slept with his fathers, and was buried with his fathers in the city of David: and Ahaziah his son reigned in his stead.

verses.original: בִּ/שְׁנַת֙ שְׁתֵּים עֶשְׂרֵ֣ה שָׁנָ֔ה לְ/יוֹרָ֥ם בֶּן אַחְאָ֖ב מֶ֣לֶךְ יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל מָלַ֛ךְ אֲחַזְיָ֥הוּ בֶן יְהוֹרָ֖ם מֶ֥לֶךְ יְהוּדָֽה
verses.translit: bshnt shtym 'shrh shnh lyvrm bn 'ch'b mlkh yshr'l mlkh 'chzyhv bn yhvrm mlkh yhvdh
verses.translation: In the twelfth year of Joram the son of Ahab king of Israel did Ahaziah the son of Jehoram king of Judah begin to reign.

verses.original: בֶּן עֶשְׂרִ֨ים וּ/שְׁתַּ֤יִם שָׁנָה֙ אֲחַזְיָ֣הוּ בְ/מָלְכ֔/וֹ וְ/שָׁנָ֣ה אַחַ֔ת מָלַ֖ךְ בִּ/ירוּשָׁלִָ֑ם וְ/שֵׁ֤ם אִמּ/וֹ֙ עֲתַלְיָ֔הוּ בַּת עָמְרִ֖י מֶ֥לֶךְ יִשְׂרָאֵֽל
verses.translit: bn 'shrym vshtym shnh 'chzyhv bmlkhv vshnh 'cht mlkh byrvshlm vshm 'mv 'tlyhv bt 'mry mlkh yshr'l
verses.translation: Two and twenty years old was Ahaziah when he began to reign; and he reigned one year in Jerusalem. And his mother’s name was Athaliah, the daughter of Omri king of Israel.

verses.original: וַ/יֵּ֗לֶךְ בְּ/דֶ֨רֶךְ֙ בֵּ֣ית אַחְאָ֔ב וַ/יַּ֧עַשׂ הָ/רַ֛ע בְּ/עֵינֵ֥י יְהוָ֖ה כְּ/בֵ֣ית אַחְאָ֑ב כִּ֛י חֲתַ֥ן בֵּית אַחְאָ֖ב הֽוּא
verses.translit: vylkh bdrkh byt 'ch'b vy'sh hr' b'yny yhvh khbyt 'ch'b khy chtn byt 'ch'b hv'
verses.translation: And he walked in the way of the house of Ahab, and did evil in the sight of the LORD , as did the house of Ahab: for he was the son in law of the house of Ahab.

verses.original: וַ/יֵּ֜לֶךְ אֶת יוֹרָ֣ם בֶּן אַחְאָ֗ב לַ/מִּלְחָמָ֛ה עִם חֲזָהאֵ֥ל מֶֽלֶךְ אֲרָ֖ם בְּ/רָמֹ֣ת גִּלְעָ֑ד וַ/יַּכּ֥וּ אֲרַמִּ֖ים אֶת יוֹרָֽם
verses.translit: vylkh 't yvrm bn 'ch'b lmlchmh 'm chzh'l mlkh 'rm brmt gl'd vykhv 'rmym 't yvrm
verses.translation: And he went with Joram the son of Ahab to the war against Hazael king of Syria in Ramoth-gilead; and the Syrians wounded Joram.

verses.original: וַ/יָּשָׁב֩ יוֹרָ֨ם הַ/מֶּ֜לֶךְ לְ/הִתְרַפֵּ֣א בְ/יִזְרְעֶ֗אל מִן הַ/מַּכִּים֙ אֲשֶׁ֨ר יַכֻּ֤/הוּ אֲרַמִּים֙ בָּֽ/רָמָ֔ה בְּ/הִלָּ֣חֲמ֔/וֹ אֶת חֲזָהאֵ֖ל מֶ֣לֶךְ אֲרָ֑ם וַ/אֲחַזְיָ֨הוּ בֶן יְהוֹרָ֜ם מֶ֣לֶךְ יְהוּדָ֗ה יָרַ֡ד לִ/רְא֞וֹת אֶת יוֹרָ֧ם בֶּן אַחְאָ֛ב בְּ/יִזְרְעֶ֖אל כִּֽי חֹלֶ֥ה הֽוּא
verses.translit: vyshb yvrm hmlkh lhtrp' byzr''l mn hmkhym 'shr ykhhv 'rmym brmh bhlchmv 't chzh'l mlkh 'rm v'chzyhv bn yhvrm mlkh yhvdh yrd lr'vt 't yvrm bn 'ch'b byzr''l khy chlh hv'
verses.translation: And king Joram went back to be healed in Jezreel of the wounds which the Syrians had given him at Ramah, when he fought against Hazael king of Syria. And Ahaziah the son of Jehoram king of Judah went down to see Joram the son of Ahab in Jezreel, because he was sick.

verses.original: וֶ/אֱלִישָׁע֙ הַ/נָּבִ֔יא קָרָ֕א לְ/אַחַ֖ד מִ/בְּנֵ֣י הַ/נְּבִיאִ֑ים וַ/יֹּ֨אמֶר ל֜/וֹ חֲגֹ֣ר מָתְנֶ֗י/ךָ וְ֠/קַח פַּ֣ךְ הַ/שֶּׁ֤מֶן הַ/זֶּה֙ בְּ/יָדֶ֔/ךָ וְ/לֵ֖ךְ רָמֹ֥ת גִּלְעָֽד
verses.translit: v'lysh' hnby' qr' l'chd mbny hnby'ym vy'mr lv chgr mtnykh vqch pkh hshmn hzh bydkh vlkh rmt gl'd
verses.translation: And Elisha the prophet called one of the children of the prophets, and said unto him, Gird up thy loins, and take this box of oil in thine hand, and go to Ramoth-gilead:

verses.original: וּ/בָ֖אתָ שָׁ֑מָּ/ה וּ/רְאֵֽה שָׁ֠ם יֵה֨וּא בֶן יְהוֹשָׁפָ֜ט בֶּן נִמְשִׁ֗י וּ/בָ֨אתָ֙ וַ/הֲקֵֽמֹת/וֹ֙ מִ/תּ֣וֹך אֶחָ֔י/ו וְ/הֵבֵיאתָ֥ אֹת֖/וֹ חֶ֥דֶר בְּ/חָֽדֶר
verses.translit: vb't shmh vr'h shm yhv' bn yhvshpt bn nmshy vb't vhqmtv mtvkh 'chyv vhby't 'tv chdr bchdr
verses.translation: And when thou comest thither, look out there Jehu the son of Jehoshaphat the son of Nimshi, and go in, and make him arise up from among his brethren, and carry him to an inner chamber;

verses.original: וְ/לָקַחְתָּ֤ פַךְ הַ/שֶּׁ֨מֶן֙ וְ/יָצַקְתָּ֣ עַל רֹאשׁ֔/וֹ וְ/אָֽמַרְתָּ֙ כֹּֽה אָמַ֣ר יְהוָ֔ה מְשַׁחְתִּ֥י/ךָֽ לְ/מֶ֖לֶךְ אֶל יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וּ/פָתַחְתָּ֥ הַ/דֶּ֛לֶת וְ/נַ֖סְתָּה וְ/לֹ֥א תְחַכֶּֽה
verses.translit: vlqcht pkh hshmn vytsqt 'l r'shv v'mrt khh 'mr yhvh mshchtykh lmlkh 'l yshr'l vptcht hdlt vnsth vl' tchkhh
verses.translation: Then take the box of oil, and pour it on his head, and say, Thus saith the LORD , I have anointed thee king over Israel. Then open the door, and flee, and tarry not.

verses.original: וַ/יֵּ֧לֶךְ הַ/נַּ֛עַר הַ/נַּ֥עַר הַ/נָּבִ֖יא רָמֹ֥ת גִּלְעָֽד
verses.translit: vylkh hn'r hn'r hnby' rmt gl'd
verses.translation: So the young man, even the young man the prophet, went to Ramoth-gilead.

verses.original: וַ/יָּבֹ֗א וְ/הִנֵּ֨ה שָׂרֵ֤י הַ/חַ֨יִל֙ יֹֽשְׁבִ֔ים וַ/יֹּ֕אמֶר דָּבָ֥ר לִ֛/י אֵלֶ֖י/ךָ הַ/שָּׂ֑ר וַ/יֹּ֤אמֶר יֵהוּא֙ אֶל מִ֣י מִ/כֻּלָּ֔/נוּ וַ/יֹּ֖אמֶר אֵלֶ֥י/ךָ הַ/שָּֽׂר
verses.translit: vyb' vhnh shry hchyl yshbym vy'mr dbr ly 'lykh hshr vy'mr yhv' 'l my mkhlnv vy'mr 'lykh hshr
verses.translation: And when he came, behold, the captains of the host were sitting; and he said, I have an errand to thee, O captain. And Jehu said, Unto which of all us? And he said, To thee, O captain.

verses.original: וַ/יָּ֨קָם֙ וַ/יָּבֹ֣א הַ/בַּ֔יְתָ/ה וַ/יִּצֹ֥ק הַ/שֶּׁ֖מֶן אֶל רֹאשׁ֑/וֹ וַ/יֹּ֣אמֶר ל֗/וֹ כֹּֽה אָמַ֤ר יְהוָה֙ אֱלֹהֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל מְשַׁחְתִּ֧י/ךָֽ לְ/מֶ֛לֶךְ אֶל עַ֥ם יְהוָ֖ה אֶל יִשְׂרָאֵֽל
verses.translit: vyqm vyb' hbyth vytsq hshmn 'l r'shv vy'mr lv khh 'mr yhvh 'lhy yshr'l mshchtykh lmlkh 'l 'm yhvh 'l yshr'l
verses.translation: And he arose, and went into the house; and he poured the oil on his head, and said unto him, Thus saith the LORD God of Israel, I have anointed thee king over the people of the LORD , even over Israel.

verses.original: וְ/הִ֨כִּיתָ֔ה אֶת בֵּ֥ית אַחְאָ֖ב אֲדֹנֶ֑י/ךָ וְ/נִקַּמְתִּ֞י דְּמֵ֣י עֲבָדַ֣/י הַ/נְּבִיאִ֗ים וּ/דְמֵ֛י כָּל עַבְדֵ֥י יְהוָ֖ה מִ/יַּ֥ד אִיזָֽבֶל
verses.translit: vhkhyth 't byt 'ch'b 'dnykh vnqmty dmy 'bdy hnby'ym vdmy khl 'bdy yhvh myd 'yzbl
verses.translation: And thou shalt smite the house of Ahab thy master, that I may avenge the blood of my servants the prophets, and the blood of all the servants of the LORD , at the hand of Jezebel.

verses.original: וְ/אָבַ֖ד כָּל בֵּ֣ית אַחְאָ֑ב וְ/הִכְרַתִּ֤י לְ/אַחְאָב֙ מַשְׁתִּ֣ין בְּ/קִ֔יר וְ/עָצ֥וּר וְ/עָז֖וּב בְּ/יִשְׂרָאֵֽל
verses.translit: v'bd khl byt 'ch'b vhkhrty l'ch'b mshtyn bqyr v'tsvr v'zvb byshr'l
verses.translation: For the whole house of Ahab shall perish: and I will cut off from Ahab him that pisseth against the wall, and him that is shut up and left in Israel:

verses.original: וְ/נָֽתַתִּי֙ אֶת בֵּ֣ית אַחְאָ֔ב כְּ/בֵ֖ית יָרָבְעָ֣ם בֶּן נְבָ֑ט וּ/כְ/בֵ֖ית בַּעְשָׁ֥א בֶן אֲחִיָּֽה
verses.translit: vntty 't byt 'ch'b khbyt yrb'm bn nbt vkhbyt b'sh' bn 'chyh
verses.translation: And I will make the house of Ahab like the house of Jeroboam the son of Nebat, and like the house of Baasha the son of Ahijah:

verses.original: וְ/אֶת אִיזֶ֜בֶל יֹאכְל֧וּ הַ/כְּלָבִ֛ים בְּ/חֵ֥לֶק יִזְרְעֶ֖אל וְ/אֵ֣ין קֹבֵ֑ר וַ/יִּפְתַּ֥ח הַ/דֶּ֖לֶת וַ/יָּנֹֽס
verses.translit: v't 'yzbl y'khlv hkhlbym bchlq yzr''l v'yn qbr vyptch hdlt vyns
verses.translation: And the dogs shall eat Jezebel in the portion of Jezreel, and there shall be none to bury her . And he opened the door, and fled.

verses.original: וְ/יֵה֗וּא יָצָא֙ אֶל עַבְדֵ֣י אֲדֹנָ֔י/ו וַ/יֹּ֤אמֶר ל/וֹ֙ הֲ/שָׁל֔וֹם מַדּ֛וּעַ בָּֽא הַ/מְשֻׁגָּ֥ע הַ/זֶּ֖ה אֵלֶ֑י/ךָ וַ/יֹּ֣אמֶר אֲלֵי/הֶ֔ם אַתֶּ֛ם יְדַעְתֶּ֥ם אֶת הָ/אִ֖ישׁ וְ/אֶת שִׂיחֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: vyhv' yts' 'l 'bdy 'dnyv vy'mr lv hshlvm mdv' b' hmshg' hzh 'lykh vy'mr 'lyhm 'tm yd'tm 't h'ysh v't shychv
verses.translation: Then Jehu came forth to the servants of his lord: and one said unto him, Is all well? wherefore came this mad fellow to thee? And he said unto them, Ye know the man, and his communication.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּאמְר֣וּ שֶׁ֔קֶר הַגֶּד נָ֖א לָ֑/נוּ וַ/יֹּ֗אמֶר כָּ/זֹ֤את וְ/כָ/זֹאת֙ אָמַ֤ר אֵלַ/י֙ לֵ/אמֹ֔ר כֹּ֚ה אָמַ֣ר יְהוָ֔ה מְשַׁחְתִּ֥י/ךָֽ לְ/מֶ֖לֶךְ אֶל יִשְׂרָאֵֽל
verses.translit: vy'mrv shqr hgd n' lnv vy'mr khz't vkhz't 'mr 'ly l'mr khh 'mr yhvh mshchtykh lmlkh 'l yshr'l
verses.translation: And they said, It is false; tell us now. And he said, Thus and thus spake he to me, saying, Thus saith the LORD , I have anointed thee king over Israel.

verses.original: וַֽ/יְמַהֲר֗וּ וַ/יִּקְחוּ֙ אִ֣ישׁ בִּגְד֔/וֹ וַ/יָּשִׂ֥ימוּ תַחְתָּ֖י/ו אֶל גֶּ֣רֶם הַֽ/מַּעֲל֑וֹת וַֽ/יִּתְקְעוּ֙ בַּ/שּׁוֹפָ֔ר וַ/יֹּאמְר֖וּ מָלַ֥ךְ יֵהֽוּא
verses.translit: vymhrv vyqchv 'ysh bgdv vyshymv tchtyv 'l grm hm'lvt vytq'v bshvpr vy'mrv mlkh yhv'
verses.translation: Then they hasted, and took every man his garment, and put it under him on the top of the stairs, and blew with trumpets, saying, Jehu is king.

verses.original: וַ/יִּתְקַשֵּׁ֗ר יֵה֛וּא בֶּן יְהוֹשָׁפָ֥ט בֶּן נִמְשִׁ֖י אֶל יוֹרָ֑ם וְ/יוֹרָם֩ הָיָ֨ה שֹׁמֵ֜ר בְּ/רָמֹ֣ת גִּלְעָ֗ד ה֚וּא וְ/כָל יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל מִ/פְּנֵ֥י חֲזָאֵ֖ל מֶֽלֶךְ אֲרָֽם
verses.translit: vytqshr yhv' bn yhvshpt bn nmshy 'l yvrm vyvrm hyh shmr brmt gl'd hv' vkhl yshr'l mpny chz'l mlkh 'rm
verses.translation: So Jehu the son of Jehoshaphat the son of Nimshi conspired against Joram. (Now Joram had kept Ramoth-gilead, he and all Israel, because of Hazael king of Syria.

verses.original: וַ/יָּשָׁב֩ יְהוֹרָ֨ם הַ/מֶּ֜לֶךְ לְ/הִתְרַפֵּ֣א בִ/יְזְרְעֶ֗אל מִן הַ/מַּכִּים֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר יַכֻּ֣/הוּ אֲרַמִּ֔ים בְּ/הִלָּ֣חֲמ֔/וֹ אֶת חֲזָאֵ֖ל מֶ֣לֶךְ אֲרָ֑ם וַ/יֹּ֤אמֶר יֵהוּא֙ אִם יֵ֣שׁ נַפְשְׁ/כֶ֔ם אַל יֵצֵ֤א פָלִיט֙ מִן הָ/עִ֔יר לָ/לֶ֖כֶת ל/גיד לְ/הַגִּ֥יד בְּ/יִזְרְעֶֽאל
verses.translit: vyshb yhvrm hmlkh lhtrp' byzr''l mn hmkhym 'shr ykhhv 'rmym bhlchmv 't chz'l mlkh 'rm vy'mr yhv' 'm ysh npshkhm 'l yts' plyt mn h'yr llkht lgyd lhgyd byzr''l
verses.translation: But king Joram was returned to be healed in Jezreel of the wounds which the Syrians had given him, when he fought with Hazael king of Syria.) And Jehu said, If it be your minds, then let none go forth nor escape out of the city to go to tell it in Jezreel.

verses.original: וַ/יִּרְכַּ֤ב יֵהוּא֙ וַ/יֵּ֣לֶךְ יִזְרְעֶ֔אלָ/ה כִּ֥י יוֹרָ֖ם שֹׁכֵ֣ב שָׁ֑מָּ/ה וַֽ/אֲחַזְיָה֙ מֶ֣לֶךְ יְהוּדָ֔ה יָרַ֖ד לִ/רְא֥וֹת אֶת יוֹרָֽם
verses.translit: vyrkhb yhv' vylkh yzr''lh khy yvrm shkhb shmh v'chzyh mlkh yhvdh yrd lr'vt 't yvrm
verses.translation: So Jehu rode in a chariot, and went to Jezreel; for Joram lay there. And Ahaziah king of Judah was come down to see Joram.

verses.original: וְ/הַ/צֹּפֶה֩ עֹמֵ֨ד עַֽל הַ/מִּגְדָּ֜ל בְּ/יִזְרְעֶ֗אל וַ/יַּ֞רְא אֶת שִׁפְעַ֤ת יֵהוּא֙ בְּ/בֹא֔/וֹ וַ/יֹּ֕אמֶר שִׁפְעַ֖ת אֲנִ֣י רֹאֶ֑ה וַ/יֹּ֣אמֶר יְהוֹרָ֗ם קַ֥ח רַכָּ֛ב וּֽ/שְׁלַ֥ח לִ/קְרָאתָ֖/ם וְ/יֹאמַ֥ר הֲ/שָׁלֽוֹם
verses.translit: vhtsph 'md 'l hmgdl byzr''l vyr' 't shp't yhv' bb'v vy'mr shp't 'ny r'h vy'mr yhvrm qch rkhb vshlch lqr'tm vy'mr hshlvm
verses.translation: And there stood a watchman on the tower in Jezreel, and he spied the company of Jehu as he came, and said, I see a company. And Joram said, Take an horseman, and send to meet them, and let him say, Is it peace?

verses.original: וַ/יֵּלֶךְ֩ רֹכֵ֨ב הַ/סּ֜וּס לִ/קְרָאת֗/וֹ וַ/יֹּ֨אמֶר֙ כֹּֽה אָמַ֤ר הַ/מֶּ֨לֶךְ֙ הֲ/שָׁל֔וֹם וַ/יֹּ֧אמֶר יֵה֛וּא מַה לְּ/ךָ֥ וּ/לְ/שָׁל֖וֹם סֹ֣ב אֶֽל אַחֲרָ֑/י וַ/יַּגֵּ֤ד הַ/צֹּפֶה֙ לֵ/אמֹ֔ר בָּֽא הַ/מַּלְאָ֥ךְ עַד הֵ֖ם וְ/לֹֽא שָֽׁב
verses.translit: vylkh rkhb hsvs lqr'tv vy'mr khh 'mr hmlkh hshlvm vy'mr yhv' mh lkh vlshlvm sb 'l 'chry vygd htsph l'mr b' hml'kh 'd hm vl' shb
