verses.translation: So there went one on horseback to meet him, and said, Thus saith the king, Is it peace? And Jehu said, What hast thou to do with peace? turn thee behind me. And the watchman told, saying, The messenger came to them, but he cometh not again.

verses.original: וַ/יִּשְׁלַ֗ח רֹכֵ֣ב סוּס֮ שֵׁנִי֒ וַ/יָּבֹ֣א אֲלֵ/הֶ֔ם וַ/יֹּ֛אמֶר כֹּֽה אָמַ֥ר הַ/מֶּ֖לֶךְ שָׁל֑וֹם וַ/יֹּ֧אמֶר יֵה֛וּא מַה לְּ/ךָ֥ וּ/לְ/שָׁל֖וֹם סֹ֥ב אֶֽל אַחֲרָֽ/י
verses.translit: vyshlch rkhb svs shny vyb' 'lhm vy'mr khh 'mr hmlkh shlvm vy'mr yhv' mh lkh vlshlvm sb 'l 'chry
verses.translation: Then he sent out a second on horseback, which came to them, and said, Thus saith the king, Is it peace? And Jehu answered, What hast thou to do with peace? turn thee behind me.

verses.original: וַ/יַּגֵּ֤ד הַ/צֹּפֶה֙ לֵ/אמֹ֔ר בָּ֥א עַד אֲלֵי/הֶ֖ם וְ/לֹֽא שָׁ֑ב וְ/הַ/מִּנְהָ֗ג כְּ/מִנְהַג֙ יֵה֣וּא בֶן נִמְשִׁ֔י כִּ֥י בְ/שִׁגָּע֖וֹן יִנְהָֽג
verses.translit: vygd htsph l'mr b' 'd 'lyhm vl' shb vhmnhg khmnhg yhv' bn nmshy khy bshg'vn ynhg
verses.translation: And the watchman told, saying, He came even unto them, and cometh not again: and the driving is like the driving of Jehu the son of Nimshi; for he driveth furiously.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֤אמֶר יְהוֹרָם֙ אֱסֹ֔ר וַ/יֶּאְסֹ֖ר רִכְבּ֑/וֹ וַ/יֵּצֵ֣א יְהוֹרָ֣ם מֶֽלֶךְ יִ֠שְׂרָאֵל וַ/אֲחַזְיָ֨הוּ מֶֽלֶךְ יְהוּדָ֜ה אִ֣ישׁ בְּ/רִכְבּ֗/וֹ וַ/יֵּֽצְאוּ֙ לִ/קְרַ֣את יֵה֔וּא וַ/יִּמְצָאֻ֔/הוּ בְּ/חֶלְקַ֖ת נָב֥וֹת הַ/יִּזְרְעֵאלִֽי
verses.translit: vy'mr yhvrm 'sr vy'sr rkhbv vyts' yhvrm mlkh yshr'l v'chzyhv mlkh yhvdh 'ysh brkhbv vyts'v lqr't yhv' vymts'hv bchlqt nbvt hyzr''ly
verses.translation: And Joram said, Make ready. And his chariot was made ready. And Joram king of Israel and Ahaziah king of Judah went out, each in his chariot, and they went out against Jehu, and met him in the portion of Naboth the Jezreelite.

verses.original: וַ/יְהִ֗י כִּ/רְא֤וֹת יְהוֹרָם֙ אֶת יֵה֔וּא וַ/יֹּ֖אמֶר הֲ/שָׁל֣וֹם יֵה֑וּא וַ/יֹּ֨אמֶר֙ מָ֣ה הַ/שָּׁל֔וֹם עַד זְנוּנֵ֞י אִיזֶ֧בֶל אִמְּ/ךָ֛ וּ/כְשָׁפֶ֖י/הָ הָ/רַבִּֽים
verses.translit: vyhy khr'vt yhvrm 't yhv' vy'mr hshlvm yhv' vy'mr mh hshlvm 'd znvny 'yzbl 'mkh vkhshpyh hrbym
verses.translation: And it came to pass, when Joram saw Jehu, that he said, Is it peace, Jehu? And he answered, What peace, so long as the whoredoms of thy mother Jezebel and her witchcrafts are so many?

verses.original: וַ/יַּהֲפֹ֧ךְ יְהוֹרָ֛ם יָדָ֖י/ו וַ/יָּנֹ֑ס וַ/יֹּ֥אמֶר אֶל אֲחַזְיָ֖הוּ מִרְמָ֥ה אֲחַזְיָֽה
verses.translit: vyhpkh yhvrm ydyv vyns vy'mr 'l 'chzyhv mrmh 'chzyh
verses.translation: And Joram turned his hands, and fled, and said to Ahaziah, There is treachery, O Ahaziah.

verses.original: וְ/יֵה֞וּא מִלֵּ֧א יָד֣/וֹ בַ/קֶּ֗שֶׁת וַ/יַּ֤ךְ אֶת יְהוֹרָם֙ בֵּ֣ין זְרֹעָ֔י/ו וַ/יֵּצֵ֥א הַ/חֵ֖צִי מִ/לִּבּ֑/וֹ וַ/יִּכְרַ֖ע בְּ/רִכְבּֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: vyhv' ml' ydv bqsht vykh 't yhvrm byn zr'yv vyts' hchtsy mlbv vykhr' brkhbv
verses.translation: And Jehu drew a bow with his full strength, and smote Jehoram between his arms, and the arrow went out at his heart, and he sunk down in his chariot.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֗אמֶר אֶל בִּדְקַר֙ שלשה שָֽׁלִשׁ֔/וֹ שָׂ֚א הַשְׁלִכֵ֔/הוּ בְּ/חֶלְקַ֕ת שְׂדֵ֖ה נָב֣וֹת הַ/יִּזְרְעֵאלִ֑י כִּֽי זְכֹ֞ר אֲנִ֣י וָ/אַ֗תָּה אֵ֣ת רֹכְבִ֤ים צְמָדִים֙ אַֽחֲרֵי֙ אַחְאָ֣ב אָבִ֔י/ו וַֽ/יהוָה֙ נָשָׂ֣א עָלָ֔י/ו אֶת הַ/מַּשָּׂ֖א הַ/זֶּֽה
verses.translit: vy'mr 'l bdqr shlshh shlshv sh' hshlkhhv bchlqt shdh nbvt hyzr''ly khy zkhr 'ny v'th 't rkhbym tsmdym 'chry 'ch'b 'byv vyhvh nsh' 'lyv 't hmsh' hzh
verses.translation: Then said Jehu to Bidkar his captain, Take up, and cast him in the portion of the field of Naboth the Jezreelite: for remember how that, when I and thou rode together after Ahab his father, the LORD laid this burden upon him;

verses.original: אִם לֹ֡א אֶת דְּמֵ֣י נָבוֹת֩ וְ/אֶת דְּמֵ֨י בָנָ֜י/ו רָאִ֤יתִי אֶ֨מֶשׁ֙ נְאֻם יְהוָ֔ה וְ/שִׁלַּמְתִּ֥י לְ/ךָ֛ בַּ/חֶלְקָ֥ה הַ/זֹּ֖את נְאֻם יְהוָ֑ה וְ/עַתָּ֗ה שָׂ֧א הַשְׁלִכֵ֛/הוּ בַּ/חֶלְקָ֖ה כִּ/דְבַ֥ר יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: 'm l' 't dmy nbvt v't dmy bnyv r'yty 'msh n'm yhvh vshlmty lkh bchlqh hz't n'm yhvh v'th sh' hshlkhhv bchlqh khdbr yhvh
verses.translation: Surely I have seen yesterday the blood of Naboth, and the blood of his sons, saith the LORD ; and I will requite thee in this plat, saith the LORD . Now therefore take and cast him into the plat of ground , according to the word of the LORD .

verses.original: וַ/אֲחַזְיָ֤ה מֶֽלֶךְ יְהוּדָה֙ רָאָ֔ה וַ/יָּ֕נָס דֶּ֖רֶךְ בֵּ֣ית הַגָּ֑ן וַ/יִּרְדֹּ֨ף אַחֲרָ֜י/ו יֵה֗וּא וַ֠/יֹּאמֶר גַּם אֹת֞/וֹ הַכֻּ֣/הוּ אֶל הַ/מֶּרְכָּבָ֗ה בְּ/מַֽעֲלֵה גוּר֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר אֶֽת יִבְלְעָ֔ם וַ/יָּ֥נָס מְגִדּ֖וֹ וַ/יָּ֥מָת שָֽׁם
verses.translit: v'chzyh mlkh yhvdh r'h vyns drkh byt hgn vyrdf 'chryv yhv' vy'mr gm 'tv hkhhv 'l hmrkhbh bm'lh gvr 'shr 't ybl'm vyns mgdv vymt shm
verses.translation: But when Ahaziah the king of Judah saw this , he fled by the way of the garden house. And Jehu followed after him, and said, Smite him also in the chariot. And they did so at the going up to Gur, which is by Ibleam. And he fled to Megiddo, and died there.

verses.original: וַ/יַּרְכִּ֧בוּ אֹת֛/וֹ עֲבָדָ֖י/ו יְרוּשָׁלְָ֑מָ/ה וַ/יִּקְבְּר֨וּ אֹת֧/וֹ בִ/קְבֻרָת֛/וֹ עִם אֲבֹתָ֖י/ו בְּ/עִ֥יר דָּוִֽד
verses.translit: vyrkhbv 'tv 'bdyv yrvshlmh vyqbrv 'tv bqbrtv 'm 'btyv b'yr dvd
verses.translation: And his servants carried him in a chariot to Jerusalem, and buried him in his sepulchre with his fathers in the city of David.

verses.original: וּ/בִ/שְׁנַת֙ אַחַ֣ת עֶשְׂרֵ֣ה שָׁנָ֔ה לְ/יוֹרָ֖ם בֶּן אַחְאָ֑ב מָלַ֥ךְ אֲחַזְיָ֖ה עַל יְהוּדָֽה
verses.translit: vbshnt 'cht 'shrh shnh lyvrm bn 'ch'b mlkh 'chzyh 'l yhvdh
verses.translation: And in the eleventh year of Joram the son of Ahab began Ahaziah to reign over Judah.

verses.original: וַ/יָּב֥וֹא יֵה֖וּא יִזְרְעֶ֑אלָ/ה וְ/אִיזֶ֣בֶל שָׁמְעָ֗ה וַ/תָּ֨שֶׂם בַּ/פּ֤וּךְ עֵינֶ֨י/הָ֙ וַ/תֵּ֣יטֶב אֶת רֹאשָׁ֔/הּ וַ/תַּשְׁקֵ֖ף בְּעַ֥ד הַ/חַלּֽוֹן
verses.translit: vybv' yhv' yzr''lh v'yzbl shm'h vtshm bpvkh 'ynyh vtytb 't r'shh vtshqf b'd hchlvn
verses.translation: And when Jehu was come to Jezreel, Jezebel heard of it; and she painted her face, and tired her head, and looked out at a window.

verses.original: וְ/יֵה֖וּא בָּ֣א בַ/שָּׁ֑עַר וַ/תֹּ֣אמֶר הֲ/שָׁל֔וֹם זִמְרִ֖י הֹרֵ֥ג אֲדֹנָֽי/ו
verses.translit: vyhv' b' bsh'r vt'mr hshlvm zmry hrg 'dnyv
verses.translation: And as Jehu entered in at the gate, she said, Had Zimri peace, who slew his master?

verses.original: וַ/יִּשָּׂ֤א פָנָי/ו֙ אֶל הַ֣/חַלּ֔וֹן וַ/יֹּ֕אמֶר מִ֥י אִתִּ֖/י מִ֑י וַ/יַּשְׁקִ֣יפוּ אֵלָ֔י/ו שְׁנַ֥יִם שְׁלֹשָׁ֖ה סָרִיסִֽים
verses.translit: vysh' pnyv 'l hchlvn vy'mr my 'ty my vyshqypv 'lyv shnym shlshh srysym
verses.translation: And he lifted up his face to the window, and said, Who is on my side? who? And there looked out to him two or three eunuchs.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֥אמֶר שמט/הו שִׁמְט֖וּ/הָ וַֽ/יִּשְׁמְט֑וּ/הָ וַ/יִּ֨ז מִ/דָּמָ֧/הּ אֶל הַ/קִּ֛יר וְ/אֶל הַ/סּוּסִ֖ים וַֽ/יִּרְמְסֶֽ/נָּה
verses.translit: vy'mr shmthv shmtvh vyshmtvh vyz mdmh 'l hqyr v'l hsvsym vyrmsnh
verses.translation: And he said, Throw her down. So they threw her down: and some of her blood was sprinkled on the wall, and on the horses: and he trode her under foot.

verses.original: וַ/יָּבֹ֖א וַ/יֹּ֣אכַל וַ/יֵּ֑שְׁתְּ וַ/יֹּ֗אמֶר פִּקְדוּ נָ֞א אֶת הָ/אֲרוּרָ֤ה הַ/זֹּאת֙ וְ/קִבְר֔וּ/הָ כִּ֥י בַת מֶ֖לֶךְ הִֽיא
verses.translit: vyb' vy'khl vysht vy'mr pqdv n' 't h'rvrh hz't vqbrvh khy bt mlkh hy'
verses.translation: And when he was come in, he did eat and drink, and said, Go, see now this cursed woman , and bury her: for she is a king’s daughter.

verses.original: וַ/יֵּלְכ֖וּ לְ/קָבְרָ֑/הּ וְ/לֹא מָ֣צְאוּ בָ֗/הּ כִּ֧י אִם הַ/גֻּלְגֹּ֛לֶת וְ/הָ/רַגְלַ֖יִם וְ/כַפּ֥וֹת הַ/יָּדָֽיִם
verses.translit: vylkhv lqbrh vl' mts'v bh khy 'm hglglt vhrglym vkhpvt hydym
verses.translation: And they went to bury her: but they found no more of her than the skull, and the feet, and the palms of her hands.

verses.original: וַ/יָּשֻׁבוּ֮ וַ/יַּגִּ֣ידוּ ל/וֹ֒ וַ/יֹּ֨אמֶר֙ דְּבַר יְהוָ֣ה ה֔וּא אֲשֶׁ֣ר דִּבֶּ֗ר בְּ/יַד עַבְדּ֛/וֹ אֵלִיָּ֥הוּ הַ/תִּשְׁבִּ֖י לֵ/אמֹ֑ר בְּ/חֵ֣לֶק יִזְרְעֶ֔אל יֹאכְל֥וּ הַ/כְּלָבִ֖ים אֶת בְּשַׂ֥ר אִיזָֽבֶל
verses.translit: vyshbv vygydv lv vy'mr dbr yhvh hv' 'shr dbr byd 'bdv 'lyhv htshby l'mr bchlq yzr''l y'khlv hkhlbym 't bshr 'yzbl
verses.translation: Wherefore they came again, and told him. And he said, This is the word of the LORD , which he spake by his servant Elijah the Tishbite, saying, In the portion of Jezreel shall dogs eat the flesh of Jezebel:

verses.original: ו/הית וְֽ/הָיְתָ֞ה נִבְלַ֣ת אִיזֶ֗בֶל כְּ/דֹ֛מֶן עַל פְּנֵ֥י הַ/שָּׂדֶ֖ה בְּ/חֵ֣לֶק יִזְרְעֶ֑אל אֲשֶׁ֥ר לֹֽא יֹאמְר֖וּ זֹ֥את אִיזָֽבֶל
verses.translit: vhyt vhyth nblt 'yzbl khdmn 'l pny hshdh bchlq yzr''l 'shr l' y'mrv z't 'yzbl
verses.translation: And the carcase of Jezebel shall be as dung upon the face of the field in the portion of Jezreel; so that they shall not say, This is Jezebel.

verses.original: וּ/לְ/אַחְאָ֛ב שִׁבְעִ֥ים בָּנִ֖ים בְּ/שֹׁמְר֑וֹן וַ/יִּכְתֹּב֩ יֵה֨וּא סְפָרִ֜ים וַ/יִּשְׁלַ֣ח שֹׁמְר֗וֹן אֶל שָׂרֵ֤י יִזְרְעֶאל֙ הַ/זְּקֵנִ֔ים וְ/אֶל הָ/אֹמְנִ֥ים אַחְאָ֖ב לֵ/אמֹֽר
verses.translit: vl'ch'b shb'ym bnym bshmrvn vykhtb yhv' sprym vyshlch shmrvn 'l shry yzr''l hzqnym v'l h'mnym 'ch'b l'mr
verses.translation: And Ahab had seventy sons in Samaria. And Jehu wrote letters, and sent to Samaria, unto the rulers of Jezreel, to the elders, and to them that brought up Ahab’s children , saying,

verses.original: וְ/עַתָּ֗ה כְּ/בֹ֨א הַ/סֵּ֤פֶר הַ/זֶּה֙ אֲלֵי/כֶ֔ם וְ/אִתְּ/כֶ֖ם בְּנֵ֣י אֲדֹנֵי/כֶ֑ם וְ/אִתְּ/כֶם֙ הָ/רֶ֣כֶב וְ/הַ/סּוּסִ֔ים וְ/עִ֥יר מִבְצָ֖ר וְ/הַ/נָּֽשֶׁק
verses.translit: v'th khb' hspr hzh 'lykhm v'tkhm bny 'dnykhm v'tkhm hrkhb vhsvsym v'yr mbtsr vhnshq
verses.translation: Now as soon as this letter cometh to you, seeing your master’s sons are with you, and there are with you chariots and horses, a fenced city also, and armour;

verses.original: וּ/רְאִיתֶ֞ם הַ/טּ֤וֹב וְ/הַ/יָּשָׁר֙ מִ/בְּנֵ֣י אֲדֹנֵי/כֶ֔ם וְ/שַׂמְתֶּ֖ם עַל כִּסֵּ֣א אָבִ֑י/ו וְ/הִֽלָּחֲמ֖וּ עַל בֵּ֥ית אֲדֹנֵי/כֶֽם
verses.translit: vr'ytm htvb vhyshr mbny 'dnykhm vshmtm 'l khs' 'byv vhlchmv 'l byt 'dnykhm
verses.translation: Look even out the best and meetest of your master’s sons, and set him on his father’s throne, and fight for your master’s house.

verses.original: וַ/יִּֽרְאוּ֙ מְאֹ֣ד מְאֹ֔ד וַ/יֹּ֣אמְר֔וּ הִנֵּה֙ שְׁנֵ֣י הַ/מְּלָכִ֔ים לֹ֥א עָמְד֖וּ לְ/פָנָ֑י/ו וְ/אֵ֖יךְ נַעֲמֹ֥ד אֲנָֽחְנוּ
verses.translit: vyr'v m'd m'd vy'mrv hnh shny hmlkhym l' 'mdv lpnyv v'ykh n'md 'nchnv
verses.translation: But they were exceedingly afraid, and said, Behold, two kings stood not before him: how then shall we stand?

verses.original: וַ/יִּשְׁלַ֣ח אֲשֶׁר עַל הַ/בַּ֣יִת וַ/אֲשֶׁ֪ר עַל הָ/עִ֟יר וְ/הַ/זְּקֵנִים֩ וְ/הָ/אֹמְנִ֨ים אֶל יֵה֤וּא לֵ/אמֹר֙ עֲבָדֶ֣י/ךָ אֲנַ֔חְנוּ וְ/כֹ֛ל אֲשֶׁר תֹּאמַ֥ר אֵלֵ֖י/נוּ נַעֲשֶׂ֑ה לֹֽא נַמְלִ֣יךְ אִ֔ישׁ הַ/טּ֥וֹב בְּ/עֵינֶ֖י/ךָ עֲשֵֽׂה
verses.translit: vyshlch 'shr 'l hbyt v'shr 'l h'yr vhzqnym vh'mnym 'l yhv' l'mr 'bdykh 'nchnv vkhl 'shr t'mr 'lynv n'shh l' nmlykh 'ysh htvb b'ynykh 'shh
verses.translation: And he that was over the house, and he that was over the city, the elders also, and the bringers up of the children , sent to Jehu, saying, We are thy servants, and will do all that thou shalt bid us; we will not make any king: do thou that which is good in thine eyes.

verses.original: וַ/יִּכְתֹּ֣ב אֲלֵי/הֶם֩ סֵ֨פֶר שֵׁנִ֜ית לֵ/אמֹ֗ר אִם לִ֨/י אַתֶּ֜ם וּ/לְ/קֹלִ֣/י אַתֶּ֣ם שֹׁמְעִ֗ים קְחוּ֙ אֶת רָאשֵׁי֙ אַנְשֵׁ֣י בְנֵֽי אֲדֹנֵי/כֶ֔ם וּ/בֹ֧אוּ אֵלַ֛/י כָּ/עֵ֥ת מָחָ֖ר יִזְרְעֶ֑אלָ/ה וּ/בְנֵ֤י הַ/מֶּ֨לֶךְ֙ שִׁבְעִ֣ים אִ֔ישׁ אֶת גְּדֹלֵ֥י הָ/עִ֖יר מְגַדְּלִ֥ים אוֹתָֽ/ם
verses.translit: vykhtb 'lyhm spr shnyt l'mr 'm ly 'tm vlqly 'tm shm'ym qchv 't r'shy 'nshy bny 'dnykhm vb'v 'ly kh't mchr yzr''lh vbny hmlkh shb'ym 'ysh 't gdly h'yr mgdlym 'vtm
verses.translation: Then he wrote a letter the second time to them, saying, If ye be mine, and if ye will hearken unto my voice, take ye the heads of the men your master’s sons, and come to me to Jezreel by to morrow this time. Now the king’s sons, being seventy persons, were with the great men of the city, which brought them up.

verses.original: וַ/יְהִ֗י כְּ/בֹ֤א הַ/סֵּ֨פֶר֙ אֲלֵי/הֶ֔ם וַ/יִּקְחוּ֙ אֶת בְּנֵ֣י הַ/מֶּ֔לֶךְ וַֽ/יִּשְׁחֲט֖וּ שִׁבְעִ֣ים אִ֑ישׁ וַ/יָּשִׂ֤ימוּ אֶת רָֽאשֵׁי/הֶם֙ בַּ/דּוּדִ֔ים וַ/יִּשְׁלְח֥וּ אֵלָ֖י/ו יִזְרְעֶֽאלָ/ה
verses.translit: vyhy khb' hspr 'lyhm vyqchv 't bny hmlkh vyshchtv shb'ym 'ysh vyshymv 't r'shyhm bdvdym vyshlchv 'lyv yzr''lh
verses.translation: And it came to pass, when the letter came to them, that they took the king’s sons, and slew seventy persons, and put their heads in baskets, and sent him them to Jezreel.

verses.original: וַ/יָּבֹ֤א הַ/מַּלְאָךְ֙ וַ/יַּגֶּד ל֣/וֹ לֵ/אמֹ֔ר הֵבִ֖יאוּ רָאשֵׁ֣י בְנֵֽי הַ/מֶּ֑לֶךְ וַ/יֹּ֗אמֶר שִׂ֣ימוּ אֹתָ֞/ם שְׁנֵ֧י צִבֻּרִ֛ים פֶּ֥תַח הַ/שַּׁ֖עַר עַד הַ/בֹּֽקֶר
verses.translit: vyb' hml'kh vygd lv l'mr hby'v r'shy bny hmlkh vy'mr shymv 'tm shny tsbrym ptch hsh'r 'd hbqr
verses.translation: And there came a messenger, and told him, saying, They have brought the heads of the king’s sons. And he said, Lay ye them in two heaps at the entering in of the gate until the morning.

verses.original: וַ/יְהִ֤י בַ/בֹּ֨קֶר֙ וַ/יֵּצֵ֣א וַֽ/יַּעֲמֹ֔ד וַ/יֹּ֨אמֶר֙ אֶל כָּל הָ/עָ֔ם צַדִּקִ֖ים אַתֶּ֑ם הִנֵּ֨ה אֲנִ֜י קָשַׁ֤רְתִּי עַל אֲדֹנִ/י֙ וָ/אֶהְרְגֵ֔/הוּ וּ/מִ֥י הִכָּ֖ה אֶת כָּל אֵֽלֶּה
verses.translit: vyhy bbqr vyts' vy'md vy'mr 'l khl h'm tsdqym 'tm hnh 'ny qshrty 'l 'dny v'hrghv vmy hkhh 't khl 'lh
verses.translation: And it came to pass in the morning, that he went out, and stood, and said to all the people, Ye be righteous: behold, I conspired against my master, and slew him: but who slew all these?

verses.original: דְּע֣וּ אֵפ֗וֹא כִּי֩ לֹ֨א יִפֹּ֜ל מִ/דְּבַ֤ר יְהוָה֙ אַ֔רְצָ/ה אֲשֶׁר דִּבֶּ֥ר יְהוָ֖ה עַל בֵּ֣ית אַחְאָ֑ב וַ/יהוָ֣ה עָשָׂ֔ה אֵ֚ת אֲשֶׁ֣ר דִּבֶּ֔ר בְּ/יַ֖ד עַבְדּ֥/וֹ אֵלִיָּֽהוּ
verses.translit: d'v 'pv' khy l' ypl mdbr yhvh 'rtsh 'shr dbr yhvh 'l byt 'ch'b vyhvh 'shh 't 'shr dbr byd 'bdv 'lyhv
verses.translation: Know now that there shall fall unto the earth nothing of the word of the LORD , which the LORD spake concerning the house of Ahab: for the LORD hath done that which he spake by his servant Elijah.

verses.original: וַ/יַּ֣ךְ יֵה֗וּא אֵ֣ת כָּל הַ/נִּשְׁאָרִ֤ים לְ/בֵית אַחְאָב֙ בְּ/יִזְרְעֶ֔אל וְ/כָל גְּדֹלָ֖י/ו וּ/מְיֻדָּעָ֣י/ו וְ/כֹהֲנָ֑י/ו עַד בִּלְתִּ֥י הִשְׁאִֽיר ל֖/וֹ שָׂרִֽיד
verses.translit: vykh yhv' 't khl hnsh'rym lbyt 'ch'b byzr''l vkhl gdlyv vmyd'yv vkhhnyv 'd blty hsh'yr lv shryd
verses.translation: So Jehu slew all that remained of the house of Ahab in Jezreel, and all his great men, and his kinsfolks, and his priests, until he left him none remaining.

verses.original: וַ/יָּ֨קָם֙ וַ/יָּבֹ֔א וַ/יֵּ֖לֶךְ שֹׁמְר֑וֹן ה֛וּא בֵּֽית עֵ֥קֶד הָרֹעִ֖ים בַּ/דָּֽרֶךְ
verses.translit: vyqm vyb' vylkh shmrvn hv' byt 'qd hr'ym bdrkh
verses.translation: And he arose and departed, and came to Samaria. And as he was at the shearing house in the way,

verses.original: וְ/יֵה֗וּא מָצָא֙ אֶת אֲחֵי֙ אֲחַזְיָ֣הוּ מֶֽלֶךְ יְהוּדָ֔ה וַ/יֹּ֖אמֶר מִ֣י אַתֶּ֑ם וַ/יֹּאמְר֗וּ אֲחֵ֤י אֲחַזְיָ֨הוּ֙ אֲנַ֔חְנוּ וַ/נֵּ֛רֶד לִ/שְׁל֥וֹם בְּנֵֽי הַ/מֶּ֖לֶךְ וּ/בְנֵ֥י הַ/גְּבִירָֽה
verses.translit: vyhv' mts' 't 'chy 'chzyhv mlkh yhvdh vy'mr my 'tm vy'mrv 'chy 'chzyhv 'nchnv vnrd lshlvm bny hmlkh vbny hgbyrh
verses.translation: Jehu met with the brethren of Ahaziah king of Judah, and said, Who are ye? And they answered, We are the brethren of Ahaziah; and we go down to salute the children of the king and the children of the queen.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֨אמֶר֙ תִּפְשׂ֣וּ/ם חַיִּ֔ים וַֽ/יִּתְפְּשׂ֖וּ/ם חַיִּ֑ים וַֽ/יִּשְׁחָט֞וּ/ם אֶל בּ֣וֹר בֵּֽית עֵ֗קֶד אַרְבָּעִ֤ים וּ/שְׁנַ֨יִם֙ אִ֔ישׁ וְ/לֹֽא הִשְׁאִ֥יר אִ֖ישׁ מֵ/הֶֽם
verses.translit: vy'mr tpshvm chyym vytpshvm chyym vyshchtvm 'l bvr byt 'qd 'rb'ym vshnym 'ysh vl' hsh'yr 'ysh mhm
verses.translation: And he said, Take them alive. And they took them alive, and slew them at the pit of the shearing house, even two and forty men; neither left he any of them.

verses.original: וַ/יֵּ֣לֶךְ מִ/שָּׁ֡ם וַ/יִּמְצָ֣א אֶת יְהוֹנָדָב֩ בֶּן רֵכָ֨ב לִ/קְרָאת֜/וֹ וַֽ/יְבָרְכֵ֗/הוּ וַ/יֹּ֨אמֶר אֵלָ֜י/ו הֲ/יֵ֧שׁ אֶת לְבָבְ/ךָ֣ יָשָׁ֗ר כַּ/אֲשֶׁ֤ר לְבָבִ/י֙ עִם לְבָבֶ֔/ךָ וַ/יֹּ֨אמֶר יְהוֹנָדָ֥ב יֵ֛שׁ וָ/יֵ֖שׁ תְּנָ֣/ה אֶת יָדֶ֑/ךָ וַ/יִּתֵּ֣ן יָד֔/וֹ וַ/יַּעֲלֵ֥/הוּ אֵלָ֖י/ו אֶל הַ/מֶּרְכָּבָֽה
verses.translit: vylkh mshm vymts' 't yhvndb bn rkhb lqr'tv vybrkhhv vy'mr 'lyv hysh 't lbbkh yshr kh'shr lbby 'm lbbkh vy'mr yhvndb ysh vysh tnh 't ydkh vytn ydv vy'lhv 'lyv 'l hmrkhbh
verses.translation: And when he was departed thence, he lighted on Jehonadab the son of Rechab coming to meet him: and he saluted him, and said to him, Is thine heart right, as my heart is with thy heart? And Jehonadab answered, It is. If it be, give me thine hand. And he gave him his hand; and he took him up to him into the chariot.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֨אמֶר֙ לְכָ֣/ה אִתִּ֔/י וּ/רְאֵ֖ה בְּ/קִנְאָתִ֣/י לַ/יהוָ֑ה וַ/יַּרְכִּ֥בוּ אֹת֖/וֹ בְּ/רִכְבּֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: vy'mr lkhh 'ty vr'h bqn'ty lyhvh vyrkhbv 'tv brkhbv
verses.translation: And he said, Come with me, and see my zeal for the LORD . So they made him ride in his chariot.

verses.original: וַ/יָּבֹא֙ שֹֽׁמְר֔וֹן וַ֠/יַּךְ אֶת כָּל הַ/נִּשְׁאָרִ֧ים לְ/אַחְאָ֛ב בְּ/שֹׁמְר֖וֹן עַד הִשְׁמִיד֑/וֹ כִּ/דְבַ֣ר יְהוָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר דִּבֶּ֖ר אֶל אֵלִיָּֽהוּ
verses.translit: vyb' shmrvn vykh 't khl hnsh'rym l'ch'b bshmrvn 'd hshmydv khdbr yhvh 'shr dbr 'l 'lyhv
verses.translation: And when he came to Samaria, he slew all that remained unto Ahab in Samaria, till he had destroyed him, according to the saying of the LORD , which he spake to Elijah.

verses.original: וַ/יִּקְבֹּ֤ץ יֵהוּא֙ אֶת כָּל הָ/עָ֔ם וַ/יֹּ֣אמֶר אֲלֵ/הֶ֔ם אַחְאָ֕ב עָבַ֥ד אֶת הַ/בַּ֖עַל מְעָ֑ט יֵה֖וּא יַעַבְדֶ֥/נּוּ הַרְבֵּֽה
verses.translit: vyqbts yhv' 't khl h'm vy'mr 'lhm 'ch'b 'bd 't hb'l m't yhv' y'bdnv hrbh
verses.translation: And Jehu gathered all the people together, and said unto them, Ahab served Baal a little; but Jehu shall serve him much.

verses.original: וְ/עַתָּ֣ה כָל נְבִיאֵ֣י הַ/בַּ֡עַל כָּל עֹבְדָ֣י/ו וְ/כָל כֹּהֲנָי/ו֩ קִרְא֨וּ אֵלַ֜/י אִ֣ישׁ אַל יִפָּקֵ֗ד כִּי֩ זֶ֨בַח גָּד֥וֹל לִ/י֙ לַ/בַּ֔עַל כֹּ֥ל אֲשֶׁר יִפָּקֵ֖ד לֹ֣א יִֽחְיֶ֑ה וְ/יֵהוּא֙ עָשָׂ֣ה בְ/עָקְבָּ֔ה לְמַ֥עַן הַאֲבִ֖יד אֶת עֹבְדֵ֥י הַ/בָּֽעַל
verses.translit: v'th khl nby'y hb'l khl 'bdyv vkhl khhnyv qr'v 'ly 'ysh 'l ypqd khy zbch gdvl ly lb'l khl 'shr ypqd l' ychyh vyhv' 'shh b'qbh lm'n h'byd 't 'bdy hb'l
verses.translation: Now therefore call unto me all the prophets of Baal, all his servants, and all his priests; let none be wanting: for I have a great sacrifice to do to Baal; whosoever shall be wanting, he shall not live. But Jehu did it in subtilty, to the intent that he might destroy the worshippers of Baal.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֣אמֶר יֵה֗וּא קַדְּשׁ֧וּ עֲצָרָ֛ה לַ/בַּ֖עַל וַ/יִּקְרָֽאוּ
verses.translit: vy'mr yhv' qdshv 'tsrh lb'l vyqr'v
verses.translation: And Jehu said, Proclaim a solemn assembly for Baal. And they proclaimed it .

verses.original: וַ/יִּשְׁלַ֤ח יֵהוּא֙ בְּ/כָל יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל וַ/יָּבֹ֨אוּ֙ כָּל עֹבְדֵ֣י הַ/בַּ֔עַל וְ/לֹֽא נִשְׁאַ֥ר אִ֖ישׁ אֲשֶׁ֣ר לֹֽא בָ֑א וַ/יָּבֹ֨אוּ֙ בֵּ֣ית הַ/בַּ֔עַל וַ/יִּמָּלֵ֥א בֵית הַ/בַּ֖עַל פֶּ֥ה לָ/פֶֽה
verses.translit: vyshlch yhv' bkhl yshr'l vyb'v khl 'bdy hb'l vl' nsh'r 'ysh 'shr l' b' vyb'v byt hb'l vyml' byt hb'l ph lph
verses.translation: And Jehu sent through all Israel: and all the worshippers of Baal came, so that there was not a man left that came not. And they came into the house of Baal; and the house of Baal was full from one end to another.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֗אמֶר לַֽ/אֲשֶׁר֙ עַל הַ/מֶּלְתָּחָ֔ה הוֹצֵ֣א לְב֔וּשׁ לְ/כֹ֖ל עֹבְדֵ֣י הַ/בָּ֑עַל וַ/יֹּצֵ֥א לָ/הֶ֖ם הַ/מַּלְבּֽוּשׁ
verses.translit: vy'mr l'shr 'l hmltchh hvts' lbvsh lkhl 'bdy hb'l vyts' lhm hmlbvsh
verses.translation: And he said unto him that was over the vestry, Bring forth vestments for all the worshippers of Baal. And he brought them forth vestments.

verses.original: וַ/יָּבֹ֥א יֵה֛וּא וִ/יהוֹנָדָ֥ב בֶּן רֵכָ֖ב בֵּ֣ית הַ/בָּ֑עַל וַ/יֹּ֜אמֶר לְ/עֹבְדֵ֣י הַ/בַּ֗עַל חַפְּשׂ֤וּ וּ/רְאוּ֙ פֶּן יֶשׁ פֹּ֤ה עִמָּ/כֶם֙ מֵ/עַבְדֵ֣י יְהוָ֔ה כִּ֛י אִם עֹבְדֵ֥י הַ/בַּ֖עַל לְ/בַדָּֽ/ם
verses.translit: vyb' yhv' vyhvndb bn rkhb byt hb'l vy'mr l'bdy hb'l chpshv vr'v pn ysh ph 'mkhm m'bdy yhvh khy 'm 'bdy hb'l lbdm
verses.translation: And Jehu went, and Jehonadab the son of Rechab, into the house of Baal, and said unto the worshippers of Baal, Search, and look that there be here with you none of the servants of the LORD , but the worshippers of Baal only.

verses.original: וַ/יָּבֹ֕אוּ לַ/עֲשׂ֖וֹת זְבָחִ֣ים וְ/עֹל֑וֹת וְ/יֵה֞וּא שָׂם ל֤/וֹ בַ/חוּץ֙ שְׁמֹנִ֣ים אִ֔ישׁ וַ/יֹּ֗אמֶר הָ/אִ֤ישׁ אֲשֶׁר יִמָּלֵט֙ מִן הָ/אֲנָשִׁ֗ים אֲשֶׁ֤ר אֲנִי֙ מֵבִ֣יא עַל יְדֵי/כֶ֔ם נַפְשׁ֖/וֹ תַּ֥חַת נַפְשֽׁ/וֹ
verses.translit: vyb'v l'shvt zbchym v'lvt vyhv' shm lv bchvts shmnym 'ysh vy'mr h'ysh 'shr ymlt mn h'nshym 'shr 'ny mby' 'l ydykhm npshv tcht npshv
verses.translation: And when they went in to offer sacrifices and burnt offerings, Jehu appointed fourscore men without, and said, If any of the men whom I have brought into your hands escape, he that letteth him go , his life shall be for the life of him.

verses.original: וַ/יְהִ֞י כְּ/כַלֹּת֣/וֹ לַ/עֲשׂ֣וֹת הָ/עֹלָ֗ה וַ/יֹּ֣אמֶר יֵ֠הוּא לָ/רָצִ֨ים וְ/לַ/שָּׁלִשִׁ֜ים בֹּ֤אוּ הַכּוּ/ם֙ אִ֣ישׁ אַל יֵצֵ֔א וַ/יַּכּ֖וּ/ם לְ/פִי חָ֑רֶב וַ/יַּשְׁלִ֗כוּ הָֽ/רָצִים֙ וְ/הַ/שָּׁ֣לִשִׁ֔ים וַ/יֵּלְכ֖וּ עַד עִ֥יר בֵּית הַ/בָּֽעַל
verses.translit: vyhy khkhltv l'shvt h'lh vy'mr yhv' lrtsym vlshlshym b'v hkhvm 'ysh 'l yts' vykhvm lpy chrb vyshlkhv hrtsym vhshlshym vylkhv 'd 'yr byt hb'l
verses.translation: And it came to pass, as soon as he had made an end of offering the burnt offering, that Jehu said to the guard and to the captains, Go in, and slay them; let none come forth. And they smote them with the edge of the sword; and the guard and the captains cast them out, and went to the city of the house of Baal.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּצִ֛אוּ אֶת מַצְּב֥וֹת בֵּית הַ/בַּ֖עַל וַֽ/יִּשְׂרְפֽוּ/הָ
verses.translit: vyts'v 't mtsbvt byt hb'l vyshrpvh
verses.translation: And they brought forth the images out of the house of Baal, and burned them.

verses.original: וַֽ/יִּתְּצ֔וּ אֵ֖ת מַצְּבַ֣ת הַ/בָּ֑עַל וַֽ/יִּתְּצוּ֙ אֶת בֵּ֣ית הַ/בַּ֔עַל וַ/יְשִׂמֻ֥/הוּ ל/מחראות לְ/מֽוֹצָא֖וֹת עַד הַ/יּֽוֹם
verses.translit: vyttsv 't mtsbt hb'l vyttsv 't byt hb'l vyshmhv lmchr'vt lmvts'vt 'd hyvm
verses.translation: And they brake down the image of Baal, and brake down the house of Baal, and made it a draught house unto this day.

verses.original: וַ/יַּשְׁמֵ֥ד יֵה֛וּא אֶת הַ/בַּ֖עַל מִ/יִּשְׂרָאֵֽל
verses.translit: vyshmd yhv' 't hb'l myshr'l
verses.translation: Thus Jehu destroyed Baal out of Israel.

verses.original: רַ֠ק חֲטָאֵ֞י יָרָבְעָ֤ם בֶּן נְבָט֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר הֶחֱטִ֣יא אֶת יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל לֹֽא סָ֥ר יֵה֖וּא מֵ/אַֽחֲרֵי/הֶ֑ם עֶגְלֵי֙ הַ/זָּהָ֔ב אֲשֶׁ֥ר בֵּֽית אֵ֖ל וַ/אֲשֶׁ֥ר בְּ/דָֽן
verses.translit: rq cht'y yrb'm bn nbt 'shr hchty' 't yshr'l l' sr yhv' m'chryhm 'gly hzhb 'shr byt 'l v'shr bdn
verses.translation: Howbeit from the sins of Jeroboam the son of Nebat, who made Israel to sin, Jehu departed not from after them, to wit , the golden calves that were in Beth-el, and that were in Dan.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֨אמֶר יְהוָ֜ה אֶל יֵה֗וּא יַ֤עַן אֲשֶׁר הֱטִיבֹ֨תָ֙ לַ/עֲשׂ֤וֹת הַ/יָּשָׁר֙ בְּ/עֵינַ֔/י כְּ/כֹל֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר בִּ/לְבָבִ֔/י עָשִׂ֖יתָ לְ/בֵ֣ית אַחְאָ֑ב בְּנֵ֣י רְבִעִ֔ים יֵשְׁב֥וּ לְ/ךָ֖ עַל כִּסֵּ֥א יִשְׂרָאֵֽל
verses.translit: vy'mr yhvh 'l yhv' y'n 'shr htybt l'shvt hyshr b'yny khkhl 'shr blbby 'shyt lbyt 'ch'b bny rb'ym yshbv lkh 'l khs' yshr'l
verses.translation: And the LORD said unto Jehu, Because thou hast done well in executing that which is right in mine eyes, and hast done unto the house of Ahab according to all that was in mine heart, thy children of the fourth generation shall sit on the throne of Israel.

verses.original: וְ/יֵה֗וּא לֹ֥א שָׁמַ֛ר לָ/לֶ֛כֶת בְּ/תֽוֹרַת יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֵֽי יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל בְּ/כָל לְבָב֑/וֹ לֹ֣א סָ֗ר מֵ/עַל֙ חַטֹּ֣אות יָֽרָבְעָ֔ם אֲשֶׁ֥ר הֶחֱטִ֖יא אֶת יִשְׂרָאֵֽל
verses.translit: vyhv' l' shmr llkht btvrt yhvh 'lhy yshr'l bkhl lbbv l' sr m'l cht'vt yrb'm 'shr hchty' 't yshr'l
verses.translation: But Jehu took no heed to walk in the law of the LORD God of Israel with all his heart: for he departed not from the sins of Jeroboam, which made Israel to sin.

verses.original: בַּ/יָּמִ֣ים הָ/הֵ֔ם הֵחֵ֣ל יְהוָ֔ה לְ/קַצּ֖וֹת בְּ/יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וַ/יַּכֵּ֥/ם חֲזָאֵ֖ל בְּ/כָל גְּב֥וּל יִשְׂרָאֵֽל
verses.translit: bymym hhm hchl yhvh lqtsvt byshr'l vykhm chz'l bkhl gbvl yshr'l
verses.translation: In those days the LORD began to cut Israel short: and Hazael smote them in all the coasts of Israel;

verses.original: מִן הַ/יַּרְדֵּן֙ מִזְרַ֣ח הַ/שֶּׁ֔מֶשׁ אֵ֚ת כָּל אֶ֣רֶץ הַ/גִּלְעָ֔ד הַ/גָּדִ֥י וְ/הָ/רֻאובֵנִ֖י וְ/הַֽ/מְנַשִּׁ֑י מֵ/עֲרֹעֵר֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר עַל נַ֣חַל אַרְנֹ֔ן וְ/הַ/גִּלְעָ֖ד וְ/הַ/בָּשָֽׁן
verses.translit: mn hyrdn mzrch hshmsh 't khl 'rts hgl'd hgdy vhr'vbny vhmnshy m'r'r 'shr 'l nchl 'rnn vhgl'd vhbshn
verses.translation: From Jordan eastward, all the land of Gilead, the Gadites, and the Reubenites, and the Manassites, from Aroer, which is by the river Arnon, even Gilead and Bashan.

verses.original: וְ/יֶ֨תֶר דִּבְרֵ֥י יֵה֛וּא וְ/כָל אֲשֶׁ֥ר עָשָׂ֖ה וְ/כָל גְּבוּרָת֑/וֹ הֲ/לֽוֹא הֵ֣ם כְּתוּבִ֗ים עַל סֵ֛פֶר דִּבְרֵ֥י הַ/יָּמִ֖ים לְ/מַלְכֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל
verses.translit: vytr dbry yhv' vkhl 'shr 'shh vkhl gbvrtv hlv' hm khtvbym 'l spr dbry hymym lmlkhy yshr'l
verses.translation: Now the rest of the acts of Jehu, and all that he did, and all his might, are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel?

verses.original: וַ/יִּשְׁכַּ֤ב יֵהוּא֙ עִם אֲבֹתָ֔י/ו וַ/יִּקְבְּר֥וּ אֹת֖/וֹ בְּ/שֹׁמְר֑וֹן וַ/יִּמְלֹ֛ךְ יְהוֹאָחָ֥ז בְּנ֖/וֹ תַּחְתָּֽי/ו
verses.translit: vyshkhb yhv' 'm 'btyv vyqbrv 'tv bshmrvn vymlkh yhv'chz bnv tchtyv
verses.translation: And Jehu slept with his fathers: and they buried him in Samaria. And Jehoahaz his son reigned in his stead.

verses.original: וְ/הַ/יָּמִ֗ים אֲשֶׁ֨ר מָלַ֤ךְ יֵהוּא֙ עַל יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל עֶשְׂרִ֥ים וּ/שְׁמֹנֶֽה שָׁנָ֖ה בְּ/שֹׁמְרֽוֹן
verses.translit: vhymym 'shr mlkh yhv' 'l yshr'l 'shrym vshmnh shnh bshmrvn
verses.translation: And the time that Jehu reigned over Israel in Samaria was twenty and eight years.

verses.original: וַֽ/עֲתַלְיָה֙ אֵ֣ם אֲחַזְיָ֔הוּ ו/ראתה רָאֲתָ֖ה כִּ֣י מֵ֣ת בְּנָ֑/הּ וַ/תָּ֨קָם֙ וַ/תְּאַבֵּ֔ד אֵ֖ת כָּל זֶ֥רַע הַ/מַּמְלָכָֽה
verses.translit: v'tlyh 'm 'chzyhv vr'th r'th khy mt bnh vtqm vt'bd 't khl zr' hmmlkhh
verses.translation: And when Athaliah the mother of Ahaziah saw that her son was dead, she arose and destroyed all the seed royal.

verses.original: וַ/תִּקַּ֣ח יְהוֹשֶׁ֣בַע בַּת הַ/מֶּֽלֶךְ י֠וֹרָם אֲח֨וֹת אֲחַזְיָ֜הוּ אֶת יוֹאָ֣שׁ בֶּן אֲחַזְיָ֗ה וַ/תִּגְנֹ֤ב אֹת/וֹ֙ מִ/תּ֤וֹךְ בְּנֵֽי הַ/מֶּ֨לֶךְ֙ ה/ממותתים הַ/מּ֣וּמָתִ֔ים אֹת֥/וֹ וְ/אֶת מֵינִקְתּ֖/וֹ בַּ/חֲדַ֣ר הַ/מִּטּ֑וֹת וַ/יַּסְתִּ֧רוּ אֹת֛/וֹ מִ/פְּנֵ֥י עֲתַלְיָ֖הוּ וְ/לֹ֥א הוּמָֽת
verses.translit: vtqch yhvshb' bt hmlkh yvrm 'chvt 'chzyhv 't yv'sh bn 'chzyh vtgnb 'tv mtvkh bny hmlkh hmmvttym hmvmtym 'tv v't mynqtv bchdr hmtvt vystrv 'tv mpny 'tlyhv vl' hvmt
verses.translation: But Jehosheba, the daughter of king Joram, sister of Ahaziah, took Joash the son of Ahaziah, and stole him from among the king’s sons which were slain; and they hid him, even him and his nurse, in the bedchamber from Athaliah, so that he was not slain.

verses.original: וַ/יְהִ֤י אִתָּ/הּ֙ בֵּ֣ית יְהוָ֔ה מִתְחַבֵּ֖א שֵׁ֣שׁ שָׁנִ֑ים וַ/עֲתַלְיָ֖ה מֹלֶ֥כֶת עַל הָ/אָֽרֶץ
verses.translit: vyhy 'th byt yhvh mtchb' shsh shnym v'tlyh mlkht 'l h'rts
verses.translation: And he was with her hid in the house of the LORD six years. And Athaliah did reign over the land.

verses.original: וּ/בַ/שָּׁנָ֣ה הַ֠/שְּׁבִיעִית שָׁלַ֨ח יְהוֹיָדָ֜ע וַ/יִּקַּ֣ח אֶת שָׂרֵ֣י ה/מאיות הַ/מֵּא֗וֹת לַ/כָּרִי֙ וְ/לָ֣/רָצִ֔ים וַ/יָּבֵ֥א אֹתָ֛/ם אֵלָ֖י/ו בֵּ֣ית יְהוָ֑ה וַ/יִּכְרֹת֩ לָ/הֶ֨ם בְּרִ֜ית וַ/יַּשְׁבַּ֤ע אֹתָ/ם֙ בְּ/בֵ֣ית יְהוָ֔ה וַ/יַּ֥רְא אֹתָ֖/ם אֶת בֶּן הַ/מֶּֽלֶךְ
verses.translit: vbshnh hshby'yt shlch yhvyd' vyqch 't shry hm'yvt hm'vt lkhry vlrtsym vyb' 'tm 'lyv byt yhvh vykhrt lhm bryt vyshb' 'tm bbyt yhvh vyr' 'tm 't bn hmlkh
verses.translation: And the seventh year Jehoiada sent and fetched the rulers over hundreds, with the captains and the guard, and brought them to him into the house of the LORD , and made a covenant with them, and took an oath of them in the house of the LORD , and shewed them the king’s son.

verses.original: וַ/יְצַוֵּ֣/ם לֵ/אמֹ֔ר זֶ֥ה הַ/דָּבָ֖ר אֲשֶׁ֣ר תַּעֲשׂ֑וּ/ן הַ/שְּׁלִשִׁ֤ית מִ/כֶּם֙ בָּאֵ֣י הַ/שַּׁבָּ֔ת וְ/שֹׁ֣מְרֵ֔י מִשְׁמֶ֖רֶת בֵּ֥ית הַ/מֶּֽלֶךְ
verses.translit: vytsvm l'mr zh hdbr 'shr t'shvn hshlshyt mkhm b'y hshbt vshmry mshmrt byt hmlkh
verses.translation: And he commanded them, saying, This is the thing that ye shall do; A third part of you that enter in on the sabbath shall even be keepers of the watch of the king’s house;

verses.original: וְ/הַ/שְּׁלִשִׁית֙ בְּ/שַׁ֣עַר ס֔וּר וְ/הַ/שְּׁלִשִׁ֥ית בַּ/שַּׁ֖עַר אַחַ֣ר הָ/רָצִ֑ים וּ/שְׁמַרְתֶּ֛ם אֶת מִשְׁמֶ֥רֶת הַ/בַּ֖יִת מַסָּֽח
verses.translit: vhshlshyt bsh'r svr vhshlshyt bsh'r 'chr hrtsym vshmrtm 't mshmrt hbyt msch
verses.translation: And a third part shall be at the gate of Sur; and a third part at the gate behind the guard: so shall ye keep the watch of the house, that it be not broken down.

verses.original: וּ/שְׁתֵּ֤י הַ/יָּדוֹת֙ בָּ/כֶ֔ם כֹּ֖ל יֹצְאֵ֣י הַ/שַּׁבָּ֑ת וְ/שָֽׁמְר֛וּ אֶת מִשְׁמֶ֥רֶת בֵּית יְהוָ֖ה אֶל הַ/מֶּֽלֶךְ
verses.translit: vshty hydvt bkhm khl yts'y hshbt vshmrv 't mshmrt byt yhvh 'l hmlkh
verses.translation: And two parts of all you that go forth on the sabbath, even they shall keep the watch of the house of the LORD about the king.

verses.original: וְ/הִקַּפְתֶּ֨ם עַל הַ/מֶּ֜לֶךְ סָבִ֗יב אִ֚ישׁ וְ/כֵלָ֣י/ו בְּ/יָד֔/וֹ וְ/הַ/בָּ֥א אֶל הַ/שְּׂדֵר֖וֹת יוּמָ֑ת וִ/הְי֥וּ אֶת הַ/מֶּ֖לֶךְ בְּ/צֵאת֥/וֹ וּ/בְ/בֹאֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: vhqptm 'l hmlkh sbyb 'ysh vkhlyv bydv vhb' 'l hshdrvt yvmt vhyv 't hmlkh bts'tv vbb'v
verses.translation: And ye shall compass the king round about, every man with his weapons in his hand: and he that cometh within the ranges, let him be slain: and be ye with the king as he goeth out and as he cometh in.

verses.original: וַֽ/יַּעֲשׂ֞וּ שָׂרֵ֣י ה/מאיות הַ/מֵּא֗וֹת כְּ/כֹ֣ל אֲשֶׁר צִוָּה֮ יְהוֹיָדָ֣ע הַ/כֹּהֵן֒ וַ/יִּקְחוּ֙ אִ֣ישׁ אֶת אֲנָשָׁ֔י/ו בָּאֵ֣י הַ/שַּׁבָּ֔ת עִ֖ם יֹצְאֵ֣י הַ/שַּׁבָּ֑ת וַ/יָּבֹ֖אוּ אֶל יְהוֹיָדָ֥ע הַ/כֹּהֵֽן
verses.translit: vy'shv shry hm'yvt hm'vt khkhl 'shr tsvh yhvyd' hkhhn vyqchv 'ysh 't 'nshyv b'y hshbt 'm yts'y hshbt vyb'v 'l yhvyd' hkhhn
verses.translation: And the captains over the hundreds did according to all things that Jehoiada the priest commanded: and they took every man his men that were to come in on the sabbath, with them that should go out on the sabbath, and came to Jehoiada the priest.

verses.original: וַ/יִּתֵּ֨ן הַ/כֹּהֵ֜ן לְ/שָׂרֵ֣י ה/מאיות הַ/מֵּא֗וֹת אֶֽת הַ/חֲנִית֙ וְ/אֶת הַ/שְּׁלָטִ֔ים אֲשֶׁ֖ר לַ/מֶּ֣לֶךְ דָּוִ֑ד אֲשֶׁ֖ר בְּ/בֵ֥ית יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: vytn hkhhn lshry hm'yvt hm'vt 't hchnyt v't hshltym 'shr lmlkh dvd 'shr bbyt yhvh
verses.translation: And to the captains over hundreds did the priest give king David’s spears and shields, that were in the temple of the LORD .

verses.original: וַ/יַּעַמְד֨וּ הָ/רָצִ֜ים אִ֣ישׁ וְ/כֵלָ֣י/ו בְּ/יָד֗/וֹ מִ/כֶּ֨תֶף הַ/בַּ֤יִת הַ/יְמָנִית֙ עַד כֶּ֤תֶף הַ/בַּ֨יִת֙ הַ/שְּׂמָאלִ֔ית לַ/מִּזְבֵּ֖חַ וְ/לַ/בָּ֑יִת עַל הַ/מֶּ֖לֶךְ סָבִֽיב
verses.translit: vy'mdv hrtsym 'ysh vkhlyv bydv mkhtf hbyt hymnyt 'd khtf hbyt hshm'lyt lmzbch vlbyt 'l hmlkh sbyb
verses.translation: And the guard stood, every man with his weapons in his hand, round about the king, from the right corner of the temple to the left corner of the temple, along by the altar and the temple.

verses.original: וַ/יּוֹצִ֣א אֶת בֶּן הַ/מֶּ֗לֶךְ וַ/יִּתֵּ֤ן עָלָי/ו֙ אֶת הַ/נֵּ֨זֶר֙ וְ/אֶת הָ֣/עֵד֔וּת וַ/יַּמְלִ֥כוּ אֹת֖/וֹ וַ/יִּמְשָׁחֻ֑/הוּ וַ/יַּכּוּ כָ֔ף וַ/יֹּאמְר֖וּ יְחִ֥י הַ/מֶּֽלֶךְ
verses.translit: vyvts' 't bn hmlkh vytn 'lyv 't hnzr v't h'dvt vymlkhv 'tv vymshchhv vykhv khf vy'mrv ychy hmlkh
verses.translation: And he brought forth the king’s son, and put the crown upon him, and gave him the testimony; and they made him king, and anointed him; and they clapped their hands, and said, God save the king.

verses.original: וַ/תִּשְׁמַ֣ע עֲתַלְיָ֔ה אֶת ק֥וֹל הָֽ/רָצִ֖ין הָ/עָ֑ם וַ/תָּבֹ֥א אֶל הָ/עָ֖ם בֵּ֥ית יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: vtshm' 'tlyh 't qvl hrtsyn h'm vtb' 'l h'm byt yhvh
verses.translation: And when Athaliah heard the noise of the guard and of the people, she came to the people into the temple of the LORD .

verses.original: וַ/תֵּ֡רֶא וְ/הִנֵּ֣ה הַ/מֶּלֶךְ֩ עֹמֵ֨ד עַֽל הָ/עַמּ֜וּד כַּ/מִּשְׁפָּ֗ט וְ/הַ/שָּׂרִ֤ים וְ/הַ/חֲצֹֽצְרוֹת֙ אֶל הַ/מֶּ֔לֶךְ וְ/כָל עַ֤ם הָ/אָ֨רֶץ֙ שָׂמֵ֔חַ וְ/תֹקֵ֖עַ בַּ/חֲצֹֽצְר֑וֹת וַ/תִּקְרַ֤ע עֲתַלְיָה֙ אֶת בְּגָדֶ֔י/הָ וַ/תִּקְרָ֖א קֶ֥שֶׁר קָֽשֶׁר
verses.translit: vtr' vhnh hmlkh 'md 'l h'mvd khmshpt vhshrym vhchtstsrvt 'l hmlkh vkhl 'm h'rts shmch vtq' bchtstsrvt vtqr' 'tlyh 't bgdyh vtqr' qshr qshr
verses.translation: And when she looked, behold, the king stood by a pillar, as the manner was , and the princes and the trumpeters by the king, and all the people of the land rejoiced, and blew with trumpets: and Athaliah rent her clothes, and cried, Treason, Treason.

verses.original: וַ/יְצַו֩ יְהוֹיָדָ֨ע הַ/כֹּהֵ֜ן אֶת שָׂרֵ֥י ה/מיאות הַ/מֵּא֣וֹת פְּקֻדֵ֣י הַ/חַ֗יִל וַ/יֹּ֤אמֶר אֲלֵי/הֶם֙ הוֹצִ֤יאוּ אֹתָ/הּ֙ אֶל מִ/בֵּ֣ית לַ/שְּׂדֵרֹ֔ת וְ/הַ/בָּ֥א אַחֲרֶ֖י/הָ הָמֵ֣ת בֶּ/חָ֑רֶב כִּ֚י אָמַ֣ר הַ/כֹּהֵ֔ן אַל תּוּמַ֖ת בֵּ֥ית יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: vytsv yhvyd' hkhhn 't shry hmy'vt hm'vt pqdy hchyl vy'mr 'lyhm hvtsy'v 'th 'l mbyt lshdrt vhb' 'chryh hmt bchrb khy 'mr hkhhn 'l tvmt byt yhvh
verses.translation: But Jehoiada the priest commanded the captains of the hundreds, the officers of the host, and said unto them, Have her forth without the ranges: and him that followeth her kill with the sword. For the priest had said, Let her not be slain in the house of the LORD .

verses.original: וַ/יָּשִׂ֤מוּ לָ/הּ֙ יָדַ֔יִם וַ/תָּב֛וֹא דֶּֽרֶךְ מְב֥וֹא הַ/סּוּסִ֖ים בֵּ֣ית הַ/מֶּ֑לֶךְ וַ/תּוּמַ֖ת שָֽׁם
verses.translit: vyshmv lh ydym vtbv' drkh mbv' hsvsym byt hmlkh vtvmt shm
verses.translation: And they laid hands on her; and she went by the way by the which the horses came into the king’s house: and there was she slain.

verses.original: וַ/יִּכְרֹ֨ת יְהוֹיָדָ֜ע אֶֽת הַ/בְּרִ֗ית בֵּ֤ין יְהוָה֙ וּ/בֵ֤ין הַ/מֶּ֨לֶךְ֙ וּ/בֵ֣ין הָ/עָ֔ם לִ/הְי֥וֹת לְ/עָ֖ם לַֽ/יהוָ֑ה וּ/בֵ֥ין הַ/מֶּ֖לֶךְ וּ/בֵ֥ין הָ/עָֽם
verses.translit: vykhrt yhvyd' 't hbryt byn yhvh vbyn hmlkh vbyn h'm lhyvt l'm lyhvh vbyn hmlkh vbyn h'm
verses.translation: And Jehoiada made a covenant between the LORD and the king and the people, that they should be the LORD’s people; between the king also and the people.

verses.original: וַ/יָּבֹ֣אוּ כָל עַם֩ הָ/אָ֨רֶץ בֵּית הַ/בַּ֜עַל וַֽ/יִּתְּצֻ֗/הוּ אֶת מזבחת/ו מִזְבְּחֹתָ֤י/ו וְ/אֶת צְלָמָי/ו֙ שִׁבְּר֣וּ הֵיטֵ֔ב וְ/אֵ֗ת מַתָּן֙ כֹּהֵ֣ן הַ/בַּ֔עַל הָרְג֖וּ לִ/פְנֵ֣י הַֽ/מִּזְבְּח֑וֹת וַ/יָּ֧שֶׂם הַ/כֹּהֵ֛ן פְּקֻדּ֖וֹת עַל בֵּ֥ית יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: vyb'v khl 'm h'rts byt hb'l vyttshv 't mzbchtv mzbchtyv v't tslmyv shbrv hytb v't mtn khhn hb'l hrgv lpny hmzbchvt vyshm hkhhn pqdvt 'l byt yhvh
verses.translation: And all the people of the land went into the house of Baal, and brake it down; his altars and his images brake they in pieces thoroughly, and slew Mattan the priest of Baal before the altars. And the priest appointed officers over the house of the LORD .

verses.original: וַ/יִּקַּ֣ח אֶת שָׂרֵ֣י הַ֠/מֵּאוֹת וְ/אֶת הַ/כָּרִ֨י וְ/אֶת הָ/רָצִ֜ים וְ/אֵ֣ת כָּל עַ֣ם הָ/אָ֗רֶץ וַ/יֹּרִ֤ידוּ אֶת הַ/מֶּ֨לֶךְ֙ מִ/בֵּ֣ית יְהוָ֔ה וַ/יָּב֛וֹאוּ דֶּֽרֶך שַׁ֥עַר הָ/רָצִ֖ים בֵּ֣ית הַ/מֶּ֑לֶךְ וַ/יֵּ֖שֶׁב עַל כִּסֵּ֥א הַ/מְּלָכִֽים
verses.translit: vyqch 't shry hm'vt v't hkhry v't hrtsym v't khl 'm h'rts vyrydv 't hmlkh mbyt yhvh vybv'v drkh sh'r hrtsym byt hmlkh vyshb 'l khs' hmlkhym
verses.translation: And he took the rulers over hundreds, and the captains, and the guard, and all the people of the land; and they brought down the king from the house of the LORD , and came by the way of the gate of the guard to the king’s house. And he sat on the throne of the kings.

verses.original: וַ/יִּשְׂמַ֥ח כָּל עַם הָ/אָ֖רֶץ וְ/הָ/עִ֣יר שָׁקָ֑טָה וְ/אֶת עֲתַלְיָ֛הוּ הֵמִ֥יתוּ בַ/חֶ֖רֶב בֵּ֥ית מלך הַ/מֶּֽלֶךְ
verses.translit: vyshmch khl 'm h'rts vh'yr shqth v't 'tlyhv hmytv bchrb byt mlkh hmlkh
verses.translation: And all the people of the land rejoiced, and the city was in quiet: and they slew Athaliah with the sword beside the king’s house.
Seven years old was Jehoash when he began to reign.

verses.original: בֶּן שֶׁ֥בַע שָׁנִ֖ים יְהוֹאָ֥שׁ בְּ/מָלְכֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: bn shb' shnym yhv'sh bmlkhv
verses.translation: In the seventh year of Jehu Jehoash began to reign; and forty years reigned he in Jerusalem. And his mother’s name was Zibiah of Beer-sheba.

verses.original: בִּ/שְׁנַת שֶׁ֤בַע לְ/יֵהוּא֙ מָלַ֣ךְ יְהוֹאָ֔שׁ וְ/אַרְבָּעִ֣ים שָׁנָ֔ה מָלַ֖ךְ בִּ/ירֽוּשָׁלִָ֑ם וְ/שֵׁ֣ם אִמּ֔/וֹ צִבְיָ֖ה מִ/בְּאֵ֥ר שָֽׁבַע
verses.translit: bshnt shb' lyhv' mlkh yhv'sh v'rb'ym shnh mlkh byrvshlm vshm 'mv tsbyh mb'r shb'
verses.translation: And Jehoash did that which was right in the sight of the LORD all his days wherein Jehoiada the priest instructed him.

verses.original: וַ/יַּ֨עַשׂ יְהוֹאָ֧שׁ הַ/יָּשָׁ֛ר בְּ/עֵינֵ֥י יְהוָ֖ה כָּל יָמָ֑י/ו אֲשֶׁ֣ר הוֹרָ֔/הוּ יְהוֹיָדָ֖ע הַ/כֹּהֵֽן
verses.translit: vy'sh yhv'sh hyshr b'yny yhvh khl ymyv 'shr hvrhv yhvyd' hkhhn
verses.translation: But the high places were not taken away: the people still sacrificed and burnt incense in the high places.

verses.original: רַ֥ק הַ/בָּמ֖וֹת לֹא סָ֑רוּ ע֥וֹד הָ/עָ֛ם מְזַבְּחִ֥ים וּֽ/מְקַטְּרִ֖ים בַּ/בָּמֽוֹת
verses.translit: rq hbmvt l' srv 'vd h'm mzbchym vmqtrym bbmvt
verses.translation: And Jehoash said to the priests, All the money of the dedicated things that is brought into the house of the LORD , even the money of every one that passeth the account , the money that every man is set at, and all the money that cometh into any man’s heart to bring into the house of the LORD ,

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֨אמֶר יְהוֹאָ֜שׁ אֶל הַ/כֹּהֲנִ֗ים כֹּל֩ כֶּ֨סֶף הַ/קֳּדָשִׁ֜ים אֲשֶׁר יוּבָ֤א בֵית יְהוָה֙ כֶּ֣סֶף עוֹבֵ֔ר אִ֕ישׁ כֶּ֥סֶף נַפְשׁ֖וֹת עֶרְכּ֑/וֹ כָּל כֶּ֗סֶף אֲשֶׁ֤ר יַֽעֲלֶה֙ עַ֣ל לֶב אִ֔ישׁ לְ/הָבִ֖יא בֵּ֥ית יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: vy'mr yhv'sh 'l hkhhnym khl khsf hqdshym 'shr yvb' byt yhvh khsf 'vbr 'ysh khsf npshvt 'rkhv khl khsf 'shr y'lh 'l lb 'ysh lhby' byt yhvh
verses.translation: Let the priests take it to them, every man of his acquaintance: and let them repair the breaches of the house, wheresoever any breach shall be found.

verses.original: יִקְח֤וּ לָ/הֶם֙ הַ/כֹּ֣הֲנִ֔ים אִ֖ישׁ מֵ/אֵ֣ת מַכָּר֑/וֹ וְ/הֵ֗ם יְחַזְּקוּ֙ אֶת בֶּ֣דֶק הַ/בַּ֔יִת לְ/כֹ֛ל אֲשֶׁר יִמָּצֵ֥א שָׁ֖ם בָּֽדֶק
verses.translit: yqchv lhm hkhhnym 'ysh m't mkhrv vhm ychzqv 't bdq hbyt lkhl 'shr ymts' shm bdq
verses.translation: But it was so, that in the three and twentieth year of king Jehoash the priests had not repaired the breaches of the house.

verses.original: וַ/יְהִ֗י בִּ/שְׁנַ֨ת עֶשְׂרִ֧ים וְ/שָׁלֹ֛שׁ שָׁנָ֖ה לַ/מֶּ֣לֶךְ יְהוֹאָ֑שׁ לֹֽא חִזְּק֥וּ הַ/כֹּהֲנִ֖ים אֶת בֶּ֥דֶק הַ/בָּֽיִת
verses.translit: vyhy bshnt 'shrym vshlsh shnh lmlkh yhv'sh l' chzqv hkhhnym 't bdq hbyt
verses.translation: Then king Jehoash called for Jehoiada the priest, and the other priests, and said unto them, Why repair ye not the breaches of the house? now therefore receive no more money of your acquaintance, but deliver it for the breaches of the house.

verses.original: וַ/יִּקְרָא֩ הַ/מֶּ֨לֶךְ יְהוֹאָ֜שׁ לִ/יהוֹיָדָ֤ע הַ/כֹּהֵן֙ וְ/לַ/כֹּ֣הֲנִ֔ים וַ/יֹּ֣אמֶר אֲלֵ/הֶ֔ם מַדּ֛וּעַ אֵינְ/כֶ֥ם מְחַזְּקִ֖ים אֶת בֶּ֣דֶק הַ/בָּ֑יִת וְ/עַתָּ֗ה אַל תִּקְחוּ כֶ֨סֶף֙ מֵ/אֵ֣ת מַכָּֽרֵי/כֶ֔ם כִּֽי לְ/בֶ֥דֶק הַ/בַּ֖יִת תִּתְּנֻֽ/הוּ
verses.translit: vyqr' hmlkh yhv'sh lyhvyd' hkhhn vlkhhnym vy'mr 'lhm mdv' 'ynkhm mchzqym 't bdq hbyt v'th 'l tqchv khsf m't mkhrykhm khy lbdq hbyt ttnhv
verses.translation: And the priests consented to receive no more money of the people, neither to repair the breaches of the house.

verses.original: וַ/יֵּאֹ֖תוּ הַ/כֹּֽהֲנִ֑ים לְ/בִלְתִּ֤י קְחַת כֶּ֨סֶף֙ מֵ/אֵ֣ת הָ/עָ֔ם וּ/לְ/בִלְתִּ֥י חַזֵּ֖ק אֶת בֶּ֥דֶק הַ/בָּֽיִת
verses.translit: vy'tv hkhhnym lblty qcht khsf m't h'm vlblty chzq 't bdq hbyt
verses.translation: But Jehoiada the priest took a chest, and bored a hole in the lid of it, and set it beside the altar, on the right side as one cometh into the house of the LORD : and the priests that kept the door put therein all the money that was brought into the house of the LORD .

verses.original: וַ/יִּקַּ֞ח יְהוֹיָדָ֤ע הַ/כֹּהֵן֙ אֲר֣וֹן אֶחָ֔ד וַ/יִּקֹּ֥ב חֹ֖ר בְּ/דַלְתּ֑/וֹ וַ/יִּתֵּ֣ן אֹת/וֹ֩ אֵ֨צֶל הַ/מִּזְבֵּ֜חַ ב/ימין מִ/יָּמִ֗ין בְּ/בֽוֹא אִישׁ֙ בֵּ֣ית יְהוָ֔ה וְ/נָֽתְנוּ שָׁ֤מָּ/ה הַ/כֹּֽהֲנִים֙ שֹׁמְרֵ֣י הַ/סַּ֔ף אֶת כָּל הַ/כֶּ֖סֶף הַ/מּוּבָ֥א בֵית יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: vyqch yhvyd' hkhhn 'rvn 'chd vyqb chr bdltv vytn 'tv 'tsl hmzbch bymyn mymyn bbv' 'ysh byt yhvh vntnv shmh hkhhnym shmry hsf 't khl hkhsf hmvb' byt yhvh
verses.translation: And it was so , when they saw that there was much money in the chest, that the king’s scribe and the high priest came up, and they put up in bags, and told the money that was found in the house of the LORD .

verses.original: וַֽ/יְהִי֙ כִּ/רְאוֹתָ֔/ם כִּֽי רַ֥ב הַ/כֶּ֖סֶף בָּֽ/אָר֑וֹן וַ/יַּ֨עַל סֹפֵ֤ר הַ/מֶּ֨לֶךְ֙ וְ/הַ/כֹּהֵ֣ן הַ/גָּד֔וֹל וַ/יָּצֻ֨רוּ֙ וַ/יִּמְנ֔וּ אֶת הַ/כֶּ֖סֶף הַ/נִּמְצָ֥א בֵית יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: vyhy khr'vtm khy rb hkhsf b'rvn vy'l spr hmlkh vhkhhn hgdvl vytsrv vymnv 't hkhsf hnmts' byt yhvh
verses.translation: And they gave the money, being told, into the hands of them that did the work, that had the oversight of the house of the LORD : and they laid it out to the carpenters and builders, that wrought upon the house of the LORD ,

verses.original: וְ/נָתְנוּ֙ אֶת הַ/כֶּ֣סֶף הַֽ/מְתֻכָּ֔ן עַל יד יְדֵי֙ עֹשֵׂ֣י הַ/מְּלָאכָ֔ה ה/פקדים הַ/מֻּפְקָדִ֖ים בֵּ֣ית יְהוָ֑ה וַ/יּוֹצִיאֻ֜/הוּ לְ/חָרָשֵׁ֤י הָ/עֵץ֙ וְ/לַ/בֹּנִ֔ים הָ/עֹשִׂ֖ים בֵּ֥ית יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: vntnv 't hkhsf hmtkhn 'l yd ydy 'shy hml'khh hpqdym hmpqdym byt yhvh vyvtsy'hv lchrshy h'ts vlbnym h'shym byt yhvh
verses.translation: And to masons, and hewers of stone, and to buy timber and hewed stone to repair the breaches of the house of the LORD , and for all that was laid out for the house to repair it .

verses.original: וְ/לַ/גֹּֽדְרִים֙ וּ/לְ/חֹצְבֵ֣י הָ/אֶ֔בֶן וְ/לִ/קְנ֤וֹת עֵצִים֙ וְ/אַבְנֵ֣י מַחְצֵ֔ב לְ/חַזֵּ֖ק אֶת בֶּ֣דֶק בֵּית יְהוָ֑ה וּ/לְ/כֹ֛ל אֲשֶׁר יֵצֵ֥א עַל הַ/בַּ֖יִת לְ/חָזְקָֽה
verses.translit: vlgdrym vlchtsby h'bn vlqnvt 'tsym v'bny mchtsb lchzq 't bdq byt yhvh vlkhl 'shr yts' 'l hbyt lchzqh
verses.translation: Howbeit there were not made for the house of the LORD bowls of silver, snuffers, basons, trumpets, any vessels of gold, or vessels of silver, of the money that was brought into the house of the LORD :

verses.original: אַךְ֩ לֹ֨א יֵעָשֶׂ֜ה בֵּ֣ית יְהוָ֗ה סִפּ֥וֹת כֶּ֨סֶף֙ מְזַמְּר֤וֹת מִזְרָקוֹת֙ חֲצֹ֣צְר֔וֹת כָּל כְּלִ֥י זָהָ֖ב וּ/כְלִי כָ֑סֶף מִן הַ/כֶּ֖סֶף הַ/מּוּבָ֥א בֵית יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: 'kh l' y'shh byt yhvh spvt khsf mzmrvt mzrqvt chtstsrvt khl khly zhb vkhly khsf mn hkhsf hmvb' byt yhvh
verses.translation: But they gave that to the workmen, and repaired therewith the house of the LORD .

verses.original: כִּֽי לְ/עֹשֵׂ֥י הַ/מְּלָאכָ֖ה יִתְּנֻ֑/הוּ וְ/חִזְּקוּ ב֖/וֹ אֶת בֵּ֥ית יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: khy l'shy hml'khh ytnhv vchzqv bv 't byt yhvh
verses.translation: Moreover they reckoned not with the men, into whose hand they delivered the money to be bestowed on workmen: for they dealt faithfully.

verses.original: וְ/לֹ֧א יְחַשְּׁב֣וּ אֶת הָ/אֲנָשִׁ֗ים אֲשֶׁ֨ר יִתְּנ֤וּ אֶת הַ/כֶּ֨סֶף֙ עַל יָדָ֔/ם לָ/תֵ֖ת לְ/עֹשֵׂ֣י הַ/מְּלָאכָ֑ה כִּ֥י בֶ/אֱמֻנָ֖ה הֵ֥ם עֹשִֽׂים
verses.translit: vl' ychshbv 't h'nshym 'shr ytnv 't hkhsf 'l ydm ltt l'shy hml'khh khy b'mnh hm 'shym
verses.translation: The trespass money and sin money was not brought into the house of the LORD : it was the priests’.

verses.original: כֶּ֤סֶף אָשָׁם֙ וְ/כֶ֣סֶף חַטָּא֔וֹת לֹ֥א יוּבָ֖א בֵּ֣ית יְהוָ֑ה לַ/כֹּהֲנִ֖ים יִהְיֽוּ
verses.translit: khsf 'shm vkhsf cht'vt l' yvb' byt yhvh lkhhnym yhyv
verses.translation: Then Hazael king of Syria went up, and fought against Gath, and took it: and Hazael set his face to go up to Jerusalem.

verses.original: אָ֣ז יַעֲלֶ֗ה חֲזָאֵל֙ מֶ֣לֶךְ אֲרָ֔ם וַ/יִּלָּ֥חֶם עַל גַּ֖ת וַֽ/יִּלְכְּדָ֑/הּ וַ/יָּ֤שֶׂם חֲזָאֵל֙ פָּנָ֔י/ו לַ/עֲל֖וֹת עַל יְרוּשָׁלִָֽם
verses.translit: 'z y'lh chz'l mlkh 'rm vylchm 'l gt vylkhdh vyshm chz'l pnyv l'lvt 'l yrvshlm
verses.translation: And Jehoash king of Judah took all the hallowed things that Jehoshaphat, and Jehoram, and Ahaziah, his fathers, kings of Judah, had dedicated, and his own hallowed things, and all the gold that was found in the treasures of the house of the LORD , and in the king’s house, and sent it to Hazael king of Syria: and he went away from Jerusalem.

verses.original: וַ/יִּקַּ֞ח יְהוֹאָ֣שׁ מֶֽלֶךְ יְהוּדָ֗ה אֵ֣ת כָּל הַ/קֳּדָשִׁ֡ים אֲשֶׁר הִקְדִּ֣ישׁוּ יְהוֹשָׁפָ֣ט וִ/יהוֹרָם֩ וַ/אֲחַזְיָ֨הוּ אֲבֹתָ֜י/ו מַלְכֵ֤י יְהוּדָה֙ וְ/אֶת קֳדָשָׁ֔י/ו וְ/אֵ֣ת כָּל הַ/זָּהָ֗ב הַ/נִּמְצָ֛א בְּ/אֹצְר֥וֹת בֵּית יְהוָ֖ה וּ/בֵ֣ית הַ/מֶּ֑לֶךְ וַ/יִּשְׁלַ֗ח לַֽ/חֲזָאֵל֙ מֶ֣לֶךְ אֲרָ֔ם וַ/יַּ֖עַל מֵ/עַ֥ל יְרוּשָׁלִָֽם
verses.translit: vyqch yhv'sh mlkh yhvdh 't khl hqdshym 'shr hqdyshv yhvshpt vyhvrm v'chzyhv 'btyv mlkhy yhvdh v't qdshyv v't khl hzhb hnmts' b'tsrvt byt yhvh vbyt hmlkh vyshlch lchz'l mlkh 'rm vy'l m'l yrvshlm
verses.translation: And the rest of the acts of Joash, and all that he did, are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah?

verses.original: וְ/יֶ֛תֶר דִּבְרֵ֥י יוֹאָ֖שׁ וְ/כָל אֲשֶׁ֣ר עָשָׂ֑ה הֲ/לוֹא הֵ֣ם כְּתוּבִ֗ים עַל סֵ֛פֶר דִּבְרֵ֥י הַ/יָּמִ֖ים לְ/מַלְכֵ֥י יְהוּדָֽה
verses.translit: vytr dbry yv'sh vkhl 'shr 'shh hlv' hm khtvbym 'l spr dbry hymym lmlkhy yhvdh
verses.translation: And his servants arose, and made a conspiracy, and slew Joash in the house of Millo, which goeth down to Silla.

verses.original: וַ/יָּקֻ֥מוּ עֲבָדָ֖י/ו וַ/יִּקְשְׁרֽוּ קָ֑שֶׁר וַ/יַּכּוּ֙ אֶת יוֹאָ֔שׁ בֵּ֥ית מִלֹּ֖א הַ/יּוֹרֵ֥ד סִלָּֽא
verses.translit: vyqmv 'bdyv vyqshrv qshr vykhv 't yv'sh byt ml' hyvrd sl'
verses.translation: For Jozachar the son of Shimeath, and Jehozabad the son of Shomer, his servants, smote him, and he died; and they buried him with his fathers in the city of David: and Amaziah his son reigned in his stead.

verses.original: בִּ/שְׁנַ֨ת עֶשְׂרִ֤ים וְ/שָׁלֹשׁ֙ שָׁנָ֔ה לְ/יוֹאָ֥שׁ בֶּן אֲחַזְיָ֖הוּ מֶ֣לֶךְ יְהוּדָ֑ה מָ֠לַךְ יְהוֹאָחָ֨ז בֶּן יֵה֤וּא עַל יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ בְּ/שֹׁ֣מְר֔וֹן שְׁבַ֥ע עֶשְׂרֵ֖ה שָׁנָֽה
verses.translit: bshnt 'shrym vshlsh shnh lyv'sh bn 'chzyhv mlkh yhvdh mlkh yhv'chz bn yhv' 'l yshr'l bshmrvn shb' 'shrh shnh
verses.translation: In the three and twentieth year of Joash the son of Ahaziah king of Judah Jehoahaz the son of Jehu began to reign over Israel in Samaria, and reigned seventeen years.

verses.original: וַ/יַּ֥עַשׂ הָ/רַ֖ע בְּ/עֵינֵ֣י יְהוָ֑ה וַ֠/יֵּלֶךְ אַחַ֨ר חַטֹּ֜את יָרָבְעָ֧ם בֶּן נְבָ֛ט אֲשֶׁר הֶחֱטִ֥יא אֶת יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל לֹא סָ֥ר מִמֶּֽ/נָּה
verses.translit: vy'sh hr' b'yny yhvh vylkh 'chr cht't yrb'm bn nbt 'shr hchty' 't yshr'l l' sr mmnh
verses.translation: And he did that which was evil in the sight of the LORD , and followed the sins of Jeroboam the son of Nebat, which made Israel to sin; he departed not therefrom.

verses.original: וַ/יִּֽחַר אַ֥ף יְהוָ֖ה בְּ/יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וַֽ/יִּתְּנֵ֞/ם בְּ/יַ֣ד חֲזָאֵ֣ל מֶֽלֶךְ אֲרָ֗ם וּ/בְ/יַ֛ד בֶּן הֲדַ֥ד בֶּן חֲזָאֵ֖ל כָּל הַ/יָּמִֽים
verses.translit: vychr 'f yhvh byshr'l vytnm byd chz'l mlkh 'rm vbyd bn hdd bn chz'l khl hymym
verses.translation: And the anger of the LORD was kindled against Israel, and he delivered them into the hand of Hazael king of Syria, and into the hand of Ben-hadad the son of Hazael, all their days.

verses.original: וַ/יְחַ֥ל יְהוֹאָחָ֖ז אֶת פְּנֵ֣י יְהוָ֑ה וַ/יִּשְׁמַ֤ע אֵלָי/ו֙ יְהוָ֔ה כִּ֤י רָאָה֙ אֶת לַ֣חַץ יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל כִּֽי לָחַ֥ץ אֹתָ֖/ם מֶ֥לֶךְ אֲרָֽם
verses.translit: vychl yhv'chz 't pny yhvh vyshm' 'lyv yhvh khy r'h 't lchts yshr'l khy lchts 'tm mlkh 'rm
verses.translation: And Jehoahaz besought the LORD , and the LORD hearkened unto him: for he saw the oppression of Israel, because the king of Syria oppressed them.

verses.original: וַ/יִּתֵּ֨ן יְהוָ֤ה לְ/יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ מוֹשִׁ֔יעַ וַ/יֵּ֣צְא֔וּ מִ/תַּ֖חַת יַד אֲרָ֑ם וַ/יֵּשְׁב֧וּ בְנֵֽי יִשְׂרָאֵ֛ל בְּ/אָהֳלֵי/הֶ֖ם כִּ/תְמ֥וֹל שִׁלְשֽׁוֹם
verses.translit: vytn yhvh lyshr'l mvshy' vyts'v mtcht yd 'rm vyshbv bny yshr'l b'hlyhm khtmvl shlshvm
verses.translation: (And the LORD gave Israel a saviour, so that they went out from under the hand of the Syrians: and the children of Israel dwelt in their tents, as beforetime.

verses.original: אַ֠ךְ לֹֽא סָ֜רוּ מֵ/חַטֹּ֧אות בֵּית יָרָבְעָ֛ם אֲשֶׁר החטי הֶחֱטִ֥יא אֶת יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל בָּ֣/הּ הָלָ֑ךְ וְ/גַם֙ הָ/אֲשֵׁרָ֔ה עָמְדָ֖ה בְּ/שֹׁמְרֽוֹן
verses.translit: 'kh l' srv mcht'vt byt yrb'm 'shr hchty hchty' 't yshr'l bh hlkh vgm h'shrh 'mdh bshmrvn
verses.translation: Nevertheless they departed not from the sins of the house of Jeroboam, who made Israel sin, but walked therein: and there remained the grove also in Samaria.)

verses.original: כִּ֣י לֹא֩ הִשְׁאִ֨יר לִ/יהוֹאָחָ֜ז עָ֗ם כִּ֣י אִם חֲמִשִּׁ֤ים פָּֽרָשִׁים֙ וַ/עֲשָׂ֣רָה רֶ֔כֶב וַ/עֲשֶׂ֥רֶת אֲלָפִ֖ים רַגְלִ֑י כִּ֤י אִבְּדָ/ם֙ מֶ֣לֶךְ אֲרָ֔ם וַ/יְשִׂמֵ֥/ם כֶּֽ/עָפָ֖ר לָ/דֻֽשׁ
verses.translit: khy l' hsh'yr lyhv'chz 'm khy 'm chmshym prshym v'shrh rkhb v'shrt 'lpym rgly khy 'bdm mlkh 'rm vyshmm kh'pr ldsh
verses.translation: Neither did he leave of the people to Jehoahaz but fifty horsemen, and ten chariots, and ten thousand footmen; for the king of Syria had destroyed them, and had made them like the dust by threshing.

verses.original: וְ/יֶ֨תֶר דִּבְרֵ֧י יְהוֹאָחָ֛ז וְ/כָל אֲשֶׁ֥ר עָשָׂ֖ה וּ/גְבוּרָת֑/וֹ הֲ/לוֹא הֵ֣ם כְּתוּבִ֗ים עַל סֵ֛פֶר דִּבְרֵ֥י הַ/יָּמִ֖ים לְ/מַלְכֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל
verses.translit: vytr dbry yhv'chz vkhl 'shr 'shh vgbvrtv hlv' hm khtvbym 'l spr dbry hymym lmlkhy yshr'l
verses.translation: Now the rest of the acts of Jehoahaz, and all that he did, and his might, are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel?

verses.original: וַ/יִּשְׁכַּ֤ב יְהֽוֹאָחָז֙ עִם אֲבֹתָ֔י/ו וַֽ/יִּקְבְּרֻ֖/הוּ בְּ/שֹׁמְר֑וֹן וַ/יִּמְלֹ֛ךְ יוֹאָ֥שׁ בְּנ֖/וֹ תַּחְתָּֽי/ו
verses.translit: vyshkhb yhv'chz 'm 'btyv vyqbrhv bshmrvn vymlkh yv'sh bnv tchtyv
verses.translation: And Jehoahaz slept with his fathers; and they buried him in Samaria: and Joash his son reigned in his stead.

verses.original: בִּ/שְׁנַ֨ת שְׁלֹשִׁ֤ים וָ/שֶׁ֨בַע֙ שָׁנָ֔ה לְ/יוֹאָ֖שׁ מֶ֣לֶךְ יְהוּדָ֑ה מָ֠לַךְ יְהוֹאָ֨שׁ בֶּן יְהוֹאָחָ֤ז עַל יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ בְּ/שֹׁ֣מְר֔וֹן שֵׁ֥שׁ עֶשְׂרֵ֖ה שָׁנָֽה
verses.translit: bshnt shlshym vshb' shnh lyv'sh mlkh yhvdh mlkh yhv'sh bn yhv'chz 'l yshr'l bshmrvn shsh 'shrh shnh
verses.translation: In the thirty and seventh year of Joash king of Judah began Jehoash the son of Jehoahaz to reign over Israel in Samaria, and reigned sixteen years.

verses.original: וַ/יַּֽעֲשֶׂ֥ה הָ/רַ֖ע בְּ/עֵינֵ֣י יְהוָ֑ה לֹ֣א סָ֗ר מִ/כָּל חַטֹּ֞אות יָרָבְעָ֧ם בֶּן נְבָ֛ט אֲשֶׁר הֶחֱטִ֥יא אֶת יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל בָּ֥/הּ הָלָֽךְ
verses.translit: vy'shh hr' b'yny yhvh l' sr mkhl cht'vt yrb'm bn nbt 'shr hchty' 't yshr'l bh hlkh
verses.translation: And he did that which was evil in the sight of the LORD ; he departed not from all the sins of Jeroboam the son of Nebat, who made Israel sin: but he walked therein.

verses.original: וְ/יֶ֨תֶר דִּבְרֵ֤י יוֹאָשׁ֙ וְ/כָל אֲשֶׁ֣ר עָשָׂ֔ה וּ/גְב֣וּרָת֔/וֹ אֲשֶׁ֣ר נִלְחַ֔ם עִ֖ם אֲמַצְיָ֣ה מֶֽלֶךְ יְהוּדָ֑ה הֲ/לֽוֹא הֵ֣ם כְּתוּבִ֗ים עַל סֵ֛פֶר דִּבְרֵ֥י הַ/יָּמִ֖ים לְ/מַלְכֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל
verses.translit: vytr dbry yv'sh vkhl 'shr 'shh vgbvrtv 'shr nlchm 'm 'mtsyh mlkh yhvdh hlv' hm khtvbym 'l spr dbry hymym lmlkhy yshr'l
verses.translation: And the rest of the acts of Joash, and all that he did, and his might wherewith he fought against Amaziah king of Judah, are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel?

verses.original: וַ/יִּשְׁכַּ֤ב יוֹאָשׁ֙ עִם אֲבֹתָ֔י/ו וְ/יָרָבְעָ֖ם יָשַׁ֣ב עַל כִּסְא֑/וֹ וַ/יִּקָּבֵ֤ר יוֹאָשׁ֙ בְּ/שֹׁ֣מְר֔וֹן עִ֖ם מַלְכֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל
verses.translit: vyshkhb yv'sh 'm 'btyv vyrb'm yshb 'l khs'v vyqbr yv'sh bshmrvn 'm mlkhy yshr'l
verses.translation: And Joash slept with his fathers; and Jeroboam sat upon his throne: and Joash was buried in Samaria with the kings of Israel.

verses.original: וֶֽ/אֱלִישָׁע֙ חָלָ֣ה אֶת חָלְי֔/וֹ אֲשֶׁ֥ר יָמ֖וּת בּ֑/וֹ וַ/יֵּ֨רֶד אֵלָ֜י/ו יוֹאָ֣שׁ מֶֽלֶךְ יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל וַ/יֵּ֤בְךְּ עַל פָּנָי/ו֙ וַ/יֹּאמַ֔ר אָבִ֣/י אָבִ֔/י רֶ֥כֶב יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל וּ/פָרָשָֽׁי/ו
verses.translit: v'lysh' chlh 't chlyv 'shr ymvt bv vyrd 'lyv yv'sh mlkh yshr'l vybkh 'l pnyv vy'mr 'by 'by rkhb yshr'l vprshyv
verses.translation: Now Elisha was fallen sick of his sickness whereof he died. And Joash the king of Israel came down unto him, and wept over his face, and said, O my father, my father, the chariot of Israel, and the horsemen thereof.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֤אמֶר ל/וֹ֙ אֱלִישָׁ֔ע קַ֖ח קֶ֣שֶׁת וְ/חִצִּ֑ים וַ/יִּקַּ֥ח אֵלָ֖י/ו קֶ֥שֶׁת וְ/חִצִּֽים
verses.translit: vy'mr lv 'lysh' qch qsht vchtsym vyqch 'lyv qsht vchtsym
verses.translation: And Elisha said unto him, Take bow and arrows. And he took unto him bow and arrows.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֣אמֶר לְ/מֶ֣לֶךְ יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל הַרְכֵּ֤ב יָֽדְ/ךָ֙ עַל הַ/קֶּ֔שֶׁת וַ/יַּרְכֵּ֖ב יָד֑/וֹ וַ/יָּ֧שֶׂם אֱלִישָׁ֛ע יָדָ֖י/ו עַל יְדֵ֥י הַ/מֶּֽלֶךְ
verses.translit: vy'mr lmlkh yshr'l hrkhb ydkh 'l hqsht vyrkhb ydv vyshm 'lysh' ydyv 'l ydy hmlkh
verses.translation: And he said to the king of Israel, Put thine hand upon the bow. And he put his hand upon it: and Elisha put his hands upon the king’s hands.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֗אמֶר פְּתַ֧ח הַ/חַלּ֛וֹן קֵ֖דְמָ/ה וַ/יִּפְתָּ֑ח וַ/יֹּ֤אמֶר אֱלִישָׁ֤ע יְרֵה֙ וַ/יּ֔וֹר וַ/יֹּ֗אמֶר חֵץ תְּשׁוּעָ֤ה לַֽ/יהוָה֙ וְ/חֵ֣ץ תְּשׁוּעָ֣ה בַֽ/אֲרָ֔ם וְ/הִכִּיתָ֧ אֶת אֲרָ֛ם בַּ/אֲפֵ֖ק עַד כַּלֵּֽה
verses.translit: vy'mr ptch hchlvn qdmh vyptch vy'mr 'lysh' yrh vyvr vy'mr chts tshv'h lyhvh vchts tshv'h b'rm vhkhyt 't 'rm b'pq 'd khlh
verses.translation: And he said, Open the window eastward. And he opened it . Then Elisha said, Shoot. And he shot. And he said, The arrow of the LORD’s deliverance, and the arrow of deliverance from Syria: for thou shalt smite the Syrians in Aphek, till thou have consumed them .

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֛אמֶר קַ֥ח הַ/חִצִּ֖ים וַ/יִּקָּ֑ח וַ/יֹּ֤אמֶר לְ/מֶֽלֶךְ יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ הַךְ אַ֔רְצָ/ה וַ/יַּ֥ךְ שָֽׁלֹשׁ פְּעָמִ֖ים וַֽ/יַּעֲמֹֽד
verses.translit: vy'mr qch hchtsym vyqch vy'mr lmlkh yshr'l hkh 'rtsh vykh shlsh p'mym vy'md
verses.translation: And he said, Take the arrows. And he took them . And he said unto the king of Israel, Smite upon the ground. And he smote thrice, and stayed.

verses.original: וַ/יִּקְצֹ֨ף עָלָ֜י/ו אִ֣ישׁ הָ/אֱלֹהִ֗ים וַ/יֹּ֨אמֶר֙ לְ/הַכּ֨וֹת חָמֵ֤שׁ אוֹ שֵׁשׁ֙ פְּעָמִ֔ים אָ֛ז הִכִּ֥יתָ אֶת אֲרָ֖ם עַד כַּלֵּ֑ה וְ/עַתָּ֕ה שָׁלֹ֥שׁ פְּעָמִ֖ים תַּכֶּ֥ה אֶת אֲרָֽם
verses.translit: vyqtsf 'lyv 'ysh h'lhym vy'mr lhkhvt chmsh 'v shsh p'mym 'z hkhyt 't 'rm 'd khlh v'th shlsh p'mym tkhh 't 'rm
verses.translation: And the man of God was wroth with him, and said, Thou shouldest have smitten five or six times; then hadst thou smitten Syria till thou hadst consumed it: whereas now thou shalt smite Syria but thrice.

verses.original: וַ/יָּ֥מָת אֱלִישָׁ֖ע וַֽ/יִּקְבְּרֻ֑/הוּ וּ/גְדוּדֵ֥י מוֹאָ֛ב יָבֹ֥אוּ בָ/אָ֖רֶץ בָּ֥א שָׁנָֽה
verses.translit: vymt 'lysh' vyqbrhv vgdvdy mv'b yb'v b'rts b' shnh
verses.translation: And Elisha died, and they buried him. And the bands of the Moabites invaded the land at the coming in of the year.

verses.original: וַ/יְהִ֞י הֵ֣ם קֹבְרִ֣ים אִ֗ישׁ וְ/הִנֵּה֙ רָא֣וּ אֶֽת הַ/גְּד֔וּד וַ/יַּשְׁלִ֥יכוּ אֶת הָ/אִ֖ישׁ בְּ/קֶ֣בֶר אֱלִישָׁ֑ע וַ/יֵּ֜לֶךְ וַ/יִּגַּ֤ע הָ/אִישׁ֙ בְּ/עַצְמ֣וֹת אֱלִישָׁ֔ע וַ/יְחִ֖י וַ/יָּ֥קָם עַל רַגְלָֽי/ו
verses.translit: vyhy hm qbrym 'ysh vhnh r'v 't hgdvd vyshlykhv 't h'ysh bqbr 'lysh' vylkh vyg' h'ysh b'tsmvt 'lysh' vychy vyqm 'l rglyv
verses.translation: And it came to pass, as they were burying a man, that, behold, they spied a band of men; and they cast the man into the sepulchre of Elisha: and when the man was let down, and touched the bones of Elisha, he revived, and stood up on his feet.

verses.original: וַֽ/חֲזָאֵל֙ מֶ֣לֶךְ אֲרָ֔ם לָחַ֖ץ אֶת יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל כֹּ֖ל יְמֵ֥י יְהוֹאָחָֽז
verses.translit: vchz'l mlkh 'rm lchts 't yshr'l khl ymy yhv'chz
verses.translation: But Hazael king of Syria oppressed Israel all the days of Jehoahaz.

verses.original: וַ/יָּחָן֩ יְהוָ֨ה אֹתָ֤/ם וַֽ/יְרַחֲמֵ/ם֙ וַ/יִּ֣פֶן אֲלֵי/הֶ֔ם לְמַ֣עַן בְּרִית֔/וֹ אֶת אַבְרָהָ֖ם יִצְחָ֣ק וְ/יַֽעֲקֹ֑ב וְ/לֹ֤א אָבָה֙ הַשְׁחִיתָ֔/ם וְ/לֹֽא הִשְׁלִיכָ֥/ם מֵֽ/עַל פָּנָ֖י/ו עַד עָֽתָּה
verses.translit: vychn yhvh 'tm vyrchmm vypn 'lyhm lm'n brytv 't 'brhm ytschq vy'qb vl' 'bh hshchytm vl' hshlykhm m'l pnyv 'd 'th
verses.translation: And the LORD was gracious unto them, and had compassion on them, and had respect unto them, because of his covenant with Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob, and would not destroy them, neither cast he them from his presence as yet.

verses.original: וַ/יָּ֖מָת חֲזָאֵ֣ל מֶֽלֶךְ אֲרָ֑ם וַ/יִּמְלֹ֛ךְ בֶּן הֲדַ֥ד בְּנ֖/וֹ תַּחְתָּֽי/ו
verses.translit: vymt chz'l mlkh 'rm vymlkh bn hdd bnv tchtyv
verses.translation: So Hazael king of Syria died; and Ben-hadad his son reigned in his stead.

verses.original: וַ/יָּ֜שָׁב יְהוֹאָ֣שׁ בֶּן יְהוֹאָחָ֗ז וַ/יִּקַּ֤ח אֶת הֶֽ/עָרִים֙ מִ/יַּד֙ בֶּן הֲדַ֣ד בֶּן חֲזָאֵ֔ל אֲשֶׁ֣ר לָקַ֗ח מִ/יַּ֛ד יְהוֹאָחָ֥ז אָבִ֖י/ו בַּ/מִּלְחָמָ֑ה שָׁלֹ֤שׁ פְּעָמִים֙ הִכָּ֣/הוּ יוֹאָ֔שׁ וַ/יָּ֖שֶׁב אֶת עָרֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל
verses.translit: vyshb yhv'sh bn yhv'chz vyqch 't h'rym myd bn hdd bn chz'l 'shr lqch myd yhv'chz 'byv bmlchmh shlsh p'mym hkhhv yv'sh vyshb 't 'ry yshr'l
verses.translation: And Jehoash the son of Jehoahaz took again out of the hand of Ben-hadad the son of Hazael the cities, which he had taken out of the hand of Jehoahaz his father by war. Three times did Joash beat him, and recovered the cities of Israel.

verses.original: בִּ/שְׁנַ֣ת שְׁתַּ֔יִם לְ/יוֹאָ֥שׁ בֶּן יוֹאָחָ֖ז מֶ֣לֶךְ יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל מָלַ֛ךְ אֲמַצְיָ֥הוּ בֶן יוֹאָ֖שׁ מֶ֥לֶךְ יְהוּדָֽה
verses.translit: bshnt shtym lyv'sh bn yv'chz mlkh yshr'l mlkh 'mtsyhv bn yv'sh mlkh yhvdh
verses.translation: In the second year of Joash son of Jehoahaz king of Israel reigned Amaziah the son of Joash king of Judah.

verses.original: בֶּן עֶשְׂרִ֨ים וְ/חָמֵ֤שׁ שָׁנָה֙ הָיָ֣ה בְ/מָלְכ֔/וֹ וְ/עֶשְׂרִ֤ים וָ/תֵ֨שַׁע֙ שָׁנָ֔ה מָלַ֖ךְ בִּ/ירוּשָׁלִָ֑ם וְ/שֵׁ֣ם אִמּ֔/וֹ יהועדין יְהֽוֹעַדָּ֖ן מִן יְרוּשָׁלִָֽם
verses.translit: bn 'shrym vchmsh shnh hyh bmlkhv v'shrym vtsh' shnh mlkh byrvshlm vshm 'mv yhv'dyn yhv'dn mn yrvshlm
verses.translation: He was twenty and five years old when he began to reign, and reigned twenty and nine years in Jerusalem. And his mother’s name was Jehoaddan of Jerusalem.

verses.original: וַ/יַּ֤עַשׂ הַ/יָּשָׁר֙ בְּ/עֵינֵ֣י יְהוָ֔ה רַ֕ק לֹ֖א כְּ/דָוִ֣ד אָבִ֑י/ו כְּ/כֹ֧ל אֲשֶׁר עָשָׂ֛ה יוֹאָ֥שׁ אָבִ֖י/ו עָשָֽׂה
verses.translit: vy'sh hyshr b'yny yhvh rq l' khdvd 'byv khkhl 'shr 'shh yv'sh 'byv 'shh
verses.translation: And he did that which was right in the sight of the LORD , yet not like David his father: he did according to all things as Joash his father did.

verses.original: רַ֥ק הַ/בָּמ֖וֹת לֹא סָ֑רוּ ע֥וֹד הָ/עָ֛ם מְזַבְּחִ֥ים וּֽ/מְקַטְּרִ֖ים בַּ/בָּמֽוֹת
verses.translit: rq hbmvt l' srv 'vd h'm mzbchym vmqtrym bbmvt
verses.translation: Howbeit the high places were not taken away: as yet the people did sacrifice and burnt incense on the high places.

verses.original: וַ/יְהִ֕י כַּ/אֲשֶׁ֛ר חָזְקָ֥ה הַ/מַּמְלָכָ֖ה בְּ/יָד֑/וֹ וַ/יַּךְ֙ אֶת עֲבָדָ֔י/ו הַ/מַּכִּ֖ים אֶת הַ/מֶּ֥לֶךְ אָבִֽי/ו
verses.translit: vyhy kh'shr chzqh hmmlkhh bydv vykh 't 'bdyv hmkhym 't hmlkh 'byv
verses.translation: And it came to pass, as soon as the kingdom was confirmed in his hand, that he slew his servants which had slain the king his father.

verses.original: וְ/אֶת בְּנֵ֥י הַ/מַּכִּ֖ים לֹ֣א הֵמִ֑ית כַּ/כָּת֣וּב בְּ/סֵ֣פֶר תּֽוֹרַת מֹ֠שֶׁה אֲשֶׁר צִוָּ֨ה יְהוָ֜ה לֵ/אמֹ֗ר לֹא יוּמְת֨וּ אָב֤וֹת עַל בָּנִים֙ וּ/בָנִים֙ לֹא יוּמְת֣וּ עַל אָב֔וֹת כִּ֛י אִם אִ֥ישׁ בְּ/חֶטְא֖/וֹ ימות יוּמָֽת
verses.translit: v't bny hmkhym l' hmyt khkhtvb bspr tvrt mshh 'shr tsvh yhvh l'mr l' yvmtv 'bvt 'l bnym vbnym l' yvmtv 'l 'bvt khy 'm 'ysh bcht'v ymvt yvmt
verses.translation: But the children of the murderers he slew not: according unto that which is written in the book of the law of Moses, wherein the LORD commanded, saying, The fathers shall not be put to death for the children, nor the children be put to death for the fathers; but every man shall be put to death for his own sin.

verses.original: הוּא הִכָּ֨ה אֶת אֱד֤וֹם בְּ/גֵיא המלח מֶ֨לַח֙ עֲשֶׂ֣רֶת אֲלָפִ֔ים וְ/תָפַ֥שׂ אֶת הַ/סֶּ֖לַע בַּ/מִּלְחָמָ֑ה וַ/יִּקְרָ֤א אֶת שְׁמָ/הּ֙ יָקְתְאֵ֔ל עַ֖ד הַ/יּ֥וֹם הַ/זֶּֽה
verses.translit: hv' hkhh 't 'dvm bgy' hmlch mlch 'shrt 'lpym vtpsh 't hsl' bmlchmh vyqr' 't shmh yqt'l 'd hyvm hzh
verses.translation: He slew of Edom in the valley of salt ten thousand, and took Selah by war, and called the name of it Joktheel unto this day.

verses.original: אָ֣ז שָׁלַ֤ח אֲמַצְיָה֙ מַלְאָכִ֔ים אֶל יְהוֹאָ֨שׁ בֶּן יְהוֹאָחָ֧ז בֶּן יֵה֛וּא מֶ֥לֶךְ יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל לֵ/אמֹ֑ר לְכָ֖/ה נִתְרָאֶ֥ה פָנִֽים
verses.translit: 'z shlch 'mtsyh ml'khym 'l yhv'sh bn yhv'chz bn yhv' mlkh yshr'l l'mr lkhh ntr'h pnym
verses.translation: Then Amaziah sent messengers to Jehoash, the son of Jehoahaz son of Jehu, king of Israel, saying, Come, let us look one another in the face.

verses.original: וַ/יִּשְׁלַ֞ח יְהוֹאָ֣שׁ מֶֽלֶךְ יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל אֶל אֲמַצְיָ֣הוּ מֶֽלֶךְ יְהוּדָה֮ לֵ/אמֹר֒ הַ/ח֜וֹחַ אֲשֶׁ֣ר בַּ/לְּבָנ֗וֹן שָׁ֠לַח אֶל הָ/אֶ֜רֶז אֲשֶׁ֤ר בַּ/לְּבָנוֹן֙ לֵ/אמֹ֔ר תְּנָֽ/ה אֶת בִּתְּ/ךָ֥ לִ/בְנִ֖/י לְ/אִשָּׁ֑ה וַֽ/תַּעֲבֹ֞ר חַיַּ֤ת הַ/שָּׂדֶה֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר בַּ/לְּבָנ֔וֹן וַ/תִּרְמֹ֖ס אֶת הַ/חֽוֹחַ
verses.translit: vyshlch yhv'sh mlkh yshr'l 'l 'mtsyhv mlkh yhvdh l'mr hchvch 'shr blbnvn shlch 'l h'rz 'shr blbnvn l'mr tnh 't btkh lbny l'shh vt'br chyt hshdh 'shr blbnvn vtrms 't hchvch
verses.translation: And Jehoash the king of Israel sent to Amaziah king of Judah, saying, The thistle that was in Lebanon sent to the cedar that was in Lebanon, saying, Give thy daughter to my son to wife: and there passed by a wild beast that was in Lebanon, and trode down the thistle.

verses.original: הַכֵּ֤ה הִכִּ֨יתָ֙ אֶת אֱד֔וֹם וּֽ/נְשָׂאֲ/ךָ֖ לִבֶּ֑/ךָ הִכָּבֵד֙ וְ/שֵׁ֣ב בְּ/בֵיתֶ֔/ךָ וְ/לָ֤/מָּה תִתְגָּרֶה֙ בְּ/רָעָ֔ה וְ/נָ֣פַלְתָּ֔ה אַתָּ֖ה וִ/יהוּדָ֥ה עִמָּֽ/ךְ
verses.translit: hkhh hkhyt 't 'dvm vnsh'kh lbkh hkhbd vshb bbytkh vlmh ttgrh br'h vnplth 'th vyhvdh 'mkh
verses.translation: Thou hast indeed smitten Edom, and thine heart hath lifted thee up: glory of this , and tarry at home: for why shouldest thou meddle to thy hurt, that thou shouldest fall, even thou, and Judah with thee?

verses.original: וְ/לֹא שָׁמַ֣ע אֲמַצְיָ֔הוּ וַ/יַּ֨עַל יְהוֹאָ֤שׁ מֶֽלֶךְ יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ וַ/יִּתְרָא֣וּ פָנִ֔ים ה֖וּא וַ/אֲמַצְיָ֣הוּ מֶֽלֶךְ יְהוּדָ֑ה בְּ/בֵ֥ית שֶׁ֖מֶשׁ אֲשֶׁ֥ר לִ/יהוּדָֽה
verses.translit: vl' shm' 'mtsyhv vy'l yhv'sh mlkh yshr'l vytr'v pnym hv' v'mtsyhv mlkh yhvdh bbyt shmsh 'shr lyhvdh
verses.translation: But Amaziah would not hear. Therefore Jehoash king of Israel went up; and he and Amaziah king of Judah looked one another in the face at Beth-shemesh, which belongeth to Judah.

verses.original: וַ/יִּנָּ֥גֶף יְהוּדָ֖ה לִ/פְנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וַ/יָּנֻ֖סוּ אִ֥ישׁ ל/אהל/ו לְ/אֹהָלָֽי/ו
verses.translit: vyngf yhvdh lpny yshr'l vynsv 'ysh l'hlv l'hlyv
verses.translation: And Judah was put to the worse before Israel; and they fled every man to their tents.

verses.original: וְ/אֵת֩ אֲמַצְיָ֨הוּ מֶֽלֶךְ יְהוּדָ֜ה בֶּן יְהוֹאָ֣שׁ בֶּן אֲחַזְיָ֗הוּ תָּפַ֛שׂ יְהוֹאָ֥שׁ מֶֽלֶךְ יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל בְּ/בֵ֣ית שָׁ֑מֶשׁ ו/יבאו וַ/יָּבֹא֙ יְר֣וּשָׁלִַ֔ם וַ/יִּפְרֹץ֩ בְּ/חוֹמַ֨ת יְרוּשָׁלִַ֜ם בְּ/שַׁ֤עַר אֶפְרַ֨יִם֙ עַד שַׁ֣עַר הַ/פִּנָּ֔ה אַרְבַּ֥ע מֵא֖וֹת אַמָּֽה
verses.translit: v't 'mtsyhv mlkh yhvdh bn yhv'sh bn 'chzyhv tpsh yhv'sh mlkh yshr'l bbyt shmsh vyb'v vyb' yrvshlm vyprts bchvmt yrvshlm bsh'r 'prym 'd sh'r hpnh 'rb' m'vt 'mh
verses.translation: And Jehoash king of Israel took Amaziah king of Judah, the son of Jehoash the son of Ahaziah, at Beth-shemesh, and came to Jerusalem, and brake down the wall of Jerusalem from the gate of Ephraim unto the corner gate, four hundred cubits.

verses.original: וְ/לָקַ֣ח אֶת כָּל הַ/זָּהָב וְ֠/הַ/כֶּסֶף וְ/אֵ֨ת כָּל הַ/כֵּלִ֜ים הַ/נִּמְצְאִ֣ים בֵּית יְהוָ֗ה וּ/בְ/אֹֽצְרוֹת֙ בֵּ֣ית הַ/מֶּ֔לֶךְ וְ/אֵ֖ת בְּנֵ֣י הַ/תַּֽעֲרֻב֑וֹת וַ/יָּ֖שָׁב שֹׁמְרֽוֹנָ/ה
verses.translit: vlqch 't khl hzhb vhkhsf v't khl hkhlym hnmts'ym byt yhvh vb'tsrvt byt hmlkh v't bny ht'rbvt vyshb shmrvnh
verses.translation: And he took all the gold and silver, and all the vessels that were found in the house of the LORD , and in the treasures of the king’s house, and hostages, and returned to Samaria.

verses.original: וְ/יֶתֶר֩ דִּבְרֵ֨י יְהוֹאָ֜שׁ אֲשֶׁ֤ר עָשָׂה֙ וּ/גְב֣וּרָת֔/וֹ וַ/אֲשֶׁ֣ר נִלְחַ֔ם עִ֖ם אֲמַצְיָ֣הוּ מֶֽלֶךְ יְהוּדָ֑ה הֲ/לֹא הֵ֣ם כְּתוּבִ֗ים עַל סֵ֛פֶר דִּבְרֵ֥י הַ/יָּמִ֖ים לְ/מַלְכֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל
verses.translit: vytr dbry yhv'sh 'shr 'shh vgbvrtv v'shr nlchm 'm 'mtsyhv mlkh yhvdh hl' hm khtvbym 'l spr dbry hymym lmlkhy yshr'l
verses.translation: Now the rest of the acts of Jehoash which he did, and his might, and how he fought with Amaziah king of Judah, are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel?

verses.original: וַ/יִּשְׁכַּ֤ב יְהוֹאָשׁ֙ עִם אֲבֹתָ֔י/ו וַ/יִּקָּבֵר֙ בְּ/שֹׁ֣מְר֔וֹן עִ֖ם מַלְכֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וַ/יִּמְלֹ֛ךְ יָרָבְעָ֥ם בְּנ֖/וֹ תַּחְתָּֽי/ו
verses.translit: vyshkhb yhv'sh 'm 'btyv vyqbr bshmrvn 'm mlkhy yshr'l vymlkh yrb'm bnv tchtyv
verses.translation: And Jehoash slept with his fathers, and was buried in Samaria with the kings of Israel; and Jeroboam his son reigned in his stead.

verses.original: וַ/יְחִ֨י אֲמַצְיָ֤הוּ בֶן יוֹאָשׁ֙ מֶ֣לֶךְ יְהוּדָ֔ה אַֽחֲרֵ֣י מ֔וֹת יְהוֹאָ֥שׁ בֶּן יְהֽוֹאָחָ֖ז מֶ֣לֶךְ יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל חֲמֵ֥שׁ עֶשְׂרֵ֖ה שָׁנָֽה
verses.translit: vychy 'mtsyhv bn yv'sh mlkh yhvdh 'chry mvt yhv'sh bn yhv'chz mlkh yshr'l chmsh 'shrh shnh
verses.translation: And Amaziah the son of Joash king of Judah lived after the death of Jehoash son of Jehoahaz king of Israel fifteen years.

verses.original: וְ/יֶ֖תֶר דִּבְרֵ֣י אֲמַצְיָ֑הוּ הֲ/לֹא הֵ֣ם כְּתוּבִ֗ים עַל סֵ֛פֶר דִּבְרֵ֥י הַ/יָּמִ֖ים לְ/מַלְכֵ֥י יְהוּדָֽה
verses.translit: vytr dbry 'mtsyhv hl' hm khtvbym 'l spr dbry hymym lmlkhy yhvdh
verses.translation: And the rest of the acts of Amaziah, are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah?

verses.original: וַ/יִּקְשְׁר֨וּ עָלָ֥י/ו קֶ֛שֶׁר בִּ/ירוּשָׁלִַ֖ם וַ/יָּ֣נָס לָכִ֑ישָׁ/ה וַ/יִּשְׁלְח֤וּ אַֽחֲרָי/ו֙ לָכִ֔ישָׁ/ה וַ/יְמִתֻ֖/הוּ שָֽׁם
verses.translit: vyqshrv 'lyv qshr byrvshlm vyns lkhyshh vyshlchv 'chryv lkhyshh vymthv shm
verses.translation: Now they made a conspiracy against him in Jerusalem: and he fled to Lachish; but they sent after him to Lachish, and slew him there.

verses.original: וַ/יִּשְׂא֥וּ אֹת֖/וֹ עַל הַ/סּוּסִ֑ים וַ/יִּקָּבֵ֧ר בִּ/ירוּשָׁלִַ֛ם עִם אֲבֹתָ֖י/ו בְּ/עִ֥יר דָּוִֽד
verses.translit: vysh'v 'tv 'l hsvsym vyqbr byrvshlm 'm 'btyv b'yr dvd
verses.translation: And they brought him on horses: and he was buried at Jerusalem with his fathers in the city of David.

verses.original: וַ/יִּקְח֞וּ כָּל עַ֤ם יְהוּדָה֙ אֶת עֲזַרְיָ֔ה וְ/ה֕וּא בֶּן שֵׁ֥שׁ עֶשְׂרֵ֖ה שָׁנָ֑ה וַ/יַּמְלִ֣כוּ אֹת֔/וֹ תַּ֖חַת אָבִ֥י/ו אֲמַצְיָֽהוּ
verses.translit: vyqchv khl 'm yhvdh 't 'zryh vhv' bn shsh 'shrh shnh vymlkhv 'tv tcht 'byv 'mtsyhv
verses.translation: And all the people of Judah took Azariah, which was sixteen years old, and made him king instead of his father Amaziah.

verses.original: ה֚וּא בָּנָ֣ה אֶת אֵילַ֔ת וַ/יְשִׁבֶ֖/הָ לִֽ/יהוּדָ֑ה אַחֲרֵ֥י שְׁכַֽב הַ/מֶּ֖לֶךְ עִם אֲבֹתָֽי/ו
verses.translit: hv' bnh 't 'ylt vyshbh lyhvdh 'chry shkhb hmlkh 'm 'btyv
verses.translation: He built Elath, and restored it to Judah, after that the king slept with his fathers.

verses.original: בִּ/שְׁנַת֙ חֲמֵשׁ עֶשְׂרֵ֣ה שָׁנָ֔ה לַ/אֲמַצְיָ֥הוּ בֶן יוֹאָ֖שׁ מֶ֣לֶךְ יְהוּדָ֑ה מָ֠לַךְ יָרָבְעָ֨ם בֶּן יוֹאָ֤שׁ מֶֽלֶךְ יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ בְּ/שֹׁ֣מְר֔וֹן אַרְבָּעִ֥ים וְ/אַחַ֖ת שָׁנָֽה
verses.translit: bshnt chmsh 'shrh shnh l'mtsyhv bn yv'sh mlkh yhvdh mlkh yrb'm bn yv'sh mlkh yshr'l bshmrvn 'rb'ym v'cht shnh
verses.translation: In the fifteenth year of Amaziah the son of Joash king of Judah Jeroboam the son of Joash king of Israel began to reign in Samaria, and reigned forty and one years.

verses.original: וַ/יַּ֥עַשׂ הָ/רַ֖ע בְּ/עֵינֵ֣י יְהוָ֑ה לֹ֣א סָ֗ר מִ/כָּל חַטֹּאות֙ יָרָבְעָ֣ם בֶּן נְבָ֔ט אֲשֶׁ֥ר הֶחֱטִ֖יא אֶת יִשְׂרָאֵֽל
verses.translit: vy'sh hr' b'yny yhvh l' sr mkhl cht'vt yrb'm bn nbt 'shr hchty' 't yshr'l
verses.translation: And he did that which was evil in the sight of the LORD : he departed not from all the sins of Jeroboam the son of Nebat, who made Israel to sin.

verses.original: ה֗וּא הֵשִׁיב֙ אֶת גְּב֣וּל יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל מִ/לְּב֥וֹא חֲמָ֖ת עַד יָ֣ם הָ/עֲרָבָ֑ה כִּ/דְבַ֤ר יְהוָה֙ אֱלֹהֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל אֲשֶׁ֣ר דִּבֶּ֗ר בְּ/יַד עַבְדּ֞/וֹ יוֹנָ֤ה בֶן אֲמִתַּי֙ הַ/נָּבִ֔יא אֲשֶׁ֖ר מִ/גַּ֥ת הַחֵֽפֶר
verses.translit: hv' hshyb 't gbvl yshr'l mlbv' chmt 'd ym h'rbh khdbr yhvh 'lhy yshr'l 'shr dbr byd 'bdv yvnh bn 'mty hnby' 'shr mgt hchpr
verses.translation: He restored the coast of Israel from the entering of Hamath unto the sea of the plain, according to the word of the LORD God of Israel, which he spake by the hand of his servant Jonah, the son of Amittai, the prophet, which was of Gath-hepher.

verses.original: כִּי רָאָ֧ה יְהוָ֛ה אֶת עֳנִ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל מֹרֶ֣ה מְאֹ֑ד וְ/אֶ֤פֶס עָצוּר֙ וְ/אֶ֣פֶס עָז֔וּב וְ/אֵ֥ין עֹזֵ֖ר לְ/יִשְׂרָאֵֽל
verses.translit: khy r'h yhvh 't 'ny yshr'l mrh m'd v'ps 'tsvr v'ps 'zvb v'yn 'zr lyshr'l
verses.translation: For the LORD saw the affliction of Israel, that it was very bitter: for there was not any shut up, nor any left, nor any helper for Israel.

verses.original: וְ/לֹא דִבֶּ֣ר יְהוָ֔ה לִ/מְחוֹת֙ אֶת שֵׁ֣ם יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל מִ/תַּ֖חַת הַ/שָּׁמָ֑יִם וַ/יּ֣וֹשִׁיעֵ֔/ם בְּ/יַ֖ד יָרָבְעָ֥ם בֶּן יוֹאָֽשׁ
verses.translit: vl' dbr yhvh lmchvt 't shm yshr'l mtcht hshmym vyvshy'm byd yrb'm bn yv'sh
verses.translation: And the LORD said not that he would blot out the name of Israel from under heaven: but he saved them by the hand of Jeroboam the son of Joash.

verses.original: וְ/יֶתֶר֩ דִּבְרֵ֨י יָרָבְעָ֜ם וְ/כָל אֲשֶׁ֤ר עָשָׂה֙ וּ/גְבוּרָת֣/וֹ אֲשֶׁר נִלְחָ֔ם וַ/אֲשֶׁ֨ר הֵשִׁ֜יב אֶת דַּמֶּ֧שֶׂק וְ/אֶת חֲמָ֛ת לִ/יהוּדָ֖ה בְּ/יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל הֲ/לֹא הֵ֣ם כְּתוּבִ֗ים עַל סֵ֛פֶר דִּבְרֵ֥י הַ/יָּמִ֖ים לְ/מַלְכֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל
verses.translit: vytr dbry yrb'm vkhl 'shr 'shh vgbvrtv 'shr nlchm v'shr hshyb 't dmshq v't chmt lyhvdh byshr'l hl' hm khtvbym 'l spr dbry hymym lmlkhy yshr'l
verses.translation: Now the rest of the acts of Jeroboam, and all that he did, and his might, how he warred, and how he recovered Damascus, and Hamath, which belonged to Judah, for Israel, are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel?

verses.original: וַ/יִּשְׁכַּ֤ב יָֽרָבְעָם֙ עִם אֲבֹתָ֔י/ו עִ֖ם מַלְכֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וַ/יִּמְלֹ֛ךְ זְכַרְיָ֥ה בְנ֖/וֹ תַּחְתָּֽי/ו
verses.translit: vyshkhb yrb'm 'm 'btyv 'm mlkhy yshr'l vymlkh zkhryh bnv tchtyv
verses.translation: And Jeroboam slept with his fathers, even with the kings of Israel; and Zachariah his son reigned in his stead.

verses.original: בִּ/שְׁנַ֨ת עֶשְׂרִ֤ים וָ/שֶׁ֨בַע֙ שָׁנָ֔ה לְ/יָרָבְעָ֖ם מֶ֣לֶךְ יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל מָלַ֛ךְ עֲזַרְיָ֥ה בֶן אֲמַצְיָ֖ה מֶ֥לֶךְ יְהוּדָֽה
verses.translit: bshnt 'shrym vshb' shnh lyrb'm mlkh yshr'l mlkh 'zryh bn 'mtsyh mlkh yhvdh
verses.translation: In the twenty and seventh year of Jeroboam king of Israel began Azariah son of Amaziah king of Judah to reign.

verses.original: בֶּן שֵׁ֨שׁ עֶשְׂרֵ֤ה שָׁנָה֙ הָיָ֣ה בְ/מָלְכ֔/וֹ וַ/חֲמִשִּׁ֤ים וּ/שְׁתַּ֨יִם֙ שָׁנָ֔ה מָלַ֖ךְ בִּ/ירוּשָׁלִָ֑ם וְ/שֵׁ֣ם אִמּ֔/וֹ יְכָלְיָ֖הוּ מִ/ירוּשָׁלִָֽם
verses.translit: bn shsh 'shrh shnh hyh bmlkhv vchmshym vshtym shnh mlkh byrvshlm vshm 'mv ykhlyhv myrvshlm
verses.translation: Sixteen years old was he when he began to reign, and he reigned two and fifty years in Jerusalem. And his mother’s name was Jecholiah of Jerusalem.

verses.original: וַ/יַּ֥עַשׂ הַ/יָּשָׁ֖ר בְּ/עֵינֵ֣י יְהוָ֑ה כְּ/כֹ֥ל אֲשֶׁר עָשָׂ֖ה אֲמַצְיָ֥הוּ אָבִֽי/ו
verses.translit: vy'sh hyshr b'yny yhvh khkhl 'shr 'shh 'mtsyhv 'byv
verses.translation: And he did that which was right in the sight of the LORD , according to all that his father Amaziah had done;

verses.original: רַ֥ק הַ/בָּמ֖וֹת לֹא סָ֑רוּ ע֥וֹד הָ/עָ֛ם מְזַבְּחִ֥ים וּֽ/מְקַטְּרִ֖ים בַּ/בָּמֽוֹת
verses.translit: rq hbmvt l' srv 'vd h'm mzbchym vmqtrym bbmvt
verses.translation: Save that the high places were not removed: the people sacrificed and burnt incense still on the high places.

verses.original: וַ/יְנַגַּ֨ע יְהוָ֜ה אֶת הַ/מֶּ֗לֶךְ וַ/יְהִ֤י מְצֹרָע֙ עַד י֣וֹם מֹת֔/וֹ וַ/יֵּ֖שֶׁב בְּ/בֵ֣ית הַ/חָפְשִׁ֑ית וְ/יוֹתָ֤ם בֶּן הַ/מֶּ֨לֶךְ֙ עַל הַ/בַּ֔יִת שֹׁפֵ֖ט אֶת עַ֥ם הָ/אָֽרֶץ
verses.translit: vyng' yhvh 't hmlkh vyhy mtsr' 'd yvm mtv vyshb bbyt hchpshyt vyvtm bn hmlkh 'l hbyt shpt 't 'm h'rts
verses.translation: And the LORD smote the king, so that he was a leper unto the day of his death, and dwelt in a several house. And Jotham the king’s son was over the house, judging the people of the land.

verses.original: וְ/יֶ֛תֶר דִּבְרֵ֥י עֲזַרְיָ֖הוּ וְ/כָל אֲשֶׁ֣ר עָשָׂ֑ה הֲ/לֹא הֵ֣ם כְּתוּבִ֗ים עַל סֵ֛פֶר דִּבְרֵ֥י הַ/יָּמִ֖ים לְ/מַלְכֵ֥י יְהוּדָֽה
verses.translit: vytr dbry 'zryhv vkhl 'shr 'shh hl' hm khtvbym 'l spr dbry hymym lmlkhy yhvdh
verses.translation: And the rest of the acts of Azariah, and all that he did, are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah?

verses.original: וַ/יִּשְׁכַּ֤ב עֲזַרְיָה֙ עִם אֲבֹתָ֔י/ו וַ/יִּקְבְּר֥וּ אֹת֛/וֹ עִם אֲבֹתָ֖י/ו בְּ/עִ֣יר דָּוִ֑ד וַ/יִּמְלֹ֛ךְ יוֹתָ֥ם בְּנ֖/וֹ תַּחְתָּֽי/ו
verses.translit: vyshkhb 'zryh 'm 'btyv vyqbrv 'tv 'm 'btyv b'yr dvd vymlkh yvtm bnv tchtyv
verses.translation: So Azariah slept with his fathers; and they buried him with his fathers in the city of David: and Jotham his son reigned in his stead.

verses.original: בִּ/שְׁנַ֨ת שְׁלֹשִׁ֤ים וּ/שְׁמֹנֶה֙ שָׁנָ֔ה לַ/עֲזַרְיָ֖הוּ מֶ֣לֶךְ יְהוּדָ֑ה מָ֠לַךְ זְכַרְיָ֨הוּ בֶן יָרָבְעָ֧ם עַל יִשְׂרָאֵ֛ל בְּ/שֹׁמְר֖וֹן שִׁשָּׁ֥ה חֳדָשִֽׁים
verses.translit: bshnt shlshym vshmnh shnh l'zryhv mlkh yhvdh mlkh zkhryhv bn yrb'm 'l yshr'l bshmrvn shshh chdshym
verses.translation: In the thirty and eighth year of Azariah king of Judah did Zachariah the son of Jeroboam reign over Israel in Samaria six months.

verses.original: וַ/יַּ֤עַשׂ הָ/רַע֙ בְּ/עֵינֵ֣י יְהוָ֔ה כַּ/אֲשֶׁ֥ר עָשׂ֖וּ אֲבֹתָ֑י/ו לֹ֣א סָ֗ר מֵֽ/חַטֹּאות֙ יָרָבְעָ֣ם בֶּן נְבָ֔ט אֲשֶׁ֥ר הֶחֱטִ֖יא אֶת יִשְׂרָאֵֽל
verses.translit: vy'sh hr' b'yny yhvh kh'shr 'shv 'btyv l' sr mcht'vt yrb'm bn nbt 'shr hchty' 't yshr'l
verses.translation: And he did that which was evil in the sight of the LORD , as his fathers had done: he departed not from the sins of Jeroboam the son of Nebat, who made Israel to sin.

verses.original: וַ/יִּקְשֹׁ֤ר עָלָי/ו֙ שַׁלֻּ֣ם בֶּן יָבֵ֔שׁ וַ/יַּכֵּ֥/הוּ קָֽבָלְ עָ֖ם וַ/יְמִיתֵ֑/הוּ וַ/יִּמְלֹ֖ךְ תַּחְתָּֽי/ו
verses.translit: vyqshr 'lyv shlm bn ybsh vykhhv qbl 'm vymythv vymlkh tchtyv
verses.translation: And Shallum the son of Jabesh conspired against him, and smote him before the people, and slew him, and reigned in his stead.

verses.original: וְ/יֶ֖תֶר דִּבְרֵ֣י זְכַרְיָ֑ה הִנָּ֣/ם כְּתוּבִ֗ים עַל סֵ֛פֶר דִּבְרֵ֥י הַ/יָּמִ֖ים לְ/מַלְכֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל
verses.translit: vytr dbry zkhryh hnm khtvbym 'l spr dbry hymym lmlkhy yshr'l
verses.translation: And the rest of the acts of Zachariah, behold, they are written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel.

verses.original: ה֣וּא דְבַר יְהוָ֗ה אֲשֶׁ֨ר דִּבֶּ֤ר אֶל יֵהוּא֙ לֵ/אמֹ֔ר בְּנֵ֣י רְבִיעִ֔ים יֵשְׁב֥וּ לְ/ךָ֖ עַל כִּסֵּ֣א יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וַֽ/יְהִי כֵֽן
verses.translit: hv' dbr yhvh 'shr dbr 'l yhv' l'mr bny rby'ym yshbv lkh 'l khs' yshr'l vyhy khn
verses.translation: This was the word of the LORD which he spake unto Jehu, saying, Thy sons shall sit on the throne of Israel unto the fourth generation . And so it came to pass.

verses.original: שַׁלּ֤וּם בֶּן יָבֵישׁ֙ מָלַ֔ךְ בִּ/שְׁנַ֨ת שְׁלֹשִׁ֤ים וָ/תֵ֨שַׁע֙ שָׁנָ֔ה לְ/עֻזִיָּ֖ה מֶ֣לֶךְ יְהוּדָ֑ה וַ/יִּמְלֹ֥ךְ יֶֽרַח יָמִ֖ים בְּ/שֹׁמְרֽוֹן
verses.translit: shlvm bn ybysh mlkh bshnt shlshym vtsh' shnh l'zyh mlkh yhvdh vymlkh yrch ymym bshmrvn
verses.translation: Shallum the son of Jabesh began to reign in the nine and thirtieth year of Uzziah king of Judah; and he reigned a full month in Samaria.

verses.original: וַ/יַּעַל֩ מְנַחֵ֨ם בֶּן גָּדִ֜י מִ/תִּרְצָ֗ה וַ/יָּבֹא֙ שֹׁמְר֔וֹן וַ/יַּ֛ךְ אֶת שַׁלּ֥וּם בֶּן יָבֵ֖ישׁ בְּ/שֹׁמְר֑וֹן וַ/יְמִיתֵ֖/הוּ וַ/יִּמְלֹ֥ךְ תַּחְתָּֽי/ו
verses.translit: vy'l mnchm bn gdy mtrtsh vyb' shmrvn vykh 't shlvm bn ybysh bshmrvn vymythv vymlkh tchtyv
verses.translation: For Menahem the son of Gadi went up from Tirzah, and came to Samaria, and smote Shallum the son of Jabesh in Samaria, and slew him, and reigned in his stead.

verses.original: וְ/יֶ֨תֶר֙ דִּבְרֵ֣י שַׁלּ֔וּם וְ/קִשְׁר֖/וֹ אֲשֶׁ֣ר קָשָׁ֑ר הִנָּ֣/ם כְּתֻבִ֗ים עַל סֵ֛פֶר דִּבְרֵ֥י הַ/יָּמִ֖ים לְ/מַלְכֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל
verses.translit: vytr dbry shlvm vqshrv 'shr qshr hnm khtbym 'l spr dbry hymym lmlkhy yshr'l
verses.translation: And the rest of the acts of Shallum, and his conspiracy which he made, behold, they are written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel.

verses.original: אָ֣ז יַכֶּֽה מְ֠נַחֵם אֶת תִּפְסַ֨ח וְ/אֶת כָּל אֲשֶׁר בָּ֤/הּ וְ/אֶת גְּבוּלֶ֨י/הָ֙ מִ/תִּרְצָ֔ה כִּ֛י לֹ֥א פָתַ֖ח וַ/יַּ֑ךְ אֵ֛ת כָּל הֶ/הָ֥רוֹתֶ֖י/הָ בִּקֵּֽעַ
verses.translit: 'z ykhh mnchm 't tpsch v't khl 'shr bh v't gbvlyh mtrtsh khy l' ptch vykh 't khl hhrvtyh bq'
verses.translation: Then Menahem smote Tiphsah, and all that were therein, and the coasts thereof from Tirzah: because they opened not to him , therefore he smote it; and all the women therein that were with child he ripped up.

verses.original: בִּ/שְׁנַ֨ת שְׁלֹשִׁ֤ים וָ/תֵ֨שַׁע֙ שָׁנָ֔ה לַ/עֲזַרְיָ֖ה מֶ֣לֶךְ יְהוּדָ֑ה מָ֠לַךְ מְנַחֵ֨ם בֶּן גָּדִ֧י עַל יִשְׂרָאֵ֛ל עֶ֥שֶׂר שָׁנִ֖ים בְּ/שֹׁמְרֽוֹן
verses.translit: bshnt shlshym vtsh' shnh l'zryh mlkh yhvdh mlkh mnchm bn gdy 'l yshr'l 'shr shnym bshmrvn
verses.translation: In the nine and thirtieth year of Azariah king of Judah began Menahem the son of Gadi to reign over Israel, and reigned ten years in Samaria.

verses.original: וַ/יַּ֥עַשׂ הָ/רַ֖ע בְּ/עֵינֵ֣י יְהוָ֑ה לֹ֣א סָ֠ר מֵ/עַ֨ל חַטֹּ֜אות יָרָבְעָ֧ם בֶּן נְבָ֛ט אֲשֶׁר הֶחֱטִ֥יא אֶת יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל כָּל יָמָֽי/ו
verses.translit: vy'sh hr' b'yny yhvh l' sr m'l cht'vt yrb'm bn nbt 'shr hchty' 't yshr'l khl ymyv
verses.translation: And he did that which was evil in the sight of the LORD : he departed not all his days from the sins of Jeroboam the son of Nebat, who made Israel to sin.

verses.original: בָּ֣א פ֤וּל מֶֽלֶךְ אַשּׁוּר֙ עַל הָ/אָ֔רֶץ וַ/יִּתֵּ֤ן מְנַחֵם֙ לְ/פ֔וּל אֶ֖לֶף כִּכַּר כָּ֑סֶף לִ/הְי֤וֹת יָדָי/ו֙ אִתּ֔/וֹ לְ/הַחֲזִ֥יק הַ/מַּמְלָכָ֖ה בְּ/יָדֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: b' pvl mlkh 'shvr 'l h'rts vytn mnchm lpvl 'lf khkhr khsf lhyvt ydyv 'tv lhchzyq hmmlkhh bydv
verses.translation: And Pul the king of Assyria came against the land: and Menahem gave Pul a thousand talents of silver, that his hand might be with him to confirm the kingdom in his hand.
