verses.original: וַ/יֹּצֵא֩ מְנַחֵ֨ם אֶת הַ/כֶּ֜סֶף עַל יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל עַ֚ל כָּל גִּבּוֹרֵ֣י הַ/חַ֔יִל לָ/תֵת֙ לְ/מֶ֣לֶךְ אַשּׁ֔וּר חֲמִשִּׁ֧ים שְׁקָלִ֛ים כֶּ֖סֶף לְ/אִ֣ישׁ אֶחָ֑ד וַ/יָּ֨שָׁב֙ מֶ֣לֶךְ אַשּׁ֔וּר וְ/לֹא עָ֥מַד שָׁ֖ם בָּ/אָֽרֶץ
verses.translit: vyts' mnchm 't hkhsf 'l yshr'l 'l khl gbvry hchyl ltt lmlkh 'shvr chmshym shqlym khsf l'ysh 'chd vyshb mlkh 'shvr vl' 'md shm b'rts
verses.translation: And Menahem exacted the money of Israel, even of all the mighty men of wealth, of each man fifty shekels of silver, to give to the king of Assyria. So the king of Assyria turned back, and stayed not there in the land.

verses.original: וְ/יֶ֛תֶר דִּבְרֵ֥י מְנַחֵ֖ם וְ/כָל אֲשֶׁ֣ר עָשָׂ֑ה הֲ/לוֹא הֵ֣ם כְּתוּבִ֗ים עַל סֵ֛פֶר דִּבְרֵ֥י הַ/יָּמִ֖ים לְ/מַלְכֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל
verses.translit: vytr dbry mnchm vkhl 'shr 'shh hlv' hm khtvbym 'l spr dbry hymym lmlkhy yshr'l
verses.translation: And the rest of the acts of Menahem, and all that he did, are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel?

verses.original: וַ/יִּשְׁכַּ֥ב מְנַחֵ֖ם עִם אֲבֹתָ֑י/ו וַ/יִּמְלֹ֛ךְ פְּקַחְיָ֥ה בְנ֖/וֹ תַּחְתָּֽי/ו
verses.translit: vyshkhb mnchm 'm 'btyv vymlkh pqchyh bnv tchtyv
verses.translation: And Menahem slept with his fathers; and Pekahiah his son reigned in his stead.

verses.original: בִּ/שְׁנַת֙ חֲמִשִּׁ֣ים שָׁנָ֔ה לַ/עֲזַרְיָ֖ה מֶ֣לֶךְ יְהוּדָ֑ה מָ֠לַךְ פְּקַֽחְיָ֨ה בֶן מְנַחֵ֧ם עַל יִשְׂרָאֵ֛ל בְּ/שֹׁמְר֖וֹן שְׁנָתָֽיִם
verses.translit: bshnt chmshym shnh l'zryh mlkh yhvdh mlkh pqchyh bn mnchm 'l yshr'l bshmrvn shntym
verses.translation: In the fiftieth year of Azariah king of Judah Pekahiah the son of Menahem began to reign over Israel in Samaria, and reigned two years.

verses.original: וַ/יַּ֥עַשׂ הָ/רַ֖ע בְּ/עֵינֵ֣י יְהוָ֑ה לֹ֣א סָ֗ר מֵֽ/חַטֹּאות֙ יָרָבְעָ֣ם בֶּן נְבָ֔ט אֲשֶׁ֥ר הֶחֱטִ֖יא אֶת יִשְׂרָאֵֽל
verses.translit: vy'sh hr' b'yny yhvh l' sr mcht'vt yrb'm bn nbt 'shr hchty' 't yshr'l
verses.translation: And he did that which was evil in the sight of the LORD : he departed not from the sins of Jeroboam the son of Nebat, who made Israel to sin.

verses.original: וַ/יִּקְשֹׁ֣ר עָלָי/ו֩ פֶּ֨קַח בֶּן רְמַלְיָ֜הוּ שָׁלִישׁ֗/וֹ וַ/יַּכֵּ֨/הוּ בְ/שֹׁמְר֜וֹן בְּ/אַרְמ֤וֹן בֵּית מלך הַ/מֶּ֨לֶךְ֙ אֶת אַרְגֹּ֣ב וְ/אֶת הָ/אַרְיֵ֔ה וְ/עִמּ֛/וֹ חֲמִשִּׁ֥ים אִ֖ישׁ מִ/בְּנֵ֣י גִלְעָדִ֑ים וַ/יְמִיתֵ֖/הוּ וַ/יִּמְלֹ֥ךְ תַּחְתָּֽי/ו
verses.translit: vyqshr 'lyv pqch bn rmlyhv shlyshv vykhhv bshmrvn b'rmvn byt mlkh hmlkh 't 'rgb v't h'ryh v'mv chmshym 'ysh mbny gl'dym vymythv vymlkh tchtyv
verses.translation: But Pekah the son of Remaliah, a captain of his, conspired against him, and smote him in Samaria, in the palace of the king’s house, with Argob and Arieh, and with him fifty men of the Gileadites: and he killed him, and reigned in his room.

verses.original: וְ/יֶ֛תֶר דִּבְרֵ֥י פְקַחְיָ֖ה וְ/כָל אֲשֶׁ֣ר עָשָׂ֑ה הִנָּ֣/ם כְּתוּבִ֗ים עַל סֵ֛פֶר דִּבְרֵ֥י הַ/יָּמִ֖ים לְ/מַלְכֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל
verses.translit: vytr dbry pqchyh vkhl 'shr 'shh hnm khtvbym 'l spr dbry hymym lmlkhy yshr'l
verses.translation: And the rest of the acts of Pekahiah, and all that he did, behold, they are written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel.

verses.original: בִּ/שְׁנַ֨ת חֲמִשִּׁ֤ים וּ/שְׁתַּ֨יִם֙ שָׁנָ֔ה לַ/עֲזַרְיָ֖ה מֶ֣לֶךְ יְהוּדָ֑ה מָ֠לַךְ פֶּ֣קַח בֶּן רְמַלְיָ֧הוּ עַל יִשְׂרָאֵ֛ל בְּ/שֹׁמְר֖וֹן עֶשְׂרִ֥ים שָׁנָֽה
verses.translit: bshnt chmshym vshtym shnh l'zryh mlkh yhvdh mlkh pqch bn rmlyhv 'l yshr'l bshmrvn 'shrym shnh
verses.translation: In the two and fiftieth year of Azariah king of Judah Pekah the son of Remaliah began to reign over Israel in Samaria, and reigned twenty years.

verses.original: וַ/יַּ֥עַשׂ הָ/רַ֖ע בְּ/עֵינֵ֣י יְהוָ֑ה לֹ֣א סָ֗ר מִן חַטֹּאות֙ יָרָבְעָ֣ם בֶּן נְבָ֔ט אֲשֶׁ֥ר הֶחֱטִ֖יא אֶת יִשְׂרָאֵֽל
verses.translit: vy'sh hr' b'yny yhvh l' sr mn cht'vt yrb'm bn nbt 'shr hchty' 't yshr'l
verses.translation: And he did that which was evil in the sight of the LORD : he departed not from the sins of Jeroboam the son of Nebat, who made Israel to sin.

verses.original: בִּ/ימֵ֞י פֶּ֣קַח מֶֽלֶךְ יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל בָּא֮ תִּגְלַ֣ת פִּלְאֶסֶר֮ מֶ֣לֶךְ אַשּׁוּר֒ וַ/יִּקַּ֣ח אֶת עִיּ֡וֹן וְ/אֶת אָבֵ֣ל בֵּֽית מַעֲכָ֡ה וְ/אֶת יָ֠נוֹחַ וְ/אֶת קֶ֨דֶשׁ וְ/אֶת חָצ֤וֹר וְ/אֶת הַ/גִּלְעָד֙ וְ/אֶת הַ/גָּלִ֔ילָ/ה כֹּ֖ל אֶ֣רֶץ נַפְתָּלִ֑י וַ/יַּגְלֵ֖/ם אַשּֽׁוּרָ/ה
verses.translit: bymy pqch mlkh yshr'l b' tglt pl'sr mlkh 'shvr vyqch 't 'yvn v't 'bl byt m'khh v't ynvch v't qdsh v't chtsvr v't hgl'd v't hglylh khl 'rts nptly vyglm 'shvrh
verses.translation: In the days of Pekah king of Israel came Tiglath-pileser king of Assyria, and took Ijon, and Abel-beth-maachah, and Janoah, and Kedesh, and Hazor, and Gilead, and Galilee, all the land of Naphtali, and carried them captive to Assyria.

verses.original: וַ/יִּקְשָׁר קֶ֜שֶׁר הוֹשֵׁ֣עַ בֶּן אֵלָ֗ה עַל פֶּ֨קַח֙ בֶּן רְמַלְיָ֔הוּ וַ/יַּכֵּ֨/הוּ֙ וַ/יְמִיתֵ֔/הוּ וַ/יִּמְלֹ֖ךְ תַּחְתָּ֑י/ו בִּ/שְׁנַ֣ת עֶשְׂרִ֔ים לְ/יוֹתָ֖ם בֶּן עֻזִיָּֽה
verses.translit: vyqshr qshr hvsh' bn 'lh 'l pqch bn rmlyhv vykhhv vymythv vymlkh tchtyv bshnt 'shrym lyvtm bn 'zyh
verses.translation: And Hoshea the son of Elah made a conspiracy against Pekah the son of Remaliah, and smote him, and slew him, and reigned in his stead, in the twentieth year of Jotham the son of Uzziah.

verses.original: וְ/יֶ֥תֶר דִּבְרֵי פֶ֖קַח וְ/כָל אֲשֶׁ֣ר עָשָׂ֑ה הִנָּ֣/ם כְּתוּבִ֗ים עַל סֵ֛פֶר דִּבְרֵ֥י הַ/יָּמִ֖ים לְ/מַלְכֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל
verses.translit: vytr dbry pqch vkhl 'shr 'shh hnm khtvbym 'l spr dbry hymym lmlkhy yshr'l
verses.translation: And the rest of the acts of Pekah, and all that he did, behold, they are written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel.

verses.original: בִּ/שְׁנַ֣ת שְׁתַּ֔יִם לְ/פֶ֥קַח בֶּן רְמַלְיָ֖הוּ מֶ֣לֶךְ יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל מָלַ֛ךְ יוֹתָ֥ם בֶּן עֻזִיָּ֖הוּ מֶ֥לֶךְ יְהוּדָֽה
verses.translit: bshnt shtym lpqch bn rmlyhv mlkh yshr'l mlkh yvtm bn 'zyhv mlkh yhvdh
verses.translation: In the second year of Pekah the son of Remaliah king of Israel began Jotham the son of Uzziah king of Judah to reign.

verses.original: בֶּן עֶשְׂרִ֨ים וְ/חָמֵ֤שׁ שָׁנָה֙ הָיָ֣ה בְ/מָלְכ֔/וֹ וְ/שֵׁשׁ עֶשְׂרֵ֣ה שָׁנָ֔ה מָלַ֖ךְ בִּ/ירוּשָׁלִָ֑ם וְ/שֵׁ֣ם אִמּ֔/וֹ יְרוּשָׁ֖א בַּת צָדֽוֹק
verses.translit: bn 'shrym vchmsh shnh hyh bmlkhv vshsh 'shrh shnh mlkh byrvshlm vshm 'mv yrvsh' bt tsdvq
verses.translation: Five and twenty years old was he when he began to reign, and he reigned sixteen years in Jerusalem. And his mother’s name was Jerusha, the daughter of Zadok.

verses.original: וַ/יַּ֥עַשׂ הַ/יָּשָׁ֖ר בְּ/עֵינֵ֣י יְהוָ֑ה כְּ/כֹ֧ל אֲשֶׁר עָשָׂ֛ה עֻזִיָּ֥הוּ אָבִ֖י/ו עָשָֽׂה
verses.translit: vy'sh hyshr b'yny yhvh khkhl 'shr 'shh 'zyhv 'byv 'shh
verses.translation: And he did that which was right in the sight of the LORD : he did according to all that his father Uzziah had done.

verses.original: רַ֤ק הַ/בָּמוֹת֙ לֹ֣א סָ֔רוּ ע֗וֹד הָ/עָ֛ם מְזַבְּחִ֥ים וּֽ/מְקַטְּרִ֖ים בַּ/בָּמ֑וֹת ה֗וּא בָּנָ֛ה אֶת שַׁ֥עַר בֵּית יְהוָ֖ה הָ/עֶלְיֽוֹן
verses.translit: rq hbmvt l' srv 'vd h'm mzbchym vmqtrym bbmvt hv' bnh 't sh'r byt yhvh h'lyvn
verses.translation: Howbeit the high places were not removed: the people sacrificed and burned incense still in the high places. He built the higher gate of the house of the LORD .

verses.original: וְ/יֶ֛תֶר דִּבְרֵ֥י יוֹתָ֖ם אֲשֶׁ֣ר עָשָׂ֑ה הֲ/לֹא הֵ֣ם כְּתוּבִ֗ים עַל סֵ֛פֶר דִּבְרֵ֥י הַ/יָּמִ֖ים לְ/מַלְכֵ֥י יְהוּדָֽה
verses.translit: vytr dbry yvtm 'shr 'shh hl' hm khtvbym 'l spr dbry hymym lmlkhy yhvdh
verses.translation: Now the rest of the acts of Jotham, and all that he did, are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah?

verses.original: בַּ/יָּמִ֣ים הָ/הֵ֔ם הֵחֵ֣ל יְהוָ֗ה לְ/הַשְׁלִ֨יחַ֙ בִּֽ/יהוּדָ֔ה רְצִ֖ין מֶ֣לֶךְ אֲרָ֑ם וְ/אֵ֖ת פֶּ֥קַח בֶּן רְמַלְיָֽהוּ
verses.translit: bymym hhm hchl yhvh lhshlych byhvdh rtsyn mlkh 'rm v't pqch bn rmlyhv
verses.translation: In those days the LORD began to send against Judah Rezin the king of Syria, and Pekah the son of Remaliah.

verses.original: וַ/יִּשְׁכַּ֤ב יוֹתָם֙ עִם אֲבֹתָ֔י/ו וַ/יִּקָּבֵר֙ עִם אֲבֹתָ֔י/ו בְּ/עִ֖יר דָּוִ֣ד אָבִ֑י/ו וַ/יִּמְלֹ֛ךְ אָחָ֥ז בְּנ֖/וֹ תַּחְתָּֽי/ו
verses.translit: vyshkhb yvtm 'm 'btyv vyqbr 'm 'btyv b'yr dvd 'byv vymlkh 'chz bnv tchtyv
verses.translation: And Jotham slept with his fathers, and was buried with his fathers in the city of David his father: and Ahaz his son reigned in his stead.

verses.original: בִּ/שְׁנַת֙ שְׁבַֽע עֶשְׂרֵ֣ה שָׁנָ֔ה לְ/פֶ֖קַח בֶּן רְמַלְיָ֑הוּ מָלַ֛ךְ אָחָ֥ז בֶּן יוֹתָ֖ם מֶ֥לֶךְ יְהוּדָֽה
verses.translit: bshnt shb' 'shrh shnh lpqch bn rmlyhv mlkh 'chz bn yvtm mlkh yhvdh
verses.translation: In the seventeenth year of Pekah the son of Remaliah Ahaz the son of Jotham king of Judah began to reign.

verses.original: בֶּן עֶשְׂרִ֤ים שָׁנָה֙ אָחָ֣ז בְּ/מָלְכ֔/וֹ וְ/שֵׁשׁ עֶשְׂרֵ֣ה שָׁנָ֔ה מָלַ֖ךְ בִּ/ירוּשָׁלִָ֑ם וְ/לֹא עָשָׂ֣ה הַ/יָּשָׁ֗ר בְּ/עֵינֵ֛י יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהָ֖י/ו כְּ/דָוִ֥ד אָבִֽי/ו
verses.translit: bn 'shrym shnh 'chz bmlkhv vshsh 'shrh shnh mlkh byrvshlm vl' 'shh hyshr b'yny yhvh 'lhyv khdvd 'byv
verses.translation: Twenty years old was Ahaz when he began to reign, and reigned sixteen years in Jerusalem, and did not that which was right in the sight of the LORD his God, like David his father.

verses.original: וַ/יֵּ֕לֶךְ בְּ/דֶ֖רֶךְ מַלְכֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וְ/גַ֤ם אֶת בְּנ/וֹ֙ הֶעֱבִ֣יר בָּ/אֵ֔שׁ כְּ/תֹֽעֲבוֹת֙ הַ/גּוֹיִ֔ם אֲשֶׁ֨ר הוֹרִ֤ישׁ יְהוָה֙ אֹתָ֔/ם מִ/פְּנֵ֖י בְּנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל
verses.translit: vylkh bdrkh mlkhy yshr'l vgm 't bnv h'byr b'sh kht'bvt hgvym 'shr hvrysh yhvh 'tm mpny bny yshr'l
verses.translation: But he walked in the way of the kings of Israel, yea, and made his son to pass through the fire, according to the abominations of the heathen, whom the LORD cast out from before the children of Israel.

verses.original: וַ/יְזַבֵּ֧חַ וַ/יְקַטֵּ֛ר בַּ/בָּמ֖וֹת וְ/עַל הַ/גְּבָע֑וֹת וְ/תַ֖חַת כָּל עֵ֥ץ רַעֲנָֽן
verses.translit: vyzbch vyqtr bbmvt v'l hgb'vt vtcht khl 'ts r'nn
verses.translation: And he sacrificed and burnt incense in the high places, and on the hills, and under every green tree.

verses.original: אָ֣ז יַעֲלֶ֣ה רְצִ֣ין מֶֽלֶךְ אֲ֠רָם וּ/פֶ֨קַח בֶּן רְמַלְיָ֧הוּ מֶֽלֶךְ יִשְׂרָאֵ֛ל יְרוּשָׁלִַ֖ם לַ/מִּלְחָמָ֑ה וַ/יָּצֻ֨רוּ֙ עַל אָחָ֔ז וְ/לֹ֥א יָכְל֖וּ לְ/הִלָּחֵֽם
verses.translit: 'z y'lh rtsyn mlkh 'rm vpqch bn rmlyhv mlkh yshr'l yrvshlm lmlchmh vytsrv 'l 'chz vl' ykhlv lhlchm
verses.translation: Then Rezin king of Syria and Pekah son of Remaliah king of Israel came up to Jerusalem to war: and they besieged Ahaz, but could not overcome him .

verses.original: בָּ/עֵ֣ת הַ/הִ֗יא הֵ֠שִׁיב רְצִ֨ין מֶֽלֶךְ אֲרָ֤ם אֶת אֵילַת֙ לַֽ/אֲרָ֔ם וַ/יְנַשֵּׁ֥ל אֶת הַ/יְהוּדִ֖ים מֵֽ/אֵיל֑וֹת ו/ארמים וַֽ/אֲדוֹמִים֙ בָּ֣אוּ אֵילַ֔ת וַ/יֵּ֣שְׁבוּ שָׁ֔ם עַ֖ד הַ/יּ֥וֹם הַ/זֶּֽה
verses.translit: b't hhy' hshyb rtsyn mlkh 'rm 't 'ylt l'rm vynshl 't hyhvdym m'ylvt v'rmym v'dvmym b'v 'ylt vyshbv shm 'd hyvm hzh
verses.translation: At that time Rezin king of Syria recovered Elath to Syria, and drave the Jews from Elath: and the Syrians came to Elath, and dwelt there unto this day.

verses.original: וַ/יִּשְׁלַ֨ח אָחָ֜ז מַלְאָכִ֗ים אֶל תִּ֠גְלַת פְּלֶ֤סֶר מֶֽלֶךְ אַשּׁוּר֙ לֵ/אמֹ֔ר עַבְדְּ/ךָ֥ וּ/בִנְ/ךָ֖ אָ֑נִי עֲלֵ֨ה וְ/הוֹשִׁעֵ֜/נִי מִ/כַּ֣ף מֶֽלֶךְ אֲרָ֗ם וּ/מִ/כַּף֙ מֶ֣לֶךְ יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל הַ/קּוֹמִ֖ים עָלָֽ/י
verses.translit: vyshlch 'chz ml'khym 'l tglt plsr mlkh 'shvr l'mr 'bdkh vbnkh 'ny 'lh vhvsh'ny mkhf mlkh 'rm vmkhf mlkh yshr'l hqvmym 'ly
verses.translation: So Ahaz sent messengers to Tiglath-pileser king of Assyria, saying, I am thy servant and thy son: come up, and save me out of the hand of the king of Syria, and out of the hand of the king of Israel, which rise up against me.

verses.original: וַ/יִּקַּ֨ח אָחָ֜ז אֶת הַ/כֶּ֣סֶף וְ/אֶת הַ/זָּהָ֗ב הַ/נִּמְצָא֙ בֵּ֣ית יְהוָ֔ה וּ/בְ/אֹֽצְר֖וֹת בֵּ֣ית הַ/מֶּ֑לֶךְ וַ/יִּשְׁלַ֥ח לְ/מֶֽלֶךְ אַשּׁ֖וּר שֹֽׁחַד
verses.translit: vyqch 'chz 't hkhsf v't hzhb hnmts' byt yhvh vb'tsrvt byt hmlkh vyshlch lmlkh 'shvr shchd
verses.translation: And Ahaz took the silver and gold that was found in the house of the LORD , and in the treasures of the king’s house, and sent it for a present to the king of Assyria.

verses.original: וַ/יִּשְׁמַ֤ע אֵלָי/ו֙ מֶ֣לֶךְ אַשּׁ֔וּר וַ/יַּעַל֩ מֶ֨לֶךְ אַשּׁ֤וּר אֶל דַּמֶּ֨שֶׂק֙ וַֽ/יִּתְפְּשֶׂ֔/הָ וַ/יַּגְלֶ֖/הָ קִ֑ירָ/ה וְ/אֶת רְצִ֖ין הֵמִֽית
verses.translit: vyshm' 'lyv mlkh 'shvr vy'l mlkh 'shvr 'l dmshq vytpshh vyglh qyrh v't rtsyn hmyt
verses.translation: And the king of Assyria hearkened unto him: for the king of Assyria went up against Damascus, and took it, and carried the people of it captive to Kir, and slew Rezin.

verses.original: וַ/יֵּ֣לֶךְ הַ/מֶּ֣לֶךְ אָחָ֡ז לִ֠/קְרַאת תִּגְלַ֨ת פִּלְאֶ֤סֶר מֶֽלֶךְ אַשּׁוּר֙ דּוּמֶּ֔שֶׂק וַ/יַּ֥רְא אֶת הַ/מִּזְבֵּ֖חַ אֲשֶׁ֣ר בְּ/דַמָּ֑שֶׂק וַ/יִּשְׁלַח֩ הַ/מֶּ֨לֶךְ אָחָ֜ז אֶל אוּרִיָּ֣ה הַ/כֹּהֵ֗ן אֶת דְּמ֧וּת הַ/מִּזְבֵּ֛חַ וְ/אֶת תַּבְנִית֖/וֹ לְ/כָֽל מַעֲשֵֽׂ/הוּ
verses.translit: vylkh hmlkh 'chz lqr't tglt pl'sr mlkh 'shvr dvmshq vyr' 't hmzbch 'shr bdmshq vyshlch hmlkh 'chz 'l 'vryh hkhhn 't dmvt hmzbch v't tbnytv lkhl m'shhv
verses.translation: And king Ahaz went to Damascus to meet Tiglath-pileser king of Assyria, and saw an altar that was at Damascus: and king Ahaz sent to Urijah the priest the fashion of the altar, and the pattern of it, according to all the workmanship thereof.

verses.original: וַ/יִּ֛בֶן אוּרִיָּ֥ה הַ/כֹּהֵ֖ן אֶת הַ/מִּזְבֵּ֑חַ כְּ/כֹ֣ל אֲשֶׁר שָׁלַח֩ הַ/מֶּ֨לֶךְ אָחָ֜ז מִ/דַּמֶּ֗שֶׂק כֵּ֤ן עָשָׂה֙ אוּרִיָּ֣ה הַ/כֹּהֵ֔ן עַד בּ֥וֹא הַ/מֶּֽלֶךְ אָחָ֖ז מִ/דַּמָּֽשֶׂק
verses.translit: vybn 'vryh hkhhn 't hmzbch khkhl 'shr shlch hmlkh 'chz mdmshq khn 'shh 'vryh hkhhn 'd bv' hmlkh 'chz mdmshq
verses.translation: And Urijah the priest built an altar according to all that king Ahaz had sent from Damascus: so Urijah the priest made it against king Ahaz came from Damascus.

verses.translit: vyb' hmlkh mdmshq vyr' hmlkh 't hmzbch vyqrb hmlkh 'l hmzbch vy'l 'lyv
verses.translation: And when the king was come from Damascus, the king saw the altar: and the king approached to the altar, and offered thereon.

verses.original: וַ/יַּקְטֵ֤ר אֶת עֹֽלָת/וֹ֙ וְ/אֶת מִנְחָת֔/וֹ וַ/יַּסֵּ֖ךְ אֶת נִסְכּ֑/וֹ וַ/יִּזְרֹ֛ק אֶת דַּֽם הַ/שְּׁלָמִ֥ים אֲשֶׁר ל֖/וֹ עַל הַ/מִּזְבֵּֽחַ
verses.translit: vyqtr 't 'ltv v't mnchtv vyskh 't nskhv vyzrq 't dm hshlmym 'shr lv 'l hmzbch
verses.translation: And he burnt his burnt offering and his meat offering, and poured his drink offering, and sprinkled the blood of his peace offerings, upon the altar.

verses.original: וְ/אֵ֨ת הַ/מִּזְבַּ֣ח הַ/נְּחֹשֶׁת֮ אֲשֶׁ֣ר לִ/פְנֵ֣י יְהוָה֒ וַ/יַּקְרֵ֗ב מֵ/אֵת֙ פְּנֵ֣י הַ/בַּ֔יִת מִ/בֵּין֙ הַ/מִּזְבֵּ֔חַ וּ/מִ/בֵּ֖ין בֵּ֣ית יְהוָ֑ה וַ/יִּתֵּ֥ן אֹת֛/וֹ עַל יֶ֥רֶךְ הַ/מִּזְבֵּ֖חַ צָפֽוֹנָ/ה
verses.translit: v't hmzbch hnchsht 'shr lpny yhvh vyqrb m't pny hbyt mbyn hmzbch vmbyn byt yhvh vytn 'tv 'l yrkh hmzbch tspvnh
verses.translation: And he brought also the brasen altar, which was before the LORD , from the forefront of the house, from between the altar and the house of the LORD , and put it on the north side of the altar.

verses.original: ו/יצו/הו וַ/יְצַוֶּ֣ה הַ/מֶּֽלֶךְ אָ֠חָז אֶת אוּרִיָּ֨ה הַ/כֹּהֵ֜ן לֵ/אמֹ֗ר עַ֣ל הַ/מִּזְבֵּ֣חַ הַ/גָּד֡וֹל הַקְטֵ֣ר אֶת עֹֽלַת הַ/בֹּקֶר֩ וְ/אֶת מִנְחַ֨ת הָ/עֶ֜רֶב וְֽ/אֶת עֹלַ֧ת הַ/מֶּ֣לֶךְ וְ/אֶת מִנְחָת֗/וֹ וְ֠/אֵת עֹלַ֞ת כָּל עַ֤ם הָ/אָ֨רֶץ֙ וּ/מִנְחָתָ֣/ם וְ/נִסְכֵּי/הֶ֔ם וְ/כָל דַּ֥ם עֹלָ֛ה וְ/כָל דַּם זֶ֖בַח עָלָ֣י/ו תִּזְרֹ֑ק וּ/מִזְבַּ֧ח הַ/נְּחֹ֛שֶׁת יִֽהְיֶה לִּ֖/י לְ/בַקֵּֽר
verses.translit: vytsvhv vytsvh hmlkh 'chz 't 'vryh hkhhn l'mr 'l hmzbch hgdvl hqtr 't 'lt hbqr v't mncht h'rb v't 'lt hmlkh v't mnchtv v't 'lt khl 'm h'rts vmnchtm vnskhyhm vkhl dm 'lh vkhl dm zbch 'lyv tzrq vmzbch hnchsht yhyh ly lbqr
verses.translation: And king Ahaz commanded Urijah the priest, saying, Upon the great altar burn the morning burnt offering, and the evening meat offering, and the king’s burnt sacrifice, and his meat offering, with the burnt offering of all the people of the land, and their meat offering, and their drink offerings; and sprinkle upon it all the blood of the burnt offering, and all the blood of the sacrifice: and the brasen altar shall be for me to enquire by .

verses.original: וַ/יַּ֖עַשׂ אוּרִיָּ֣ה הַ/כֹּהֵ֑ן כְּ/כֹ֥ל אֲשֶׁר צִוָּ֖ה הַ/מֶּ֥לֶךְ אָחָֽז
verses.translit: vy'sh 'vryh hkhhn khkhl 'shr tsvh hmlkh 'chz
verses.translation: Thus did Urijah the priest, according to all that king Ahaz commanded.

verses.original: וַ/יְקַצֵּץ֩ הַ/מֶּ֨לֶךְ אָחָ֜ז אֶת הַ/מִּסְגְּר֣וֹת הַ/מְּכֹנ֗וֹת וַ/יָּ֤סַר מֵֽ/עֲלֵי/הֶם֙ ו/את אֶת הַ/כִּיֹּ֔ר וְ/אֶת הַ/יָּ֣ם הוֹרִ֔ד מֵ/עַ֛ל הַ/בָּקָ֥ר הַ/נְּחֹ֖שֶׁת אֲשֶׁ֣ר תַּחְתֶּ֑י/הָ וַ/יִּתֵּ֣ן אֹת֔/וֹ עַ֖ל מַרְצֶ֥פֶת אֲבָנִֽים
verses.translit: vyqtsts hmlkh 'chz 't hmsgrvt hmkhnvt vysr m'lyhm v't 't hkhyr v't hym hvrd m'l hbqr hnchsht 'shr tchtyh vytn 'tv 'l mrtspt 'bnym
verses.translation: And king Ahaz cut off the borders of the bases, and removed the laver from off them; and took down the sea from off the brasen oxen that were under it, and put it upon a pavement of stones.

verses.original: וְ/אֶת מיסך מוּסַ֨ךְ הַ/שַּׁבָּ֜ת אֲשֶׁר בָּנ֣וּ בַ/בַּ֗יִת וְ/אֶת מְב֤וֹא הַ/מֶּ֨לֶךְ֙ הַֽ/חִיצ֔וֹנָ/ה הֵסֵ֖ב בֵּ֣ית יְהוָ֑ה מִ/פְּנֵ֖י מֶ֥לֶךְ אַשּֽׁוּר
verses.translit: v't myskh mvskh hshbt 'shr bnv bbyt v't mbv' hmlkh hchytsvnh hsb byt yhvh mpny mlkh 'shvr
verses.translation: And the covert for the sabbath that they had built in the house, and the king’s entry without, turned he from the house of the LORD for the king of Assyria.

verses.original: וְ/יֶ֛תֶר דִּבְרֵ֥י אָחָ֖ז אֲשֶׁ֣ר עָשָׂ֑ה הֲ/לֹא הֵ֣ם כְּתוּבִ֗ים עַל סֵ֛פֶר דִּבְרֵ֥י הַ/יָּמִ֖ים לְ/מַלְכֵ֥י יְהוּדָֽה
verses.translit: vytr dbry 'chz 'shr 'shh hl' hm khtvbym 'l spr dbry hymym lmlkhy yhvdh
verses.translation: Now the rest of the acts of Ahaz which he did, are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah?

verses.original: וַ/יִּשְׁכַּ֤ב אָחָז֙ עִם אֲבֹתָ֔י/ו וַ/יִּקָּבֵ֥ר עִם אֲבֹתָ֖י/ו בְּ/עִ֣יר דָּוִ֑ד וַ/יִּמְלֹ֛ךְ חִזְקִיָּ֥הוּ בְנ֖/וֹ תַּחְתָּֽי/ו
verses.translit: vyshkhb 'chz 'm 'btyv vyqbr 'm 'btyv b'yr dvd vymlkh chzqyhv bnv tchtyv
verses.translation: And Ahaz slept with his fathers, and was buried with his fathers in the city of David: and Hezekiah his son reigned in his stead.

verses.original: בִּ/שְׁנַת֙ שְׁתֵּ֣ים עֶשְׂרֵ֔ה לְ/אָחָ֖ז מֶ֣לֶךְ יְהוּדָ֑ה מָ֠לַךְ הוֹשֵׁ֨עַ בֶּן אֵלָ֧ה בְ/שֹׁמְר֛וֹן עַל יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל תֵּ֥שַׁע שָׁנִֽים
verses.translit: bshnt shtym 'shrh l'chz mlkh yhvdh mlkh hvsh' bn 'lh bshmrvn 'l yshr'l tsh' shnym
verses.translation: In the twelfth year of Ahaz king of Judah began Hoshea the son of Elah to reign in Samaria over Israel nine years.

verses.original: וַ/יַּ֥עַשׂ הָ/רַ֖ע בְּ/עֵינֵ֣י יְהוָ֑ה רַ֗ק לֹ֚א כְּ/מַלְכֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל אֲשֶׁ֥ר הָי֖וּ לְ/פָנָֽי/ו
verses.translit: vy'sh hr' b'yny yhvh rq l' khmlkhy yshr'l 'shr hyv lpnyv
verses.translation: And he did that which was evil in the sight of the LORD , but not as the kings of Israel that were before him.

verses.original: עָלָ֣י/ו עָלָ֔ה שַׁלְמַנְאֶ֖סֶר מֶ֣לֶךְ אַשּׁ֑וּר וַֽ/יְהִי ל֤/וֹ הוֹשֵׁ֨עַ֙ עֶ֔בֶד וַ/יָּ֥שֶׁב ל֖/וֹ מִנְחָֽה
verses.translit: 'lyv 'lh shlmn'sr mlkh 'shvr vyhy lv hvsh' 'bd vyshb lv mnchh
verses.translation: Against him came up Shalmaneser king of Assyria; and Hoshea became his servant, and gave him presents.

verses.original: וַ/יִּמְצָא֩ מֶֽלֶךְ אַשּׁ֨וּר בְּ/הוֹשֵׁ֜עַ קֶ֗שֶׁר אֲשֶׁ֨ר שָׁלַ֤ח מַלְאָכִים֙ אֶל ס֣וֹא מֶֽלֶךְ מִצְרַ֔יִם וְ/לֹא הֶעֱלָ֥ה מִנְחָ֛ה לְ/מֶ֥לֶךְ אַשּׁ֖וּר כְּ/שָׁנָ֣ה בְ/שָׁנָ֑ה וַֽ/יַּעַצְרֵ֨/הוּ֙ מֶ֣לֶךְ אַשּׁ֔וּר וַ/יַּאַסְרֵ֖/הוּ בֵּ֥ית כֶּֽלֶא
verses.translit: vymts' mlkh 'shvr bhvsh' qshr 'shr shlch ml'khym 'l sv' mlkh mtsrym vl' h'lh mnchh lmlkh 'shvr khshnh bshnh vy'tsrhv mlkh 'shvr vy'srhv byt khl'
verses.translation: And the king of Assyria found conspiracy in Hoshea: for he had sent messengers to So king of Egypt, and brought no present to the king of Assyria, as he had done year by year: therefore the king of Assyria shut him up, and bound him in prison.

verses.original: וַ/יַּ֥עַל מֶֽלֶךְ אַשּׁ֖וּר בְּ/כָל הָ/אָ֑רֶץ וַ/יַּ֨עַל֙ שֹׁמְר֔וֹן וַ/יָּ֥צַר עָלֶ֖י/הָ שָׁלֹ֥שׁ שָׁנִֽים
verses.translit: vy'l mlkh 'shvr bkhl h'rts vy'l shmrvn vytsr 'lyh shlsh shnym
verses.translation: Then the king of Assyria came up throughout all the land, and went up to Samaria, and besieged it three years.

verses.original: בִּ/שְׁנַ֨ת הַ/תְּשִׁיעִ֜ית לְ/הוֹשֵׁ֗עַ לָכַ֤ד מֶֽלֶךְ אַשּׁוּר֙ אֶת שֹׁ֣מְר֔וֹן וַ/יֶּ֥גֶל אֶת יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל אַשּׁ֑וּרָ/ה וַ/יֹּ֨שֶׁב אֹתָ֜/ם בַּ/חְלַ֧ח וּ/בְ/חָב֛וֹר נְהַ֥ר גּוֹזָ֖ן וְ/עָרֵ֥י מָדָֽי
verses.translit: bshnt htshy'yt lhvsh' lkhd mlkh 'shvr 't shmrvn vygl 't yshr'l 'shvrh vyshb 'tm bchlch vbchbvr nhr gvzn v'ry mdy
verses.translation: In the ninth year of Hoshea the king of Assyria took Samaria, and carried Israel away into Assyria, and placed them in Halah and in Habor by the river of Gozan, and in the cities of the Medes.

verses.original: וַ/יְהִ֗י כִּֽי חָטְא֤וּ בְנֵֽי יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ לַ/יהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֵי/הֶ֔ם הַ/מַּעֲלֶ֤ה אֹתָ/ם֙ מֵ/אֶ֣רֶץ מִצְרַ֔יִם מִ/תַּ֕חַת יַ֖ד פַּרְעֹ֣ה מֶֽלֶךְ מִצְרָ֑יִם וַ/יִּֽירְא֖וּ אֱלֹהִ֥ים אֲחֵרִֽים
verses.translit: vyhy khy cht'v bny yshr'l lyhvh 'lhyhm hm'lh 'tm m'rts mtsrym mtcht yd pr'h mlkh mtsrym vyyr'v 'lhym 'chrym
verses.translation: For so it was, that the children of Israel had sinned against the LORD their God, which had brought them up out of the land of Egypt, from under the hand of Pharaoh king of Egypt, and had feared other gods,

verses.original: וַ/יֵּֽלְכוּ֙ בְּ/חֻקּ֣וֹת הַ/גּוֹיִ֔ם אֲשֶׁר֙ הוֹרִ֣ישׁ יְהוָ֔ה מִ/פְּנֵ֖י בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וּ/מַלְכֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל אֲשֶׁ֥ר עָשֽׂוּ
verses.translit: vylkhv bchqvt hgvym 'shr hvrysh yhvh mpny bny yshr'l vmlkhy yshr'l 'shr 'shv
verses.translation: And walked in the statutes of the heathen, whom the LORD cast out from before the children of Israel, and of the kings of Israel, which they had made.

verses.original: וַ/יְחַפְּא֣וּ בְנֵֽי יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל דְּבָרִים֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר לֹא כֵ֔ן עַל יְהוָ֖ה אֱלֹהֵי/הֶ֑ם וַ/יִּבְנ֨וּ לָ/הֶ֤ם בָּמוֹת֙ בְּ/כָל עָ֣רֵי/הֶ֔ם מִ/מִּגְדַּ֥ל נוֹצְרִ֖ים עַד עִ֥יר מִבְצָֽר
verses.translit: vychp'v bny yshr'l dbrym 'shr l' khn 'l yhvh 'lhyhm vybnv lhm bmvt bkhl 'ryhm mmgdl nvtsrym 'd 'yr mbtsr
verses.translation: And the children of Israel did secretly those things that were not right against the LORD their God, and they built them high places in all their cities, from the tower of the watchmen to the fenced city.

verses.original: וַ/יַּצִּ֧בוּ לָ/הֶ֛ם מַצֵּב֖וֹת וַ/אֲשֵׁרִ֑ים עַ֚ל כָּל גִּבְעָ֣ה גְבֹהָ֔ה וְ/תַ֖חַת כָּל עֵ֥ץ רַעֲנָֽן
verses.translit: vytsbv lhm mtsbvt v'shrym 'l khl gb'h gbhh vtcht khl 'ts r'nn
verses.translation: And they set them up images and groves in every high hill, and under every green tree:

verses.original: וַ/יְקַטְּרוּ שָׁם֙ בְּ/כָל בָּמ֔וֹת כַּ/גּוֹיִ֕ם אֲשֶׁר הֶגְלָ֥ה יְהוָ֖ה מִ/פְּנֵי/הֶ֑ם וַֽ/יַּעֲשׂוּ֙ דְּבָרִ֣ים רָעִ֔ים לְ/הַכְעִ֖יס אֶת יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: vyqtrv shm bkhl bmvt khgvym 'shr hglh yhvh mpnyhm vy'shv dbrym r'ym lhkh'ys 't yhvh
verses.translation: And there they burnt incense in all the high places, as did the heathen whom the LORD carried away before them; and wrought wicked things to provoke the LORD to anger:

verses.original: וַ/יַּֽעַבְד֖וּ הַ/גִּלֻּלִ֑ים אֲשֶׁ֨ר אָמַ֤ר יְהוָה֙ לָ/הֶ֔ם לֹ֥א תַעֲשׂ֖וּ אֶת הַ/דָּבָ֥ר הַ/זֶּֽה
verses.translit: vy'bdv hgllym 'shr 'mr yhvh lhm l' t'shv 't hdbr hzh
verses.translation: For they served idols, whereof the LORD had said unto them, Ye shall not do this thing.

verses.original: וַ/יָּ֣עַד יְהוָ֡ה בְּ/יִשְׂרָאֵ֣ל וּ/בִ/יהוּדָ֡ה בְּ/יַד֩ כָּל נביא/ו נְבִיאֵ֨י כָל חֹזֶ֜ה לֵ/אמֹ֗ר שֻׁ֝֠בוּ מִ/דַּרְכֵי/כֶ֤ם הָֽ/רָעִים֙ וְ/שִׁמְרוּ֙ מִצְוֺתַ֣/י חֻקּוֹתַ֔/י כְּ/כָ֨ל הַ/תּוֹרָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר צִוִּ֖יתִי אֶת אֲבֹֽתֵי/כֶ֑ם וַֽ/אֲשֶׁר֙ שָׁלַ֣חְתִּי אֲלֵי/כֶ֔ם בְּ/יַ֖ד עֲבָדַ֥/י הַ/נְּבִיאִֽים
verses.translit: vy'd yhvh byshr'l vbyhvdh byd khl nby'v nby'y khl chzh l'mr shbv mdrkhykhm hr'ym vshmrv mtsvty chqvty khkhl htvrh 'shr tsvyty 't 'btykhm v'shr shlchty 'lykhm byd 'bdy hnby'ym
verses.translation: Yet the LORD testified against Israel, and against Judah, by all the prophets, and by all the seers, saying, Turn ye from your evil ways, and keep my commandments and my statutes, according to all the law which I commanded your fathers, and which I sent to you by my servants the prophets.

verses.original: וְ/לֹ֖א שָׁמֵ֑עוּ וַ/יַּקְשׁ֤וּ אֶת עָרְפָּ/ם֙ כְּ/עֹ֣רֶף אֲבוֹתָ֔/ם אֲשֶׁר֙ לֹ֣א הֶאֱמִ֔ינוּ בַּֽ/יהוָ֖ה אֱלֹהֵי/הֶֽם
verses.translit: vl' shm'v vyqshv 't 'rpm kh'rf 'bvtm 'shr l' h'mynv byhvh 'lhyhm
verses.translation: Notwithstanding they would not hear, but hardened their necks, like to the neck of their fathers, that did not believe in the LORD their God.

verses.original: וַ/יִּמְאֲס֣וּ אֶת חֻקָּ֗י/ו וְ/אֶת בְּרִית/וֹ֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר כָּרַ֣ת אֶת אֲבוֹתָ֔/ם וְ/אֵת֙ עֵֽדְוֺתָ֔י/ו אֲשֶׁ֥ר הֵעִ֖יד בָּ֑/ם וַ/יֵּ֨לְכ֜וּ אַחֲרֵ֤י הַ/הֶ֨בֶל֙ וַ/יֶּהְבָּ֔לוּ וְ/אַחֲרֵ֤י הַ/גּוֹיִם֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר סְבִֽיבֹתָ֔/ם אֲשֶׁ֨ר צִוָּ֤ה יְהוָה֙ אֹתָ֔/ם לְ/בִלְתִּ֖י עֲשׂ֥וֹת כָּ/הֶֽם
verses.translit: vym'sv 't chqyv v't brytv 'shr khrt 't 'bvtm v't 'dvtyv 'shr h'yd bm vylkhv 'chry hhbl vyhblv v'chry hgvym 'shr sbybtm 'shr tsvh yhvh 'tm lblty 'shvt khhm
verses.translation: And they rejected his statutes, and his covenant that he made with their fathers, and his testimonies which he testified against them; and they followed vanity, and became vain, and went after the heathen that were round about them, concerning whom the LORD had charged them, that they should not do like them.

verses.original: וַ/יַּעַזְב֗וּ אֶת כָּל מִצְוֺת֙ יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֵי/הֶ֔ם וַ/יַּעֲשׂ֥וּ לָ/הֶ֛ם מַסֵּכָ֖ה שנים שְׁנֵ֣י עֲגָלִ֑ים וַ/יַּעֲשׂ֣וּ אֲשֵׁירָ֗ה וַ/יִּֽשְׁתַּחֲווּ֙ לְ/כָל צְבָ֣א הַ/שָּׁמַ֔יִם וַ/יַּעַבְד֖וּ אֶת הַ/בָּֽעַל
verses.translit: vy'zbv 't khl mtsvt yhvh 'lhyhm vy'shv lhm mskhh shnym shny 'glym vy'shv 'shyrh vyshtchvv lkhl tsb' hshmym vy'bdv 't hb'l
verses.translation: And they left all the commandments of the LORD their God, and made them molten images, even two calves, and made a grove, and worshipped all the host of heaven, and served Baal.

verses.original: וַֽ֠/יַּעֲבִירוּ אֶת בְּנֵי/הֶ֤ם וְ/אֶת בְּנֽוֹתֵי/הֶם֙ בָּ/אֵ֔שׁ וַ/יִּקְסְמ֥וּ קְסָמִ֖ים וַ/יְנַחֵ֑שׁוּ וַ/יִּֽתְמַכְּר֗וּ לַ/עֲשׂ֥וֹת הָ/רַ֛ע בְּ/עֵינֵ֥י יְהוָ֖ה לְ/הַכְעִיסֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: vy'byrv 't bnyhm v't bnvtyhm b'sh vyqsmv qsmym vynchshv vytmkhrv l'shvt hr' b'yny yhvh lhkh'ysv
verses.translation: And they caused their sons and their daughters to pass through the fire, and used divination and enchantments, and sold themselves to do evil in the sight of the LORD , to provoke him to anger.

verses.original: וַ/יִּתְאַנַּ֨ף יְהוָ֤ה מְאֹד֙ בְּ/יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל וַ/יְסִרֵ֖/ם מֵ/עַ֣ל פָּנָ֑י/ו לֹ֣א נִשְׁאַ֔ר רַ֛ק שֵׁ֥בֶט יְהוּדָ֖ה לְ/בַדּֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: vyt'nf yhvh m'd byshr'l vysrm m'l pnyv l' nsh'r rq shbt yhvdh lbdv
verses.translation: Therefore the LORD was very angry with Israel, and removed them out of his sight: there was none left but the tribe of Judah only.

verses.original: גַּם יְהוּדָ֕ה לֹ֣א שָׁמַ֔ר אֶת מִצְוֺ֖ת יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֵי/הֶ֑ם וַ/יֵּ֣לְכ֔וּ בְּ/חֻקּ֥וֹת יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל אֲשֶׁ֥ר עָשֽׂוּ
verses.translit: gm yhvdh l' shmr 't mtsvt yhvh 'lhyhm vylkhv bchqvt yshr'l 'shr 'shv
verses.translation: Also Judah kept not the commandments of the LORD their God, but walked in the statutes of Israel which they made.

verses.original: וַ/יִּמְאַ֨ס יְהוָ֜ה בְּ/כָל זֶ֤רַע יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ וַ/יְעַנֵּ֔/ם וַֽ/יִּתְּנֵ֖/ם בְּ/יַד שֹׁסִ֑ים עַ֛ד אֲשֶׁ֥ר הִשְׁלִיכָ֖/ם מִ/פָּנָֽי/ו
verses.translit: vym's yhvh bkhl zr' yshr'l vy'nm vytnm byd shsym 'd 'shr hshlykhm mpnyv
verses.translation: And the LORD rejected all the seed of Israel, and afflicted them, and delivered them into the hand of spoilers, until he had cast them out of his sight.

verses.original: כִּֽי קָרַ֣ע יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל מֵ/עַל֙ בֵּ֣ית דָּוִ֔ד וַ/יַּמְלִ֖יכוּ אֶת יָרָבְעָ֣ם בֶּן נְבָ֑ט ו/ידא וַ/יַּדַּ֨ח יָרָבְעָ֤ם אֶת יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ מֵ/אַחֲרֵ֣י יְהוָ֔ה וְ/הֶחֱטֵיאָ֖/ם חֲטָאָ֥ה גְדוֹלָֽה
verses.translit: khy qr' yshr'l m'l byt dvd vymlykhv 't yrb'm bn nbt vyd' vydch yrb'm 't yshr'l m'chry yhvh vhchty'm cht'h gdvlh
verses.translation: For he rent Israel from the house of David; and they made Jeroboam the son of Nebat king: and Jeroboam drave Israel from following the LORD , and made them sin a great sin.

verses.original: וַ/יֵּֽלְכוּ֙ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל בְּ/כָל חַטֹּ֥אות יָרָבְעָ֖ם אֲשֶׁ֣ר עָשָׂ֑ה לֹא סָ֖רוּ מִמֶּֽ/נָּה
verses.translit: vylkhv bny yshr'l bkhl cht'vt yrb'm 'shr 'shh l' srv mmnh
verses.translation: For the children of Israel walked in all the sins of Jeroboam which he did; they departed not from them;

verses.original: עַ֠ד אֲשֶׁר הֵסִ֨יר יְהוָ֤ה אֶת יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ מֵ/עַ֣ל פָּנָ֔י/ו כַּ/אֲשֶׁ֣ר דִּבֶּ֔ר בְּ/יַ֖ד כָּל עֲבָדָ֣י/ו הַ/נְּבִיאִ֑ים וַ/יִּ֨גֶל יִשְׂרָאֵ֜ל מֵ/עַ֤ל אַדְמָת/וֹ֙ אַשּׁ֔וּרָ/ה עַ֖ד הַ/יּ֥וֹם הַ/זֶּֽה
verses.translit: 'd 'shr hsyr yhvh 't yshr'l m'l pnyv kh'shr dbr byd khl 'bdyv hnby'ym vygl yshr'l m'l 'dmtv 'shvrh 'd hyvm hzh
verses.translation: Until the LORD removed Israel out of his sight, as he had said by all his servants the prophets. So was Israel carried away out of their own land to Assyria unto this day.

verses.original: וַ/יָּבֵ֣א מֶֽלֶךְ אַשּׁ֡וּר מִ/בָּבֶ֡ל וּ֠/מִ/כּוּ֠תָ/ה וּ/מֵ/עַוָּ֤א וּ/מֵֽ/חֲמָת֙ וּ/סְפַרְוַ֔יִם וַ/יֹּ֨שֶׁב֙ בְּ/עָרֵ֣י שֹֽׁמְר֔וֹן תַּ֖חַת בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וַ/יִּֽרְשׁוּ֙ אֶת שֹׁ֣מְר֔וֹן וַ/יֵּֽשְׁב֖וּ בְּ/עָרֶֽי/הָ
verses.translit: vyb' mlkh 'shvr mbbl vmkhvth vm'v' vmchmt vsprvym vyshb b'ry shmrvn tcht bny yshr'l vyrshv 't shmrvn vyshbv b'ryh
verses.translation: And the king of Assyria brought men from Babylon, and from Cuthah, and from Ava, and from Hamath, and from Sepharvaim, and placed them in the cities of Samaria instead of the children of Israel: and they possessed Samaria, and dwelt in the cities thereof.

verses.original: וַ/יְהִ֗י בִּ/תְחִלַּת֙ שִׁבְתָּ֣/ם שָׁ֔ם לֹ֥א יָרְא֖וּ אֶת יְהוָ֑ה וַ/יְשַׁלַּ֨ח יְהוָ֤ה בָּ/הֶם֙ אֶת הָ֣/אֲרָי֔וֹת וַ/יִּֽהְי֥וּ הֹרְגִ֖ים בָּ/הֶֽם
verses.translit: vyhy btchlt shbtm shm l' yr'v 't yhvh vyshlch yhvh bhm 't h'ryvt vyhyv hrgym bhm
verses.translation: And so it was at the beginning of their dwelling there, that they feared not the LORD : therefore the LORD sent lions among them, which slew some of them.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּאמְר֗וּ לְ/מֶ֣לֶךְ אַשּׁוּר֮ לֵ/אמֹר֒ הַ/גּוֹיִ֗ם אֲשֶׁ֤ר הִגְלִ֨יתָ֙ וַ/תּ֨וֹשֶׁב֙ בְּ/עָרֵ֣י שֹׁמְר֔וֹן לֹ֣א יָֽדְע֔וּ אֶת מִשְׁפַּ֖ט אֱלֹהֵ֣י הָ/אָ֑רֶץ וַ/יְשַׁלַּח בָּ֣/ם אֶת הָ/אֲרָי֗וֹת וְ/הִנָּ/ם֙ מְמִיתִ֣ים אוֹתָ֔/ם כַּ/אֲשֶׁר֙ אֵינָ֣/ם יֹדְעִ֔ים אֶת מִשְׁפַּ֖ט אֱלֹהֵ֥י הָ/אָֽרֶץ
verses.translit: vy'mrv lmlkh 'shvr l'mr hgvym 'shr hglyt vtvshb b'ry shmrvn l' yd'v 't mshpt 'lhy h'rts vyshlch bm 't h'ryvt vhnm mmytym 'vtm kh'shr 'ynm yd'ym 't mshpt 'lhy h'rts
verses.translation: Wherefore they spake to the king of Assyria, saying, The nations which thou hast removed, and placed in the cities of Samaria, know not the manner of the God of the land: therefore he hath sent lions among them, and, behold, they slay them, because they know not the manner of the God of the land.

verses.original: וַ/יְצַ֨ו מֶֽלֶךְ אַשּׁ֜וּר לֵ/אמֹ֗ר הֹלִ֤יכוּ שָׁ֨מָּ/ה֙ אֶחָ֤ד מֵ/הַ/כֹּֽהֲנִים֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר הִגְלִיתֶ֣ם מִ/שָּׁ֔ם וְ/יֵלְכ֖וּ וְ/יֵ֣שְׁבוּ שָׁ֑ם וְ/יֹרֵ֕/ם אֶת מִשְׁפַּ֖ט אֱלֹהֵ֥י הָ/אָֽרֶץ
verses.translit: vytsv mlkh 'shvr l'mr hlykhv shmh 'chd mhkhhnym 'shr hglytm mshm vylkhv vyshbv shm vyrm 't mshpt 'lhy h'rts
verses.translation: Then the king of Assyria commanded, saying, Carry thither one of the priests whom ye brought from thence; and let them go and dwell there, and let him teach them the manner of the God of the land.

verses.original: וַ/יָּבֹ֞א אֶחָ֣ד מֵ/הַ/כֹּהֲנִ֗ים אֲשֶׁ֤ר הִגְלוּ֙ מִ/שֹּׁ֣מְר֔וֹן וַ/יֵּ֖שֶׁב בְּ/בֵֽית אֵ֑ל וַֽ/יְהִי֙ מוֹרֶ֣ה אֹתָ֔/ם אֵ֖יךְ יִֽירְא֥וּ אֶת יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: vyb' 'chd mhkhhnym 'shr hglv mshmrvn vyshb bbyt 'l vyhy mvrh 'tm 'ykh yyr'v 't yhvh
verses.translation: Then one of the priests whom they had carried away from Samaria came and dwelt in Beth-el, and taught them how they should fear the LORD .

verses.original: וַ/יִּהְי֣וּ עֹשִׂ֔ים גּ֥וֹי גּ֖וֹי אֱלֹהָ֑י/ו וַ/יַּנִּ֣יחוּ בְּ/בֵ֣ית הַ/בָּמ֗וֹת אֲשֶׁ֤ר עָשׂוּ֙ הַ/שֹּׁ֣מְרֹנִ֔ים גּ֥וֹי גּוֹי֙ בְּ/עָ֣רֵי/הֶ֔ם אֲשֶׁ֛ר הֵ֥ם יֹשְׁבִ֖ים שָֽׁם
verses.translit: vyhyv 'shym gvy gvy 'lhyv vynychv bbyt hbmvt 'shr 'shv hshmrnym gvy gvy b'ryhm 'shr hm yshbym shm
verses.translation: Howbeit every nation made gods of their own, and put them in the houses of the high places which the Samaritans had made, every nation in their cities wherein they dwelt.

verses.original: וְ/אַנְשֵׁ֣י בָבֶ֗ל עָשׂוּ֙ אֶת סֻכּ֣וֹת בְּנ֔וֹת וְ/אַנְשֵׁי כ֔וּת עָשׂ֖וּ אֶת נֵֽרְגַ֑ל וְ/אַנְשֵׁ֥י חֲמָ֖ת עָשׂ֥וּ אֶת אֲשִׁימָֽא
verses.translit: v'nshy bbl 'shv 't skhvt bnvt v'nshy khvt 'shv 't nrgl v'nshy chmt 'shv 't 'shym'
verses.translation: And the men of Babylon made Succoth-benoth, and the men of Cuth made Nergal, and the men of Hamath made Ashima,

verses.original: וְ/הָ/עַוִּ֛ים עָשׂ֥וּ נִבְחַ֖ז וְ/אֶת תַּרְתָּ֑ק וְ/הַ/סְפַרְוִ֗ים שֹׂרְפִ֤ים אֶת בְּנֵי/הֶם֙ בָּ/אֵ֔שׁ לְ/אַדְרַמֶּ֥לֶךְ וַֽ/עֲנַמֶּ֖לֶךְ אלה אֱלֹהֵ֥י ספרים סְפַרְוָֽיִם
verses.translit: vh'vym 'shv nbchz v't trtq vhsprvym shrpym 't bnyhm b'sh l'drmlkh v'nmlkh 'lh 'lhy sprym sprvym
verses.translation: And the Avites made Nibhaz and Tartak, and the Sepharvites burnt their children in fire to Adrammelech and Anammelech, the gods of Sepharvaim.

verses.original: וַ/יִּהְי֥וּ יְרֵאִ֖ים אֶת יְהוָ֑ה וַ/יַּעֲשׂ֨וּ לָ/הֶ֤ם מִ/קְצוֹתָ/ם֙ כֹּהֲנֵ֣י בָמ֔וֹת וַ/יִּהְי֛וּ עֹשִׂ֥ים לָ/הֶ֖ם בְּ/בֵ֥ית הַ/בָּמֽוֹת
verses.translit: vyhyv yr'ym 't yhvh vy'shv lhm mqtsvtm khhny bmvt vyhyv 'shym lhm bbyt hbmvt
verses.translation: So they feared the LORD , and made unto themselves of the lowest of them priests of the high places, which sacrificed for them in the houses of the high places.

verses.original: אֶת יְהוָ֖ה הָי֣וּ יְרֵאִ֑ים וְ/אֶת אֱלֹֽהֵי/הֶם֙ הָי֣וּ עֹֽבְדִ֔ים כְּ/מִשְׁפַּט֙ הַ/גּוֹיִ֔ם אֲשֶׁר הִגְל֥וּ אֹתָ֖/ם מִ/שָּֽׁם
verses.translit: 't yhvh hyv yr'ym v't 'lhyhm hyv 'bdym khmshpt hgvym 'shr hglv 'tm mshm
verses.translation: They feared the LORD , and served their own gods, after the manner of the nations whom they carried away from thence.

verses.original: עַ֣ד הַ/יּ֤וֹם הַ/זֶּה֙ הֵ֣ם עֹשִׂ֔ים כַּ/מִּשְׁפָּטִ֖ים הָ/רִֽאשֹׁנִ֑ים אֵינָ֤/ם יְרֵאִים֙ אֶת יְהוָ֔ה וְ/אֵינָ֣/ם עֹשִׂ֗ים כְּ/חֻקֹּתָ/ם֙ וּ/כְ/מִשְׁפָּטָ֔/ם וְ/כַ/תּוֹרָ֣ה וְ/כַ/מִּצְוָ֗ה אֲשֶׁ֨ר צִוָּ֤ה יְהוָה֙ אֶת בְּנֵ֣י יַעֲקֹ֔ב אֲשֶׁר שָׂ֥ם שְׁמ֖/וֹ יִשְׂרָאֵֽל
verses.translit: 'd hyvm hzh hm 'shym khmshptym hr'shnym 'ynm yr'ym 't yhvh v'ynm 'shym khchqtm vkhmshptm vkhtvrh vkhmtsvh 'shr tsvh yhvh 't bny y'qb 'shr shm shmv yshr'l
verses.translation: Unto this day they do after the former manners: they fear not the LORD , neither do they after their statutes, or after their ordinances, or after the law and commandment which the LORD commanded the children of Jacob, whom he named Israel;

verses.original: וַ/יִּכְרֹ֨ת יְהוָ֤ה אִתָּ/ם֙ בְּרִ֔ית וַ/יְצַוֵּ֣/ם לֵ/אמֹ֔ר לֹ֥א תִֽירְא֖וּ אֱלֹהִ֣ים אֲחֵרִ֑ים וְ/לֹא תִשְׁתַּחֲו֣וּ לָ/הֶ֔ם וְ/לֹ֣א תַעַבְד֔וּ/ם וְ/לֹ֥א תִזְבְּח֖וּ לָ/הֶֽם
verses.translit: vykhrt yhvh 'tm bryt vytsvm l'mr l' tyr'v 'lhym 'chrym vl' tshtchvv lhm vl' t'bdvm vl' tzbchv lhm
verses.translation: With whom the LORD had made a covenant, and charged them, saying, Ye shall not fear other gods, nor bow yourselves to them, nor serve them, nor sacrifice to them:

verses.original: כִּ֣י אִֽם אֶת יְהוָ֗ה אֲשֶׁר֩ הֶעֱלָ֨ה אֶתְ/כֶ֜ם מֵ/אֶ֧רֶץ מִצְרַ֛יִם בְּ/כֹ֧חַ גָּד֛וֹל וּ/בִ/זְר֥וֹעַ נְטוּיָ֖ה אֹת֣/וֹ תִירָ֑אוּ וְ/ל֥/וֹ תִֽשְׁתַּחֲו֖וּ וְ/ל֥/וֹ תִזְבָּֽחוּ
verses.translit: khy 'm 't yhvh 'shr h'lh 'tkhm m'rts mtsrym bkhch gdvl vbzrv' ntvyh 'tv tyr'v vlv tshtchvv vlv tzbchv
verses.translation: But the LORD , who brought you up out of the land of Egypt with great power and a stretched out arm, him shall ye fear, and him shall ye worship, and to him shall ye do sacrifice.

verses.original: וְ/אֶת הַ/חֻקִּ֨ים וְ/אֶת הַ/מִּשְׁפָּטִ֜ים וְ/הַ/תּוֹרָ֤ה וְ/הַ/מִּצְוָה֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר כָּתַ֣ב לָ/כֶ֔ם תִּשְׁמְר֥וּ/ן לַ/עֲשׂ֖וֹת כָּל הַ/יָּמִ֑ים וְ/לֹ֥א תִֽירְא֖וּ אֱלֹהִ֥ים אֲחֵרִֽים
verses.translit: v't hchqym v't hmshptym vhtvrh vhmtsvh 'shr khtb lkhm tshmrvn l'shvt khl hymym vl' tyr'v 'lhym 'chrym
verses.translation: And the statutes, and the ordinances, and the law, and the commandment, which he wrote for you, ye shall observe to do for evermore; and ye shall not fear other gods.

verses.original: וְ/הַ/בְּרִ֛ית אֲשֶׁר כָּרַ֥תִּי אִתְּ/כֶ֖ם לֹ֣א תִשְׁכָּ֑חוּ וְ/לֹ֥א תִֽירְא֖וּ אֱלֹהִ֥ים אֲחֵרִֽים
verses.translit: vhbryt 'shr khrty 'tkhm l' tshkhchv vl' tyr'v 'lhym 'chrym
verses.translation: And the covenant that I have made with you ye shall not forget; neither shall ye fear other gods.

verses.original: כִּ֛י אִֽם אֶת יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֵי/כֶ֖ם תִּירָ֑אוּ וְ/הוּא֙ יַצִּ֣יל אֶתְ/כֶ֔ם מִ/יַּ֖ד כָּל אֹיְבֵי/כֶֽם
verses.translit: khy 'm 't yhvh 'lhykhm tyr'v vhv' ytsyl 'tkhm myd khl 'ybykhm
verses.translation: But the LORD your God ye shall fear; and he shall deliver you out of the hand of all your enemies.

verses.original: וְ/לֹ֖א שָׁמֵ֑עוּ כִּ֛י אִֽם כְּ/מִשְׁפָּטָ֥/ם הָֽ/רִאשׁ֖וֹן הֵ֥ם עֹשִֽׂים
verses.translit: vl' shm'v khy 'm khmshptm hr'shvn hm 'shym
verses.translation: Howbeit they did not hearken, but they did after their former manner.

verses.original: וַ/יִּהְי֣וּ הַ/גּוֹיִ֣ם הָ/אֵ֗לֶּה יְרֵאִים֙ אֶת יְהוָ֔ה וְ/אֶת פְּסִֽילֵי/הֶ֖ם הָי֣וּ עֹֽבְדִ֑ים גַּם בְּנֵי/הֶ֣ם וּ/בְנֵ֣י בְנֵי/הֶ֗ם כַּ/אֲשֶׁ֨ר עָשׂ֤וּ אֲבֹתָ/ם֙ הֵ֣ם עֹשִׂ֔ים עַ֖ד הַ/יּ֥וֹם הַ/זֶּֽה
verses.translit: vyhyv hgvym h'lh yr'ym 't yhvh v't psylyhm hyv 'bdym gm bnyhm vbny bnyhm kh'shr 'shv 'btm hm 'shym 'd hyvm hzh
verses.translation: So these nations feared the LORD , and served their graven images, both their children, and their children’s children: as did their fathers, so do they unto this day.

verses.original: וַֽ/יְהִי֙ בִּ/שְׁנַ֣ת שָׁלֹ֔שׁ לְ/הוֹשֵׁ֥עַ בֶּן אֵלָ֖ה מֶ֣לֶךְ יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל מָלַ֛ךְ חִזְקִיָּ֥ה בֶן אָחָ֖ז מֶ֥לֶךְ יְהוּדָֽה
verses.translit: vyhy bshnt shlsh lhvsh' bn 'lh mlkh yshr'l mlkh chzqyh bn 'chz mlkh yhvdh
verses.translation: Now it came to pass in the third year of Hoshea son of Elah king of Israel, that Hezekiah the son of Ahaz king of Judah began to reign.

verses.original: בֶּן עֶשְׂרִ֨ים וְ/חָמֵ֤שׁ שָׁנָה֙ הָיָ֣ה בְ/מָלְכ֔/וֹ וְ/עֶשְׂרִ֤ים וָ/תֵ֨שַׁע֙ שָׁנָ֔ה מָלַ֖ךְ בִּ/ירוּשָׁלִָ֑ם וְ/שֵׁ֣ם אִמּ֔/וֹ אֲבִ֖י בַּת זְכַרְיָֽה
verses.translit: bn 'shrym vchmsh shnh hyh bmlkhv v'shrym vtsh' shnh mlkh byrvshlm vshm 'mv 'by bt zkhryh
verses.translation: Twenty and five years old was he when he began to reign; and he reigned twenty and nine years in Jerusalem. His mother’s name also was Abi, the daughter of Zachariah.

verses.original: וַ/יַּ֥עַשׂ הַ/יָּשָׁ֖ר בְּ/עֵינֵ֣י יְהוָ֑ה כְּ/כֹ֥ל אֲשֶׁר עָשָׂ֖ה דָּוִ֥ד אָבִֽי/ו
verses.translit: vy'sh hyshr b'yny yhvh khkhl 'shr 'shh dvd 'byv
verses.translation: And he did that which was right in the sight of the LORD , according to all that David his father did.

verses.original: ה֣וּא הֵסִ֣יר אֶת הַ/בָּמ֗וֹת וְ/שִׁבַּר֙ אֶת הַ/מַּצֵּבֹ֔ת וְ/כָרַ֖ת אֶת הָֽ/אֲשֵׁרָ֑ה וְ/כִתַּת֩ נְחַ֨שׁ הַ/נְּחֹ֜שֶׁת אֲשֶׁר עָשָׂ֣ה מֹשֶׁ֗ה כִּ֣י עַד הַ/יָּמִ֤ים הָ/הֵ֨מָּה֙ הָי֤וּ בְנֵֽי יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ מְקַטְּרִ֣ים ל֔/וֹ וַ/יִּקְרָא ל֖/וֹ נְחֻשְׁתָּֽן
verses.translit: hv' hsyr 't hbmvt vshbr 't hmtsbt vkhrt 't h'shrh vkhtt nchsh hnchsht 'shr 'shh mshh khy 'd hymym hhmh hyv bny yshr'l mqtrym lv vyqr' lv nchshtn
verses.translation: He removed the high places, and brake the images, and cut down the groves, and brake in pieces the brasen serpent that Moses had made: for unto those days the children of Israel did burn incense to it: and he called it Nehushtan.

verses.original: בַּ/יהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֵֽי יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל בָּטָ֑ח וְ/אַחֲרָ֞י/ו לֹא הָיָ֣ה כָמֹ֗/הוּ בְּ/כֹל֙ מַלְכֵ֣י יְהוּדָ֔ה וַ/אֲשֶׁ֥ר הָי֖וּ לְ/פָנָֽי/ו
verses.translit: byhvh 'lhy yshr'l btch v'chryv l' hyh khmhv bkhl mlkhy yhvdh v'shr hyv lpnyv
verses.translation: He trusted in the LORD God of Israel; so that after him was none like him among all the kings of Judah, nor any that were before him.

verses.original: וַ/יִּדְבַּק֙ בַּֽ/יהוָ֔ה לֹא סָ֖ר מֵ/אַֽחֲרָ֑י/ו וַ/יִּשְׁמֹר֙ מִצְוֺתָ֔י/ו אֲשֶׁר צִוָּ֥ה יְהוָ֖ה אֶת מֹשֶֽׁה
verses.translit: vydbq byhvh l' sr m'chryv vyshmr mtsvtyv 'shr tsvh yhvh 't mshh
verses.translation: For he clave to the LORD , and departed not from following him, but kept his commandments, which the LORD commanded Moses.

verses.original: וְ/הָיָ֤ה יְהוָה֙ עִמּ֔/וֹ בְּ/כֹ֥ל אֲשֶׁר יֵצֵ֖א יַשְׂכִּ֑יל וַ/יִּמְרֹ֥ד בְּ/מֶֽלֶךְ אַשּׁ֖וּר וְ/לֹ֥א עֲבָדֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: vhyh yhvh 'mv bkhl 'shr yts' yshkhyl vymrd bmlkh 'shvr vl' 'bdv
verses.translation: And the LORD was with him; and he prospered whithersoever he went forth: and he rebelled against the king of Assyria, and served him not.

verses.original: הֽוּא הִכָּ֧ה אֶת פְּלִשְׁתִּ֛ים עַד עַזָּ֖ה וְ/אֶת גְּבוּלֶ֑י/הָ מִ/מִּגְדַּ֥ל נוֹצְרִ֖ים עַד עִ֥יר מִבְצָֽר
verses.translit: hv' hkhh 't plshtym 'd 'zh v't gbvlyh mmgdl nvtsrym 'd 'yr mbtsr
verses.translation: He smote the Philistines, even unto Gaza, and the borders thereof, from the tower of the watchmen to the fenced city.

verses.original: וַֽ/יְהִ֞י בַּ/שָּׁנָ֤ה הָֽ/רְבִיעִית֙ לַ/מֶּ֣לֶךְ חִזְקִיָּ֔הוּ הִ֚יא הַ/שָּׁנָ֣ה הַ/שְּׁבִיעִ֔ית לְ/הוֹשֵׁ֥עַ בֶּן אֵלָ֖ה מֶ֣לֶךְ יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל עָלָ֞ה שַׁלְמַנְאֶ֧סֶר מֶֽלֶךְ אַשּׁ֛וּר עַל שֹׁמְר֖וֹן וַ/יָּ֥צַר עָלֶֽי/הָ
verses.translit: vyhy bshnh hrby'yt lmlkh chzqyhv hy' hshnh hshby'yt lhvsh' bn 'lh mlkh yshr'l 'lh shlmn'sr mlkh 'shvr 'l shmrvn vytsr 'lyh
verses.translation: And it came to pass in the fourth year of king Hezekiah, which was the seventh year of Hoshea son of Elah king of Israel, that Shalmaneser king of Assyria came up against Samaria, and besieged it.

verses.original: וַֽ/יִּלְכְּדֻ֗/הָ מִ/קְצֵה֙ שָׁלֹ֣שׁ שָׁנִ֔ים בִּ/שְׁנַת שֵׁ֖שׁ לְ/חִזְקִיָּ֑ה הִ֣יא שְׁנַת תֵּ֗שַׁע לְ/הוֹשֵׁ֨עַ֙ מֶ֣לֶךְ יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל נִלְכְּדָ֖ה שֹׁמְרֽוֹן
verses.translit: vylkhdh mqtsh shlsh shnym bshnt shsh lchzqyh hy' shnt tsh' lhvsh' mlkh yshr'l nlkhdh shmrvn
verses.translation: And at the end of three years they took it: even in the sixth year of Hezekiah, that is the ninth year of Hoshea king of Israel, Samaria was taken.

verses.original: וַ/יֶּ֧גֶל מֶֽלֶךְ אַשּׁ֛וּר אֶת יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל אַשּׁ֑וּרָ/ה וַ/יַּנְחֵ֞/ם בַּ/חְלַ֧ח וּ/בְ/חָב֛וֹר נְהַ֥ר גּוֹזָ֖ן וְ/עָרֵ֥י מָדָֽי
verses.translit: vygl mlkh 'shvr 't yshr'l 'shvrh vynchm bchlch vbchbvr nhr gvzn v'ry mdy
verses.translation: And the king of Assyria did carry away Israel unto Assyria, and put them in Halah and in Habor by the river of Gozan, and in the cities of the Medes:

verses.original: עַ֣ל אֲשֶׁ֣ר לֹֽא שָׁמְע֗וּ בְּ/קוֹל֙ יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֵי/הֶ֔ם וַ/יַּעַבְרוּ֙ אֶת בְּרִית֔/וֹ אֵ֚ת כָּל אֲשֶׁ֣ר צִוָּ֔ה מֹשֶׁ֖ה עֶ֣בֶד יְהוָ֑ה וְ/לֹ֥א שָׁמְע֖וּ וְ/לֹ֥א עָשֽׂוּ
verses.translit: 'l 'shr l' shm'v bqvl yhvh 'lhyhm vy'brv 't brytv 't khl 'shr tsvh mshh 'bd yhvh vl' shm'v vl' 'shv
verses.translation: Because they obeyed not the voice of the LORD their God, but transgressed his covenant, and all that Moses the servant of the LORD commanded, and would not hear them , nor do them .

verses.original: וּ/בְ/אַרְבַּע֩ עֶשְׂרֵ֨ה שָׁנָ֜ה לַ/מֶּ֣לֶךְ חִזְקִיָּ֗ה עָלָ֞ה סַנְחֵרִ֤יב מֶֽלֶךְ אַשּׁוּר֙ עַ֣ל כָּל עָרֵ֧י יְהוּדָ֛ה הַ/בְּצֻר֖וֹת וַֽ/יִּתְפְּשֵֽׂ/ם
verses.translit: vb'rb' 'shrh shnh lmlkh chzqyh 'lh snchryb mlkh 'shvr 'l khl 'ry yhvdh hbtsrvt vytpshm
verses.translation: Now in the fourteenth year of king Hezekiah did Sennacherib king of Assyria come up against all the fenced cities of Judah, and took them.

verses.original: וַ/יִּשְׁלַ֣ח חִזְקִיָּ֣ה מֶֽלֶךְ יְהוּדָ֣ה אֶל מֶֽלֶךְ אַשּׁוּר֩ לָכִ֨ישָׁ/ה לֵ/אמֹ֤ר חָטָ֨אתִי֙ שׁ֣וּב מֵֽ/עָלַ֔/י אֵ֛ת אֲשֶׁר תִּתֵּ֥ן עָלַ֖/י אֶשָּׂ֑א וַ/יָּ֨שֶׂם מֶֽלֶךְ אַשּׁ֜וּר עַל חִזְקִיָּ֣ה מֶֽלֶךְ יְהוּדָ֗ה שְׁלֹ֤שׁ מֵאוֹת֙ כִּכַּר כֶּ֔סֶף וּ/שְׁלֹשִׁ֖ים כִּכַּ֥ר זָהָֽב
verses.translit: vyshlch chzqyh mlkh yhvdh 'l mlkh 'shvr lkhyshh l'mr cht'ty shvb m'ly 't 'shr ttn 'ly 'sh' vyshm mlkh 'shvr 'l chzqyh mlkh yhvdh shlsh m'vt khkhr khsf vshlshym khkhr zhb
verses.translation: And Hezekiah king of Judah sent to the king of Assyria to Lachish, saying, I have offended; return from me: that which thou puttest on me will I bear. And the king of Assyria appointed unto Hezekiah king of Judah three hundred talents of silver and thirty talents of gold.

verses.original: וַ/יִּתֵּן֙ חִזְקִיָּ֔ה אֶת כָּל הַ/כֶּ֖סֶף הַ/נִּמְצָ֣א בֵית יְהוָ֑ה וּ/בְ/אֹצְר֖וֹת בֵּ֥ית הַ/מֶּֽלֶךְ
verses.translit: vytn chzqyh 't khl hkhsf hnmts' byt yhvh vb'tsrvt byt hmlkh
verses.translation: And Hezekiah gave him all the silver that was found in the house of the LORD , and in the treasures of the king’s house.

verses.original: בָּ/עֵ֣ת הַ/הִ֗יא קִצַּ֨ץ חִזְקִיָּ֜ה אֶת דַּלְת֨וֹת הֵיכַ֤ל יְהוָה֙ וְ/אֶת הָ/אֹ֣מְנ֔וֹת אֲשֶׁ֣ר צִפָּ֔ה חִזְקִיָּ֖ה מֶ֣לֶךְ יְהוּדָ֑ה וַֽ/יִּתְּנֵ֖/ם לְ/מֶ֥לֶךְ אַשּֽׁוּר
verses.translit: b't hhy' qtsts chzqyh 't dltvt hykhl yhvh v't h'mnvt 'shr tsph chzqyh mlkh yhvdh vytnm lmlkh 'shvr
verses.translation: At that time did Hezekiah cut off the gold from the doors of the temple of the LORD , and from the pillars which Hezekiah king of Judah had overlaid, and gave it to the king of Assyria.

verses.original: וַ/יִּשְׁלַ֣ח מֶֽלֶךְ אַשּׁ֡וּר אֶת תַּרְתָּ֥ן וְ/אֶת רַב סָרִ֣יס וְ/אֶת רַב שָׁקֵ֨ה מִן לָכִ֜ישׁ אֶל הַ/מֶּ֧לֶךְ חִזְקִיָּ֛הוּ בְּ/חֵ֥יל כָּבֵ֖ד יְרוּשָׁלִָ֑ם וַֽ/יַּעֲלוּ֙ וַ/יָּבֹ֣אוּ יְרוּשָׁלִַ֔ם וַ/יַּעֲל֣וּ וַ/יָּבֹ֗אוּ וַ/יַּֽעַמְדוּ֙ בִּ/תְעָלַת֙ הַ/בְּרֵכָ֣ה הָֽ/עֶלְיוֹנָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֕ר בִּ/מְסִלַּ֖ת שְׂדֵ֥ה כוֹבֵֽס
verses.translit: vyshlch mlkh 'shvr 't trtn v't rb srys v't rb shqh mn lkhysh 'l hmlkh chzqyhv bchyl khbd yrvshlm vy'lv vyb'v yrvshlm vy'lv vyb'v vy'mdv bt'lt hbrkhh h'lyvnh 'shr bmslt shdh khvbs
verses.translation: And the king of Assyria sent Tartan and Rabsaris and Rab-shakeh from Lachish to king Hezekiah with a great host against Jerusalem. And they went up and came to Jerusalem. And when they were come up, they came and stood by the conduit of the upper pool, which is in the highway of the fuller’s field.

verses.original: וַֽ/יִּקְרְאוּ֙ אֶל הַ/מֶּ֔לֶךְ וַ/יֵּצֵ֧א אֲלֵ/הֶ֛ם אֶלְיָקִ֥ים בֶּן חִלְקִיָּ֖הוּ אֲשֶׁ֣ר עַל הַ/בָּ֑יִת וְ/שֶׁבְנָה֙ הַ/סֹּפֵ֔ר וְ/יוֹאָ֥ח בֶּן אָסָ֖ף הַ/מַּזְכִּֽיר
verses.translit: vyqr'v 'l hmlkh vyts' 'lhm 'lyqym bn chlqyhv 'shr 'l hbyt vshbnh hspr vyv'ch bn 'sf hmzkhyr
verses.translation: And when they had called to the king, there came out to them Eliakim the son of Hilkiah, which was over the household, and Shebna the scribe, and Joah the son of Asaph the recorder.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֤אמֶר אֲלֵ/הֶם֙ רַב שָׁקֵ֔ה אִמְרוּ נָ֖א אֶל חִזְקִיָּ֑הוּ כֹּֽה אָמַ֞ר הַ/מֶּ֤לֶךְ הַ/גָּדוֹל֙ מֶ֣לֶךְ אַשּׁ֔וּר מָ֧ה הַ/בִּטָּח֛וֹן הַ/זֶּ֖ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר בָּטָֽחְתָּ
verses.translit: vy'mr 'lhm rb shqh 'mrv n' 'l chzqyhv khh 'mr hmlkh hgdvl mlkh 'shvr mh hbtchvn hzh 'shr btcht
verses.translation: And Rab-shakeh said unto them, Speak ye now to Hezekiah, Thus saith the great king, the king of Assyria, What confidence is this wherein thou trustest?

verses.original: אָמַ֨רְתָּ֙ אַךְ דְּבַר שְׂפָתַ֔יִם עֵצָ֥ה וּ/גְבוּרָ֖ה לַ/מִּלְחָמָ֑ה עַתָּה֙ עַל מִ֣י בָטַ֔חְתָּ כִּ֥י מָרַ֖דְתָּ בִּֽ/י
verses.translit: 'mrt 'kh dbr shptym 'tsh vgbvrh lmlchmh 'th 'l my btcht khy mrdt by
verses.translation: Thou sayest, (but they are but vain words,) I have counsel and strength for the war. Now on whom dost thou trust, that thou rebellest against me?

verses.original: עַתָּ֡ה הִנֵּ֣ה בָטַ֣חְתָּ לְּ/ךָ֡ עַל מִשְׁעֶנֶת֩ הַ/קָּנֶ֨ה הָ/רָצ֤וּץ הַ/זֶּה֙ עַל מִצְרַ֔יִם אֲשֶׁ֨ר יִסָּמֵ֥ךְ אִישׁ֙ עָלָ֔י/ו וּ/בָ֥א בְ/כַפּ֖/וֹ וּ/נְקָבָ֑/הּ כֵּ֚ן פַּרְעֹ֣ה מֶֽלֶךְ מִצְרַ֔יִם לְ/כָֽל הַ/בֹּטְחִ֖ים עָלָֽי/ו
verses.translit: 'th hnh btcht lkh 'l msh'nt hqnh hrtsvts hzh 'l mtsrym 'shr ysmkh 'ysh 'lyv vb' bkhpv vnqbh khn pr'h mlkh mtsrym lkhl hbtchym 'lyv
verses.translation: Now, behold, thou trustest upon the staff of this bruised reed, even upon Egypt, on which if a man lean, it will go into his hand, and pierce it: so is Pharaoh king of Egypt unto all that trust on him.

verses.original: וְ/כִי תֹאמְר֣וּ/ן אֵלַ֔/י אֶל יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֵ֖י/נוּ בָּטָ֑חְנוּ הֲ/לוֹא ה֗וּא אֲשֶׁ֨ר הֵסִ֤יר חִזְקִיָּ֨הוּ֙ אֶת בָּמֹתָ֣י/ו וְ/אֶת מִזְבְּחֹתָ֔י/ו וַ/יֹּ֤אמֶר לִֽ/יהוּדָה֙ וְ/לִ/יר֣וּשָׁלִַ֔ם לִ/פְנֵי֙ הַ/מִּזְבֵּ֣חַ הַ/זֶּ֔ה תִּֽשְׁתַּחֲו֖וּ בִּ/ירוּשָׁלִָֽם
verses.translit: vkhy t'mrvn 'ly 'l yhvh 'lhynv btchnv hlv' hv' 'shr hsyr chzqyhv 't bmtyv v't mzbchtyv vy'mr lyhvdh vlyrvshlm lpny hmzbch hzh tshtchvv byrvshlm
verses.translation: But if ye say unto me, We trust in the LORD our God: is not that he, whose high places and whose altars Hezekiah hath taken away, and hath said to Judah and Jerusalem, Ye shall worship before this altar in Jerusalem?

verses.original: וְ/עַתָּה֙ הִתְעָ֣רֶב נָ֔א אֶת אֲדֹנִ֖/י אֶת מֶ֣לֶךְ אַשּׁ֑וּר וְ/אֶתְּנָ֤ה לְ/ךָ֙ אַלְפַּ֣יִם סוּסִ֔ים אִם תּוּכַ֕ל לָ֥/תֶת לְ/ךָ֖ רֹכְבִ֥ים עֲלֵי/הֶֽם
verses.translit: v'th ht'rb n' 't 'dny 't mlkh 'shvr v'tnh lkh 'lpym svsym 'm tvkhl ltt lkh rkhbym 'lyhm
verses.translation: Now therefore, I pray thee, give pledges to my lord the king of Assyria, and I will deliver thee two thousand horses, if thou be able on thy part to set riders upon them.

verses.original: וְ/אֵ֣יךְ תָּשִׁ֗יב אֵ֠ת פְּנֵ֨י פַחַ֥ת אַחַ֛ד עַבְדֵ֥י אֲדֹנִ֖/י הַ/קְּטַנִּ֑ים וַ/תִּבְטַ֤ח לְ/ךָ֙ עַל מִצְרַ֔יִם לְ/רֶ֖כֶב וּ/לְ/פָרָשִֽׁים
verses.translit: v'ykh tshyb 't pny pcht 'chd 'bdy 'dny hqtnym vtbtch lkh 'l mtsrym lrkhb vlprshym
verses.translation: How then wilt thou turn away the face of one captain of the least of my master’s servants, and put thy trust on Egypt for chariots and for horsemen?

verses.original: עַתָּה֙ הֲ/מִ/בַּלְעֲדֵ֣י יְהוָ֔ה עָלִ֛יתִי עַל הַ/מָּק֥וֹם הַ/זֶּ֖ה לְ/הַשְׁחִת֑/וֹ יְהוָה֙ אָמַ֣ר אֵלַ֔/י עֲלֵ֛ה עַל הָ/אָ֥רֶץ הַ/זֹּ֖את וְ/הַשְׁחִיתָֽ/הּ
verses.translit: 'th hmbl'dy yhvh 'lyty 'l hmqvm hzh lhshchtv yhvh 'mr 'ly 'lh 'l h'rts hz't vhshchyth
verses.translation: Am I now come up without the LORD against this place to destroy it? The LORD said to me, Go up against this land, and destroy it.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֣אמֶר אֶלְיָקִ֣ים בֶּן חִ֠לְקִיָּהוּ וְ/שֶׁבְנָ֨ה וְ/יוֹאָ֜ח אֶל רַב שָׁקֵ֗ה דַּבֶּר נָ֤א אֶל עֲבָדֶ֨י/ךָ֙ אֲרָמִ֔ית כִּ֥י שֹׁמְעִ֖ים אֲנָ֑חְנוּ וְ/אַל תְּדַבֵּ֤ר עִמָּ֨/נוּ֙ יְהוּדִ֔ית בְּ/אָזְנֵ֣י הָ/עָ֔ם אֲשֶׁ֖ר עַל הַ/חֹמָֽה
verses.translit: vy'mr 'lyqym bn chlqyhv vshbnh vyv'ch 'l rb shqh dbr n' 'l 'bdykh 'rmyt khy shm'ym 'nchnv v'l tdbr 'mnv yhvdyt b'zny h'm 'shr 'l hchmh
verses.translation: Then said Eliakim the son of Hilkiah, and Shebna, and Joah, unto Rab-shakeh, Speak, I pray thee, to thy servants in the Syrian language; for we understand it: and talk not with us in the Jews’ language in the ears of the people that are on the wall.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֨אמֶר אֲלֵי/הֶ֜ם רַב שָׁקֵ֗ה הַ/עַ֨ל אֲדֹנֶ֤י/ךָ וְ/אֵלֶ֨י/ךָ֙ שְׁלָחַ֣/נִי אֲדֹנִ֔/י לְ/דַבֵּ֖ר אֶת הַ/דְּבָרִ֣ים הָ/אֵ֑לֶּה הֲ/לֹ֣א עַל הָ/אֲנָשִׁ֗ים הַ/יֹּֽשְׁבִים֙ עַל הַ֣/חֹמָ֔ה לֶ/אֱכֹ֣ל אֶת חרי/הם צוֹאָתָ֗/ם וְ/לִ/שְׁתּ֛וֹת אֶת שיני/הם מימֵ֥י רַגְלֵי/הֶ֖ם עִמָּ/כֶֽם
verses.translit: vy'mr 'lyhm rb shqh h'l 'dnykh v'lykh shlchny 'dny ldbr 't hdbrym h'lh hl' 'l h'nshym hyshbym 'l hchmh l'khl 't chryhm tsv'tm vlshtvt 't shynyhm mymy rglyhm 'mkhm
verses.translation: But Rab-shakeh said unto them, Hath my master sent me to thy master, and to thee, to speak these words? hath he not sent me to the men which sit on the wall, that they may eat their own dung, and drink their own piss with you?

verses.original: וַֽ/יַּעֲמֹד֙ רַב שָׁקֵ֔ה וַ/יִּקְרָ֥א בְ/קוֹל גָּד֖וֹל יְהוּדִ֑ית וַ/יְדַבֵּ֣ר וַ/יֹּ֔אמֶר שִׁמְע֛וּ דְּבַר הַ/מֶּ֥לֶךְ הַ/גָּד֖וֹל מֶ֥לֶךְ אַשּֽׁוּר
verses.translit: vy'md rb shqh vyqr' bqvl gdvl yhvdyt vydbr vy'mr shm'v dbr hmlkh hgdvl mlkh 'shvr
verses.translation: Then Rab-shakeh stood and cried with a loud voice in the Jews’ language, and spake, saying, Hear the word of the great king, the king of Assyria:

verses.original: כֹּ֚ה אָמַ֣ר הַ/מֶּ֔לֶךְ אַל יַשִּׁ֥יא לָ/כֶ֖ם חִזְקִיָּ֑הוּ כִּי לֹ֣א יוּכַ֔ל לְ/הַצִּ֥יל אֶתְ/כֶ֖ם מִ/יָּדֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: khh 'mr hmlkh 'l yshy' lkhm chzqyhv khy l' yvkhl lhtsyl 'tkhm mydv
verses.translation: Thus saith the king, Let not Hezekiah deceive you: for he shall not be able to deliver you out of his hand:

verses.original: וְ/אַל יַבְטַ֨ח אֶתְ/כֶ֤ם חִזְקִיָּ֨הוּ֙ אֶל יְהוָ֣ה לֵ/אמֹ֔ר הַצֵּ֥ל יַצִּילֵ֖/נוּ יְהוָ֑ה וְ/לֹ֤א תִנָּתֵן֙ אֶת הָ/עִ֣יר הַ/זֹּ֔את בְּ/יַ֖ד מֶ֥לֶךְ אַשּֽׁוּר
verses.translit: v'l ybtch 'tkhm chzqyhv 'l yhvh l'mr htsl ytsylnv yhvh vl' tntn 't h'yr hz't byd mlkh 'shvr
verses.translation: Neither let Hezekiah make you trust in the LORD , saying, The LORD will surely deliver us, and this city shall not be delivered into the hand of the king of Assyria.

verses.original: אַֽל תִּשְׁמְע֖וּ אֶל חִזְקִיָּ֑הוּ כִּי֩ כֹ֨ה אָמַ֜ר מֶ֣לֶךְ אַשּׁ֗וּר עֲשֽׂוּ אִתִּ֤/י בְרָכָה֙ וּ/צְא֣וּ אֵלַ֔/י וְ/אִכְל֤וּ אִישׁ גַּפְנ/וֹ֙ וְ/אִ֣ישׁ תְּאֵֽנָת֔/וֹ וּ/שְׁת֖וּ אִ֥ישׁ מֵֽי בוֹרֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: 'l tshm'v 'l chzqyhv khy khh 'mr mlkh 'shvr 'shv 'ty brkhh vts'v 'ly v'khlv 'ysh gpnv v'ysh t'ntv vshtv 'ysh my bvrv
verses.translation: Hearken not to Hezekiah: for thus saith the king of Assyria, Make an agreement with me by a present, and come out to me, and then eat ye every man of his own vine, and every one of his fig tree, and drink ye every one the waters of his cistern:

verses.original: עַד בֹּאִ/י֩ וְ/לָקַחְתִּ֨י אֶתְ/כֶ֜ם אֶל אֶ֣רֶץ כְּ/אַרְצְ/כֶ֗ם אֶרֶץ֩ דָּגָ֨ן וְ/תִיר֜וֹשׁ אֶ֧רֶץ לֶ֣חֶם וּ/כְרָמִ֗ים אֶ֣רֶץ זֵ֤ית יִצְהָר֙ וּ/דְבַ֔שׁ וִֽ/חְי֖וּ וְ/לֹ֣א תָמֻ֑תוּ וְ/אַֽל תִּשְׁמְעוּ֙ אֶל חִזְקִיָּ֔הוּ כִּֽי יַסִּ֤ית אֶתְ/כֶם֙ לֵ/אמֹ֔ר יְהוָ֖ה יַצִּילֵֽ/נוּ
verses.translit: 'd b'y vlqchty 'tkhm 'l 'rts kh'rtskhm 'rts dgn vtyrvsh 'rts lchm vkhrmym 'rts zyt ytshr vdbsh vchyv vl' tmtv v'l tshm'v 'l chzqyhv khy ysyt 'tkhm l'mr yhvh ytsylnv
verses.translation: Until I come and take you away to a land like your own land, a land of corn and wine, a land of bread and vineyards, a land of oil olive and of honey, that ye may live, and not die: and hearken not unto Hezekiah, when he persuadeth you, saying, The LORD will deliver us.

verses.original: הַ/הַצֵּ֥ל הִצִּ֛ילוּ אֱלֹהֵ֥י הַ/גּוֹיִ֖ם אִ֣ישׁ אֶת אַרְצ֑/וֹ מִ/יַּ֖ד מֶ֥לֶךְ אַשּֽׁוּר
verses.translit: hhtsl htsylv 'lhy hgvym 'ysh 't 'rtsv myd mlkh 'shvr
verses.translation: Hath any of the gods of the nations delivered at all his land out of the hand of the king of Assyria?

verses.original: אַיֵּה֩ אֱלֹהֵ֨י חֲמָ֜ת וְ/אַרְפָּ֗ד אַיֵּ֛ה אֱלֹהֵ֥י סְפַרְוַ֖יִם הֵנַ֣ע וְ/עִוָּ֑ה כִּֽי הִצִּ֥ילוּ אֶת שֹׁמְר֖וֹן מִ/יָּדִֽ/י
verses.translit: 'yh 'lhy chmt v'rpd 'yh 'lhy sprvym hn' v'vh khy htsylv 't shmrvn mydy
verses.translation: Where are the gods of Hamath, and of Arpad? where are the gods of Sepharvaim, Hena, and Ivah? have they delivered Samaria out of mine hand?

verses.original: מִ֚י בְּ/כָל אֱלֹהֵ֣י הָֽ/אֲרָצ֔וֹת אֲשֶׁר הִצִּ֥ילוּ אֶת אַרְצָ֖/ם מִ/יָּדִ֑/י כִּי יַצִּ֧יל יְהוָ֛ה אֶת יְרוּשָׁלִַ֖ם מִ/יָּדִֽ/י
verses.translit: my bkhl 'lhy h'rtsvt 'shr htsylv 't 'rtsm mydy khy ytsyl yhvh 't yrvshlm mydy
verses.translation: Who are they among all the gods of the countries, that have delivered their country out of mine hand, that the LORD should deliver Jerusalem out of mine hand?

verses.original: וְ/הֶחֱרִ֣ישׁוּ הָ/עָ֔ם וְ/לֹֽא עָנ֥וּ אֹת֖/וֹ דָּבָ֑ר כִּי מִצְוַ֨ת הַ/מֶּ֥לֶךְ הִ֛יא לֵ/אמֹ֖ר לֹ֥א תַעֲנֻֽ/הוּ
verses.translit: vhchryshv h'm vl' 'nv 'tv dbr khy mtsvt hmlkh hy' l'mr l' t'nhv
verses.translation: But the people held their peace, and answered him not a word: for the king’s commandment was, saying, Answer him not.

verses.original: וַ/יָּבֹ֣א אֶלְיָקִ֣ים בֶּן חִלְקִיָּ֣ה אֲשֶׁר עַל הַ֠/בַּיִת וְ/שֶׁבְנָ֨א הַ/סֹּפֵ֜ר וְ/יוֹאָ֨ח בֶּן אָסָ֧ף הַ/מַּזְכִּ֛יר אֶל חִזְקִיָּ֖הוּ קְרוּעֵ֣י בְגָדִ֑ים וַ/יַּגִּ֣דוּ ל֔/וֹ דִּבְרֵ֖י רַב שָׁקֵֽה
verses.translit: vyb' 'lyqym bn chlqyh 'shr 'l hbyt vshbn' hspr vyv'ch bn 'sf hmzkhyr 'l chzqyhv qrv'y bgdym vygdv lv dbry rb shqh
verses.translation: Then came Eliakim the son of Hilkiah, which was over the household, and Shebna the scribe, and Joah the son of Asaph the recorder, to Hezekiah with their clothes rent, and told him the words of Rab-shakeh.

verses.original: וַ/יְהִ֗י כִּ/שְׁמֹ֨עַ֙ הַ/מֶּ֣לֶךְ חִזְקִיָּ֔הוּ וַ/יִּקְרַ֖ע אֶת בְּגָדָ֑י/ו וַ/יִּתְכַּ֣ס בַּ/שָּׂ֔ק וַ/יָּבֹ֖א בֵּ֥ית יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: vyhy khshm' hmlkh chzqyhv vyqr' 't bgdyv vytkhs bshq vyb' byt yhvh
verses.translation: And it came to pass, when king Hezekiah heard it , that he rent his clothes, and covered himself with sackcloth, and went into the house of the LORD .

verses.original: וַ֠/יִּשְׁלַח אֶת אֶלְיָקִ֨ים אֲשֶׁר עַל הַ/בַּ֜יִת וְ/שֶׁבְנָ֣א הַ/סֹּפֵ֗ר וְ/אֵת֙ זִקְנֵ֣י הַ/כֹּֽהֲנִ֔ים מִתְכַּסִּ֖ים בַּ/שַּׂקִּ֑ים אֶל יְשַֽׁעְיָ֥הוּ הַ/נָּבִ֖יא בֶּן אָמֽוֹץ
verses.translit: vyshlch 't 'lyqym 'shr 'l hbyt vshbn' hspr v't zqny hkhhnym mtkhsym bshqym 'l ysh'yhv hnby' bn 'mvts
verses.translation: And he sent Eliakim, which was over the household, and Shebna the scribe, and the elders of the priests, covered with sackcloth, to Isaiah the prophet the son of Amoz.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּאמְר֣וּ אֵלָ֗י/ו כֹּ֚ה אָמַ֣ר חִזְקִיָּ֔הוּ יוֹם צָרָ֧ה וְ/תוֹכֵחָ֛ה וּ/נְאָצָ֖ה הַ/יּ֣וֹם הַ/זֶּ֑ה כִּ֣י בָ֤אוּ בָנִים֙ עַד מַשְׁבֵּ֔ר וְ/כֹ֥חַ אַ֖יִן לְ/לֵדָֽה
verses.translit: vy'mrv 'lyv khh 'mr chzqyhv yvm tsrh vtvkhchh vn'tsh hyvm hzh khy b'v bnym 'd mshbr vkhch 'yn lldh
verses.translation: And they said unto him, Thus saith Hezekiah, This day is a day of trouble, and of rebuke, and blasphemy: for the children are come to the birth, and there is not strength to bring forth.

verses.original: אוּלַ֡י יִשְׁמַע֩ יְהוָ֨ה אֱלֹהֶ֜י/ךָ אֵ֣ת כָּל דִּבְרֵ֣י רַב שָׁקֵ֗ה אֲשֶׁר֩ שְׁלָח֨/וֹ מֶֽלֶךְ אַשּׁ֤וּר אֲדֹנָי/ו֙ לְ/חָרֵף֙ אֱלֹהִ֣ים חַ֔י וְ/הוֹכִ֨יחַ֙ בַּ/דְּבָרִ֔ים אֲשֶׁ֥ר שָׁמַ֖ע יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶ֑י/ךָ וְ/נָשָׂ֣אתָ תְפִלָּ֔ה בְּעַ֥ד הַ/שְּׁאֵרִ֖ית הַ/נִּמְצָאָֽה
verses.translit: 'vly yshm' yhvh 'lhykh 't khl dbry rb shqh 'shr shlchv mlkh 'shvr 'dnyv lchrf 'lhym chy vhvkhych bdbrym 'shr shm' yhvh 'lhykh vnsh't tplh b'd hsh'ryt hnmts'h
verses.translation: It may be the LORD thy God will hear all the words of Rab-shakeh, whom the king of Assyria his master hath sent to reproach the living God; and will reprove the words which the LORD thy God hath heard: wherefore lift up thy prayer for the remnant that are left.

verses.original: וַ/יָּבֹ֗אוּ עַבְדֵ֛י הַ/מֶּ֥לֶךְ חִזְקִיָּ֖הוּ אֶל יְשַֽׁעַיָֽהוּ
verses.translit: vyb'v 'bdy hmlkh chzqyhv 'l ysh'yhv
verses.translation: So the servants of king Hezekiah came to Isaiah.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֤אמֶר לָ/הֶם֙ יְשַֽׁעְיָ֔הוּ כֹּ֥ה תֹאמְר֖וּ/ן אֶל אֲדֹֽנֵי/כֶ֑ם כֹּ֣ה אָמַ֣ר יְהוָ֗ה אַל תִּירָא֙ מִ/פְּנֵ֤י הַ/דְּבָרִים֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר שָׁמַ֗עְתָּ אֲשֶׁ֧ר גִּדְּפ֛וּ נַעֲרֵ֥י מֶֽלֶךְ אַשּׁ֖וּר אֹתִֽ/י
verses.translit: vy'mr lhm ysh'yhv khh t'mrvn 'l 'dnykhm khh 'mr yhvh 'l tyr' mpny hdbrym 'shr shm't 'shr gdpv n'ry mlkh 'shvr 'ty
verses.translation: And Isaiah said unto them, Thus shall ye say to your master, Thus saith the LORD , Be not afraid of the words which thou hast heard, with which the servants of the king of Assyria have blasphemed me.

verses.original: הִנְ/נִ֨י נֹתֵ֥ן בּ/וֹ֙ ר֔וּחַ וְ/שָׁמַ֥ע שְׁמוּעָ֖ה וְ/שָׁ֣ב לְ/אַרְצ֑/וֹ וְ/הִפַּלְתִּ֥י/ו בַּ/חֶ֖רֶב בְּ/אַרְצֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: hnny ntn bv rvch vshm' shmv'h vshb l'rtsv vhpltyv bchrb b'rtsv
verses.translation: Behold, I will send a blast upon him, and he shall hear a rumour, and shall return to his own land; and I will cause him to fall by the sword in his own land.

verses.original: וַ/יָּ֨שָׁב֙ רַב שָׁקֵ֔ה וַ/יִּמְצָא֙ אֶת מֶ֣לֶךְ אַשּׁ֔וּר נִלְחָ֖ם עַל לִבְנָ֑ה כִּ֣י שָׁמַ֔ע כִּ֥י נָסַ֖ע מִ/לָּכִֽישׁ
verses.translit: vyshb rb shqh vymts' 't mlkh 'shvr nlchm 'l lbnh khy shm' khy ns' mlkhysh
verses.translation: So Rab-shakeh returned, and found the king of Assyria warring against Libnah: for he had heard that he was departed from Lachish.

verses.original: וַ/יִּשְׁמַ֗ע אֶל תִּרְהָ֤קָה מֶֽלֶך כּוּשׁ֙ לֵ/אמֹ֔ר הִנֵּ֥ה יָצָ֖א לְ/הִלָּחֵ֣ם אִתָּ֑/ךְ וַ/יָּ֨שָׁב֙ וַ/יִּשְׁלַ֣ח מַלְאָכִ֔ים אֶל חִזְקִיָּ֖הוּ לֵ/אמֹֽר
verses.translit: vyshm' 'l trhqh mlkh khvsh l'mr hnh yts' lhlchm 'tkh vyshb vyshlch ml'khym 'l chzqyhv l'mr
verses.translation: And when he heard say of Tirhakah king of Ethiopia, Behold, he is come out to fight against thee: he sent messengers again unto Hezekiah, saying,

verses.original: כֹּ֣ה תֹאמְר֗וּ/ן אֶל חִזְקִיָּ֤הוּ מֶֽלֶךְ יְהוּדָה֙ לֵ/אמֹ֔ר אַל יַשִּׁאֲ/ךָ֣ אֱלֹהֶ֔י/ךָ אֲשֶׁ֥ר אַתָּ֛ה בֹּטֵ֥חַ בּ֖/וֹ לֵ/אמֹ֑ר לֹ֤א תִנָּתֵן֙ יְר֣וּשָׁלִַ֔ם בְּ/יַ֖ד מֶ֥לֶךְ אַשּֽׁוּר
verses.translit: khh t'mrvn 'l chzqyhv mlkh yhvdh l'mr 'l ysh'kh 'lhykh 'shr 'th btch bv l'mr l' tntn yrvshlm byd mlkh 'shvr
verses.translation: Thus shall ye speak to Hezekiah king of Judah, saying, Let not thy God in whom thou trustest deceive thee, saying, Jerusalem shall not be delivered into the hand of the king of Assyria.

verses.original: הִנֵּ֣ה אַתָּ֣ה שָׁמַ֗עְתָּ אֵת֩ אֲשֶׁ֨ר עָשׂ֜וּ מַלְכֵ֥י אַשּׁ֛וּר לְ/כָל הָ/אֲרָצ֖וֹת לְ/הַֽחֲרִימָ֑/ם וְ/אַתָּ֖ה תִּנָּצֵֽל
verses.translit: hnh 'th shm't 't 'shr 'shv mlkhy 'shvr lkhl h'rtsvt lhchrymm v'th tntsl
verses.translation: Behold, thou hast heard what the kings of Assyria have done to all lands, by destroying them utterly: and shalt thou be delivered?

verses.original: הַ/הִצִּ֨ילוּ אֹתָ֜/ם אֱלֹהֵ֤י הַ/גּוֹיִם֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר שִׁחֲת֣וּ אֲבוֹתַ֔/י אֶת גּוֹזָ֖ן וְ/אֶת חָרָ֑ן וְ/רֶ֥צֶף וּ/בְנֵי עֶ֖דֶן אֲשֶׁ֥ר בִּ/תְלַאשָּֽׂר
verses.translit: hhtsylv 'tm 'lhy hgvym 'shr shchtv 'bvty 't gvzn v't chrn vrtsf vbny 'dn 'shr btl'shr
verses.translation: Have the gods of the nations delivered them which my fathers have destroyed; as Gozan, and Haran, and Rezeph, and the children of Eden which were in Thelasar?

verses.original: אַיּ֤/וֹ מֶֽלֶךְ חֲמָת֙ וּ/מֶ֣לֶךְ אַרְפָּ֔ד וּ/מֶ֖לֶךְ לָעִ֣יר סְפַרְוָ֑יִם הֵנַ֖ע וְ/עִוָּֽה
verses.translit: 'yv mlkh chmt vmlkh 'rpd vmlkh l'yr sprvym hn' v'vh
verses.translation: Where is the king of Hamath, and the king of Arpad, and the king of the city of Sepharvaim, of Hena, and Ivah?

verses.original: וַ/יִּקַּ֨ח חִזְקִיָּ֧הוּ אֶת הַ/סְּפָרִ֛ים מִ/יַּ֥ד הַ/מַּלְאָכִ֖ים וַ/יִּקְרָאֵ֑/ם וַ/יַּ֨עַל֙ בֵּ֣ית יְהוָ֔ה וַ/יִּפְרְשֵׂ֥/הוּ חִזְקִיָּ֖הוּ לִ/פְנֵ֥י יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: vyqch chzqyhv 't hsprym myd hml'khym vyqr'm vy'l byt yhvh vyprshhv chzqyhv lpny yhvh
verses.translation: And Hezekiah received the letter of the hand of the messengers, and read it: and Hezekiah went up into the house of the LORD , and spread it before the LORD .

verses.original: וַ/יִּתְפַּלֵּ֨ל חִזְקִיָּ֜הוּ לִ/פְנֵ֣י יְהוָה֮ וַ/יֹּאמַר֒ יְהוָ֞ה אֱלֹהֵ֤י יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ יֹשֵׁ֣ב הַ/כְּרֻבִ֔ים אַתָּה ה֤וּא הָֽ/אֱלֹהִים֙ לְ/בַדְּ/ךָ֔ לְ/כֹ֖ל מַמְלְכ֣וֹת הָ/אָ֑רֶץ אַתָּ֣ה עָשִׂ֔יתָ אֶת הַ/שָּׁמַ֖יִם וְ/אֶת הָ/אָֽרֶץ
verses.translit: vytpll chzqyhv lpny yhvh vy'mr yhvh 'lhy yshr'l yshb hkhrbym 'th hv' h'lhym lbdkh lkhl mmlkhvt h'rts 'th 'shyt 't hshmym v't h'rts
verses.translation: And Hezekiah prayed before the LORD , and said, O LORD God of Israel, which dwellest between the cherubims, thou art the God, even thou alone, of all the kingdoms of the earth; thou hast made heaven and earth.

verses.original: הַטֵּ֨ה יְהוָ֤ה אָזְנְ/ךָ֙ וּֽ/שֲׁמָ֔ע פְּקַ֧ח יְהוָ֛ה עֵינֶ֖י/ךָ וּ/רְאֵ֑ה וּ/שְׁמַ֗ע אֵ֚ת דִּבְרֵ֣י סַנְחֵרִ֔יב אֲשֶׁ֣ר שְׁלָח֔/וֹ לְ/חָרֵ֖ף אֱלֹהִ֥ים חָֽי
verses.translit: hth yhvh 'znkh vshm' pqch yhvh 'ynykh vr'h vshm' 't dbry snchryb 'shr shlchv lchrf 'lhym chy
verses.translation: LORD , bow down thine ear, and hear: open, LORD , thine eyes, and see: and hear the words of Sennacherib, which hath sent him to reproach the living God.

verses.original: אָמְנָ֖ם יְהוָ֑ה הֶחֱרִ֜יבוּ מַלְכֵ֥י אַשּׁ֛וּר אֶת הַ/גּוֹיִ֖ם וְ/אֶת אַרְצָֽ/ם
verses.translit: 'mnm yhvh hchrybv mlkhy 'shvr 't hgvym v't 'rtsm
verses.translation: Of a truth, LORD , the kings of Assyria have destroyed the nations and their lands,

verses.original: וְ/נָתְנ֥וּ אֶת אֱלֹהֵי/הֶ֖ם בָּ/אֵ֑שׁ כִּי֩ לֹ֨א אֱלֹהִ֜ים הֵ֗מָּה כִּ֣י אִם מַעֲשֵׂ֧ה יְדֵֽי אָדָ֛ם עֵ֥ץ וָ/אֶ֖בֶן וַֽ/יְאַבְּדֽוּ/ם
verses.translit: vntnv 't 'lhyhm b'sh khy l' 'lhym hmh khy 'm m'shh ydy 'dm 'ts v'bn vy'bdvm
verses.translation: And have cast their gods into the fire: for they were no gods, but the work of men’s hands, wood and stone: therefore they have destroyed them.

verses.original: וְ/עַתָּה֙ יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֵ֔י/נוּ הוֹשִׁיעֵ֥/נוּ נָ֖א מִ/יָּד֑/וֹ וְ/יֵֽדְעוּ֙ כָּל מַמְלְכ֣וֹת הָ/אָ֔רֶץ כִּ֥י אַתָּ֛ה יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהִ֖ים לְ/בַדֶּֽ/ךָ
verses.translit: v'th yhvh 'lhynv hvshy'nv n' mydv vyd'v khl mmlkhvt h'rts khy 'th yhvh 'lhym lbdkh
verses.translation: Now therefore, O LORD our God, I beseech thee, save thou us out of his hand, that all the kingdoms of the earth may know that thou art the LORD God, even thou only.

verses.original: וַ/יִּשְׁלַח֙ יְשַֽׁעְיָ֣הוּ בֶן אָמ֔וֹץ אֶל חִזְקִיָּ֖הוּ לֵ/אמֹ֑ר כֹּֽה אָמַ֤ר יְהוָה֙ אֱלֹהֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל אֲשֶׁ֨ר הִתְפַּלַּ֧לְתָּ אֵלַ֛/י אֶל סַנְחֵרִ֥ב מֶֽלֶךְ אַשּׁ֖וּר שָׁמָֽעְתִּי
verses.translit: vyshlch ysh'yhv bn 'mvts 'l chzqyhv l'mr khh 'mr yhvh 'lhy yshr'l 'shr htpllt 'ly 'l snchrb mlkh 'shvr shm'ty
verses.translation: Then Isaiah the son of Amoz sent to Hezekiah, saying, Thus saith the LORD God of Israel, That which thou hast prayed to me against Sennacherib king of Assyria I have heard.

verses.original: זֶ֣ה הַ/דָּבָ֔ר אֲשֶׁר דִּבֶּ֥ר יְהוָ֖ה עָלָ֑י/ו בָּזָ֨ה לְ/ךָ֜ לָעֲגָ֣ה לְ/ךָ֗ בְּתוּלַת֙ בַּת צִיּ֔וֹן אַחֲרֶ֨י/ךָ֙ רֹ֣אשׁ הֵנִ֔יעָה בַּ֖ת יְרוּשָׁלִָֽם
verses.translit: zh hdbr 'shr dbr yhvh 'lyv bzh lkh l'gh lkh btvlt bt tsyvn 'chrykh r'sh hny'h bt yrvshlm
verses.translation: This is the word that the LORD hath spoken concerning him; The virgin the daughter of Zion hath despised thee, and laughed thee to scorn; the daughter of Jerusalem hath shaken her head at thee.

verses.original: אֶת מִ֤י חֵרַ֨פְתָּ֙ וְ/גִדַּ֔פְתָּ וְ/עַל מִ֖י הֲרִימ֣וֹתָ קּ֑וֹל וַ/תִּשָּׂ֥א מָר֛וֹם עֵינֶ֖י/ךָ עַל קְד֥וֹשׁ יִשְׂרָאֵֽל
verses.translit: 't my chrpt vgdpt v'l my hrymvt qvl vtsh' mrvm 'ynykh 'l qdvsh yshr'l
verses.translation: Whom hast thou reproached and blasphemed? and against whom hast thou exalted thy voice, and lifted up thine eyes on high? even against the Holy One of Israel.

verses.original: בְּ/יַ֣ד מַלְאָכֶי/ךָ֮ חֵרַ֣פְתָּ אֲדֹנָ/י֒ וַ/תֹּ֗אמֶר ב/רכב בְּ/רֹ֥ב רִכְבִּ֛/י אֲנִ֥י עָלִ֛יתִי מְר֥וֹם הָרִ֖ים יַרְכְּתֵ֣י לְבָנ֑וֹן וְ/אֶכְרֹ֞ת קוֹמַ֤ת אֲרָזָי/ו֙ מִבְח֣וֹר בְּרֹשָׁ֔י/ו וְ/אָב֨וֹאָה֙ מְל֣וֹן קִצֹּ֔/ה יַ֖עַר כַּרְמִלּֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: byd ml'khykh chrpt 'dny vt'mr brkhb brb rkhby 'ny 'lyty mrvm hrym yrkhty lbnvn v'khrt qvmt 'rzyv mbchvr brshyv v'bv'h mlvn qtsh y'r khrmlv
verses.translation: By thy messengers thou hast reproached the Lord, and hast said, With the multitude of my chariots I am come up to the height of the mountains, to the sides of Lebanon, and will cut down the tall cedar trees thereof, and the choice fir trees thereof: and I will enter into the lodgings of his borders, and into the forest of his Carmel.

verses.original: אֲנִ֣י קַ֔רְתִּי וְ/שָׁתִ֖יתִי מַ֣יִם זָרִ֑ים וְ/אַחְרִב֙ בְּ/כַף פְּעָמַ֔/י כֹּ֖ל יְאֹרֵ֥י מָצֽוֹר
verses.translit: 'ny qrty vshtyty mym zrym v'chrb bkhf p'my khl y'ry mtsvr
verses.translation: I have digged and drunk strange waters, and with the sole of my feet have I dried up all the rivers of besieged places.

verses.original: הֲ/לֹֽא שָׁמַ֤עְתָּ לְ/מֵֽ/רָחוֹק֙ אֹתָ֣/הּ עָשִׂ֔יתִי לְ/מִ֥/ימֵי קֶ֖דֶם וִֽ/יצַרְתִּ֑י/הָ עַתָּ֣ה הֲבֵיאתִ֗י/הָ וּ/תְהִ֗י לַ/הְשׁ֛וֹת גַּלִּ֥ים נִצִּ֖ים עָרִ֥ים בְּצֻרֽוֹת
verses.translit: hl' shm't lmrchvq 'th 'shyty lmymy qdm vytsrtyh 'th hby'tyh vthy lhshvt glym ntsym 'rym btsrvt
verses.translation: Hast thou not heard long ago how I have done it, and of ancient times that I have formed it? now have I brought it to pass, that thou shouldest be to lay waste fenced cities into ruinous heaps.

verses.original: וְ/יֹֽשְׁבֵי/הֶן֙ קִצְרֵי יָ֔ד חַ֖תּוּ וַ/יֵּבֹ֑שׁוּ הָי֞וּ עֵ֤שֶׂב שָׂדֶה֙ וִ֣/ירַק דֶּ֔שֶׁא חֲצִ֣יר גַּגּ֔וֹת וּ/שְׁדֵפָ֖ה לִ/פְנֵ֥י קָמָֽה
verses.translit: vyshbyhn qtsry yd chtv vybshv hyv 'shb shdh vyrq dsh' chtsyr ggvt vshdph lpny qmh
verses.translation: Therefore their inhabitants were of small power, they were dismayed and confounded; they were as the grass of the field, and as the green herb, as the grass on the housetops, and as corn blasted before it be grown up.

verses.translit: vshbtkh vts'tkh vb'kh yd'ty v't htrgzkh 'ly
verses.translation: But I know thy abode, and thy going out, and thy coming in, and thy rage against me.

verses.translit: y'n htrgzkh 'ly vsh'nnkh 'lh b'zny vshmty chchy b'pkh vmtgy bshptykh vhshbtykh bdrkh 'shr b't bh
verses.translation: Because thy rage against me and thy tumult is come up into mine ears, therefore I will put my hook in thy nose, and my bridle in thy lips, and I will turn thee back by the way by which thou camest.

verses.original: וְ/זֶה לְּ/ךָ֣ הָ/א֔וֹת אָכ֤וֹל הַ/שָּׁנָה֙ סָפִ֔יחַ וּ/בַ/שָּׁנָ֥ה הַ/שֵּׁנִ֖ית סָחִ֑ישׁ וּ/בַ/שָּׁנָ֣ה הַ/שְּׁלִישִׁ֗ית זִרְע֧וּ וְ/קִצְר֛וּ וְ/נִטְע֥וּ כְרָמִ֖ים וְ/אִכְל֥וּ פִרְיָֽ/ם
verses.translit: vzh lkh h'vt 'khvl hshnh spych vbshnh hshnyt schysh vbshnh hshlyshyt zr'v vqtsrv vnt'v khrmym v'khlv prym
verses.translation: And this shall be a sign unto thee, Ye shall eat this year such things as grow of themselves, and in the second year that which springeth of the same; and in the third year sow ye, and reap, and plant vineyards, and eat the fruits thereof.

verses.original: וְ/יָ֨סְפָ֜ה פְּלֵיטַ֧ת בֵּית יְהוּדָ֛ה הַ/נִּשְׁאָרָ֖ה שֹׁ֣רֶשׁ לְ/מָ֑טָּה וְ/עָשָׂ֥ה פְרִ֖י לְ/מָֽעְלָ/ה
verses.translit: vysph plytt byt yhvdh hnsh'rh shrsh lmth v'shh pry lm'lh
verses.translation: And the remnant that is escaped of the house of Judah shall yet again take root downward, and bear fruit upward.

verses.original: כִּ֤י מִ/ירוּשָׁלִַ֨ם֙ תֵּצֵ֣א שְׁאֵרִ֔ית וּ/פְלֵיטָ֖ה מֵ/הַ֣ר צִיּ֑וֹן קִנְאַ֛ת יְהוָ֥ה צְבָא֖וֹת תַּֽעֲשֶׂה זֹּֽאת
verses.translit: khy myrvshlm tts' sh'ryt vplyth mhr tsyvn qn't yhvh tsb'vt t'shh z't
verses.translation: For out of Jerusalem shall go forth a remnant, and they that escape out of mount Zion: the zeal of the LORD of hosts shall do this.

verses.original: לָ/כֵ֗ן כֹּֽה אָמַ֤ר יְהוָה֙ אֶל מֶ֣לֶךְ אַשּׁ֔וּר לֹ֤א יָבֹא֙ אֶל הָ/עִ֣יר הַ/זֹּ֔את וְ/לֹֽא יוֹרֶ֥ה שָׁ֖ם חֵ֑ץ וְ/לֹֽא יְקַדְּמֶ֣/נָּה מָגֵ֔ן וְ/לֹֽא יִשְׁפֹּ֥ךְ עָלֶ֖י/הָ סֹלְלָֽה
verses.translit: lkhn khh 'mr yhvh 'l mlkh 'shvr l' yb' 'l h'yr hz't vl' yvrh shm chts vl' yqdmnh mgn vl' yshpkh 'lyh sllh
verses.translation: Therefore thus saith the LORD concerning the king of Assyria, He shall not come into this city, nor shoot an arrow there, nor come before it with shield, nor cast a bank against it.

verses.original: בַּ/דֶּ֥רֶךְ אֲשֶׁר יָבֹ֖א בָּ֣/הּ יָשׁ֑וּב וְ/אֶל הָ/עִ֥יר הַ/זֹּ֛את לֹ֥א יָבֹ֖א נְאֻם יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: bdrkh 'shr yb' bh yshvb v'l h'yr hz't l' yb' n'm yhvh
verses.translation: By the way that he came, by the same shall he return, and shall not come into this city, saith the LORD .

verses.original: וְ/גַנּוֹתִ֛י אֶל הָ/עִ֥יר הַ/זֹּ֖את לְ/הֽוֹשִׁיעָ֑/הּ לְמַֽעֲנִ֔/י וּ/לְמַ֖עַן דָּוִ֥ד עַבְדִּֽ/י
verses.translit: vgnvty 'l h'yr hz't lhvshy'h lm'ny vlm'n dvd 'bdy
verses.translation: For I will defend this city, to save it, for mine own sake, and for my servant David’s sake.

verses.original: וַ/יְהִי֮ בַּ/לַּ֣יְלָה הַ/הוּא֒ וַ/יֵּצֵ֣א מַלְאַ֣ךְ יְהוָ֗ה וַ/יַּךְ֙ בְּ/מַחֲנֵ֣ה אַשּׁ֔וּר מֵאָ֛ה שְׁמוֹנִ֥ים וַ/חֲמִשָּׁ֖ה אָ֑לֶף וַ/יַּשְׁכִּ֣ימוּ בַ/בֹּ֔קֶר וְ/הִנֵּ֥ה כֻלָּ֖/ם פְּגָרִ֥ים מֵתִֽים
verses.translit: vyhy blylh hhv' vyts' ml'kh yhvh vykh bmchnh 'shvr m'h shmvnym vchmshh 'lf vyshkhymv bbqr vhnh khlm pgrym mtym
verses.translation: And it came to pass that night, that the angel of the LORD went out, and smote in the camp of the Assyrians an hundred fourscore and five thousand: and when they arose early in the morning, behold, they were all dead corpses.

verses.original: וַ/יִּסַּ֣ע וַ/יֵּ֔לֶךְ וַ/יָּ֖שָׁב סַנְחֵרִ֣יב מֶֽלֶךְ אַשּׁ֑וּר וַ/יֵּ֖שֶׁב בְּ/נִֽינְוֵֽה
verses.translit: vys' vylkh vyshb snchryb mlkh 'shvr vyshb bnynvh
verses.translation: So Sennacherib king of Assyria departed, and went and returned, and dwelt at Nineveh.

verses.original: וַ/יְהִי֩ ה֨וּא מִֽשְׁתַּחֲוֶ֜ה בֵּ֣ית נִסְרֹ֣ךְ אֱלֹהָ֗י/ו וְֽ/אַדְרַמֶּ֨לֶךְ וְ/שַׂרְאֶ֤צֶר בָּנָי/ו֙ הִכֻּ֣/הוּ בַ/חֶ֔רֶב וְ/הֵ֥מָּה נִמְלְט֖וּ אֶ֣רֶץ אֲרָרָ֑ט וַ/יִּמְלֹ֛ךְ אֵֽסַר חַדֹּ֥ן בְּנ֖/וֹ תַּחְתָּֽי/ו
verses.translit: vyhy hv' mshtchvh byt nsrkh 'lhyv v'drmlkh vshr'tsr bnyv hkhhv bchrb vhmh nmltv 'rts 'rrt vymlkh 'sr chdn bnv tchtyv
verses.translation: And it came to pass, as he was worshipping in the house of Nisroch his god, that Adrammelech and Sharezer his sons smote him with the sword: and they escaped into the land of Armenia. And Esar-haddon his son reigned in his stead.

verses.original: בַּ/יָּמִ֣ים הָ/הֵ֔ם חָלָ֥ה חִזְקִיָּ֖הוּ לָ/מ֑וּת וַ/יָּבֹ֣א אֵ֠לָי/ו יְשַׁעְיָ֨הוּ בֶן אָמ֜וֹץ הַ/נָּבִ֗יא וַ/יֹּ֨אמֶר אֵלָ֜י/ו כֹּֽה אָמַ֤ר יְהוָה֙ צַ֣ו לְ/בֵיתֶ֔/ךָ כִּ֛י מֵ֥ת אַתָּ֖ה וְ/לֹ֥א תִֽחְיֶֽה
verses.translit: bymym hhm chlh chzqyhv lmvt vyb' 'lyv ysh'yhv bn 'mvts hnby' vy'mr 'lyv khh 'mr yhvh tsv lbytkh khy mt 'th vl' tchyh
verses.translation: In those days was Hezekiah sick unto death. And the prophet Isaiah the son of Amoz came to him, and said unto him, Thus saith the LORD , Set thine house in order; for thou shalt die, and not live.

verses.original: וַ/יַּסֵּ֥ב אֶת פָּנָ֖י/ו אֶל הַ/קִּ֑יר וַ/יִּ֨תְפַּלֵּ֔ל אֶל יְהוָ֖ה לֵ/אמֹֽר
verses.translit: vysb 't pnyv 'l hqyr vytpll 'l yhvh l'mr
verses.translation: Then he turned his face to the wall, and prayed unto the LORD , saying,

verses.original: אָנָּ֣ה יְהוָ֗ה זְכָר נָ֞א אֵ֣ת אֲשֶׁ֧ר הִתְהַלַּ֣כְתִּי לְ/פָנֶ֗י/ךָ בֶּֽ/אֱמֶת֙ וּ/בְ/לֵבָ֣ב שָׁלֵ֔ם וְ/הַ/טּ֥וֹב בְּ/עֵינֶ֖י/ךָ עָשִׂ֑יתִי וַ/יֵּ֥בְךְּ חִזְקִיָּ֖הוּ בְּכִ֥י גָדֽוֹל
verses.translit: 'nh yhvh zkhr n' 't 'shr hthlkhty lpnykh b'mt vblbb shlm vhtvb b'ynykh 'shyty vybkh chzqyhv bkhy gdvl
verses.translation: I beseech thee, O LORD , remember now how I have walked before thee in truth and with a perfect heart, and have done that which is good in thy sight. And Hezekiah wept sore.

verses.original: וַ/יְהִ֣י יְשַׁעְיָ֔הוּ לֹ֣א יָצָ֔א ה/עיר חָצֵ֖ר הַ/תִּֽיכֹנָ֑ה וּ/דְבַר יְהוָ֔ה הָיָ֥ה אֵלָ֖י/ו לֵ/אמֹֽר
verses.translit: vyhy ysh'yhv l' yts' h'yr chtsr htykhnh vdbr yhvh hyh 'lyv l'mr
verses.translation: And it came to pass, afore Isaiah was gone out into the middle court, that the word of the LORD came to him, saying,

verses.original: שׁ֣וּב וְ/אָמַרְתָּ֞ אֶל חִזְקִיָּ֣הוּ נְגִיד עַמִּ֗/י כֹּֽה אָמַ֤ר יְהוָה֙ אֱלֹהֵי֙ דָּוִ֣ד אָבִ֔י/ךָ שָׁמַ֨עְתִּי֙ אֶת תְּפִלָּתֶ֔/ךָ רָאִ֖יתִי אֶת דִּמְעָתֶ֑/ךָ הִנְ/נִי֙ רֹ֣פֶא לָ֔/ךְ בַּ/יּוֹם֙ הַ/שְּׁלִישִׁ֔י תַּעֲלֶ֖ה בֵּ֥ית יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: shvb v'mrt 'l chzqyhv ngyd 'my khh 'mr yhvh 'lhy dvd 'bykh shm'ty 't tpltkh r'yty 't dm'tkh hnny rp' lkh byvm hshlyshy t'lh byt yhvh
verses.translation: Turn again, and tell Hezekiah the captain of my people, Thus saith the LORD , the God of David thy father, I have heard thy prayer, I have seen thy tears: behold, I will heal thee: on the third day thou shalt go up unto the house of the LORD .

verses.original: וְ/הֹסַפְתִּ֣י עַל יָמֶ֗י/ךָ חֲמֵ֤שׁ עֶשְׂרֵה֙ שָׁנָ֔ה וּ/מִ/כַּ֤ף מֶֽלֶךְ אַשּׁוּר֙ אַצִּ֣ילְ/ךָ֔ וְ/אֵ֖ת הָ/עִ֣יר הַ/זֹּ֑את וְ/גַנּוֹתִי֙ עַל הָ/עִ֣יר הַ/זֹּ֔את לְמַֽעֲנִ֔/י וּ/לְמַ֖עַן דָּוִ֥ד עַבְדִּֽ/י
verses.translit: vhspty 'l ymykh chmsh 'shrh shnh vmkhf mlkh 'shvr 'tsylkh v't h'yr hz't vgnvty 'l h'yr hz't lm'ny vlm'n dvd 'bdy
verses.translation: And I will add unto thy days fifteen years; and I will deliver thee and this city out of the hand of the king of Assyria; and I will defend this city for mine own sake, and for my servant David’s sake.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֣אמֶר יְשַֽׁעְיָ֔הוּ קְח֖וּ דְּבֶ֣לֶת תְּאֵנִ֑ים וַ/יִּקְח֛וּ וַ/יָּשִׂ֥ימוּ עַֽל הַ/שְּׁחִ֖ין וַ/יֶּֽחִי
verses.translit: vy'mr ysh'yhv qchv dblt t'nym vyqchv vyshymv 'l hshchyn vychy
verses.translation: And Isaiah said, Take a lump of figs. And they took and laid it on the boil, and he recovered.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֤אמֶר חִזְקִיָּ֨הוּ֙ אֶֽל יְשַׁעְיָ֔הוּ מָ֣ה א֔וֹת כִּֽי יִרְפָּ֥א יְהוָ֖ה לִ֑/י וְ/עָלִ֛יתִי בַּ/יּ֥וֹם הַ/שְּׁלִישִׁ֖י בֵּ֥ית יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: vy'mr chzqyhv 'l ysh'yhv mh 'vt khy yrp' yhvh ly v'lyty byvm hshlyshy byt yhvh
verses.translation: And Hezekiah said unto Isaiah, What shall be the sign that the LORD will heal me, and that I shall go up into the house of the LORD the third day?

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֣אמֶר יְשַׁעְיָ֗הוּ זֶה לְּ/ךָ֤ הָ/אוֹת֙ מֵ/אֵ֣ת יְהוָ֔ה כִּ֚י יַעֲשֶׂ֣ה יְהוָ֔ה אֶת הַ/דָּבָ֖ר אֲשֶׁ֣ר דִּבֵּ֑ר הָלַ֤ךְ הַ/צֵּל֙ עֶ֣שֶׂר מַֽעֲל֔וֹת אִם יָשׁ֖וּב עֶ֥שֶׂר מַעֲלֽוֹת
verses.translit: vy'mr ysh'yhv zh lkh h'vt m't yhvh khy y'shh yhvh 't hdbr 'shr dbr hlkh htsl 'shr m'lvt 'm yshvb 'shr m'lvt
verses.translation: And Isaiah said, This sign shalt thou have of the LORD , that the LORD will do the thing that he hath spoken: shall the shadow go forward ten degrees, or go back ten degrees?

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֨אמֶר֙ יְחִזְקִיָּ֔הוּ נָקֵ֣ל לַ/צֵּ֔ל לִ/נְט֖וֹת עֶ֣שֶׂר מַעֲל֑וֹת לֹ֣א כִ֔י יָשׁ֥וּב הַ/צֵּ֛ל אֲחֹרַנִּ֖ית עֶ֥שֶׂר מַעֲלֽוֹת
verses.translit: vy'mr ychzqyhv nql ltsl lntvt 'shr m'lvt l' khy yshvb htsl 'chrnyt 'shr m'lvt
verses.translation: And Hezekiah answered, It is a light thing for the shadow to go down ten degrees: nay, but let the shadow return backward ten degrees.

verses.original: וַ/יִּקְרָ֛א יְשַׁעְיָ֥הוּ הַ/נָּבִ֖יא אֶל יְהוָ֑ה וַ/יָּ֣שֶׁב אֶת הַ/צֵּ֗ל בַּֽ֠/מַּעֲלוֹת אֲשֶׁ֨ר יָרְדָ֜ה בְּ/מַעֲל֥וֹת אָחָ֛ז אֲחֹֽרַנִּ֖ית עֶ֥שֶׂר מַעֲלֽוֹת
verses.translit: vyqr' ysh'yhv hnby' 'l yhvh vyshb 't htsl bm'lvt 'shr yrdh bm'lvt 'chz 'chrnyt 'shr m'lvt
verses.translation: And Isaiah the prophet cried unto the LORD : and he brought the shadow ten degrees backward, by which it had gone down in the dial of Ahaz.

verses.original: בָּ/עֵ֣ת הַ/הִ֡יא שָׁלַ֡ח בְּרֹאדַ֣ךְ בַּ֠לְאֲדָן בֶּֽן בַּלְאֲדָ֧ן מֶֽלֶךְ בָּבֶ֛ל סְפָרִ֥ים וּ/מִנְחָ֖ה אֶל חִזְקִיָּ֑הוּ כִּ֣י שָׁמַ֔ע כִּ֥י חָלָ֖ה חִזְקִיָּֽהוּ
verses.translit: b't hhy' shlch br'dkh bl'dn bn bl'dn mlkh bbl sprym vmnchh 'l chzqyhv khy shm' khy chlh chzqyhv
verses.translation: At that time Berodach-baladan, the son of Baladan, king of Babylon, sent letters and a present unto Hezekiah: for he had heard that Hezekiah had been sick.

verses.original: וַ/יִּשְׁמַ֣ע עֲלֵי/הֶם֮ חִזְקִיָּהוּ֒ וַ/יַּרְאֵ֣/ם אֶת כָּל בֵּ֣ית נְכֹתֹ֡/ה אֶת הַ/כֶּסֶף֩ וְ/אֶת הַ/זָּהָ֨ב וְ/אֶת הַ/בְּשָׂמִ֜ים וְ/אֵ֣ת שֶׁ֣מֶן הַ/טּ֗וֹב וְ/אֵת֙ בֵּ֣ית כֵּלָ֔י/ו וְ/אֵ֛ת כָּל אֲשֶׁ֥ר נִמְצָ֖א בְּ/אֽוֹצְרֹתָ֑י/ו לֹֽא הָיָ֣ה דָבָ֗ר אֲ֠שֶׁר לֹֽא הֶרְאָ֧/ם חִזְקִיָּ֛הוּ בְּ/בֵית֖/וֹ וּ/בְ/כָל מֶמְשַׁלְתּֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: vyshm' 'lyhm chzqyhv vyr'm 't khl byt nkhth 't hkhsf v't hzhb v't hbshmym v't shmn htvb v't byt khlyv v't khl 'shr nmts' b'vtsrtyv l' hyh dbr 'shr l' hr'm chzqyhv bbytv vbkhl mmshltv
verses.translation: And Hezekiah hearkened unto them, and shewed them all the house of his precious things, the silver, and the gold, and the spices, and the precious ointment, and all the house of his armour, and all that was found in his treasures: there was nothing in his house, nor in all his dominion, that Hezekiah shewed them not.

verses.original: וַ/יָּבֹא֙ יְשַֽׁעְיָ֣הוּ הַ/נָּבִ֔יא אֶל הַ/מֶּ֖לֶךְ חִזְקִיָּ֑הוּ וַ/יֹּ֨אמֶר אֵלָ֜י/ו מָ֥ה אָמְר֣וּ הָ/אֲנָשִׁ֣ים הָ/אֵ֗לֶּה וּ/מֵ/אַ֨יִן֙ יָבֹ֣אוּ אֵלֶ֔י/ךָ וַ/יֹּ֨אמֶר֙ חִזְקִיָּ֔הוּ מֵ/אֶ֧רֶץ רְחוֹקָ֛ה בָּ֖אוּ מִ/בָּבֶֽל
verses.translit: vyb' ysh'yhv hnby' 'l hmlkh chzqyhv vy'mr 'lyv mh 'mrv h'nshym h'lh vm'yn yb'v 'lykh vy'mr chzqyhv m'rts rchvqh b'v mbbl
verses.translation: Then came Isaiah the prophet unto king Hezekiah, and said unto him, What said these men? and from whence came they unto thee? And Hezekiah said, They are come from a far country, even from Babylon.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֕אמֶר מָ֥ה רָא֖וּ בְּ/בֵיתֶ֑/ךָ וַ/יֹּ֣אמֶר חִזְקִיָּ֗הוּ אֵ֣ת כָּל אֲשֶׁ֤ר בְּ/בֵיתִ/י֙ רָא֔וּ לֹא הָיָ֥ה דָבָ֛ר אֲשֶׁ֥ר לֹֽא הִרְאִיתִ֖/ם בְּ/אֹצְרֹתָֽ/י
verses.translit: vy'mr mh r'v bbytkh vy'mr chzqyhv 't khl 'shr bbyty r'v l' hyh dbr 'shr l' hr'ytm b'tsrty
