verses.translation: And he said, What have they seen in thine house? And Hezekiah answered, All the things that are in mine house have they seen: there is nothing among my treasures that I have not shewed them.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֥אמֶר יְשַׁעְיָ֖הוּ אֶל חִזְקִיָּ֑הוּ שְׁמַ֖ע דְּבַר יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: vy'mr ysh'yhv 'l chzqyhv shm' dbr yhvh
verses.translation: And Isaiah said unto Hezekiah, Hear the word of the LORD .

verses.original: הִנֵּה֮ יָמִ֣ים בָּאִים֒ וְ/נִשָּׂ֣א כָּל אֲשֶׁ֣ר בְּ/בֵיתֶ֗/ךָ וַ/אֲשֶׁ֨ר אָצְר֧וּ אֲבֹתֶ֛י/ךָ עַד הַ/יּ֥וֹם הַ/זֶּ֖ה בָּבֶ֑לָ/ה לֹֽא יִוָּתֵ֥ר דָּבָ֖ר אָמַ֥ר יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: hnh ymym b'ym vnsh' khl 'shr bbytkh v'shr 'tsrv 'btykh 'd hyvm hzh bblh l' yvtr dbr 'mr yhvh
verses.translation: Behold, the days come, that all that is in thine house, and that which thy fathers have laid up in store unto this day, shall be carried into Babylon: nothing shall be left, saith the LORD .

verses.original: וּ/מִ/בָּנֶ֜י/ךָ אֲשֶׁ֨ר יֵצְא֧וּ מִמְּ/ךָ֛ אֲשֶׁ֥ר תּוֹלִ֖יד יקח יִקָּ֑חוּ וְ/הָיוּ֙ סָֽרִיסִ֔ים בְּ/הֵיכַ֖ל מֶ֥לֶךְ בָּבֶֽל
verses.translit: vmbnykh 'shr yts'v mmkh 'shr tvlyd yqch yqchv vhyv srysym bhykhl mlkh bbl
verses.translation: And of thy sons that shall issue from thee, which thou shalt beget, shall they take away; and they shall be eunuchs in the palace of the king of Babylon.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֤אמֶר חִזְקִיָּ֨הוּ֙ אֶֽל יְשַֽׁעְיָ֔הוּ ט֥וֹב דְּבַר יְהוָ֖ה אֲשֶׁ֣ר דִּבַּ֑רְתָּ וַ/יֹּ֕אמֶר הֲ/ל֛וֹא אִם שָׁל֥וֹם וֶ/אֱמֶ֖ת יִהְיֶ֥ה בְ/יָמָֽ/י
verses.translit: vy'mr chzqyhv 'l ysh'yhv tvb dbr yhvh 'shr dbrt vy'mr hlv' 'm shlvm v'mt yhyh bymy
verses.translation: Then said Hezekiah unto Isaiah, Good is the word of the LORD which thou hast spoken. And he said, Is it not good , if peace and truth be in my days?

verses.original: וְ/יֶ֨תֶר דִּבְרֵ֤י חִזְקִיָּ֨הוּ֙ וְ/כָל גְּב֣וּרָת֔/וֹ וַ/אֲשֶׁ֣ר עָשָׂ֗ה אֶת הַ/בְּרֵכָה֙ וְ/אֶת הַ/תְּעָלָ֔ה וַ/יָּבֵ֥א אֶת הַ/מַּ֖יִם הָ/עִ֑ירָ/ה הֲ/לֹא הֵ֣ם כְּתוּבִ֗ים עַל סֵ֛פֶר דִּבְרֵ֥י הַ/יָּמִ֖ים לְ/מַלְכֵ֥י יְהוּדָֽה
verses.translit: vytr dbry chzqyhv vkhl gbvrtv v'shr 'shh 't hbrkhh v't ht'lh vyb' 't hmym h'yrh hl' hm khtvbym 'l spr dbry hymym lmlkhy yhvdh
verses.translation: And the rest of the acts of Hezekiah, and all his might, and how he made a pool, and a conduit, and brought water into the city, are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah?

verses.original: וַ/יִּשְׁכַּ֥ב חִזְקִיָּ֖הוּ עִם אֲבֹתָ֑י/ו וַ/יִּמְלֹ֛ךְ מְנַשֶּׁ֥ה בְנ֖/וֹ תַּחְתָּֽי/ו
verses.translit: vyshkhb chzqyhv 'm 'btyv vymlkh mnshh bnv tchtyv
verses.translation: And Hezekiah slept with his fathers: and Manasseh his son reigned in his stead.

verses.original: בֶּן שְׁתֵּ֨ים עֶשְׂרֵ֤ה שָׁנָה֙ מְנַשֶּׁ֣ה בְ/מָלְכ֔/וֹ וַ/חֲמִשִּׁ֤ים וְ/חָמֵשׁ֙ שָׁנָ֔ה מָלַ֖ךְ בִּ/ירוּשָׁלִָ֑ם וְ/שֵׁ֥ם אִמּ֖/וֹ חֶפְצִי בָֽהּ
verses.translit: bn shtym 'shrh shnh mnshh bmlkhv vchmshym vchmsh shnh mlkh byrvshlm vshm 'mv chptsy bh
verses.translation: Manasseh was twelve years old when he began to reign, and reigned fifty and five years in Jerusalem. And his mother’s name was Hephzi-bah.

verses.original: וַ/יַּ֥עַשׂ הָ/רַ֖ע בְּ/עֵינֵ֣י יְהוָ֑ה כְּ/תֽוֹעֲבֹת֙ הַ/גּוֹיִ֔ם אֲשֶׁר֙ הוֹרִ֣ישׁ יְהוָ֔ה מִ/פְּנֵ֖י בְּנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל
verses.translit: vy'sh hr' b'yny yhvh khtv'bt hgvym 'shr hvrysh yhvh mpny bny yshr'l
verses.translation: And he did that which was evil in the sight of the LORD , after the abominations of the heathen, whom the LORD cast out before the children of Israel.

verses.original: וַ/יָּ֗שָׁב וַ/יִּ֨בֶן֙ אֶת הַ/בָּמ֔וֹת אֲשֶׁ֥ר אִבַּ֖ד חִזְקִיָּ֣הוּ אָבִ֑י/ו וַ/יָּ֨קֶם מִזְבְּחֹ֜ת לַ/בַּ֗עַל וַ/יַּ֤עַשׂ אֲשֵׁרָה֙ כַּ/אֲשֶׁ֣ר עָשָׂ֗ה אַחְאָב֙ מֶ֣לֶךְ יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל וַ/יִּשְׁתַּ֨חוּ֙ לְ/כָל צְבָ֣א הַ/שָּׁמַ֔יִם וַֽ/יַּעֲבֹ֖ד אֹתָֽ/ם
verses.translit: vyshb vybn 't hbmvt 'shr 'bd chzqyhv 'byv vyqm mzbcht lb'l vy'sh 'shrh kh'shr 'shh 'ch'b mlkh yshr'l vyshtchv lkhl tsb' hshmym vy'bd 'tm
verses.translation: For he built up again the high places which Hezekiah his father had destroyed; and he reared up altars for Baal, and made a grove, as did Ahab king of Israel; and worshipped all the host of heaven, and served them.

verses.original: וּ/בָנָ֥ה מִזְבְּחֹ֖ת בְּ/בֵ֣ית יְהוָ֑ה אֲשֶׁר֙ אָמַ֣ר יְהוָ֔ה בִּ/ירוּשָׁלִַ֖ם אָשִׂ֥ים אֶת שְׁמִֽ/י
verses.translit: vbnh mzbcht bbyt yhvh 'shr 'mr yhvh byrvshlm 'shym 't shmy
verses.translation: And he built altars in the house of the LORD , of which the LORD said, In Jerusalem will I put my name.

verses.original: וַ/יִּ֥בֶן מִזְבְּח֖וֹת לְ/כָל צְבָ֣א הַ/שָּׁמָ֑יִם בִּ/שְׁתֵּ֖י חַצְר֥וֹת בֵּית יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: vybn mzbchvt lkhl tsb' hshmym bshty chtsrvt byt yhvh
verses.translation: And he built altars for all the host of heaven in the two courts of the house of the LORD .

verses.original: וְ/הֶעֱבִ֤יר אֶת בְּנ/וֹ֙ בָּ/אֵ֔שׁ וְ/עוֹנֵ֣ן וְ/נִחֵ֔שׁ וְ/עָ֥שָׂה א֖וֹב וְ/יִדְּעֹנִ֑ים הִרְבָּ֗ה לַ/עֲשׂ֥וֹת הָ/רַ֛ע בְּ/עֵינֵ֥י יְהוָ֖ה לְ/הַכְעִֽיס
verses.translit: vh'byr 't bnv b'sh v'vnn vnchsh v'shh 'vb vyd'nym hrbh l'shvt hr' b'yny yhvh lhkh'ys
verses.translation: And he made his son pass through the fire, and observed times, and used enchantments, and dealt with familiar spirits and wizards: he wrought much wickedness in the sight of the LORD , to provoke him to anger.

verses.original: וַ/יָּ֕שֶׂם אֶת פֶּ֥סֶל הָ/אֲשֵׁרָ֖ה אֲשֶׁ֣ר עָשָׂ֑ה בַּ/בַּ֗יִת אֲשֶׁ֨ר אָמַ֤ר יְהוָה֙ אֶל דָּוִד֙ וְ/אֶל שְׁלֹמֹ֣ה בְנ֔/וֹ בַּ/בַּ֨יִת הַ/זֶּ֜ה וּ/בִ/ירוּשָׁלִַ֗ם אֲשֶׁ֤ר בָּחַ֨רְתִּי֙ מִ/כֹּל֙ שִׁבְטֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל אָשִׂ֥ים אֶת שְׁמִ֖/י לְ/עוֹלָֽם
verses.translit: vyshm 't psl h'shrh 'shr 'shh bbyt 'shr 'mr yhvh 'l dvd v'l shlmh bnv bbyt hzh vbyrvshlm 'shr bchrty mkhl shbty yshr'l 'shym 't shmy l'vlm
verses.translation: And he set a graven image of the grove that he had made in the house, of which the LORD said to David, and to Solomon his son, In this house, and in Jerusalem, which I have chosen out of all tribes of Israel, will I put my name for ever:

verses.original: וְ/לֹ֣א אֹסִ֗יף לְ/הָנִיד֙ רֶ֣גֶל יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל מִן הָ֣/אֲדָמָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר נָתַ֖תִּי לַֽ/אֲבוֹתָ֑/ם רַ֣ק אִם יִשְׁמְר֣וּ לַ/עֲשׂ֗וֹת כְּ/כֹל֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר צִוִּיתִ֔י/ם וּ/לְ/כָל הַ֨/תּוֹרָ֔ה אֲשֶׁר צִוָּ֥ה אֹתָ֖/ם עַבְדִּ֥/י מֹשֶֽׁה
verses.translit: vl' 'syf lhnyd rgl yshr'l mn h'dmh 'shr ntty l'bvtm rq 'm yshmrv l'shvt khkhl 'shr tsvytym vlkhl htvrh 'shr tsvh 'tm 'bdy mshh
verses.translation: Neither will I make the feet of Israel move any more out of the land which I gave their fathers; only if they will observe to do according to all that I have commanded them, and according to all the law that my servant Moses commanded them.

verses.original: וְ/לֹ֖א שָׁמֵ֑עוּ וַ/יַּתְעֵ֤/ם מְנַשֶּׁה֙ לַ/עֲשׂ֣וֹת אֶת הָ/רָ֔ע מִן הַ֨/גּוֹיִ֔ם אֲשֶׁר֙ הִשְׁמִ֣יד יְהוָ֔ה מִ/פְּנֵ֖י בְּנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל
verses.translit: vl' shm'v vyt'm mnshh l'shvt 't hr' mn hgvym 'shr hshmyd yhvh mpny bny yshr'l
verses.translation: But they hearkened not: and Manasseh seduced them to do more evil than did the nations whom the LORD destroyed before the children of Israel.

verses.original: וַ/יְדַבֵּ֧ר יְהוָ֛ה בְּ/יַד עֲבָדָ֥י/ו הַ/נְּבִיאִ֖ים לֵ/אמֹֽר
verses.translit: vydbr yhvh byd 'bdyv hnby'ym l'mr
verses.translation: And the LORD spake by his servants the prophets, saying,

verses.original: יַעַן֩ אֲשֶׁ֨ר עָשָׂ֜ה מְנַשֶּׁ֤ה מֶֽלֶךְ יְהוּדָה֙ הַ/תֹּעֵב֣וֹת הָ/אֵ֔לֶּה הֵרַ֕ע מִ/כֹּ֛ל אֲשֶׁר עָשׂ֥וּ הָ/אֱמֹרִ֖י אֲשֶׁ֣ר לְ/פָנָ֑י/ו וַ/יַּחֲטִ֥א גַֽם אֶת יְהוּדָ֖ה בְּ/גִלּוּלָֽי/ו
verses.translit: y'n 'shr 'shh mnshh mlkh yhvdh ht'bvt h'lh hr' mkhl 'shr 'shv h'mry 'shr lpnyv vycht' gm 't yhvdh bglvlyv
verses.translation: Because Manasseh king of Judah hath done these abominations, and hath done wickedly above all that the Amorites did, which were before him, and hath made Judah also to sin with his idols:

verses.original: לָ/כֵ֗ן כֹּֽה אָמַ֤ר יְהוָה֙ אֱלֹהֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל הִנְ/נִי֙ מֵבִ֣יא רָעָ֔ה עַל יְרוּשָׁלִַ֖ם וִֽ/יהוּדָ֑ה אֲשֶׁר֙ כָּל שמעי/ו שֹׁ֣מְעָ֔/הּ תִּצַּ֖לְנָה שְׁתֵּ֥י אָזְנָֽי/ו
verses.translit: lkhn khh 'mr yhvh 'lhy yshr'l hnny mby' r'h 'l yrvshlm vyhvdh 'shr khl shm'yv shm'h ttslnh shty 'znyv
verses.translation: Therefore thus saith the LORD God of Israel, Behold, I am bringing such evil upon Jerusalem and Judah, that whosoever heareth of it, both his ears shall tingle.

verses.original: וְ/נָטִ֣יתִי עַל יְרוּשָׁלִַ֗ם אֵ֚ת קָ֣ו שֹֽׁמְר֔וֹן וְ/אֶת מִשְׁקֹ֖לֶת בֵּ֣ית אַחְאָ֑ב וּ/מָחִ֨יתִי אֶת יְרוּשָׁלִַ֜ם כַּֽ/אֲשֶׁר יִמְחֶ֤ה אֶת הַ/צַּלַּ֨חַת֙ מָחָ֔ה וְ/הָפַ֖ךְ עַל פָּנֶֽי/הָ
verses.translit: vntyty 'l yrvshlm 't qv shmrvn v't mshqlt byt 'ch'b vmchyty 't yrvshlm kh'shr ymchh 't htslcht mchh vhpkh 'l pnyh
verses.translation: And I will stretch over Jerusalem the line of Samaria, and the plummet of the house of Ahab: and I will wipe Jerusalem as a man wipeth a dish, wiping it , and turning it upside down.

verses.original: וְ/נָטַשְׁתִּ֗י אֵ֚ת שְׁאֵרִ֣ית נַחֲלָתִ֔/י וּ/נְתַתִּ֖י/ם בְּ/יַ֣ד אֹֽיְבֵי/הֶ֑ם וְ/הָי֥וּ לְ/בַ֛ז וְ/לִ/מְשִׁסָּ֖ה לְ/כָל אֹיְבֵי/הֶֽם
verses.translit: vntshty 't sh'ryt nchlty vnttym byd 'ybyhm vhyv lbz vlmshsh lkhl 'ybyhm
verses.translation: And I will forsake the remnant of mine inheritance, and deliver them into the hand of their enemies; and they shall become a prey and a spoil to all their enemies;

verses.original: יַ֗עַן אֲשֶׁ֨ר עָשׂ֤וּ אֶת הָ/רַע֙ בְּ/עֵינַ֔/י וַ/יִּהְי֥וּ מַכְעִסִ֖ים אֹתִ֑/י מִן הַ/יּ֗וֹם אֲשֶׁ֨ר יָצְא֤וּ אֲבוֹתָ/ם֙ מִ/מִּצְרַ֔יִם וְ/עַ֖ד הַ/יּ֥וֹם הַ/זֶּֽה
verses.translit: y'n 'shr 'shv 't hr' b'yny vyhyv mkh'sym 'ty mn hyvm 'shr yts'v 'bvtm mmtsrym v'd hyvm hzh
verses.translation: Because they have done that which was evil in my sight, and have provoked me to anger, since the day their fathers came forth out of Egypt, even unto this day.

verses.original: וְ/גַם֩ דָּ֨ם נָקִ֜י שָׁפַ֤ךְ מְנַשֶּׁה֙ הַרְבֵּ֣ה מְאֹ֔ד עַ֛ד אֲשֶׁר מִלֵּ֥א אֶת יְרוּשָׁלִַ֖ם פֶּ֣ה לָ/פֶ֑ה לְ/בַ֤ד מֵֽ/חַטָּאת/וֹ֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר הֶחֱטִ֣יא אֶת יְהוּדָ֔ה לַ/עֲשׂ֥וֹת הָ/רַ֖ע בְּ/עֵינֵ֥י יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: vgm dm nqy shpkh mnshh hrbh m'd 'd 'shr ml' 't yrvshlm ph lph lbd mcht'tv 'shr hchty' 't yhvdh l'shvt hr' b'yny yhvh
verses.translation: Moreover Manasseh shed innocent blood very much, till he had filled Jerusalem from one end to another; beside his sin wherewith he made Judah to sin, in doing that which was evil in the sight of the LORD .

verses.original: וְ/יֶ֨תֶר דִּבְרֵ֤י מְנַשֶּׁה֙ וְ/כָל אֲשֶׁ֣ר עָשָׂ֔ה וְ/חַטָּאת֖/וֹ אֲשֶׁ֣ר חָטָ֑א הֲ/לֹא הֵ֣ם כְּתוּבִ֗ים עַל סֵ֛פֶר דִּבְרֵ֥י הַ/יָּמִ֖ים לְ/מַלְכֵ֥י יְהוּדָֽה
verses.translit: vytr dbry mnshh vkhl 'shr 'shh vcht'tv 'shr cht' hl' hm khtvbym 'l spr dbry hymym lmlkhy yhvdh
verses.translation: Now the rest of the acts of Manasseh, and all that he did, and his sin that he sinned, are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah?

verses.original: וַ/יִּשְׁכַּ֤ב מְנַשֶּׁה֙ עִם אֲבֹתָ֔י/ו וַ/יִּקָּבֵ֥ר בְּ/גַן בֵּית֖/וֹ בְּ/גַן עֻזָּ֑א וַ/יִּמְלֹ֛ךְ אָמ֥וֹן בְּנ֖/וֹ תַּחְתָּֽי/ו
verses.translit: vyshkhb mnshh 'm 'btyv vyqbr bgn bytv bgn 'z' vymlkh 'mvn bnv tchtyv
verses.translation: And Manasseh slept with his fathers, and was buried in the garden of his own house, in the garden of Uzza: and Amon his son reigned in his stead.

verses.original: בֶּן עֶשְׂרִ֨ים וּ/שְׁתַּ֤יִם שָׁנָה֙ אָמ֣וֹן בְּ/מָלְכ֔/וֹ וּ/שְׁתַּ֣יִם שָׁנִ֔ים מָלַ֖ךְ בִּ/ירוּשָׁלִָ֑ם וְ/שֵׁ֣ם אִמּ֔/וֹ מְשֻׁלֶּ֥מֶת בַּת חָר֖וּץ מִן יָטְבָֽה
verses.translit: bn 'shrym vshtym shnh 'mvn bmlkhv vshtym shnym mlkh byrvshlm vshm 'mv mshlmt bt chrvts mn ytbh
verses.translation: Amon was twenty and two years old when he began to reign, and he reigned two years in Jerusalem. And his mother’s name was Meshullemeth, the daughter of Haruz of Jotbah.

verses.original: וַ/יַּ֥עַשׂ הָ/רַ֖ע בְּ/עֵינֵ֣י יְהוָ֑ה כַּ/אֲשֶׁ֥ר עָשָׂ֖ה מְנַשֶּׁ֥ה אָבִֽי/ו
verses.translit: vy'sh hr' b'yny yhvh kh'shr 'shh mnshh 'byv
verses.translation: And he did that which was evil in the sight of the LORD , as his father Manasseh did.

verses.original: וַ/יֵּ֕לֶךְ בְּ/כָל הַ/דֶּ֖רֶךְ אֲשֶׁר הָלַ֣ךְ אָבִ֑י/ו וַֽ/יַּעֲבֹ֗ד אֶת הַ/גִּלֻּלִים֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר עָבַ֣ד אָבִ֔י/ו וַ/יִּשְׁתַּ֖חוּ לָ/הֶֽם
verses.translit: vylkh bkhl hdrkh 'shr hlkh 'byv vy'bd 't hgllym 'shr 'bd 'byv vyshtchv lhm
verses.translation: And he walked in all the way that his father walked in, and served the idols that his father served, and worshipped them:

verses.original: וַ/יַּעֲזֹ֕ב אֶת יְהוָ֖ה אֱלֹהֵ֣י אֲבֹתָ֑י/ו וְ/לֹ֥א הָלַ֖ךְ בְּ/דֶ֥רֶךְ יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: vy'zb 't yhvh 'lhy 'btyv vl' hlkh bdrkh yhvh
verses.translation: And he forsook the LORD God of his fathers, and walked not in the way of the LORD .

verses.original: וַ/יִּקְשְׁר֥וּ עַבְדֵֽי אָמ֖וֹן עָלָ֑י/ו וַ/יָּמִ֥יתוּ אֶת הַ/מֶּ֖לֶךְ בְּ/בֵיתֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: vyqshrv 'bdy 'mvn 'lyv vymytv 't hmlkh bbytv
verses.translation: And the servants of Amon conspired against him, and slew the king in his own house.

verses.original: וַ/יַּךְ֙ עַם הָ/אָ֔רֶץ אֵ֥ת כָּל הַ/קֹּשְׁרִ֖ים עַל הַ/מֶּ֣לֶךְ אָמ֑וֹן וַ/יַּמְלִ֧יכוּ עַם הָ/אָ֛רֶץ אֶת יֹאשִׁיָּ֥הוּ בְנ֖/וֹ תַּחְתָּֽי/ו
verses.translit: vykh 'm h'rts 't khl hqshrym 'l hmlkh 'mvn vymlykhv 'm h'rts 't y'shyhv bnv tchtyv
verses.translation: And the people of the land slew all them that had conspired against king Amon; and the people of the land made Josiah his son king in his stead.

verses.original: וְ/יֶ֛תֶר דִּבְרֵ֥י אָמ֖וֹן אֲשֶׁ֣ר עָשָׂ֑ה הֲ/לֹא הֵ֣ם כְּתוּבִ֗ים עַל סֵ֛פֶר דִּבְרֵ֥י הַ/יָּמִ֖ים לְ/מַלְכֵ֥י יְהוּדָֽה
verses.translit: vytr dbry 'mvn 'shr 'shh hl' hm khtvbym 'l spr dbry hymym lmlkhy yhvdh
verses.translation: Now the rest of the acts of Amon which he did, are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah?

verses.original: וַ/יִּקְבְֹּ֥ר אֹת֛/וֹ בִּ/קְבֻרָת֖/וֹ בְּ/גַן עֻזָּ֑א וַ/יִּמְלֹ֛ךְ יֹאשִׁיָּ֥הוּ בְנ֖/וֹ תַּחְתָּֽי/ו
verses.translit: vyqbr 'tv bqbrtv bgn 'z' vymlkh y'shyhv bnv tchtyv
verses.translation: And he was buried in his sepulchre in the garden of Uzza: and Josiah his son reigned in his stead.

verses.original: בֶּן שְׁמֹנֶ֤ה שָׁנָה֙ יֹאשִׁיָּ֣הוּ בְ/מָלְכ֔/וֹ וּ/שְׁלֹשִׁ֤ים וְ/אַחַת֙ שָׁנָ֔ה מָלַ֖ךְ בִּ/ירוּשָׁלִָ֑ם וְ/שֵׁ֣ם אִמּ֔/וֹ יְדִידָ֥ה בַת עֲדָ֖יָה מִ/בָּצְקַֽת
verses.translit: bn shmnh shnh y'shyhv bmlkhv vshlshym v'cht shnh mlkh byrvshlm vshm 'mv ydydh bt 'dyh mbtsqt
verses.translation: Josiah was eight years old when he began to reign, and he reigned thirty and one years in Jerusalem. And his mother’s name was Jedidah, the daughter of Adaiah of Boscath.

verses.original: וַ/יַּ֥עַשׂ הַ/יָּשָׁ֖ר בְּ/עֵינֵ֣י יְהוָ֑ה וַ/יֵּ֗לֶךְ בְּ/כָל דֶּ֨רֶךְ֙ דָּוִ֣ד אָבִ֔י/ו וְ/לֹא סָ֖ר יָמִ֥ין וּ/שְׂמֹֽאול
verses.translit: vy'sh hyshr b'yny yhvh vylkh bkhl drkh dvd 'byv vl' sr ymyn vshm'vl
verses.translation: And he did that which was right in the sight of the LORD , and walked in all the way of David his father, and turned not aside to the right hand or to the left.

verses.original: וַ/יְהִ֗י בִּ/שְׁמֹנֶ֤ה עֶשְׂרֵה֙ שָׁנָ֔ה לַ/מֶּ֖לֶךְ יֹאשִׁיָּ֑הוּ שָׁלַ֣ח הַ֠/מֶּלֶךְ אֶת שָׁפָ֨ן בֶּן אֲצַלְיָ֤הוּ בֶן מְשֻׁלָּם֙ הַ/סֹּפֵ֔ר בֵּ֥ית יְהוָ֖ה לֵ/אמֹֽר
verses.translit: vyhy bshmnh 'shrh shnh lmlkh y'shyhv shlch hmlkh 't shpn bn 'tslyhv bn mshlm hspr byt yhvh l'mr
verses.translation: And it came to pass in the eighteenth year of king Josiah, that the king sent Shaphan the son of Azaliah, the son of Meshullam, the scribe, to the house of the LORD , saying,

verses.original: עֲלֵ֗ה אֶל חִלְקִיָּ֨הוּ֙ הַ/כֹּהֵ֣ן הַ/גָּד֔וֹל וְ/יַתֵּ֣ם אֶת הַ/כֶּ֔סֶף הַ/מּוּבָ֖א בֵּ֣ית יְהוָ֑ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר אָסְפ֛וּ שֹׁמְרֵ֥י הַ/סַּ֖ף מֵ/אֵ֥ת הָ/עָֽם
verses.translit: 'lh 'l chlqyhv hkhhn hgdvl vytm 't hkhsf hmvb' byt yhvh 'shr 'spv shmry hsf m't h'm
verses.translation: Go up to Hilkiah the high priest, that he may sum the silver which is brought into the house of the LORD , which the keepers of the door have gathered of the people:

verses.original: ו/יתנ/ה וְ/יִתְּנֻ֗/הוּ עַל יַד֙ עֹשֵׂ֣י הַ/מְּלָאכָ֔ה הַ/מֻּפְקָדִ֖ים ב/בית בֵּ֣ית יְהוָ֑ה וְ/יִתְּנ֣וּ אֹת֗/וֹ לְ/עֹשֵׂ֤י הַ/מְּלָאכָה֙ אֲשֶׁר֙ בְּ/בֵ֣ית יְהוָ֔ה לְ/חַזֵּ֖ק בֶּ֥דֶק הַ/בָּֽיִת
verses.translit: vytnh vytnhv 'l yd 'shy hml'khh hmpqdym bbyt byt yhvh vytnv 'tv l'shy hml'khh 'shr bbyt yhvh lchzq bdq hbyt
verses.translation: And let them deliver it into the hand of the doers of the work, that have the oversight of the house of the LORD : and let them give it to the doers of the work which is in the house of the LORD , to repair the breaches of the house,

verses.original: לֶ/חָ֣רָשִׁ֔ים וְ/לַ/בֹּנִ֖ים וְ/לַ/גֹּֽדְרִ֑ים וְ/לִ/קְנ֤וֹת עֵצִים֙ וְ/אַבְנֵ֣י מַחְצֵ֔ב לְ/חַזֵּ֖ק אֶת הַ/בָּֽיִת
verses.translit: lchrshym vlbnym vlgdrym vlqnvt 'tsym v'bny mchtsb lchzq 't hbyt
verses.translation: Unto carpenters, and builders, and masons, and to buy timber and hewn stone to repair the house.

verses.original: אַ֚ךְ לֹא יֵחָשֵׁ֣ב אִתָּ֔/ם הַ/כֶּ֖סֶף הַ/נִּתָּ֣ן עַל יָדָ֑/ם כִּ֥י בֶ/אֱמוּנָ֖ה הֵ֥ם עֹשִֽׂים
verses.translit: 'kh l' ychshb 'tm hkhsf hntn 'l ydm khy b'mvnh hm 'shym
verses.translation: Howbeit there was no reckoning made with them of the money that was delivered into their hand, because they dealt faithfully.

verses.original: וַ֠/יֹּאמֶר חִלְקִיָּ֜הוּ הַ/כֹּהֵ֤ן הַ/גָּדוֹל֙ עַל שָׁפָ֣ן הַ/סֹּפֵ֔ר סֵ֧פֶר הַ/תּוֹרָ֛ה מָצָ֖אתִי בְּ/בֵ֣ית יְהוָ֑ה וַ/יִּתֵּ֨ן חִלְקִיָּ֧ה אֶת הַ/סֵּ֛פֶר אֶל שָׁפָ֖ן וַ/יִּקְרָאֵֽ/הוּ
verses.translit: vy'mr chlqyhv hkhhn hgdvl 'l shpn hspr spr htvrh mts'ty bbyt yhvh vytn chlqyh 't hspr 'l shpn vyqr'hv
verses.translation: And Hilkiah the high priest said unto Shaphan the scribe, I have found the book of the law in the house of the LORD . And Hilkiah gave the book to Shaphan, and he read it.

verses.original: וַ/יָּבֹ֞א שָׁפָ֤ן הַ/סֹּפֵר֙ אֶל הַ/מֶּ֔לֶךְ וַ/יָּ֥שֶׁב אֶת הַ/מֶּ֖לֶךְ דָּבָ֑ר וַ/יֹּ֗אמֶר הִתִּ֤יכוּ עֲבָדֶ֨י/ךָ֙ אֶת הַ/כֶּ֨סֶף֙ הַ/נִּמְצָ֣א בַ/בַּ֔יִת וַֽ/יִּתְּנֻ֗/הוּ עַל יַד֙ עֹשֵׂ֣י הַ/מְּלָאכָ֔ה הַ/מֻּפְקָדִ֖ים בֵּ֥ית יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: vyb' shpn hspr 'l hmlkh vyshb 't hmlkh dbr vy'mr htykhv 'bdykh 't hkhsf hnmts' bbyt vytnhv 'l yd 'shy hml'khh hmpqdym byt yhvh
verses.translation: And Shaphan the scribe came to the king, and brought the king word again, and said, Thy servants have gathered the money that was found in the house, and have delivered it into the hand of them that do the work, that have the oversight of the house of the LORD .

verses.original: וַ/יַּגֵּ֞ד שָׁפָ֤ן הַ/סֹּפֵר֙ לַ/מֶּ֣לֶךְ לֵ/אמֹ֔ר סֵ֚פֶר נָ֣תַן לִ֔/י חִלְקִיָּ֖ה הַ/כֹּהֵ֑ן וַ/יִּקְרָאֵ֥/הוּ שָׁפָ֖ן לִ/פְנֵ֥י הַ/מֶּֽלֶךְ
verses.translit: vygd shpn hspr lmlkh l'mr spr ntn ly chlqyh hkhhn vyqr'hv shpn lpny hmlkh
verses.translation: And Shaphan the scribe shewed the king, saying, Hilkiah the priest hath delivered me a book. And Shaphan read it before the king.

verses.original: וַֽ/יְהִי֙ כִּ/שְׁמֹ֣עַ הַ/מֶּ֔לֶךְ אֶת דִּבְרֵ֖י סֵ֣פֶר הַ/תּוֹרָ֑ה וַ/יִּקְרַ֖ע אֶת בְּגָדָֽי/ו
verses.translit: vyhy khshm' hmlkh 't dbry spr htvrh vyqr' 't bgdyv
verses.translation: And it came to pass, when the king had heard the words of the book of the law, that he rent his clothes.

verses.original: וַ/יְצַ֣ו הַ/מֶּ֡לֶךְ אֶת חִלְקִיָּ֣ה הַ/כֹּהֵ֡ן וְ/אֶת אֲחִיקָ֣ם בֶּן שָׁ֠פָן וְ/אֶת עַכְבּ֨וֹר בֶּן מִיכָיָ֜ה וְ/אֵ֣ת שָׁפָ֣ן הַ/סֹּפֵ֗ר וְ/אֵ֛ת עֲשָׂיָ֥ה עֶֽבֶד הַ/מֶּ֖לֶךְ לֵ/אמֹֽר
verses.translit: vytsv hmlkh 't chlqyh hkhhn v't 'chyqm bn shpn v't 'khbvr bn mykhyh v't shpn hspr v't 'shyh 'bd hmlkh l'mr
verses.translation: And the king commanded Hilkiah the priest, and Ahikam the son of Shaphan, and Achbor the son of Michaiah, and Shaphan the scribe, and Asahiah a servant of the king’s, saying,

verses.original: לְכוּ֩ דִרְשׁ֨וּ אֶת יְהוָ֜ה בַּעֲדִ֣/י וּ/בְעַד הָ/עָ֗ם וּ/בְעַד֙ כָּל יְהוּדָ֔ה עַל דִּבְרֵ֛י הַ/סֵּ֥פֶר הַ/נִּמְצָ֖א הַ/זֶּ֑ה כִּֽי גְדוֹלָ֞ה חֲמַ֣ת יְהוָ֗ה אֲשֶׁר הִיא֙ נִצְּתָ֣ה בָ֔/נוּ עַל֩ אֲשֶׁ֨ר לֹֽא שָׁמְע֜וּ אֲבֹתֵ֗י/נוּ עַל דִּבְרֵי֙ הַ/סֵּ֣פֶר הַ/זֶּ֔ה לַ/עֲשׂ֖וֹת כְּ/כָל הַ/כָּת֥וּב עָלֵֽי/נוּ
verses.translit: lkhv drshv 't yhvh b'dy vb'd h'm vb'd khl yhvdh 'l dbry hspr hnmts' hzh khy gdvlh chmt yhvh 'shr hy' ntsth bnv 'l 'shr l' shm'v 'btynv 'l dbry hspr hzh l'shvt khkhl hkhtvb 'lynv
verses.translation: Go ye, enquire of the LORD for me, and for the people, and for all Judah, concerning the words of this book that is found: for great is the wrath of the LORD that is kindled against us, because our fathers have not hearkened unto the words of this book, to do according unto all that which is written concerning us.

verses.original: וַ/יֵּ֣לֶךְ חִלְקִיָּ֣הוּ הַ֠/כֹּהֵן וַ/אֲחִיקָ֨ם וְ/עַכְבּ֜וֹר וְ/שָׁפָ֣ן וַ/עֲשָׂיָ֗ה אֶל חֻלְדָּ֨ה הַ/נְּבִיאָ֜ה אֵ֣שֶׁת שַׁלֻּ֣ם בֶּן תִּקְוָ֗ה בֶּן חַרְחַס֙ שֹׁמֵ֣ר הַ/בְּגָדִ֔ים וְ/הִ֛יא יֹשֶׁ֥בֶת בִּ/ירוּשָׁלִַ֖ם בַּ/מִּשְׁנֶ֑ה וַֽ/יְדַבְּר֖וּ אֵלֶֽי/הָ
verses.translit: vylkh chlqyhv hkhhn v'chyqm v'khbvr vshpn v'shyh 'l chldh hnby'h 'sht shlm bn tqvh bn chrchs shmr hbgdym vhy' yshbt byrvshlm bmshnh vydbrv 'lyh
verses.translation: So Hilkiah the priest, and Ahikam, and Achbor, and Shaphan, and Asahiah, went unto Huldah the prophetess, the wife of Shallum the son of Tikvah, the son of Harhas, keeper of the wardrobe; (now she dwelt in Jerusalem in the college;) and they communed with her.

verses.original: וַ/תֹּ֣אמֶר אֲלֵי/הֶ֔ם כֹּֽה אָמַ֥ר יְהוָ֖ה אֱלֹהֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל אִמְר֣וּ לָ/אִ֔ישׁ אֲשֶׁר שָׁלַ֥ח אֶתְ/כֶ֖ם אֵלָֽ/י
verses.translit: vt'mr 'lyhm khh 'mr yhvh 'lhy yshr'l 'mrv l'ysh 'shr shlch 'tkhm 'ly
verses.translation: And she said unto them, Thus saith the LORD God of Israel, Tell the man that sent you to me,

verses.original: כֹּ֚ה אָמַ֣ר יְהוָ֔ה הִנְ/נִ֨י מֵבִ֥יא רָעָ֛ה אֶל הַ/מָּק֥וֹם הַ/זֶּ֖ה וְ/עַל יֹֽשְׁבָ֑י/ו אֵ֚ת כָּל דִּבְרֵ֣י הַ/סֵּ֔פֶר אֲשֶׁ֥ר קָרָ֖א מֶ֥לֶךְ יְהוּדָֽה
verses.translit: khh 'mr yhvh hnny mby' r'h 'l hmqvm hzh v'l yshbyv 't khl dbry hspr 'shr qr' mlkh yhvdh
verses.translation: Thus saith the LORD , Behold, I will bring evil upon this place, and upon the inhabitants thereof, even all the words of the book which the king of Judah hath read:

verses.original: תַּ֣חַת אֲשֶׁ֣ר עֲזָב֗וּ/נִי וַֽ/יְקַטְּרוּ֙ לֵ/אלֹהִ֣ים אֲחֵרִ֔ים לְמַ֨עַן֙ הַכְעִיסֵ֔/נִי בְּ/כֹ֖ל מַעֲשֵׂ֣ה יְדֵי/הֶ֑ם וְ/נִצְּתָ֧ה חֲמָתִ֛/י בַּ/מָּק֥וֹם הַ/זֶּ֖ה וְ/לֹ֥א תִכְבֶּֽה
verses.translit: tcht 'shr 'zbvny vyqtrv l'lhym 'chrym lm'n hkh'ysny bkhl m'shh ydyhm vntsth chmty bmqvm hzh vl' tkhbh
verses.translation: Because they have forsaken me, and have burned incense unto other gods, that they might provoke me to anger with all the works of their hands; therefore my wrath shall be kindled against this place, and shall not be quenched.

verses.original: וְ/אֶל מֶ֣לֶךְ יְהוּדָ֗ה הַ/שֹּׁלֵ֤חַ אֶתְ/כֶם֙ לִ/דְרֹ֣שׁ אֶת יְהוָ֔ה כֹּ֥ה תֹאמְר֖וּ אֵלָ֑י/ו כֹּֽה אָמַ֤ר יְהוָה֙ אֱלֹהֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל הַ/דְּבָרִ֖ים אֲשֶׁ֥ר שָׁמָֽעְתָּ
verses.translit: v'l mlkh yhvdh hshlch 'tkhm ldrsh 't yhvh khh t'mrv 'lyv khh 'mr yhvh 'lhy yshr'l hdbrym 'shr shm't
verses.translation: But to the king of Judah which sent you to enquire of the LORD , thus shall ye say to him, Thus saith the LORD God of Israel, As touching the words which thou hast heard;

verses.original: יַ֠עַן רַךְ לְבָ֨בְ/ךָ֜ וַ/תִּכָּנַ֣ע מִ/פְּנֵ֣י יְהוָ֗ה בְּֽ/שָׁמְעֲ/ךָ֡ אֲשֶׁ֣ר דִּבַּרְתִּי֩ עַל הַ/מָּק֨וֹם הַ/זֶּ֜ה וְ/עַל יֹשְׁבָ֗י/ו לִ/הְי֤וֹת לְ/שַׁמָּה֙ וְ/לִ/קְלָלָ֔ה וַ/תִּקְרַע֙ אֶת בְּגָדֶ֔י/ךָ וַ/תִּבְכֶּ֖ה לְ/פָנָ֑/י וְ/גַ֧ם אָנֹכִ֛י שָׁמַ֖עְתִּי נְאֻם יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: y'n rkh lbbkh vtkhn' mpny yhvh bshm'kh 'shr dbrty 'l hmqvm hzh v'l yshbyv lhyvt lshmh vlqllh vtqr' 't bgdykh vtbkhh lpny vgm 'nkhy shm'ty n'm yhvh
verses.translation: Because thine heart was tender, and thou hast humbled thyself before the LORD , when thou heardest what I spake against this place, and against the inhabitants thereof, that they should become a desolation and a curse, and hast rent thy clothes, and wept before me; I also have heard thee , saith the LORD .

verses.original: לָ/כֵן֩ הִנְ/נִ֨י אֹֽסִפְ/ךָ֜ עַל אֲבֹתֶ֗י/ךָ וְ/נֶאֱסַפְתָּ֣ אֶל קִבְרֹתֶי/ךָ֮ בְּ/שָׁלוֹם֒ וְ/לֹא תִרְאֶ֣ינָה עֵינֶ֔י/ךָ בְּ/כֹל֙ הָֽ/רָעָ֔ה אֲשֶׁר אֲנִ֥י מֵבִ֖יא עַל הַ/מָּק֣וֹם הַ/זֶּ֑ה וַ/יָּשִׁ֥יבוּ אֶת הַ/מֶּ֖לֶךְ דָּבָֽר
verses.translit: lkhn hnny 'spkh 'l 'btykh vn'spt 'l qbrtykh bshlvm vl' tr'ynh 'ynykh bkhl hr'h 'shr 'ny mby' 'l hmqvm hzh vyshybv 't hmlkh dbr
verses.translation: Behold therefore, I will gather thee unto thy fathers, and thou shalt be gathered into thy grave in peace; and thine eyes shall not see all the evil which I will bring upon this place. And they brought the king word again.

verses.original: וַ/יִּשְׁלַ֖ח הַ/מֶּ֑לֶךְ וַ/יַּאַסְפ֣וּ אֵלָ֔י/ו כָּל זִקְנֵ֥י יְהוּדָ֖ה וִ/ירוּשָׁלִָֽם
verses.translit: vyshlch hmlkh vy'spv 'lyv khl zqny yhvdh vyrvshlm
verses.translation: And the king sent, and they gathered unto him all the elders of Judah and of Jerusalem.

verses.original: וַ/יַּ֣עַל הַ/מֶּ֣לֶךְ בֵּית יְהוָ֡ה וְ/כָל אִ֣ישׁ יְהוּדָה֩ וְ/כָל יֹשְׁבֵ֨י יְרוּשָׁלִַ֜ם אִתּ֗/וֹ וְ/הַ/כֹּֽהֲנִים֙ וְ/הַ/נְּבִיאִ֔ים וְ/כָל הָ/עָ֖ם לְ/מִ/קָּטֹ֣ן וְ/עַד גָּד֑וֹל וַ/יִּקְרָ֣א בְ/אָזְנֵי/הֶ֗ם אֶת כָּל דִּבְרֵי֙ סֵ֣פֶר הַ/בְּרִ֔ית הַ/נִּמְצָ֖א בְּ/בֵ֥ית יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: vy'l hmlkh byt yhvh vkhl 'ysh yhvdh vkhl yshby yrvshlm 'tv vhkhhnym vhnby'ym vkhl h'm lmqtn v'd gdvl vyqr' b'znyhm 't khl dbry spr hbryt hnmts' bbyt yhvh
verses.translation: And the king went up into the house of the LORD , and all the men of Judah and all the inhabitants of Jerusalem with him, and the priests, and the prophets, and all the people, both small and great: and he read in their ears all the words of the book of the covenant which was found in the house of the LORD .

verses.original: וַ/יַּעֲמֹ֣ד הַ֠/מֶּלֶךְ עַֽל הָ֨/עַמּ֜וּד וַ/יִּכְרֹ֥ת אֶֽת הַ/בְּרִ֣ית לִ/פְנֵ֣י יְהוָ֗ה לָ/לֶ֜כֶת אַחַ֤ר יְהוָה֙ וְ/לִ/שְׁמֹ֨ר מִצְוֺתָ֜י/ו וְ/אֶת עֵדְוֺתָ֤י/ו וְ/אֶת חֻקֹּתָי/ו֙ בְּ/כָל לֵ֣ב וּ/בְ/כָל נֶ֔פֶשׁ לְ/הָקִ֗ים אֶת דִּבְרֵי֙ הַ/בְּרִ֣ית הַ/זֹּ֔את הַ/כְּתֻבִ֖ים עַל הַ/סֵּ֣פֶר הַ/זֶּ֑ה וַ/יַּעֲמֹ֥ד כָּל הָ/עָ֖ם בַּ/בְּרִֽית
verses.translit: vy'md hmlkh 'l h'mvd vykhrt 't hbryt lpny yhvh llkht 'chr yhvh vlshmr mtsvtyv v't 'dvtyv v't chqtyv bkhl lb vbkhl npsh lhqym 't dbry hbryt hz't hkhtbym 'l hspr hzh vy'md khl h'm bbryt
verses.translation: And the king stood by a pillar, and made a covenant before the LORD , to walk after the LORD , and to keep his commandments and his testimonies and his statutes with all their heart and all their soul, to perform the words of this covenant that were written in this book. And all the people stood to the covenant.

verses.original: וַ/יְצַ֣ו הַ/מֶּ֡לֶךְ אֶת חִלְקִיָּהוּ֩ הַ/כֹּהֵ֨ן הַ/גָּד֜וֹל וְ/אֶת כֹּהֲנֵ֣י הַ/מִּשְׁנֶה֮ וְ/אֶת שֹׁמְרֵ֣י הַ/סַּף֒ לְ/הוֹצִיא֙ מֵ/הֵיכַ֣ל יְהוָ֔ה אֵ֣ת כָּל הַ/כֵּלִ֗ים הָֽ/עֲשׂוּיִם֙ לַ/בַּ֣עַל וְ/לָֽ/אֲשֵׁרָ֔ה וּ/לְ/כֹ֖ל צְבָ֣א הַ/שָּׁמָ֑יִם וַֽ/יִּשְׂרְפֵ֞/ם מִ/ח֤וּץ לִ/ירוּשָׁלִַ֨ם֙ בְּ/שַׁדְמ֣וֹת קִדְר֔וֹן וְ/נָשָׂ֥א אֶת עֲפָרָ֖/ם בֵּֽית אֵֽל
verses.translit: vytsv hmlkh 't chlqyhv hkhhn hgdvl v't khhny hmshnh v't shmry hsf lhvtsy' mhykhl yhvh 't khl hkhlym h'shvym lb'l vl'shrh vlkhl tsb' hshmym vyshrpm mchvts lyrvshlm bshdmvt qdrvn vnsh' 't 'prm byt 'l
verses.translation: And the king commanded Hilkiah the high priest, and the priests of the second order, and the keepers of the door, to bring forth out of the temple of the LORD all the vessels that were made for Baal, and for the grove, and for all the host of heaven: and he burned them without Jerusalem in the fields of Kidron, and carried the ashes of them unto Beth-el.

verses.original: וְ/הִשְׁבִּ֣ית אֶת הַ/כְּמָרִ֗ים אֲשֶׁ֤ר נָֽתְנוּ֙ מַלְכֵ֣י יְהוּדָ֔ה וַ/יְקַטֵּ֤ר בַּ/בָּמוֹת֙ בְּ/עָרֵ֣י יְהוּדָ֔ה וּ/מְסִבֵּ֖י יְרוּשָׁלִָ֑ם וְ/אֶת הַֽ/מְקַטְּרִ֣ים לַ/בַּ֗עַל לַ/שֶּׁ֤מֶשׁ וְ/לַ/יָּרֵ֨חַ֙ וְ/לַ/מַּזָּל֔וֹת וּ/לְ/כֹ֖ל צְבָ֥א הַ/שָּׁמָֽיִם
verses.translit: vhshbyt 't hkhmrym 'shr ntnv mlkhy yhvdh vyqtr bbmvt b'ry yhvdh vmsby yrvshlm v't hmqtrym lb'l lshmsh vlyrch vlmzlvt vlkhl tsb' hshmym
verses.translation: And he put down the idolatrous priests, whom the kings of Judah had ordained to burn incense in the high places in the cities of Judah, and in the places round about Jerusalem; them also that burned incense unto Baal, to the sun, and to the moon, and to the planets, and to all the host of heaven.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּצֵ֣א אֶת הָ/אֲשֵׁרָה֩ מִ/בֵּ֨ית יְהוָ֜ה מִ/ח֤וּץ לִ/ירוּשָׁלִַ֨ם֙ אֶל נַ֣חַל קִדְר֔וֹן וַ/יִּשְׂרֹ֥ף אֹתָ֛/הּ בְּ/נַ֥חַל קִדְר֖וֹן וַ/יָּ֣דֶק לְ/עָפָ֑ר וַ/יַּשְׁלֵךְ֙ אֶת עֲפָרָ֔/הּ עַל קֶ֖בֶר בְּנֵ֥י הָ/עָֽם
verses.translit: vyts' 't h'shrh mbyt yhvh mchvts lyrvshlm 'l nchl qdrvn vyshrf 'th bnchl qdrvn vydq l'pr vyshlkh 't 'prh 'l qbr bny h'm
verses.translation: And he brought out the grove from the house of the LORD , without Jerusalem, unto the brook Kidron, and burned it at the brook Kidron, and stamped it small to powder, and cast the powder thereof upon the graves of the children of the people.

verses.original: וַ/יִּתֹּץ֙ אֶת בָּתֵּ֣י הַ/קְּדֵשִׁ֔ים אֲשֶׁ֖ר בְּ/בֵ֣ית יְהוָ֑ה אֲשֶׁ֣ר הַ/נָּשִׁ֗ים אֹרְג֥וֹת שָׁ֛ם בָּתִּ֖ים לָ/אֲשֵׁרָֽה
verses.translit: vytts 't bty hqdshym 'shr bbyt yhvh 'shr hnshym 'rgvt shm btym l'shrh
verses.translation: And he brake down the houses of the sodomites, that were by the house of the LORD , where the women wove hangings for the grove.

verses.original: וַ/יָּבֵ֤א אֶת כָּל הַ/כֹּֽהֲנִים֙ מֵ/עָרֵ֣י יְהוּדָ֔ה וַ/יְטַמֵּ֣א אֶת הַ/בָּמ֗וֹת אֲשֶׁ֤ר קִטְּרוּ שָׁ֨מָּ/ה֙ הַ/כֹּ֣הֲנִ֔ים מִ/גֶּ֖בַע עַד בְּאֵ֣ר שָׁ֑בַע וְ/נָתַ֞ץ אֶת בָּמ֣וֹת הַ/שְּׁעָרִ֗ים אֲשֶׁר פֶּ֜תַח שַׁ֤עַר יְהוֹשֻׁ֨עַ֙ שַׂר הָ/עִ֔יר אֲשֶֽׁר עַל שְׂמֹ֥אול אִ֖ישׁ בְּ/שַׁ֥עַר הָ/עִֽיר
verses.translit: vyb' 't khl hkhhnym m'ry yhvdh vytm' 't hbmvt 'shr qtrv shmh hkhhnym mgb' 'd b'r shb' vntts 't bmvt hsh'rym 'shr ptch sh'r yhvsh' shr h'yr 'shr 'l shm'vl 'ysh bsh'r h'yr
verses.translation: And he brought all the priests out of the cities of Judah, and defiled the high places where the priests had burned incense, from Geba to Beer-sheba, and brake down the high places of the gates that were in the entering in of the gate of Joshua the governor of the city, which were on a man’s left hand at the gate of the city.

verses.original: אַ֗ךְ לֹ֤א יַֽעֲלוּ֙ כֹּהֲנֵ֣י הַ/בָּמ֔וֹת אֶל מִזְבַּ֥ח יְהוָ֖ה בִּ/ירוּשָׁלִָ֑ם כִּ֛י אִם אָכְל֥וּ מַצּ֖וֹת בְּ/ת֥וֹךְ אֲחֵי/הֶֽם
verses.translit: 'kh l' y'lv khhny hbmvt 'l mzbch yhvh byrvshlm khy 'm 'khlv mtsvt btvkh 'chyhm
verses.translation: Nevertheless the priests of the high places came not up to the altar of the LORD in Jerusalem, but they did eat of the unleavened bread among their brethren.

verses.original: וְ/טִמֵּ֣א אֶת הַ/תֹּ֔פֶת אֲשֶׁ֖ר בְּ/גֵ֣י בני בֶן הִנֹּ֑ם לְ/בִלְתִּ֗י לְ/הַעֲבִ֨יר אִ֜ישׁ אֶת בְּנ֧/וֹ וְ/אֶת בִּתּ֛/וֹ בָּ/אֵ֖שׁ לַ/מֹּֽלֶךְ
verses.translit: vtm' 't htpt 'shr bgy bny bn hnm lblty lh'byr 'ysh 't bnv v't btv b'sh lmlkh
verses.translation: And he defiled Topheth, which is in the valley of the children of Hinnom, that no man might make his son or his daughter to pass through the fire to Molech.

verses.original: וַ/יַּשְׁבֵּ֣ת אֶת הַ/סּוּסִ֗ים אֲשֶׁ֣ר נָתְנוּ֩ מַלְכֵ֨י יְהוּדָ֤ה לַ/שֶּׁ֨מֶשׁ֙ מִ/בֹּ֣א בֵית יְהוָ֔ה אֶל לִשְׁכַּת֙ נְתַן מֶ֣לֶךְ הַ/סָּרִ֔יס אֲשֶׁ֖ר בַּ/פַּרְוָרִ֑ים וְ/אֶת מַרְכְּב֥וֹת הַ/שֶּׁ֖מֶשׁ שָׂרַ֥ף בָּ/אֵֽשׁ
verses.translit: vyshbt 't hsvsym 'shr ntnv mlkhy yhvdh lshmsh mb' byt yhvh 'l lshkht ntn mlkh hsrys 'shr bprvrym v't mrkhbvt hshmsh shrf b'sh
verses.translation: And he took away the horses that the kings of Judah had given to the sun, at the entering in of the house of the LORD , by the chamber of Nathan-melech the chamberlain, which was in the suburbs, and burned the chariots of the sun with fire.

verses.original: וְ/אֶֽת הַֽ/מִּזְבְּח֡וֹת אֲשֶׁ֣ר עַל הַ/גָּג֩ עֲלִיַּ֨ת אָחָ֜ז אֲשֶׁר עָשׂ֣וּ מַלְכֵ֣י יְהוּדָ֗ה וְ/אֶת הַֽ/מִּזְבְּחוֹת֙ אֲשֶׁר עָשָׂ֣ה מְנַשֶּׁ֔ה בִּ/שְׁתֵּ֛י חַצְר֥וֹת בֵּית יְהוָ֖ה נָתַ֣ץ הַ/מֶּ֑לֶךְ וַ/יָּ֣רָץ מִ/שָּׁ֔ם וְ/הִשְׁלִ֥יךְ אֶת עֲפָרָ֖/ם אֶל נַ֥חַל קִדְרֽוֹן
verses.translit: v't hmzbchvt 'shr 'l hgg 'lyt 'chz 'shr 'shv mlkhy yhvdh v't hmzbchvt 'shr 'shh mnshh bshty chtsrvt byt yhvh ntts hmlkh vyrts mshm vhshlykh 't 'prm 'l nchl qdrvn
verses.translation: And the altars that were on the top of the upper chamber of Ahaz, which the kings of Judah had made, and the altars which Manasseh had made in the two courts of the house of the LORD , did the king beat down, and brake them down from thence, and cast the dust of them into the brook Kidron.

verses.original: וְֽ/אֶת הַ/בָּמ֞וֹת אֲשֶׁ֣ר עַל פְּנֵ֣י יְרוּשָׁלִַ֗ם אֲשֶׁר֮ מִ/ימִ֣ין לְ/הַר הַ/מַּשְׁחִית֒ אֲשֶׁ֣ר בָּ֠נָה שְׁלֹמֹ֨ה מֶֽלֶךְ יִשְׂרָאֵ֜ל לְ/עַשְׁתֹּ֣רֶת שִׁקֻּ֣ץ צִידֹנִ֗ים וְ/לִ/כְמוֹשׁ֙ שִׁקֻּ֣ץ מוֹאָ֔ב וּ/לְ/מִלְכֹּ֖ם תּוֹעֲבַ֣ת בְּנֵֽי עַמּ֑וֹן טִמֵּ֖א הַ/מֶּֽלֶךְ
verses.translit: v't hbmvt 'shr 'l pny yrvshlm 'shr mymyn lhr hmshchyt 'shr bnh shlmh mlkh yshr'l l'shtrt shqts tsydnym vlkhmvsh shqts mv'b vlmlkhm tv'bt bny 'mvn tm' hmlkh
verses.translation: And the high places that were before Jerusalem, which were on the right hand of the mount of corruption, which Solomon the king of Israel had builded for Ashtoreth the abomination of the Zidonians, and for Chemosh the abomination of the Moabites, and for Milcom the abomination of the children of Ammon, did the king defile.

verses.original: וְ/שִׁבַּר֙ אֶת הַ/מַּצֵּב֔וֹת וַ/יִּכְרֹ֖ת אֶת הָ/אֲשֵׁרִ֑ים וַ/יְמַלֵּ֥א אֶת מְקוֹמָ֖/ם עַצְמ֥וֹת אָדָֽם
verses.translit: vshbr 't hmtsbvt vykhrt 't h'shrym vyml' 't mqvmm 'tsmvt 'dm
verses.translation: And he brake in pieces the images, and cut down the groves, and filled their places with the bones of men.

verses.original: וְ/גַ֨ם אֶת הַ/מִּזְבֵּ֜חַ אֲשֶׁ֣ר בְּ/בֵֽית אֵ֗ל הַ/בָּמָה֙ אֲשֶׁ֨ר עָשָׂ֜ה יָרָבְעָ֤ם בֶּן נְבָט֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר הֶחֱטִ֣יא אֶת יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל גַּ֣ם אֶת הַ/מִּזְבֵּ֧חַ הַ/ה֛וּא וְ/אֶת הַ/בָּמָ֖ה נָתָ֑ץ וַ/יִּשְׂרֹ֧ף אֶת הַ/בָּמָ֛ה הֵדַ֥ק לְ/עָפָ֖ר וְ/שָׂרַ֥ף אֲשֵׁרָֽה
verses.translit: vgm 't hmzbch 'shr bbyt 'l hbmh 'shr 'shh yrb'm bn nbt 'shr hchty' 't yshr'l gm 't hmzbch hhv' v't hbmh ntts vyshrf 't hbmh hdq l'pr vshrf 'shrh
verses.translation: Moreover the altar that was at Beth-el, and the high place which Jeroboam the son of Nebat, who made Israel to sin, had made, both that altar and the high place he brake down, and burned the high place, and stamped it small to powder, and burned the grove.

verses.original: וַ/יִּ֣פֶן יֹאשִׁיָּ֗הוּ וַ/יַּ֨רְא אֶת הַ/קְּבָרִ֤ים אֲשֶׁר שָׁם֙ בָּ/הָ֔ר וַ/יִּשְׁלַ֗ח וַ/יִּקַּ֤ח אֶת הָֽ/עֲצָמוֹת֙ מִן הַ/קְּבָרִ֔ים וַ/יִּשְׂרֹ֥ף עַל הַ/מִּזְבֵּ֖חַ וַֽ/יְטַמְּאֵ֑/הוּ כִּ/דְבַ֣ר יְהוָ֗ה אֲשֶׁ֤ר קָרָא֙ אִ֣ישׁ הָ/אֱלֹהִ֔ים אֲשֶׁ֣ר קָרָ֔א אֶת הַ/דְּבָרִ֖ים הָ/אֵֽלֶּה
verses.translit: vypn y'shyhv vyr' 't hqbrym 'shr shm bhr vyshlch vyqch 't h'tsmvt mn hqbrym vyshrf 'l hmzbch vytm'hv khdbr yhvh 'shr qr' 'ysh h'lhym 'shr qr' 't hdbrym h'lh
verses.translation: And as Josiah turned himself, he spied the sepulchres that were there in the mount, and sent, and took the bones out of the sepulchres, and burned them upon the altar, and polluted it, according to the word of the LORD which the man of God proclaimed, who proclaimed these words.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֕אמֶר מָ֚ה הַ/צִּיּ֣וּן הַלָּ֔ז אֲשֶׁ֖ר אֲנִ֣י רֹאֶ֑ה וַ/יֹּאמְר֨וּ אֵלָ֜י/ו אַנְשֵׁ֣י הָ/עִ֗יר הַ/קֶּ֤בֶר אִישׁ הָֽ/אֱלֹהִים֙ אֲשֶׁר בָּ֣א מִֽ/יהוּדָ֔ה וַ/יִּקְרָ֗א אֶת הַ/דְּבָרִ֤ים הָ/אֵ֨לֶּה֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר עָשִׂ֔יתָ עַ֖ל הַ/מִּזְבַּ֥ח בֵּֽית אֵֽל
verses.translit: vy'mr mh htsyvn hlz 'shr 'ny r'h vy'mrv 'lyv 'nshy h'yr hqbr 'ysh h'lhym 'shr b' myhvdh vyqr' 't hdbrym h'lh 'shr 'shyt 'l hmzbch byt 'l
verses.translation: Then he said, What title is that that I see? And the men of the city told him, It is the sepulchre of the man of God, which came from Judah, and proclaimed these things that thou hast done against the altar of Beth-el.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֨אמֶר֙ הַנִּ֣יחוּ ל֔/וֹ אִ֖ישׁ אַל יָנַ֣ע עַצְמֹתָ֑י/ו וַֽ/יְמַלְּטוּ֙ עַצְמֹתָ֔י/ו אֵ֚ת עַצְמ֣וֹת הַ/נָּבִ֔יא אֲשֶׁר בָּ֖א מִ/שֹּׁמְרֽוֹן
verses.translit: vy'mr hnychv lv 'ysh 'l yn' 'tsmtyv vymltv 'tsmtyv 't 'tsmvt hnby' 'shr b' mshmrvn
verses.translation: And he said, Let him alone; let no man move his bones. So they let his bones alone, with the bones of the prophet that came out of Samaria.

verses.original: וְ/גַם֩ אֶת כָּל בָּתֵּ֨י הַ/בָּמ֜וֹת אֲשֶׁ֣ר בְּ/עָרֵ֣י שֹׁמְר֗וֹן אֲשֶׁ֨ר עָשׂ֜וּ מַלְכֵ֤י יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ לְ/הַכְעִ֔יס הֵסִ֖יר יֹֽאשִׁיָּ֑הוּ וַ/יַּ֣עַשׂ לָ/הֶ֔ם כְּ/כָל הַֽ/מַּעֲשִׂ֔ים אֲשֶׁ֥ר עָשָׂ֖ה בְּ/בֵֽית אֵֽל
verses.translit: vgm 't khl bty hbmvt 'shr b'ry shmrvn 'shr 'shv mlkhy yshr'l lhkh'ys hsyr y'shyhv vy'sh lhm khkhl hm'shym 'shr 'shh bbyt 'l
verses.translation: And all the houses also of the high places that were in the cities of Samaria, which the kings of Israel had made to provoke the Lord to anger, Josiah took away, and did to them according to all the acts that he had done in Beth-el.

verses.original: וַ֠/יִּזְבַּח אֶת כָּל כֹּהֲנֵ֨י הַ/בָּמ֤וֹת אֲשֶׁר שָׁם֙ עַל הַֽ/מִּזְבְּח֔וֹת וַ/יִּשְׂרֹ֛ף אֶת עַצְמ֥וֹת אָדָ֖ם עֲלֵי/הֶ֑ם וַ/יָּ֖שָׁב יְרוּשָׁלִָֽם
verses.translit: vyzbch 't khl khhny hbmvt 'shr shm 'l hmzbchvt vyshrf 't 'tsmvt 'dm 'lyhm vyshb yrvshlm
verses.translation: And he slew all the priests of the high places that were there upon the altars, and burned men’s bones upon them, and returned to Jerusalem.

verses.original: וַ/יְצַ֤ו הַ/מֶּ֨לֶךְ֙ אֶת כָּל הָ/עָ֣ם לֵ/אמֹ֔ר עֲשׂ֣וּ פֶ֔סַח לַֽ/יהוָ֖ה אֱלֹֽהֵי/כֶ֑ם כַּ/כָּת֕וּב עַ֛ל סֵ֥פֶר הַ/בְּרִ֖ית הַ/זֶּֽה
verses.translit: vytsv hmlkh 't khl h'm l'mr 'shv psch lyhvh 'lhykhm khkhtvb 'l spr hbryt hzh
verses.translation: And the king commanded all the people, saying, Keep the passover unto the LORD your God, as it is written in the book of this covenant.

verses.original: כִּ֣י לֹ֤א נַֽעֲשָׂה֙ כַּ/פֶּ֣סַח הַ/זֶּ֔ה מִ/ימֵי֙ הַ/שֹּׁ֣פְטִ֔ים אֲשֶׁ֥ר שָׁפְט֖וּ אֶת יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וְ/כֹ֗ל יְמֵ֛י מַלְכֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל וּ/מַלְכֵ֥י יְהוּדָֽה
verses.translit: khy l' n'shh khpsch hzh mymy hshptym 'shr shptv 't yshr'l vkhl ymy mlkhy yshr'l vmlkhy yhvdh
verses.translation: Surely there was not holden such a passover from the days of the judges that judged Israel, nor in all the days of the kings of Israel, nor of the kings of Judah;

verses.original: כִּ֗י אִם בִּ/שְׁמֹנֶ֤ה עֶשְׂרֵה֙ שָׁנָ֔ה לַ/מֶּ֖לֶךְ יֹֽאשִׁיָּ֑הוּ נַעֲשָׂ֞ה הַ/פֶּ֧סַח הַ/זֶּ֛ה לַ/יהוָ֖ה בִּ/ירוּשָׁלִָֽם
verses.translit: khy 'm bshmnh 'shrh shnh lmlkh y'shyhv n'shh hpsch hzh lyhvh byrvshlm
verses.translation: But in the eighteenth year of king Josiah, wherein this passover was holden to the LORD in Jerusalem.

verses.original: וְ/גַ֣ם אֶת הָ/אֹב֣וֹת וְ/אֶת הַ֠/יִּדְּעֹנִים וְ/אֶת הַ/תְּרָפִ֨ים וְ/אֶת הַ/גִּלֻּלִ֜ים וְ/אֵ֣ת כָּל הַ/שִּׁקֻּצִ֗ים אֲשֶׁ֤ר נִרְאוּ֙ בְּ/אֶ֤רֶץ יְהוּדָה֙ וּ/בִ/יר֣וּשָׁלִַ֔ם בִּעֵ֖ר יֹֽאשִׁיָּ֑הוּ לְ֠מַעַן הָקִ֞ים אֶת דִּבְרֵ֤י הַ/תּוֹרָה֙ הַ/כְּתֻבִ֣ים עַל הַ/סֵּ֔פֶר אֲשֶׁ֥ר מָצָ֛א חִלְקִיָּ֥הוּ הַ/כֹּהֵ֖ן בֵּ֥ית יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: vgm 't h'bvt v't hyd'nym v't htrpym v't hgllym v't khl hshqtsym 'shr nr'v b'rts yhvdh vbyrvshlm b'r y'shyhv lm'n hqym 't dbry htvrh hkhtbym 'l hspr 'shr mts' chlqyhv hkhhn byt yhvh
verses.translation: Moreover the workers with familiar spirits, and the wizards, and the images, and the idols, and all the abominations that were spied in the land of Judah and in Jerusalem, did Josiah put away, that he might perform the words of the law which were written in the book that Hilkiah the priest found in the house of the LORD .

verses.original: וְ/כָמֹ/הוּ֩ לֹֽא הָיָ֨ה לְ/פָנָ֜י/ו מֶ֗לֶךְ אֲשֶׁר שָׁ֤ב אֶל יְהוָה֙ בְּ/כָל לְבָב֤/וֹ וּ/בְ/כָל נַפְשׁ/וֹ֙ וּ/בְ/כָל מְאֹד֔/וֹ כְּ/כֹ֖ל תּוֹרַ֣ת מֹשֶׁ֑ה וְ/אַחֲרָ֖י/ו לֹֽא קָ֥ם כָּמֹֽ/הוּ
verses.translit: vkhmhv l' hyh lpnyv mlkh 'shr shb 'l yhvh bkhl lbbv vbkhl npshv vbkhl m'dv khkhl tvrt mshh v'chryv l' qm khmhv
verses.translation: And like unto him was there no king before him, that turned to the LORD with all his heart, and with all his soul, and with all his might, according to all the law of Moses; neither after him arose there any like him.

verses.original: אַ֣ךְ לֹֽא שָׁ֣ב יְהוָ֗ה מֵ/חֲר֤וֹן אַפּ/וֹ֙ הַ/גָּד֔וֹל אֲשֶׁר חָרָ֥ה אַפּ֖/וֹ בִּֽ/יהוּדָ֑ה עַ֚ל כָּל הַ/כְּעָסִ֔ים אֲשֶׁ֥ר הִכְעִיס֖/וֹ מְנַשֶּֽׁה
verses.translit: 'kh l' shb yhvh mchrvn 'pv hgdvl 'shr chrh 'pv byhvdh 'l khl hkh'sym 'shr hkh'ysv mnshh
verses.translation: Notwithstanding the LORD turned not from the fierceness of his great wrath, wherewith his anger was kindled against Judah, because of all the provocations that Manasseh had provoked him withal.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֣אמֶר יְהוָ֗ה גַּ֤ם אֶת יְהוּדָה֙ אָסִיר֙ מֵ/עַ֣ל פָּנַ֔/י כַּ/אֲשֶׁ֥ר הֲסִרֹ֖תִי אֶת יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וּ֠/מָאַסְתִּי אֶת הָ/עִ֨יר הַ/זֹּ֤את אֲשֶׁר בָּחַ֨רְתִּי֙ אֶת יְר֣וּשָׁלִַ֔ם וְ/אֶת הַ/בַּ֔יִת אֲשֶׁ֣ר אָמַ֔רְתִּי יִהְיֶ֥ה שְׁמִ֖/י שָֽׁם
verses.translit: vy'mr yhvh gm 't yhvdh 'syr m'l pny kh'shr hsrty 't yshr'l vm'sty 't h'yr hz't 'shr bchrty 't yrvshlm v't hbyt 'shr 'mrty yhyh shmy shm
verses.translation: And the LORD said, I will remove Judah also out of my sight, as I have removed Israel, and will cast off this city Jerusalem which I have chosen, and the house of which I said, My name shall be there.

verses.original: וְ/יֶ֛תֶר דִּבְרֵ֥י יֹאשִׁיָּ֖הוּ וְ/כָל אֲשֶׁ֣ר עָשָׂ֑ה הֲ/לֹא הֵ֣ם כְּתוּבִ֗ים עַל סֵ֛פֶר דִּבְרֵ֥י הַ/יָּמִ֖ים לְ/מַלְכֵ֥י יְהוּדָֽה
verses.translit: vytr dbry y'shyhv vkhl 'shr 'shh hl' hm khtvbym 'l spr dbry hymym lmlkhy yhvdh
verses.translation: Now the rest of the acts of Josiah, and all that he did, are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah?

verses.original: בְּ/יָמָ֡י/ו עָלָה֩ פַרְעֹ֨ה נְכֹ֧ה מֶֽלֶךְ מִצְרַ֛יִם עַל מֶ֥לֶךְ אַשּׁ֖וּר עַל נְהַר פְּרָ֑ת וַ/יֵּ֨לֶךְ הַ/מֶּ֤לֶךְ יֹאשִׁיָּ֨הוּ֙ לִ/קְרָאת֔/וֹ וַ/יְמִיתֵ֨/הוּ֙ בִּ/מְגִדּ֔וֹ כִּ/רְאֹת֖/וֹ אֹתֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: bymyv 'lh pr'h nkhh mlkh mtsrym 'l mlkh 'shvr 'l nhr prt vylkh hmlkh y'shyhv lqr'tv vymythv bmgdv khr'tv 'tv
verses.translation: In his days Pharaoh-nechoh king of Egypt went up against the king of Assyria to the river Euphrates: and king Josiah went against him; and he slew him at Megiddo, when he had seen him.

verses.original: וַ/יַּרְכִּבֻ֨/הוּ עֲבָדָ֥י/ו מֵת֙ מִ/מְּגִדּ֔וֹ וַ/יְבִאֻ֨/הוּ֙ יְר֣וּשָׁלִַ֔ם וַֽ/יִּקְבְּרֻ֖/הוּ בִּ/קְבֻֽרָת֑/וֹ וַ/יִּקַּ֣ח עַם הָ/אָ֗רֶץ אֶת יְהֽוֹאָחָז֙ בֶּן יֹ֣אשִׁיָּ֔הוּ וַ/יִּמְשְׁח֥וּ אֹת֛/וֹ וַ/יַּמְלִ֥יכוּ אֹת֖/וֹ תַּ֥חַת אָבִֽי/ו
verses.translit: vyrkhbhv 'bdyv mt mmgdv vyb'hv yrvshlm vyqbrhv bqbrtv vyqch 'm h'rts 't yhv'chz bn y'shyhv vymshchv 'tv vymlykhv 'tv tcht 'byv
verses.translation: And his servants carried him in a chariot dead from Megiddo, and brought him to Jerusalem, and buried him in his own sepulchre. And the people of the land took Jehoahaz the son of Josiah, and anointed him, and made him king in his father’s stead.

verses.original: בֶּן עֶשְׂרִ֨ים וְ/שָׁלֹ֤שׁ שָׁנָה֙ יְהוֹאָחָ֣ז בְּ/מָלְכ֔/וֹ וּ/שְׁלֹשָׁ֣ה חֳדָשִׁ֔ים מָלַ֖ךְ בִּ/ירוּשָׁלִָ֑ם וְ/שֵׁ֣ם אִמּ֔/וֹ חֲמוּטַ֥ל בַּֽת יִרְמְיָ֖הוּ מִ/לִּבְנָֽה
verses.translit: bn 'shrym vshlsh shnh yhv'chz bmlkhv vshlshh chdshym mlkh byrvshlm vshm 'mv chmvtl bt yrmyhv mlbnh
verses.translation: Jehoahaz was twenty and three years old when he began to reign; and he reigned three months in Jerusalem. And his mother’s name was Hamutal, the daughter of Jeremiah of Libnah.

verses.original: וַ/יַּ֥עַשׂ הָ/רַ֖ע בְּ/עֵינֵ֣י יְהוָ֑ה כְּ/כֹ֥ל אֲשֶׁר עָשׂ֖וּ אֲבֹתָֽי/ו
verses.translit: vy'sh hr' b'yny yhvh khkhl 'shr 'shv 'btyv
verses.translation: And he did that which was evil in the sight of the LORD , according to all that his fathers had done.

verses.original: וַ/יַּאַסְרֵ/הוּ֩ פַרְעֹ֨ה נְכֹ֤ה בְ/רִבְלָה֙ בְּ/אֶ֣רֶץ חֲמָ֔ת ב/מלך מִ/מְּלֹ֖ךְ בִּ/ירוּשָׁלִָ֑ם וַ/יִּתֶּן עֹ֨נֶשׁ֙ עַל הָ/אָ֔רֶץ מֵאָ֥ה כִכַּר כֶּ֖סֶף וְ/כִכַּ֥ר זָהָֽב
verses.translit: vy'srhv pr'h nkhh brblh b'rts chmt bmlkh mmlkh byrvshlm vytn 'nsh 'l h'rts m'h khkhr khsf vkhkhr zhb
verses.translation: And Pharaoh-nechoh put him in bands at Riblah in the land of Hamath, that he might not reign in Jerusalem; and put the land to a tribute of an hundred talents of silver, and a talent of gold.

verses.original: וַ/יַּמְלֵךְ֩ פַּרְעֹ֨ה נְכֹ֜ה אֶת אֶלְיָקִ֣ים בֶּן יֹאשִׁיָּ֗הוּ תַּ֚חַת יֹאשִׁיָּ֣הוּ אָבִ֔י/ו וַ/יַּסֵּ֥ב אֶת שְׁמ֖/וֹ יְהוֹיָקִ֑ים וְ/אֶת יְהוֹאָחָ֣ז לָקָ֔ח וַ/יָּבֹ֥א מִצְרַ֖יִם וַ/יָּ֥מָת שָֽׁם
verses.translit: vymlkh pr'h nkhh 't 'lyqym bn y'shyhv tcht y'shyhv 'byv vysb 't shmv yhvyqym v't yhv'chz lqch vyb' mtsrym vymt shm
verses.translation: And Pharaoh-nechoh made Eliakim the son of Josiah king in the room of Josiah his father, and turned his name to Jehoiakim, and took Jehoahaz away: and he came to Egypt, and died there.

verses.original: וְ/הַ/כֶּ֣סֶף וְ/הַ/זָּהָ֗ב נָתַ֤ן יְהוֹיָקִים֙ לְ/פַרְעֹ֔ה אַ֚ךְ הֶעֱרִ֣יךְ אֶת הָ/אָ֔רֶץ לָ/תֵ֥ת אֶת הַ/כֶּ֖סֶף עַל פִּ֣י פַרְעֹ֑ה אִ֣ישׁ כְּ/עֶרְכּ֗/וֹ נָגַ֞שׂ אֶת הַ/כֶּ֤סֶף וְ/אֶת הַ/זָּהָב֙ אֶת עַ֣ם הָ/אָ֔רֶץ לָ/תֵ֖ת לְ/פַרְעֹ֥ה נְכֹֽה
verses.translit: vhkhsf vhzhb ntn yhvyqym lpr'h 'kh h'rykh 't h'rts ltt 't hkhsf 'l py pr'h 'ysh kh'rkhv ngsh 't hkhsf v't hzhb 't 'm h'rts ltt lpr'h nkhh
verses.translation: And Jehoiakim gave the silver and the gold to Pharaoh; but he taxed the land to give the money according to the commandment of Pharaoh: he exacted the silver and the gold of the people of the land, of every one according to his taxation, to give it unto Pharaoh-nechoh.

verses.original: בֶּן עֶשְׂרִ֨ים וְ/חָמֵ֤שׁ שָׁנָ֨ה יְהוֹיָקִ֣ים בְּ/מָלְכ֔/וֹ וְ/אַחַ֤ת עֶשְׂרֵה֙ שָׁנָ֔ה מָלַ֖ךְ בִּ/ירוּשָׁלִָ֑ם וְ/שֵׁ֣ם אִמּ֔/וֹ זבידה זְבוּדָּ֥ה בַת פְּדָיָ֖ה מִן רוּמָֽה
verses.translit: bn 'shrym vchmsh shnh yhvyqym bmlkhv v'cht 'shrh shnh mlkh byrvshlm vshm 'mv zbydh zbvdh bt pdyh mn rvmh
verses.translation: Jehoiakim was twenty and five years old when he began to reign; and he reigned eleven years in Jerusalem. And his mother’s name was Zebudah, the daughter of Pedaiah of Rumah.

verses.original: וַ/יַּ֥עַשׂ הָ/רַ֖ע בְּ/עֵינֵ֣י יְהוָ֑ה כְּ/כֹ֥ל אֲשֶׁר עָשׂ֖וּ אֲבֹתָֽי/ו
verses.translit: vy'sh hr' b'yny yhvh khkhl 'shr 'shv 'btyv
verses.translation: And he did that which was evil in the sight of the LORD , according to all that his fathers had done.

verses.original: בְּ/יָמָ֣י/ו עָלָ֔ה נְבֻכַדְנֶאצַּ֖ר מֶ֣לֶךְ בָּבֶ֑ל וַ/יְהִי ל֨/וֹ יְהוֹיָקִ֥ים עֶ֨בֶד֙ שָׁלֹ֣שׁ שָׁנִ֔ים וַ/יָּ֖שָׁב וַ/יִּמְרָד בּֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: bymyv 'lh nbkhdn'tsr mlkh bbl vyhy lv yhvyqym 'bd shlsh shnym vyshb vymrd bv
verses.translation: In his days Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon came up, and Jehoiakim became his servant three years: then he turned and rebelled against him.

verses.original: וַ/יְשַׁלַּ֣ח יְהוָ֣ה בּ֡/וֹ אֶת גְּדוּדֵ֣י כַשְׂדִּים֩ וְ/אֶת גְּדוּדֵ֨י אֲרָ֜ם וְ/אֵ֣ת גְּדוּדֵ֣י מוֹאָ֗ב וְ/אֵת֙ גְּדוּדֵ֣י בְנֵֽי עַמּ֔וֹן וַ/יְשַׁלְּחֵ֥/ם בִּֽ/יהוּדָ֖ה לְ/הַֽאֲבִיד֑/וֹ כִּ/דְבַ֣ר יְהוָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֣ר דִּבֶּ֔ר בְּ/יַ֖ד עֲבָדָ֥י/ו הַ/נְּבִיאִֽים
verses.translit: vyshlch yhvh bv 't gdvdy khshdym v't gdvdy 'rm v't gdvdy mv'b v't gdvdy bny 'mvn vyshlchm byhvdh lh'bydv khdbr yhvh 'shr dbr byd 'bdyv hnby'ym
verses.translation: And the LORD sent against him bands of the Chaldees, and bands of the Syrians, and bands of the Moabites, and bands of the children of Ammon, and sent them against Judah to destroy it, according to the word of the LORD , which he spake by his servants the prophets.

verses.original: אַ֣ךְ עַל פִּ֣י יְהוָ֗ה הָֽיְתָה֙ בִּֽ/יהוּדָ֔ה לְ/הָסִ֖יר מֵ/עַ֣ל פָּנָ֑י/ו בְּ/חַטֹּ֣את מְנַשֶּׁ֔ה כְּ/כֹ֖ל אֲשֶׁ֥ר עָשָֽׂה
verses.translit: 'kh 'l py yhvh hyth byhvdh lhsyr m'l pnyv bcht't mnshh khkhl 'shr 'shh
verses.translation: Surely at the commandment of the LORD came this upon Judah, to remove them out of his sight, for the sins of Manasseh, according to all that he did;

verses.original: וְ/גַ֤ם דַּֽם הַ/נָּקִי֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר שָׁפָ֔ךְ וַ/יְמַלֵּ֥א אֶת יְרוּשָׁלִַ֖ם דָּ֣ם נָקִ֑י וְ/לֹֽא אָבָ֥ה יְהוָ֖ה לִ/סְלֹֽחַ
verses.translit: vgm dm hnqy 'shr shpkh vyml' 't yrvshlm dm nqy vl' 'bh yhvh lslch
verses.translation: And also for the innocent blood that he shed: for he filled Jerusalem with innocent blood; which the LORD would not pardon.

verses.original: וְ/יֶ֛תֶר דִּבְרֵ֥י יְהוֹיָקִ֖ים וְ/כָל אֲשֶׁ֣ר עָשָׂ֑ה הֲ/לֹא הֵ֣ם כְּתוּבִ֗ים עַל סֵ֛פֶר דִּבְרֵ֥י הַ/יָּמִ֖ים לְ/מַלְכֵ֥י יְהוּדָֽה
verses.translit: vytr dbry yhvyqym vkhl 'shr 'shh hl' hm khtvbym 'l spr dbry hymym lmlkhy yhvdh
verses.translation: Now the rest of the acts of Jehoiakim, and all that he did, are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah?

verses.original: וַ/יִּשְׁכַּ֥ב יְהוֹיָקִ֖ים עִם אֲבֹתָ֑י/ו וַ/יִּמְלֹ֛ךְ יְהוֹיָכִ֥ין בְּנ֖/וֹ תַּחְתָּֽי/ו
verses.translit: vyshkhb yhvyqym 'm 'btyv vymlkh yhvykhyn bnv tchtyv
verses.translation: So Jehoiakim slept with his fathers: and Jehoiachin his son reigned in his stead.

verses.original: וְ/לֹֽא הֹסִ֥יף עוֹד֙ מֶ֣לֶךְ מִצְרַ֔יִם לָ/צֵ֖את מֵֽ/אַרְצ֑/וֹ כִּֽי לָקַ֞ח מֶ֣לֶךְ בָּבֶ֗ל מִ/נַּ֤חַל מִצְרַ֨יִם֙ עַד נְהַר פְּרָ֔ת כֹּ֛ל אֲשֶׁ֥ר הָיְתָ֖ה לְ/מֶ֥לֶךְ מִצְרָֽיִם
verses.translit: vl' hsyf 'vd mlkh mtsrym lts't m'rtsv khy lqch mlkh bbl mnchl mtsrym 'd nhr prt khl 'shr hyth lmlkh mtsrym
verses.translation: And the king of Egypt came not again any more out of his land: for the king of Babylon had taken from the river of Egypt unto the river Euphrates all that pertained to the king of Egypt.

verses.original: בֶּן שְׁמֹנֶ֨ה עֶשְׂרֵ֤ה שָׁנָה֙ יְהוֹיָכִ֣ין בְּ/מָלְכ֔/וֹ וּ/שְׁלֹשָׁ֣ה חֳדָשִׁ֔ים מָלַ֖ךְ בִּ/ירוּשָׁלִָ֑ם וְ/שֵׁ֣ם אִמּ֔/וֹ נְחֻשְׁתָּ֥א בַת אֶלְנָתָ֖ן מִ/ירוּשָׁלִָֽם
verses.translit: bn shmnh 'shrh shnh yhvykhyn bmlkhv vshlshh chdshym mlkh byrvshlm vshm 'mv nchsht' bt 'lntn myrvshlm
verses.translation: Jehoiachin was eighteen years old when he began to reign, and he reigned in Jerusalem three months. And his mother’s name was Nehushta, the daughter of Elnathan of Jerusalem.

verses.original: וַ/יַּ֥עַשׂ הָ/רַ֖ע בְּ/עֵינֵ֣י יְהוָ֑ה כְּ/כֹ֥ל אֲשֶׁר עָשָׂ֖ה אָבִֽי/ו
verses.translit: vy'sh hr' b'yny yhvh khkhl 'shr 'shh 'byv
verses.translation: And he did that which was evil in the sight of the LORD , according to all that his father had done.

verses.original: בָּ/עֵ֣ת הַ/הִ֔יא עלה עָל֗וּ עַבְדֵ֛י נְבֻכַדְנֶאצַּ֥ר מֶֽלֶךְ בָּבֶ֖ל יְרוּשָׁלִָ֑ם וַ/תָּבֹ֥א הָ/עִ֖יר בַּ/מָּצֽוֹר
verses.translit: b't hhy' 'lh 'lv 'bdy nbkhdn'tsr mlkh bbl yrvshlm vtb' h'yr bmtsvr
verses.translation: At that time the servants of Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon came up against Jerusalem, and the city was besieged.

verses.original: וַ/יָּבֹ֛א נְבוּכַדְנֶאצַּ֥ר מֶֽלֶךְ בָּבֶ֖ל עַל הָ/עִ֑יר וַ/עֲבָדָ֖י/ו צָרִ֥ים עָלֶֽי/הָ
verses.translit: vyb' nbvkhdn'tsr mlkh bbl 'l h'yr v'bdyv tsrym 'lyh
verses.translation: And Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon came against the city, and his servants did besiege it.

verses.original: וַ/יֵּצֵ֞א יְהוֹיָכִ֤ין מֶֽלֶךְ יְהוּדָה֙ עַל מֶ֣לֶךְ בָּבֶ֔ל ה֣וּא וְ/אִמּ֔/וֹ וַ/עֲבָדָ֖י/ו וְ/שָׂרָ֣י/ו וְ/סָֽרִיסָ֑י/ו וַ/יִּקַּ֤ח אֹת/וֹ֙ מֶ֣לֶךְ בָּבֶ֔ל בִּ/שְׁנַ֥ת שְׁמֹנֶ֖ה לְ/מָלְכֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: vyts' yhvykhyn mlkh yhvdh 'l mlkh bbl hv' v'mv v'bdyv vshryv vsrysyv vyqch 'tv mlkh bbl bshnt shmnh lmlkhv
verses.translation: And Jehoiachin the king of Judah went out to the king of Babylon, he, and his mother, and his servants, and his princes, and his officers: and the king of Babylon took him in the eighth year of his reign.

verses.original: וַ/יּוֹצֵ֣א מִ/שָּׁ֗ם אֶת כָּל אוֹצְרוֹת֙ בֵּ֣ית יְהוָ֔ה וְ/אֽוֹצְר֖וֹת בֵּ֣ית הַ/מֶּ֑לֶךְ וַ/יְקַצֵּ֞ץ אֶת כָּל כְּלֵ֣י הַ/זָּהָ֗ב אֲשֶׁ֨ר עָשָׂ֜ה שְׁלֹמֹ֤ה מֶֽלֶךְ יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ בְּ/הֵיכַ֣ל יְהוָ֔ה כַּֽ/אֲשֶׁ֖ר דִּבֶּ֥ר יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: vyvts' mshm 't khl 'vtsrvt byt yhvh v'vtsrvt byt hmlkh vyqtsts 't khl khly hzhb 'shr 'shh shlmh mlkh yshr'l bhykhl yhvh kh'shr dbr yhvh
verses.translation: And he carried out thence all the treasures of the house of the LORD , and the treasures of the king’s house, and cut in pieces all the vessels of gold which Solomon king of Israel had made in the temple of the LORD , as the LORD had said.

verses.original: וְ/הִגְלָ֣ה אֶת כָּל יְ֠רוּשָׁלִַם וְֽ/אֶת כָּל הַ/שָּׂרִ֞ים וְ/אֵ֣ת כָּל גִּבּוֹרֵ֣י הַ/חַ֗יִל עשרה עֲשֶׂ֤רֶת אֲלָפִים֙ גּוֹלֶ֔ה וְ/כָל הֶ/חָרָ֖שׁ וְ/הַ/מַּסְגֵּ֑ר לֹ֣א נִשְׁאַ֔ר זוּלַ֖ת דַּלַּ֥ת עַם הָ/אָֽרֶץ
verses.translit: vhglh 't khl yrvshlm v't khl hshrym v't khl gbvry hchyl 'shrh 'shrt 'lpym gvlh vkhl hchrsh vhmsgr l' nsh'r zvlt dlt 'm h'rts
verses.translation: And he carried away all Jerusalem, and all the princes, and all the mighty men of valour, even ten thousand captives, and all the craftsmen and smiths: none remained, save the poorest sort of the people of the land.

verses.original: וַ/יֶּ֥גֶל אֶת יְהוֹיָכִ֖ין בָּבֶ֑לָ/ה וְ/אֶת אֵ֣ם הַ֠/מֶּלֶךְ וְ/אֶת נְשֵׁ֨י הַ/מֶּ֜לֶךְ וְ/אֶת סָרִיסָ֗י/ו וְ/אֵת֙ אולי אֵילֵ֣י הָ/אָ֔רֶץ הוֹלִ֛יךְ גּוֹלָ֥ה מִ/ירוּשָׁלִַ֖ם בָּבֶֽלָ/ה
verses.translit: vygl 't yhvykhyn bblh v't 'm hmlkh v't nshy hmlkh v't srysyv v't 'vly 'yly h'rts hvlykh gvlh myrvshlm bblh
verses.translation: And he carried away Jehoiachin to Babylon, and the king’s mother, and the king’s wives, and his officers, and the mighty of the land, those carried he into captivity from Jerusalem to Babylon.

verses.original: וְ/אֵת֩ כָּל אַנְשֵׁ֨י הַ/חַ֜יִל שִׁבְעַ֣ת אֲלָפִ֗ים וְ/הֶ/חָרָ֤שׁ וְ/הַ/מַּסְגֵּר֙ אֶ֔לֶף הַ/כֹּ֕ל גִּבּוֹרִ֖ים עֹשֵׂ֣י מִלְחָמָ֑ה וַ/יְבִיאֵ֧/ם מֶֽלֶךְ בָּבֶ֛ל גּוֹלָ֖ה בָּבֶֽלָ/ה
verses.translit: v't khl 'nshy hchyl shb't 'lpym vhchrsh vhmsgr 'lf hkhl gbvrym 'shy mlchmh vyby'm mlkh bbl gvlh bblh
verses.translation: And all the men of might, even seven thousand, and craftsmen and smiths a thousand, all that were strong and apt for war, even them the king of Babylon brought captive to Babylon.

verses.original: וַ/יַּמְלֵ֧ךְ מֶֽלֶךְ בָּבֶ֛ל אֶת מַתַּנְיָ֥ה דֹד֖/וֹ תַּחְתָּ֑י/ו וַ/יַּסֵּ֥ב אֶת שְׁמ֖/וֹ צִדְקִיָּֽהוּ
verses.translit: vymlkh mlkh bbl 't mtnyh ddv tchtyv vysb 't shmv tsdqyhv
verses.translation: And the king of Babylon made Mattaniah his father’s brother king in his stead, and changed his name to Zedekiah.

verses.original: בֶּן עֶשְׂרִ֨ים וְ/אַחַ֤ת שָׁנָה֙ צִדְקִיָּ֣הוּ בְ/מָלְכ֔/וֹ וְ/אַחַ֤ת עֶשְׂרֵה֙ שָׁנָ֔ה מָלַ֖ךְ בִּ/ירוּשָׁלִָ֑ם וְ/שֵׁ֣ם אִמּ֔/וֹ חמיטל חֲמוּטַ֥ל בַּֽת יִרְמְיָ֖הוּ מִ/לִּבְנָֽה
verses.translit: bn 'shrym v'cht shnh tsdqyhv bmlkhv v'cht 'shrh shnh mlkh byrvshlm vshm 'mv chmytl chmvtl bt yrmyhv mlbnh
verses.translation: Zedekiah was twenty and one years old when he began to reign, and he reigned eleven years in Jerusalem. And his mother’s name was Hamutal, the daughter of Jeremiah of Libnah.

verses.original: וַ/יַּ֥עַשׂ הָ/רַ֖ע בְּ/עֵינֵ֣י יְהוָ֑ה כְּ/כֹ֥ל אֲשֶׁר עָשָׂ֖ה יְהוֹיָקִֽים
verses.translit: vy'sh hr' b'yny yhvh khkhl 'shr 'shh yhvyqym
verses.translation: And he did that which was evil in the sight of the LORD , according to all that Jehoiakim had done.

verses.original: כִּ֣י עַל אַ֣ף יְהוָ֗ה הָיְתָ֤ה בִ/ירוּשָׁלִַ֨ם֙ וּ/בִ֣/יהוּדָ֔ה עַד הִשְׁלִכ֥/וֹ אֹתָ֖/ם מֵ/עַ֣ל פָּנָ֑י/ו וַ/יִּמְרֹ֥ד צִדְקִיָּ֖הוּ בְּ/מֶ֥לֶךְ בָּבֶֽל
verses.translit: khy 'l 'f yhvh hyth byrvshlm vbyhvdh 'd hshlkhv 'tm m'l pnyv vymrd tsdqyhv bmlkh bbl
verses.translation: For through the anger of the LORD it came to pass in Jerusalem and Judah, until he had cast them out from his presence, that Zedekiah rebelled against the king of Babylon.

verses.original: וַ/יְהִי֩ בִ/שְׁנַ֨ת הַ/תְּשִׁיעִ֜ית לְ/מָלְכ֗/וֹ בַּ/חֹ֣דֶשׁ הָ/עֲשִׂירִי֮ בֶּ/עָשׂ֣וֹר לַ/חֹדֶשׁ֒ בָּ֠א נְבֻכַדְנֶאצַּ֨ר מֶֽלֶךְ בָּבֶ֜ל ה֧וּא וְ/כָל חֵיל֛/וֹ עַל יְרוּשָׁלִַ֖ם וַ/יִּ֣חַן עָלֶ֑י/הָ וַ/יִּבְנ֥וּ עָלֶ֖י/הָ דָּיֵ֥ק סָבִֽיב
verses.translit: vyhy bshnt htshy'yt lmlkhv bchdsh h'shyry b'shvr lchdsh b' nbkhdn'tsr mlkh bbl hv' vkhl chylv 'l yrvshlm vychn 'lyh vybnv 'lyh dyq sbyb
verses.translation: And it came to pass in the ninth year of his reign, in the tenth month, in the tenth day of the month, that Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon came, he, and all his host, against Jerusalem, and pitched against it; and they built forts against it round about.

verses.original: וַ/תָּבֹ֥א הָ/עִ֖יר בַּ/מָּצ֑וֹר עַ֚ד עַשְׁתֵּ֣י עֶשְׂרֵ֣ה שָׁנָ֔ה לַ/מֶּ֖לֶךְ צִדְקִיָּֽהוּ
verses.translit: vtb' h'yr bmtsvr 'd 'shty 'shrh shnh lmlkh tsdqyhv
verses.translation: And the city was besieged unto the eleventh year of king Zedekiah.

verses.original: בְּ/תִשְׁעָ֣ה לַ/חֹ֔דֶשׁ וַ/יֶּחֱזַ֥ק הָ/רָעָ֖ב בָּ/עִ֑יר וְ/לֹא הָ֥יָה לֶ֖חֶם לְ/עַ֥ם הָ/אָֽרֶץ
verses.translit: btsh'h lchdsh vychzq hr'b b'yr vl' hyh lchm l'm h'rts
verses.translation: And on the ninth day of the fourth month the famine prevailed in the city, and there was no bread for the people of the land.

verses.original: וַ/תִּבָּקַ֣ע הָ/עִ֗יר וְ/כָל אַנְשֵׁ֨י הַ/מִּלְחָמָ֤ה הַ/לַּ֨יְלָה֙ דֶּ֜רֶךְ שַׁ֣עַר בֵּ֣ין הַ/חֹמֹתַ֗יִם אֲשֶׁר֙ עַל גַּ֣ן הַ/מֶּ֔לֶךְ וְ/כַשְׂדִּ֥ים עַל הָ/עִ֖יר סָבִ֑יב וַ/יֵּ֖לֶךְ דֶּ֥רֶךְ הָ/עֲרָבָֽה
verses.translit: vtbq' h'yr vkhl 'nshy hmlchmh hlylh drkh sh'r byn hchmtym 'shr 'l gn hmlkh vkhshdym 'l h'yr sbyb vylkh drkh h'rbh
verses.translation: And the city was broken up, and all the men of war fled by night by the way of the gate between two walls, which is by the king’s garden: (now the Chaldees were against the city round about:) and the king went the way toward the plain.

verses.original: וַ/יִּרְדְּפ֤וּ חֵיל כַּשְׂדִּים֙ אַחַ֣ר הַ/מֶּ֔לֶךְ וַ/יַּשִּׂ֥גוּ אֹת֖/וֹ בְּ/עַרְב֣וֹת יְרֵח֑וֹ וְ/כָל חֵיל֔/וֹ נָפֹ֖צוּ מֵ/עָלָֽי/ו
verses.translit: vyrdpv chyl khshdym 'chr hmlkh vyshgv 'tv b'rbvt yrchv vkhl chylv nptsv m'lyv
verses.translation: And the army of the Chaldees pursued after the king, and overtook him in the plains of Jericho: and all his army were scattered from him.

verses.original: וַֽ/יִּתְפְּשׂוּ֙ אֶת הַ/מֶּ֔לֶךְ וַ/יַּעֲל֥וּ אֹת֛/וֹ אֶל מֶ֥לֶךְ בָּבֶ֖ל רִבְלָ֑תָ/ה וַ/יְדַבְּר֥וּ אִתּ֖/וֹ מִשְׁפָּֽט
verses.translit: vytpshv 't hmlkh vy'lv 'tv 'l mlkh bbl rblth vydbrv 'tv mshpt
verses.translation: So they took the king, and brought him up to the king of Babylon to Riblah; and they gave judgment upon him.

verses.original: וְ/אֶת בְּנֵי֙ צִדְקִיָּ֔הוּ שָׁחֲט֖וּ לְ/עֵינָ֑י/ו וְ/אֶת עֵינֵ֤י צִדְקִיָּ֨הוּ֙ עִוֵּ֔ר וַ/יַּאַסְרֵ֨/הוּ֙ בַֽ/נְחֻשְׁתַּ֔יִם וַ/יְבִאֵ֖/הוּ בָּבֶֽל
verses.translit: v't bny tsdqyhv shchtv l'ynyv v't 'yny tsdqyhv 'vr vy'srhv bnchshtym vyb'hv bbl
verses.translation: And they slew the sons of Zedekiah before his eyes, and put out the eyes of Zedekiah, and bound him with fetters of brass, and carried him to Babylon.

verses.original: וּ/בַ/חֹ֤דֶשׁ הַֽ/חֲמִישִׁי֙ בְּ/שִׁבְעָ֣ה לַ/חֹ֔דֶשׁ הִ֗יא שְׁנַת֙ תְּשַֽׁע עֶשְׂרֵ֣ה שָׁנָ֔ה לַ/מֶּ֖לֶךְ נְבֻכַדְנֶאצַּ֣ר מֶֽלֶךְ בָּבֶ֑ל בָּ֞א נְבוּזַרְאֲדָ֧ן רַב טַבָּחִ֛ים עֶ֥בֶד מֶֽלֶךְ בָּבֶ֖ל יְרוּשָׁלִָֽם
verses.translit: vbchdsh hchmyshy bshb'h lchdsh hy' shnt tsh' 'shrh shnh lmlkh nbkhdn'tsr mlkh bbl b' nbvzr'dn rb tbchym 'bd mlkh bbl yrvshlm
verses.translation: And in the fifth month, on the seventh day of the month, which is the nineteenth year of king Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon, came Nebuzar-adan, captain of the guard, a servant of the king of Babylon, unto Jerusalem:

verses.original: וַ/יִּשְׂרֹ֥ף אֶת בֵּית יְהוָ֖ה וְ/אֶת בֵּ֣ית הַ/מֶּ֑לֶךְ וְ/אֵ֨ת כָּל בָּתֵּ֧י יְרוּשָׁלִַ֛ם וְ/אֶת כָּל בֵּ֥ית גָּד֖וֹל שָׂרַ֥ף בָּ/אֵֽשׁ
verses.translit: vyshrf 't byt yhvh v't byt hmlkh v't khl bty yrvshlm v't khl byt gdvl shrf b'sh
verses.translation: And he burnt the house of the LORD , and the king’s house, and all the houses of Jerusalem, and every great man’s house burnt he with fire.

verses.original: וְ/אֶת חוֹמֹ֥ת יְרוּשָׁלִַ֖ם סָבִ֑יב נָֽתְצוּ֙ כָּל חֵ֣יל כַּשְׂדִּ֔ים אֲשֶׁ֖ר רַב טַבָּחִֽים
verses.translit: v't chvmt yrvshlm sbyb nttsv khl chyl khshdym 'shr rb tbchym
verses.translation: And all the army of the Chaldees, that were with the captain of the guard, brake down the walls of Jerusalem round about.

verses.original: וְ/אֵת֩ יֶ֨תֶר הָ/עָ֜ם הַ/נִּשְׁאָרִ֣ים בָּ/עִ֗יר וְ/אֶת הַ/נֹּֽפְלִים֙ אֲשֶׁ֤ר נָפְלוּ֙ עַל הַ/מֶּ֣לֶךְ בָּבֶ֔ל וְ/אֵ֖ת יֶ֣תֶר הֶ/הָמ֑וֹן הֶגְלָ֕ה נְבוּזַרְאֲדָ֖ן רַב טַבָּחִֽים
verses.translit: v't ytr h'm hnsh'rym b'yr v't hnplym 'shr nplv 'l hmlkh bbl v't ytr hhmvn hglh nbvzr'dn rb tbchym
verses.translation: Now the rest of the people that were left in the city, and the fugitives that fell away to the king of Babylon, with the remnant of the multitude, did Nebuzar-adan the captain of the guard carry away.

verses.original: וּ/מִ/דַּלַּ֣ת הָ/אָ֔רֶץ הִשְׁאִ֖יר רַב טַבָּחִ֑ים לְ/כֹֽרְמִ֖ים וּ/לְ/יֹגְבִֽים
verses.translit: vmdlt h'rts hsh'yr rb tbchym lkhrmym vlygbym
verses.translation: But the captain of the guard left of the poor of the land to be vinedressers and husbandmen.

verses.original: וְ/אֶת עַמּוּדֵ֨י הַ/נְּחֹ֜שֶׁת אֲשֶׁ֣ר בֵּית יְהוָ֗ה וְֽ/אֶת הַ/מְּכֹנ֞וֹת וְ/אֶת יָ֧ם הַ/נְּחֹ֛שֶׁת אֲשֶׁ֥ר בְּ/בֵית יְהוָ֖ה שִׁבְּר֣וּ כַשְׂדִּ֑ים וַ/יִּשְׂא֥וּ אֶת נְחֻשְׁתָּ֖/ם בָּבֶֽלָ/ה
verses.translit: v't 'mvdy hnchsht 'shr byt yhvh v't hmkhnvt v't ym hnchsht 'shr bbyt yhvh shbrv khshdym vysh'v 't nchshtm bblh
verses.translation: And the pillars of brass that were in the house of the LORD , and the bases, and the brasen sea that was in the house of the LORD , did the Chaldees break in pieces, and carried the brass of them to Babylon.

verses.original: וְ/אֶת הַ/סִּירֹ֨ת וְ/אֶת הַ/יָּעִ֜ים וְ/אֶת הַֽ/מְזַמְּר֣וֹת וְ/אֶת הַ/כַּפּ֗וֹת וְ/אֵ֨ת כָּל כְּלֵ֧י הַ/נְּחֹ֛שֶׁת אֲשֶׁ֥ר יְשָֽׁרְתוּ בָ֖/ם לָקָֽחוּ
verses.translit: v't hsyrt v't hy'ym v't hmzmrvt v't hkhpvt v't khl khly hnchsht 'shr yshrtv bm lqchv
verses.translation: And the pots, and the shovels, and the snuffers, and the spoons, and all the vessels of brass wherewith they ministered, took they away.

verses.original: וְ/אֶת הַ/מַּחְתּוֹת֙ וְ/אֶת הַ/מִּזְרָק֗וֹת אֲשֶׁ֤ר זָהָב֙ זָהָ֔ב וַ/אֲשֶׁר כֶּ֖סֶף כָּ֑סֶף לָקַ֖ח רַב טַבָּחִֽים
verses.translit: v't hmchtvt v't hmzrqvt 'shr zhb zhb v'shr khsf khsf lqch rb tbchym
verses.translation: And the firepans, and the bowls, and such things as were of gold, in gold, and of silver, in silver, the captain of the guard took away.

verses.original: הָ/עַמּוּדִ֣ים שְׁנַ֗יִם הַ/יָּ֤ם הָֽ/אֶחָד֙ וְ/הַ/מְּכֹנ֔וֹת אֲשֶׁר עָשָׂ֥ה שְׁלֹמֹ֖ה לְ/בֵ֣ית יְהוָ֑ה לֹא הָיָ֣ה מִשְׁקָ֔ל לִ/נְחֹ֖שֶׁת כָּל הַ/כֵּלִ֥ים הָ/אֵֽלֶּה
verses.translit: h'mvdym shnym hym h'chd vhmkhnvt 'shr 'shh shlmh lbyt yhvh l' hyh mshql lnchsht khl hkhlym h'lh
verses.translation: The two pillars, one sea, and the bases which Solomon had made for the house of the LORD ; the brass of all these vessels was without weight.

verses.original: שְׁמֹנֶה֩ עֶשְׂרֵ֨ה אַמָּ֜ה קוֹמַ֣ת הָ/עַמּ֣וּד הָ/אֶחָ֗ד וְ/כֹתֶ֨רֶת עָלָ֥י/ו נְחֹשֶׁת֮ וְ/קוֹמַ֣ת הַ/כֹּתֶרֶת֮ שָׁלֹ֣שׁ אמה אַמּוֹת֒ וּ/שְׂבָכָ֨ה וְ/רִמֹּנִ֧ים עַֽל הַ/כֹּתֶ֛רֶת סָבִ֖יב הַ/כֹּ֣ל נְחֹ֑שֶׁת וְ/כָ/אֵ֛לֶּה לַֽ/עַמּ֥וּד הַ/שֵּׁנִ֖י עַל הַ/שְּׂבָכָֽה
verses.translit: shmnh 'shrh 'mh qvmt h'mvd h'chd vkhtrt 'lyv nchsht vqvmt hkhtrt shlsh 'mh 'mvt vshbkhh vrmnym 'l hkhtrt sbyb hkhl nchsht vkh'lh l'mvd hshny 'l hshbkhh
verses.translation: The height of the one pillar was eighteen cubits, and the chapiter upon it was brass: and the height of the chapiter three cubits; and the wreathen work, and pomegranates upon the chapiter round about, all of brass: and like unto these had the second pillar with wreathen work.

verses.original: וַ/יִּקַּ֣ח רַב טַבָּחִ֗ים אֶת שְׂרָיָה֙ כֹּהֵ֣ן הָ/רֹ֔אשׁ וְ/אֶת צְפַנְיָ֖הוּ כֹּהֵ֣ן מִשְׁנֶ֑ה וְ/אֶת שְׁלֹ֖שֶׁת שֹׁמְרֵ֥י הַ/סַּֽף
verses.translit: vyqch rb tbchym 't shryh khhn hr'sh v't tspnyhv khhn mshnh v't shlsht shmry hsf
verses.translation: And the captain of the guard took Seraiah the chief priest, and Zephaniah the second priest, and the three keepers of the door:

verses.original: וּ/מִן הָ/עִ֡יר לָקַח֩ סָרִ֨יס אֶחָ֜ד אֲֽשֶׁר ה֥וּא פָקִ֣יד עַל אַנְשֵׁ֣י הַ/מִּלְחָמָ֗ה וַ/חֲמִשָּׁ֨ה אֲנָשִׁ֜ים מֵ/רֹאֵ֤י פְנֵֽי הַ/מֶּ֨לֶךְ֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר נִמְצְא֣וּ בָ/עִ֔יר וְ/אֵ֗ת הַ/סֹּפֵר֙ שַׂ֣ר הַ/צָּבָ֔א הַ/מַּצְבִּ֖א אֶת עַ֣ם הָ/אָ֑רֶץ וְ/שִׁשִּׁ֥ים אִישׁ֙ מֵ/עַ֣ם הָ/אָ֔רֶץ הַֽ/נִּמְצְאִ֖ים בָּ/עִֽיר
verses.translit: vmn h'yr lqch srys 'chd 'shr hv' pqyd 'l 'nshy hmlchmh vchmshh 'nshym mr'y pny hmlkh 'shr nmts'v b'yr v't hspr shr htsb' hmtsb' 't 'm h'rts vshshym 'ysh m'm h'rts hnmts'ym b'yr
verses.translation: And out of the city he took an officer that was set over the men of war, and five men of them that were in the king’s presence, which were found in the city, and the principal scribe of the host, which mustered the people of the land, and threescore men of the people of the land that were found in the city:

verses.original: וַ/יִּקַּ֣ח אֹתָ֔/ם נְבוּזַרְאֲדָ֖ן רַב טַבָּחִ֑ים וַ/יֹּ֧לֶךְ אֹתָ֛/ם עַל מֶ֥לֶךְ בָּבֶ֖ל רִבְלָֽתָ/ה
verses.translit: vyqch 'tm nbvzr'dn rb tbchym vylkh 'tm 'l mlkh bbl rblth
verses.translation: And Nebuzar-adan captain of the guard took these, and brought them to the king of Babylon to Riblah:

verses.original: וַ/יַּ֣ךְ אֹתָ/ם֩ מֶ֨לֶךְ בָּבֶ֧ל וַ/יְמִיתֵ֛/ם בְּ/רִבְלָ֖ה בְּ/אֶ֣רֶץ חֲמָ֑ת וַ/יִּ֥גֶל יְהוּדָ֖ה מֵ/עַ֥ל אַדְמָתֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: vykh 'tm mlkh bbl vymytm brblh b'rts chmt vygl yhvdh m'l 'dmtv
verses.translation: And the king of Babylon smote them, and slew them at Riblah in the land of Hamath. So Judah was carried away out of their land.

verses.original: וְ/הָ/עָ֗ם הַ/נִּשְׁאָר֙ בְּ/אֶ֣רֶץ יְהוּדָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֣ר הִשְׁאִ֔יר נְבֽוּכַדְנֶאצַּ֖ר מֶ֣לֶךְ בָּבֶ֑ל וַ/יַּפְקֵ֣ד עֲלֵי/הֶ֔ם אֶת גְּדַלְיָ֖הוּ בֶּן אֲחִיקָ֥ם בֶּן שָׁפָֽן
verses.translit: vh'm hnsh'r b'rts yhvdh 'shr hsh'yr nbvkhdn'tsr mlkh bbl vypqd 'lyhm 't gdlyhv bn 'chyqm bn shpn
verses.translation: And as for the people that remained in the land of Judah, whom Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon had left, even over them he made Gedaliah the son of Ahikam, the son of Shaphan, ruler.

verses.original: וַ/יִּשְׁמְעוּ֩ כָל שָׂרֵ֨י הַ/חֲיָלִ֜ים הֵ֣מָּה וְ/הָ/אֲנָשִׁ֗ים כִּֽי הִפְקִ֤יד מֶֽלֶךְ בָּבֶל֙ אֶת גְּדַלְיָ֔הוּ וַ/יָּבֹ֥אוּ אֶל גְּדַלְיָ֖הוּ הַ/מִּצְפָּ֑ה וְ/יִשְׁמָעֵ֣אל בֶּן נְתַנְיָ֡ה וְ/יוֹחָנָ֣ן בֶּן קָ֠רֵחַ וּ/שְׂרָיָ֨ה בֶן תַּנְחֻ֜מֶת הַ/נְּטֹפָתִ֗י וְ/יַֽאֲזַנְיָ֨הוּ֙ בֶּן הַ/מַּ֣עֲכָתִ֔י הֵ֖מָּה וְ/אַנְשֵׁי/הֶֽם
verses.translit: vyshm'v khl shry hchylym hmh vh'nshym khy hpqyd mlkh bbl 't gdlyhv vyb'v 'l gdlyhv hmtsph vyshm''l bn ntnyh vyvchnn bn qrch vshryh bn tnchmt hntpty vy'znyhv bn hm'khty hmh v'nshyhm
verses.translation: And when all the captains of the armies, they and their men, heard that the king of Babylon had made Gedaliah governor, there came to Gedaliah to Mizpah, even Ishmael the son of Nethaniah, and Johanan the son of Careah, and Seraiah the son of Tanhumeth the Netophathite, and Jaazaniah the son of a Maachathite, they and their men.

verses.original: וַ/יִּשָּׁבַ֨ע לָ/הֶ֤ם גְּדַלְיָ֨הוּ֙ וּ/לְ/אַנְשֵׁי/הֶ֔ם וַ/יֹּ֣אמֶר לָ/הֶ֔ם אַל תִּֽירְא֖וּ מֵ/עַבְדֵ֣י הַ/כַּשְׂדִּ֑ים שְׁב֣וּ בָ/אָ֗רֶץ וְ/עִבְד֛וּ אֶת מֶ֥לֶךְ בָּבֶ֖ל וְ/יִטַ֥ב לָ/כֶֽם
verses.translit: vyshb' lhm gdlyhv vl'nshyhm vy'mr lhm 'l tyr'v m'bdy hkhshdym shbv b'rts v'bdv 't mlkh bbl vytb lkhm
verses.translation: And Gedaliah sware to them, and to their men, and said unto them, Fear not to be the servants of the Chaldees: dwell in the land, and serve the king of Babylon; and it shall be well with you.

verses.original: וַ/יְהִ֣י בַּ/חֹ֣דֶשׁ הַ/שְּׁבִיעִ֗י בָּ֣א יִשְׁמָעֵ֣אל בֶּן נְ֠תַנְיָה בֶּן אֱלִ֨ישָׁמָ֜ע מִ/זֶּ֣רַע הַ/מְּלוּכָ֗ה וַ/עֲשָׂרָ֤ה אֲנָשִׁים֙ אִתּ֔/וֹ וַ/יַּכּ֥וּ אֶת גְּדַלְיָ֖הוּ וַ/יָּמֹ֑ת וְ/אֶת הַ/יְּהוּדִים֙ וְ/אֶת הַ/כַּשְׂדִּ֔ים אֲשֶׁר הָי֥וּ אִתּ֖/וֹ בַּ/מִּצְפָּֽה
verses.translit: vyhy bchdsh hshby'y b' yshm''l bn ntnyh bn 'lyshm' mzr' hmlvkhh v'shrh 'nshym 'tv vykhv 't gdlyhv vymt v't hyhvdym v't hkhshdym 'shr hyv 'tv bmtsph
verses.translation: But it came to pass in the seventh month, that Ishmael the son of Nethaniah, the son of Elishama, of the seed royal, came, and ten men with him, and smote Gedaliah, that he died, and the Jews and the Chaldees that were with him at Mizpah.

verses.original: וַ/יָּקֻ֨מוּ כָל הָ/עָ֜ם מִ/קָּטֹ֤ן וְ/עַד גָּדוֹל֙ וְ/שָׂרֵ֣י הַ/חֲיָלִ֔ים וַ/יָּבֹ֖אוּ מִצְרָ֑יִם כִּ֥י יָרְא֖וּ מִ/פְּנֵ֥י כַשְׂדִּֽים
verses.translit: vyqmv khl h'm mqtn v'd gdvl vshry hchylym vyb'v mtsrym khy yr'v mpny khshdym
verses.translation: And all the people, both small and great, and the captains of the armies, arose, and came to Egypt: for they were afraid of the Chaldees.

verses.original: וַ/יְהִי֩ בִ/שְׁלֹשִׁ֨ים וָ/שֶׁ֜בַע שָׁנָ֗ה לְ/גָלוּת֙ יְהוֹיָכִ֣ין מֶֽלֶךְ יְהוּדָ֔ה בִּ/שְׁנֵ֤ים עָשָׂר֙ חֹ֔דֶשׁ בְּ/עֶשְׂרִ֥ים וְ/שִׁבְעָ֖ה לַ/חֹ֑דֶשׁ נָשָׂ֡א אֱוִ֣יל מְרֹדַךְ֩ מֶ֨לֶךְ בָּבֶ֜ל בִּ/שְׁנַ֣ת מָלְכ֗/וֹ אֶת רֹ֛אשׁ יְהוֹיָכִ֥ין מֶֽלֶךְ יְהוּדָ֖ה מִ/בֵּ֥ית כֶּֽלֶא
verses.translit: vyhy bshlshym vshb' shnh lglvt yhvykhyn mlkh yhvdh bshnym 'shr chdsh b'shrym vshb'h lchdsh nsh' 'vyl mrdkh mlkh bbl bshnt mlkhv 't r'sh yhvykhyn mlkh yhvdh mbyt khl'
verses.translation: And it came to pass in the seven and thirtieth year of the captivity of Jehoiachin king of Judah, in the twelfth month, on the seven and twentieth day of the month, that Evil-merodach king of Babylon in the year that he began to reign did lift up the head of Jehoiachin king of Judah out of prison;

verses.original: וַ/יְדַבֵּ֥ר אִתּ֖/וֹ טֹב֑וֹת וַ/יִּתֵּן֙ אֶת כִּסְא֔/וֹ מֵ/עַ֗ל כִּסֵּ֧א הַ/מְּלָכִ֛ים אֲשֶׁ֥ר אִתּ֖/וֹ בְּ/בָבֶֽל
verses.translit: vydbr 'tv tbvt vytn 't khs'v m'l khs' hmlkhym 'shr 'tv bbbl
verses.translation: And he spake kindly to him, and set his throne above the throne of the kings that were with him in Babylon;

verses.original: וְ/שִׁנָּ֕א אֵ֖ת בִּגְדֵ֣י כִלְא֑/וֹ וְ/אָכַ֨ל לֶ֧חֶם תָּמִ֛יד לְ/פָנָ֖י/ו כָּל יְמֵ֥י חַיָּֽי/ו
verses.translit: vshn' 't bgdy khl'v v'khl lchm tmyd lpnyv khl ymy chyyv
verses.translation: And changed his prison garments: and he did eat bread continually before him all the days of his life.

verses.original: וַ/אֲרֻחָת֗/וֹ אֲרֻחַ֨ת תָּמִ֧יד נִתְּנָה לּ֛/וֹ מֵ/אֵ֥ת הַ/מֶּ֖לֶךְ דְּבַר י֣וֹם בְּ/יוֹמ֑/וֹ כֹּ֖ל יְמֵ֥י חַיָּֽ/ו
verses.translit: v'rchtv 'rcht tmyd ntnh lv m't hmlkh dbr yvm byvmv khl ymy chyv
verses.translation: And his allowance was a continual allowance given him of the king, a daily rate for every day, all the days of his life.

verses.original: אָדָ֥ם שֵׁ֖ת אֱנֽוֹשׁ
verses.translit: 'dm sht 'nvsh
verses.translation: Adam, Sheth, Enosh,

verses.original: קֵינָ֥ן מַהֲלַלְאֵ֖ל יָֽרֶד
verses.translit: qynn mhll'l yrd
verses.translation: Kenan, Mahalaleel, Jered,

verses.original: חֲנ֥וֹךְ מְתוּשֶׁ֖לַח לָֽמֶךְ
verses.translit: chnvkh mtvshlch lmkh
verses.translation: Henoch, Methuselah, Lamech,

verses.original: נֹ֥חַ שֵׁ֖ם חָ֥ם וָ/יָֽפֶת
verses.translit: nch shm chm vypt
verses.translation: Noah, Shem, Ham, and Japheth.

verses.original: בְּנֵ֣י יֶ֔פֶת גֹּ֣מֶר וּ/מָג֔וֹג וּ/מָדַ֖י וְ/יָוָ֣ן וְ/תֻבָ֑ל וּ/מֶ֖שֶׁךְ וְ/תִירָֽס
verses.translit: bny ypt gmr vmgvg vmdy vyvn vtbl vmshkh vtyrs
verses.translation: The sons of Japheth; Gomer, and Magog, and Madai, and Javan, and Tubal, and Meshech, and Tiras.

verses.original: וּ/בְנֵ֖י גֹּ֑מֶר אַשְׁכֲּנַ֥ז וְ/דִיפַ֖ת וְ/תוֹגַרְמָֽה
verses.translit: vbny gmr 'shkhnz vdypt vtvgrmh
verses.translation: And the sons of Gomer; Ashchenaz, and Riphath, and Togarmah.

verses.original: וּ/בְנֵ֥י יָוָ֖ן אֱלִישָׁ֣ה וְ/תַרְשִׁ֑ישָׁ/ה כִּתִּ֖ים וְ/רוֹדָנִֽים
verses.translit: vbny yvn 'lyshh vtrshyshh khtym vrvdnym
verses.translation: And the sons of Javan; Elishah, and Tarshish, Kittim, and Dodanim.

verses.original: בְּנֵ֖י חָ֑ם כּ֥וּשׁ וּ/מִצְרַ֖יִם פּ֥וּט וּ/כְנָֽעַן
verses.translit: bny chm khvsh vmtsrym pvt vkhn'n
verses.translation: The sons of Ham; Cush, and Mizraim, Put, and Canaan.

verses.original: וּ/בְנֵ֣י כ֔וּשׁ סְבָא֙ וַ/חֲוִילָ֔ה וְ/סַבְתָּ֥א וְ/רַעְמָ֖א וְ/סַבְתְּכָ֑א וּ/בְנֵ֥י רַעְמָ֖א שְׁבָ֥א וּ/דְדָֽן
verses.translit: vbny khvsh sb' vchvylh vsbt' vr'm' vsbtkh' vbny r'm' shb' vddn
verses.translation: And the sons of Cush; Seba, and Havilah, and Sabta, and Raamah, and Sabtecha. And the sons of Raamah; Sheba, and Dedan.

verses.original: וְ/כ֖וּשׁ יָלַ֣ד אֶת נִמְר֑וֹד ה֣וּא הֵחֵ֔ל לִ/הְי֥וֹת גִּבּ֖וֹר בָּ/אָֽרֶץ
verses.translit: vkhvsh yld 't nmrvd hv' hchl lhyvt gbvr b'rts
verses.translation: And Cush begat Nimrod: he began to be mighty upon the earth.

verses.original: וּ/מִצְרַ֡יִם יָלַ֞ד אֶת לודיים לוּדִ֧ים וְ/אֶת עֲנָמִ֛ים וְ/אֶת לְהָבִ֖ים וְ/אֶת נַפְתֻּחִֽים
verses.translit: vmtsrym yld 't lvdyym lvdym v't 'nmym v't lhbym v't nptchym
verses.translation: And Mizraim begat Ludim, and Anamim, and Lehabim, and Naphtuhim,

verses.original: וְֽ/אֶת פַּתְרֻסִ֞ים וְ/אֶת כַּסְלֻחִ֗ים אֲשֶׁ֨ר יָצְא֥וּ מִ/שָּׁ֛ם פְּלִשְׁתִּ֖ים וְ/אֶת כַּפְתֹּרִֽים
verses.translit: v't ptrsym v't khslchym 'shr yts'v mshm plshtym v't khptrym
verses.translation: And Pathrusim, and Casluhim, (of whom came the Philistines,) and Caphthorim.

verses.original: וּ/כְנַ֗עַן יָלַ֛ד אֶת צִיד֥וֹן בְּכֹר֖/וֹ וְ/אֶת חֵֽת
verses.translit: vkhn'n yld 't tsydvn bkhrv v't cht
verses.translation: And Canaan begat Zidon his firstborn, and Heth,

verses.original: וְ/אֶת הַ/יְבוּסִי֙ וְ/אֶת הָ֣/אֱמֹרִ֔י וְ/אֵ֖ת הַ/גִּרְגָּשִֽׁי
verses.translit: v't hybvsy v't h'mry v't hgrgshy
verses.translation: The Jebusite also, and the Amorite, and the Girgashite,

verses.original: וְ/אֶת הַ/חִוִּ֥י וְ/אֶת הַֽ/עַרְקִ֖י וְ/אֶת הַ/סִּינִֽי
verses.translit: v't hchvy v't h'rqy v't hsyny
verses.translation: And the Hivite, and the Arkite, and the Sinite,

verses.original: וְ/אֶת הָ/אַרְוָדִ֥י וְ/אֶת הַ/צְּמָרִ֖י וְ/אֶת הַֽ/חֲמָתִֽי
verses.translit: v't h'rvdy v't htsmry v't hchmty
verses.translation: And the Arvadite, and the Zemarite, and the Hamathite.

verses.original: בְּנֵ֣י שֵׁ֔ם עֵילָ֣ם וְ/אַשּׁ֔וּר וְ/אַרְפַּכְשַׁ֖ד וְ/ל֣וּד וַ/אֲרָ֑ם וְ/ע֥וּץ וְ/ח֖וּל וְ/גֶ֥תֶר וָ/מֶֽשֶׁךְ
verses.translit: bny shm 'ylm v'shvr v'rpkhshd vlvd v'rm v'vts vchvl vgtr vmshkh
verses.translation: The sons of Shem; Elam, and Asshur, and Arphaxad, and Lud, and Aram, and Uz, and Hul, and Gether, and Meshech.

verses.original: וְ/אַרְפַּכְשַׁ֖ד יָלַ֣ד אֶת שָׁ֑לַח וְ/שֶׁ֖לַח יָלַ֥ד אֶת עֵֽבֶר
verses.translit: v'rpkhshd yld 't shlch vshlch yld 't 'br
verses.translation: And Arphaxad begat Shelah, and Shelah begat Eber.

verses.original: וּ/לְ/עֵ֥בֶר יֻלַּ֖ד שְׁנֵ֣י בָנִ֑ים שֵׁ֣ם הָ/אֶחָ֞ד פֶּ֗לֶג כִּ֤י בְ/יָמָי/ו֙ נִפְלְגָ֣ה הָ/אָ֔רֶץ וְ/שֵׁ֥ם אָחִ֖י/ו יָקְטָֽן
verses.translit: vl'br yld shny bnym shm h'chd plg khy bymyv nplgh h'rts vshm 'chyv yqtn
verses.translation: And unto Eber were born two sons: the name of the one was Peleg; because in his days the earth was divided: and his brother’s name was Joktan.

verses.original: וְ/יָקְטָ֣ן יָלַ֔ד אֶת אַלְמוֹדָ֖ד וְ/אֶת שָׁ֑לֶף וְ/אֶת חֲצַרְמָ֖וֶת וְ/אֶת יָֽרַח
verses.translit: vyqtn yld 't 'lmvdd v't shlf v't chtsrmvt v't yrch
verses.translation: And Joktan begat Almodad, and Sheleph, and Hazarmaveth, and Jerah,

verses.original: וְ/אֶת הֲדוֹרָ֥ם וְ/אֶת אוּזָ֖ל וְ/אֶת דִּקְלָֽה
verses.translit: v't hdvrm v't 'vzl v't dqlh
verses.translation: Hadoram also, and Uzal, and Diklah,

verses.original: וְ/אֶת עֵיבָ֥ל וְ/אֶת אֲבִימָאֵ֖ל וְ/אֶת שְׁבָֽא
verses.translit: v't 'ybl v't 'bym'l v't shb'
verses.translation: And Ebal, and Abimael, and Sheba,

verses.original: וְ/אֶת אוֹפִ֥יר וְ/אֶת חֲוִילָ֖ה וְ/אֶת יוֹבָ֑ב כָּל אֵ֖לֶּה בְּנֵ֥י יָקְטָֽן
verses.translit: v't 'vpyr v't chvylh v't yvbb khl 'lh bny yqtn
verses.translation: And Ophir, and Havilah, and Jobab. All these were the sons of Joktan.

verses.original: שֵׁ֥ם אַרְפַּכְשַׁ֖ד שָֽׁלַח
verses.translit: shm 'rpkhshd shlch
verses.translation: Shem, Arphaxad, Shelah,

verses.original: עֵ֥בֶר פֶּ֖לֶג רְעֽוּ
verses.translit: 'br plg r'v
verses.translation: Eber, Peleg, Reu,

verses.original: שְׂר֥וּג נָח֖וֹר תָּֽרַח
verses.translit: shrvg nchvr trch
verses.translation: Serug, Nahor, Terah,

verses.original: אַבְרָ֖ם ה֥וּא אַבְרָהָֽם
verses.translit: 'brm hv' 'brhm
verses.translation: Abram; the same is Abraham.

verses.original: בְּנֵי֙ אַבְרָהָ֔ם יִצְחָ֖ק וְ/יִשְׁמָעֵֽאל
verses.translit: bny 'brhm ytschq vyshm''l
verses.translation: The sons of Abraham; Isaac, and Ishmael.

verses.original: אֵ֖לֶּה תֹּלְדוֹתָ֑/ם בְּכ֤וֹר יִשְׁמָעֵאל֙ נְבָי֔וֹת וְ/קֵדָ֥ר וְ/אַדְבְּאֵ֖ל וּ/מִבְשָֽׂם
verses.translit: 'lh tldvtm bkhvr yshm''l nbyvt vqdr v'db'l vmbshm
verses.translation: These are their generations: The firstborn of Ishmael, Nebaioth; then Kedar, and Adbeel, and Mibsam,

verses.original: מִשְׁמָ֣ע וְ/דוּמָ֔ה מַשָּׂ֖א חֲדַ֥ד וְ/תֵימָֽא
verses.translit: mshm' vdvmh msh' chdd vtym'
verses.translation: Mishma, and Dumah, Massa, Hadad, and Tema,

verses.original: יְט֥וּר נָפִ֖ישׁ וָ/קֵ֑דְמָה אֵ֥לֶּה הֵ֖ם בְּנֵ֥י יִשְׁמָעֵֽאל
verses.translit: ytvr npysh vqdmh 'lh hm bny yshm''l
verses.translation: Jetur, Naphish, and Kedemah. These are the sons of Ishmael.

verses.original: וּ/בְנֵ֨י קְטוּרָ֜ה פִּילֶ֣גֶשׁ אַבְרָהָ֗ם יָלְדָ֞ה אֶת זִמְרָ֧ן וְ/יָקְשָׁ֛ן וּ/מְדָ֥ן וּ/מִדְיָ֖ן וְ/יִשְׁבָּ֣ק וְ/שׁ֑וּחַ וּ/בְנֵ֥י יָקְשָׁ֖ן שְׁבָ֥א וּ/דְדָֽן
verses.translit: vbny qtvrh pylgsh 'brhm yldh 't zmrn vyqshn vmdn vmdyn vyshbq vshvch vbny yqshn shb' vddn
verses.translation: Now the sons of Keturah, Abraham’s concubine: she bare Zimran, and Jokshan, and Medan, and Midian, and Ishbak, and Shuah. And the sons of Jokshan; Sheba, and Dedan.

verses.original: וּ/בְנֵ֣י מִדְיָ֗ן עֵיפָ֤ה וָ/עֵ֨פֶר֙ וַ/חֲנ֔וֹךְ וַ/אֲבִידָ֖ע וְ/אֶלְדָּעָ֑ה כָּל אֵ֖לֶּה בְּנֵ֥י קְטוּרָֽה
verses.translit: vbny mdyn 'yph v'pr vchnvkh v'byd' v'ld'h khl 'lh bny qtvrh
verses.translation: And the sons of Midian; Ephah, and Epher, and Henoch, and Abida, and Eldaah. All these are the sons of Keturah.

verses.original: וַ/יּ֥וֹלֶד אַבְרָהָ֖ם אֶת יִצְחָ֑ק בְּנֵ֣י יִצְחָ֔ק עֵשָׂ֖ו וְ/יִשְׂרָאֵֽל
verses.translit: vyvld 'brhm 't ytschq bny ytschq 'shv vyshr'l
verses.translation: And Abraham begat Isaac. The sons of Isaac; Esau and Israel.

verses.original: בְּנֵ֖י עֵשָׂ֑ו אֱלִיפַ֛ז רְעוּאֵ֥ל וִ/יע֖וּשׁ וְ/יַעְלָ֥ם וְ/קֹֽרַח
verses.translit: bny 'shv 'lypz r'v'l vy'vsh vy'lm vqrch
verses.translation: The sons of Esau; Eliphaz, Reuel, and Jeush, and Jaalam, and Korah.

verses.original: בְּנֵ֖י אֱלִיפָ֑ז תֵּימָ֤ן וְ/אוֹמָר֙ צְפִ֣י וְ/גַעְתָּ֔ם קְנַ֖ז וְ/תִמְנָ֥ע וַ/עֲמָלֵֽק
verses.translit: bny 'lypz tymn v'vmr tspy vg'tm qnz vtmn' v'mlq
verses.translation: The sons of Eliphaz; Teman, and Omar, Zephi, and Gatam, Kenaz, and Timna, and Amalek.

verses.original: בְּנֵ֖י רְעוּאֵ֑ל נַ֥חַת זֶ֖רַח שַׁמָּ֥ה וּ/מִזָּֽה
verses.translit: bny r'v'l ncht zrch shmh vmzh
verses.translation: The sons of Reuel; Nahath, Zerah, Shammah, and Mizzah.

verses.original: וּ/בְנֵ֣י שֵׂעִ֔יר לוֹטָ֥ן וְ/שׁוֹבָ֖ל וְ/צִבְע֣וֹן וַֽ/עֲנָ֑ה וְ/דִישֹׁ֥ן וְ/אֵ֖צֶר וְ/דִישָֽׁן
verses.translit: vbny sh'yr lvtn vshvbl vtsb'vn v'nh vdyshn v'tsr vdyshn
verses.translation: And the sons of Seir; Lotan, and Shobal, and Zibeon, and Anah, and Dishon, and Ezer, and Dishan.

verses.original: וּ/בְנֵ֥י לוֹטָ֖ן חֹרִ֣י וְ/הוֹמָ֑ם וַ/אֲח֥וֹת לוֹטָ֖ן תִּמְנָֽע
verses.translit: vbny lvtn chry vhvmm v'chvt lvtn tmn'
verses.translation: And the sons of Lotan; Hori, and Homam: and Timna was Lotan’s sister.

verses.original: בְּנֵ֣י שׁוֹבָ֔ל עַלְיָ֧ן וּ/מָנַ֛חַת וְ/עֵיבָ֖ל שְׁפִ֣י וְ/אוֹנָ֑ם וּ/בְנֵ֥י צִבְע֖וֹן אַיָּ֥ה וַ/עֲנָֽה
verses.translit: bny shvbl 'lyn vmncht v'ybl shpy v'vnm vbny tsb'vn 'yh v'nh
verses.translation: The sons of Shobal; Alian, and Manahath, and Ebal, Shephi, and Onam. And the sons of Zibeon; Aiah, and Anah.

verses.original: בְּנֵ֥י עֲנָ֖ה דִּישׁ֑וֹן וּ/בְנֵ֣י דִישׁ֔וֹן חַמְרָ֥ן וְ/אֶשְׁבָּ֖ן וְ/יִתְרָ֥ן וּ/כְרָֽן
verses.translit: bny 'nh dyshvn vbny dyshvn chmrn v'shbn vytrn vkhrn
verses.translation: The sons of Anah; Dishon. And the sons of Dishon; Amram, and Eshban, and Ithran, and Cheran.

verses.original: בְּֽנֵי אֵ֔צֶר בִּלְהָ֥ן וְ/זַעֲוָ֖ן יַעֲקָ֑ן בְּנֵ֥י דִישׁ֖וֹן ע֥וּץ וַ/אֲרָֽן
verses.translit: bny 'tsr blhn vz'vn y'qn bny dyshvn 'vts v'rn
verses.translation: The sons of Ezer; Bilhan, and Zavan, and Jakan. The sons of Dishan; Uz, and Aran.

verses.original: וְ/אֵ֣לֶּה הַ/מְּלָכִ֗ים אֲשֶׁ֤ר מָלְכוּ֙ בְּ/אֶ֣רֶץ אֱד֔וֹם לִ/פְנֵ֥י מְלָךְ מֶ֖לֶךְ לִ/בְנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל בֶּ֚לַע בֶּן בְּע֔וֹר וְ/שֵׁ֥ם עִיר֖/וֹ דִּנְהָֽבָה
verses.translit: v'lh hmlkhym 'shr mlkhv b'rts 'dvm lpny mlkh mlkh lbny yshr'l bl' bn b'vr vshm 'yrv dnhbh
verses.translation: Now these are the kings that reigned in the land of Edom before any king reigned over the children of Israel; Bela the son of Beor: and the name of his city was Dinhabah.

verses.original: וַ/יָּ֖מָת בָּ֑לַע וַ/יִּמְלֹ֣ךְ תַּחְתָּ֔י/ו יוֹבָ֥ב בֶּן זֶ֖רַח מִ/בָּצְרָֽה
verses.translit: vymt bl' vymlkh tchtyv yvbb bn zrch mbtsrh
verses.translation: And when Bela was dead, Jobab the son of Zerah of Bozrah reigned in his stead.

verses.original: וַ/יָּ֖מָת יוֹבָ֑ב וַ/יִּמְלֹ֣ךְ תַּחְתָּ֔י/ו חוּשָׁ֖ם מֵ/אֶ֥רֶץ הַ/תֵּימָנִֽי
verses.translit: vymt yvbb vymlkh tchtyv chvshm m'rts htymny
