verses.translation: And when Jobab was dead, Husham of the land of the Temanites reigned in his stead.

verses.original: וַ/יָּ֖מָת חוּשָׁ֑ם וַ/יִּמְלֹ֨ךְ תַּחְתָּ֜י/ו הֲדַ֣ד בֶּן בְּדַ֗ד הַ/מַּכֶּ֤ה אֶת מִדְיָן֙ בִּ/שְׂדֵ֣ה מוֹאָ֔ב וְ/שֵׁ֥ם עִיר֖/וֹ עיות עֲוִֽית
verses.translit: vymt chvshm vymlkh tchtyv hdd bn bdd hmkhh 't mdyn bshdh mv'b vshm 'yrv 'yvt 'vyt
verses.translation: And when Husham was dead, Hadad the son of Bedad, which smote Midian in the field of Moab, reigned in his stead: and the name of his city was Avith.

verses.original: וַ/יָּ֖מָת הֲדָ֑ד וַ/יִּמְלֹ֣ךְ תַּחְתָּ֔י/ו שַׂמְלָ֖ה מִ/מַּשְׂרֵקָֽה
verses.translit: vymt hdd vymlkh tchtyv shmlh mmshrqh
verses.translation: And when Hadad was dead, Samlah of Masrekah reigned in his stead.

verses.original: וַ/יָּ֖מָת שַׂמְלָ֑ה וַ/יִּמְלֹ֣ךְ תַּחְתָּ֔י/ו שָׁא֖וּל מֵ/רְחֹב֥וֹת הַ/נָּהָֽר
verses.translit: vymt shmlh vymlkh tchtyv sh'vl mrchbvt hnhr
verses.translation: And when Samlah was dead, Shaul of Rehoboth by the river reigned in his stead.

verses.original: וַ/יָּ֖מָת שָׁא֑וּל וַ/יִּמְלֹ֣ךְ תַּחְתָּ֔י/ו בַּ֥עַל חָנָ֖ן בֶּן עַכְבּֽוֹר
verses.translit: vymt sh'vl vymlkh tchtyv b'l chnn bn 'khbvr
verses.translation: And when Shaul was dead, Baal-hanan the son of Achbor reigned in his stead.

verses.original: וַ/יָּ֨מָת֙ בַּ֣עַל חָנָ֔ן וַ/יִּמְלֹ֤ךְ תַּחְתָּי/ו֙ הֲדַ֔ד וְ/שֵׁ֥ם עִיר֖/וֹ פָּ֑עִי וְ/שֵׁ֨ם אִשְׁתּ֤/וֹ מְהֵיטַבְאֵל֙ בַּת מַטְרֵ֔ד בַּ֖ת מֵ֥י זָהָֽב
verses.translit: vymt b'l chnn vymlkh tchtyv hdd vshm 'yrv p'y vshm 'shtv mhytb'l bt mtrd bt my zhb
verses.translation: And when Baal-hanan was dead, Hadad reigned in his stead: and the name of his city was Pai; and his wife’s name was Mehetabel, the daughter of Matred, the daughter of Mezahab.

verses.original: וַ/יָּ֖מָת הֲדָ֑ד וַ/יִּהְיוּ֙ אַלּוּפֵ֣י אֱד֔וֹם אַלּ֥וּף תִּמְנָ֛ע אַלּ֥וּף עליה עַֽלְוָ֖ה אַלּ֥וּף יְתֵֽת
verses.translit: vymt hdd vyhyv 'lvpy 'dvm 'lvf tmn' 'lvf 'lyh 'lvh 'lvf ytt
verses.translation: Hadad died also. And the dukes of Edom were; duke Timnah, duke Aliah, duke Jetheth,

verses.original: אַלּ֧וּף אָהֳלִיבָמָ֛ה אַלּ֥וּף אֵלָ֖ה אַלּ֥וּף פִּינֹֽן
verses.translit: 'lvf 'hlybmh 'lvf 'lh 'lvf pynn
verses.translation: Duke Aholibamah, duke Elah, duke Pinon,

verses.original: אַלּ֥וּף קְנַ֛ז אַלּ֥וּף תֵּימָ֖ן אַלּ֣וּף מִבְצָֽר
verses.translit: 'lvf qnz 'lvf tymn 'lvf mbtsr
verses.translation: Duke Kenaz, duke Teman, duke Mibzar,

verses.original: אַלּ֥וּף מַגְדִּיאֵ֖ל אַלּ֣וּף עִירָ֑ם אֵ֖לֶּה אַלּוּפֵ֥י אֱדֽוֹם
verses.translit: 'lvf mgdy'l 'lvf 'yrm 'lh 'lvpy 'dvm
verses.translation: Duke Magdiel, duke Iram. These are the dukes of Edom.

verses.original: אֵ֖לֶּה בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל רְאוּבֵ֤ן שִׁמְעוֹן֙ לֵוִ֣י וִ/יהוּדָ֔ה יִשָׂשכָ֖ר וּ/זְבֻלֽוּן
verses.translit: 'lh bny yshr'l r'vbn shm'vn lvy vyhvdh yshshkhr vzblvn
verses.translation: These are the sons of Israel; Reuben, Simeon, Levi, and Judah, Issachar, and Zebulun,

verses.original: דָּ֚ן יוֹסֵ֣ף וּ/בִנְיָמִ֔ן נַפְתָּלִ֖י גָּ֥ד וְ/אָשֵֽׁר
verses.translit: dn yvsf vbnymn nptly gd v'shr
verses.translation: Dan, Joseph, and Benjamin, Naphtali, Gad, and Asher.

verses.original: בְּנֵ֣י יְהוּדָ֗ה עֵ֤ר וְ/אוֹנָן֙ וְ/שֵׁלָ֔ה שְׁלוֹשָׁה֙ נ֣וֹלַד ל֔/וֹ מִ/בַּת שׁ֖וּעַ הַֽ/כְּנַעֲנִ֑ית וַ/יְהִ֞י עֵ֣ר בְּכ֣וֹר יְהוּדָ֗ה רַ֛ע בְּ/עֵינֵ֥י יְהוָ֖ה וַ/יְמִיתֵֽ/הוּ
verses.translit: bny yhvdh 'r v'vnn vshlh shlvshh nvld lv mbt shv' hkhn'nyt vyhy 'r bkhvr yhvdh r' b'yny yhvh vymythv
verses.translation: The sons of Judah; Er, and Onan, and Shelah: which three were born unto him of the daughter of Shua the Canaanitess. And Er, the firstborn of Judah, was evil in the sight of the LORD ; and he slew him.

verses.original: וְ/תָמָר֙ כַּלָּת֔/וֹ יָ֥לְדָה לּ֖/וֹ אֶת פֶּ֣רֶץ וְ/אֶת זָ֑רַח כָּל בְּנֵ֥י יְהוּדָ֖ה חֲמִשָּֽׁה
verses.translit: vtmr khltv yldh lv 't prts v't zrch khl bny yhvdh chmshh
verses.translation: And Tamar his daughter in law bare him Pharez and Zerah. All the sons of Judah were five.

verses.original: בְּנֵי פֶ֖רֶץ חֶצְר֥וֹן וְ/חָמֽוּל
verses.translit: bny prts chtsrvn vchmvl
verses.translation: The sons of Pharez; Hezron, and Hamul.

verses.original: וּ/בְנֵ֣י זֶ֗רַח זִ֠מְרִי וְ/אֵיתָ֧ן וְ/הֵימָ֛ן וְ/כַלְכֹּ֥ל וָ/דָ֖רַע כֻּלָּ֥/ם חֲמִשָּֽׁה
verses.translit: vbny zrch zmry v'ytn vhymn vkhlkhl vdr' khlm chmshh
verses.translation: And the sons of Zerah; Zimri, and Ethan, and Heman, and Calcol, and Dara: five of them in all.

verses.original: וּ/בְנֵ֖י כַּרְמִ֑י עָכָר֙ עוֹכֵ֣ר יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל אֲשֶׁ֥ר מָעַ֖ל בַּ/חֵֽרֶם
verses.translit: vbny khrmy 'khr 'vkhr yshr'l 'shr m'l bchrm
verses.translation: And the sons of Carmi; Achar, the troubler of Israel, who transgressed in the thing accursed.

verses.original: וּ/בְנֵ֥י אֵיתָ֖ן עֲזַרְיָֽה
verses.translit: vbny 'ytn 'zryh
verses.translation: And the sons of Ethan; Azariah.

verses.original: וּ/בְנֵ֥י חֶצְר֖וֹן אֲשֶׁ֣ר נוֹלַד ל֑/וֹ אֶת יְרַחְמְאֵ֥ל וְ/אֶת רָ֖ם וְ/אֶת כְּלוּבָֽי
verses.translit: vbny chtsrvn 'shr nvld lv 't yrchm'l v't rm v't khlvby
verses.translation: The sons also of Hezron, that were born unto him; Jerahmeel, and Ram, and Chelubai.

verses.original: וְ/רָ֖ם הוֹלִ֣יד אֶת עַמִּינָדָ֑ב וְ/עַמִּינָדָב֙ הוֹלִ֣יד אֶת נַחְשׁ֔וֹן נְשִׂ֖יא בְּנֵ֥י יְהוּדָֽה
verses.translit: vrm hvlyd 't 'myndb v'myndb hvlyd 't nchshvn nshy' bny yhvdh
verses.translation: And Ram begat Amminadab; and Amminadab begat Nahshon, prince of the children of Judah;

verses.original: וְ/נַחְשׁוֹן֙ הוֹלִ֣יד אֶת שַׂלְמָ֔א וְ/שַׂלְמָ֖א הוֹלִ֥יד אֶת בֹּֽעַז
verses.translit: vnchshvn hvlyd 't shlm' vshlm' hvlyd 't b'z
verses.translation: And Nahshon begat Salma, and Salma begat Boaz,

verses.original: וּ/בֹ֨עַז֙ הוֹלִ֣יד אֶת עוֹבֵ֔ד וְ/עוֹבֵ֖ד הוֹלִ֥יד אֶת יִשָֽׁי
verses.translit: vb'z hvlyd 't 'vbd v'vbd hvlyd 't yshy
verses.translation: And Boaz begat Obed, and Obed begat Jesse,

verses.original: וְ/אִישַׁ֛י הוֹלִ֥יד אֶת בְּכֹר֖/וֹ אֶת אֱלִיאָ֑ב וַ/אֲבִינָדָב֙ הַ/שֵּׁנִ֔י וְ/שִׁמְעָ֖א הַ/שְּׁלִישִֽׁי
verses.translit: v'yshy hvlyd 't bkhrv 't 'ly'b v'byndb hshny vshm'' hshlyshy
verses.translation: And Jesse begat his firstborn Eliab, and Abinadab the second, and Shimma the third,

verses.original: נְתַנְאֵל֙ הָֽ/רְבִיעִ֔י רַדַּ֖י הַ/חֲמִישִֽׁי
verses.translit: ntn'l hrby'y rdy hchmyshy
verses.translation: Nethaneel the fourth, Raddai the fifth,

verses.original: אֹ֚צֶם הַ/שִּׁשִּׁ֔י דָּוִ֖יד הַ/שְּׁבִעִֽי
verses.translit: 'tsm hshshy dvyd hshb'y
verses.translation: Ozem the sixth, David the seventh:

verses.original: ו/אחיתי/הם וְ/אַחְיוֹתֵי/הֶ֖ם צְרוּיָ֣ה וַ/אֲבִיגָ֑יִל וּ/בְנֵ֣י צְרוּיָ֗ה אַבְשַׁ֛י וְ/יוֹאָ֥ב וַ/עֲשָׂה אֵ֖ל שְׁלֹשָֽׁה
verses.translit: v'chytyhm v'chyvtyhm tsrvyh v'bygyl vbny tsrvyh 'bshy vyv'b v'shh 'l shlshh
verses.translation: Whose sisters were Zeruiah, and Abigail. And the sons of Zeruiah; Abishai, and Joab, and Asahel, three.

verses.original: וַ/אֲבִיגַ֕יִל יָלְדָ֖ה אֶת עֲמָשָׂ֑א וַ/אֲבִ֣י עֲמָשָׂ֔א יֶ֖תֶר הַ/יִּשְׁמְעֵאלִֽי
verses.translit: v'bygyl yldh 't 'msh' v'by 'msh' ytr hyshm''ly
verses.translation: And Abigail bare Amasa: and the father of Amasa was Jether the Ishmeelite.

verses.original: וְ/כָלֵ֣ב בֶּן חֶצְר֗וֹן הוֹלִ֛יד אֶת עֲזוּבָ֥ה אִשָּׁ֖ה וְ/אֶת יְרִיע֑וֹת וְ/אֵ֣לֶּה בָנֶ֔י/הָ יֵ֥שֶׁר וְ/שׁוֹבָ֖ב וְ/אַרְדּֽוֹן
verses.translit: vkhlb bn chtsrvn hvlyd 't 'zvbh 'shh v't yry'vt v'lh bnyh yshr vshvbb v'rdvn
verses.translation: And Caleb the son of Hezron begat children of Azubah his wife, and of Jerioth: her sons are these; Jesher, and Shobab, and Ardon.

verses.original: וַ/תָּ֖מָת עֲזוּבָ֑ה וַ/יִּֽקַּֽח ל֤/וֹ כָלֵב֙ אֶת אֶפְרָ֔ת וַ/תֵּ֥לֶד ל֖/וֹ אֶת חֽוּר
verses.translit: vtmt 'zvbh vyqch lv khlb 't 'prt vtld lv 't chvr
verses.translation: And when Azubah was dead, Caleb took unto him Ephrath, which bare him Hur.

verses.original: וְ/חוּר֙ הוֹלִ֣יד אֶת אוּרִ֔י וְ/אוּרִ֖י הוֹלִ֥יד אֶת בְּצַלְאֵֽל
verses.translit: vchvr hvlyd 't 'vry v'vry hvlyd 't btsl'l
verses.translation: And Hur begat Uri, and Uri begat Bezaleel.

verses.original: וְ/אַחַ֗ר בָּ֤א חֶצְרוֹן֙ אֶל בַּת מָכִיר֙ אֲבִ֣י גִלְעָ֔ד וְ/ה֣וּא לְקָחָ֔/הּ וְ/ה֖וּא בֶּן שִׁשִּׁ֣ים שָׁנָ֑ה וַ/תֵּ֥לֶד ל֖/וֹ אֶת שְׂגֽוּב
verses.translit: v'chr b' chtsrvn 'l bt mkhyr 'by gl'd vhv' lqchh vhv' bn shshym shnh vtld lv 't shgvb
verses.translation: And afterward Hezron went in to the daughter of Machir the father of Gilead, whom he married when he was threescore years old; and she bare him Segub.

verses.original: וּ/שְׂג֖וּב הוֹלִ֣יד אֶת יָאִ֑יר וַֽ/יְהִי ל֗/וֹ עֶשְׂרִ֤ים וְ/שָׁלוֹשׁ֙ עָרִ֔ים בְּ/אֶ֖רֶץ הַ/גִּלְעָֽד
verses.translit: vshgvb hvlyd 't y'yr vyhy lv 'shrym vshlvsh 'rym b'rts hgl'd
verses.translation: And Segub begat Jair, who had three and twenty cities in the land of Gilead.

verses.original: וַ/יִּקַּ֣ח גְּשֽׁוּר וַ֠/אֲרָם אֶת חַוֺּ֨ת יָאִ֧יר מֵ/אִתָּ֛/ם אֶת קְנָ֥ת וְ/אֶת בְּנֹתֶ֖י/הָ שִׁשִּׁ֣ים עִ֑יר כָּל אֵ֕לֶּה בְּנֵ֖י מָכִ֥יר אֲבִי גִלְעָֽד
verses.translit: vyqch gshvr v'rm 't chvt y'yr m'tm 't qnt v't bntyh shshym 'yr khl 'lh bny mkhyr 'by gl'd
verses.translation: And he took Geshur, and Aram, with the towns of Jair, from them, with Kenath, and the towns thereof, even threescore cities. All these belonged to the sons of Machir the father of Gilead.

verses.original: וְ/אַחַ֥ר מוֹת חֶצְר֖וֹן בְּ/כָלֵ֣ב אֶפְרָ֑תָה וְ/אֵ֤שֶׁת חֶצְרוֹן֙ אֲבִיָּ֔ה וַ/תֵּ֣לֶד ל֔/וֹ אֶת אַשְׁח֖וּר אֲבִ֥י תְקֽוֹעַ
verses.translit: v'chr mvt chtsrvn bkhlb 'prth v'sht chtsrvn 'byh vtld lv 't 'shchvr 'by tqv'
verses.translation: And after that Hezron was dead in Caleb-ephratah, then Abiah Hezron’s wife bare him Ashur the father of Tekoa.

verses.original: וַ/יִּהְי֧וּ בְנֵי יְרַחְמְאֵ֛ל בְּכ֥וֹר חֶצְר֖וֹן הַ/בְּכ֣וֹר רָ֑ם וּ/בוּנָ֥ה וָ/אֹ֛רֶן וָ/אֹ֖צֶם אֲחִיָּֽה
verses.translit: vyhyv bny yrchm'l bkhvr chtsrvn hbkhvr rm vbvnh v'rn v'tsm 'chyh
verses.translation: And the sons of Jerahmeel the firstborn of Hezron were, Ram the firstborn, and Bunah, and Oren, and Ozem, and Ahijah.

verses.original: וַ/תְּהִ֨י אִשָּׁ֥ה אַחֶ֛רֶת לִֽ/ירַחְמְאֵ֖ל וּ/שְׁמָ֣/הּ עֲטָרָ֑ה הִ֖יא אֵ֥ם אוֹנָֽם
verses.translit: vthy 'shh 'chrt lyrchm'l vshmh 'trh hy' 'm 'vnm
verses.translation: Jerahmeel had also another wife, whose name was Atarah; she was the mother of Onam.

verses.original: וַ/יִּהְי֥וּ בְנֵי רָ֖ם בְּכ֣וֹר יְרַחְמְאֵ֑ל מַ֥עַץ וְ/יָמִ֖ין וָ/עֵֽקֶר
verses.translit: vyhyv bny rm bkhvr yrchm'l m'ts vymyn v'qr
verses.translation: And the sons of Ram the firstborn of Jerahmeel were, Maaz, and Jamin, and Eker.

verses.original: וַ/יִּהְי֥וּ בְנֵי אוֹנָ֖ם שַׁמַּ֣י וְ/יָדָ֑ע וּ/בְנֵ֣י שַׁמַּ֔י נָדָ֖ב וַ/אֲבִישֽׁוּר
verses.translit: vyhyv bny 'vnm shmy vyd' vbny shmy ndb v'byshvr
verses.translation: And the sons of Onam were, Shammai, and Jada. And the sons of Shammai; Nadab, and Abishur.

verses.original: וְ/שֵׁ֛ם אֵ֥שֶׁת אֲבִישׁ֖וּר אֲבִיהָ֑יִל וַ/תֵּ֣לֶד ל֔/וֹ אֶת אַחְבָּ֖ן וְ/אֶת מוֹלִֽיד
verses.translit: vshm 'sht 'byshvr 'byhyl vtld lv 't 'chbn v't mvlyd
verses.translation: And the name of the wife of Abishur was Abihail, and she bare him Ahban, and Molid.

verses.original: וּ/בְנֵ֥י נָדָ֖ב סֶ֣לֶד וְ/אַפָּ֑יִם וַ/יָּ֥מָת סֶ֖לֶד לֹ֥א בָנִֽים
verses.translit: vbny ndb sld v'pym vymt sld l' bnym
verses.translation: And the sons of Nadab; Seled, and Appaim: but Seled died without children.

verses.original: וּ/בְנֵ֥י אַפַּ֖יִם יִשְׁעִ֑י וּ/בְנֵ֤י יִשְׁעִי֙ שֵׁשָׁ֔ן וּ/בְנֵ֥י שֵׁשָׁ֖ן אַחְלָֽי
verses.translit: vbny 'pym ysh'y vbny ysh'y shshn vbny shshn 'chly
verses.translation: And the sons of Appaim; Ishi. And the sons of Ishi; Sheshan. And the children of Sheshan; Ahlai.

verses.original: וּ/בְנֵ֤י יָדָע֙ אֲחִ֣י שַׁמַּ֔י יֶ֖תֶר וְ/יוֹנָתָ֑ן וַ/יָּ֥מָת יֶ֖תֶר לֹ֥א בָנִֽים
verses.translit: vbny yd' 'chy shmy ytr vyvntn vymt ytr l' bnym
verses.translation: And the sons of Jada the brother of Shammai; Jether, and Jonathan: and Jether died without children.

verses.original: וּ/בְנֵ֥י יוֹנָתָ֖ן פֶּ֣לֶת וְ/זָזָ֑א אֵ֥לֶּה הָי֖וּ בְּנֵ֥י יְרַחְמְאֵֽל
verses.translit: vbny yvntn plt vzz' 'lh hyv bny yrchm'l
verses.translation: And the sons of Jonathan; Peleth, and Zaza. These were the sons of Jerahmeel.

verses.original: וְ/לֹֽא הָיָ֧ה לְ/שֵׁשָׁ֛ן בָּנִ֖ים כִּ֣י אִם בָּנ֑וֹת וּ/לְ/שֵׁשָׁ֛ן עֶ֥בֶד מִצְרִ֖י וּ/שְׁמ֥/וֹ יַרְחָֽע
verses.translit: vl' hyh lshshn bnym khy 'm bnvt vlshshn 'bd mtsry vshmv yrch'
verses.translation: Now Sheshan had no sons, but daughters. And Sheshan had a servant, an Egyptian, whose name was Jarha.

verses.original: וַ/יִּתֵּ֨ן שֵׁשָׁ֧ן אֶת בִּתּ֛/וֹ לְ/יַרְחָ֥ע עַבְדּ֖/וֹ לְ/אִשָּׁ֑ה וַ/תֵּ֥לֶד ל֖/וֹ אֶת עַתָּֽי
verses.translit: vytn shshn 't btv lyrch' 'bdv l'shh vtld lv 't 'ty
verses.translation: And Sheshan gave his daughter to Jarha his servant to wife; and she bare him Attai.

verses.original: וְ/עַתַּי֙ הֹלִ֣יד אֶת נָתָ֔ן וְ/נָתָ֖ן הוֹלִ֥יד אֶת זָבָֽד
verses.translit: v'ty hlyd 't ntn vntn hvlyd 't zbd
verses.translation: And Attai begat Nathan, and Nathan begat Zabad,

verses.original: וְ/זָבָד֙ הוֹלִ֣יד אֶת אֶפְלָ֔ל וְ/אֶפְלָ֖ל הוֹלִ֥יד אֶת עוֹבֵֽד
verses.translit: vzbd hvlyd 't 'pll v'pll hvlyd 't 'vbd
verses.translation: And Zabad begat Ephlal, and Ephlal begat Obed,

verses.original: וְ/עוֹבֵד֙ הוֹלִ֣יד אֶת יֵה֔וּא וְ/יֵה֖וּא הוֹלִ֥יד אֶת עֲזַרְיָֽה
verses.translit: v'vbd hvlyd 't yhv' vyhv' hvlyd 't 'zryh
verses.translation: And Obed begat Jehu, and Jehu begat Azariah,

verses.original: וַ/עֲזַרְיָה֙ הֹלִ֣יד אֶת חָ֔לֶץ וְ/חֶ֖לֶץ הֹלִ֥יד אֶת אֶלְעָשָֽׂה
verses.translit: v'zryh hlyd 't chlts vchlts hlyd 't 'l'shh
verses.translation: And Azariah begat Helez, and Helez begat Eleasah,

verses.original: וְ/אֶלְעָשָׂה֙ הֹלִ֣יד אֶת סִֽסְמָ֔י וְ/סִסְמַ֖י הֹלִ֥יד אֶת שַׁלּֽוּם
verses.translit: v'l'shh hlyd 't ssmy vssmy hlyd 't shlvm
verses.translation: And Eleasah begat Sisamai, and Sisamai begat Shallum,

verses.original: וְ/שַׁלּוּם֙ הוֹלִ֣יד אֶת יְקַמְיָ֔ה וִֽ/יקַמְיָ֖ה הֹלִ֥יד אֶת אֱלִישָׁמָֽע
verses.translit: vshlvm hvlyd 't yqmyh vyqmyh hlyd 't 'lyshm'
verses.translation: And Shallum begat Jekamiah, and Jekamiah begat Elishama.

verses.original: וּ/בְנֵ֤י כָלֵב֙ אֲחִ֣י יְרַחְמְאֵ֔ל מֵישָׁ֥ע בְּכֹר֖/וֹ ה֣וּא אֲבִי זִ֑יף וּ/בְנֵ֥י מָרֵשָׁ֖ה אֲבִ֥י חֶבְרֽוֹן
verses.translit: vbny khlb 'chy yrchm'l mysh' bkhrv hv' 'by zyf vbny mrshh 'by chbrvn
verses.translation: Now the sons of Caleb the brother of Jerahmeel were , Mesha his firstborn, which was the father of Ziph; and the sons of Mareshah the father of Hebron.

verses.original: וּ/בְנֵ֖י חֶבְר֑וֹן קֹ֥רַח וְ/תַפֻּ֖חַ וְ/רֶ֥קֶם וָ/שָֽׁמַע
verses.translit: vbny chbrvn qrch vtpch vrqm vshm'
verses.translation: And the sons of Hebron; Korah, and Tappuah, and Rekem, and Shema.

verses.original: וְ/שֶׁ֣מַע הוֹלִ֔יד אֶת רַ֖חַם אֲבִ֣י יָרְקֳעָ֑ם וְ/רֶ֖קֶם הוֹלִ֥יד אֶת שַׁמָּֽי
verses.translit: vshm' hvlyd 't rchm 'by yrq'm vrqm hvlyd 't shmy
verses.translation: And Shema begat Raham, the father of Jorkoam: and Rekem begat Shammai.

verses.original: וּ/בֶן שַׁמַּ֖י מָע֑וֹן וּ/מָע֖וֹן אֲבִ֥י בֵֽית צֽוּר
verses.translit: vbn shmy m'vn vm'vn 'by byt tsvr
verses.translation: And the son of Shammai was Maon: and Maon was the father of Beth-zur.

verses.original: וְ/עֵיפָה֙ פִּילֶ֣גֶשׁ כָּלֵ֔ב יָֽלְדָ֛ה אֶת חָרָ֥ן וְ/אֶת מוֹצָ֖א וְ/אֶת גָּזֵ֑ז וְ/חָרָ֖ן הֹלִ֥יד אֶת גָּזֵֽז
verses.translit: v'yph pylgsh khlb yldh 't chrn v't mvts' v't gzz vchrn hlyd 't gzz
verses.translation: And Ephah, Caleb’s concubine, bare Haran, and Moza, and Gazez: and Haran begat Gazez.

verses.original: וּ/בְנֵ֖י יָהְדָּ֑י רֶ֧גֶם וְ/יוֹתָ֛ם וְ/גֵישָׁ֥ן וָ/פֶ֖לֶט וְ/עֵיפָ֥ה וָ/שָֽׁעַף
verses.translit: vbny yhdy rgm vyvtm vgyshn vplt v'yph vsh'f
verses.translation: And the sons of Jahdai; Regem, and Jotham, and Geshan, and Pelet, and Ephah, and Shaaph.

verses.original: פִּלֶ֤גֶשׁ כָּלֵב֙ מַעֲכָ֔ה יָ֥לַד שֶׁ֖בֶר וְ/אֶֽת תִּרְחֲנָֽה
verses.translit: plgsh khlb m'khh yld shbr v't trchnh
verses.translation: Maachah, Caleb’s concubine, bare Sheber, and Tirhanah.

verses.original: וַ/תֵּ֗לֶד שַׁ֚עַף אֲבִ֣י מַדְמַנָּ֔ה אֶת שְׁוָ֛א אֲבִ֥י מַכְבֵּנָ֖ה וַ/אֲבִ֣י גִבְעָ֑א וּ/בַת כָּלֵ֖ב עַכְסָֽה
verses.translit: vtld sh'f 'by mdmnh 't shv' 'by mkhbnh v'by gb'' vbt khlb 'khsh
verses.translation: She bare also Shaaph the father of Madmannah, Sheva the father of Machbenah, and the father of Gibea: and the daughter of Caleb was Achsah.

verses.original: אֵ֤לֶּה הָיוּ֙ בְּנֵ֣י כָלֵ֔ב בֶּן ח֖וּר בְּכ֣וֹר אֶפְרָ֑תָה שׁוֹבָ֕ל אֲבִ֖י קִרְיַ֥ת יְעָרִֽים
verses.translit: 'lh hyv bny khlb bn chvr bkhvr 'prth shvbl 'by qryt y'rym
verses.translation: These were the sons of Caleb the son of Hur, the firstborn of Ephratah; Shobal the father of Kirjath-jearim,

verses.original: שַׂלְמָא֙ אֲבִ֣י בֵֽית לָ֔חֶם חָרֵ֖ף אֲבִ֥י בֵית גָּדֵֽר
verses.translit: shlm' 'by byt lchm chrf 'by byt gdr
verses.translation: Salma the father of Beth-lehem, Hareph the father of Beth-gader.

verses.original: וַ/יִּהְי֤וּ בָנִים֙ לְ/שׁוֹבָ֔ל אֲבִ֖י קִרְיַ֣ת יְעָרִ֑ים הָרֹאֶ֖ה חֲצִ֥י הַ/מְּנֻחֽוֹת
verses.translit: vyhyv bnym lshvbl 'by qryt y'rym hr'h chtsy hmnchvt
verses.translation: And Shobal the father of Kirjath-jearim had sons; Haroeh, and half of the Manahethites.

verses.original: וּ/מִשְׁפְּחוֹת֙ קִרְיַ֣ת יְעָרִ֔ים הַ/יִּתְרִי֙ וְ/הַ/פּוּתִ֔י וְ/הַ/שֻּׁמָתִ֖י וְ/הַ/מִּשְׁרָעִ֑י מֵ/אֵ֗לֶּה יָצְאוּ֙ הַ/צָּ֣רְעָתִ֔י וְ/הָ/אֶשְׁתָּ֖אֻֽלִֽי
verses.translit: vmshpchvt qryt y'rym hytry vhpvty vhshmty vhmshr'y m'lh yts'v htsr'ty vh'sht'ly
verses.translation: And the families of Kirjath-jearim; the Ithrites, and the Puhites, and the Shumathites, and the Mishraites; of them came the Zareathites, and the Eshtaulites.

verses.original: בְּנֵ֣י שַׂלְמָ֗א בֵּ֥ית לֶ֨חֶם֙ וּ/נְט֣וֹפָתִ֔י עַטְר֖וֹת בֵּ֣ית יוֹאָ֑ב וַ/חֲצִ֥י הַ/מָּנַחְתִּ֖י הַ/צָּרְעִֽי
verses.translit: bny shlm' byt lchm vntvpty 'trvt byt yv'b vchtsy hmnchty htsr'y
verses.translation: The sons of Salma; Beth-lehem, and the Netophathites, Ataroth, the house of Joab, and half of the Manahethites, the Zorites.

verses.original: וּ/מִשְׁפְּח֤וֹת סֹפְרִים֙ ישבו יֹשְׁבֵ֣י יַעְבֵּ֔ץ תִּרְעָתִ֥ים שִׁמְעָתִ֖ים שׂוּכָתִ֑ים הֵ֚מָּה הַ/קִּינִ֣ים הַ/בָּאִ֔ים מֵ/חַמַּ֖ת אֲבִ֥י בֵית רֵכָֽב
verses.translit: vmshpchvt sprym yshbv yshby y'bts tr'tym shm'tym shvkhtym hmh hqynym hb'ym mchmt 'by byt rkhb
verses.translation: And the families of the scribes which dwelt at Jabez; the Tirathites, the Shimeathites, and Suchathites. These are the Kenites that came of Hemath, the father of the house of Rechab.

verses.original: וְ/אֵ֤לֶּה הָיוּ֙ בְּנֵ֣י דָויִ֔ד אֲשֶׁ֥ר נֽוֹלַד ל֖/וֹ בְּ/חֶבְר֑וֹן הַ/בְּכ֣וֹר אַמְנֹ֗ן לַ/אֲחִינֹ֨עַם֙ הַ/יִּזְרְעֵאלִ֔ית שֵׁנִי֙ דָּנִיֵּ֔אל לַ/אֲבִיגַ֖יִל הַֽ/כַּרְמְלִֽית
verses.translit: v'lh hyv bny dvyd 'shr nvld lv bchbrvn hbkhvr 'mnn l'chyn'm hyzr''lyt shny dny'l l'bygyl hkhrmlyt
verses.translation: Now these were the sons of David, which were born unto him in Hebron; the firstborn Amnon, of Ahinoam the Jezreelitess; the second Daniel, of Abigail the Carmelitess:

verses.original: הַ/שְּׁלִשִׁי֙ לְ/אַבְשָׁל֣וֹם בֶּֽן מַעֲכָ֔ה בַּת תַּלְמַ֖י מֶ֣לֶךְ גְּשׁ֑וּר הָ/רְבִיעִ֖י אֲדֹנִיָּ֥ה בֶן חַגִּֽית
verses.translit: hshlshy l'bshlvm bn m'khh bt tlmy mlkh gshvr hrby'y 'dnyh bn chgyt
verses.translation: The third, Absalom the son of Maachah the daughter of Talmai king of Geshur: the fourth, Adonijah the son of Haggith:

verses.original: הַ/חֲמִישִׁ֥י שְׁפַטְיָ֖ה לַ/אֲבִיטָ֑ל הַ/שִּׁשִּׁ֥י יִתְרְעָ֖ם לְ/עֶגְלָ֥ה אִשְׁתּֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: hchmyshy shptyh l'bytl hshshy ytr'm l'glh 'shtv
verses.translation: The fifth, Shephatiah of Abital: the sixth, Ithream by Eglah his wife.

verses.original: שִׁשָּׁה֙ נֽוֹלַד ל֣/וֹ בְ/חֶבְר֔וֹן וַ/יִּ֨מְלָךְ שָׁ֔ם שֶׁ֥בַע שָׁנִ֖ים וְ/שִׁשָּׁ֣ה חֳדָשִׁ֑ים וּ/שְׁלֹשִׁ֤ים וְ/שָׁלוֹשׁ֙ שָׁנָ֔ה מָלַ֖ךְ בִּ/ירוּשָׁלִָֽם
verses.translit: shshh nvld lv bchbrvn vymlkh shm shb' shnym vshshh chdshym vshlshym vshlvsh shnh mlkh byrvshlm
verses.translation: These six were born unto him in Hebron; and there he reigned seven years and six months: and in Jerusalem he reigned thirty and three years.

verses.original: וְ/אֵ֥לֶּה נוּלְּדוּ ל֖/וֹ בִּ/ירוּשָׁלָ֑יִם שִׁ֠מְעָא וְ/שׁוֹבָ֞ב וְ/נָתָ֤ן וּ/שְׁלֹמֹה֙ אַרְבָּעָ֔ה לְ/בַת שׁ֖וּעַ בַּת עַמִּיאֵֽל
verses.translit: v'lh nvldv lv byrvshlym shm'' vshvbb vntn vshlmh 'rb'h lbt shv' bt 'my'l
verses.translation: And these were born unto him in Jerusalem; Shimea, and Shobab, and Nathan, and Solomon, four, of Bath-shua the daughter of Ammiel:

verses.original: וְ/יִבְחָ֥ר וֶ/אֱלִישָׁמָ֖ע וֶ/אֱלִיפָֽלֶט
verses.translit: vybchr v'lyshm' v'lyplt
verses.translation: Ibhar also, and Elishama, and Eliphelet,

verses.original: וְ/נֹ֥גַהּ וְ/נֶ֖פֶג וְ/יָפִֽיעַ
verses.translit: vngh vnpg vypy'
verses.translation: And Nogah, and Nepheg, and Japhia,

verses.original: וֶ/אֱלִישָׁמָ֧ע וְ/אֶלְיָדָ֛ע וֶ/אֱלִיפֶ֖לֶט תִּשְׁעָֽה
verses.translit: v'lyshm' v'lyd' v'lyplt tsh'h
verses.translation: And Elishama, and Eliada, and Eliphelet, nine.

verses.original: כֹּ֖ל בְּנֵ֣י דָוִ֑יד מִ/לְּ/בַ֥ד בְּֽנֵי פִֽילַגְשִׁ֖ים וְ/תָמָ֥ר אֲחוֹתָֽ/ם
verses.translit: khl bny dvyd mlbd bny pylgshym vtmr 'chvtm
verses.translation: These were all the sons of David, beside the sons of the concubines, and Tamar their sister.

verses.original: וּ/בֶן שְׁלֹמֹ֖ה רְחַבְעָ֑ם אֲבִיָּ֥ה בְנ֛/וֹ אָסָ֥א בְנ֖/וֹ יְהוֹשָׁפָ֥ט בְּנֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: vbn shlmh rchb'm 'byh bnv 's' bnv yhvshpt bnv
verses.translation: And Solomon’s son was Rehoboam, Abia his son, Asa his son, Jehoshaphat his son,

verses.original: יוֹרָ֥ם בְּנ֛/וֹ אֲחַזְיָ֥הוּ בְנ֖/וֹ יוֹאָ֥שׁ בְּנֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: yvrm bnv 'chzyhv bnv yv'sh bnv
verses.translation: Joram his son, Ahaziah his son, Joash his son,

verses.original: אֲמַצְיָ֧הוּ בְנ֛/וֹ עֲזַרְיָ֥ה בְנ֖/וֹ יוֹתָ֥ם בְּנֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: 'mtsyhv bnv 'zryh bnv yvtm bnv
verses.translation: Amaziah his son, Azariah his son, Jotham his son,

verses.original: אָחָ֥ז בְּנ֛/וֹ חִזְקִיָּ֥הוּ בְנ֖/וֹ מְנַשֶּׁ֥ה בְנֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: 'chz bnv chzqyhv bnv mnshh bnv
verses.translation: Ahaz his son, Hezekiah his son, Manasseh his son,

verses.original: אָמ֥וֹן בְּנ֖/וֹ יֹאשִׁיָּ֥הוּ בְנֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: 'mvn bnv y'shyhv bnv
verses.translation: Amon his son, Josiah his son.

verses.original: וּ/בְנֵי֙ יֹאשִׁיָּ֔הוּ הַ/בְּכוֹר֙ יוֹחָנָ֔ן הַ/שֵּׁנִ֖י יְהוֹיָקִ֑ים הַ/שְּׁלִשִׁי֙ צִדְקִיָּ֔הוּ הָ/רְבִיעִ֖י שַׁלּֽוּם
verses.translit: vbny y'shyhv hbkhvr yvchnn hshny yhvyqym hshlshy tsdqyhv hrby'y shlvm
verses.translation: And the sons of Josiah were , the firstborn Johanan, the second Jehoiakim, the third Zedekiah, the fourth Shallum.

verses.original: וּ/בְנֵ֖י יְהוֹיָקִ֑ים יְכָנְיָ֥ה בְנ֖/וֹ צִדְקִיָּ֥ה בְנֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: vbny yhvyqym ykhnyh bnv tsdqyh bnv
verses.translation: And the sons of Jehoiakim: Jeconiah his son, Zedekiah his son.

verses.original: וּ/בְנֵי֙ יְכָנְיָ֣ה אַסִּ֔ר שְׁאַלְתִּיאֵ֖ל בְּנֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: vbny ykhnyh 'sr sh'lty'l bnv
verses.translation: And the sons of Jeconiah; Assir, Salathiel his son,

verses.original: וּ/מַלְכִּירָ֥ם וּ/פְדָיָ֖ה וְ/שֶׁנְאַצַּ֑ר יְקַמְיָ֥ה הוֹשָׁמָ֖ע וּ/נְדַבְיָֽה
verses.translit: vmlkhyrm vpdyh vshn'tsr yqmyh hvshm' vndbyh
verses.translation: Malchiram also, and Pedaiah, and Shenazar, Jecamiah, Hoshama, and Nedabiah.

verses.original: וּ/בְנֵ֣י פְדָיָ֔ה זְרֻבָּבֶ֖ל וְ/שִׁמְעִ֑י וּ/בֶן זְרֻבָּבֶל֙ מְשֻׁלָּ֣ם וַ/חֲנַנְיָ֔ה וּ/שְׁלֹמִ֖ית אֲחוֹתָֽ/ם
verses.translit: vbny pdyh zrbbl vshm'y vbn zrbbl mshlm vchnnyh vshlmyt 'chvtm
verses.translation: And the sons of Pedaiah were , Zerubbabel, and Shimei: and the sons of Zerubbabel; Meshullam, and Hananiah, and Shelomith their sister:

verses.original: וַ/חֲשֻׁבָ֡ה וָ֠/אֹהֶל וּ/בֶרֶכְיָ֧ה וַֽ/חֲסַדְיָ֛ה י֥וּשַׁב חֶ֖סֶד חָמֵֽשׁ
verses.translit: vchshbh v'hl vbrkhyh vchsdyh yvshb chsd chmsh
verses.translation: And Hashubah, and Ohel, and Berechiah, and Hasadiah, Jushab-hesed, five.

verses.original: וּ/בֶן חֲנַנְיָ֖ה פְּלַטְיָ֣ה וִ/ישַֽׁעְיָ֑ה בְּנֵ֤י רְפָיָה֙ בְּנֵ֣י אַרְנָ֔ן בְּנֵ֥י עֹבַדְיָ֖ה בְּנֵ֥י שְׁכַנְיָֽה
verses.translit: vbn chnnyh pltyh vysh'yh bny rpyh bny 'rnn bny 'bdyh bny shkhnyh
verses.translation: And the sons of Hananiah; Pelatiah, and Jesaiah: the sons of Rephaiah, the sons of Arnan, the sons of Obadiah, the sons of Shechaniah.

verses.original: וּ/בְנֵ֥י שְׁכַנְיָ֖ה שְׁמַעְיָ֑ה וּ/בְנֵ֣י שְׁמַעְיָ֗ה חַטּ֡וּשׁ וְ֠/יִגְאָל וּ/בָרִ֧יחַ וּ/נְעַרְיָ֛ה וְ/שָׁפָ֖ט שִׁשָּֽׁה
verses.translit: vbny shkhnyh shm'yh vbny shm'yh chtvsh vyg'l vbrych vn'ryh vshpt shshh
verses.translation: And the sons of Shechaniah; Shemaiah: and the sons of Shemaiah; Hattush, and Igeal, and Bariah, and Neariah, and Shaphat, six.

verses.original: וּ/בֶן נְעַרְיָ֗ה אֶלְיוֹעֵינַ֧י וְ/חִזְקִיָּ֛ה וְ/עַזְרִיקָ֖ם שְׁלֹשָֽׁה
verses.translit: vbn n'ryh 'lyv'yny vchzqyh v'zryqm shlshh
verses.translation: And the sons of Neariah; Elioenai, and Hezekiah, and Azrikam, three.

verses.original: וּ/בְנֵ֣י אֶלְיוֹעֵינַ֗י הדיוהו הוֹדַוְיָ֡הוּ וְ/אֶלְיָשִׁ֡יב וּ/פְלָיָ֡ה וְ֠/עַקּוּב וְ/יוֹחָנָ֧ן וּ/דְלָיָ֛ה וַ/עֲנָ֖נִי שִׁבְעָֽה
verses.translit: vbny 'lyv'yny hdyvhv hvdvyhv v'lyshyb vplyh v'qvb vyvchnn vdlyh v'nny shb'h
verses.translation: And the sons of Elioenai were , Hodaiah, and Eliashib, and Pelaiah, and Akkub, and Johanan, and Dalaiah, and Anani, seven.

verses.original: בְּנֵ֖י יְהוּדָ֑ה פֶּ֧רֶץ חֶצְר֛וֹן וְ/כַרְמִ֖י וְ/ח֥וּר וְ/שׁוֹבָֽל
verses.translit: bny yhvdh prts chtsrvn vkhrmy vchvr vshvbl
verses.translation: The sons of Judah; Pharez, Hezron, and Carmi, and Hur, and Shobal.

verses.original: וּ/רְאָיָ֤ה בֶן שׁוֹבָל֙ הוֹלִ֣יד אֶת יַ֔חַת וְ/יַ֣חַת הֹלִ֔יד אֶת אֲחוּמַ֖י וְ/אֶת לָ֑הַד אֵ֖לֶּה מִשְׁפְּח֥וֹת הַ/צָּֽרְעָתִֽי
verses.translit: vr'yh bn shvbl hvlyd 't ycht vycht hlyd 't 'chvmy v't lhd 'lh mshpchvt htsr'ty
verses.translation: And Reaiah the son of Shobal begat Jahath; and Jahath begat Ahumai, and Lahad. These are the families of the Zorathites.

verses.original: וְ/אֵ֨לֶּה֙ אֲבִ֣י עֵיטָ֔ם יִזְרְעֶ֥אל וְ/יִשְׁמָ֖א וְ/יִדְבָּ֑שׁ וְ/שֵׁ֥ם אֲחוֹתָ֖/ם הַצְלֶלְפּֽוֹנִי
verses.translit: v'lh 'by 'ytm yzr''l vyshm' vydbsh vshm 'chvtm htsllpvny
verses.translation: And these were of the father of Etam; Jezreel, and Ishma, and Idbash: and the name of their sister was Hazelelponi:

verses.original: וּ/פְנוּאֵל֙ אֲבִ֣י גְדֹ֔ר וְ/עֵ֖זֶר אֲבִ֣י חוּשָׁ֑ה אֵ֤לֶּה בְנֵי חוּר֙ בְּכ֣וֹר אֶפְרָ֔תָה אֲבִ֖י בֵּ֥ית לָֽחֶם
verses.translit: vpnv'l 'by gdr v'zr 'by chvshh 'lh bny chvr bkhvr 'prth 'by byt lchm
verses.translation: And Penuel the father of Gedor, and Ezer the father of Hushah. These are the sons of Hur, the firstborn of Ephratah, the father of Beth-lehem.

verses.original: וּ/לְ/אַשְׁחוּר֙ אֲבִ֣י תְק֔וֹעַ הָי֖וּ שְׁתֵּ֣י נָשִׁ֑ים חֶלְאָ֖ה וְ/נַעֲרָֽה
verses.translit: vl'shchvr 'by tqv' hyv shty nshym chl'h vn'rh
verses.translation: And Ashur the father of Tekoa had two wives, Helah and Naarah.

verses.original: וַ/תֵּ֨לֶד ל֤/וֹ נַעֲרָה֙ אֶת אֲחֻזָּ֣ם וְ/אֶת חֵ֔פֶר וְ/אֶת תֵּימְנִ֖י וְ/אֶת הָ/אֲחַשְׁתָּרִ֑י אֵ֖לֶּה בְּנֵ֥י נַעֲרָֽה
verses.translit: vtld lv n'rh 't 'chzm v't chpr v't tymny v't h'chshtry 'lh bny n'rh
verses.translation: And Naarah bare him Ahuzam, and Hepher, and Temeni, and Haahashtari. These were the sons of Naarah.

verses.original: וּ/בְנֵ֖י חֶלְאָ֑ה צֶ֥רֶת יצחר וְ/צֹ֖חַר וְ/אֶתְנָֽן
verses.translit: vbny chl'h tsrt ytschr vtschr v'tnn
verses.translation: And the sons of Helah were , Zereth, and Jezoar, and Ethnan.

verses.original: וְ/ק֣וֹץ הוֹלִ֔יד אֶת עָנ֖וּב וְ/אֶת הַ/צֹּבֵבָ֑ה וּ/מִשְׁפְּח֥וֹת אֲחַרְחֵ֖ל בֶּן הָרֽוּם
verses.translit: vqvts hvlyd 't 'nvb v't htsbbh vmshpchvt 'chrchl bn hrvm
verses.translation: And Coz begat Anub, and Zobebah, and the families of Aharhel the son of Harum.

verses.original: וַ/יְהִ֣י יַעְבֵּ֔ץ נִכְבָּ֖ד מֵ/אֶחָ֑י/ו וְ/אִמּ֗/וֹ קָרְאָ֨ה שְׁמ֤/וֹ יַעְבֵּץ֙ לֵ/אמֹ֔ר כִּ֥י יָלַ֖דְתִּי בְּ/עֹֽצֶב
verses.translit: vyhy y'bts nkhbd m'chyv v'mv qr'h shmv y'bts l'mr khy yldty b'tsb
verses.translation: And Jabez was more honourable than his brethren: and his mother called his name Jabez, saying, Because I bare him with sorrow.

verses.original: וַ/יִּקְרָ֣א יַ֠עְבֵּץ לֵ/אלֹהֵ֨י יִשְׂרָאֵ֜ל לֵ/אמֹ֗ר אִם בָּרֵ֨ךְ תְּבָרֲכֵ֜/נִי וְ/הִרְבִּ֤יתָ אֶת גְּבוּלִ/י֙ וְ/הָיְתָ֤ה יָדְ/ךָ֙ עִמִּ֔/י וְ/עָשִׂ֥יתָ מֵּ/רָעָ֖ה לְ/בִלְתִּ֣י עָצְבִּ֑/י וַ/יָּבֵ֥א אֱלֹהִ֖ים אֵ֥ת אֲשֶׁר שָׁאָֽל
verses.translit: vyqr' y'bts l'lhy yshr'l l'mr 'm brkh tbrkhny vhrbyt 't gbvly vhyth ydkh 'my v'shyt mr'h lblty 'tsby vyb' 'lhym 't 'shr sh'l
verses.translation: And Jabez called on the God of Israel, saying, Oh that thou wouldest bless me indeed, and enlarge my coast, and that thine hand might be with me, and that thou wouldest keep me from evil, that it may not grieve me! And God granted him that which he requested.

verses.original: וּ/כְל֥וּב אֲחִֽי שׁוּחָ֖ה הוֹלִ֣יד אֶת מְחִ֑יר ה֖וּא אֲבִ֥י אֶשְׁתּֽוֹן
verses.translit: vkhlvb 'chy shvchh hvlyd 't mchyr hv' 'by 'shtvn
verses.translation: And Chelub the brother of Shuah begat Mehir, which was the father of Eshton.

verses.original: וְ/אֶשְׁתּ֗וֹן הוֹלִ֞יד אֶת בֵּ֤ית רָפָא֙ וְ/אֶת פָּסֵ֔חַ וְ/אֶת תְּחִנָּ֖ה אֲבִ֣י עִ֣יר נָחָ֑שׁ אֵ֖לֶּה אַנְשֵׁ֥י רֵכָֽה
verses.translit: v'shtvn hvlyd 't byt rp' v't psch v't tchnh 'by 'yr nchsh 'lh 'nshy rkhh
verses.translation: And Eshton begat Beth-rapha, and Paseah, and Tehinnah the father of Ir-nahash. These are the men of Rechah.

verses.original: וּ/בְנֵ֣י קְנַ֔ז עָתְנִיאֵ֖ל וּ/שְׂרָיָ֑ה וּ/בְנֵ֥י עָתְנִיאֵ֖ל חֲתַֽת
verses.translit: vbny qnz 'tny'l vshryh vbny 'tny'l chtt
verses.translation: And the sons of Kenaz; Othniel, and Seraiah: and the sons of Othniel; Hathath.

verses.original: וּ/מְעוֹנֹתַ֖י הוֹלִ֣יד אֶת עָפְרָ֑ה וּ/שְׂרָיָ֗ה הוֹלִ֤יד אֶת יוֹאָב֙ אֲבִי֙ גֵּ֣יא חֲרָשִׁ֔ים כִּ֥י חֲרָשִׁ֖ים הָיֽוּ
verses.translit: vm'vnty hvlyd 't 'prh vshryh hvlyd 't yv'b 'by gy' chrshym khy chrshym hyv
verses.translation: And Meonothai begat Ophrah: and Seraiah begat Joab, the father of the valley of Charashim; for they were craftsmen.

verses.original: וּ/בְנֵי֙ כָּלֵ֣ב בֶּן יְפֻנֶּ֔ה עִ֥ירוּ אֵלָ֖ה וָ/נָ֑עַם וּ/בְנֵ֥י אֵלָ֖ה וּ/קְנַֽז
verses.translit: vbny khlb bn ypnh 'yrv 'lh vn'm vbny 'lh vqnz
verses.translation: And the sons of Caleb the son of Jephunneh; Iru, Elah, and Naam: and the sons of Elah, even Kenaz.

verses.original: וּ/בְנֵ֖י יְהַלֶּלְאֵ֑ל זִ֣יף וְ/זִיפָ֔ה תִּירְיָ֖א וַ/אֲשַׂרְאֵֽל
verses.translit: vbny yhll'l zyf vzyph tyry' v'shr'l
verses.translation: And the sons of Jehaleleel; Ziph, and Ziphah, Tiria, and Asareel.

verses.original: וּ/בֶן עֶזְרָ֔ה יֶ֥תֶר וּ/מֶ֖רֶד וְ/עֵ֣פֶר וְ/יָל֑וֹן וַ/תַּ֨הַר֙ אֶת מִרְיָ֣ם וְ/אֶת שַׁמַּ֔י וְ/אֶת יִשְׁבָּ֖ח אֲבִ֥י אֶשְׁתְּמֹֽעַ
verses.translit: vbn 'zrh ytr vmrd v'pr vylvn vthr 't mrym v't shmy v't yshbch 'by 'shtm'
verses.translation: And the sons of Ezra were , Jether, and Mered, and Epher, and Jalon: and she bare Miriam, and Shammai, and Ishbah the father of Eshtemoa.

verses.original: וְ/אִשְׁתּ֣/וֹ הַ/יְהֻדִיָּ֗ה יָלְדָ֞ה אֶת יֶ֨רֶד אֲבִ֤י גְדוֹר֙ וְ/אֶת חֶ֨בֶר֙ אֲבִ֣י שׂוֹכ֔וֹ וְ/אֶת יְקֽוּתִיאֵ֖ל אֲבִ֣י זָנ֑וֹחַ וְ/אֵ֗לֶּה בְּנֵי֙ בִּתְיָ֣ה בַת פַּרְעֹ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר לָקַ֖ח מָֽרֶד
verses.translit: v'shtv hyhdyh yldh 't yrd 'by gdvr v't chbr 'by shvkhv v't yqvty'l 'by znvch v'lh bny btyh bt pr'h 'shr lqch mrd
verses.translation: And his wife Jehudijah bare Jered the father of Gedor, and Heber the father of Socho, and Jekuthiel the father of Zanoah. And these are the sons of Bithiah the daughter of Pharaoh, which Mered took.

verses.original: וּ/בְנֵי֙ אֵ֣שֶׁת הֽוֹדִיָּ֔ה אֲח֣וֹת נַ֔חַם אֲבִ֥י קְעִילָ֖ה הַ/גַּרְמִ֑י וְ/אֶשְׁתְּמֹ֖עַ הַ/מַּעֲכָתִֽי
verses.translit: vbny 'sht hvdyh 'chvt nchm 'by q'ylh hgrmy v'shtm' hm'khty
verses.translation: And the sons of his wife Hodiah the sister of Naham, the father of Keilah the Garmite, and Eshtemoa the Maachathite.

verses.original: וּ/בְנֵ֣י שִׁימ֔וֹן אַמְנ֣וֹן וְ/רִנָּ֔ה בֶּן חָנָ֖ן ו/תולון וְ/תִיל֑וֹן וּ/בְנֵ֣י יִשְׁעִ֔י זוֹחֵ֖ת וּ/בֶן זוֹחֵֽת
verses.translit: vbny shymvn 'mnvn vrnh bn chnn vtvlvn vtylvn vbny ysh'y zvcht vbn zvcht
verses.translation: And the sons of Shimon were , Amnon, and Rinnah, Ben-hanan, and Tilon. And the sons of Ishi were , Zoheth, and Ben-zoheth.

verses.original: בְּנֵי֙ שֵׁלָ֣ה בֶן יְהוּדָ֔ה עֵ֚ר אֲבִ֣י לֵכָ֔ה וְ/לַעְדָּ֖ה אֲבִ֣י מָרֵשָׁ֑ה וּ/מִשְׁפְּח֛וֹת בֵּית עֲבֹדַ֥ת הַ/בֻּ֖ץ לְ/בֵ֥ית אַשְׁבֵּֽעַ
verses.translit: bny shlh bn yhvdh 'r 'by lkhh vl'dh 'by mrshh vmshpchvt byt 'bdt hbts lbyt 'shb'
verses.translation: The sons of Shelah the son of Judah were , Er the father of Lecah, and Laadah the father of Mareshah, and the families of the house of them that wrought fine linen, of the house of Ashbea,

verses.original: וְ/יוֹקִ֞ים וְ/אַנְשֵׁ֣י כֹזֵבָ֗א וְ/יוֹאָ֧שׁ וְ/שָׂרָ֛ף אֲשֶׁר בָּעֲל֥וּ לְ/מוֹאָ֖ב וְ/יָשֻׁ֣בִי לָ֑חֶם וְ/הַ/דְּבָרִ֖ים עַתִּיקִֽים
verses.translit: vyvqym v'nshy khzb' vyv'sh vshrf 'shr b'lv lmv'b vyshby lchm vhdbrym 'tyqym
verses.translation: And Jokim, and the men of Chozeba, and Joash, and Saraph, who had the dominion in Moab, and Jashubi-lehem. And these are ancient things.

verses.original: הֵ֚מָּה הַ/יּ֣וֹצְרִ֔ים וְ/יֹשְׁבֵ֥י נְטָעִ֖ים וּ/גְדֵרָ֑ה עִם הַ/מֶּ֥לֶךְ בִּ/מְלַאכְתּ֖/וֹ יָ֥שְׁבוּ שָֽׁם
verses.translit: hmh hyvtsrym vyshby nt'ym vgdrh 'm hmlkh bml'khtv yshbv shm
verses.translation: These were the potters, and those that dwelt among plants and hedges: there they dwelt with the king for his work.

verses.original: בְּנֵ֖י שִׁמְע֑וֹן נְמוּאֵ֣ל וְ/יָמִ֔ין יָרִ֖יב זֶ֥רַח שָׁאֽוּל
verses.translit: bny shm'vn nmv'l vymyn yryb zrch sh'vl
verses.translation: The sons of Simeon were , Nemuel, and Jamin, Jarib, Zerah, and Shaul:

verses.original: שַׁלֻּ֥ם בְּנ֛/וֹ מִבְשָׂ֥ם בְּנ֖/וֹ מִשְׁמָ֥ע בְּנֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: shlm bnv mbshm bnv mshm' bnv
verses.translation: Shallum his son, Mibsam his son, Mishma his son.

verses.original: וּ/בְנֵ֖י מִשְׁמָ֑ע חַמּוּאֵ֥ל בְּנ֛/וֹ זַכּ֥וּר בְּנ֖/וֹ שִׁמְעִ֥י בְנֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: vbny mshm' chmv'l bnv zkhvr bnv shm'y bnv
verses.translation: And the sons of Mishma; Hamuel his son, Zacchur his son, Shimei his son.

verses.original: וּ/לְ/שִׁמְעִ֞י בָּנִ֨ים שִׁשָּׁ֤ה עָשָׂר֙ וּ/בָנ֣וֹת שֵׁ֔שׁ וּ/לְ/אֶחָ֕י/ו אֵ֖ין בָּנִ֣ים רַבִּ֑ים וְ/כֹל֙ מִשְׁפַּחְתָּ֔/ם לֹ֥א הִרְבּ֖וּ עַד בְּנֵ֥י יְהוּדָֽה
verses.translit: vlshm'y bnym shshh 'shr vbnvt shsh vl'chyv 'yn bnym rbym vkhl mshpchtm l' hrbv 'd bny yhvdh
verses.translation: And Shimei had sixteen sons and six daughters; but his brethren had not many children, neither did all their family multiply, like to the children of Judah.

verses.original: וַ/יֵּֽשְׁב֛וּ בִּ/בְאֵֽר שֶׁ֥בַע וּ/מוֹלָדָ֖ה וַ/חֲצַ֥ר שׁוּעָֽל
verses.translit: vyshbv bb'r shb' vmvldh vchtsr shv'l
verses.translation: And they dwelt at Beer-sheba, and Moladah, and Hazar-shual,

verses.original: וּ/בְ/בִלְהָ֥ה וּ/בְ/עֶ֖צֶם וּ/בְ/תוֹלָֽד
verses.translit: vbblhh vb'tsm vbtvld
verses.translation: And at Bilhah, and at Ezem, and at Tolad,

verses.original: וּ/בִ/בְתוּאֵ֥ל וּ/בְ/חָרְמָ֖ה וּ/בְ/צִֽיקְלָֽג
verses.translit: vbbtv'l vbchrmh vbtsyqlg
verses.translation: And at Bethuel, and at Hormah, and at Ziklag,

verses.original: וּ/בְ/בֵ֤ית מַרְכָּבוֹת֙ וּ/בַ/חֲצַ֣ר סוּסִ֔ים וּ/בְ/בֵ֥ית בִּרְאִ֖י וּֽ/בְ/שַׁעֲרָ֑יִם אֵ֥לֶּה עָרֵי/הֶ֖ם עַד מְלֹ֥ךְ דָּוִֽיד
verses.translit: vbbyt mrkhbvt vbchtsr svsym vbbyt br'y vbsh'rym 'lh 'ryhm 'd mlkh dvyd
verses.translation: And at Beth-marcaboth, and Hazar-susim, and at Beth-birei, and at Shaaraim. These were their cities unto the reign of David.

verses.original: וְ/חַצְרֵי/הֶם֙ עֵיטָ֣ם וָ/עַ֔יִן רִמּ֥וֹן וְ/תֹ֖כֶן וְ/עָשָׁ֑ן עָרִ֖ים חָמֵֽשׁ
verses.translit: vchtsryhm 'ytm v'yn rmvn vtkhn v'shn 'rym chmsh
verses.translation: And their villages were , Etam, and Ain, Rimmon, and Tochen, and Ashan, five cities:

verses.original: וְ/כָל חַצְרֵי/הֶ֗ם אֲשֶׁ֧ר סְבִיב֛וֹת הֶ/עָרִ֥ים הָ/אֵ֖לֶּה עַד בָּ֑עַל זֹ֚את מוֹשְׁבֹתָ֔/ם וְ/הִתְיַחְשָׂ֖/ם לָ/הֶֽם
verses.translit: vkhl chtsryhm 'shr sbybvt h'rym h'lh 'd b'l z't mvshbtm vhtychshm lhm
verses.translation: And all their villages that were round about the same cities, unto Baal. These were their habitations, and their genealogy.

verses.original: וּ/מְשׁוֹבָ֣ב וְ/יַמְלֵ֔ךְ וְ/יוֹשָׁ֖ה בֶּן אֲמַצְיָֽה
verses.translit: vmshvbb vymlkh vyvshh bn 'mtsyh
verses.translation: And Meshobab, and Jamlech, and Joshah the son of Amaziah,

verses.original: וְ/יוֹאֵ֑ל וְ/יֵהוּא֙ בֶּן י֣וֹשִׁבְיָ֔ה בֶּן שְׂרָיָ֖ה בֶּן עֲשִׂיאֵֽל
verses.translit: vyv'l vyhv' bn yvshbyh bn shryh bn 'shy'l
verses.translation: And Joel, and Jehu the son of Josibiah, the son of Seraiah, the son of Asiel,

verses.original: וְ/אֶלְיוֹעֵינַ֡י וְֽ/יַעֲקֹ֡בָה וִ֠/ישׁוֹחָיָה וַ/עֲשָׂיָ֧ה וַ/עֲדִיאֵ֛ל וִ/ישִׂימִאֵ֖ל וּ/בְנָיָֽה
verses.translit: v'lyv'yny vy'qbh vyshvchyh v'shyh v'dy'l vyshym'l vbnyh
verses.translation: And Elioenai, and Jaakobah, and Jeshohaiah, and Asaiah, and Adiel, and Jesimiel, and Benaiah,

verses.original: וְ/זִיזָ֨א בֶן שִׁפְעִ֧י בֶן אַלּ֛וֹן בֶּן יְדָיָ֥ה בֶן שִׁמְרִ֖י בֶּן שְׁמַֽעְיָֽה
verses.translit: vzyz' bn shp'y bn 'lvn bn ydyh bn shmry bn shm'yh
verses.translation: And Ziza the son of Shiphi, the son of Allon, the son of Jedaiah, the son of Shimri, the son of Shemaiah;

verses.original: אֵ֚לֶּה הַ/בָּאִ֣ים בְּ/שֵׁמ֔וֹת נְשִׂיאִ֖ים בְּ/מִשְׁפְּחוֹתָ֑/ם וּ/בֵית֙ אֲב֣וֹתֵי/הֶ֔ם פָּרְצ֖וּ לָ/רֽוֹב
verses.translit: 'lh hb'ym bshmvt nshy'ym bmshpchvtm vbyt 'bvtyhm prtsv lrvb
verses.translation: These mentioned by their names were princes in their families: and the house of their fathers increased greatly.

verses.original: וַ/יֵּלְכוּ֙ לִ/מְב֣וֹא גְדֹ֔ר עַ֖ד לְ/מִזְרַ֣ח הַ/גָּ֑יְא לְ/בַקֵּ֥שׁ מִרְעֶ֖ה לְ/צֹאנָֽ/ם
verses.translit: vylkhv lmbv' gdr 'd lmzrch hgy' lbqsh mr'h lts'nm
verses.translation: And they went to the entrance of Gedor, even unto the east side of the valley, to seek pasture for their flocks.

verses.original: וַֽ/יִּמְצְא֤וּ מִרְעֶה֙ שָׁמֵ֣ן וָ/ט֔וֹב וְ/הָ/אָ֨רֶץ֙ רַחֲבַ֣ת יָדַ֔יִם וְ/שֹׁקֶ֖טֶת וּ/שְׁלֵוָ֑ה כִּ֣י מִן חָ֔ם הַ/יֹּשְׁבִ֥ים שָׁ֖ם לְ/פָנִֽים
verses.translit: vymts'v mr'h shmn vtvb vh'rts rchbt ydym vshqtt vshlvh khy mn chm hyshbym shm lpnym
verses.translation: And they found fat pasture and good, and the land was wide, and quiet, and peaceable; for they of Ham had dwelt there of old.

verses.original: וַ/יָּבֹ֡אוּ אֵלֶּה֩ הַ/כְּתוּבִ֨ים בְּ/שֵׁמ֜וֹת בִּ/ימֵ֣י יְחִזְקִיָּ֣הוּ מֶֽלֶךְ יְהוּדָ֗ה וַ/יַּכּ֨וּ אֶת אָהֳלֵי/הֶ֜ם וְ/אֶת ה/מעינים הַ/מְּעוּנִ֨ים אֲשֶׁ֤ר נִמְצְאוּ שָׁ֨מָּ/ה֙ וַ/יַּחֲרִימֻ/ם֙ עַד הַ/יּ֣וֹם הַ/זֶּ֔ה וַ/יֵּשְׁב֖וּ תַּחְתֵּי/הֶ֑ם כִּֽי מִרְעֶ֥ה לְ/צֹאנָ֖/ם שָֽׁם
verses.translit: vyb'v 'lh hkhtvbym bshmvt bymy ychzqyhv mlkh yhvdh vykhv 't 'hlyhm v't hm'ynym hm'vnym 'shr nmts'v shmh vychrymm 'd hyvm hzh vyshbv tchtyhm khy mr'h lts'nm shm
verses.translation: And these written by name came in the days of Hezekiah king of Judah, and smote their tents, and the habitations that were found there, and destroyed them utterly unto this day, and dwelt in their rooms: because there was pasture there for their flocks.

verses.original: וּ/מֵ/הֶ֣ם מִן בְּנֵ֣י שִׁמְע֗וֹן הָלְכוּ֙ לְ/הַ֣ר שֵׂעִ֔יר אֲנָשִׁ֖ים חֲמֵ֣שׁ מֵא֑וֹת וּ/פְלַטְיָ֡ה וּ֠/נְעַרְיָה וּ/רְפָיָ֧ה וְ/עֻזִּיאֵ֛ל בְּנֵ֥י יִשְׁעִ֖י בְּ/רֹאשָֽׁ/ם
verses.translit: vmhm mn bny shm'vn hlkhv lhr sh'yr 'nshym chmsh m'vt vpltyh vn'ryh vrpyh v'zy'l bny ysh'y br'shm
verses.translation: And some of them, even of the sons of Simeon, five hundred men, went to mount Seir, having for their captains Pelatiah, and Neariah, and Rephaiah, and Uzziel, the sons of Ishi.

verses.original: וַ/יַּכּ֕וּ אֶת שְׁאֵרִ֥ית הַ/פְּלֵטָ֖ה לַ/עֲמָלֵ֑ק וַ/יֵּ֣שְׁבוּ שָׁ֔ם עַ֖ד הַ/יּ֥וֹם הַ/זֶּֽה
verses.translit: vykhv 't sh'ryt hplth l'mlq vyshbv shm 'd hyvm hzh
verses.translation: And they smote the rest of the Amalekites that were escaped, and dwelt there unto this day.

verses.original: וּ/בְנֵ֨י רְאוּבֵ֥ן בְּכֽוֹר יִשְׂרָאֵל֮ כִּ֣י ה֣וּא הַ/בְּכוֹר֒ וּֽ/בְ/חַלְּל/וֹ֙ יְצוּעֵ֣י אָבִ֔י/ו נִתְּנָה֙ בְּכֹ֣רָת֔/וֹ לִ/בְנֵ֥י יוֹסֵ֖ף בֶּן יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וְ/לֹ֥א לְ/הִתְיַחֵ֖שׂ לַ/בְּכֹרָֽה
verses.translit: vbny r'vbn bkhvr yshr'l khy hv' hbkhvr vbchllv ytsv'y 'byv ntnh bkhrtv lbny yvsf bn yshr'l vl' lhtychsh lbkhrh
verses.translation: Now the sons of Reuben the firstborn of Israel, (for he was the firstborn; but, forasmuch as he defiled his father’s bed, his birthright was given unto the sons of Joseph the son of Israel: and the genealogy is not to be reckoned after the birthright.

verses.original: כִּ֤י יְהוּדָה֙ גָּבַ֣ר בְּ/אֶחָ֔י/ו וּ/לְ/נָגִ֖יד מִמֶּ֑/נּוּ וְ/הַ/בְּכֹרָ֖ה לְ/יוֹסֵֽף
verses.translit: khy yhvdh gbr b'chyv vlngyd mmnv vhbkhrh lyvsf
verses.translation: For Judah prevailed above his brethren, and of him came the chief ruler; but the birthright was Joseph’s:)

verses.original: בְּנֵ֥י רְאוּבֵ֖ן בְּכ֣וֹר יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל חֲנ֥וֹךְ וּ/פַלּ֖וּא חֶצְר֥וֹן וְ/כַרְמִֽי
verses.translit: bny r'vbn bkhvr yshr'l chnvkh vplv' chtsrvn vkhrmy
verses.translation: The sons, I say , of Reuben the firstborn of Israel were , Hanoch, and Pallu, Hezron, and Carmi.

verses.original: בְּנֵ֖י יוֹאֵ֑ל שְׁמַֽעְיָ֥ה בְנ֛/וֹ גּ֥וֹג בְּנ֖/וֹ שִׁמְעִ֥י בְנֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: bny yv'l shm'yh bnv gvg bnv shm'y bnv
verses.translation: The sons of Joel; Shemaiah his son, Gog his son, Shimei his son,

verses.original: מִיכָ֥ה בְנ֛/וֹ רְאָיָ֥ה בְנ֖/וֹ בַּ֥עַל בְּנֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: mykhh bnv r'yh bnv b'l bnv
verses.translation: Micah his son, Reaia his son, Baal his son,

verses.original: בְּאֵרָ֣ה בְנ֔/וֹ אֲשֶׁ֣ר הֶגְלָ֔ה תִּלְּגַ֥ת פִּלְנְאֶ֖סֶר מֶ֣לֶךְ אַשֻּׁ֑ר ה֥וּא נָשִׂ֖יא לָ/רֽאוּבֵנִֽי
verses.translit: b'rh bnv 'shr hglh tlgt pln'sr mlkh 'shr hv' nshy' lr'vbny
verses.translation: Beerah his son, whom Tilgath-pilneser king of Assyria carried away captive: he was prince of the Reubenites.

verses.original: וְ/אֶחָי/ו֙ לְ/מִשְׁפְּחֹתָ֔י/ו בְּ/הִתְיַחֵ֖שׂ לְ/תֹלְדוֹתָ֑/ם הָ/רֹ֥אשׁ יְעִיאֵ֖ל וּ/זְכַרְיָֽהוּ
verses.translit: v'chyv lmshpchtyv bhtychsh ltldvtm hr'sh y'y'l vzkhryhv
verses.translation: And his brethren by their families, when the genealogy of their generations was reckoned, were the chief, Jeiel, and Zechariah,

verses.original: וּ/בֶ֨לַע֙ בֶּן עָזָ֔ז בֶּן שֶׁ֖מַע בֶּן יוֹאֵ֑ל ה֚וּא יוֹשֵׁ֣ב בַּ/עֲרֹעֵ֔ר וְ/עַד נְב֖וֹ וּ/בַ֥עַל מְעֽוֹן
verses.translit: vbl' bn 'zz bn shm' bn yv'l hv' yvshb b'r'r v'd nbv vb'l m'vn
verses.translation: And Bela the son of Azaz, the son of Shema, the son of Joel, who dwelt in Aroer, even unto Nebo and Baal-meon:

verses.original: וְ/לַ/מִּזְרָ֗ח יָשַׁב֙ עַד לְ/ב֣וֹא מִדְבָּ֔רָ/ה לְ/מִן הַ/נָּהָ֖ר פְּרָ֑ת כִּ֧י מִקְנֵי/הֶ֛ם רָב֖וּ בְּ/אֶ֥רֶץ גִּלְעָֽד
verses.translit: vlmzrch yshb 'd lbv' mdbrh lmn hnhr prt khy mqnyhm rbv b'rts gl'd
verses.translation: And eastward he inhabited unto the entering in of the wilderness from the river Euphrates: because their cattle were multiplied in the land of Gilead.

verses.original: וּ/בִ/ימֵ֣י שָׁא֗וּל עָשׂ֤וּ מִלְחָמָה֙ עִם הַֽ/הַגְרִאִ֔ים וַֽ/יִּפְּל֖וּ בְּ/יָדָ֑/ם וַ/יֵּשְׁבוּ֙ בְּ/אָ֣הֳלֵי/הֶ֔ם עַֽל כָּל פְּנֵ֖י מִזְרָ֥ח לַ/גִּלְעָֽד
verses.translit: vbymy sh'vl 'shv mlchmh 'm hhgr'ym vyplv bydm vyshbv b'hlyhm 'l khl pny mzrch lgl'd
verses.translation: And in the days of Saul they made war with the Hagarites, who fell by their hand: and they dwelt in their tents throughout all the east land of Gilead.

verses.original: וּ/בְנֵי גָ֣ד לְ/נֶגְדָּ֗/ם יָֽשְׁב֛וּ בְּ/אֶ֥רֶץ הַ/בָּשָׁ֖ן עַד סַלְכָֽה
verses.translit: vbny gd lngdm yshbv b'rts hbshn 'd slkhh
verses.translation: And the children of Gad dwelt over against them, in the land of Bashan unto Salchah:

verses.original: יוֹאֵ֣ל הָ/רֹ֔אשׁ וְ/שָׁפָ֖ם הַ/מִּשְׁנֶ֑ה וְ/יַעְנַ֥י וְ/שָׁפָ֖ט בַּ/בָּשָֽׁן
verses.translit: yv'l hr'sh vshpm hmshnh vy'ny vshpt bbshn
verses.translation: Joel the chief, and Shapham the next, and Jaanai, and Shaphat in Bashan.

verses.original: וַ/אֲחֵי/הֶ֞ם לְ/בֵ֣ית אֲבוֹתֵי/הֶ֗ם מִֽיכָאֵ֡ל וּ/מְשֻׁלָּ֡ם וְ֠/שֶׁבַע וְ/יוֹרַ֧י וְ/יַעְכָּ֛ן וְ/זִ֥יעַ וָ/עֵ֖בֶר שִׁבְעָֽה
verses.translit: v'chyhm lbyt 'bvtyhm mykh'l vmshlm vshb' vyvry vy'khn vzy' v'br shb'h
verses.translation: And their brethren of the house of their fathers were , Michael, and Meshullam, and Sheba, and Jorai, and Jachan, and Zia, and Heber, seven.

verses.original: אֵ֣לֶּה בְּנֵ֣י אֲבִיחַ֗יִל בֶּן חוּרִ֡י בֶּן יָ֠רוֹחַ בֶּן גִּלְעָ֧ד בֶּן מִיכָאֵ֛ל בֶּן יְשִׁישַׁ֥י בֶּן יַחְדּ֖וֹ בֶּן בּֽוּז
verses.translit: 'lh bny 'bychyl bn chvry bn yrvch bn gl'd bn mykh'l bn yshyshy bn ychdv bn bvz
verses.translation: These are the children of Abihail the son of Huri, the son of Jaroah, the son of Gilead, the son of Michael, the son of Jeshishai, the son of Jahdo, the son of Buz;

verses.original: אֲחִי֙ בֶּן עַבְדִּיאֵ֣ל בֶּן גּוּנִ֔י רֹ֖אשׁ לְ/בֵ֥ית אֲבוֹתָֽ/ם
verses.translit: 'chy bn 'bdy'l bn gvny r'sh lbyt 'bvtm
verses.translation: Ahi the son of Abdiel, the son of Guni, chief of the house of their fathers.

verses.original: וַ/יֵּֽשְׁב֛וּ בַּ/גִּלְעָ֥ד בַּ/בָּשָׁ֖ן וּ/בִ/בְנֹתֶ֑י/הָ וּ/בְ/כָֽל מִגְרְשֵׁ֥י שָׁר֖וֹן עַל תּוֹצְאוֹתָֽ/ם
verses.translit: vyshbv bgl'd bbshn vbbntyh vbkhl mgrshy shrvn 'l tvts'vtm
verses.translation: And they dwelt in Gilead in Bashan, and in her towns, and in all the suburbs of Sharon, upon their borders.

verses.original: כֻּלָּ/ם֙ הִתְיַחְשׂ֔וּ בִּ/ימֵ֖י יוֹתָ֣ם מֶֽלֶךְ יְהוּדָ֑ה וּ/בִ/ימֵ֖י יָרָבְעָ֥ם מֶֽלֶךְ יִשְׂרָאֵֽל
verses.translit: khlm htychshv bymy yvtm mlkh yhvdh vbymy yrb'm mlkh yshr'l
verses.translation: All these were reckoned by genealogies in the days of Jotham king of Judah, and in the days of Jeroboam king of Israel.

verses.original: בְּנֵֽי רְאוּבֵ֨ן וְ/גָדִ֜י וַ/חֲצִ֥י שֵֽׁבֶט מְנַשֶּׁה֮ מִן בְּנֵי חַיִל֒ אֲ֠נָשִׁים נֹשְׂאֵ֨י מָגֵ֤ן וְ/חֶ֨רֶב֙ וְ/דֹ֣רְכֵי קֶ֔שֶׁת וּ/לְמוּדֵ֖י מִלְחָמָ֑ה אַרְבָּעִ֨ים וְ/אַרְבָּעָ֥ה אֶ֛לֶף וּ/שְׁבַע מֵא֥וֹת וְ/שִׁשִּׁ֖ים יֹצְאֵ֥י צָבָֽא
verses.translit: bny r'vbn vgdy vchtsy shbt mnshh mn bny chyl 'nshym nsh'y mgn vchrb vdrkhy qsht vlmvdy mlchmh 'rb'ym v'rb'h 'lf vshb' m'vt vshshym yts'y tsb'
verses.translation: The sons of Reuben, and the Gadites, and half the tribe of Manasseh, of valiant men, men able to bear buckler and sword, and to shoot with bow, and skilful in war, were four and forty thousand seven hundred and threescore, that went out to the war.

verses.original: וַ/יַּעֲשׂ֥וּ מִלְחָמָ֖ה עִם הַֽ/הַגְרִיאִ֑ים וִ/יט֥וּר וְ/נָפִ֖ישׁ וְ/נוֹדָֽב
verses.translit: vy'shv mlchmh 'm hhgry'ym vytvr vnpysh vnvdb
verses.translation: And they made war with the Hagarites, with Jetur, and Nephish, and Nodab.

verses.original: וַ/יֵּעָזְר֣וּ עֲלֵי/הֶ֔ם וַ/יִּנָּתְנ֤וּ בְ/יָדָ/ם֙ הַֽ/הַגְרִיאִ֔ים וְ/כֹ֖ל שֶׁ֣/עִמָּ/הֶ֑ם כִּ֠י לֵ/אלֹהִ֤ים זָעֲקוּ֙ בַּ/מִּלְחָמָ֔ה וְ/נַעְתּ֥וֹר לָ/הֶ֖ם כִּי בָ֥טְחוּ בֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: vy'zrv 'lyhm vyntnv bydm hhgry'ym vkhl sh'mhm khy l'lhym z'qv bmlchmh vn'tvr lhm khy btchv bv
verses.translation: And they were helped against them, and the Hagarites were delivered into their hand, and all that were with them: for they cried to God in the battle, and he was intreated of them; because they put their trust in him.

verses.original: וַ/יִּשְׁבּ֣וּ מִקְנֵי/הֶ֗ם גְּֽמַלֵּי/הֶ֞ם חֲמִשִּׁ֥ים אֶ֨לֶף֙ וְ/צֹ֗אן מָאתַ֤יִם וַ/חֲמִשִּׁים֙ אֶ֔לֶף וַ/חֲמוֹרִ֖ים אַלְפָּ֑יִם וְ/נֶ֥פֶשׁ אָדָ֖ם מֵ֥אָה אָֽלֶף
verses.translit: vyshbv mqnyhm gmlyhm chmshym 'lf vts'n m'tym vchmshym 'lf vchmvrym 'lpym vnpsh 'dm m'h 'lf
verses.translation: And they took away their cattle; of their camels fifty thousand, and of sheep two hundred and fifty thousand, and of asses two thousand, and of men an hundred thousand.

verses.original: כִּֽי חֲלָלִ֤ים רַבִּים֙ נָפָ֔לוּ כִּ֥י מֵ/הָ/אֱלֹהִ֖ים הַ/מִּלְחָמָ֑ה וַ/יֵּשְׁב֥וּ תַחְתֵּי/הֶ֖ם עַד הַ/גֹּלָֽה
verses.translit: khy chllym rbym nplv khy mh'lhym hmlchmh vyshbv tchtyhm 'd hglh
verses.translation: For there fell down many slain, because the war was of God. And they dwelt in their steads until the captivity.

verses.original: וּ/בְנֵ֗י חֲצִי֙ שֵׁ֣בֶט מְנַשֶּׁ֔ה יָשְׁב֖וּ בָּ/אָ֑רֶץ מִ/בָּשָׁ֞ן עַד בַּ֧עַל חֶרְמ֛וֹן וּ/שְׂנִ֥יר וְ/הַר חֶרְמ֖וֹן הֵ֥מָּה רָבֽוּ
verses.translit: vbny chtsy shbt mnshh yshbv b'rts mbshn 'd b'l chrmvn vshnyr vhr chrmvn hmh rbv
verses.translation: And the children of the half tribe of Manasseh dwelt in the land: they increased from Bashan unto Baal-hermon and Senir, and unto mount Hermon.

verses.original: וְ/אֵ֖לֶּה רָאשֵׁ֣י בֵית אֲבוֹתָ֑/ם וְ/עֵ֡פֶר וְ/יִשְׁעִ֡י וֶ/אֱלִיאֵ֡ל וְ֠/עַזְרִיאֵל וְ/יִרְמְיָ֨ה וְ/הוֹדַוְיָ֜ה וְ/יַחְדִּיאֵ֗ל אֲנָשִׁים֙ גִּבּ֣וֹרֵי חַ֔יִל אַנְשֵׁ֣י שֵׁמ֔וֹת רָאשִׁ֖ים לְ/בֵ֥ית אֲבוֹתָֽ/ם
verses.translit: v'lh r'shy byt 'bvtm v'pr vysh'y v'ly'l v'zry'l vyrmyh vhvdvyh vychdy'l 'nshym gbvry chyl 'nshy shmvt r'shym lbyt 'bvtm
verses.translation: And these were the heads of the house of their fathers, even Epher, and Ishi, and Eliel, and Azriel, and Jeremiah, and Hodaviah, and Jahdiel, mighty men of valour, famous men, and heads of the house of their fathers.

verses.original: וַ/יִּֽמְעֲל֔וּ בֵּ/אלֹהֵ֖י אֲבוֹתֵי/הֶ֑ם וַ/יִּזְנ֗וּ אַחֲרֵי֙ אֱלֹהֵ֣י עַמֵּי הָ/אָ֔רֶץ אֲשֶׁר הִשְׁמִ֥יד אֱלֹהִ֖ים מִ/פְּנֵי/הֶֽם
verses.translit: vym'lv b'lhy 'bvtyhm vyznv 'chry 'lhy 'my h'rts 'shr hshmyd 'lhym mpnyhm
verses.translation: And they transgressed against the God of their fathers, and went a whoring after the gods of the people of the land, whom God destroyed before them.

verses.original: וַ/יָּעַר֩ אֱלֹהֵ֨י יִשְׂרָאֵ֜ל אֶת ר֣וּחַ פּ֣וּל מֶֽלֶךְ אַשּׁ֗וּר וְ/אֶת ר֨וּחַ֙ תִּלְּגַ֤ת פִּלְנֶ֨סֶר֙ מֶ֣לֶךְ אַשּׁ֔וּר וַ/יַּגְלֵ/ם֙ לָ/ראוּבֵנִ֣י וְ/לַ/גָּדִ֔י וְ/לַ/חֲצִ֖י שֵׁ֣בֶט מְנַשֶּׁ֑ה וַ֠/יְבִיאֵ/ם לַ/חְלַ֨ח וְ/חָב֤וֹר וְ/הָרָא֙ וּ/נְהַ֣ר גּוֹזָ֔ן עַ֖ד הַ/יּ֥וֹם הַ/זֶּֽה
verses.translit: vy'r 'lhy yshr'l 't rvch pvl mlkh 'shvr v't rvch tlgt plnsr mlkh 'shvr vyglm lr'vbny vlgdy vlchtsy shbt mnshh vyby'm lchlch vchbvr vhr' vnhr gvzn 'd hyvm hzh
verses.translation: And the God of Israel stirred up the spirit of Pul king of Assyria, and the spirit of Tilgath-pilneser king of Assyria, and he carried them away, even the Reubenites, and the Gadites, and the half tribe of Manasseh, and brought them unto Halah, and Habor, and Hara, and to the river Gozan, unto this day.

verses.original: בְּנֵ֖י לֵוִ֑י גֵּרְשֹׁ֕ם קְהָ֖ת וּ/מְרָרִֽי
verses.translit: bny lvy grshm qht vmrry
verses.translation: The sons of Levi; Gershon, Kohath, and Merari.

verses.original: וְ/אֵ֛לֶּה שְׁמ֥וֹת בְּֽנֵי גֵרְשׁ֖וֹם לִבְנִ֥י וְ/שִׁמְעִֽי
verses.translit: v'lh shmvt bny grshvm lbny vshm'y
verses.translation: And the sons of Kohath; Amram, Izhar, and Hebron, and Uzziel.

verses.original: וּ/בְנֵ֖י קְהָ֑ת עַמְרָ֣ם וְ/יִצְהָ֔ר וְ/חֶבְר֖וֹן וְ/עֻזִּיאֵֽל
verses.translit: vbny qht 'mrm vytshr vchbrvn v'zy'l
verses.translation: And the children of Amram; Aaron, and Moses, and Miriam. The sons also of Aaron; Nadab, and Abihu, Eleazar, and Ithamar.

verses.original: בְּנֵ֥י מְרָרִ֖י מַחְלִ֣י וּ/מֻשִׁ֑י וְ/אֵ֛לֶּה מִשְׁפְּח֥וֹת הַ/לֵּוִ֖י לַ/אֲבוֹתֵי/הֶֽם
verses.translit: bny mrry mchly vmshy v'lh mshpchvt hlvy l'bvtyhm
verses.translation: Eleazar begat Phinehas, Phinehas begat Abishua,

verses.original: לְֽ/גֵרְשׁ֑וֹם לִבְנִ֥י בְנ֛/וֹ יַ֥חַת בְּנ֖/וֹ זִמָּ֥ה בְנֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: lgrshvm lbny bnv ycht bnv zmh bnv
verses.translation: And Abishua begat Bukki, and Bukki begat Uzzi,

verses.original: יוֹאָ֤ח בְּנ/וֹ֙ עִדּ֣וֹ בְנ֔/וֹ זֶ֥רַח בְּנ֖/וֹ יְאָתְרַ֥י בְּנֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: yv'ch bnv 'dv bnv zrch bnv y'try bnv
verses.translation: And Uzzi begat Zerahiah, and Zerahiah begat Meraioth,

verses.original: בְּנֵ֖י קְהָ֑ת עַמִּינָדָ֣ב בְּנ֔/וֹ קֹ֥רַח בְּנ֖/וֹ אַסִּ֥יר בְּנֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: bny qht 'myndb bnv qrch bnv 'syr bnv
verses.translation: Meraioth begat Amariah, and Amariah begat Ahitub,

verses.original: אֶלְקָנָ֥ה בְנ֛/וֹ וְ/אֶבְיָסָ֥ף בְּנ֖/וֹ וְ/אַסִּ֥יר בְּנֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: 'lqnh bnv v'bysf bnv v'syr bnv
verses.translation: And Ahitub begat Zadok, and Zadok begat Ahimaaz,

verses.original: תַּ֤חַת בְּנ/וֹ֙ אוּרִיאֵ֣ל בְּנ֔/וֹ עֻזִּיָּ֥ה בְנ֖/וֹ וְ/שָׁא֥וּל בְּנֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: tcht bnv 'vry'l bnv 'zyh bnv vsh'vl bnv
verses.translation: And Ahimaaz begat Azariah, and Azariah begat Johanan,

verses.original: וּ/בְנֵי֙ אֶלְקָנָ֔ה עֲמָשַׂ֖י וַ/אֲחִימֽוֹת
verses.translit: vbny 'lqnh 'mshy v'chymvt
verses.translation: And Johanan begat Azariah, (he it is that executed the priest’s office in the temple that Solomon built in Jerusalem:)

verses.original: אֶלְקָנָ֑ה בנ/ו בְּנֵי֙ אֶלְקָנָ֔ה צוֹפַ֥י בְּנ֖/וֹ וְ/נַ֥חַת בְּנֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: 'lqnh bnv bny 'lqnh tsvpy bnv vncht bnv
verses.translation: And Azariah begat Amariah, and Amariah begat Ahitub,

verses.original: אֱלִיאָ֥ב בְּנ֛/וֹ יְרֹחָ֥ם בְּנ֖/וֹ אֶלְקָנָ֥ה בְנֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: 'ly'b bnv yrchm bnv 'lqnh bnv
verses.translation: And Ahitub begat Zadok, and Zadok begat Shallum,

verses.original: וּ/בְנֵ֧י שְׁמוּאֵ֛ל הַ/בְּכֹ֥ר וַשְׁנִ֖י וַ/אֲבִיָּֽה
verses.translit: vbny shmv'l hbkhr vshny v'byh
verses.translation: And Shallum begat Hilkiah, and Hilkiah begat Azariah,

verses.original: בְּנֵ֥י מְרָרִ֖י מַחְלִ֑י לִבְנִ֥י בְנ֛/וֹ שִׁמְעִ֥י בְנ֖/וֹ עֻזָּ֥ה בְנֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: bny mrry mchly lbny bnv shm'y bnv 'zh bnv
verses.translation: And Azariah begat Seraiah, and Seraiah begat Jehozadak,

verses.original: שִׁמְעָ֥א בְנ֛/וֹ חַגִּיָּ֥ה בְנ֖/וֹ עֲשָׂיָ֥ה בְנֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: shm'' bnv chgyh bnv 'shyh bnv
verses.translation: And Jehozadak went into captivity , when the LORD carried away Judah and Jerusalem by the hand of Nebuchadnezzar.

verses.original: וְ/אֵ֗לֶּה אֲשֶׁ֨ר הֶעֱמִ֥יד דָּוִ֛יד עַל יְדֵי שִׁ֖יר בֵּ֣ית יְהוָ֑ה מִ/מְּנ֖וֹחַ הָ/אָרֽוֹן
verses.translit: v'lh 'shr h'myd dvyd 'l ydy shyr byt yhvh mmnvch h'rvn
verses.translation: The sons of Levi; Gershom, Kohath, and Merari.

verses.original: וַ/יִּהְי֨וּ מְשָׁרְתִ֜ים לִ/פְנֵ֨י מִשְׁכַּ֤ן אֹֽהֶל מוֹעֵד֙ בַּ/שִּׁ֔יר עַד בְּנ֧וֹת שְׁלֹמֹ֛ה אֶת בֵּ֥ית יְהוָ֖ה בִּ/ירוּשָׁלִָ֑ם וַ/יַּעַמְד֥וּ כְ/מִשְׁפָּטָ֖/ם עַל עֲבוֹדָתָֽ/ם
verses.translit: vyhyv mshrtym lpny mshkhn 'hl mv'd bshyr 'd bnvt shlmh 't byt yhvh byrvshlm vy'mdv khmshptm 'l 'bvdtm
verses.translation: And these be the names of the sons of Gershom; Libni, and Shimei.

verses.original: וְ/אֵ֥לֶּה הָ/עֹמְדִ֖ים וּ/בְנֵי/הֶ֑ם מִ/בְּנֵי֙ הַ/קְּהָתִ֔י הֵימָן֙ הַ/מְשׁוֹרֵ֔ר בֶּן יוֹאֵ֖ל בֶּן שְׁמוּאֵֽל
verses.translit: v'lh h'mdym vbnyhm mbny hqhty hymn hmshvrr bn yv'l bn shmv'l
verses.translation: And the sons of Kohath were , Amram, and Izhar, and Hebron, and Uzziel.

verses.original: בֶּן אֶלְקָנָה֙ בֶּן יְרֹחָ֔ם בֶּן אֱלִיאֵ֖ל בֶּן תּֽוֹחַ
verses.translit: bn 'lqnh bn yrchm bn 'ly'l bn tvch
verses.translation: The sons of Merari; Mahli, and Mushi. And these are the families of the Levites according to their fathers.

verses.original: בֶּן ציף צוּף֙ בֶּן אֶלְקָנָ֔ה בֶּן מַ֖חַת בֶּן עֲמָשָֽׂי
verses.translit: bn tsyf tsvf bn 'lqnh bn mcht bn 'mshy
verses.translation: Of Gershom; Libni his son, Jahath his son, Zimmah his son,

verses.original: בֶּן אֶלְקָנָה֙ בֶּן יוֹאֵ֔ל בֶּן עֲזַרְיָ֖ה בֶּן צְפַנְיָֽה
verses.translit: bn 'lqnh bn yv'l bn 'zryh bn tspnyh
verses.translation: Joah his son, Iddo his son, Zerah his son, Jeaterai his son.

verses.original: בֶּן תַּ֨חַת֙ בֶּן אַסִּ֔יר בֶּן אֶבְיָסָ֖ף בֶּן קֹֽרַח
verses.translit: bn tcht bn 'syr bn 'bysf bn qrch
verses.translation: The sons of Kohath; Amminadab his son, Korah his son, Assir his son,

verses.original: בֶּן יִצְהָ֣ר בֶּן קְהָ֔ת בֶּן לֵוִ֖י בֶּן יִשְׂרָאֵֽל
verses.translit: bn ytshr bn qht bn lvy bn yshr'l
verses.translation: Elkanah his son, and Ebiasaph his son, and Assir his son,

verses.original: וְ/אָחִ֣י/ו אָסָ֔ף הָ/עֹמֵ֖ד עַל יְמִינ֑/וֹ אָסָ֥ף בֶּן בֶּרֶכְיָ֖הוּ בֶּן שִׁמְעָֽא
verses.translit: v'chyv 'sf h'md 'l ymynv 'sf bn brkhyhv bn shm''
verses.translation: Tahath his son, Uriel his son, Uzziah his son, and Shaul his son.

verses.original: בֶּן מִיכָאֵ֥ל בֶּן בַּעֲשֵׂיָ֖ה בֶּן מַלְכִּיָּֽה
verses.translit: bn mykh'l bn b'shyh bn mlkhyh
verses.translation: And the sons of Elkanah; Amasai, and Ahimoth.

verses.original: בֶּן אֶתְנִ֥י בֶן זֶ֖רַח בֶּן עֲדָיָֽה
verses.translit: bn 'tny bn zrch bn 'dyh
verses.translation: As for Elkanah: the sons of Elkanah; Zophai his son, and Nahath his son,

verses.original: בֶּן אֵיתָ֥ן בֶּן זִמָּ֖ה בֶּן שִׁמְעִֽי
verses.translit: bn 'ytn bn zmh bn shm'y
verses.translation: Eliab his son, Jeroham his son, Elkanah his son.

verses.original: בֶּן יַ֥חַת בֶּן גֵּרְשֹׁ֖ם בֶּן לֵוִֽי
verses.translit: bn ycht bn grshm bn lvy
verses.translation: And the sons of Samuel; the firstborn Vashni, and Abiah.

verses.original: וּ/בְנֵ֧י מְרָרִ֛י אֲחֵי/הֶ֖ם עַֽל הַ/שְּׂמֹ֑אול אֵיתָן֙ בֶּן קִישִׁ֔י בֶּן עַבְדִּ֖י בֶּן מַלּֽוּךְ
verses.translit: vbny mrry 'chyhm 'l hshm'vl 'ytn bn qyshy bn 'bdy bn mlvkh
verses.translation: The sons of Merari; Mahli, Libni his son, Shimei his son, Uzza his son,

verses.original: בֶּן חֲשַׁבְיָ֥ה בֶן אֲמַצְיָ֖ה בֶּן חִלְקִיָּֽה
verses.translit: bn chshbyh bn 'mtsyh bn chlqyh
verses.translation: Shimea his son, Haggiah his son, Asaiah his son.

verses.original: בֶּן אַמְצִ֥י בֶן בָּנִ֖י בֶּן שָֽׁמֶר
verses.translit: bn 'mtsy bn bny bn shmr
verses.translation: And these are they whom David set over the service of song in the house of the LORD , after that the ark had rest.

verses.original: בֶּן מַחְלִי֙ בֶּן מוּשִׁ֔י בֶּן מְרָרִ֖י בֶּן לֵוִֽי
verses.translit: bn mchly bn mvshy bn mrry bn lvy
verses.translation: And they ministered before the dwelling place of the tabernacle of the congregation with singing, until Solomon had built the house of the LORD in Jerusalem: and then they waited on their office according to their order.

verses.original: וַ/אֲחֵי/הֶ֖ם הַ/לְוִיִּ֑ם נְתוּנִ֕ים לְ/כָ֨ל עֲבוֹדַ֔ת מִשְׁכַּ֖ן בֵּ֥ית הָ/אֱלֹהִֽים
verses.translit: v'chyhm hlvym ntvnym lkhl 'bvdt mshkhn byt h'lhym
verses.translation: And these are they that waited with their children. Of the sons of the Kohathites: Heman a singer, the son of Joel, the son of Shemuel,

verses.original: וְֽ/אַהֲרֹ֨ן וּ/בָנָ֜י/ו מַקְטִירִ֨ים עַל מִזְבַּ֤ח הָֽ/עוֹלָה֙ וְ/עַל מִזְבַּ֣ח הַ/קְּטֹ֔רֶת לְ/כֹ֕ל מְלֶ֖אכֶת קֹ֣דֶשׁ הַ/קֳּדָשִׁ֑ים וּ/לְ/כַפֵּר֙ עַל יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל כְּ/כֹל֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר צִוָּ֔ה מֹשֶׁ֖ה עֶ֥בֶד הָ/אֱלֹהִֽים
verses.translit: v'hrn vbnyv mqtyrym 'l mzbch h'vlh v'l mzbch hqtrt lkhl ml'kht qdsh hqdshym vlkhpr 'l yshr'l khkhl 'shr tsvh mshh 'bd h'lhym
verses.translation: The son of Elkanah, the son of Jeroham, the son of Eliel, the son of Toah,

verses.original: וְ/אֵ֖לֶּה בְּנֵ֣י אַהֲרֹ֑ן אֶלְעָזָ֥ר בְּנ֛/וֹ פִּֽינְחָ֥ס בְּנ֖/וֹ אֲבִישׁ֥וּעַ בְּנֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: v'lh bny 'hrn 'l'zr bnv pynchs bnv 'byshv' bnv
verses.translation: The son of Zuph, the son of Elkanah, the son of Mahath, the son of Amasai,

verses.original: בֻּקִּ֥י בְנ֛/וֹ עֻזִּ֥י בְנ֖/וֹ זְרַֽחְיָ֥ה בְנֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: bqy bnv 'zy bnv zrchyh bnv
verses.translation: The son of Elkanah, the son of Joel, the son of Azariah, the son of Zephaniah,

verses.original: מְרָי֥וֹת בְּנ֛/וֹ אֲמַרְיָ֥ה בְנ֖/וֹ אֲחִיט֥וּב בְּנֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: mryvt bnv 'mryh bnv 'chytvb bnv
verses.translation: The son of Tahath, the son of Assir, the son of Ebiasaph, the son of Korah,

verses.original: צָד֥וֹק בְּנ֖/וֹ אֲחִימַ֥עַץ בְּנֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: tsdvq bnv 'chym'ts bnv
verses.translation: The son of Izhar, the son of Kohath, the son of Levi, the son of Israel.

verses.original: וְ/אֵ֨לֶּה֙ מוֹשְׁבוֹתָ֔/ם לְ/טִירוֹתָ֖/ם בִּ/גְבוּלָ֑/ם לִ/בְנֵ֤י אַהֲרֹן֙ לְ/מִשְׁפַּחַ֣ת הַ/קְּהָתִ֔י כִּ֥י לָ/הֶ֖ם הָיָ֥ה הַ/גּוֹרָֽל
verses.translit: v'lh mvshbvtm ltyrvtm bgbvlm lbny 'hrn lmshpcht hqhty khy lhm hyh hgvrl
verses.translation: And his brother Asaph, who stood on his right hand, even Asaph the son of Berachiah, the son of Shimea,

verses.original: וַֽ/יִּתְּנ֥וּ לָ/הֶ֛ם אֶת חֶבְר֖וֹן בְּ/אֶ֣רֶץ יְהוּדָ֑ה וְ/אֶת מִגְרָשֶׁ֖י/הָ סְבִיבֹתֶֽי/הָ
verses.translit: vytnv lhm 't chbrvn b'rts yhvdh v't mgrshyh sbybtyh
verses.translation: The son of Michael, the son of Baaseiah, the son of Malchiah,

verses.original: וְ/אֶת שְׂדֵ֥ה הָ/עִ֖יר וְ/אֶת חֲצֵרֶ֑י/הָ נָתְנ֖וּ לְ/כָלֵ֥ב בֶּן יְפֻנֶּֽה
verses.translit: v't shdh h'yr v't chtsryh ntnv lkhlb bn ypnh
verses.translation: The son of Ethni, the son of Zerah, the son of Adaiah,

verses.original: וְ/לִ/בְנֵ֣י אַהֲרֹ֗ן נָתְנוּ֙ אֶת עָרֵ֣י הַ/מִּקְלָ֔ט אֶת חֶבְר֥וֹן וְ/אֶת לִבְנָ֖ה וְ/אֶת מִגְרָשֶׁ֑י/הָ וְ/אֶת יַתִּ֥ר וְ/אֶֽת אֶשְׁתְּמֹ֖עַ וְ/אֶת מִגְרָשֶֽׁי/הָ
verses.translit: vlbny 'hrn ntnv 't 'ry hmqlt 't chbrvn v't lbnh v't mgrshyh v't ytr v't 'shtm' v't mgrshyh
verses.translation: The son of Ethan, the son of Zimmah, the son of Shimei,

verses.original: וְ/אֶת חִילֵז֙ וְ/אֶת מִגְרָשֶׁ֔י/הָ אֶת דְּבִ֖יר וְ/אֶת מִגְרָשֶֽׁי/הָ
verses.translit: v't chylz v't mgrshyh 't dbyr v't mgrshyh
verses.translation: The son of Jahath, the son of Gershom, the son of Levi.

verses.original: וְ/אֶת עָשָׁן֙ וְ/אֶת מִגְרָשֶׁ֔י/הָ וְ/אֶת בֵּ֥ית שֶׁ֖מֶשׁ וְ/אֶת מִגְרָשֶֽׁי/הָ
verses.translit: v't 'shn v't mgrshyh v't byt shmsh v't mgrshyh
verses.translation: And their brethren the sons of Merari stood on the left hand: Ethan the son of Kishi, the son of Abdi, the son of Malluch,

verses.original: וּ/מִ/מַּטֵּ֣ה בִנְיָמִ֗ן אֶת גֶּ֤בַע וְ/אֶת מִגְרָשֶׁ֨י/הָ֙ וְ/אֶת עָלֶ֣מֶת וְ/אֶת מִגְרָשֶׁ֔י/הָ וְ/אֶת עֲנָת֖וֹת וְ/אֶת מִגְרָשֶׁ֑י/הָ כָּל עָרֵי/הֶ֛ם שְׁלֹשׁ עֶשְׂרֵ֥ה עִ֖יר בְּ/מִשְׁפְּחוֹתֵי/הֶֽם
verses.translit: vmmth bnymn 't gb' v't mgrshyh v't 'lmt v't mgrshyh v't 'ntvt v't mgrshyh khl 'ryhm shlsh 'shrh 'yr bmshpchvtyhm
verses.translation: The son of Hashabiah, the son of Amaziah, the son of Hilkiah,

verses.original: וְ/לִ/בְנֵ֨י קְהָ֜ת הַ/נּוֹתָרִ֗ים מִ/מִּשְׁפַּ֣חַת הַ/מַּטֶּ֡ה מִֽ֠/מַּחֲצִית מַטֵּ֨ה חֲצִ֧י מְנַשֶּׁ֛ה בַּ/גּוֹרָ֖ל עָרִ֥ים עָֽשֶׂר
verses.translit: vlbny qht hnvtrym mmshpcht hmth mmchtsyt mth chtsy mnshh bgvrl 'rym 'shr
verses.translation: The son of Amzi, the son of Bani, the son of Shamer,

verses.original: וְ/לִ/בְנֵ֨י גֵרְשׁ֜וֹם לְ/מִשְׁפְּחוֹתָ֗/ם מִ/מַּטֵּ֣ה יִ֠שָׂשכָר וּ/מִ/מַּטֵּ֨ה אָשֵׁ֜ר וּ/מִ/מַּטֵּ֣ה נַפְתָּלִ֗י וּ/מִ/מַּטֵּ֤ה מְנַשֶּׁה֙ בַּ/בָּשָׁ֔ן עָרִ֖ים שְׁלֹ֥שׁ עֶשְׂרֵֽה
verses.translit: vlbny grshvm lmshpchvtm mmth yshshkhr vmmth 'shr vmmth nptly vmmth mnshh bbshn 'rym shlsh 'shrh
verses.translation: The son of Mahli, the son of Mushi, the son of Merari, the son of Levi.

verses.original: לִ/בְנֵ֨י מְרָרִ֜י לְ/מִשְׁפְּחוֹתָ֗/ם מִ/מַּטֵּ֣ה רְ֠אוּבֵן וּֽ/מִ/מַּטֵּה גָ֞ד וּ/מִ/מַּטֵּ֤ה זְבוּלֻן֙ בַּ/גּוֹרָ֔ל עָרִ֖ים שְׁתֵּ֥ים עֶשְׂרֵֽה
verses.translit: lbny mrry lmshpchvtm mmth r'vbn vmmth gd vmmth zbvln bgvrl 'rym shtym 'shrh
verses.translation: Their brethren also the Levites were appointed unto all manner of service of the tabernacle of the house of God.

verses.original: וַ/יִּתְּנ֥וּ בְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל לַ/לְוִיִּ֑ם אֶת הֶ/עָרִ֖ים וְ/אֶת מִגְרְשֵׁי/הֶֽם
verses.translit: vytnv bny yshr'l llvym 't h'rym v't mgrshyhm
verses.translation: But Aaron and his sons offered upon the altar of the burnt offering, and on the altar of incense, and were appointed for all the work of the place most holy, and to make an atonement for Israel, according to all that Moses the servant of God had commanded.

verses.original: וַ/יִּתְּנ֣וּ בַ/גּוֹרָ֗ל מִ/מַּטֵּ֤ה בְנֵי יְהוּדָה֙ וּ/מִ/מַּטֵּ֣ה בְנֵי שִׁמְע֔וֹן וּ/מִ/מַּטֵּ֖ה בְּנֵ֣י בִנְיָמִ֑ן אֵ֚ת הֶ/עָרִ֣ים הָ/אֵ֔לֶּה אֲשֶׁר יִקְרְא֥וּ אֶתְ/הֶ֖ם בְּ/שֵׁמֽוֹת
verses.translit: vytnv bgvrl mmth bny yhvdh vmmth bny shm'vn vmmth bny bnymn 't h'rym h'lh 'shr yqr'v 'thm bshmvt
verses.translation: And these are the sons of Aaron; Eleazar his son, Phinehas his son, Abishua his son,

verses.original: וּ/מִֽ/מִּשְׁפְּח֖וֹת בְּנֵ֣י קְהָ֑ת וַ/יְהִי֙ עָרֵ֣י גְבוּלָ֔/ם מִ/מַּטֵּ֖ה אֶפְרָֽיִם
verses.translit: vmmshpchvt bny qht vyhy 'ry gbvlm mmth 'prym
verses.translation: Bukki his son, Uzzi his son, Zerahiah his son,

verses.original: וַ/יִּתְּנ֨וּ לָ/הֶ֜ם אֶת עָרֵ֧י הַ/מִּקְלָ֛ט אֶת שְׁכֶ֥ם וְ/אֶת מִגְרָשֶׁ֖י/הָ בְּ/הַ֣ר אֶפְרָ֑יִם וְ/אֶת גֶּ֖זֶר וְ/אֶת מִגְרָשֶֽׁי/הָ
verses.translit: vytnv lhm 't 'ry hmqlt 't shkhm v't mgrshyh bhr 'prym v't gzr v't mgrshyh
verses.translation: Meraioth his son, Amariah his son, Ahitub his son,

verses.original: וְ/אֶֽת יָקְמְעָם֙ וְ/אֶת מִגְרָשֶׁ֔י/הָ וְ/אֶת בֵּ֥ית חוֹר֖וֹן וְ/אֶת מִגְרָשֶֽׁי/הָ
verses.translit: v't yqm'm v't mgrshyh v't byt chvrvn v't mgrshyh
verses.translation: Zadok his son, Ahimaaz his son.

verses.original: וְ/אֶת אַיָּלוֹן֙ וְ/אֶת מִגְרָשֶׁ֔י/הָ וְ/אֶת גַּת רִמּ֖וֹן וְ/אֶת מִגְרָשֶֽׁי/הָ
verses.translit: v't 'ylvn v't mgrshyh v't gt rmvn v't mgrshyh
verses.translation: Now these are their dwelling places throughout their castles in their coasts, of the sons of Aaron, of the families of the Kohathites: for theirs was the lot.

verses.original: וּ/מִֽ/מַּחֲצִית֙ מַטֵּ֣ה מְנַשֶּׁ֔ה אֶת עָנֵר֙ וְ/אֶת מִגְרָשֶׁ֔י/הָ וְ/אֶת בִּלְעָ֖ם וְ/אֶת מִגְרָשֶׁ֑י/הָ לְ/מִשְׁפַּ֥חַת לִ/בְנֵי קְהָ֖ת הַ/נּוֹתָרִֽים
verses.translit: vmmchtsyt mth mnshh 't 'nr v't mgrshyh v't bl'm v't mgrshyh lmshpcht lbny qht hnvtrym
verses.translation: And they gave them Hebron in the land of Judah, and the suburbs thereof round about it.

verses.original: לִ/בְנֵי֮ גֵּרְשׁוֹם֒ מִ/מִּשְׁפַּ֗חַת חֲצִי֙ מַטֵּ֣ה מְנַשֶּׁ֔ה אֶת גּוֹלָ֥ן בַּ/בָּשָׁ֖ן וְ/אֶת מִגְרָשֶׁ֑י/הָ וְ/אֶת עַשְׁתָּר֖וֹת וְ/אֶת מִגְרָשֶֽׁי/הָ
verses.translit: lbny grshvm mmshpcht chtsy mth mnshh 't gvln bbshn v't mgrshyh v't 'shtrvt v't mgrshyh
verses.translation: But the fields of the city, and the villages thereof, they gave to Caleb the son of Jephunneh.

verses.original: וּ/מִ/מַּטֵּ֣ה יִשָׂשכָ֔ר אֶת קֶ֖דֶשׁ וְ/אֶת מִגְרָשֶׁ֑י/הָ אֶת דָּבְרַ֖ת וְ/אֶת מִגְרָשֶֽׁי/הָ
verses.translit: vmmth yshshkhr 't qdsh v't mgrshyh 't dbrt v't mgrshyh
verses.translation: And to the sons of Aaron they gave the cities of Judah, namely , Hebron, the city of refuge, and Libnah with her suburbs, and Jattir, and Eshtemoa, with their suburbs,

verses.original: וְ/אֶת רָאמוֹת֙ וְ/אֶת מִגְרָשֶׁ֔י/הָ וְ/אֶת עָנֵ֖ם וְ/אֶת מִגְרָשֶֽׁי/הָ
verses.translit: v't r'mvt v't mgrshyh v't 'nm v't mgrshyh
verses.translation: And Hilen with her suburbs, Debir with her suburbs,

verses.original: וּ/מִ/מַּטֵּ֣ה אָשֵׁ֔ר אֶת מָשָׁ֖ל וְ/אֶת מִגְרָשֶׁ֑י/הָ וְ/אֶת עַבְדּ֖וֹן וְ/אֶת מִגְרָשֶֽׁי/הָ
verses.translit: vmmth 'shr 't mshl v't mgrshyh v't 'bdvn v't mgrshyh
verses.translation: And Ashan with her suburbs, and Beth-shemesh with her suburbs:

verses.original: וְ/אֶת חוּקֹק֙ וְ/אֶת מִגְרָשֶׁ֔י/הָ וְ/אֶת רְחֹ֖ב וְ/אֶת מִגְרָשֶֽׁי/הָ
verses.translit: v't chvqq v't mgrshyh v't rchb v't mgrshyh
verses.translation: And out of the tribe of Benjamin; Geba with her suburbs, and Alemeth with her suburbs, and Anathoth with her suburbs. All their cities throughout their families were thirteen cities.

verses.original: וּ/מִ/מַּטֵּ֣ה נַפְתָּלִ֗י אֶת קֶ֤דֶשׁ בַּ/גָּלִיל֙ וְ/אֶת מִגְרָשֶׁ֔י/הָ וְ/אֶת חַמּ֖וֹן וְ/אֶת מִגְרָשֶׁ֑י/הָ וְ/אֶת קִרְיָתַ֖יִם וְ/אֶת מִגְרָשֶֽׁי/הָ
verses.translit: vmmth nptly 't qdsh bglyl v't mgrshyh v't chmvn v't mgrshyh v't qrytym v't mgrshyh
verses.translation: And unto the sons of Kohath, which were left of the family of that tribe, were cities given out of the half tribe, namely, out of the half tribe of Manasseh, by lot, ten cities.

verses.original: לִ/בְנֵ֣י מְרָרִי֮ הַ/נּוֹתָרִים֒ מִ/מַּטֵּ֣ה זְבוּלֻ֔ן אֶת רִמּוֹנ֖וֹ וְ/אֶת מִגְרָשֶׁ֑י/הָ אֶת תָּב֖וֹר וְ/אֶת מִגְרָשֶֽׁי/הָ
verses.translit: lbny mrry hnvtrym mmth zbvln 't rmvnv v't mgrshyh 't tbvr v't mgrshyh
verses.translation: And to the sons of Gershom throughout their families out of the tribe of Issachar, and out of the tribe of Asher, and out of the tribe of Naphtali, and out of the tribe of Manasseh in Bashan, thirteen cities.

verses.original: וּ/מֵ/עֵ֜בֶר לְ/יַרְדֵּ֣ן יְרֵחוֹ֮ לְ/מִזְרַ֣ח הַ/יַּרְדֵּן֒ מִ/מַּטֵּ֣ה רְאוּבֵ֔ן אֶת בֶּ֥צֶר בַּ/מִּדְבָּ֖ר וְ/אֶת מִגְרָשֶׁ֑י/הָ וְ/אֶת יַ֖הְצָ/ה וְ/אֶת מִגְרָשֶֽׁי/הָ
verses.translit: vm'br lyrdn yrchv lmzrch hyrdn mmth r'vbn 't btsr bmdbr v't mgrshyh v't yhtsh v't mgrshyh
verses.translation: Unto the sons of Merari were given by lot, throughout their families, out of the tribe of Reuben, and out of the tribe of Gad, and out of the tribe of Zebulun, twelve cities.

verses.original: וְ/אֶת קְדֵמוֹת֙ וְ/אֶת מִגְרָשֶׁ֔י/הָ וְ/אֶת מֵיפַ֖עַת וְ/אֶת מִגְרָשֶֽׁי/הָ
verses.translit: v't qdmvt v't mgrshyh v't myp't v't mgrshyh
verses.translation: And the children of Israel gave to the Levites these cities with their suburbs.

verses.original: וּ/מִ֨/מַּטֵּה גָ֔ד אֶת רָאמ֥וֹת בַּ/גִּלְעָ֖ד וְ/אֶת מִגְרָשֶׁ֑י/הָ וְ/אֶֽת מַחֲנַ֖יִם וְ/אֶת מִגְרָשֶֽׁי/הָ
verses.translit: vmmth gd 't r'mvt bgl'd v't mgrshyh v't mchnym v't mgrshyh
verses.translation: And they gave by lot out of the tribe of the children of Judah, and out of the tribe of the children of Simeon, and out of the tribe of the children of Benjamin, these cities, which are called by their names.

verses.original: וְ/אֶת חֶשְׁבּוֹן֙ וְ/אֶת מִגְרָשֶׁ֔י/הָ וְ/אֶת יַעְזֵ֖יר וְ/אֶת מִגְרָשֶֽׁי/הָ
verses.translit: v't chshbvn v't mgrshyh v't y'zyr v't mgrshyh
verses.translation: And the residue of the families of the sons of Kohath had cities of their coasts out of the tribe of Ephraim.
And they gave unto them, of the cities of refuge, Shechem in mount Ephraim with her suburbs; they gave also Gezer with her suburbs,
And Jokmeam with her suburbs, and Beth-horon with her suburbs,
And Aijalon with her suburbs, and Gath-rimmon with her suburbs:
And out of the half tribe of Manasseh; Aner with her suburbs, and Bileam with her suburbs, for the family of the remnant of the sons of Kohath.
Unto the sons of Gershom were given out of the family of the half tribe of Manasseh, Golan in Bashan with her suburbs, and Ashtaroth with her suburbs:
And out of the tribe of Issachar; Kedesh with her suburbs, Daberath with her suburbs,
And Ramoth with her suburbs, and Anem with her suburbs:
And out of the tribe of Asher; Mashal with her suburbs, and Abdon with her suburbs,
And Hukok with her suburbs, and Rehob with her suburbs:
And out of the tribe of Naphtali; Kedesh in Galilee with her suburbs, and Hammon with her suburbs, and Kirjathaim with her suburbs.
Unto the rest of the children of Merari were given out of the tribe of Zebulun, Rimmon with her suburbs, Tabor with her suburbs:
And on the other side Jordan by Jericho, on the east side of Jordan, were given them out of the tribe of Reuben, Bezer in the wilderness with her suburbs, and Jahzah with her suburbs,
Kedemoth also with her suburbs, and Mephaath with her suburbs:
And out of the tribe of Gad; Ramoth in Gilead with her suburbs, and Mahanaim with her suburbs,
And Heshbon with her suburbs, and Jazer with her suburbs.

verses.original: וְ/לִ/בְנֵ֣י יִשָׂשכָ֗ר תּוֹלָ֧ע וּ/פוּאָ֛ה ישיב יָשׁ֥וּב וְ/שִׁמְר֖וֹן אַרְבָּעָֽה
verses.translit: vlbny yshshkhr tvl' vpv'h yshyb yshvb vshmrvn 'rb'h
verses.translation: Now the sons of Issachar were , Tola, and Puah, Jashub, and Shimron, four.

verses.original: וּ/בְנֵ֣י תוֹלָ֗ע עֻזִּ֡י וּ/רְפָיָ֡ה וִֽ֠/ירִיאֵל וְ/יַחְמַ֨י וְ/יִבְשָׂ֜ם וּ/שְׁמוּאֵ֗ל רָאשִׁ֤ים לְ/בֵית אֲבוֹתָ/ם֙ לְ/תוֹלָ֔ע גִּבּ֥וֹרֵי חַ֖יִל לְ/תֹלְדוֹתָ֑/ם מִסְפָּרָ/ם֙ בִּ/ימֵ֣י דָוִ֔יד עֶשְׂרִֽים וּ/שְׁנַ֥יִם אֶ֖לֶף וְ/שֵׁ֥שׁ מֵאֽוֹת
verses.translit: vbny tvl' 'zy vrpyh vyry'l vychmy vybshm vshmv'l r'shym lbyt 'bvtm ltvl' gbvry chyl ltldvtm msprm bymy dvyd 'shrym vshnym 'lf vshsh m'vt
verses.translation: And the sons of Tola; Uzzi, and Rephaiah, and Jeriel, and Jahmai, and Jibsam, and Shemuel, heads of their father’s house, to wit , of Tola: they were valiant men of might in their generations; whose number was in the days of David two and twenty thousand and six hundred.

verses.original: וּ/בְנֵ֥י עֻזִּ֖י יִֽזְרַֽחְיָ֑ה וּ/בְנֵ֣י יִֽזְרַֽחְיָ֗ה מִֽיכָאֵ֡ל וְ֠/עֹבַדְיָה וְ/יוֹאֵ֧ל יִשִּׁיָּ֛ה חֲמִשָּׁ֖ה רָאשִׁ֥ים כֻּלָּֽ/ם
verses.translit: vbny 'zy yzrchyh vbny yzrchyh mykh'l v'bdyh vyv'l yshyh chmshh r'shym khlm
verses.translation: And the sons of Uzzi; Izrahiah: and the sons of Izrahiah; Michael, and Obadiah, and Joel, Ishiah, five: all of them chief men.

verses.original: וַ/עֲלֵי/הֶ֨ם לְ/תֹלְדוֹתָ֜/ם לְ/בֵ֣ית אֲבוֹתָ֗/ם גְּדוּדֵי֙ צְבָ֣א מִלְחָמָ֔ה שְׁלֹשִׁ֥ים וְ/שִׁשָּׁ֖ה אָ֑לֶף כִּֽי הִרְבּ֥וּ נָשִׁ֖ים וּ/בָנִֽים
verses.translit: v'lyhm ltldvtm lbyt 'bvtm gdvdy tsb' mlchmh shlshym vshshh 'lf khy hrbv nshym vbnym
verses.translation: And with them, by their generations, after the house of their fathers, were bands of soldiers for war, six and thirty thousand men: for they had many wives and sons.

verses.original: וַ/אֲחֵי/הֶ֗ם לְ/כֹל֙ מִשְׁפְּח֣וֹת יִשָׂשכָ֔ר גִּבּוֹרֵ֖י חֲיָלִ֑ים שְׁמוֹנִ֤ים וְ/שִׁבְעָה֙ אֶ֔לֶף הִתְיַחְשָׂ֖/ם לַ/כֹּֽל
verses.translit: v'chyhm lkhl mshpchvt yshshkhr gbvry chylym shmvnym vshb'h 'lf htychshm lkhl
verses.translation: And their brethren among all the families of Issachar were valiant men of might, reckoned in all by their genealogies fourscore and seven thousand.

verses.original: בִּנְיָמִ֗ן בֶּ֧לַע וָ/בֶ֛כֶר וִ/ידִֽיעֲאֵ֖ל שְׁלֹשָֽׁה
verses.translit: bnymn bl' vbkhr vydy''l shlshh
verses.translation: The sons of Benjamin; Bela, and Becher, and Jediael, three.

verses.original: וּ/בְנֵ֣י בֶ֗לַע אֶצְבּ֡וֹן וְ/עֻזִּ֡י וְ֠/עֻזִּיאֵל וִ/ירִימ֨וֹת וְ/עִירִ֜י חֲמִשָּׁ֗ה רָאשֵׁי֙ בֵּ֣ית אָב֔וֹת גִּבּוֹרֵ֖י חֲיָלִ֑ים וְ/הִתְיַחְשָׂ֗/ם עֶשְׂרִ֤ים וּ/שְׁנַ֨יִם֙ אֶ֔לֶף וּ/שְׁלֹשִׁ֖ים וְ/אַרְבָּעָֽה
verses.translit: vbny bl' 'tsbvn v'zy v'zy'l vyrymvt v'yry chmshh r'shy byt 'bvt gbvry chylym vhtychshm 'shrym vshnym 'lf vshlshym v'rb'h
verses.translation: And the sons of Bela; Ezbon, and Uzzi, and Uzziel, and Jerimoth, and Iri, five; heads of the house of their fathers, mighty men of valour; and were reckoned by their genealogies twenty and two thousand and thirty and four.

verses.original: וּ/בְנֵ֣י בֶ֗כֶר זְמִירָ֡ה וְ/יוֹעָ֡שׁ וֶ֠/אֱלִיעֶזֶר וְ/אֶלְיוֹעֵינַ֤י וְ/עָמְרִי֙ וִ/ירֵמ֣וֹת וַ/אֲבִיָּ֔ה וַ/עֲנָת֖וֹת וְ/עָלָ֑מֶת כָּל אֵ֖לֶּה בְּנֵי בָֽכֶר
verses.translit: vbny bkhr zmyrh vyv'sh v'ly'zr v'lyv'yny v'mry vyrmvt v'byh v'ntvt v'lmt khl 'lh bny bkhr
verses.translation: And the sons of Becher; Zemira, and Joash, and Eliezer, and Elioenai, and Omri, and Jerimoth, and Abiah, and Anathoth, and Alameth. All these are the sons of Becher.

verses.original: וְ/הִתְיַחְשָׂ֣/ם לְ/תֹלְדוֹתָ֗/ם רָאשֵׁי֙ בֵּ֣ית אֲבוֹתָ֔/ם גִּבּוֹרֵ֖י חָ֑יִל עֶשְׂרִ֥ים אֶ֖לֶף וּ/מָאתָֽיִם
verses.translit: vhtychshm ltldvtm r'shy byt 'bvtm gbvry chyl 'shrym 'lf vm'tym
verses.translation: And the number of them, after their genealogy by their generations, heads of the house of their fathers, mighty men of valour, was twenty thousand and two hundred.

verses.original: וּ/בְנֵ֥י יְדִיעֲאֵ֖ל בִּלְהָ֑ן וּ/בְנֵ֣י בִלְהָ֗ן יעיש יְע֡וּשׁ וּ֠/בִנְיָמִן וְ/אֵה֤וּד וּֽ/כְנַעֲנָה֙ וְ/זֵיתָ֔ן וְ/תַרְשִׁ֖ישׁ וַ/אֲחִישָֽׁחַר
verses.translit: vbny ydy''l blhn vbny blhn y'ysh y'vsh vbnymn v'hvd vkhn'nh vzytn vtrshysh v'chyshchr
verses.translation: The sons also of Jediael; Bilhan: and the sons of Bilhan; Jeush, and Benjamin, and Ehud, and Chenaanah, and Zethan, and Tharshish, and Ahishahar.

verses.original: כָּל אֵ֜לֶּה בְּנֵ֤י יְדִֽיעֲאֵל֙ לְ/רָאשֵׁ֣י הָ/אָב֔וֹת גִּבּוֹרֵ֖י חֲיָלִ֑ים שִׁבְעָֽה עָשָׂ֥ר אֶ֨לֶף֙ וּ/מָאתַ֔יִם יֹצְאֵ֥י צָבָ֖א לַ/מִּלְחָמָֽה
verses.translit: khl 'lh bny ydy''l lr'shy h'bvt gbvry chylym shb'h 'shr 'lf vm'tym yts'y tsb' lmlchmh
verses.translation: All these the sons of Jediael, by the heads of their fathers, mighty men of valour, were seventeen thousand and two hundred soldiers , fit to go out for war and battle.

verses.original: וְ/שֻׁפִּ֤ם וְ/חֻפִּם֙ בְּנֵ֣י עִ֔יר חֻשִׁ֖ם בְּנֵ֥י אַחֵֽר
verses.translit: vshpm vchpm bny 'yr chshm bny 'chr
verses.translation: Shuppim also, and Huppim, the children of Ir, and Hushim, the sons of Aher.

verses.original: בְּנֵ֣י נַפְתָּלִ֗י יַחֲצִיאֵ֧ל וְ/גוּנִ֛י וְ/יֵ֥צֶר וְ/שַׁלּ֖וּם בְּנֵ֥י בִלְהָֽה
verses.translit: bny nptly ychtsy'l vgvny vytsr vshlvm bny blhh
verses.translation: The sons of Naphtali; Jahziel, and Guni, and Jezer, and Shallum, the sons of Bilhah.

verses.original: בְּנֵ֣י מְנַשֶּׁ֔ה אַשְׂרִיאֵ֖ל אֲשֶׁ֣ר יָלָ֑דָה פִּֽילַגְשׁ/וֹ֙ הָֽ/אֲרַמִּיָּ֔ה יָלְדָ֕ה אֶת מָכִ֖יר אֲבִ֥י גִלְעָֽד
verses.translit: bny mnshh 'shry'l 'shr yldh pylgshv h'rmyh yldh 't mkhyr 'by gl'd
verses.translation: The sons of Manasseh; Ashriel, whom she bare: ( but his concubine the Aramitess bare Machir the father of Gilead:

verses.original: וּ/מָכִ֞יר לָקַ֤ח אִשָּׁה֙ לְ/חֻפִּ֣ים וּ/לְ/שֻׁפִּ֔ים וְ/שֵׁ֤ם אֲחֹת/וֹ֙ מַעֲכָ֔ה וְ/שֵׁ֥ם הַ/שֵּׁנִ֖י צְלָפְחָ֑ד וַ/תִּהְיֶ֥נָה לִ/צְלָפְחָ֖ד בָּנֽוֹת
verses.translit: vmkhyr lqch 'shh lchpym vlshpym vshm 'chtv m'khh vshm hshny tslpchd vthynh ltslpchd bnvt
verses.translation: And Machir took to wife the sister of Huppim and Shuppim, whose sister’s name was Maachah;) and the name of the second was Zelophehad: and Zelophehad had daughters.

verses.original: וַ/תֵּ֨לֶד מַעֲכָ֤ה אֵֽשֶׁת מָכִיר֙ בֵּ֔ן וַ/תִּקְרָ֤א שְׁמ/וֹ֙ פֶּ֔רֶשׁ וְ/שֵׁ֥ם אָחִ֖י/ו שָׁ֑רֶשׁ וּ/בָנָ֖י/ו אוּלָ֥ם וָ/רָֽקֶם
verses.translit: vtld m'khh 'sht mkhyr bn vtqr' shmv prsh vshm 'chyv shrsh vbnyv 'vlm vrqm
verses.translation: And Maachah the wife of Machir bare a son, and she called his name Peresh; and the name of his brother was Sheresh; and his sons were Ulam and Rakem.

verses.original: וּ/בְנֵ֥י אוּלָ֖ם בְּדָ֑ן אֵ֚לֶּה בְּנֵ֣י גִלְעָ֔ד בֶּן מָכִ֖יר בֶּן מְנַשֶּֽׁה
verses.translit: vbny 'vlm bdn 'lh bny gl'd bn mkhyr bn mnshh
verses.translation: And the sons of Ulam; Bedan. These were the sons of Gilead, the son of Machir, the son of Manasseh.

verses.original: וַ/אֲחֹת֖/וֹ הַ/מֹּלֶ֑כֶת יָלְדָה֙ אֶת אִישְׁה֔וֹד וְ/אֶת אֲבִיעֶ֖זֶר וְ/אֶת מַחְלָֽה
verses.translit: v'chtv hmlkht yldh 't 'yshhvd v't 'by'zr v't mchlh
verses.translation: And his sister Hammoleketh bare Ishod, and Abiezer, and Mahalah.

verses.original: וַ/יִּהְי֖וּ בְּנֵ֣י שְׁמִידָ֑ע אַחְיָ֣ן וָ/שֶׁ֔כֶם וְ/לִקְחִ֖י וַ/אֲנִיעָֽם
verses.translit: vyhyv bny shmyd' 'chyn vshkhm vlqchy v'ny'm
verses.translation: And the sons of Shemida were, Ahian, and Shechem, and Likhi, and Aniam.

verses.original: וּ/בְנֵ֥י אֶפְרַ֖יִם שׁוּתָ֑לַח וּ/בֶ֤רֶד בְּנ/וֹ֙ וְ/תַ֣חַת בְּנ֔/וֹ וְ/אֶלְעָדָ֥ה בְנ֖/וֹ וְ/תַ֥חַת בְּנֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: vbny 'prym shvtlch vbrd bnv vtcht bnv v'l'dh bnv vtcht bnv
verses.translation: And the sons of Ephraim; Shuthelah, and Bered his son, and Tahath his son, and Eladah his son, and Tahath his son,

verses.original: וְ/זָבָ֥ד בְּנ֛/וֹ וְ/שׁוּתֶ֥לַח בְּנ֖/וֹ וְ/עֵ֣זֶר וְ/אֶלְעָ֑ד וַ/הֲרָג֗וּ/ם אַנְשֵׁי גַת֙ הַ/נּוֹלָדִ֣ים בָּ/אָ֔רֶץ כִּ֣י יָרְד֔וּ לָ/קַ֖חַת אֶת מִקְנֵי/הֶֽם
verses.translit: vzbd bnv vshvtlch bnv v'zr v'l'd vhrgvm 'nshy gt hnvldym b'rts khy yrdv lqcht 't mqnyhm
verses.translation: And Zabad his son, and Shuthelah his son, and Ezer, and Elead, whom the men of Gath that were born in that land slew, because they came down to take away their cattle.

verses.original: וַ/יִּתְאַבֵּ֛ל אֶפְרַ֥יִם אֲבִי/הֶ֖ם יָמִ֣ים רַבִּ֑ים וַ/יָּבֹ֥אוּ אֶחָ֖י/ו לְ/נַחֲמֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: vyt'bl 'prym 'byhm ymym rbym vyb'v 'chyv lnchmv
verses.translation: And Ephraim their father mourned many days, and his brethren came to comfort him.

verses.original: וַ/יָּבֹא֙ אֶל אִשְׁתּ֔/וֹ וַ/תַּ֖הַר וַ/תֵּ֣לֶד בֵּ֑ן וַ/יִּקְרָ֤א אֶת שְׁמ/וֹ֙ בְּרִיעָ֔ה כִּ֥י בְ/רָעָ֖ה הָיְתָ֥ה בְּ/בֵיתֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: vyb' 'l 'shtv vthr vtld bn vyqr' 't shmv bry'h khy br'h hyth bbytv
verses.translation: And when he went in to his wife, she conceived, and bare a son, and he called his name Beriah, because it went evil with his house.

verses.original: וּ/בִתּ֣/וֹ שֶׁאֱרָ֔ה וַ/תִּ֧בֶן אֶת בֵּית חוֹר֛וֹן הַ/תַּחְתּ֖וֹן וְ/אֶת הָ/עֶלְי֑וֹן וְ/אֵ֖ת אֻזֵּ֥ן שֶׁאֱרָֽה
verses.translit: vbtv sh'rh vtbn 't byt chvrvn htchtvn v't h'lyvn v't 'zn sh'rh
verses.translation: (And his daughter was Sherah, who built Beth-horon the nether, and the upper, and Uzzen-sherah.)

verses.original: וְ/רֶ֣פַח בְּנ֗/וֹ וְ/רֶ֧שֶׁף וְ/תֶ֛לַח בְּנ֖/וֹ וְ/תַ֥חַן בְּנֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: vrpch bnv vrshf vtlch bnv vtchn bnv
verses.translation: And Rephah was his son, also Resheph, and Telah his son, and Tahan his son,

verses.original: לַעְדָּ֥ן בְּנ֛/וֹ עַמִּיה֥וּד בְּנ֖/וֹ אֱלִישָׁמָ֥ע בְּנֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: l'dn bnv 'myhvd bnv 'lyshm' bnv
verses.translation: Laadan his son, Ammihud his son, Elishama his son,

verses.original: נ֥וֹן בְּנ֖/וֹ יְהוֹשֻׁ֥עַ בְּנֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: nvn bnv yhvsh' bnv
verses.translation: Non his son, Jehoshua his son.

verses.original: וַ/אֲחֻזָּתָ/ם֙ וּ/מֹ֣שְׁבוֹתָ֔/ם בֵּֽית אֵ֖ל וּ/בְנֹתֶ֑י/הָ וְ/לַ/מִּזְרָ֣ח נַעֲרָ֔ן וְ/לַֽ/מַּעֲרָ֗ב גֶּ֤זֶר וּ/בְנֹתֶ֨י/הָ֙ וּ/שְׁכֶ֣ם וּ/בְנֹתֶ֔י/הָ עַד עַיָּ֖ה וּ/בְנֹתֶֽי/הָ
verses.translit: v'chztm vmshbvtm byt 'l vbntyh vlmzrch n'rn vlm'rb gzr vbntyh vshkhm vbntyh 'd 'yh vbntyh
