verses.translation: And their possessions and habitations were , Beth-el and the towns thereof, and eastward Naaran, and westward Gezer, with the towns thereof; Shechem also and the towns thereof, unto Gaza and the towns thereof:

verses.original: וְ/עַל יְדֵ֣י בְנֵי מְנַשֶּׁ֗ה בֵּית שְׁאָ֤ן וּ/בְנֹתֶ֨י/הָ֙ תַּעְנַ֣ךְ וּ/בְנֹתֶ֔י/הָ מְגִדּ֥וֹ וּ/בְנוֹתֶ֖י/הָ דּ֣וֹר וּ/בְנוֹתֶ֑י/הָ בְּ/אֵ֨לֶּה֙ יָשְׁב֔וּ בְּנֵ֥י יוֹסֵ֖ף בֶּן יִשְׂרָאֵֽל
verses.translit: v'l ydy bny mnshh byt sh'n vbntyh t'nkh vbntyh mgdv vbnvtyh dvr vbnvtyh b'lh yshbv bny yvsf bn yshr'l
verses.translation: And by the borders of the children of Manasseh, Beth-shean and her towns, Taanach and her towns, Megiddo and her towns, Dor and her towns. In these dwelt the children of Joseph the son of Israel.

verses.original: בְּנֵ֣י אָשֵׁ֗ר יִמְנָ֧ה וְ/יִשְׁוָ֛ה וְ/יִשְׁוִ֥י וּ/בְרִיעָ֖ה וְ/שֶׂ֥רַח אֲחוֹתָֽ/ם
verses.translit: bny 'shr ymnh vyshvh vyshvy vbry'h vshrch 'chvtm
verses.translation: The sons of Asher; Imnah, and Isuah, and Ishuai, and Beriah, and Serah their sister.

verses.original: וּ/בְנֵ֣י בְרִיעָ֔ה חֶ֖בֶר וּ/מַלְכִּיאֵ֑ל ה֖וּא אֲבִ֥י ברזות בִרְזָֽיִת
verses.translit: vbny bry'h chbr vmlkhy'l hv' 'by brzvt brzyt
verses.translation: And the sons of Beriah; Heber, and Malchiel, who is the father of Birzavith.

verses.original: וְ/חֶ֨בֶר֙ הוֹלִ֣יד אֶת יַפְלֵ֔ט וְ/אֶת שׁוֹמֵ֖ר וְ/אֶת חוֹתָ֑ם וְ/אֵ֖ת שׁוּעָ֥א אֲחוֹתָֽ/ם
verses.translit: vchbr hvlyd 't yplt v't shvmr v't chvtm v't shv'' 'chvtm
verses.translation: And Heber begat Japhlet, and Shomer, and Hotham, and Shua their sister.

verses.original: וּ/בְנֵ֣י יַפְלֵ֔ט פָּסַ֥ךְ וּ/בִמְהָ֖ל וְ/עַשְׁוָ֑ת אֵ֖לֶּה בְּנֵ֥י יַפְלֵֽט
verses.translit: vbny yplt pskh vbmhl v'shvt 'lh bny yplt
verses.translation: And the sons of Japhlet; Pasach, and Bimhal, and Ashvath. These are the children of Japhlet.

verses.original: וּ/בְנֵ֖י שָׁ֑מֶר אֲחִ֥י ו/רוהגה וְ/רָהְגָּ֖ה יחבה וְ/חֻבָּ֥ה וַ/אֲרָֽם
verses.translit: vbny shmr 'chy vrvhgh vrhgh ychbh vchbh v'rm
verses.translation: And the sons of Shamer; Ahi, and Rohgah, Jehubbah, and Aram.

verses.original: וּ/בֶן הֵ֖לֶם אָחִ֑י/ו צוֹפַ֥ח וְ/יִמְנָ֖ע וְ/שֵׁ֥לֶשׁ וְ/עָמָֽל
verses.translit: vbn hlm 'chyv tsvpch vymn' vshlsh v'ml
verses.translation: And the sons of his brother Helem; Zophah, and Imna, and Shelesh, and Amal.

verses.original: בְּנֵ֖י צוֹפָ֑ח ס֧וּחַ וְ/חַרְנֶ֛פֶר וְ/שׁוּעָ֖ל וּ/בֵרִ֥י וְ/יִמְרָֽה
verses.translit: bny tsvpch svch vchrnpr vshv'l vbry vymrh
verses.translation: The sons of Zophah; Suah, and Harnepher, and Shual, and Beri, and Imrah,

verses.original: בֶּ֣צֶר וָ/ה֗וֹד וְ/שַׁמָּ֧א וְ/שִׁלְשָׁ֛ה וְ/יִתְרָ֖ן וּ/בְאֵרָֽא
verses.translit: btsr vhvd vshm' vshlshh vytrn vb'r'
verses.translation: Bezer, and Hod, and Shamma, and Shilshah, and Ithran, and Beera.

verses.original: וּ/בְנֵ֖י יֶ֑תֶר יְפֻנֶּ֥ה וּ/פִסְפָּ֖ה וַ/אְרָֽא
verses.translit: vbny ytr ypnh vpsph v'r'
verses.translation: And the sons of Jether; Jephunneh, and Pispah, and Ara.

verses.original: וּ/בְנֵ֖י עֻלָּ֑א אָרַ֥ח וְ/חַנִּיאֵ֖ל וְ/רִצְיָֽא
verses.translit: vbny 'l' 'rch vchny'l vrtsy'
verses.translation: And the sons of Ulla; Arah, and Haniel, and Rezia.

verses.original: כָּל אֵ֣לֶּה בְנֵי אָ֠שֵׁר רָאשֵׁ֨י בֵית הָ/אָב֤וֹת בְּרוּרִים֙ גִּבּוֹרֵ֣י חֲיָלִ֔ים רָאשֵׁ֖י הַ/נְּשִׂיאִ֑ים וְ/הִתְיַחְשָׂ֤/ם בַּ/צָּבָא֙ בַּ/מִּלְחָמָ֔ה מִסְפָּרָ֣/ם אֲנָשִׁ֔ים עֶשְׂרִ֥ים וְ/שִׁשָּׁ֖ה אָֽלֶף
verses.translit: khl 'lh bny 'shr r'shy byt h'bvt brvrym gbvry chylym r'shy hnshy'ym vhtychshm btsb' bmlchmh msprm 'nshym 'shrym vshshh 'lf
verses.translation: All these were the children of Asher, heads of their father’s house, choice and mighty men of valour, chief of the princes. And the number throughout the genealogy of them that were apt to the war and to battle was twenty and six thousand men.

verses.original: וּ/בִ֨נְיָמִ֔ן הוֹלִ֖יד אֶת בֶּ֣לַע בְּכֹר֑/וֹ אַשְׁבֵּל֙ הַ/שֵּׁנִ֔י וְ/אַחְרַ֖ח הַ/שְּׁלִישִֽׁי
verses.translit: vbnymn hvlyd 't bl' bkhrv 'shbl hshny v'chrch hshlyshy
verses.translation: Now Benjamin begat Bela his firstborn, Ashbel the second, and Aharah the third,

verses.original: נוֹחָה֙ הָֽ/רְבִיעִ֔י וְ/רָפָ֖א הַ/חֲמִישִֽׁי
verses.translit: nvchh hrby'y vrp' hchmyshy
verses.translation: Nohah the fourth, and Rapha the fifth.

verses.original: וַ/יִּהְי֥וּ בָנִ֖ים לְ/בָ֑לַע אַדָּ֥ר וְ/גֵרָ֖א וַ/אֲבִיהֽוּד
verses.translit: vyhyv bnym lbl' 'dr vgr' v'byhvd
verses.translation: And the sons of Bela were, Addar, and Gera, and Abihud,

verses.original: וַ/אֲבִישׁ֥וּעַ וְ/נַעֲמָ֖ן וַ/אֲחֽוֹחַ
verses.translit: v'byshv' vn'mn v'chvch
verses.translation: And Abishua, and Naaman, and Ahoah,

verses.original: וְ/גֵרָ֥א וּ/שְׁפוּפָ֖ן וְ/חוּרָֽם
verses.translit: vgr' vshpvpn vchvrm
verses.translation: And Gera, and Shephuphan, and Huram.

verses.original: וְ/אֵ֖לֶּה בְּנֵ֣י אֵח֑וּד אֵ֣לֶּה הֵ֞ם רָאשֵׁ֤י אָבוֹת֙ לְ/י֣וֹשְׁבֵי גֶ֔בַע וַ/יַּגְל֖וּ/ם אֶל מָנָֽחַת
verses.translit: v'lh bny 'chvd 'lh hm r'shy 'bvt lyvshby gb' vyglvm 'l mncht
verses.translation: And these are the sons of Ehud: these are the heads of the fathers of the inhabitants of Geba, and they removed them to Manahath:

verses.original: וְ/נַעֲמָ֧ן וַ/אֲחִיָּ֛ה וְ/גֵרָ֖א ה֣וּא הֶגְלָ֑/ם וְ/הוֹלִ֥יד אֶת עֻזָּ֖א וְ/אֶת אֲחִיחֻֽד
verses.translit: vn'mn v'chyh vgr' hv' hglm vhvlyd 't 'z' v't 'chychd
verses.translation: And Naaman, and Ahiah, and Gera, he removed them, and begat Uzza, and Ahihud.

verses.original: וְ/שַׁחֲרַ֗יִם הוֹלִיד֙ בִּ/שְׂדֵ֣ה מוֹאָ֔ב מִן שִׁלְח֖/וֹ אֹתָ֑/ם חוּשִׁ֥ים וְ/אֶֽת בַּעֲרָ֖א נָשָֽׁי/ו
verses.translit: vshchrym hvlyd bshdh mv'b mn shlchv 'tm chvshym v't b'r' nshyv
verses.translation: And Shaharaim begat children in the country of Moab, after he had sent them away; Hushim and Baara were his wives.

verses.original: וַ/יּ֖וֹלֶד מִן חֹ֣דֶשׁ אִשְׁתּ֑/וֹ אֶת יוֹבָב֙ וְ/אֶת צִבְיָ֔א וְ/אֶת מֵישָׁ֖א וְ/אֶת מַלְכָּֽם
verses.translit: vyvld mn chdsh 'shtv 't yvbb v't tsby' v't mysh' v't mlkhm
verses.translation: And he begat of Hodesh his wife, Jobab, and Zibia, and Mesha, and Malcham,

verses.original: וְ/אֶת יְע֥וּץ וְ/אֶת שָֽׂכְיָ֖ה וְ/אֶת מִרְמָ֑ה אֵ֥לֶּה בָנָ֖י/ו רָאשֵׁ֥י אָבֽוֹת
verses.translit: v't y'vts v't shkhyh v't mrmh 'lh bnyv r'shy 'bvt
verses.translation: And Jeuz, and Shachia, and Mirma. These were his sons, heads of the fathers.

verses.original: וּ/מֵ/חֻשִׁ֛ים הוֹלִ֥יד אֶת אֲבִיט֖וּב וְ/אֶת אֶלְפָּֽעַל
verses.translit: vmchshym hvlyd 't 'bytvb v't 'lp'l
verses.translation: And of Hushim he begat Abitub, and Elpaal.

verses.original: וּ/בְנֵ֣י אֶלְפַּ֔עַל עֵ֥בֶר וּ/מִשְׁעָ֖ם וָ/שָׁ֑מֶד ה֚וּא בָּנָ֣ה אֶת אוֹנ֔וֹ וְ/אֶת לֹ֖ד וּ/בְנֹתֶֽי/הָ
verses.translit: vbny 'lp'l 'br vmsh'm vshmd hv' bnh 't 'vnv v't ld vbntyh
verses.translation: The sons of Elpaal; Eber, and Misham, and Shamed, who built Ono, and Lod, with the towns thereof:

verses.original: וּ/בְרִעָ֣ה וָ/שֶׁ֔מַע הֵ֚מָּה רָאשֵׁ֣י הָ/אָב֔וֹת לְ/יוֹשְׁבֵ֖י אַיָּל֑וֹן הֵ֥מָּה הִבְרִ֖יחוּ אֶת י֥וֹשְׁבֵי גַֽת
verses.translit: vbr'h vshm' hmh r'shy h'bvt lyvshby 'ylvn hmh hbrychv 't yvshby gt
verses.translation: Beriah also, and Shema, who were heads of the fathers of the inhabitants of Aijalon, who drove away the inhabitants of Gath:

verses.original: וְ/אַחְי֥וֹ שָׁשָׁ֖ק וִ/ירֵמֽוֹת
verses.translit: v'chyv shshq vyrmvt
verses.translation: And Ahio, Shashak, and Jeremoth,

verses.original: וּ/זְבַדְיָ֥ה וַ/עֲרָ֖ד וָ/עָֽדֶר
verses.translit: vzbdyh v'rd v'dr
verses.translation: And Zebadiah, and Arad, and Ader,

verses.original: וּ/מִיכָאֵ֧ל וְ/יִשְׁפָּ֛ה וְ/יוֹחָ֖א בְּנֵ֥י בְרִיעָֽה
verses.translit: vmykh'l vyshph vyvch' bny bry'h
verses.translation: And Michael, and Ispah, and Joha, the sons of Beriah;

verses.original: וּ/זְבַדְיָ֥ה וּ/מְשֻׁלָּ֖ם וְ/חִזְקִ֥י וָ/חָֽבֶר
verses.translit: vzbdyh vmshlm vchzqy vchbr
verses.translation: And Zebadiah, and Meshullam, and Hezeki, and Heber,

verses.original: וְ/יִשְׁמְרַ֧י וְ/יִזְלִיאָ֛ה וְ/יוֹבָ֖ב בְּנֵ֥י אֶלְפָּֽעַל
verses.translit: vyshmry vyzly'h vyvbb bny 'lp'l
verses.translation: Ishmerai also, and Jezliah, and Jobab, the sons of Elpaal;

verses.original: וְ/יָקִ֥ים וְ/זִכְרִ֖י וְ/זַבְדִּֽי
verses.translit: vyqym vzkhry vzbdy
verses.translation: And Jakim, and Zichri, and Zabdi,

verses.original: וֶ/אֱלִיעֵנַ֥י וְ/צִלְּתַ֖י וֶ/אֱלִיאֵֽל
verses.translit: v'ly'ny vtslty v'ly'l
verses.translation: And Elienai, and Zilthai, and Eliel,

verses.original: וַ/עֲדָיָ֧ה וּ/בְרָאיָ֛ה וְ/שִׁמְרָ֖ת בְּנֵ֥י שִׁמְעִֽי
verses.translit: v'dyh vbr'yh vshmrt bny shm'y
verses.translation: And Adaiah, and Beraiah, and Shimrath, the sons of Shimhi;

verses.original: וְ/יִשְׁפָּ֥ן וָ/עֵ֖בֶר וֶ/אֱלִיאֵֽל
verses.translit: vyshpn v'br v'ly'l
verses.translation: And Ishpan, and Heber, and Eliel,

verses.original: וְ/עַבְדּ֥וֹן וְ/זִכְרִ֖י וְ/חָנָֽן
verses.translit: v'bdvn vzkhry vchnn
verses.translation: And Abdon, and Zichri, and Hanan,

verses.original: וַ/חֲנַנְיָ֥ה וְ/עֵילָ֖ם וְ/עַנְתֹתִיָּֽה
verses.translit: vchnnyh v'ylm v'nttyh
verses.translation: And Hananiah, and Elam, and Antothijah,

verses.original: וְ/יִפְדְיָ֥ה ו/פניאל וּ/פְנוּאֵ֖ל בְּנֵ֥י שָׁשָֽׁק
verses.translit: vypdyh vpny'l vpnv'l bny shshq
verses.translation: And Iphedeiah, and Penuel, the sons of Shashak;

verses.original: וְ/שַׁמְשְׁרַ֥י וּ/שְׁחַרְיָ֖ה וַ/עֲתַלְיָֽה
verses.translit: vshmshry vshchryh v'tlyh
verses.translation: And Shamsherai, and Shehariah, and Athaliah,

verses.original: וְ/יַעֲרֶשְׁיָ֧ה וְ/אֵלִיָּ֛ה וְ/זִכְרִ֖י בְּנֵ֥י יְרֹחָֽם
verses.translit: vy'rshyh v'lyh vzkhry bny yrchm
verses.translation: And Jaresiah, and Eliah, and Zichri, the sons of Jeroham.

verses.original: אֵ֣לֶּה רָאשֵׁ֥י אָב֛וֹת לְ/תֹלְדוֹתָ֖/ם רָאשִׁ֑ים אֵ֖לֶּה יָשְׁב֥וּ בִ/ירוּשָׁלִָֽם
verses.translit: 'lh r'shy 'bvt ltldvtm r'shym 'lh yshbv byrvshlm
verses.translation: These were heads of the fathers, by their generations, chief men . These dwelt in Jerusalem.

verses.original: וּ/בְ/גִבְע֥וֹן יָשְׁב֖וּ אֲבִ֣י גִבְע֑וֹן וְ/שֵׁ֥ם אִשְׁתּ֖/וֹ מַעֲכָֽה
verses.translit: vbgb'vn yshbv 'by gb'vn vshm 'shtv m'khh
verses.translation: And at Gibeon dwelt the father of Gibeon; whose wife’s name was Maachah:

verses.original: וּ/בְנ֥/וֹ הַ/בְּכ֖וֹר עַבְדּ֑וֹן וְ/צ֥וּר וְ/קִ֖ישׁ וּ/בַ֥עַל וְ/נָדָֽב
verses.translit: vbnv hbkhvr 'bdvn vtsvr vqysh vb'l vndb
verses.translation: And his firstborn son Abdon, and Zur, and Kish, and Baal, and Nadab,

verses.original: וּ/גְד֥וֹר וְ/אַחְי֖וֹ וָ/זָֽכֶר
verses.translit: vgdvr v'chyv vzkhr
verses.translation: And Gedor, and Ahio, and Zacher.

verses.original: וּ/מִקְל֖וֹת הוֹלִ֣יד אֶת שִׁמְאָ֑ה וְ/אַף הֵ֗מָּה נֶ֧גֶד אֲחֵי/הֶ֛ם יָשְׁב֥וּ בִ/ירוּשָׁלִַ֖ם עִם אֲחֵי/הֶֽם
verses.translit: vmqlvt hvlyd 't shm'h v'f hmh ngd 'chyhm yshbv byrvshlm 'm 'chyhm
verses.translation: And Mikloth begat Shimeah. And these also dwelt with their brethren in Jerusalem, over against them.

verses.original: וְ/נֵר֙ הוֹלִ֣יד אֶת קִ֔ישׁ וְ/קִ֖ישׁ הוֹלִ֣יד אֶת שָׁא֑וּל וְ/שָׁא֗וּל הוֹלִ֤יד אֶת יְהֽוֹנָתָן֙ וְ/אֶת מַלְכִּי שׁ֔וּעַ וְ/אֶת אֲבִֽינָדָ֖ב וְ/אֶת אֶשְׁבָּֽעַל
verses.translit: vnr hvlyd 't qysh vqysh hvlyd 't sh'vl vsh'vl hvlyd 't yhvntn v't mlkhy shv' v't 'byndb v't 'shb'l
verses.translation: And Ner begat Kish, and Kish begat Saul, and Saul begat Jonathan, and Malchi-shua, and Abinadab, and Esh-baal.

verses.original: וּ/בֶן יְהוֹנָתָ֖ן מְרִ֣יב בָּ֑עַל וּ/מְרִ֥יב בַּ֖עַל הוֹלִ֥יד אֶת מִיכָֽה
verses.translit: vbn yhvntn mryb b'l vmryb b'l hvlyd 't mykhh
verses.translation: And the son of Jonathan was Merib-baal; and Merib-baal begat Micah.

verses.original: וּ/בְנֵ֖י מִיכָ֑ה פִּית֥וֹן וָ/מֶ֖לֶךְ וְ/תַאְרֵ֥עַ וְ/אָחָֽז
verses.translit: vbny mykhh pytvn vmlkh vt'r' v'chz
verses.translation: And the sons of Micah were , Pithon, and Melech, and Tarea, and Ahaz.

verses.original: וְ/אָחָז֙ הוֹלִ֣יד אֶת יְהוֹעַדָּ֔ה וִ/יהֽוֹעַדָּ֗ה הוֹלִ֛יד אֶת עָלֶ֥מֶת וְ/אֶת עַזְמָ֖וֶת וְ/אֶת זִמְרִ֑י וְ/זִמְרִ֖י הוֹלִ֥יד אֶת מוֹצָֽא
verses.translit: v'chz hvlyd 't yhv'dh vyhv'dh hvlyd 't 'lmt v't 'zmvt v't zmry vzmry hvlyd 't mvts'
verses.translation: And Ahaz begat Jehoadah; and Jehoadah begat Alemeth, and Azmaveth, and Zimri; and Zimri begat Moza,

verses.original: וּ/מוֹצָ֖א הוֹלִ֣יד אֶת בִּנְעָ֑א רָפָ֥ה בְנ֛/וֹ אֶלְעָשָׂ֥ה בְנ֖/וֹ אָצֵ֥ל בְּנֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: vmvts' hvlyd 't bn'' rph bnv 'l'shh bnv 'tsl bnv
verses.translation: And Moza begat Binea: Rapha was his son, Eleasah his son, Azel his son:

verses.original: וּ/לְ/אָצֵל֮ שִׁשָּׁ֣ה בָנִים֒ וְ/אֵ֣לֶּה שְׁמוֹתָ֗/ם עַזְרִיקָ֥ם בֹּ֨כְרוּ֙ וְ/יִשְׁמָעֵ֣אל וּ/שְׁעַרְיָ֔ה וְ/עֹבַדְיָ֖ה וְ/חָנָ֑ן כָּל אֵ֖לֶּה בְּנֵ֥י אָצַֽל
verses.translit: vl'tsl shshh bnym v'lh shmvtm 'zryqm bkhrv vyshm''l vsh'ryh v'bdyh vchnn khl 'lh bny 'tsl
verses.translation: And Azel had six sons, whose names are these, Azrikam, Bocheru, and Ishmael, and Sheariah, and Obadiah, and Hanan. All these were the sons of Azel.

verses.original: וּ/בְנֵ֖י עֵ֣שֶׁק אָחִ֑י/ו אוּלָ֣ם בְּכֹר֔/וֹ יְעוּשׁ֙ הַ/שֵּׁנִ֔י וֶֽ/אֱלִיפֶ֖לֶט הַ/שְּׁלִשִֽׁי
verses.translit: vbny 'shq 'chyv 'vlm bkhrv y'vsh hshny v'lyplt hshlshy
verses.translation: And the sons of Eshek his brother were , Ulam his firstborn, Jehush the second, and Eliphelet the third.

verses.original: וַֽ/יִּהְי֣וּ בְנֵי א֠וּלָם אֲנָשִׁ֨ים גִּבֹּרֵי חַ֜יִל דֹּ֣רְכֵי קֶ֗שֶׁת וּ/מַרְבִּ֤ים בָּנִים֙ וּ/בְנֵ֣י בָנִ֔ים מֵאָ֖ה וַ/חֲמִשִּׁ֑ים כָּל אֵ֖לֶּה מִ/בְּנֵ֥י בִנְיָמִֽן
verses.translit: vyhyv bny 'vlm 'nshym gbry chyl drkhy qsht vmrbym bnym vbny bnym m'h vchmshym khl 'lh mbny bnymn
verses.translation: And the sons of Ulam were mighty men of valour, archers, and had many sons, and sons’ sons, an hundred and fifty. All these are of the sons of Benjamin.

verses.original: וְ/כָל יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ הִתְיַחְשׂ֔וּ וְ/הִנָּ֣/ם כְּתוּבִ֔ים עַל סֵ֖פֶר מַלְכֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וִ/יהוּדָ֛ה הָגְל֥וּ לְ/בָבֶ֖ל בְּ/מַעֲלָֽ/ם
verses.translit: vkhl yshr'l htychshv vhnm khtvbym 'l spr mlkhy yshr'l vyhvdh hglv lbbl bm'lm
verses.translation: So all Israel were reckoned by genealogies; and, behold, they were written in the book of the kings of Israel and Judah, who were carried away to Babylon for their transgression.

verses.original: וְ/הַ/יּוֹשְׁבִים֙ הָ/רִ֣אשֹׁנִ֔ים אֲשֶׁ֥ר בַּ/אֲחֻזָּתָ֖/ם בְּ/עָרֵי/הֶ֑ם יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ הַ/כֹּ֣הֲנִ֔ים הַ/לְוִיִּ֖ם וְ/הַ/נְּתִינִֽים
verses.translit: vhyvshbym hr'shnym 'shr b'chztm b'ryhm yshr'l hkhhnym hlvym vhntynym
verses.translation: Now the first inhabitants that dwelt in their possessions in their cities were , the Israelites, the priests, Levites, and the Nethinims.

verses.original: וּ/בִ/ירוּשָׁלִַ֨ם֙ יָשְׁב֔וּ מִן בְּנֵ֥י יְהוּדָ֖ה וּ/מִן בְּנֵ֣י בִנְיָמִ֑ן וּ/מִן בְּנֵ֥י אֶפְרַ֖יִם וּ/מְנַשֶּֽׁה
verses.translit: vbyrvshlm yshbv mn bny yhvdh vmn bny bnymn vmn bny 'prym vmnshh
verses.translation: And in Jerusalem dwelt of the children of Judah, and of the children of Benjamin, and of the children of Ephraim, and Manasseh;

verses.original: עוּתַ֨י בֶּן עַמִּיה֤וּד בֶּן עָמְרִי֙ בֶּן אִמְרִ֣י בֶן בני/מן בָּנִ֔י מִן בְּנֵי פֶ֖רֶץ בֶּן יְהוּדָֽה
verses.translit: 'vty bn 'myhvd bn 'mry bn 'mry bn bnymn bny mn bny prts bn yhvdh
verses.translation: Uthai the son of Ammihud, the son of Omri, the son of Imri, the son of Bani, of the children of Pharez the son of Judah.

verses.original: וּ/מִן הַ/שִּׁ֣ילוֹנִ֔י עֲשָׂיָ֥ה הַ/בְּכ֖וֹר וּ/בָנָֽי/ו
verses.translit: vmn hshylvny 'shyh hbkhvr vbnyv
verses.translation: And of the Shilonites; Asaiah the firstborn, and his sons.

verses.original: וּ/מִן בְּנֵי זֶ֖רַח יְעוּאֵ֑ל וַ/אֲחֵי/הֶ֖ם שֵׁשׁ מֵא֥וֹת וְ/תִשְׁעִֽים
verses.translit: vmn bny zrch y'v'l v'chyhm shsh m'vt vtsh'ym
verses.translation: And of the sons of Zerah; Jeuel, and their brethren, six hundred and ninety.

verses.original: וּ/מִן בְּנֵ֖י בִּנְיָמִ֑ן סַלּוּא֙ בֶּן מְשֻׁלָּ֔ם בֶּן הוֹדַוְיָ֖ה בֶּן הַ/סְּנֻאָֽה
verses.translit: vmn bny bnymn slv' bn mshlm bn hvdvyh bn hsn'h
verses.translation: And of the sons of Benjamin; Sallu the son of Meshullam, the son of Hodaviah, the son of Hasenuah,

verses.original: וְ/יִבְנְיָה֙ בֶּן יְרֹחָ֔ם וְ/אֵלָ֥ה בֶן עֻזִּ֖י בֶּן מִכְרִ֑י וּ/מְשֻׁלָּם֙ בֶּן שְׁפַטְיָ֔ה בֶּן רְעוּאֵ֖ל בֶּן יִבְנִיָּֽה
verses.translit: vybnyh bn yrchm v'lh bn 'zy bn mkhry vmshlm bn shptyh bn r'v'l bn ybnyh
verses.translation: And Ibneiah the son of Jeroham, and Elah the son of Uzzi, the son of Michri, and Meshullam the son of Shephathiah, the son of Reuel, the son of Ibnijah;

verses.original: וַ/אֲחֵי/הֶם֙ לְ/תֹ֣לְדוֹתָ֔/ם תְּשַׁ֥ע מֵא֖וֹת וַ/חֲמִשִּׁ֣ים וְ/שִׁשָּׁ֑ה כָּל אֵ֣לֶּה אֲנָשִׁ֔ים רָאשֵׁ֥י אָב֖וֹת לְ/בֵ֥ית אֲבֹתֵי/הֶֽם
verses.translit: v'chyhm ltldvtm tsh' m'vt vchmshym vshshh khl 'lh 'nshym r'shy 'bvt lbyt 'btyhm
verses.translation: And their brethren, according to their generations, nine hundred and fifty and six. All these men were chief of the fathers in the house of their fathers.

verses.original: וּ/מִן הַֽ/כֹּהֲנִ֑ים יְדַֽעְיָ֥ה וִ/יהוֹיָרִ֖יב וְ/יָכִֽין
verses.translit: vmn hkhhnym yd'yh vyhvyryb vykhyn
verses.translation: And of the priests; Jedaiah, and Jehoiarib, and Jachin,

verses.original: וַ/עֲזַרְיָ֨ה בֶן חִלְקִיָּ֜ה בֶּן מְשֻׁלָּ֣ם בֶּן צָד֗וֹק בֶּן מְרָיוֹת֙ בֶּן אֲחִיט֔וּב נְגִ֖יד בֵּ֥ית הָ/אֱלֹהִֽים
verses.translit: v'zryh bn chlqyh bn mshlm bn tsdvq bn mryvt bn 'chytvb ngyd byt h'lhym
verses.translation: And Azariah the son of Hilkiah, the son of Meshullam, the son of Zadok, the son of Meraioth, the son of Ahitub, the ruler of the house of God;

verses.original: וַ/עֲדָיָה֙ בֶּן יְרֹחָ֔ם בֶּן פַּשְׁח֖וּר בֶּן מַלְכִּיָּ֑ה וּ/מַעְשַׂ֨י בֶּן עֲדִיאֵ֧ל בֶּן יַחְזֵ֛רָה בֶּן מְשֻׁלָּ֥ם בֶּן מְשִׁלֵּמִ֖ית בֶּן אִמֵּֽר
verses.translit: v'dyh bn yrchm bn pshchvr bn mlkhyh vm'shy bn 'dy'l bn ychzrh bn mshlm bn mshlmyt bn 'mr
verses.translation: And Adaiah the son of Jeroham, the son of Pashur, the son of Malchijah, and Maasiai the son of Adiel, the son of Jahzerah, the son of Meshullam, the son of Meshillemith, the son of Immer;

verses.original: וַ/אֲחֵי/הֶ֗ם רָאשִׁים֙ לְ/בֵ֣ית אֲבוֹתָ֔/ם אֶ֕לֶף וּ/שְׁבַ֥ע מֵא֖וֹת וְ/שִׁשִּׁ֑ים גִּבּ֣וֹרֵי חֵ֔יל מְלֶ֖אכֶת עֲבוֹדַ֥ת בֵּית הָ/אֱלֹהִֽים
verses.translit: v'chyhm r'shym lbyt 'bvtm 'lf vshb' m'vt vshshym gbvry chyl ml'kht 'bvdt byt h'lhym
verses.translation: And their brethren, heads of the house of their fathers, a thousand and seven hundred and threescore; very able men for the work of the service of the house of God.

verses.original: וּ/מִֽן הַ/לְוִיִּ֑ם שְׁמַֽעְיָ֧ה בֶן חַשּׁ֛וּב בֶּן עַזְרִיקָ֥ם בֶּן חֲשַׁבְיָ֖ה מִן בְּנֵ֥י מְרָרִֽי
verses.translit: vmn hlvym shm'yh bn chshvb bn 'zryqm bn chshbyh mn bny mrry
verses.translation: And of the Levites; Shemaiah the son of Hasshub, the son of Azrikam, the son of Hashabiah, of the sons of Merari;

verses.original: וּ/בַקְבַּקַּ֥ר חֶ֖רֶשׁ וְ/גָלָ֑ל וּ/מַתַּנְיָה֙ בֶּן מִיכָ֔א בֶּן זִכְרִ֖י בֶּן אָסָֽף
verses.translit: vbqbqr chrsh vgll vmtnyh bn mykh' bn zkhry bn 'sf
verses.translation: And Bakbakkar, Heresh, and Galal, and Mattaniah the son of Micah, the son of Zichri, the son of Asaph;

verses.original: וְ/עֹבַדְיָה֙ בֶּֽן שְׁמַֽעְיָ֔ה בֶּן גָּלָ֖ל בֶּן יְדוּת֑וּן וּ/בֶרֶכְיָ֤ה בֶן אָסָא֙ בֶּן אֶלְקָנָ֔ה הַ/יּוֹשֵׁ֖ב בְּ/חַצְרֵ֥י נְטוֹפָתִֽי
verses.translit: v'bdyh bn shm'yh bn gll bn ydvtvn vbrkhyh bn 's' bn 'lqnh hyvshb bchtsry ntvpty
verses.translation: And Obadiah the son of Shemaiah, the son of Galal, the son of Jeduthun, and Berechiah the son of Asa, the son of Elkanah, that dwelt in the villages of the Netophathites.

verses.original: וְ/הַ/שֹּׁעֲרִים֙ שַׁלּ֣וּם וְ/עַקּ֔וּב וְ/טַלְמֹ֖ן וַ/אֲחִימָ֑ן וַ/אֲחִי/הֶ֥ם שַׁלּ֖וּם הָ/רֹֽאשׁ
verses.translit: vhsh'rym shlvm v'qvb vtlmn v'chymn v'chyhm shlvm hr'sh
verses.translation: And the porters were , Shallum, and Akkub, and Talmon, and Ahiman, and their brethren: Shallum was the chief;

verses.original: וְֽ/עַד הֵ֔נָּה בְּ/שַׁ֥עַר הַ/מֶּ֖לֶךְ מִזְרָ֑חָ/ה הֵ֚מָּה הַ/שֹּׁ֣עֲרִ֔ים לְ/מַחֲנ֖וֹת בְּנֵ֥י לֵוִֽי
verses.translit: v'd hnh bsh'r hmlkh mzrchh hmh hsh'rym lmchnvt bny lvy
verses.translation: Who hitherto waited in the king’s gate eastward: they were porters in the companies of the children of Levi.

verses.original: וְ/שַׁלּ֣וּם בֶּן ק֠וֹרֵא בֶּן אֶבְיָסָ֨ף בֶּן קֹ֜רַח וְֽ/אֶחָ֧י/ו לְ/בֵית אָבִ֣י/ו הַ/קָּרְחִ֗ים עַ֚ל מְלֶ֣אכֶת הָ/עֲבוֹדָ֔ה שֹׁמְרֵ֥י הַ/סִּפִּ֖ים לָ/אֹ֑הֶל וַ/אֲבֹֽתֵי/הֶם֙ עַל מַחֲנֵ֣ה יְהוָ֔ה שֹׁמְרֵ֖י הַ/מָּבֽוֹא
verses.translit: vshlvm bn qvr' bn 'bysf bn qrch v'chyv lbyt 'byv hqrchym 'l ml'kht h'bvdh shmry hspym l'hl v'btyhm 'l mchnh yhvh shmry hmbv'
verses.translation: And Shallum the son of Kore, the son of Ebiasaph, the son of Korah, and his brethren, of the house of his father, the Korahites, were over the work of the service, keepers of the gates of the tabernacle: and their fathers, being over the host of the LORD , were keepers of the entry.

verses.original: וּ/פִֽינְחָ֣ס בֶּן אֶלְעָזָ֗ר נָגִ֨יד הָיָ֧ה עֲלֵי/הֶ֛ם לְ/פָנִ֖ים יְהוָ֥ה עִמּֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: vpynchs bn 'l'zr ngyd hyh 'lyhm lpnym yhvh 'mv
verses.translation: And Phinehas the son of Eleazar was the ruler over them in time past, and the LORD was with him.

verses.original: זְכַרְיָה֙ בֶּ֣ן מְשֶֽׁלֶמְיָ֔ה שֹׁעֵ֥ר פֶּ֖תַח לְ/אֹ֥הֶל מוֹעֵֽד
verses.translit: zkhryh bn mshlmyh sh'r ptch l'hl mv'd
verses.translation: And Zechariah the son of Meshelemiah was porter of the door of the tabernacle of the congregation.

verses.original: כֻּלָּ֤/ם הַ/בְּרוּרִים֙ לְ/שֹׁעֲרִ֣ים בַּ/סִּפִּ֔ים מָאתַ֖יִם וּ/שְׁנֵ֣ים עָשָׂ֑ר הֵ֤מָּה בְ/חַצְרֵי/הֶם֙ הִתְיַחְשָׂ֔/ם הֵ֣מָּה יִסַּ֥ד דָּוִ֛יד וּ/שְׁמוּאֵ֥ל הָ/רֹאֶ֖ה בֶּ/אֱמוּנָתָֽ/ם
verses.translit: khlm hbrvrym lsh'rym bspym m'tym vshnym 'shr hmh bchtsryhm htychshm hmh ysd dvyd vshmv'l hr'h b'mvntm
verses.translation: All these which were chosen to be porters in the gates were two hundred and twelve. These were reckoned by their genealogy in their villages, whom David and Samuel the seer did ordain in their set office.

verses.original: וְ/הֵ֨ם וּ/בְנֵי/הֶ֜ם עַל הַ/שְּׁעָרִ֧ים לְ/בֵית יְהוָ֛ה לְ/בֵ֥ית הָ/אֹ֖הֶל לְ/מִשְׁמָרֽוֹת
verses.translit: vhm vbnyhm 'l hsh'rym lbyt yhvh lbyt h'hl lmshmrvt
verses.translation: So they and their children had the oversight of the gates of the house of the LORD , namely , the house of the tabernacle, by wards.

verses.original: לְ/אַרְבַּ֣ע רוּח֔וֹת יִהְי֖וּ הַ/שֹּׁעֲרִ֑ים מִזְרָ֥ח יָ֖מָּ/ה צָפ֥וֹנָ/ה וָ/נֶֽגְבָּ/ה
verses.translit: l'rb' rvchvt yhyv hsh'rym mzrch ymh tspvnh vngbh
verses.translation: In four quarters were the porters, toward the east, west, north, and south.

verses.original: וַ/אֲחֵי/הֶ֨ם בְּ/חַצְרֵי/הֶ֜ם לָ/ב֨וֹא לְ/שִׁבְעַ֧ת הַ/יָּמִ֛ים מֵ/עֵ֥ת אֶל עֵ֖ת עִם אֵֽלֶּה
verses.translit: v'chyhm bchtsryhm lbv' lshb't hymym m't 'l 't 'm 'lh
verses.translation: And their brethren, which were in their villages, were to come after seven days from time to time with them.

verses.original: כִּ֣י בֶ/אֱמוּנָ֞ה הֵ֗מָּה אַרְבַּ֨עַת֙ גִּבֹּרֵ֣י הַ/שֹּׁעֲרִ֔ים הֵ֖ם הַ/לְוִיִּ֑ם וְ/הָיוּ֙ עַל הַ/לְּשָׁכ֔וֹת וְ/עַ֥ל הָ/אֹצְר֖וֹת בֵּ֥ית הָ/אֱלֹהִֽים
verses.translit: khy b'mvnh hmh 'rb't gbry hsh'rym hm hlvym vhyv 'l hlshkhvt v'l h'tsrvt byt h'lhym
verses.translation: For these Levites, the four chief porters, were in their set office, and were over the chambers and treasuries of the house of God.

verses.original: וּ/סְבִיב֥וֹת בֵּית הָ/אֱלֹהִ֖ים יָלִ֑ינוּ כִּֽי עֲלֵי/הֶ֣ם מִשְׁמֶ֔רֶת וְ/הֵ֥ם עַל הַ/מַּפְתֵּ֖חַ וְ/לַ/בֹּ֥קֶר לַ/בֹּֽקֶר
verses.translit: vsbybvt byt h'lhym ylynv khy 'lyhm mshmrt vhm 'l hmptch vlbqr lbqr
verses.translation: And they lodged round about the house of God, because the charge was upon them, and the opening thereof every morning pertained to them.

verses.original: וּ/מֵ/הֶ֖ם עַל כְּלֵ֣י הָ/עֲבוֹדָ֑ה כִּֽי בְ/מִסְפָּ֣ר יְבִיא֔וּ/ם וּ/בְ/מִסְפָּ֖ר יוֹצִיאֽוּ/ם
verses.translit: vmhm 'l khly h'bvdh khy bmspr yby'vm vbmspr yvtsy'vm
verses.translation: And certain of them had the charge of the ministering vessels, that they should bring them in and out by tale.

verses.original: וּ/מֵ/הֶ֗ם מְמֻנִּים֙ עַל הַ/כֵּלִ֔ים וְ/עַ֖ל כָּל כְּלֵ֣י הַ/קֹּ֑דֶשׁ וְ/עַל הַ/סֹּ֨לֶת֙ וְ/הַ/יַּ֣יִן וְ/הַ/שֶּׁ֔מֶן וְ/הַ/לְּבוֹנָ֖ה וְ/הַ/בְּשָׂמִֽים
verses.translit: vmhm mmnym 'l hkhlym v'l khl khly hqdsh v'l hslt vhyyn vhshmn vhlbvnh vhbshmym
verses.translation: Some of them also were appointed to oversee the vessels, and all the instruments of the sanctuary, and the fine flour, and the wine, and the oil, and the frankincense, and the spices.

verses.original: וּ/מִן בְּנֵי֙ הַ/כֹּ֣הֲנִ֔ים רֹקְחֵ֥י הַ/מִּרְקַ֖חַת לַ/בְּשָׂמִֽים
verses.translit: vmn bny hkhhnym rqchy hmrqcht lbshmym
verses.translation: And some of the sons of the priests made the ointment of the spices.

verses.original: וּ/מַתִּתְיָה֙ מִן הַ/לְוִיִּ֔ם ה֥וּא הַ/בְּכ֖וֹר לְ/שַׁלֻּ֣ם הַ/קָּרְחִ֑י בֶּ/אֱמוּנָ֕ה עַ֖ל מַעֲשֵׂ֥ה הַ/חֲבִתִּֽים
verses.translit: vmttyh mn hlvym hv' hbkhvr lshlm hqrchy b'mvnh 'l m'shh hchbtym
verses.translation: And Mattithiah, one of the Levites, who was the firstborn of Shallum the Korahite, had the set office over the things that were made in the pans.

verses.original: וּ/מִן בְּנֵ֧י הַ/קְּהָתִ֛י מִן אֲחֵי/הֶ֖ם עַל לֶ֣חֶם הַֽ/מַּעֲרָ֑כֶת לְ/הָכִ֖ין שַׁבַּ֥ת שַׁבָּֽת
verses.translit: vmn bny hqhty mn 'chyhm 'l lchm hm'rkht lhkhyn shbt shbt
verses.translation: And other of their brethren, of the sons of the Kohathites, were over the shewbread, to prepare it every sabbath.

verses.original: וְ/אֵ֣לֶּה הַ֠/מְשֹׁרְרִים רָאשֵׁ֨י אָב֧וֹת לַ/לְוִיִּ֛ם בַּ/לְּשָׁכֹ֖ת פטירים פְּטוּרִ֑ים כִּֽי יוֹמָ֥ם וָ/לַ֛יְלָה עֲלֵי/הֶ֖ם בַּ/מְּלָאכָֽה
verses.translit: v'lh hmshrrym r'shy 'bvt llvym blshkht ptyrym ptvrym khy yvmm vlylh 'lyhm bml'khh
verses.translation: And these are the singers, chief of the fathers of the Levites, who remaining in the chambers were free: for they were employed in that work day and night.

verses.original: אֵלֶּה֩ רָאשֵׁ֨י הָ/אָב֧וֹת לַ/לְוִיִּ֛ם לְ/תֹלְדוֹתָ֖/ם רָאשִׁ֑ים אֵ֖לֶּה יָשְׁב֥וּ בִ/ירוּשָׁלִָֽם
verses.translit: 'lh r'shy h'bvt llvym ltldvtm r'shym 'lh yshbv byrvshlm
verses.translation: These chief fathers of the Levites were chief throughout their generations; these dwelt at Jerusalem.

verses.original: וּ/בְ/גִבְע֛וֹן יָשְׁב֥וּ אֲבִֽי גִבְע֖וֹן יעואל יְעִיאֵ֑ל וְ/שֵׁ֥ם אִשְׁתּ֖/וֹ מַעֲכָֽה
verses.translit: vbgb'vn yshbv 'by gb'vn y'v'l y'y'l vshm 'shtv m'khh
verses.translation: And in Gibeon dwelt the father of Gibeon, Jehiel, whose wife’s name was Maachah:

verses.original: וּ/בְנ֥/וֹ הַ/בְּכ֖וֹר עַבְדּ֑וֹן וְ/צ֣וּר וְ/קִ֔ישׁ וּ/בַ֥עַל וְ/נֵ֖ר וְ/נָדָֽב
verses.translit: vbnv hbkhvr 'bdvn vtsvr vqysh vb'l vnr vndb
verses.translation: And his firstborn son Abdon, then Zur, and Kish, and Baal, and Ner, and Nadab,

verses.original: וּ/גְד֣וֹר וְ/אַחְי֔וֹ וּ/זְכַרְיָ֖ה וּ/מִקְלֽוֹת
verses.translit: vgdvr v'chyv vzkhryh vmqlvt
verses.translation: And Gedor, and Ahio, and Zechariah, and Mikloth.

verses.original: וּ/מִקְל֖וֹת הוֹלִ֣יד אֶת שִׁמְאָ֑ם וְ/אַף הֵ֗ם נֶ֧גֶד אֲחֵי/הֶ֛ם יָשְׁב֥וּ בִ/ירֽוּשָׁלִַ֖ם עִם אֲחֵי/הֶֽם
verses.translit: vmqlvt hvlyd 't shm'm v'f hm ngd 'chyhm yshbv byrvshlm 'm 'chyhm
verses.translation: And Mikloth begat Shimeam. And they also dwelt with their brethren at Jerusalem, over against their brethren.

verses.original: וְ/נֵר֙ הוֹלִ֣יד אֶת קִ֔ישׁ וְ/קִ֖ישׁ הוֹלִ֣יד אֶת שָׁא֑וּל וְ/שָׁא֗וּל הוֹלִ֤יד אֶת יְהֽוֹנָתָן֙ וְ/אֶת מַלְכִּי שׁ֔וּעַ וְ/אֶת אֲבִינָדָ֖ב וְ/אֶת אֶשְׁבָּֽעַל
verses.translit: vnr hvlyd 't qysh vqysh hvlyd 't sh'vl vsh'vl hvlyd 't yhvntn v't mlkhy shv' v't 'byndb v't 'shb'l
verses.translation: And Ner begat Kish; and Kish begat Saul; and Saul begat Jonathan, and Malchi-shua, and Abinadab, and Esh-baal.

verses.original: וּ/בֶן יְהוֹנָתָ֖ן מְרִ֣יב בָּ֑עַל וּ/מְרִי בַ֖עַל הוֹלִ֥יד אֶת מִיכָֽה
verses.translit: vbn yhvntn mryb b'l vmry b'l hvlyd 't mykhh
verses.translation: And the son of Jonathan was Merib-baal: and Merib-baal begat Micah.

verses.original: וּ/בְנֵ֖י מִיכָ֑ה פִּית֥וֹן וָ/מֶ֖לֶךְ וְ/תַחְרֵֽעַ
verses.translit: vbny mykhh pytvn vmlkh vtchr'
verses.translation: And the sons of Micah were , Pithon, and Melech, and Tahrea, and Ahaz .

verses.original: וְ/אָחָז֙ הוֹלִ֣יד אֶת יַעְרָ֔ה וְ/יַעְרָ֗ה הוֹלִ֛יד אֶת עָלֶ֥מֶת וְ/אֶת עַזְמָ֖וֶת וְ/אֶת זִמְרִ֑י וְ/זִמְרִ֖י הוֹלִ֥יד אֶת מוֹצָֽא
verses.translit: v'chz hvlyd 't y'rh vy'rh hvlyd 't 'lmt v't 'zmvt v't zmry vzmry hvlyd 't mvts'
verses.translation: And Ahaz begat Jarah; and Jarah begat Alemeth, and Azmaveth, and Zimri; and Zimri begat Moza;

verses.original: וּ/מוֹצָ֖א הוֹלִ֣יד אֶת בִּנְעָ֑א וּ/רְפָיָ֥ה בְנ֛/וֹ אֶלְעָשָׂ֥ה בְנ֖/וֹ אָצֵ֥ל בְּנֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: vmvts' hvlyd 't bn'' vrpyh bnv 'l'shh bnv 'tsl bnv
verses.translation: And Moza begat Binea; and Rephaiah his son, Eleasah his son, Azel his son.

verses.original: וּ/לְ/אָצֵל֮ שִׁשָּׁ֣ה בָנִים֒ וְ/אֵ֣לֶּה שְׁמוֹתָ֗/ם עַזְרִיקָ֥ם בֹּ֨כְרוּ֙ וְ/יִשְׁמָעֵ֣אל וּ/שְׁעַרְיָ֔ה וְ/עֹבַדְיָ֖ה וְ/חָנָ֑ן אֵ֖לֶּה בְּנֵ֥י אָצַֽל
verses.translit: vl'tsl shshh bnym v'lh shmvtm 'zryqm bkhrv vyshm''l vsh'ryh v'bdyh vchnn 'lh bny 'tsl
verses.translation: And Azel had six sons, whose names are these, Azrikam, Bocheru, and Ishmael, and Sheariah, and Obadiah, and Hanan: these were the sons of Azel.

verses.original: וּ/פְלִשְׁתִּ֖ים נִלְחֲמ֣וּ בְ/יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וַ/יָּ֑נָס אִֽישׁ יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ מִ/פְּנֵ֣י פְלִשְׁתִּ֔ים וַ/יִּפְּל֥וּ חֲלָלִ֖ים בְּ/הַ֥ר גִּלְבֹּֽעַ
verses.translit: vplshtym nlchmv byshr'l vyns 'ysh yshr'l mpny plshtym vyplv chllym bhr glb'
verses.translation: Now the Philistines fought against Israel; and the men of Israel fled from before the Philistines, and fell down slain in mount Gilboa.

verses.original: וַ/יַּדְבְּק֣וּ פְלִשְׁתִּ֔ים אַחֲרֵ֥י שָׁא֖וּל וְ/אַחֲרֵ֣י בָנָ֑י/ו וַ/יַּכּ֣וּ פְלִשְׁתִּ֗ים אֶת יוֹנָתָ֧ן וְ/אֶת אֲבִינָדָ֛ב וְ/אֶת מַלְכִּי שׁ֖וּעַ בְּנֵ֥י שָׁאֽוּל
verses.translit: vydbqv plshtym 'chry sh'vl v'chry bnyv vykhv plshtym 't yvntn v't 'byndb v't mlkhy shv' bny sh'vl
verses.translation: And the Philistines followed hard after Saul, and after his sons; and the Philistines slew Jonathan, and Abinadab, and Malchi-shua, the sons of Saul.

verses.original: וַ/תִּכְבַּ֤ד הַ/מִּלְחָמָה֙ עַל שָׁא֔וּל וַ/יִּמְצָאֻ֖/הוּ הַ/מּוֹרִ֣ים בַּ/קָּ֑שֶׁת וַ/יָּ֖חֶל מִן הַ/יּוֹרִֽים
verses.translit: vtkhbd hmlchmh 'l sh'vl vymts'hv hmvrym bqsht vychl mn hyvrym
verses.translation: And the battle went sore against Saul, and the archers hit him, and he was wounded of the archers.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֣אמֶר שָׁאוּל֩ אֶל נֹשֵׂ֨א כֵלָ֜י/ו שְׁלֹ֥ף חַרְבְּ/ךָ֣ וְ/דָקְרֵ֣/נִי בָ֗/הּ פֶּן יָבֹ֜אוּ הָ/עֲרֵלִ֤ים הָ/אֵ֨לֶּה֙ וְ/הִתְעַלְּלוּ בִ֔/י וְ/לֹ֤א אָבָה֙ נֹשֵׂ֣א כֵלָ֔י/ו כִּ֥י יָרֵ֖א מְאֹ֑ד וַ/יִּקַּ֤ח שָׁאוּל֙ אֶת הַ/חֶ֔רֶב וַ/יִּפֹּ֖ל עָלֶֽי/הָ
verses.translit: vy'mr sh'vl 'l nsh' khlyv shlf chrbkh vdqrny bh pn yb'v h'rlym h'lh vht'llv by vl' 'bh nsh' khlyv khy yr' m'd vyqch sh'vl 't hchrb vypl 'lyh
verses.translation: Then said Saul to his armourbearer, Draw thy sword, and thrust me through therewith; lest these uncircumcised come and abuse me. But his armourbearer would not; for he was sore afraid. So Saul took a sword, and fell upon it.

verses.original: וַ/יַּ֥רְא נֹשֵֽׂא כֵלָ֖י/ו כִּ֣י מֵ֣ת שָׁא֑וּל וַ/יִּפֹּ֥ל גַּם ה֛וּא עַל הַ/חֶ֖רֶב וַ/יָּמֹֽת
verses.translit: vyr' nsh' khlyv khy mt sh'vl vypl gm hv' 'l hchrb vymt
verses.translation: And when his armourbearer saw that Saul was dead, he fell likewise on the sword, and died.

verses.original: וַ/יָּ֤מָת שָׁאוּל֙ וּ/שְׁלֹ֣שֶׁת בָּנָ֔י/ו וְ/כָל בֵּית֖/וֹ יַחְדָּ֥ו מֵֽתוּ
verses.translit: vymt sh'vl vshlsht bnyv vkhl bytv ychdv mtv
verses.translation: So Saul died, and his three sons, and all his house died together.

verses.original: וַ֠/יִּרְאוּ כָּל אִ֨ישׁ יִשְׂרָאֵ֤ל אֲשֶׁר בָּ/עֵ֨מֶק֙ כִּ֣י נָ֔סוּ וְ/כִי מֵ֖תוּ שָׁא֣וּל וּ/בָנָ֑י/ו וַ/יַּעַזְב֤וּ עָרֵי/הֶם֙ וַ/יָּנֻ֔סוּ וַ/יָּבֹ֣אוּ פְלִשְׁתִּ֔ים וַ/יֵּשְׁב֖וּ בָּ/הֶֽם
verses.translit: vyr'v khl 'ysh yshr'l 'shr b'mq khy nsv vkhy mtv sh'vl vbnyv vy'zbv 'ryhm vynsv vyb'v plshtym vyshbv bhm
verses.translation: And when all the men of Israel that were in the valley saw that they fled, and that Saul and his sons were dead, then they forsook their cities, and fled: and the Philistines came and dwelt in them.

verses.original: וַ/יְהִי֙ מִֽ/מָּחֳרָ֔ת וַ/יָּבֹ֣אוּ פְלִשְׁתִּ֔ים לְ/פַשֵּׁ֖ט אֶת הַֽ/חֲלָלִ֑ים וַֽ/יִּמְצְא֤וּ אֶת שָׁאוּל֙ וְ/אֶת בָּנָ֔י/ו נֹפְלִ֖ים בְּ/הַ֥ר גִּלְבֹּֽעַ
verses.translit: vyhy mmchrt vyb'v plshtym lpsht 't hchllym vymts'v 't sh'vl v't bnyv nplym bhr glb'
verses.translation: And it came to pass on the morrow, when the Philistines came to strip the slain, that they found Saul and his sons fallen in mount Gilboa.

verses.original: וַ/יַּ֨פְשִׁיטֻ֔/הוּ וַ/יִּשְׂא֥וּ אֶת רֹאשׁ֖/וֹ וְ/אֶת כֵּלָ֑י/ו וַ/יְשַׁלְּח֨וּ בְ/אֶֽרֶץ פְלִשְׁתִּ֜ים סָבִ֗יב לְ/בַשֵּׂ֛ר אֶת עֲצַבֵּי/הֶ֖ם וְ/אֶת הָ/עָֽם
verses.translit: vypshythv vysh'v 't r'shv v't khlyv vyshlchv b'rts plshtym sbyb lbshr 't 'tsbyhm v't h'm
verses.translation: And when they had stripped him, they took his head, and his armour, and sent into the land of the Philistines round about, to carry tidings unto their idols, and to the people.

verses.original: וַ/יָּשִׂ֨ימוּ֙ אֶת כֵּלָ֔י/ו בֵּ֖ית אֱלֹהֵי/הֶ֑ם וְ/אֶת גֻּלְגָּלְתּ֥/וֹ תָקְע֖וּ בֵּ֥ית דָּגֽוֹן
verses.translit: vyshymv 't khlyv byt 'lhyhm v't glgltv tq'v byt dgvn
verses.translation: And they put his armour in the house of their gods, and fastened his head in the temple of Dagon.

verses.original: וַֽ/יִּשְׁמְע֔וּ כֹּ֖ל יָבֵ֣ישׁ גִּלְעָ֑ד אֵ֛ת כָּל אֲשֶׁר עָשׂ֥וּ פְלִשְׁתִּ֖ים לְ/שָׁאֽוּל
verses.translit: vyshm'v khl ybysh gl'd 't khl 'shr 'shv plshtym lsh'vl
verses.translation: And when all Jabesh-gilead heard all that the Philistines had done to Saul,

verses.original: וַ/יָּקוּמוּ֮ כָּל אִ֣ישׁ חַיִל֒ וַ/יִּשְׂא֞וּ אֶת גּוּפַ֣ת שָׁא֗וּל וְ/אֵת֙ גּוּפֹ֣ת בָּנָ֔י/ו וַ/יְבִיא֖וּ/ם יָבֵ֑ישָׁ/ה וַ/יִּקְבְּר֨וּ אֶת עַצְמוֹתֵי/הֶ֜ם תַּ֤חַת הָ/אֵלָה֙ בְּ/יָבֵ֔שׁ וַ/יָּצ֖וּמוּ שִׁבְעַ֥ת יָמִֽים
verses.translit: vyqvmv khl 'ysh chyl vysh'v 't gvpt sh'vl v't gvpt bnyv vyby'vm ybyshh vyqbrv 't 'tsmvtyhm tcht h'lh bybsh vytsvmv shb't ymym
verses.translation: They arose, all the valiant men, and took away the body of Saul, and the bodies of his sons, and brought them to Jabesh, and buried their bones under the oak in Jabesh, and fasted seven days.

verses.original: וַ/יָּ֣מָת שָׁא֗וּל בְּ/מַֽעֲל/וֹ֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר מָעַ֣ל בַּֽ/יהוָ֔ה עַל דְּבַ֥ר יְהוָ֖ה אֲשֶׁ֣ר לֹא שָׁמָ֑ר וְ/גַם לִ/שְׁא֥וֹל בָּ/א֖וֹב לִ/דְרֽוֹשׁ
verses.translit: vymt sh'vl bm'lv 'shr m'l byhvh 'l dbr yhvh 'shr l' shmr vgm lsh'vl b'vb ldrvsh
verses.translation: So Saul died for his transgression which he committed against the LORD , even against the word of the LORD , which he kept not, and also for asking counsel of one that had a familiar spirit, to enquire of it;

verses.original: וְ/לֹֽא דָרַ֥שׁ בַּֽ/יהוָ֖ה וַ/יְמִיתֵ֑/הוּ וַ/יַּסֵּב֙ אֶת הַ/מְּלוּכָ֔ה לְ/דָוִ֖יד בֶּן יִשָֽׁי
verses.translit: vl' drsh byhvh vymythv vysb 't hmlvkhh ldvyd bn yshy
verses.translation: And enquired not of the LORD : therefore he slew him, and turned the kingdom unto David the son of Jesse.

verses.original: וַ/יִּקָּבְצ֧וּ כָֽל יִשְׂרָאֵ֛ל אֶל דָּוִ֖יד חֶבְר֣וֹנָ/ה לֵ/אמֹ֑ר הִנֵּ֛ה עַצְמְ/ךָ֥ וּֽ/בְשָׂרְ/ךָ֖ אֲנָֽחְנוּ
verses.translit: vyqbtsv khl yshr'l 'l dvyd chbrvnh l'mr hnh 'tsmkh vbshrkh 'nchnv
verses.translation: Then all Israel gathered themselves to David unto Hebron, saying, Behold, we are thy bone and thy flesh.

verses.original: גַּם תְּמ֣וֹל גַּם שִׁלְשׁ֗וֹם גַּ֚ם בִּ/הְי֣וֹת שָׁא֣וּל מֶ֔לֶךְ אַתָּ֛ה הַ/מּוֹצִ֥יא וְ/הַ/מֵּבִ֖יא אֶת יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וַ/יֹּאמֶר֩ יְהוָ֨ה אֱלֹהֶ֜י/ךָ לְ/ךָ֗ אַתָּ֨ה תִרְעֶ֤ה אֶת עַמִּ/י֙ אֶת יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל וְ/אַתָּה֙ תִּהְיֶ֣ה נָגִ֔יד עַ֖ל עַמִּ֥/י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל
verses.translit: gm tmvl gm shlshvm gm bhyvt sh'vl mlkh 'th hmvtsy' vhmby' 't yshr'l vy'mr yhvh 'lhykh lkh 'th tr'h 't 'my 't yshr'l v'th thyh ngyd 'l 'my yshr'l
verses.translation: And moreover in time past, even when Saul was king, thou wast he that leddest out and broughtest in Israel: and the LORD thy God said unto thee, Thou shalt feed my people Israel, and thou shalt be ruler over my people Israel.

verses.original: וַ֠/יָּבֹאוּ כָּל זִקְנֵ֨י יִשְׂרָאֵ֤ל אֶל הַ/מֶּ֨לֶךְ֙ חֶבְר֔וֹנָ/ה וַ/יִּכְרֹת֩ לָ/הֶ֨ם דָּוִ֥יד בְּרִ֛ית בְּ/חֶבְר֖וֹן לִ/פְנֵ֣י יְהוָ֑ה וַ/יִּמְשְׁח֨וּ אֶת דָּוִ֤יד לְ/מֶ֨לֶךְ֙ עַל יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל כִּ/דְבַ֥ר יְהוָ֖ה בְּ/יַד שְׁמוּאֵֽל
verses.translit: vyb'v khl zqny yshr'l 'l hmlkh chbrvnh vykhrt lhm dvyd bryt bchbrvn lpny yhvh vymshchv 't dvyd lmlkh 'l yshr'l khdbr yhvh byd shmv'l
verses.translation: Therefore came all the elders of Israel to the king to Hebron; and David made a covenant with them in Hebron before the LORD ; and they anointed David king over Israel, according to the word of the LORD by Samuel.

verses.original: וַ/יֵּ֨לֶךְ דָּוִ֧יד וְ/כָל יִשְׂרָאֵ֛ל יְרוּשָׁלִַ֖ם הִ֣יא יְב֑וּס וְ/שָׁם֙ הַ/יְבוּסִ֔י יֹשְׁבֵ֖י הָ/אָֽרֶץ
verses.translit: vylkh dvyd vkhl yshr'l yrvshlm hy' ybvs vshm hybvsy yshby h'rts
verses.translation: And David and all Israel went to Jerusalem, which is Jebus; where the Jebusites were , the inhabitants of the land.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֨אמְר֜וּ יֹשְׁבֵ֤י יְבוּס֙ לְ/דָוִ֔יד לֹ֥א תָב֖וֹא הֵ֑נָּה וַ/יִּלְכֹּ֤ד דָּוִיד֙ אֶת מְצֻדַ֣ת צִיּ֔וֹן הִ֖יא עִ֥יר דָּוִֽיד
verses.translit: vy'mrv yshby ybvs ldvyd l' tbv' hnh vylkhd dvyd 't mtsdt tsyvn hy' 'yr dvyd
verses.translation: And the inhabitants of Jebus said to David, Thou shalt not come hither. Nevertheless David took the castle of Zion, which is the city of David.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֣אמֶר דָּוִ֔יד כָּל מַכֵּ֤ה יְבוּסִי֙ בָּ/רִ֣אשׁוֹנָ֔ה יִהְיֶ֥ה לְ/רֹ֖אשׁ וּ/לְ/שָׂ֑ר וַ/יַּ֧עַל בָּ/רִאשׁוֹנָ֛ה יוֹאָ֥ב בֶּן צְרוּיָ֖ה וַ/יְהִ֥י לְ/רֹֽאשׁ
verses.translit: vy'mr dvyd khl mkhh ybvsy br'shvnh yhyh lr'sh vlshr vy'l br'shvnh yv'b bn tsrvyh vyhy lr'sh
verses.translation: And David said, Whosoever smiteth the Jebusites first shall be chief and captain. So Joab the son of Zeruiah went first up, and was chief.

verses.original: וַ/יֵּ֥שֶׁב דָּוִ֖יד בַּ/מְצָ֑ד עַל כֵּ֥ן קָרְאוּ ל֖/וֹ עִ֥יר דָּוִֽיד
verses.translit: vyshb dvyd bmtsd 'l khn qr'v lv 'yr dvyd
verses.translation: And David dwelt in the castle; therefore they called it the city of David.

verses.original: וַ/יִּ֤בֶן הָ/עִיר֙ מִ/סָּבִ֔יב מִן הַ/מִּלּ֖וֹא וְ/עַד הַ/סָּבִ֑יב וְ/יוֹאָ֕ב יְחַיֶּ֖ה אֶת שְׁאָ֥ר הָ/עִֽיר
verses.translit: vybn h'yr msbyb mn hmlv' v'd hsbyb vyv'b ychyh 't sh'r h'yr
verses.translation: And he built the city round about, even from Millo round about: and Joab repaired the rest of the city.

verses.original: וַ/יֵּ֥לֶךְ דָּוִ֖יד הָל֣וֹךְ וְ/גָד֑וֹל וַ/יהוָ֥ה צְבָא֖וֹת עִמּֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: vylkh dvyd hlvkh vgdvl vyhvh tsb'vt 'mv
verses.translation: So David waxed greater and greater: for the LORD of hosts was with him.

verses.original: וְ/אֵ֨לֶּה רָאשֵׁ֤י הַ/גִּבּוֹרִים֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר לְ/דָוִ֔יד הַ/מִּתְחַזְּקִ֨ים עִמּ֧/וֹ בְ/מַלְכוּת֛/וֹ עִם כָּל יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל לְ/הַמְלִיכ֑/וֹ כִּ/דְבַ֥ר יְהוָ֖ה עַל יִשְׂרָאֵֽל
verses.translit: v'lh r'shy hgbvrym 'shr ldvyd hmtchzqym 'mv bmlkhvtv 'm khl yshr'l lhmlykhv khdbr yhvh 'l yshr'l
verses.translation: These also are the chief of the mighty men whom David had, who strengthened themselves with him in his kingdom, and with all Israel, to make him king, according to the word of the LORD concerning Israel.

verses.original: וְ/אֵ֛לֶּה מִסְפַּ֥ר הַ/גִּבֹּרִ֖ים אֲשֶׁ֣ר לְ/דָוִ֑יד יָשָׁבְעָ֣ם בֶּן חַכְמוֹנִ֗י רֹ֚אשׁ ה/שלושים הַ/שָּׁ֣לִישִׁ֔ים הֽוּא עוֹרֵ֧ר אֶת חֲנִית֛/וֹ עַל שְׁלֹשׁ מֵא֥וֹת חָלָ֖ל בְּ/פַ֥עַם אֶחָֽת
verses.translit: v'lh mspr hgbrym 'shr ldvyd yshb'm bn chkhmvny r'sh hshlvshym hshlyshym hv' 'vrr 't chnytv 'l shlsh m'vt chll bp'm 'cht
verses.translation: And this is the number of the mighty men whom David had; Jashobeam, an Hachmonite, the chief of the captains: he lifted up his spear against three hundred slain by him at one time.

verses.original: וְ/אַחֲרָ֛י/ו אֶלְעָזָ֥ר בֶּן דּוֹד֖וֹ הָ/אֲחוֹחִ֑י ה֖וּא בִּ/שְׁלוֹשָׁ֥ה הַ/גִּבֹּרִֽים
verses.translit: v'chryv 'l'zr bn dvdv h'chvchy hv' bshlvshh hgbrym
verses.translation: And after him was Eleazar the son of Dodo, the Ahohite, who was one of the three mighties.

verses.original: הֽוּא הָיָ֨ה עִם דָּוִ֜יד בַּ/פַּ֣ס דַּמִּ֗ים וְ/הַ/פְּלִשְׁתִּים֙ נֶאֱסְפוּ שָׁ֣ם לַ/מִּלְחָמָ֔ה וַ/תְּהִ֛י חֶלְקַ֥ת הַ/שָּׂדֶ֖ה מְלֵאָ֣ה שְׂעוֹרִ֑ים וְ/הָ/עָ֥ם נָ֖סוּ מִ/פְּנֵ֥י פְלִשְׁתִּֽים
verses.translit: hv' hyh 'm dvyd bps dmym vhplshtym n'spv shm lmlchmh vthy chlqt hshdh ml'h sh'vrym vh'm nsv mpny plshtym
verses.translation: He was with David at Pas-dammim, and there the Philistines were gathered together to battle, where was a parcel of ground full of barley; and the people fled from before the Philistines.

verses.original: וַ/יִּֽתְיַצְּב֤וּ בְ/תוֹךְ הַ/חֶלְקָה֙ וַ/יַּצִּיל֔וּ/הָ וַ/יַּכּ֖וּ אֶת פְּלִשְׁתִּ֑ים וַ/יּ֥וֹשַׁע יְהוָ֖ה תְּשׁוּעָ֥ה גְדוֹלָֽה
verses.translit: vytytsbv btvkh hchlqh vytsylvh vykhv 't plshtym vyvsh' yhvh tshv'h gdvlh
verses.translation: And they set themselves in the midst of that parcel, and delivered it, and slew the Philistines; and the LORD saved them by a great deliverance.

verses.original: וַ/יֵּרְד֡וּ שְֽׁלוֹשָׁה֩ מִן הַ/שְּׁלוֹשִׁ֨ים רֹ֤אשׁ עַל הַ/צֻּר֙ אֶל דָּוִ֔יד אֶל מְעָרַ֖ת עֲדֻלָּ֑ם וּ/מַחֲנֵ֣ה פְלִשְׁתִּ֔ים חֹנָ֖ה בְּ/עֵ֥מֶק רְפָאִֽים
verses.translit: vyrdv shlvshh mn hshlvshym r'sh 'l htsr 'l dvyd 'l m'rt 'dlm vmchnh plshtym chnh b'mq rp'ym
verses.translation: Now three of the thirty captains went down to the rock to David, into the cave of Adullam; and the host of the Philistines encamped in the valley of Rephaim.

verses.original: וְ/דָוִ֖יד אָ֣ז בַּ/מְּצוּדָ֑ה וּ/נְצִ֣יב פְּלִשְׁתִּ֔ים אָ֖ז בְּ/בֵ֥ית לָֽחֶם
verses.translit: vdvyd 'z bmtsvdh vntsyb plshtym 'z bbyt lchm
verses.translation: And David was then in the hold, and the Philistines’ garrison was then at Beth-lehem.

verses.original: ו/יתאו וַ/יִּתְאָ֥יו דָּוִ֖יד וַ/יֹּאמַ֑ר מִ֚י יַשְׁקֵ֣/נִי מַ֔יִם מִ/בּ֥וֹר בֵּֽית לֶ֖חֶם אֲשֶׁ֥ר בַּ/שָּֽׁעַר
verses.translit: vyt'v vyt'yv dvyd vy'mr my yshqny mym mbvr byt lchm 'shr bsh'r
verses.translation: And David longed, and said, Oh that one would give me drink of the water of the well of Beth-lehem, that is at the gate!

verses.original: וַ/יִּבְקְע֨וּ הַ/שְּׁלֹשָׁ֜ה בְּ/מַחֲנֵ֣ה פְלִשְׁתִּ֗ים וַ/יִּֽשְׁאֲבוּ מַ֨יִם֙ מִ/בּ֤וֹר בֵּֽית לֶ֨חֶם֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר בַּ/שַּׁ֔עַר וַ/יִּשְׂא֖וּ וַ/יָּבִ֣אוּ אֶל דָּוִ֑יד וְ/לֹֽא אָבָ֤ה דָוִיד֙ לִ/שְׁתּוֹתָ֔/ם וַ/יְנַסֵּ֥ךְ אֹתָ֖/ם לַ/יהוָֽה
verses.translit: vybq'v hshlshh bmchnh plshtym vysh'bv mym mbvr byt lchm 'shr bsh'r vysh'v vyb'v 'l dvyd vl' 'bh dvyd lshtvtm vynskh 'tm lyhvh
verses.translation: And the three brake through the host of the Philistines, and drew water out of the well of Beth-lehem, that was by the gate, and took it , and brought it to David: but David would not drink of it, but poured it out to the LORD ,

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֡אמֶר חָלִילָ/ה֩ לִּ֨/י מֵ/אֱלֹהַ֜/י מֵ/עֲשׂ֣וֹת זֹ֗את הֲ/דַ֣ם הָ/אֲנָשִׁים֩ הָ/אֵ֨לֶּה אֶשְׁתֶּ֤ה בְ/נַפְשׁוֹתָ/ם֙ כִּ֣י בְ/נַפְשׁוֹתָ֣/ם הֱבִיא֔וּ/ם וְ/לֹ֥א אָבָ֖ה לִ/שְׁתּוֹתָ֑/ם אֵ֣לֶּה עָשׂ֔וּ שְׁלֹ֖שֶׁת הַ/גִּבּוֹרִֽים
verses.translit: vy'mr chlylh ly m'lhy m'shvt z't hdm h'nshym h'lh 'shth bnpshvtm khy bnpshvtm hby'vm vl' 'bh lshtvtm 'lh 'shv shlsht hgbvrym
verses.translation: And said, My God forbid it me, that I should do this thing: shall I drink the blood of these men that have put their lives in jeopardy? for with the jeopardy of their lives they brought it. Therefore he would not drink it. These things did these three mightiest.

verses.original: וְ/אַבְשַׁ֣י אֲחִֽי יוֹאָ֗ב ה֤וּא הָיָה֙ רֹ֣אשׁ הַ/שְּׁלוֹשָׁ֔ה וְ/הוּא֙ עוֹרֵ֣ר אֶת חֲנִית֔/וֹ עַל שְׁלֹ֥שׁ מֵא֖וֹת חָלָ֑ל ו/לא וְ/ל/וֹ שֵׁ֖ם בַּ/שְּׁלוֹשָֽׁה
verses.translit: v'bshy 'chy yv'b hv' hyh r'sh hshlvshh vhv' 'vrr 't chnytv 'l shlsh m'vt chll vl' vlv shm bshlvshh
verses.translation: And Abishai the brother of Joab, he was chief of the three: for lifting up his spear against three hundred, he slew them , and had a name among the three.

verses.original: מִן הַ/שְּׁלוֹשָׁ֤ה בַ/שְּׁנַ֨יִם֙ נִכְבָּ֔ד וַ/יְהִ֥י לָ/הֶ֖ם לְ/שָׂ֑ר וְ/עַד הַ/שְּׁלוֹשָׁ֖ה לֹֽא בָֽא
verses.translit: mn hshlvshh bshnym nkhbd vyhy lhm lshr v'd hshlvshh l' b'
verses.translation: Of the three, he was more honourable than the two; for he was their captain: howbeit he attained not to the first three.

verses.original: בְּנָיָ֨ה בֶן יְהוֹיָדָ֧ע בֶּן אִֽישׁ חַ֛יִל רַב פְּעָלִ֖ים מִֽן קַבְצְאֵ֑ל ה֣וּא הִכָּ֗ה אֵ֣ת שְׁנֵ֤י אֲרִיאֵל֙ מוֹאָ֔ב וְ֠/הוּא יָרַ֞ד וְ/הִכָּ֧ה אֶֽת הָ/אֲרִ֛י בְּ/ת֥וֹךְ הַ/בּ֖וֹר בְּ/י֥וֹם הַ/שָּֽׁלֶג
verses.translit: bnyh bn yhvyd' bn 'ysh chyl rb p'lym mn qbts'l hv' hkhh 't shny 'ry'l mv'b vhv' yrd vhkhh 't h'ry btvkh hbvr byvm hshlg
verses.translation: Benaiah the son of Jehoiada, the son of a valiant man of Kabzeel, who had done many acts; he slew two lionlike men of Moab: also he went down and slew a lion in a pit in a snowy day.

verses.original: וְ/הֽוּא הִכָּה֩ אֶת הָ/אִ֨ישׁ הַ/מִּצְרִ֜י אִ֥ישׁ מִדָּ֣ה חָמֵ֣שׁ בָּ/אַמָּ֗ה וּ/בְ/יַ֨ד הַ/מִּצְרִ֤י חֲנִית֙ כִּ/מְנ֣וֹר אֹרְגִ֔ים וַ/יֵּ֥רֶד אֵלָ֖י/ו בַּ/שָּׁ֑בֶט וַ/יִּגְזֹ֤ל אֶֽת הַ/חֲנִית֙ מִ/יַּ֣ד הַ/מִּצְרִ֔י וַ/יַּהַרְגֵ֖/הוּ בַּ/חֲנִיתֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: vhv' hkhh 't h'ysh hmtsry 'ysh mdh chmsh b'mh vbyd hmtsry chnyt khmnvr 'rgym vyrd 'lyv bshbt vygzl 't hchnyt myd hmtsry vyhrghv bchnytv
verses.translation: And he slew an Egyptian, a man of great stature, five cubits high; and in the Egyptian’s hand was a spear like a weaver’s beam; and he went down to him with a staff, and plucked the spear out of the Egyptian’s hand, and slew him with his own spear.

verses.original: אֵ֣לֶּה עָשָׂ֔ה בְּנָיָ֖הוּ בֶּן יְהוֹיָדָ֑ע וְ/ל/וֹ שֵׁ֖ם בִּ/שְׁלוֹשָׁ֥ה הַ/גִּבֹּרִֽים
verses.translit: 'lh 'shh bnyhv bn yhvyd' vlv shm bshlvshh hgbrym
verses.translation: These things did Benaiah the son of Jehoiada, and had the name among the three mighties.

verses.original: מִן הַ/שְּׁלוֹשִׁ֗ים הִנּ֤/וֹ נִכְבָּד֙ ה֔וּא וְ/אֶל הַ/שְּׁלוֹשָׁ֖ה לֹא בָ֑א וַ/יְשִׂימֵ֥/הוּ דָוִ֖יד עַל מִשְׁמַעְתּֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: mn hshlvshym hnv nkhbd hv' v'l hshlvshh l' b' vyshymhv dvyd 'l mshm'tv
verses.translation: Behold, he was honourable among the thirty, but attained not to the first three: and David set him over his guard.

verses.original: וְ/גִבּוֹרֵ֖י הַ/חֲיָלִ֑ים עֲשָׂה אֵל֙ אֲחִ֣י יוֹאָ֔ב אֶלְחָנָ֥ן בֶּן דּוֹד֖וֹ מִ/בֵּ֥ית לָֽחֶם
verses.translit: vgbvry hchylym 'shh 'l 'chy yv'b 'lchnn bn dvdv mbyt lchm
verses.translation: Also the valiant men of the armies were , Asahel the brother of Joab, Elhanan the son of Dodo of Beth-lehem,

verses.original: שַׁמּוֹת֙ הַ/הֲרוֹרִ֔י חֶ֖לֶץ הַ/פְּלוֹנִֽי
verses.translit: shmvt hhrvry chlts hplvny
verses.translation: Shammoth the Harorite, Helez the Pelonite,

verses.original: עִירָ֤א בֶן עִקֵּשׁ֙ הַ/תְּקוֹעִ֔י אֲבִיעֶ֖זֶר הָ/עֲנְּתוֹתִֽי
verses.translit: 'yr' bn 'qsh htqv'y 'by'zr h'ntvty
verses.translation: Ira the son of Ikkesh the Tekoite, Abi-ezer the Antothite,

verses.original: סִבְּכַי֙ הַ/חֻ֣שָׁתִ֔י עִילַ֖י הָ/אֲחוֹחִֽי
verses.translit: sbkhy hchshty 'yly h'chvchy
verses.translation: Sibbecai the Hushathite, Ilai the Ahohite,

verses.original: מַהְרַי֙ הַ/נְּטֹ֣פָתִ֔י חֵ֥לֶד בֶּֽן בַּֽעֲנָ֖ה הַ/נְּטוֹפָתִֽי
verses.translit: mhry hntpty chld bn b'nh hntvpty
verses.translation: Maharai the Netophathite, Heled the son of Baanah the Netophathite,

verses.original: אִיתַ֣י בֶּן רִיבַ֗י מִ/גִּבְעַת֙ בְּנֵ֣י בִנְיָמִ֔ן בְּנָיָ֖ה הַ/פִּרְעָתֹנִֽי
verses.translit: 'yty bn ryby mgb't bny bnymn bnyh hpr'tny
verses.translation: Ithai the son of Ribai of Gibeah, that pertained to the children of Benjamin, Benaiah the Pirathonite,

verses.original: חוּרַי֙ מִ/נַּ֣חֲלֵי גָ֔עַשׁ אֲבִיאֵ֖ל הָ/עַרְבָתִֽי
verses.translit: chvry mnchly g'sh 'by'l h'rbty
verses.translation: Hurai of the brooks of Gaash, Abiel the Arbathite,

verses.original: עַזְמָ֨וֶת֙ הַ/בַּ֣חֲרוּמִ֔י אֶלְיַחְבָּ֖א הַ/שַּׁעַלְבֹנִֽי
verses.translit: 'zmvt hbchrvmy 'lychb' hsh'lbny
verses.translation: Azmaveth the Baharumite, Eliahba the Shaalbonite,

verses.original: בְּנֵ֗י הָשֵׁם֙ הַ/גִּ֣זוֹנִ֔י יוֹנָתָ֥ן בֶּן שָׁגֵ֖ה הַ/הֲרָרִֽי
verses.translit: bny hshm hgzvny yvntn bn shgh hhrry
verses.translation: The sons of Hashem the Gizonite, Jonathan the son of Shage the Hararite,

verses.original: אֲחִיאָ֧ם בֶּן שָׂכָ֛ר הַ/הֲרָרִ֖י אֱלִיפַ֥ל בֶּן אֽוּר
verses.translit: 'chy'm bn shkhr hhrry 'lypl bn 'vr
verses.translation: Ahiam the son of Sacar the Hararite, Eliphal the son of Ur,

verses.original: חֵ֚פֶר הַ/מְּכֵ֣רָתִ֔י אֲחִיָּ֖ה הַ/פְּלֹנִֽי
verses.translit: chpr hmkhrty 'chyh hplny
verses.translation: Hepher the Mecherathite, Ahijah the Pelonite,

verses.original: חֶצְרוֹ֙ הַֽ/כַּרְמְלִ֔י נַעֲרַ֖י בֶּן אֶזְבָּֽי
verses.translit: chtsrv hkhrmly n'ry bn 'zby
verses.translation: Hezro the Carmelite, Naarai the son of Ezbai,

verses.original: יוֹאֵל֙ אֲחִ֣י נָתָ֔ן מִבְחָ֖ר בֶּן הַגְרִֽי
verses.translit: yv'l 'chy ntn mbchr bn hgry
verses.translation: Joel the brother of Nathan, Mibhar the son of Haggeri,

verses.original: צֶ֖לֶק הָ/עַמּוֹנִ֑י נַחְרַי֙ הַ/בֵּ֣רֹתִ֔י נֹשֵׂ֕א כְּלֵ֖י יוֹאָ֥ב בֶּן צְרוּיָֽה
verses.translit: tslq h'mvny nchry hbrty nsh' khly yv'b bn tsrvyh
verses.translation: Zelek the Ammonite, Naharai the Berothite, the armourbearer of Joab the son of Zeruiah,

verses.original: עִירָא֙ הַ/יִּתְרִ֔י גָּרֵ֖ב הַ/יִּתְרִֽי
verses.translit: 'yr' hytry grb hytry
verses.translation: Ira the Ithrite, Gareb the Ithrite,

verses.original: אֽוּרִיָּה֙ הַ/חִתִּ֔י זָבָ֖ד בֶּן אַחְלָֽי
verses.translit: 'vryh hchty zbd bn 'chly
verses.translation: Uriah the Hittite, Zabad the son of Ahlai,

verses.original: עֲדִינָ֨א בֶן שִׁיזָ֜א הָ/רֽאוּבֵנִ֗י רֹ֛אשׁ לָ/רֽאוּבֵנִ֖י וְ/עָלָ֥י/ו שְׁלוֹשִֽׁים
verses.translit: 'dyn' bn shyz' hr'vbny r'sh lr'vbny v'lyv shlvshym
verses.translation: Adina the son of Shiza the Reubenite, a captain of the Reubenites, and thirty with him,

verses.original: חָנָן֙ בֶּֽן מַעֲכָ֔ה וְ/יוֹשָׁפָ֖ט הַ/מִּתְנִֽי
verses.translit: chnn bn m'khh vyvshpt hmtny
verses.translation: Hanan the son of Maachah, and Joshaphat the Mithnite,

verses.original: עֻזִיָּ֖א הָ/עֲשְׁתְּרָתִ֑י שָׁמָע֙ ו/יעואל וִֽ/יעִיאֵ֔ל בְּנֵ֖י חוֹתָ֥ם הָ/עֲרֹעֵרִֽי
verses.translit: 'zy' h'shtrty shm' vy'v'l vy'y'l bny chvtm h'r'ry
verses.translation: Uzzia the Ashterathite, Shama and Jehiel the sons of Hothan the Aroerite,

verses.original: יְדִֽיעֲאֵל֙ בֶּן שִׁמְרִ֔י וְ/יֹחָ֥א אָחִ֖י/ו הַ/תִּיצִֽי
verses.translit: ydy''l bn shmry vych' 'chyv htytsy
verses.translation: Jediael the son of Shimri, and Joha his brother, the Tizite,

verses.original: אֱלִיאֵל֙ הַֽ/מַּחֲוִ֔ים וִ/ירִיבַ֥י וְ/יוֹשַׁוְיָ֖ה בְּנֵ֣י אֶלְנָ֑עַם וְ/יִתְמָ֖ה הַ/מּוֹאָבִֽי
verses.translit: 'ly'l hmchvym vyryby vyvshvyh bny 'ln'm vytmh hmv'by
verses.translation: Eliel the Mahavite, and Jeribai, and Joshaviah, the sons of Elnaam, and Ithmah the Moabite,

verses.original: אֱלִיאֵ֣ל וְ/עוֹבֵ֔ד וְ/יַעֲשִׂיאֵ֖ל הַ/מְּצֹבָיָֽה
verses.translit: 'ly'l v'vbd vy'shy'l hmtsbyh
verses.translation: Eliel, and Obed, and Jasiel the Mesobaite.

verses.original: וְ/אֵ֗לֶּה הַ/בָּאִ֤ים אֶל דָּוִיד֙ לְ/צִ֣יקְלַ֔ג ע֣וֹד עָצ֔וּר מִ/פְּנֵ֖י שָׁא֣וּל בֶּן קִ֑ישׁ וְ/הֵ֨מָּה֙ בַּ/גִּבּוֹרִ֔ים עֹזְרֵ֖י הַ/מִּלְחָמָֽה
verses.translit: v'lh hb'ym 'l dvyd ltsyqlg 'vd 'tsvr mpny sh'vl bn qysh vhmh bgbvrym 'zry hmlchmh
verses.translation: Now these are they that came to David to Ziklag, while he yet kept himself close because of Saul the son of Kish: and they were among the mighty men, helpers of the war.

verses.original: נֹ֣שְׁקֵי קֶ֗שֶׁת מַיְמִינִ֤ים וּ/מַשְׂמִאלִים֙ בָּֽ/אֲבָנִ֔ים וּ/בַ/חִצִּ֖ים בַּ/קָּ֑שֶׁת מֵ/אֲחֵ֥י שָׁא֖וּל מִ/בִּנְיָמִֽן
verses.translit: nshqy qsht mymynym vmshm'lym b'bnym vbchtsym bqsht m'chy sh'vl mbnymn
verses.translation: They were armed with bows, and could use both the right hand and the left in hurling stones and shooting arrows out of a bow, even of Saul’s brethren of Benjamin.

verses.original: הָ/רֹ֨אשׁ אֲחִיעֶ֜זֶר וְ/יוֹאָ֗שׁ בְּנֵי֙ הַ/שְּׁמָעָ֣ה הַ/גִּבְעָתִ֔י ו/יזואל וִ/יזִיאֵ֥ל וָ/פֶ֖לֶט בְּנֵ֣י עַזְמָ֑וֶת וּ/בְרָכָ֕ה וְ/יֵה֖וּא הָ/עֲנְּתֹתִֽי
verses.translit: hr'sh 'chy'zr vyv'sh bny hshm'h hgb'ty vyzv'l vyzy'l vplt bny 'zmvt vbrkhh vyhv' h'ntty
verses.translation: The chief was Ahiezer, then Joash, the sons of Shemaah the Gibeathite; and Jeziel, and Pelet, the sons of Azmaveth; and Berachah, and Jehu the Antothite,

verses.original: וְ/יִֽשְׁמַֽעְיָ֧ה הַ/גִּבְעוֹנִ֛י גִּבּ֥וֹר בַּ/שְּׁלֹשִׁ֖ים וְ/עַל הַ/שְּׁלֹשִֽׁים
verses.translit: vyshm'yh hgb'vny gbvr bshlshym v'l hshlshym
verses.translation: And Ismaiah the Gibeonite, a mighty man among the thirty, and over the thirty; and Jeremiah, and Jahaziel, and Johanan, and Josabad the Gederathite,

verses.original: וְ/יִרְמְיָ֤ה וְ/יַחֲזִיאֵל֙ וְ/י֣וֹחָנָ֔ן וְ/יוֹזָבָ֖ד הַ/גְּדֵרָתִֽי
verses.translit: vyrmyh vychzy'l vyvchnn vyvzbd hgdrty
verses.translation: Eluzai, and Jerimoth, and Bealiah, and Shemariah, and Shephatiah the Haruphite,

verses.original: אֶלְעוּזַ֤י וִ/ירִימוֹת֙ וּ/בְעַלְיָ֣ה וּ/שְׁמַרְיָ֔הוּ וּ/שְׁפַטְיָ֖הוּ ה/חריפי הַ/חֲרוּפִֽי
verses.translit: 'l'vzy vyrymvt vb'lyh vshmryhv vshptyhv hchrypy hchrvpy
verses.translation: Elkanah, and Jesiah, and Azareel, and Joezer, and Jashobeam, the Korhites,

verses.original: אֶלְקָנָ֡ה וְ֠/יִשִּׁיָּהוּ וַ/עֲזַרְאֵ֧ל וְ/יוֹעֶ֛זֶר וְ/יָשָׁבְעָ֖ם הַ/קָּרְחִֽים
verses.translit: 'lqnh vyshyhv v'zr'l vyv'zr vyshb'm hqrchym
verses.translation: And Joelah, and Zebadiah, the sons of Jeroham of Gedor.

verses.original: וְ/יוֹעֵאלָ֧ה וּ/זְבַדְיָ֛ה בְּנֵ֥י יְרֹחָ֖ם מִן הַ/גְּדֽוֹר
verses.translit: vyv''lh vzbdyh bny yrchm mn hgdvr
verses.translation: And of the Gadites there separated themselves unto David into the hold to the wilderness men of might, and men of war fit for the battle, that could handle shield and buckler, whose faces were like the faces of lions, and were as swift as the roes upon the mountains;

verses.original: וּ/מִן הַ/גָּדִ֡י נִבְדְּל֣וּ אֶל דָּוִיד֩ לַ/מְצַ֨ד מִדְבָּ֜רָ/ה גִּבֹּרֵ֣י הַ/חַ֗יִל אַנְשֵׁ֤י צָבָא֙ לַ/מִּלְחָמָ֔ה עֹרְכֵ֥י צִנָּ֖ה וָ/רֹ֑מַח וּ/פְנֵ֤י אַרְיֵה֙ פְּנֵי/הֶ֔ם וְ/כִ/צְבָאיִ֥ם עַל הֶ/הָרִ֖ים לְ/מַהֵֽר
verses.translit: vmn hgdy nbdlv 'l dvyd lmtsd mdbrh gbry hchyl 'nshy tsb' lmlchmh 'rkhy tsnh vrmch vpny 'ryh pnyhm vkhtsb'ym 'l hhrym lmhr
verses.translation: Ezer the first, Obadiah the second, Eliab the third,

verses.original: עֵ֖זֶר הָ/רֹ֑אשׁ עֹבַדְיָה֙ הַ/שֵּׁנִ֔י אֱלִיאָ֖ב הַ/שְּׁלִשִֽׁי
verses.translit: 'zr hr'sh 'bdyh hshny 'ly'b hshlshy
verses.translation: Mishmannah the fourth, Jeremiah the fifth,

verses.original: מִשְׁמַנָּה֙ הָ/רְבִיעִ֔י יִרְמְיָ֖ה הַ/חֲמִשִֽׁי
verses.translit: mshmnh hrby'y yrmyh hchmshy
verses.translation: Attai the sixth, Eliel the seventh,

verses.original: עַתַּי֙ הַ/שִּׁשִּׁ֔י אֱלִיאֵ֖ל הַ/שְּׁבִעִֽי
verses.translit: 'ty hshshy 'ly'l hshb'y
verses.translation: Johanan the eighth, Elzabad the ninth,

verses.original: יֽוֹחָנָן֙ הַ/שְּׁמִינִ֔י אֶלְזָבָ֖ד הַ/תְּשִׁיעִֽי
verses.translit: yvchnn hshmyny 'lzbd htshy'y
verses.translation: Jeremiah the tenth, Machbanai the eleventh.

verses.original: יִרְמְיָ֨הוּ֙ הָ/עֲשִׂירִ֔י מַכְבַּנַּ֖י עַשְׁתֵּ֥י עָשָֽׂר
verses.translit: yrmyhv h'shyry mkhbny 'shty 'shr
verses.translation: These were of the sons of Gad, captains of the host: one of the least was over an hundred, and the greatest over a thousand.

verses.original: אֵ֥לֶּה מִ/בְּנֵי גָ֖ד רָאשֵׁ֣י הַ/צָּבָ֑א אֶחָ֤ד לְ/מֵאָה֙ הַ/קָּטָ֔ן וְ/הַ/גָּד֖וֹל לְ/אָֽלֶף
verses.translit: 'lh mbny gd r'shy htsb' 'chd lm'h hqtn vhgdvl l'lf
verses.translation: These are they that went over Jordan in the first month, when it had overflown all his banks; and they put to flight all them of the valleys, both toward the east, and toward the west.

verses.original: אֵ֣לֶּה הֵ֗ם אֲשֶׁ֨ר עָבְר֤וּ אֶת הַ/יַּרְדֵּן֙ בַּ/חֹ֣דֶשׁ הָ/רִאשׁ֔וֹן וְ/ה֥וּא מְמַלֵּ֖א עַל כָּל גדיתי/ו גְּדוֹתָ֑י/ו וַ/יַּבְרִ֨יחוּ֙ אֶת כָּל הָ֣/עֲמָקִ֔ים לַ/מִּזְרָ֖ח וְ/לַֽ/מַּעֲרָֽב
verses.translit: 'lh hm 'shr 'brv 't hyrdn bchdsh hr'shvn vhv' mml' 'l khl gdytyv gdvtyv vybrychv 't khl h'mqym lmzrch vlm'rb
verses.translation: And there came of the children of Benjamin and Judah to the hold unto David.

verses.original: וַ/יָּבֹ֗אוּ מִן בְּנֵ֤י בִנְיָמִן֙ וִֽ/יהוּדָ֔ה עַד לַ/מְצָ֖ד לְ/דָוִֽיד
verses.translit: vyb'v mn bny bnymn vyhvdh 'd lmtsd ldvyd
verses.translation: And David went out to meet them, and answered and said unto them, If ye be come peaceably unto me to help me, mine heart shall be knit unto you: but if ye be come to betray me to mine enemies, seeing there is no wrong in mine hands, the God of our fathers look thereon , and rebuke it .

verses.original: וַ/יֵּצֵ֣א דָוִיד֮ לִ/פְנֵי/הֶם֒ וַ/יַּ֨עַן֙ וַ/יֹּ֣אמֶר לָ/הֶ֔ם אִם לְ/שָׁל֞וֹם בָּאתֶ֤ם אֵלַ/י֙ לְ/עָזְרֵ֔/נִי יִֽהְיֶה לִּ֧/י עֲלֵי/כֶ֛ם לֵבָ֖ב לְ/יָ֑חַד וְ/אִֽם לְ/רַמּוֹתַ֣/נִי לְ/צָרַ֗/י בְּ/לֹ֤א חָמָס֙ בְּ/כַפַּ֔/י יֵ֛רֶא אֱלֹהֵ֥י אֲבוֹתֵ֖י/נוּ וְ/יוֹכַֽח
verses.translit: vyts' dvyd lpnyhm vy'n vy'mr lhm 'm lshlvm b'tm 'ly l'zrny yhyh ly 'lykhm lbb lychd v'm lrmvtny ltsry bl' chms bkhpy yr' 'lhy 'bvtynv vyvkhch
verses.translation: Then the spirit came upon Amasai, who was chief of the captains, and he said , Thine are we , David, and on thy side, thou son of Jesse: peace, peace be unto thee, and peace be to thine helpers; for thy God helpeth thee. Then David received them, and made them captains of the band.

verses.original: וְ/ר֣וּחַ לָבְשָׁ֗ה אֶת עֲמָשַׂי֮ רֹ֣אשׁ ה/שלושים הַ/שָּׁלִישִׁים֒ לְ/ךָ֤ דָוִיד֙ וְ/עִמְּ/ךָ֣ בֶן יִשַׁ֔י שָׁל֨וֹם שָׁל֜וֹם לְ/ךָ֗ וְ/שָׁלוֹם֙ לְ/עֹ֣זְרֶ֔/ךָ כִּ֥י עֲזָרְ/ךָ֖ אֱלֹהֶ֑י/ךָ וַ/יְקַבְּלֵ֣/ם דָּוִ֔יד וַֽ/יִּתְּנֵ֖/ם בְּ/רָאשֵׁ֥י הַ/גְּדֽוּד
verses.translit: vrvch lbshh 't 'mshy r'sh hshlvshym hshlyshym lkh dvyd v'mkh bn yshy shlvm shlvm lkh vshlvm l'zrkh khy 'zrkh 'lhykh vyqblm dvyd vytnm br'shy hgdvd
verses.translation: And there fell some of Manasseh to David, when he came with the Philistines against Saul to battle: but they helped them not: for the lords of the Philistines upon advisement sent him away, saying, He will fall to his master Saul to the jeopardy of our heads.

verses.original: וּ/מִֽ/מְּנַשֶּׁ֞ה נָפְל֣וּ עַל דָּוִ֗יד בְּ/בֹא֨/וֹ עִם פְּלִשְׁתִּ֧ים עַל שָׁא֛וּל לַ/מִּלְחָמָ֖ה וְ/לֹ֣א עֲזָרֻ֑/ם כִּ֣י בְ/עֵצָ֗ה שִׁלְּחֻ֜/הוּ סַרְנֵ֤י פְלִשְׁתִּים֙ לֵ/אמֹ֔ר בְּ/רָאשֵׁ֕י/נוּ יִפּ֖וֹל אֶל אֲדֹנָ֥י/ו שָׁאֽוּל
verses.translit: vmmnshh nplv 'l dvyd bb'v 'm plshtym 'l sh'vl lmlchmh vl' 'zrm khy b'tsh shlchhv srny plshtym l'mr br'shynv ypvl 'l 'dnyv sh'vl
verses.translation: As he went to Ziklag, there fell to him of Manasseh, Adnah, and Jozabad, and Jediael, and Michael, and Jozabad, and Elihu, and Zilthai, captains of the thousands that were of Manasseh.

verses.original: בְּ/לֶכְתּ֣/וֹ אֶל צִֽיקְלַ֗ג נָפְל֣וּ עָלָ֣י/ו מִֽ/מְּנַשֶּׁ֡ה עַ֠דְנַח וְ/יוֹזָבָ֤ד וִ/ידִֽיעֲאֵל֙ וּ/מִיכָאֵ֣ל וְ/יוֹזָבָ֔ד וֶ/אֱלִיה֖וּא וְ/צִלְּתָ֑י רָאשֵׁ֥י הָ/אֲלָפִ֖ים אֲשֶׁ֥ר לִ/מְנַשֶּֽׁה
verses.translit: blkhtv 'l tsyqlg nplv 'lyv mmnshh 'dnch vyvzbd vydy''l vmykh'l vyvzbd v'lyhv' vtslty r'shy h'lpym 'shr lmnshh
verses.translation: And they helped David against the band of the rovers: for they were all mighty men of valour, and were captains in the host.

verses.original: וְ/הֵ֗מָּה עָזְר֤וּ עִם דָּוִיד֙ עַֽל הַ/גְּד֔וּד כִּֽי גִבּ֥וֹרֵי חַ֖יִל כֻּלָּ֑/ם וַ/יִּהְי֥וּ שָׂרִ֖ים בַּ/צָּבָֽא
verses.translit: vhmh 'zrv 'm dvyd 'l hgdvd khy gbvry chyl khlm vyhyv shrym btsb'
verses.translation: For at that time day by day there came to David to help him, until it was a great host, like the host of God.

verses.original: כִּ֚י לְ/עֶת י֣וֹם בְּ/י֔וֹם יָבֹ֥אוּ עַל דָּוִ֖יד לְ/עָזְר֑/וֹ עַד לְ/מַחֲנֶ֥ה גָד֖וֹל כְּ/מַחֲנֵ֥ה אֱלֹהִֽים
verses.translit: khy l't yvm byvm yb'v 'l dvyd l'zrv 'd lmchnh gdvl khmchnh 'lhym
verses.translation: And these are the numbers of the bands that were ready armed to the war, and came to David to Hebron, to turn the kingdom of Saul to him, according to the word of the LORD .

verses.original: וְ֠/אֵלֶּה מִסְפְּרֵ֞י רָאשֵׁ֤י הֶֽ/חָלוּץ֙ לַ/צָּבָ֔א בָּ֥אוּ עַל דָּוִ֖יד חֶבְר֑וֹנָ/ה לְ/הָסֵ֞ב מַלְכ֥וּת שָׁא֛וּל אֵלָ֖י/ו כְּ/פִ֥י יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: v'lh mspry r'shy hchlvts ltsb' b'v 'l dvyd chbrvnh lhsb mlkhvt sh'vl 'lyv khpy yhvh
verses.translation: The children of Judah that bare shield and spear were six thousand and eight hundred, ready armed to the war.

verses.original: בְּנֵ֣י יְהוּדָ֔ה נֹשְׂאֵ֥י צִנָּ֖ה וָ/רֹ֑מַח שֵׁ֧שֶׁת אֲלָפִ֛ים וּ/שְׁמוֹנֶ֥ה מֵא֖וֹת חֲלוּצֵ֥י צָבָֽא
verses.translit: bny yhvdh nsh'y tsnh vrmch shsht 'lpym vshmvnh m'vt chlvtsy tsb'
verses.translation: Of the children of Simeon, mighty men of valour for the war, seven thousand and one hundred.

verses.original: מִן בְּנֵ֣י שִׁמְע֗וֹן גִּבּ֤וֹרֵי חַ֨יִל֙ לַ/צָּבָ֔א שִׁבְעַ֥ת אֲלָפִ֖ים וּ/מֵאָֽה
verses.translit: mn bny shm'vn gbvry chyl ltsb' shb't 'lpym vm'h
verses.translation: Of the children of Levi four thousand and six hundred.

verses.original: מִן בְּנֵי֙ הַ/לֵּוִ֔י אַרְבַּ֥עַת אֲלָפִ֖ים וְ/שֵׁ֥שׁ מֵאֽוֹת
verses.translit: mn bny hlvy 'rb't 'lpym vshsh m'vt
verses.translation: And Jehoiada was the leader of the Aaronites, and with him were three thousand and seven hundred;

verses.original: וִ/יהוֹיָדָ֖ע הַ/נָּגִ֣יד לְ/אַהֲרֹ֑ן וְ/עִמּ֕/וֹ שְׁלֹ֥שֶׁת אֲלָפִ֖ים וּ/שְׁבַ֥ע מֵאֽוֹת
verses.translit: vyhvyd' hngyd l'hrn v'mv shlsht 'lpym vshb' m'vt
verses.translation: And Zadok, a young man mighty of valour, and of his father’s house twenty and two captains.

verses.original: וְ/צָד֥וֹק נַ֖עַר גִּבּ֣וֹר חָ֑יִל וּ/בֵית אָבִ֥י/ו שָׂרִ֖ים עֶשְׂרִ֥ים וּ/שְׁנָֽיִם
verses.translit: vtsdvq n'r gbvr chyl vbyt 'byv shrym 'shrym vshnym
verses.translation: And of the children of Benjamin, the kindred of Saul, three thousand: for hitherto the greatest part of them had kept the ward of the house of Saul.

verses.original: וּ/מִן בְּנֵ֧י בִנְיָמִ֛ן אֲחֵ֥י שָׁא֖וּל שְׁלֹ֣שֶׁת אֲלָפִ֑ים וְ/עַד הֵ֨נָּה֙ מַרְבִּיתָ֔/ם שֹׁמְרִ֕ים מִשְׁמֶ֖רֶת בֵּ֥ית שָׁאֽוּל
verses.translit: vmn bny bnymn 'chy sh'vl shlsht 'lpym v'd hnh mrbytm shmrym mshmrt byt sh'vl
verses.translation: And of the children of Ephraim twenty thousand and eight hundred, mighty men of valour, famous throughout the house of their fathers.

verses.original: וּ/מִן בְּנֵ֣י אֶפְרַ֔יִם עֶשְׂרִ֥ים אֶ֖לֶף וּ/שְׁמוֹנֶ֣ה מֵא֑וֹת גִּבּ֣וֹרֵי חַ֔יִל אַנְשֵׁ֥י שֵׁמ֖וֹת לְ/בֵ֥ית אֲבוֹתָֽ/ם
verses.translit: vmn bny 'prym 'shrym 'lf vshmvnh m'vt gbvry chyl 'nshy shmvt lbyt 'bvtm
verses.translation: And of the half tribe of Manasseh eighteen thousand, which were expressed by name, to come and make David king.

verses.original: וּ/מֵ/חֲצִי֙ מַטֵּ֣ה מְנַשֶּׁ֔ה שְׁמוֹנָ֥ה עָשָׂ֖ר אָ֑לֶף אֲשֶׁ֤ר נִקְּבוּ֙ בְּ/שֵׁמ֔וֹת לָ/ב֖וֹא לְ/הַמְלִ֥יךְ אֶת דָּוִֽיד
verses.translit: vmchtsy mth mnshh shmvnh 'shr 'lf 'shr nqbv bshmvt lbv' lhmlykh 't dvyd
verses.translation: And of the children of Issachar, which were men that had understanding of the times, to know what Israel ought to do; the heads of them were two hundred; and all their brethren were at their commandment.

verses.original: וּ/מִ/בְּנֵ֣י יִשָּׂשכָ֗ר יוֹדְעֵ֤י בִינָה֙ לַֽ/עִתִּ֔ים לָ/דַ֖עַת מַה יַּעֲשֶׂ֣ה יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל רָאשֵׁי/הֶ֣ם מָאתַ֔יִם וְ/כָל אֲחֵי/הֶ֖ם עַל פִּי/הֶֽם
verses.translit: vmbny yshshkhr yvd'y bynh l'tym ld't mh y'shh yshr'l r'shyhm m'tym vkhl 'chyhm 'l pyhm
verses.translation: Of Zebulun, such as went forth to battle, expert in war, with all instruments of war, fifty thousand, which could keep rank: they were not of double heart.

verses.original: מִ/זְּבֻל֞וּן יוֹצְאֵ֣י צָבָ֗א עֹרְכֵ֧י מִלְחָמָ֛ה בְּ/כָל כְּלֵ֥י מִלְחָמָ֖ה חֲמִשִּׁ֣ים אָ֑לֶף וְ/לַ/עֲדֹ֖ר בְּ/לֹא לֵ֥ב וָ/לֵֽב
verses.translit: mzblvn yvts'y tsb' 'rkhy mlchmh bkhl khly mlchmh chmshym 'lf vl'dr bl' lb vlb
verses.translation: And of Naphtali a thousand captains, and with them with shield and spear thirty and seven thousand.

verses.original: וּ/מִ/נַּפְתָּלִ֖י שָׂרִ֣ים אָ֑לֶף וְ/עִמָּ/הֶם֙ בְּ/צִנָּ֣ה וַ/חֲנִ֔ית שְׁלֹשִׁ֥ים וְ/שִׁבְעָ֖ה אָֽלֶף
verses.translit: vmnptly shrym 'lf v'mhm btsnh vchnyt shlshym vshb'h 'lf
verses.translation: And of the Danites expert in war twenty and eight thousand and six hundred.

verses.original: וּ/מִן הַ/דָּנִי֙ עֹרְכֵ֣י מִלְחָמָ֔ה עֶשְׂרִֽים וּ/שְׁמוֹנָ֥ה אֶ֖לֶף וְ/שֵׁ֥שׁ מֵאֽוֹת
verses.translit: vmn hdny 'rkhy mlchmh 'shrym vshmvnh 'lf vshsh m'vt
verses.translation: And of Asher, such as went forth to battle, expert in war, forty thousand.

verses.original: וּ/מֵ/אָשֵׁ֗ר יוֹצְאֵ֥י צָבָ֛א לַ/עֲרֹ֥ךְ מִלְחָמָ֖ה אַרְבָּעִ֥ים אָֽלֶף
verses.translit: vm'shr yvts'y tsb' l'rkh mlchmh 'rb'ym 'lf
verses.translation: And on the other side of Jordan, of the Reubenites, and the Gadites, and of the half tribe of Manasseh, with all manner of instruments of war for the battle, an hundred and twenty thousand.

verses.original: וּ/מֵ/עֵ֣בֶר לַ֠/יַּרְדֵּן מִן הָ/ראוּבֵנִ֨י וְ/הַ/גָּדִ֜י וַ/חֲצִ֣י שֵׁ֣בֶט מְנַשֶּׁ֗ה בְּ/כֹל֙ כְּלֵי֙ צְבָ֣א מִלְחָמָ֔ה מֵאָ֥ה וְ/עֶשְׂרִ֖ים אָֽלֶף
verses.translit: vm'br lyrdn mn hr'vbny vhgdy vchtsy shbt mnshh bkhl khly tsb' mlchmh m'h v'shrym 'lf
verses.translation: All these men of war, that could keep rank, came with a perfect heart to Hebron, to make David king over all Israel: and all the rest also of Israel were of one heart to make David king.

verses.original: כָּל אֵ֜לֶּה אַנְשֵׁ֣י מִלְחָמָה֮ עֹדְרֵ֣י מַעֲרָכָה֒ בְּ/לֵבָ֤ב שָׁלֵם֙ בָּ֣אוּ חֶבְר֔וֹנָ/ה לְ/הַמְלִ֥יךְ אֶת דָּוִ֖יד עַל כָּל יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וְ֠/גַם כָּל שֵׁרִ֧ית יִשְׂרָאֵ֛ל לֵ֥ב אֶחָ֖ד לְ/הַמְלִ֥יךְ אֶת דָּוִֽיד
verses.translit: khl 'lh 'nshy mlchmh 'dry m'rkhh blbb shlm b'v chbrvnh lhmlykh 't dvyd 'l khl yshr'l vgm khl shryt yshr'l lb 'chd lhmlykh 't dvyd
verses.translation: And there they were with David three days, eating and drinking: for their brethren had prepared for them.

verses.original: וַ/יִּהְיוּ שָׁ֤ם עִם דָּוִיד֙ יָמִ֣ים שְׁלוֹשָׁ֔ה אֹכְלִ֖ים וְ/שׁוֹתִ֑ים כִּֽי הֵכִ֥ינוּ לָ/הֶ֖ם אֲחֵי/הֶֽם
verses.translit: vyhyv shm 'm dvyd ymym shlvshh 'khlym vshvtym khy hkhynv lhm 'chyhm
verses.translation: Moreover they that were nigh them, even unto Issachar and Zebulun and Naphtali, brought bread on asses, and on camels, and on mules, and on oxen, and meat, meal, cakes of figs, and bunches of raisins, and wine, and oil, and oxen, and sheep abundantly: for there was joy in Israel.

verses.original: וַ/יִּוָּעַ֣ץ דָּוִ֗יד עִם שָׂרֵ֧י הָ/אֲלָפִ֛ים וְ/הַ/מֵּא֖וֹת לְ/כָל נָגִֽיד
verses.translit: vyv'ts dvyd 'm shry h'lpym vhm'vt lkhl ngyd
verses.translation: And David consulted with the captains of thousands and hundreds, and with every leader.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֨אמֶר דָּוִ֜יד לְ/כֹ֣ל קְהַ֣ל יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל אִם עֲלֵי/כֶ֨ם ט֜וֹב וּ/מִן יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֵ֗י/נוּ נִפְרְצָה֙ נִשְׁלְחָ֞ה עַל אַחֵ֣י/נוּ הַ/נִּשְׁאָרִ֗ים בְּ/כֹל֙ אַרְצ֣וֹת יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל וְ/עִמָּ/הֶ֛ם הַ/כֹּהֲנִ֥ים וְ/הַ/לְוִיִּ֖ם בְּ/עָרֵ֣י מִגְרְשֵׁי/הֶ֑ם וְ/יִקָּבְצ֖וּ אֵלֵֽי/נוּ
verses.translit: vy'mr dvyd lkhl qhl yshr'l 'm 'lykhm tvb vmn yhvh 'lhynv nprtsh nshlchh 'l 'chynv hnsh'rym bkhl 'rtsvt yshr'l v'mhm hkhhnym vhlvym b'ry mgrshyhm vyqbtsv 'lynv
verses.translation: And David said unto all the congregation of Israel, If it seem good unto you, and that it be of the LORD our God, let us send abroad unto our brethren every where, that are left in all the land of Israel, and with them also to the priests and Levites which are in their cities and suburbs, that they may gather themselves unto us:

verses.original: וְ/נָסֵ֛בָּה אֶת אֲר֥וֹן אֱלֹהֵ֖י/נוּ אֵלֵ֑י/נוּ כִּי לֹ֥א דְרַשְׁנֻ֖/הוּ בִּ/ימֵ֥י שָׁאֽוּל
verses.translit: vnsbh 't 'rvn 'lhynv 'lynv khy l' drshnhv bymy sh'vl
verses.translation: And let us bring again the ark of our God to us: for we enquired not at it in the days of Saul.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּאמְר֥וּ כָֽל הַ/קָּהָ֖ל לַ/עֲשׂ֣וֹת כֵּ֑ן כִּֽי יָשַׁ֥ר הַ/דָּבָ֖ר בְּ/עֵינֵ֥י כָל הָ/עָֽם
verses.translit: vy'mrv khl hqhl l'shvt khn khy yshr hdbr b'yny khl h'm
verses.translation: And all the congregation said that they would do so: for the thing was right in the eyes of all the people.

verses.original: וַ/יַּקְהֵ֤ל דָּוִיד֙ אֶת כָּל יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל מִן שִׁיח֥וֹר מִצְרַ֖יִם וְ/עַד לְב֣וֹא חֲמָ֑ת לְ/הָבִיא֙ אֶת אֲר֣וֹן הָ/אֱלֹהִ֔ים מִ/קִּרְיַ֖ת יְעָרִֽים
verses.translit: vyqhl dvyd 't khl yshr'l mn shychvr mtsrym v'd lbv' chmt lhby' 't 'rvn h'lhym mqryt y'rym
verses.translation: So David gathered all Israel together, from Shihor of Egypt even unto the entering of Hemath, to bring the ark of God from Kirjath-jearim.

verses.original: וַ/יַּ֨עַל דָּוִ֤יד וְ/כָל יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ בַּעֲלָ֔תָ/ה אֶל קִרְיַ֥ת יְעָרִ֖ים אֲשֶׁ֣ר לִ/יהוּדָ֑ה לְ/הַעֲל֣וֹת מִ/שָּׁ֗ם אֵת֩ אֲר֨וֹן הָ/אֱלֹהִ֧ים יְהוָ֛ה יוֹשֵׁ֥ב הַ/כְּרוּבִ֖ים אֲשֶׁר נִקְרָ֥א שֵֽׁם
verses.translit: vy'l dvyd vkhl yshr'l b'lth 'l qryt y'rym 'shr lyhvdh lh'lvt mshm 't 'rvn h'lhym yhvh yvshb hkhrvbym 'shr nqr' shm
verses.translation: And David went up, and all Israel, to Baalah, that is , to Kirjath-jearim, which belonged to Judah, to bring up thence the ark of God the LORD , that dwelleth between the cherubims, whose name is called on it .

verses.original: וַ/יַּרְכִּ֜יבוּ אֶת אֲר֤וֹן הָ/אֱלֹהִים֙ עַל עֲגָלָ֣ה חֲדָשָׁ֔ה מִ/בֵּ֖ית אֲבִינָדָ֑ב וְ/עֻזָּ֣א וְ/אַחְי֔וֹ נֹהֲגִ֖ים בָּ/עֲגָלָֽה
verses.translit: vyrkhybv 't 'rvn h'lhym 'l 'glh chdshh mbyt 'byndb v'z' v'chyv nhgym b'glh
verses.translation: And they carried the ark of God in a new cart out of the house of Abinadab: and Uzza and Ahio drave the cart.

verses.original: וְ/דָוִ֣יד וְ/כָל יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל מְשַׂחֲקִ֛ים לִ/פְנֵ֥י הָ/אֱלֹהִ֖ים בְּ/כָל עֹ֑ז וּ/בְ/שִׁירִ֤ים וּ/בְ/כִנֹּרוֹת֙ וּ/בִ/נְבָלִ֣ים וּ/בְ/תֻפִּ֔ים וּ/בִ/מְצִלְתַּ֖יִם וּ/בַ/חֲצֹצְרֽוֹת
verses.translit: vdvyd vkhl yshr'l mshchqym lpny h'lhym bkhl 'z vbshyrym vbkhnrvt vbnblym vbtpym vbmtsltym vbchtstsrvt
verses.translation: And David and all Israel played before God with all their might, and with singing, and with harps, and with psalteries, and with timbrels, and with cymbals, and with trumpets.

verses.original: וַ/יָּבֹ֖אוּ עַד גֹּ֣רֶן כִּידֹ֑ן וַ/יִּשְׁלַ֨ח עֻזָּ֜א אֶת יָד֗/וֹ לֶ/אֱחֹז֙ אֶת הָ֣/אָר֔וֹן כִּ֥י שָֽׁמְט֖וּ הַ/בָּקָֽר
verses.translit: vyb'v 'd grn khydn vyshlch 'z' 't ydv l'chz 't h'rvn khy shmtv hbqr
verses.translation: And when they came unto the threshingfloor of Chidon, Uzza put forth his hand to hold the ark; for the oxen stumbled.

verses.original: וַ/יִּֽחַר אַ֤ף יְהוָה֙ בְּ/עֻזָּ֔א וַ/יַּכֵּ֕/הוּ עַ֛ל אֲשֶׁר שָׁלַ֥ח יָד֖/וֹ עַל הָ/אָר֑וֹן וַ/יָּ֥מָת שָׁ֖ם לִ/פְנֵ֥י אֱלֹהִֽים
verses.translit: vychr 'f yhvh b'z' vykhhv 'l 'shr shlch ydv 'l h'rvn vymt shm lpny 'lhym
verses.translation: And the anger of the LORD was kindled against Uzza, and he smote him, because he put his hand to the ark: and there he died before God.

verses.original: וַ/יִּ֣חַר לְ/דָוִ֔יד כִּֽי פָרַ֧ץ יְהוָ֛ה פֶּ֖רֶץ בְּ/עֻזָּ֑א וַ/יִּקְרָ֞א לַ/מָּק֤וֹם הַ/הוּא֙ פֶּ֣רֶץ עֻזָּ֔א עַ֖ד הַ/יּ֥וֹם הַ/זֶּֽה
verses.translit: vychr ldvyd khy prts yhvh prts b'z' vyqr' lmqvm hhv' prts 'z' 'd hyvm hzh
verses.translation: And David was displeased, because the LORD had made a breach upon Uzza: wherefore that place is called Perez-uzza to this day.

verses.original: וַ/יִּירָ֤א דָוִיד֙ אֶת הָ֣/אֱלֹהִ֔ים בַּ/יּ֥וֹם הַ/ה֖וּא לֵ/אמֹ֑ר הֵ֚יךְ אָבִ֣יא אֵלַ֔/י אֵ֖ת אֲר֥וֹן הָ/אֱלֹהִֽים
verses.translit: vyyr' dvyd 't h'lhym byvm hhv' l'mr hykh 'by' 'ly 't 'rvn h'lhym
verses.translation: And David was afraid of God that day, saying, How shall I bring the ark of God home to me?

verses.original: וְ/לֹֽא הֵסִ֨יר דָּוִ֧יד אֶת הָ/אָר֛וֹן אֵלָ֖י/ו אֶל עִ֣יר דָּוִ֑יד וַ/יַּטֵּ֕/הוּ אֶל בֵּ֥ית עֹבֵֽד אֱדֹ֖ם הַ/גִּתִּֽי
verses.translit: vl' hsyr dvyd 't h'rvn 'lyv 'l 'yr dvyd vythv 'l byt 'bd 'dm hgty
verses.translation: So David brought not the ark home to himself to the city of David, but carried it aside into the house of Obed-edom the Gittite.

verses.original: וַ/יֵּשֶׁב֩ אֲר֨וֹן הָ/אֱלֹהִ֜ים עִם בֵּ֨ית עֹבֵ֥ד אֱדֹ֛ם בְּ/בֵית֖/וֹ שְׁלֹשָׁ֣ה חֳדָשִׁ֑ים וַ/יְבָ֧רֶךְ יְהוָ֛ה אֶת בֵּ֥ית עֹבֵֽד אֱדֹ֖ם וְ/אֶת כָּל אֲשֶׁר לֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: vyshb 'rvn h'lhym 'm byt 'bd 'dm bbytv shlshh chdshym vybrkh yhvh 't byt 'bd 'dm v't khl 'shr lv
verses.translation: And the ark of God remained with the family of Obed-edom in his house three months. And the LORD blessed the house of Obed-edom, and all that he had.

verses.original: וַ֠/יִּשְׁלַח חירם חוּרָ֨ם מֶֽלֶךְ צֹ֥ר מַלְאָכִים֮ אֶל דָּוִיד֒ וַ/עֲצֵ֣י אֲרָזִ֔ים וְ/חָרָשֵׁ֣י קִ֔יר וְ/חָרָשֵׁ֖י עֵצִ֑ים לִ/בְנ֥וֹת ל֖/וֹ בָּֽיִת
verses.translit: vyshlch chyrm chvrm mlkh tsr ml'khym 'l dvyd v'tsy 'rzym vchrshy qyr vchrshy 'tsym lbnvt lv byt
verses.translation: Now Hiram king of Tyre sent messengers to David, and timber of cedars, with masons and carpenters, to build him an house.

verses.original: וַ/יֵּ֣דַע דָּוִ֔יד כִּֽי הֱכִינ֧/וֹ יְהוָ֛ה לְ/מֶ֖לֶךְ עַל יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל כִּֽי נִשֵּׂ֤את לְ/מַ֨עְלָ/ה֙ מַלְכוּת֔/וֹ בַּ/עֲב֖וּר עַמּ֥/וֹ יִשְׂרָאֵֽל
verses.translit: vyd' dvyd khy hkhynv yhvh lmlkh 'l yshr'l khy nsh't lm'lh mlkhvtv b'bvr 'mv yshr'l
verses.translation: And David perceived that the LORD had confirmed him king over Israel, for his kingdom was lifted up on high, because of his people Israel.

verses.original: וַ/יִּקַּ֨ח דָּוִ֥יד ע֛וֹד נָשִׁ֖ים בִּ/ירוּשָׁלִָ֑ם וַ/יּ֧וֹלֶד דָּוִ֛יד ע֖וֹד בָּנִ֥ים וּ/בָנֽוֹת
verses.translit: vyqch dvyd 'vd nshym byrvshlm vyvld dvyd 'vd bnym vbnvt
verses.translation: And David took more wives at Jerusalem: and David begat more sons and daughters.

verses.original: וְ/אֵ֨לֶּה֙ שְׁמ֣וֹת הַ/יְלוּדִ֔ים אֲשֶׁ֥ר הָיוּ ל֖/וֹ בִּ/ירוּשָׁלִָ֑ם שַׁמּ֣וּעַ וְ/שׁוֹבָ֔ב נָתָ֖ן וּ/שְׁלֹמֹֽה
verses.translit: v'lh shmvt hylvdym 'shr hyv lv byrvshlm shmv' vshvbb ntn vshlmh
verses.translation: Now these are the names of his children which he had in Jerusalem; Shammua, and Shobab, Nathan, and Solomon,

verses.original: וְ/יִבְחָ֥ר וֶ/אֱלִישׁ֖וּעַ וְ/אֶלְפָּֽלֶט
verses.translit: vybchr v'lyshv' v'lplt
verses.translation: And Ibhar, and Elishua, and Elpalet,

verses.original: וְ/נֹ֥גַהּ וְ/נֶ֖פֶג וְ/יָפִֽיעַ
verses.translit: vngh vnpg vypy'
verses.translation: And Nogah, and Nepheg, and Japhia,

verses.original: וֶ/אֱלִישָׁמָ֥ע וּ/בְעֶלְיָדָ֖ע וֶ/אֱלִיפָֽלֶט
verses.translit: v'lyshm' vb'lyd' v'lyplt
verses.translation: And Elishama, and Beeliada, and Eliphalet.

verses.original: וַ/יִּשְׁמְע֣וּ פְלִשְׁתִּ֗ים כִּי נִמְשַׁ֨ח דָּוִ֤יד לְ/מֶ֨לֶךְ֙ עַל כָּל יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל וַ/יַּעֲל֥וּ כָל פְּלִשְׁתִּ֖ים לְ/בַקֵּ֣שׁ אֶת דָּוִ֑יד וַ/יִּשְׁמַ֣ע דָּוִ֔יד וַ/יֵּצֵ֖א לִ/פְנֵי/הֶֽם
verses.translit: vyshm'v plshtym khy nmshch dvyd lmlkh 'l khl yshr'l vy'lv khl plshtym lbqsh 't dvyd vyshm' dvyd vyts' lpnyhm
verses.translation: And when the Philistines heard that David was anointed king over all Israel, all the Philistines went up to seek David. And David heard of it , and went out against them.

verses.original: וּ/פְלִשְׁתִּ֖ים בָּ֑אוּ וַֽ/יִּפְשְׁט֖וּ בְּ/עֵ֥מֶק רְפָאִֽים
verses.translit: vplshtym b'v vypshtv b'mq rp'ym
verses.translation: And the Philistines came and spread themselves in the valley of Rephaim.

verses.original: וַ/יִּשְׁאַ֨ל דָּוִ֤יד בֵּ/אלֹהִים֙ לֵ/אמֹ֔ר הַ/אֶֽעֱלֶה֙ עַל פלשתיים פְּלִשְׁתִּ֔ים וּ/נְתַתָּ֖/ם בְּ/יָדִ֑/י וַ/יֹּ֨אמֶר ל֤/וֹ יְהוָה֙ עֲלֵ֔ה וּ/נְתַתִּ֖י/ם בְּ/יָדֶֽ/ךָ
verses.translit: vysh'l dvyd b'lhym l'mr h''lh 'l plshtyym plshtym vnttm bydy vy'mr lv yhvh 'lh vnttym bydkh
verses.translation: And David enquired of God, saying, Shall I go up against the Philistines? and wilt thou deliver them into mine hand? And the LORD said unto him, Go up; for I will deliver them into thine hand.

verses.original: וַ/יַּעֲל֥וּ בְּ/בַֽעַל פְּרָצִים֮ וַ/יַּכֵּ֣/ם שָׁ֣ם דָּוִיד֒ וַ/יֹּ֣אמֶר דָּוִ֔יד פָּרַ֨ץ הָֽ/אֱלֹהִ֧ים אֶת אוֹיְבַ֛/י בְּ/יָדִ֖/י כְּ/פֶ֣רֶץ מָ֑יִם עַל כֵּ֗ן קָֽרְא֛וּ שֵֽׁם הַ/מָּק֥וֹם הַ/ה֖וּא בַּ֥עַל פְּרָצִֽים
verses.translit: vy'lv bb'l prtsym vykhm shm dvyd vy'mr dvyd prts h'lhym 't 'vyby bydy khprts mym 'l khn qr'v shm hmqvm hhv' b'l prtsym
verses.translation: So they came up to Baal-perazim; and David smote them there. Then David said, God hath broken in upon mine enemies by mine hand like the breaking forth of waters: therefore they called the name of that place Baal-perazim.

verses.original: וַ/יַּעַזְבוּ שָׁ֖ם אֶת אֱלֹֽהֵי/הֶ֑ם וַ/יֹּ֣אמֶר דָּוִ֔יד וַ/יִּשָּׂרְפ֖וּ בָּ/אֵֽשׁ
verses.translit: vy'zbv shm 't 'lhyhm vy'mr dvyd vyshrpv b'sh
verses.translation: And when they had left their gods there, David gave a commandment, and they were burned with fire.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּסִ֤יפוּ עוֹד֙ פְּלִשְׁתִּ֔ים וַֽ/יִּפְשְׁט֖וּ בָּ/עֵֽמֶק
verses.translit: vysypv 'vd plshtym vypshtv b'mq
verses.translation: And the Philistines yet again spread themselves abroad in the valley.

verses.original: וַ/יִּשְׁאַ֨ל ע֤וֹד דָּוִיד֙ בֵּֽ/אלֹהִ֔ים וַ/יֹּ֤אמֶר ל/וֹ֙ הָֽ/אֱלֹהִ֔ים לֹ֥א תַֽעֲלֶ֖ה אַֽחֲרֵי/הֶ֑ם הָסֵב֙ מֵֽ/עֲלֵי/הֶ֔ם וּ/בָ֥אתָ לָ/הֶ֖ם מִ/מּ֥וּל הַ/בְּכָאִֽים
verses.translit: vysh'l 'vd dvyd b'lhym vy'mr lv h'lhym l' t'lh 'chryhm hsb m'lyhm vb't lhm mmvl hbkh'ym
verses.translation: Therefore David enquired again of God; and God said unto him, Go not up after them; turn away from them, and come upon them over against the mulberry trees.

verses.original: וִ֠/יהִי כְּֽ/שָׁמְעֲ/ךָ֞ אֶת ק֤וֹל הַ/צְּעָדָה֙ בְּ/רָאשֵׁ֣י הַ/בְּכָאִ֔ים אָ֖ז תֵּצֵ֣א בַ/מִּלְחָמָ֑ה כִּֽי יָצָ֤א הָֽ/אֱלֹהִים֙ לְ/פָנֶ֔י/ךָ לְ/הַכּ֖וֹת אֶת מַחֲנֵ֥ה פְלִשְׁתִּֽים
verses.translit: vyhy khshm'kh 't qvl hts'dh br'shy hbkh'ym 'z tts' bmlchmh khy yts' h'lhym lpnykh lhkhvt 't mchnh plshtym
verses.translation: And it shall be, when thou shalt hear a sound of going in the tops of the mulberry trees, that then thou shalt go out to battle: for God is gone forth before thee to smite the host of the Philistines.

verses.original: וַ/יַּ֣עַשׂ דָּוִ֔יד כַּֽ/אֲשֶׁ֥ר צִוָּ֖/הוּ הָֽ/אֱלֹהִ֑ים וַ/יַּכּוּ֙ אֶת מַחֲנֵ֣ה פְלִשְׁתִּ֔ים מִ/גִּבְע֖וֹן וְ/עַד גָּֽזְרָ/ה
verses.translit: vy'sh dvyd kh'shr tsvhv h'lhym vykhv 't mchnh plshtym mgb'vn v'd gzrh
verses.translation: David therefore did as God commanded him: and they smote the host of the Philistines from Gibeon even to Gazer.

verses.original: וַ/יֵּצֵ֥א שֵׁם דָּוִ֖יד בְּ/כָל הָֽ/אֲרָצ֑וֹת וַֽ/יהוָ֛ה נָתַ֥ן אֶת פַּחְדּ֖/וֹ עַל כָּל הַ/גּוֹיִֽם
verses.translit: vyts' shm dvyd bkhl h'rtsvt vyhvh ntn 't pchdv 'l khl hgvym
verses.translation: And the fame of David went out into all lands; and the LORD brought the fear of him upon all nations.

verses.original: וַ/יַּֽעַשׂ ל֥/וֹ בָתִּ֖ים בְּ/עִ֣יר דָּוִ֑יד וַ/יָּ֤כֶן מָקוֹם֙ לַֽ/אֲר֣וֹן הָֽ/אֱלֹהִ֔ים וַ/יֶּט ל֖/וֹ אֹֽהֶל
verses.translit: vy'sh lv btym b'yr dvyd vykhn mqvm l'rvn h'lhym vyt lv 'hl
verses.translation: And David made him houses in the city of David, and prepared a place for the ark of God, and pitched for it a tent.

verses.original: אָ֚ז אָמַ֣ר דָּוִ֔יד לֹ֤א לָ/שֵׂאת֙ אֶת אֲר֣וֹן הָֽ/אֱלֹהִ֔ים כִּ֖י אִם הַ/לְוִיִּ֑ם כִּי בָ֣/ם בָּחַ֣ר יְהוָ֗ה לָ/שֵׂ֞את אֶת אֲר֧וֹן יְהוָ֛ה וּֽ/לְ/שָׁרְת֖/וֹ עַד עוֹלָֽם
verses.translit: 'z 'mr dvyd l' lsh't 't 'rvn h'lhym khy 'm hlvym khy bm bchr yhvh lsh't 't 'rvn yhvh vlshrtv 'd 'vlm
verses.translation: Then David said, None ought to carry the ark of God but the Levites: for them hath the LORD chosen to carry the ark of God, and to minister unto him for ever.

verses.original: וַ/יַּקְהֵ֥ל דָּוִ֛יד אֶת כָּל יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל אֶל יְרֽוּשָׁלִָ֑ם לְ/הַעֲלוֹת֙ אֶת אֲר֣וֹן יְהוָ֔ה אֶל מְקוֹמ֖/וֹ אֲשֶׁר הֵכִ֥ין לֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: vyqhl dvyd 't khl yshr'l 'l yrvshlm lh'lvt 't 'rvn yhvh 'l mqvmv 'shr hkhyn lv
verses.translation: And David gathered all Israel together to Jerusalem, to bring up the ark of the LORD unto his place, which he had prepared for it.

verses.original: וַ/יֶּאֱסֹ֥ף דָּוִ֛יד אֶת בְּנֵ֥י אַֽהֲרֹ֖ן וְ/אֶת הַ/לְוִיִּֽם
verses.translit: vy'sf dvyd 't bny 'hrn v't hlvym
verses.translation: And David assembled the children of Aaron, and the Levites:

verses.original: לִ/בְנֵ֖י קְהָ֑ת אוּרִיאֵ֣ל הַ/שָּׂ֔ר וְ/אֶחָ֖י/ו מֵאָ֥ה וְ/עֶשְׂרִֽים
verses.translit: lbny qht 'vry'l hshr v'chyv m'h v'shrym
verses.translation: Of the sons of Kohath; Uriel the chief, and his brethren an hundred and twenty:

verses.original: לִ/בְנֵ֖י מְרָרִ֑י עֲשָׂיָ֣ה הַ/שָּׂ֔ר וְ/אֶחָ֖י/ו מָאתַ֥יִם וְ/עֶשְׂרִֽים
verses.translit: lbny mrry 'shyh hshr v'chyv m'tym v'shrym
verses.translation: Of the sons of Merari; Asaiah the chief, and his brethren two hundred and twenty:

verses.original: לִ/בְנֵ֖י גֵּרְשׁ֑וֹם יוֹאֵ֣ל הַ/שָּׂ֔ר וְ/אֶחָ֖י/ו מֵאָ֥ה וּ/שְׁלֹשִֽׁים
verses.translit: lbny grshvm yv'l hshr v'chyv m'h vshlshym
verses.translation: Of the sons of Gershom; Joel the chief, and his brethren an hundred and thirty:

verses.original: לִ/בְנֵ֖י אֱלִֽיצָפָ֑ן שְׁמַֽעְיָ֥ה הַ/שָּׂ֖ר וְ/אֶחָ֥י/ו מָאתָֽיִם
verses.translit: lbny 'lytspn shm'yh hshr v'chyv m'tym
