verses.translation: Of the sons of Elizaphan; Shemaiah the chief, and his brethren two hundred:

verses.original: לִ/בְנֵ֖י חֶבְר֑וֹן אֱלִיאֵ֥ל הַ/שָּׂ֖ר וְ/אֶחָ֥י/ו שְׁמוֹנִֽים
verses.translit: lbny chbrvn 'ly'l hshr v'chyv shmvnym
verses.translation: Of the sons of Hebron; Eliel the chief, and his brethren fourscore:

verses.original: לִ/בְנֵ֖י עֻזִּיאֵ֑ל עַמִּינָדָ֣ב הַ/שָּׂ֔ר וְ/אֶחָ֕י/ו מֵאָ֖ה וּ/שְׁנֵ֥ים עָשָֽׂר
verses.translit: lbny 'zy'l 'myndb hshr v'chyv m'h vshnym 'shr
verses.translation: Of the sons of Uzziel; Amminadab the chief, and his brethren an hundred and twelve.

verses.original: וַ/יִּקְרָ֣א דָוִ֔יד לְ/צָד֥וֹק וּ/לְ/אֶבְיָתָ֖ר הַ/כֹּֽהֲנִ֑ים וְ/לַ/לְוִיִּ֗ם לְ/אֽוּרִיאֵ֤ל עֲשָׂיָה֙ וְ/יוֹאֵ֣ל שְׁמַֽעְיָ֔ה וֶ/אֱלִיאֵ֖ל וְ/עַמִּינָדָֽב
verses.translit: vyqr' dvyd ltsdvq vl'bytr hkhhnym vllvym l'vry'l 'shyh vyv'l shm'yh v'ly'l v'myndb
verses.translation: And David called for Zadok and Abiathar the priests, and for the Levites, for Uriel, Asaiah, and Joel, Shemaiah, and Eliel, and Amminadab,

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֣אמֶר לָ/הֶ֔ם אַתֶּ֛ם רָאשֵׁ֥י הָ/אָב֖וֹת לַ/לְוִיִּ֑ם הִֽתְקַדְּשׁוּ֙ אַתֶּ֣ם וַ/אֲחֵי/כֶ֔ם וְ/הַֽעֲלִיתֶ֗ם אֵ֣ת אֲר֤וֹן יְהוָה֙ אֱלֹהֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל אֶל הֲכִינ֖וֹתִי לֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: vy'mr lhm 'tm r'shy h'bvt llvym htqdshv 'tm v'chykhm vh'lytm 't 'rvn yhvh 'lhy yshr'l 'l hkhynvty lv
verses.translation: And said unto them, Ye are the chief of the fathers of the Levites: sanctify yourselves, both ye and your brethren, that ye may bring up the ark of the LORD God of Israel unto the place that I have prepared for it.

verses.original: כִּ֛י לְ/מַ בָּ/רִ֥אשׁוֹנָ֖ה לֹ֣א אַתֶּ֑ם פָּרַ֨ץ יְהוָ֤ה אֱלֹהֵ֨י/נוּ֙ בָּ֔/נוּ כִּי לֹ֥א דְרַשְׁנֻ֖/הוּ כַּ/מִּשְׁפָּֽט
verses.translit: khy lm br'shvnh l' 'tm prts yhvh 'lhynv bnv khy l' drshnhv khmshpt
verses.translation: For because ye did it not at the first, the LORD our God made a breach upon us, for that we sought him not after the due order.

verses.original: וַ/יִּֽתְקַדְּשׁ֔וּ הַ/כֹּהֲנִ֖ים וְ/הַ/לְוִיִּ֑ם לְ/הַעֲל֕וֹת אֶת אֲר֥וֹן יְהוָ֖ה אֱלֹהֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל
verses.translit: vytqdshv hkhhnym vhlvym lh'lvt 't 'rvn yhvh 'lhy yshr'l
verses.translation: So the priests and the Levites sanctified themselves to bring up the ark of the LORD God of Israel.

verses.original: וַ/יִּשְׂא֣וּ בְנֵֽי הַ/לְוִיִּ֗ם אֵ֚ת אֲר֣וֹן הָֽ/אֱלֹהִ֔ים כַּ/אֲשֶׁ֛ר צִוָּ֥ה מֹשֶׁ֖ה כִּ/דְבַ֣ר יְהוָ֑ה בִּ/כְתֵפָ֥/ם בַּ/מֹּט֖וֹת עֲלֵי/הֶֽם
verses.translit: vysh'v bny hlvym 't 'rvn h'lhym kh'shr tsvh mshh khdbr yhvh bkhtpm bmtvt 'lyhm
verses.translation: And the children of the Levites bare the ark of God upon their shoulders with the staves thereon, as Moses commanded according to the word of the LORD .

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֣אמֶר דָּוִיד֮ לְ/שָׂרֵ֣י הַ/לְוִיִּם֒ לְ/הַֽעֲמִ֗יד אֶת אֲחֵי/הֶם֙ הַ/מְשֹׁ֣רְרִ֔ים בִּ/כְלֵי שִׁ֛יר נְבָלִ֥ים וְ/כִנֹּר֖וֹת וּ/מְצִלְתָּ֑יִם מַשְׁמִיעִ֥ים לְ/הָרִֽים בְּ/ק֖וֹל לְ/שִׂמְחָֽה
verses.translit: vy'mr dvyd lshry hlvym lh'myd 't 'chyhm hmshrrym bkhly shyr nblym vkhnrvt vmtsltym mshmy'ym lhrym bqvl lshmchh
verses.translation: And David spake to the chief of the Levites to appoint their brethren to be the singers with instruments of musick, psalteries and harps and cymbals, sounding, by lifting up the voice with joy.

verses.original: וַ/יַּעֲמִ֣ידוּ הַ/לְוִיִּ֗ם אֵ֚ת הֵימָ֣ן בֶּן יוֹאֵ֔ל וּ/מִ֨ן אֶחָ֔י/ו אָסָ֖ף בֶּן בֶּֽרֶכְיָ֑הוּ וּ/מִן בְּנֵ֤י מְרָרִי֙ אֲחֵי/הֶ֔ם אֵיתָ֖ן בֶּן קֽוּשָׁיָֽהוּ
verses.translit: vy'mydv hlvym 't hymn bn yv'l vmn 'chyv 'sf bn brkhyhv vmn bny mrry 'chyhm 'ytn bn qvshyhv
verses.translation: So the Levites appointed Heman the son of Joel; and of his brethren, Asaph the son of Berechiah; and of the sons of Merari their brethren, Ethan the son of Kushaiah;

verses.original: וְ/עִמָּ/הֶ֖ם אֲחֵי/הֶ֣ם הַ/מִּשְׁנִ֑ים זְכַרְיָ֡הוּ בֵּ֡ן וְ/יַֽעֲזִיאֵ֡ל וּ/שְׁמִֽירָמ֡וֹת וִ/יחִיאֵ֣ל וְ/עֻנִּ֡י אֱלִיאָ֡ב וּ/בְנָיָ֡הוּ וּ/מַֽעֲשֵׂיָ֡הוּ וּ/מַתִּתְיָהוּ֩ וֶ/אֱלִ֨יפְלֵ֜הוּ וּ/מִקְנֵיָ֨הוּ וְ/עֹבֵ֥ד אֱדֹ֛ם וִֽ/יעִיאֵ֖ל הַ/שֹּׁעֲרִֽים
verses.translit: v'mhm 'chyhm hmshnym zkhryhv bn vy'zy'l vshmyrmvt vychy'l v'ny 'ly'b vbnyhv vm'shyhv vmttyhv v'lyplhv vmqnyhv v'bd 'dm vy'y'l hsh'rym
verses.translation: And with them their brethren of the second degree , Zechariah, Ben, and Jaaziel, and Shemiramoth, and Jehiel, and Unni, Eliab, and Benaiah, and Maaseiah, and Mattithiah, and Elipheleh, and Mikneiah, and Obed-edom, and Jeiel, the porters.

verses.original: וְ/הַ/מְשֹׁ֣רְרִ֔ים הֵימָ֥ן אָסָ֖ף וְ/אֵיתָ֑ן בִּ/מְצִלְתַּ֥יִם נְחֹ֖שֶׁת לְ/הַשְׁמִֽיעַ
verses.translit: vhmshrrym hymn 'sf v'ytn bmtsltym nchsht lhshmy'
verses.translation: So the singers, Heman, Asaph, and Ethan, were appointed to sound with cymbals of brass;

verses.original: וּ/זְכַרְיָ֨ה וַ/עֲזִיאֵ֜ל וּ/שְׁמִֽירָמ֤וֹת וִֽ/יחִיאֵל֙ וְ/עֻנִּ֣י וֶֽ/אֱלִיאָ֔ב וּ/מַעֲשֵׂיָ֖הוּ וּ/בְנָיָ֑הוּ בִּ/נְבָלִ֖ים עַל עֲלָמֽוֹת
verses.translit: vzkhryh v'zy'l vshmyrmvt vychy'l v'ny v'ly'b vm'shyhv vbnyhv bnblym 'l 'lmvt
verses.translation: And Zechariah, and Aziel, and Shemiramoth, and Jehiel, and Unni, and Eliab, and Maaseiah, and Benaiah, with psalteries on Alamoth;

verses.original: וּ/מַתִּתְיָ֣הוּ וֶ/אֱלִֽיפְלֵ֗הוּ וּ/מִקְנֵיָ֨הוּ֙ וְ/עֹבֵ֣ד אֱדֹ֔ם וִֽ/יעִיאֵ֖ל וַ/עֲזַזְיָ֑הוּ בְּ/כִנֹּר֥וֹת עַל הַ/שְּׁמִינִ֖ית לְ/נַצֵּֽחַ
verses.translit: vmttyhv v'lyplhv vmqnyhv v'bd 'dm vy'y'l v'zzyhv bkhnrvt 'l hshmynyt lntsch
verses.translation: And Mattithiah, and Elipheleh, and Mikneiah, and Obed-edom, and Jeiel, and Azaziah, with harps on the Sheminith to excel.

verses.original: וּ/כְנַנְיָ֥הוּ שַֽׂר הַ/לְוִיִּ֖ם בְּ/מַשָּׂ֑א יָסֹר֙ בַּ/מַּשָּׂ֔א כִּ֥י מֵבִ֖ין הֽוּא
verses.translit: vkhnnyhv shr hlvym bmsh' ysr bmsh' khy mbyn hv'
verses.translation: And Chenaniah, chief of the Levites, was for song: he instructed about the song, because he was skilful.

verses.original: וּ/בֶֽרֶכְיָה֙ וְ/אֶלְקָנָ֔ה שֹׁעֲרִ֖ים לָ/אָרֽוֹן
verses.translit: vbrkhyh v'lqnh sh'rym l'rvn
verses.translation: And Berechiah and Elkanah were doorkeepers for the ark.

verses.original: וּ/שְׁבַנְיָ֡הוּ וְ/יֽוֹשָׁפָ֡ט וּ/נְתַנְאֵ֡ל וַ/עֲמָשַׂ֡י וּ֠/זְכַרְיָהוּ וּ/בְנָיָ֤הוּ וֶֽ/אֱלִיעֶ֨זֶר֙ הַ/כֹּ֣הֲנִ֔ים מחצצרים מַחְצְרִים֙ בַּ/חֲצֹ֣צְר֔וֹת לִ/פְנֵ֖י אֲר֣וֹן הָֽ/אֱלֹהִ֑ים וְ/עֹבֵ֤ד אֱדֹם֙ וִֽ/יחִיָּ֔ה שֹׁעֲרִ֖ים לָ/אָרֽוֹן
verses.translit: vshbnyhv vyvshpt vntn'l v'mshy vzkhryhv vbnyhv v'ly'zr hkhhnym mchtstsrym mchtsrym bchtstsrvt lpny 'rvn h'lhym v'bd 'dm vychyh sh'rym l'rvn
verses.translation: And Shebaniah, and Jehoshaphat, and Nethaneel, and Amasai, and Zechariah, and Benaiah, and Eliezer, the priests, did blow with the trumpets before the ark of God: and Obed-edom and Jehiah were doorkeepers for the ark.

verses.original: וַ/יְהִ֥י דָוִ֛יד וְ/זִקְנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל וְ/שָׂרֵ֣י הָ/אֲלָפִ֑ים הַ/הֹֽלְכִ֗ים לְֽ/הַעֲל֞וֹת אֶת אֲר֧וֹן בְּרִית יְהוָ֛ה מִן בֵּ֥ית עֹבֵֽד אֱדֹ֖ם בְּ/שִׂמְחָֽה
verses.translit: vyhy dvyd vzqny yshr'l vshry h'lpym hhlkhym lh'lvt 't 'rvn bryt yhvh mn byt 'bd 'dm bshmchh
verses.translation: So David, and the elders of Israel, and the captains over thousands, went to bring up the ark of the covenant of the LORD out of the house of Obed-edom with joy.

verses.original: וַֽ/יְהִי֙ בֶּ/עְזֹ֣ר הָֽ/אֱלֹהִ֔ים אֶ֨ת הַ/לְוִיִּ֔ם נֹשְׂאֵ֖י אֲר֣וֹן בְּרִית יְהוָ֑ה וַ/יִּזְבְּח֥וּ שִׁבְעָֽה פָרִ֖ים וְ/שִׁבְעָ֥ה אֵילִֽים
verses.translit: vyhy b'zr h'lhym 't hlvym nsh'y 'rvn bryt yhvh vyzbchv shb'h prym vshb'h 'ylym
verses.translation: And it came to pass, when God helped the Levites that bare the ark of the covenant of the LORD , that they offered seven bullocks and seven rams.

verses.original: וְ/דָוִ֞יד מְכֻרְבָּ֣ל בִּ/מְעִ֣יל בּ֗וּץ וְ/כָל הַ/לְוִיִּם֙ הַ/נֹּשְׂאִ֣ים אֶת הָ/אָר֔וֹן וְ/הַ/מְשֹׁ֣רְרִ֔ים וּ/כְנַנְיָ֛ה הַ/שַּׂ֥ר הַ/מַּשָּׂ֖א הַ/מְשֹֽׁרְרִ֑ים וְ/עַל דָּוִ֖יד אֵפ֥וֹד בָּֽד
verses.translit: vdvyd mkhrbl bm'yl bvts vkhl hlvym hnsh'ym 't h'rvn vhmshrrym vkhnnyh hshr hmsh' hmshrrym v'l dvyd 'pvd bd
verses.translation: And David was clothed with a robe of fine linen, and all the Levites that bare the ark, and the singers, and Chenaniah the master of the song with the singers: David also had upon him an ephod of linen.

verses.original: וְ/כָל יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל מַעֲלִים֙ אֶת אֲר֣וֹן בְּרִית יְהוָ֔ה בִּ/תְרוּעָה֙ וּ/בְ/ק֣וֹל שׁוֹפָ֔ר וּ/בַ/חֲצֹצְר֖וֹת וּ/בִ/מְצִלְתָּ֑יִם מַשְׁמִעִ֕ים בִּ/נְבָלִ֖ים וְ/כִנֹּרֽוֹת
verses.translit: vkhl yshr'l m'lym 't 'rvn bryt yhvh btrv'h vbqvl shvpr vbchtstsrvt vbmtsltym mshm'ym bnblym vkhnrvt
verses.translation: Thus all Israel brought up the ark of the covenant of the LORD with shouting, and with sound of the cornet, and with trumpets, and with cymbals, making a noise with psalteries and harps.

verses.original: וַ/יְהִ֗י אֲרוֹן֙ בְּרִ֣ית יְהוָ֔ה בָּ֖א עַד עִ֣יר דָּוִ֑יד וּ/מִיכַ֨ל בַּת שָׁא֜וּל נִשְׁקְפָ֣ה בְּעַ֣ד הַ/חַלּ֗וֹן וַ/תֵּ֨רֶא אֶת הַ/מֶּ֤לֶךְ דָּוִיד֙ מְרַקֵּ֣ד וּ/מְשַׂחֵ֔ק וַ/תִּ֥בֶז ל֖/וֹ בְּ/לִבָּֽ/הּ
verses.translit: vyhy 'rvn bryt yhvh b' 'd 'yr dvyd vmykhl bt sh'vl nshqph b'd hchlvn vtr' 't hmlkh dvyd mrqd vmshchq vtbz lv blbh
verses.translation: And it came to pass, as the ark of the covenant of the LORD came to the city of David, that Michal the daughter of Saul looking out at a window saw king David dancing and playing: and she despised him in her heart.

verses.original: וַ/יָּבִ֨יאוּ֙ אֶת אֲר֣וֹן הָֽ/אֱלֹהִ֔ים וַ/יַּצִּ֣יגוּ אֹת֔/וֹ בְּ/ת֣וֹךְ הָ/אֹ֔הֶל אֲשֶׁ֥ר נָֽטָה ל֖/וֹ דָּוִ֑יד וַ/יַּקְרִ֛יבוּ עֹל֥וֹת וּ/שְׁלָמִ֖ים לִ/פְנֵ֥י הָ/אֱלֹהִֽים
verses.translit: vyby'v 't 'rvn h'lhym vytsygv 'tv btvkh h'hl 'shr nth lv dvyd vyqrybv 'lvt vshlmym lpny h'lhym
verses.translation: So they brought the ark of God, and set it in the midst of the tent that David had pitched for it: and they offered burnt sacrifices and peace offerings before God.

verses.original: וַ/יְכַ֣ל דָּוִ֔יד מֵ/הַעֲל֥וֹת הָ/עֹלָ֖ה וְ/הַ/שְּׁלָמִ֑ים וַ/יְבָ֥רֶךְ אֶת הָ/עָ֖ם בְּ/שֵׁ֥ם יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: vykhl dvyd mh'lvt h'lh vhshlmym vybrkh 't h'm bshm yhvh
verses.translation: And when David had made an end of offering the burnt offerings and the peace offerings, he blessed the people in the name of the LORD .

verses.original: וַ/יְחַלֵּק֙ לְ/כָל אִ֣ישׁ יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל מֵ/אִ֖ישׁ וְ/עַד אִשָּׁ֑ה לְ/אִישׁ֙ כִּכַּר לֶ֔חֶם וְ/אֶשְׁפָּ֖ר וַ/אֲשִׁישָֽׁה
verses.translit: vychlq lkhl 'ysh yshr'l m'ysh v'd 'shh l'ysh khkhr lchm v'shpr v'shyshh
verses.translation: And he dealt to every one of Israel, both man and woman, to every one a loaf of bread, and a good piece of flesh, and a flagon of wine .

verses.original: וַ/יִּתֵּ֞ן לִ/פְנֵ֨י אֲר֧וֹן יְהוָ֛ה מִן הַ/לְוִיִּ֖ם מְשָׁרְתִ֑ים וּ/לְ/הַזְכִּיר֙ וּ/לְ/הוֹד֣וֹת וּ/לְ/הַלֵּ֔ל לַ/יהוָ֖ה אֱלֹהֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל
verses.translit: vytn lpny 'rvn yhvh mn hlvym mshrtym vlhzkhyr vlhvdvt vlhll lyhvh 'lhy yshr'l
verses.translation: And he appointed certain of the Levites to minister before the ark of the LORD , and to record, and to thank and praise the LORD God of Israel:

verses.original: אָסָ֥ף הָ/רֹ֖אשׁ וּ/מִשְׁנֵ֣/הוּ זְכַרְיָ֑ה יְעִיאֵ֡ל וּ/שְׁמִֽירָמ֡וֹת וִֽ/יחִיאֵ֡ל וּ/מַתִּתְיָ֡ה וֶ/אֱלִיאָ֡ב וּ/בְנָיָהוּ֩ וְ/עֹבֵ֨ד אֱדֹ֜ם וִֽ/יעִיאֵ֗ל בִּ/כְלֵ֤י נְבָלִים֙ וּ/בְ/כִנֹּר֔וֹת וְ/אָסָ֖ף בַּֽ/מְצִלְתַּ֥יִם מַשְׁמִֽיעַ
verses.translit: 'sf hr'sh vmshnhv zkhryh y'y'l vshmyrmvt vychy'l vmttyh v'ly'b vbnyhv v'bd 'dm vy'y'l bkhly nblym vbkhnrvt v'sf bmtsltym mshmy'
verses.translation: Asaph the chief, and next to him Zechariah, Jeiel, and Shemiramoth, and Jehiel, and Mattithiah, and Eliab, and Benaiah, and Obed-edom: and Jeiel with psalteries and with harps; but Asaph made a sound with cymbals;

verses.original: וּ/בְנָיָ֥הוּ וְ/יַחֲזִיאֵ֖ל הַ/כֹּהֲנִ֑ים בַּ/חֲצֹצְר֣וֹת תָּמִ֔יד לִ/פְנֵ֖י אֲר֥וֹן בְּרִית הָ/אֱלֹהִֽים
verses.translit: vbnyhv vychzy'l hkhhnym bchtstsrvt tmyd lpny 'rvn bryt h'lhym
verses.translation: Benaiah also and Jahaziel the priests with trumpets continually before the ark of the covenant of God.

verses.original: בַּ/יּ֣וֹם הַ/ה֗וּא אָ֣ז נָתַ֤ן דָּוִיד֙ בָּ/רֹ֔אשׁ לְ/הֹד֖וֹת לַ/יהוָ֑ה בְּ/יַד אָסָ֖ף וְ/אֶחָֽי/ו
verses.translit: byvm hhv' 'z ntn dvyd br'sh lhdvt lyhvh byd 'sf v'chyv
verses.translation: Then on that day David delivered first this psalm to thank the LORD into the hand of Asaph and his brethren.

verses.original: הוֹד֤וּ לַֽ/יהוָה֙ קִרְא֣וּ בִ/שְׁמ֔/וֹ הוֹדִ֥יעוּ בָ/עַמִּ֖ים עֲלִילֹתָֽי/ו
verses.translit: hvdv lyhvh qr'v bshmv hvdy'v b'mym 'lyltyv
verses.translation: Give thanks unto the LORD , call upon his name, make known his deeds among the people.

verses.original: שִׁ֤ירוּ ל/וֹ֙ זַמְּרוּ ל֔/וֹ שִׂ֖יחוּ בְּ/כָל נִפְלְאֹתָֽי/ו
verses.translit: shyrv lv zmrv lv shychv bkhl npl'tyv
verses.translation: Sing unto him, sing psalms unto him, talk ye of all his wondrous works.

verses.original: הִֽתְהַֽלְלוּ֙ בְּ/שֵׁ֣ם קָדְשׁ֔/וֹ יִשְׂמַ֕ח לֵ֖ב מְבַקְשֵׁ֥י יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: hthllv bshm qdshv yshmch lb mbqshy yhvh
verses.translation: Glory ye in his holy name: let the heart of them rejoice that seek the LORD .

verses.original: דִּרְשׁ֤וּ יְהוָה֙ וְ/עֻזּ֔/וֹ בַּקְּשׁ֥וּ פָנָ֖י/ו תָּמִֽיד
verses.translit: drshv yhvh v'zv bqshv pnyv tmyd
verses.translation: Seek the LORD and his strength, seek his face continually.

verses.original: זִכְר֗וּ נִפְלְאֹתָי/ו֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר עָשָׂ֔ה מֹפְתָ֖י/ו וּ/מִשְׁפְּטֵי פִֽי/הוּ
verses.translit: zkhrv npl'tyv 'shr 'shh mptyv vmshpty pyhv
verses.translation: Remember his marvellous works that he hath done, his wonders, and the judgments of his mouth;

verses.original: זֶ֚רַע יִשְׂרָאֵ֣ל עַבְדּ֔/וֹ בְּנֵ֥י יַעֲקֹ֖ב בְּחִירָֽי/ו
verses.translit: zr' yshr'l 'bdv bny y'qb bchyryv
verses.translation: O ye seed of Israel his servant, ye children of Jacob, his chosen ones.

verses.original: ה֚וּא יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֵ֔י/נוּ בְּ/כָל הָ/אָ֖רֶץ מִשְׁפָּטָֽי/ו
verses.translit: hv' yhvh 'lhynv bkhl h'rts mshptyv
verses.translation: He is the LORD our God; his judgments are in all the earth.

verses.original: זִכְר֤וּ לְ/עוֹלָם֙ בְּרִית֔/וֹ דָּבָ֥ר צִוָּ֖ה לְ/אֶ֥לֶף דּֽוֹר
verses.translit: zkhrv l'vlm brytv dbr tsvh l'lf dvr
verses.translation: Be ye mindful always of his covenant; the word which he commanded to a thousand generations;

verses.original: אֲשֶׁ֤ר כָּרַת֙ אֶת אַבְרָהָ֔ם וּ/שְׁבוּעָת֖/וֹ לְ/יִצְחָֽק
verses.translit: 'shr khrt 't 'brhm vshbv'tv lytschq
verses.translation: Even of the covenant which he made with Abraham, and of his oath unto Isaac;

verses.original: וַ/יַּעֲמִידֶ֤/הָ לְ/יַעֲקֹב֙ לְ/חֹ֔ק לְ/יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל בְּרִ֥ית עוֹלָֽם
verses.translit: vy'mydh ly'qb lchq lyshr'l bryt 'vlm
verses.translation: And hath confirmed the same to Jacob for a law, and to Israel for an everlasting covenant,

verses.original: לֵ/אמֹ֗ר לְ/ךָ֙ אֶתֵּ֣ן אֶֽרֶץ כְּנָ֔עַן חֶ֖בֶל נַחֲלַתְ/כֶֽם
verses.translit: l'mr lkh 'tn 'rts khn'n chbl nchltkhm
verses.translation: Saying, Unto thee will I give the land of Canaan, the lot of your inheritance;

verses.original: בִּֽ/הְיֽוֹתְ/כֶם֙ מְתֵ֣י מִסְפָּ֔ר כִּ/מְעַ֖ט וְ/גָרִ֥ים בָּֽ/הּ
verses.translit: bhyvtkhm mty mspr khm't vgrym bh
verses.translation: When ye were but few, even a few, and strangers in it.

verses.original: וַ/יִּֽתְהַלְּכוּ֙ מִ/גּ֣וֹי אֶל גּ֔וֹי וּ/מִ/מַּמְלָכָ֖ה אֶל עַ֥ם אַחֵֽר
verses.translit: vythlkhv mgvy 'l gvy vmmmlkhh 'l 'm 'chr
verses.translation: And when they went from nation to nation, and from one kingdom to another people;

verses.original: לֹא הִנִּ֤יחַ לְ/אִישׁ֙ לְ/עָשְׁקָ֔/ם וַ/יּ֥וֹכַח עֲלֵי/הֶ֖ם מְלָכִֽים
verses.translit: l' hnych l'ysh l'shqm vyvkhch 'lyhm mlkhym
verses.translation: He suffered no man to do them wrong: yea, he reproved kings for their sakes,

verses.original: אַֽל תִּגְּעוּ֙ בִּ/מְשִׁיחָ֔/י וּ/בִ/נְבִיאַ֖/י אַל תָּרֵֽעוּ
verses.translit: 'l tg'v bmshychy vbnby'y 'l tr'v
verses.translation: Saying , Touch not mine anointed, and do my prophets no harm.

verses.original: שִׁ֤ירוּ לַֽ/יהוָה֙ כָּל הָ/אָ֔רֶץ בַּשְּׂר֥וּ מִ/יּֽוֹם אֶל י֖וֹם יְשׁוּעָתֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: shyrv lyhvh khl h'rts bshrv myvm 'l yvm yshv'tv
verses.translation: Sing unto the LORD , all the earth; shew forth from day to day his salvation.

verses.original: סַפְּר֤וּ בַ/גּוֹיִם֙ אֶת כְּבוֹד֔/וֹ בְּ/כָל הָ/עַמִּ֖ים נִפְלְאֹתָֽי/ו
verses.translit: sprv bgvym 't khbvdv bkhl h'mym npl'tyv
verses.translation: Declare his glory among the heathen; his marvellous works among all nations.

verses.original: כִּי֩ גָד֨וֹל יְהוָ֤ה וּ/מְהֻלָּל֙ מְאֹ֔ד וְ/נוֹרָ֥א ה֖וּא עַל כָּל אֱלֹהִֽים
verses.translit: khy gdvl yhvh vmhll m'd vnvr' hv' 'l khl 'lhym
verses.translation: For great is the LORD , and greatly to be praised: he also is to be feared above all gods.

verses.original: כִּ֠י כָּל אֱלֹהֵ֤י הָ/עַמִּים֙ אֱלִילִ֔ים וַ/יהוָ֖ה שָׁמַ֥יִם עָשָֽׂה
verses.translit: khy khl 'lhy h'mym 'lylym vyhvh shmym 'shh
verses.translation: For all the gods of the people are idols: but the LORD made the heavens.

verses.original: ה֤וֹד וְ/הָדָר֙ לְ/פָנָ֔י/ו עֹ֥ז וְ/חֶדְוָ֖ה בִּ/מְקֹמֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: hvd vhdr lpnyv 'z vchdvh bmqmv
verses.translation: Glory and honour are in his presence; strength and gladness are in his place.

verses.original: הָב֤וּ לַֽ/יהוָה֙ מִשְׁפְּח֣וֹת עַמִּ֔ים הָב֥וּ לַ/יהוָ֖ה כָּב֥וֹד וָ/עֹֽז
verses.translit: hbv lyhvh mshpchvt 'mym hbv lyhvh khbvd v'z
verses.translation: Give unto the LORD , ye kindreds of the people, give unto the LORD glory and strength.

verses.original: הָב֥וּ לַ/יהוָ֖ה כְּב֣וֹד שְׁמ֑/וֹ שְׂא֤וּ מִנְחָה֙ וּ/בֹ֣אוּ לְ/פָנָ֔י/ו הִשְׁתַּחֲו֥וּ לַ/יהוָ֖ה בְּ/הַדְרַת קֹֽדֶשׁ
verses.translit: hbv lyhvh khbvd shmv sh'v mnchh vb'v lpnyv hshtchvv lyhvh bhdrt qdsh
verses.translation: Give unto the LORD the glory due unto his name: bring an offering, and come before him: worship the LORD in the beauty of holiness.

verses.original: חִ֤ילוּ מִ/לְּ/פָנָי/ו֙ כָּל הָ/אָ֔רֶץ אַף תִּכּ֥וֹן תֵּבֵ֖ל בַּל תִּמּֽוֹט
verses.translit: chylv mlpnyv khl h'rts 'f tkhvn tbl bl tmvt
verses.translation: Fear before him, all the earth: the world also shall be stable, that it be not moved.

verses.original: יִשְׂמְח֤וּ הַ/שָּׁמַ֨יִם֙ וְ/תָגֵ֣ל הָ/אָ֔רֶץ וְ/יֹאמְר֥וּ בַ/גּוֹיִ֖ם יְהוָ֥ה מָלָֽךְ
verses.translit: yshmchv hshmym vtgl h'rts vy'mrv bgvym yhvh mlkh
verses.translation: Let the heavens be glad, and let the earth rejoice: and let men say among the nations, The LORD reigneth.

verses.original: יִרְעַ֤ם הַ/יָּם֙ וּ/מְלוֹא֔/וֹ יַעֲלֹ֥ץ הַ/שָּׂדֶ֖ה וְ/כָל אֲשֶׁר בּֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: yr'm hym vmlv'v y'lts hshdh vkhl 'shr bv
verses.translation: Let the sea roar, and the fulness thereof: let the fields rejoice, and all that is therein.

verses.original: אָ֥ז יְרַנְּנ֖וּ עֲצֵ֣י הַ/יָּ֑עַר מִ/לִּ/פְנֵ֣י יְהוָ֔ה כִּי בָ֖א לִ/שְׁפּ֥וֹט אֶת הָ/אָֽרֶץ
verses.translit: 'z yrnnv 'tsy hy'r mlpny yhvh khy b' lshpvt 't h'rts
verses.translation: Then shall the trees of the wood sing out at the presence of the LORD , because he cometh to judge the earth.

verses.original: הוֹד֤וּ לַ/יהוָה֙ כִּ֣י ט֔וֹב כִּ֥י לְ/עוֹלָ֖ם חַסְדּֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: hvdv lyhvh khy tvb khy l'vlm chsdv
verses.translation: O give thanks unto the LORD ; for he is good; for his mercy endureth for ever.

verses.original: וְ/אִמְר֕וּ הוֹשִׁיעֵ֨/נוּ֙ אֱלֹהֵ֣י יִשְׁעֵ֔/נוּ וְ/קַבְּצֵ֥/נוּ וְ/הַצִּילֵ֖/נוּ מִן הַ/גּוֹיִ֑ם לְ/הֹדוֹת֙ לְ/שֵׁ֣ם קָדְשֶׁ֔/ךָ לְ/הִשְׁתַּבֵּ֖חַ בִּ/תְהִלָּתֶֽ/ךָ
verses.translit: v'mrv hvshy'nv 'lhy ysh'nv vqbtsnv vhtsylnv mn hgvym lhdvt lshm qdshkh lhshtbch bthltkh
verses.translation: And say ye, Save us, O God of our salvation, and gather us together, and deliver us from the heathen, that we may give thanks to thy holy name, and glory in thy praise.

verses.original: בָּר֤וּךְ יְהוָה֙ אֱלֹהֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל מִן הָ/עוֹלָ֖ם וְ/עַ֣ד הָ/עֹלָ֑ם וַ/יֹּאמְר֤וּ כָל הָ/עָם֙ אָמֵ֔ן וְ/הַלֵּ֖ל לַֽ/יהוָֽה
verses.translit: brvkh yhvh 'lhy yshr'l mn h'vlm v'd h'lm vy'mrv khl h'm 'mn vhll lyhvh
verses.translation: Blessed be the LORD God of Israel for ever and ever. And all the people said, Amen, and praised the LORD .

verses.original: וַ/יַּֽעֲזָב שָׁ֗ם לִ/פְנֵי֙ אֲר֣וֹן בְּרִית יְהוָ֔ה לְ/אָסָ֖ף וּ/לְ/אֶחָ֑י/ו לְ/שָׁרֵ֞ת לִ/פְנֵ֧י הָ/אָר֛וֹן תָּמִ֖יד לִ/דְבַר י֥וֹם בְּ/יוֹמֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: vy'zb shm lpny 'rvn bryt yhvh l'sf vl'chyv lshrt lpny h'rvn tmyd ldbr yvm byvmv
verses.translation: So he left there before the ark of the covenant of the LORD Asaph and his brethren, to minister before the ark continually, as every day’s work required:

verses.original: וְ/עֹבֵ֥ד אֱדֹ֛ם וַ/אֲחֵי/הֶ֖ם שִׁשִּׁ֣ים וּ/שְׁמוֹנָ֑ה וְ/עֹבֵ֨ד אֱדֹ֧ם בֶּן יְדִית֛וּן וְ/חֹסָ֖ה לְ/שֹׁעֲרִֽים
verses.translit: v'bd 'dm v'chyhm shshym vshmvnh v'bd 'dm bn ydytvn vchsh lsh'rym
verses.translation: And Obed-edom with their brethren, threescore and eight; Obed-edom also the son of Jeduthun and Hosah to be porters:

verses.original: וְ/אֵ֣ת צָד֣וֹק הַ/כֹּהֵ֗ן וְ/אֶחָי/ו֙ הַ/כֹּ֣הֲנִ֔ים לִ/פְנֵ֖י מִשְׁכַּ֣ן יְהוָ֑ה בַּ/בָּמָ֖ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר בְּ/גִבְעֽוֹן
verses.translit: v't tsdvq hkhhn v'chyv hkhhnym lpny mshkhn yhvh bbmh 'shr bgb'vn
verses.translation: And Zadok the priest, and his brethren the priests, before the tabernacle of the LORD in the high place that was at Gibeon,

verses.original: לְֽ/הַעֲלוֹת֩ עֹל֨וֹת לַ/יהוָ֜ה עַל מִזְבַּ֧ח הָ/עֹלָ֛ה תָּמִ֖יד לַ/בֹּ֣קֶר וְ/לָ/עָ֑רֶב וּ/לְ/כָל הַ/כָּתוּב֙ בְּ/תוֹרַ֣ת יְהוָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר צִוָּ֖ה עַל יִשְׂרָאֵֽל
verses.translit: lh'lvt 'lvt lyhvh 'l mzbch h'lh tmyd lbqr vl'rb vlkhl hkhtvb btvrt yhvh 'shr tsvh 'l yshr'l
verses.translation: To offer burnt offerings unto the LORD upon the altar of the burnt offering continually morning and evening, and to do according to all that is written in the law of the LORD , which he commanded Israel;

verses.original: וְ/עִמָּ/הֶם֙ הֵימָ֣ן וִֽ/ידוּת֔וּן וּ/שְׁאָר֙ הַ/בְּרוּרִ֔ים אֲשֶׁ֥ר נִקְּב֖וּ בְּ/שֵׁמ֑וֹת לְ/הֹדוֹת֙ לַֽ/יהוָ֔ה כִּ֥י לְ/עוֹלָ֖ם חַסְדּֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: v'mhm hymn vydvtvn vsh'r hbrvrym 'shr nqbv bshmvt lhdvt lyhvh khy l'vlm chsdv
verses.translation: And with them Heman and Jeduthun, and the rest that were chosen, who were expressed by name, to give thanks to the LORD , because his mercy endureth for ever;

verses.original: וְ/עִמָּ/הֶם֩ הֵימָ֨ן וִֽ/ידוּת֜וּן חֲצֹצְר֤וֹת וּ/מְצִלְתַּ֨יִם֙ לְ/מַשְׁמִיעִ֔ים וּ/כְלֵ֖י שִׁ֣יר הָ/אֱלֹהִ֑ים וּ/בְנֵ֥י יְדוּת֖וּן לַ/שָּֽׁעַר
verses.translit: v'mhm hymn vydvtvn chtstsrvt vmtsltym lmshmy'ym vkhly shyr h'lhym vbny ydvtvn lsh'r
verses.translation: And with them Heman and Jeduthun with trumpets and cymbals for those that should make a sound, and with musical instruments of God. And the sons of Jeduthun were porters.

verses.original: וַ/יֵּלְכ֥וּ כָל הָ/עָ֖ם אִ֣ישׁ לְ/בֵית֑/וֹ וַ/יִּסֹּ֥ב דָּוִ֖יד לְ/בָרֵ֥ךְ אֶת בֵּיתֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: vylkhv khl h'm 'ysh lbytv vysb dvyd lbrkh 't bytv
verses.translation: And all the people departed every man to his house: and David returned to bless his house.

verses.original: וַ/יְהִ֕י כַּ/אֲשֶׁ֛ר יָשַׁ֥ב דָּוִ֖יד בְּ/בֵית֑/וֹ וַ/יֹּ֨אמֶר דָּוִ֜יד אֶל נָתָ֣ן הַ/נָּבִ֗יא הִנֵּ֨ה אָנֹכִ֤י יוֹשֵׁב֙ בְּ/בֵ֣ית הָֽ/אֲרָזִ֔ים וַ/אֲר֥וֹן בְּרִית יְהוָ֖ה תַּ֥חַת יְרִיעֽוֹת
verses.translit: vyhy kh'shr yshb dvyd bbytv vy'mr dvyd 'l ntn hnby' hnh 'nkhy yvshb bbyt h'rzym v'rvn bryt yhvh tcht yry'vt
verses.translation: Now it came to pass, as David sat in his house, that David said to Nathan the prophet, Lo, I dwell in an house of cedars, but the ark of the covenant of the LORD remaineth under curtains.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֤אמֶר נָתָן֙ אֶל דָּוִ֔יד כֹּ֛ל אֲשֶׁ֥ר בִּֽ/לְבָבְ/ךָ֖ עֲשֵׂ֑ה כִּ֥י הָ/אֱלֹהִ֖ים עִמָּֽ/ךְ
verses.translit: vy'mr ntn 'l dvyd khl 'shr blbbkh 'shh khy h'lhym 'mkh
verses.translation: Then Nathan said unto David, Do all that is in thine heart; for God is with thee.

verses.original: וַֽ/יְהִ֖י בַּ/לַּ֣יְלָה הַ/ה֑וּא וַ/יְהִי֙ דְּבַר אֱלֹהִ֔ים אֶל נָתָ֖ן לֵ/אמֹֽר
verses.translit: vyhy blylh hhv' vyhy dbr 'lhym 'l ntn l'mr
verses.translation: And it came to pass the same night, that the word of God came to Nathan, saying,

verses.original: לֵ֤ךְ וְ/אָמַרְתָּ֙ אֶל דָּוִ֣יד עַבְדִּ֔/י כֹּ֖ה אָמַ֣ר יְהוָ֑ה לֹ֥א אַתָּ֛ה תִּבְנֶה לִּ֥/י הַ/בַּ֖יִת לָ/שָֽׁבֶת
verses.translit: lkh v'mrt 'l dvyd 'bdy khh 'mr yhvh l' 'th tbnh ly hbyt lshbt
verses.translation: Go and tell David my servant, Thus saith the LORD , Thou shalt not build me an house to dwell in:

verses.original: כִּ֣י לֹ֤א יָשַׁ֨בְתִּי֙ בְּ/בַ֔יִת מִן הַ/יּ֗וֹם אֲשֶׁ֤ר הֶעֱלֵ֨יתִי֙ אֶת יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל עַ֖ד הַ/יּ֣וֹם הַ/זֶּ֑ה וָֽ/אֶהְיֶ֛ה מֵ/אֹ֥הֶל אֶל אֹ֖הֶל וּ/מִ/מִּשְׁכָּֽן
verses.translit: khy l' yshbty bbyt mn hyvm 'shr h'lyty 't yshr'l 'd hyvm hzh v'hyh m'hl 'l 'hl vmmshkhn
verses.translation: For I have not dwelt in an house since the day that I brought up Israel unto this day; but have gone from tent to tent, and from one tabernacle to another .

verses.original: בְּ/כֹ֥ל אֲשֶֽׁר הִתְהַלַּכְתִּי֮ בְּ/כָל יִשְׂרָאֵל֒ הֲ/דָבָ֣ר דִּבַּ֗רְתִּי אֶת אַחַד֙ שֹׁפְטֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל אֲשֶׁ֥ר צִוִּ֛יתִי לִ/רְע֥וֹת אֶת עַמִּ֖/י לֵ/אמֹ֑ר לָ֛/מָּה לֹא בְנִיתֶ֥ם לִ֖/י בֵּ֥ית אֲרָזִֽים
verses.translit: bkhl 'shr hthlkhty bkhl yshr'l hdbr dbrty 't 'chd shpty yshr'l 'shr tsvyty lr'vt 't 'my l'mr lmh l' bnytm ly byt 'rzym
verses.translation: Wheresoever I have walked with all Israel, spake I a word to any of the judges of Israel, whom I commanded to feed my people, saying, Why have ye not built me an house of cedars?

verses.original: וְ֠/עַתָּה כֹּֽה תֹאמַ֞ר לְ/עַבְדִּ֣/י לְ/דָוִ֗יד כֹּ֤ה אָמַר֙ יְהוָ֣ה צְבָא֔וֹת אֲנִ֤י לְקַחְתִּ֨י/ךָ֙ מִן הַ/נָּוֶ֔ה מִֽן אַחֲרֵ֖י הַ/צֹּ֑אן לִ/הְי֣וֹת נָגִ֔יד עַ֖ל עַמִּ֥/י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל
verses.translit: v'th khh t'mr l'bdy ldvyd khh 'mr yhvh tsb'vt 'ny lqchtykh mn hnvh mn 'chry hts'n lhyvt ngyd 'l 'my yshr'l
verses.translation: Now therefore thus shalt thou say unto my servant David, Thus saith the LORD of hosts, I took thee from the sheepcote, even from following the sheep, that thou shouldest be ruler over my people Israel:

verses.original: וָֽ/אֶהְיֶ֣ה עִמְּ/ךָ֗ בְּ/כֹל֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר הָלַ֔כְתָּ וָ/אַכְרִ֥ית אֶת כָּל אוֹיְבֶ֖י/ךָ מִ/פָּנֶ֑י/ךָ וְ/עָשִׂ֤יתִֽי לְ/ךָ֙ שֵׁ֔ם כְּ/שֵׁ֥ם הַ/גְּדוֹלִ֖ים אֲשֶׁ֥ר בָּ/אָֽרֶץ
verses.translit: v'hyh 'mkh bkhl 'shr hlkht v'khryt 't khl 'vybykh mpnykh v'shyty lkh shm khshm hgdvlym 'shr b'rts
verses.translation: And I have been with thee whithersoever thou hast walked, and have cut off all thine enemies from before thee, and have made thee a name like the name of the great men that are in the earth.

verses.original: וְ/שַׂמְתִּ֣י מָ֠קוֹם לְ/עַמִּ֨/י יִשְׂרָאֵ֤ל וּ/נְטַעְתִּ֨י/הוּ֙ וְ/שָׁכַ֣ן תַּחְתָּ֔י/ו וְ/לֹ֥א יִרְגַּ֖ז ע֑וֹד וְ/לֹא יוֹסִ֤יפוּ בְנֵי עַוְלָה֙ לְ/בַלֹּת֔/וֹ כַּ/אֲשֶׁ֖ר בָּ/רִאשׁוֹנָֽה
verses.translit: vshmty mqvm l'my yshr'l vnt'tyhv vshkhn tchtyv vl' yrgz 'vd vl' yvsypv bny 'vlh lbltv kh'shr br'shvnh
verses.translation: Also I will ordain a place for my people Israel, and will plant them, and they shall dwell in their place, and shall be moved no more; neither shall the children of wickedness waste them any more, as at the beginning,

verses.original: וּ/לְ/מִ/יָּמִ֗ים אֲשֶׁ֨ר צִוִּ֤יתִי שֹֽׁפְטִים֙ עַל עַמִּ֣/י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל וְ/הִכְנַ֖עְתִּי אֶת כָּל אוֹיְבֶ֑י/ךָ וָ/אַגִּ֣ד לָ֔/ךְ וּ/בַ֖יִת יִֽבְנֶה לְּ/ךָ֥ יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: vlmymym 'shr tsvyty shptym 'l 'my yshr'l vhkhn'ty 't khl 'vybykh v'gd lkh vbyt ybnh lkh yhvh
verses.translation: And since the time that I commanded judges to be over my people Israel. Moreover I will subdue all thine enemies. Furthermore I tell thee that the LORD will build thee an house.

verses.original: וְ/הָיָ֗ה כִּֽי מָלְא֤וּ יָמֶ֨י/ךָ֙ לָ/לֶ֣כֶת עִם אֲבֹתֶ֔י/ךָ וַ/הֲקִֽימוֹתִ֤י אֶֽת זַרְעֲ/ךָ֙ אַחֲרֶ֔י/ךָ אֲשֶׁ֥ר יִהְיֶ֖ה מִ/בָּנֶ֑י/ךָ וַ/הֲכִינוֹתִ֖י אֶת מַלְכוּתֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: vhyh khy ml'v ymykh llkht 'm 'btykh vhqymvty 't zr'kh 'chrykh 'shr yhyh mbnykh vhkhynvty 't mlkhvtv
verses.translation: And it shall come to pass, when thy days be expired that thou must go to be with thy fathers, that I will raise up thy seed after thee, which shall be of thy sons; and I will establish his kingdom.

verses.original: ה֥וּא יִבְנֶה לִּ֖/י בָּ֑יִת וְ/כֹנַנְתִּ֥י אֶת כִּסְא֖/וֹ עַד עוֹלָֽם
verses.translit: hv' ybnh ly byt vkhnnty 't khs'v 'd 'vlm
verses.translation: He shall build me an house, and I will stablish his throne for ever.

verses.original: אֲנִי֙ אֶֽהְיֶה לּ֣/וֹ לְ/אָ֔ב וְ/ה֖וּא יִֽהְיֶה לִּ֣/י לְ/בֵ֑ן וְ/חַסְדִּ/י֙ לֹא אָסִ֣יר מֵֽ/עִמּ֔/וֹ כַּ/אֲשֶׁ֣ר הֲסִיר֔וֹתִי מֵ/אֲשֶׁ֥ר הָיָ֖ה לְ/פָנֶֽי/ךָ
verses.translit: 'ny 'hyh lv l'b vhv' yhyh ly lbn vchsdy l' 'syr m'mv kh'shr hsyrvty m'shr hyh lpnykh
verses.translation: I will be his father, and he shall be my son: and I will not take my mercy away from him, as I took it from him that was before thee:

verses.original: וְ/הַֽעֲמַדְתִּ֛י/הוּ בְּ/בֵיתִ֥/י וּ/בְ/מַלְכוּתִ֖/י עַד הָ/עוֹלָ֑ם וְ/כִסְא֕/וֹ יִהְיֶ֥ה נָכ֖וֹן עַד עוֹלָֽם
verses.translit: vh'mdtyhv bbyty vbmlkhvty 'd h'vlm vkhs'v yhyh nkhvn 'd 'vlm
verses.translation: But I will settle him in mine house and in my kingdom for ever: and his throne shall be established for evermore.

verses.original: כְּ/כֹל֙ הַ/דְּבָרִ֣ים הָ/אֵ֔לֶּה וּ/כְ/כֹ֖ל הֶ/חָז֣וֹן הַ/זֶּ֑ה כֵּ֛ן דִּבֶּ֥ר נָתָ֖ן אֶל דָּוִֽיד
verses.translit: khkhl hdbrym h'lh vkhkhl hchzvn hzh khn dbr ntn 'l dvyd
verses.translation: According to all these words, and according to all this vision, so did Nathan speak unto David.

verses.original: וַ/יָּבֹא֙ הַ/מֶּ֣לֶךְ דָּוִ֔יד וַ/יֵּ֖שֶׁב לִ/פְנֵ֣י יְהוָ֑ה וַ/יֹּ֗אמֶר מִֽי אֲנִ֞י יְהוָ֤ה אֱלֹהִים֙ וּ/מִ֣י בֵיתִ֔/י כִּ֥י הֲבִיאֹתַ֖/נִי עַד הֲלֹֽם
verses.translit: vyb' hmlkh dvyd vyshb lpny yhvh vy'mr my 'ny yhvh 'lhym vmy byty khy hby'tny 'd hlm
verses.translation: And David the king came and sat before the LORD , and said, Who am I, O LORD God, and what is mine house, that thou hast brought me hitherto?

verses.original: וַ/תִּקְטַ֨ן זֹ֤את בְּ/עֵינֶ֨י/ךָ֙ אֱלֹהִ֔ים וַ/תְּדַבֵּ֥ר עַל בֵּֽית עַבְדְּ/ךָ֖ לְ/מֵ/רָח֑וֹק וּ/רְאִיתַ֗/נִי כְּ/ת֧וֹר הָ/אָדָ֛ם הַֽ/מַּעֲלָ֖ה יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהִֽים
verses.translit: vtqtn z't b'ynykh 'lhym vtdbr 'l byt 'bdkh lmrchvq vr'ytny khtvr h'dm hm'lh yhvh 'lhym
verses.translation: And yet this was a small thing in thine eyes, O God; for thou hast also spoken of thy servant’s house for a great while to come, and hast regarded me according to the estate of a man of high degree, O LORD God.

verses.original: מַה יּוֹסִ֨יף ע֥וֹד דָּוִ֛יד אֵלֶ֖י/ךָ לְ/כָב֣וֹד אֶת עַבְדֶּ֑/ךָ וְ/אַתָּ֖ה אֶֽת עַבְדְּ/ךָ֥ יָדָֽעְתָּ
verses.translit: mh yvsyf 'vd dvyd 'lykh lkhbvd 't 'bdkh v'th 't 'bdkh yd't
verses.translation: What can David speak more to thee for the honour of thy servant? for thou knowest thy servant.

verses.original: יְהוָ֕ה בַּ/עֲב֤וּר עַבְדְּ/ךָ֙ וּֽ/כְ/לִבְּ/ךָ֔ עָשִׂ֕יתָ אֵ֥ת כָּל הַ/גְּדוּלָּ֖ה הַ/זֹּ֑את לְ/הֹדִ֖יעַ אֶת כָּל הַ/גְּדֻלּֽוֹת
verses.translit: yhvh b'bvr 'bdkh vkhlbkh 'shyt 't khl hgdvlh hz't lhdy' 't khl hgdlvt
verses.translation: O LORD , for thy servant’s sake, and according to thine own heart, hast thou done all this greatness, in making known all these great things.

verses.original: יְהוָה֙ אֵ֣ין כָּמ֔וֹ/ךָ וְ/אֵ֥ין אֱלֹהִ֖ים זוּלָתֶ֑/ךָ בְּ/כֹ֥ל אֲשֶׁר שָׁמַ֖עְנוּ בְּ/אָזְנֵֽי/נוּ
verses.translit: yhvh 'yn khmvkh v'yn 'lhym zvltkh bkhl 'shr shm'nv b'znynv
verses.translation: O LORD , there is none like thee, neither is there any God beside thee, according to all that we have heard with our ears.

verses.original: וּ/מִי֙ כְּ/עַמְּ/ךָ֣ יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל גּ֥וֹי אֶחָ֖ד בָּ/אָ֑רֶץ אֲשֶׁר֩ הָלַ֨ךְ הָ/אֱלֹהִ֜ים לִ/פְדּ֧וֹת ל֣/וֹ עָ֗ם לָ/שׂ֤וּם לְ/ךָ֙ שֵׁ֚ם גְּדֻלּ֣וֹת וְ/נֹרָא֔וֹת לְ/גָרֵ֗שׁ מִ/פְּנֵ֧י עַמְּ/ךָ֛ אֲשֶׁר פָּדִ֥יתָ מִ/מִּצְרַ֖יִם גּוֹיִֽם
verses.translit: vmy kh'mkh yshr'l gvy 'chd b'rts 'shr hlkh h'lhym lpdvt lv 'm lshvm lkh shm gdlvt vnr'vt lgrsh mpny 'mkh 'shr pdyt mmtsrym gvym
verses.translation: And what one nation in the earth is like thy people Israel, whom God went to redeem to be his own people, to make thee a name of greatness and terribleness, by driving out nations from before thy people, whom thou hast redeemed out of Egypt?

verses.original: וַ֠/תִּתֵּן אֶת עַמְּ/ךָ֨ יִשְׂרָאֵ֧ל לְ/ךָ֛ לְ/עָ֖ם עַד עוֹלָ֑ם וְ/אַתָּ֣ה יְהוָ֔ה הָיִ֥יתָ לָ/הֶ֖ם לֵ/אלֹהִֽים
verses.translit: vttn 't 'mkh yshr'l lkh l'm 'd 'vlm v'th yhvh hyyt lhm l'lhym
verses.translation: For thy people Israel didst thou make thine own people for ever; and thou, LORD , becamest their God.

verses.original: וְ/עַתָּ֣ה יְהוָ֔ה הַ/דָּבָ֗ר אֲשֶׁ֨ר דִּבַּ֤רְתָּ עַֽל עַבְדְּ/ךָ֙ וְ/עַל בֵּית֔/וֹ יֵאָמֵ֖ן עַד עוֹלָ֑ם וַ/עֲשֵׂ֖ה כַּ/אֲשֶׁ֥ר דִּבַּֽרְתָּ
verses.translit: v'th yhvh hdbr 'shr dbrt 'l 'bdkh v'l bytv y'mn 'd 'vlm v'shh kh'shr dbrt
verses.translation: Therefore now, LORD , let the thing that thou hast spoken concerning thy servant and concerning his house be established for ever, and do as thou hast said.

verses.original: וְ֠/יֵֽאָמֵן וְ/יִגְדַּ֨ל שִׁמְ/ךָ֤ עַד עוֹלָם֙ לֵ/אמֹ֔ר יְהוָ֤ה צְבָאוֹת֙ אֱלֹהֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל אֱלֹהִ֖ים לְ/יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וּ/בֵית דָּוִ֥יד עַבְדְּ/ךָ֖ נָכ֥וֹן לְ/פָנֶֽי/ךָ
verses.translit: vy'mn vygdl shmkh 'd 'vlm l'mr yhvh tsb'vt 'lhy yshr'l 'lhym lyshr'l vbyt dvyd 'bdkh nkhvn lpnykh
verses.translation: Let it even be established, that thy name may be magnified for ever, saying, The LORD of hosts is the God of Israel, even a God to Israel: and let the house of David thy servant be established before thee.

verses.original: כִּ֣י אַתָּ֣ה אֱלֹהַ֗/י גָּלִ֨יתָ֙ אֶת אֹ֣זֶן עַבְדְּ/ךָ֔ לִ/בְנ֥וֹת ל֖/וֹ בָּ֑יִת עַל כֵּן֙ מָצָ֣א עַבְדְּ/ךָ֔ לְ/הִתְפַּלֵּ֖ל לְ/פָנֶֽי/ךָ
verses.translit: khy 'th 'lhy glyt 't 'zn 'bdkh lbnvt lv byt 'l khn mts' 'bdkh lhtpll lpnykh
verses.translation: For thou, O my God, hast told thy servant that thou wilt build him an house: therefore thy servant hath found in his heart to pray before thee.

verses.original: וְ/עַתָּ֣ה יְהוָ֔ה אַתָּה ה֖וּא הָ/אֱלֹהִ֑ים וַ/תְּדַבֵּר֙ עַֽל עַבְדְּ/ךָ֔ הַ/טּוֹבָ֖ה הַ/זֹּֽאת
verses.translit: v'th yhvh 'th hv' h'lhym vtdbr 'l 'bdkh htvbh hz't
verses.translation: And now, LORD , thou art God, and hast promised this goodness unto thy servant:

verses.original: וְ/עַתָּ֗ה הוֹאַ֨לְתָּ֙ לְ/בָרֵךְ֙ אֶת בֵּ֣ית עַבְדְּ/ךָ֔ לִ/הְי֥וֹת לְ/עוֹלָ֖ם לְ/פָנֶ֑י/ךָ כִּֽי אַתָּ֤ה יְהוָה֙ בֵּרַ֔כְתָּ וּ/מְבֹרָ֖ךְ לְ/עוֹלָֽם
verses.translit: v'th hv'lt lbrkh 't byt 'bdkh lhyvt l'vlm lpnykh khy 'th yhvh brkht vmbrkh l'vlm
verses.translation: Now therefore let it please thee to bless the house of thy servant, that it may be before thee for ever: for thou blessest, O LORD , and it shall be blessed for ever.

verses.original: וַ/יְהִי֙ אַחֲרֵי כֵ֔ן וַ/יַּ֥ךְ דָּוִ֛יד אֶת פְּלִשְׁתִּ֖ים וַ/יַּכְנִיעֵ֑/ם וַ/יִּקַּ֛ח אֶת גַּ֥ת וּ/בְנֹתֶ֖י/הָ מִ/יַּ֥ד פְּלִשְׁתִּֽים
verses.translit: vyhy 'chry khn vykh dvyd 't plshtym vykhny'm vyqch 't gt vbntyh myd plshtym
verses.translation: Now after this it came to pass, that David smote the Philistines, and subdued them, and took Gath and her towns out of the hand of the Philistines.

verses.original: וַ/יַּ֖ךְ אֶת מוֹאָ֑ב וַ/יִּהְי֤וּ מוֹאָב֙ עֲבָדִ֣ים לְ/דָוִ֔יד נֹשְׂאֵ֖י מִנְחָֽה
verses.translit: vykh 't mv'b vyhyv mv'b 'bdym ldvyd nsh'y mnchh
verses.translation: And he smote Moab; and the Moabites became David’s servants, and brought gifts.

verses.original: וַ/יַּ֥ךְ דָּוִ֛יד אֶת הֲדַדְעֶ֥זֶר מֶֽלֶךְ צוֹבָ֖ה חֲמָ֑תָ/ה בְּ/לֶכְתּ֕/וֹ לְ/הַצִּ֥יב יָד֖/וֹ בִּֽ/נְהַר פְּרָֽת
verses.translit: vykh dvyd 't hdd'zr mlkh tsvbh chmth blkhtv lhtsyb ydv bnhr prt
verses.translation: And David smote Hadarezer king of Zobah unto Hamath, as he went to stablish his dominion by the river Euphrates.

verses.original: וַ/יִּלְכֹּד֩ דָּוִ֨יד מִמֶּ֜/נּוּ אֶ֣לֶף רֶ֗כֶב וְ/שִׁבְעַ֤ת אֲלָפִים֙ פָּֽרָשִׁ֔ים וְ/עֶשְׂרִ֥ים אֶ֖לֶף אִ֣ישׁ רַגְלִ֑י וַ/יְעַקֵּ֤ר דָּוִיד֙ אֶת כָּל הָ/רֶ֔כֶב וַ/יּוֹתֵ֥ר מִמֶּ֖/נּוּ מֵ֥אָה רָֽכֶב
verses.translit: vylkhd dvyd mmnv 'lf rkhb vshb't 'lpym prshym v'shrym 'lf 'ysh rgly vy'qr dvyd 't khl hrkhb vyvtr mmnv m'h rkhb
verses.translation: And David took from him a thousand chariots, and seven thousand horsemen, and twenty thousand footmen: David also houghed all the chariot horses , but reserved of them an hundred chariots.

verses.original: וַ/יָּבֹא֙ אֲרַ֣ם דַּרְמֶ֔שֶׂק לַ/עְז֕וֹר לַ/הֲדַדְעֶ֖זֶר מֶ֣לֶךְ צוֹבָ֑ה וַ/יַּ֤ךְ דָּוִיד֙ בַּ/אֲרָ֔ם עֶשְׂרִֽים וּ/שְׁנַ֥יִם אֶ֖לֶף אִֽישׁ
verses.translit: vyb' 'rm drmshq l'zvr lhdd'zr mlkh tsvbh vykh dvyd b'rm 'shrym vshnym 'lf 'ysh
verses.translation: And when the Syrians of Damascus came to help Hadarezer king of Zobah, David slew of the Syrians two and twenty thousand men.

verses.original: וַ/יָּ֤שֶׂם דָּוִיד֙ בַּ/אֲרַ֣ם דַּרְמֶ֔שֶׂק וַ/יְהִ֤י אֲרָם֙ לְ/דָוִ֔יד עֲבָדִ֖ים נֹשְׂאֵ֣י מִנְחָ֑ה וַ/יּ֤וֹשַׁע יְהוָה֙ לְ/דָוִ֔יד בְּ/כֹ֖ל אֲשֶׁ֥ר הָלָֽךְ
verses.translit: vyshm dvyd b'rm drmshq vyhy 'rm ldvyd 'bdym nsh'y mnchh vyvsh' yhvh ldvyd bkhl 'shr hlkh
verses.translation: Then David put garrisons in Syria-damascus; and the Syrians became David’s servants, and brought gifts. Thus the LORD preserved David whithersoever he went.

verses.original: וַ/יִּקַּ֣ח דָּוִ֗יד אֵ֚ת שִׁלְטֵ֣י הַ/זָּהָ֔ב אֲשֶׁ֣ר הָי֔וּ עַ֖ל עַבְדֵ֣י הֲדַדְעָ֑זֶר וַ/יְבִיאֵ֖/ם יְרוּשָׁלִָֽם
verses.translit: vyqch dvyd 't shlty hzhb 'shr hyv 'l 'bdy hdd'zr vyby'm yrvshlm
verses.translation: And David took the shields of gold that were on the servants of Hadarezer, and brought them to Jerusalem.

verses.original: וּ/מִ/טִּבְחַ֤ת וּ/מִ/כּוּן֙ עָרֵ֣י הֲדַדְעֶ֔זֶר לָקַ֥ח דָּוִ֛יד נְחֹ֖שֶׁת רַבָּ֣ה מְאֹ֑ד בָּ֣/הּ עָשָׂ֣ה שְׁלֹמֹ֗ה אֶת יָ֤ם הַ/נְּחֹ֨שֶׁת֙ וְ/אֶת הָֽ/עַמּוּדִ֔ים וְ/אֵ֖ת כְּלֵ֥י הַ/נְּחֹֽשֶׁת
verses.translit: vmtbcht vmkhvn 'ry hdd'zr lqch dvyd nchsht rbh m'd bh 'shh shlmh 't ym hnchsht v't h'mvdym v't khly hnchsht
verses.translation: Likewise from Tibhath, and from Chun, cities of Hadarezer, brought David very much brass, wherewith Solomon made the brasen sea, and the pillars, and the vessels of brass.

verses.original: וַ/יִּשְׁמַ֕ע תֹּ֖עוּ מֶ֣לֶךְ חֲמָ֑ת כִּ֚י הִכָּ֣ה דָוִ֔יד אֶת כָּל חֵ֖יל הֲדַדְעֶ֥זֶר מֶֽלֶךְ צוֹבָֽה
verses.translit: vyshm' t'v mlkh chmt khy hkhh dvyd 't khl chyl hdd'zr mlkh tsvbh
verses.translation: Now when Tou king of Hamath heard how David had smitten all the host of Hadarezer king of Zobah;

verses.original: וַ/יִּשְׁלַ֣ח אֶת הֲדֽוֹרָם בְּנ֣/וֹ אֶל הַ/מֶּֽלֶךְ דָּ֠וִיד ל/שאול לִ/שְׁאָל ל֨/וֹ לְ/שָׁל֜וֹם וּֽ/לְ/בָרֲכ֗/וֹ עַל֩ אֲשֶׁ֨ר נִלְחַ֤ם בַּ/הֲדַדְעֶ֨זֶר֙ וַ/יַּכֵּ֔/הוּ כִּי אִ֛ישׁ מִלְחֲמ֥וֹת תֹּ֖עוּ הָיָ֣ה הֲדַדְעָ֑זֶר וְ/כֹ֗ל כְּלֵ֛י זָהָ֥ב וָ/כֶ֖סֶף וּ/נְחֹֽשֶׁת
verses.translit: vyshlch 't hdvrm bnv 'l hmlkh dvyd lsh'vl lsh'l lv lshlvm vlbrkhv 'l 'shr nlchm bhdd'zr vykhhv khy 'ysh mlchmvt t'v hyh hdd'zr vkhl khly zhb vkhsf vnchsht
verses.translation: He sent Hadoram his son to king David, to enquire of his welfare, and to congratulate him, because he had fought against Hadarezer, and smitten him; (for Hadarezer had war with Tou;) and with him all manner of vessels of gold and silver and brass.

verses.original: גַּם אֹתָ֗/ם הִקְדִּ֞ישׁ הַ/מֶּ֤לֶךְ דָּוִיד֙ לַ/יהוָ֔ה עִם הַ/כֶּ֨סֶף֙ וְ/הַ/זָּהָ֔ב אֲשֶׁ֥ר נָשָׂ֖א מִ/כָּל הַ/גּוֹיִ֑ם מֵֽ/אֱד֤וֹם וּ/מִ/מּוֹאָב֙ וּ/מִ/בְּנֵ֣י עַמּ֔וֹן וּ/מִ/פְּלִשְׁתִּ֖ים וּ/מֵֽ/עֲמָלֵֽק
verses.translit: gm 'tm hqdysh hmlkh dvyd lyhvh 'm hkhsf vhzhb 'shr nsh' mkhl hgvym m'dvm vmmv'b vmbny 'mvn vmplshtym vm'mlq
verses.translation: Them also king David dedicated unto the LORD , with the silver and the gold that he brought from all these nations; from Edom, and from Moab, and from the children of Ammon, and from the Philistines, and from Amalek.

verses.original: וְ/אַבְשַׁ֣י בֶּן צְרוּיָ֗ה הִכָּ֤ה אֶת אֱדוֹם֙ בְּ/גֵ֣יא הַמֶּ֔לַח שְׁמוֹנָ֥ה עָשָׂ֖ר אָֽלֶף
verses.translit: v'bshy bn tsrvyh hkhh 't 'dvm bgy' hmlch shmvnh 'shr 'lf
verses.translation: Moreover Abishai the son of Zeruiah slew of the Edomites in the valley of salt eighteen thousand.

verses.original: וַ/יָּ֤שֶׂם בֶּֽ/אֱדוֹם֙ נְצִיבִ֔ים וַ/יִּהְי֥וּ כָל אֱד֖וֹם עֲבָדִ֣ים לְ/דָוִ֑יד וַ/יּ֤וֹשַׁע יְהוָה֙ אֶת דָּוִ֔יד בְּ/כֹ֖ל אֲשֶׁ֥ר הָלָֽךְ
verses.translit: vyshm b'dvm ntsybym vyhyv khl 'dvm 'bdym ldvyd vyvsh' yhvh 't dvyd bkhl 'shr hlkh
verses.translation: And he put garrisons in Edom; and all the Edomites became David’s servants. Thus the LORD preserved David whithersoever he went.

verses.original: וַ/יִּמְלֹ֥ךְ דָּוִ֖יד עַל כָּל יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וַ/יְהִ֗י עֹשֶׂ֛ה מִשְׁפָּ֥ט וּ/צְדָקָ֖ה לְ/כָל עַמּֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: vymlkh dvyd 'l khl yshr'l vyhy 'shh mshpt vtsdqh lkhl 'mv
verses.translation: So David reigned over all Israel, and executed judgment and justice among all his people.

verses.original: וְ/יוֹאָ֥ב בֶּן צְרוּיָ֖ה עַל הַ/צָּבָ֑א וִ/יהוֹשָׁפָ֥ט בֶּן אֲחִיל֖וּד מַזְכִּֽיר
verses.translit: vyv'b bn tsrvyh 'l htsb' vyhvshpt bn 'chylvd mzkhyr
verses.translation: And Joab the son of Zeruiah was over the host; and Jehoshaphat the son of Ahilud, recorder.

verses.original: וְ/צָד֧וֹק בֶּן אֲחִיט֛וּב וַ/אֲבִימֶ֥לֶךְ בֶּן אֶבְיָתָ֖ר כֹּהֲנִ֑ים וְ/שַׁוְשָׁ֖א סוֹפֵֽר
verses.translit: vtsdvq bn 'chytvb v'bymlkh bn 'bytr khhnym vshvsh' svpr
verses.translation: And Zadok the son of Ahitub, and Abimelech the son of Abiathar, were the priests; and Shavsha was scribe;

verses.original: וּ/בְנָיָ֨הוּ֙ בֶּן יְה֣וֹיָדָ֔ע עַל הַ/כְּרֵתִ֖י וְ/הַ/פְּלֵתִ֑י וּ/בְנֵי דָוִ֥יד הָ/רִאשֹׁנִ֖ים לְ/יַ֥ד הַ/מֶּֽלֶךְ
verses.translit: vbnyhv bn yhvyd' 'l hkhrty vhplty vbny dvyd hr'shnym lyd hmlkh
verses.translation: And Benaiah the son of Jehoiada was over the Cherethites and the Pelethites; and the sons of David were chief about the king.

verses.original: וַ/יְהִי֙ אַחֲרֵי כֵ֔ן וַ/יָּ֕מָת נָחָ֖שׁ מֶ֣לֶךְ בְּנֵי עַמּ֑וֹן וַ/יִּמְלֹ֥ךְ בְּנ֖/וֹ תַּחְתָּֽי/ו
verses.translit: vyhy 'chry khn vymt nchsh mlkh bny 'mvn vymlkh bnv tchtyv
verses.translation: Now it came to pass after this, that Nahash the king of the children of Ammon died, and his son reigned in his stead.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֨אמֶר דָּוִ֜יד אֶֽעֱשֶׂה חֶ֣סֶד עִם חָנ֣וּן בֶּן נָחָ֗שׁ כִּֽי עָשָׂ֨ה אָבִ֤י/ו עִמִּ/י֙ חֶ֔סֶד וַ/יִּשְׁלַ֥ח דָּוִ֛יד מַלְאָכִ֖ים לְ/נַחֲמ֣/וֹ עַל אָבִ֑י/ו וַ/יָּבֹאוּ֩ עַבְדֵ֨י דָוִ֜יד אֶל אֶ֧רֶץ בְּנֵי עַמּ֛וֹן אֶל חָנ֖וּן לְ/נַחֲמֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: vy'mr dvyd ''shh chsd 'm chnvn bn nchsh khy 'shh 'byv 'my chsd vyshlch dvyd ml'khym lnchmv 'l 'byv vyb'v 'bdy dvyd 'l 'rts bny 'mvn 'l chnvn lnchmv
verses.translation: And David said, I will shew kindness unto Hanun the son of Nahash, because his father shewed kindness to me. And David sent messengers to comfort him concerning his father. So the servants of David came into the land of the children of Ammon to Hanun, to comfort him.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּאמְרוּ֩ שָׂרֵ֨י בְנֵי עַמּ֜וֹן לְ/חָנ֗וּן הַֽ/מְכַבֵּ֨ד דָּוִ֤יד אֶת אָבִ֨י/ךָ֙ בְּ/עֵינֶ֔י/ךָ כִּֽי שָׁלַ֥ח לְ/ךָ֖ מְנַחֲמִ֑ים הֲ/לֹ֡א בַּ֠/עֲבוּר לַ/חְקֹ֨ר וְ/לַ/הֲפֹ֤ךְ וּ/לְ/רַגֵּל֙ הָ/אָ֔רֶץ בָּ֥אוּ עֲבָדָ֖י/ו אֵלֶֽי/ךָ
verses.translit: vy'mrv shry bny 'mvn lchnvn hmkhbd dvyd 't 'bykh b'ynykh khy shlch lkh mnchmym hl' b'bvr lchqr vlhpkh vlrgl h'rts b'v 'bdyv 'lykh
verses.translation: But the princes of the children of Ammon said to Hanun, Thinkest thou that David doth honour thy father, that he hath sent comforters unto thee? are not his servants come unto thee for to search, and to overthrow, and to spy out the land?

verses.original: וַ/יִּקַּ֨ח חָנ֜וּן אֶת עַבְדֵ֤י דָוִיד֙ וַֽ/יְגַלְּחֵ֔/ם וַ/יִּכְרֹ֧ת אֶת מַדְוֵי/הֶ֛ם בַּ/חֵ֖צִי עַד הַ/מִּפְשָׂעָ֑ה וַֽ/יְשַׁלְּחֵֽ/ם
verses.translit: vyqch chnvn 't 'bdy dvyd vyglchm vykhrt 't mdvyhm bchtsy 'd hmpsh'h vyshlchm
verses.translation: Wherefore Hanun took David’s servants, and shaved them, and cut off their garments in the midst hard by their buttocks, and sent them away.

verses.original: וַ/יֵּלְכוּ֩ וַ/יַּגִּ֨ידוּ לְ/דָוִ֤יד עַל הָֽ/אֲנָשִׁים֙ וַ/יִּשְׁלַ֣ח לִ/קְרָאתָ֔/ם כִּי הָי֥וּ הָ/אֲנָשִׁ֖ים נִכְלָמִ֣ים מְאֹ֑ד וַ/יֹּ֤אמֶר הַ/מֶּ֨לֶךְ֙ שְׁב֣וּ בִֽ/ירֵח֔וֹ עַ֛ד אֲשֶׁר יְצַמַּ֥ח זְקַנְ/כֶ֖ם וְ/שַׁבְתֶּֽם
verses.translit: vylkhv vygydv ldvyd 'l h'nshym vyshlch lqr'tm khy hyv h'nshym nkhlmym m'd vy'mr hmlkh shbv byrchv 'd 'shr ytsmch zqnkhm vshbtm
verses.translation: Then there went certain , and told David how the men were served. And he sent to meet them: for the men were greatly ashamed. And the king said, Tarry at Jericho until your beards be grown, and then return.

verses.original: וַ/יִּרְאוּ֙ בְּנֵ֣י עַמּ֔וֹן כִּ֥י הִֽתְבָּאֲשׁ֖וּ עִם דָּוִ֑יד וַ/יִּשְׁלַ֣ח חָ֠נוּן וּ/בְנֵ֨י עַמּ֜וֹן אֶ֣לֶף כִּכַּר כֶּ֗סֶף לִ/שְׂכֹּ֣ר לָ֠/הֶם מִן אֲרַ֨ם נַהֲרַ֜יִם וּ/מִן אֲרַ֤ם מַעֲכָה֙ וּ/מִ/צּוֹבָ֔ה רֶ֖כֶב וּ/פָרָשִֽׁים
verses.translit: vyr'v bny 'mvn khy htb'shv 'm dvyd vyshlch chnvn vbny 'mvn 'lf khkhr khsf lshkhr lhm mn 'rm nhrym vmn 'rm m'khh vmtsvbh rkhb vprshym
verses.translation: And when the children of Ammon saw that they had made themselves odious to David, Hanun and the children of Ammon sent a thousand talents of silver to hire them chariots and horsemen out of Mesopotamia, and out of Syria-maachah, and out of Zobah.

verses.original: וַ/יִּשְׂכְּר֣וּ לָ/הֶ֡ם שְׁנַיִם֩ וּ/שְׁלֹשִׁ֨ים אֶ֜לֶף רֶ֗כֶב וְ/אֶת מֶ֤לֶךְ מַעֲכָה֙ וְ/אֶת עַמּ֔/וֹ וַ/יָּבֹ֕אוּ וַֽ/יַּחֲנ֖וּ לִ/פְנֵ֣י מֵידְבָ֑א וּ/בְנֵ֣י עַמּ֗וֹן נֶאֶסְפוּ֙ מֵ/עָ֣רֵי/הֶ֔ם וַ/יָּבֹ֖אוּ לַ/מִּלְחָמָֽה
verses.translit: vyshkhrv lhm shnym vshlshym 'lf rkhb v't mlkh m'khh v't 'mv vyb'v vychnv lpny mydb' vbny 'mvn n'spv m'ryhm vyb'v lmlchmh
verses.translation: So they hired thirty and two thousand chariots, and the king of Maachah and his people; who came and pitched before Medeba. And the children of Ammon gathered themselves together from their cities, and came to battle.

verses.original: וַ/יִּשְׁמַ֖ע דָּוִ֑יד וַ/יִּשְׁלַח֙ אֶת יוֹאָ֔ב וְ/אֵ֥ת כָּל צָבָ֖א הַ/גִּבּוֹרִֽים
verses.translit: vyshm' dvyd vyshlch 't yv'b v't khl tsb' hgbvrym
verses.translation: And when David heard of it , he sent Joab, and all the host of the mighty men.

verses.original: וַ/יֵּצְאוּ֙ בְּנֵ֣י עַמּ֔וֹן וַ/יַּֽעַרְכ֥וּ מִלְחָמָ֖ה פֶּ֣תַח הָ/עִ֑יר וְ/הַ/מְּלָכִ֣ים אֲשֶׁר בָּ֔אוּ לְ/בַדָּ֖/ם בַּ/שָּׂדֶֽה
verses.translit: vyts'v bny 'mvn vy'rkhv mlchmh ptch h'yr vhmlkhym 'shr b'v lbdm bshdh
verses.translation: And the children of Ammon came out, and put the battle in array before the gate of the city: and the kings that were come were by themselves in the field.

verses.original: וַ/יַּ֣רְא יוֹאָ֗ב כִּֽי הָיְתָ֧ה פְנֵי הַ/מִּלְחָמָ֛ה אֵלָ֖י/ו פָּנִ֣ים וְ/אָח֑וֹר וַ/יִּבְחַ֗ר מִ/כָּל בָּחוּר֙ בְּ/יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל וַֽ/יַּעֲרֹ֖ךְ לִ/קְרַ֥את אֲרָֽם
verses.translit: vyr' yv'b khy hyth pny hmlchmh 'lyv pnym v'chvr vybchr mkhl bchvr byshr'l vy'rkh lqr't 'rm
verses.translation: Now when Joab saw that the battle was set against him before and behind, he chose out of all the choice of Israel, and put them in array against the Syrians.

verses.original: וְ/אֵת֙ יֶ֣תֶר הָ/עָ֔ם נָתַ֕ן בְּ/יַ֖ד אַבְשַׁ֣י אָחִ֑י/ו וַ/יַּ֣עַרְכ֔וּ לִ/קְרַ֖את בְּנֵ֥י עַמּֽוֹן
verses.translit: v't ytr h'm ntn byd 'bshy 'chyv vy'rkhv lqr't bny 'mvn
verses.translation: And the rest of the people he delivered unto the hand of Abishai his brother, and they set themselves in array against the children of Ammon.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֗אמֶר אִם תֶּחֱזַ֤ק מִמֶּ֨/נִּי֙ אֲרָ֔ם וְ/הָיִ֥יתָ לִּ֖/י לִ/תְשׁוּעָ֑ה וְ/אִם בְּנֵ֥י עַמּ֛וֹן יֶֽחֶזְק֥וּ מִמְּ/ךָ֖ וְ/הוֹשַׁעְתִּֽי/ךָ
verses.translit: vy'mr 'm tchzq mmny 'rm vhyyt ly ltshv'h v'm bny 'mvn ychzqv mmkh vhvsh'tykh
verses.translation: And he said, If the Syrians be too strong for me, then thou shalt help me: but if the children of Ammon be too strong for thee, then I will help thee.

verses.original: חֲזַ֤ק וְ/נִֽתְחַזְּקָה֙ בְּעַד עַמֵּ֔/נוּ וּ/בְעַ֖ד עָרֵ֣י אֱלֹהֵ֑י/נוּ וַֽ/יהוָ֔ה הַ/טּ֥וֹב בְּ/עֵינָ֖י/ו יַעֲשֶֽׂה
verses.translit: chzq vntchzqh b'd 'mnv vb'd 'ry 'lhynv vyhvh htvb b'ynyv y'shh
verses.translation: Be of good courage, and let us behave ourselves valiantly for our people, and for the cities of our God: and let the LORD do that which is good in his sight.

verses.original: וַ/יִּגַּ֨שׁ יוֹאָ֜ב וְ/הָ/עָ֧ם אֲשֶׁר עִמּ֛/וֹ לִ/פְנֵ֥י אֲרָ֖ם לַ/מִּלְחָמָ֑ה וַ/יָּנ֖וּסוּ מִ/פָּנָֽי/ו
verses.translit: vygsh yv'b vh'm 'shr 'mv lpny 'rm lmlchmh vynvsv mpnyv
verses.translation: So Joab and the people that were with him drew nigh before the Syrians unto the battle; and they fled before him.

verses.original: וּ/בְנֵ֨י עַמּ֤וֹן רָאוּ֙ כִּי נָ֣ס אֲרָ֔ם וַ/יָּנ֣וּסוּ גַם הֵ֗ם מִ/פְּנֵי֙ אַבְשַׁ֣י אָחִ֔י/ו וַ/יָּבֹ֖אוּ הָ/עִ֑ירָ/ה וַ/יָּבֹ֥א יוֹאָ֖ב יְרוּשָׁלִָֽם
verses.translit: vbny 'mvn r'v khy ns 'rm vynvsv gm hm mpny 'bshy 'chyv vyb'v h'yrh vyb' yv'b yrvshlm
verses.translation: And when the children of Ammon saw that the Syrians were fled, they likewise fled before Abishai his brother, and entered into the city. Then Joab came to Jerusalem.

verses.original: וַ/יַּ֣רְא אֲרָ֗ם כִּ֣י נִגְּפוּ֮ לִ/פְנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵל֒ וַֽ/יִּשְׁלְחוּ֙ מַלְאָכִ֔ים וַ/יּוֹצִ֣יאוּ אֶת אֲרָ֔ם אֲשֶׁ֖ר מֵ/עֵ֣בֶר הַ/נָּהָ֑ר וְ/שׁוֹפַ֛ךְ שַׂר צְבָ֥א הֲדַדְעֶ֖זֶר לִ/פְנֵי/הֶֽם
verses.translit: vyr' 'rm khy ngpv lpny yshr'l vyshlchv ml'khym vyvtsy'v 't 'rm 'shr m'br hnhr vshvpkh shr tsb' hdd'zr lpnyhm
verses.translation: And when the Syrians saw that they were put to the worse before Israel, they sent messengers, and drew forth the Syrians that were beyond the river: and Shophach the captain of the host of Hadarezer went before them.

verses.original: וַ/יֻּגַּ֣ד לְ/דָוִ֗יד וַ/יֶּאֱסֹ֤ף אֶת כָּל יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ וַ/יַּעֲבֹ֣ר הַ/יַּרְדֵּ֔ן וַ/יָּבֹ֣א אֲלֵ/הֶ֔ם וַֽ/יַּעֲרֹ֖ךְ אֲלֵ/הֶ֑ם וַ/יַּעֲרֹ֨ךְ דָּוִ֜יד לִ/קְרַ֤את אֲרָם֙ מִלְחָמָ֔ה וַ/יִּֽלָּחֲמ֖וּ עִמּֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: vygd ldvyd vy'sf 't khl yshr'l vy'br hyrdn vyb' 'lhm vy'rkh 'lhm vy'rkh dvyd lqr't 'rm mlchmh vylchmv 'mv
verses.translation: And it was told David; and he gathered all Israel, and passed over Jordan, and came upon them, and set the battle in array against them. So when David had put the battle in array against the Syrians, they fought with him.

verses.original: וַ/יָּ֣נָס אֲרָם֮ מִ/לִּ/פְנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵל֒ וַ/יַּהֲרֹ֨ג דָּוִ֜יד מֵ/אֲרָ֗ם שִׁבְעַ֤ת אֲלָפִים֙ רֶ֔כֶב וְ/אַרְבָּעִ֥ים אֶ֖לֶף אִ֣ישׁ רַגְלִ֑י וְ/אֵ֛ת שׁוֹפַ֥ךְ שַֽׂר הַ/צָּבָ֖א הֵמִֽית
verses.translit: vyns 'rm mlpny yshr'l vyhrg dvyd m'rm shb't 'lpym rkhb v'rb'ym 'lf 'ysh rgly v't shvpkh shr htsb' hmyt
verses.translation: But the Syrians fled before Israel; and David slew of the Syrians seven thousand men which fought in chariots, and forty thousand footmen, and killed Shophach the captain of the host.

verses.original: וַ/יִּרְא֞וּ עַבְדֵ֣י הֲדַדְעֶ֗זֶר כִּ֤י נִגְּפוּ֙ לִ/פְנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל וַ/יַּשְׁלִ֥ימוּ עִם דָּוִ֖יד וַ/יַּֽעַבְדֻ֑/הוּ וְ/לֹא אָבָ֣ה אֲרָ֔ם לְ/הוֹשִׁ֥יעַ אֶת בְּנֵי עַמּ֖וֹן עֽוֹד
verses.translit: vyr'v 'bdy hdd'zr khy ngpv lpny yshr'l vyshlymv 'm dvyd vy'bdhv vl' 'bh 'rm lhvshy' 't bny 'mvn 'vd
verses.translation: And when the servants of Hadarezer saw that they were put to the worse before Israel, they made peace with David, and became his servants: neither would the Syrians help the children of Ammon any more.

verses.original: וַ/יְהִ֡י לְ/עֵת֩ תְּשׁוּבַ֨ת הַ/שָּׁנָ֜ה לְ/עֵ֣ת צֵ֣את הַ/מְּלָכִ֗ים וַ/יִּנְהַ֣ג יוֹאָב֩ אֶת חֵ֨יל הַ/צָּבָ֜א וַ/יַּשְׁחֵ֣ת אֶת אֶ֣רֶץ בְּנֵֽי עַמּ֗וֹן וַ/יָּבֹא֙ וַ/יָּ֣צַר אֶת רַבָּ֔ה וְ/דָוִ֖יד יֹשֵׁ֣ב בִּ/ירֽוּשָׁלִָ֑ם וַ/יַּ֥ךְ יוֹאָ֛ב אֶת רַבָּ֖ה וַ/יֶּֽהֶרְסֶֽ/הָ
verses.translit: vyhy l't tshvbt hshnh l't ts't hmlkhym vynhg yv'b 't chyl htsb' vyshcht 't 'rts bny 'mvn vyb' vytsr 't rbh vdvyd yshb byrvshlm vykh yv'b 't rbh vyhrsh
verses.translation: And it came to pass, that after the year was expired, at the time that kings go out to battle , Joab led forth the power of the army, and wasted the country of the children of Ammon, and came and besieged Rabbah. But David tarried at Jerusalem. And Joab smote Rabbah, and destroyed it.

verses.original: וַ/יִּקַּ֣ח דָּוִ֣יד אֶת עֲטֶֽרֶת מַלְכָּ/ם֩ מֵ/עַ֨ל רֹאשׁ֜/וֹ וַֽ/יִּמְצָאָ֣/הּ מִשְׁקַ֣ל כִּכַּר זָהָ֗ב וּ/בָ/הּ֙ אֶ֣בֶן יְקָרָ֔ה וַ/תְּהִ֖י עַל רֹ֣אשׁ דָּוִ֑יד וּ/שְׁלַ֥ל הָ/עִ֛יר הוֹצִ֖יא הַרְבֵּ֥ה מְאֹֽד
verses.translit: vyqch dvyd 't 'trt mlkhm m'l r'shv vymts'h mshql khkhr zhb vbh 'bn yqrh vthy 'l r'sh dvyd vshll h'yr hvtsy' hrbh m'd
verses.translation: And David took the crown of their king from off his head, and found it to weigh a talent of gold, and there were precious stones in it; and it was set upon David’s head: and he brought also exceeding much spoil out of the city.

verses.original: וְ/אֶת הָ/עָ֨ם אֲשֶׁר בָּ֜/הּ הוֹצִ֗יא וַ/יָּ֨שַׂר בַּ/מְּגֵרָ֜ה וּ/בַ/חֲרִיצֵ֤י הַ/בַּרְזֶל֙ וּ/בַ/מְּגֵר֔וֹת וְ/כֵן֙ יַעֲשֶׂ֣ה דָוִ֔יד לְ/כֹ֖ל עָרֵ֣י בְנֵי עַמּ֑וֹן וַ/יָּ֧שָׁב דָּוִ֛יד וְ/כָל הָ/עָ֖ם יְרוּשָׁלִָֽם
verses.translit: v't h'm 'shr bh hvtsy' vyshr bmgrh vbchrytsy hbrzl vbmgrvt vkhn y'shh dvyd lkhl 'ry bny 'mvn vyshb dvyd vkhl h'm yrvshlm
verses.translation: And he brought out the people that were in it, and cut them with saws, and with harrows of iron, and with axes. Even so dealt David with all the cities of the children of Ammon. And David and all the people returned to Jerusalem.

verses.original: וַ/יְהִי֙ אַחֲרֵי כֵ֔ן וַ/תַּעֲמֹ֧ד מִלְחָמָ֛ה בְּ/גֶ֖זֶר עִם פְּלִשְׁתִּ֑ים אָ֣ז הִכָּ֞ה סִבְּכַ֣י הַ/חֻֽשָׁתִ֗י אֶת סִפַּ֛י מִ/ילִדֵ֥י הָ/רְפָאִ֖ים וַ/יִּכָּנֵֽעוּ
verses.translit: vyhy 'chry khn vt'md mlchmh bgzr 'm plshtym 'z hkhh sbkhy hchshty 't spy myldy hrp'ym vykhn'v
verses.translation: And it came to pass after this, that there arose war at Gezer with the Philistines; at which time Sibbechai the Hushathite slew Sippai, that was of the children of the giant: and they were subdued.

verses.original: וַ/תְּהִי ע֥וֹד מִלְחָמָ֖ה אֶת פְּלִשְׁתִּ֑ים וַ/יַּ֞ךְ אֶלְחָנָ֣ן בֶּן יעור יָעִ֗יר אֶת לַחְמִי֙ אֲחִי֙ גָּלְיָ֣ת הַ/גִּתִּ֔י וְ/עֵ֣ץ חֲנִית֔/וֹ כִּ/מְנ֖וֹר אֹרְגִֽים
verses.translit: vthy 'vd mlchmh 't plshtym vykh 'lchnn bn y'vr y'yr 't lchmy 'chy glyt hgty v'ts chnytv khmnvr 'rgym
verses.translation: And there was war again with the Philistines; and Elhanan the son of Jair slew Lahmi the brother of Goliath the Gittite, whose spear staff was like a weaver’s beam.

verses.original: וַ/תְּהִי ע֥וֹד מִלְחָמָ֖ה בְּ/גַ֑ת וַ/יְהִ֣י אִ֣ישׁ מִדָּ֗ה וְ/אֶצְבְּעֹתָ֤י/ו שֵׁשׁ וָ/שֵׁשׁ֙ עֶשְׂרִ֣ים וְ/אַרְבַּ֔ע וְ/גַם ה֖וּא נוֹלַ֥ד לְ/הָ/רָפָֽא
verses.translit: vthy 'vd mlchmh bgt vyhy 'ysh mdh v'tsb'tyv shsh vshsh 'shrym v'rb' vgm hv' nvld lhrp'
verses.translation: And yet again there was war at Gath, where was a man of great stature, whose fingers and toes were four and twenty, six on each hand , and six on each foot: and he also was the son of the giant.

verses.original: וַ/יְחָרֵ֖ף אֶת יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וַ/יַּכֵּ֨/הוּ֙ יְה֣וֹנָתָ֔ן בֶּן שִׁמְעָ֖א אֲחִ֥י דָוִֽיד
verses.translit: vychrf 't yshr'l vykhhv yhvntn bn shm'' 'chy dvyd
verses.translation: But when he defied Israel, Jonathan the son of Shimea David’s brother slew him.

verses.original: אֵ֛ל נוּלְּד֥וּ לְ/הָ/רָפָ֖א בְּ/גַ֑ת וַ/יִּפְּל֥וּ בְ/יַד דָּוִ֖יד וּ/בְ/יַד עֲבָדָֽי/ו
verses.translit: 'l nvldv lhrp' bgt vyplv byd dvyd vbyd 'bdyv
verses.translation: These were born unto the giant in Gath; and they fell by the hand of David, and by the hand of his servants.

verses.original: וַ/יַּֽעֲמֹ֥ד שָׂטָ֖ן עַל יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וַ/יָּ֨סֶת֙ אֶת דָּוִ֔יד לִ/מְנ֖וֹת אֶת יִשְׂרָאֵֽל
verses.translit: vy'md shtn 'l yshr'l vyst 't dvyd lmnvt 't yshr'l
verses.translation: And Satan stood up against Israel, and provoked David to number Israel.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֨אמֶר דָּוִ֤יד אֶל יוֹאָב֙ וְ/אֶל שָׂרֵ֣י הָ/עָ֔ם לְכ֗וּ סִפְרוּ֙ אֶת יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל מִ/בְּאֵ֥ר שֶׁ֖בַע וְ/עַד דָּ֑ן וְ/הָבִ֣יאוּ אֵלַ֔/י וְ/אֵדְעָ֖ה אֶת מִסְפָּרָֽ/ם
verses.translit: vy'mr dvyd 'l yv'b v'l shry h'm lkhv sprv 't yshr'l mb'r shb' v'd dn vhby'v 'ly v'd'h 't msprm
verses.translation: And David said to Joab and to the rulers of the people, Go, number Israel from Beer-sheba even to Dan; and bring the number of them to me, that I may know it .

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֣אמֶר יוֹאָ֗ב יוֹסֵף֩ יְהוָ֨ה עַל עַמּ֤/וֹ כָּ/הֵם֙ מֵאָ֣ה פְעָמִ֔ים הֲ/לֹא֙ אֲדֹנִ֣/י הַ/מֶּ֔לֶךְ כֻּלָּ֥/ם לַ/אדֹנִ֖/י לַ/עֲבָדִ֑ים לָ֣/מָּה יְבַקֵּ֥שׁ זֹאת֙ אֲדֹנִ֔/י לָ֛/מָּה יִהְיֶ֥ה לְ/אַשְׁמָ֖ה לְ/יִשְׂרָאֵֽל
verses.translit: vy'mr yv'b yvsf yhvh 'l 'mv khhm m'h p'mym hl' 'dny hmlkh khlm l'dny l'bdym lmh ybqsh z't 'dny lmh yhyh l'shmh lyshr'l
verses.translation: And Joab answered, The LORD make his people an hundred times so many more as they be: but, my lord the king, are they not all my lord’s servants? why then doth my lord require this thing? why will he be a cause of trespass to Israel?

verses.original: וּ/דְבַר הַ/מֶּ֖לֶךְ חָזַ֣ק עַל יוֹאָ֑ב וַ/יֵּצֵ֣א יוֹאָ֗ב וַ/יִּתְהַלֵּךְ֙ בְּ/כָל יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל וַ/יָּבֹ֖א יְרוּשָׁלִָֽם
verses.translit: vdbr hmlkh chzq 'l yv'b vyts' yv'b vythlkh bkhl yshr'l vyb' yrvshlm
verses.translation: Nevertheless the king’s word prevailed against Joab. Wherefore Joab departed, and went throughout all Israel, and came to Jerusalem.

verses.original: וַ/יִּתֵּ֥ן יוֹאָ֛ב אֶת מִסְפַּ֥ר מִפְקַד הָ/עָ֖ם אֶל דָּוִ֑יד וַ/יְהִ֣י כָֽל יִשְׂרָאֵ֡ל אֶ֣לֶף אֲלָפִים֩ וּ/מֵאָ֨ה אֶ֤לֶף אִישׁ֙ שֹׁ֣לֵֽף חֶ֔רֶב וִֽ/יהוּדָ֕ה אַרְבַּע֩ מֵא֨וֹת וְ/שִׁבְעִ֥ים אֶ֛לֶף אִ֖ישׁ שֹׁ֥לֵֽף חָֽרֶב
verses.translit: vytn yv'b 't mspr mpqd h'm 'l dvyd vyhy khl yshr'l 'lf 'lpym vm'h 'lf 'ysh shlf chrb vyhvdh 'rb' m'vt vshb'ym 'lf 'ysh shlf chrb
verses.translation: And Joab gave the sum of the number of the people unto David. And all they of Israel were a thousand thousand and an hundred thousand men that drew sword: and Judah was four hundred threescore and ten thousand men that drew sword.

verses.original: וְ/לֵוִי֙ וּ/בִנְיָמִ֔ן לֹ֥א פָקַ֖ד בְּ/תוֹכָ֑/ם כִּֽי נִתְעַ֥ב דְּבַר הַ/מֶּ֖לֶךְ אֶת יוֹאָֽב
verses.translit: vlvy vbnymn l' pqd btvkhm khy nt'b dbr hmlkh 't yv'b
verses.translation: But Levi and Benjamin counted he not among them: for the king’s word was abominable to Joab.

verses.original: וַ/יֵּ֨רַע֙ בְּ/עֵינֵ֣י הָ/אֱלֹהִ֔ים עַל הַ/דָּבָ֖ר הַ/זֶּ֑ה וַ/יַּ֖ךְ אֶת יִשְׂרָאֵֽל
verses.translit: vyr' b'yny h'lhym 'l hdbr hzh vykh 't yshr'l
verses.translation: And God was displeased with this thing; therefore he smote Israel. concerning this thing

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֤אמֶר דָּוִיד֙ אֶל הָ֣/אֱלֹהִ֔ים חָטָ֣אתִֽי מְאֹ֔ד אֲשֶׁ֥ר עָשִׂ֖יתִי אֶת הַ/דָּבָ֣ר הַ/זֶּ֑ה וְ/עַתָּ֗ה הַֽעֲבֶר נָא֙ אֶת עֲו֣וֹן עַבְדְּ/ךָ֔ כִּ֥י נִסְכַּ֖לְתִּי מְאֹֽד
verses.translit: vy'mr dvyd 'l h'lhym cht'ty m'd 'shr 'shyty 't hdbr hzh v'th h'br n' 't 'vvn 'bdkh khy nskhlty m'd
verses.translation: And David said unto God, I have sinned greatly, because I have done this thing: but now, I beseech thee, do away the iniquity of thy servant; for I have done very foolishly.

verses.original: וַ/יְדַבֵּ֤ר יְהוָה֙ אֶל גָּ֔ד חֹזֵ֥ה דָוִ֖יד לֵ/אמֹֽר
verses.translit: vydbr yhvh 'l gd chzh dvyd l'mr
verses.translation: And the LORD spake unto Gad, David’s seer, saying,

verses.original: לֵךְ֩ וְ/דִבַּרְתָּ֨ אֶל דָּוִ֜יד לֵ/אמֹ֗ר כֹּ֚ה אָמַ֣ר יְהוָ֔ה שָׁל֕וֹשׁ אֲנִ֖י נֹטֶ֣ה עָלֶ֑י/ךָ בְּחַר לְ/ךָ֛ אַחַ֥ת מֵ/הֵ֖נָּה וְ/אֶֽעֱשֶׂה לָּֽ/ךְ
verses.translit: lkh vdbrt 'l dvyd l'mr khh 'mr yhvh shlvsh 'ny nth 'lykh bchr lkh 'cht mhnh v''shh lkh
verses.translation: Go and tell David, saying, Thus saith the LORD , I offer thee three things: choose thee one of them, that I may do it unto thee.

verses.original: וַ/יָּ֥בֹא גָ֖ד אֶל דָּוִ֑יד וַ/יֹּ֥אמֶר ל֛/וֹ כֹּֽה אָמַ֥ר יְהוָ֖ה קַבֶּל לָֽ/ךְ
verses.translit: vyb' gd 'l dvyd vy'mr lv khh 'mr yhvh qbl lkh
verses.translation: So Gad came to David, and said unto him, Thus saith the LORD , Choose thee

verses.original: אִם שָׁל֨וֹשׁ שָׁנִ֜ים רָעָ֗ב וְ/אִם שְׁלֹשָׁ֨ה חֳדָשִׁ֜ים נִסְפֶּ֥ה מִ/פְּנֵי צָרֶי/ךָ֮ וְ/חֶ֣רֶב אוֹיְבֶ֣/ךָ לְ/מַשֶּׂגֶת֒ וְ/אִם שְׁלֹ֣שֶׁת יָ֠מִים חֶ֣רֶב יְהוָ֤ה וְ/דֶ֨בֶר֙ בָּ/אָ֔רֶץ וּ/מַלְאַ֣ךְ יְהוָ֔ה מַשְׁחִ֖ית בְּ/כָל גְּב֣וּל יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וְ/עַתָּ֣ה רְאֵ֔ה מָֽה אָשִׁ֥יב אֶת שֹׁלְחִ֖/י דָּבָֽר
verses.translit: 'm shlvsh shnym r'b v'm shlshh chdshym nsph mpny tsrykh vchrb 'vybkh lmshgt v'm shlsht ymym chrb yhvh vdbr b'rts vml'kh yhvh mshchyt bkhl gbvl yshr'l v'th r'h mh 'shyb 't shlchy dbr
verses.translation: Either three years’ famine; or three months to be destroyed before thy foes, while that the sword of thine enemies overtaketh thee; or else three days the sword of the LORD , even the pestilence, in the land, and the angel of the LORD destroying throughout all the coasts of Israel. Now therefore advise thyself what word I shall bring again to him that sent me.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֧אמֶר דָּוִ֛יד אֶל גָּ֖ד צַר לִ֣/י מְאֹ֑ד אֶפְּלָה נָּ֣א בְ/יַד יְהוָ֗ה כִּֽי רַבִּ֤ים רַחֲמָי/ו֙ מְאֹ֔ד וּ/בְ/יַד אָדָ֖ם אַל אֶפֹּֽל
verses.translit: vy'mr dvyd 'l gd tsr ly m'd 'plh n' byd yhvh khy rbym rchmyv m'd vbyd 'dm 'l 'pl
verses.translation: And David said unto Gad, I am in a great strait: let me fall now into the hand of the LORD ; for very great are his mercies: but let me not fall into the hand of man.

verses.original: וַ/יִּתֵּ֧ן יְהוָ֛ה דֶּ֖בֶר בְּ/יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וַ/יִּפֹּל֙ מִ/יִּשְׂרָאֵ֔ל שִׁבְעִ֥ים אֶ֖לֶף אִֽישׁ
verses.translit: vytn yhvh dbr byshr'l vypl myshr'l shb'ym 'lf 'ysh
verses.translation: So the LORD sent pestilence upon Israel: and there fell of Israel seventy thousand men.

verses.original: וַ/יִּשְׁלַח֩ הָ/אֱלֹהִ֨ים מַלְאָ֥ךְ לִֽ/ירוּשָׁלִַם֮ לְ/הַשְׁחִיתָ/הּ֒ וּ/כְ/הַשְׁחִ֗ית רָאָ֤ה יְהוָה֙ וַ/יִּנָּ֣חֶם עַל הָֽ/רָעָ֔ה וַ/יֹּ֨אמֶר לַ/מַּלְאָ֤ךְ הַ/מַּשְׁחִית֙ רַ֔ב עַתָּ֖ה הֶ֣רֶף יָדֶ֑/ךָ וּ/מַלְאַ֤ךְ יְהוָה֙ עֹמֵ֔ד עִם גֹּ֖רֶן אָרְנָ֥ן הַ/יְבוּסִֽי
verses.translit: vyshlch h'lhym ml'kh lyrvshlm lhshchyth vkhhshchyt r'h yhvh vynchm 'l hr'h vy'mr lml'kh hmshchyt rb 'th hrf ydkh vml'kh yhvh 'md 'm grn 'rnn hybvsy
verses.translation: And God sent an angel unto Jerusalem to destroy it: and as he was destroying, the LORD beheld, and he repented him of the evil, and said to the angel that destroyed, It is enough, stay now thine hand. And the angel of the LORD stood by the threshingfloor of Ornan the Jebusite.

verses.original: וַ/יִּשָּׂ֨א דָוִ֜יד אֶת עֵינָ֗י/ו וַ/יַּ֞רְא אֶת מַלְאַ֤ךְ יְהוָה֙ עֹמֵ֗ד בֵּ֤ין הָ/אָ֨רֶץ֙ וּ/בֵ֣ין הַ/שָּׁמַ֔יִם וְ/חַרְבּ֤/וֹ שְׁלוּפָה֙ בְּ/יָד֔/וֹ נְטוּיָ֖ה עַל יְרוּשָׁלִָ֑ם וַ/יִּפֹּ֨ל דָּוִ֧יד וְ/הַ/זְּקֵנִ֛ים מְכֻסִּ֥ים בַּ/שַּׂקִּ֖ים עַל פְּנֵי/הֶֽם
verses.translit: vysh' dvyd 't 'ynyv vyr' 't ml'kh yhvh 'md byn h'rts vbyn hshmym vchrbv shlvph bydv ntvyh 'l yrvshlm vypl dvyd vhzqnym mkhsym bshqym 'l pnyhm
verses.translation: And David lifted up his eyes, and saw the angel of the LORD stand between the earth and the heaven, having a drawn sword in his hand stretched out over Jerusalem. Then David and the elders of Israel, who were clothed in sackcloth, fell upon their faces.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֣אמֶר דָּוִ֣יד אֶֽל הָ/אֱלֹהִ֡ים הֲ/לֹא֩ אֲנִ֨י אָמַ֜רְתִּי לִ/מְנ֣וֹת בָּ/עָ֗ם וַ/אֲנִי ה֤וּא אֲשֶׁר חָטָ֨אתִי֙ וְ/הָרֵ֣עַ הֲרֵע֔וֹתִי וְ/אֵ֥לֶּה הַ/צֹּ֖אן מֶ֣ה עָשׂ֑וּ יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהַ֗/י תְּהִ֨י נָ֤א יָֽדְ/ךָ֙ בִּ֚/י וּ/בְ/בֵ֣ית אָבִ֔/י וּֽ/בְ/עַמְּ/ךָ֖ לֹ֥א לְ/מַגֵּפָֽה
verses.translit: vy'mr dvyd 'l h'lhym hl' 'ny 'mrty lmnvt b'm v'ny hv' 'shr cht'ty vhr' hr'vty v'lh hts'n mh 'shv yhvh 'lhy thy n' ydkh by vbbyt 'by vb'mkh l' lmgph
verses.translation: And David said unto God, Is it not I that commanded the people to be numbered? even I it is that have sinned and done evil indeed; but as for these sheep, what have they done? let thine hand, I pray thee, O LORD my God, be on me, and on my father’s house; but not on thy people, that they should be plagued.

verses.original: וּ/מַלְאַ֧ךְ יְהוָ֛ה אָמַ֥ר אֶל גָּ֖ד לֵ/אמֹ֣ר לְ/דָוִ֑יד כִּ֣י יַעֲלֶ֣ה דָוִ֗יד לְ/הָקִ֤ים מִזְבֵּ֨חַ֙ לַ/יהוָ֔ה בְּ/גֹ֖רֶן אָרְנָ֥ן הַ/יְבֻסִֽי
verses.translit: vml'kh yhvh 'mr 'l gd l'mr ldvyd khy y'lh dvyd lhqym mzbch lyhvh bgrn 'rnn hybsy
verses.translation: Then the angel of the LORD commanded Gad to say to David, that David should go up, and set up an altar unto the LORD in the threshingfloor of Ornan the Jebusite.

verses.original: וַ/יַּ֤עַל דָּוִיד֙ בִּ/דְבַר גָּ֔ד אֲשֶׁ֥ר דִּבֶּ֖ר בְּ/שֵׁ֥ם יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: vy'l dvyd bdbr gd 'shr dbr bshm yhvh
verses.translation: And David went up at the saying of Gad, which he spake in the name of the LORD .

verses.original: וַ/יָּ֣שָׁב אָרְנָ֗ן וַ/יַּרְא֙ אֶת הַ/מַּלְאָ֔ךְ וְ/אַרְבַּ֧עַת בָּנָ֛י/ו עִמּ֖/וֹ מִֽתְחַבְּאִ֑ים וְ/אָרְנָ֖ן דָּ֥שׁ חִטִּֽים
verses.translit: vyshb 'rnn vyr' 't hml'kh v'rb't bnyv 'mv mtchb'ym v'rnn dsh chtym
verses.translation: And Ornan turned back, and saw the angel; and his four sons with him hid themselves. Now Ornan was threshing wheat.

verses.original: וַ/יָּבֹ֥א דָוִ֖יד עַד אָרְנָ֑ן וַ/יַּבֵּ֤ט אָרְנָן֙ וַ/יַּ֣רְא אֶת דָּוִ֔יד וַ/יֵּצֵא֙ מִן הַ/גֹּ֔רֶן וַ/יִּשְׁתַּ֧חוּ לְ/דָוִ֛יד אַפַּ֖יִם אָֽרְצָ/ה
verses.translit: vyb' dvyd 'd 'rnn vybt 'rnn vyr' 't dvyd vyts' mn hgrn vyshtchv ldvyd 'pym 'rtsh
verses.translation: And as David came to Ornan, Ornan looked and saw David, and went out of the threshingfloor, and bowed himself to David with his face to the ground.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֨אמֶר דָּוִ֜יד אֶל אָרְנָ֗ן תְּנָ/ה לִּ/י֙ מְק֣וֹם הַ/גֹּ֔רֶן וְ/אֶבְנֶה בּ֥/וֹ מִזְבֵּ֖חַ לַ/יהוָ֑ה בְּ/כֶ֤סֶף מָלֵא֙ תְּנֵ֣/הוּ לִ֔/י וְ/תֵעָצַ֥ר הַ/מַּגֵּפָ֖ה מֵ/עַ֥ל הָ/עָֽם
verses.translit: vy'mr dvyd 'l 'rnn tnh ly mqvm hgrn v'bnh bv mzbch lyhvh bkhsf ml' tnhv ly vt'tsr hmgph m'l h'm
verses.translation: Then David said to Ornan, Grant me the place of this threshingfloor, that I may build an altar therein unto the LORD : thou shalt grant it me for the full price: that the plague may be stayed from the people.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֨אמֶר אָרְנָ֤ן אֶל דָּוִיד֙ קַֽח לָ֔/ךְ וְ/יַ֛עַשׂ אֲדֹנִ֥/י הַ/מֶּ֖לֶךְ הַ/טּ֣וֹב בְּ/עֵינָ֑י/ו רְאֵה֩ נָתַ֨תִּי הַ/בָּקָ֜ר לָֽ/עֹל֗וֹת וְ/הַ/מּוֹרִגִּ֧ים לָ/עֵצִ֛ים וְ/הַ/חִטִּ֥ים לַ/מִּנְחָ֖ה הַ/כֹּ֥ל נָתָֽתִּי
verses.translit: vy'mr 'rnn 'l dvyd qch lkh vy'sh 'dny hmlkh htvb b'ynyv r'h ntty hbqr l'lvt vhmvrgym l'tsym vhchtym lmnchh hkhl ntty
verses.translation: And Ornan said unto David, Take it to thee, and let my lord the king do that which is good in his eyes: lo, I give thee the oxen also for burnt offerings, and the threshing instruments for wood, and the wheat for the meat offering; I give it all.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֨אמֶר הַ/מֶּ֤לֶךְ דָּוִיד֙ לְ/אָרְנָ֔ן לֹ֕א כִּֽי קָנֹ֥ה אֶקְנֶ֖ה בְּ/כֶ֣סֶף מָלֵ֑א כִּ֠י לֹא אֶשָּׂ֤א אֲשֶׁר לְ/ךָ֙ לַ/יהוָ֔ה וְ/הַעֲל֥וֹת עוֹלָ֖ה חִנָּֽם
verses.translit: vy'mr hmlkh dvyd l'rnn l' khy qnh 'qnh bkhsf ml' khy l' 'sh' 'shr lkh lyhvh vh'lvt 'vlh chnm
verses.translation: And king David said to Ornan, Nay; but I will verily buy it for the full price: for I will not take that which is thine for the LORD , nor offer burnt offerings without cost.

verses.original: וַ/יִּתֵּ֥ן דָּוִ֛יד לְ/אָרְנָ֖ן בַּ/מָּק֑וֹם שִׁקְלֵ֣י זָהָ֔ב מִשְׁקָ֖ל שֵׁ֥שׁ מֵאֽוֹת
verses.translit: vytn dvyd l'rnn bmqvm shqly zhb mshql shsh m'vt
verses.translation: So David gave to Ornan for the place six hundred shekels of gold by weight.

verses.original: וַ/יִּבֶן֩ שָׁ֨ם דָּוִ֤יד מִזְבֵּ֨חַ֙ לַ/יהוָ֔ה וַ/יַּ֥עַל עֹל֖וֹת וּ/שְׁלָמִ֑ים וַ/יִּקְרָא֙ אֶל יְהוָ֔ה וַ/יַּֽעֲנֵ֤/הוּ בָ/אֵשׁ֙ מִן הַ/שָּׁמַ֔יִם עַ֖ל מִזְבַּ֥ח הָ/עֹלָֽה
verses.translit: vybn shm dvyd mzbch lyhvh vy'l 'lvt vshlmym vyqr' 'l yhvh vy'nhv b'sh mn hshmym 'l mzbch h'lh
verses.translation: And David built there an altar unto the LORD , and offered burnt offerings and peace offerings, and called upon the LORD ; and he answered him from heaven by fire upon the altar of burnt offering.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֤אמֶר יְהוָה֙ לַ/מַּלְאָ֔ךְ וַ/יָּ֥שֶׁב חַרְבּ֖/וֹ אֶל נְדָנָֽ/הּ
verses.translit: vy'mr yhvh lml'kh vyshb chrbv 'l ndnh
verses.translation: And the LORD commanded the angel; and he put up his sword again into the sheath thereof.

verses.original: בָּ/עֵ֣ת הַ/הִ֔יא בִּ/רְא֤וֹת דָּוִיד֙ כִּי עָנָ֣/הוּ יְהוָ֔ה בְּ/גֹ֖רֶן אָרְנָ֣ן הַ/יְבוּסִ֑י וַ/יִּזְבַּ֖ח שָֽׁם
verses.translit: b't hhy' br'vt dvyd khy 'nhv yhvh bgrn 'rnn hybvsy vyzbch shm
verses.translation: At that time when David saw that the LORD had answered him in the threshingfloor of Ornan the Jebusite, then he sacrificed there.

verses.original: וּ/מִשְׁכַּ֣ן יְ֠הוָה אֲשֶׁר עָשָׂ֨ה מֹשֶׁ֧ה בַ/מִּדְבָּ֛ר וּ/מִזְבַּ֥ח הָ/עוֹלָ֖ה בָּ/עֵ֣ת הַ/הִ֑יא בַּ/בָּמָ֖ה בְּ/גִבְעֽוֹן
verses.translit: vmshkhn yhvh 'shr 'shh mshh bmdbr vmzbch h'vlh b't hhy' bbmh bgb'vn
verses.translation: For the tabernacle of the LORD , which Moses made in the wilderness, and the altar of the burnt offering, were at that season in the high place at Gibeon.

verses.original: וְ/לֹא יָכֹ֥ל דָּוִ֛יד לָ/לֶ֥כֶת לְ/פָנָ֖י/ו לִ/דְרֹ֣שׁ אֱלֹהִ֑ים כִּ֣י נִבְעַ֔ת מִ/פְּנֵ֕י חֶ֖רֶב מַלְאַ֥ךְ יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: vl' ykhl dvyd llkht lpnyv ldrsh 'lhym khy nb't mpny chrb ml'kh yhvh
verses.translation: But David could not go before it to enquire of God: for he was afraid because of the sword of the angel of the LORD .

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֣אמֶר דָּוִ֔יד זֶ֣ה ה֔וּא בֵּ֖ית יְהוָ֣ה הָ/אֱלֹהִ֑ים וְ/זֶה מִּזְבֵּ֥חַ לְ/עֹלָ֖ה לְ/יִשְׂרָאֵֽל
verses.translit: vy'mr dvyd zh hv' byt yhvh h'lhym vzh mzbch l'lh lyshr'l
verses.translation: Then David said, This is the house of the LORD God, and this is the altar of the burnt offering for Israel.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֣אמֶר דָּוִ֔יד לִ/כְנוֹס֙ אֶת הַ/גֵּרִ֔ים אֲשֶׁ֖ר בְּ/אֶ֣רֶץ יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וַ/יַּעֲמֵ֣ד חֹֽצְבִ֗ים לַ/חְצוֹב֙ אַבְנֵ֣י גָזִ֔ית לִ/בְנ֖וֹת בֵּ֥ית הָ/אֱלֹהִֽים
verses.translit: vy'mr dvyd lkhnvs 't hgrym 'shr b'rts yshr'l vy'md chtsbym lchtsvb 'bny gzyt lbnvt byt h'lhym
verses.translation: And David commanded to gather together the strangers that were in the land of Israel; and he set masons to hew wrought stones to build the house of God.

verses.original: וּ/בַרְזֶ֣ל לָ֠/רֹב לַֽ/מִּסְמְרִ֞ים לְ/דַלְת֧וֹת הַ/שְּׁעָרִ֛ים וְ/לַֽ/מְחַבְּר֖וֹת הֵכִ֣ין דָּוִ֑יד וּ/נְחֹ֥שֶׁת לָ/רֹ֖ב אֵ֥ין מִשְׁקָֽל
verses.translit: vbrzl lrb lmsmrym ldltvt hsh'rym vlmchbrvt hkhyn dvyd vnchsht lrb 'yn mshql
verses.translation: And David prepared iron in abundance for the nails for the doors of the gates, and for the joinings; and brass in abundance without weight;

verses.original: וַ/עֲצֵ֥י אֲרָזִ֖ים לְ/אֵ֣ין מִסְפָּ֑ר כִּֽי הֵ֠בִיאוּ הַ/צִּֽידֹנִ֨ים וְ/הַ/צֹּרִ֜ים עֲצֵ֧י אֲרָזִ֛ים לָ/רֹ֖ב לְ/דָוִֽיד
verses.translit: v'tsy 'rzym l'yn mspr khy hby'v htsydnym vhtsrym 'tsy 'rzym lrb ldvyd
verses.translation: Also cedar trees in abundance: for the Zidonians and they of Tyre brought much cedar wood to David.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֣אמֶר דָּוִ֗יד שְׁלֹמֹ֣ה בְנִ/י֮ נַ֣עַר וָ/רָךְ֒ וְ/הַ/בַּ֜יִת לִ/בְנ֣וֹת לַ/יהוָ֗ה לְ/הַגְדִּ֨יל לְ/מַ֜עְלָ/ה לְ/שֵׁ֤ם וּ/לְ/תִפְאֶ֨רֶת֙ לְ/כָל הָ֣/אֲרָצ֔וֹת אָכִ֥ינָה נָּ֖א ל֑/וֹ וַ/יָּ֧כֶן דָּוִ֛יד לָ/רֹ֖ב לִ/פְנֵ֥י מוֹתֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: vy'mr dvyd shlmh bny n'r vrkh vhbyt lbnvt lyhvh lhgdyl lm'lh lshm vltp'rt lkhl h'rtsvt 'khynh n' lv vykhn dvyd lrb lpny mvtv
verses.translation: And David said, Solomon my son is young and tender, and the house that is to be builded for the LORD must be exceeding magnifical, of fame and of glory throughout all countries: I will therefore now make preparation for it. So David prepared abundantly before his death.

verses.original: וַ/יִּקְרָ֖א לִ/שְׁלֹמֹ֣ה בְנ֑/וֹ וַ/יְצַוֵּ֨/הוּ֙ לִ/בְנ֣וֹת בַּ֔יִת לַ/יהוָ֖ה אֱלֹהֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל
verses.translit: vyqr' lshlmh bnv vytsvhv lbnvt byt lyhvh 'lhy yshr'l
verses.translation: Then he called for Solomon his son, and charged him to build an house for the LORD God of Israel.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֥אמֶר דָּוִ֖יד לִ/שְׁלֹמֹ֑ה בנ/ו בְּנִ֕/י אֲנִי֙ הָיָ֣ה עִם לְבָבִ֔/י לִ/בְנ֣וֹת בַּ֔יִת לְ/שֵׁ֖ם יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהָֽ/י
verses.translit: vy'mr dvyd lshlmh bnv bny 'ny hyh 'm lbby lbnvt byt lshm yhvh 'lhy
verses.translation: And David said to Solomon, My son, as for me, it was in my mind to build an house unto the name of the LORD my God:

verses.original: וַ/יְהִ֨י עָלַ֤/י דְּבַר יְהוָה֙ לֵ/אמֹ֔ר דָּ֤ם לָ/רֹב֙ שָׁפַ֔כְתָּ וּ/מִלְחָמ֥וֹת גְּדֹל֖וֹת עָשִׂ֑יתָ לֹֽא תִבְנֶ֥ה בַ֨יִת֙ לִ/שְׁמִ֔/י כִּ֚י דָּמִ֣ים רַבִּ֔ים שָׁפַ֥כְתָּ אַ֖רְצָ/ה לְ/פָנָֽ/י
verses.translit: vyhy 'ly dbr yhvh l'mr dm lrb shpkht vmlchmvt gdlvt 'shyt l' tbnh byt lshmy khy dmym rbym shpkht 'rtsh lpny
verses.translation: But the word of the LORD came to me, saying, Thou hast shed blood abundantly, and hast made great wars: thou shalt not build an house unto my name, because thou hast shed much blood upon the earth in my sight.

verses.original: הִנֵּה בֵ֞ן נוֹלָ֣ד לָ֗/ךְ ה֤וּא יִהְיֶה֙ אִ֣ישׁ מְנוּחָ֔ה וַ/הֲנִח֥וֹתִי ל֛/וֹ מִ/כָּל אוֹיְבָ֖י/ו מִ/סָּבִ֑יב כִּ֤י שְׁלֹמֹה֙ יִהְיֶ֣ה שְׁמ֔/וֹ וְ/שָׁל֥וֹם וָ/שֶׁ֛קֶט אֶתֵּ֥ן עַל יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל בְּ/יָמָֽי/ו
verses.translit: hnh bn nvld lkh hv' yhyh 'ysh mnvchh vhnchvty lv mkhl 'vybyv msbyb khy shlmh yhyh shmv vshlvm vshqt 'tn 'l yshr'l bymyv
verses.translation: Behold, a son shall be born to thee, who shall be a man of rest; and I will give him rest from all his enemies round about: for his name shall be Solomon, and I will give peace and quietness unto Israel in his days.

verses.original: הֽוּא יִבְנֶ֥ה בַ֨יִת֙ לִ/שְׁמִ֔/י וְ/הוּא֙ יִהְיֶה לִּ֣/י לְ/בֵ֔ן וַ/אֲנִי ל֖/וֹ לְ/אָ֑ב וַ/הֲכִ֨ינוֹתִ֜י כִּסֵּ֧א מַלְכוּת֛/וֹ עַל יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל עַד עוֹלָֽם
verses.translit: hv' ybnh byt lshmy vhv' yhyh ly lbn v'ny lv l'b vhkhynvty khs' mlkhvtv 'l yshr'l 'd 'vlm
verses.translation: He shall build an house for my name; and he shall be my son, and I will be his father; and I will establish the throne of his kingdom over Israel for ever.

verses.original: עַתָּ֣ה בְנִ֔/י יְהִ֥י יְהוָ֖ה עִמָּ֑/ךְ וְ/הִצְלַחְתָּ֗ וּ/בָנִ֨יתָ֙ בֵּ֚ית יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶ֔י/ךָ כַּ/אֲשֶׁ֖ר דִּבֶּ֥ר עָלֶֽי/ךָ
verses.translit: 'th bny yhy yhvh 'mkh vhtslcht vbnyt byt yhvh 'lhykh kh'shr dbr 'lykh
verses.translation: Now, my son, the LORD be with thee; and prosper thou, and build the house of the LORD thy God, as he hath said of thee.

verses.original: אַ֣ךְ יִֽתֶּן לְּ/ךָ֤ יְהוָה֙ שֵׂ֣כֶל וּ/בִינָ֔ה וִֽ/יצַוְּ/ךָ֖ עַל יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וְ/לִ/שְׁמ֕וֹר אֶת תּוֹרַ֖ת יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֶֽי/ךָ
verses.translit: 'kh ytn lkh yhvh shkhl vbynh vytsvkh 'l yshr'l vlshmvr 't tvrt yhvh 'lhykh
verses.translation: Only the LORD give thee wisdom and understanding, and give thee charge concerning Israel, that thou mayest keep the law of the LORD thy God.

verses.original: אָ֣ז תַּצְלִ֔יחַ אִם תִּשְׁמ֗וֹר לַ/עֲשׂוֹת֙ אֶת הַֽ/חֻקִּ֣ים וְ/אֶת הַ/מִּשְׁפָּטִ֔ים אֲשֶׁ֨ר צִוָּ֧ה יְהוָ֛ה אֶת מֹשֶׁ֖ה עַל יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל חֲזַ֣ק וֶ/אֱמָ֔ץ אַל תִּירָ֖א וְ/אַל תֵּחָֽת
verses.translit: 'z ttslych 'm tshmvr l'shvt 't hchqym v't hmshptym 'shr tsvh yhvh 't mshh 'l yshr'l chzq v'mts 'l tyr' v'l tcht
verses.translation: Then shalt thou prosper, if thou takest heed to fulfil the statutes and judgments which the LORD charged Moses with concerning Israel: be strong, and of good courage; dread not, nor be dismayed.

verses.original: וְ/הִנֵּ֨ה בְ/עָנְיִ֜/י הֲכִינ֣וֹתִי לְ/בֵית יְהוָ֗ה זָהָ֞ב כִּכָּרִ֤ים מֵֽאָה אֶ֨לֶף֙ וְ/כֶ֗סֶף אֶ֤לֶף אֲלָפִים֙ כִּכָּרִ֔ים וְ/לַ/נְּחֹ֤שֶׁת וְ/לַ/בַּרְזֶל֙ אֵ֣ין מִשְׁקָ֔ל כִּ֥י לָ/רֹ֖ב הָיָ֑ה וְ/עֵצִ֤ים וַ/אֲבָנִים֙ הֲכִינ֔וֹתִי וַ/עֲלֵי/הֶ֖ם תּוֹסִֽיף
verses.translit: vhnh b'nyy hkhynvty lbyt yhvh zhb khkhrym m'h 'lf vkhsf 'lf 'lpym khkhrym vlnchsht vlbrzl 'yn mshql khy lrb hyh v'tsym v'bnym hkhynvty v'lyhm tvsyf
verses.translation: Now, behold, in my trouble I have prepared for the house of the LORD an hundred thousand talents of gold, and a thousand thousand talents of silver; and of brass and iron without weight; for it is in abundance: timber also and stone have I prepared; and thou mayest add thereto.

verses.original: וְ/עִמְּ/ךָ֤ לָ/רֹב֙ עֹשֵׂ֣י מְלָאכָ֔ה חֹצְבִ֕ים וְ/חָרָשֵׁ֥י אֶ֖בֶן וָ/עֵ֑ץ וְ/כָל חָכָ֖ם בְּ/כָל מְלָאכָֽה
verses.translit: v'mkh lrb 'shy ml'khh chtsbym vchrshy 'bn v'ts vkhl chkhm bkhl ml'khh
verses.translation: Moreover there are workmen with thee in abundance, hewers and workers of stone and timber, and all manner of cunning men for every manner of work.

verses.original: לַ/זָּהָ֥ב לַ/כֶּ֛סֶף וְ/לַ/נְּחֹ֥שֶׁת וְ/לַ/בַּרְזֶ֖ל אֵ֣ין מִסְפָּ֑ר ק֣וּם וַ/עֲשֵׂ֔ה וִ/יהִ֥י יְהוָ֖ה עִמָּֽ/ךְ
verses.translit: lzhb lkhsf vlnchsht vlbrzl 'yn mspr qvm v'shh vyhy yhvh 'mkh
verses.translation: Of the gold, the silver, and the brass, and the iron, there is no number. Arise therefore , and be doing, and the LORD be with thee.

verses.original: וַ/יְצַ֤ו דָּוִיד֙ לְ/כָל שָׂרֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל לַ/עְזֹ֖ר לִ/שְׁלֹמֹ֥ה בְנֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: vytsv dvyd lkhl shry yshr'l l'zr lshlmh bnv
verses.translation: David also commanded all the princes of Israel to help Solomon his son, saying ,

verses.original: הֲ/לֹ֨א יְהוָ֤ה אֱלֹֽהֵי/כֶם֙ עִמָּ/כֶ֔ם וְ/הֵנִ֥יחַ לָ/כֶ֖ם מִ/סָּבִ֑יב כִּ֣י נָתַ֣ן בְּ/יָדִ֗/י אֵ֚ת יֹשְׁבֵ֣י הָ/אָ֔רֶץ וְ/נִכְבְּשָׁ֥ה הָ/אָ֛רֶץ לִ/פְנֵ֥י יְהוָ֖ה וְ/לִ/פְנֵ֥י עַמּֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: hl' yhvh 'lhykhm 'mkhm vhnych lkhm msbyb khy ntn bydy 't yshby h'rts vnkhbshh h'rts lpny yhvh vlpny 'mv
verses.translation: Is not the LORD your God with you? and hath he not given you rest on every side? for he hath given the inhabitants of the land into mine hand; and the land is subdued before the LORD , and before his people.

verses.original: עַתָּ֗ה תְּנ֤וּ לְבַבְ/כֶם֙ וְ/נַפְשְׁ/כֶ֔ם לִ/דְר֖וֹשׁ לַ/יהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֵי/כֶ֑ם וְ/ק֗וּמוּ וּ/בְנוּ֙ אֶת מִקְדַּשׁ֙ יְהוָ֣ה הָֽ/אֱלֹהִ֔ים לְ/הָבִ֞יא אֶת אֲר֣וֹן בְּרִית יְהוָ֗ה וּ/כְלֵי֙ קֹ֣דֶשׁ הָֽ/אֱלֹהִ֔ים לַ/בַּ֖יִת הַ/נִּבְנֶ֥ה לְ/שֵׁם יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: 'th tnv lbbkhm vnpshkhm ldrvsh lyhvh 'lhykhm vqvmv vbnv 't mqdsh yhvh h'lhym lhby' 't 'rvn bryt yhvh vkhly qdsh h'lhym lbyt hnbnh lshm yhvh
verses.translation: Now set your heart and your soul to seek the LORD your God; arise therefore, and build ye the sanctuary of the LORD God, to bring the ark of the covenant of the LORD , and the holy vessels of God, into the house that is to be built to the name of the LORD .

verses.original: וְ/דָוִ֥יד זָקֵ֖ן וְ/שָׂבַ֣ע יָמִ֑ים וַ/יַּמְלֵ֛ךְ אֶת שְׁלֹמֹ֥ה בְנ֖/וֹ עַל יִשְׂרָאֵֽל
verses.translit: vdvyd zqn vshb' ymym vymlkh 't shlmh bnv 'l yshr'l
verses.translation: So when David was old and full of days, he made Solomon his son king over Israel.

verses.original: וַ/יֶּאֱסֹף֙ אֶת כָּל שָׂרֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל וְ/הַ/כֹּהֲנִ֖ים וְ/הַ/לְוִיִּֽם
verses.translit: vy'sf 't khl shry yshr'l vhkhhnym vhlvym
verses.translation: And he gathered together all the princes of Israel, with the priests and the Levites.

verses.original: וַ/יִּסָּֽפְרוּ֙ הַ/לְוִיִּ֔ם מִ/בֶּ֛ן שְׁלֹשִׁ֥ים שָׁנָ֖ה וָ/מָ֑עְלָ/ה וַ/יְהִ֨י מִסְפָּרָ֤/ם לְ/גֻלְגְּלֹתָ/ם֙ לִ/גְבָרִ֔ים שְׁלֹשִׁ֥ים וּ/שְׁמוֹנָ֖ה אָֽלֶף
verses.translit: vysprv hlvym mbn shlshym shnh vm'lh vyhy msprm lglgltm lgbrym shlshym vshmvnh 'lf
verses.translation: Now the Levites were numbered from the age of thirty years and upward: and their number by their polls, man by man, was thirty and eight thousand.

verses.original: מֵ/אֵ֗לֶּה לְ/נַצֵּ֨חַ֙ עַל מְלֶ֣אכֶת בֵּית יְהוָ֔ה עֶשְׂרִ֥ים וְ/אַרְבָּעָ֖ה אָ֑לֶף וְ/שֹׁטְרִ֥ים וְ/שֹׁפְטִ֖ים שֵׁ֥שֶׁת אֲלָפִֽים
verses.translit: m'lh lntsch 'l ml'kht byt yhvh 'shrym v'rb'h 'lf vshtrym vshptym shsht 'lpym
verses.translation: Of which, twenty and four thousand were to set forward the work of the house of the LORD ; and six thousand were officers and judges:

verses.original: וְ/אַרְבַּ֥עַת אֲלָפִ֖ים שֹׁעֲרִ֑ים וְ/אַרְבַּ֤עַת אֲלָפִים֙ מְהַֽלְלִ֣ים לַ/יהוָ֔ה בַּ/כֵּלִ֕ים אֲשֶׁ֥ר עָשִׂ֖יתִי לְ/הַלֵּֽל
verses.translit: v'rb't 'lpym sh'rym v'rb't 'lpym mhllym lyhvh bkhlym 'shr 'shyty lhll
verses.translation: Moreover four thousand were porters; and four thousand praised the LORD with the instruments which I made, said David , to praise therewith .

verses.original: וַ/יֶּֽחָלְקֵ֥/ם דָּוִ֖יד מַחְלְק֑וֹת לִ/בְנֵ֣י לֵוִ֔י לְ/גֵרְשׁ֖וֹן קְהָ֥ת וּ/מְרָרִֽי
verses.translit: vychlqm dvyd mchlqvt lbny lvy lgrshvn qht vmrry
verses.translation: And David divided them into courses among the sons of Levi, namely , Gershon, Kohath, and Merari.

verses.original: לַ/גֵּרְשֻׁנִּ֖י לַעְדָּ֥ן וְ/שִׁמְעִֽי
verses.translit: lgrshny l'dn vshm'y
verses.translation: Of the Gershonites were , Laadan, and Shimei.

verses.original: בְּנֵ֣י לַעְדָּ֗ן הָ/רֹ֧אשׁ יְחִיאֵ֛ל וְ/זֵתָ֥ם וְ/יוֹאֵ֖ל שְׁלֹשָֽׁה
verses.translit: bny l'dn hr'sh ychy'l vztm vyv'l shlshh
verses.translation: The sons of Laadan; the chief was Jehiel, and Zetham, and Joel, three.

verses.original: בְּנֵ֣י שִׁמְעִ֗י שלמות שְׁלוֹמִ֧ית וַ/חֲזִיאֵ֛ל וְ/הָרָ֖ן שְׁלֹשָׁ֑ה אֵ֛לֶּה רָאשֵׁ֥י הָ/אָב֖וֹת לְ/לַעְדָּֽן
verses.translit: bny shm'y shlmvt shlvmyt vchzy'l vhrn shlshh 'lh r'shy h'bvt ll'dn
verses.translation: The sons of Shimei; Shelomith, and Haziel, and Haran, three. These were the chief of the fathers of Laadan.

verses.original: וּ/בְנֵ֣י שִׁמְעִ֔י יַ֣חַת זִינָ֔א וִ/יע֖וּשׁ וּ/בְרִיעָ֑ה אֵ֥לֶּה בְנֵי שִׁמְעִ֖י אַרְבָּעָֽה
verses.translit: vbny shm'y ycht zyn' vy'vsh vbry'h 'lh bny shm'y 'rb'h
verses.translation: And the sons of Shimei were , Jahath, Zina, and Jeush, and Beriah. These four were the sons of Shimei.
