verses.original: וַֽ/יְהִי יַ֣חַת הָ/רֹ֔אשׁ וְ/זִיזָ֖ה הַ/שֵּׁנִ֑י וִ/יע֤וּשׁ וּ/בְרִיעָה֙ לֹֽא הִרְבּ֣וּ בָנִ֔ים וַ/יִּֽהְיוּ֙ לְ/בֵ֣ית אָ֔ב לִ/פְקֻדָּ֖ה אֶחָֽת
verses.translit: vyhy ycht hr'sh vzyzh hshny vy'vsh vbry'h l' hrbv bnym vyhyv lbyt 'b lpqdh 'cht
verses.translation: And Jahath was the chief, and Zizah the second: but Jeush and Beriah had not many sons; therefore they were in one reckoning, according to their father’s house.

verses.original: בְּנֵ֣י קְהָ֗ת עַמְרָ֥ם יִצְהָ֛ר חֶבְר֥וֹן וְ/עֻזִּיאֵ֖ל אַרְבָּעָֽה
verses.translit: bny qht 'mrm ytshr chbrvn v'zy'l 'rb'h
verses.translation: The sons of Kohath; Amram, Izhar, Hebron, and Uzziel, four.

verses.original: בְּנֵ֥י עַמְרָ֖ם אַהֲרֹ֣ן וּ/מֹשֶׁ֑ה וַ/יִּבָּדֵ֣ל אַהֲרֹ֡ן לְֽ/הַקְדִּישׁ/וֹ֩ קֹ֨דֶשׁ קָֽדָשִׁ֤ים הֽוּא וּ/בָנָי/ו֙ עַד עוֹלָ֔ם לְ/הַקְטִיר֩ לִ/פְנֵ֨י יְהוָ֧ה לְ/שָׁרְת֛/וֹ וּ/לְ/בָרֵ֥ךְ בִּ/שְׁמ֖/וֹ עַד עוֹלָֽם
verses.translit: bny 'mrm 'hrn vmshh vybdl 'hrn lhqdyshv qdsh qdshym hv' vbnyv 'd 'vlm lhqtyr lpny yhvh lshrtv vlbrkh bshmv 'd 'vlm
verses.translation: The sons of Amram; Aaron and Moses: and Aaron was separated, that he should sanctify the most holy things, he and his sons for ever, to burn incense before the LORD , to minister unto him, and to bless in his name for ever.

verses.original: וּ/מֹשֶׁ֖ה אִ֣ישׁ הָ/אֱלֹהִ֑ים בָּנָ֕י/ו יִקָּרְא֖וּ עַל שֵׁ֥בֶט הַ/לֵּוִֽי
verses.translit: vmshh 'ysh h'lhym bnyv yqr'v 'l shbt hlvy
verses.translation: Now concerning Moses the man of God, his sons were named of the tribe of Levi.

verses.original: בְּנֵ֣י מֹשֶׁ֔ה גֵּרְשֹׁ֖ם וֶ/אֱלִיעֶֽזֶר
verses.translit: bny mshh grshm v'ly'zr
verses.translation: The sons of Moses were , Gershom, and Eliezer.

verses.original: בְּנֵ֥י גֵרְשׁ֖וֹם שְׁבוּאֵ֥ל הָ/רֹֽאשׁ
verses.translit: bny grshvm shbv'l hr'sh
verses.translation: Of the sons of Gershom, Shebuel was the chief.

verses.original: וַ/יִּֽהְי֥וּ בְנֵי אֱלִיעֶ֖זֶר רְחַבְיָ֣ה הָ/רֹ֑אשׁ וְ/לֹא הָיָ֤ה לֶ/אֱלִיעֶ֨זֶר֙ בָּנִ֣ים אֲחֵרִ֔ים וּ/בְנֵ֥י רְחַבְיָ֖ה רָב֥וּ לְ/מָֽעְלָ/ה
verses.translit: vyhyv bny 'ly'zr rchbyh hr'sh vl' hyh l'ly'zr bnym 'chrym vbny rchbyh rbv lm'lh
verses.translation: And the sons of Eliezer were , Rehabiah the chief. And Eliezer had none other sons; but the sons of Rehabiah were very many.

verses.original: בְּנֵ֥י יִצְהָ֖ר שְׁלֹמִ֥ית הָ/רֹֽאשׁ
verses.translit: bny ytshr shlmyt hr'sh
verses.translation: Of the sons of Izhar; Shelomith the chief.

verses.original: בְּנֵ֖י חֶבְר֑וֹן יְרִיָּ֤הוּ הָ/רֹאשׁ֙ אֲמַרְיָ֣ה הַ/שֵּׁנִ֔י יַחֲזִיאֵל֙ הַ/שְּׁלִישִׁ֔י וִֽ/יקַמְעָ֖ם הָ/רְבִיעִֽי
verses.translit: bny chbrvn yryhv hr'sh 'mryh hshny ychzy'l hshlyshy vyqm'm hrby'y
verses.translation: Of the sons of Hebron; Jeriah the first, Amariah the second, Jahaziel the third, and Jekameam the fourth.

verses.original: בְּנֵ֖י עֻזִּיאֵ֑ל מִיכָ֣ה הָ/רֹ֔אשׁ וְ/יִשִּׁיָּ֖ה הַ/שֵּׁנִֽי
verses.translit: bny 'zy'l mykhh hr'sh vyshyh hshny
verses.translation: Of the sons of Uzziel; Michah the first, and Jesiah the second.

verses.original: בְּנֵ֤י מְרָרִי֙ מַחְלִ֣י וּ/מוּשִׁ֔י בְּנֵ֥י מַחְלִ֖י אֶלְעָזָ֥ר וְ/קִֽישׁ
verses.translit: bny mrry mchly vmvshy bny mchly 'l'zr vqysh
verses.translation: The sons of Merari; Mahli, and Mushi. The sons of Mahli; Eleazar, and Kish.

verses.original: וַ/יָּ֨מָת֙ אֶלְעָזָ֔ר וְ/לֹא הָ֥יוּ ל֛/וֹ בָּנִ֖ים כִּ֣י אִם בָּנ֑וֹת וַ/יִּשָּׂא֥וּ/ם בְּנֵי קִ֖ישׁ אֲחֵי/הֶֽם
verses.translit: vymt 'l'zr vl' hyv lv bnym khy 'm bnvt vysh'vm bny qysh 'chyhm
verses.translation: And Eleazar died, and had no sons, but daughters: and their brethren the sons of Kish took them.

verses.original: בְּנֵ֣י מוּשִׁ֗י מַחְלִ֥י וְ/עֵ֛דֶר וִ/ירֵמ֖וֹת שְׁלֹשָֽׁה
verses.translit: bny mvshy mchly v'dr vyrmvt shlshh
verses.translation: The sons of Mushi; Mahli, and Eder, and Jeremoth, three.

verses.original: אֵ֣לֶּה בְנֵֽי לֵוִי֩ לְ/בֵ֨ית אֲבֹתֵי/הֶ֜ם רָאשֵׁ֧י הָ/אָב֣וֹת לִ/פְקוּדֵי/הֶ֗ם בְּ/מִסְפַּ֤ר שֵׁמוֹת֙ לְ/גֻלְגְּלֹתָ֔/ם עֹשֵׂה֙ הַ/מְּלָאכָ֔ה לַ/עֲבֹדַ֖ת בֵּ֣ית יְהוָ֑ה מִ/בֶּ֛ן עֶשְׂרִ֥ים שָׁנָ֖ה וָ/מָֽעְלָ/ה
verses.translit: 'lh bny lvy lbyt 'btyhm r'shy h'bvt lpqvdyhm bmspr shmvt lglgltm 'shh hml'khh l'bdt byt yhvh mbn 'shrym shnh vm'lh
verses.translation: These were the sons of Levi after the house of their fathers; even the chief of the fathers, as they were counted by number of names by their polls, that did the work for the service of the house of the LORD , from the age of twenty years and upward.

verses.original: כִּ֚י אָמַ֣ר דָּוִ֔יד הֵנִ֛יחַ יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֵֽי יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל לְ/עַמּ֑/וֹ וַ/יִּשְׁכֹּ֥ן בִּ/ירוּשָׁלִַ֖ם עַד לְ/עוֹלָֽם
verses.translit: khy 'mr dvyd hnych yhvh 'lhy yshr'l l'mv vyshkhn byrvshlm 'd l'vlm
verses.translation: For David said, The LORD God of Israel hath given rest unto his people, that they may dwell in Jerusalem for ever:

verses.original: וְ/גַ֖ם לַ/לְוִיִּ֑ם אֵין לָ/שֵׂ֧את אֶת הַ/מִּשְׁכָּ֛ן וְ/אֶת כָּל כֵּלָ֖י/ו לַ/עֲבֹדָתֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: vgm llvym 'yn lsh't 't hmshkhn v't khl khlyv l'bdtv
verses.translation: And also unto the Levites; they shall no more carry the tabernacle, nor any vessels of it for the service thereof.

verses.original: כִּ֣י בְ/דִבְרֵ֤י דָוִיד֙ הָ/אַ֣חֲרֹנִ֔ים הֵ֖מָּה מִסְפַּ֣ר בְּנֵי לֵוִ֑י מִ/בֶּ֛ן עֶשְׂרִ֥ים שָׁנָ֖ה וּ/לְ/מָֽעְלָ/ה
verses.translit: khy bdbry dvyd h'chrnym hmh mspr bny lvy mbn 'shrym shnh vlm'lh
verses.translation: For by the last words of David the Levites were numbered from twenty years old and above:

verses.original: כִּ֣י מַעֲמָדָ֞/ם לְ/יַד בְּנֵ֣י אַהֲרֹ֗ן לַ/עֲבֹדַת֙ בֵּ֣ית יְהוָ֔ה עַל הַ/חֲצֵרוֹת֙ וְ/עַל הַ/לְּשָׁכ֔וֹת וְ/עַֽל טָהֳרַ֖ת לְ/כָל קֹ֑דֶשׁ וּ/מַֽעֲשֵׂ֔ה עֲבֹדַ֖ת בֵּ֥ית הָ/אֱלֹהִֽים
verses.translit: khy m'mdm lyd bny 'hrn l'bdt byt yhvh 'l hchtsrvt v'l hlshkhvt v'l thrt lkhl qdsh vm'shh 'bdt byt h'lhym
verses.translation: Because their office was to wait on the sons of Aaron for the service of the house of the LORD , in the courts, and in the chambers, and in the purifying of all holy things, and the work of the service of the house of God;

verses.original: וּ/לְ/לֶ֨חֶם הַֽ/מַּעֲרֶ֜כֶת וּ/לְ/סֹ֤לֶת לְ/מִנְחָה֙ וְ/לִ/רְקִיקֵ֣י הַ/מַּצּ֔וֹת וְ/לַֽ/מַּחֲבַ֖ת וְ/לַ/מֻּרְבָּ֑כֶת וּ/לְ/כָל מְשׂוּרָ֖ה וּ/מִדָּֽה
verses.translit: vllchm hm'rkht vlslt lmnchh vlrqyqy hmtsvt vlmchbt vlmrbkht vlkhl mshvrh vmdh
verses.translation: Both for the shewbread, and for the fine flour for meat offering, and for the unleavened cakes, and for that which is baked in the pan, and for that which is fried, and for all manner of measure and size;

verses.original: וְ/לַ/עֲמֹד֙ בַּ/בֹּ֣קֶר בַּ/בֹּ֔קֶר לְ/הֹד֥וֹת וּ/לְ/הַלֵּ֖ל לַ/יהוָ֑ה וְ/כֵ֖ן לָ/עָֽרֶב
verses.translit: vl'md bbqr bbqr lhdvt vlhll lyhvh vkhn l'rb
verses.translation: And to stand every morning to thank and praise the LORD , and likewise at even;

verses.original: וּ/לְ/כֹ֨ל הַעֲל֤וֹת עֹלוֹת֙ לַ/יהוָ֔ה לַ/שַּׁבָּת֔וֹת לֶ/חֳדָשִׁ֖ים וְ/לַ/מֹּעֲדִ֑ים בְּ/מִסְפָּ֨ר כְּ/מִשְׁפָּ֧ט עֲלֵי/הֶ֛ם תָּמִ֖יד לִ/פְנֵ֥י יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: vlkhl h'lvt 'lvt lyhvh lshbtvt lchdshym vlm'dym bmspr khmshpt 'lyhm tmyd lpny yhvh
verses.translation: And to offer all burnt sacrifices unto the LORD in the sabbaths, in the new moons, and on the set feasts, by number, according to the order commanded unto them, continually before the LORD :

verses.original: וְ/שָׁמְר֞וּ אֶת מִשְׁמֶ֣רֶת אֹֽהֶל מוֹעֵ֗ד וְ/אֵת֙ מִשְׁמֶ֣רֶת הַ/קֹּ֔דֶשׁ וּ/מִשְׁמֶ֕רֶת בְּנֵ֥י אַהֲרֹ֖ן אֲחֵי/הֶ֑ם לַ/עֲבֹדַ֖ת בֵּ֥ית יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: vshmrv 't mshmrt 'hl mv'd v't mshmrt hqdsh vmshmrt bny 'hrn 'chyhm l'bdt byt yhvh
verses.translation: And that they should keep the charge of the tabernacle of the congregation, and the charge of the holy place , and the charge of the sons of Aaron their brethren, in the service of the house of the LORD .

verses.original: וְ/לִ/בְנֵ֥י אַהֲרֹ֖ן מַחְלְקוֹתָ֑/ם בְּנֵ֣י אַהֲרֹ֔ן נָדָב֙ וַ/אֲבִיה֔וּא אֶלְעָזָ֖ר וְ/אִיתָמָֽר
verses.translit: vlbny 'hrn mchlqvtm bny 'hrn ndb v'byhv' 'l'zr v'ytmr
verses.translation: Now these are the divisions of the sons of Aaron. The sons of Aaron; Nadab, and Abihu, Eleazar, and Ithamar.

verses.original: וַ/יָּ֨מָת נָדָ֤ב וַ/אֲבִיהוּא֙ לִ/פְנֵ֣י אֲבִי/הֶ֔ם וּ/בָנִ֖ים לֹא הָי֣וּ לָ/הֶ֑ם וַֽ/יְכַהֲנ֔וּ אֶלְעָזָ֖ר וְ/אִיתָמָֽר
verses.translit: vymt ndb v'byhv' lpny 'byhm vbnym l' hyv lhm vykhhnv 'l'zr v'ytmr
verses.translation: But Nadab and Abihu died before their father, and had no children: therefore Eleazar and Ithamar executed the priest’s office.

verses.original: וַ/יֶּֽחָלְקֵ֣/ם דָּוִ֔יד וְ/צָדוֹק֙ מִן בְּנֵ֣י אֶלְעָזָ֔ר וַ/אֲחִימֶ֖לֶךְ מִן בְּנֵ֣י אִיתָמָ֑ר לִ/פְקֻדָּתָ֖/ם בַּ/עֲבֹדָתָֽ/ם
verses.translit: vychlqm dvyd vtsdvq mn bny 'l'zr v'chymlkh mn bny 'ytmr lpqdtm b'bdtm
verses.translation: And David distributed them, both Zadok of the sons of Eleazar, and Ahimelech of the sons of Ithamar, according to their offices in their service.

verses.original: וַ/יִּמָּצְא֣וּ בְֽנֵי אֶלְעָזָ֡ר רַבִּ֞ים לְ/רָאשֵׁ֧י הַ/גְּבָרִ֛ים מִן בְּנֵ֥י אִיתָמָ֖ר וַֽ/יַּחְלְק֑וּ/ם לִ/בְנֵ֨י אֶלְעָזָ֜ר רָאשִׁ֤ים לְ/בֵית אָבוֹת֙ שִׁשָּׁ֣ה עָשָׂ֔ר וְ/לִ/בְנֵ֧י אִיתָמָ֛ר לְ/בֵ֥ית אֲבוֹתָ֖/ם שְׁמוֹנָֽה
verses.translit: vymts'v bny 'l'zr rbym lr'shy hgbrym mn bny 'ytmr vychlqvm lbny 'l'zr r'shym lbyt 'bvt shshh 'shr vlbny 'ytmr lbyt 'bvtm shmvnh
verses.translation: And there were more chief men found of the sons of Eleazar than of the sons of Ithamar; and thus were they divided. Among the sons of Eleazar there were sixteen chief men of the house of their fathers, and eight among the sons of Ithamar according to the house of their fathers.

verses.original: וַ/יַּחְלְק֥וּ/ם בְּ/גוֹרָל֖וֹת אֵ֣לֶּה עִם אֵ֑לֶּה כִּי הָי֤וּ שָֽׂרֵי קֹ֨דֶשׁ֙ וְ/שָׂרֵ֣י הָ/אֱלֹהִ֔ים מִ/בְּנֵ֥י אֶלְעָזָ֖ר וּ/בִ/בְנֵ֥י אִיתָמָֽר
verses.translit: vychlqvm bgvrlvt 'lh 'm 'lh khy hyv shry qdsh vshry h'lhym mbny 'l'zr vbbny 'ytmr
verses.translation: Thus were they divided by lot, one sort with another; for the governors of the sanctuary, and governors of the house of God, were of the sons of Eleazar, and of the sons of Ithamar.

verses.original: וַֽ/יִּכְתְּבֵ֡/ם שְֽׁמַֽעְיָה֩ בֶן נְתַנְאֵ֨ל הַ/סּוֹפֵ֜ר מִן הַ/לֵּוִ֗י לִ/פְנֵ֨י הַ/מֶּ֤לֶךְ וְ/הַ/שָּׂרִים֙ וְ/צָד֣וֹק הַ/כֹּהֵ֗ן וַ/אֲחִימֶ֨לֶךְ֙ בֶּן אֶבְיָתָ֔ר וְ/רָאשֵׁי֙ הָֽ/אָב֔וֹת לַ/כֹּהֲנִ֖ים וְ/לַ/לְוִיִּ֑ם בֵּֽית אָ֣ב אֶחָ֗ד אָחֻז֙ לְ/אֶלְעָזָ֔ר וְ/אָחֻ֥ז אָחֻ֖ז לְ/אִיתָמָֽר
verses.translit: vykhtbm shm'yh bn ntn'l hsvpr mn hlvy lpny hmlkh vhshrym vtsdvq hkhhn v'chymlkh bn 'bytr vr'shy h'bvt lkhhnym vllvym byt 'b 'chd 'chz l'l'zr v'chz 'chz l'ytmr
verses.translation: And Shemaiah the son of Nethaneel the scribe, one of the Levites, wrote them before the king, and the princes, and Zadok the priest, and Ahimelech the son of Abiathar, and before the chief of the fathers of the priests and Levites: one principal household being taken for Eleazar, and one taken for Ithamar.

verses.original: וַ/יֵּצֵ֞א הַ/גּוֹרָ֤ל הָ/רִאשׁוֹן֙ לִ/יה֣וֹיָרִ֔יב לִֽ/ידַעְיָ֖ה הַ/שֵּׁנִֽי
verses.translit: vyts' hgvrl hr'shvn lyhvyryb lyd'yh hshny
verses.translation: Now the first lot came forth to Jehoiarib, the second to Jedaiah,

verses.original: לְ/חָרִם֙ הַ/שְּׁלִישִׁ֔י לִ/שְׂעֹרִ֖ים הָ/רְבִעִֽי
verses.translit: lchrm hshlyshy lsh'rym hrb'y
verses.translation: The third to Harim, the fourth to Seorim,

verses.translit: lmlkhyh hchmyshy lmymn hshshy
verses.translation: The fifth to Malchijah, the sixth to Mijamin,

verses.original: לְ/הַקּוֹץ֙ הַ/שְּׁבִעִ֔י לַ/אֲבִיָּ֖ה הַ/שְּׁמִינִֽי
verses.translit: lhqvts hshb'y l'byh hshmyny
verses.translation: The seventh to Hakkoz, the eighth to Abijah,

verses.original: לְ/יֵשׁ֨וּעַ֙ הַ/תְּשִׁעִ֔י לִ/שְׁכַנְיָ֖הוּ הָ/עֲשִׂרִֽי
verses.translit: lyshv' htsh'y lshkhnyhv h'shry
verses.translation: The ninth to Jeshua, the tenth to Shecaniah,

verses.original: לְ/אֶלְיָשִׁיב֙ עַשְׁתֵּ֣י עָשָׂ֔ר לְ/יָקִ֖ים שְׁנֵ֥ים עָשָֽׂר
verses.translit: l'lyshyb 'shty 'shr lyqym shnym 'shr
verses.translation: The eleventh to Eliashib, the twelfth to Jakim,

verses.original: לְ/חֻפָּה֙ שְׁלֹשָׁ֣ה עָשָׂ֔ר לְ/יֶֽשֶׁבְאָ֖ב אַרְבָּעָ֥ה עָשָֽׂר
verses.translit: lchph shlshh 'shr lyshb'b 'rb'h 'shr
verses.translation: The thirteenth to Huppah, the fourteenth to Jeshebeab,

verses.original: לְ/בִלְגָּה֙ חֲמִשָּׁ֣ה עָשָׂ֔ר לְ/אִמֵּ֖ר שִׁשָּׁ֥ה עָשָֽׂר
verses.translit: lblgh chmshh 'shr l'mr shshh 'shr
verses.translation: The fifteenth to Bilgah, the sixteenth to Immer,

verses.original: לְ/חֵזִיר֙ שִׁבְעָ֣ה עָשָׂ֔ר לְ/הַ/פִּצֵּ֖ץ שְׁמוֹנָ֥ה עָשָֽׂר
verses.translit: lchzyr shb'h 'shr lhptsts shmvnh 'shr
verses.translation: The seventeenth to Hezir, the eighteenth to Aphses,

verses.original: לִֽ/פְתַחְיָה֙ תִּשְׁעָ֣ה עָשָׂ֔ר לִֽ/יחֶזְקֵ֖אל הָ/עֶשְׂרִֽים
verses.translit: lptchyh tsh'h 'shr lychzq'l h'shrym
verses.translation: The nineteenth to Pethahiah, the twentieth to Jehezekel,

verses.original: לְ/יָכִין֙ אֶחָ֣ד וְ/עֶשְׂרִ֔ים לְ/גָמ֖וּל שְׁנַ֥יִם וְ/עֶשְׂרִֽים
verses.translit: lykhyn 'chd v'shrym lgmvl shnym v'shrym
verses.translation: The one and twentieth to Jachin, the two and twentieth to Gamul,

verses.original: לִ/דְלָיָ֨הוּ֙ שְׁלֹשָׁ֣ה וְ/עֶשְׂרִ֔ים לְ/מַֽעַזְיָ֖הוּ אַרְבָּעָ֥ה וְ/עֶשְׂרִֽים
verses.translit: ldlyhv shlshh v'shrym lm'zyhv 'rb'h v'shrym
verses.translation: The three and twentieth to Delaiah, the four and twentieth to Maaziah.

verses.original: אֵ֣לֶּה פְקֻדָּתָ֞/ם לַ/עֲבֹדָתָ֗/ם לָ/ב֤וֹא לְ/בֵית יְהוָה֙ כְּ/מִשְׁפָּטָ֔/ם בְּ/יַ֖ד אַהֲרֹ֣ן אֲבִי/הֶ֑ם כַּ/אֲשֶׁ֣ר צִוָּ֔/הוּ יְהוָ֖ה אֱלֹהֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל
verses.translit: 'lh pqdtm l'bdtm lbv' lbyt yhvh khmshptm byd 'hrn 'byhm kh'shr tsvhv yhvh 'lhy yshr'l
verses.translation: These were the orderings of them in their service to come into the house of the LORD , according to their manner, under Aaron their father, as the LORD God of Israel had commanded him.

verses.original: וְ/לִ/בְנֵ֥י לֵוִ֖י הַ/נּוֹתָרִ֑ים לִ/בְנֵ֤י עַמְרָם֙ שֽׁוּבָאֵ֔ל לִ/בְנֵ֥י שׁוּבָאֵ֖ל יֶחְדְּיָֽהוּ
verses.translit: vlbny lvy hnvtrym lbny 'mrm shvb'l lbny shvb'l ychdyhv
verses.translation: And the rest of the sons of Levi were these: Of the sons of Amram; Shubael: of the sons of Shubael; Jehdeiah.

verses.original: לִ/רְחַבְיָ֑הוּ לִ/בְנֵ֣י רְחַבְיָ֔הוּ הָ/רֹ֖אשׁ יִשִּׁיָּֽה
verses.translit: lrchbyhv lbny rchbyhv hr'sh yshyh
verses.translation: Concerning Rehabiah: of the sons of Rehabiah, the first was Isshiah.

verses.original: לַ/יִּצְהָרִ֣י שְׁלֹמ֔וֹת לִ/בְנֵ֥י שְׁלֹמ֖וֹת יָֽחַת
verses.translit: lytshry shlmvt lbny shlmvt ycht
verses.translation: Of the Izharites; Shelomoth: of the sons of Shelomoth; Jahath.

verses.original: וּ/בְנָ֖י יְרִיָּ֑הוּ אֲמַרְיָ֨הוּ֙ הַ/שֵּׁנִ֔י יַחֲזִיאֵל֙ הַ/שְּׁלִישִׁ֔י יְקַמְעָ֖ם הָ/רְבִיעִֽי
verses.translit: vbny yryhv 'mryhv hshny ychzy'l hshlyshy yqm'm hrby'y
verses.translation: And the sons of Hebron; Jeriah the first , Amariah the second, Jahaziel the third, Jekameam the fourth.

verses.original: בְּנֵ֤י עֻזִּיאֵל֙ מִיכָ֔ה לִ/בְנֵ֥י מִיכָ֖ה שמור שָׁמִֽיר
verses.translit: bny 'zy'l mykhh lbny mykhh shmvr shmyr
verses.translation: Of the sons of Uzziel; Michah: of the sons of Michah; Shamir.

verses.original: אֲחִ֤י מִיכָה֙ יִשִּׁיָּ֔ה לִ/בְנֵ֥י יִשִּׁיָּ֖ה זְכַרְיָֽהוּ
verses.translit: 'chy mykhh yshyh lbny yshyh zkhryhv
verses.translation: The brother of Michah was Isshiah: of the sons of Isshiah; Zechariah.

verses.original: בְּנֵ֤י מְרָרִי֙ מַחְלִ֣י וּ/מוּשִׁ֔י בְּנֵ֖י יַעֲזִיָּ֥הֽוּ בְנֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: bny mrry mchly vmvshy bny y'zyhv bnv
verses.translation: The sons of Merari were Mahli and Mushi: the sons of Jaaziah; Beno.

verses.original: בְּנֵ֖י מְרָרִ֑י לְ/יַֽעֲזִיָּ֣הֽוּ בְנ֔/וֹ וְ/שֹׁ֥הַם וְ/זַכּ֖וּר וְ/עִבְרִֽי
verses.translit: bny mrry ly'zyhv bnv vshhm vzkhvr v'bry
verses.translation: The sons of Merari by Jaaziah; Beno, and Shoham, and Zaccur, and Ibri.

verses.original: לְ/מַחְלִי֙ אֶלְעָזָ֔ר וְ/לֹא הָ֥יָה ל֖/וֹ בָּנִֽים
verses.translit: lmchly 'l'zr vl' hyh lv bnym
verses.translation: Of Mahli came Eleazar, who had no sons.

verses.original: לְ/קִ֖ישׁ בְּנֵי קִ֥ישׁ יְרַחְמְאֵֽל
verses.translit: lqysh bny qysh yrchm'l
verses.translation: Concerning Kish: the son of Kish was Jerahmeel.

verses.original: וּ/בְנֵ֣י מוּשִׁ֔י מַחְלִ֥י וְ/עֵ֖דֶר וִ/ירִימ֑וֹת אֵ֛לֶּה בְּנֵ֥י הַ/לְוִיִּ֖ם לְ/בֵ֥ית אֲבֹתֵי/הֶֽם
verses.translit: vbny mvshy mchly v'dr vyrymvt 'lh bny hlvym lbyt 'btyhm
verses.translation: The sons also of Mushi; Mahli, and Eder, and Jerimoth. These were the sons of the Levites after the house of their fathers.

verses.original: וַ/יַּפִּילוּ֩ גַם הֵ֨ם גּוֹרָל֜וֹת לְ/עֻמַּ֣ת אֲחֵי/הֶ֣ם בְּנֵֽי אַהֲרֹ֗ן לִ/פְנֵ֨י דָוִ֤יד הַ/מֶּ֨לֶךְ֙ וְ/צָד֣וֹק וַ/אֲחִימֶ֔לֶךְ וְ/רָאשֵׁי֙ הָֽ/אָב֔וֹת לַ/כֹּהֲנִ֖ים וְ/לַ/לְוִיִּ֑ם אָב֣וֹת הָ/רֹ֔אשׁ לְ/עֻמַּ֖ת אָחִ֥י/ו הַ/קָּטָֽן
verses.translit: vypylv gm hm gvrlvt l'mt 'chyhm bny 'hrn lpny dvyd hmlkh vtsdvq v'chymlkh vr'shy h'bvt lkhhnym vllvym 'bvt hr'sh l'mt 'chyv hqtn
verses.translation: These likewise cast lots over against their brethren the sons of Aaron in the presence of David the king, and Zadok, and Ahimelech, and the chief of the fathers of the priests and Levites, even the principal fathers over against their younger brethren.

verses.original: וַ/יַּבְדֵּ֣ל דָּוִיד֩ וְ/שָׂרֵ֨י הַ/צָּבָ֜א לַ/עֲבֹדָ֗ה לִ/בְנֵ֤י אָסָף֙ וְ/הֵימָ֣ן וִֽ/ידוּת֔וּן ה/נביאים הַֽ/נִּבְּאִ֛ים בְּ/כִנֹּר֥וֹת בִּ/נְבָלִ֖ים וּ/בִ/מְצִלְתָּ֑יִם וַֽ/יְהִי֙ מִסְפָּרָ֔/ם אַנְשֵׁ֥י מְלָאכָ֖ה לַ/עֲבֹדָתָֽ/ם
verses.translit: vybdl dvyd vshry htsb' l'bdh lbny 'sf vhymn vydvtvn hnby'ym hnb'ym bkhnrvt bnblym vbmtsltym vyhy msprm 'nshy ml'khh l'bdtm
verses.translation: Moreover David and the captains of the host separated to the service of the sons of Asaph, and of Heman, and of Jeduthun, who should prophesy with harps, with psalteries, and with cymbals: and the number of the workmen according to their service was:

verses.original: לִ/בְנֵ֣י אָסָ֗ף זַכּ֧וּר וְ/יוֹסֵ֛ף וּ/נְתַנְיָ֥ה וַ/אֲשַׂרְאֵ֖לָה בְּנֵ֣י אָסָ֑ף עַ֚ל יַד אָסָ֔ף הַ/נִּבָּ֖א עַל יְדֵ֥י הַ/מֶּֽלֶךְ
verses.translit: lbny 'sf zkhvr vyvsf vntnyh v'shr'lh bny 'sf 'l yd 'sf hnb' 'l ydy hmlkh
verses.translation: Of the sons of Asaph; Zaccur, and Joseph, and Nethaniah, and Asarelah, the sons of Asaph under the hands of Asaph, which prophesied according to the order of the king.

verses.original: לִ/ידוּת֑וּן בְּנֵ֣י יְדוּת֡וּן גְּדַלְיָ֡הוּ וּ/צְרִ֡י וִֽ֠/ישַׁעְיָהוּ חֲשַׁבְיָ֨הוּ וּ/מַתִּתְיָ֜הוּ שִׁשָּׁ֗ה עַל֩ יְדֵ֨י אֲבִי/הֶ֤ם יְדוּתוּן֙ בַּ/כִּנּ֔וֹר הַ/נִּבָּ֕א עַל הֹד֥וֹת וְ/הַלֵּ֖ל לַ/יהוָֽה
verses.translit: lydvtvn bny ydvtvn gdlyhv vtsry vysh'yhv chshbyhv vmttyhv shshh 'l ydy 'byhm ydvtvn bkhnvr hnb' 'l hdvt vhll lyhvh
verses.translation: Of Jeduthun: the sons of Jeduthun; Gedaliah, and Zeri, and Jeshaiah, Hashabiah, and Mattithiah, six, under the hands of their father Jeduthun, who prophesied with a harp, to give thanks and to praise the LORD .

verses.original: לְ/הֵימָ֑ן בְּנֵ֣י הֵימָ֡ן בֻּקִּיָּ֡הוּ מַתַּנְיָ֡הוּ עֻ֠זִּיאֵל שְׁבוּאֵ֨ל וִֽ/ירִימ֜וֹת חֲנַנְיָ֣ה חֲנָ֗נִי אֱלִיאָ֤תָה גִדַּ֨לְתִּי֙ וְ/רֹמַ֣מְתִּי עֶ֔זֶר יָשְׁבְּקָ֣שָׁה מַלּ֔וֹתִי הוֹתִ֖יר מַחֲזִיאֽוֹת
verses.translit: lhymn bny hymn bqyhv mtnyhv 'zy'l shbv'l vyrymvt chnnyh chnny 'ly'th gdlty vrmmty 'zr yshbqshh mlvty hvtyr mchzy'vt
verses.translation: Of Heman: the sons of Heman; Bukkiah, Mattaniah, Uzziel, Shebuel, and Jerimoth, Hananiah, Hanani, Eliathah, Giddalti, and Romamti-ezer, Joshbekashah, Mallothi, Hothir, and Mahazioth:

verses.original: כָּל אֵ֨לֶּה בָנִ֜ים לְ/הֵימָ֗ן חֹזֵ֥ה הַ/מֶּ֛לֶךְ בְּ/דִבְרֵ֥י הָ/אֱלֹהִ֖ים לְ/הָרִ֣ים קָ֑רֶן וַ/יִּתֵּ֨ן הָ/אֱלֹהִ֜ים לְ/הֵימָ֗ן בָּנִ֛ים אַרְבָּעָ֥ה עָשָׂ֖ר וּ/בָנ֥וֹת שָׁלֽוֹשׁ
verses.translit: khl 'lh bnym lhymn chzh hmlkh bdbry h'lhym lhrym qrn vytn h'lhym lhymn bnym 'rb'h 'shr vbnvt shlvsh
verses.translation: All these were the sons of Heman the king’s seer in the words of God, to lift up the horn. And God gave to Heman fourteen sons and three daughters.

verses.original: כָּל אֵ֣לֶּה עַל יְדֵי֩ אֲבִי/הֶ֨ם בַּ/שִּׁ֜יר בֵּ֣ית יְהוָ֗ה בִּ/מְצִלְתַּ֨יִם֙ נְבָלִ֣ים וְ/כִנֹּר֔וֹת לַ/עֲבֹדַ֖ת בֵּ֣ית הָ/אֱלֹהִ֑ים עַ֚ל יְדֵ֣י הַ/מֶּ֔לֶךְ אָסָ֥ף וִ/ידוּת֖וּן וְ/הֵימָֽן
verses.translit: khl 'lh 'l ydy 'byhm bshyr byt yhvh bmtsltym nblym vkhnrvt l'bdt byt h'lhym 'l ydy hmlkh 'sf vydvtvn vhymn
verses.translation: All these were under the hands of their father for song in the house of the LORD , with cymbals, psalteries, and harps, for the service of the house of God, according to the king’s order to Asaph, Jeduthun, and Heman.

verses.original: וַ/יְהִ֤י מִסְפָּרָ/ם֙ עִם אֲחֵי/הֶ֔ם מְלֻמְּדֵי שִׁ֖יר לַ/יהוָ֑ה כָּל הַ֨/מֵּבִ֔ין מָאתַ֖יִם שְׁמוֹנִ֥ים וּ/שְׁמוֹנָֽה
verses.translit: vyhy msprm 'm 'chyhm mlmdy shyr lyhvh khl hmbyn m'tym shmvnym vshmvnh
verses.translation: So the number of them, with their brethren that were instructed in the songs of the LORD , even all that were cunning, was two hundred fourscore and eight.

verses.original: וַ/יַּפִּ֜ילוּ גּוֹרָל֣וֹת מִשְׁמֶ֗רֶת לְ/עֻמַּת֙ כַּ/קָּטֹ֣ן כַּ/גָּד֔וֹל מֵבִ֖ין עִם תַּלְמִֽיד
verses.translit: vypylv gvrlvt mshmrt l'mt khqtn khgdvl mbyn 'm tlmyd
verses.translation: And they cast lots, ward against ward , as well the small as the great, the teacher as the scholar.

verses.original: וַ/יֵּצֵ֞א הַ/גּוֹרָ֧ל הָ/רִאשׁ֛וֹן לְ/אָסָ֖ף לְ/יוֹסֵ֑ף גְּדַלְיָ֨הוּ֙ הַ/שֵּׁנִ֔י הֽוּא וְ/אֶחָ֥י/ו וּ/בָנָ֖י/ו שְׁנֵ֥ים עָשָֽׂר
verses.translit: vyts' hgvrl hr'shvn l'sf lyvsf gdlyhv hshny hv' v'chyv vbnyv shnym 'shr
verses.translation: Now the first lot came forth for Asaph to Joseph: the second to Gedaliah, who with his brethren and sons were twelve:

verses.original: הַ/שְּׁלִשִׁ֣י זַכּ֔וּר בָּנָ֥י/ו וְ/אֶחָ֖י/ו שְׁנֵ֥ים עָשָֽׂר
verses.translit: hshlshy zkhvr bnyv v'chyv shnym 'shr
verses.translation: The third to Zaccur, he , his sons, and his brethren, were twelve:

verses.original: הָ/רְבִיעִי֙ לַ/יִּצְרִ֔י בָּנָ֥י/ו וְ/אֶחָ֖י/ו שְׁנֵ֥ים עָשָֽׂר
verses.translit: hrby'y lytsry bnyv v'chyv shnym 'shr
verses.translation: The fourth to Izri, he , his sons, and his brethren, were twelve:

verses.original: הַ/חֲמִישִׁ֣י נְתַנְיָ֔הוּ בָּנָ֥י/ו וְ/אֶחָ֖י/ו שְׁנֵ֥ים עָשָֽׂר
verses.translit: hchmyshy ntnyhv bnyv v'chyv shnym 'shr
verses.translation: The fifth to Nethaniah, he , his sons, and his brethren, were twelve:

verses.original: הַ/שִּׁשִּׁ֣י בֻקִּיָּ֔הוּ בָּנָ֥י/ו וְ/אֶחָ֖י/ו שְׁנֵ֥ים עָשָֽׂר
verses.translit: hshshy bqyhv bnyv v'chyv shnym 'shr
verses.translation: The sixth to Bukkiah, he , his sons, and his brethren, were twelve:

verses.original: הַ/שְּׁבִעִ֣י יְשַׂרְאֵ֔לָה בָּנָ֥י/ו וְ/אֶחָ֖י/ו שְׁנֵ֥ים עָשָֽׂר
verses.translit: hshb'y yshr'lh bnyv v'chyv shnym 'shr
verses.translation: The seventh to Jesharelah, he , his sons, and his brethren, were twelve:

verses.original: הַ/שְּׁמִינִ֣י יְשַֽׁעְיָ֔הוּ בָּנָ֥י/ו וְ/אֶחָ֖י/ו שְׁנֵ֥ים עָשָֽׂר
verses.translit: hshmyny ysh'yhv bnyv v'chyv shnym 'shr
verses.translation: The eighth to Jeshaiah, he , his sons, and his brethren, were twelve:

verses.original: הַ/תְּשִׁיעִ֣י מַתַּנְיָ֔הוּ בָּנָ֥י/ו וְ/אֶחָ֖י/ו שְׁנֵ֥ים עָשָֽׂר
verses.translit: htshy'y mtnyhv bnyv v'chyv shnym 'shr
verses.translation: The ninth to Mattaniah, he , his sons, and his brethren, were twelve:

verses.original: הָ/עֲשִׂירִ֣י שִׁמְעִ֔י בָּנָ֥י/ו וְ/אֶחָ֖י/ו שְׁנֵ֥ים עָשָֽׂר
verses.translit: h'shyry shm'y bnyv v'chyv shnym 'shr
verses.translation: The tenth to Shimei, he , his sons, and his brethren, were twelve:

verses.original: עַשְׁתֵּֽי עָשָׂ֣ר עֲזַרְאֵ֔ל בָּנָ֥י/ו וְ/אֶחָ֖י/ו שְׁנֵ֥ים עָשָֽׂר
verses.translit: 'shty 'shr 'zr'l bnyv v'chyv shnym 'shr
verses.translation: The eleventh to Azareel, he , his sons, and his brethren, were twelve:

verses.original: הַ/שְּׁנֵ֤ים עָשָׂר֙ לַ/חֲשַׁבְיָ֔ה בָּנָ֥י/ו וְ/אֶחָ֖י/ו שְׁנֵ֥ים עָשָֽׂר
verses.translit: hshnym 'shr lchshbyh bnyv v'chyv shnym 'shr
verses.translation: The twelfth to Hashabiah, he , his sons, and his brethren, were twelve:

verses.original: לִ/שְׁלֹשָׁ֤ה עָשָׂר֙ שֽׁוּבָאֵ֔ל בָּנָ֥י/ו וְ/אֶחָ֖י/ו שְׁנֵ֥ים עָשָֽׂר
verses.translit: lshlshh 'shr shvb'l bnyv v'chyv shnym 'shr
verses.translation: The thirteenth to Shubael, he , his sons, and his brethren, were twelve:

verses.original: לְ/אַרְבָּעָ֤ה עָשָׂר֙ מַתִּתְיָ֔הוּ בָּנָ֥י/ו וְ/אֶחָ֖י/ו שְׁנֵ֥ים עָשָֽׂר
verses.translit: l'rb'h 'shr mttyhv bnyv v'chyv shnym 'shr
verses.translation: The fourteenth to Mattithiah, he , his sons, and his brethren, were twelve:

verses.original: לַ/חֲמִשָּׁ֤ה עָשָׂר֙ לִֽ/ירֵמ֔וֹת בָּנָ֥י/ו וְ/אֶחָ֖י/ו שְׁנֵ֥ים עָשָֽׂר
verses.translit: lchmshh 'shr lyrmvt bnyv v'chyv shnym 'shr
verses.translation: The fifteenth to Jeremoth, he , his sons, and his brethren, were twelve:

verses.original: לְ/שִׁשָּׁ֤ה עָשָׂר֙ לַ/חֲנַנְיָ֔הוּ בָּנָ֥י/ו וְ/אֶחָ֖י/ו שְׁנֵ֥ים עָשָֽׂר
verses.translit: lshshh 'shr lchnnyhv bnyv v'chyv shnym 'shr
verses.translation: The sixteenth to Hananiah, he , his sons, and his brethren, were twelve:

verses.original: לְ/שִׁבְעָ֤ה עָשָׂר֙ לְ/יָשְׁבְּקָ֔שָׁה בָּנָ֥י/ו וְ/אֶחָ֖י/ו שְׁנֵ֥ים עָשָֽׂר
verses.translit: lshb'h 'shr lyshbqshh bnyv v'chyv shnym 'shr
verses.translation: The seventeenth to Joshbekashah, he , his sons, and his brethren, were twelve:

verses.original: לִ/שְׁמוֹנָ֤ה עָשָׂר֙ לַ/חֲנָ֔נִי בָּנָ֥י/ו וְ/אֶחָ֖י/ו שְׁנֵ֥ים עָשָֽׂר
verses.translit: lshmvnh 'shr lchnny bnyv v'chyv shnym 'shr
verses.translation: The eighteenth to Hanani, he , his sons, and his brethren, were twelve:

verses.original: לְ/תִשְׁעָ֤ה עָשָׂר֙ לְ/מַלּ֔וֹתִי בָּנָ֥י/ו וְ/אֶחָ֖י/ו שְׁנֵ֥ים עָשָֽׂר
verses.translit: ltsh'h 'shr lmlvty bnyv v'chyv shnym 'shr
verses.translation: The nineteenth to Mallothi, he , his sons, and his brethren, were twelve:

verses.original: לְ/עֶשְׂרִים֙ לֶֽ/אֱלִיָּ֔תָה בָּנָ֥י/ו וְ/אֶחָ֖י/ו שְׁנֵ֥ים עָשָֽׂר
verses.translit: l'shrym l'lyth bnyv v'chyv shnym 'shr
verses.translation: The twentieth to Eliathah, he , his sons, and his brethren, were twelve:

verses.original: לְ/אֶחָ֤ד וְ/עֶשְׂרִים֙ לְ/הוֹתִ֔יר בָּנָ֥י/ו וְ/אֶחָ֖י/ו שְׁנֵ֥ים עָשָֽׂר
verses.translit: l'chd v'shrym lhvtyr bnyv v'chyv shnym 'shr
verses.translation: The one and twentieth to Hothir, he , his sons, and his brethren, were twelve:

verses.original: לִ/שְׁנַ֤יִם וְ/עֶשְׂרִים֙ לְ/גִדַּ֔לְתִּי בָּנָ֥י/ו וְ/אֶחָ֖י/ו שְׁנֵ֥ים עָשָֽׂר
verses.translit: lshnym v'shrym lgdlty bnyv v'chyv shnym 'shr
verses.translation: The two and twentieth to Giddalti, he , his sons, and his brethren, were twelve:

verses.original: לִ/שְׁלֹשָׁ֤ה וְ/עֶשְׂרִים֙ לְ/מַ֣חֲזִיא֔וֹת בָּנָ֥י/ו וְ/אֶחָ֖י/ו שְׁנֵ֥ים עָשָֽׂר
verses.translit: lshlshh v'shrym lmchzy'vt bnyv v'chyv shnym 'shr
verses.translation: The three and twentieth to Mahazioth, he , his sons, and his brethren, were twelve:

verses.original: לְ/אַרְבָּעָ֤ה וְ/עֶשְׂרִים֙ לְ/רוֹמַ֣מְתִּי עָ֔זֶר בָּנָ֥י/ו וְ/אֶחָ֖י/ו שְׁנֵ֥ים עָשָֽׂר
verses.translit: l'rb'h v'shrym lrvmmty 'zr bnyv v'chyv shnym 'shr
verses.translation: The four and twentieth to Romamti-ezer, he , his sons, and his brethren, were twelve.

verses.original: לְ/מַחְלְק֖וֹת לְ/שֹׁעֲרִ֑ים לַ/קָּרְחִ֕ים מְשֶֽׁלֶמְיָ֥הוּ בֶן קֹרֵ֖א מִן בְּנֵ֥י אָסָֽף
verses.translit: lmchlqvt lsh'rym lqrchym mshlmyhv bn qr' mn bny 'sf
verses.translation: Concerning the divisions of the porters: Of the Korhites was Meshelemiah the son of Kore, of the sons of Asaph.

verses.original: וְ/לִ/מְשֶֽׁלֶמְיָ֖הוּ בָּנִ֑ים זְכַרְיָ֤הוּ הַ/בְּכוֹר֙ יְדִֽיעֲאֵ֣ל הַ/שֵּׁנִ֔י זְבַדְיָ֨הוּ֙ הַ/שְּׁלִישִׁ֔י יַתְנִיאֵ֖ל הָ/רְבִיעִֽי
verses.translit: vlmshlmyhv bnym zkhryhv hbkhvr ydy''l hshny zbdyhv hshlyshy ytny'l hrby'y
verses.translation: And the sons of Meshelemiah were , Zechariah the firstborn, Jediael the second, Zebadiah the third, Jathniel the fourth,

verses.original: עֵילָ֤ם הַ/חֲמִישִׁי֙ יְהוֹחָנָ֣ן הַ/שִּׁשִּׁ֔י אֶלְיְהוֹעֵינַ֖י הַ/שְּׁבִיעִֽי
verses.translit: 'ylm hchmyshy yhvchnn hshshy 'lyhv'yny hshby'y
verses.translation: Elam the fifth, Jehohanan the sixth, Elioenai the seventh.

verses.original: וּ/לְ/עֹבֵ֥ד אֱדֹ֖ם בָּנִ֑ים שְׁמַֽעְיָ֤ה הַ/בְּכוֹר֙ יְהוֹזָבָ֣ד הַ/שֵּׁנִ֔י יוֹאָ֤ח הַ/שְּׁלִשִׁי֙ וְ/שָׂכָ֣ר הָ/רְבִיעִ֔י וּ/נְתַנְאֵ֖ל הַ/חֲמִישִֽׁי
verses.translit: vl'bd 'dm bnym shm'yh hbkhvr yhvzbd hshny yv'ch hshlshy vshkhr hrby'y vntn'l hchmyshy
verses.translation: Moreover the sons of Obed-edom were , Shemaiah the firstborn, Jehozabad the second, Joah the third, and Sacar the fourth, and Nethaneel the fifth,

verses.original: עַמִּיאֵ֤ל הַ/שִּׁשִּׁי֙ יִשָׂשכָ֣ר הַ/שְּׁבִיעִ֔י פְּעֻלְּתַ֖י הַ/שְּׁמִינִ֑י כִּ֥י בֵרֲכ֖/וֹ אֱלֹהִֽים
verses.translit: 'my'l hshshy yshshkhr hshby'y p'lty hshmyny khy brkhv 'lhym
verses.translation: Ammiel the sixth, Issachar the seventh, Peulthai the eighth: for God blessed him.

verses.original: וְ/לִֽ/שְׁמַֽעְיָ֤ה בְנ/וֹ֙ נוֹלַ֣ד בָּנִ֔ים הַ/מִּמְשָׁלִ֖ים לְ/בֵ֣ית אֲבִי/הֶ֑ם כִּֽי גִבּ֥וֹרֵי חַ֖יִל הֵֽמָּה
verses.translit: vlshm'yh bnv nvld bnym hmmshlym lbyt 'byhm khy gbvry chyl hmh
verses.translation: Also unto Shemaiah his son were sons born, that ruled throughout the house of their father: for they were mighty men of valour.

verses.original: בְּנֵ֣י שְׁמַֽעְיָ֗ה עָ֠תְנִי וּ/רְפָאֵ֨ל וְ/עוֹבֵ֧ד אֶלְזָבָ֛ד אֶחָ֖י/ו בְּנֵי חָ֑יִל אֱלִיה֖וּ וּ/סְמַכְיָֽהוּ
verses.translit: bny shm'yh 'tny vrp'l v'vbd 'lzbd 'chyv bny chyl 'lyhv vsmkhyhv
verses.translation: The sons of Shemaiah; Othni, and Rephael, and Obed, Elzabad, whose brethren were strong men, Elihu, and Semachiah.

verses.original: כָּל אֵ֜לֶּה מִ/בְּנֵ֣י עֹבֵ֣ד אֱדֹ֗ם הֵ֤מָּה וּ/בְנֵי/הֶם֙ וַ/אֲחֵי/הֶ֔ם אִֽישׁ חַ֥יִל בַּ/כֹּ֖חַ לַ/עֲבֹדָ֑ה שִׁשִּׁ֥ים וּ/שְׁנַ֖יִם לְ/עֹבֵ֥ד אֱדֹֽם
verses.translit: khl 'lh mbny 'bd 'dm hmh vbnyhm v'chyhm 'ysh chyl bkhch l'bdh shshym vshnym l'bd 'dm
verses.translation: All these of the sons of Obed-edom: they and their sons and their brethren, able men for strength for the service, were threescore and two of Obed-edom.

verses.original: וְ/לִ/מְשֶֽׁלֶמְיָ֗הוּ בָּנִ֧ים וְ/אַחִ֛ים בְּנֵי חָ֖יִל שְׁמוֹנָ֥ה עָשָֽׂר
verses.translit: vlmshlmyhv bnym v'chym bny chyl shmvnh 'shr
verses.translation: And Meshelemiah had sons and brethren, strong men, eighteen.

verses.original: וּ/לְ/חֹסָ֥ה מִן בְּנֵי מְרָרִ֖י בָּנִ֑ים שִׁמְרִ֤י הָ/רֹאשׁ֙ כִּ֣י לֹא הָיָ֣ה בְכ֔וֹר וַ/יְשִׂימֵ֥/הוּ אָבִ֖י/הוּ לְ/רֹֽאשׁ
verses.translit: vlchsh mn bny mrry bnym shmry hr'sh khy l' hyh bkhvr vyshymhv 'byhv lr'sh
verses.translation: Also Hosah, of the children of Merari, had sons; Simri the chief, (for though he was not the firstborn, yet his father made him the chief;)

verses.original: חִלְקִיָּ֤הוּ הַ/שֵּׁנִי֙ טְבַלְיָ֣הוּ הַ/שְּׁלִשִׁ֔י זְכַרְיָ֖הוּ הָ/רְבִעִ֑י כָּל בָּנִ֧ים וְ/אַחִ֛ים לְ/חֹסָ֖ה שְׁלֹשָׁ֥ה עָשָֽׂר
verses.translit: chlqyhv hshny tblyhv hshlshy zkhryhv hrb'y khl bnym v'chym lchsh shlshh 'shr
verses.translation: Hilkiah the second, Tebaliah the third, Zechariah the fourth: all the sons and brethren of Hosah were thirteen.

verses.original: לְ֠/אֵלֶּה מַחְלְק֨וֹת הַ/שֹּֽׁעֲרִ֜ים לְ/רָאשֵׁ֧י הַ/גְּבָרִ֛ים מִשְׁמָר֖וֹת לְ/עֻמַּ֣ת אֲחֵי/הֶ֑ם לְ/שָׁרֵ֖ת בְּ/בֵ֥ית יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: l'lh mchlqvt hsh'rym lr'shy hgbrym mshmrvt l'mt 'chyhm lshrt bbyt yhvh
verses.translation: Among these were the divisions of the porters, even among the chief men, having wards one against another, to minister in the house of the LORD .

verses.original: וַ/יַּפִּ֨ילוּ גוֹרָל֜וֹת כַּ/קָּטֹ֧ן כַּ/גָּד֛וֹל לְ/בֵ֥ית אֲבוֹתָ֖/ם לְ/שַׁ֥עַר וָ/שָֽׁעַר
verses.translit: vypylv gvrlvt khqtn khgdvl lbyt 'bvtm lsh'r vsh'r
verses.translation: And they cast lots, as well the small as the great, according to the house of their fathers, for every gate.

verses.original: וַ/יִּפֹּ֧ל הַ/גּוֹרָ֛ל מִזְרָ֖חָ/ה לְ/שֶֽׁלֶמְיָ֑הוּ וּ/זְכַרְיָ֨הוּ בְנ֜/וֹ יוֹעֵ֣ץ בְּ/שֶׂ֗כֶל הִפִּ֨ילוּ֙ גּֽוֹרָל֔וֹת וַ/יֵּצֵ֥א גוֹרָל֖/וֹ צָפֽוֹנָ/ה
verses.translit: vypl hgvrl mzrchh lshlmyhv vzkhryhv bnv yv'ts bshkhl hpylv gvrlvt vyts' gvrlv tspvnh
verses.translation: And the lot eastward fell to Shelemiah. Then for Zechariah his son, a wise counsellor, they cast lots; and his lot came out northward.

verses.original: לְ/עֹבֵ֥ד אֱדֹ֖ם נֶ֑גְבָּ/ה וּ/לְ/בָנָ֖י/ו בֵּ֥ית הָ/אֲסֻפִּֽים
verses.translit: l'bd 'dm ngbh vlbnyv byt h'spym
verses.translation: To Obed-edom southward; and to his sons the house of Asuppim.

verses.original: לְ/שֻׁפִּ֤ים וּ/לְ/חֹסָה֙ לַֽ/מַּעֲרָ֔ב עִ֚ם שַׁ֣עַר שַׁלֶּ֔כֶת בַּֽ/מְסִלָּ֖ה הָ/עוֹלָ֑ה מִשְׁמָ֖ר לְ/עֻמַּ֥ת מִשְׁמָֽר
verses.translit: lshpym vlchsh lm'rb 'm sh'r shlkht bmslh h'vlh mshmr l'mt mshmr
verses.translation: To Shuppim and Hosah the lot came forth westward, with the gate Shallecheth, by the causeway of the going up, ward against ward.

verses.original: לַ/מִּזְרָח֮ הַ/לְוִיִּ֣ם שִׁשָּׁה֒ לַ/צָּפ֤וֹנָ/ה לַ/יּוֹם֙ אַרְבָּעָ֔ה לַ/נֶּ֥גְבָּ/ה לַ/יּ֖וֹם אַרְבָּעָ֑ה וְ/לָ/אֲסֻפִּ֖ים שְׁנַ֥יִם שְׁנָֽיִם
verses.translit: lmzrch hlvym shshh ltspvnh lyvm 'rb'h lngbh lyvm 'rb'h vl'spym shnym shnym
verses.translation: Eastward were six Levites, northward four a day, southward four a day, and toward Asuppim two and two.

verses.original: לַ/פַּרְבָּ֖ר לַֽ/מַּעֲרָ֑ב אַרְבָּעָה֙ לַֽ/מְסִלָּ֔ה שְׁנַ֖יִם לַ/פַּרְבָּֽר
verses.translit: lprbr lm'rb 'rb'h lmslh shnym lprbr
verses.translation: At Parbar westward, four at the causeway, and two at Parbar.

verses.original: אֵ֗לֶּה מַחְלְקוֹת֙ הַ/שֹּׁ֣עֲרִ֔ים לִ/בְנֵ֥י הַ/קָּרְחִ֖י וְ/לִ/בְנֵ֥י מְרָרִֽי
verses.translit: 'lh mchlqvt hsh'rym lbny hqrchy vlbny mrry
verses.translation: These are the divisions of the porters among the sons of Kore, and among the sons of Merari.

verses.original: וְֽ/הַ/לְוִיִּ֑ם אֲחִיָּ֗ה עַל אֽוֹצְרוֹת֙ בֵּ֣ית הָ/אֱלֹהִ֔ים וּ/לְ/אֹֽצְר֖וֹת הַ/קֳּדָשִֽׁים
verses.translit: vhlvym 'chyh 'l 'vtsrvt byt h'lhym vl'tsrvt hqdshym
verses.translation: And of the Levites, Ahijah was over the treasures of the house of God, and over the treasures of the dedicated things.

verses.original: בְּנֵ֣י לַ֠עְדָּן בְּנֵ֨י הַ/גֵּרְשֻׁנִּ֜י לְ/לַעְדָּ֗ן רָאשֵׁ֧י הָ/אָב֛וֹת לְ/לַעְדָּ֥ן הַ/גֵּרְשֻׁנִּ֖י יְחִיאֵלִֽי
verses.translit: bny l'dn bny hgrshny ll'dn r'shy h'bvt ll'dn hgrshny ychy'ly
verses.translation: As concerning the sons of Laadan; the sons of the Gershonite Laadan, chief fathers, even of Laadan the Gershonite, were Jehieli.

verses.original: בְּנֵ֖י יְחִֽיאֵלִ֑י זֵתָם֙ וְ/יוֹאֵ֣ל אָחִ֔י/ו עַל אֹצְר֖וֹת בֵּ֥ית יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: bny ychy'ly ztm vyv'l 'chyv 'l 'tsrvt byt yhvh
verses.translation: The sons of Jehieli; Zetham, and Joel his brother, which were over the treasures of the house of the LORD .

verses.original: לַֽ/עַמְרָמִי֙ לַ/יִּצְהָרִ֔י לַֽ/חֶבְרוֹנִ֖י לָֽ/עָזִּיאֵלִֽי
verses.translit: l'mrmy lytshry lchbrvny l'zy'ly
verses.translation: Of the Amramites, and the Izharites, the Hebronites, and the Uzzielites:

verses.original: וּ/שְׁבֻאֵל֙ בֶּן גֵּרְשׁ֣וֹם בֶּן מֹשֶׁ֔ה נָגִ֖יד עַל הָ/אֹצָרֽוֹת
verses.translit: vshb'l bn grshvm bn mshh ngyd 'l h'tsrvt
verses.translation: And Shebuel the son of Gershom, the son of Moses, was ruler of the treasures.

verses.original: וְ/אֶחָ֖י/ו לֶֽ/אֱלִיעֶ֑זֶר רְחַבְיָ֨הוּ בְנ֜/וֹ וִֽ/ישַׁעְיָ֤הוּ בְנ/וֹ֙ וְ/יֹרָ֣ם בְּנ֔/וֹ וְ/זִכְרִ֥י בְנ֖/וֹ ו/שלמות וּ/שְׁלֹמִ֥ית בְּנֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: v'chyv l'ly'zr rchbyhv bnv vysh'yhv bnv vyrm bnv vzkhry bnv vshlmvt vshlmyt bnv
verses.translation: And his brethren by Eliezer; Rehabiah his son, and Jeshaiah his son, and Joram his son, and Zichri his son, and Shelomith his son.

verses.original: ה֧וּא שְׁלֹמ֣וֹת וְ/אֶחָ֗י/ו עַ֣ל כָּל אֹצְר֤וֹת הַ/קֳּדָשִׁים֙ אֲשֶׁ֨ר הִקְדִּ֜ישׁ דָּוִ֣יד הַ/מֶּ֗לֶךְ וְ/רָאשֵׁ֧י הָ/אָב֛וֹת לְ/שָׂרֵֽי הָ/אֲלָפִ֥ים וְ/הַ/מֵּא֖וֹת וְ/שָׂרֵ֥י הַ/צָּבָֽא
verses.translit: hv' shlmvt v'chyv 'l khl 'tsrvt hqdshym 'shr hqdysh dvyd hmlkh vr'shy h'bvt lshry h'lpym vhm'vt vshry htsb'
verses.translation: Which Shelomith and his brethren were over all the treasures of the dedicated things, which David the king, and the chief fathers, the captains over thousands and hundreds, and the captains of the host, had dedicated.

verses.original: מִן הַ/מִּלְחָמ֥וֹת וּ/מִן הַ/שָּׁלָ֖ל הִקְדִּ֑ישׁוּ לְ/חַזֵּ֖ק לְ/בֵ֥ית יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: mn hmlchmvt vmn hshll hqdyshv lchzq lbyt yhvh
verses.translation: Out of the spoils won in battles did they dedicate to maintain the house of the LORD .

verses.original: וְ/כֹ֨ל הַֽ/הִקְדִּ֜ישׁ שְׁמוּאֵ֤ל הָ/רֹאֶה֙ וְ/שָׁא֣וּל בֶּן קִ֔ישׁ וְ/אַבְנֵ֣ר בֶּן נֵ֔ר וְ/יוֹאָ֖ב בֶּן צְרוּיָ֑ה כֹּ֚ל הַ/מַּקְדִּ֔ישׁ עַ֥ל יַד שְׁלֹמִ֖ית וְ/אֶחָֽי/ו
verses.translit: vkhl hhqdysh shmv'l hr'h vsh'vl bn qysh v'bnr bn nr vyv'b bn tsrvyh khl hmqdysh 'l yd shlmyt v'chyv
verses.translation: And all that Samuel the seer, and Saul the son of Kish, and Abner the son of Ner, and Joab the son of Zeruiah, had dedicated; and whosoever had dedicated any thing, it was under the hand of Shelomith, and of his brethren.

verses.original: לַ/יִּצְהָרִ֞י כְּנַנְיָ֣הוּ וּ/בָנָ֗י/ו לַ/מְּלָאכָ֤ה הַ/חִֽיצוֹנָה֙ עַל יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל לְ/שֹׁטְרִ֖ים וּ/לְ/שֹׁפְטִֽים
verses.translit: lytshry khnnyhv vbnyv lml'khh hchytsvnh 'l yshr'l lshtrym vlshptym
verses.translation: Of the Izharites, Chenaniah and his sons were for the outward business over Israel, for officers and judges.

verses.original: לַֽ/חֶבְרוֹנִ֡י חֲשַׁבְיָהוּ֩ וְ/אֶחָ֨י/ו בְּנֵי חַ֜יִל אֶ֣לֶף וּ/שְׁבַע מֵא֗וֹת עַ֚ל פְּקֻדַּ֣ת יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל מֵ/עֵ֥בֶר לַ/יַּרְדֵּ֖ן מַעְרָ֑בָ/ה לְ/כֹל֙ מְלֶ֣אכֶת יְהוָ֔ה וְ/לַ/עֲבֹדַ֖ת הַ/מֶּֽלֶךְ
verses.translit: lchbrvny chshbyhv v'chyv bny chyl 'lf vshb' m'vt 'l pqdt yshr'l m'br lyrdn m'rbh lkhl ml'kht yhvh vl'bdt hmlkh
verses.translation: And of the Hebronites, Hashabiah and his brethren, men of valour, a thousand and seven hundred, were officers among them of Israel on this side Jordan westward in all the business of the LORD , and in the service of the king.

verses.original: לַֽ/חֶבְרוֹנִי֙ יְרִיָּ֣ה הָ/רֹ֔אשׁ לַֽ/חֶבְרוֹנִ֥י לְ/תֹלְדֹתָ֖י/ו לְ/אָב֑וֹת בִּ/שְׁנַ֨ת הָֽ/אַרְבָּעִ֜ים לְ/מַלְכ֤וּת דָּוִיד֙ נִדְרָ֔שׁוּ וַ/יִּמָּצֵ֥א בָ/הֶ֛ם גִּבּ֥וֹרֵי חַ֖יִל בְּ/יַעְזֵ֥יר גִּלְעָֽד
verses.translit: lchbrvny yryh hr'sh lchbrvny ltldtyv l'bvt bshnt h'rb'ym lmlkhvt dvyd ndrshv vymts' bhm gbvry chyl by'zyr gl'd
verses.translation: Among the Hebronites was Jerijah the chief, even among the Hebronites, according to the generations of his fathers. In the fortieth year of the reign of David they were sought for, and there were found among them mighty men of valour at Jazer of Gilead.

verses.original: וְ/אֶחָ֣י/ו בְּנֵי חַ֗יִל אַלְפַּ֛יִם וּ/שְׁבַ֥ע מֵא֖וֹת רָאשֵׁ֣י הָ/אָב֑וֹת וַ/יַּפְקִידֵ֞/ם דָּוִ֣יד הַ/מֶּ֗לֶךְ עַל הָ/ראוּבֵנִ֤י וְ/הַ/גָּדִי֙ וַ/חֲצִי֙ שֵׁ֣בֶט הַֽ/מְנַשִּׁ֔י לְ/כָל דְּבַ֥ר הָ/אֱלֹהִ֖ים וּ/דְבַ֥ר הַ/מֶּֽלֶךְ
verses.translit: v'chyv bny chyl 'lpym vshb' m'vt r'shy h'bvt vypqydm dvyd hmlkh 'l hr'vbny vhgdy vchtsy shbt hmnshy lkhl dbr h'lhym vdbr hmlkh
verses.translation: And his brethren, men of valour, were two thousand and seven hundred chief fathers, whom king David made rulers over the Reubenites, the Gadites, and the half tribe of Manasseh, for every matter pertaining to God, and affairs of the king.

verses.original: וּ/בְנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֣ל לְֽ/מִסְפָּרָ֡/ם רָאשֵׁ֣י הָ/אָב֣וֹת וְ/שָׂרֵ֣י הָֽ/אֲלָפִ֣ים וְ/הַ/מֵּא֡וֹת וְ/שֹׁטְרֵי/הֶם֩ הַ/מְשָׁרְתִ֨ים אֶת הַ/מֶּ֜לֶךְ לְ/כֹ֣ל דְּבַ֣ר הַֽ/מַּחְלְק֗וֹת הַ/בָּאָ֤ה וְ/הַ/יֹּצֵאת֙ חֹ֣דֶשׁ בְּ/חֹ֔דֶשׁ לְ/כֹ֖ל חָדְשֵׁ֣י הַ/שָּׁנָ֑ה הַֽ/מַּחֲלֹ֨קֶת֙ הָֽ/אַחַ֔ת עֶשְׂרִ֥ים וְ/אַרְבָּעָ֖ה אָֽלֶף
verses.translit: vbny yshr'l lmsprm r'shy h'bvt vshry h'lpym vhm'vt vshtryhm hmshrtym 't hmlkh lkhl dbr hmchlqvt hb'h vhyts't chdsh bchdsh lkhl chdshy hshnh hmchlqt h'cht 'shrym v'rb'h 'lf
verses.translation: Now the children of Israel after their number, to wit , the chief fathers and captains of thousands and hundreds, and their officers that served the king in any matter of the courses, which came in and went out month by month throughout all the months of the year, of every course were twenty and four thousand.

verses.original: עַ֞ל הַ/מַּחֲלֹ֤קֶת הָ/רִֽאשׁוֹנָה֙ לַ/חֹ֣דֶשׁ הָ/רִאשׁ֔וֹן יָֽשָׁבְעָ֖ם בֶּן זַבְדִּיאֵ֑ל וְ/עַל֙ מַֽחֲלֻקְתּ֔/וֹ עֶשְׂרִ֥ים וְ/אַרְבָּעָ֖ה אָֽלֶף
verses.translit: 'l hmchlqt hr'shvnh lchdsh hr'shvn yshb'm bn zbdy'l v'l mchlqtv 'shrym v'rb'h 'lf
verses.translation: Over the first course for the first month was Jashobeam the son of Zabdiel: and in his course were twenty and four thousand.

verses.original: מִן בְּנֵי פֶ֗רֶץ הָ/רֹ֛אשׁ לְ/כָל שָׂרֵ֥י הַ/צְּבָא֖וֹת לַ/חֹ֥דֶשׁ הָ/רִאשֽׁוֹן
verses.translit: mn bny prts hr'sh lkhl shry htsb'vt lchdsh hr'shvn
verses.translation: Of the children of Perez was the chief of all the captains of the host for the first month.

verses.original: וְ/עַ֞ל מַחֲלֹ֣קֶת הַ/חֹ֣דֶשׁ הַ/שֵּׁנִ֗י דּוֹדַ֤י הָ/אֲחוֹחִי֙ וּ/מַ֣חֲלֻקְתּ֔/וֹ וּ/מִקְל֖וֹת הַ/נָּגִ֑יד וְ/עַל֙ מַחֲלֻקְתּ֔/וֹ עֶשְׂרִ֥ים וְ/אַרְבָּעָ֖ה אָֽלֶף
verses.translit: v'l mchlqt hchdsh hshny dvdy h'chvchy vmchlqtv vmqlvt hngyd v'l mchlqtv 'shrym v'rb'h 'lf
verses.translation: And over the course of the second month was Dodai an Ahohite, and of his course was Mikloth also the ruler: in his course likewise were twenty and four thousand.

verses.original: שַׂ֣ר הַ/צָּבָ֤א הַ/שְּׁלִישִׁי֙ לַ/חֹ֣דֶשׁ הַ/שְּׁלִישִׁ֔י בְּנָיָ֧הוּ בֶן יְהוֹיָדָ֛ע הַ/כֹּהֵ֖ן רֹ֑אשׁ וְ/עַל֙ מַחֲלֻקְתּ֔/וֹ עֶשְׂרִ֥ים וְ/אַרְבָּעָ֖ה אָֽלֶף
verses.translit: shr htsb' hshlyshy lchdsh hshlyshy bnyhv bn yhvyd' hkhhn r'sh v'l mchlqtv 'shrym v'rb'h 'lf
verses.translation: The third captain of the host for the third month was Benaiah the son of Jehoiada, a chief priest: and in his course were twenty and four thousand.

verses.original: ה֧וּא בְנָיָ֛הוּ גִּבּ֥וֹר הַ/שְּׁלֹשִׁ֖ים וְ/עַל הַ/שְּׁלֹשִׁ֑ים וּ/מַ֣חֲלֻקְתּ֔/וֹ עַמִּיזָבָ֖ד בְּנֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: hv' bnyhv gbvr hshlshym v'l hshlshym vmchlqtv 'myzbd bnv
verses.translation: This is that Benaiah, who was mighty among the thirty, and above the thirty: and in his course was Ammizabad his son.

verses.original: הָֽ/רְבִיעִ֞י לַ/חֹ֣דֶשׁ הָ/רְבִיעִ֗י עֲשָׂה אֵל֙ אֲחִ֣י יוֹאָ֔ב וּ/זְבַדְיָ֥ה בְנ֖/וֹ אַחֲרָ֑י/ו וְ/עַל֙ מַחֲלֻקְתּ֔/וֹ עֶשְׂרִ֥ים וְ/אַרְבָּעָ֖ה אָֽלֶף
verses.translit: hrby'y lchdsh hrby'y 'shh 'l 'chy yv'b vzbdyh bnv 'chryv v'l mchlqtv 'shrym v'rb'h 'lf
verses.translation: The fourth captain for the fourth month was Asahel the brother of Joab, and Zebadiah his son after him: and in his course were twenty and four thousand.

verses.original: הַ/חַמִישִׁי֙ לַ/חֹ֣דֶשׁ הַ/חֲמִישִׁ֔י הַ/שַּׂ֖ר שַׁמְה֣וּת הַ/יִּזְרָ֑ח וְ/עַל֙ מַחֲלֻקְתּ֔/וֹ עֶשְׂרִ֥ים וְ/אַרְבָּעָ֖ה אָֽלֶף
verses.translit: hchmyshy lchdsh hchmyshy hshr shmhvt hyzrch v'l mchlqtv 'shrym v'rb'h 'lf
verses.translation: The fifth captain for the fifth month was Shamhuth the Izrahite: and in his course were twenty and four thousand.

verses.original: הַ/שִּׁשִּׁי֙ לַ/חֹ֣דֶשׁ הַ/שִּׁשִּׁ֔י עִירָ֥א בֶן עִקֵּ֖שׁ הַ/תְּקוֹעִ֑י וְ/עַל֙ מַחֲלֻקְתּ֔/וֹ עֶשְׂרִ֥ים וְ/אַרְבָּעָ֖ה אָֽלֶף
verses.translit: hshshy lchdsh hshshy 'yr' bn 'qsh htqv'y v'l mchlqtv 'shrym v'rb'h 'lf
verses.translation: The sixth captain for the sixth month was Ira the son of Ikkesh the Tekoite: and in his course were twenty and four thousand.

verses.original: הַ/שְּׁבִיעִי֙ לַ/חֹ֣דֶשׁ הַ/שְּׁבִיעִ֔י חֶ֥לֶץ הַ/פְּלוֹנִ֖י מִן בְּנֵ֣י אֶפְרָ֑יִם וְ/עַל֙ מַחֲלֻקְתּ֔/וֹ עֶשְׂרִ֥ים וְ/אַרְבָּעָ֖ה אָֽלֶף
verses.translit: hshby'y lchdsh hshby'y chlts hplvny mn bny 'prym v'l mchlqtv 'shrym v'rb'h 'lf
verses.translation: The seventh captain for the seventh month was Helez the Pelonite, of the children of Ephraim: and in his course were twenty and four thousand.

verses.original: הַ/שְּׁמִינִי֙ לַ/חֹ֣דֶשׁ הַ/שְּׁמִינִ֔י סִבְּכַ֥י הַ/חֻשָׁתִ֖י לַ/זַּרְחִ֑י וְ/עַל֙ מַחֲלֻקְתּ֔/וֹ עֶשְׂרִ֥ים וְ/אַרְבָּעָ֖ה אָֽלֶף
verses.translit: hshmyny lchdsh hshmyny sbkhy hchshty lzrchy v'l mchlqtv 'shrym v'rb'h 'lf
verses.translation: The eighth captain for the eighth month was Sibbecai the Hushathite, of the Zarhites: and in his course were twenty and four thousand.

verses.original: הַ/תְּשִׁיעִי֙ לַ/חֹ֣דֶשׁ הַ/תְּשִׁיעִ֔י אֲבִיעֶ֥זֶר הָ/עַנְּתֹתִ֖י ל/בנימיני לַ/בֵּ֣ן יְמִינִ֑י וְ/עַל֙ מַחֲלֻקְתּ֔/וֹ עֶשְׂרִ֥ים וְ/אַרְבָּעָ֖ה אָֽלֶף
verses.translit: htshy'y lchdsh htshy'y 'by'zr h'ntty lbnymyny lbn ymyny v'l mchlqtv 'shrym v'rb'h 'lf
verses.translation: The ninth captain for the ninth month was Abi-ezer the Anetothite, of the Benjamites: and in his course were twenty and four thousand.

verses.original: הָ/עֲשִׂירִי֙ לַ/חֹ֣דֶשׁ הָ/עֲשִׂירִ֔י מַהְרַ֥י הַ/נְּטֽוֹפָתִ֖י לַ/זַּרְחִ֑י וְ/עַל֙ מַֽחֲלֻקְתּ֔/וֹ עֶשְׂרִ֥ים וְ/אַרְבָּעָ֖ה אָֽלֶף
verses.translit: h'shyry lchdsh h'shyry mhry hntvpty lzrchy v'l mchlqtv 'shrym v'rb'h 'lf
verses.translation: The tenth captain for the tenth month was Maharai the Netophathite, of the Zarhites: and in his course were twenty and four thousand.

verses.original: עַשְׁתֵּֽי עָשָׂר֙ לְ/עַשְׁתֵּ֣י עָשָׂ֣ר הַ/חֹ֔דֶשׁ בְּנָיָ֥ה הַ/פִּרְעָתוֹנִ֖י מִן בְּנֵ֣י אֶפְרָ֑יִם וְ/עַל֙ מַחֲלֻקְתּ֔/וֹ עֶשְׂרִ֥ים וְ/אַרְבָּעָ֖ה אָֽלֶף
verses.translit: 'shty 'shr l'shty 'shr hchdsh bnyh hpr'tvny mn bny 'prym v'l mchlqtv 'shrym v'rb'h 'lf
verses.translation: The eleventh captain for the eleventh month was Benaiah the Pirathonite, of the children of Ephraim: and in his course were twenty and four thousand.

verses.original: הַ/שְּׁנֵ֤ים עָשָׂר֙ לִ/שְׁנֵ֣ים עָשָׂ֣ר הַ/חֹ֔דֶשׁ חֶלְדַּ֥י הַ/נְּטוֹפָתִ֖י לְ/עָתְנִיאֵ֑ל וְ/עַל֙ מַחֲלֻקְתּ֔/וֹ עֶשְׂרִ֥ים וְ/אַרְבָּעָ֖ה אָֽלֶף
verses.translit: hshnym 'shr lshnym 'shr hchdsh chldy hntvpty l'tny'l v'l mchlqtv 'shrym v'rb'h 'lf
verses.translation: The twelfth captain for the twelfth month was Heldai the Netophathite, of Othniel: and in his course were twenty and four thousand.

verses.original: וְ/עַל֙ שִׁבְטֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל לָ/רֽאוּבֵנִ֣י נָגִ֔יד אֱלִיעֶ֖זֶר בֶּן זִכְרִ֑י לַ/שִּׁ֨מְעוֹנִ֔י שְׁפַטְיָ֖הוּ בֶּֽן מַעֲכָֽה
verses.translit: v'l shbty yshr'l lr'vbny ngyd 'ly'zr bn zkhry lshm'vny shptyhv bn m'khh
verses.translation: Furthermore over the tribes of Israel: the ruler of the Reubenites was Eliezer the son of Zichri: of the Simeonites, Shephatiah the son of Maachah:

verses.original: לְ/לֵוִ֛י חֲשַׁבְיָ֥ה בֶן קְמוּאֵ֖ל לְ/אַהֲרֹ֥ן צָדֽוֹק
verses.translit: llvy chshbyh bn qmv'l l'hrn tsdvq
verses.translation: Of the Levites, Hashabiah the son of Kemuel: of the Aaronites, Zadok:

verses.original: לִֽ/יהוּדָ֕ה אֱלִיה֖וּ מֵ/אֲחֵ֣י דָוִ֑יד לְ/יִ֨שָׂשכָ֔ר עָמְרִ֖י בֶּן מִיכָאֵֽל
verses.translit: lyhvdh 'lyhv m'chy dvyd lyshshkhr 'mry bn mykh'l
verses.translation: Of Judah, Elihu, one of the brethren of David: of Issachar, Omri the son of Michael:

verses.original: לִ/זְבוּלֻ֕ן יִֽשְׁמַֽעְיָ֖הוּ בֶּן עֹבַדְיָ֑הוּ לְ/נַ֨פְתָּלִ֔י יְרִימ֖וֹת בֶּן עַזְרִיאֵֽל
verses.translit: lzbvln yshm'yhv bn 'bdyhv lnptly yrymvt bn 'zry'l
verses.translation: Of Zebulun, Ishmaiah the son of Obadiah: of Naphtali, Jerimoth the son of Azriel:

verses.original: לִ/בְנֵ֣י אֶפְרַ֔יִם הוֹשֵׁ֖עַ בֶּן עֲזַזְיָ֑הוּ לַ/חֲצִי֙ שֵׁ֣בֶט מְנַשֶּׁ֔ה יוֹאֵ֖ל בֶּן פְּדָיָֽהוּ
verses.translit: lbny 'prym hvsh' bn 'zzyhv lchtsy shbt mnshh yv'l bn pdyhv
verses.translation: Of the children of Ephraim, Hoshea the son of Azaziah: of the half tribe of Manasseh, Joel the son of Pedaiah:

verses.original: לַ/חֲצִ֤י הַֽ/מְנַשֶּׁה֙ גִּלְעָ֔דָ/ה יִדּ֖וֹ בֶּן זְכַרְיָ֑הוּ לְ/בִנְיָמִ֔ן יַעֲשִׂיאֵ֖ל בֶּן אַבְנֵֽר
verses.translit: lchtsy hmnshh gl'dh ydv bn zkhryhv lbnymn y'shy'l bn 'bnr
verses.translation: Of the half tribe of Manasseh in Gilead, Iddo the son of Zechariah: of Benjamin, Jaasiel the son of Abner:

verses.original: לְ/דָ֕ן עֲזַרְאֵ֖ל בֶּן יְרֹחָ֑ם אֵ֕לֶּה שָׂרֵ֖י שִׁבְטֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל
verses.translit: ldn 'zr'l bn yrchm 'lh shry shbty yshr'l
verses.translation: Of Dan, Azareel the son of Jeroham. These were the princes of the tribes of Israel.

verses.original: וְ/לֹא נָשָׂ֤א דָוִיד֙ מִסְפָּרָ֔/ם לְ/מִ/בֶּ֛ן עֶשְׂרִ֥ים שָׁנָ֖ה וּ/לְ/מָ֑טָּה כִּ֚י אָמַ֣ר יְהוָ֔ה לְ/הַרְבּ֥וֹת אֶת יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל כְּ/כוֹכְבֵ֥י הַ/שָּׁמָֽיִם
verses.translit: vl' nsh' dvyd msprm lmbn 'shrym shnh vlmth khy 'mr yhvh lhrbvt 't yshr'l khkhvkhby hshmym
verses.translation: But David took not the number of them from twenty years old and under: because the LORD had said he would increase Israel like to the stars of the heavens.

verses.original: יוֹאָ֨ב בֶּן צְרוּיָ֜ה הֵחֵ֤ל לִ/מְנוֹת֙ וְ/לֹ֣א כִלָּ֔ה וַ/יְהִ֥י בָ/זֹ֛את קֶ֖צֶף עַל יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וְ/לֹ֤א עָלָה֙ הַ/מִּסְפָּ֔ר בְּ/מִסְפַּ֥ר דִּבְרֵֽי הַ/יָּמִ֖ים לַ/מֶּ֥לֶךְ דָּוִֽיד
verses.translit: yv'b bn tsrvyh hchl lmnvt vl' khlh vyhy bz't qtsf 'l yshr'l vl' 'lh hmspr bmspr dbry hymym lmlkh dvyd
verses.translation: Joab the son of Zeruiah began to number, but he finished not, because there fell wrath for it against Israel; neither was the number put in the account of the chronicles of king David.

verses.original: וְ/עַל֙ אֹצְר֣וֹת הַ/מֶּ֔לֶךְ עַזְמָ֖וֶת בֶּן עֲדִיאֵ֑ל וְ/עַ֣ל הָֽ/אֹצָר֡וֹת בַּ/שָּׂדֶ֞ה בֶּ/עָרִ֤ים וּ/בַ/כְּפָרִים֙ וּ/בַ/מִּגְדָּל֔וֹת יְהוֹנָתָ֖ן בֶּן עֻזִּיָּֽהוּ
verses.translit: v'l 'tsrvt hmlkh 'zmvt bn 'dy'l v'l h'tsrvt bshdh b'rym vbkhprym vbmgdlvt yhvntn bn 'zyhv
verses.translation: And over the king’s treasures was Azmaveth the son of Adiel: and over the storehouses in the fields, in the cities, and in the villages, and in the castles, was Jehonathan the son of Uzziah:

verses.original: וְ/עַ֗ל עֹשֵׂי֙ מְלֶ֣אכֶת הַ/שָּׂדֶ֔ה לַ/עֲבֹדַ֖ת הָ/אֲדָמָ֑ה עֶזְרִ֖י בֶּן כְּלֽוּב
verses.translit: v'l 'shy ml'kht hshdh l'bdt h'dmh 'zry bn khlvb
verses.translation: And over them that did the work of the field for tillage of the ground was Ezri the son of Chelub:

verses.original: וְ/עַל הַ֨/כְּרָמִ֔ים שִׁמְעִ֖י הָ/רָֽמָתִ֑י וְ/עַ֤ל שֶׁ/בַּ/כְּרָמִים֙ לְ/אֹצְר֣וֹת הַ/יַּ֔יִן זַבְדִּ֖י הַ/שִּׁפְמִֽי
verses.translit: v'l hkhrmym shm'y hrmty v'l shbkhrmym l'tsrvt hyyn zbdy hshpmy
verses.translation: And over the vineyards was Shimei the Ramathite: over the increase of the vineyards for the wine cellars was Zabdi the Shiphmite:

verses.original: וְ/עַל הַ/זֵּיתִ֤ים וְ/הַ/שִּׁקְמִים֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר בַּ/שְּׁפֵלָ֔ה בַּ֥עַל חָנָ֖ן הַ/גְּדֵרִ֑י וְ/עַל אֹצְר֥וֹת הַ/שֶּׁ֖מֶן יוֹעָֽשׁ
verses.translit: v'l hzytym vhshqmym 'shr bshplh b'l chnn hgdry v'l 'tsrvt hshmn yv'sh
verses.translation: And over the olive trees and the sycomore trees that were in the low plains was Baal-hanan the Gederite: and over the cellars of oil was Joash:

verses.original: וְ/עַל הַ/בָּקָר֙ הָ/רֹעִ֣ים בַּ/שָּׁר֔וֹן שטרי שִׁרְטַ֖י הַ/שָּׁרוֹנִ֑י וְ/עַל הַ/בָּקָר֙ בָּֽ/עֲמָקִ֔ים שָׁפָ֖ט בֶּן עַדְלָֽי
verses.translit: v'l hbqr hr'ym bshrvn shtry shrty hshrvny v'l hbqr b'mqym shpt bn 'dly
verses.translation: And over the herds that fed in Sharon was Shitrai the Sharonite: and over the herds that were in the valleys was Shaphat the son of Adlai:

verses.original: וְ/עַל הַ֨/גְּמַלִּ֔ים אוֹבִ֖יל הַ/יִּשְׁמְעֵלִ֑י וְ/עַל הָ֣/אֲתֹנ֔וֹת יֶחְדְּיָ֖הוּ הַ/מֵּרֹנֹתִֽי
verses.translit: v'l hgmlym 'vbyl hyshm'ly v'l h'tnvt ychdyhv hmrnty
verses.translation: Over the camels also was Obil the Ishmaelite: and over the asses was Jehdeiah the Meronothite:

verses.original: וְ/עַל הַ/צֹּ֖אן יָזִ֣יז הַֽ/הַגְרִ֑י כָּל אֵ֨לֶּה֙ שָׂרֵ֣י הָ/רְכ֔וּשׁ אֲשֶׁ֖ר לַ/מֶּ֥לֶךְ דָּוִֽיד
verses.translit: v'l hts'n yzyz hhgry khl 'lh shry hrkhvsh 'shr lmlkh dvyd
verses.translation: And over the flocks was Jaziz the Hagerite. All these were the rulers of the substance which was king David’s.

verses.original: וִֽ/יהוֹנָתָ֤ן דּוֹד דָּוִיד֙ יוֹעֵ֔ץ אִישׁ מֵבִ֥ין וְ/סוֹפֵ֖ר ה֑וּא וִֽ/יחִיאֵ֥ל בֶּן חַכְמוֹנִ֖י עִם בְּנֵ֥י הַ/מֶּֽלֶךְ
verses.translit: vyhvntn dvd dvyd yv'ts 'ysh mbyn vsvpr hv' vychy'l bn chkhmvny 'm bny hmlkh
verses.translation: Also Jonathan David’s uncle was a counsellor, a wise man, and a scribe: and Jehiel the son of Hachmoni was with the king’s sons:

verses.original: וַ/אֲחִיתֹ֖פֶל יוֹעֵ֣ץ לַ/מֶּ֑לֶךְ וְ/חוּשַׁ֥י הָ/אַרְכִּ֖י רֵ֥עַ הַ/מֶּֽלֶךְ
verses.translit: v'chytpl yv'ts lmlkh vchvshy h'rkhy r' hmlkh
verses.translation: And Ahithophel was the king’s counsellor: and Hushai the Archite was the king’s companion:

verses.original: וְ/אַחֲרֵ֣י אֲחִיתֹ֗פֶל יְהוֹיָדָ֤ע בֶּן בְּנָיָ֨הוּ֙ וְ/אֶבְיָתָ֔ר וְ/שַׂר צָבָ֥א לַ/מֶּ֖לֶךְ יוֹאָֽב
verses.translit: v'chry 'chytpl yhvyd' bn bnyhv v'bytr vshr tsb' lmlkh yv'b
verses.translation: And after Ahithophel was Jehoiada the son of Benaiah, and Abiathar: and the general of the king’s army was Joab.
